name: Warm family breakfast
description: During the New Year holiday, the whole family got up a little later. Yajing cooked Minnan misua paste with ingredients prepared in advance, and fried smiley-faced eggs and sausages. The family of three sat around the dining table exchanging New Year wishes. Yajing gave her daughter Xuanxuan some misua, wishing her a long, safe, and peaceful life. The table was filled with the warmth and hope of the New Year.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Being alone and clear-headed, sorting out her emotions.
description: Her husband Aqiang took their daughter to watch cartoons in the living room. After cleaning up the dishes, Yajing brewed a pot of monk fruit tea and went into the study. She didn't start working immediately. Instead, she opened the window to let the cold air in, looked at the street scene in the direction of Shanggu Street, and took a deep breath, silently mentally preparing for the upcoming quarterly accounting work.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Seeing family off and preparing the store's account settlement
description: Aqiang helped Xuanxuan put on her jacket, took a water bottle and some snacks, and headed out to Bailuzhou Park. Yajing saw them off at the entrance to the residential compound. Back home, she cleaned the living room coffee table, took out her laptop, paper transaction statements, a calculator, colored markers, and a notebook, brewed some monk fruit tea, turned off phone notifications, and formally entered bookkeeper mode, ready to reconcile the quarterly cash flow.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the community entrance

name: Review the quarterly accounts and confirm the decline in sales revenue.
description: Yajing was completely focused, entering the daily revenue from October to December day by day from the Excel spreadsheet on her computer and paper ledgers into the calculator, recording weekly and monthly subtotals. Her brows were knitted tightly, and her fingers pressed the calculator keys rapidly. Two hours later, she reached the final conclusion: the cumulative revenue from October to December had fallen about 16% compared with the same period last year. She cross-checked the purchase costs and fixed expenses and confirmed that the data was correct, not a bookkeeping oversight. The facts right before her eyes made her feel anxious, and then a stubborn refusal to admit defeat surged up.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Simple lunch and a brief rest
description: Aqiang and Xuanxuan had lunch near the park. Yajing used the rice she had scheduled to stir-fry herself a plate of shrimp and mixed-vegetable egg fried rice. While eating, she scrolled through discussions among peers about online transformation, and her feelings were mixed. After the meal, she simply tidied up the table and the kitchen.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Walk to Jiaxing Garden Park for a financial discussion and transformation decision.
description: Yajing walked to Jiaxing Garden Park near her home with a heavy heart. Soon after she sat down on a park bench, Aqiang also arrived at the park with Xuanxuan. After confirming that Xuanxuan was playing by herself in the sandpit, Yajing explained the shop's difficulties to Aqiang. The two analyzed the causes: the shift in online shopping habits, fewer pedestrians on the pedestrian street, and the impact of newly opened discount stores. Aqiang suggested trying a low-cost transformation using short videos and a community group. After weighing the options repeatedly, Yajing finally agreed. The two reached a preliminary consensus, tears glistening in her eyes; her husband's encouragement gave her determination.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanied daughter playing in the park and walked home
description: After the discussion, Yajing adjusted her emotions and watched ants move and swung on a swing with Xuanxuan. Her daughter's laughter relieved the heavy pressure and anxiety. Then the family of three walked home along a quiet path, with Xuanxuan riding her small tricycle in front, and Yajing and Aqiang walking behind chatting. Sunlight filtered through the leaves, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Video-called parents in Quanzhou to send New Year greetings.
description: In the study, Yajing used her phone to make a video call to her parents in Quanzhou. Her father Song Minghui and mother Lin Xiuying greeted her happily on the other end. Yajing mustered her energy to report on Xuanxuan's recent life, showed them the child's drawings, and lied that business at the shop was going smoothly. Her parents' words made her feel supported by her family and gave her a sense of reassurance.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Warm family dinner for three
description: Yajing used frozen pork-and-cabbage dumplings with tomatoes and seaweed to make an improved tomato-seaweed dumpling soup, and also pan-fried golden egg dumplings as a garnish. The family of three had dinner under the warm yellow light. Xuanxuan ate with great relish, and Aqiang, breaking his usual habit, had an extra bowl. The atmosphere at the table became much more relaxed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: The online transformation strategy has officially launched
description: After dinner, A Qiang cleared away the dishes. Yajing played with Xuanxuan for a while, then brought A Qiang into the study. A Qiang moved out a portable whiteboard, opened Douyin, and showed Yajing some local outfit-blogger cases. He wrote a "three-step" strategy on the whiteboard: learn filming techniques, try short videos, and activate the existing community group. Yajing saved the key points in her phone's notes app. The two agreed that Saturday evening would be the time for the first lesson. Although she was terrified of being on camera, seeing her husband's determined gaze made her feel ready.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family game time
description: After the online discussion ended, the family of three played a role-playing game in the living room. Xuanxuan was the doctor treating the stuffed animals, Yajing played the nurse, and Aqiang played the laboratory doctor, using a hair dryer as a fake CT scanner. The room was filled with laughter.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Xuanxuan's wash-up and bedtime story.
description: Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a bath, adding a few drops of lavender essential oil to the bathwater to calm her. After brushing teeth and changing into pajamas, she carried Xuanxuan to bed and read 'Guess How Much I Love You.' After the story, the two hugged each other tightly and said 'I love you' countless times.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Stress eating, processing emotions alone
description: Aqiang went to wash up first, and Yajing sat alone in the dining room, with the determination to make a change and the anxiety of reality battling in her heart. She opened the refrigerator, cut a large piece of tiramisu cake, took out a carton of milk, and wolfed it all down. The cloying cream and slightly bitter cocoa powder did not relieve her anxiety; instead, the guilt of breaking her resolve grew even stronger. After finishing, she let out a self-reproachful sigh.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Contacting suppliers, bedtime preparation, and falling asleep
description: Yajing sent WeChat New Year greetings to Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, and mentioned that after the New Year she wanted to talk about new styles to be featured as online bestsellers. After receiving a reply, she felt somewhat relieved. Then she took a long hot shower, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed, replaying the day's conversations and plans in her mind. With anticipation for the future, nervousness about the unknown, and a faint guilt about her weight, she silently recited a prayer and slowly fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Morning weigh-in and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off right on time. After getting up, she went to the bathroom to wash up, then stepped on the scale. Seeing the number was still 50.0kg, she felt a little guilty when she thought about the piece of tiramisu from last night. She took a deep breath in front of the mirror and wrote in her phone memo: “From today on, control sugar! No sugar in breakfast, and fruit instead of dessert.” Then she quickly put on a light, fresh work makeup look, chose an oatmeal-colored cashmere cardigan with dark straight-leg jeans, simple and energetic.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Nutritious breakfast and a meeting to assign online learning tasks
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Song Yajing had made fried egg toast, hot milk, and a small plate of cut apples. While spreading jam on her daughter Xuanxuan's toast, she discussed the short-video learning plan they had talked about the night before with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. Chen Zhiqiang opened his phone and created a shared memo. They divided the work: he would find beginner tutorials for shooting and editing short videos, and Song Yajing would come up with outfit themes, such as winter outfits for petite women that make them look taller. They agreed to spend an hour learning after closing the shop every day and to focus on hands-on practice on weekends. Xuanxuan also happily said she would be her mother's first audience member.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking her daughter to kindergarten and shopping along the way
description: Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan put on her little backpack and walked hand in hand with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she told Xuanxuan that they would sort out the clothes she had outgrown and give them to children in need. After dropping off her daughter, she didn't go straight home but stopped by the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way, bought a bottle of unsweetened soy milk and two Red Fuji apples as an extra snack for the store today, and silently cheered herself on: "Start by watching what you eat."
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sorting and storing clothes in categories before opening the store.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing went straight to the walk-in closet in the master bedroom and spent nearly an hour sorting all the winter clothes into four categories: "adults often wear," "adults rarely wear," "fits Xuanxuan," and "Xuanxuan has outgrown." She piled them in categories on the bed. She carefully inspected each piece, packed the "rarely worn" and "outgrown" clothes in vacuum compression bags, and took photos to document them. She planned to schedule an old-clothes recycling pickup, both to free up space and to help the environment.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street, No. 82 residential compound, home, master bedroom walk-in closet

name: Commuting and booking used-clothing recycling
description: Song Yajing carried two compressed bags of clothes downstairs, put them in the trunk, and then drove to the store on Zhongshan Road. As soon as she started the car, she opened the “White Whale Fish” mini program on Alipay, filled in an order to schedule old clothes recycling for tomorrow afternoon, with the address as the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road. After submitting successfully, she felt a sense of relief. There was not much traffic on the road. She arrived at Zhongshan Road around 10:20, parked the car, and opened the store door.
location: On the way from the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the store and planning short-video content
description: After entering the store, Song Yajing put on her work apron and started the day's work. She first dressed the window mannequin in the newly arrived caramel-colored double-faced wool coat, accessorizing with an off-white scarf and faux maple leaves to create a warm autumn-winter atmosphere. Then she tidied the shelves, placing the most elegant cashmere sweaters in the most prominent positions. There were few customers in the morning, so she sat behind the cash register and used her phone memo to brainstorm short video script ideas, writing down initial one-piece-multiple-looks concepts such as 'coat + wide-leg pants = office commuting style' and 'coat + floral skirt + boots = romantic date style,' preparing for an evening discussion with her husband.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Light lunch and blood sugar control practice
description: After part-time staff member Xiaomei came in for her shift, Song Yajing asked her to help order takeout, specifically ordering a Caesar salad with dressing on the side. She took out the apple she had bought in the morning and placed it next to Xiaomei's lunch. The two sat on the fitting bench in the shop and quickly finished lunch. Eating the refreshing salad and the crisp, sweet apple, she thought this was much more guilt-free than eating cake. She even felt lighter, and the first day of her sugar-control plan went smoothly.
location: In the rest area inside Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business peak and customer maintenance.
description: The store gradually became busy in the afternoon. Song Yajing and Xiaomei warmly received customers, recommending outfits, getting sizes, and answering questions. Vivian, a regular customer, came to the store, and Song Yajing chatted with her about the orange chiffon cake recipe they had mentioned last time. Afterward, she also found time to send WeChat New Year greetings to her Guangzhou supplier Susan and agreed to contact her after the Lantern Festival to look at spring new arrivals. The whole afternoon passed in busy work, balancing sales with customer relationship maintenance.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Checkout and bank deposit
description: As the pre-closing rush hour approached, Song Yajing had Xiaomei watch the store while she counted the day's revenue. The cash and mobile payment records were considerable. She took the money and drove to the Qianpu ICBC branch, deposited the cash and part of the online income into the store's corporate account, and felt much more relieved after getting the receipt.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up shop after work and preparing to pick up the child
description: Song Yajing returned from the bank to the store and did the final tidy-up with Xiaomei: sweeping the floor, tidying the fitting room, and turning off some of the lights. Seeing it was already 17:40, she told Xiaomei to pull down the rolling shutter, then hurried to drive to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. On the way, she sent her husband a voice message saying she planned to make dumpling soup with tomato and seaweed for dinner and would be home soon.
location: On the way from Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Arrived at the kindergarten gate on time. Xuanxuan was looking around with her little backpack on, and as soon as she saw her mother, she rushed into her arms. Song Yajing took her little hand and walked back, asking what she had learned today. Xuanxuan excitedly said they had painted winter trees, and the teacher praised her for drawing the most realistically. Song Yajing happily complimented her.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing a simple dinner and working together as a family.
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already watching cartoons with Xuanxuan. Song Yajing tied on an apron and deftly boiled water, added frozen dumplings, cut tomatoes, and washed greens. She quickly made tomato and seaweed soup dumplings and blanched greens. Chen Zhiqiang poured aromatic vinegar for everyone, and the family sat around the table eating and chatting about interesting things.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family games and bedtime rituals
description: After the meal, Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes, while Song Yajing played a role-playing game of 'running a clothing store' with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan acted as the store manager and 'matched' clothes just like her mother. At 8 p.m., Song Yajing began helping Xuanxuan wash up, then told the story of The Little Mermaid. Half an hour later, she watched her daughter fall asleep peacefully.
location: Living room and children's room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal study and work review
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing went into the study and turned on her phone. She first organized the short-video script ideas she had conceived during the day into a document and sent it to the shared memo with her husband. Then she opened several Bilibili tutorial videos that Chen Zhiqiang had shared, carefully watched a "Beginners Mobile Portrait Photography Tutorial" and took notes. She left a message suggesting they start by adjusting the phone settings on Saturday evening.
location: The home study at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recharging and relaxing.
description: Song Yajing returned to the living room, curled up on the soft sofa, and opened Xiaohongshu and Douyin, focusing on Xiamen local outfit bloggers. She studied their camera composition, topic selection, and copywriting, such as "one garment, multiple styling tips," "petite girl height-boosting guide," "how to choose a New Year outfit," and thought about how to shoot similar looks using the clothes in her own store. She felt much clearer and her fear of short videos decreased.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation and heart-to-heart talk between spouses
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. Chen Zhiqiang had also finished his work and turned off the computer. The two leaned against the headboard. Song Yajing told him about the short-video direction she had been thinking about, saying they should start with something basic and easy to pick up, such as 'Three Ways to Wear a Coat.' Chen Zhiqiang agreed, saying it would have the widest audience, and they arranged to finalize the script on Saturday night, after which he would teach her how to use CapCut. Song Yajing proactively took his hand to thank him, and her husband smiled and took her hand back.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Journaling and sound sleep
description: After saying goodnight to each other, Song Yajing set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning and opened the notes app on her phone to write a mood diary: 'January 2, Thursday, sunny. The first day of the sugar-control plan was a complete success! The clothing recycling is booked too. Today I tried coming up with a few short-video directions and felt not as anxious. Although the pressure on revenue remains, following the plan step by step today calmed me down a lot. Goodnight, Xiamen.' After writing, she turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep with a bit of ease and exhaustion.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Got up, washed up, and stood by for duty.
description: The alarm went off on time. Yajing was a little tired because her daughter Xuanxuan had cried and fussed for half an hour last night after a nightmare. After getting up, she found her husband Chen Zhiqiang already in the kitchen preparing a simple breakfast. While washing up quickly, she tidied her hair in front of the mirror, remembered the prayer that had been interrupted while calming the child last night, and silently added in her heart, 'May the Lord bless the new day.' Then she went to the entryway to confirm the two bags of packed old clothes, then went into the kitchen to greet her husband and quietly told him about what happened last night.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing to take my daughter to school.
description: Yajing helped her bleary-eyed daughter Xuanxuan change into her kindergarten uniform, promising to pray together for the teddy bear in the evening and ask God to bless her with a sound sleep. She brought her commuter bag, water bottle, and an old down jacket she planned to donate, and said goodbye to her husband at the gate of the community. In the light rain, Yajing held an umbrella and took Xuanxuan's hand, walking along the familiar route to Siming Experimental Kindergarten.
location: On the way from Community 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten

name: Dropping daughter off at school, shopping, and commuting.

Then she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Remembering her sugar-control plan, she only bought unsweetened oolong tea and a boiled egg as a morning snack. She then took Metro Line 1 from Zhenhai Road Station, got off two stops later at Zhongshan Park Station, and walked with an umbrella to the store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, thinking about the group sharing content along the way.

name: Morning store operations and community engagement

At nearly 9, she sent the carefully edited graphic post 'Three-Step Method for Seasonal Wardrobe Sorting' to the 'Yajing Life Gallery' WeChat group, then organized the newly arrived spring clothing. After 10:30, a customer came in asking about a Chanel-style jacket, and Yajing received her warmly. During this time, she noticed that the organization post had generated enthusiastic responses in the group, with many mothers sharing ideas for upcycling old clothes. While recommending outfits to the customer, she also made time to reply to group members, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.

name: Sugar-controlled lunch and study recharge.

Back in the store, she had her meal while opening Xiaohongshu. Following the idea her husband had given her the night before, she saved several short video tutorials on shooting clothing details with a phone and studied them carefully.

name: Open as usual in the afternoon.

She listened patiently to their needs, successfully sold two knit cardigans and a pleated skirt, and added one of the girls on WeChat. She felt delighted.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Yajing handed over two large bags of old clothes and the down jacket, scanned the code to weigh them, and confirmed the recycling order in the app. Watching the specialist leave, she felt refreshed, having done her part for environmental protection and community mutual aid.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business and account reconciliation
description: In the afternoon, customer flow was steady. Yajing received several regular customers and chatted with them. Near five o'clock, she used the break to open the calculator and ledger on her phone, calculating the day's inventory changes and business turnover. Everything was under control.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went to pick up the child before closing the store.

location: On the way from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten.

name: Picking up from school and going home
description: Xuanxuan had fun at kindergarten and had already forgotten last night's nightmare. As soon as she saw her mother, she chattered away sharing interesting things. description: Yajing opened her diary on her phone and recorded the day's reflections: success in controlling sugar, a small sense of achievement from community interaction, the satisfaction of recycling old clothes, and anticipation for the weekend practice after seeing Aqiang organize the materials. name: Morning family time and health management

location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Had lunch with my husband and discussed the shooting plan.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang appeared at the store entrance on time, carrying the phone tripod he had brought from home. The two walked to the Hong Kong-style tea restaurant inside Zhonghua City. Yajing ordered shrimp wonton noodles and blanched choy sum, while her husband ordered curry beef brisket rice. Over the meal, they discussed the details of the evening shoot. Her husband drew a simple composition sketch in his memo app, and Yajing shared what she had learned that morning; both felt they could shoot well that night. Before leaving, her husband handed the tripod to Yajing.
location: Gangli Restaurant, inside Zhonghua City, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store reception and community interaction
description: After the meal, she returned to the shop, and customer traffic increased. Yajing focused on styling several customers and successfully sold two outfits from the new spring collection, also adding them on WeChat. In a break, she replied in the “Yajing Life House” WeChat group to moms’ practical questions about the seasonal-adjustment categorization method, and teased that she would share a little surprise tonight; the group was lively. In the afternoon, customer traffic was steady. Xiaomei expertly attended to customers, while Yajing sat in the rest area reviewing her morning notes, putting together the evening’s shooting script based on the clothes in the shop. She also messaged her Guangzhou supplier Susan on WeChat to ask about the progress of the new styles, and was delighted to learn that sample photos would be sent next week.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Close the shop early, go home, and prepare the shooting scene.
description: Closed the store early, checked the day's accounts with Xiaomei, then walked home carrying a tripod and three spring outfits selected from the store (a floral print dress, a blazer-and-shorts set, and a knit cardigan) along with matching shoes, bags, and accessories. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she picked up a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea. After arriving home, she moved the living room coffee table aside to clear an open area, took out the tripod, studied the manual, and successfully fixed her phone at chest height. Then she hung the three matching outfits on the floor clothes rack and placed the corresponding shoes and bags below, simulating the store's display.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Learning composition and light-and-shadow techniques
description: Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, returned home, washed up briefly, changed into loungewear, and started a formal teaching session. Using the floor lamp and ceiling light in the living room, he demonstrated through moving and blocking the different visual effects of front light, side light, and side-backlight on the texture of clothing fabrics. Yajing suddenly realized that she had previously ignored the direction of light. Her husband also taught her hands-on how to compose using the rule of thirds with the grid lines on his phone.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Practicing in front of the camera and a simple dinner
description: After the theory came practice. Yajing first changed into a floral-print dress and stood in front of the phone. At first she avoided eye contact and moved awkwardly, but with her husband's constant encouragement and guidance, she repeated the moves five or six times and gradually became natural, completing poses such as standing, slow turns, and putting her hands in her pockets. After practice, the couple had a simple dinner—her husband heated up the pork rib and corn soup made in the morning, and Yajing made a vegetable salad. Over dinner, they confirmed the shooting script details and editing workflow in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shoot the first short video.
description: After the meal, they rested briefly, and the official shoot began. Her husband served as photographer and director while Yajing started changing outfits. Following the practiced moves, she performed smoothly in the side-light position, and her husband shot with his phone's native camera. She filmed 2-3 backup videos for each of the three outfits, and after each one Yajing excitedly reviewed the footage, feeling she had improved noticeably.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video editing and publishing
description: The two sat side by side on the sofa. Her husband opened CapCut, demonstrated how to split and delete unnecessary parts, taught Yajing how to adjust the video speed, and added a beat-synced BGM for a spring outing. At Yajing's request, her husband taught her how to add a store logo watermark. Yajing operated it herself, revising three times until she was satisfied. With her husband's help, she wrote the title "Petite Early Spring Outfit | Nailing the Gentle Style That Adds 5cm!", added hashtags, and finally took a deep breath and uploaded it to Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-publish feedback observation and evening review
description: After posting, Yajing refreshed her phone every few minutes and saw a few likes and a comment saying 'So pretty!' She excitedly called her husband over, and the two had a small celebration. She then shared the video link to the 'Yajing Life Gallery' WeChat group and thanked everyone for their support. After washing up, the two leaned against the headboard to review: the video had over 60 views, 10 likes, and 3 new followers. Chen Zhiqiang affirmed her performance and stressed the importance of persistence. Yajing took out her phone memo and recorded the core takeaways (composition techniques, use of light and shadow, basic editing operations), and wrote down next week's goals: shoot short videos of the store's real scenes with outfit pairings, and learn CapCut's picture-in-picture feature. She also marked every Saturday afternoon through evening on the calendar as 'Video Learning and Creation Time.'
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sleepless from excitement and studying late at night
description: After turning off the lights, Yajing's mind kept replaying the details of the evening's filming. Her body was tired but her mind was excited. She couldn't resist picking up her phone again and spent half an hour scrolling through the works of several top fashion bloggers on Xiaohongshu and Douyin, studying their filter tones and transition methods. She didn't put down the phone until her eyelids were drooping, close to midnight, and then fell into a deep sleep full of hope for the future.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Weighing in after getting up and preparing breakfast.
description: Song Yajing woke up in the morning light and first went to the bathroom to weigh herself. She weighed 50.3 kg, the same as yesterday, so her sugar control was going well. Then she opened the fridge, took out the multigrain porridge and heated it, while toasting two slices of whole wheat bread. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped boil eggs and reminded her that it was windy on Gulangyu today, so she should put an extra jacket on their daughter.
location: Bedroom and kitchen in the apartment at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Woke up her daughter and helped her wash up and get dressed
description: Song Yajing walked into her daughter Chen Lexuan's room, opened the curtains, put a red padded jacket on her, and added a pure cotton undershirt underneath to protect against the sea breeze. She changed into jeans and a beige loose sweater, and put a beige scarf in her bag. She then combed her daughter's hair and tied it into two small ponytails.
location: Daughter's bedroom and bathroom in the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive to the ferry terminal and take a boat to Gulangyu Island.
description: Song Yajing drove with her daughter to the First Pier parking lot, about an 8-minute drive. They took the 8:50 Xiagu resident ferry, which took about 8 minutes, and arrived at Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu. Then they walked about 10 minutes along Lujiao Road to Gulangyu Catholic Church. With the sea breeze blowing, her daughter Chen Lexuan watched the seagulls excitedly.
location: From First Pier, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Sanqiutian Pier, Gulangyu, then walked to the Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District.

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Song Yajing and her daughter sat down in their usual old seats near the front of the church. As the Latin hymn played, her mind gradually calmed. During the prayer, she closed her eyes and devoutly prayed for the store’s transition, her husband’s job, and her daughter’s health, taking in the peace of the church and the play of light through the stained glass. Her daughter was very well-behaved today and crossed herself as well.
location: Main hall of Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Communicated with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member
description: After Mass, fellow parishioner Lin Xiuying took Song Yajing's hand in the square outside the church and asked with concern how the shop was doing. Song Yajing admitted that the shop was trying short videos but the numbers were not good. Aunt Lin comforted her to relax and trust that the Lord would make arrangements, and they agreed to have coffee together when they had time. Song Yajing nodded gratefully.
location: Square at the entrance of Gulangyu Catholic Church, 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home
description: After leaving the church, Song Yajing and her daughter walked along Longtou Road to Sanqiutian Pier, took the 11:00 ferry back to First Pier on Xiamen Island. After picking up the car, they drove directly back to the community at 82 Shanggu Street, a total journey of about 25 minutes.
location: From Sanqiutian Wharf on Gulangyu Island to First Wharf, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and finally back to the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District

name: Went home for lunch and shared reflections on the Mass
description: When she got home, the dining table had already been set with rice steamed on a timer by her husband Chen Zhiqiang before he left, along with stir-fried greens and pan-fried hairtail. Song Yajing and her daughter shared their church experiences while eating lunch, such as the priest's sermon on "faith" and Aunt Lin's encouragement. Her daughter also learned to make the sign of the cross, which was very cute.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanying daughter for an afternoon nap and replying to WeChat messages
description: After lunch, her daughter got sleepy. Song Yajing lay in bed with her for a while and read half of "The Little Prince" picture book. After her daughter fell asleep, she went to the living room, opened her phone, posted a church photo in the "Yajing Life Gallery" WeChat group with the caption "Peace on the Lord's Day," and browsed the new likes and comments on yesterday's video.
location: At home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: living room sofa and master bedroom.

name: Family leisure time doing jigsaw puzzles.
description: After their daughter woke from her afternoon nap, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home after finishing overtime and brought out a brand-new "Animal Forest" puzzle. The family of three sat cross-legged on the living room floor. Song Yajing was in charge of finding the border pieces, her husband sorted them by color, and their daughter excitedly looked for animal patterns. The three chatted and laughed, enjoying fully engaged family time, and finally completed an elephant.
location: On the living room floor at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street housing estate, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to the supermarket to shop and share ice cream.
description: After finishing the puzzle, Song Yajing took her daughter to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy daily necessities, purchasing family-size milk and unsweetened oolong tea. Then they bought apples and bananas at a fruit stall at the entrance of the residential complex. In the snack area of the convenience store, her daughter wanted strawberry-flavored ice cream, and Song Yajing bought her a box as a reward. The two sat down in the rest area outside the convenience store to share the ice cream and enjoy a sweet mother-daughter moment. Finally, they walked home.
location: The convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, the rest area by its entrance, and the fruit stall near the residential community, before finally returning to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Prepare and help cook dinner
description: After getting home, Song Yajing put away the groceries and took out the pork ribs for dinner to thaw. In the evening, her husband tied on an apron, ready to show off his cooking skills. She was in charge of washing and cutting tomatoes, broccoli, and other side ingredients, while her husband handled the braised pork ribs and stir-fried broccoli. Their daughter played with building blocks in the living room, occasionally running into the kitchen to “supervise” and sneak a piece of pork rib fresh out of the pan. The aroma of the food filled the kitchen.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and discussion of tomorrow's plans
description: Dinner began, the family of three eating and chatting. Song Yajing mentioned that tomorrow is Monday; after opening the shop she planned to first clean up previously shot video footage, and in the afternoon use her phone to learn the picture-in-picture feature in CapCut, in preparation for next week's live-action shooting. Her husband said he could come to the shop after work to help set up the scene and bring her a cup of her favorite coconut milk latte.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanied her daughter during bath time, read picture books, prayed, and coaxed her to sleep.
description: After dinner, after a short rest, Song Yajing took her daughter to bathe. While washing her hair, they played with the bubbles. After the bath, she changed her into cute pajamas, read her the remainder of The Little Prince, and then told her a Bible story about Noah's Ark. Holding her teddy bear, her daughter gradually closed her eyes and fell asleep to her mother's voice. Song Yajing tucked her in and quietly left the room.
location: Home bathroom and daughter's bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal creation and community interaction
description: Song Yajing brewed a cup of herbal tea, picked up her phone to check the previous day's video, found 3 new likes and 1 comment asking for the store address, and replied immediately. Then, in the besties group 'Old Workplace Trio', she shared photos of today's mother-daughter ice cream and the completed jigsaw puzzle, happily interacting with her friends. Finally, in the 'Yajing Boutique Clothing Store' WeChat group, she posted a message announcing that tomorrow's goal is to learn the picture-in-picture feature in CapCut.
location: Study or living room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Communication with suppliers regarding work.
description: Song Yajing sent a WeChat message to her supplier Susan in Guangzhou, asking whether the sample clothing photos could be sent on Tuesday or Wednesday, as she wanted to do a warm-up for the spring new arrivals. Susan replied quickly that there was no problem and that she would send them next Tuesday afternoon. After confirming, Song Yajing felt relieved.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Learning CapCut's picture-in-picture feature and taking notes
description: Song Yajing sat at her desk, opened the CapCut app, and searched for and studied the 'picture-in-picture' feature tutorial video. While watching, she noted the steps in her phone memos: add picture-in-picture, adjust the size, set the blend mode, and adjust the opacity. She followed the tutorial twice and felt she had improved a lot compared with yesterday.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wash up and do relaxing stretches.
description: After finishing her washing up, Song Yajing applied skincare. Before bed, she did several sets of shoulder and neck stretches on the yoga mat to ease the soreness from long periods of looking down, gradually relaxing both body and mind.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Write a journal, prepare for bed, and wind down for sleep.
description: Song Yajing leaned against the headboard, opened her diary, and wrote down today's feelings: experiencing ultimate peace in the church on Gulangyu Island and feeling completely recharged by family leisure time, she thanked the Lord for all the strength He gave her. She set her alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning. After turning off the light, she closed her eyes and recalled the image of her daughter excitedly watching the sea view on the ferry and the glow of the church's stained glass. With a satisfied smile, she gradually fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, personal care, and breakfast for the whole family.
description: The alarm went off at 7:10. After getting up, Song Yajing weighed herself first: 50.1 kg, showing stable blood sugar control. After washing up, she changed into a casual knit top and pants, went into the kitchen, took out thin noodles and lean meat from the refrigerator, cooked a pot of Minnan misua soup, and fried two sunny-side-up eggs. At around 7:40, she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and helped her put on a fleece-lined undershirt and a kindergarten cartoon hoodie. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came to the table, and the whole family sat together for breakfast. Song Yajing served each person a bowl of misua soup, sprinkled with pepper and chopped scallions, and reminded her husband to put on more clothes as the temperature was dropping.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing wiped her daughter's mouth clean, put on her backpack, and walked hand in hand with her out of the residential complex. They walked about 10 minutes along Zhenhai Road, and on the way her daughter shared a bear story from a picture book. At the kindergarten gate, Song Yajing squatted down, kissed her daughter on the forehead, and watched as the teacher led her into the classroom before leaving.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy a morning drink on the commute
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked 10 minutes to a convenience store near Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and two boiled eggs as an energy supply for the shop. Then she strolled leisurely along Zhenhai Road toward Zhongshan Road, checking out the breakfast stalls on the way.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, convenience store inside Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Arriving at the shop and opening preparations
description: At 8:40, Song Yajing arrived at her Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She skillfully pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights and air conditioner to warm up, then cleaned, wiped the counters and clothing racks, played light music, and began the new day in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store new arrivals, display adjustment, and photography practice
description: At 9 o'clock, part-time shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. The two unpacked the spring clothing packages that had arrived last week, including knit cardigans, floral dresses, and denim jackets. Song Yajing used a steam iron to smooth the clothes, and Xiaomei hung the featured knitwear on a prominent mannequin as instructed. Song Yajing applied the color-matching knowledge she had learned and placed outfits of the same color scheme on adjacent racks, enhancing the sense of layering. After 11:30 a.m., while there were no customers, Song Yajing took out her phone, opened her notes app, reviewed the steps for the picture-in-picture feature, practiced shooting cutaway shots of the pothos in the store, and tried combining the cutaways with handheld shots of the spring clothing display. She got the hang of it and felt more confident about the weekend shoot.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and microlearning
description: At noon, Song Yajing walked five minutes to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City. As usual, she ordered a sugar-free coconut latte and a vegetable salad, and sat by the window. While eating lunch, she opened the CapCut app and repeatedly studied the picture-in-picture feature tutorial, adding key notes to her notebook.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Practicing camera moves and attempting to create finished videos alone
description: After returning to the store, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to look after the front area. She fixed her phone on a tripod in front of the green plants at the back of the store, and used basic camera movements such as push, pull, pan, and track to shoot a preview of the store. The lens swept across the plants and paused on the spring clothing display area. Then, incorporating her noon notes, she combined the footage into a smoother finished video. Though the result was still a bit amateurish, it was much better than in the morning.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Business reception and WeChat customer maintenance
description: In the afternoon, as more customers arrived, Song Yajing put down her phone and greeted them warmly. She recommended a floral dress with a knitted cardigan to a young mother and introduced the advantages of the fabric. At the same time, she posted a few photos of new styles in the WeChat group "Yajing Lifestyle Store" with a caption announcing the upcoming new arrivals, and people in the group soon asked about prices.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bank wealth management phone call and family discussion.
description: Right after replying to WeChat messages, Song Yajing received a call from Lin Xiaofeng, the account manager at Qianpu ICBC, who recommended a short-term fixed-term wealth management product. After calculating quickly, she politely replied that she would think it over because she had to pay Susan in Guangzhou for goods this month and cash flow was tight. She then told her husband Chen Zhiqiang via WeChat. Chen Zhiqiang replied with a voice message saying that since they had just launched new products and had many expenses, there was no rush to invest, and they should stabilize the business. Song Yajing smiled knowingly and replied to Lin Xiaofeng, politely declining.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Continue operating the store and handling customer inquiries.
description: The afternoon passed smoothly with receiving customers, tidying up tried-on clothes, and replying to WeChat messages. Song Yajing successfully recommended new outfit combinations to two regular customers, and with Xiaomei's help, got a customer who bought two dresses to join the WeChat group.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contacted a fellow parishioner to arrange a meeting
description: In the evening when there were few people, Song Yajing opened the WeChat chat with her fellow believer Lin Xiuying, shared photos of the stained-glass windows and sacred icons from yesterday's Sunday Mass, and expressed her wish to chat with her. Auntie Lin happily replied, and they agreed to meet at Grace Coffee near Zhongshan Road at 3 p.m. on Wednesday, January 8. Putting down her phone, Song Yajing felt a sense of relief at the prospect of being listened to.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-closing tidy-up and financial wrap-up
description: After hanging up the voice call, Song Yajing and Xiaomei counted and recorded the day's revenue, kept the books, and briefly noted customer feedback and fitting data in a notebook. Then they cleaned the store, put away the steam iron, and checked the lighting equipment to ensure there were no safety hazards.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: Song Yajing said goodbye to Xiaomei, who was off work, pulled down the rolling shutter door, and walked briskly for about 3 minutes to the kindergarten, just as school was letting out. Her daughter rushed over with her backpack, excitedly telling her mother that she had learned to fold an origami rabbit today. Song Yajing scooped her up into her arms.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stopped to do some shopping on the way home
description: Holding her daughter's hand, Song Yajing walked 10 minutes to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought two bottles of fresh milk, a pack of tissues, and two bags of frozen dumplings as a backup lunch. Passing the snack section, her daughter whispered that she wanted strawberry ice cream. Remembering her promise, Song Yajing picked up a small box as a reward.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, convenience store inside Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: After arriving home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already simmering pork rib soup in the kitchen. Song Yajing put the purchased items into the refrigerator and started preparing dinner. She stir-fried a green vegetable and reheated the leftover misua soup from the morning, combining it into a simple, warm meal.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: The family sat around the dining table. While eating, Song Yajing shared funny stories from today's store new arrivals and practice videos, mentioning that Aunt Lin had agreed to have coffee on Wednesday. Her husband encouraged her to take it slow, and her daughter excitedly showed off the little paper rabbit she had folded. After dinner, Song Yajing wiped her daughter's mouth and began reading an excerpt from the picture book The Little Prince with her.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Helping with homework and getting ready for bed
description: After reading the picture book, Song Yajing helped her daughter finish her kindergarten homework: recognizing 5 numbers and tracing over them. Then she bathed her, changed her into clean pajamas, and dried her hair. After getting into bed, the two of them said a prayer of thanks for the strawberry ice cream they bought today, and her daughter soon fell asleep.
location: Living room and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organized personal video materials and studied.
description: After settling her daughter, Song Yajing brewed a cup of hot tea, went to her desk, and imported the three clips she had shot in the store during the day (empty shots of green plants, spring clothing background display, picture-in-picture practice) into her computer. Referring to the notes she reviewed on the CapCut app that afternoon, she repeatedly adjusted the position and size of the picture-in-picture, combining the clips into a smoother complete video. She felt she had improved quite a bit compared to noon.
location: Home study/bedroom, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Writing a diary, washing up, and relaxing before bed
description: After finishing her study, Song Yajing turned off the computer and wrote in her diary about the day's smooth new arrivals, progress in photography, her appointment with Aunt Lin, and the bank incident, feeling clear-headed. Then she washed up, did her facial care routine, laid out a yoga mat on the floor, and did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relax her sore muscles. After that, she changed into pajamas and got into bed. While scrolling through her Moments, she saw her friend Li Meiling's baking photos, liked them, and left a comment. She showed today's video to her husband, who commented that the background could be a bit brighter but that it was an overall improvement. Then she put down her phone, said goodnight to her husband, and began to drift off to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Falling asleep
description: Song Yajing closed her eyes and reviewed the day: the children's smiling faces, the busy figures in the shop, and the appointment with Aunt Lin. She felt a plain but fulfilling happiness. She silently prayed in her heart for her family, the shop, and the upcoming conversation, then drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning weigh-in and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off. After getting up on time, Song Yajing first stepped onto the bedroom electronic scale, which showed 50.0 kg. Her weight had stayed stable after four days of sugar control, which pleased her. Then she entered the kitchen and used pork rib soup, thin noodles, and eggs to prepare Minnan misua soup. She also fried two sunny-side-up eggs and chopped scallions, thinking to herself that there was still a lot of pork rib soup her husband Aqiang had stewed yesterday, and it could be reheated in the evening. Next, she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on footed fleece pajamas, and reminded her that the weather was turning colder. Then she woke her husband. The family sat around the table to enjoy breakfast. She told Xuanxuan to drink more water at kindergarten and reminded Aqiang to buy a bottle of soy sauce on his way home from work.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school, shopping on the way, and preparing the store.
description: Song Yajing put a mask on Xuanxuan, helped her put on her little backpack, and the mother and daughter walked hand in hand to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter happily shared how she had played the “doctor and patient” game with other children yesterday. At the school gate, she squatted down and gently reminded her to drink plenty of water if she coughed, promising to pick her up on time in the afternoon. After watching her daughter enter the school, she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought sugar-free oolong tea, facial tissues, and toilet paper. At checkout, she remembered that the matcha powder was used up and made a note to buy some in the afternoon. She then continued on foot to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, unlocked the door with her key, and swept the floor, wiped down the cabinets, and laid out the welcome mat together with Xiaomei, the shop assistant who had arrived early, preparing for a new day of business.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten and Zhenhai Road Metro Station Convenience Store)

name: Brainstorm video themes and handle morning store operations.
description: There were not many customers in the shop in the morning. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and opened the same-city fashion account on Xiaohongshu. After studying videos with many likes, she found that the topic "one trench coat, many ways to wear" was very popular. She took out her notebook and carefully wrote down three styling directions: "trench coat + wide-leg pants = commuter style", "trench coat + floral dress = date style", "trench coat + hoodie = casual style", and drew simple sketches. During this time, she received a regular customer who was looking for an autumn coat. She patiently explained that the new spring styles had arrived, successfully recommended a light trench coat with an inner outfit, and the customer was satisfied and made the purchase. The part-time shop assistant Xiaomei helped with watching the store and receiving customers.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and learning video editing
description: After instructing Xiaomei to keep an eye on the store, Song Yajing walked to the 85°C Bakery Cafe at Zhonghua City, where she ordered a sugar-free coconut latte and a vegetable salad. Sitting in a window seat, she put on earphones, opened the CapCut app, and carefully studied the advanced uses of the picture-in-picture feature, taking screenshots to note down the key steps in preparation for her regular Saturday practice.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Filming video footage and reviewing.
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing immediately started shooting video material. In the fitting room, she changed into the first outfit, 'trench coat + silk blouse + tailored trousers,' and stood in front of the full-length mirror holding her phone to shoot several walking videos. Then she changed into the second outfit, 'trench coat + floral dress,' and asked Xiaomei to film from different angles. When she reviewed the footage, she felt the lighting and camera movement still needed improvement. Though a bit discouraged, she decided to focus on perfecting them on Saturday.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business peak and wholesale order processing
description: In the afternoon, customers gradually increased in the store, and Song Yajing and Xiaomei were busy receiving them and recommending outfits. At about 3 p.m., she checked WeChat during a break at the register. A regular customer sent a message asking for 6 of the same long-sleeved top in different colors for a company team-building event. She immediately checked the inventory system, found the colors were incomplete, then called supplier Susan on voice. The two communicated for about ten minutes about stock and alternatives, finally deciding to replace it with a thicker long-sleeved top made of more comfortable fabric. She promised to ship in two days, and the customer agreed.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Sorted inventory and updated accounts.
description: As customer traffic dwindled, Song Yajing and Xiaomei tidied the messy shelves together, rearranging the spring clothing by color. She opened the bookkeeping app on her phone, counted the day's sales, and entered them into the system. When checking the matcha powder inventory, she confirmed it was used up both at home and in the store, which strengthened her decision to go to the supermarket after picking up her daughter in the afternoon.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closed the store early to pick up my daughter from school.
description: To buy matcha powder and go home to prepare dinner, Song Yajing asked store clerk Xiaomei to close the store ten minutes early. She herself hurried toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten, thinking that she must be on time and not let Xuanxuan be the last child to be picked up again.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road)

name: Pick up my daughter and buy baking ingredients.
description: Picking up Xuanxuan at the kindergarten gate, the child happily handed over a little red flower folded in handicraft class. Song Yajing felt warm at heart, took her daughter's hand and walked along the way to Tangchao Save-Money Supermarket. In the baking section, she carefully picked a bag of high-quality imported matcha powder, and also bought a box of butter and a bag of cake flour for later use, resolving silently that tonight's baking must succeed.
location: Tangchao Money-Saving Supermarket, No. 7 North Siming Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home and prepare dinner.
description: After getting home, Song Yajing let Xuanxuan watch cartoons in the living room for a while, then tied on an apron and started preparing dinner. She took last night's rib soup out of the fridge to thaw, washed a bunch of greens for blanching, and rinsed rice to cook, making efficient use of time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family of three sat around the dining table. Dinner was reheated pork rib soup, blanched greens, and pan-fried fish. Song Yajing excitedly shared her ideas for video directions and the process of handling wholesale orders that day. Her husband encouraged her to have a good talk with Aunt Lin tomorrow. Xuanxuan chattered about having played 'doctor and patient' at kindergarten. The dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending time with daughter and parent-child learning.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan in the children's room to finish her kindergarten animal classification homework. They used colored pens to draw birds and fish. Although the drawings were crooked, she kept patiently encouraging her. Then she picked up the picture book "The Little Prince" and read her daughter the chapter "Making Friends with the Fox," enjoying the parent-child reading time.
location: Children's room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Putting daughter to bed and saying bedtime prayers.
description: Song Yajing first took Xuanxuan to bathe and change into pajamas, then the mother and daughter knelt together by the bed, and she guided her daughter in a bedtime prayer: "Thank the Lord for giving us a wonderful day, and please bless Mom, Dad, teachers, and classmates..." After Xuanxuan quietly fell asleep, she gently turned off the desk lamp and left the room.
location: Children's room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Mentally preparing for tomorrow's heart-to-heart talk.
description: Sitting at the vanity in her bedroom, Song Yajing quietly rehearsed in front of the mirror tomorrow's conversation with Aunt Lin at the coffee shop. She planned to openly share her anxiety about declining store revenue, the attempt to transition to short videos, and her worries about Xuanxuan's upcoming elementary school enrollment next year. She opened the Bible she carried with her and silently recited Proverbs 3:5-6: "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight." She did this to seek inner peace and strength.
location: dressing table in the bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Failed to bake matcha cookies
description: She tied on an apron, took out the newly bought matcha powder, and carefully weighed butter, powdered sugar, and flour according to a recipe on her phone, beating until smooth. Finally she rolled out the dough, cut it into pieces, and put it in the oven. But because she was distracted thinking about tomorrow's heart-to-heart talk, she forgot to adjust the oven temperature. By the time she smelled a burning smell, the edges of the cookies were already scorched. Annoyed, she took them out with a spatula, looked at the ruined cookies, and decided to throw them all away. She felt a little disappointed that she would have to go empty-handed to see Aunt Lin tomorrow.
location: Kitchen of the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Clean the kitchen and wash up for the evening
description: Song Yajing silently cleaned up the burnt cookies, scrubbed the baking sheet and mixing bowl, and tidied the kitchen. Then she went to the bathroom, washed up carefully, and put on a hydrating mask, hoping to look fresh tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stretching before bed and writing in the diary.
description: She spread out the yoga mat in the bedroom and did several sets of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches, syncing the phone's record of 4,500 steps. Then she sat by the bed, took out her diary, and wrote down today's mood: "I came up with the video direction, handled the batch orders, and mentally prepared for tomorrow. The cookies got burnt, a bit frustrated, but I still have to face tomorrow. Lord, please give me courage. Good night."
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: She turned off the bedside lamp, said goodnight softly to her husband, and put on her sleep mask. With a slight unease about tomorrow's heart-to-heart talk, a faint regret over tonight's failed baking, and also a sense of expectation, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, weigh in, and prepare breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm went off. She went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into loungewear, then checked her weight on the scale: 50.2 kg, the same as yesterday, showing steady blood sugar control. Then she went into the kitchen, boiled water to make Minnan misua soup, adding misua, oysters, and eggs, and sprinkling chopped green onions and white pepper. At the same time, she cut last night's youtiao into pieces and toasted them in the oven to make them crispy, completing a warm breakfast that would not spike her blood sugar.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake the family and have breakfast together.
description: Song Yajing first gently woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and told him to come home early in the evening to help their daughter make a lantern. Then she went to the children's room to wake her daughter Chen Lexuan and told her they would buy sequins for the lantern after school. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating thin noodle soup and grilled fried dough sticks while chatting about their ideas for the handmade lantern that evening. The atmosphere was warm.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing put on her daughter's coat, helped her with her backpack, and held her hand as they walked along Zhenhai Road for about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter excitedly planned to paint a little rabbit on the lantern, and Yajing smiled in response. After a brief exchange with the teacher at the kindergarten gate, she watched her daughter enter the classroom.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop and buy flowers on the way.
description: Walking from the kindergarten to the store on Zhongshan Road, she went along Zhenhai Road. When she passed the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she remembered that visiting Aunt Lin empty-handed would not be appropriate, so she went in, picked a budding light purple daisy, and had the clerk wrap it simply. Then she continued walking to the store, opened the door early, and started the cash register system.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Open the shop for business and organize the charity sale inventory
description: Song Yajing opened the store on time. After checking that the floor was clean, she went to the storage area and opened the bins containing out-of-season inventory. Following the standards for the church charity sale, she selected clothes that were in decent condition and of appropriate styles, photographed them with her phone, and mentally calculated which ones were suitable to put out. During this time, staff member Xiaomei came in to work at 10 o'clock, and Yajing briefly handed over the tasks.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Give instructions to the shop assistant and leave for the appointment.
description: There were not many customers in the store. Song Yajing called Xiaomei to the cash register and reiterated that she was going to meet Aunt Lin at Grace Coffee on Douxi Road at noon, expecting to be back between 2:30 and 3:00. She told Xiaomei to take care of her own lunch and mind the store, and in the afternoon to help shoot B-roll video footage of model outfits. After that, she put on her commuter bag, picked up the little daisy, and walked out of the store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking to the café
description: Song Yajing walked from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Douxi Road, threading through the bustling crowds and turning into Douxi Road, which was lined with tall mango trees. Her mood gradually calmed.
location: Near Grace Coffee on Douxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Heart-to-heart talk with Aunt Lin over coffee
description: Song Yajing pushed open the wooden door of Grace Coffee a few minutes early and saw Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, already sitting in a booth by the window. They ordered a latte each and a pot of black tea, then Yajing gave Aunt Lin the daisies and poured out her worries about declining store revenue, the pressure of shifting to short videos, and anxiety over choosing an elementary school for her daughter. Her voice choked up as she became emotional. Aunt Lin comforted her like a kind mother, shared how she had gotten through hard times by selling clay figurines at a stall when she was young, and used a passage from the Gospel of Matthew to counsel her. The long conversation made Yajing's eyes red, but she felt much lighter inside.
location: Grace Coffee, Douxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Saying goodbye to Aunt Lin and walking back to the store.
description: Just after 1 p.m., Yajing said a reluctant goodbye to Aunt Lin at the café entrance. Aunt Lin gave her a small holy medal as a protective charm and invited her to next month's church charity sale, suggesting she donate part of the store's inventory. Yajing felt it would both do good and promote the store, so she agreed immediately. She walked back along Douxi Road, lined with mango trees on both sides. Sunlight filtered through the leaves, and with a brisk step she jotted down initial ideas for the charity sale in her phone's memo app.
location: Along the route from the entrance of Grace Coffee on Douxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 56 Zhongshan Road

name: Return to the shop to deal with matters and confirm the charity sale plan
description: Song Yajing returned to the shop. Xiaomei reported that two regular customers had added items to their cart but had not placed orders. Yajing immediately sent them WeChat messages with styling suggestions, then handled several orders from regular customers on WeChat. She reviewed the B-roll footage Xiaomei had shot; the lighting and composition were acceptable. After that, she went back to the storage room, photographed the selected clothes for the charity sale and filed them, planning to add some small items to make the stall more varied.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closed the store and walked to pick up her daughter.
description: At 16:30, Yajing tidied the checkout counter, told Xiaomei to close the store, and set off half an hour early on foot to pick up her daughter at Siming Experimental Kindergarten.
location: Along the route from No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to No. 123 Gucheng West Road

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing arrived at the kindergarten gate on time. Her daughter Xuanxuan spotted her mother at once and happily rushed over. Yajing took her daughter's hand and left the kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase craft supplies and walk home.
description: Song Yajing did not go straight home. Instead, she and her daughter turned into a convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station. In the stationery section, the mother and daughter picked out colorful sequins, small stickers, and tassels for making lanterns. Xuanxuan insisted on choosing a unicorn sticker as well. After paying, Yajing carried the bag and held her daughter's hand as they walked back home to No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arrive home and prepare dinner
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already stewing pork rib and radish soup in the kitchen and preparing to stir-fry greens. Yajing changed into home clothes, tied on an apron, helped cut the washed vegetables, and placed the craft materials on the coffee table.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Aqiang served the soup, and Yajing brought out stir-fried beef and garlic lettuce. At the table, Yajing talked about what she had gained from meeting Auntie Lin that afternoon and the great idea of a church charity sale. Aqiang expressed agreement, while Xuanxuan kept asking when they would make lanterns. The atmosphere was warm.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province
