name: After-dinner cleanup and setting up the parent-child craft area.
description: After dinner, A Qiang voluntarily washed the dishes. Yajing cleaned the coffee table in the living room, spread out old newspapers, took out the picture book Reunion, colored cardstock, safety scissors, a glue stick, and the glitter stickers she had just bought from the study, placed two small stools on the carpet, and set up a cozy parent-child craft area.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child picture books and lantern making
description: The mother and daughter squeezed together on the sofa. Yajing read to her daughter the passage from "Reunion" about making tangyuan during the New Year in Mandarin with a Hokkien accent, and Xuanxuan listened carefully. Then they began making a lantern. Yajing cut red cardstock for the lantern body, Xuanxuan drew little rabbits and stars on it with crayons, and carefully stuck on sequins. Yajing naturally hummed the Hokkien nursery rhyme "Dian Zai Dian Ding Ding," and her daughter followed along in her baby voice. The atmosphere was warm and cozy, and a beautiful little red lantern gradually took shape.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wrap-up presentation and bedtime preparation
description: After the lantern was finished, Yajing attached the tassels. Xuanxuan showed off her work in front of her father, and Yajing helped her place the lantern on the sideboard. Then she bathed her daughter and changed her into pajamas. Before bed, the mother and daughter knelt by the bed and prayed together. Xuanxuan thanked Jesus for making Mommy happy and thanked Mommy for making the lantern with her.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple chat, journaling, and personal care.
description: After settling her daughter down, Yajing returned to the master bedroom and wrote in her diary at the dressing table, recording the takeaways from today's conversation with Aunt Lin, inspiration for the charity sale, and her daughter's smiling face while making lanterns. After writing, she chatted with her husband, who was leaning against the headboard, and shared how she had gone from feeling heavy to feeling relieved. Aqiang held her hand and comforted her, saying that taking things slowly would make everything better. Then Yajing went to the bathroom to remove her makeup, cleanse her face, apply a hydrating mask, and put on serum and moisturizer. Finally, she did a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch on the bedroom carpet to relax her legs, shoulders, and neck.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Review and sleep
description: At 22:00, Song Yajing turned off the light and lay down, briefly reviewing the day in her mind: mianxian hu, buying flowers, Aunt Lin's comforting words, the great charity sale idea, her daughter's lantern and smiling face. With the relief of a storm having passed and the warmth of being with family, she took a deep breath and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake-up, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: In the early morning, Song Yajing woke up to the alarm clock and habitually weighed herself: 50.3 kg, about the same as yesterday. There was light fog outside the window and the weather was a bit overcast. While washing up, she began planning today's tasks: booking train tickets, assigning Xiaomei's work, and packing luggage. Today she made her daughter's favorite Minnan-style thin noodle soup and added a poached egg, hoping her daughter would be happy.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family communication and breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, and the family had breakfast together in the dining room. During the meal, Song Yajing told her husband that she had checked the high-speed train schedule and planned to leave tomorrow afternoon, and asked whether he could take compensatory leave tomorrow noon to pick up their daughter. Chen Zhiqiang readily agreed and even offered to see her off at the station, but Song Yajing smiled and declined, telling him to focus on work.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing held her daughter’s hand and walked about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Her daughter was somewhat quiet today. At the gate, Song Yajing squatted down and gently told her that she would take the high-speed train to Hangzhou tomorrow for a two-day business trip, and that her father would pick her up and play with her, and she would bring back a gift. Though her daughter’s eyes were slightly red, she still nodded sensibly and said, “Mommy, come back early,” then put on her backpack and walked into the campus.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the church to handle church affairs
description: After dropping off her child, Song Yajing did not go straight to the shop. Instead, she took the bus to the ferry terminal, then a boat to Gulangyu Island, and arrived at the Catholic church. In the quiet church, she lit a candle in the morning light, praying for tomorrow's trip and the shop's transformation. Afterwards, in the lounge, she used her phone to organize the photos of the inventory clothes she had selected yesterday to donate to the church's charity sale, categorizing and filing them by size and season.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting to the store and doing a little shopping
description: After taking the ferry back from the church, Song Yajing walked toward the store on Zhongshan Road. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she went in and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and a boiled egg as a mid-morning snack. She then continued walking for about 7 minutes to reach the store.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the shop, booking tickets, and contacting her best friend.
description: Song Yajing opened the store on time, turned on ventilation and lights, and watered the green plants inside. After brewing a cup of jasmine tea, she opened the Railway 12306 app on her phone, searched for and booked a G1678 high-speed rail ticket from Xiamen North to Hangzhou East for tomorrow afternoon at 14:19, choosing window seat F. After booking, she immediately contacted her best friend Zhao Min via WeChat, saying she would arrive at Hangzhou East around 5:30 tomorrow afternoon. Zhao Min quickly called back and excitedly said she would pick her up at the station and plan to take her to taste the Pian’er Chuan noodles at the shop downstairs from her home.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Follow up on shipments and handle online business
description: Song Yajing checked the shipping status of the replacement base layer top that supplier Susan had promised to send yesterday. The status showed "Picked up by carrier," and she took a screenshot and sent it to the waiting customer to put their mind at ease. Then she opened the inventory management software, pulled up the arrival list and the list of customers to be contacted that she needed to hand over to store clerk Xiaomei the next day, and printed two copies.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Had lunch with Xiaomei and handed over work.
description: Song Yajing and the shop assistant Xiaomei ordered satay noodles for delivery and ate in the store's rest area while chatting. She spread the printed list on the table and gave detailed instructions about the incoming shipments and VIP customer follow-up visits for the next two days. She also told Xiaomei that if she encountered customer requests she was unsure about, she should send photos and wait for her return to decide, and to follow up on the shipment of undervests from yesterday. After giving the instructions, Song Yajing hung the red lantern she had made with her daughter the night before by the cash register and told Xiaomei to take good care of it. Xiaomei smiled and agreed, saying the lantern was very festive.
location: Rest area of Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon: store operations and learning e-commerce knowledge
description: In the afternoon, customers came one after another. During gaps between serving customers, Song Yajing put in Bluetooth earbuds and repeatedly played pre-downloaded audio courses on "private domain traffic" and "community fission," quietly noting key terms to prepare for the day-after-tomorrow salon. She completed fragmented learning while running the store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidying up early to prepare for closing the shop
description: In her spare time, Song Yajing organized the photos of the clothes she planned to donate to the church charity sale, sent them to the sister in charge, and left a message saying she would pack them up and deliver them to the church before leaving tomorrow afternoon. Then she turned off the computer, counted the day's takings, and locked them in the drawer, getting ready to close the shop.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing closed the shop early and walked to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter. Chen Lexuan saw her mother and happily threw herself over, handing her a tulip drawing she had made that afternoon. Song Yajing kissed her daughter on the cheek, carefully put the drawing into her bag, and then took her daughter's hand and left.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping on the way and going home
description: Holding her daughter's hand, Song Yajing stopped by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought milk, small breads, nuts, and water needed for tomorrow's trip, plus a pack of the dried strawberries her daughter loved. Then mother and daughter walked hand in hand slowly back home.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packing luggage and preparing the family dinner.
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing let her daughter play in the living room, took down a small suitcase from the top of the wardrobe, and began packing for the trip, putting in two changes of clothes, a salon notebook, and a power bank. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang got home from work, he confirmed the arrangement to take leave at noon the next day to pick up their daughter. Song Yajing also set aside the spare key, ready to give it to their neighbor Aunt Zhang. Meanwhile, Chen Zhiqiang started preparing dinner in the kitchen.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and parent-child time.
description: Chen Zhiqiang cooked a few home-style dishes: steamed sea bass, stir-fried greens, and pork rib soup. At the dinner table, the family shared the good news that train tickets had been booked today and that Zhao Min would pick them up at the station. Chen Zhiqiang was happy for his wife too. After dinner, Song Yajing played with building blocks with her daughter in the living room. Chen Lexuan built a "high-speed rail station" with the blocks, saying it was where her mother was going tomorrow. A warm feeling surged in Song Yajing's heart.
location: Dining room and living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: After bathing her daughter, Song Yajing lay on the bed. Her daughter lay on her chest and asked with reluctance whether her mother was really leaving the next day. Song Yajing held her tight and gently told her that she would be back the next evening, and urged her to sleep well and that Daddy would pick her up the next day. Her daughter closed her eyes, murmured 'Safe travels, Mommy, may Jesus bless Mommy', and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Daughter's bedroom at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handled unexpected situations and continued packing luggage.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom to continue packing. When she took out her favorite beige scarf, she found a watercolor marker stain in a corner—her daughter's 'masterpiece'. She felt a twinge of heartache at first, but then softened at the memory of her daughter's smiling face while drawing. She carefully wiped it with a wet wipe; the mark faded but was still visible. She decided to take it as it was, as a memento. Then she finished organizing the suitcase and hung out the clothes for the next day.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Browsing e-commerce articles to build anticipation for the salon
description: After packing, Song Yajing leaned back on the living room sofa, picked up her tablet, and opened her saved articles on "private-domain traffic closed loop" and "community membership playbook." Although some technical terms were hard to read, she pushed through and finished them one by one, taking simple notes as final preparation for the e-commerce content salon the day after tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening relaxation and couple conversation
description: After washing up, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, applied face cream, and did a few bedtime stretches. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came in after watching the ball game, and the two chatted for a while. Chen Zhiqiang asked his wife if she was nervous; Song Yajing admitted she was a little, but felt more anticipation. Her husband comforted her, saying to just treat it as seeing the world and making friends, and not put too much pressure on herself. Song Yajing felt reassured.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime routine and mood journaling
description: Song Yajing knelt on the rug beside the bed and said her bedtime prayers, thanking God for seeing the day through safely and asking for smooth travels the next day. Then she took out her diary and wrote down how she felt: 'The tickets are booked, the luggage is packed, and Xuanxuan has been very good. Tomorrow is a new beginning. I'm a little scared, but I'm more looking forward to it. Goodnight, Xiamen.'
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the bedside lamp, Song Yajing closed her eyes, with anticipation and a slight nervousness about tomorrow, and slowly drifted into sleep amid her husband's even breathing.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and morning review
description: Awakened by the sound of rain and her phone alarm, she saw the dim sky outside the window. Although she had chatted with Zhao Min about e-commerce until late last night, she still struggled to get up because there was an important salon today. While washing up, she encouraged herself in the mirror: "Song Yajing, you're here to learn, not to be a deserter." She made a cup of hot water, sat on the living room sofa, and quickly reviewed the e-commerce logic diagram Zhao Min had written on the whiteboard last night, silently repeating the unfamiliar terms.
location: Gang'er Lane Community, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Zhao Min's home)

name: Commuting and basic study.
description: She put on her Warrior sneakers, a comfortable hoodie, and a trench coat over it. She brought the notebook she had organized the night before, a power bank, and her phone. Before leaving, she sent Zhao Min a WeChat message saying she was on her way. Holding an umbrella, she walked seven minutes (about 500 meters) to Ding'an Road Station, where she bought a tea egg and a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at the convenience store inside the station for breakfast. She took Metro Line 1 (toward Xianghu), transferred to Line 4 at Jinjiang Station (toward Chihua Street), and got out at Exit A of Yongjiang Road Station. The whole trip took about 25 minutes. On the metro, she took out the slip of paper with the terms she had copied last night and quietly memorized the meanings of DSR, UV, and GPM.
location: Along the public transit route from Gang'er Lane Residential Community, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, to Relax Grand Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch)

name: Check-in and preparation
description: Arrived at the salon venue, scanned the QR code to check in at the registration desk, and received a guest badge and a conference materials handbook. She found a seat near the edge in the middle section, placed her notebook and pen neatly, took a deep breath, opened her phone, and quickly browsed live-stream highlights from several top fashion bloggers, trying to get herself into a learning state.
location: At the entrance to the banquet hall on the 2nd floor of Relax Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch), No. 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Attending an e-commerce salon for theoretical learning.
description: The morning lecture officially began, with the topics "The Underlying Logic of Livestream Traffic" and "Tiered Community Operations in Practice." The instructor was a hands-on teacher who explained vividly, breaking down the subject with numerous case studies. Song Yajing listened extremely attentively and wrote quickly, taking nearly 10 pages of notes, highlighting core points such as "use trust among acquaintances to win the first order" and "the key to a high repurchase rate is delivering beyond expectations." When the instructor mentioned that "apparel, as a non-standard product, is best suited for a cold start from WeChat Moments and private domain," she felt her heartbeat quicken, feeling that this was exactly the tailor-made path for herself.
location: 2nd Floor Banquet Hall, Relax Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch), No. 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Lunch and in-depth conversation.
description: At the buffet lunch arranged by the salon, Song Yajing carried her plate and took the initiative to chat with a kind-looking woman of similar age at the same table. This Boss Li had a small stall at Sijiqing in Hangzhou. The two talked about pain points in product selection and inventory pressure, and found they had a lot in common. Boss Li shared her experience of "using community pre-sales to nurture offline traffic," especially mentioning "starting with an internal purchase group for regular customers—the profit is not high, but repeat purchases are extremely stable." Song Yajing felt enlightened, proactively added her on WeChat, and exchanged contact information.
location: First-floor buffet restaurant, Relax Grand Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch), 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Suffered a major setback during the hands-on practice session.
description: In the afternoon, she entered the hands-on workshop. The instructor required participants to use a simulated e-commerce backend (Qianchuan Beginner Edition) to set up a livestream preview and write sales copy within 80 characters. Facing a screen full of terms (DSR product description score, UV visitors, GPM revenue per thousand impressions) and function buttons she had never seen before, Song Yajing had no idea where to start. She tried several times, either filling in the wrong fields or failing to upload images, and her palms were sweating with anxiety. The young man next to her finished in 5 minutes and was praised by the teaching assistant. Staring at her lagging computer screen, her cheeks burned and her ears turned red, and a deep sense of frustration surged over her like a tide.
location: Hall A, Practical Workshop, 3rd Floor, Relax Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch), 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang

name: Post-setback adjustment and help-seeking review
description: After the hands-on practice session ended, Song Yajing had no energy left to attend the next sharing session. Carrying her phone and thermos, she walked to the rest area in the lobby and plopped down on the sofa. She felt so down that she even wanted to buy a ticket back to Xiamen immediately. She called Zhao Min and tearfully told her about being “crushed” that day. Zhao Min comforted her over the phone: “Sis, nobody is born knowing how. When I first entered the industry, I was scolded every day too. Use your phone right now to write down what I told you yesterday. Your foundation is too weak; don't try to do too much. First, get one platform down.” That phone call calmed her down, and she wrote in her phone memo: “1. Focus on Xiaohongshu. 2. Start with the private purchase group. 3. Once back in Xiamen, start with regular customers.”
location: Coffee corner in the rest area on the 1st floor, Relax Grand Hotel (Qianjiang New City Branch), No. 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Commute and urban stroll (heading to Hefang Street).
description: Leaving the venue, the rain had stopped and the air was filled with the moist southern atmosphere. Song Yajing put on her earphones, listened to noise-canceling music, and followed the navigation directions on foot to Hefang Street. Starting from Wangjiang East Road, she walked north along Zhonghe Middle Road, about 1.2 kilometers in total, a walk of about 15 minutes. This route made her feel somewhat calmer.
location: The walking route from Relax Grand Hotel, No. 333 Wangjiang East Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, to Hefang Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: City walk and shopping for local specialties
description: Strolling along the quaint Hefang Street, she was drawn to the shops on both sides. Her mood was still low, but her gaze gradually regained focus. She walked into the specialty shop Nansong Huji and picked out two boxes of dingsheng cake and a serving of congbao hui, thinking of bringing them to Xuanxuan and Aqiang to taste — this also fulfilled her wish to buy local specialties.
location: Hefang Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Commute (Hefang Street to Grandma's Home)
description: She walked from Hefang Street to Grandma’s Home, about 1.2 kilometers in total, a 15-minute walk. She headed toward Wushan Square and took in the lively weekend evening atmosphere of downtown Hangzhou along the way.
location: Walking route from Hefang Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province to Grandma's Home, 5th floor, West Lake Intime City, No. 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Healing dinner with Zhao Min
description: After work, Zhao Min rode her bike directly to West Lake Intime to meet. Song Yajing chose this Hangzhou cuisine restaurant and ordered sweet and sour pork tenderloin, Longjing shrimp, osmanthus yam, and a hot drink. At the table, she poured out all the frustration from the afternoon while eating. Zhao Min listened quietly, then began to review it with her like a teacher: from the basic front-end and back-end operations to the implementation of "layered private-domain community operations" — for example, how to put loyal fans, regular customers, and new customers into different groups and send different content. Song Yajing took rapid notes in her phone memo as she listened, and also bought a digital copy of the "Private Domain White Paper for the Apparel Industry" on Taobao for 9.9 yuan.
location: Grandma's Home (Hangzhou West Lake Intime City Branch), 5th Floor, West Lake Intime City, No. 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Post-meal walk and dessert therapy
description: After the meal, Zhao Min suggested taking a walk to help digest the food. The two walked north along Yan'an Road, chatting. Zhao Min could see that Song Yajing was still feeling heavyhearted, so she said, "Come on, I know there's an 85°C nearby. Let's go buy a tiramisu to sweeten your mood." They walked and chatted all the way, taking about 30 minutes to arrive. In the store, Song Yajing chose the tiramisu she had been craving since last night and a hot unsweetened latte. Even though it was over her sugar limit, she felt much lighter in her heart.
location: 85°C (Hangzhou Zhaohui Store), 188 Zhaohui Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Returning to Zhao Min's home and outlining the action plan after returning to Xiamen
description: The two took a taxi back to Zhao Min's home (about a 15-minute ride). Song Yajing did not rest right away; instead, she sat down at the coffee table, opened her laptop, and, combining the insights from the day with Zhao Min's suggestions, carefully wrote out a “7-Day Action Plan After Returning to Xiamen”: 1. Day 1-2: Sort out 80 high-net-worth repeat customers from WeChat contacts, chat privately with them, and set up a “Yajing's Secret Wardrobe” private buying group; 2. Day 3: Pick 5 of the most versatile base tops and best-sellers from the store, take flat-lay and detail photos, and prepare pre-sale copy for the group; 3. Day 4-5: Learn to use the mobile “Kuaituantuan” or “Qunjielong” mini-program and simulate posting a purchase link; 4. Day 6-7: Based on what you learned, post a Moments teaser: “The regular-customer private sale restarts this Saturday, limited to 48 hours.”
location: Living room at Zhao Min's home, Gang'er Alley Residential Complex, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Bedtime prayer, phone calls, and tidying up
description: After sorting out her plan, Song Yajing felt an unprecedented sense of peace. She walked into the guest room, knelt beside the bed, made the Sign of the Cross, and prayed for today's setbacks, her family's support, and tomorrow's journey home. Then she called Aqiang on video. Xuanxuan said sweetly to the camera, “Mommy, I miss you.” She held back her tears and said she would be home tomorrow afternoon and had bought Hangzhou specialties for both of them. After hanging up, she began packing her suitcase, carefully placing the specialties and meeting materials she had bought that day, and folding the scarf her daughter had drawn watercolor marks on and putting it on top.
location: Guest room, Gang'er Lane Community, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Zhao Min's home).

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: While washing up, she looked at herself in the mirror. The corners of her eyes were still a little red from fatigue, but her gaze held more determination. She said softly to herself in the mirror, “Song Yajing, you can do this. Go slowly, and you'll get there faster.” Then she put on a hydrating sheet mask, lay down on the bed, opened the “Tide” app, and listened to meditation music for a while.
location: Guest room and bathroom in Gang'er Lane Residential Community, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (Zhao Min's home)

name: Bedtime Reading and Mood Journal
description: Before bed, she opened the memo app on her phone and faithfully recorded the feelings of the day—from the ambition in the morning, to the breakdown and frustration in the afternoon, and then to the fulfilling review at night. Finally, she wrote: 'Day three in Hangzhou, I finally learned to keep my head down and watch the road. E-commerce is not a myth; it is a craft. Tomorrow I am going back to Xiamen, starting by re-adding one old customer.' Then she closed her eyes and fell into a deep sleep, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: On the guest room bed at Zhao Min's home in the Ganger Alley community, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Wake up and tidy up.
description: Woke up at her best friend Zhao Min's home. It was drizzling outside and the air was humid. After washing up, she changed into comfortable casual clothes, briefly tidied her suitcase, and carefully placed the Dingsheng cake given by Zhao Min and the three exquisite samples that Zheng Kai had sent over with his colleague between the clothes to prevent wrinkles.
location: Zhao Min's home in a residential community in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Farewell and Morning Prayer
description: Ate the poached egg noodles that Zhao Min cooked, and thanked her for her care and encouragement over the past two days. At exactly 8 o'clock, hugged Zhao Min goodbye with suitcase in tow. In the elevator, silently made the sign of the cross on her chest, prayed softly, thanked the Lord for guidance, and asked for courage and wisdom to put it into practice.
location: In Zhao Min's home and in the elevator of a residential community in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Go to the agreed restaurant.
description: Dragging her suitcase and holding an umbrella, she walked about 10 minutes to Ding'an Road Station on Metro Line 1. She took the metro to the Xinbailu restaurant at Intime West Lake, and on the way took out her phone again to review the community operations notes Zhao Min had explained the night before.
location: Streets and alleys in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, and Hangzhou Metro Line 1

name: Arrival and strolling around beforehand
description: Arrived half an hour earlier than agreed and strolled around the basement level of Intime City West Lake, where the restaurant was located. The rain was gradually stopping and the air was fresh. Looking at the shops that had just opened and the elderly people buying breakfast after morning exercise, she thought to herself how nice it would be if her own storefront had such a small space that draws people in.
location: B1, West Lake Intime City, 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Lunch with former colleague Zheng Kai
description: Zheng Kai showed up in his signature black designer jacket. At the table, he bluntly advised her not to touch live streaming, but to focus on WeChat communities and short videos, and to test the waters with a private sale among her most trusted regular customers. He called his colleagues on the spot and had them pack three sets of new samples and deliver them to the restaurant, for Yajing to take back to Xiamen to see how they'd be received.
location: Xinbailu (West Lake Intime City Store), 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Receiving samples and saying goodbye
description: Zheng Kai's colleague delivered three elegant clothing gift bags to the restaurant, containing a velvet blazer, a patchwork-design knit top, and a pair of wide-leg pants with excellent drape. She thanked him emotionally, feeling that this timely advice and the samples were like a beam of light shining into her heart. She said goodbye to Zheng Kai at the restaurant entrance, and he patted her shoulder and said, “Don't overthink it. Just get it done.”
location: Entrance of New Bailu (West Lake Intime City Store), No. 98 Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Go to Hangzhou East Railway Station.
description: Carrying a heavier suitcase than when she came to Hangzhou (stuffed with samples and the Dingsheng cake Zhao Min gave her), she took the metro to Hangzhou East Station. On the crowded train, with one hand pulling the suitcase and the other protecting the sample bag, she felt much calmer inside than when she arrived.
location: Hangzhou Metro Line 1

name: Waiting for the bus, lunch, and brainstorming
description: She passed security smoothly and found the ticket gate. After sitting down on a waiting bench, she took out her notebook and organized Zheng Kai and Zhao Min's suggestions into items: build a core group of 10 regular customers; post 3 high-quality styling videos every week; hold a small private sale every month. She also wrote next to them: "First thing: take photos tonight to build anticipation." Then she bought a sandwich and milk at a convenience store in the station for lunch.
location: Waiting hall, Hangzhou East Railway Station, No. 1 Tiancheng Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Return by high-speed train G1678
description: The train departed on time, and the scenery outside the window flew by. I opened my notebook and began carefully drafting the teaser copy to post in the group tonight: “Ladies, I’ve found some treasures! Exclusive pieces by designer Zheng Kai...” While writing, I used my phone to search for the best natural-light shooting angle at home. As the train entered a series of tunnels and the signal was lost, I simply took out the samples and gently felt the fabric, feeling a long-lost sense of earnestness rising in my heart.
location: G1678 high-speed train (Hangzhou East to Xiamen North)

name: Arrival in Xiamen and pickup at the station.
description: The train slowly pulled into Xiamen North Station. She got off with the crowd and immediately spotted her husband Chen Zhiqiang waiting at the exit, wearing that gray jacket with a smile on his face. She hurried over, and he naturally took the heaviest suitcase from her, patted her head with concern, and said, “Tired, right? Let's go home and I'll make you something delicious.”
location: Xiamen North Railway Station exit, 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Driving home and communicating.
description: In the car on the way home, she couldn't wait to share her Hangzhou experience with her husband: the frustration of the salon, the late-night talk with Zhao Min, Zheng Kai's blunt advice, and these three sets of samples. Her husband listened attentively while driving. As she reached the crucial point, he took one hand off the wheel and squeezed her hand, saying, “Having a direction is good enough, I support you.”
location: In the car heading from Xiamen North Station toward Hubin South Road, Siming District

name: Returning home to rest and dinner
description: After arriving home, her husband warmed up the food, and she changed out of her outdoor clothes. Daughter Xuanxuan had already eaten dinner and was watching cartoons in the living room. At the dining table, she showed the samples to her husband in detail and analyzed the fabric and tailoring. Her husband nodded and said, “The fabric is good; Vivian in your group will definitely like it.”
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Minor couple's quarrel and reconciliation
description: After the meal, feeling a little low from travel fatigue, she complained a bit when she saw the living room was messy. Her husband silently cleared the dishes, then sat down beside her and apologized first: “I know you're under a lot of pressure. I didn't think it through.” Hearing that, she softened and formally apologized: “A Qiang, I've been under a lot of pressure lately and spoke too harshly. Don't take it to heart.” The two made up.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking teaser photos of the sample items.
description: She changed into that velvet suit and asked her husband to help check the lighting. In the end, she chose the natural light by the living room bay window and the warm bedside lamp light in the bedroom. Wearing three sample outfits and pairing them with bags and scarves from home, she carefully took more than a dozen photos using a tripod and a phone selfie stick. Her husband also helped adjust the angle of the desk lamp and added some fill light to her face.
location: Living room and bedroom of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Social warm-up and adjustment
description: Exported the 9 most satisfying photos, used editing software to unify the color tone and layout. Posted them in three batches in the "Yajing's Wardrobe VIP Besties Group" (15 members), with carefully written captions: "New treasures brought back from Hangzhou, exclusive pieces from a designer friend of mine, a little sample for you sisters~" and attached a "sneak peek" emoji.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's late-night talk and plans for tomorrow.
description: After sending the group message, she sat side by side with her husband on the sofa. He peeled an apple, and the two talked about their daughter's parent-teacher meeting next week and their work plans for the coming week. Leaning on her husband's shoulder, she said sincerely, “Aqiang, thank you. If you weren't always there to back me up, I really wouldn't dare to take such risks.” He hugged her tightly and said, “Silly, we're family.”
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and prayer
description: Took a comfortable hot bath and felt all the fatigue of the journey melt away. After changing into pajamas, I knelt at the head of the bed, pressed my palms together, and prayed in a low voice: thanking the Lord for guidance, which helped me find direction in my confusion; thanking my husband and family for their support; and asking forgiveness for my anxiety over the past few days and the hurt I caused others. Finally, I prayed to humbly and wisely start with small things.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Browsing feedback and tomorrow's plans
description: Before going to bed, she found five or six replies in the 'Yajing's Wardrobe VIP Besties Group'. Vivian said: 'Yajing has good taste as always; those wide-leg pants look so comfortable!' Someone also asked about the fabric and price. Feeling warm, she replied with an emoji that said 'Links will be posted tomorrow, with an internal special price for sisters.' Then she wrote tomorrow's plan in her journal: tally the group's sign-up intentions, contact Zheng Kai to confirm prices and sizes, and go to the bank to deposit last week's business revenue.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: I turned off the desk lamp, and beside me came the sound of my husband's even breathing. Listening to the occasional sound of cars passing outside the window, the heavy weight that had been pressing on me for days because of the salon failure finally lifted. I closed my eyes and fell fast asleep. In my dream, there was no more chaos, but a cozy living room where several regular customers were happily trying on recommended clothes.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning prayer, and taking my daughter to school
description: At 7:10, sunlight woke me. The first thing I did was hold the cross on the bedside table and say a quiet morning prayer. I nudged my husband Chen Zhiqiang awake: 'Aqiang, time to get up. It's Monday today; we need to take Xuanxuan.' The three of us divided tasks in the kitchen: my husband prepared boiled eggs and milk, I cooked Minnan misua soup with last night's pork rib soup, and my daughter dressed herself in her kindergarten uniform. We left at 8:00 sharp. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, I went in and bought two bottles of unsweetened oolong tea. The three of us walked for 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and watched Xuanxuan bounce in merrily.
location: Room 502, Building 4, Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning rest and store handover
description: After returning home, she quickly used her phone in the “Yajing's Wardrobe VIP Bestie Group” to tally the interest responses for the Hangzhou sample photos. Vivian and five other regular customers had already expressed clear interest. Then she walked seven minutes to the Zhongshan Road store to check whether the three sets of samples that Zheng Kai had sent by express the previous night had arrived. The package had arrived, and Xiaomei was unpacking and organizing. She told her, “Xiaomei, you're in full charge of the store today. I'll spend the morning at home organizing the Hangzhou notes.” Before leaving, she used her phone to take pictures of the sample tag information and sent them to herself.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: In-depth review of Hangzhou notes
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear. She spread out the more than ten pages of notes from the Hangzhou trip on the table, with red, yellow, and blue highlighters at hand. Reading page by page, she marked in red “can implement immediately” (e.g., community warm-up, price confirmation), in yellow “needs learning” (e.g., advanced transitions in CapCut), and in blue “set aside for now” (e.g., livestreaming). She circled the two points that Zheng Kai and Zhao Min both emphasized—“start with communities of regular and familiar customers” and “build trust with real outfits.” She wrote these two ideas on sticky notes and put them on the wall directly in front of the desk. After that, she opened the CapCut app, created a new project called “Vlog-2025 Hangzhou Trip,” imported the footage, and prepared for the afternoon editing practice.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 4, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Lujiang Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and a short rest
description: She cooked herself the leftover misua noodle soup from yesterday in the fridge, adding greens and a fried egg. While eating, she replied to messages in a few VIP groups, announcing that sample details would officially go live tomorrow. After the meal, she washed the dishes and took a 15-minute nap on the sofa to relieve the soreness in her lower back.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 4, Residential Community No. 82 Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Setbacks and adjustments in learning video editing
description: After the lunch break, she officially began editing practice. She tried to splice together a 30-second travel vlog, but the beat alignment was off and the transitions were stiff. An hour later, looking at the messy timeline, a wave of irritation surged over her. 'No matter how I practice, I can't get it right!' She angrily threw down her stylus. After a moment of silence, she took a deep breath, picked up the pen, and decided to set the vlog aside for now and instead practice making a two-photo page-flip video using 'cross dissolve' transitions. This time she succeeded, and a small sense of achievement diluted the frustration.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 4, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Lujiang Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out for a walk, depositing business revenue at the bank, and visiting the fabric market
description: Decided to go out for some air and walked to Jiaxingyuan Park for a half-hour stroll. At 15:00, sitting on a park bench, she called Zheng Kai on WeChat voice: 'Brother Zheng, the samples have arrived! Velvet blazer in M, wide-leg pants in S, wholesale prices 280 yuan and 185 yuan, right? Checked and no problem; tomorrow I'll warm up the group.' After confirming, she walked to the Qianpu ICBC branch (about 15 minutes) and deposited part of yesterday's store revenue into the corporate account. After leaving the bank, she stopped by a nearby fabric and accessories shop for inspiration for making some small matching items later.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bought dinner ingredients and prepared for the community warm-up
description: Around 16:00, after leaving the bank, she stopped by Xiashang Minxing Supermarket on Zhenhai Road to buy ingredients for dinner: a box of cherry tomatoes, a pack of bean sprouts, and a bag of whole-wheat steamed buns. She planned to make bean sprout soup with the pork rib soup she had at home. After returning home and tidying up briefly, she opened WeChat and started editing the "sample product warm-up script" to send in the group the next day. While writing, she muttered to herself: "Be sincere, not too much like an ad... Just write, 'Brother Zheng's designer friend, I picked these myself. Sisters, take a look.'"
location: Kitchen of Room 502, Building 4, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter from school and family dinner
description: At 17:30, she walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on time. Chen Lexuan excitedly showed off the clay 'Mom version of Xiao Jing' she had made today. On the way home, mother and daughter each had a banana as an afternoon snack. When they got home, her husband had already gotten off work and was cooking bean sprout soup in the kitchen. The family had dinner together: whole wheat steamed buns, pork rib and bean sprout soup, and marinated eggs. After dinner, Yajing helped her daughter decorate the clay 'Mom' with colorful sequins and stickers.
location: Room 502, Building 4, Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night family meeting: the couple works together to finalize the transformation strategy.
description: After dinner, Yajing played with her daughter, decorating a clay “Mom” with colorful sequins and stickers, then put her daughter to sleep around 20:30. Afterwards, she sat down facing her husband in the bedroom and spread out the notes she had organized during the day: “A Qiang, let's take it step by step. Tomorrow we'll first warm up the pre-sale in the group chat. You can help me pick music for the short video, and I'll shoot the real outfits.” Chen Zhiqiang read the plan carefully and nodded in support: “Okay, this weekend I'll help you explore CapCut's advanced features.” The two also checked SM City Plaza on a map app and had a preliminary discussion about where to pick a gift for their January 15 wedding anniversary, but made no purchase decision.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 4, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime routine: wash up, pray, write in journal
description: After finishing the discussion, I washed up and changed into pajamas. Walking to the nightstand, I held the cross and said evening prayer: "Lord, thank You for helping me sort out my thoughts today and for not giving up during the editing setbacks. Grant me the courage and peace to act tomorrow." Then I opened my journal and recorded today's key matters: 1. Finished organizing notes; thoughts are clear. 2. Sample prices confirmed. 3. First editing experience—difficult but didn't give up. 4. Clear division of work with A Qiang, feeling grounded. Finally, I turned off the lights and went to bed before 22:30.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 4, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, preparing breakfast, and getting ready to take daughter to school.
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. After getting up, Song Yajing found that her lower back still ached. She cooked thin noodle soup for her daughter Xuanxuan, adding a poached egg and greens. At 7:20, she woke her daughter, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and braided her hair. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also got up and prepared for work, and the two briefly discussed the day's plans.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and buy stationery on the way
description: Song Yajing walked out holding her daughter’s hand and walked to the Chenguang Stationery Store at Phase 2, Yubin City, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, fulfilling her promise and letting Xuanxuan pick a box of 24-color watercolor pens. Then she rode an electric bike with her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, and after a brief exchange with the teacher at the school gate, she said goodbye.
location: From the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, passing Chenguang Stationery Store at No. 35 Park South Road, and arriving at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal breakfast and commute.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing rode her electric bike along Hubin South Road and picked up a takeout of preserved egg and lean pork congee and a fried dough stick from her usual Ajie Porridge Shop. Then she rode about 10 minutes to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and entered her own store, Yajing Lifestyle Store.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: from No. 123 Gucheng West Road, passing Ajie Congee Shop on Hubin South Road, to Yajing Lifestyle Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Opening preparations and log review
description: After arriving at the shop, Song Yajing turned on the lights and air conditioning, and used a duster to clean the shelves and the floor. She sat behind the cash register, eating preserved egg and lean pork congee while reviewing yesterday's handover notes from shop assistant Xiaomei, and confirmed that Zheng Kai's sample shipment had been updated to "Arrived at Xiamen Distribution Center." At exactly 9 o'clock, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, and Song Yajing assigned the key tasks for today: fully support sample photography and community warm-up.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-production preparation for sample photo shooting and copywriting
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing wrote the title and description for the community warm-up post in her phone's memo app, carefully polishing the wording. Xiaomei, meanwhile, tidied the fitting room, checked the reflector, phone stand, and power bank, and moved the white background cloth and clothes rack to the best-lit spot by the window to wait for the samples to arrive.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sign for and quality-check samples.
description: Just after 10 o'clock, the courier delivered the package. Song Yajing and Xiaomei opened it together and took out three new items: a French balloon dress, a heavily embroidered shirt, and a knit vest + wide-leg pants set. She carefully inspected the stitching, zippers, buttons, and fabric texture of each garment. In natural light, she confirmed there were no snags or color differences and verified the quality was excellent.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take photos of the samples from multiple angles
description: Taking advantage of the best natural light in the morning, Song Yajing had Xiaomei hold a reflector while she used her phone to take flat-lay photos, hanging shots, and close-ups of details such as the collar embroidery, hem stitching, and button material. She took more than 15 photos of each garment, striving to capture the beauty of the clothes.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and simple photo editing
description: At noon, Song Yajing ordered a bowl of satay noodles on her phone, and Xiaomei bought back oyster omelets and misua soup. During the meal break, Song Yajing used Meitu Xiuxiu to select the 9 most satisfying photos, uniformly adjusted brightness and contrast, and added a warm-tone filter and the shop's logo watermark.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Published a teaser push to the community group
description: At 12:30, Song Yajing sent a nine-grid photo and carefully edited text to the "Yajing Life Gallery" WeChat group: "Sisters, these are the new spring styles sent by my designer friend from Hangzhou. Take a look and see which one you like? If there are enough people, Yajing will negotiate a discount for everyone~" The group immediately became lively. Regular customer "Vivian" asked about the fabric and price and reserved a vest set; "Lili's Mom" asked whether the bellflower dress came in a plus size. She replied while taking notes in her notebook, feeling both excited and nervous.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community interaction and receiving walk-in customers
description: Song Yajing replied to group messages and private messages on her phone, answering questions about sizes, fabrics, and pre-sale times, while also receiving walk-in customers who came in to buy winter clothing. Xiaomei helped pass clothes and tidy up tried-on items. In the midst of the busy work, her lower back discomfort worsened. She leaned against the cash register, drank warm water and rested for a while, and ate a piece of chocolate to comfort herself.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Track interested parties and follow up privately
description: In the afternoon, as the number of customers decreased, Song Yajing compiled the information of interested customers into a note on her phone and sent private messages to regulars such as Vivian and Lili's Mom about the expected pre-sale discount and arrival time (around next weekend). Vivian replied, "Reserve two sets for me—I want both the spring and summer ones!" Excitedly, she marked it "Locked in."
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidying the shop and taking a short rest
description: Song Yajing tidied the fitting room, hung the popular sample styles in prominent positions, and used the store phone to order two cups of hot pearl milk tea to treat herself and Xiaomei. She sat at the cashier counter, rubbing her waist while drinking the milk tea, and relaxed a little.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school
description: After letting Xiao Mei leave work on time, Song Yajing carefully closed the doors and windows, checked the power, and neatly folded the three samples into a tote bag. She rode an electric bike for 15 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and picked up her daughter Xuanxuan, who had been waiting in after-school care.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: from No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road.

name: Buying fruit on the way home.
description: Song Yajing rode with Xuanxuan on her scooter and stopped at the “Old Wang Fruit” shop near their home on Hubin South Road. Xuanxuan chose strawberries and ponkan oranges. Chatting and laughing, the mother and daughter returned to their home in the No. 82 community on Shanggu Street five minutes later.
location: Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province; passing by No. 55 Gugong Road, Lao Wang Fruit Shop; destination: the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner
description: After getting home, Song Yajing quickly made a pot of seafood noodles with clams, shrimp, and greens, topped with fried eggs. The mother and daughter chatted while eating. Xuanxuan talked about painting with new watercolor pens at kindergarten, and Song Yajing shared how the mothers in the group liked the new clothes.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and getting daughter to sleep
description: After dinner, Song Yajing played house with Xuanxuan, gave her a bath and changed her into pajamas, and together they lay in bed reading the picture book "Guess How Much I Love You". Xuanxuan fell asleep quickly, and Song Yajing kissed her forehead.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing the joy of work with her husband
description: When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from overtime, Song Yajing excitedly held up the three samples to show him, reporting on the group's lively activity that day: 12 sisters had confirmed their orders, and Vivian had reserved two sets. Her husband happily massaged her sore shoulders, promised to help film short videos on the weekend, and planned to go with her next week to learn tips from a store-reviewing influencer.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple chatting and relaxing before bed.
description: The two leaned against the headboard, and her husband opened his phone to show Song Yajing selected short videos of store-visit outfit ideas; she took notes while watching. They also talked about Xuanxuan's interest classes next semester and the plan to go to Gulangyu Island for next week's family day.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up, relaxing, and going to bed
description: Song Yajing took a shower, used hot water on her lower back to relieve soreness, drank a large glass of warm milk, and got into bed. Reflecting on the day, she felt tired but full of a sense of groundedness and accomplishment. She set the alarm for the next day and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and taking care of daughter
description: When the alarm went off, Song Yajing got up quietly without waking her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She first went to the bathroom to wash up, checked her complexion, and reminded herself to watch her diet while brushing her teeth. Then she changed into the oatmeal-colored knit sweater and dark blue straight-leg jeans from her own store. Then she gently pushed open the door to her daughter Chen Lexuan's room; her daughter was already half awake. She kissed her daughter's forehead, helped her put on a fleece-lined base layer top and skirt, and while braiding her hair told her there was a special arrangement tonight and Aunt Zhang would come to keep her company. She checked her daughter's backpack and pickup card to make sure everything was in order.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took my daughter to school and went home for breakfast
description: Song Yajing held her daughter Chen Lexuan's hand and walked about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She briefly talked with the teacher at the gate about her daughter's situation at the kindergarten, confirmed that her daughter was emotionally stable, and watched her go into the classroom. As she turned, she used her phone to photograph the morning light at the kindergarten gate, posted it on WeChat Moments visible only to herself, and then walked home. At home, she heated skim milk in the microwave, had whole-wheat bread and a boiled egg as a light meal, and while eating she scrolled through her phone to check customer updates in the community group, encouraging herself to finish the shirt order.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Rode an electric bike to the clothing store
description: Song Yajing got on her small electric bike, rode along Zhenhai Road for about 12 minutes, and headed to her store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The morning air was fresh, sunlight sprinkled down through the roadside trees, and she felt relaxed and full of anticipation for the new day.
location: Along the route from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Store opening preparations and morning business
description: Song Yajing arrived at the shop, opened the door to air it out, turned on the lights and played cheerful music on the sound system, then cleaned the floor, fitting room, and entrance. She re-styled the newly arrived spring samples and displayed them on a mannequin in a prominent spot. From the storage room she found the small lantern her daughter had made, and carefully hung it on the decorative wall by the main fitting room to add a festive New Year touch. At 10 a.m., part-time clerk Xiaomei arrived and took over greeting customers, while Song Yajing focused on community group operations: she contacted hesitant customers again, sent outfit photos of the shirts and size suggestions, and won them over with warm copy. About 20 minutes later, the customer confirmed the order and transferred the deposit; Song Yajing happily recorded it in the order notebook. She then organized the pre-sale orders of regular customers such as Vivian into a list and checked them one by one. She also photographed the lanterns in the shop and sent the photo to the customer group, wishing everyone prosperity, and received likes. When Xiaomei took care of walk-in customers, Song Yajing occasionally stood up to offer styling advice.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break
description: Song Yajing ordered takeout light salad, including chicken breast, lettuce, corn kernels, and cherry tomatoes. She brought it to the store's rest area and, while eating, scrolled through short videos by fashion bloggers to learn lighting techniques and high-end filters. She saved two filters she liked.
location: In-store rest area, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business operations and order processing.
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers in the store. Xiaomei proactively solicited customers at the entrance, while Song Yajing organized the pre-sale order details into an Excel spreadsheet behind the counter and sent it via WeChat to supplier Susan to confirm stocking and delivery times. A young female customer asked for styling advice with a dress; Song Yajing recommended a wool cardigan and encouraged her to try it on. In the end, the customer was satisfied and bought two items. At 3 p.m., she felt sore in her lower back, so she sat on a chair next to the fitting room to rest for 15 minutes, drinking warm water from her thermos.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop early and put away the lanterns.
description: Song Yajing decided to close early. She first explained to Xiaomei the display priorities for tomorrow's new arrivals, and asked Xiaomei to tidy up and put away the clothes that had been tried on. After checking the accounts, she locked the cash register. Before leaving, she deliberately took down the small lantern from the wall and gently placed it in a canvas bag to take home.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, wash up, change clothes, and get ready
description: Song Yajing rode her electric scooter home in about 12 minutes. She washed her hands upon entering, then opened the oven and put the butter cookies baked last night into a pretty glass jar. Then she took a quick shower, changed into the deep red fitted dress she had specially prepared for tonight, and put on light, elegant makeup, getting ready for the anniversary dinner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and take her to the neighbor's house.
description: Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving a few minutes early and joining the front of the pick-up queue. After picking up her daughter Chen Lexuan, she told her they would go to Grandma Zhang's house to play first. When they reached the downstairs of their building, they knocked on Auntie Zhang's door in the neighboring unit, carrying that jar of cookies. Song Yajing thanked her repeatedly and said she would come back around 8:30 p.m. to pick up her daughter, who greeted Auntie Zhang politely. Auntie Zhang warmly took her daughter inside, and Song Yajing left at ease after watching them enter.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Aunt Zhang's home at Compound 82, Shanggu Street

name: Waiting for her husband and receiving an anniversary gift.
description: Song Yajing waited downstairs for a few minutes, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang drove back. He had deliberately washed the car, and the inside was very tidy. After Song Yajing sat in the passenger seat, Chen Zhiqiang handed her a small box and said with a smile, Happy anniversary. She opened it and found a pair of simple pearl earrings, exactly the style she liked, and felt sweet in her heart. The two chatted in the car for a few minutes before getting ready to leave.
location: Downstairs at home, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive to the restaurant and enjoy the wedding anniversary dinner
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove through the evening rush-hour traffic, heading along Lujiang Road for about 15 minutes to reach the Lujiang Impression Western Restaurant. Soft music played in the car along the way, and Song Yajing wore her new earrings, feeling delightful. Through the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, Gulangyu Island's brilliant lights sparkled, creating a wonderful atmosphere. Chen Zhiqiang ordered red wine, and the two enjoyed Wellington steak while recalling the clumsy details of their first date at a Western restaurant when they were dating, laughing together. Song Yajing shared the pressure of transforming her community, and Chen Zhiqiang earnestly said he would support her no matter the outcome, and that she had him as the family's solid backing. Song Yajing's nose tingled, and she raised her glass to thank her husband.
location: Lujiang Impression Western Restaurant, Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Seaside stroll along Lujiang Road.
description: After dinner, the two didn't rush home; they strolled slowly along the seaside boardwalk outside the restaurant. The evening breeze was slightly cool, their fingers intertwined. Chen Zhiqiang shared work anecdotes, while Song Yajing discussed with him the idea of shooting a short video over the weekend. Slightly tipsy, they felt especially at peace.
location: Lujiang Road Seafront Boardwalk, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Drive home and pick up her daughter.
description: After their walk, the two drove home. Traffic had thinned on the way back, so Chen Zhiqiang drove more steadily. While waiting at a red light, he held his wife's hand, and they smiled at each other. About 20 minutes later, when they got home, they walked together to Aunt Zhang's door. Their daughter was already sleepy and sat on the sofa rubbing her eyes. Song Yajing picked up her daughter, thanked Aunt Zhang again, and kissed her daughter's forehead as the girl murmured "Mommy," then handed her to her husband.
location: Lujiang Road and Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Put daughter to bed and talk with husband.
description: After getting home, Chen Zhiqiang first helped their daughter change into pajamas, while Song Yajing told her a short bedtime story until she fell sound asleep; then the two quietly closed the door. Back in the living room, Song Yajing opened the can of cookies, made two cups of hot tea, and leaned on the sofa with Chen Zhiqiang to talk about how they felt that evening. Chen Zhiqiang showed her the photos he had taken, and she remarked how rare and precious this time alone together was.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal care.
description: Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup and took a hot shower, letting the steam from the hot water dispel the day’s fatigue. After showering, she carefully applied a hydrating and moisturizing mask, then used a massager to massage her waist, which felt the most sore, and relaxed her body.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Lying in bed, her body was tired but her mind was calm and content. Song Yajing picked up the Harper’s Bazaar magazine on the nightstand and flipped through a few pages, feeling that this anniversary had been especially perfect. Before falling asleep, she silently prayed, thanking God for all the wonderful people and things today, then turned off the light and prepared to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up early to prepare breakfast, have breakfast with my daughter, and take her to school.
description: At 7:00 in the morning, Yajing quietly got up to prepare breakfast. She cooked small wontons and heated milk, then woke up her 5-year-old daughter Xuanxuan, helped her get dressed, and tied her hair into a ponytail. The mother and daughter had breakfast together at the table, and Xuanxuan excitedly shared stories about painting at kindergarten the day before. At 7:45, Yajing helped her daughter put on a light jacket and walked with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After arriving, she told her daughter to be obedient and drink plenty of water, and watched her walk into the classroom. After dropping off her daughter, Yajing bought a new box of colored pens for Xuanxuan at the stationery store on Park South Road near the kindergarten.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District: home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), and the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road (Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road).

name: Returned home, tidied up briefly, and prepared to go out.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing walked home along the old street and bought soy milk and tea eggs from the bun shop at the entrance of the residential complex to take away as breakfast. After getting home, she quickly finished breakfast, changed into a carefully chosen thin knit cardigan over a white shirt, touched up her makeup in the mirror, put on pearl earrings, checked her phone and keys, and left cheerfully.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the shop on an electric bike.
description: Yajing got on her electric bike, put on her helmet, and followed her familiar route to Zhongshan Road. Under the morning light, the arcade street was getting busier. As she rode, she ran through the day's priorities in her head. About 10 minutes later she arrived at the store and parked the bike in the charging area.
location: In Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, on the way from the No. 82 community on Shanggu Street to Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Arriving at the store to tidy up the storefront and check inventory.
description: Yajing rolled up the store's security shutter on time, opened the windows for ventilation, wiped the counter and display shelves, and carefully adjusted the mannequin's outfit in the window. Then she took out the accounting book and, against the inventory records on her phone, counted the slow-moving winter styles and marked the ones for post-New Year discount promotions, while also calculating cash flow before the New Year. After shop assistant Xiaomei arrived at 9:15, the two sorted the goods that had arrived the day before.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking product photos, retouching images, and confirming sample garment details with the supplier
description: In the morning, with light foot traffic, Yajing focused on online pre-sale work. She took the floral chiffon shirt and slim-leg trousers samples sent by Hangzhou supplier Zheng Kai to the bright doorway of the store, photographed details from multiple angles with her phone, adjusted colors in a photo editing app, and added the copy Yajing's Selection First Pre-sale. Then she had a voice call with Zheng Kai on WeChat to confirm fabric composition, stock quantities for five sizes, wholesale base prices, and drop-shipping logistics details, finally finalizing all pre-sale arrangements.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: At noon, shop assistant Xiaomei went out to eat, and Yajing tended the store alone. She ordered a light salad for delivery and, while eating quinoa chicken breast salad in the shop, scrolled through Xiaohongshu, browsing popular spring outfit bloggers and saving two outfit ideas. After lunch, she leaned back in the rattan chair and rested with her eyes closed for about 15 minutes to relieve lower back fatigue.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and online pre-sale announcement
description: In the afternoon, groups of girls came into the store one after another. Yajing received them warmly, helped recommend outfits, and successfully sold one pair of jeans and one sweater. During lulls between customers, she edited her Moments post and group announcement, and at exactly 3 p.m. published the pre-sale notice in the Yajing Lifestyle Store WeChat group, emphasizing designer-brand exclusives, limited quantities, the group purchase officially opens tomorrow at 8 p.m., and attached the retouched nine-grid photo. People in the group immediately asked about sizes and colors, and Yajing patiently replied to each one, feeling both excited and nervous inside.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle family insurance renewal communications and shop insurance consultation
description: During an afternoon break, Yajing saw a renewal notice for the family comprehensive insurance in her mobile email. She took a screenshot and sent it to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, discussing on WeChat whether to renew. Her husband replied, 'Coverage can't be interrupted; you decide.' Later, Yajing remembered the issue of insurance for the store's merchandise, so she called her close friend Wang Jia, a product manager in Shenzhen. They chatted on WeChat voice for more than ten minutes. After reading the terms carefully, Wang Jia pointed out that 'non-residential ancillary property is not covered' and suggested separately consulting about commercial insurance for the store. Yajing decided to go home that evening and pay the family premium first, and consult about the store insurance separately.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close up the shop, tidy up, and go to the kindergarten to pick up my daughter
description: As it got dark, Yajing and the shop assistant Xiaomei together sorted the tried-on clothes, cleaned up, and checked the day's accounts. After locking the shop door, she rode her electric bike to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she made a brief call to her mother, mentioning that her sister would come on the weekend. When she reached the kindergarten gate, she saw her husband Chen Zhiqiang's car parked by the roadside. The two smiled at each other and waited together for their daughter to get out of school.
location: On the way from Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter and preparing dinner.
description: When her daughter Xuanxuan saw both parents coming to pick her up, she excitedly rushed over. The family of three drove home. Once home, her husband played with blocks with their daughter in the living room while Yajing put on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She quickly made stir-fried broccoli and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and reheated the braised pork ribs her mother had sent over earlier. During this, she asked her husband to find the family savings card from the cabinet, in preparation for paying the insurance after dinner.
location: Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province: on the way from Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road) to the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community, and at home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community.

name: Family dinner, paying insurance, and accompanying daughter
description: The family sat around the dinner table together. Yajing showed her husband screenshots of the insurance terms and relayed her close friend Wang Jia's reminder. Her husband agreed to renew the policy first and to consult separately about the store insurance next week. After dinner, Yajing paid 5,800 yuan for the comprehensive family insurance using her banking app in the living room. After a brief network lag, the payment succeeded. She took a screenshot, sent it to her husband, and added the note "Done."
