Then Yajing played a role-playing game with her daughter, pretending to be a shopkeeper and a customer dressing up a doll's clothes. Her daughter had a great time.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Confirm weekend plans with older sister Song Yawen.
description: Yajing received a screenshot of the high-speed rail ticket from her older sister Song Yawen, showing that she would arrive at Xiamen North Station at 1:45 p.m. on January 18, on train G1602. She immediately called her back via WeChat voice, and the sisters chatted for more than ten minutes. They agreed to go to Zhongshan Road together on the weekend to buy spring clothes for Xuanxuan. Her sister also said she had brought gifts for them from Shenzhen. After hanging up, Yajing noted the plan in her phone calendar and felt warmth in her heart.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and bedtime relaxation.
description: Yajing took a hot shower to wash away her fatigue, put on a facial mask, and leaned against the headboard to open Xiaohongshu. She browsed for more than twenty minutes through spring outfit ideas and no-bake tiramisu recipes. She saved an improved recipe, planning to make it herself when her mother came. After removing the mask and completing her nighttime skincare routine, she gradually relaxed both body and mind.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep review and preparing for bed.
description: Yajing turned off her phone and closed her eyes to review the day: the online presale had a good start and the group response was positive; the family insurance was renewed smoothly; her sister would visit on the weekend. Though her body felt slightly tired, her heart was full and grounded. She quietly prayed in gratitude and slowly drifted into sleep in the stillness.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up and preparing the family for the day
description: Got up after the alarm clock rang. Because of tonight's online presale event, she felt both nervous and full of anticipation. After quickly washing up, she prepared a nutritious breakfast for her daughter Xuanxuan—her favorite tomato and egg noodles with milk. She gently woke her up, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and tied her pigtails.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Left on foot at 07:40 and arrived at the kindergarten about 10 minutes later. A fine drizzle was falling from the sky today, but Xuanxuan was still very happy because her aunt was coming tomorrow. I told her to listen to the teacher obediently and only left after watching her walk into the teaching building.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and breakfast
description: 07:55 Walked from the kindergarten to the shop on Zhongshan Road, about 15 minutes. 08:10 On the way, stopped by Huang Zehe Peanut Soup Shop (main store on Zhongshan Road) and got a peanut soup and a chive pie to go for breakfast. 08:20 Arrived at the shop, unlocked the door, turned on the lights, put down my things, and sat at the counter enjoying breakfast while scanning the store displays and planning the day's work.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store morning preparation.
description: After breakfast, she began to tidy up the bar counter and check the cashier system. Then she opened the WeChat group “Yajing Life Studio” on her phone. Seeing many expectant replies under the notice posted last night, she took a deep breath and encouraged herself: “Tonight I'll show them.” Then she started ironing the samples.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sale sample photography and material preparation.
description: At 09:00, after Xiaomei arrived at the store, the two began their core preparations. Xiaomei was responsible for carefully ironing the sample floral chiffon blouse and cigarette trousers featured for tonight. Yajing used a ring light and her phone to repeatedly take close-up shots of details such as the lace collar and fabric texture. At the same time, she opened the memo app on her phone and, based on the information confirmed with supplier Zheng Kai, wrote out word for word a complete product description including the size chart, fabric composition (100% polyester / 97% cotton + 3% spandex), washing suggestions, and pre-sale rules (deposit 50 yuan, shipping in 7–10 days).
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and discussion
description: Because it was raining and she didn't want to go far, Yajing ordered two portions of Yuehua satay noodles (with tofu and squid) for delivery on the Ele.me mini-program. As they ate, the two rehearsed the opening introduction for 8 p.m. Being a young person, Xiaomei made some interesting colloquial suggestions, which Yajing found very helpful.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and community traffic generation
description: In the afternoon, the rain gradually lightened and customer traffic increased. Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work, one at the cash register and one at the door attracting customers. A college couple visiting Xiamen came into the store, and the girl couldn't put down a knit cardigan. Yajing seized the opportunity to recommend it and invited her to scan the QR code to join the pre-sale group; the girl readily joined. She squeezed in time to organize the pre-sale information into illustrated notes and repeatedly checked the links.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handled the electronic insurance policy
description: At 15:10, she received a text message from Ping An Insurance. She opened her email, downloaded the electronic policy PDF, and carefully checked the policyholder, the insured, the coverage type (home property and business liability insurance), the coverage period (2025.01.17-2026.01.17), and the premium (5800 yuan). After confirming everything was correct, she breathed a sigh of relief. She then uploaded the file to Baidu Cloud Drive and WeChat Favorites as a double backup, and sent a screenshot to her husband Chen Zhiqiang.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Continued operations and final packaging of materials
description: Customer flow was steady in the afternoon. Yajing attended to customers while preparing six standard replies in her memo for possible questions. At 17:00, she and Xiao Mei packaged all photos and materials into a folder named '20250117 pre-sale package' and sent it to the WeChat File Transfer Assistant and the computer, making absolutely sure nothing was lost.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store closing up and handover.
description: As it grew dark, the two of them put the fitting-room clothes back in place and wiped down the display counters. Yajing instructed Xiaomei that if any customers asked about pre-sale tomorrow, she should guide them to check the records, and also told her to retrieve the spare key after opening the store normally at 09:30 tomorrow.
location: "Yajing Life Gallery", No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home and dinner.
description: After closing at 17:45, Yajing asked her husband Chen Zhiqiang to pick up their daughter, and she walked home herself. On the way, she ordered a takeaway portion of classic shacha noodles (with squid and dried tofu) from Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop (Zhongshan Road branch) for dinner. It took about 2 minutes to walk from the store to the noodle shop, and about 18 minutes from the noodle shop to home. She got home at 18:15. She simply heated up the noodles and chatted with Chen Zhiqiang, who was accompanying Xuanxuan in reading a picture book, about the day's preparations.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and family collaboration.
description: After a quick dinner, Yajing played a role-playing game of 'running a clothing store' with Xuanxuan for a while. She showed her photos of sample dresses, and Xuanxuan said happily, 'Mommy's clothes are so beautiful, just like a princess!' At 19:00, Chen Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan to wash up on time, while Yajing went to the study for final preparations.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final fine-tuning and community warm-up before the pre-sale
description: Alone in the study, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, keeping only the "Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion" group notifications. She checked the home WiFi, opened the pre-sale link preview page, and tested the loading speed of each image one by one. She sent a "last 10 minute countdown" voice message in the group, with three nervous and cute stickers. Several people in the group immediately replied, "Looking forward to it! Online and waiting."
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Official pre-sale launch with real-time customer responses.
description: At exactly 20:00, she posted the pre-sale graphic link and a mini-program card with "Free shipping insurance for the first 10 orders" in the "Yajing Life Studio" group. The group instantly became lively. She stayed anxiously in front of her phone, typing quickly and replying to questions one by one such as "Do the sizes run big or small?", "Is the chiffon see-through?", and "Will it arrive before Chinese New Year?", while also handling private messages from several regular customers. It was not until 22:00 that the group messages gradually subsided.
location: Home study/living room, Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recorded orders and confirmed with customers via private messages
description: About two hours after launching the group buy, a total of 7 orders had been received (2 more than expected). She took out her special pre-sale record book and neatly wrote down each customer's nickname, style, size, color, and address. Then she sent each customer a private message to confirm the details one by one, along with a note of thanks. When she saw that regular customer Vivian had ordered two items and said, “I recommended it to my colleagues,” a wave of warmth rose in her heart.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Review the past and plan for the future with her husband.
description: After putting Xuanxuan to sleep, Chen Zhiqiang came to the living room and saw Yajing hugging her notebook and giggling. She excitedly handed it to him. Chen Zhiqiang read it carefully, smiled, and patted her head, saying, “The first step is taken—great! Better than I imagined.” The two curled up on the sofa for a quick review. Yajing mentioned that a customer had asked, “Is there a video showing how it looks on?” Chen Zhiqiang suggested, “Tomorrow is perfect—when my sister comes, after we pick out kids' clothes on Zhongshan Road, I can help you shoot a few short videos in the store with a phone stand, focusing on sizing and outfit matching. That will definitely be better than just looking at photos.” Yajing thought this was a great idea and nodded repeatedly.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and browsing information.
description: After washing up, she lay in bed. Her heart was still beating a bit fast, but she felt a deep sense of reassurance. Thinking that her sister Song Yawen would arrive tomorrow afternoon and that they might talk about Xuanxuan's schooling, she couldn't help picking up her phone and searching for "Siming District 2025 primary school enrollment policy" on a local forum. She skimmed through posts about school catchment areas and registration discussions, and her anxiety was temporarily eased. With satisfaction over tonight's results and anticipation for tomorrow's reunion, she smiled and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning care
description: At 8 a.m., Song Yajing woke from a sleepless night. Looking at her daughter Chen Lexuan sleeping soundly beside her, feelings of tenderness and guilt welled up in her heart. She leaned over and kissed her daughter's forehead, tucking in the corner of the blanket. Then she went into the bathroom, washed her face with cold water, tied her hair up simply, and changed into comfortable loungewear, trying to shake off the exhaustion of a night without sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast and planning tomorrow's school visit
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang had already cooked millet porridge and fried a fried egg. While having breakfast with Chen Zhiqiang on the living room sofa, Yajing opened her laptop and visited the official websites of Siming District Experimental Primary School and the Primary School Affiliated to Foreign Languages to confirm the schedule for tomorrow's Parents' Open Day: the Experimental Primary School from 9:00-11:00, and the Foreign Language School from 14:00-16:00. The two used a mobile map to simulate tomorrow's driving route, planning to set off at 8 a.m. Yajing wrote down the questions she wanted to ask on a sticky note: class size, whether there were midday care and extended-hour services, and requirements for household registration duration. Her heart felt heavy.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commuting to the store
description: Yajing changed into a neat knit top and jeans, picked up her e-bike keys, rode her white electric scooter along familiar streets through the morning breeze, and arrived at the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street at 9:20 sharp.
location: On the way from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the "Yajing Lifestyle Gallery" at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Go to the shop to handle pre-sale orders and update the community.
description: The shop assistant Xiaomei had already opened the door and was cleaning. Yajing entered the 5 Weini orders she had recorded in the pre-sale notebook last night into a computer Excel spreadsheet one by one, including customer WeChat nickname, style, size, color, address, and pickup method notes. She sent the spreadsheet to Hangzhou supplier Zheng Kai via WeChat with the message: "Brother Kai, these are last night's pre-sale orders. Five need to be drop-shipped from Hangzhou; please arrange to send them out today. You can ignore the ones marked 'self-pickup' in the spreadsheet. Thanks!" Then she and Xiaomei found the matching dust bags and packaging bags to prepare for customers who might come to the store for self-pickup. Around 10:30, she posted a carefully edited message in the customer group: "Thank you, ladies, for your enthusiastic support last night! The pre-sale has concluded successfully. After the New Year, another wave of spring new arrivals will arrive at the store. The group will get first choice then, so stay tuned~" Along with a polished photo snapped casually on her new phone, a few regular customers in the group immediately responded enthusiastically.
location: Yajing Life Gallery, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Light lunch
description: After handling the store's affairs, Yajing found a Shaye Light Food branch on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, ordered a signature chicken salad and a hot Americano, and sat in a corner to eat quickly. During lunch, she sent a WeChat message to her sister Song Yawen: 'Sis, I'll set off for the North Station to pick you up as soon as I finish eating. Take care on the way.'
location: Shaye Light Food (Zhongshan Road Branch), Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove to Xiamen North Railway Station.
description: Yajing parked her electric bike at the store entrance and switched to the family's white Toyota Corolla. She contacted her older sister via car Bluetooth and told her she expected to arrive by 12:45. Her sister asked her to drive slowly and said she would wait at the exit, and suggested going to Zhongshan Road in the afternoon to buy clothes for Xuanxuan. Yajing drove via Chenggong Avenue, Haicang Bridge, and Shenhai Expressway toward Xiamen North Railway Station.
location: En route from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Xiamen North Station, Jimei District, Xiamen.

name: Pick up older sister and exchange greetings
description: Yajing parked the car in the underground parking lot and walked to the arrival exit. After waiting about 10 minutes, she saw her older sister Song Yawen walking out with a carry-on suitcase. The sisters warmly linked arms. Song Yawen looked her younger sister up and down, said she looked better but her eyes were red. Yajing gave a wry smile and admitted that she had been unable to sleep last night.
location: Exit hall, Xiamen North Railway Station, No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove back into the city
description: The two sisters drove back to the city. On the way, Song Yawen shared updates on Shenzhen's foreign trade market recovering, though customers were becoming more demanding about quality. Yajing talked about her online pre-sale progress, which was going more smoothly than she had expected—she had received 5 orders last night, so she was on the right track. Her sister encouraged her to combine online and offline sales, which was better than just staying in the shop, and it opened up her thinking.
location: On the way from Xiamen North Station in Jimei District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street in Siming District.

name: Selecting spring clothes for her niece
description: The two parked the car in the Zhongshan Road parking lot and began choosing spring clothes for Xuanxuan on the pedestrian street. They browsed brand stores such as ABC KIDS and Pepco. At the budget children's clothing store, Song Yawen picked up a bright yellow hoodie, while Yajing took a fancy to a pair of denim overalls with a cartoon pattern. At the Balabala children's clothing store, her sister pointed at a pink trench coat and said the material was good and suitable for spring. In the end, Yajing bought the pink trench coat and the overalls. At checkout, her sister casually mentioned the case of a supervisor at her company who sold their house and bought another one in a better school district, reminding Yajing that Xuanxuan would soon be starting elementary school and she needed to plan early, as competition for good schools in Siming District was fierce. Yajing's hand holding the card paused, her mood suddenly became heavy, and thinking that she was going to visit the school tomorrow, she felt even more unsettled.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (stores such as ABC Children's Wear and Balabala Children's Wear).

name: Chatting with girlfriends at a drink shop
description: Tired from shopping, the two walked into the Fangniuban tea shop on the first floor of Zhonghua City. Each ordered a cup of the signature fruit tea and sat by the window to rest. The older sister brought up Shenzhen's high-pressure education environment and examples of clients selling their homes to buy school district housing. Yajing listened, her anxiety growing, and couldn't help sighing. 'Sis, I know all that in my heart, but when I think of having to raise so much money, and Xuanxuan being so young and having to fight for a spot...' Her sister patted her hand and comforted her, 'Don't rush. We're just learning about it early to have a better sense of things. Tomorrow is the open day—go and listen first. We can discuss it when you get back. There will always be a way.'
location: Fangniuban (Zhonghua City Store), Plot a1, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home.
description: The two left the tea shop. Yajing was driving, feeling a little heavy-hearted. She no longer brought up the topic of Xuanxuan's schooling on her own, only making small talk with her sister about the street scenes outside the window.
location: En route from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District.

name: Returned home to rest and prepare dinner.
description: After arriving home, Yajing settled her sister in the guest bedroom and gave her a set of clean pajamas to change into. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang poked his head out of the kitchen to say hello and said that today he had specially made her sister's favorite stir-fried Chinese broccoli and ginger duck. Yajing went into the kitchen to help, washed some fruit, and brought it out for her sister.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: At the dinner table, Chen Zhiqiang had a small glass of beer with Song Yawen and chatted about recent funny stories in the IT industry and what he had seen in Shenzhen. Yajing listened quietly, occasionally serving her sister food. After dinner, their daughter Chen Lexuan was coaxed by Chen Zhiqiang to take a bath and go to bed.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Elder sister went back to her room to rest.
description: After dinner, her elder sister felt a little tired and went back to her room to wash up and rest. Yajing boiled some hot water for her, adjusted the air conditioner temperature, and said softly, "Sis, get some good rest. We still have to go out and have fun tomorrow." Her elder sister looked at her and smiled. "Okay, don't worry too much. Go to sleep early. Don't carry everything on your own."
location: Guest bedroom at home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Couple's balcony night chat.
description: After her sister returned to her room, Yajing took her husband Chen Zhiqiang to the balcony. Leaning against the railing, she recounted in a low voice what her sister had said during the day about school-district housing and competitive pressure. Her tone was worried and her eyes were slightly red. She said, “Aqiang, I know my sister means well for us. But whenever I think about having to scrape together so much money, and Xuanxuan being so young and already having to fight for a spot, I just...” Chen Zhiqiang put his arm around her shoulder and comforted her, “Don't scare yourself. Tomorrow we'll first go and get a clear picture of the school situation and see what policies exist. We don't necessarily have to buy school-district housing. There will always be a way. We'll face it together, don't be afraid.”
location: The balcony of the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and anxiety
description: After the conversation with her husband, Yajing went to shower first. She brushed her teeth and did her basic skincare, but once she lay down in bed, the anxiety of the day washed over her again. She closed her eyes, and images kept flashing through her mind: the revenue pressure of the store, the uncertainty of her daughter's enrollment, and all the cases her sister had mentioned today. She tossed and turned, unable to fall asleep.
location: At home in the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian: bedroom and bathroom.

name: Jolted awake by a nightmare, then a sleepless night.
description: After who knows how long, Yajing drifted off into a hazy sleep, but she had a chaotic dream. In the dream, all the clothing racks in the shop were emptied, the fluorescent lights flickered on and off, and the landlady, Sister Li, stood at the door demanding the rent. She woke with a start, her back covered in cold sweat, her heart racing. She turned sideways to look at her phone; it was already 3:12 a.m. She forced herself to close her eyes, but her thoughts would not be controlled. The shop's cash flow, Xuanxuan's school admission spot, tomorrow's school visit details... all kinds of thoughts intertwined and collided in her mind. In the end, in that state of extreme mental tension, with her heart as heavy as if a stone were pressing on it, she eventually fell asleep again at some point as dawn was breaking.
location: Home bedroom in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning heart-to-heart and initial planning
description: The sky was just starting to lighten when Song Yajing woke with a start from a nightmare and shook her husband Chen Zhiqiang awake. The two threw on coats and sat on the sofa in the living room. In a slightly trembling voice, she described the details of the dream in which the shop had gone bankrupt. A Qiang held her hand, and they talked calmly for half an hour, deciding to treat their daughter's school selection as a project to push forward. Today's site visit would be the first step. They agreed on a division of labor: Song Yajing would take notes, and A Qiang would ask around for feedback from parents with children at the school.
location: Living room at home, Unit 3, Room 502, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast, getting ready, and heading out
description: Song Yajing made a simple breakfast of fried egg toast and milk for three. Knowing she had two schools to visit today, she made a point of drinking an extra glass of water. After the meal, she changed into comfortable flat shoes, put on a large-capacity tote bag containing a notebook, pens, a power bank, and a bottle of water, and took a spare scarf from the entryway cabinet in case the temperature dropped in the evening. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang checked the map on his phone and estimated the driving and walking time. Her daughter Chen Lexuan also finished breakfast at home.
location: Home, Room 502, Unit 3, Community at 82 Shanggu Street, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Visit Siming District Experimental Primary School
description: Song Yajing and her husband walked from home to Xiamen Experimental Primary School in Fujian Province. After registering at the school gate, they followed the guide teacher to visit the teaching building, the 200-meter track playground, the library, and the cafeteria that can hold 400 people. She paid special attention to the smart blackboards in the classrooms and the students' art works displayed in the corridor, feeling that the campus culture was quite good. Aqiang took the initiative to talk with another father who had also come for the school visit and learned that the workload in the upper grades was not light, but the teachers were very responsible. Song Yajing used her phone memo and notebook to record key data such as the admission scope, number of applicants, and advancement rate at the same time.
location: Fujian Xiamen Experimental Primary School, No. 5 Tong'anli, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch conversation
description: After the visit, Song Yajing and her husband walked to Yuehua Shacha Noodle Restaurant on Zhenhai Road for lunch. She ordered a classic satay noodle soup with tofu and squid, and A Qiang ordered pork trotter noodles. While eating, they exchanged opinions: Song Yajing thought the Experimental Primary School's facilities met the standards, but the class sizes were on the large side, about 45 students per class; A Qiang valued more that it was close to home and convenient for pick-up and drop-off. They listed 'class size' and 'pick-up distance' as important comparison points.
location: Yuehua Satay Noodles, No. 26 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Transition and lunch break
description: After the meal, Song Yajing and her husband walked to the next school. On the way, they rested on a bench at Hubin Yili Community Park for 15 minutes, and she used the time to organize her previous notes and close her eyes for a brief rest. The early spring sunshine felt pleasant on her skin, and the short break relieved the fatigue of waking up early. Then they continued to the Primary School Affiliated with the Foreign Language School.
location: Hubin Yili Community Park, Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Visited the Foreign Language School Affiliated Primary School and ran into a fellow parishioner
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing and her husband visited the Primary School Affiliated to the Foreign Language School. The school had a strong bilingual atmosphere; the handwritten posters in the hallway were in English and were covered with photos of the International Culture Festival. Song Yajing was immediately attracted by a baking club classroom equipped with professional ovens, and she thought her daughter would definitely like it. During the visit, she ran into Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member. The two chatted in the hallway for a while. Lin Xiuying comforted her, saying 'Don't worry. The school that suits your child is the best one,' which warmed her heart. Later, she also talked with several parents at the school and learned that enrollment was highly competitive and required an interview, which meant they needed to prepare a simple English self-introduction in advance. Song Yajing carefully noted this and felt slightly nervous.
location: No. 25 Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, Primary School Attached to Xiamen Foreign Language School (Hubin Campus)

name: Returned home to organize and create a school comparison table.
description: After the visit, Song Yajing and her husband walked home. As soon as she got home, she took out two A4 sheets and colored pens to make a school-comparison chart. On one sheet she wrote "Experimental Primary School: high cost-effectiveness, positive school culture, close to home," with a note "relatively large class sizes"; on the other she wrote "Foreign Language School: bilingual features, rich extracurricular clubs (baking), broad perspectives," with a note "highly competitive, interview required." Taking into account her daughter's lively and active personality, she tentatively set Experimental Primary School as her first choice and the Foreign Language School as a reach backup. After Aqiang read the comparison chart, he nodded in agreement. The two finally reached a preliminary conclusion, and the anxiety settled into concrete goals.
location: Living room at home, Unit 3, Room 502, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Xiamen Station to pick up her mother.
description: Song Yajing drove out alone, heading along North Siming Road to Xiamen Railway Station. She waited at the exit for less than ten minutes before seeing her mother, Lin Xiuying, walk out carrying a large blue canvas bag that had been washed until it was faded. Her mother's face showed both the weariness of the long trip and the joy of seeing her daughter. Yajing hurried forward to take the heavy bag. Her mother smiled and said her father had insisted on bringing homemade sausages and pickled vegetables, and specifically told her not to worry too much, saying his hearing had been a bit poor lately. Hearing this, Song Yajing's heart tightened, and she felt a pang of sadness mixed with warmth. She took her mother's arm and headed toward the parking lot.
location: Xiamen Station (Exit), No. 900 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner: mother's cooking
description: After picking up the car and driving home, Mother insisted on cooking herself. She deftly sliced the sausages she had brought and steamed them, and also stir-fried a plate of greens. At seven in the evening, the family sat around the table. A Qiang told his mother-in-law funny stories about helping someone fix a computer that day, while daughter Xuanxuan kept putting food in her grandmother's bowl and shouted, “Grandma's sausages are the best!” The table was filled with the aroma of food and laughter. Song Yajing temporarily set aside the pressure of school choice and simply enjoyed this rare, reassuring sense of being wrapped in family affection.
location: Dining room at home, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took a walk around the neighborhood with her mother and daughter.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing suggested going downstairs for a walk. She walked ahead arm in arm with her mother, while her daughter Xuanxuan hopped and skipped in front like a little rabbit. They sat for a while in the pavilion of the community garden. Song Yajing told her mother about what she had seen at the school today and her decision. Her mother held her hand and said, 'You and Aqiang are both sensible people. Once you've made up your mind, go ahead and do it, and don't be too hard on yourself.' The evening breeze blew with a hint of chill, but her heart was especially calm.
location: Garden of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Settle her mother and Xuanxuan into bed
description: After walking home, Song Yajing first helped her daughter take a bath, changed her into pajamas, and read two picture-book stories about going to school. Her daughter soon fell asleep. Then she went to the guest bedroom to make the bed for her mother, adjusted the air conditioner temperature, and reminded her to cover herself with the quilt at night. Her mother told her to rest early too and not to be too tired.
location: Home, Room 502, Unit 3, Community at 82 Shanggu Street, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal relaxation and preparing for sleep
description: Finally, she had time to herself. Song Yajing took a hot bath and felt the exhaustion throughout her body ease. She sat on the edge of the bed, flipped through a few pages of a novel by the bedside lamp, but her mind still wandered a bit. She set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning on her phone and silently planned that when she got to the store tomorrow, she would send the preview of the new community products to Susan. After turning off the light and lying down, she heard her husband's even breathing beside her. The notebook filled with highlighted key points from today and the warm meal brought by her mother alternated in her mind over and over. Carrying a solid sense of being supported by her plans, she slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 5 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and prayer
description: The alarm went off right on time at 07:30. I got out of bed quietly without waking Zhiqiang, who was sound asleep beside me. I walked to the corner of the living room, knelt on the soft cushion, and began my morning prayer, giving thanks for my mother's safe arrival yesterday and asking for a wonderful time with her today. The sky outside was still a bit dark, and fine rain was pattering on the windowsill.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential complex on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bedroom, living room)

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up daughter
description: After morning prayer, I went into the kitchen. I took out the Quanzhou sausage my mother brought, cut a few slices, steamed some frozen custard buns, and warmed a glass of milk for Xuanxuan. At exactly 8:00, I gently pushed open my daughter's door and called softly, “Xuanxuan, little princess, time to get up! Grandma is here today, so we need to go to kindergarten early.” I helped her change clothes and tied her favorite little bun.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (kitchen, daughter’s bedroom).

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: I held a clear umbrella and took Xuanxuan's little hand, walking her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The rain was light, but the ground was wet. At the kindergarten gate, she turned around and shouted to me, "Mom, come pick me up early with Grandma this afternoon!" I smiled and waved goodbye to her, "Okay, I'll be there when school is over." Then I turned and walked back.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast and mother-daughter chat.
description: When I got home, my mother had already washed up and was sitting at the dining table waiting for me. I put the reheated breakfast on the table and sat down to have a bowl of sweet potato porridge myself. My mother brought up again that my father's voice had been hard to hear on the phone last night. I comforted her, "Mom, after the New Year, when the shop is not busy, I'll personally go back to Quanzhou to pick Dad up, and we'll go to the 174 Hospital to see a specialist." Mother nodded, and a relieved look came over her face.
location: At home (dining room), No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Make tiramisu for her mother
description: After clearing the table and washing the dishes, I tied on an apron and took out the mascarpone cheese and ladyfingers that had been chilled in the refrigerator overnight. My mother leaned against the kitchen door, handing me eggs and measuring the coffee liqueur while telling amusing stories about helping out at a cake shop in Quanzhou when she was young and learning to make cakes. Following the adjusted recipe, I skillfully separated the egg yolks and whites and whipped the mascarpone mixture. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of espresso and rum. After laying the ladyfingers layer by layer, I evenly sprinkled a thick layer of cocoa powder on top, and finally carefully put it into the refrigerator to set. Looking at the square tiramisu, I felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Home (kitchen), No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tasting tiramisu; mother suggests adding a beverage corner.
description: After the cake was chilled and set, I cut two slices, paired them with some Earl Grey tea, and sat at the dining table with my mother to taste it. My mother took a bite, her eyes lit up, and she said, 'It's even better than the ones sold in shops! The texture is so delicate!' I was delighted to hear that. Then she changed the subject: 'Yajing, you make such good cakes and you're so particular about coffee. Why not set up a little corner in the store where customers can have a drink while browsing clothes? Some clothing stores I've been to in Quanzhou are doing this now, and it feels really warm and personal.' I was taken aback, and then my mind started racing. The more I thought about it, the more it seemed like a great idea. I immediately put down my fork, went to the study to get paper and pen, and drew a simple layout sketch of the corner with my mother right on the napkin.
location: At home (dining room), No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple lunch and continued discussion about school choice
description: I simply stir-fried some egg fried rice for lunch. While eating, I brought up again the visit yesterday with Zhiqiang to the Siming District Experimental Primary School and the Foreign Language School Affiliated Primary School. 'The experimental primary school is close to home, so picking up and dropping off is convenient, but the class sizes really are large. The foreign language school has better facilities and a bilingual environment, but I'm afraid Xuanxuan won't pass the interview...' My mother smiled and interrupted me: 'Why worry so much? Whichever school she gets into is Xuanxuan's blessing. I think the comparison table you and Zhiqiang made is quite good. Take it step by step, don't rush.'
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (dining room, kitchen).

name: Commuting to the store
description: After changing into flat shoes and a dark trench coat, I put on my helmet, threw on a raincoat, and set off on my little electric bike. The road was drizzly and there were few people on the street. About 15 minutes later, I parked in the designated parking area in the back alley of the pedestrian street, folded my umbrella, and opened the rolling shutter door of the shop.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: In the afternoon, went to the store to relieve Xiao Mei for her break.
description: When I arrived at the store, Xiaomei had just finished her takeout lunch. I let her rest for a while on the small sofa in the warehouse and took over watching the store myself. It was rainy, and there were only a few customers on the pedestrian street. Taking advantage of this rare free time, I paced around the store and noticed a corner wall near the cash register. There was an unused display rack there. I took out the tape measure I carried with me, carefully measured the empty space — 85 cm wide and 65 cm deep, and silently noted that number.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Planning details and budget for the beverage corner
description: There wasn't a single customer in the shop. I sat behind the cash register, opened Taobao on my phone, and searched for “Italian semi-automatic espresso machine.” I lingered over models in the 1,500-4,000 yuan price range, carefully reading specs, reviews, and customer photos. I also jotted down a rough budget in my memo: an entry-level espresso machine (about 3,000 yuan), an electric milk frother (50 yuan), disposable paper cups (50 yuan), selected Italian espresso beans (100 yuan), totaling about 3,200 yuan. I thought that with this amount of money I could test the idea, and it would be enough to discuss with Zhiqiang. I even planned how to use the existing cash register countertop without buying an extra table.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidy up the shop and prepare to get off work.
description: In the afternoon, the rain gradually stopped. One or two customers came into the shop from time to time, but they looked around and left. Taking advantage of the lull, I re-ironed and tidied up the women's clothing that had been rummaged through, and moved a few spring styles that were selling well to more prominent positions. At 17:15, I told Xiaomei she had worked hard today and let her leave early. Then I closed the shop door myself. Today I walked about 3,500 steps in the store.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commute home and buy groceries on the way
description: Riding my electric bike, on the way home I turned into the Minfeng Fresh Supermarket by the roadside. I bought Xuanxuan's favorite white mushrooms and a bunch of fresh green broccoli, and also picked up a box of soft tofu to make fish head tofu soup for dinner.
location: Minfeng Fresh Supermarket (Xinming Building Branch), No. 2 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute back home
description: Carrying the groceries, I rode back to the neighborhood. Parked the bike, picked up the groceries, and went upstairs.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time after work: jumping in puddles with my daughter.
description: As soon as I entered, my mother said she had just brought Xuanxuan back. The little one saw me and immediately rushed over, saying excitedly, “Mom, the rain has stopped! There are so many puddles on the ground, I want to go stomp in them!” I smiled and had her put on her rain boots, then went downstairs to accompany her. In the community garden, I watched her happily jumping in puddle after puddle, splashing water everywhere, as she giggled nonstop. My mother stood under the eaves, watching us with a kindly smile.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street, residential community garden

name: Prepared dinner and dined with the family.
description: After going upstairs, Zhiqiang also happened to arrive home from work. I tied on an apron and busied myself in the kitchen with my mother. I stir-fried mushrooms and broccoli, and made a soup with soft tofu and the fish head bones left over from lunch. My mother heated up the sausages and pickled vegetables she had brought. The four of us sat around the dining table and enjoyed a simple home-cooked meal. At the table, Xuanxuan gestured animatedly as she talked about how much fun she had jumping in puddles, making everyone laugh heartily.
location: Home (kitchen, dining room) at the residential compound, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to sleep.
description: After dinner, I played with Xuanxuan with building blocks for a while, then helped her take a bath. After she lay down in bed, I told her two Winnie the Pooh stories. At 20:10, she finally fell into a deep sleep, breathing evenly and steadily. I gently closed her bedroom door and went to the living room.
location: Home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (daughter's bedroom)

name: Proposed the beverage corner plan to her husband
description: Mother had already gone back to her room, and Zhiqiang was leaning on the sofa looking at his phone. I took a deep breath, picked up the notebook I kept at the store and the phone screenshots, and sat down next to him. In as calm a tone as possible, I said, "Aqiang, Mom gave me a really good idea today. I want to set up a very small drink corner in that empty space next to the cash register in the store, just buy a small espresso machine, no renovation." I showed him in detail the dimensions, the machine budget, and a plan to use the existing tabletop.
location: Home (living room), No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The couple argued over renovation costs and compromised
description: Chen Zhiqiang pushed up his glasses, carefully finished reading my notes, and frowned: “Buying the machine is a small expense, but the beans, cleaning, and subsequent wear and tear will definitely add up to more than 3,000 yuan. We haven't made back the money from our online transition yet.” I felt he was always rejecting my ideas, and my voice unconsciously rose: “So I did all that research for nothing? Mom and I both think it's feasible!” After more than ten minutes of arguing, Zhiqiang calmed down first: “How about this: since you want to try, take 3,000 yuan from your private savings to buy a machine. If it works, we'll invest together.” Although I felt a bit wronged, I knew this was the best compromise, so I bit my lip and nodded.
location: Home (living room), No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The couple browsed online together to choose a coffee machine.
description: The atmosphere was still a bit stiff, but we sat together on the sofa and opened an e-commerce platform to browse Italian semi-automatic espresso machines. Zhiqiang analyzed pump pressure and temperature control from a technical perspective, while I cared more about whether the machine's appearance would match my shop. We compared several models and eventually saved two to favorites: the "Breville 878" and the "Gemilai 3005", both within a budget of 2800-3500 yuan. We agreed to decide tomorrow evening.
location: At home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room sofa)

name: Bedtime ritual and gratitude journal
description: I soaked my feet for half an hour and let my tense nerves relax. Then I wrote a gratitude journal in my phone memo: thank Mom for her whimsical ideas; thank Ah Qiang for his final compromise; and thank myself for the courage not to give up communication. At 22:45, I turned off the light and lay down, listening to Zhiqiang's even breathing beside me, and slowly closed my eyes. Tomorrow is another day.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and spiritual practice
description: The alarm clock rang, and Song Yajing got up nimbly. After a quick wash, she habitually walked to the small holy icon in the living room, closed her eyes, and prayed quietly for 5 minutes, thanking God for the peace He had granted and asking that everything would go smoothly today with buying the coffee machine and setting up the beverage corner. When she stood up, she felt full of energy and vigor.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up daughter.
description: Song Yajing went into the kitchen and used the whole wheat bread she had bought yesterday to make simple, nutritious ham-and-fried-egg sandwiches, and warmed two glasses of milk. Then she pushed open her daughter's door and called softly, 'Xuanxuan, little princess, time to get up! Today there's your favorite little sandwich.' Her daughter rubbed her eyes. She helped her daughter get dressed, and her daughter happily said that today she was going to tell her teacher that Mommy was going to make super delicious coffee.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking my daughter to school and discussing with my mother
description: Song Yajing held her daughter's hand with one hand and carried the little backpack with the other. She walked Xuanxuan to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten in 10 minutes, briefly greeted the teacher, and then hurried home. When she entered, her mother Lin Xiuying had already set out breakfast. While eating, she excitedly talked about her plan to go straight to Gome today and bring back that DeLonghi coffee machine. Her mother murmured words of support in Minnan dialect, which made her feel more assured.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: E-commerce price comparison and purchase confirmation with husband
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing curled up on the living room sofa, opened the shopping app on her phone to compare prices and reviews of several coffee machines, took a screenshot and sent it to her husband Chen Zhiqiang with the message: “I'm going for it. Let's settle on this silver De'Longhi, 2999. What do you think?” A few minutes later, Zhiqiang replied, “Okay, buy it.” She grinned, completely reassured.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping for a coffee machine at Gome
description: Song Yajing put on her coat, grabbed her keys and phone, and drove to the Gome Longmen flagship store. She arrived around 9:48 and headed straight to the small appliance section. She stopped in front of the DeLonghi and Philips display units, asked the sales assistant to demonstrate milk frothing, tried the feel herself, and asked about after-sales policy. In the end, she decisively chose the silver DeLonghi semi-automatic Italian espresso machine, and politely declined the extended warranty recommendation when paying by card.
location: Floors 1-2, Gome Electrical Appliances, No. 678 Xianyue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchased coffee ingredients and returned
description: Carrying the coffee machine to the trunk, Song Yajing drove to her familiar baking ingredients store on Shuixian Road. The proprietress greeted her warmly. She picked Ethiopian coffee beans, caramel and vanilla syrup, extra-thick paper cups, and wooden stirrers, and the proprietress gave her 10 percent off. Then she drove home, carried the coffee machine and ingredients inside, and her mother, seeing them, said over and over that they were good.
location: Baking ingredients store on Shuixian Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mother-daughter lunch
description: After a quick tidy-up, Song Yajing and her mother made two steaming bowls of satay noodles using the satay sauce and noodles already at home, adding bean sprouts and lean pork. As mother and daughter ate and chatted, her mother talked about how she used to carry coffee in a thermos. Yajing smiled and agreed, feeling full of anticipation for the afternoon's setup.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Set off for the store.
description: After finishing the noodles, Song Yajing changed into a coffee-colored wool long skirt and a beige knit cardigan. She organized her phone, keys, and the receipt for the coffee machine, packed the syrup and paper cups into a reusable shopping bag, and secured the coffee machine on the footboard of her e-bike. She rode to the shop on Zhongshan Road, passing through the community park along the way. Sunlight fell on the green plants, and she felt especially cheerful.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Setting up the store's drink corner
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and the shop assistant Xiaomei moved the coffee machine and supplies in. At the spot next to the cash register that had been measured yesterday, they worked together to wipe clean the old table, connected the coffee machine to the power, and set it up. They also found a small shelf from the storage room, put syrup, paper cups, and stir sticks on it, and covered it with a treasured floral cotton-linen cloth. The drink station took shape quite nicely.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Test the new coffee machine.
description: After washing her hands, Song Yajing carefully read the coffee machine manual, then ground the beans, distributed the grounds, tamped them, and extracted the espresso on the machine. The dark brown espresso with golden crema flowed out slowly. She leaned in to smell it, took a careful sip—rich crema, balanced acidity and bitterness, and the machine ran perfectly. Xiaomei also drank it and said in surprise it was better than the coffee from outside shops. The two smiled at each other over their small success.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Greet customers and warm up the community.
description: After helping the first batch of afternoon customers try on the spring new arrivals, Song Yajing, while tidying the clothes racks, shared a photo of the drink corner and a close-up of the espresso in the customer WeChat group, with the caption: “Hey ladies, our little shop has just set up a mini drink corner, and the first latte is out! We're having a soft opening tomorrow. Come visit and use the secret code ‘Yajing's Special’.” People in the group replied quickly, and she felt warm inside.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Mother visited the store and offered suggestions.
description: At 5 p.m., her mother Lin Xiuying walked over to the shop. As soon as she entered, she praised the coffee machine repeatedly, walked around the table, and suggested, “There’s a small blackboard missing here. Write ‘Today’s Special’ and draw a coffee cup with chalk—how eye-catching!” Song Yajing thought it was a great idea. She found the unused blackboard and colored chalk, wrote “Today’s Special: Specialty Latte (15 yuan)” and drew a steaming coffee cup. Her mother nodded with satisfaction.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle evening customer traffic
description: In the early evening, several office workers who stopped by on their way home from work came into the store. Song Yajing warmly invited them to try on the newly arrived French-style balloon-sleeve dresses and chiffon shirts. One customer was drawn to the drink corner, so she recommended the signature latte and made one on the spot. The customer praised the taste while drinking it and said she would bring her colleagues next time. Her mother watched from the side, beaming with pride.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing the store and saying goodbye.
description: As it grew dark, the customers dispersed. Song Yajing and Xiaomei wiped down the cash register counter, sorted the tried-on clothes, and restocked the shelves, while her mother helped fold stools and pick up paper scraps. After closing, her mother had to go home first to reheat food for Xuanxuan. She told her mother to be careful on the way, invited Xiaomei to have a latte together tomorrow, then locked the store door, put away the day’s revenue and the coffee machine key, and rode her electric bike home.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Grocery shopping and family dinner
description: Song Yajing rode her bike and on the way went to Xiashang Farmers Market on Zhenhai Road to buy fresh bok choy, tomatoes, lean pork, and tofu, then went home to make tomato and egg noodles. At dinner, she animatedly told her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the day's amusing events—buying a coffee machine, comparing prices, Mom offering advice, making the first cup of coffee—and Zhiqiang rarely smiled; the couple looked at each other and laughed, and all the previous awkwardness vanished.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child games and soothing daughter to sleep.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing and her daughter Xuanxuan played "doctor" on the carpet. Xuanxuan, as the doctor, used a toy stethoscope to listen to her heartbeat. Afterwards, she gave her daughter a hot bath, changed her into dinosaur pajamas, and read the picture book Dumbo. Her daughter fell sweetly asleep after hearing half of the book.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gratitude journal and bedtime preparation
description: After tucking Xuanxuan's blanket in, Song Yajing returned to the living room, took out her gratitude journal, and wrote down three little joys of the day: the coffee machine was bought and the coffee turned out well, her mother was always the best advisor, and sitting at the same table with Aqiang and laughing together made the conflict disappear. Then she took a hot shower, and while doing her skincare routine in front of the mirror, she was already thinking about what kind of milk to use for tomorrow's latte and what new recommendation to write.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: After changing into comfortable loungewear and lying on the bed, Song Yajing picked up her phone to reply to the questions from her close friends in the group and set a time with them. After putting down the phone, she closed her eyes, took deep breaths, and meditated to relax. In her mind appeared the scene of making her first cup of coffee with the new coffee machine in the shop today. Filled with a sense of stability and accomplishment, she prayed softly in gratitude to God, then gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Getting up and preparing the family for the day
description: At 7 a.m., the phone alarm rang. Song Yajing got up, washed up, and prepared small wontons for her daughter Xuanxuan's breakfast. During that time, she mentioned to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who had just woken up, about impulsively buying a coffee machine yesterday. Instead of blaming her, her husband smiled and expressed approval and understanding, which warmed her heart.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helping daughter with breakfast and taking her to school
description: Song Yajing woke her daughter, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into a ponytail. The mother and daughter enjoyed a wonton breakfast together. Her daughter excitedly said she would draw a coffee shop sign at kindergarten to give to her mother. Then Song Yajing held her daughter's hand and walked 10 minutes to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, her daughter was curious about what the coffee machine looked like, and Song Yajing described it. After seeing her to the school gate, her daughter waved goodbye and skipped into the campus.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home to have breakfast with mother and discuss plans
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing returned home. Her mother Lin Xiuying had already baked whole wheat toast and made drip coffee. Mother and daughter had breakfast together. Song Yajing told her mother the good news that the drink corner would have its soft opening today. Her mother took out a carefully ironed embroidered tablecloth and asked her to bring it to the store, and suggested using a small blackboard to write today's recommendation. Song Yajing decided to take her mother's good suggestion and planned to buy a small blackboard on the way.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the store to purchase supplies and set up a drink corner
description: Song Yajing brought her mother's embroidered tablecloth and coffee supplies, then set off on her electric bike. On the way, she stopped at a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and picked out a small wooden blackboard and colored chalk. After arriving at the Yajing Lifestyle Gallery at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, she set up the drink corner with Xiaomei, the shop assistant: she spread the embroidered tablecloth on the small round table in the designated area, placed the De'Longhi coffee machine, grinder, and other supplies, and taught Xiaomei how to clean the brew head and steam wand. Then she wrote on the blackboard with chalk, "Today's special handcrafted latte, free tasting," drew a cute coffee bean pattern, and hung it in a conspicuous place.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Community warm-up and morning tasting service.
description: After finishing the setup, Song Yajing took photos of the beverage corner and posted a surprise announcement in the shop's VIP customer WeChat group, saying that customers could come in and enjoy a free heart-shaped latte made by the owner. Customers responded immediately after the message was sent. After the shop opened at 10 a.m., Song Yajing stood near the entrance and warmly handed each incoming customer a freshly made hot latte. She skillfully ground the beans, pulled the espresso, and frothed the milk, drawing beautiful heart-shaped patterns for several young women. The pleasantly surprised customers took photos and posted them on their Moments, praising the owner's excellent craftsmanship. The morning tasting event received a great response.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and the beginning of afternoon business hours
description: At noon, as the number of customers gradually thinned, Song Yajing ordered two bowls of the signature satay noodles from the neighboring shop via WeChat and took turns eating with Xiaomei. While eating, she took out her notebook and quickly jotted down customer feedback, such as “The paper cups don't look good in photos” and “The latte is smooth but I'd want to add sugar.” In the afternoon, when there were relatively few customers, she organized the feedback she had recorded in the morning into the memo app on her phone, specifically marking keywords such as paper cup aesthetics and adding a caffeine-free option. Meanwhile, she posted a short video in the WeChat group showing how popular the morning drinks corner had been, drawing likes and discussion in the group.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Received regular customer Vivian and recorded her suggestions.
description: At 1:30 p.m., regular customer Vivian arrived at the store on time. Song Yajing made her a special hazelnut latte. Vivian tasted it while trying on the newly arrived French knitwear, remarking that the experience felt like being in a boutique select shop in Gangnam, Seoul. Song Yajing took the opportunity to humbly ask for her suggestions on drink pricing, flavors, and packaging. Vivian gave thoughtful feedback and suggested pairing the drink with a small cookie, and said she would bring her colleagues once it was officially launched. After seeing Vivian off, Song Yajing immediately drew a five-pointed star next to the suggestion in her notebook, took a photo of Vivian holding the coffee while wearing the new clothes, retouched it, and posted it to her Moments with the caption: Today's happiness comes from coffee and beautiful you.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Received neighbor Aunt Zhang and got advice.
description: At a little past 3 p.m., Auntie Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, came to the store. Song Yajing served her a cup of American coffee. After tasting it, Auntie Zhang praised it as authentic, but carefully pointed out that the small round table where the sample cups were placed wobbled, which could easily spill coffee and scald someone, and suggested adding a non-slip mat. She also told Song Yajing that the community was promoting a "Small Merchant Mutual Aid Program" and suggested she look into it, as she might be able to obtain official promotional resources. Song Yajing took down these suggestions carefully and planned to follow up.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Check supplies and the evening rush
description: During a lull in business, Song Yajing checked the inventory of coffee beans and milk to make sure they could handle the evening rush, refilled the water dispenser, and tidied the clothing racks that customers had rummaged through. Starting around 4:30 p.m., the first wave of customer traffic arrived. She divided the work with her shop assistant Xiaomei: Xiaomei greeted customers who were choosing clothes, while Song Yajing made coffee and handled the cashier. She also found time to retouch the photos she'd taken that day of the drink corner and customer interactions, selected nine, and planned to post them on WeChat Moments later. Then came the evening rush hour, the busiest time of the day. Song Yajing rang up purchases while handing out drink samples to warm up the atmosphere, and Xiaomei skillfully packed items and checked labels. The two worked well together.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing, tidying, cleaning, and taking inventory
description: After seeing off the last customer, Song Yajing and Xiao Mei began the closing work. They carefully cleaned the espresso machine's brew head, steam wand, and coffee grinder, polished the machine body with a clean cloth until it shone, and sealed the opened fresh milk with plastic wrap before putting it into the small refrigerator. Song Yajing tallied today's tasting consumption: about half a pound of coffee beans and six liters of fresh milk, with costs fully within the controllable range. Looking at the tidy drink corner, she felt confident about the future.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closed the store, cycled home, and bought groceries
description: After locking up the shop and saying goodbye to Xiaomei, Song Yajing rode her electric bike home, facing the evening breeze. Passing the vegetable stall at the entrance of the community, she stopped to pick out a fresh head of broccoli and two garlic bulbs, planning to make a garlic broccoli dish at home.
location: Vegetable stall at the entrance of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Arrived home, sorted out feedback, and cooked and shared a meal with mother
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing changed into loungewear, sat on the sofa, and entered the day's recorded customer feedback points and WeChat group suggestions into her phone's memo app. Then she went into the kitchen and cooked with her mother, who had already started preparing dinner. While washing broccoli, she excitedly shared the highlights of the day: Vivian's comments on the boutique, Aunt Zhang's mutual-aid plan information, and so on. Her mother listened with great interest and praised her daughter for being resourceful.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner, playing with daughter, and getting her to sleep.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family sat around the dinner table. Dishes included garlic broccoli made by Song Yajing and pork rib soup stewed by her mother. Song Yajing talked about today's customer praise and Vivian's specific suggestions. Her husband listened attentively and affirmed that she had made the right move, saying it added a new trump card. After dinner, Song Yajing played puzzles with her daughter Xuanxuan in the living room. Her daughter took out a crayon drawing of a coffee cup she had drawn as a gift, with the words "Mom's Coffee Shop" written on it, which delighted her. At bedtime, she helped her daughter brush teeth, wash face, and change into pajamas. Her daughter pestered her for a story, so Song Yajing improvised a fairy tale about "Little Coffee Bean and Miss Sweater," and her daughter fell asleep sweetly listening to the story.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal evening time: journaling, stretching, and browsing before bed
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing took out her gratitude journal under the desk lamp in the study and wrote down the three things she was most grateful for today: the drink corner had been well received, her mother had supported her, and her husband had understood her. She also thought about improvement plans, such as contacting someone to customize paper cups with the store logo and asking about a community mutual-aid program for small microbusinesses. Then she returned to the bedroom, spread out her yoga mat, and did a set of leg stretches to relieve the muscle soreness from standing all day. Finally, lying in bed, she scrolled through the lively discussion about the latte in the WeChat group, liked a beautiful photo Vivian had posted on Moments, mulled over ordering the new paper cups tomorrow, and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to the future.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Song Yajing woke up to the sound of the alarm clock. She first prepared breakfast for her daughter Chen Lexuan: warmed milk and boiled small wontons. Then she went to her daughter's room, gently woke her up, braided her hair, and they washed up together. Her mother-in-law Lin Xiuying was having breakfast in the living room, and the two chatted about the weather.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking my daughter to school and communicating online
description: Song Yajing walked hand in hand with her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan shared the fun of doing handicrafts. After arriving at the school gate and giving her daughter some instructions, on the way back she used her phone to contact the Chenguang custom packaging seller to inquire about rush-ordering corrugated paper cups and non-slip mats with the "Yajing Life Pavilion" logo, and also asked for details about the community micro-business mutual aid program.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home, tidy up, and have breakfast
description: When she got home, her mother-in-law had already set out breakfast: plain congee, side dishes, and fried eggs. While eating, Song Yajing chatted with her mother-in-law about the shop's Spring Festival activity plans. Her mother-in-law told her not to get too tired and offered to pick up Xuanxuan from school.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing rode her electric bike along the old street and reached Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, in about 15 minutes. After arriving at the store, she divided the cleaning tasks with the shop assistant Xiaomei: wiped down the shelves and clothing racks, preheated the coffee machine; took out the Spring Festival decorative streamers and window paper-cuts to air them, washed the tasting cups, and checked the stock of coffee beans and milk.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Review the soft-opening data and finalize new recipes.
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei analyzed yesterday's customer feedback at the drink corner. Based on the comments, they agreed: the Americano strength will be adjusted from a double espresso to 1.2 times a single shot; the latte will add a vanilla syrup option; the Americano will be priced at 15 yuan and the latte at 20 yuan, as tomorrow's free gift for purchases of 500 yuan or more. Xiaomei volunteered to take charge of tomorrow's drink-area cleaning and supply restocking.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out to buy promotional materials
description: Song Yajing brought her reusable shopping bag and first went to the Sweet Time baking ingredient store near Zhongshan Road to restock 50 extra-thick paper cups, 6 packs of peach oolong tea bags, and 2 packs of rose tea bags. Then she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought two black rubber non-slip mats, and also picked up a bottle of soy sauce for home.
location: Sweet Time Baking Ingredients Store near Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Lunch, print setup, and inventory counting.
description: After returning to the store, it was nearly noon. Song Yajing and Xiaomei took turns watching the store. While eating satay noodles for lunch, she confirmed on her phone the promotional poster design draft sent by the advertising company, replying, "No problem, just print this version," and asked them to send it directly to the store's WiFi printer. After the meal, she printed three A3 posters with the color printer and handwrote the event details with a brush pen: "Celebrate the New Year: spend 500 yuan and get a free specialty drink." Then she divided the work with Xiaomei: she laid non-slip mats under the table in the beverage corner and put up posters on the inside of the glass door and next to the checkout counter, while Xiaomei wrote the event preview in colored chalk on the small blackboard beside the fitting room. Song Yajing took stock of the winter clothing inventory, picked out two knee-length cashmere coats and three turtleneck sweaters, and attached handwritten tags reading "New Year Special 50% Off."
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: She fine-tuned the store's atmosphere.
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei redecorated the storefront window together with Spring Festival stickers and small lanterns to add a festive New Year atmosphere. Xiaomei hung the handwritten preview blackboard in a conspicuous place at the store entrance, which read, "Tomorrow is the last day of business before the New Year; discounted winter clothing is waiting for you!"
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online warm-up and interaction with regular customers
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic decreased, so Song Yajing asked a shop assistant to take a few close-up shots of the newly decorated drink corner and the discounted winter clothes. She wrote a Moments post: "Tomorrow is the last day of business before the New Year. Winter clothes are on clearance with sizes missing. Spend over 500 yuan and get a new coffee or fruit tea as a gift. Wishing everyone new clothes for the New Year!" She posted it together with the photos to Moments and the "Yajing Life Gallery" WeChat group. Within half an hour, the group responded enthusiastically, with several regular customers saying they would definitely come tomorrow. She also received private messages from two regular customers and reserved the winter styles they specified.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up the shop and picking up my daughter from school
