description: At around 17:50, Song Yajing replied to several regular customers' reservation requests in the WeChat group, confirming styles and sizes. Then she and Xiaomei tidied up the clothes that had been tried on, checked the coffee machine's power supply and water tank, and reminded Xiaomei to arrive on time the next morning and to lock the shop door. She rode her electric scooter away from the shop and headed straight to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. When she arrived, her mother-in-law Lin Xiuying had already picked up Xuanxuan and was waiting at the gate. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her mother, she ran over and happily showed the red paper in her hand, saying she wanted to go home to cut paper window decorations. Then the three of them walked home together.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: Back home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already gotten off work and was making stir-fried seasonal vegetables in the kitchen. Song Yajing helped warm up the pork rib soup her mother-in-law had stewed. The family of four sat around the dining table. She shared the progress of the store's event preparation and the positive feedback from the online warm-up. Her husband encouraged her to keep going strong tomorrow, and her mother-in-law also said she would help pick up Xuanxuan, so she could focus on the store.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cozy family time: doing crafts
description: After the meal, her mother-in-law took out scissors and red paper, and Song Yajing led Xuanxuan to cut window decorations on the living room floor mat. She taught her daughter to cut the character 'Fu' (fortune). Xuanxuan accidentally cut off a corner and was about to cry. Song Yajing taped it back together and comforted her humorously: "This 'Fu' character has a little patch, meaning fortune has leaked into our home!" Three generations of the family enjoyed a happy time together.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and parent-child reading
description: Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a bath, and the mother and daughter soaked their feet together. She picked up the picture book “The Story of Spring Festival,” leaned against the headboard, and told her daughter the legend of Nian. After the story, she kissed Xuanxuan on the forehead, turned off the light, and coaxed her daughter to sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal time and reflection
description: After confirming that her daughter was asleep, Song Yajing returned to the living room, used the memo app on her phone to record today's shopping expenses and online warm-up feedback, and silently walked through tomorrow's event process in her mind, feeling at ease.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Song Yajing did some simple stretches, finished her bedtime prayer, and lay in bed reviewing the next day's plan, feeling both expectant and nervous. At 23:00, she turned off the light and fell asleep, storing up energy for the busy day ahead.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time and preparations.
description: At 7 a.m., Song Yajing woke up naturally. After washing up, she prepared breakfast for the family: she made a cup of warm milk for her daughter Chen Lexuan and fried eggs and toast. Her mother Lin Xiuying was already in the living room; the paper window decorations she had cut yesterday were still spread out on the coffee table, and she kept saying she would help put them up in the store later. Song Yajing reminded her mother to pick up Xuanxuan from kindergarten on time in the afternoon and to try to come back early in the evening. At 7:20, she woke her daughter, helped her change into a pink sweater, and the family enjoyed a warm breakfast together.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Building 1, Room 303.

name: Rode an electric bike to the store for the commute.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Song Yajing picked up the small bag she had prepared in advance, containing promotional posters, a tape measure, and spare pearl earrings. After saying goodbye to her family, she rode her electric scooter to the shop. In the early morning, there were few tourists on Zhongshan Road, and a gentle breeze brushed her face. It took about 15 minutes to reach the shop entrance.
location: On the way from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Pre-opening creative decoration and equipment check
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing skillfully unlocked the door, opened the windows for ventilation, and checked the cleaning records left by shop assistant Xiaomei. She turned on the coffee machine to preheat, then wrote the day's recommended activity on the small blackboard with colored chalk: “Today's Special: Spend 500 yuan to get a limited-edition handwritten blessing with a signature latte / Americano (caffeine-free flower and fruit tea also available).” She placed the blackboard in a prominent spot at the store entrance. Finally, she spread out the Suzhou embroidery tablecloth her mother had brought, carefully arranged several orange ranunculus and eucalyptus leaves in a vase, and the area by the cash register instantly looked cozy and full of New Year spirit.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning business and a small peak in customer traffic
description: Business officially started at 9 o'clock. As expected, yesterday's WeChat Moments preview worked. Regular customer Vivian brought two friends into the store. Song Yajing greeted them warmly and accurately recommended New Year outfit styles. Vivian tried on a camel-colored trench coat and a red wool sweater, and was satisfied enough to buy directly. After reaching the full-spend threshold, she chose a latte. Song Yajing handwrote the Chinese character “Fu” on the cup sleeve and handed it to her. Vivian happily took a photo and posted it on WeChat Moments. The flow of customers never stopped all morning. Song Yajing was busy receiving customers, recommending try-ons, and also keeping an eye on the drink corner.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and family catch-up
description: At 12:15 p.m., her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought two bowls of Wutang satay noodles. While eating, Song Yajing discussed with her husband the arrangements for packing for the trip back to Quanzhou for the Spring Festival, telling him to sort the clothes and set aside the thermal underwear and New Year gift boxes separately. Xiaomei independently covered the counter and attended to customers, while Song Yajing occasionally looked up to observe and give styling suggestions.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business peak and record-breaking transactions
description: After 2 p.m., the store entered its peak. Customers who had reserved styles arrived as promised, buying not only spring outfits but also discounted winter clothes. Song Yajing patiently helped them try on clothes, explained washing instructions, and carefully recorded transactions. Orders at the drink corner hit their peak, and more than forty specialty drinks were served. Song Yajing and Xiao Mei worked in perfect sync: Xiao Mei brewed the coffee, while Song Yajing handed out drinks and wrote blessing messages. The numbers on the cash register kept ticking up, and Song Yajing felt thrilled inside.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Restocking, stocktaking, and a treat before closing
description: At 5:30 p.m., the store quieted down. Song Yajing made herself and Xiaomei each a hot Americano and, while drinking, took stock of the inventory. She labeled winter clothes with incomplete size runs as 'Special on Remaining Sizes' and put dust covers on the newly arrived spring clothes. During this, she noticed the pearl earring on her right ear was missing, but she had no time to look carefully and had to give up.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reconcile the day's revenue, close up, and engage with the community.
description: At 6:30 p.m., Song Yajing counted the day's revenue and found it nearly double the same weekday of last week, setting a record for the highest single-day takings since November. Excited, she hugged Xiaomei. After calming down, she counted the cash, checked the incoming transfers, locked the money away, and checked the power, turned off the lights, and pulled down the rolling shutter door together with Xiaomei. Standing outside, she took a photo of the storefront sign and posted it to the membership group: 'See you next year! Thank you for your support all year!' She felt a great sense of satisfaction.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy fruit on the way home.
description: On the way home on her electric bike, Song Yajing stopped by her usual fruit shop at the entrance of the residential complex and bought a large bag of sugar tangerines and a box of cherries, thinking that the family should have some festive fruit for the New Year.
location: Fruit shop next to the No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and packing bags
description: She got home at 7:50 p.m., and her mother had already prepared a simple dinner. The whole family sat around the table, and Song Yajing shared the good news of the shop's record-breaking performance, which even made her daughter eat a few extra bites. After dinner, her mother played with LEGO with Xuanxuan, while Song Yajing and her husband packed for their return to Quanzhou the next day, checking thermal underwear, hearing aid brochures, dessert gift boxes, and New Year goods. Their daughter excitedly stuffed picture books and plush toys into her backpack.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Building 1, Room 303.

name: Bedtime preparation and gratitude prayer.
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom to wash up and did a few stretches to relax her body. Before bed, as usual, she made the sign of the cross and whispered a prayer, thanking God for the good harvest and asking for a safe journey tomorrow. With anticipation and gratitude for tomorrow, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Building 1, Room 303.

name: Morning routine, morning prayer, and breakfast
description: Woke up in the sunshine of the first day of the holiday, lingered in bed a bit longer than usual, then washed up. Knelt before the statue of the Virgin Mary in the bedroom and prayed softly for a safe trip back to Quanzhou and for the family's health. Then had breakfast with mother-in-law Lin Xiuying and daughter Chen Lexuan. Mother-in-law cooked satay noodles, and there were sugar tangerines on the table. While feeding noodles to her daughter, she discussed the morning plans and details of returning to Quanzhou tomorrow with her mother-in-law and husband. The daughter was delighted to learn she was going to her maternal grandparents' home.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get ready and head to the store.
description: After breakfast, she found old rags and a small spray bottle in the storage room at home, checked the battery level of the e-bike key, and prepared to take them to the store for final cleaning. Then she rode the e-bike along Hubin South Road and turned into Zhongshan Road. The street was not crowded but already had a festive New Year atmosphere, and she arrived at the store entrance.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final store cleaning and official closing
description: She opened the rolling shutter door to air the place, and used a spray bottle and cloth to wipe the cashier counter, shelves, and display cabinets. She focused on cleaning the drink corner: she turned the DeLonghi coffee machine's water tank upside down to drain it, cleaned and dried the machine body with cleaning tablets, and covered all the equipment with dust cloths. Looking around the empty little shop, she felt reluctant yet content, whispered 'Good work. Keep it up next year,' then pulled down the rolling shutter door, locked it, and put the key into her bag.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Xinhua Bookstore to buy books and walk home
description: Strolled from the store to the Xinhua Bookstore on Zhongshan Road, carefully selected 3 picture books about Spring Festival traditional culture and adventure stories in the children's picture book area, including pop-up flap books and pinyin bridge books, planning for her daughter to read them in the car. After checking out, she took a photo of the store's festive decorations and sent it to the family group, then carried the picture books and walked home slowly, greeting the grandmother downstairs on the way.
location: Xinhua Bookstore on Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: When she got home, her mother-in-law was ladling out soup. The family had lunch, with the main dish being her mother-in-law's specialty: assorted fish poached in soy sauce. As they ate, they shared their feelings about closing the shop and the picture books she had bought. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes, went to the bedroom to change into sneakers, checked the Carrefour e-member card and coupons on her phone, made a shopping list, then called her husband to tell him she was about to leave for the supermarket.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove to Carrefour to stock up on Chinese New Year goods
description: Drove the white car for about 17 minutes and arrived at Carrefour in SM City Plaza. She went straight to the New Year gift box section and picked out Tieguanyin tea and imported nut gift boxes for her parents. In the skincare section, she chose a facial cream gift set for her mother and one for her sister. Passing the specialty section, she picked up Gulangyu pies and dried meat slices. In the beverage section, she took a photo of the price of Kinmen Kaoliang and, after getting her husband's consent, took a bottle. During the trip, her cart accidentally bumped into another customer's cart, and she immediately smiled and apologized. After paying, she loaded two large full bags into the trunk.
location: Carrefour supermarket, B1, Phase I, SM City Plaza, No. 399 Jiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home to sort out the Chinese New Year goods
description: Drove home and sorted the New Year goods into categories: put the gifts for her parents separately into a travel bag, and left the bulk local specialties and sorghum liquor at the entrance for easy loading the next day. Her mother-in-law came over to help, and the two chatted while tidying things up.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family leisure and preparing baking ingredients
description: She changed into loungewear and started preparing for the evening's baking. She opened the refrigerator to check whether there were enough eggs, mascarpone cheese, and whipping cream, then took out the dried cranberries and cake flour to thaw and weigh. Her daughter Chen Lexuan followed behind, helping to cut the butter into small pieces. In the living room, her mother-in-law was picking vegetables to prepare a simple dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family had a simple, light dinner together. At the dinner table, they finalized tomorrow's schedule: get up and get ready at 9 a.m., leave at 10:30 a.m., and arrive in Quanzhou around 1 p.m. After dinner, her husband volunteered to do the dishes so that Song Yajing could prepare the baking with peace of mind.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Carefully crafted baked desserts
description: Tied my hair up and put on a floral apron, then made tiramisu and cranberry cookies in the kitchen. Carefully separated the egg yolks from the whites and whipped the mascarpone cheese; my daughter Chen Lexuan brought over a small stool and stood beside me watching curiously, tasting the cheese mixture with a small spoon. I soaked ladyfingers in coffee, layered cookies and cream, sprinkled cocoa powder on top, and put it in the fridge to set. Next, I made cranberry cookies. While whipping the butter, I answered my sister's call to confirm the Chinese New Year gifts. Distracted, the first batch of cookies baked three and a half minutes too long and the edges were slightly darker; I picked out the burnt ones and baked a second batch. The oven gave off a sweet aroma, and my daughter couldn't resist sneaking a bite of the piping hot cookie and blew on her mouth to cool it down.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Finish cleaning up and confirm the itinerary with family.
description: She put the cooled cookies into an airtight jar, covered the tiramisu with plastic wrap, and wiped down the stove top with a damp cloth. She and her husband and mother-in-law confirmed again that they would set off at 10:30 tomorrow. Her husband had already checked the tire pressure and fuel level and set the navigation. Her mother-in-law called her father in Quanzhou, and her father's happy voice came through, saying he had already prepared the vinegar pork.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal Care and Socializing
description: While her daughter was falling asleep, she made a cup of hot lemon water and sat on the sofa. She sent a WeChat message to her best friend Wang Jia, asking to meet on the 31st at the usual place in Quanzhou. Wang Jia quickly replied and agreed. Then she checked the shop's customer group and replied one by one to regular customers' New Year greetings. Afterward, she soaked her feet in hot water, watched a video about Spring Festival customs on her phone, and let herself completely relax.
location: Master bedroom and living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Tuck daughter in and say evening prayers.
description: I went into my daughter's room, turned off the main light and left only the night light on. I lay down beside her and gently read the newly bought picture book "Going Home." When the story reached the little animals going home for the New Year, my daughter asked whether we would also go to grandma and grandpa's house. After the story, I softly led her in a bedtime prayer, kissed her forehead goodnight, and only quietly got up after seeing her sleeping evenly.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Back in the master bedroom, she said goodnight to her husband and did a simple set of neck and shoulder stretches to shake off fatigue. Lying in bed, she silently reviewed tomorrow's itinerary once more, said to herself, "Everything will go well. Goodnight," set the alarm, and turned off the lights to fall asleep at 23:00 sharp.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning prayer
description: Morning light streamed through the curtains onto her face as Song Yajing was awakened right on time by her alarm. She closed her eyes and said a brief morning prayer, thanking the Lord for granting her a peaceful new day. Then she got up quietly, washed up, checked her makeup in the mirror, and prepared to return to her parents' home in good spirits.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family.
description: Song Yajing heated frozen steamed buns in the kitchen, fried eggs, and made instant coffee for herself and her mother. Her mother Lin Xiuying was organizing New Year goods and luggage in the living room. Song Yajing first went to her daughter's room and gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, telling her that today they would go back to Quanzhou to see grandparents; then she went to the master bedroom to wake her husband Chen Zhiqiang and urged him to get up and eat breakfast so they could hurry up and pack.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bedroom at home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family has breakfast together and does a final check of the luggage.
description: The family of four sat around the dining table. While eating, Song Yajing took out the tiramisu and cranberry cookies she had made last night from the refrigerator and carefully packed them into an insulated bag and a tin box. She checked the packing list again to make sure the thermal underwear for her father, her daughter's picture books, and the tablet were all packed. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, said he would move the luggage right after the meal and try to leave as soon as possible.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Loading luggage into the car and pre-departure checks
description: After breakfast, Chen Zhiqiang and Song Yajing carried the packed luggage to the trunk of the car in the underground garage. The luggage included Tieguanyin tea, a skincare gift set, Xiamen specialty pies, Kinmen kaoliang liquor, desserts, and a change of clothes for the family. The mother helped pass things along and reminded them not to leave anything out. Song Yajing did a final check of the doors, windows, and water and electricity, and after confirming everything was off, locked the door.
location: Underground garage of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Drove along the Shenhai Expressway toward Quanzhou (first half of the trip)
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove the car out of the residential complex and onto the Shenhai Expressway. Song Yajing sat in the passenger seat, while her mother and daughter sat in the back, with their daughter secured in the child safety seat. Song Yajing played old Hokkien songs and chatted with her mother about funny childhood memories of Chinese New Year, creating a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere in the car. Chen Lexuan curiously looked out the window at the scenery.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Xiamen–Quanzhou section, Fujian Province)

name: Quick rest and supplies at Puli Service Area
description: The car entered Puli Service Area in Jinjiang City. The family got out to stretch. Chen Lexuan was attracted to the grilled sausage stall, and Song Yajing bought grilled sausages for her daughter and her mother. Everyone used the restroom and took a short break. Chen Zhiqiang checked the tire pressure and refilled his daughter's water bottle.
location: Puli Service Area, Jinjiang City, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (Shenhai Expressway, toward Shenyang)

name: Continued driving and arrived downstairs at the parents' home in Quanzhou
description: The car set off again and continued along the Shenhai Expressway for about half an hour before entering Quanzhou city. When the car drove into the familiar alley on Xinhua North Road in Licheng District and stopped under an old residential building, Song Yajing saw her father Song Minghui looking around downstairs. Excitedly, she lowered the car window and shouted "Dad!" Her father greeted her with a big smile, and the family was finally reunited.
location: Downstairs at No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Arrive at parents' home to hand out New Year goods and desserts.
description: Her father, Song Minghui, helped carry the luggage, and the whole family bustled through the door. Hot tea had already been brewed in the living room. Song Yajing immediately opened her luggage, handing her father the Tieguanyin tea leaves, a skincare gift set, and thermal underwear; she also took out tiramisu and cranberry cookies, set them on the table, and urged everyone to taste them. Her father said it was wasteful, but his face was full of smiles.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Drinking tea and chatting with parents about family matters.
description: The family sat together in the living room drinking tea and eating desserts. Song Yajing asked in detail about her father's health and community activities. Her father showed photos on his phone of winning a chess competition. Her mother asked about her daughter's dessert shop promotions and was relieved to learn of their success. Chen Zhiqiang also joined the conversation and chatted with his father-in-law about the news. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Taking a walk with father and daughter in the alley
description: The afternoon sun was just right. Her father wanted to take his granddaughter out for a walk, and Song Yajing gladly accompanied them. The three of them walked slowly along the familiar alley downstairs. Every time her father met an old neighbor, he would proudly introduce his daughter and granddaughter. At the entrance to the senior activity center, her father checked the activity schedule for the next week. Chen Lexuan was attracted by a neighbor's cat and squatted down to watch it.
location: Alleys and old streets near No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Helped prepare dinner ingredients and enjoyed mother-daughter time.
description: Back home, Song Yajing tied up her hair and went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner ingredients. Her mother was processing fresh spareribs to make vinegar pork, while Song Yajing trimmed and washed the vegetables. As they worked, the mother and daughter chatted about the recent news of their Quanzhou neighbors. Her mother also mentioned that a young priest had recently come to the church at the end of the street, and his sermons were very interesting.
location: Parents' home kitchen, 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Played chess with father to enjoy some parent-child time.
description: Her father came back from his walk, made tea in the living room, and brought out the Chinese chess set. Song Yajing played three games with her father, deliberately letting him win two. Her father was grinning from ear to ear and praised that his daughter really understood him. Song Yajing also smiled and said his chess skills had improved, that even she could no longer beat him.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: A familiar aroma drifted out of the kitchen. Song Yajing helped her mother with the cooking, while Chen Lexuan sat on a small stool beside them reading a picture book. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped his father-in-law set out the bowls and chopsticks. In the evening, a table of steaming home-cooked dishes was set: the father's special vinegar pork was the centerpiece, along with green vegetables, spare rib soup, and several small dishes Song Yajing loved. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting, tasting the dishes, sharing funny sales stories, their daughter's amusing mishaps, and neighborhood news, with laughter and joy all around.
location: Kitchen and dining room at parents' home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Helped mother wash dishes and listened to her chat about everyday things
description: After the meal, Song Yajing volunteered to wash the dishes. Her mother pulled up a chair and sat nearby, chattering about family matters such as the neighbor's grandson starting kindergarten and Aunt Li bringing back prayer beads from her trip to Mount Putuo. Song Yajing listened patiently, occasionally responding, enjoying the mother-daughter time alone together.
location: Parents' home kitchen, 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Bathe my daughter, read picture books, and tuck her into bed.
description: Song Yajing prepared a change of clothes for her daughter and took her to the bathroom for a bath. Chen Lexuan was tired but excited after a day of play and splashed in the bathtub. After bathing and changing into clean pajamas, Song Yajing, in the bedroom she had lived in since childhood, took out the picture book 'Reunion' and read a bedtime story to her daughter. Halfway through the story, the daughter fell asleep from drowsiness. Song Yajing gently tucked her in and kissed her on the forehead.
location: Parents' home bathroom and Song Yajing's old bedroom, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal time and conversation with my husband
description: Her husband and daughter had already fallen asleep. In the old bedroom, Song Yajing felt a long-missed peace looking at the familiar bedside lamp and desk. She sent a WeChat message to her best friend to let her know she had arrived home safely, and said a brief prayer of gratitude. Then her husband Chen Zhiqiang came back to the bedroom and chatted with her as she lay in bed, remarking on the warmth of being back at her parents' home, and they discussed their plan to take her parents to the newly opened dim sum restaurant the next morning. Finally, surrounded by familiar scents and her family, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Song Yajing’s old bedroom at her parents’ home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Woke up to the sound of firecrackers, got up, and washed up.
description: In the early morning, sporadic firecracker sounds came from outside the window, waking me from sleep. When I opened my eyes, the first thing I saw was the old ceiling fan on the ceiling and the familiar printed patterns on the wall, and a sense of security at being back home welled up in my heart. I lingered in bed for a while, breathing in the room's unique smell of old books mixed with camphor wood; the warm scene of the family sitting together last night eating vinegar pork and sweet potato porridge still echoed in my mind. After getting up, I put on a thick pajama robe and went into the bathroom. Splashing my face with cold tap water instantly refreshed me and got me ready for the new day.
location: Room 301, No. 42 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: The whole family sat around enjoying a hometown-style breakfast.
description: Entering the dining room, my mother had already prepared the breakfast I missed most: steaming sweet potato porridge, golden-fried turnip cakes, and a plate of homemade crunchy pickled radish. The whole family sat together. My daughter Xuanxuan, her mouth stuffed full of turnip cake, mumbled to her maternal grandparents about finding the lucky money her paternal grandparents had left under her pillow last night, making everyone laugh. I picked up a piece of turnip cake for my husband Aqiang and told him to do his best today. The family was full of joy.
location: Dining room at Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied her mother to West Street food market to buy Chinese New Year goods and returned home to organize them.
description: After breakfast, my mother and I carried vegetable baskets and walked about 15 minutes to the bustling West Street Market. I followed behind my mother, watching her deftly pick the freshest oysters (each one had to have “spit out all its water”), lively tiger prawns, and she also ordered a free-range chicken that had been slaughtered that morning. Following our plan, we bought all the ingredients needed for Quanzhou satay noodles: peanut butter, lye water, and sliced meat. On the way, we ran into our old neighbor Aunt Zhang, whom we hadn't seen for years. She smiled and said, “Yajing is exactly like you when you were young — both of you are great homemakers!” My mother was grinning from ear to ear. After shopping, we carried the heavy ingredients home, chatting and laughing along the way. On the road, my mother remarked that the market was still the same as ever, except the old stall owners had all grown older. When we got home, we stored the fish, shrimp, and meat separately in the kitchen, hung the chicken up to drain, and I took the chance to drink two glasses of warm water and rest a little.
location: Xijie Food Market at No. 210 Xijie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, and on the way home

name: Pasting Spring Festival couplets with father, cleaning the courtyard with the family, and husband inspecting electrical appliances.
description: Father took out the Spring Festival couplets and a 'Fu' character written by the community calligraphy teacher. I held the paste basin while the two of us, father and daughter, worked on them—one brushing on paste and the other putting them up straight—until we had pasted them one by one on the front door and all the other doors. When we were putting up the horizontal scroll above the front door, a gust of wind nearly blew it away. Father caught it with a quick hand and joked, “This is the God of Wealth rushing to get in!” Meanwhile, my husband A Qiang brought a ladder to check the TV signal cable. He found that a loose plug was causing the weak signal; after he tightened it, the picture immediately became clear. Then he fetched a wrench and replaced the worn washer on the dripping kitchen faucet. I handed him rags and tea from the side, while my daughter Xuanxuan, small broom in hand, made a serious show of sweeping the fallen leaves in the yard, making Grandpa laugh heartily. Finally, Father and I swept the old dust from the corners of the yard out the door, muttering, “Bad luck swept clean away, gold and silver treasures roll in.” The whole family was happily busy.
location: Front gate, all room doors, and courtyard of Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: The whole family enjoyed a home-style lunch.
description: Mother deftly prepared a table of dishes: authentic Quanzhou fried rice noodles, oyster omelet with minced garlic, and a clear fish ball soup. The family sat around the table. My father asked about the year-end promotion at my store, and I smiled and said business was good, quickly changing the subject. After the meal, Aqiang turned on the TV in the living room, and the picture was indeed clear. He then went to the kitchen to check the repaired faucet, and my father kept praising his handiness. I shuttled between the dining table and the kitchen, helping serve dishes and wash fruit. The family enjoyed a simple and warm lunch together.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon nap, regaining peace.
description: After lunch, I felt a little sleepy, so I returned to the small room where I lived as a child. Without looking at my phone, I lay down on the bed directly, stared at the familiar water stain pattern on the ceiling, listened to the sound of my mother and father chatting downstairs and the noise of A Qiang moving chairs, and felt extremely at peace. I slept soundly, and when I woke up I was refreshed, with plenty of energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City, Licheng District, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Room 301, secondary bedroom.

name: Helped mother pickle New Year dishes and learned to make bowl cakes.
description: In the afternoon, I tied on an apron and officially joined the kitchen crew. I first marinated the New Year dish with my mother. I put the cut pork belly pieces into a basin and, following the recipe she taught me, poured in soy sauce, five-spice powder, and mashed garlic, then kneaded everything carefully with my hands to make sure every piece was coated with the marinade. I covered the basin with plastic wrap and let it sit to absorb the flavor. Then came the highlight of the day—learning to make Quanzhou bowl cakes. Following my mother's guidance, I mixed rice flour, sugar, and yeast into a rice batter, carefully poured it into small porcelain bowls until eight-tenths full, and placed them into a steaming basket over boiling water. When the first batch came out, several bowl cakes hadn't “smiled” (cracked open). Mom teased, “These ones represent that Yajing's shop will open a chain in the future—lots of tricks to come! They'll definitely do better than your mom!” That made me both embarrassed and delighted. In the steam and rice fragrance, the two of us chatted about work and my elder sister far away in Shenzhen, as if we had endless things to say.
location: Kitchen, Room 301, No. 42 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Took my daughter to buy flowers and firecrackers, went home to decorate, and confirmed the church Mass time.
description: I put a small jacket on Xuanxuan and put on my coat before going out. First, I went to the flower shop on East Street (No. 38-5, East Street, Licheng District) and carefully picked two bunches of silver willow and a bunch of gladiolus. Xuanxuan pointed at a bunch of pink silver willow and said, 'It looks like Mommy's skirt, so pretty!' Then I walked to the grocery store on Daxi Street (No. 19, Daxi Street, Licheng District). The enthusiastic shopkeeper recognized me and we chatted for a while; I bought a few strings of red firecrackers and some snap pops for the kids. On the way home, I deliberately took a detour past Quanzhou Catholic Quanxi Church (No. 208, West Street, Licheng District) and saw a notice on the bulletin board that Mass would be held tomorrow (Chinese New Year's Eve) at nine in the morning. I silently noted it to make sure it wouldn't conflict with family plans. After getting home, I quickly put the silver willow and gladiolus into a large vase and placed them on both sides of the TV cabinet in the living room, instantly adding a festive touch. Then I hung the firecrackers on the balcony clothes rack to air out. Xuanxuan hugged the boxes of snap pops and couldn't put them down. I promised her we would play with them tomorrow on Chinese New Year's Eve.
location: Flower shop at No. 38-5 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province   grocery store at No. 19 Daxi Street   Quanxi Church at No. 208 West Street   home at No. 42 North Xinhua Road

name: Help mother prepare dinner
description: In the evening, my mother began to get dinner ready for the whole family, and I took the initiative to help, washing vegetables, slicing ginger, and peeling garlic. The clatter of pots and pans in the kitchen mingled with the aroma of food. My mother was at the stove, and I was her assistant; we worked in perfect harmony, making the final preparations for a hearty dinner.
location: Kitchen, Room 301, No. 42 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: The whole family enjoys a warm dinner
description: Dinner was the mother's specialty dishes, and the whole family sat around the table happily. Father was in a good mood and opened a bottle of his own medicinal liquor, sharing a small glass with her husband Aqiang. During the meal, everyone discussed the menu for tomorrow's New Year's Eve dinner. Mother said she would steam a fish, Father suggested stewing a chicken, and the whole family was full of anticipation for New Year's Eve.
location: Dining room at Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Evening family leisure time
description: After dinner, the whole family sat on the living room sofa watching TV. Father focused on the evening news, Mother chatted with Aqiang about family matters, and I played with building blocks with Xuanxuan on the carpet. A lighthearted program was on TV, and warm lighting and family laughter filled the living room.
location: Living room, Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Bathe daughter and tell a bedtime story
description: Xuanxuan was a bit tired from playing, so I took her to the bathroom for a hot bath, washing away the sweat from a day of play. After changing into her cute pig pajamas, I leaned against the headboard and read the picture book Reunion for the New Year with her. I told her that tomorrow was Chinese New Year's Eve, and she'd get to eat even more delicious food and wear new clothes. She snuggled in my arms and fell sweetly asleep as she listened.
location: Bathroom and second bedroom at Room 301, 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Personal preparation before bed, prayer, and confirmation for tomorrow.
description: Looking at Xuanxuan's serene sleeping face, I felt deeply content. First, I used my phone to send a WeChat message to Aqiang in the next bedroom: "Tomorrow at 9 a.m., we'll accompany Mom and Dad to Quanxi Church for Mass. Please drive and lead the way." Then I took out my pocket notebook and wrote a memo: "Tomorrow reminder: dress Xuanxuan in new clothes; at 9 a.m. the whole family goes to Quanxi Church on West Street for New Year's Eve Mass. Remember to bring the bowl cake Mom made for Father Wang to try." After that, I knelt by the bed with my hands clasped and prayed devoutly for tomorrow's reunion and the smooth running of the store. Then I washed up, did my skincare routine, and changed into comfortable cotton pajamas. Before going to sleep, I walked quietly to my parents' room and confirmed the next day's plan with my mother, who was still awake: "Mom, we'll go to church at nine tomorrow morning. I've set an alarm and will get up at eight to prepare." Mother nodded and told me to go to bed early. Back in my room, I lay down, breathed in the distinctive woody smell of the old house, listened to the occasional sound of cars outside the window, and with peace in my heart, soon fell asleep.
location: Doorway of the second bedroom and parents' bedroom, Room 301, No. 42 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast with the family.
description: Early in the morning, sporadic firecrackers came from outside the window. Song Yajing gently woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, telling her daughter that today was Chinese New Year's Eve. She dressed her in a bright red down jacket and a knitted cap with a tiger pattern. Her daughter excitedly asked if she could stay up all night. After washing up, Song Yajing briefly sorted out what she needed to do that day. Then the whole family enjoyed breakfast prepared by her mother in the first-floor dining room: rice porridge, pork floss, salted duck eggs, and pickled cucumbers. Her father watched the morning news at the dining table, and her mother urged Song Yajing to come back early after Mass to help. The family chatted and ate together in a warm atmosphere.
location: Bedroom and first-floor dining room at No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Prepare the bowl cake gift box and get ready to leave
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing sorted the bowl cakes she had steamed last night and intended to give to Father Wang. She chose six that had split open with a smile and were the fullest in shape, carefully wrapped them in plastic wrap, and put them in a paper tote bag. She checked her phone and wallet, said goodbye to her mother, and got ready to head out to the church.
location: Kitchen at the parents' home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Attend Chinese New Year's Eve Mass.
description: Song Yajing walked about 15 minutes from her home on Xinhua North Road to Quanzhou Catholic Quanxi Church at Huaxiang Xucuocheng, arriving around 08:30. Today was New Year's Eve, and more parishioners came to Mass than usual. Mass ended around 09:30. After it ended, she found Father Wang at the door and handed him a gift box of bowl cakes. Father Wang smiled, accepted it, and wished the whole family peace and joy in the New Year. Song Yajing also took the opportunity to offer him an early New Year greeting.
location: Quanzhou Catholic Quanxi Church, Xucuocheng, Huaxiang, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Bought small fireworks on the way back.
description: After leaving the church, Song Yajing deliberately detoured to a familiar grocery store at the alley entrance of Daxi Street, where she picked out some small sparklers, small spinning tops, and snap pops. After paying, she quickened her pace and walked home along Daxi Street, thinking about her mother waiting for her in the kitchen to prepare the New Year's Eve dinner together.
location: En route from the grocery store at the entrance of Daxi Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, to No. 45 North Xinhua Road

name: Preparing the New Year's Eve dinner with her mother.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing immediately tied on an apron and started preparing the New Year's Eve dinner. She was in charge of making the satay soup base, slowly sautéing shrimp heads over low heat to render the red oil, then adding peanut butter and chili sauce. Her mother was wrapping Quanzhou meat zongzi on the other side, while Song Yajing soaked glutinous rice and cut shiitake mushrooms and dried scallops. On the stove, chicken soup was steaming, and cleaned mud crabs were arranged on a plate waiting to be steamed. The mother and daughter discussed the evening's plating while they worked.
location: Kitchen at the parents' home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: At noon, the family had a simple meal of noodles cooked with the "longevity vegetable" (mustard greens) that her mother had specially prepared, symbolizing a long life. After the meal, Song Yajing rested for a while, leaned on the sofa in the living room, and scrolled through her phone. She received a message from her elder sister Yawen saying she would arrive at noon on the second day of the New Year. She replied, "Got it, safe travels."
location: Dining room and living room at parents’ home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Helped butcher red crabs and prepare cold dishes.
description: After the break, Song Yajing returned to the kitchen and continued working. Her mother was preparing the red crabs, and Song Yajing helped with the fried items and cold dishes: she cut the jellyfish skin into strips, mixed the dipping sauce, and shredded and plated the roast chicken bought the day before. Her mother asked her to put several cold dishes on the dining table first and cover them with plastic wrap.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (parents' home), kitchen and dining room

name: A quick clean-up in preparation for staying up for New Year's Eve.
description: Song Yajing asked her husband to clear the living room coffee table and portion the sunflower seeds, peanuts, pistachios, and candy into snack trays. Her daughter helped arrange the peanuts nearby, while Song Yajing wiped down the TV stand and tables and chairs with a damp cloth, preparing for the evening's dumpling-making activity.
location: Living room, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: The whole family sat around making dumplings.
description: Her father moved the kneading board and rolling pin to the living room coffee table, and Song Yajing was in charge of mixing the filling (pork and cabbage with shrimp). The whole family began making dumplings. The dumplings her father made were shaped like ingots; Aqiang's wrappers were not round but looked presentable; Xuanxuan shaped a small piece of dough into a "little bun." Laughter and flour flew together. When the topic turned to Song Yajing's shop, her father said, "It's better to be steady and not take risks." She nodded in agreement.
location: Living room, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Finish up by boiling the dumplings and setting the table
description: After the dumplings were wrapped, the mother first cooked a pot for the whole family to taste the seasoning. Song Yajing and her husband began to set the New Year's Eve dinner table: spreading a red tablecloth printed with the character 'Fu', arranging festive bowls, chopsticks, and wine glasses, and finding two red candles to light carefully. The mother brought the first plate of cooked dumplings to the table. Song Yajing tasted one and praised her skill.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (parents' home), kitchen and dining room

name: Cook the final hot dishes and prepare to serve the meal
description: The New Year's Eve dinner entered its final push. Under her mother's direction, Song Yajing brought dishes to the table one by one, including steamed red crab, oyster omelet, and five-spice rolls. Her husband poured rice wine for his father and mother and coconut juice for his daughter. Song Yajing invited everyone to take their seats and announced that the reunion dinner had officially begun.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (parents' home), kitchen and dining room

name: New Year's Eve reunion dinner and the topic of father's hearing
description: The table was full of steaming dishes, and the whole family raised their glasses to celebrate the New Year. Halfway through the meal, her father suddenly mentioned that his left ear hearing had deteriorated badly, and he was afraid of becoming a burden to the family in the future. Song Yajing's heart tightened. She served her father a bowl of chicken soup and said firmly, "Dad, don't overthink it. After the New Year, I'll immediately arrange a hospital in Xiamen. Hearing aids work really well now!" After dinner, she quietly downloaded a hearing test app on her phone for her father to try. The results showed a significant decline in mid-to-high frequencies, which strengthened her determination to take her father to see a doctor.
location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City, Licheng District, No. 45 North Xinhua Road (parents' home) - dining room

name: Clear the table, have tea with my father, and test his hearing.
description: Song Yajing cleared the dishes with her mother and put the leftovers into separate containers. She brewed a pot of Tieguanyin tea for her father, sat with him and chatted about everyday life and old memories, reassured him not to worry because medical technology is very advanced now, and had him take a hearing test on his phone. Her father nodded at the result, and his expression softened considerably.
location: Living room, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Watch the Spring Festival Gala and video call with my sister.
description: The Spring Festival Gala had just started when Song Yajing made a WeChat video call to her older sister Song Yawen. They exchanged New Year greetings. Her sister confirmed that she would drive back from Shenzhen on the morning of the second day of the Chinese New Year and would bring a big seafood haul. Song Yajing reminded her to drive safely and said the tiramisu was ready. After hanging up, the whole family watched the gala together. Her daughter played a red-envelope grabbing game on her phone, shouting excitedly every time she opened one, making everyone laugh. Song Yajing and her husband also joined in grabbing red envelopes in the family group and customer groups. Seeing a funny skit, the whole family laughed heartily.
location: Living room, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Give daughter a bath and put her to sleep
description: Time was late. Song Yajing took her daughter to bathe and changed her into the new red pajamas. Her daughter kept saying she was sleepy, but Song Yajing still told her a little story about the "Nian" beast. Her daughter leaned against her and fell asleep before finishing. She gently kissed her daughter's forehead.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Packing up tomorrow's gifts for visiting relatives with my husband
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing and her husband began sorting out gifts for visiting relatives tomorrow: the cigarettes and alcohol were specified by her father's cousins, and the pastries were brought back from Xiamen. They divided the gifts into several opaque paper bags according to the list made in the morning, wrote the forms of address on sticky notes and attached them, and checked three times before feeling at ease.
location: Living room, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Brief prayer on the balcony for blessings
description: In the dead of night, Song Yajing stood alone on the balcony, looking at the scattered lights of the old city and the occasional fireworks blooming in the distance. The night wind felt cool on her face. She closed her eyes, made the sign of the cross over her chest, and silently prayed for her family and her shop for the new year. The sourness in her heart slowly melted into a sense of responsibility for the future.
location: Balcony at No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home)

name: Staying up for the New Year countdown and setting off small fireworks
description: Song Yajing woke up her daughter and held her while they watched the Spring Festival Gala countdown. From the TV came shouts of '3, 2, 1,' and outside the window firecrackers were deafening. The whole family loudly said 'Happy New Year' to one another. Afterwards, she took her still-drowsy daughter to the alley entrance, lit the small sparklers she had bought, and her daughter waved them in her arms, her face lit up by the brilliant glow.
location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City, Licheng District, No. 45 North Xinhua Road (parents' home), living room and alley entrance

name: Discuss father's medical treatment arrangements with husband
description: Back in the room, Song Yajing quietly told her husband about the idea of getting medical treatment for her father. Her husband was very steady and held her hand, saying, 'Don't worry. We'll share this together. After the New Year, I'll go with you to take Dad.' She felt much more at ease, and the two discussed making an appointment with an ENT specialist as soon as they returned to Xiamen.
location: Bedroom, No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home).

name: Write down New Year wishes before bed
description: Song Yajing took out a sticky note on the small bedside table and wrote a few lines: 'Family health', 'Smooth store transformation', 'Learn to make more desserts'. She pressed the note under her phone case and let out a long breath. She turned off the light and lay down. Outside, the sound of firecrackers gradually faded. She silently said goodnight in her heart, hoping tomorrow would be better.
location: Bedroom, No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home).

name: Get up, wash up, change into new clothes, and send blessings.
description: Woke up at her parents' home in Quanzhou, feeling fairly energetic. She went to the bathroom to wash up and weighed herself (51.3 kg). Then she returned to the room and put on the red sweater she had specially prepared for the New Year. While her daughter was still asleep, she sat on the living room sofa and opened WeChat on her phone. She first sent New Year greetings to the junior high school classmates group, then chatted privately with Zhang Wei, learned about his job change, and offered comfort.
location: Bedroom and living room of the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Street, Licheng District, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up daughter for breakfast
description: Hearing sounds in the living room, Song Yajing went back to the bedroom to wake her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on a red dress, and tied her hair into a little bun. The whole family sat around eating the thread noodles and steamed bowl cakes her mother had made, while her father and husband chatted. Song Yajing reminded her husband to drive to her father's hometown after Mass.
location: Dining room at the parents’ home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Fujian Province

name: Attend the Chinese New Year Mass (including walking there)
description: After a quick tidy-up, the family of five walked to the Catholic church, passing through several old alleys filled with festive New Year atmosphere. The weather was fine. Entering Quanxi Church, Father Wang Mingde personally presided over the Chinese New Year Mass, with a sermon centered on family and gratitude. Song Yajing prayed devoutly, making wishes for her shop's transformation, her parents' health, and her daughter's school advancement. After Mass, they exchanged New Year greetings with Father Wang and fellow parishioners.
location: Quanzhou Catholic Quanxi Church, Xucuocheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Drove to her father's hometown.
description: After Mass, the family drove to her father's hometown village. On the way, their daughter excitedly looked at the scenery, and her parents talked about the relatives they were going to visit. Song Yajing used her phone's memo app to record her reflections on the Mass and her conversation with Zhang Wei.
location: Father’s hometown natural village near Wulin Traditional Village, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: New Year greeting lunch with relatives and friends
description: When they arrived at the village, paternal cousins gathered in the courtyard of the old house with red brick walls and swallowtail ridges. They exchanged New Year greetings. Song Yajing took her daughter to pay respects to the elders, offering red envelopes and cookies. The elders asked about her clothing store, and she told them about the online pre-sale and the drink corner. Her cousins' wives and older female cousins found it novel and encouraged her. Lunch was Minnan farmhouse dishes. During the meal, they chatted, and she asked her father whether he was willing to go to Xiamen for an ear examination.
location: The courtyard of the old family house in her father's hometown village, near Wulin Traditional Village, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: After the meal, enjoyed tea, chatted, and took a walk.
description: After the meal, everyone sat around drinking tea, peeling oranges, cracking sunflower seeds, and chatting. The cousins' wives were interested in online pre-sales, and Song Yajing answered in detail. The children played in the alley, and Xuanxuan joined in. Song Yajing chatted with her female cousins and sisters-in-law, enjoying the slow-paced rural Spring Festival.
location: Father’s hometown natural village near Wulin Traditional Village, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Say goodbye to relatives and friends and return to parents' home.
description: At 3 p.m. they said goodbye, and the cousin warmly gave them napa cabbage and dried sweet potatoes. Song Yajing thanked her cousin's wife for the encouragement and invited her to visit Xiamen. On the way back, her daughter got sleepy and dozed off in her mother's arms.
location: On the way from near Wulin Traditional Village, Jinjiang City, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province to the parents' home in Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou

name: Midday rest and personal notes.
description: Returned to her parents' home and carried her sleeping daughter to bed. The daughter nearly rolled off the bed, and she caught her, still shaken. She then leaned against the headboard and used her phone's memo app to record her thoughts on the New Year visits and Zhang Wei's situation, reminding herself to be cautious in the online transition. She set an alarm and took a nap.
location: Bedroom at the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Fujian Province.

name: Chat with mother to confirm tomorrow's arrangements
description: After the alarm went off, she went to the living room and saw her mother picking vegetables, so she sat down to help pick green beans and chat. She asked what needed to be prepared for her elder sister's visit back home on the second day of the Lunar New Year the next day, and her mother said everything was ready.
location: Living room of the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Playing with her daughter and helping with meal prep
description: After her daughter woke up in good spirits, she played with toys with her in the living room. Then she took her daughter to the kitchen to make dumplings with her mother, letting Xuanxuan knead the dough. It was full of laughter.
location: Living room and kitchen of the parents' home at Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner was hearty, with takeout farmhouse dishes and dumplings made by her mother. Her father volunteered to go to Xiamen after the New Year to have his ears checked, and Song Yajing felt relieved. After dinner, she sat with her father and drank tea, talking about the shop's new spring arrivals. Her father said it was better to be steady.
location: Dining room at the parents’ home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Fujian Province

name: Video call with my older sister.
description: Song Yajing used her phone to video call her older sister Song Yawen and confirmed that Song Yawen and her brother-in-law would arrive in Quanzhou around ten the next day. She reminded her sister that their father's ear had already been arranged for a check-up back in Xiamen, to reassure her. They chatted about the seafood gift box her sister had brought and the tiramisu she had made.
location: Living room and balcony of the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Soothing her daughter to sleep and pre-bed washing up.
description: Daughter was sleepy, so I helped her wash up, read a picture book story, and hummed songs to lull her to sleep. After she fell asleep, I washed up and did my skincare. My husband talked about how visiting relatives felt, and we both agreed the New Year atmosphere was strong.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the parents' home, Kaiyuan Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Relaxation and prayer before bed.
description: Back in bed, I browsed fashion news and local news on my phone. Then I stretched for 15 minutes to relax; today's step count was about 8,000 steps. Before bed, I knelt by the bedside and prayed, grateful that the first day of the new year had passed peacefully.
location: Bedroom at the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-sleep conversation and going to bed
description: Talked with her husband about how the shop could put out the new spring collection after returning to Xiamen. Then turned off the lights and rested, ending a fulfilling first day of the Lunar New Year.
location: Bedroom at the parents' home in Quanzhou, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Fujian Province.

name: Morning gratitude and preparation
description: Woke up in the bedroom at her parents' home and had a short morning prayer, thanking the Lord for a peaceful new day and asking for a smooth family gathering. Then she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan and told her that her aunt and older cousin were about to arrive. Xuanxuan was immediately wide awake.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: After washing up, the family came to the dining room. Mother had prepared the Manjian cake bought from a time-honored shop on West Street during Father's morning run, along with freshly squeezed soy milk. Father brewed a pot of Anxi Tieguanyin tea. Everyone sat around together, and the conversation centered on the upcoming arrival of my sister's family. I reminded my husband to tidy up the space in the car, while Xuanxuan excitedly counted down to when her cousin would arrive.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Mother and daughter worked together to prepare tea to welcome the bridegroom.
description: After breakfast, I began preparing with my mother to welcome my older sister's family. I took out the tiramisu and cookies made in advance to bring to room temperature, while my mother brought out her treasured candies and snacks to arrange on plates. I rearranged the living room coffee table, made decorations from folded red paper, placed narcissus, and told my father to brew the best Tieguanyin, creating a strong New Year atmosphere.
location: Parents' home living room and kitchen, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Precious reunion of sisters
description: My older sister Song Yawen and her family arrived. I quickly walked to the door and hugged her tightly. My brother-in-law took out large and small bags of New Year goods from the trunk, including Shenzhen pastries and dried squid. I happily opened the packages and started eating, and my sister laughed at me for being such a foodie. My parents stood at the door watching their two daughters each arriving with their families, their eyes full of pride and contentment.
location: At the front door of the parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Paying New Year visits, chatting about everyday life, and distributing gifts.
description: After entering the house, we exchanged New Year greetings. I gave my nephew a red envelope with lucky money, and my sister and brother-in-law gave Xuanxuan a Disney stationery gift set. The children quickly became familiar and played with scooters and snap pops in the yard. The adults sat in the living room drinking tea and eating snacks while catching up. I noticed my sister looked well and was in good spirits.
location: Parents' home living room and courtyard, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian

name: Sumptuous luncheon and planning exchange
description: The lunch feast was Minnan home-style dishes that my parents had been busy preparing all morning, including oyster omelet, fried vinegar pork, braised noodles, and pork rib soup. The atmosphere at the table was lively. My older sister shared new models for cross-border e-commerce from Shenzhen and suggested I try posting short styling videos on Xiaohongshu with shop links. I carefully noted down the keywords. Then I took out the school comparison chart on my phone about choosing a school for my daughter and discussed it with my sister. She recommended the Experimental Primary School, which is close to home and has a gentle atmosphere, saying it would suit Xuanxuan better. We agreed to continue the discussion after the New Year.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon tea, farewell, and an unexpected interlude.
description: After the lunch banquet, we had tea. I brought out the tiramisu, and my sister tasted it with surprise and praised it. My sister's family had to rush back to Shenzhen, so I packed up the remaining cookies and a large piece of tiramisu for them to eat on the way. My mother reluctantly gave her reminders, and the children said goodbye reluctantly. Before the car started, my nephew knocked over a bottle of mineral water in the car and wet the seat. I helped wipe it up and made a joke to ease the sadness of parting. Then I stood by the roadside watching my sister's car drive out of the alley. Though I felt reluctant, I was filled with the contentment of being together.
location: The parents' home living room and beside the parking space downstairs at No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Brief rest and refreshment
description: After seeing off her sister's family, she returned to her room, sat on the edge of the bed to rest, opened the memo on her phone, and noted down the short video and e-commerce operation keywords her sister had mentioned, feeling that she had gained a lot.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon Stroll in the Fragrant Grass Garden: Family Time and Career Ideas
description: The family of three set out from Xianhou Street and walked along Jiuguanyi Lane to Fangcao Garden. Inside the garden, red-brick traditional houses stood out against the fresh greenery, and the air was clean. While walking, I told my husband about the short-video product promotion model my sister suggested. He said we could give it a try but reminded me to keep running the physical store steadily. I also mentioned the plan to renovate the drink corner of the shop, wanting to add wood-grain stickers, a magazine rack, and so on. My husband told me to measure the space first when I got back and reminded me not to forget to pay the parking fee.
location: Fangcaoyuan, Xinhua South Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and rest
description: After walking home, Xuanxuan was a little tired, so I helped her wash her hands and face. My mother prepared dinner, reheated the dishes left from lunch, and cooked a pot of sweet potato porridge. My father watched the news and my husband chatted with him. During dinner, my father mentioned again that he wanted to go to Xiamen to have his ears checked. I solemnly reassured him and confirmed that a full check-up would be arranged after the Spring Festival. After dinner, I helped my mother clear the dishes.
location: Parents' home at No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Companionship and soothing her to sleep
description: Gave Xuanxuan a hot bath and read her a picture book story about a little rabbit reuniting with its good friends. After hearing it, she asked if she could play with her older cousin again tomorrow. I kissed her forehead and promised to invite them to the beach again during the summer vacation. She hugged my neck and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night planning, outlining a business blueprint.
description: After the family went to bed, she brewed a cup of flower tea and sat at her desk. Using a tape measure and pencil, she carefully drew a top-view plan for remodeling the drink corner, marking the dimensions and the positions of the coffee machine, cup rack, and small blackboard, and simulated the power strip routing to ensure safety. Finally, she made a materials list: self-adhesive wood-grain wall stickers, a warm-color desk lamp, a wrought-iron magazine rack, and so on. Although a bit tired, she felt motivated thinking of her husband's practical care and had a clear picture of the store adjustment after the New Year.
location: At the desk in her parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Today: a good end and a restful sleep
description: Did bedtime stretches to relieve the day's fatigue. Recorded today's weight (51.2kg) and step count (about 6,500 steps) on my phone. Knelt by the bed and said a brief prayer of thanks for family reunion, my father's smooth check-up, my sister's family's safe return trip, and my own career development. After setting the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow, I lay down peacefully, ending a day of both emotional and planning success.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 79 Xianhou Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up, family breakfast, and getting my daughter settled.
description: Sunlight streamed through the wooden window lattice of the old house into the bedroom, and Song Yajing woke up naturally. After washing up, she went downstairs, where her mother Lin Xiuying had prepared a hearty breakfast: sweet potato porridge, homemade pickled radish, and fried dough sticks. She fed her daughter Xuanxuan, who was acting cute in her grandmother's arms. Song Yajing smiled and handed Xuanxuan to her mother, telling her she wouldn't be back for lunch. Her mother urged her to change into the new sweater her sister had given her, saying the color flattered her complexion.
location: Parents' home, Taikui Lane, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Grooming and getting ready to go out.
description: Returning to the bedroom, she changed into the beige cashmere sweater and dark corduroy skirt her sister gave her, simple and elegant. She applied a muted rose lipstick in the mirror to look energetic. She carefully checked her handbag to make sure she had her phone, wallet, and keys, then kissed Xuanxuan, who was still lying in bed, said goodbye to her mother, and got ready to go out.
location: Bedroom at the parents’ home, Taikui Alley, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Walked to Zhongshan Road to meet up with her best friend
description: Song Yajing walked out of her home and headed along West Street toward the Clock Tower intersection of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Many shops along the way had already opened, and the old town remained lively as the Spring Festival holiday drew to a close. She stopped at the clock tower and waited for her close friends Li Meiling and Wang Jia to arrive.
location: Clock Tower Intersection, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Went shopping with her best friend on Zhongshan Road.
description: Li Meiling and Wang Jia arrived on time. Li Meiling laughed and said Song Yajing looked much better in person than in the video. The three of them felt like they were back in middle school, slowly browsing through shops one by one along Zhongshan Road. Song Yajing tried on vintage barrettes, Wang Jia liked a cashmere scarf, and Li Meiling lingered in front of a dinosaur toy store. They chatted while walking. Li Meiling shared amusing stories from her students' final exams, Wang Jia complained about her year-end bonus shrinking, and Song Yajing talked about her sister's advice on choosing a school for Xuanxuan. Laughter kept coming, carefree and unrestrained.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch: trying authentic local snacks at Afen Braised Noodles
description: Around noon, Song Yajing suggested going to the nearby A-Fen Braised Noodles for lunch. The three walked into this old shop specializing in Quanzhou braised noodles, and each ordered a steaming bowl of braised noodles with pork large intestines and vinegar pork. As she ate, Song Yajing remarked that the taste of her hometown was exactly right—a flavor you can't find in Xiamen.
location: Afen Braised Noodles (Huaxiang Branch), No. 6 Zhongshan Middle Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Go to Twelve Flavors Café.
description: After lunch, the three of them strolled leisurely along Zhongshan Road toward Beimen Street, admiring the arcade buildings on both sides, chatting and laughing. After about ten-odd minutes' walk, they arrived at the quiet Twelve Flavors Café.
location: Twelve Flavors Café, Beimen Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Had an in-depth discussion at the café and got advice on community operations.
description: They sat down in the coffee aroma and ordered a caramel macchiato and tiramisu. Song Yajing mentioned her confusion about trying community pre-sales. Wang Jia seriously suggested, "You can post styling tips at a fixed time every day, such as 8 p.m., to develop user habits, and then use a mini program for group-buying chain orders." She also recommended a tool called "Shimo Docs" for collecting customer preference data, and demonstrated it on her phone right there. Song Yajing quickly recorded it in her phone memo and remarked, "No wonder she is an internet mogul." In the warmth of the coffee, she felt the shop's future seemed a little clearer.
location: Twelve Flavors Café, Beimen Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Say goodbye to her close friend, take a walk alone, experience the local street life, and relax with a shampoo.
description: At 3 p.m., her best friends were about to leave. The three hugged and said goodbye at the door of the café, agreeing to meet again in Xiamen. After watching them leave, Song Yajing strolled alone into the deep alleys of Beimen Street, passing through Taikui Lane, Pei Lane, and others. She passed a street-side park and watched old men playing chess; at the lane entrance she bought a cup of refreshingly sweet stone flower jelly and drank it as she walked. Spotting a clean and tidy hair salon, she decided on a whim to go in for a shampoo and enjoyed a comfortable head massage that relieved her days of fatigue.
location: Lane and barbershop near Beimen Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Returned to her parents' home and helped her family prepare dinner.
