description: After enjoying the head massage, Song Yajing felt refreshed and walked about 15 minutes back to her parents' home along familiar alleys. Pushing open the door, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was helping her father Song Minghui tend to the kumquat potted plant on the balcony, while her mother Lin Xiuying was busy in the kitchen preparing shacha noodles. Song Yajing washed her hands and went into the kitchen to help, telling her mother about her shopping trip and Wang Jia's suggestions as she trimmed the vegetables, feeling the aroma rising in the kitchen and the warmth of family.
location: Parents' home, Taikui Lane, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had a reunion dinner together.
description: In the evening, the rich aroma of satay noodles filled the air. The whole family sat around the table for the last reunion dinner of the Spring Festival holiday. The table also had her mother's braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fried vinegar pork. Her father reminded her to drive safely back to Xiamen tomorrow, and her mother kept putting food into Song Yajing's bowl, telling her not to just focus on the store but to take care of her health. Song Yajing's nose stung slightly as she agreed one by one.
location: Parents' home, Taikui Lane, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: After-dinner chat and packing luggage
description: After dinner, Song Yajing sat with her parents in the living room watching TV and chatted about her plans to return to Xiamen. Her husband Aqiang played with building blocks with their daughter. Later, she went to the bedroom and began packing for the return trip. She carefully put the red envelopes from the past few days and the stationery gift box her sister had given Xuanxuan into the suitcase, and wrapped the plastic bag her mother had pressed on her, filled with homemade sausages and meat zongzi, in clothes to keep it from being crushed.
location: Parents' home, Taikui Lane, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Discovered the money her mother had secretly slipped to her.
description: While tidying her makeup bag, Song Yajing found a bulging envelope inside. Opening it, she saw a thick stack of cash, 2,000 yuan. Her eyes instantly reddened; she understood her mother had put it there secretly. She didn't make a fuss and carefully tucked the envelope at the bottom of her suitcase. Then she stood by the window, looked at the peaceful night view of Quanzhou's old town, took a photo, and posted it on Moments with the caption: 'Recharged, ready to go again.'
location: Bedroom at the parents’ home, Taikui Alley, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Writing in a diary and quiet reflection
description: After packing her luggage, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard, took out her diary, and wrote a review by the bedside lamp: this January had sleepless nights, tears, and arguments, but she also tried to open the shop online, seriously considered Xuanxuan's schooling, and for the first time felt the sadness of her father growing old... but the family was all together. She wrote "Come on, February." Then she closed the notebook and went to wash up.
location: Bedroom at the parents’ home, Taikui Alley, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep.
description: After washing up, Song Yajing returned to bed and quietly said her bedtime prayers, thanking God for the day's reunion and the peace and strength He granted, asking for a safe journey home tomorrow and a smooth new year for the store. Then she turned off the bedside lamp and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at the parents’ home, Taikui Alley, West Street, Kaiyuan Subdistrict, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken by the alarm clock and the aroma of oyster omelet drifting up from downstairs, I turned my head and saw my daughter Xuanxuan still sound asleep, her little face rosy. I got up quietly, washed up briefly, and opened the window to feel the cool morning air of Quanzhou on the last day of the holiday. Hearing my father and mother talking downstairs, I felt especially at ease.
location: Second-floor bedroom in her parents' home at Luxiading, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Family shares a Minnan-style breakfast together and cleans up after the meal
description: After Aqiang and Xuanxuan finished washing up, the family of five sat around the dining table. Breakfast was the sweet potato porridge, fried oysters, pickled radish omelette, and pickled cucumbers that Mother had prepared. Father and Mother discussed what needed to be tidied up at home after we returned to Xiamen tomorrow. Aqiang asked Father about the dripping faucet, while Xuanxuan gestured beside them, acting out stories Grandpa told her when she was little. As I put food on Xuanxuan's plate, I thought about video-calling my sister today. After breakfast, I helped Mother take the dishes to the kitchen, and while she was washing them, I told her I wanted to video-call my sister in the morning. Mother said a neighbor happened to be coming over, and they could make a cake together. I went upstairs to get my phone to contact my sister.
location: The first-floor dining room and kitchen of the parents' home at Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Video call with older sister Song Yawen
description: Back in the bedroom, she initiated a video call on WeChat with her older sister Song Yawen, who is in Shenzhen. They talked for nearly half an hour. Her sister shared amusing stories from her short trip to Guangzhou during the Spring Festival and also asked about my shop's plans for new products after the New Year. I explained in detail my ideas for adding a drink corner in the shop and running fine-grained community operations. My sister reminded me to calculate the costs carefully and make a budget. I also mentioned Dad's declining hearing and hoped she could say something during the video call to urge Dad to go to Xiamen for a check-up after the holiday. She agreed and said she would video-call Dad again in the evening. Finally, I said I planned to go to the church in the afternoon to say a short prayer for tomorrow's return trip, to put her mind at ease.
location: Second-floor bedroom in her parents' home at Luxiading, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Made old-fashioned cakes with her mother and neighbors
description: After hanging up the phone, I went downstairs to the kitchen, where my mother had already taken out the cake flour, eggs, milk, corn oil, and lemons for making an old-fashioned cake. I tied on an apron, helped her separate the egg whites and yolks, and prepared the molds. My mother took out the old oven and wiped it clean. Soon the kitchen became lively. Aunt Lin from the neighboring alley dropped by; she was my mother's old friend and also a fellow church member. My mother gave instructions, Aunt Lin helped as an assistant, and I operated according to the directions: heating the corn oil, sifting in the flour, stirring the egg yolk batter, whipping the egg whites... While waiting for the cake to bake, my mother, Aunt Lin, and I talked about the pressure at the store. They advised me to relax and rely more on faith. My mother quietly mentioned that she wanted a silk scarf for her birthday on February 14, one I had shown her before, and I made a mental note. An hour later, the cake came out of the oven. The surface was slightly cracked but the texture was soft and fluffy, with a rich aroma of egg yolks and milk.
location: The first-floor kitchen and living room of her parents' home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and tasting the freshly baked cake
description: Aunt Lin said goodbye and went home. Mother cut the freshly baked cake into pieces, and the family had it as a pre-meal snack. Xuanxuan especially loved it and had two pieces. Then Mother reheated the leftover pork rib soup and stir-fried vegetables from last night, and we had a simple lunch. At the table, I mentioned going for a walk in Zhongshan Park in the afternoon; Father nodded and said he would buy a newspaper on the way.
location: Dining room on the first floor of her parents’ home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and personal review
description: After lunch, I played building blocks with Xuanxuan for a while, then coaxed her to take an afternoon nap. After she fell asleep, I leaned against the headboard but didn't fully rest. I opened the Shimo Docs app on my phone and, following Wang Jia's earlier suggestion, created a table framework called "Yaji Apparel - Customer Preference Collection" with columns for style preferences, sizes, special occasion needs, contact information, and so on. Then I opened my notes and reviewed the community operation ideas I'd written down while shopping with Jiajia and Lingling. I picked a few that seemed feasible and wrote a draft teaser post for WeChat Moments: "On the last day of the holiday, eating the cake my mom made, thinking about how to make you all even more beautiful this year. After I return to Xiamen, see you in the group ~"
location: Second-floor bedroom in her parents' home at Luxiading, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied her father to Zhongshan Park for a walk and back.
description: She gently woke Xuanxuan, wiped her face, and helped her put on outdoor clothes. She also changed into her sneakers and a thick coat, and grabbed her wallet and phone. Going downstairs, she told her husband and father that they were ready to go for a walk. She walked side by side with her father through the alleys of Licheng's old town. The winter sun was warm, and the streets still had a Spring Festival atmosphere. After reaching Zhongshan Park, her father told stories of his youth here as they walked. She took the opportunity to bring up his declining hearing again and said seriously, "Dad, yesterday Aunt Lin also said that people have to repeat themselves loudly when they talk to you. We're going back to Xiamen tomorrow. You and Mom should come stay with us for a few days next week, and I'll take you to the First Hospital for a thorough checkup." After a moment of silence, her father agreed. After leaving the park, she went to the newsstand at the main gate and bought Quanzhou Evening News and Readers. After walking home, she put away her father's newspaper and coat and told her mother that Dad had agreed to the checkup. Her mother said yes repeatedly, feeling as if a weight had been lifted from her heart.
location: Zhongshan Park on Zhongshan North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian, and the newsstand at its main entrance.

name: Organized notes on community operations and the customer data framework.
description: She went up to her father's study on the second floor, sat down at the desk, and opened her phone. Combining Wang Jia's suggestions from yesterday with her own ideas, she first used Shimo Docs to improve the table framework for customer preferences and added a 'Beverage Preferences' column to build anticipation for the beverage corner. Next, she polished the draft of her previous WeChat Moments post and wrote another teaser post about 'an auspicious start to work,' planning to publish it tomorrow evening after arriving in Xiamen. After doing all this, she felt much more at ease.
location: Second-floor study at parents' home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian, China.

name: Family interaction and dinner preparation
description: Went downstairs and joined Aqiang and Xuanxuan's jigsaw puzzle battle, helping find a few key pieces of the "bamboo" and "eyes". After that, my mother suggested making Xuanxuan's favorite popiah for dinner, so I helped by shredding carrots and dried tofu. Aqiang was in the living room discussing with my father what time to set off back to Xiamen tomorrow, and they finally decided to leave after lunch, so the schedule was relaxed.
location: Living room and kitchen on the first floor of her parents' home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner was abundant. Mother made popiah, steamed sea bass, and garlic lettuce. The news was playing on TV. Father was in a good mood and asked about my plans for new items in the shop after the Spring Festival. I briefly told them about my idea of adding a drink corner and using social media for online operations. Mother kept saying 'good' and told me not to work too hard, while Father instructed Aqiang to help me more and not let me carry everything on my own.
location: Dining room on the first floor of her parents’ home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Packed luggage with her daughter and comforted her emotions.
description: After dinner, I took Xuanxuan back to the bedroom and opened the suitcase that wasn't packed yet. I first folded the clothes and put them in, then carefully packed the dried seafood and meat zongzi my mother had prepared, as well as the picture books and jigsaw puzzle my father had bought for Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan helped me put her toy bunny and crayons into the small carry-on bag, but her little mouth was pouting higher and higher and her eyes were turning red. I squatted down, hugged her, and said softly, "Sweetie, are you going to miss Grandpa and Grandma?" She nodded and tears fell. I comforted her patiently and promised that as soon as the store wasn't busy, I would definitely bring her back to Quanzhou to stay for many days, and we could also take her to Grandma's vegetable garden to pick vegetables.
location: Second-floor bedroom in her parents' home at Luxiading, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Took a walk with her husband near the neighborhood in the evening
description: After Xuanxuan calmed down, Aqiang suggested going out for a walk to help digest. We left Xuanxuan with my parents for a while, changed shoes, and went out. The neighborhood was quiet, and the streets were brightly lit. We strolled slowly along Jiadi Lane at the entrance. He asked if I was confident about going back to Xiamen tomorrow. I said I was a bit nervous, but knowing my family was so supportive, I wasn't afraid. He squeezed my hand and told me not to overthink and just follow the plan.
location: Inside Luxiacheng Residential Community and surrounding streets such as Jiadi Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Video call with older sister and father.
description: After coming back from the walk, I took my father by the hand and sat down with him on the sofa, then called my sister via video on my phone. My sister first chatted with my father for a while, then smiled and urged him: "Dad, Yajing says you're a bit hard of hearing. You should listen to her and go to Xiamen for a check-up. Don't keep toughing it out just because you think you're in good health." My father rarely declined this time; he smiled and agreed. My mother was also happy on the side. After chatting for more than ten minutes, I felt more at ease after hanging up.
location: Living room on the first floor of her parents' home at Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: I bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and carried her back to bed. She wrapped her arms around my neck and whispered, "Mom, drive carefully tomorrow." My heart warmed. I told her two bedtime stories and watched her slowly close her eyes and breathe evenly. After confirming she was asleep, I quietly left the room.
location: Second-floor bedroom in her parents' home at Luxiading, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation, prayer, and going to bed.
description: She quietly returned to the bedroom, first checking the list of items to bring back to Xiamen tomorrow: ID documents, keys, charger, local specialties for her husband and daughter... Then she checked again that the silk scarf, her mother's birthday gift, was hidden in the suitcase lining. Then she sat down at the small desk, took out her diary, and briefly wrote down today's feelings, writing 'Go February.' In her phone memo, she listed a simple plan for tomorrow's return trip: leave early, arrive home at noon, organize luggage in the afternoon, and stop by the shop in the evening. After everything was ready, she knelt by the bed, pressed her palms together, and closed her eyes, thanking God for the warm Spring Festival holiday, thanking Him for her family's safety and health, and also praying for wisdom and courage for the shop in the new year, entrusting her inner tension and expectations to the Lord. After Aqiang came back to the room, she quietly told him that her father had agreed to the check-up, and he was very happy. When she mentioned her mother's birthday gift, he said she should decide. They chatted a bit about tomorrow's travel arrangements, and he told her to go to sleep early. She lay down and turned off the light, feeling nostalgia for the holiday and anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Second-floor bedroom and study at parents' home, Luxiacheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Early morning wake-up and pre-departure preparations.
description: In the bedroom at her parents' home in Quanzhou, Song Yajing woke up naturally and quietly got out of bed to fill cups with warm water for her husband and herself. She checked the hearing aid brochure prepared for her father and the local specialties her mother had packed into the luggage, such as meat zongzi and rice cakes. Then she woke her daughter Xuanxuan and helped her put on a thick coat. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang checked the luggage to make sure the keys and chargers were all in place.
location: Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home, bedroom and living room area)

name: Warm breakfast and saying goodbye to family
description: In the dining room at her parents' home, her mother Lin Xiuying had prepared Hokkien misua soup, pork floss, and fried eggs. During the meal, her mother repeatedly reminded them to be safe on the road, and her father Song Minghui put a piece of turnip cake on Xuanxuan's plate and told her to be good. Although Xuanxuan was feeling low, she finished breakfast while listening to her grandmother's stories. Looking at her parents' graying hair, Yajing felt concerned about her father's hearing problem.
location: Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (parents' home dining room)

name: Loading the luggage and bidding a reluctant farewell
description: At the lane entrance downstairs from her parents' home, Chen Zhiqiang loaded the suitcase and local specialties into the car. Yajing hugged her parents goodbye. Her father patted her shoulder and said he would get his ears checked, while her mother secretly wiped away tears. Xuanxuan clung to her grandmother and cried for a while, then Yajing put her into the car and buckled her into the safety seat. At 8:50 the car slowly pulled away, and Yajing watched her parents' figures in the rearview mirror until they disappeared.
location: Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (alley entrance downstairs from parents' home)

name: Shenhai Expressway, first half of the return trip (Quanzhou to Xiamen).
description: They entered the Shenhai Expressway from the Quanzhou toll station and headed for Xiamen. Because of heavy return traffic, the drive was stop-and-go. Chen Zhiqiang focused on driving while Yajing took care of their daughter, playing cartoons on a tablet and soothing her with snacks. She sent a WeChat message to her sister to let her know they were safe, and also notified the shop assistant Xiaomei of the next day's opening preparations, including turning on the heating, checking the lanterns, and putting up the reopening poster.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Quanzhou section to Xiamen section)

name: Rest and lunch at Puli Service Area
description: Because of traffic congestion and fatigue, the family stopped at Puli Service Area to rest. After queuing for the restroom, Yajing bought instant noodles and braised eggs at the convenience store, and together with the meat zongzi they had brought, the family had a simple lunch on benches in the rest area, taking about 50 minutes.
location: Puli Service Area, Jinjiang City, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province (Shenyang direction, Shenhai Expressway)

name: Second half of the return trip on the Shenhai Expressway (severe congestion)
description: After leaving the service area, the road was still severely congested. Due to a rear-end collision, the speed dropped to 15 km/h, and the navigation map was a sea of red. Chen Zhiqiang drove cautiously, while Yajing took care of their daughter, feeding her crackers and playing nursery rhymes. She checked the traffic conditions on her phone and sent a WeChat message to supplier Susan to confirm the shipment of the spring new arrivals.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Xiamen section)

name: Drive off the expressway and enter Xiamen city.
description: Around 3 p.m., they left the Shenhai Expressway and entered Xiamen city, where the roads were relatively smooth. The daughter was tired and fell asleep in the car. Yajing replied to several New Year greeting WeChat messages, including a greeting from former colleague Zheng Kai. Chen Zhiqiang drove along Yanwu Bridge and Siming South Road toward home.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (along Yanwu Bridge and Siming South Road)

name: Arrived home in Xiamen and got settled.
description: At 3:40 p.m., the car drove into the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community. After Chen Zhiqiang parked, the two took turns carrying the luggage up to the third-floor home. The daughter was still asleep and was gently carried upstairs and placed on the bedroom sofa, covered with a blanket.
location: 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (parking lot and home)

name: Household tidying and rest.
description: Yajing sorted and put away the luggage, hung up the spring new-arrival clothing to take to the shop, put food in the freezer, returned daily necessities to their places, and found the remote control for the shop's rolling shutter door to charge it. Chen Zhiqiang went downstairs to check the car and inflated the tires.
location: Residential complex at No. 82 Shangu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home living room and kitchen)

name: Simple dinner and family time
description: Xuanxuan woke up, and the family of three sat around the dining table. Yajing cooked instant noodles with Quanzhou rice cakes, green vegetables, and eggs as dinner. After the meal, she wiped the dining table and began preparing to return to work the next day.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare for tomorrow's return to work and communication matters.
description: In the study, Yajing video-called her mother on her phone to report that she was safe. Then she opened Shimo Docs to sort out the next day's workflow: turn on the heating at the store, put up posters, organize the shelves, confirm orders with Susan, update the customer preference table, and sketch an outline for a short styling video script. She wrote an opening note in her journal.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home study room)

name: Washing up, praying, and accompanying her daughter.
description: Yajing gave Xuanxuan a hot bath, changed her into pajamas, and did a quick wash-up herself. The family of three gathered in the bedroom. Yajing lit a prayer candle and led the family in a bedtime prayer, thanking God for their safe travels and praying for a smooth workday. Then she read Xuanxuan the story "Tom the Little Rabbit" and watched her fall asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Personal planning and preparation for returning to work
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Yajing replied to her older sister's voice message in the study, confirming the appointment for her father to come to Xiamen next Wednesday for a hearing check. She opened Shimo Docs to write the copy for the start-of-work short video, and notified Xiaomei, the shop assistant, to send a start-of-work greeting red packet in the community group the next day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home study room)

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Turned off the phone alarm, did neck stretches, then turned off the lights and lay down. The body was tired but the heart was full; after silently reciting a short prayer, I gradually fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home bedroom)

name: Morning gratitude and family breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm went off and lay in bed saying a quiet prayer of gratitude. When she heard her husband Chen Zhiqiang preparing breakfast, she changed into dark gray sweatpants and a white long-sleeved T-shirt and tied her hair into a low ponytail. The family of three had breakfast together; her husband had cooked sweet potato porridge and fried eggs. Yajing asked her husband to take their daughter Chen Lexuan to kindergarten and also to bring her down jacket to the dry cleaner. Their daughter exclaimed excitedly that she had dreamed of her maternal grandparents buying her cotton candy. Yajing smiled and promised that she could tell them about it herself during the video call that evening.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready to go out, walking commute, and buying breakfast
description: Song Yajing slung her crossbody bag over her shoulder, checked her shop keys, phone, and electric bike keys, put on a light down jacket and flat sneakers, and headed out. She chose to walk to the shop, going along Shanggu Street. Passing Xiao Li Fresh Bun Shop at the Huyuan intersection, she bought two pork buns and a cup of hot soy milk, ate them simply while walking, and enjoyed the morning sunshine.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: walk from No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex to Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, passing Xiaoli Fresh Baozi Shop at No. 1 Huyuan Road

name: Deep cleaning the store
description: Song Yajing arrived at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, opened the windows for ventilation, and used her phone's Bluetooth to connect to the speaker and play "Here Comes the Sun." She put on rubber gloves and started cleaning thoroughly from the fitting room, using a small brush to remove mildew spots in the corners, disinfecting and wiping down, mopping the floor, wiping the shelves, and polishing the display window with newspaper and glass cleaner. The bending work made her waist sore and numb; she sighed softly but persisted in tidying the cashier counter and the stockroom, leaving the store completely refreshed.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Packing up lunch and taking a short midday rest
description: Song Yajing walked to the Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop, ordered the classic shacha noodles to go, with squid and tofu, then brought them back to the shop and ate them at the cashier counter. While eating, she scrolled through her phone and replied in the customer group about the official opening tomorrow. After the meal, she leaned back in her chair and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes.
location: Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop at No. 78 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road.

name: Unpacking, ironing, and displaying spring clothing.
description: Song Yajing carried out several boxes of early spring new arrivals, opened them with a utility knife, and took out shirts, dresses, and light knitwear to carefully inspect the loose threads and buttons. She steamed each garment one by one, immersed in the texture of the fabrics. Then she rearranged the display in a gradient color scheme of light pink, white, misty blue, and grass green, replacing the winter coats in the window with floral dresses and off-white knit cardigans, and also adjusted the main display stand by color. Finally, she handwrote the "Spring Collection 2025" price tags.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Capsule Coffee Machine Test and Drink Corner Upgrade Concept
description: Song Yajing excitedly brought out the capsule coffee machine, filled it with water, plugged it in, and inserted a capsule. But the coffee came out too fast, the crema was thin, and the aroma was weak, leaving her a little disappointed. This strengthened her resolve to upgrade her drink corner. She noted in her phone memo, "Determined to upgrade; target: semi-automatic espresso machine + professional grinder; budget to be calculated," and imagined where to place a bar counter. She also wiped down the coffee machine.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Buying medicine and shopping on the way home from work
description: Due to a full day of intense labor, her lower back was sore. Song Yajing locked the shop door and walked to Luyan Pharmacy on Zhenhai Road to buy Yunnan Baiyao patches and calcium tablets. Then she rode her electric bike home and bought whole-wheat bread and milk at Xingjiuwan Grocery Convenience Store at the entrance of the residential community to prepare for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: Luyan Pharmacy at No. 39-2 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Xingjiuwan Grocery Store near the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Song Yajing got home to find her husband preparing dinner and her daughter doing homework. She took over the cooking and made garlic broccoli and shredded pork with green peppers. The family of three ate together happily. She shared the distinctive floral-print dress she had noticed that day while ironing and the story of the coffee machine test that didn't turn out well. Her husband suggested that they calculate the investment costs carefully and not act impulsively.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening: building LEGO together with the child.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing sat on the carpet with her daughter and played with LEGO. As they built, they made up stories together. Xuanxuan called it the "Princess's Spring Garden." Yajing thought the theme was romantic and quietly noted it might serve as inspiration for the window display.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
description: Song Yajing called her mother Lin Xiuying on video. Her daughter eagerly told her grandparents that she had dreamed of them buying cotton candy, and they laughed heartily. Yajing took over the phone to greet her mother, then chatted with her father Song Minghui about his trip to Xiamen next Thursday for a hearing check-up, confirmed that the high-speed train ticket had been bought, and reminded him not to forget. The call warmed her heart.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal review and photo organization
description: Song Yajing made a cup of hot tea, opened her journal in the study, and recorded the day's insights, writing in detail her initial ideas and budget for upgrading the coffee machine. She browsed the photos of the store's spring clothing displays on her phone, selected a few satisfactory ones, adjusted the colors with a photo-editing app, and saved them as backup images for Moments.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shared the fruits of today's labor with her best friend.
description: Song Yajing sent photos of the shop's new display to the three-person besties group chat, showing her childhood friends Wang Jia and Li Meiling the results. Wang Jia praised the color coordination as amazing and said she wanted to go in and browse; Li Meiling said she would come to the store next weekend to buy a new dress. Yajing felt very satisfied looking at the replies.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lower back care and relaxation.
description: Song Yajing changed into her pajamas and asked her husband to apply a Yunnan Baiyao medicated patch to her lower back. Worried about her, her husband advised her not to push herself too hard the next day. Lying on her stomach on the bed, she applied a hot water bottle to her lower back, closed her eyes, and emptied her mind, feeling the fatigue gradually dissipate with the warmth.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and rest.
description: Song Yajing and her husband knelt down together by the bed, holding hands for a short prayer, thanking the Lord for a fulfilling and peaceful day and praying for the health and safety of their family. Afterwards she leaned against the headboard and read Proverbs chapter 31, then turned off the light and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations
description: Song Yajing woke up at home in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, washed up, and felt her lower back was still sore and swollen. She then lit a candle before the holy icon in the living room for morning prayer, asking for smoothness and for wisdom to communicate with her husband. After praying, she heated milk and had breakfast with whole-wheat bread and rice cakes. After breakfast, she checked the store keys and power bank, put a folding umbrella into her commuter bag, confirmed that her father would come to Xiamen the day after tomorrow, put on a thin down jacket, locked the door, and got ready to leave.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and store opening preparations
description: Yajing walked from home to “Yajing Boutique Clothing Store” at Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. When passing the stationery store on Park South Road, she did not go in, because her daughter Xuanxuan was with her husband today. After arriving at the store, she pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights and heater, boiled water and made coffee, and at the same time sent a voice message to Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, asking about the spring clothing delivery time. Then she looked at the empty area next to the cash register, her heart racing.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, along the route from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex to Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and inside the shop

name: Impulsively placed an order for a coffee machine and a bar counter
description: Yajing called the coffee equipment supplier from the shop and confirmed the details and total price of 19,800 yuan for a commercial semi-automatic espresso machine and a small solid wood bar counter. The salesperson promised delivery and installation before 3 p.m. She checked the shop's corporate account and confirmed sufficient working capital, then paid via mobile banking. When the transfer succeeded, her heart raced and she felt resolute. She then sent the delivery address to the salesperson.

participant.name: Sales representative for a coffee equipment supplier

location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: In-store tidying and mental preparation
description: After paying for the coffee machine, Yajing cleaned out old magazines and packaging boxes in the store to free up space for the counter. While working, she thought about how to explain the investment to her husband in the evening, calculating the additional revenue coffee might bring, such as increasing the average customer spend by 30% and increasing customers' dwell time, to boost her confidence.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went out at noon for lunch and bank errands.
description: Yajing locked the shop door and walked to Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop at No. 78 Zhenbang Road, Siming District. She ordered a bowl of shacha noodles with tofu and squid. While eating, she looked at photos of her father practicing tai chi and replied with a thumbs-up. After the meal, she took the bus to the Qianpu ICBC branch at Lianqian East Road, transferred yesterday's sales proceeds to the family expense card at the self-service terminal, and printed the receipt to show her husband in the evening as proof of her financial planning.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop and the Qianpu branch of ICBC.

name: Return to the store, wait for the delivery, and clean up the venue.
description: Yajing drove back from the bank to her shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, she confirmed the coffee machine's power supply and water line locations. Meanwhile, the supplier Susan replied that the spring clothing would ship as early as February 5 and was expected to arrive on February 6. Yajing figured that her father could help receive the goods when he came, so she replied to confirm the shipment. Then she used a small brush and a wet cloth to thoroughly clean the right corner of the cashier counter, preparing for the installation.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Coffee machine and bar counter arrived, and learning how to set them up
description: A little after 3 p.m., the installer delivered and installed the solid wood bar counter and coffee machine. Yajing then learned to operate it, following the tutorial and instruction manual. After adjusting the grind size—failing twice at first—she succeeded on the third attempt in extracting coffee with golden crema. She then tried frothing milk and made a latte. Some coffee splashed on the floor during the process, but in the end she succeeded, and the aroma filled the store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Official opening and welcoming the first customer
description: Yajing cleaned the work counter and turned on the store music. Regular customer Vivian came in, and Yajing handed her a freshly made latte, which was praised as classy and delicious. Yajing recommended a spring dress; Vivian tried it on and bought it. Yajing felt hope that the store's future would be filled with coffee aroma and laughter.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing up the store, returning home, and preparing dinner.
description: After seeing off Vivian, Yajing cleaned the coffee counter and sink, swept up crumbs, checked the doors, windows, and power, pulled down the roller shutter, and headed home early. Once home, she changed clothes, tied on an apron, and started preparing dinner: braised pork ribs, seafood fried rice noodles, and stir-fried lettuce, hoping that a warm meal would ease the atmosphere when talking with her husband that evening.
location: From No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter and having dinner together
description: At nearly 7 p.m., her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought their daughter Chen Lexuan home after playing. Xuanxuan rushed into her mother's arms, and Yajing told her to wash her hands for dinner. At the table, the family of three ate together. Xuanxuan talked about her playtime today, Aqiang asked about the business, and Yajing gave a vague answer, not yet bringing up the coffee machine.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chen Zhiqiang's confrontation and heated argument
description: After dinner, when Chen Zhiqiang was checking the store's account records, he discovered an expenditure of 19,800 yuan and confronted Yajing. Yajing stammered and admitted to buying the coffee machine. A Qiang shouted, accusing her of making decisions on her own and disregarding the family's financial security. Yajing argued that it was a necessary investment and cited Vivian's example. The quarrel moved from the living room to the kitchen, and their daughter Xuanxuan, frightened into tears, hid by the door clutching her stuffed toy.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cold War and separate bedrooms
description: The argument got nowhere. Chen Zhiqiang threw out, “You just don't care about this family!” and shut the study door. Yajing cried in the living room; her lower back began to twinge, and she felt hurt and panicked. After sitting alone for a long time, she took a quilt from the bedroom and spread it out in the master bedroom, while her husband spent the night in the study.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Comforting her daughter and privately licking her wounds.
description: Yajing endured her back pain and went to her daughter's room to comfort the frightened Xuanxuan, explaining that her parents were just discussing something. She played with her daughter's dolls, tucked her in with the blanket, and told stories until she fell asleep. Then she returned to the master bedroom, locked the door from the inside, and cried in the dark from back pain and heartache. After managing to lie down with difficulty, she still tossed and turned and could not sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A sleepless night and a late-night visit to the doctor.
description: Yajing lay in bed, the pain in her lower back worsening and affecting her breathing. When she struggled to get up to find a medicated patch, the movement aggravated the sore spot, and cold sweat poured down. At 1 a.m., she knocked on the study door for help. Although Chen Zhiqiang was still angry, seeing his wife's pallid face, he immediately helped her into the car and drove to the emergency department at the Siming Branch of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 6 Gucheng West Road, Siming District. The doctor gave her a painkiller injection, prescribed medicated patches, and told her to rest more. They returned home at 2:15 a.m. A Qiang silently brought warm water, then went back to the study. Yajing took the medicine and fell asleep exhausted.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 6 Gucheng West Road, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University (Siming Campus), and home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community

name: Getting up, morning prayer, and ice-breaking attempts
description: Waking up to the sound of the alarm, she still felt soreness in her lower back. She carefully got up, wrote a note for her husband saying, "The noodles are in the pot, remember to eat," and stuck it on the refrigerator door. Then she woke up her daughter, helped her comb her hair, and put on a coat. After a quick wash-up, she did her morning prayer in a corner of the living room, asking the Virgin Mary to grant wisdom and courage to resolve today's impasse, and praying for her father's safe journey.
location: At home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take daughter to school and send a friendly WeChat message
description: She and her daughter went out with an umbrella in the drizzling rain. After walking 10 minutes to send her daughter to the kindergarten, she kissed her cheek at the gate and told her to have a happy day. Watching her daughter enter the classroom, she stood under the eaves at the kindergarten entrance, took a deep breath, and sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang: 'Aqiang, you worked hard last night. My back is much better now. There is porridge kept warm in the pot; have some before going to work.' After sending it, she felt a little relieved.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the way

name: Walking to the shop and having breakfast
description: Walked about 20 minutes from the kindergarten to Zhongshan Road. Passing a familiar roadside breakfast stall, she bought a mushroom and pork bun and a cup of freshly ground soy milk, eating while walking. Under the light rain, Zhongshan Road had few tourists and looked a little quiet.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the route

name: Opening the store and serving regular customers
description: After arriving at the store, she first checked the bar counter and coffee machine installed yesterday and wiped the countertop with a clean cloth. Then she opened the shop's rolling shutter door, tidied the shelves, and made slight adjustments to the display. At that moment, Vivian, a regular customer, pushed the door open and was pleasantly surprised to see the new bar counter. Yajing, suppressing the heaviness in her heart, made two cappuccinos with the new coffee machine for her and another regular customer who came in, and received praise. But this did not dispel the heaviness in her heart.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Coffee practice and sorting new styles during lulls in business
description: During a lull in customer traffic, she began practicing seriously with the espresso machine. Following the manual, she adjusted the grind setting and pulled three espressos in a row, barely passing. She then tried steaming milk and found the feel for making fine, velvety microfoam. Meanwhile, she took out her phone, took a few photos from the new spring collection catalog, and sent them to the regular-customer group with the caption: "New spring arrivals will be in store soon; reservations are welcome."
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Solo lunch and emotional reflection.
description: Around noon, the rain stopped, but the sky was still gloomy. She asked the shop assistant Xiaomei to help pack a set meal from A Jie's Five-Spice Shop nearby (five-spice rolls + savory rice). Sitting alone behind the cash register, facing the newly added bar counter and coffee machine, she had mixed feelings. While eating lunch, she scrolled through a photo of the family of three taken on Gulangyu last summer and sighed silently. She ate absent-mindedly and didn't even react when Xiaomei called her to lunch.
location: Cashier counter of Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and a short rest
description: After the meal, she lay on the newly bought fabric sofa in the corner of the store, played a soothing hymn on her phone, and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes. The soreness in her lower back made it hard to fully relax, but mentally she found a moment of peace.
location: Sofa area, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: In-store inventory and planning
description: After the lunch break, she felt somewhat refreshed. She began checking the inventory sheet and carefully counted all the spring and summer bottoms in the store, especially comparing the new styles Susan sent yesterday to check for duplicate styles. During this, she opened "Shimo Docs" on her phone and redesigned the customer preference collection form that Wang Jia had suggested, but she miscalculated the quantities several times and felt uneasy. After telling the shop assistant Xiaomei the key points for the afternoon reception, she let her watch the store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Phone call with best friend and emotional support
description: After finishing the inventory, she had just sat down to rest when her phone rang — it was her best friend Li Meiling. Lingling had originally wanted to invite her to go shopping on the weekend, but she heard the loneliness in her voice. Yajing couldn't help tearfully pouring out over the phone about the quarrel the night before and her grievances, and also mentioned her frustration at having tried to reach out but not getting a response. Lingling listened patiently on the other end and advised her: "20,000 yuan is indeed not a small amount, but you did it for the good of the shop. What he's angry about is that you didn't discuss it with him. Both of you should take a step back. When he comes back in the evening, first clearly explain the benefits of the coffee machine and your plan. Don't just talk about money — talk about the possibilities for the future." The phone call lasted nearly an hour, and it lifted her spirits a little.
location: Sofa area, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing the store early and buying ingredients
description: After hanging up, she decided to close the shop early. She briefly explained the next day's matters to Xiao Mei, the store assistant, and then locked the rolling shutter door. She walked to the nearby Eighth Market (about 17 minutes on foot) and bought fresh clams, squid, lean meat, and alkaline noodles at familiar stalls, plus shrimp and a big bunch of greens. She planned to cook a pot of satay noodles that Aqiang loved, hoping the familiar taste could open up the conversation.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to pick her daughter up from school
description: From Bashi Market to the kindergarten, she arrived just in time for school dismissal. In the waiting area, she saw her daughter and her little friends walking out hand in hand. To keep her daughter from noticing anything unusual, she managed to put on the brightest smile and walked over to take her daughter's backpack: “Xuanxuan, Mom made the shacha noodles you and Dad love the most. Are you happy?” The daughter jumped for joy, took her hand, and said, “Mom is the best!”
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing the family dinner and spending time with her daughter
description: After getting home, she first let her daughter watch cartoons in the living room, then put on an apron and got busy. The key to satay noodles is the soup base. She simmered a pot of fresh broth with shrimp and pork bones, added satay sauce and peanut butter, then blanched the seafood and lean meat, and finally cooked the noodles and blanched the greens. The rich aroma of satay drifted through the living room. Once it was ready, she ladled out a large bowl, covered it with a thermal lid, and left it on the dining table for Aqiang. Then she accompanied her daughter through dinner, and at her daughter's request, they drew a picture together of three little figures holding hands, with the word 'home' written beside them.
location: Kitchen and living room at home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cold and silent family dinner and evening
description: A Qiang came home a bit later than usual. When he walked in and saw the shacha noodles on the table, he was taken aback and gave Yajing a complicated look. Yajing's heart tightened, and she said softly, 'You're back? The noodles are ready, eat them while they're hot.' A Qiang didn't reply, just sat down quietly and began eating. Their daughter tried to lighten the mood by showing her father the painting she had just finished. A Qiang patted her head, gave a forced smile, and said, 'That's really well painted.' The whole dinner remained gloomy, with all three lost in their own thoughts.
location: Dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing dishes, a family phone call, and time alone to rebalance
description: After dinner, Aqiang went into the study as usual. Yajing cleared the table. While washing dishes by the sink, tears slipped down again. She quickly wiped them away, then called her parents in Quanzhou to confirm her father's high-speed train schedule for the next day and explained how to pick him up at the station. Her mother comforted her on the phone: "Stay calm and harmonious; no difficulty is insurmountable." After hanging up, she returned to the living room and saw her daughter still quietly drawing. She sat beside her, sorting through her thoughts while checking the emergency room records from last night on her phone, wondering whether to use medical insurance to cover part of the expenses.
location: Kitchen and living room at home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime companionship and warm family time
description: She bathed her daughter and changed her into pajamas. After her daughter had gotten into bed, she sat by the bedside and told her a story about "making up and forgiving." The daughter listened attentively, and after it ended, she suddenly hugged her and said, "Mom, the noodles you cooked today were so delicious. Dad must have liked them too. Can you two please not fight?" These words broke her defenses instantly. She hugged her daughter tightly and whispered, "Mommy knows. Mommy and Daddy will make up."
location: Daughter's bedroom in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care, skincare, and preparing for bed
description: After settling her daughter in, she returned to the master bedroom. She first applied a new medicated patch to her waist, then soaked her feet in hot water to relieve the fatigue of the day. After that, she did her basic skincare routine: removing makeup, cleansing her face, and applying a hydrating mask. Lying in bed, she used the notes app on her phone to further refine the customer preference collection form she had compiled today, and checked the route to the high-speed railway station for picking up her father the next morning.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp. She knelt in front of the bed and said her bedtime prayers. She thanked God for giving her the courage to face difficulties today, prayed that the Virgin Mary would soften her husband's heart, bless the family with harmony, and especially prayed for a smooth physical examination for her father tomorrow. Afterward, she lay down on the bed. Though her lower back still ached faintly, her heart was much calmer than in the morning. Thinking that her father would come tomorrow, she forced herself not to dwell on it, and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82, Shanggu Street, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and morning preparations
description: When the alarm went off at seven in the morning, Song Yajing got up and washed up despite still feeling tired. She deliberately put on the off-white knitted cardigan her husband had given her, carefully arranged her hair, hoping to start the new day with a gentle image.
location: Bedroom and bathroom in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Communicating with husband and having breakfast together
description: Song Yajing went to the living room and found her husband Chen Zhiqiang had not left for work early but was waiting by the dining table. The mood was still heavy, but Yajing took the initiative to sit next to him. Zhiqiang proposed setting up an electronic ledger for the shop, with any expense over 1,000 yuan requiring discussion. Yajing agreed and apologized for impulsively buying the coffee machine. Then the two ate the simple breakfast Zhiqiang had prepared—their first quiet meal together since the argument.
location: Living room and dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Brief morning prayer
description: After breakfast, her husband cleared the dishes. Song Yajing sat alone on the living room sofa, eyes closed and head lowered, hands clasped in a brief prayer, thanking God for a peaceful day, asking for guidance in communicating with Zhiqiang, blessing her father's smooth journey, and hoping to bring the family back to love.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on her coat and backpack, and the two walked hand in hand to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, when they passed a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, Xuanxuan wanted stickers. Yajing could not bear to refuse and bought a sheet for her. After handing her daughter to the teacher at the kindergarten, Yajing turned and hurried to the shop.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the route

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Song Yajing sent a WeChat message to the shop assistant Xiaomei letting her know she would arrive at the store in ten minutes, then walked about 12 minutes along her usual route to the Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went to the store to take care of matters and set up an electronic ledger.
description: When Song Yajing arrived at the shop, Xiaomei had already opened the door and was cleaning. She first adjusted the spring clothing displays by color and took photos to post on Moments. Then she downloaded a bookkeeping app and spent nearly an hour setting up income and expense categories, recording yesterday’s coffee beans and this morning’s breakfast expenses. Midway, because her lower back was sore, she did ten minutes of stretching with Xiaomei’s help. After 10:30, there were no customers in the shop, so she took out the new coffee machine and practiced making a latte. Although the milk foam wasn’t smooth and creamy enough, she noted the key points.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Midday solitude and relaxation
description: Song Yajing told Xiaomei that she was going out to eat. She walked alone to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, ordered a hot fruit tea and a tiramisu, and sat in a corner by the window. As she ate, she sent voice messages in the besties group "Three's Company" sharing what she had talked through with Zhiqiang that morning. She received encouraging replies from her friends Li Meiling and Wang Jia, which lifted her mood considerably.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and pick-up preparation
description: When Song Yajing returned to the store, Xiaomei had already taken an order. While tidying the shelves, she weighed the financial rule her husband had proposed that morning and wrote down her thoughts in the memo on her phone. Then she looked up high-speed rail schedules for her father from Quanzhou to Xiamen, expected him to arrive at Xiamen North Station at about 4 p.m., and booked a regular ENT appointment for around 5 p.m. in advance at Xiamen Humanity Hospital through the 'Beautiful Xiamen' official account.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Handling picky customers in the store
description: Around 3:00 PM, a picky female customer about forty years old came into the store, tried on two pieces of clothing, and asked Song Yajing to make coffee. Though nervous, Yajing smiled and made a cup. The customer said the taste was too weak, so Yajing patiently explained the characteristics of the coffee beans and adjusted the strength again. The customer was finally satisfied and even bought a spring trench coat. After seeing the customer off, Xiaomei took the initiative to greet the other customers, giving Yajing time to calm down.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Drove to Xiamen North Railway Station to pick up my father.
description: After Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the store, she called a ride-hailing car at the store entrance. Once in the car, she called her father to confirm the train number and the exit. The ride took about 35 minutes, covering 26.5 kilometers, and arrived at Xiamen North Railway Station at 4:05 p.m.
location: On the way to Xiamen North Station, 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up her father
description: At the exit of Xiamen North Station, Song Yajing successfully picked up her father Song Minghui, who had graying hair and a backpack. Her father was in good spirits, but because of his hearing problems, the two spoke in louder voices. After briefly asking about her father's recent situation in the car, Yajing set the navigation directly for the reserved Xiamen Hongai Hospital.
location: Xiamen North Railway Station, No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanied father for a hearing check
description: The ride-hailing car departed from North Station and arrived at Xiamen Hongai Hospital at 17:20 after about 23.3 kilometers. Song Yajing helped her father get a queue number. After waiting about half an hour, they saw the doctor. The doctor performed pure-tone audiometry and acoustic immittance testing on her father, diagnosed him with moderate-to-severe age-related hearing loss, recommended hearing aids, and issued a diagnostic certificate and hearing report.
location: No. 3777 Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Xiamen Hong'ai Hospital

name: Bought ingredients on the way back.
description: After the medical examination, it was already late, so Song Yajing decided to take her father directly home to cook. The ride-hailing car first stopped at the Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market near their home. Yajing bought oysters, lean meat, tofu, greens, and a free-range chicken that her father loved, then walked back to the residential complex in less than a minute.
location: XiaShang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the way.

name: Prepare dinner and dine with the family.
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing immediately started cooking. She simmered chicken soup and made oyster omelet and stir-fried choy sum. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang happened to return from picking up their daughter Chen Lexuan from school. Xuanxuan was very happy to see her maternal grandfather. During dinner, the family sat together and discussed her father's examination results. Yajing and Zhiqiang both advised her father to consider getting hearing aids, and the atmosphere was much more harmonious than in the previous days.
location: Kitchen and dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Showing her husband the electronic ledger.
description: After tidying up the kitchen, Song Yajing voluntarily sat down on the sofa and showed her husband Chen Zhiqiang today's transactions in the bookkeeping app, explaining in detail that she had recorded all expenses from breakfast to dinner and studied the categories. After checking, Zhiqiang's expression softened and he approved of the accounts, while reminding her that large store expenses should be communicated in advance in the future.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's affection and warm family moments.
description: Seizing the chance to talk, Song Yajing rubbed her lower back and acted vulnerable to her husband, saying her back was sore and she hadn't slept well the night before. Zhiqiang didn't say much, but he stood up, fetched a new box of medicated patches, and handed them to her, telling her not to push herself too hard. Yajing was touched and accepted the patches. Later, their daughter Xuanxuan pulled both parents into a game of Chinese checkers, and the family of three enjoyed a rare warm time together in the living room.
location: Living room and bedroom in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chat with my father and ask about his checkup results.
description: After her husband took Xuanxuan to bathe, Song Yajing came to the living room to chat with her father, who was watching TV. She asked in detail about the doctor's recommendations for hearing aids. Her father mentioned that the fitting center recommended by the hospital was expensive. Yajing comforted him not to worry about money and promised to accompany him to a professional fitting center next week to choose a cost-effective hearing aid.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime companionship with daughter and personal care
description: After her husband bathed Xuanxuan, Song Yajing took a picture book into her daughter’s room, told her the story of Grandpa coming to Xiamen, and read half a book. After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Yajing returned to the bathroom to soak her feet in hot water to ease the soreness and carefully applied the medicated patch her husband had given her.
location: Children's room and bathroom, 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayers and diary
description: Song Yajing changed into her pajamas, knelt by the bedside lamp and prayed, thanking God that she and her husband had reconciled today and that her father's examination had gone smoothly, and asking for continued protection for the family. Then she wrote in her phone memo: “The first day of keeping accounts felt solid; Dad's test results are out; Zhiqiang's medicated patch was the warmest gift today.” After that, she set her alarm and fell asleep in the cool warmth of the patch.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake-up, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: When the alarm went off, Yajing felt heavy, and her mood was complicated as she thought about last night's conversation with her husband about finances. She washed up first, patted her face with cold water to reduce puffiness, then woke up her husband Chen Zhiqiang and her daughter Chen Lexuan. For breakfast she prepared fried egg toast and milk. At the table, she calmly told her husband that they needed to sort out the accounts together tonight; he agreed and promised to leave work early.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal grooming and morning prayer.
description: After the family finished breakfast, Yajing returned to the bedroom and said a short morning prayer before the cross and Bible by the bedside, praying for her father's health and for peace to handle the accounts calmly today. Then she changed into a warm sweater and long pants and got ready to go out.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and buy school supplies
description: Yajing helped her daughter put on her coat and backpack, took her hand, and walked out of the neighborhood. The morning sunlight was soft and the air was slightly cool. Passing the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, her daughter pulled her inside. Yajing remembered the agreement to “think for three days before buying,” but still bought her daughter a pack of bunny stickers as a Friday reward. The mother and daughter said goodbye at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road)

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing walked along her familiar route to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, she opened the bookkeeping app to quickly review the financial rules agreed upon last night, determined to get the accounts in order today.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Morning store preparation and preliminary classification of accounts.
description: After arriving at the shop, she greeted staff member Xiao Mei and explained that today's main task was organizing the accounts, with Xiao Mei taking on more of the front desk and customer reception. Yajing opened the bottom drawer of the cashier counter and dumped out two months' worth of crumpled receipts onto the counter, including purchase orders, supply receipts, and transfer screenshots. She sorted them by date and category, while marking a few suspicious large expenditures in her phone notes.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch and a short rest
description: Yajing told Xiaomei to eat first, and ordered takeout from 85°C to the store herself. While eating a sandwich and a hot Americano, she pondered how to explain the miscellaneous expenses to her husband in the evening.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Yajing leaned back in the shop’s lounge chair and rested with her eyes closed for about 15 minutes, but her mind was still occupied by the figures on the bills.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: In-depth account sorting and preliminary accounting
description: After the lunch break, Yajing pulled herself together and used a calculator and notebook to itemize and reconcile the sorted receipts. She found that the decorative silk scarves she had impulsively stockpiled before the holiday cost nearly 3,000 yuan, and she had no memory of several "stock" purchase records. Feeling ashamed, she wrote in her notebook, "Think for three days before buying," and stuck it on the calculator.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Daily customer reception and sales promotion.
description: An old customer brought a friend into the store. Yajing immediately put away the account book and warmly greeted them. Based on the customer's figure, she recommended several new spring arrivals, recalled the clothes she tried on last time, and successfully made two coat sales. Xiaomei helped with packaging and writing up the order.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Continue deepening account reconciliation and electronic record-keeping.
description: After saying goodbye to the customer, Yajing continued working on the accounts. She opened WeChat and Alipay, exported all payment and transfer records since February, and checked them one by one against the paper receipts. She found several purchase transfers that had system records but were missing paper vouchers, so she contacted the suppliers to take photos and added remarks in the accounting app. Although the afternoon sun was nice, sweat beaded on her forehead as she could clearly see how severe the financial situation was.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Closing preparations
description: Yajing carefully put the account books and receipts into a document folder, checked the store displays and cleanliness, gave Xiaomei instructions for the next day's shift, and locked the store door.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Walked to pick up her daughter from school.
description: Yajing walked quickly toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and on the way sent her husband a WeChat message telling him that she had finished sorting out the accounts and they would go over them together in the evening.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up her daughter from school and played at the park.
description: Yajing picked up her daughter from kindergarten right on time. The weather was sunny, so she took her to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park to play on the slide and swings. Watching her daughter's smiling face, her tense nerves relaxed a little. Sitting on a bench, she sent a WeChat message to Teacher Chen, her baking teacher, asking if it would be okay to learn pour-over coffee and tiramisu tomorrow afternoon.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: Yajing took her daughter home. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had arrived earlier and was preparing dinner in the kitchen. After a quick rinse, Yajing joined him in cleaning vegetables. Dinner was braised pork ribs, stir-fried greens, and oyster soup made by her husband.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family chat
description: The family of three chatted while eating at the table, and the daughter shared funny stories from kindergarten; the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, Yajing cleared the dishes, and her husband watched cartoons with their daughter in the living room.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing Daughter for Sleep
description: At 7 p.m., Yajing bathed her daughter, then read the picture book The Little Prince. At 19:40 she kissed her daughter on the forehead, said goodnight, and coaxed her to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The couple worked together to organize the electronic accounts and set a budget
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Yajing sat down with Chen Zhiqiang at the dining table, opened the document envelope, and laid out all the receipts and phone screenshots in order. Chen Zhiqiang created an Excel workbook called 'Small Shop Ledger, January-February 2025' on his laptop and entered revenue, rent, inventory costs, consumables, and coffee machine expenses item by item, occasionally asking calmly about the purpose of a particular expense. After tallying, it showed that after fixed costs, only about 6,000 yuan of working capital remained for February. Yajing turned pale and clenched her hands tightly. The two set strict budget limits together: employee wages and rent/logistics would come first, personal living expenses drawn from the shop would be cut by one third, and consumables like coffee beans would have weekly quotas. Yajing promised not to buy any personal clothing in February and agreed to show the ledger to her husband every Sunday evening. Chen Zhiqiang's expression softened, and he took her hand, saying, 'I'm not trying to control you; I want to carry this with you.' Yajing's eyes reddened slightly as she nodded.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact the baking teacher to confirm the study schedule
description: After finishing the accounts, Yajing sent a WeChat message to Master Chen to confirm that she would go to the studio at two o’clock tomorrow afternoon to learn pour-over coffee and tiramisu. Master Chen quickly replied to confirm. She then found her baking notebook and made a list of items to bring, including an apron and a digital scale. When she stood up, she suddenly felt dizzy, and held onto the back of the chair and closed her eyes for a moment.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and bedtime preparation.
description: Yajing soaked her feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue and felt a faint headache. After a quick wash, she changed into pajamas and lay down in bed. She opened the Bible app and softly read a few verses from Psalms, giving thanks that she and her husband had been able to face the financial crisis calmly that day, and praying for her father's health and for tomorrow's study.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Journaling and going to bed
description: Before turning off the light, Yajing wrote by hand in her diary: “February 7, sunny. The accounts were spread out, and the numbers were glaring, but even more glaring was seeing our fear fading away. When he held my hand, I knew that even at the edge of a financial cliff, we were standing together. Tomorrow I’ll go learn to make coffee; I can’t let my husband’s coffee machine have been bought for nothing. Good night.” Then she turned off the desk lamp and fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 8:05 in the morning, the phone alarm went off, and Song Yajing got up on time. Although her body still carried some heaviness from last night's accounting, she felt more at ease in her heart.
