She quickly washed up, encouraged herself in the mirror, and deliberately did not tie up her hair, to refresh her mood for the afternoon's study.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and do some shopping on the way
description: Her husband had already gone to the office. Song Yajing woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her braid her hair, and the two had a simple breakfast of bread and milk. At 8:20, holding Xuanxuan's hand, she walked about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter mentioned dreaming of picking up seashells at the beach, and Yajing promised to take her to play on the weekend. After dropping off her daughter, she turned toward Zhongshan Road. At 8:35, she passed the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City and went in to buy a box of coffee filter papers and two bottles of milk, spending 28 yuan, reminding herself to strictly follow her bookkeeping plan. She then walked about 5 minutes along the pedestrian street and arrived at her shop on time at 8:48.
location: Starting from the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, and 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery at No. 189 Siming South Road, then arriving at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District

name: Running the shop on her own and organizing the accounts
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing immediately opened the notes app on her phone, created a new note titled "February 8 Expenses," entered the 28 yuan breakfast purchase, and placed a dedicated small notebook in the cash register drawer to remind employees to record cash expenses. She wiped down the coffee machine and made herself a pour-over coffee with fresh filter paper and milk; the bitter aroma carried a sense of accomplishment. Customer traffic was light in the morning, so she rearranged the window display, putting the spring clothing in a color gradient. From 10:00 to 11:30, five customers came in one after another. She greeted them warmly and offered styling suggestions, closing two sales. At 11:40 she checked the morning's income and expenses and felt a sense of control she had not had in a long time.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple lunch and rest at noon
description: At noon, she turned off the store music, went to the small compartment in the back of the store, cooked instant noodles in the store's small electric pot, and added an egg and a few slices of greens for lunch. While eating, she reviewed the study notes sent by Master Chen. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off for the baking studio
description: At 12:45, she locked the shop door and left early. At the entrance of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she used her phone to book a ride-hailing car to the Xianhou Baking Studio in Huli District. The drive took about 25 minutes. Leaning against the car window, she silently reviewed pour-over flow control and tiramisu steps in her mind. She arrived downstairs at the studio at 13:10, 20 minutes early.
location: By car from Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Xianhou Baking Studio, No. 120, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Learning Pour-Over Coffee and Classic Tiramisu
description: The class started right on time at 13:30. Master Chen first taught pour-over kettle flow control, having her repeatedly practice the blooming technique of a “thin, steady stream.” After half an hour, she finally mastered a stable, thin water stream. Next, they made tiramisu, from whipping the mascarpone cheese mixture to lightly dipping the ladyfingers into the espresso and rum mixture like a dragonfly skimming the water. Master Chen stressed, “If you dip them too much, the cake base will collapse and turn mushy.” Yajing immediately drew a star in her notebook. During a break, she mentioned that she had been having lower back pain recently, so Master Chen taught her a few simple waist stretches. At 16:00, the finished tiramisu was put into the refrigerator to chill and set. Master Chen packed up a portion of the trimmings for her to take home and taste, encouraging her to make it for her family at home.
location: Baking studio at Xianhou No. 120, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying medicine and fruit on the way back
description: At 16:15, after saying goodbye to Master Chen with the notes and leftover tiramisu scraps, I walked about 10 minutes to Luyan Pharmacy (Yibin Road Branch) and bought a bottle of medicated oil. After paying, I walked about 13 minutes to Kangle Fruit Store, picked out the baba tangerines Dad loves and the strawberries my daughter loves, and spent 35 yuan. Then I hailed a ride-hailing car at the store entrance; the ride took about 20 minutes, and I arrived at the entrance of the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential compound around 16:55.
location: From Luyan Pharmacy on Yibin Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Kangle Fruit Shop, No. 14, 272 Nanshan Road, Huli District, then returned by car to the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District.

name: Preparing dinner for a family gathering.
description: After arriving home, she put the tiramisu, fruit, and medicated oil in the refrigerator, tied on an apron, and started preparing dinner, planning to make steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup. At 17:45 she prepared the ingredients ahead of time. At 17:50 her husband Zhiqiang came home from work, and at 18:00 he went to the kindergarten to pick up their daughter Xuanxuan. As soon as Xuanxuan came in, she said she was hungry, and Yajing smiled and served the steaming-hot food.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Yajing excitedly shared what she had learned about making tiramisu that afternoon and mentioned that her lower back was a little sore. Zhiqiang volunteered to apply a hot compress with medicated oil for her after dinner, and their daughter clapped happily beside them. The warm atmosphere temporarily eased the financial pressure.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family interaction and waist care.
description: After dinner, Yajing washed the dishes while Zhiqiang played with LEGO with their daughter in the living room. She took out her phone and replied to inquiries in two customer groups, then sat down on the sofa. Her husband brought over medicated oil and a hot towel, asked her to lie down, and carefully massaged her lower back. The warmth and the medicinal effect relaxed the nerves that had been tense all day. After the hot compress, she did a few lower-back stretches following the moves Master Chen had taught her and felt much better.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime wash-up and companionship
description: After the hot compress, Yajing bathed her daughter and changed her into pajamas. She took out the tiramisu trimmings brought back from Master Chen's studio, fed her daughter a small bite, and Xuanxuan happily said it was delicious. Then she read her two picture-book stories and watched her fall asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening self-care and reflection
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing spread out a yoga mat in the living room and seriously did the waist-stretching exercises Master Chen had taught, ten minutes in total. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out today's study notes, recopied the key points Master Chen had emphasized, and in the 'Today's Mood' column of her account book wrote: "It feels great to learn a new skill; my body is relaxed, and a space has opened up in my heart."
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Talked with husband before going to bed.
description: Yajing leaned against the headboard and told her husband, who was looking at his phone, that the makeup workday had been quite interesting. Zhiqiang responded that things would always get better. They exchanged a few words about tomorrow's plans, and the atmosphere was calm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and bedtime prayer
description: She got up to wash up and do her skincare routine. At 21:20, she turned off the desk lamp, made the sign of the cross on her chest, and prayed softly, thanking the Lord for the joy of learning and the safety of her family, and asking for blessings for the family and for her father's ears to get better. After the prayer, she soon fell asleep with a full heart.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and family communication.
description: After the alarm went off, Song Yajing got up and felt more energetic than in the previous days. She quickly washed up, put on a dark blue knit dress and an off-white wool cardigan. She simply had a glass of warm milk and some slices of whole wheat bread, and went over in her mind the route to Gulangyu for Mass. Before leaving, she talked with her husband Chen Zhiqiang at the entrance and told him to come back before noon and take their daughter Xuanxuan to the supermarket in the afternoon, and to keep lunch simple so as not to delay her afternoon practice of tiramisu. Chen Zhiqiang smiled and nodded, telling her to be safe, especially since the ferry was crowded.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Go to Gulangyu Catholic Church
description: Song Yajing drove her own small car along the familiar route to Lujiang Road, parking in a paid parking lot near Zhongshan Road Ferry Terminal. She walked into the ferry hall, swiped her E-Tong Card to board. There were not many people on the ferry, so she sat by the window, watching the sea in the morning light and the outline of Gulangyu Island on the opposite shore. After disembarking, she strolled along Gulangyu's early-morning stone paths, passing old buildings and flower bushes, arriving early at Gulangyu Catholic Church at 34 Lujiao Road. She sat on a bench, silently reading the Bible to prepare herself for Mass.
location: Route from No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Gulangyu Catholic Church (drive to First Pier Ferry Station, take the ferry to Piano Pier, then walk to No. 34 Lujiao Road)

name: Attend Sunday Mass and converse outside the church.
description: The Mass officially began. Father Wang Mingde preached on the theme “Do not worry about tomorrow,” quoting from the Gospel of Matthew. Song Yajing listened with her eyes closed, repeating it silently, and felt the anxiety in her heart over the shop's funds and the quarrel with her husband gradually calm down. After Mass, she went to the courtyard full of bougainvillea. Lin Xiuying, an older fellow parishioner, asked about her with concern and suggested she brew a cup of coffee for her husband to ease the conflict. At that moment, Zhao Li, a new parishioner and floral designer, passed by. Lin Xiuying introduced them. Zhao Li became interested in the clothing shop Song Yajing ran and offered to help with a floral window display. The three chatted happily, and Song Yajing and Zhao Li added each other on WeChat.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church (worship hall and courtyard), No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Returning home
description: After saying goodbye to her fellow church members, Song Yajing walked back to Piano Pier, took the ferry across the sea, then drove from Zhongshan Road Ferry Terminal back to her home at No. 82 Shanggu Street. On the way, she checked her phone and received a report from shop assistant Xiao Mei about yesterday's business situation. She replied that she was aware and reminded her to respond promptly to the customer inquiries from Sunday afternoon.
location: Return trip from Gulangyu Catholic Church, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex (walking, ferry, self-driving)

name: Housework organization, budget checking, and family lunch.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing first tidied up the living room and put away the picture books her daughter had left scattered around. Then she went into the study, carefully checked the February family budget and the store expense ledger, and used a calculator to repeatedly verify the drink corner's purchase list and available balance. At noon, she prepared lunch early, cooking dried noodles with leftover pork rib soup and greens. Around 12:30, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan came back from their walk. The family of three sat around the table and enjoyed the steaming hot pork rib soup noodles, creating a warm atmosphere. After the meal, her husband wiped their daughter's mouth, put on her hat, picked up the eco-friendly shopping bag, and took her to the supermarket. Song Yajing saw them to the entryway and watched the two get into the elevator.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Focus on practicing tiramisu and share the results
description: After the family went out, Song Yajing tied on an apron, took out mascarpone, eggs, coffee liqueur, and other ingredients, and followed the notes she had made at Master Chen's studio yesterday. She worked step by step: separating egg whites and yolks, whisking the yolk mixture over a water bath, whipping the cream, combining the cheese mixture, quickly dipping the ladyfingers, and layering them alternately. Her movements were smoother than yesterday, and the finished cake had a smooth, even surface. When it was done, she covered it with plastic wrap and refrigerated it, then carefully washed the tools and tidied the counter. She then cut a small piece from the edge to taste—it was rich and delicate. She took the whole tiramisu out of the refrigerator, took top-down photos of the whole cake and its cross-section with her phone, sent them to Master Chen for his feedback, and shared them in the family group chat, tagging her husband and daughter to share the joy.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, home kitchen and dining room

name: Keeping in touch with new friends and taking a reading break
description: Song Yajing sat down on the sofa in the living room, opened florist Zhao Li's WeChat, composed a message thanking her for the shop suggestion, and invited her to come by the store for coffee and to see the floral inspiration when she had time. Afterward, she went to the study and read the section of "A Practical Guide to Café Operations" about increasing average order value, using sticky notes to jot down meal combo suggestions. Midway, she walked to the balcony, looked out at the children playing in the garden downstairs, and took the chance to clear her mind.
location: The living room sofa, study, and balcony at home in the 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Family returning and sharing dinner.
description: The door lock turned, and her daughter Xuanxuan ran in carrying snacks, gleefully showing off her supermarket “loot” and telling her mother that she had met a classmate at the supermarket. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang carried the purchased daily necessities into the kitchen. Song Yajing brought her daughter over to taste the freshly made tiramisu, and her daughter said it was better than the cake shop's. The family of three prepared dinner together; her husband washed and cut vegetables, while Song Yajing cooked, making stir-fried shrimp with celery and steamed sea bass. During the meal, she made her husband a hand-poured coffee, and he praised the taste. After dinner, Song Yajing washed the dishes while her husband played with building blocks with their daughter, and the living room was full of laughter.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Husband-and-wife discussion about store operations
description: After Chen Zhiqiang coaxed their daughter into the room to play with building blocks, Song Yajing called him into the study. The two opened a tablet, and Song Yajing showed the order progress of the community's 'Spring Renewal' pre-sale event and the drink corner purchase list she had organized that afternoon. Together they analyzed costs and expected returns, confirmed the necessities to purchase the next day (Monday), and agreed on a budget red line. The communication atmosphere was harmonious and pragmatic.
location: Study room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Chatting online with my best friend.
description: Song Yajing curled up on the bay window in her bedroom and sent a voice call to her best friend Li Meiling. She excitedly shared her experience of meeting florist Zhao Li at church and asked if she had time next week to come to the shop and give advice on the window display. Before hanging up, Li Meiling invited her to visit a newly opened dessert shop at Huli Wanda Plaza next Saturday afternoon, and Song Yajing happily agreed.
location: Bedroom, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Evening care routine, bedtime prayer, and a sound sleep.
description: Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup and washed her face, applied toner and moisturizer, took a soothing hydrating mask from the fridge and put it on, closing her eyes to enjoy a moment of peace. Then she set the alarm for 7:20 the next morning, turned off the bedside lamp, and prayed softly in bed, recalling the Mass scripture, praying for her family, the shop, and her new acquaintance Zhao Li. She silently told herself not to worry about tomorrow, felt calm and at peace, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 07:45 in the morning, the alarm went off. Song Yajing got up and washed up. It was drizzling outside the window, and the soreness in her lower back reminded her of the fatigue from standing for long hours baking yesterday. After washing up, she changed into loungewear and watered the pothos on the windowsill. Her husband A Qiang had prepared breakfast: hot milk, whole-wheat bread, and fried eggs. The two ate in the dining room. A Qiang told Song Yajing that he would drive their daughter Xuanxuan to kindergarten today, and said he would cook dinner so that Yajing could focus on making cakes. After breakfast, Song Yajing checked the pearl earring samples and the accounting notebook to bring to the shop, and packed the baking ingredients she had prepared in advance (butter, chocolate, coffee powder, etc.) into a canvas tote bag, ready to go out.
location: 5th floor, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commuting to the store.
description: Song Yajing put on her waterproof trench coat, put on her helmet, and walked downstairs carrying a canvas bag. She placed the bag in the front basket of her electric bike and rode along Hubin South Road, Zhenhai Road, and Zhongshan Road to the store. The whole trip took about 15 minutes, and the fine drizzle gently brushed her face.
location: Along the route from Hubin South Road to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening prep and community affairs
description: When arriving at the store, staff member Xiaomei had already changed into her uniform. The two worked together to pull up the roller shutter, turn on the lights, and check the cash register system. Song Yajing opened WeChat to handle community inquiries; there were 4 questions about the pre-sale of the new styles. She replied to each about sizes and colors, successfully guiding 2 customers to place deposits. Then, according to the list, she contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat to confirm the order for the new coats and requested the latest fabric detail photos and inventory sheet.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Elegant Select Boutique Clothing Store

name: Store tidying and new merchandise display.
description: Morning foot traffic was light. Song Yajing and Xiaomei tidied the shelves, using the new spray bottle and fish-scale cloth Xiaomei brought to wipe down the glass display cabinets. Song Yajing rearranged the display of several new knit sweaters, grouping them into "Early Spring Workplace" and "Weekend Casual" themes. Xiaomei praised her professional display skills, but after bending over for a long time, Song Yajing felt a dull ache in her lower back, and she quietly supported her waist.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and online replies.
description: Xiaomei went to the small eatery across the street and packed some satay noodles to bring back, and the two of them quickly ate in the shop's rest area. While eating, Song Yajing opened WeChat Moments to like and comment on her regular customers' posts, and received a video from Su Shan showing fabric for the new coat. After checking it carefully, she replied that two of the styles were fine and urged that they be shipped.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Handling customers and closing up the store
description: After the meal, Song Yajing replied to her mother's WeChat question about the weekend family dinner. She opened this season's account book to briefly check income and expenses and calculate cash flow. Then she told Xiao Mei that she would go home at 2 p.m. and leave the store to her, and reminded her that a regular customer would come at 3 p.m. to try on a pre-sale dress. She packed the baking ingredients from the fridge into a canvas bag, ready to take them away.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Commute home
description: Song Yajing got on her electric bike and headed home along Zhongshan Road, Siming South Road, and Zhenhai Road. It was still raining, so she rode carefully in her poncho, mentally running through the steps for making an Opera cake.
location: Along the route from Zhongshan Road to Hubin South Road in Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: First attempt at Opera cake ends in failure and emotional breakdown
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing put on an apron and confidently started challenging the opera cake. She made the almond sponge cake layers, boiled coffee syrup, prepared ganache, and whipped coffee buttercream. During this, regular customer Vivian called to ask about shipping for a custom dress, and she explained for 5 minutes; then WeChat rang again—a customer sent a photo asking about matching—and she replied again. Because of the distraction, the butter in the ganache melted too much; in the flurry, the cake layers collapsed badly, and the buttercream got mixed with coffee grounds, making it unbearably bitter. Watching the expensive ingredients go to waste, she squatted helplessly on the kitchen floor tiles and burst into tears. When she stood up, the old pain in her lower back flared up sharply; she held onto the stove, breaking into a cold sweat. Then, enduring back pain and frustration, she slowly cleaned up the kitchen, washed the utensils, and threw away the failed cake. She went to the bedroom, applied a pain relief patch, lay down to rest for 15 minutes, and sent a voice message to shop assistant Xiao Mei saying she would be back at the shop later.
location: Kitchen and bedroom, 5th floor, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Commuting back to the shop
description: Song Yajing tidied herself up, forced herself to cheer up, and rode her electric bike to the store again in the rain, telling herself on the way that one failure didn't matter.
location: Along the route from Hubin South Road to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Xiaomei comforted her and closed the store early.
description: Back at the shop, Xiaomei noticed Song Yajing's pale face and the way she was holding her waist. Xiaomei immediately poured some warm water and asked with concern. After learning that the cake had failed, she comforted her, saying failure was normal, and encouraged her to go home early to rest, saying she could take care of the shop. Song Yajing felt warmed by this. After settling accounts with her, she closed the shop early at 6 p.m.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Commute home
description: Song Yajing rode her e-bike home as the rain gradually eased. She texted her husband that her lower back was uncomfortable and learned that he had already picked up their daughter and was cooking dinner; he told her to rest directly.
location: Along the route from Zhongshan Road to Hubin South Road in Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Arrive home and join the family.
description: When she got home, her daughter Xuanxuan rushed over and hugged her. Her husband leaned out of the kitchen and asked with concern about her back pain, telling her to rest first. The family's care eased some of the grievance she felt.
location: 5th floor, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband made tomato and egg noodles, and the family sat around the table. Song Yajing had a poor appetite and ate very little, listening to her daughter talk about funny things at kindergarten, while her husband quietly put the fried egg into her bowl.
location: Restaurant, 5th floor, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompany daughter
description: After the meal, her husband washed the dishes while Song Yajing played with Legos with her daughter in the room. She leaned back on the beanbag sofa; her backache kept her from building together, but she still helped her daughter find pieces and cheered her on.
location: Daughter's room, 5th floor, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bath and bedtime preparation
description: Song Yajing, despite the pain, bathed her daughter, changed her into pajamas, and told her a bedtime story about a brave little rabbit. After her daughter fell asleep, she kissed her forehead softly and left.
location: Bathroom and daughter's bedroom, Building 3, 5th floor, No. 82 Compound, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: My daughter's silent comfort.
description: Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom and saw a new crayon drawing by her daughter stuck to the headboard. It showed her mother standing in front of a house full of hanging dresses, with "ma ma jia you" and a heart written beside it. Her daughter slipped into the room, hugged her, and said, "Mommy, the cake I drew is also very pretty, don't cry." Song Yajing was moved to tears and hugged her daughter tightly.
location: Master bedroom, 5th floor, Building 3, residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing ran hot water in the bathroom, added soothing essential oil, and took a bath, letting the hot water ease her aches and pains. Reflecting on the day's experiences, her lower back ached, but her emotional wounds had been healed.
location: Bathroom, 5th floor, Building 3, residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening reflection and planning
description: After showering and drying her hair, Song Yajing sat at her desk, opened her journal, and recorded the lessons from today's cake failure (insufficient preparation, phone distractions), and wrote down a plan: go to the shop tomorrow to confirm Susan's delivery, and message Zhao Li to invite her to come to the shop this weekend to look at the window display.
location: Master bedroom, 5th floor, Building 3, residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Song Yajing got into bed. Her husband massaged her lower back, and she briefly told him about the failed cake. He comforted her, saying he would help next time and that he would love anything she made. In her husband's embrace and with her daughter's comfort, she fell asleep, tired and moved.
location: Master bedroom, 5th floor, Building 3, residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning review and baking consultation
description: At 7:35 in the morning, the alarm went off. Song Yajing slowly got up, feeling that her lower back was still a bit stiff. After a simple wash-up, she came to the dining table, where her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already cooked plain rice porridge. While drinking the porridge, she opened her phone photo album, looked at the photo of yesterday's failed opera cake, and compared it with the temperature and time notes she had recorded last night. She contacted the trusted pastry chef, Chef Chen, via WeChat, sent the failed photo and a brief description of the process, and sent a voice message asking for advice. Seeing Aqiang's concerned look, she forced an "I'm fine" smile and continued eating breakfast.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk daughter to school and stretch at the park.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing helped her daughter Xuanxuan put on her coat and backpack. Because of lower back discomfort, she decided not to take the electric scooter, and they walked hand in hand. They left home at 8:00 and arrived at Jiaxingyuan Park at 8:13. They walked two slow laps and did lower back stretches on a bench. Then they continued to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving at 8:35. She watched Xuanxuan run into the kindergarten, waved goodbye, and felt lighthearted.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road

name: Received professional guidance from Master Chen
description: When she reached the entrance of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she received a WeChat voice message from Master Chen. He analyzed in detail the problems: the ganache temperature was too high, the emulsification wasn't thorough, and the cake batter's meringue had deflated. He suggested working in stages and using a timer, and invited her to his studio on the weekend for hands-on guidance. Song Yajing felt touched, replied with thanks, and decided to write down the key points and stick them on the refrigerator, then learn in person on the weekend. She took out her keys as she walked into the store.
location: At the entrance of the Elegant Select Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arriving at the shop and preparing to open
description: Arriving at the store entrance, I took out my keys and opened the rolling shutter door. After entering, I opened the windows for ventilation and exchanged morning greetings with Xiaomei. Walking to the counter, I wrote Master Chen's suggestions on a sticky note, reminding myself of the key points for retrying the Opéra cake on the weekend, and stuck it on the back of my laptop. I set the goal of driving away yesterday's frustration with focused work.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sales data analysis and product selection preparation.
description: Pulled up the sales backend data for the past three months, used a highlighter to mark the top five best-selling items by sell-out rate and the spring styles frequently asked about by customers, and noted high sell-out rate categories such as macaron-colored shirts and A-line skirts with fitted waists, paying special attention to customer demand for mid-length floral dresses and lightweight knitwear. Due to lower back discomfort, she got up and moved around every 20 minutes.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with Guangzhou supplier Susan to select products and place an order.
description: Connected with supplier Susan via WeChat video. Susan was showing new spring styles at her stall in Guangzhou. Based on her notes, Song Yajing made requests: a macaron light-blue shirt in size S and a fitted floral midi skirt in size M, and asked about a sample of the soft silk shirt. She carefully checked sizes, fabrics, tag prices, and delivery times, cut out unsuitable styles, and finalized the first order: 8 styles, 30 pieces, at 75% of the supply price. After hanging up, she recorded the purchase ledger and confirmed the delivery arrangement with Xiaomei.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch discussion and rest at a convenience store.
description: Around noon, Song Yajing went with Xiaomei to Ade's Shacha Noodle Shop near Zhongshan Road for lunch. On the way, they discussed the morning's data analysis. Xiaomei suggested reworking the iron rack at the entrance to display spring styles. Song Yajing agreed, mentioned the flower arrangement looked outdated, and asked Xiaomei to watch for inspiration. After eating, they stopped by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy pearl milk tea, rested on a bench outside the store for 15 minutes to ease her lower back soreness, then walked back to the shop.
location: Ade Shacha Noodles near Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road.

name: Contact Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai to finalize the trial sale
description: After the lunch break, feeling refreshed, she proactively contacted Zheng Kai, an independent designer in Hangzhou, to ask about the fabric, care and washing instructions, and minimum order quantity for the hand-embroidered silk tops. After Zheng Kai answered, Song Yajing felt that the designs matched her customer base, decided to order two pieces of each style for trial sales, transferred a 450 yuan deposit via WeChat, left a message about the expected arrival time to coordinate with the spring display, and noted the details in her notebook.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store customer reception and handling of miscellaneous matters.
description: In the afternoon, regular customers came to the store one after another. Vivian, an old customer, brought a friend, and Song Yajing warmly received them, bringing out niche brooches and silk scarves for them to try on and match. In between, she replied to size and return/exchange inquiries in WeChat groups, checked the afternoon arrival list with Xiaomei, and dealt with customer return/exchange calls gently and professionally.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store closing handover and flower arrangement invitation surprise
description: In the evening, as she was preparing to close the shop, she told Xiaomei about the delivery list and planned to adjust the display stands on Saturday. At that moment, she received a WeChat message from florist Zhao Li asking whether she could design flower arrangements for the shop over the weekend for a photo shoot. Song Yajing was pleasantly surprised and immediately discussed the floral style (fresh and natural) and flowers (chamomile, pink anthurium, etc.) by voice message for nearly ten minutes. After hanging up, she expressed to Xiaomei her expectations for the Saturday shooting setup.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter from school and parent-child time on the way home
description: After closing the store, she hurried to the kindergarten. Xuanxuan ran over excitedly to share her folded paper airplanes and a new nursery rhyme. Song Yajing crouched down and hugged her (carefully protecting her lower back). On the way home, they passed the stationery store on Park South Road, and she bought Xuanxuan “Go, go!” Peppa Pig stickers, promising to put them on the drawing book in the evening. They continued walking and arrived home at 18:20.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; and the stationery store at Phase 2 of Yubincheng, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road.

name: Family dinner and quality time
description: After arriving home, Aqiang was already busy in the kitchen. Song Yajing helped cook the rice and prepare vegetables and shared that Zhao Li had taken the initiative to contact her. Aqiang said he could help take photos on Saturday. During dinner, Xuanxuan sang nursery rhymes, and the whole family laughed. After dinner, she stuck stickers onto the painting with Xuanxuan, read picture books, checked her math homework, and praised her.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal time and review
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Song Yajing applied a warm towel to her lower back, curled up on the sofa browsing Xiaohongshu for spring outfit ideas and high-end floral arrangement cases, and thought about the details to discuss with Zhao Li on Saturday. In the close friends group, she shared the day's efficiency and surprises and received encouragement from Meiling and Jiajia. Checking the ledger to confirm the day's cash flow, she felt fulfilled and in control.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and sound sleep
description: After taking a shower, she put on her nightgown and lay down gently on the bed; Aqiang was already asleep. She checked tomorrow's work, sent Zhao Li a goodnight WeChat message, listened to Master Chen's voice message, and planned the details for her weekend study. After turning off the screen, she felt the relaxation from the warm compress on her lower back and fell asleep with hope for life.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning prayer, preparing breakfast, and taking daughter to school
description: Waking up in the early morning, she knelt on the bedroom floor for morning prayer, giving thanks for the arrival of the Lantern Festival and praying for her family. Then she went to the kitchen to steam custard buns and fry an egg for her daughter Chen Lexuan, woke her up, helped her put on a red sweater, and told her that they would make tangyuan and a rabbit lantern together in the evening. After breakfast, she took her daughter's hand and went out. Downstairs they met Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, who gave them some homemade turnip cake, and they chatted for a while. Then she walked her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and did not leave until she saw the teacher take her inside.
location: Home in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying coffee, preparing to open the store, and handling online matters.
description: After dropping off the child, she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought a latte. Then she continued to the Elegant Select Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, rolled up the roller shutter, turned on the lights and music, and gave the cashier counter a quick clean. Next, following the methods taught by physiotherapist Master Chen, she did 8 minutes of soothing lower back stretches. After that, she sat at the counter drinking coffee while handling messages on her phone: she checked the message from Guangzhou supplier Susan about the 30 pieces of spring clothing ordered yesterday having been packed and expected to ship tomorrow, and replied with thanks; she received a notification from Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai that the handmade tops would be sent out in the afternoon, and replied reminding him to be careful with the packaging.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way)

name: Adjust the store display, prepare for the floral art exhibition, and learn to make rabbit lanterns.
description: Together with Xiaomei, she took down the red little lanterns and 'fortune' character decorations hung for the Spring Festival, cleared part of the display window area, and wiped the glass to leave space for florist Zhao Li to design the floral arrangement on Saturday. During a break, she sat behind the cashier counter and searched Xiaohongshu on her phone for the 'red envelope rabbit lantern tutorial.' She watched the video carefully and saved screenshots of the key steps: 'fold the red envelope in half,' 'fix it with staples,' and 'tassel pendant.' She also looked at a tutorial on making glutinous rice balls and noted two tips: 'add a little lard when kneading the dough' and 'use warm water throughout when mixing the dough.'
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Have lunch and notify the staff to leave work early.
description: Walked with Xiaomei to Dazhong Satay Noodle Shop on Zhongshan Road for lunch. We ordered satay noodles. While eating, I told Xiaomei that because of the Lantern Festival, I wanted to go home early and close the shop at 4 p.m., so she could leave early for the festival. Xiaomei happily agreed, and the two of us chatted about everyday things while eating.
location: Dazhong Shacha Noodles, 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write Lantern Festival greetings and store closure notice for the community group.
description: After lunch, she returned to the shop and prepared two messages: one sent to the VIP customer WeChat group, wishing everyone a happy Lantern Festival and informing them that the shop would close early at 16:00 today, accompanied by a photo of the neatly arranged window display; the other was written on the blackboard as a notice at the door.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business, serving regular customers, and reviewing inventory data.
description: In the afternoon, regular customers came into the store. Among them, Vivian, a regular customer, came to pick up the dress she had reserved and tried on some newly arrived spring clothes, buying two pieces. After seeing the customers off, she used a lull to quickly tally the afternoon's sales, sent supplier Susan a message to confirm that the spring clothes must be shipped tomorrow, and sent florist Zhao Li a WeChat message to confirm tomorrow morning's floral arrangement.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidy up the storefront, close the store, and post a notice.
description: Together with Xiaomei, I rehung and ironed the clothes customers had tried on, cleaned the carpet and the leaves of the green plants, and counted the cash in the register and the petty cash. At exactly 16:00, we placed the prepared small blackboard in a conspicuous spot at the door, locked the rolling shutter door, and after wishing each other a happy Lantern Festival, said goodbye.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bought ingredients for tangyuan, purchased flowers, and picked up daughter from school.
description: After closing the store, she walked to the Eighth Vegetable Market and bought half a jin of freshly ground water-milled glutinous rice flour, a box of handmade black sesame tangyuan filling, and a bag of dried longan. Then she detoured to Hualuozi Flower Shop at the entrance of the residential community, picked a few stems of pink spray daisies and lisianthus, and simply wrapped them into a bouquet. Then she hurried to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving just as school was letting out, and picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan to go home together.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then to Hualuozi Flower Shop, No. 2 Xinyi Lane, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; and finally to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home for a reunion, prepared ingredients, and the whole family made tangyuan together.
description: When she returned home, she felt warm at heart seeing her husband Chen Zhiqiang installing a small swing for their daughter on the balcony. She put the flowers she had bought into a vase and placed it in the center of the dining table. Then in the kitchen she mixed glutinous rice flour with warm water, added lard, and kneaded the dough; her husband and daughter came to help. The family gathered around, wrapping sesame filling in the dough. Her daughter creatively shaped a few into little rabbits and stars and secretly wrapped a strawberry soft candy inside one tangyuan.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cooking and tasting tangyuan.
description: After the water boils, put the hand-wrapped tangyuan into the pot and cook until done. Serve three bowls, and the family sits around the dining table. The daughter is delighted to eat the strawberry-sugar-filled tangyuan she made herself. The couple smiles at each other, enjoying the delicious handmade food and the warmth of reunion.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Make a rabbit lantern using red envelopes
description: After dinner, they took out materials such as New Year red envelopes, scissors, and a stapler and followed a phone tutorial to make a rabbit lantern together with the family. The daughter handed over materials while her husband assisted. After half an hour of effort, a bright red rabbit lantern was completed. The daughter carried it and ran around the living room, its light and shadows swaying.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Edited and published the Lantern Festival Vlog and replied to community comments
description: While the father and daughter were playing on the swing on the balcony and gesturing at the lanterns, she used her phone to capture warm moments: a close-up of her kneading dough, her daughter concentrating on making a rabbit lantern, and her husband's profile as he held the bamboo skewers steady. Sitting on the sofa, she used an editing app to stitch them into a 30-second short video, set it to the Southern Fujian nursery rhyme "Celebrating the Lantern Festival on the Fifteenth Day of the First Month," and posted it in the store community group and her personal video channel with the caption: "No matter how busy business is, make life whole. Happy Lantern Festival to everyone! #LanternFestival #FamilyTime." It quickly received likes, and regular customers left blessings. She replied to them one by one, her heart full of emotion.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community lantern-viewing night tour at Jiaxing Garden
description: The family of three went out, their daughter carrying a homemade rabbit lantern, heading to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road. The park was hung with red lanterns and lantern riddle slips. The family guessed lantern riddles, admired the moon, and enjoyed the Lantern Festival night.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: After returning home from the park, she helped her daughter wash up and change into pajamas, read the picture book 'The Moon Story', and stayed until she fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night conversation and review between the couple
description: After their daughter fell asleep, she curled up on the living room sofa with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She scrolled through the comments on her phone from the community group and videos, while her husband looked at feedback on the swing installation. She broke the silence and said, "Zhiqiang, today was wonderful. Thank you for installing the swing for Xuanxuan." He replied, "Mm, I'll spend more time with you and the child from now on." She leaned on his shoulder, feeling the warmth and peace returning between them.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime gratitude, stretching, and going to sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, I recorded today's feelings in my journal: "Lantern Festival, a fulfilling day. The store's spring clothing is ready, the family atmosphere is warming up, and Xuanxuan laughed a lot." After writing, I knelt by the bed and gave thanks to the Lord. Then I did a few minutes of bedtime stretching to relieve lower back soreness, put on a face mask, checked the WeChat message from florist Zhao Li: "See you tomorrow! I've already figured out how to arrange the display!" I replied with an excited emoji, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and having breakfast with the family
description: Yajing was awakened by the aroma of fried eggs wafting from the kitchen; her husband Aqiang had gotten up early to make breakfast. She did five minutes of cat stretch to ease the soreness in her lower back, and after washing up, the family of three sat down to breakfast in a warm atmosphere. Aqiang had made fried egg toast and hot milk. Yajing praised his improved cooking, while their daughter Xuanxuan cracked jokes.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Yajing walked hand in hand with Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter shared her creative idea about the rabbit-shaped rice balls, and Yajing praised her vivid imagination. At the kindergarten gate, they hugged and said goodbye. Yajing told her to be a good girl and watched her into the classroom.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: Yajing walked from the kindergarten to the 'Elegant Selection' boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, passing through the quiet Zhongshan Road in the early morning. On the way, she passed by 85°C and bought two croissants as afternoon tea snacks.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store opening preparations and strategic test-brewing of coffee.
description: After Yajing and Xiaomei arrived at the store, they pulled up the rolling shutter door together, turned on the lights, and tidied up the shop. Xiaomei boiled water, and Yajing opened the bookkeeping app and the cash register system to retrieve last week's free-coffee traffic-driving data. She found that 210 yuan was spent on soy milk in 7 days, attracting 12 new customers, but only 4 actually placed orders, and regular customers made excuses when she promoted spring clothing. After recording this, the two each brewed a hot latte to taste, savoring the aroma of the beans and discussing whether it was worth pricing at 15 yuan. Yajing felt even more confident about the "limited free" approach.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organize and evaluate the data from the free tastings at the beverage corner
description: Yajing and Xiaomei sat down at the cash register, spread out the account book, and analyzed the data item by item: this week, coffee beans and milk cost 210 yuan, attracted 12 new faces, with a conversion rate of only 33%. Vivian, a regular customer, came twice and only had coffee without buying any clothes. The two recalled the customers who took coffee and didn't browse, and realized that building goodwill purely with free coffee was too costly and not worth it.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Discussed the new limited-free-offer strategy over lunch.
description: Yajing and Xiaomei closed the shop and went to “Dazhong Shacha Noodles” for lunch. While waiting for their food, Yajing proactively proposed an adjustment: keep it free but add a “cap” — the first 10 customers each day get it free. Xiaomei agreed, feeling that a limit makes people sense scarcity more than free-for-all, and is both fairer and cost-controlling. The two settled on the new rule: “First 10 customers free every day.”
location: Dazhong Shacha Noodles, 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday online tasks and community content preparation
description: After returning to the store, taking advantage of the quiet midday traffic, Yajing first sent a WeChat message to supplier Susan in Guangzhou asking for the spring clothing shipment tracking number, then sent a voice message to florist Zhao Li to confirm her arrival time the next day. Then she checked the inventory management system. After that, she began preparing for the 3 p.m. community preview: she captured a close-up coffee shot from the coffee machine vlog she filmed yesterday, changed into the newly arrived beige trench coat and took a selfie in front of the fitting mirror, and edited the copy in her memo: 'I've always wanted to give the lovely ladies who come to the store a better afternoon tea time. Starting today, the first 10 lovely ladies to arrive each day can enjoy freshly ground coffee brewed by me ~' She read it twice and felt the tone was friendly and had a product feel. Soon after, she received Susan's reply with the tracking number and an encouraging note, and Zhao Li also confirmed she would arrive at 10 a.m. the next morning with the flower materials ready. Yajing felt that everything was under control.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: WeChat group preview announcement and a large order closed by a regular customer bringing in a new customer
description: At 3 p.m. sharp, she sent the copy, coffee close-ups, and selfies to the 'Yajing Good Clothes Old Friends' group, and the group immediately became lively. Vivian, a regular customer, was the first to speak up and praised the trench coat. Many regular customers asked questions, and Yajing replied to each one cheerfully. In less than an hour, Vivian came in with her colleague Xiao Chen, saying they had come to drink coffee and buy workplace outfits. Yajing welcomed them warmly and served two cups of freshly ground coffee. Vivian picked out three sets of early spring new arrivals (a silk blouse, wide-leg pants, and a trench coat). Xiao Chen, on her recommendation, tried on a suit skirt with a silk scarf and bought it without hesitation. The total was over 2,500 yuan. Yajing was happy inside but remained composed.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Counting inventory and tidying up the store
description: After seeing off the customer, Yajing was in a great mood. She reviewed the sales details with Xiaomei while tidying up the shop. She hung up the clothes left messy from try-ons, checked the cash register accounts, and recorded the day's revenue in the ledger, calculating in her mind that this single order had already covered the coffee cost and made a handsome profit.
location: Elegant Selection Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: Closed the shop on time at 6 o'clock, walked to the kindergarten, and bought a box of strawberries at a Pagoda Fruits store near Zhongshan Road on the way. At the kindergarten gate, she saw Xuanxuan saying goodbye to her classmates and felt tender inside. She picked up her daughter.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: Yajing brought her daughter home, and Aqiang had just gotten off work. She asked Aqiang to play with Xuanxuan, put on an apron, and went into the kitchen. She kneaded the leftover tangyuan dough from last night into small patties, pan-fried them as breakfast cakes, and simply stir-fried two dishes. The family sat around and had dinner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time
description: After dinner, Yajing played with Lego with Xuanxuan. Her daughter built a little castle and gave it to her mother, and Yajing praised her for being clever and dexterous. Aqiang captured the heartwarming moment with his phone. Yajing told Aqiang about the big deal she made today. Aqiang was happy for her and told her not to push herself too hard.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and recording reflections
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Yajing washed up, sat at her desk, and took out her productivity notebook. She carefully recorded today's coffee account data analysis results, the process of formulating the new strategy, and the big order from the afternoon. At the end she wrote: “Speaking with data feels much more reliable than acting on intuition.”
location: Bedroom and study at home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shared the joy in the besties group chat.
description: In the besties group chat "Three Little Cuties," Yajing sent a message sharing her joy about closing a big order of more than 2,000 yuan after changing the free coffee to a limited offer. Her besties Meiling and Jiajia responded enthusiastically, and the group chat was lively. Yajing shared her feelings about closing the deal and analyzing the data, feeling the day was complete.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime stretching and gratitude prayer.
description: After turning off her phone, Yajing did a set of gentle lower back stretches while lying in bed. She then said a short prayer of gratitude to God for smoothly resolving business issues, customer trust, her husband's thoughtfulness, and her daughter's growth. Feeling calm and grounded, she fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, morning preparations, and family breakfast.
description: The alarm went off at 7. She got up quietly to avoid waking her husband, did some light stretching, then woke her daughter Lexuan. The family of three sat at the dining table eating toast, fried eggs, and milk. While braiding her daughter's hair, she reminded her husband to pick up their daughter and take her to Grandma's house in the evening.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and getting ready to head out
description: After the meal, she changed into an off-white knitted top and dark jeans, with an apricot trench coat over them, put on light makeup, put an extra lipstick and some spare cash in her bag, and tidied the sofa before going out.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Walked her daughter to kindergarten
description: Holding hands, they left the house. At the entrance of the residential community, they met their neighbor Aunt Zhang, who praised how pretty the daughter was dressed. After exchanging pleasantries, they watched the daughter run into Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123, Gucheng West Road.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Bought coffee at a convenience store.
description: After dropping off her daughter, she walked alone for about 10 minutes to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought a medium hot latte and two butter cookies as a mid-morning snack.
location: 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Store opening preparations and staff communication
description: Arrived at "Elegant Select", located at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The shop assistant Xiaomei was already waiting at the door. Cleaned up together, wiped down the shelves, and told Xiaomei that the florist would come today to set up a Valentine's Day atmosphere, so she should keep her spirits up.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Greet the florist and answer Mom's phone call.
description: Florist Zhao Li arrived on time with flowers and tools. Just as they were discussing the decoration plan, her phone vibrated—her mother was calling. She stepped into the rest area to answer. Her mother told her that her father's hearing test at Quanzhou First People's Hospital showed moderate-to-severe age-related hearing loss, and he had already been fitted with hearing aids; the old man himself said he could hear clearly. Half of the weight in her heart was lifted. She urged her mother to let her father adapt slowly. After hanging up, she looked at the flowers being arranged, with mixed emotions.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Completed the floral arrangement
description: In front of the shop window, she took a deep breath, silently made the sign of the cross on her chest, adjusted her mood, and returned to the store, completing the main floral arrangement in the window with Zhao Li. An hour later, the atmosphere in the store became gentle and romantic.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch time
description: After Zhao Li took her leave, it was almost noon, so she asked Xiaomei to go have lunch first. After Xiaomei finished, she herself went to eat. She walked to the Dazhong Shacha Noodle Shop at the corner of Zhongshan Road, ordered a bowl of shacha noodles with tofu and squid, and added a braised egg for herself. While eating, she took out her phone and browsed the messages in the shop's community group.
location: Near Yingkai Hotel, No. 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Afternoon business: serving customers
description: Returned to the shop and threw myself into the afternoon business. With Valentine's Day approaching, foot traffic increased, and I warmly received every wave of customers. I successfully put together a date outfit for a young woman and recommended new spring arrivals to regular customers. Xiaomei handled the cash register and tidied the clothes. In the spare moments, I sent a timely blessing message to the customer group.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Handling business at the bank
description: Taking advantage of the low customer traffic in the store, she asked Xiaomei to watch the shop and took a taxi to the ICBC branch in Qianpu. At the bank, she used the self-service inquiry machine to check the shop account balance and transaction records, confirmed that the payment had arrived, and then withdrew 2,000 yuan in cash at the counter for backup.
location: Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Returning to the store to continue operations and prepare for closing.
description: Took a taxi back to the shop. There were few customers at this time, so she and Xiao Mei tidied up the clothes that had been rummaged through in the afternoon. She posted a notice in the group: 'Dear sisters, today is Valentine's Day, our little shop will close a tiny bit early. If you haven't gotten off work yet, hurry over and try your luck~' Then they tacitly began to count the inventory and clean up before closing.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Closed the store early and walked home.
description: At 16:30 she pulled down the rolling shutter door on time and locked up the shop. After saying goodbye to Xiaomei, she walked quickly toward home. The walk from Zhongshan Road to home took about 15 minutes. Passing a flower shop on the way, she saw bouquets of flowers, thought about tonight's plans, and the corners of her mouth curled up unconsciously.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Go home to change clothes and put on makeup.
description: After arriving home, she quickly took a shower and changed into a specially prepared wine-red knit dress. She carefully fixed her hair in front of the mirror and put on more refined makeup. For the moment, she suppressed her anxiety about the shop rent and her worries about her father's health.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Husband drove to pick her up and take her to the restaurant.
description: Your husband Chen Zhiqiang's car stopped right on time downstairs in the residential compound. Picking up your bag, you got into the passenger seat; soothing jazz was playing in the car. Your husband told you that he had taken your daughter to her grandmother's house as planned. The two of you didn't talk much. You turned to look at the festive lights outside the window, feeling both expectant and nervous.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Valentine's Day candlelight dinner
description: The restaurant had soft lighting, and every table was set with candles and roses. Your husband had booked a window seat overlooking the city night view. He took your hand and said, "You've worked hard these days. I just want you to be well—don't push yourself too hard." The words instantly opened up the emotions you had been suppressing all day. The balance in your mobile banking app and next month's shop rent flashed through your mind. You suddenly pulled your hand back and argued in a lowered voice, speaking faster and faster. The smile on your husband's face froze, and he silently cut his steak. You forced down a few tasteless bites, then your husband called the waiter and paid the bill in silence.
location: A French restaurant in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Drove home in silence
description: After dinner, they walked out of the restaurant. The street was still lively, but there was only silence between them. After getting in the car, her husband drove home without a word the whole way. The quiet in the car was harder to bear than any argument. Several times she wanted to speak up and apologize, but she didn't know where to begin, so she could only turn her head to watch the speeding street scenes outside the window, full of guilt and self-blame.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Arrived home, washed up, the atmosphere was cold.
description: Arrived home at 20:30, the two of you entered one after another. You told your husband you were going to wash up, and he just said mm and walked straight into the bathroom. When you finished washing up and returned to the bedroom, you found your husband already lying down with his back to you. Your heart gave a jolt, knowing he was still angry.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Being alone with self-reproach and prayer.
description: Wide awake, she quietly walked to the living room, took out the heavy 2015 wedding album from the back of the TV cabinet drawer, and flipped through it page by page. Seeing herself in a simple wedding dress, with her husband embracing her from behind, both smiling brightly, compared with the current pressure and cracks, she could no longer hold back her tears. Thinking of the news from her mother's phone call today that her father had gotten a hearing aid made her even sadder. She began to pray softly, “Lord, please help me, let me be gentler, and don't let stress destroy my family.” It was past 1 a.m. before she gradually calmed down, her heart filled with guilt and determination to change.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Returned to bed and took the initiative to reconcile
description: At 1:30 a.m., she dried her tears and tiptoed back to the bedroom. In the darkness, her husband was still turned away. She quietly lifted the covers and lay down. After hesitating for a few seconds, she wrapped her arms around her husband's waist from behind and pressed her cheek against his back. She could feel his body stiffen slightly, but he didn't pull away. She just held him quietly, without a word.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Falling asleep
description: Holding her husband's hand, with a heart full of guilt and a faint glimmer of resolve to change, she gradually drifted off to sleep. This Valentine's Day night, though it began with an argument, ultimately ended in a silent embrace.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community

name: Morning prayer and family reading time
description: I tossed and turned last night and didn't fall asleep until 2 a.m. When the alarm woke me at 9:30 in the morning, my eyes still felt gritty. I got out of bed quietly, afraid of waking my husband and daughter, who were still sound asleep. I walked to the small prayer table in the corner of my daughter's bedroom, closed my eyes, and prayed for my father's health, my family's safety, and today's work to go smoothly. Then I went to the living room and found my husband Chen Zhiqiang already sitting on the sofa with five-year-old Xuanxuan, reading a picture book. He looked up and said softly, 'Mom's awake. You rest a bit more today — I'll make breakfast.' My heart warmed, and I managed a faint smile.
location: Room 302, Community at 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple breakfast and photo shoot preparation
description: Zhiqiang had already prepared warm milk and whole wheat bread. I finished breakfast quickly, applied an ice pack to my still swollen eyelids, then stuffed a pack of soda crackers and a lumbar heat patch into the canvas bag in case my back hurt during the shoot. I said to Zhiqiang: "The shoot is at the store today; Xiaomei will help. Take Xuanxuan to the science museum for a look and don't cook lunch." He nodded in agreement.
location: Dining room, Room 302, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the clothing store
description: I changed into comfortable flat shoes, picked up my canvas bag, and left. In the morning, sunlight spilled onto Hubin South Road, and breakfast shops along the street wafted out aromas. I greeted Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor who was taking her child to a training class, and deliberately made a detour to the convenience store at the Zhenhai Road Metro Station entrance to buy a bottle of iced water to wake myself up. After walking about 7 minutes, I arrived at "Elegant Selection" at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Along the route from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Set up the floral photography background with Zhao Li
description: When I arrived at the store, Xiaomei had already swept the floor clean. At 10:30, my good friend Zhao Li arrived as promised. She is a fellow churchgoer I met at Gulangyu Catholic Church and is good at flower arranging. She brought big bundles of eucalyptus leaves, dried roses, and kraft paper. Together we moved aside the shelves outside the fitting room and used hemp rope and a wooden ladder to build a rustic backdrop. I took the rattan baskets from the storage room, and Zhao Li skillfully arranged them into a tasteful display. Seeing the tired look in my eyes, she handed me a glass of warm water and said, "Sister Yajing, you don’t look your best today. In a little while I’ll help you brighten up your base makeup." I smiled gratefully.
location: Inside the "Yazhi Select" store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch with Zhao Li and Xiaomei
description: The filming backdrop was basically ready, and we decided to have a simple lunch. Xiaomei said she wanted to try the newly opened Japanese-style light meal place, but Zhao Li and I both wanted to go to Meet Fresh for a bowl of taro ball soup. In the end, the three of us walked six minutes to Meet Fresh. I ordered a hot bowl of tomato beef brisket noodles, Zhao Li ordered grass jelly, and we chatted about next week's Mass arrangements and the succulents Zhao Li keeps at home, deliberately avoiding last night's troubles, just wanting to keep our mood light.
location: Meet Fresh (Siming South Road store), 24-26 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Changing clothes and doing makeup to prepare for the shoot
description: Back at the store, I changed into the first early-spring commuting outfit for the shoot: a mint green blazer paired with white wide-leg pants. Zhao Li used a makeup brush to quickly touch up my blush and lipstick, covering up my tired look, and pinned up my hair with an elegant claw clip, making me look neat and energetic. I looked in the mirror, confirmed I looked good, and said to Zhao Li, "Thank goodness for you, otherwise my face would have fallen apart."
location: Fitting room and makeup area inside the 'Elegant Selection' store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Filming a short video of early spring outfits.
description: At 1 p.m., the photo shoot officially began. I changed into the six carefully prepared spring outfits, including a mint green blazer, a floral shirt paired with a khaki skirt, a misty blue shirt, a beige trench coat, and more. Zhao Li and Xiaomei assisted beside me, constantly adjusting the phone camera angle, lighting, and hem details. Facing the camera, I introduced the feel of the fabrics and styling ideas in a gentle voice: "The sleeves of this misty blue shirt are very flowing, and the buttons are mother-of-pearl, really textured..." The collars of several outfits kept turning up, so Zhao Li cleverly fixed them from behind with safety pins. Constantly bending over to change shoes and adjust skirts made the soreness in my lower back worse, and a thin sweat broke out on my forehead, but I still insisted on shooting a complete styling explanation for each outfit.
location: At No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, inside the "Elegant Selection" store, in front of the floral arrangement background.

name: Wrapping up the photo shoot and tidying the store.
description: After the shoot, I collapsed into a chair in the shop and rubbed my lower back. Xiaomei brought hot water, and Zhao Li helped put away the equipment. During this time I received a WeChat message from my husband Zhiqiang: "Xuanxuan is tired and already fell asleep in the car. I'm going home to cook. Come back soon after you finish." Seeing this message, my tense heart relaxed. After seeing Zhao Li off, Xiaomei and I cleaned up the leftover scraps in the store together, and I told Xiaomei to rest tomorrow and come back to work on Monday, the day after tomorrow.
location: Inside the "Yazhi Select" store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home
description: After locking the store door, I dragged my tired body home on foot. The setting sun slanted across Zhongshan Road, and the crowds were still bustling, but my mood was much calmer than last night. The sweet smell of milk tea drifted from a roadside shop, and I decided to buy myself a cup on the weekend.
location: Along the route from No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Family dinner and parent-child interaction
description: When I got home, my husband was stir-frying in the kitchen, and braised pork ribs and garlic lettuce were already set out on the table. I first went to the bedroom to look at our sleeping daughter Chen Lexuan and kissed her little face. Then I took the initiative to help my husband in the kitchen, scooping rice and arranging chopsticks. The three of us ate and chatted; after Xuanxuan woke up, she excitedly talked about the big dinosaur at the science museum, and I responded with a smile.
