After the meal, I insisted on washing the dishes myself and let my husband play with magnetic tiles with Xuanxuan.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 302, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gave her daughter a bath, told her stories, and soothed her to sleep.
description: Accompanying Xuanxuan to bathe and reading bedtime stories is a daily ritual. Today she chose the story "Little Rabbit Learns to Be Brave." After listening, Xuanxuan hugged me and said, "Mommy, Xuanxuan will be brave too, just like the little rabbit in the story!" My heart warmed, and I kissed her forehead. After coaxing my daughter to sleep, I gently closed the door.
location: Daughter's bedroom, Room 302, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Edit outfit videos and publish them for promotion
description: Putting on my Bluetooth earphones, I sat at the dining table and opened the editing app on my phone. I edited the six clips shot this afternoon one by one, added carefully selected light BGM, and included the fancy title and subtitles "One Week of Early Spring Commute Outfits." Finally, I added promotional copy to the video about the store's limited-time 5% off preorder for spring clothing. After the video was finished, I took a deep breath and posted it to the customer WeChat group and the Channels account respectively. Just a few minutes after posting, my phone started ringing with "ding ding" notifications. I saw a reply from a regular customer, Vivian: "Please hold the whole third outfit for me!" Then came inquiries from several other customers. I was completely wide awake, replied to each one carefully, and neatly recorded the sizes and prepayments in my order notebook.
location: Dining table in Room 302, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle online orders and rest.
description: Online orders kept increasing. I spent nearly another hour replying and sorting out information for seven customers who had made reservations in my notebook. My lower back was so sore and painful that I couldn't bear it. I got up and walked to the living room, where my husband was sitting on the sofa looking at his phone. I didn't say anything; I just sat down beside him and placed a cushion behind my back. Seeing this, Zhiqiang silently got up and went into the kitchen.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 302, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Her husband handed her warm milk as a silent reconciliation.
description: A few minutes later, Chen Zhiqiang came out carrying a glass of hot milk, gently set it on the tea table in front of me, and said in a low voice, "Does your back still hurt? Go to bed early." Then he sat back down on the sofa. I held the warm milk in both hands, and warmth instantly traveled from my fingertips to my heart. I didn't look up, but softly replied, "Mm, you worked hard today." That sentence was like a tiny crack that loosened the frozen air from last night. We sat there in silence for a while, each scrolling on our phones, yet it felt as if the temperature in the house had risen a little.
location: Living room, Room 302, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and rosary prayer.
description: After finishing the milk, I got up, went to the kitchen to wash the cup, and then went back to the bedroom to wash up briefly. After changing into comfortable pajamas, I did not lie down immediately. Instead, I sat on the edge of the bed, took out the rosary from under the pillow, and prayed quietly. I thanked God for letting today's work go smoothly and offered gratitude for Zhiqiang's thoughtfulness and the family's peace. I prayed for my father's health and for myself to have more wisdom to run the shop and the family well.
location: Master bedroom, Room 302, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: I lay back down on the bed; my husband beside me had already fallen into even breathing. I turned on my side, looked at his back, which was turned to me but breathing calmly, and turned off the lamp. In the darkness, I murmured to myself, "Good night, tomorrow will be better." That night, I didn't have insomnia again.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom, Room 302, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparation at home and departure.
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm, washed up quietly, and used foundation to conceal the faint dark circles left from anxious, poor sleep the night before. She took out pork ribs and tomatoes from the refrigerator to make breakfast for the family, cooked white congee in the rice cooker, fried sunny-side-up eggs in a frying pan, and prepared some pork floss. She left notes for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan: 'Congee is in the pot, eat the eggs while they're hot.' Then she returned to the bedroom, sat by the window, took out her rosary and prayed in a low voice, giving thanks for Zhao Li's help and the smooth video shoot, feeling relieved about Vivian's reservation, and praying to resolve the cold war with her husband over the coffee machine investment and to bless her father as he adapted to his hearing aid. Afterward, she changed into a plain long dress and a knit cardigan, picked up her cloth bag containing her Bible and notebook, gently closed the door behind her, and headed to the bus stop at the entrance of the residential complex.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the community entrance

name: Commute to the church
description: She took the bus heading for the ferry terminal and browsed the shop's customer group chat on the way. Seeing a regular customer's comment under the spring clothing video, 'The third set looks good. Do you have size S?', she felt a little reassured. After arriving at the ferry terminal, she swiped her annual tourism pass to board. Standing by the rail with the sea breeze on her face and looking at the outline of Gulangyu Island, her mood gradually calmed.
location: From the bus stop at the entrance of the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Gulangyu Piano Pier (via Xiamen Ferry Terminal, 15 Lujiang Road)

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: She arrived earlier than the scheduled time, sat down by the flower bed in the courtyard of the Catholic church on Gulangyu, opened the Bible and read softly, taking in the quiet of the morning church. The Mass was presided over by Father Wang Mingde, and the sermon was titled “Sowing Peace in the Family.” She closed her eyes and prayed for guidance for the shop's business, her father's health, and the cold war with her husband. The sound of the pipe organ calmed her, and Aunt Lin Xiuying and other fellow parishioners were also present.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ran into Zhao Li in the church courtyard.
description: After Mass, she met Zhao Li by the flower bed in the courtyard of the Catholic church. Zhao Li was playing with her daughter. They sat down on a bench, and Zhao Li noticed her tiredness. She mentioned the small disagreement with her husband and her father's health condition. Zhao Li shared the hardships of her own flower-arranging work and encouraged her: 'The Lord will bless kind people, and everything will be all right.' Zhao Li's daughter picked a small flower and gave it to her, which warmed her heart.
location: Courtyard of Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return trip and buying supplies along the way
description: She said goodbye to Zhao Li and took the ferry back to the main island. After getting off, she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought pork ribs her husband loved, a bunch of asparagus, and a few tomatoes, and prepared lunch.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home to prepare lunch.
description: She came home carrying groceries and saw her husband Chen Zhiqiang playing with building blocks with their daughter Chen Lexuan in the living room. She changed out of her coat, tied on an apron, and went into the kitchen. While washing vegetables, she poked her head out and struck up a conversation with her husband in a relaxed tone: “Hey, I ran into that florist Zhao Li at church again, the one I mentioned to you before. She's really nice. Don't you think it might be better to ask her to help us do the shop window?” Her husband was a bit taken aback, but despite his flat tone, he expressed support: “It's up to you. It's good to have another friend helping.” This made her feel that a crack had appeared in their cold war.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 502, Unit 3, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family lunch
description: She served the carefully prepared clear-simmered pork rib soup and garlic lettuce. The family sat around the table; she ladled soup for her husband, and he put food on her plate. Their daughter Chen Lexuan excitedly showed off her 'Spring' painting from kindergarten: 'Mommy, look! This is me and Daddy in the park!' The painting showed little figures holding hands. After the meal, her husband took the initiative to clear the dishes and wash them.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday Leisure and Companionship
description: She played with magnetic tiles with her daughter in the living room, building the garden castle from her imagination. The afternoon sunlight fell on the wooden floor, warm and cozy. She leaned back on the sofa and dozed off, while her daughter obediently lay beside her flipping through a picture book.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 3, 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon walk around the neighborhood to relax
description: After she woke up, she put a coat on her daughter and took her downstairs for a walk. The spring sunlight cast dappled shadows through the leaves. Her daughter chased butterflies on the lawn while she sat down on a bench. Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, came over to chat and asked about the shop business. She smiled and replied, 'I'm adjusting gradually; it will be fine.' Watching her daughter's carefree manner, she also felt much lighter.
location: Central Garden of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon work at home and shopping.
description: After taking her daughter home, she let her daughter play with building blocks in the living room by herself and sat down in the study. She first replied to the regular customer Vivian's booking message from last night, confirmed the spring clothing size as S, and thanked her for her support. Then she posted the retouched spring clothing photos taken by Zhao Li in the customer group with the caption: “Spring is growing stronger, the flowers outside the window are blooming, and the flowers in my shop are blooming for you too.” Two customers asked about outfit matching. Then she sent a voice message to the shop assistant Xiaomei, telling her to arrive early tomorrow morning for the shop's floral makeover. At that moment, Zhao Li sent a WeChat message and a hand-drawn floral window display design, excitedly suggesting: “Sister Jing, let me decorate the window with dried flowers for you. I'll only charge the cost price to attract customers!” She replied, moved: “That's great! You're really a godsend! Come to the shop at ten tomorrow morning, and we'll do it together!” The details were settled. Afterwards, she contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou to ask about the early spring new arrivals logistics. Susan replied that the goods were expected to arrive on Tuesday. To prepare for tomorrow's makeover, she walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road metro station, bought transparent tape, rags, and candy, and treated herself to a hot latte as a reward.
location: Study at Room 502, Unit 3, the housing estate at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road)

name: Prepare dinner
description: She returned home in a good mood, humming a song as she started preparing dinner. She specially made a dish her husband loved—steamed baby cabbage with garlic and vermicelli—and also boiled a pot of clear, sweet white radish and pork rib soup. The kitchen was filled with a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and sharing small blessings
description: At dinner, she casually mentioned as if unintentionally that Zhao Li had shown her floral design sketches that afternoon and would come to the store the next morning to help decorate the window. Her husband silently ladled her a bowl of soup and said, “Mm, as long as you can manage on your own.” Their daughter curiously asked what a storefront window display was, and she patiently explained. The atmosphere at the table was not exactly warm, but the stiffness had indeed melted away considerably.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening parent-child time and putting the child to sleep
description: After dinner, her husband went to the study to deal with work. She took her daughter back to the small room, read the picture book 'Little Rabbit Learns About Spending' together, and patiently explained the meaning of a budget. Then they worked together on a kindergarten-themed drawing, sketching the butterflies they had chased that day and the flowers in the garden. Afterwards, she bathed her daughter, changed her into pajamas, and soothed her to sleep. Her daughter wrapped her arms around her neck and said, “Mommy, I had a really happy day today. The butterflies were beautiful.” She kissed her daughter's forehead and led her in a bedtime prayer: “Thank you, Lord, for letting us have a safe and happy day. Please bless Mom and Dad's work, and bless Grandpa, wishing him a speedy recovery.”
location: Daughter's room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal time: research and planning
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she went back to the study, saved Zhao Li's design drawings to her phone, and opened her notes app to carefully plan tomorrow's setup details: cleaning tools needed, shelf positions to move, flower arrangements, and so on. Then she made a video call to her mother, Lin Xiuying, in Quanzhou, and asked how her father was adjusting to wearing his hearing aid. Her mother said her father was much better today and could communicate loudly on the phone. After days of worry, she finally felt relieved.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and stretching to relax
description: She hung up the phone and felt much more relaxed. She went to the bathroom and took a comfortable hot shower, changed into pajamas, and carefully did a set of waist stretching exercises on the bedroom floor, which eased the soreness that had persisted for several days and stretched out her body.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Review and bedtime
description: She lay in bed, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on, silently reviewing the fulfilling day in her mind: the morning's quiet in the church gave her strength, Zhao Li's friendship and support warmed her, the midday thawing of the cold war with her husband brought hope, and her father's improving health put her at ease. She felt the day was like a gas station, filling her with enough energy to face the new week. She picked up the rosary beads by the bed, said one final devout prayer, then turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: At 6:50 in the morning, the phone alarm rang. Song Yajing washed up, changed into comfortable loungewear, and observed the cloudy day by the window to adjust her mood. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: a cheese omelet for her daughter Chen Lexuan, and bacon and toast for herself. While cooking, she gently woke her daughter and helped her wash up and braid her hair. She had a brief exchange with her husband Aqiang, telling him about the day's plan to renovate the storefront and the possibility of coming home late, creating a relaxed morning atmosphere.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing helped her daughter Chen Lexuan put on a thick coat, picked up her little backpack, and walked hand in hand to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, her daughter shared fun stories about playing with LEGO over the weekend, and Yajing responded patiently. After a hug goodbye at the kindergarten gate, she walked to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked to the shop. On the way, she bought mixed noodles and hot soy milk at Jukou Mixed Noodle Shop as breakfast for Zhao Li. While waiting, she used the spare moment to write promotional copy keywords for Zhao Li's flower art in her phone memo. After arriving at the shop, she turned on the lights, powered on the register, checked sales records, cleaned the floor with Xiaomei, wiped down the display shelves and counter, and prepared flower arrangement tools. At 9:45, Zhao Li arrived with the florals. Yajing went up to take the bags and handed her breakfast. After a brief exchange, they began preparing the window display makeover.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Window floral display makeover and cooperation established.
description: Zhao Li led the window floral design, using dried cotton, eucalyptus leaves, dried lavender, and faux tulips to create a 'Warm Wilderness' style. Song Yajing helped by passing tools, adjusting mannequins, and cleaning up trimmings. The two chatted about entrepreneurship and funny store stories while working, in a relaxed atmosphere. After finishing, they took photos of the window to remember the occasion, including a close-up of Zhao Li and a photo of the two together. Yajing proposed a mutually beneficial plan for long-term floral collaboration, and Zhao Li readily agreed, establishing an oral partnership.
location: In front of the window of Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Had lunch with Zhao Li and saw her off.
description: After locking the store, Yajing went with Zhao Li to Dazhong Shacha Noodles for lunch. They ordered the signature shacha noodles with extra duck blood, tofu, and squid, and Yajing treated. While waiting for the food, she asked Zhao Li for tips on flower care and color matching. They chatted while eating, and their friendship warmed. After the meal, they said goodbye at the restaurant entrance. Yajing thanked Zhao Li for her help and agreed to collaborate again on the next new-product photo shoot, then walked back to the store.
location: Dazhong Shacha Noodles, 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon shop work.
description: Yajing first invited four core regular customers, including Vivian, via WeChat private messages to attend tomorrow's tea party, noting details such as Vivian's preference for Earl Grey tea. Then she posted new window display photos to the customer group to build anticipation, announced tomorrow's tea party and the activity of offering coffee to customers who try on clothes in the store, which received positive responses. Next, at the drink corner, she conceptualized cup-style tiramisu and recorded the ingredients. In the afternoon, under light rain, she and Xiaomei took turns receiving customers, proactively serving hot hand-brewed coffee. Two regular customers came specially. In her spare time, she continued to refine her dessert ideas.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Closing up the store and shopping on the way home
description: Yajing and Xiao Mei tidied up the storefront and checked the day's cash and electronic bills. Then they reviewed the day's work and went over the arrangements for tomorrow's tea party. Together they pulled down the roller shutter door and left the shop. On the way home, Yajing stopped by Xiali Foods to buy the ladyfingers needed for making tiramisu, and also picked up her daughter's favorite pineapple cakes and lemongrass tea, preparing for the family and tomorrow's event.
location: Xiali Food, No. 297, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: When Yajing got home, her husband had already cooked the meal and was helping their daughter with pinyin. She kissed her daughter and thanked her husband, and then the family of three had a warm dinner together. The daughter shared fun stories from kindergarten, while Yajing talked about the results of the window display makeover and the plan for tomorrow's tea party. Her husband reminded her that the cooperation needed clear cost calculations. Although there was still emotional distance, there was no more hostility.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family companionship and housework
description: After dinner, Yajing took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy the kitchen, then played games with her daughter in the room. At 20:00, her husband bathed their daughter while Yajing organized the kitchen and checked the materials needed for tomorrow’s tea party, laying the groundwork for the next day’s event.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal relaxation and social media promotion
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing did 15 minutes of waist stretches in the bedroom to relieve fatigue. Then she opened her phone, selected photos of the shop window and Zhao Li taken during the day, paired them with the caption she had drafted earlier, and posted a Moments post sincerely recommending Zhao Li's florist studio, completing the online promotion for the shop's collaboration.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Introspection and prayer
description: After turning off her phone, Yajing knelt by the bedside, holding a rosary and saying a prayer of gratitude. She gave thanks for the joy of today's successful cooperation and the warmth of friendship, prayed for tomorrow's tea gathering to go smoothly and for her father's hearing to improve, and asked for peace and understanding to come to the family. She felt deeply at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tomorrow's planning and going to bed
description: Lying in bed, her husband already fast asleep. Yajing organized tomorrow's tea party schedule in her phone's memo: prepare the tiramisu mixture in the morning, assemble it in the afternoon and prepare fruit tea, and set out the tea set in advance. After setting the alarm for 6:50 the next morning, she put down her phone, summarized the solid gains of the day, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off. Yajing took a deep breath and got up. She first drank a glass of warm water and did some simple lower back stretches. After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear and prepared for a busy day.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: For her daughter Xuanxuan, she made her favorite cheese omelet, served with milk and strawberries. For herself and her husband Aqiang, she prepared toast, fried eggs, and black coffee. The family of three sat down at the table. Aqiang asked about the afternoon tea party. Yajing briefly explained the schedule and reminded him to pick up their daughter in the evening. He nodded in agreement.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Holding an umbrella, she walked Xuanxuan to kindergarten. The air was fresh after the rain. When they passed the small square at Jiaxing Garden, she saw a few little birds hopping at the edge of a puddle, and Xuanxuan excitedly pointed them out to Yajing. After handing her over to the teacher at the kindergarten gate, Yajing waved goodbye.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fresh produce procurement.
description: Following the list she had written the night before, Yajing went shopping at the Eighth Market. First she bought a bunch of yellow daisies and eucalyptus leaves to decorate the afternoon tea table. Then she went to her usual stall and bought mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, espresso, cocoa powder for making tiramisu, as well as fresh strawberries, lemons, passion fruit, and local honey for fruit tea. She also compared egg prices at different stalls.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arriving at the store and preparing for opening
description: Carrying the purchased items, she returned to the “Elegant Selection” clothing store. The clerk Xiao Mei had already opened the door. Together they put away the ingredients and flowers, mopped the floor, wiped the fitting mirror, and tidied the shelves. Yajing specially checked the logistics information on her phone and felt more at ease when she saw that the spring clothing showed “out for delivery”.
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Focused on back-kitchen baking
description: Yajing put on an apron and began making afternoon tea snacks in the kitchen. She whipped the mascarpone cheese, mixed the egg yolks, layered ladyfingers dipped in coffee one by one into a glass square container, and finally sifted a thick layer of cocoa powder on top before putting it in the refrigerator to set the tiramisu. She then boiled fruit tea: she put chopped strawberries, lemon, and passion fruit into a pot, added honey and rock sugar, and simmered over low heat. Meanwhile, around 10 a.m., Xiaomei informed her that the courier had delivered the spring clothing to the intersection, so Yajing asked her to unpack and verify the item count.
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Xiao Mei went to Jukou Street and brought back two portions of Lianhuan oyster omelet and pork liver soup to the shop. Yajing sat behind the cash register and ate quickly while replying to online customer inquiries on her phone. She sent a WeChat message to her husband Aqiang to confirm picking up their daughter in the evening, and Aqiang replied that he would go on time.
location: Yazhi Select Shop, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (lunch takeout from Lianhuan Oyster Omelet on Jukou Street)

name: Organizing spring clothes and setting up the venue.
description: After lunch, Yajing and Xiaomei opened the spring clothing parcel together; it contained 5 new styles. The two teamed up to unpack the items, cut off the hang tags, steam them smooth with a garment steamer, and hang them in a prominent position. Yajing picked out one of the mint green silk blouses and paired it with white wide-leg pants as her 'private showcase' for the tea party. Then they pushed together the two round glass tables in the corner, covered them with a light beige linen tablecloth, and placed the freshly bought daisies on them, setting up the venue for the afternoon tea party.
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final confirmation and preparation for the tea gathering.
description: She took the set tiramisu out of the refrigerator, cut it into small bite-sized squares, and placed them on delicate small plates. She poured the cooked fruit tea into a glass teapot and set crystal glasses beside it. Yajing checked the table arrangement, confirmed that the tableware and napkins were all in place, and changed into a neatly tailored beige knit top.
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: VIP regular customer afternoon tea
description: At 2 PM, Vivian and four other regular customers arrived as promised. Yajing warmly invited them to sit at the flower-decorated tea table and personally served each of them tiramisu and fruit tea. The atmosphere was cozy as everyone ate and chatted. Yajing took the opportunity to ask about their expectations for the spring new arrivals, especially their clothing coordination needs. Vivian praised the tiramisu and suggested that the store could also stock some chic accessories such as earrings and silk scarves. Yajing took out her phone and carefully noted the suggestions, and the other guests began discussing their favorite accessory styles.
location: Tea gathering area of Elegant Select shop, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Event wrap-up and social media posting.
description: Before the tea party ended, Yajing gave each guest a handwritten 'Spring New Arrivals 20% Off Trial Voucher' and thanked them for their support and suggestions. After seeing the guests off, she took photos of the flower arrangements and tea snacks, selected a few from the earlier window display she had worked on with Zhao Li and from the afternoon group photos, edited the text, and posted it on WeChat Moments: 'Thank you, my dearest VIP sisters! Today's suggestions about accessories were so rewarding! Looking forward to the spring wardrobe—together we'll be even more beautiful.'
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daily operations and customer follow-up.
description: After posting to Moments, Yajing replied one by one to comments asking about the new styles and the 20% off coupons, and received two or three walk-in customers attracted by the window display. While greeting customers, she reminded Xiaomei to rearrange and display the spring clothing by color and style. At the same time, she also sent WeChat messages to customers who had pre-ordered spring clothing to let them know the goods had arrived.
location: Elegant Select Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handed over closing duties and picked up her daughter
description: At 17:45, Yajing told Xiao Mei to close the shop at the appointed time and left early to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. Holding an umbrella, she walked quickly through the light rain to Siming Experimental Kindergarten.
location: Walk from No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District

name: Pick up my daughter from school and head home on the way
description: After picking up Xuanxuan from kindergarten, the little girl chattered on about learning origami today. Yajing listened patiently. When they passed the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, she bought Xuanxuan a sticker book she liked as a reward. Mother and daughter held hands and slowly walked home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; passing the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road; returning home to No. 128 Hubin South Road.

name: Preparing dinner and family time
description: When she got home, her husband Aqiang had also just come back from work. Yajing nimbly rinsed the rice and started cooking, while taking out the vegetables she bought in the morning and the pork ribs from the fridge to prepare braised pork ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. In the kitchen's lively cooking atmosphere, she shared with Aqiang the joy of today's successful tea party and Vivian's suggestions. Aqiang also mentioned that work wasn't so busy today and that they could play with Xuanxuan together after dinner.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time
description: After the family of three finished dinner, Aqiang was responsible for clearing the table. Yajing sat on the living room carpet and played with Xuanxuan with a newly bought sticker book, putting clothes and accessories on the cartoon characters. After playing for a while, she took out the picture book 'Little Rabbit Learns to Be Brave' and patiently read it to her daughter.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to sleep and video calling with mother.
description: Yajing gave Xuanxuan a warm bath, changed her into clean pajamas, sat by the bed and told a few bedtime stories, watching her daughter slowly fall asleep. After confirming that her daughter was sound asleep, she gently turned off the light and left. She went to the living room sofa, poured herself a glass of warm water, and video-called her mother, Lin Xiuying. During the video call, Yajing talked about the recent cash flow pressure on the shop, the occasional frictions with her husband, and how tired she still felt even though the afternoon tea party had been a success. Her mother gently comforted her in Hokkien: “When husband and wife are of one heart, they can cut through metal. Take it slow; don’t rush.” She then changed the subject and taught her the secrets of making traditional Hokkien-style meat zongzi, from soaking the glutinous rice and marinating the pork belly to tying the zongzi. Yajing listened and took notes in her phone’s memo app.
location: Home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (daughter's room and living room)

name: Recording recipes and personal reflections
description: After hanging up, Yajing's eyes were slightly red but she had a smile on her lips. She went to the desk in the bedroom, opened the notes on her phone, carefully sorted out the meat zongzi recipe her mother dictated, and added the little details her mother had reminded her of. Then she quickly reviewed tomorrow's schedule and wrote in her planner: “Buy glutinous rice and bamboo leaves in the morning, try making zongzi for the first time.” After that, she opened her diary and wrote down three things she was grateful for: Vivian and the customers' support, Aqiang sharing the housework, and her mother's warm comfort.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 community on Shanggu Street, desk in the bedroom at home.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Yajing went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully removing her makeup and doing her skincare routine. After changing into pajamas, she did a simple 5-minute pre-sleep stretch on the bed to relax her tired lower back and legs.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening prayers and bedtime
description: After turning off the light, Yajing prayed softly in the darkness, thanking the Lord for a peaceful day, thanking Him for the smooth afternoon tea gathering and her mother's care, and entrusting her joy, exhaustion, and anxiety to the Lord. She felt an unprecedented sense of calm inside, smiled, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of her home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In the early morning, urgently took care of daughter who was vomiting.
description: Around 2 a.m., her daughter Chen Lexuan suddenly vomited and had a low-grade fever, waking Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang. They divided the work: one cleaned up the vomit and the bed sheets, while the other wiped their daughter's body with warm water. Song Yajing quickly called family doctor Wang Mingyuan and, following his instructions, gave her daughter electrolyte water and kept monitoring her temperature. The couple took turns holding and soothing their daughter until dawn, when her temperature gradually stabilized.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, morning prayer, and preparing breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Song Yajing was awakened by her alarm clock and washed up briefly. In the bedroom, she lit a candle before the statue of the Virgin Mary and said her morning prayers, praying for a safe shopping trip and for her family's well-being. Then she went into the kitchen and prepared breakfast using ingredients including the glutinous rice she had soaked the night before. She cooked millet porridge, fried eggs, and sliced toast and apples. When it was ready, she woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and her daughter Chen Lexuan, and the family of three enjoyed breakfast together in a warm atmosphere. During the meal, Yajing shared her plan to go treasure-hunting at the wholesale market in the morning. Aqiang reminded her to compare prices, while Xuanxuan was curious and asked her mother to bring back little hair clips.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten and head to the shop to prepare.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing packed her daughter’s schoolbag and water bottle, took her hand, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way they passed a stationery store, and she bought Xuanxuan a pencil with a bunny pattern. At the kindergarten gate she chatted briefly with the teacher, watched her daughter go into the classroom, and then walked to the store “Yazhi Select” on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, she opened the door with shop assistant Xiaomei to let in fresh air, wiped down the shelves, adjusted the spring outfit colors on the window mannequins, and took out the memo where she had previously recorded customer suggestions. She discussed the day’s plan with Xiaomei: in the morning, she would go to Jiya Market to pick accessories, Xiaomei would be in charge of the store, and new-product pre-sale registrations could be done in the meantime.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to "Elegant Select", Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Go to Jiya Small Commodities Wholesale Market to look for accessory samples.
description: As planned, Song Yajing rode her electric bike to the Jiya Small Commodity Wholesale Market and went straight to the Korean-style accessories section on the second floor. At Cloud Dress Workshop she picked out several silk scarves, focusing on the light purple print and dark green polka dots. At a vintage-style small shop she found 3 pairs of uniquely designed metal earrings. At a hat stall she took a liking to an off-white wide-brimmed straw hat and negotiated a small-batch wholesale price with the owner. Throughout the process, she took sample photos on her phone and recorded quotes, efficiently completing the initial selection of accessories.
location: Jiya Small Commodities Wholesale Market, at the intersection of Hubin South Road and Douxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the store and had lunch.
description: Carrying a few bags of samples, Song Yajing rode her electric bike back to Zhongshan Road. Passing by 85°C, she bought a hot latte along the way to reward herself. After returning to the shop and putting her things down, she walked to Lianhuan Oyster Omelet on Jukou Cross Alley before the lunch rush, ordered a signature oyster omelet and a bowl of fish ball soup, and enjoyed a steaming hot lunch.
location: 85°C on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province and Lianhuan Oyster Omelet at Jukou Cross Lane, Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing samples and preparing for midday business.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing returned to the shop and couldn't wait to share the samples she had picked up in the morning with Xiaomei. The two discussed styling and pricing. Then came the midday customer rush. She skillfully used the newly sourced silk scarves to style customers trying on spring clothes, and the effect was so remarkable that it directly resulted in two sales.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Select'

name: Accessory and dried flower pairing, plus online communication.
description: During a lull between customers, Song Yajing took the wide-brimmed straw hat and lavender silk scarf to the display window, creatively paired them with dried flower bundles and woven baskets, and took photos. She sent them to her florist friend Zhao Li via WeChat, suggesting adding a "Flowers and Accessories" theme to next week's new-product shoot. Zhao Li enthusiastically agreed, and the two finalized the collaboration details online. Then, remembering that her dried flowers at home had not been brought in, she called her neighbor Lao Chen and asked him to close the windows if it rained at night.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Select'

name: Daily business operations and online customer maintenance
description: During the afternoon business hours, Song Yajing received customers who came into the store while also carefully editing sample photos of accessories and sending them to the VIP customer group, with a message previewing early spring new items and accepting reservations. Within minutes of posting, she received several reservation messages. She also found time to reply to an online regular customer's inquiries about spring clothing sizes, continuously maintaining customer relationships.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Select'

name: Try making Minnan-style meat zongzi and close the shop
description: After the evening rush-hour crowd had thinned, Song Yajing told Xiaomei to look after the store, put on an apron, and went into the back kitchen to try making zongzi. She followed the recipe her mother had taught her: cleaned the bamboo leaves, soaked the glutinous rice, and cut meat and stir-fried the filling. At first she fumbled; the first zongzi fell apart, the second was oddly shaped, and only the third began to look right. It took nearly 90 minutes to make 10 zongzi, which she cooked in the rice cooker; the fragrance of zongzi filled the kitchen. When they were done, she tasted one and found it about 70% close to her mother's skill. She then packed 6 zongzi in an insulated container for the family, left 3 for Xiaomei, cleaned the kitchen together with her, locked the shop door, and prepared to go home.
location: Back kitchen of "Elegant Select" at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycled home and shopped on the way.
description: Song Yajing carefully placed the insulated container in the front basket of her e-bike, got on her little electric scooter, and headed home into the night wind. On the way, she detoured to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought her daughter's favorite yogurt and a small box of electrolyte water, just in case.
location: Convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing homemade zongzi with the family.
description: Back home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Xuanxuan were preparing to have dinner. Song Yajing opened the insulated box as if presenting a treasure, and the aroma of zongzi filled the air. The father and daughter were pleasantly surprised. The family sat together and shared them. After tasting, Aqiang praised that they tasted like home in Quanzhou, and Xuanxuan held up half a zongzi and said it was delicious. After the warm zongzi moment, Aqiang took the initiative to clear the dishes.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Playing with daughter and helping her fall asleep
description: After a short rest following the meal, Song Yajing watched two episodes of My Little Pony with her daughter and played with a jigsaw puzzle. Then she brushed her daughter's teeth, bathed her, and told her a story about a little bear who wasn't afraid of being sick, until Xuanxuan fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal relaxation, evening prayer, and bedtime
description: After coming out of her daughter's room, Song Yajing felt tired but fulfilled. She did some simple waist stretches, then said her evening prayers, thanking God for the smooth day and praying for the shop's future. Then she charged her phone, set an alarm, and turned down the volume so she could keep an ear on her daughter's room, and then got into bed ready to sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, saying morning prayers, and checking on daughter
description: Woken by the alarm at 7 a.m., she washed up briefly and quietly walked into her daughter Chen Lexuan's room to check her temperature and sleep condition, confirming that her illness was stable. Then she lit a rose aromatherapy candle in the living room and did a short five-minute morning prayer, praying for her daughter's speedy recovery and smooth store operations. Overall, this shows Song Yajing's attentiveness as a mother and the support of her faith.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared breakfast and gave her daughter her medicine.
description: Heated up Minnan meat zongzi from the refrigerator and prepared sour plum drink for breakfast. Woke up her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter, and told her husband that he needed to help take care of their daughter in the morning. Patiently coaxed her daughter to take children's probiotics and encouraged her to drink half a glass of warm water to prepare for the follow-up checkup later. This reflects the mother's concern for her daughter's health and the family's division of labor.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to the community health service center for a follow-up.
description: After dressing her daughter properly, Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes to the Community Health Service Center of Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District. The pre-booked Dr. Wang performed routine examinations on Chen Lexuan, including auscultation and abdominal palpation, and diagnosed her with ordinary viral gastroenteritis. He advised continuing a light diet and getting plenty of rest. Yajing carefully noted the doctor's care points, expressed her thanks, and then took her daughter home. This follow-up visit put her more at ease about her daughter's condition.
location: No. 60, Ding'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Zhonghua Street Community Health Service Center, Siming District

name: After taking her daughter home, she rushed to the store to deal with work.
description: After the follow-up examination, Yajing took her daughter home. After telling her husband the doctor's instructions, she grabbed her commuter bag and e-bike keys and headed out. She rode the e-bike along Zhenhai Road and Siming South Road to the Elegant Select Clothing Store at 56 Zhongshan Road, taking about 15 minutes. When she arrived, the shop assistant Xiaomei was already cleaning. Yajing first opened her phone to check the data for the spring clothing short video she had posted last night: it had over 2,000 plays and 15 customers had commented and interacted, which was very encouraging. Then she moved on to order processing: she cut the tags off the reserved spring new arrivals (mint green blazers, floral shirts, etc.) and pressed them with a garment steamer. Around 9:50, she contacted the ZTO Express courier to come to the store, counted out 6 packages, and handed them over. During this, she noticed that only 2 pieces of a French-style dress were left in stock, so she immediately contacted Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat to place a follow-up order. But because the fabric was sold out, Susan suggested replacing it with new items in a similar fabric. Yajing decided to try selling 5 pieces first and asked for photos of the actual product details. After finishing the orders, she took out the silk scarves, vintage earrings, and wide-brimmed straw hats she had bought wholesale yesterday, and adjusted the central island display next to the cash register by material and color scheme. She also used her phone to take styling photos of the organza scarves with the straw hats, ready to post in the customer group, and decorated the payment-code stand with dried flowers and eucalyptus leaves to add a spring touch to the store.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch at 85°C
description: After greeting Xiaomei, Yajing walked 3 minutes to the 85°C Bakery on level B1 of Zhonghua City. She bought a cup of the signature sea salt milk green tea (less sugar), a smoked chicken sandwich, and a slice of tiramisu as a treat. She sat by the window, quickly finished her lunch, and scrolled through early spring outfit content posted by other clothing bloggers on her phone, looking for new inspiration for the store display.
location: 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery, B1 Level, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon shop operations and hosting regular customer Vivian
description: After lunch, she returned to the store. The afternoon sunlight streamed through the display window, creating a cozy atmosphere. From 13:00 to 14:30, several waves of walk-in customers came in, mainly attended to by Xiaomei, while Yajing organized her customer preference notes at the cash register to prepare for next week's customer follow-up visits. Around 17:00, a regular customer, Vivian, stopped by after work. She tried on a wide-brimmed straw hat and vintage earrings, couldn't bear to put them down, and also tried a new vest, finally buying a silk scarf. As they chatted, Yajing mentioned the planned 'Flowers & Accessories' co-branded photo shoot for next week, and Vivian readily agreed to help brainstorm a slogan, showing their good customer relationship.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close up the shop, hand over work, and buy fruit on the way.
description: At 5 p.m., Yajing hung up a 'Temporarily Closed' sign, checked today's customer orders and accounts with Xiaomei, and explained the handling process for the next day's new arrivals (trimming loose threads, steam ironing, and putting them on display), as well as preparing the dried flowers and accessory samples needed for the 'Flowers & Accessories' theme in advance. After finishing, she rode her electric bike and stopped by 'Fresh Fruit Shop' at the exit of Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way, picking up red-fleshed dragon fruit, fresh strawberries, and bananas that her daughter loved, to prepare for going home.
location: Elegant Select Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home to enjoy dinner with family.
description: When Yajing got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was in the living room watching the cartoon Finding Nemo with their daughter. She washed some fruit, cut a small bowl of dragon fruit for her daughter, and then cooked a big bowl of light tomato and lean pork congee using tomatoes, eggs, and the lean pork she had bought in the morning. The family of three sat around the table to eat, and her daughter praised her mother's congee as the best. The warm atmosphere made Yajing feel content.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Playing with her daughter, bathing her, and telling bedtime stories
description: After dinner, Yajing played with Xuanxuan on the crawling mat in the living room with magnetic tiles and building blocks, and Xuanxuan built a “castle.” She then gave her daughter a bath using strawberry-scented shower gel. At 7:45 p.m., Xuanxuan changed into her pajamas, and Yajing took the picture book “The Taste of the Moon” from the bookshelf. Leaning against the headboard, she told her daughter the story of little animals stacking on top of one another to reach the moon, enjoying a warm parent-child moment.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Answered a phone call from old classmate Liu Fang.
description: Halfway through the story, her phone vibrated. The caller ID showed Liu Fang, an old classmate from Shenzhen. Yajing let her daughter flip through the book by herself, got up, and went to the study to answer. Liu Fang excitedly talked about the elementary school graduation photo and childhood memories. The two recalled things like being punished to stand for sneaking spicy strips, and catching grasshoppers after school, laughing without stop. But when Liu Fang talked about her situation at a big tech company—high salary but overtime and loneliness—Yajing tried to share the pressure of running her own shop and the occasional friction with her husband, only to be brushed off by Liu Fang's remark, "You own a shop, you're free and easy." Yajing suddenly felt disappointed, feeling that the other didn't really understand her hard work. The call ended after about half an hour, leaving Yajing with mixed feelings.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Trying to read to calm down
description: After hanging up, she still felt a little empty inside, and her friend's words lingered in her mind. She walked to the bookshelf, took out the Yi Shu novel 'The Golden Years' that she had bought six months ago and never unwrapped, and sat in the armchair to read. But the sleep deprivation from caring for her daughter over the past few days, plus the daytime busyness, brought on drowsiness. After only three or four pages, her eyelids grew heavy and she couldn't continue.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fell asleep on the sofa in the study
description: The book dropped onto her lap, and drowsiness finally won her over. She slumped sideways against the armrest of the sofa and fell into a deep sleep. The lights in the living room and master bedroom were still on, and the room was very quiet. After checking his daughter's homework and coaxing her to sleep, her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the study to look for her, only to find her curled up on the sofa, already fast asleep.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Woken by her husband and preparing for bed.
description: Her husband gently woke Yajing and reminded her not to catch a cold. Yajing woke up groggily and felt a bit embarrassed. She got up, turned off the light in the study, went to the bathroom to wash her face with warm water, changed into her pajamas, and got ready for bed.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and falling asleep
description: After lying down in bed, her body was tired but her mind was somewhat clear from the short nap earlier. She recalled Vivian's compliments during the day, the newly pursued orders, and the estrangement in Liu Fang's phone call, and she felt mixed emotions. Finally, she said a brief bedtime prayer in her heart: thanking the Lord for her daughter's improving condition, grateful for today's smooth work, and asking to be more tolerant and have a stronger heart to understand friends. Amid her husband's even breathing, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: On a drizzly morning, Song Yajing got up to the sound of her alarm. After washing up quickly, she prepared steaming hot millet pumpkin porridge and steamed egg for her daughter Chen Lexuan, and carefully gave her the medicine to strengthen her stomach. She herself drank a glass of milk and ate two slices of whole-wheat toast. During breakfast, she gently encouraged her daughter: “Xuanxuan, just hold on one more day today. Tomorrow is the weekend, and Mommy will take you to the park to feed the pigeons.”
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school and shopping at the convenience store.
description: At 7:45, Yajing put a small raincoat on her daughter and walked her to kindergarten holding an umbrella. She told her daughter to drink more water and to raise her hand to report to the teacher if she felt unwell. After handing her over at the school gate at 8:00, she turned around and walked about 10 minutes to the Meiyijia convenience store in Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought a bottle of sugar-free yogurt and a copy of Xiamen Daily, adding a little touch of happiness to her morning work.
location: Meiyijia Convenience Store, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store
description: Starting from the convenience store, Yajing walked 5 minutes to the entrance of Zhenhai Road Metro Station and took Line 1 (Zhenhai Road to Zhongshan Park, 1 stop). After exiting the station, she walked with an umbrella through the damp Zhongshan Pedestrian Street and arrived at her shop at about 8:35. After unlocking, she turned on the lights and air conditioning, checked the doors, windows, water, and electricity from the night before, then changed into dry cloth shoes and used a dry mop to wipe the mud stains that rain had brought onto the shop floor.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Opening preparations and restocking confirmation
description: At 8:45, Yajing brewed a pot of Tieguanyin and opened WeChat on her phone. At 9:00 sharp, she contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou. First, she confirmed that the dress in the same fabric ordered yesterday had been shipped with the new fabric as a substitute, and she obtained the new tracking number. Then she carefully checked the shipping list Susan sent, and finally paid the remaining 15,000 yuan via mobile banking, with the message: “Susan, when the new styles arrive, I'll take a look at the quality. Next time you have unique French-style pieces, let me know first!”
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Store display update
description: 9:30, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived at the store. Together they opened the cardboard boxes that had arrived last night, which contained several French floral dresses, silk scarves, and straw hats. Yajing guided Xiaomei to use the steam garment steamer to press the sample garments smooth, while she began adjusting the main display on the center island counter: she placed the newest floral dress on the mannequin, matched it with a scarf and straw hat in the same color scheme, and decorated around it with a few eucalyptus branches and daisies she had bought from the flower shop that morning, creating an 'early spring garden' feel. The removed winter clothes and fur accessories were carefully packed and put into the warehouse.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Deepening the filming plan and co-branding negotiations.
description: At 10:30, seeing the rain beginning to ease, Yajing sat at the cash register and called florist Zhao Li via WeChat voice. The two had an in-depth discussion about the shooting details scheduled for Wednesday (February 26). Yajing suggested using Zhao Li's studio in Huamei Space, Huli District, as the shooting location, with the theme set as "The Wild Charm and Delicacy of Early Spring." Yajing would provide silk scarves, a straw hat, and a pair of vintage earrings as props, while Zhao Li would prepare natural-style dried flowers and wildflowers. Going a step further, Yajing took the opportunity to propose a long-term co-branding idea: "Let's do a trial shoot next week first. If the group responds well, maybe we can develop a co-branded gift box—you make the floral accessories, and I'll pair them with accessories." Zhao Li readily agreed: "Great idea! See you next week, and we can discuss the details in person."
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Morning opening and lunch
description: After 11:30, the rain gradually lightened and more and more tourists began to trickle into the shop. Yajing warmly received a young woman who wanted to buy a birthday gift for a colleague, recommending a vintage earrings and silk scarf pairing. Although the sale didn't go through, Yajing still gave her a coupon for 30 yuan off purchases over 200 yuan as a thank-you. Seeing the rain pick up again, she suggested ordering takeout for lunch, and the two ordered a bowl of Yuehua satay noodles (with tofu, pork liver, and bean sprouts) plus two servings of satay sauce on Ele.me. After finishing lunch at 12:00, Xiaomei talked about a mystery drama she had been watching recently, and the mood was relaxed.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Afternoon work and community operations
description: In the afternoon, the rain gradually stopped again. At 12:45, regular customer Vivien sent a WeChat photo of herself wearing the green shirt she had bought that morning. Yajing immediately complimented her warmly: "This green really brightens your complexion! We'll have new accessories next week—do come by and take a look!" At the same time, she checked the data for the spring outfit short video posted in the community group yesterday—views had reached nearly 3,500, with 22 new inquiries. While replying to questions from potential customers, she pushed the latest VIP 20%-off coupon. After 14:00 the shop became somewhat quiet, so she arranged for Xiao Mei to go to the nearby Tiger City and buy two cups of hot milk tea to reward themselves for the busy afternoon.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Invite close friends for a heart-to-heart talk
description: At 14:30, with a hot milk tea in hand, the shop became quiet again. The unease in Yajing's heart caused by school choice and family trivialities surfaced again. She picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Li Meiling: “Meiling, what with the kid's schooling and the shop lately, I feel like I'm being crushed. Are you free tomorrow Saturday afternoon? The usual place, Yiyu Coffee. I'll treat you to afternoon tea and vent my troubles.” After sending, she nervously refreshed a few times. A few minutes later, the phone screen lit up, and she saw Li Meiling's reply with two hugging emojis and a message: “No problem! I'll wait for you at 2 p.m. tomorrow.” She let out a long sigh, feeling much more at ease.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Sustained operations and sales.
description: At 15:00, a well-dressed middle-aged woman entered the store and was attracted by the floral dress on the center island display counter. Yajing immediately came up to her and introduced it enthusiastically in Hokkien: 'Sister, this fabric is really comfortable, and the cut is very flattering.' She suggested pairing it with a straw hat and a silk scarf. The woman happily bought the full outfit, with the sale totaling 1200 yuan. Yajing was in high spirits, skillfully packed the items, wrote up the order, and also gave her a 95-yuan community coupon. After 16:30, she began checking the day's accounts, confirming the payment records, and noting the new customer's preferences. At 17:00, she did a final cleanliness check of the store with Xiaomei, tidied the fitting room, and confirmed all power was turned off.
location: 'Elegant Select', No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Picked up daughter from school and bought stationery.
description: She closed the store on time at 17:30 and walked to the kindergarten. At 17:45 she picked up her daughter. Xuanxuan excitedly said that she had gotten a little star today for drawing in kindergarten. Yajing praised her and kept her morning promise, taking her to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road on the way and letting her choose a sticker book she liked. Xuanxuan happily picked the Princess Elsa sticker book. After Yajing paid, the mother and daughter left hand in hand.
location: Stationery store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping for ingredients at the market
description: Yajing walked hand in hand with little Xuanxuan to the Eighth Market. The air was filled with the damp smell of seafood and the sound of vendors hawking. She first bought 500 grams of fresh clams, then picked tender Chinese flowering cabbage, a few Red Fuji apples, and a bunch of bananas. Passing the handmade fish-ball stall, she thought of how much her daughter loved them and bought another 250 grams. Around 18:40, carrying the groceries in her left hand and holding her daughter's hand with her right, she walked about 15 minutes back to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: Arrived home at 18:55; her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already off work and watching cartoons with Xuanxuan in the living room. Yajing went straight into the kitchen, put the clams in water to purge sand, sliced the fish balls, washed the choy sum, and cut a fruit salad. At 19:15, the family of three sat around the dining table and ate a steaming dinner. At the table, Yajing mentioned that Li Meiling had said the kindergarten-to-primary-school pre-registration might start in early March, her tone filled with obvious anxiety. Chen Zhiqiang put down his bowl and said seriously, "Don't worry. After dinner we'll search for information online and first get a clear picture of the policies at our preferred schools."
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family school selection information search
description: After the meal, Chen Zhiqiang cleared the table, and Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into pajamas. At 19:50, after settling their daughter in the living room with a picture book, the two went into the study in the master bedroom and closed the door. Chen Zhiqiang opened his laptop and skillfully searched for the "2025 Xiamen Siming District Primary School Enrollment Zoning Plan," and focused on browsing the enrollment brochures of "Xiamen Experimental Primary School" and "Primary School Affiliated to Xiamen Foreign Language School." The two sat side by side, analyzing last year's policy item by item, focusing on the required years of household registration, school district scope, and enrollment size. Yajing noted key information in her phone memo: "Siming Experimental Primary School requires two years of household registration" and "The foreign language school's affiliated primary school has a high threshold for designated communities." Chen Zhiqiang suggested, "This weekend let's put together a few candidate communities. I'll ask my colleagues whose children attend these two schools." Yajing's furrowed brow finally relaxed a bit, and her anxiety was noticeably relieved.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Spending time with her daughter and reading.
description: 21:00, Yajing walked into her daughter's room and played with her newly bought Princess Elsa sticker book, listening to her make up fairy tales about the stickers. At 21:15, she turned off the main light, switched on the small bedside lamp, and read her daughter Guess How Much I Love You, then gently patted her to sleep. At 21:30, seeing that her daughter was fast asleep, she tiptoed back to the living room, picked up the brand-new Yi Shu novel The Golden Years, and flipped through a few pages, but her thoughts soon drifted away again. She picked up her phone and sent Li Meiling a WeChat message: "See you tomorrow. I finally told A Qiang what was on my mind today, and I feel much better." Meiling replied instantly: "That's the way! Let's have a good chat tomorrow afternoon!"
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening wrap-up and bedtime routine
description: At 21:45, Yajing went to the bathroom to wash up, applied a hydrating moisturizing mask, and put on body lotion while wearing it. At 22:00, she changed into her pajamas, knelt by the bed, and said her evening prayers. She thanked God for giving her daughter a happy day at school, for blessing the shop's business that day, and prayed that next week's photoshoot and tomorrow's get-together with her best friend would go smoothly, and asked for wisdom for the choices she and her family make. At 22:15, she blew her hair dry, set the alarm for 7:15 tomorrow morning, and soon fell into a deep sleep after lying down. She walked about 9,000 steps in total that day, and her weight stayed at 50.0 kg.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning family time
description: Outside the window, the sky was gray and overcast. Yajing woke up rubbing her somewhat sore and swollen lower back. Her husband was still sleeping, while her daughter Chen Lexuan was already awake, quietly playing with an animal jigsaw puzzle by the bed. She got up quietly, helped her daughter get dressed, and held her hand as they went to the bathroom to wash up.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Yajing went to the kitchen and cooked her daughter a bowl of her favorite tomato and egg noodles, made drip-bag coffee for herself and her husband, and toasted two slices of bread. After Chen Zhiqiang got up, the family of three sat around the dining table. While eating breakfast, Yajing reminded her husband, 'Today is Saturday and the shop is busy. I have plans with Meiling this afternoon, so I may be back a bit late. Why don't you take Xuanxuan to the park for a while?' Chen Zhiqiang nodded and said, 'Sure, I'll take her to Jiaxing Garden to ride her scooter, and stop by the vegetable market to buy some ribs to make you soup tonight.'
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (kitchen and dining room).

name: Preparing before going out and commuting.
description: After breakfast, Yajing changed into the new spring outfit from the store, packed her commuter bag (with her phone, power bank, notebook, and pen). She reminded her husband not to forget to buy the pork ribs, then kissed her daughter on the cheek. After leaving, she walked along the familiar street to the shop. The early spring morning breeze was gentle, with few pedestrians on the road. As she walked, she thought about how to arrange the newly arrived accessories. She arrived at Zhongshan Road 15 minutes later.
location: Walking route from the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to 56 Zhongshan Road

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: Yajing arrived at the shop, first pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the store lights and air conditioning, then briefly wiped down the cashier counter and shelves, so the shop could greet the weekend customers in its best condition.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Morning store operations and goods organization
description: The shop assistant Xiaomei also arrived on time. Yajing first counted the batch of spring accessories that arrived by express delivery last night (including silk scarves, earrings, and necklaces) with her. She took out label paper and a pen, carefully wrote price tags by hand for each accessory according to the purchase order, and affixed them. Then she adjusted the outfit on the mannequin at the store entrance to display two newly arrived silk scarves. Morning customer flow was not too heavy, so Yajing used the spare time to teach Xiaomei how to recommend new accessories to regular customers and instructed Xiaomei: “I’ll step out for a while around two in the afternoon. If any regular customers come looking for me, let them add me on WeChat first, or write down the items they want to reserve.” After ten, three young women entered the store. Yajing keenly noticed that one of them was very interested in the silk scarf on the mannequin’s neck at the entrance, so she proactively introduced styling tips. The customer tried it on, loved it, and bought it readily.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Lunch and rest
description: Around noon, the pedestrian street gradually got more crowded. Xiaomei went to the nearby 'Yuehua Satay Noodles' and packed two classic satay noodle bowls to take back. The two had a simple lunch in the rest area behind the shop. While eating and chatting, Xiaomei mentioned that the new fruit tea at the neighboring milk tea shop was delicious. Yajing kept it in mind, thinking she could do a small activity for regular customers in the group next time. After the meal, Yajing leaned back in her chair and rested with her eyes closed for twenty minutes to ease the discomfort in her lower back.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Afternoon operations and task handover.
description: Yajing checked again where the newly displayed accessories were placed, and helped a middle-aged female customer put together a complete spring outfit (shirt + skirt + silk scarf). The customer was very satisfied. Around 1:30, seeing that time was about right, she reminded Xiao Mei again about the afternoon things to note, checked the store's payment QR code and change, then quickly touched up her lipstick and got ready to leave.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Walking to the café
description: Yajing said hello to Xiaomei and walked out of the store. She crossed the bustling main pedestrian street and turned into a quieter side alley, where “Yiyu Coffee” was halfway down the alley. On a weekend afternoon, Zhongshan Road was bustling with people. As she walked, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Li Meiling: “I'm on my way, two minutes.”
location: Walking from 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Yiyu Coffee.

name: Pouring her heart out to and seeking advice from her best friend Li Meiling.
description: When Yajing arrived, Li Meiling had already ordered a hot latte for her and was drinking an iced Americano herself. The two sat by the window. Yajing looked at the gray sky outside, and the emotions she had bottled up for so long finally burst out. She poured out all her recent stress: the fierce argument with her husband after impulsively buying an espresso machine, the ruined Valentine's Day dinner, the anxiety over declining store revenue, and her deep worries about her daughter's transition from kindergarten to primary school. Li Meiling listened quietly, occasionally patting the back of her hand. After listening, Meiling said seriously, 'Yajing, the online pre-registration for primary school enrollment in Siming District usually starts in early March. You need to gather the property ownership certificate, household register, marriage certificate and other documents now. Don't just worry - start taking action. Let me check the past policies for you.' With that, Li Meiling opened the education bureau's official website on her phone and went through key conditions such as the 'Two Consistencies' with her item by item. Meiling also comforted her, 'You and Brother Zhiqiang have been through so much together over the years; he has this family in his heart. And you've managed to keep the store going on Zhongshan Road for four years - that's amazing!' After the two-hour conversation, Yajing felt greatly relieved of the pent-up pressure and much more at ease.
