location: Inside 'A Corner Café' in a side alley off Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near No. 230 Zhongshan Road)

name: Farewell and reflections on the way home
description: The two said goodbye at the café entrance. Li Meiling still had to hurry to school to prepare the lesson plan for next week's open class. Yajing slowly walked back along Zhongshan Road, mulling over Li Meiling's reminder about the pre-registration deadline and feeling the pressure of time. She opened WeChat on her phone and replied one by one to customer messages from yesterday through this morning. When she got near Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she sent her husband a message: 'I'm about to head back. Are you all having fun at the park?' Then she continued walking home.
location: While walking back from Yiyu Coffee to the No. 82 Shanggu Street community in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing by Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Stopped to shop on the way.
description: When she was almost home, Yajing turned into the convenience store at the subway station entrance. Remembering that her daughter had said she wanted strawberries, she picked out a box of fresh strawberries and also took a bag of whole-wheat bread for tomorrow morning's breakfast.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: Yajing returned home to find that her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already brought their daughter back, and the aroma of pork rib soup wafted from the kitchen. Their daughter Xuanxuan ran over excitedly, showing off a beautiful leaf she had picked up in the park. Chen Zhiqiang poked his head out of the kitchen and said with a smile, "You're back? The soup is almost ready. Wash your hands and get ready to eat." At the dinner table, Chen Zhiqiang had made lotus root and pork rib soup, stir-fried greens, and a shrimp and egg dish that their daughter loved. The three chatted as they ate, with Xuanxuan talking about the fun things at the park, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious. After dinner, Yajing took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Chen Zhiqiang stayed in the living room to watch cartoons with their daughter.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (dining room and kitchen)

name: Calm discussion with her husband and looking up school enrollment policies
description: After cleaning up the kitchen, Yajing sat down beside her husband and told Chen Zhiqiang in detail about the urgency of primary-school pre-registration that Li Meiling had mentioned that afternoon, as well as the key policy points she had looked up. The two rarely sat down to discuss this matter so calmly. Chen Zhiqiang said, "Since time is so tight, while we have free time now, go online and find the past years' enrollment notices from the Siming District Education Bureau, and let's check them one by one." Yajing then turned on the computer in the study, found the policy pages from previous years, and examined the requirements one by one, including property, household registration, and when the household was registered. She got paper and a pen and, together with her husband, began listing the materials they would need to prepare based on their own situation (property on Hubin South Road, household registration on Shanggu Street). She marked the uncertain points and planned to call the Education Bureau afterward for consultation.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (study room)

name: Time with daughter and family relaxation
description: After checking the information, Yajing felt much more confident. She went to the living room and played a "teacher and student" role-playing game with her husband and daughter, with Xuanxuan as the teacher, teaching her parents new Chinese characters they had learned. When they were tired of playing, Yajing washed some strawberries for her daughter, and the family of three snuggled on the sofa to watch another half hour of clips from the animated movie Zootopia.
location: Home (living room), No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime routine.
description: At nine o'clock, Yajing took her daughter to the bathroom for a bath. While washing her hair, Xuanxuan hummed a nursery rhyme she had learned in kindergarten. After the bath, Yajing read her two picture books: The Fresh News on Tooth Street and Billy the Bunny. As she listened, Xuanxuan slowly closed her eyes and fell asleep. Yajing gently kissed her daughter's forehead and turned off the desk lamp.
location: Home at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bathroom and daughter's bedroom)

name: Solitude and remembrance.
description: Yajing returned to the master bedroom, where Chen Zhiqiang had already washed up and was leaning against the bed looking at his phone. After removing her makeup, washing up, and doing basic skincare, she lay down in bed as well. In the stillness of the night, thinking about the afternoon's heart-to-heart talk and the evening's planning, she felt much calmer than she had in the previous few days. She leaned against the headboard instead of going straight to sleep and opened her phone photo album, swiping through photos one by one—from the renovation photos of the shop she rented in 2018 to the group photos with customers at last year's Christmas event. Looking at those busy, laughing, and moving moments, a warm current welled up in her heart, and she felt she had to make it through the difficulty in front of her.
location: Home (master bedroom), No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare to rest
description: After browsing the photo album, Yajing felt drowsy. She turned off her phone screen and said softly to her husband beside her, “Zhiqiang, thank you and Xuanxuan, really.” Chen Zhiqiang put down his phone, turned off the light, and held her hand: “Sleep now. This weekend let's relax first and take Xuanxuan to the park. We'll deal with things one by one and face them together.” Yajing murmured “Mm” and, in peace and hope, gradually fell asleep.
location: Home (master bedroom), No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family morning: preparing outdoor gear, waking up the family, and having breakfast together
description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing was the first to get up and quietly prepared outdoor supplies: she took out her daughter's butterfly kite and checked the spool, packed pigeon feed, mineral water, and cut strawberries and blueberries into the picnic backpack. Then she woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. Xuanxuan was thrilled when she saw the kite. After washing up, the family had breakfast together: toast, milk, and fried eggs. Xuanxuan drank milk from her rabbit cup, and the family chatted and laughed in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Gulangyu Catholic Church and attend Sunday Mass.
description: After breakfast, the family of three walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Line 1 to Zhenhai Road Station, and after exiting the station walked to Xiamen Ferry Terminal. Using their citizen cards, they took the ferry to Gulangyu Island. The sea breeze was slightly salty; Xuanxuan leaned over the ship's rail watching seagulls, with A Qiang protecting her from behind. They arrived at Gulangyu Catholic Church around nine o'clock and attended Sunday Mass. Father Wang Mingde's sermon was on ‘Forgiveness and Moving Forward,’ and Song Yajing silently prayed for family harmony and her daughter's school admission. After Mass, she chatted with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, who was concerned about Xuanxuan's enrollment. Song Yajing smiled and thanked her.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Catholic Church, and en route via Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Xiamen Ferry Terminal, and Gulangyu Piano Pier

name: Returned to downtown Xiamen and enjoyed family time at Zhongshan Park.
description: After Mass, the family took the ferry back to downtown Xiamen along the same route, then walked to the Maternal and Child Health Hospital Station and took Bus No. 139. After about 20 minutes, they got off at Zhongshan Park Station and walked into Zhongshan Park. On the large lawn on the east side, Aqiang taught Xuanxuan to fly a kite. Xuanxuan ran excitedly as the kite rose, and Song Yajing took photos of the bright father-daughter moments. Then they moved to Pigeon Square, where Xuanxuan crouched down to feed the pigeons. The white pigeons pecked at the corn kernels in her palm, and she giggled happily. Song Yajing and Aqiang sat side by side on a bench in the nearby shade, watching their daughter and chatting easily about amusing moments from her growth and the upcoming primary school enrollment. The earlier cold-war atmosphere quietly melted away.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, the large lawn on the east side of Zhongshan Park and Pigeon Square on Gongyuan South Road, as well as passing by Maternal and Child Health Hospital Station, Zhongshan Park Station, etc. on the way back.

name: Walked home, put her daughter to sleep, and researched primary school enrollment policies in depth.
description: After the event ended, Xuanxuan was tired and sleepy from playing. Aqiang let her ride on his shoulders, and the family walked along Park South Road for about ten-plus minutes back to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound. Once home, Song Yajing helped her daughter change into pajamas, Aqiang told a short story, and Xuanxuan soon fell asleep clutching her stuffed toy. After settling her daughter, Song Yajing made a cup of hot tea, went to the study, and carefully read the Siming District Education Bureau's 2025 autumn primary school enrollment work guidelines, focusing on the catchment area, household registration duration, and application materials. She found that the Experimental Primary School she liked required household registration for one year, but Xuanxuan's transfer fell two months short. She took photos to record the key clauses and wrote down two to-do items: verify transitional policies and prepare backup options such as People's Primary School.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; walked back from Zhongshan Park.

name: Brief rest, browsing fashion news to de-stress.
description: After studying the policy, her mind was tense. Song Yajing went to the living room, curled up on the sofa, and scrolled through a fashion blogger's official account on her phone. She saw a commute-friendly work outfit suitable for the store's spring display and saved the image as styling inspiration. She also came across a short video on making strawberry mousse; the tempting visuals helped her relax quite a bit.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: She played role-playing games with her daughter and went out to buy ingredients for dinner.
description: After her afternoon nap, Xuanxuan woke up full of energy. Song Yajing accompanied her in the living room to build a little school with LEGO, using stuffed animals as classmates and playing a make-believe game of going to school, with laughter all the while. Afterwards, Aqiang took the initiative to teach their daughter drawing. Taking advantage of the break, Song Yajing went out, walked five minutes to the 99 Convenience Store (Xinhua Branch) at the entrance of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, and bought a sea bass, a bunch of greens, and a few tomatoes, planning to make steamed sea bass and tomato egg drop soup for dinner.
location: In the living room of the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and at 99 Convenience Supermarket (Xinhua Store) on Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family worked together to cook a warm dinner.
description: Back home, Song Yajing put on an apron to prepare the fish and vegetables. Aqiang helped wash the greens, and Xuanxuan stood on a small stool, carefully peeling garlic. Aqiang suggested also making cola chicken wings, and Song Yajing agreed with a smile. The three busy figures moved around one another in the kitchen, the oil sizzling in the pan, filling the space with the warm, homey atmosphere of everyday cooking.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Enjoy dinner and have an in-depth discussion about the daughter's school enrollment.
description: Steamed sea bass, Coca-Cola chicken wings, and tomato and egg soup were brought to the table, and the family of three sat around it. Xuanxuan picked up a chicken wing for her mother, A Qiang ladled out the soup, and they enjoyed a warm, loving mealtime. Over dinner, they formally discussed the plan for preparing school enrollment materials. A Qiang suggested taking half a day off tomorrow to go to the District Education Bureau Admissions Office together for consultation and to check out the nearby Renmin Primary School as a backup. Song Yajing agreed and felt much more at ease.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family gathered around to watch a lighthearted short drama, sharing warm quality time.
description: After the serious topic, Song Yajing suggested watching the drama they were following, 'Meet Yourself.' Ah Qiang cast it on the TV, and Xuanxuan snuggled between them. The pastoral scenery and slow-paced life in the show temporarily soothed their anxiety. The family watched and discussed, filling the living room with warmth and drawing closer together.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helped her daughter wash up, read bedtime stories, and put her to sleep
description: After the short drama ended, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to bathe, working up a rich lather while her daughter played in the water and recalled fun moments from the day. After washing up and changing into pajamas, Xuanxuan chose *Guess How Much I Love You*. Song Yajing leaned back on the headboard and read in a gentle voice. Before the story was even half done, Xuanxuan fell fast asleep clutching the hem of her clothes.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Yoga stretching before bed to ease back and waist soreness
description: Gently closing her daughter's door, she returned to the master bedroom. After days of rushing around, her lower back was sore and swollen. Song Yajing spread out a yoga mat beside the bed and followed a tutorial to do stretches like Cat-Cow and Child's Pose. Her tense muscles gradually loosened, her body and mind relaxed, and she decided to keep up this habit in the future.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bathe, do skincare, and prepare items for opening the shop tomorrow.
description: After stretching, she took a hot shower and carefully performed her facial care routine, from serum to moisturizer. Then she went to the dressing room and prepared an off-white knit top and dark blue wide-leg pants to wear tomorrow. She also placed the new scarf catalog on the key box at the entrance to remind herself to study it when she got to the shop.
location: Bathroom and dressing room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Relaxed by reading and fell asleep peacefully
description: As the day drew to a close, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and read a few pages of "The Storied Life of A. J. Fikry," calming her mood under the soft light. She dimmed the lamp, briefly reviewed the day's warmth and tomorrow's plans, turned off the light and lay down. The neon outside faintly shone through, and she sank into sleep with a sense of peace and anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up, prepare breakfast, and wake the family
description: The phone alarm went off right on time. Outside the window, the sky was dull and overcast. You threw on a jacket, got up, washed up briefly, went into the kitchen, and skillfully cooked oatmeal while heating a few eggs. At 7:20, you went to the bedroom and woke your husband Chen Zhiqiang, then went to your daughter's room, gently woke Xuanxuan, and helped her put on the prepared kindergarten uniform.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: The air after the rain carried the moist smell of earth. Holding an umbrella and Xuanxuan's little hand, you walked along Zhenhai Road toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, you talked about the little rabbit from last night's picture book, and you told her to listen to the teacher obediently at kindergarten today. When you reached the gate, you watched her run into the classroom carrying her little backpack before turning and leaving.
location: From the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 West Gucheng Road, Siming District

name: Sort out the enrollment documents for her daughter's school registration and check relevant policies
description: After getting home, you changed into comfortable loungewear, then found the small safe containing important documents in the living room and took out the property ownership certificate, the family's household registration booklet, the marriage certificate, Xuanxuan's birth certificate, and vaccination certificate, checking them one by one at the desk. You noticed that the pen writing on your native place page of the household registration booklet was a bit blurry, and worried that it might affect the review, so you took a close-up photo with your phone to keep as a consultation record. Then you opened your laptop, looked up the official website of the Siming District Education Bureau and the enrollment brochures of several preferred primary schools, recorded the key information in a notebook, and gained a clearer picture of the alternatives.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Called the admissions office of Siming District Experimental Primary School for an initial consultation.
description: After organizing the materials, you took a deep breath and mustered the courage to call the admissions office of Siming District Experimental Primary School. A female teacher with a gentle voice answered the phone. You explained your situation in detail, especially the issue of the timing of your household registration transfer. The teacher replied that this year's policy is expected to be released in mid-to-late March, but based on previous years' standards, there are indeed clear requirements for the length of household registration, and suggested you closely watch the official website announcements, prepare all the materials, and submit them as soon as the pre-registration channel opens. After hanging up, although you felt a little heavy-hearted, at least you got an official answer and felt somewhat relieved.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Called her father back.
description: You called your father in Quanzhou. After brief greetings, you told him about the elementary school consultation you had just made and its results. Your father comforted you, telling you not to worry too much, saying that things will work themselves out and to let the family know if you need help. You murmured in agreement, feeling warm inside, and chatted a little with your mother before hanging up.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Got ready and headed out to go to the store.
description: You sorted all the documents and materials back into folders and put them in the safe. Then you changed into the beige knit cardigan and dark casual pants you had planned for today, checked your wallet and keys, and grabbed the store account book and your phone. Before heading out, you sent a WeChat to your husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was still at work: 'The materials are sorted, and I also made the consultation call. The situation is a bit tricky. I'll explain in detail when I get home tonight.'
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to the store, passing by Bashi Market to buy groceries.
description: The rain had stopped and the air was a little damp. You put on your earphones, listened to light music, and walked toward Zhongshan Road. You deliberately turned into the Bashi Market you passed by, picked out some fresh kiwifruit and mangoes at the fruit stall, and planned to have them with Xiaomei as after-dinner fruit.
location: On the way from No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Bashi Food Market

name: Went to the shop to have lunch with Xiaomei and see how business was going.
description: When you arrived at the shop, Xiao Mei had already organized the shelves. You greeted her, then checked the morning's sales records; the numbers were acceptable. Later, in the store's rest area, you chatted about everyday things while eating the sha cha noodles and fruit you had bought on the way. Xiao Mei said a few regular customers had come by in the morning and, since they didn't see you, asked about you.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arrange this week's work priorities and handle finances
description: After the meal, you and Xiaomei started discussing this week's work arrangements. You told her that the new accessories would arrive on Wednesday, that the display table at the entrance needed to be rearranged, and asked her to start thinking about a styling plan. For the weekend's 'Spring Flower Language' event, you discussed the timing for posting the teaser poster to Moments and the customer group. Then you used the mobile banking app to transfer this month's store rent to the landlady, Sister Li, and took a screenshot for your records.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Communicating with Zhao Li about the progress of the floral co-branding
description: During the shop's quiet afternoon time, you had a WeChat voice call with Zhao Li. On the call, she excitedly described several small bouquet styles she had designed for the event and immediately sent hand-drawn sketches via WeChat. You zoomed in on the images and examined them closely, and you particularly liked one fresh design she had made with lisianthus and daisies. You agreed to meet at 3 p.m. on Thursday, February 27, and asked her to bring samples directly to the shop to finalize the details in person.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In-store work and customer reception
description: After you ended the call with Zhao Li, you started organizing the list of new spring items in the shop. During that time, three customers came in. You warmly received them and recommended a trench coat to one of them based on her body type and style, ultimately making the sale. Afterward, you sent a WeChat message to Susan, your supplier in Guangzhou, confirming the shipping time and tracking number for next week's new spring arrivals.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the pharmacy to buy throat-soothing tea
description: Your throat felt a bit dry and itchy again, and you remembered that during the season change you should brew some soothing throat tea. Taking advantage of a lull in the shop, you told Xiaomei and quickly walked to the familiar Hongrentang Pharmacy near Zhongshan Road. The clerk recommended a monk fruit and malva nut tea. You bought a box and paid by card.
location: Hongrentang Pharmacy, Ding'an Cross Alley, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Writing work notes and follow-up checklist
description: Back at the store, you took out your work notebook and recorded the key points of the half day's work. You wrote down the Wednesday display adjustment plan, the weekend event warm-up time, the date to meet Zhao Li, and the items to follow up on with Susan's shipment. After finishing the notes, you felt much more clear-headed.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Having dinner with family at the store.
description: After work, her husband Chen Zhiqiang first picked up their daughter Xuanxuan from kindergarten. Then, as you instructed, he bought some duck necks, tofu, and porridge at a braised food shop near the community, packed them, and brought them to the store. The family of three had a cozy dinner in the rest area at the back of the store. Xuanxuan chattered about interesting things at kindergarten, while you and Zhiqiang talked about your respective plans for the day.
location: Rest area of the 'Yazhi' boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening operations and Xiaomei getting off work.
description: After dinner, Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan home first to do homework. You chatted with a few regular customers in the store for a while and helped them put together several new outfits. Around 20:00, you let Xiaomei leave work early, saying to her, "Thanks for your hard work, see you tomorrow."
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the store and walked home
description: You pull down the shop's rolling shutter door, check that it is locked, and walk home alone through the night. The streets are still bustling, but your heart feels a little grounded because of the day's busyness.
location: From 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District.

name: Accompanying her daughter Xuanxuan
description: When you got home, Xuanxuan had already taken a bath and was lying in bed waiting for her mother to tell her a story. You picked up her copy of The Magic School Bus and read it to her gently. After finishing the story, you kissed her forehead and softly coaxed her to sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal hygiene and stretching
description: After watching your daughter fall asleep, you tiptoed out of the room. You went to the bathroom, took a hot shower, and put on a moisturizing mask. Then you did a 10-minute calming stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on relieving your lower back and neck and shoulders. Much of your physical fatigue melted away.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and trying to fall asleep
description: You lie back in bed, pick up the novel Meet Yourself from the bedside table, and read a few pages, letting the slow-paced life in the story dilute your thoughts. After finishing a chapter, you turn off the lamp, close your eyes, silently pray that everything goes smoothly, and then try to fall asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Having trouble falling asleep due to anxiety, she got up to sort out her thoughts.
description: Despite trying to clear your mind, thoughts about your daughter's school enrollment uncontrollably came back, and anxiety hit, making you toss and turn in bed. At 1 a.m., you simply put on a robe, walked to the living room, turned on the desk lamp, and wrote down the urgent to-dos in a notebook: “1. Keep following the official website of Experimental Primary School; 2. Analyze the material requirements of backup schools; 3. Meet with Zhao Li on 2.27; 4. Remind Xiaomei about the Wednesday display.” After writing the list, you let out a long breath and felt more assured. You got back into bed, still a bit uneasy, but the feeling of moving forward according to plan brought a sense of control. You gradually relaxed and finally fell asleep at around 1:30 a.m.
location: Living room and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening washing, prayer, and sleep
description: At 12:15 AM, Song Yajing turned off her computer, went to the bathroom to thoroughly cleanse her skin and apply night cream, then changed into pajamas and quietly got into bed. At 12:30 AM, she knelt by the bedside for her routine prayer, giving thanks for the day's blessings and praying for her family's safety and the store's smooth operation. She then wrote tomorrow's to-do items in her phone memo. At about 1 AM, she turned off the light and went to sleep, soon falling into a peaceful slumber.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning family prelude and school drop-off
description: At 7 a.m., Song Yajing got up on time. Despite not getting enough sleep the night before due to anxiety, she still prepared breakfast for the family: hot milk, fried eggs, and toast. She woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. During breakfast, she reminded Zhiqiang to drive carefully in the rain, and helped Xuanxuan pack her raincoat and spare masks. At 8:05, the mother and daughter put on their rain gear, and Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to take her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After watching her daughter say goodbye to the teacher, she returned home.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten

name: Home materials check and baking preparation
description: After returning home at 8:35, Song Yajing cleaned up the kitchen, double-checked her daughter’s primary school enrollment materials, and organized photos of the household register. At 9:00, she went into the study, put on headphones, and replayed the baking tutorial video, carefully writing down the key steps for the opera cake: the baking temperature for the almond sponge, the coffee buttercream recipe, and the glaze temperature control. At 9:45, she went into the kitchen, weighed and portioned the pre-purchased almond flour, dark chocolate, butter, and other ingredients according to the recipe, and neatly placed them in an insulated bag, fully prepared to make the cake at the shop.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting to the store
description: At 10:15, Song Yajing checked the water, electricity, doors, and windows at home, put on her coat, picked up the insulated bag with cake ingredients and her commuting bag, and went out. Because the road was still wet, she carefully rode her e-bike from Zhenhai Road onto Zhongshan Road, stopped at the entrance to the pedestrian street, walked a few minutes, and arrived at the Yazhi clothing store at 10:30 sharp.
location: On the way from No. 82 Shanggu Street Community to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening and pre-noon operations
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and the shop assistant Xiaomei finished cleaning and unpacking the new goods. They carefully arranged the newly arrived spring accessories—pearl headbands, three-dimensional flower brooches, and more—on the small round table, laid a lace tablecloth, and adjusted the spotlights. Song Yajing guided Xiaomei to model for promotional photos and a short video, and wrote the caption "Spring new arrivals: let flowers bloom in your hair" to post on Moments. Afterward, she checked the previous day's revenue, replied to regular customers' WeChat inquiries, and arranged a time for altering a pair of trousers that needed hemming.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and preparation for the competition
description: At noon, to keep Xiaomei from going out in the rain, Song Yajing asked her to pick up two portions of Yuehua satay noodles from a nearby shop, with extra dried tofu and pork liver. The two chatted while eating in the store's rest area. Song Yajing said that with fewer customers in the afternoon, she could focus on making the cake. After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the takeout boxes, took a deep breath, silently prayed for success, then went into the back kitchen work area, put the ingredients from the cold-insulation bag in their places, and checked the oven and tools.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Master the Opéra cake.
description: At exactly 13:00, Song Yajing closed the prep room door and devoted herself entirely to making the opera cake. She strictly followed the steps in her notes: first, she baked the almond sponge cake, carefully whipping the egg whites and observing the batter's consistency; then she boiled the espresso syrup and whipped the coffee buttercream; finally, she prepared the chocolate ganache. When glazing, she used a thermometer to keep the ganache at 35°C, slowly poured it over, and smoothed it with a spatula to achieve a glossy mirror-like finish. At 15:00, she finished and put it in the refrigerator to chill quickly.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reviewing results and sharing the joy
description: At 15:15, Song Yajing took the cake out of the refrigerator, unmolded it, and cut it into pieces. She was thrilled to see the seven-layer cross-section with clear layers and neat edges. She immediately used her phone to take close-up photos and a video of the cut cake and sent them to her baking teacher Master Chen and her florist friend Zhao Li, asking for advice. Xiaomei heard the commotion and came over to admire it, and Song Yajing felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In-depth communication with Zhao Li and new shopping ideas.
description: At 15:45, Song Yajing enthusiastically discussed the 'dessert bouquet' idea with Zhao Li via a WeChat voice call. Zhao Li praised the cake's beautiful cross-section and suggested pairing mini bouquets or dried flower wreaths with desserts such as canelés and madeleines, wrapped with twine and kraft paper. Song Yajing used her phone's memo app to note down the idea and cost budget, and the two agreed that on February 27 Zhao Li would bring floral samples to the store for detailed discussion. After the call, Song Yajing cut the cake for the staff and regular customers to taste, then searched and favorited packaging materials such as food-grade resealable bags and mini kraft paper dessert boxes on a shopping app.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening rush-hour reception and daily upkeep
description: At 17:30, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to watch the shop while she spent half an hour cleaning the back kitchen. After the rain stopped at 18:00, the street became more crowded. A regular customer, Vivian, came in and took a liking to the newly arrived pearl headbands. Song Yajing warmly matched her with a floral print dress and a solid-color cardigan, and taught her hair-bunning techniques to wear with it. Vivian made a purchase and left satisfied. Song Yajing was in a good mood and decided to close earlier than usual.
location: “Yazhi” Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm return home
description: At 18:30, Song Yajing let the shop assistant Xiaomei leave for home. She checked the power, windows, and doors, then pulled down the roller shutter. She got on her little electric scooter and rode against the slightly damp cool breeze, arriving home in about 10 minutes. When she walked in at 18:45, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was playing with building blocks with their daughter in the living room, and the dining table was set with freshly bought pork ribs and green vegetables.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and companionship
description: At 7 p.m., the family sat around and had dinner. Song Yajing excitedly showed a photo of the opera cake she had successfully made that day and received rare praise from her husband. Taking advantage of the moment, she brought up the "dessert bouquet" idea with Zhao Li, and Zhiqiang reminded her to watch costs and waste. After dinner, she played with building blocks with her daughter, bathed her, and told her the bedtime story "Little Rabbit, Be Good" until her daughter fell asleep peacefully at 8:30.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night planning and packaging research.
description: After their daughter went to sleep at 8:30 PM and her husband watched the ball game, Song Yajing made a cup of hot tea and went into the study. She created a new document, "Elegant Floral Dessert Gift Box," wrote down her business concept, sketched the product, and estimated the costs. Still excited, she then used her phone to browse through the packaging shops she had saved, carefully comparing buyer reviews on things like the airtightness of nougat bags and the sturdiness of kraft paper boxes, and did not feel tired until the early morning. The original date crossed midnight, but in accordance with the rule, it is uniformly recorded as that same day.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Early morning preparation and contacting the baking class
description: Woken by the sound of rain and an aching lower back, she got up a little later. After a quick wash, she used the whole-wheat toast, cheese, and ham slices made yesterday to prepare sandwich breakfasts for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. While boiling water, she did a few cat-cow stretches to relieve stiffness. Then she quickly washed up and put on makeup (light base and lipstick), and while filling in her eyebrows, she sent a WeChat message to her baking instructor, Chef Chen, saying she wanted to sign up for the four-week online advanced course and asking for the syllabus and payment method.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school and heading to the store
description: She put on a lightweight waterproof rain jacket, and walked with an umbrella to take her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Her daughter wore little rain boots and had fun splashing in puddles. After giving instructions at the school gate, she stopped by a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road on the way and bought two new watercolor sketchbooks, one for her daughter and one for Xiao Mei from the shop. Then she continued walking to the 'Elegant' boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, she bought a small bag of sugar-roasted chestnuts at the street corner, planning to share them with Xiao Mei as a snack.
location: Along the route from Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road

name: Going to the store to handle business matters and signing up for a baking class.
description: After arriving at the store, she turned on the air conditioner and dehumidifier. The shop assistant Xiaomei reported the previous day's sales and showed the new spring clothing arrivals. Yajing checked the WeChat work group and customer inquiries, and discussed the day's featured items and display adjustments with Xiaomei. She then contacted the supplier Susan to finalize the restocking order for basic styles with incomplete size runs, such as black pleated skirts and white silk shirts, and confirmed the delivery time. Afterwards, Master Chen replied with the course details and fees. Yajing thought the course schedule was reasonable, so she paid and registered via WeChat transfer and received the electronic course schedule. She immediately printed the schedule on the store's small printer and attached it to the corkboard behind the cash register with colorful magnetic pins for easy daily viewing.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Initial communication with Zhao Li about the flower bouquet gift box collaboration.
description: Zhao Li sent the initial electronic version of the 'Spring Sweetheart' proposal, including flower material selection and gift box design sketches. The two had an in-depth discussion on the positioning of the flower bouquet gift box, product selection (small desserts such as madeleines and canelés), packaging style, and a trial production schedule. They preliminarily decided that Yajing would make the first batch of madeleine and canelé samples before this weekend, while Zhao Li would be responsible for designing the matching small bouquets and packaging.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Lunch time
description: Yajing shared the sugar-roasted chestnuts she bought in the morning with Xiaomei. Taking advantage of the fact that there were no customers in the store, she asked Xiaomei to mind the shop while she walked with an umbrella to the old-established “Aya Shacha Noodles” at the street corner, packed up two portions of classic shacha noodles and fried five-spice rolls, and brought them back to the store for them to enjoy lunch together.
location: Aya Shacha Noodles, No. 27 Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (packed to take back to the store)

name: Midday break stretching and time planning.
description: After lunch, she rested in the small back room of the store. First, she took out a notebook and sketched a rough schedule for the next four weeks based on her class timetable. Because of soreness and fatigue in her lower back, she opened a yoga app on her phone and followed a video to do about 8 minutes of simple stretches, such as Cat-Cow and Child's pose, to relieve the discomfort. Then she carefully planned her study and business time: she found that most live classes (14:00-15:30) coincided with the store's off-peak customer flow, so she could leave Xiaomei to watch the store while she followed the class with headphones. She drew a weekly plan in her notebook, marking Wednesday morning for grocery shopping and afternoon for baking practice, and reserving Sunday for Mass and family day.
location: Back room of the 'Yazhi' boutique clothing store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Refined the trial production plan with Zhao Li.
description: After scheduling the time, Yajing took a photo of the preliminary timetable and sent it to Zhao Li. The two finally decided: Yajing would be responsible for trial-making two basic items, madeleines and canelés, within the week, and Zhao Li would be responsible for matching light-purple small bouquets and biodegradable clear gift box packaging, with the goal of launching the 'Spring Sweetheart' bouquet gift box before March 8.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Pick up daughter from school and take care of her while working at the store.
description: After saying hello to Xiao Mei, Yajing held an umbrella and hurried to the kindergarten. She picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan, who was humming a newly learned nursery rhyme. At the convenience store on the corner, she bought her daughter a small carton of milk, then took her back to the shop. Her daughter changed into her little rain boots and played with a new watercolor coloring book in the corner of the shop. While keeping an eye on her daughter, Yajing searched her phone for tutorial videos on madeleines and canelés and marked the key steps, and meanwhile received one or two customers who dropped by. At the same time, Zhao Li sent over hand-drawn sketches and color swatches for a small bouquet design, and the two confirmed they would do the first trial sample on Friday afternoon.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang left work early and brought takeout from "Zhou Quan Zhou Dao" to the store. The family of three squeezed around the small table in the back room, eating seafood porridge, pan-fried dumplings, and greens. Yajing shared the good news of successfully signing up for the baking class. Her husband asked about the class schedule and, though he didn't say much, thoughtfully picked a fried dumpling for Yajing.
location: Back room of the 'Yazhi' boutique clothing store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening business and closing the store to go home
description: After dinner, Xiaomei got off work. Yajing let her daughter watch cartoons in the rest area. The pedestrian street entered its evening rush hour, and Yajing attended the store and greeted customers while sorting out business receipts and customer orders. The rain gradually subsided, and she rolled up half of the plastic rain curtain at the door. At around 20:15, seeing that pedestrians were thinning out, she decided to close early. She neatly turned off the lights, turned off the air conditioner, and locked the rolling shutter door. Her husband carried their sleepy daughter, and the family of three walked home holding an umbrella. On the way, Yajing held her husband's arm and told him in detail about signing up for the baking class, the course schedule, and her plan for balancing her time. After hearing this, her husband said with concern, 'If you enjoy it, study it well, but don't overdo it. If the store is too busy to manage, let Xiaomei cover for a bit longer.'
location: The 'Elegant' boutique clothing store at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the way home from there

name: Evening family time and bedtime
description: After arriving home, she first helped her daughter wash up and change into pajamas, then played a little "doctor" pretend game with her in the living room. Her daughter "examined" Yajing with a toy stethoscope and said, "Mommy, you're too tired today, you need a sleep shot." Then she told two Peppa Pig bedtime stories to lull her daughter to sleep. After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing poured a glass of warm water, carefully removed her makeup, and did her skincare routine. Rain pattered outside the window. Lying in bed, she checked tomorrow's weather forecast and silently noted a few things for her shopping plan. Before bed, she said a quiet bedtime prayer, asking for peace and success for her family, the shop, and her baking studies. She turned off the light and went to sleep at 22:40.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and prepare breakfast
description: At 7:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yajing woke up and found that her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already left for work. She changed into loungewear, quickly washed up, then went into the kitchen to prepare her daughter Xuanxuan's favorite ham sandwich and warm milk. The sizzle of the fried egg and the aroma of toast filled the quiet home, giving the day a warm start.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up daughter and have a meal together
description: After breakfast was ready, Yajing walked into her daughter Xuanxuan's room, gently woke her up as she was a little reluctant to get out of bed, kissed her forehead, and told her breakfast was her favorite ham sandwich. Xuanxuan sat up rubbing her eyes. Yajing helped her get dressed and combed her hair, and the mother and daughter sat down at the dining table together. While eating, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about the fairy she had dreamed of last night. Yajing listened with a smile and told her to behave well at kindergarten.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Called to make a health checkup appointment on the way to take her daughter to school.
description: At 8:05, Yajing helped Xuanxuan put on her little backpack and walked out holding her hand. The mother and daughter walked along the tree-lined path on Shanggu Street, about to turn right onto Gucheng West Road. On the way, Yajing took out her phone and called the number on family doctor Wang Mingyuan's business card, saying she had been feeling tired lately and wanted to book a comprehensive physical checkup. Dr. Wang suggested booking the checkup package for 9:00 a.m. on March 5, and reminded her to fast from food and water after 10 p.m. the night before. Yajing noted it all down and felt much more at ease.
location: On the way from Shanggu Street in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Gucheng West Road

name: Took her daughter to kindergarten.
description: At 8:15, the mother and daughter arrived on time at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan saw Teacher Li and ran over happily. Yajing squatted down, hugged her, and told her that Mom would pick her up in the afternoon, that she should listen to the teacher, and that she should have fun with the other kids. Watching Xuanxuan's small figure walk into the classroom, Yajing turned and left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to the shop and brainstormed copy for the event
description: It takes about 15 minutes to walk from the kindergarten to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Yajing slowed down and, while walking, thought about the copy for the “Spring Flower Language” event she would discuss with Zhao Li in the afternoon. She came up with a great slogan: “Wear spring on your body and bring flowers home.” She immediately recorded it in her phone’s memo, and also jotted down inspiration for the window display.
location: On the way from Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Prepare to open the store and meet with the clerk
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, Yajing arrived on time at the “Yazhi” boutique clothing store, took out her keys, and pulled up the rolling shutter door. The store lights came on, and she turned on the stereo to play relaxing music. Before long, the shop assistant Xiaomei also arrived and greeted her energetically with a good morning. The two tidied the shelves together and covered the side table beside the cash register with an elegant linen cloth, preparing for Zhao Li to arrange sample bouquets in the afternoon.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Adjusting the store display for the co-branded event
description: Yajing put on gloves and began adjusting the window facing the pedestrian street. She carefully matched several new spring items that arrived yesterday—soft knit sweaters and flowing floral skirts—and hung them on the dress forms. Xiaomei, meanwhile, used a spray bottle to hydrate the leaves of the green plants in the store and fine-tuned the lighting angle. As they worked, they chatted about how the store might become livelier after finalizing the collaboration with Zhao Li in the afternoon. Xiaomei suggested that when Yajing went to pick up her child in the afternoon, she would first take close-up photos of a few clothes in the store to prepare for posting on WeChat Moments in the evening.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact the flower supplier to finalize the first order.
description: Taking advantage of the few customers in the morning, Yajing contacted Mr. Zhang, the flower material supplier recommended by Zhao Li, via WeChat, and sent the first list of what she needed: 60 dried flower packs, 50 chamomile stems, some eucalyptus leaves, and baby's breath. The supplier quickly replied with a quote and promised direct delivery to the shop on the morning of March 1. Yajing paid a 20% deposit via WeChat in advance, and synchronized the arrival information to the shop's work group, reminding Xiaomei to check for the delivery next Monday.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Having lunch with the store clerk
description: At noon, Yajing invited Xiaomei to go have lunch together. Instead of going to their usual spot, they went to the newly opened 'Old Alley' satay noodle shop on nearby Zhenbang Road. They each ordered a bowl of satay noodles with fried five-spice rolls and chatted while eating. Xiaomei was looking forward to the afternoon meeting, and Yajing shared the copy she had thought up in the morning to hear her opinion. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Old Alley Satay Noodles, No. 13 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tea break and organizing meeting materials.
description: After lunch, Yajing returned to the store, brewed herself a cup of hot tea, sat by the window, and opened her notebook. She organized all the ideas and details from the past two days about the "Spring Flower Language" event into a clear meeting outline. She listed key points such as the form of cooperation, event time, cost sharing, and profit split, ensuring that her afternoon communication with Zhao Li would be efficient and smooth.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Formal consultation and contract signing with florist Zhao Li
description: At two in the afternoon, Zhao Li arrived as promised, bringing several samples of spring bouquets she had personally designed and the materials for making them. Yajing warmly invited her to sit in the rest area, and the two discussed the cooperation details in a fine and congenial atmosphere. They finally settled on the following: from March 1 to 7, a Spring Flower Language themed week would be held, and the shop windows would all be changed to dried flower decorations designed by Zhao Li; customers who spent 388 yuan or more would receive a free handmade bouquet, with the cost borne by Yajing; for customers who bought bouquets separately, the profit would be split fifty-fifty. The two happily signed a simple cooperation memorandum.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Photographing sample flower bouquets in the store
description: After signing the contract, both were in a good mood. Yajing asked Zhao Li to place the bouquet samples on the prepared coffee table, matching them with the clothes in the store, and took more than a dozen photos from different angles with her phone as material for writing copy that evening. Zhao Li also shared photography tips, and the two added each other on WeChat for later communication.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reviewed the afternoon meeting with the shop assistant
description: After seeing Zhao Li off, Yajing quickly reviewed the afternoon meeting with Xiaomei. She instructed Xiaomei: starting tomorrow, when serving customers, you can give them an early preview of next week's event and tell them that we will give away co-branded bouquets. Then Yajing tidied her hair, put on her bag, and got ready to pick up Xuanxuan from school.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and stop by the stationery store on the way
description: Yajing walked quickly to the kindergarten and made it just in time for school dismissal. Xuanxuan ran over joyfully and handed her a drawing—a colorful sea of flowers and a little figure in a skirt. Yajing said in surprise, “Wow, is this the Spring Floral Whispers activity with Mommy? What a beautiful drawing!” The two walked home hand in hand. When they passed a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, Yajing remembered that they had run out of white paper at home, so she took Xuanxuan inside and bought a drawing pad and colored pencils. Xuanxuan happily chose two more stickers.
location: Near No. 35 South Park Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing by Ying Stationery Store)

name: Family reunion dinner
description: After returning home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already finished work and was watching the news in the living room. He came over and took the things from Yajing's hands. Yajing put on an apron, quickly made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried bok choy, and reheated the pork rib soup she had simmered yesterday. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Yajing shared the good news of successfully signing the contract with Zhao Li that afternoon, and her husband was happy for her too. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Time with daughter and family
description: After dinner, Yajing played with puzzles with Xuanxuan on the living room floor, listening to her tell funny stories from kindergarten, while her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to wash the dishes. Afterwards, Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and told her the story of Sleeping Beauty. Watching her daughter fall asleep peacefully with a cute expression, her heart was full of tenderness and happiness.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write event promotional copy and confirm orders.
description: After getting her daughter settled, Yajing went to the study, opened her laptop, imported the afternoon photos, and carefully adjusted the colors with a photo-editing app. Then she focused on writing the first round of WeChat Moments teaser copy and group announcements. The copy was warm and lively, paired with carefully selected photos, and she kept refining it until 10:30 p.m. before saving it with satisfaction. After that, she opened WeChat again to double-check the order to the flower supplier, and only felt reassured when she saw that the other party had confirmed shipping on March 1.
location: Study, Unit 3, Room 602, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Checking the baking course schedule
description: After finishing work, Yajing opened her email to check the course schedule that Master Baker Chen had sent after she registered. She planned to go to the 85°C near the shop during her lunch break next Monday to buy some basic ingredients in preparation for a trial batch on the weekend. She also saved the recipe to her phone so she could check it anytime.
location: Study, Unit 3, Room 602, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime yoga, washing up, and going to sleep
description: Feeling some soreness in her shoulders and neck, Yajing unrolled her yoga mat and followed a phone video to do 15 minutes of gentle bedtime yoga, focusing on stretching her shoulders, neck, and back. After finishing, she felt much more relaxed and then went to take a shower. After the shower, she knelt by the bed, giving thanks for everything going smoothly today and praying for tomorrow's work and her family. Finally, she turned off the bedside lamp, got into the warm bed, images of the day's signing and preparing copy flashing through her mind. Feeling fulfilled and content, she whispered to herself, "Good night, Yajing," and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up early to prepare, starting a busy day
description: The alarm went off. Song Yajing quickly got up, washed up briefly, and prepared breakfast in the kitchen: putting the soaked millet into the pot, frying eggs, and reheating char siu buns. At the same time, she prepared the materials for her daughter's kindergarten enrollment and elementary school consultation, placing the household registration book, birth certificate, and a copy of the property ownership certificate into a kraft paper bag, and adding her homemade madeleines. She gently woke her husband and daughter, helped her daughter put on the kindergarten uniform and braid her hair, and told her daughter that she would pick her up in the afternoon.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten together with her husband.
description: The family of three went out. Song Yajing held her daughter's hand, Chen Zhiqiang walked alongside, and they walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, her daughter greeted politely. Song Yajing kissed her daughter on the forehead and promised to pick her up in the afternoon. After watching her daughter enter the kindergarten, she walked toward Zhenhai Road Metro Station with her husband.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took the subway to the elementary school for consultation.
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 from Zhenhai Road Station to Zhongshan Park Station, and on the way double-checked the consultation questions with her husband. After exiting the station, walked through South Park Road and arrived at the gate of Xiamen Experimental Primary School, Fujian Province about 10 minutes later.
location: Fujian Xiamen Experimental Primary School, No. 5-1, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Inquire about elementary school enrollment and admission policies
description: In the admissions consultation office of Xiamen Experimental Primary School, Fujian Province, a female admissions officer received Song Yajing and her husband. Song Yajing handed over the materials, and the teacher explained the 2025 enrollment policy in detail, emphasizing that household registration must be in place for at least one year. Their family had registered last December, two months short of the requirement. The teacher said that supplementary admission slots occasionally opened up and advised them to pay close attention to the Education Bureau's notice in mid-March. Song Yajing took the enrollment brochure, feeling both delighted and worried.
location: Admissions Office, Fujian Xiamen Experimental Primary School, No. 5-1, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Consultation over; went separate ways
description: After walking out of the school gate, her husband Chen Zhiqiang comforted Song Yajing and told her not to overthink things. He decided to go grocery shopping in the afternoon and asked her to head back to the shop first. Song Yajing watched her husband walk toward the subway station, then clutched the enrollment brochure and walked along Gongyuan South Road toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Entrance to Fujian Xiamen Experimental Primary School, No. 5-1 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Receive the floral materials and prepare supplies for the event
description: Arriving at the entrance of Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, she ran into the small truck delivering the floral materials that Zhao Li had arranged. She and Xiaomei opened the boxes together and inspected eucalyptus leaves, chamomile, dried flower bundles, and other items. After confirming the quality and quantity, they signed for the delivery. Following the diagram Zhao Li sent, they moved the floral materials into the air-conditioned room, sorted and placed them in vases, trimmed the branches and leaves, and kept them moisturized, preparing for tomorrow's window display.
location: 'Yazhi' Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reconciling accounts and analyzing business performance.
description: After finishing the flower work, Song Yajing opened the electronic ledger on the computer at the cash register and reviewed the complete accounts for February, checking purchase receipts, bank statements, coffee machine depreciation, miscellaneous expenses, and so on. She found that because of the post-Spring Festival slow season and the coffee machine expense, net profit had barely broken even. After deducting the quarterly rent that was about to come due, the working capital on the books was less than 5,000 yuan. She anxiously bit her lip, but quickly perked up, picked up her phone, and contacted Lin Xiaofeng, the customer manager at ICBC.
location: Cashier counter, Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Called the bank to inquire about a loan, had a simple lunch
description: After the call connected, Song Yajing explained her operating pressure to Manager Lin and asked about a small-business loan plan that required no collateral. Manager Lin said a credit loan was possible; she would need to provide corporate account statements for the past six months, purchase invoices, and business certificates, and suggested sorting them out as soon as possible and coming to the bank on Monday morning (March 3) for an in-person assessment. Song Yajing noted down the requirements. Xiaomei brought back satay rice noodles from the noodle shop opposite, and Song Yajing ate them while organizing an electronic spreadsheet directory of the bank statements on her phone.
location: 'Yazhi' Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon operations and material organization
description: In the afternoon, sunlight streamed into the store. Song Yajing handled daily reception, replied to regular customer Vivian's WeChat inquiries, and meanwhile, in her spare time, filtered and organized the corporate account transaction records of the past six months on the computer as requested by Manager Lin, and photographed and archived the purchase documents. Xiao Mei was beside her wiping the coffee machine and arranging promotional paper cups and sugar packets to warm up for tomorrow's event.
location: 'Yazhi' Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Brief rest and inner prayer
description: After working continuously, her shoulders and neck were stiff. Song Yajing went to the back kitchen to pour a glass of water. Looking at the chamomile in the sunlight by the door, she prayed silently, asking for strength and wisdom. After a moment of peace, she composed herself again and got ready to pick up her daughter.
location: Back kitchen/rest area of the "Yazhi" boutique clothing store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up daughter from school and enjoyed quality time together.
description: Song Yajing turned off her computer early and walked along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and West Gucheng Road for about 25 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After picking up her daughter Xuanxuan, she held her hand and listened to her talk about the dinosaur she drew that day, feeling a wave of tenderness. On the way back, she bought her daughter new crayons at a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. Back at the store, she let her daughter draw in the rest area while she continued to organize the material checklist for the loan interview.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In-store display arrangement and customer communication
description: Xiaomei organized the event materials, set up the coffee corner, and wrote "Spring Floral Greetings - Enjoy Hand-Dripped Coffee In-Store" on the small blackboard at the door. Song Yajing took the opportunity to send a voice message to supplier Susan confirming the delivery time for next week's new spring clothing. Xuanxuan quietly drew in the corner, and the store was filled with a warm, bustling atmosphere.
location: 'Yazhi' Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner, a brief reunion.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came to the store carrying fresh fish and vegetables bought from the nearby market. Xiaomei took Xuanxuan over so the family of three could have dinner at the small table in the back of the store. Song Yajing told her husband about the loan consultation. His expression turned grave, but he did not blame her, saying he would go to the bank with her on Monday and they would shoulder it together. Song Yajing's eyes welled up, and she held his hand.
location: At the folding table behind the 'Yazhi' boutique clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning to family and planning finances together
description: After dinner, the family went home. Song Yajing bathed her daughter and told her stories to help her fall asleep. Later, she and her husband spread out the ledger in the living room and reorganized family expenses. They canceled several shopping app memberships, and her husband also decided to bring a thermos to the office to save on coffee. Together they found small ways to save money and felt a bit more financially secure.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop again and complete closing procedures
description: After urging her husband to take care of their daughter, Song Yajing went back to the store. Xiaomei was about to lock up, and the two rechecked the coffee machine, arranged the sugar packets and paper cups for the next day, and confirmed the small blackboard was in place. Song Yajing crossed the street, took a quiet nighttime photo of the store with its warm lights glowing, and posted it to WeChat Moments and the customer group with a promotional caption. Almost as soon as she posted it, people liked and commented.
location: 'Yazhi' Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: On the way home, quietly reflecting alone
description: Walking alone in the slightly chilly early-spring night breeze, the streetlights lengthened her shadow. Song Yajing felt that although financial pressure remained, she had consulted about a loan during the day and planned expenses with her husband in the evening. The way forward was becoming clearer, so she quickened her steps home.
location: Along the route from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Shanggu Street community

name: Stretching and prayer before bed, returning to calm.
description: After returning home, her husband and daughter had already fallen asleep. Song Yajing put on her yoga clothes and did fifteen minutes of meditative stretching on the floor, focusing on her breathing and relaxing her shoulders. At the end, she sat cross-legged, pressed her palms together, and softly recited the Lord's Prayer.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple wrap-up for tomorrow's plan
description: Before bed, Song Yajing took out the enrollment brochure she had received that afternoon and looked through it again, then wrote in the memo on her phone the list of materials to prepare tomorrow and the documents to bring to the bank on Monday: ID card, business license, six-month bank statements, and purchase receipts. After everything was properly arranged, she felt at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Turning off the lamp, her husband's steady breathing came from beside her. Outside the window was the cool early-spring night sky. Though the pressure remained, she felt more grounded than in the past few days. Song Yajing clenched her fist, believing that solutions always outnumber difficulties, and looked forward to the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rushing out in the morning and getting ready at the store.
description: Waking up 20 minutes later than planned, she realized her phone had completely died and the alarm had failed, and felt panicked. She charged the phone immediately, washed up quickly, skipped her skincare routine, drank only half a glass of milk, and changed clothes in a flustered state. After telling her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who had just come out of the bedroom, that their daughter Xuanxuan's breakfast was in the fridge, she rushed out of the house. She walked quickly along Shanggu Street toward Zhongshan Road. Seven minutes later, she arrived at the entrance of the pedestrian street and found she had forgotten her keys, so she had no choice but to turn back home. After getting the keys and briefly complaining to her husband, she set off again at an even faster pace and opened the store door at 8:01. She decided to go home in the afternoon to get a spare key.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cleaning and seasonal display changes
description: Turn on all the lights and play soft background music. Take down the winter door curtain, empty the heavy sweaters and padded coats from the window display, and wipe the glass and display racks with a damp cloth. Bring light-colored tablecloths and lace decorations out from the storeroom, spread them on the central display stand and the small table next to the fitting room, making space for the flower arrangement.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Collaborated with a florist to create a spring floral language window display
description: After cleaning, she walked to the store entrance for a short break, breathing fresh air and observing the Saturday morning customer flow. At 9:30, florist Zhao Li arrived with dried lavender, eucalyptus leaves, and light pink bunny tail grass. The two divided the work: Song Yajing used an electric iron to press a light blue chiffon blouse and a floral skirt and hung them on the dress form; Zhao Li built a gracefully layered floral display with floral foam in the corner and wrote the event slogan "Spring Flower Whispers" and the promotional text "Spend 388 yuan or more and receive a small bouquet" on a handheld chalkboard. The two discussed new ideas for joint online floral community promotion, and Song Yajing kept them in mind.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Setting up the coffee corner and preparing lunch.
description: While Zhao Li was doing the final adjustments, Yajing moved the coffee machine from the corner to a more visible spot next to the fitting room and wrote in colored chalk on the blackboard: “Buy spring clothes, get a free American coffee.” She then used her phone to order the usual sha cha noodles for delivery.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and first online promotion.
description: The takeout shacha noodles were delivered. While eating at the cashier counter, she used her phone to take a delicate photo of the coffee corner with the flower arrangement. She selected one and captioned it "The spring breeze is nice, but not as nice as the coffee in your hand. Starting today, buy spring clothes and get a free hand-poured Americano. I am waiting for you at Yazhi," then posted it to WeChat Moments and the "Yazhi VIP Regular Customer Group" with the store location set.
location: Cashier counter at Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and trial event
description: In the afternoon, seven or eight customers came in one after another. I took the initiative to introduce the new spring styles and the 'buy clothes, get coffee' promotion. All seven cups of coffee were given away, but most customers were not very interested in the free coffee and cared more about the clothes themselves. Taking advantage of the moments when customers were trying on clothes, I quickly tidied the shelves and rearranged the new spring arrivals by color. I noticed that the WeChat Moments promotion had very few likes and the customer group was unusually quiet. I felt a bit disappointed, and for the first time realized I needed to promote more proactively and through more channels.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Phone appointment for annual physical examination
description: Seeing the reminder in her phone memo, she called the Huli District Community Health Service Center, provided her identity information, and successfully booked the annual comprehensive physical examination package for the morning of Thursday, March 5. The customer service reminded her not to eat or drink after 10 p.m. the night before the exam. She carefully noted the appointment information, saved it in her phone memo, and set double reminders — 'one day in advance' and 'the morning of the appointment.'
location: Cashier counter at Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: End-of-day closing and accounting before closing the shop
