description: Lowered the rolling shutter halfway and sorted out today's accounts. Revenue was not ideal; watching working capital decrease due to event purchases, I felt a trace of anxiety about the month-end cash flow. I took a deep breath, photographed the full storefront in the evening light as a keepsake, turned off the coffee machine, counted the inventory, and cleaned the shop.
location: 'Elegant' Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After work, walking in the park and going home.
description: Closed the shop, headed north along Zhongshan Road through two intersections, and walked about fifteen minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park. The early spring evening breeze was slightly cool. She walked two slow laps along the path, watching an elderly man walking his dog and children playing and laughing, and her anxiety gradually calmed. She left through the park's south gate, turned onto Bailu Road, then onto Shanggu Street, and walked fifteen minutes before reaching home.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and family time.
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan had already eaten dinner. Her husband had specially kept hot soup and dishes and brought them to the table. The daughter ran over and talked about the cartoon she watched with Dad today. While eating, Yajing chatted with her husband about the day's activities, her tone a little low. After dinner, her husband took their daughter to bathe. Yajing opened the computer in the study and carefully checked the school enrollment material list and copies for her daughter. Seeing the note 'household registration period is two months short' weighed on her, and she silently hoped for the notice in mid-March.
location: The dining room and study in the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation and preparation for bed
description: Did shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom carpet to relieve the fatigue of standing all day. Then I knelt devoutly by the bedside, palms together, and prayed, thanking the Lord for His care, asking for inner peace and wisdom to run the shop, and praying for good news about my daughter's school admission. After praying, my mind calmed down. I charged my phone and confirmed the alarm was set for the next day. Lying in bed, I reviewed tomorrow's plan to attend Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church and the key points for next week's bank meeting, and gradually fell asleep with mixed feelings.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and morning prayer
description: Woken by the alarm clock, she prepared breakfast and lunchboxes for the family, woke up her husband and daughter, and the family sat down for breakfast. After clearing the table, she returned to the bedroom to complete her morning prayers, pouring out to God the challenges and needs of the day. Then she changed into a shirt and trousers, organized her belongings, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the church and attend Sunday Mass
description: Walking through the east gate of Zhongshan Park, she went to Siming Catholic Church to attend Sunday Mass. During the Mass, listening to Father Wang Mingde's sermon on the theme 'Do not worry about tomorrow,' she felt comforted and inspired, and the disappointment of yesterday seemed to ease.
location: Siming Catholic Church, Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Socializing, helping others, and returning to the shop after Mass
description: After Mass, she talked with fellow churchgoer Lin Xiuying at the church entrance and felt comforted. Then she took the initiative to help a white-haired elderly woman carrying heavy items, accompanying her to the bus stop on Gongyuan South Road. During their conversation, she was deeply moved. After saying goodbye to the elderly woman, she walked back to Zhongshan Road, bought a takeaway lunch at Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop, and finally returned to the clothing store.
location: Starting from Siming Catholic Church on Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing Gongyuan South Road Bus Stop, to Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop at No. 78 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and finally arriving at Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and preparation for online promotion and livestream
description: While eating lunch in the store, she used her computer to edit floral arrangement photos and spring outfit matching images, create the co-branded event poster and copy, and after confirming with florist Zhao Li, posted the promotional content on WeChat Moments and in the VIP group, and replied to customer inquiries. Then she set up a phone stand, prepared background music, and organized live-streaming key notes, making final preparations for the first WeChat Channels live stream that afternoon.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Unexpected situation during the first WeChat Channels livestream.
description: Started the livestream to introduce spring clothes and flower bouquets; initially there were a few viewers. When switching the background music, a copyright infringement warning suddenly appeared on the screen. In a panic, she also received a call from regular customer Vivian, forcing her to interrupt the livestream to answer it. The number of viewers in the livestream room dropped sharply, so she had to end the livestream hastily in embarrassment and felt very frustrated.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-livestream recovery and afternoon general work
description: After ending the livestream, she felt low. With Xiaomei's comfort, she adjusted her mood, warmly received customers in the store, and recommended outfits. During breaks, she followed up on the response to the online co-branded event, replied to messages in the floristry community group, and checked the livestream replay data. Then she specifically replied to regular customer Vivian, recommended a new shirt, and set up a fitting time. Finally, she checked her mobile banking balance and organized the materials list needed for the next day's bank interview.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business peak and display adjustments
description: The peak crowd arrived at Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She divided the work with Xiaomei to receive customers and successfully sold dresses and commuter suits. Afterward, she adjusted the mannequin displays based on sales and decorated the shelves with dried flower bouquets to create an atmosphere for the collaboration event.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner time
description: Had Xiaomei watch the store, went to A Ling's misua soup shop, ordered a bowl of misua soup with a fried dough stick, and while eating quickly used the memo app on her phone to record the key points from the livestream review, in preparation for future improvements.
location: A Ling's Misua Soup Shop, Xi'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening operations, livestream review, and material preparation
description: Returned to the shop to continue the evening business. During the lull in customer flow, she used the computer at the cash register to write a detailed livestream review and improvement plan, analyzed platform rules, saved livestream technique videos, and drafted the script for the second livestream. At the same time, she sorted the materials needed for the bank interview into a file folder to make sure everything was ready.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with husband
description: Had a video call with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and learned that their daughter was having a great time at the science museum. She shared the unexpected incident from her first livestream and received comfort and encouragement from her husband. Finally, she reminded him of the time and preparation items for the next day's bank interview.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and return home
description: Completed cashiering, account checking, cleaning, and turning off the power with Xiaomei. After closing the store door, we said goodbye to each other and walked back home to the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: From Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time and putting my daughter to sleep
description: After arriving home, she quickly washed up, went into her daughter's room, took the picture book from her husband and read No, David! to her daughter. Then they said their bedtime prayers together, and she sang softly until her daughter fell asleep.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Alone in the study, reviewing materials, and evening prayer.
description: In the study, she double-checked the materials for the bank interview and placed them at the entrance. She neatly copied the livestream review and improvement plan into her diary and wrote words of self-encouragement. Then she did shoulder and neck stretches, turned off the light, sat quietly, and completed her evening prayer, giving thanks for the day's gains and asking for the strength to keep going and for a smooth interview.
location: Study room, Room 602, Building 3, Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Changed into pajamas, drank a glass of warm water, set the alarm for the next morning, reviewed the day's ups and downs, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom of Room 602, Building 3, Community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning family time and taking daughter to school
description: At seven in the morning, Song Yajing was woken by her phone alarm. She got up quietly and washed up. She deliberately wore a light camel-colored knit cardigan with a white shirt and light makeup to boost her confidence for today's bank loan interview. Then she prepared a ham sandwich for her husband Chen Zhiqiang in the kitchen, and heated milk and steamed egg custard buns for her daughter Chen Lexuan. She woke her daughter, helped her put on the kindergarten uniform printed with little rabbits, and braided her hair. The family of three had breakfast together. Her husband told her not to panic at the bank interview, and she replied that she had already checked the documents and confirmed that she would pick up their daughter in the afternoon. After breakfast, she walked her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan shared her dream, and they hugged goodbye at the school gate. After that, she returned home and checked the interview materials again, including the business license, bank statements, business plan, and a copy of the property ownership certificate. She checked the list on her phone to make sure everything was foolproof.
location: Home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten (123 Gucheng West Road)

name: Bank interview and loan consultation.
description: Song Yajing set out from home, walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 to Lücuo Station, then transferred to Line 2 and got off at Qianpu Station. The whole trip took about 30 minutes, and she arrived at the Qianpu ICBC branch office at 9:05 a.m. After tidying herself up, she went straight to the second floor and met the account manager Lin Xiaofeng she had made an appointment with. She calmly handed over all the materials and explained in detail that the shop had new opportunities thanks to the co-branded “Spring Flower Language” event, but also faced a short-term cash flow gap, and clearly laid out her repayment plan for the coming year. Manager Lin approved of her proposal and offered two loan options for her to choose from. Song Yajing said she needed to go home and discuss it with her husband, and would reply by Thursday at the latest.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A short break at the bakery
description: After the meeting ended, a light drizzle began outside. Song Yajing walked for five minutes with an umbrella to the 'Wheat Fragrance Village' bakery. She bought a plain croissant and a hot Americano, sat at a small round table by the window, watched the rainy street scene, and felt a sense of groundedness, enjoying a short moment of treating herself.
location: No. 255 Qianpu Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, Andelusen (Dongsheng Garden Store).

name: Arrival at the shop and morning operations.
description: After finishing the snacks, the rain stopped. Song Yajing walked to Qianpu Bus Stop and took Bus 88 for about 25 minutes to Zhongshan Road Station. She then stepped onto Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and pushed open the glass door of the "Elegant" boutique clothing store. The clerk Xiaomei was tidying the clothes on the mannequin and asked her whether the bank visit had gone smoothly. Song Yajing smiled and nodded, put on her work apron, and quickly briefed Xiaomei on the morning's foot traffic and customer inquiries.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Afternoon store operations and online engagement
description: Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to pack two portions of satay noodles, and the two ate together in the store's break area while discussing the "Spring Flower Whispers" event, deciding to keep promoting it as the main focus in the afternoon. As customer flow gradually increased after noon, she used a lull to post a photo — which a regular customer had agreed to let her share — of a light camel trench coat paired with a floral skirt to the customer group, with the caption: “Today's outfit: light camel trench coat + floral skirt, bright spring vibe ~ Last 3 spots get a small bouquet. Sisters who like it, come DM me~” The group quickly responded. Around 3 p.m., a customer, Ms. Wang, came in with a dress she had bought the previous week, claiming it had shrunk after washing and demanding a full refund. Song Yajing looked closely and noticed that the care label required cold-water hand washing, but the dress showed signs of machine washing. Instead of directly contradicting her, she sincerely offered to shorten it for free into a trendy short style. Ms. Wang agreed, and she took her measurements. After seeing the customer off, she took out her phone and checked the Xiamen Municipal Education Bureau website for first-grade primary school enrollment policies, took screenshots of the key information on "household registration length" and "supplementary admission time", and wrote "mid-March supplementary admission notice" in her memo. Then she organized the newly arrived silk scarves, folding them into flower shapes for display. Near 4 p.m., she received a WeChat message from Vivian, a regular customer, saying she wanted a wine-red dress for her birthday party next week. Song Yajing immediately replied with several photos of new styles and arranged for her to come in for a fitting on Wednesday afternoon. She felt that this kind of one-on-one service was the foundation of the store.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Seeing that it was almost time for her daughter to finish school, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to watch the shop and quickly walked 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She picked up Chen Lexuan on time, and Xuanxuan, who came flying over like a little swallow, excitedly held up a painting of a rainbow to show her. She happily kissed her daughter and walked hand in hand with her back to the shop, where she let her daughter spread out drawing paper in the rest area to continue drawing.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Evening peak business hours and handover
description: During the evening rush hour, the pedestrian street was crowded and the shop saw more customers. Song Yajing looked after her daughter while helping a young girl put together a khaki trench coat with off-white wide-leg pants. The girl was satisfied and paid. Chen Lexuan sat nearby quietly drawing. Around 6:15 p.m., customer traffic gradually decreased. Song Yajing told Xiaomei that if Ms. Wang, who had returned an item, came to pick up the altered dress, she should hand it over and apologize again. Then she got ready to leave work and go home.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, the Yazhi boutique clothing store

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: Song Yajing packed up her daughter's painting supplies and walked home holding her hand. When they arrived, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already changed into loungewear and was heating up the food in the kitchen. On the table were his stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised fish, and braised snacks bought downstairs. The family of three sat around the table for dinner, and Chen Lexuan excitedly talked about funny things at kindergarten.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter and putting her to bed
description: After dinner, her husband washed the dishes, and Song Yajing played with blocks with her daughter for a while, then gave her a bath. After changing into pajamas, she sat on the edge of the bed and read the picture book 'The Little Prince' to her daughter. Xuanxuan fell asleep soon after. She gently kissed her daughter's forehead and turned off the desk lamp.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spousal conversation and emotional support.
description: After settling her daughter down, Song Yajing sat beside her husband, looking a little tired. She brought up the embarrassing 'fail' in yesterday's livestream, saying it was too humiliating: the music was flagged with a warning, and phone calls kept coming in. Chen Zhiqiang put down his phone and listened carefully, then explained how music copyright works on WeChat Channels and gave practical advice: next time, first use the phone's recording function to record some light music, then after going live, turn off the original audio and play the recording, and at the same time turn on Do Not Disturb mode. After hearing this, Song Yajing suddenly felt enlightened and grateful.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal tidying and night prayer
description: After talking with her husband, Song Yajing took a hot bath to relax. Then she sat down in the study, opened her diary, and wrote down the two loan options from the bank and her husband's advice. Then she knelt by the bedside with her hands together in evening prayer, thanking the Lord for smoothly obtaining the loan options and for the valuable communication with Zhiqiang, and asking the Lord to guide her next steps and keep her daughter safe and healthy.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Night rest
description: After evening prayer, feeling at peace, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, turned off the main light and left only a night light on. She said softly to her husband, 'Zhiqiang, thank you for today,' then lay down. Today she had run to the bank, handled returns, and resolved the frustration from the livestream. She felt an unprecedented sense of solidity, soon fell into a deep sleep, and her body and mind were fully restored.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family preparations and taking daughter to school
description: After getting up at 7 in the morning, Song Yajing quickly washed up and prepared a peanut butter sandwich and warm milk for her daughter Chen Lexuan, and checked her raincoat and rain boots. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang got up, and after a brief exchange she learned that he might have to work overtime tonight. Song Yajing reminded Xiaomei, the store clerk, in her memo to bring an umbrella. Then she put her daughter in her raincoat, held an umbrella herself, and walked hand in hand with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, reminding her daughter about things at school on the way. Passing the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, she bought a pack of colored origami paper, making her daughter happy. She handed her daughter over to the teacher at 8 o'clock sharp and left.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting to the store and morning preparations
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked to the clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The rain had gradually stopped and the air was fresh. On the way, she opened the memo app on her phone to sort out the day's work plan: first take stock of the data, then contact the florist Zhao Li, and adjust the displays in the afternoon. Passing by Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at a convenience store. She arrived at the store at 8:20.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning activity data review and communication about restocking flowers
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing cleaned up with the clerk Xiao Mei and boiled water to make tea. The two consolidated the sales receipts and flower-gift records from the previous three-day "Spring Flower Language" event and checked them with a calculator at the cashier counter, finding that the add-on rate had increased. Song Yajing photographed the remaining flower materials and sent them to florist Zhao Li, then communicated via WeChat video for about half an hour. They decided to restock two bunches of dried sunflowers and two bunches of baby's breath. Zhao Li showed a mini bouquet idea, and Song Yajing suggested holding a DIY event in the customer group as a warm-up, which Zhao Li readily agreed to.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and lunch
description: The weather cleared up. Song Yajing and her shop assistant Xiao Mei went to their usual 'Old Alley' satay noodle shop on Zhenbang Road for lunch. Song Yajing ordered the classic satay noodles with pork liver and tofu, and shared the good news of the morning inventory check showing an increased attachment rate, asking Xiao Mei to think about how to organize the inventory in the afternoon. Xiao Mei excitedly suggested looking for the unsold retro bell-bottom pants from last year.
location: Old Xiamen Shacha Noodles (Zhongshan Road Branch), No. 13 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon in-store display adjustment and community promotion
description: After lunch, back at the store, Song Yajing and Xiaomei used the sunny afternoon to start rearranging the storefront. They moved the coffee machine onto the low cabinet outside the fitting room. Song Yajing wrote 'Free Coffee' in chalk on the blackboard at the entrance and drew flowers, and hung up dried flower decorations. Xiaomei handwrote clear price tags and hung them next to the coffee machine. Song Yajing took photos of the rearranged area with her phone and sent them to the customer group, with a caption promoting the new location of the coffee corner and the fitting experience.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Inventory sorting in heavy rain and an unexpected discovery.
description: At 3 p.m., heavy rain suddenly poured down, and there were few pedestrians on the street. Song Yajing and Xiaomei moved the unopened cardboard boxes from the warehouse into the store, laid down floor mats, checked the tags item by item, and re-hung the clothes by color. They unexpectedly found last autumn's camel-colored knit cardigans and retro flare jeans. Song Yajing joked that this was a chance for the long-stored treasures to see the light of day again, and Xiaomei suggested holding a “seasonal clearance special event.” As they worked, they chatted about funny stories from their student days. By 5 p.m. the rain had eased, and the inventory was fully organized.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Taking advantage of the rain easing, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the store and walked to the kindergarten with an umbrella. On the way, she replied to Zhao Li on WeChat to confirm the arrival time of the restocked floral materials tomorrow. At 17:20, she arrived at the kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan, who excitedly said the teacher had taught them origami frogs. Then she walked back to the store with her daughter.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening rush hour shop operation with daughter in the store
description: She brought her daughter back to the shop and let her fold paper frogs with the newly bought colored paper in the rest area. Song Yajing continued to welcome customers, handle online inquiries, and chat on WeChat with regular customer Vivian, who was interested in the new coffee corner setup and said she would come on the weekend to have coffee and see the spring collection. She also sent a photo of her dress to ask for advice.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gone home after work and had dinner with the family.
description: Around 18:40, Song Yajing finished the handover with Xiaomei and walked home with her daughter. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang and learned that he was working overtime. After arriving home, Song Yajing cooked noodles with greens and luncheon meat for a simple dinner. After dinner, her daughter watched cartoons in the living room while Song Yajing cleaned up the dishes.

participant.name: Chen Zhiqiang
participant.relation: Husband (worked overtime and came home late)

location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family time and a baking attempt
description: Song Yajing played with building blocks and read picture books with her daughter, then helped her take a bath and put her to bed. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang got home after 9 p.m. and ate some leftovers. After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing went to the kitchen to take another shot at the French lemon tart. She strictly followed the tutorial, but the tart still collapsed and had a hard texture after baking. Her husband tasted it and teased that it was like a lemon cookie. Song Yajing didn't know whether to laugh or cry. Although it failed, the process of kneading the dough temporarily made her forget her anxiety about inventory and accounts, and she felt calm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal tidying and tomorrow's plan
description: Song Yajing cleaned up the kitchen, wrapped the failed lemon tart in plastic wrap, and put it in the refrigerator. After a quick wash-up, she lay in bed and reviewed the day, feeling that data inventory, restocking communication, display adjustments, and stock sorting had all been worthwhile. Although the baking failed, it was stress-relieving. She opened the memo on her phone and wrote a note for the next day: go to Xianhou Baking Studio in Huli District in the morning to ask Master Chen why the lemon tart failed; take Vivian's dress and invite her to the shop for a fitting; reply to Manager Lin at the bank about the business loan plan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep.
description: Before going to sleep, Song Yajing knelt by the bed for her bedtime prayer. She gave thanks for everything that had gone smoothly and everything that had not, prayed for her family's health and the store's operation, prayed for the upcoming baking class to go smoothly, and prayed to the Virgin Mary for protection. Then she turned off the light and went to sleep, falling asleep with a sense of peace.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and farewell.
description: After the alarm rang, Song Yajing stayed in bed for a moment, feeling groggy and a bit anxious because she needed to fast for the physical exam. She washed up quickly, touched up her puffy eye area in the mirror, and applied concealer. In the kitchen, she made egg sandwiches and warm milk for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, but only had black coffee herself. At 7:20 Chen Zhiqiang left for work first. At 7:30 Yajing changed into casual clothes, checked her ID card and physical exam form, kissed Xuanxuan who was eating her sandwich, told her to be good and wait for Auntie Xiaomei to pick her up, and then left.
location: Home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and initial contacts
description: Yajing walked out of the residential area and hailed a taxi at the Zhenhai Road Metro Station entrance to go to the Huli District Community Health Service Center. Once in the car, she took out her phone and first sent a WeChat message to her customer Vivian, inviting her to come in the afternoon to try on a dress. Then she sent a message to staff member Xiaomei, telling her that she had arrived at the hospital and asking her to take Xuanxuan to kindergarten and handle the store cleaning and the coffee machine.
location: In a taxi from Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the Huli Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, Huli District.

name: Annual physical exam and health wake-up call.
description: Yajing arrived at the community health service center on time. Under the nurse's guidance, she completed fasting blood draw, urine sample collection, and blood pressure measurement. She ran into her neighbor Auntie Zhang Xiuying. While greeting her, she secretly prayed that her high blood pressure wouldn't be noticed; the result was 138/85 mmHg, slightly elevated. While waiting for the ultrasound, she rested on a bench on the second floor and browsed the shop's customer group messages on her phone. Around ten o'clock, all the items were done. Doctor Wang Mingyuan, based on the preliminary report, told her that her core indicators were basically normal, but prolonged standing had caused obvious muscle strain in her neck and shoulders, and her blood pressure was borderline. He reminded her that this was a sign of too much stress and that she should schedule regular exercise such as brisk walking or swimming twice a week. Yajing wrote in her phone memo: 'Tuesday and Thursday evenings, brisk walk for 30 minutes.'
location: Huli Street Community Health Service Center, No. 53 Haitian Road, Huli Street, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast after the checkup and letting the family know I'm safe.
description: Feeling hungry after the medical checkup, Yajing ordered a lean pork rice noodle roll at the 'Grandma's Old-Fashioned Taste' rice noodle roll shop at the hospital entrance. After sitting down, she sent a voice message to her mother Lin Xiuying at home in Quanzhou to report that she was safe, hiding her blood pressure and neck/shoulder problems, and only saying she was in great health and telling her parents not to worry. After finishing breakfast, she felt her energy recover a bit.
location: Grandma's Traditional-Flavor Rice Noodle Roll Shop near No. 53 Haitian Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store, arrange work tasks, and organize loan documents
description: Yajing took the bus back to Zhongshan Road. On the way, she sent a message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang asking about lunch; he replied that he had a client appointment. When she arrived at the shop, her daughter Chen Lexuan was drawing with Xiaomei. She changed into her work clothes, checked the cash register and the coffee machine, and arranged for Xiaomei to receive VIP customer Vivian and prepare for the clearance sale in the afternoon. Then she sat down behind the cash register, opened the safe, and took out the sales ledgers, bank transaction receipts, and purchase orders from the past three months. She used a calculator to check the monthly turnover month by month, found that the average monthly turnover was 42,000 yuan, and also pulled out promotional photos of the popular woolen coat she wore during the shop's anniversary event last December as proof of her business capability. She sorted all the materials into a document envelope by category.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch, clearance sale preparation, and VIP customer reception.
description: At noon, Yajing had Xiaomei bring back Huangji Satay Noodles to the shop, and the two chatted while eating in the back rest area. Using her phone, she took detail shots of the camel-colored cardigan and slightly flared jeans, and came up with the clearance copy 'Old Times, New Wardrobe,' pricing each item with its original price and an attractive discounted price. At 13:50, the customer Vivian arrived as scheduled. Yajing greeted her warmly, prepared freshly ground coffee, and hung a dress that suited her and the new dark-green slim-fit knit dress in the fitting room. While Vivian was trying on clothes, Yajing chatted with her outside the curtain about fashion trends and customer feedback, and asked for her opinion on the clearance pricing. Vivian suggested 'buy two, get one free' or 'spend 500, get 80 off' and pairing it with dried flower bouquets to create a nice atmosphere. Before she left, Yajing gave her a small dried-flower sachet. After the reception, her mood improved.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Zhonghua Subdistrict, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, the rear rest area and fitting room of Elegant Boutique Clothing Store.

name: ICBC loan interview
description: At 14:30, Yajing walked with a document bag to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch on Lujiang Road. At 14:50 she entered the wealth management office on time to meet the account manager Lin Xiaofeng, and politely stated that she was applying for a 150,000 yuan operating loan for her small and micro business to purchase spring clothing inventory. After reviewing the materials, Lin Xiaofeng pointed out that her sole proprietorship's monthly revenue was just over 40,000 yuan and her tax payment record had gaps, so under the risk control model the feasible loan amount would be very low and the risk score high. He suggested adding a co-borrower or using the property for a second mortgage to increase the chance of approval. Yajing's cheeks burned; she barely managed to keep a smile and said she would go home and discuss it. Walking out of the bank, the March spring breeze felt bitterly cold on her face, and her heart was full of frustration.
location: Wealth Management Room, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Siming Sub-branch), 270 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned to the store to regroup, set up the clearance display, and conduct market research after closing.
description: At 15:40, Yajing returned to the store without showing any disappointment in front of her staff. She pulled herself together and tidied the warehouse with Xiaomei, moved the camel cardigans and flared jeans to the center of the store, used dried sunflowers and baby's breath to create a clearance area display, adjusted the clothes rack angles, drew a blossoming tree on the small blackboard by the door and wrote "Seasonal clearance, seeking an old story," and hung handwritten price tags on every piece of clothing. Her daughter Xuanxuan sat nearby quietly drawing. After closing at 18:00, Yajing asked Xiaomei to take Xuanxuan home first, and walked alone along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She went into several clothing stores that were doing good business to observe their window displays and lighting. In a French-style casual store, she saw decorations made of old newspapers and dried flowers, and took photos for inspiration.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Dinner alone
description: After getting tired from shopping, Yajing stopped at the entrance of the old Sibei Peanut Soup shop at No. 64 Siming North Road and ordered a bowl of signature peanut soup and a chive box. The sweet, soft and glutinous peanut soup eased her tense nerves a little. Sitting alone in the corner, she watched the bustling crowd outside the window and, recalling what had happened at the medical checkup and the bank, felt an exhaustion she had never experienced before.
location: Sibei Peanut Soup Snack Shop, 64 Siming North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family communication and self-care.
description: After walking home, Yajing made a video call to her mother Lin Xiuying in Quanzhou from the living room sofa, saying that everything was fine to set her mother's mind at ease. After hanging up, she sat quietly in the dark for a moment. At 20:15, she took a deep breath and called her elder sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen, pouring out her experience of being rejected for the loan. Her sister calmly analyzed the bank's rules and advised her not to hide it from her husband, first to clear existing inventory to revive cash flow, and said she would also keep an eye on supply chain financial products. After hearing her sister's words, Yajing couldn't help crying but felt relieved. After the call, she took a hot bath, blew her hair dry, applied a hydrating mask, and did simple shoulder and neck stretches to relieve physical and mental fatigue.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep prayer and restless tossing and turning.
description: Yajing knelt by the bedside, clasped her hands in prayer. She thanked the Lord for allowing her to complete the health check-up safely and meet the sister who helped her, and prayed for wisdom and courage to handle the clearance sale and communicate with her husband, not to be overwhelmed by anxiety, and for peaceful sleep. After praying, the burden was slightly lighter. After turning off the light, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode. In the darkness, she planned the details of tomorrow's clearance sale, with the bank manager's words, Vivian's suggestions, and the older sister's comfort interweaving in her mind. She decided not to tell her husband about the loan rejection for now, and to rely on herself to complete the clearance and revitalize cash flow. In the darkness, her stubbornness was stirred up; she tossed and turned again and again, and finally fell into a deep sleep without knowing how long it took.
location: Bedroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning stretching, washing up, and family breakfast
description: The sky was just turning light when the alarm went off. After getting up, Song Yajing did 15 minutes of gentle neck-and-shoulder yoga by the bed, following the doctor's advice. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at herself in the mirror, she recalled yesterday's setback and cheered herself up. Afterward, she went to the kitchen, where the multigrain porridge was already cooked; she fried an egg and steamed some buns. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped prepare the milk powder, and the family of three sat down to breakfast together. While peeling a boiled egg for her daughter Chen Lexuan, Song Yajing reminded her to be good in kindergarten. After the meal, Song Yajing cleared the dishes, and Chen Zhiqiang got ready for work.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten, buy craft materials on the way, and walk to the store
description: She helped her daughter put on her little backpack and held her hand as they left home, walking about 15 minutes to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. She let her daughter pick a pack of colored origami paper with a rabbit-and-star pattern, and also bought a bottle of children's safe glue. After paying, they walked another 7 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Watching her daughter skip into her teacher's arms, Song Yajing waved goodbye. Then she walked along Gucheng West Road toward Zhongshan Road, passed the 85°C bakery, and casually replied to a customer's inquiry about clothing sizes, feeling somewhat more at ease.
location: Starting from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing the Gongyuan South Road Stationery Store at Phase 2, Yubincheng, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, along the way to Yazhi Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Arrive at the shop to prepare and do the final setup for the flower arrangement activity.
description: Arrived at the Elegant Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road; the shop assistant Xiaomei was already cleaning the floor. Song Yajing was in charge of arranging the flower materials. First, she wrote "Spring flower bouquet giveaway: only the last two days left!" in colored chalk on the small blackboard by the door and drew little flowers. Then she bundled the remaining lavender, eucalyptus leaves, and baby's breath into 12 delicate brooch flowers as the final free gifts of the day.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning Business and Customer Interaction
description: The store officially opened for business. When customers tried on new arrivals, Song Yajing handed them handmade brooch flowers and offered her blessings. During a lull, she took close-up photos of the three remaining bouquets in the store and sent them to the VIP customer group, letting them know the event had only two days left. This attracted two regular customers who said they would come in the afternoon.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and organizing the fabric information sent by her sister
description: At noon, Xiaomei went to eat first, while Song Yajing watched the shop and ordered her usual Yuehua satay noodle takeout. While eating, she carefully checked the WeChat messages her elder sister Song Yawen had sent in the morning, including links to three Taobao-based remnant fabric online stores and the business cards of two factory managers. She saved them one by one to her contacts, created a new folder named 'Fabric Suppliers - Recommended by Sister Yawen' in her phone notes, and wrote down her sister's notes and suggestions.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and formulating a plan to tighten operations.
description: After Xiao Mei returned and took over the shop, the afternoon had few customers and the sunlight was just right. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register, took out a loose-leaf notebook, and focused on writing next month's cost-cutting plan: 1) Optimize purchasing: notify Guangzhou supplier Susan to reduce the spring end-of-season purchase quantity by 20%; 2) Set up a clearance zone: select 5 out-of-season coats and 3 slow-moving shirts to launch a "Spring Refresh: 5 items at 40% off" section; 3) Control costs: after using up the existing packaging bags, switch to simple kraft paper bags, and cancel the background music platform membership, saving about 1,300 yuan per month.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Customer follow-ups, inventory organization, afternoon business, and wrapping up the floral arrangement event.
description: After finishing the plan, Song Yajing got up and moved around. She remembered that the dress she had promised to shorten for customer Vivian was ready, so she found the dress, took a photo, sent it to Vivian, and invited her to come for a fitting. Then she sorted through the remaining dried baby's breath in the storeroom with Xiaomei and decided to use them as single-stem giveaways. In the afternoon, the customer flow gradually picked up. Several regular customers arrived as promised, and Song Yajing warmly helped them try on new outfits. The last bundle of dried baby's breath was taken by a young woman who bought two dresses at around 4:30 p.m., wrapping up the flower event successfully. During the process, Song Yajing recorded the distribution of the giveaways in her phone memo.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and return to the store.
description: Leaving the store in Xiaomei's care, Song Yajing walked quickly to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Her daughter excitedly showed off the folded paper frog she had made. After praising her, Song Yajing held her hand and walked 6 minutes back to the store.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Evening store duty and parent-child time
description: Back at the store, after Xiaomei got off work, Song Yajing had her daughter sit in the rest area behind the cash register, took out the origami paper bought that morning, and the mother and daughter folded paper airplanes and origami cranes together. While accompanying her daughter, she replied to several voice messages sent by her elder sister about fabric sourcing. Taking advantage of the store being empty of customers, Song Yajing stood up and did a few simple chest-opening and neck side-stretch movements.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the store and taking daughter home
description: At closing time, Song Yajing pulled down the rolling shutter door and locked it, then walked home with her daughter along Zhongshan Road as the streetlights were coming on. Passing a fruit stall, she bought a green mango for her daughter. After getting home, she found her husband Chen Zhiqiang was still working overtime and said over the phone that he was on the subway.
location: On the way from No. 56 Zhongshan Road to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a simple dinner
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing reheated the leftover winter melon and pork rib soup from last night, cooked a small pot of fine dried noodles, and added sliced pork and blanched greens. The mother and daughter ate dinner quietly. She asked her husband to buy two packs of toast at the convenience store on his way home for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: After bathing her daughter and changing her into pajamas, the daughter, too excited from playing during the day, refused to sleep and whined for a new story. Song Yajing held her and paced the room, humming nursery rhymes such as "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" and "Two Tigers", and then told the story of "Little Bear's Birthday". Only after about half an hour did her daughter fall into a deep sleep.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Housework tidying and washing up.
description: Gently putting her sleeping daughter into the small bed, Song Yajing returned to the living room to clean up the building blocks and picture books on the sofa and wipe the dining table. Then she went to the bathroom to take a shower, changed into comfortable lounge clothes, and felt much of her fatigue disappear.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video-called her sister Song Yawen to ask for advice.
description: Song Yajing called her elder sister over WeChat video and detailed her bank loan rejection and the cost control plan she had made that day. Her sister calmly analyzed that the bank valued stable cash flow, suggested optimizing purchase costs, and recommended Boss Liu, who dealt in foreign trade overstock, saying she would send his WeChat contact to her. Song Yajing noted down the name “Boss Liu”, and her sister's encouragement rekindled her hope.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime ritual and mood journaling
description: After the video call ended, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, knelt by the bed, and silently said her bedtime prayers. She thanked the Lord for the day's peace and prayed for the health of the store and her family. Then she opened her journal and recorded the core feelings of the day: the flower arrangement event came to a successful close; the tightened business plan was expected to save 1,300 yuan a month; her elder sister recommended a fabric supplier; and her daughter was very well-behaved, filling her with strength. After recording, she stood up and did five minutes of serious neck and shoulder stretches.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Got an initial understanding of fabric supplier information.
description: After stretching, Song Yajing did not go to sleep immediately. Instead, she opened the fabric supplier link recommended by her sister, quickly browsed the styles and quotes of several shops, and bookmarked two shop pages that seemed most promising for cooperation. She felt a bit more confident about tomorrow.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Sleepiness set in. Song Yajing turned off her phone, leaving only a dim bedside lamp. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already come back from overtime and gone to sleep. She quietly lay down on the other side of the bed, adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position, thought about contacting Boss Liu tomorrow, and gradually fell asleep with hope in her heart.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: Woke up at home in Siming District in the early morning; her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already taken her daughter Xuanxuan to kindergarten. After a quick wash, she did shoulder and neck stretches in front of the mirror, following Dr. Wang's earlier advice. Then she warmed milk, ate whole wheat toast, and checked the weather forecast on her phone, confirming a sunny day with a temperature of 16–22°C, setting a good foundation for the day.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Call the doctor to get the physical exam report
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, she opened her planner and then called Dr. Wang Mingyuan at the Huli District Community Health Service Center. Dr. Wang explained the electronic report item by item: the complete blood count, electrocardiogram, and gynecological indicators were all normal. The only problem was neck and shoulder myofascial strain, and he advised her to do stretching every week. She asked him to send the PDF report to her email and confirmed that it had been successfully backed up, feeling a great weight lifted from her mind.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to the store for his commute.
description: After checking her small shoulder bag (phone, journal, keys), she left and chose to walk to the shop. Along Hubin South Road, passing through the stone-paved old street of Zhongshan Road, she enjoyed the moist, cool morning air and the sunlight on the old buildings, feeling grounded and calm. She arrived at the shop about 15 minutes later.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning work: business preparation and event wrap-up
description: After arriving at the store, I opened the door and the rolling shutter, turned on the cash register and the sound system, and played soft jazz. I checked the store displays with Xiao Mei, the store clerk, to make sure everything was neat. Then I tallied the data for the seven-day "Spring Flower Language" event: total revenue about 8,700 yuan, 32 bouquets and 20 cups of coffee given away, 11 new WeChat friends added, and I wrote it all into my journal. Compared with the same period last year, it fell short of expectations, but foot traffic rose slightly. Taking advantage of the quiet morning, I replied to backlogged WeChat inquiries, selected new spring clothing, and took natural-light try-on photos in the fitting room and in front of the display window, posting them to my Moments and customer groups with the caption "Last day of the event—seize the tail of spring."
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: During her lunch break, she walked to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, ordered an iced latte and a slice of tiramisu, and sat in a window seat for one. While enjoying lunch, she zoned out, scrolled a fashion news app to check spring/summer trends, and also came across a short video on community operation tips, which she saved for later. The sunlight outside was just right, and she enjoyed a brief, pleasant moment.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon work: material removal and in-depth review.
description: In the afternoon, Zhao Li arrived at the store on time. The three of them, including Xiaomei, carefully removed the dried flower decorations from the display window. The intact parts were packed into boxes for Zhao Li to use for her salon, and the withered parts were discarded. During the removal, Song Yajing discussed the promotional data with Zhao Li: although the number of customers directly directed to the store was not large, the 'clothing + floral' photo set received three times the usual number of likes, making the brand exposure a success. Meanwhile, Xiaomei found a handwritten thank-you card left by regular customer Vivian while cleaning the checkout counter. The card's warm words moved Song Yajing, and she tucked it into her journal, considering it the best gift of the day.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out for review and community plan discussion.
description: In the evening, she closed the shop with Zhao Li and walked to the small café "Encounter" at the corner of the block. Each ordered a hot latte and sat in a quiet corner for an honest review: they affirmed the success of the cross-border format in visuals and topics, but also frankly acknowledged that sales conversion was insufficient. Song Yajing proposed establishing a customer community called "Yajing's Wardrobe." Zhao Li responded enthusiastically and was willing to select and recommend targeted fans from her flower arrangement student group. They also had a preliminary discussion about holding small offline sharing events combining "styling + flower arranging" in the future. As they shook hands to say goodbye, their cooperation took a step forward.
location: 'Encounter' Café, 225-2 Zhongshan Road Side Alley, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home after closing the store.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, she walked home alone. The evening breeze blew gently, and the night market on Zhongshan Road was brightly lit. On the way, she received a message from her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, saying that a company project dinner would keep him out late, that he had already cooked dumplings for their daughter, and advising her not to drink too much. After walking about 15 minutes, she returned to the residential complex.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family time
description: After getting home, she changed into home clothes and checked her daughter Xuanxuan's dinner (a few dumplings were left, so she had eaten well), then had a simple bowl of vegetable salad herself. She sat beside Xuanxuan, who was drawing at the small table. Xuanxuan showed her the piece titled "Mommy and the Flower Shop" and told her about the fun time Aunt Zhang from next door had taken her to the park that afternoon. Then they read the picture books "The Very Hungry Caterpillar" and "Guess How Much I Love You" together, and she told Xuanxuan about receiving the thank-you card and the story of Aunt Vivian. Xuanxuan praised her, saying, "Mommy is the best-dressed mommy in the world."
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal review and journal update
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, she sat down at the dressing table in her bedroom and took out the thank-you card to look at it again. Over a WeChat voice call, she shared with her older sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen: the medical checkup went well, the event was wrapping up, and although sales did not meet the target, she had received a heartwarming card and had confirmed the first step of community cooperation with Zhao Li. Her sister was happy and reminded her that on the next trip to Guangzhou to stock up, she could contact a foreign-trade surplus goods supplier she knew. After the call, she wrote a core summary in her journal: "Medical checkup passed, event concluded, a heartwarming card received, and the first step of community cooperation with Zhao Li confirmed. Though it did not meet expectations, the road is extending." She also planned to take Xuanxuan to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass on Sunday.
location: Dressing table in the bedroom at home, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Took a hot bath to relieve fatigue. After blow-drying her hair, she prepared for the next day's Mass on Gulangyu: checked the church veil and Xuanxuan's little jacket in the eco-friendly bag. After everything was in order, she turned off the light and quickly fell asleep in the night glow, bringing the fulfilling week to a close.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations and flower arranging
description: Got up early in the morning and washed up quietly to avoid waking her husband and daughter. Feeling happy because of Women's Day, she carefully arranged the pink carnations received yesterday and placed them in an empty glass vase on the bedroom dressing table, adding a touch of brightness to the room.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attended Sunday morning Mass.
description: Left home, walked to First Pier, took a ferry to Gulangyu, then walked to Gulangyu Catholic Church for the 8 a.m. early Mass. During Mass, she prayed for her family, the shop, and recent difficulties. Afterward, at the church entrance, she exchanged Women's Day greetings with several fellow church members.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ferry return trip and buying breakfast.
description: Walked from the church to Sanqiutian Pier and took the ferry back. After getting off the boat, walked to the 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery (189 South Siming Road, Zhongshan Road), bought plain pillow bread and hot soy milk for my daughter, and a pork floss bun for my husband. On the walk home, took photos of the morning scenery along Lujiang Road and thought up a holiday Moments caption.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast and commemorative photos
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan were already up. She put the breakfast she had brought home on the dining table, then moved the carnation vase from the bedroom to the table. She used her phone to take photos of the flowers, the holiday card, and the table in the sunlight, and her daughter also curiously took pictures. She edited a WeChat Moments post visible only to herself as a Women's Day keepsake. After the meal, she talked with her husband about visiting the school in the afternoon and asked him to check the admissions brochure on his phone.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went to the shop and arranged work
description: Walked to the clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, I contacted the shop assistant Xiaomei via WeChat to confirm she could help watch the store in the afternoon, while mentally going over the accounts to settle with my flower-arranging partner Zhao Li and the leftover materials for the store event.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: In-store work: profit settlement and finalizing salon cooperation
description: After arriving at the store, first checked the profit-sharing data for the floral co-branding with Zhao Li. Around 10:30, Zhao Li arrived with the remaining floral materials. The two settled accounts in the lounge area. Song Yajing transferred the full 1,760 yuan profit share via WeChat and gifted a Morandi blue small silk scarf as a Women's Day gift. After accepting it, Zhao Li proposed bringing floral design students to the store to hold a styling salon. The two finalized the first small-scale crossover salon for the afternoon of next Saturday (March 15), and decided on the event process and the maximum number of participants.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Simple lunch and midday rest stretching
description: She didn't go home for lunch. She ordered steamed dumplings and black chicken soup from Shaxian Snacks (Gucheng West Road branch) via a food delivery platform and had a quick meal in the shop. While eating, she browsed Xiaohongshu for community activity cases to find inspiration for next Saturday's salon. After the meal, she did a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch in the shop during her lunch break to relieve fatigue.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Hand over the store and return home to meet up.
description: Store assistant Xiaomei arrived at the store early. After briefly going over the afternoon tasks with her, Song Yajing left the shop and walked home to meet her waiting husband and daughter, ready to go together to visit the primary school.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The family of three walked to the elementary school
description: The family of three set out from home and walked about 25 minutes to Lujiang Xincheng Primary School. Along the way, their daughter was very happy. Taking advantage of the holiday, Song Yajing told her the origin of International Women's Day, explaining that it commemorates women's struggle for equal rights and a happy life.
location: Lujiang New City Primary School, No. 186 Lianxiuli, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Attending the primary school open day and anxiety about starting school
description: The family of three entered the campus for a visit. The admissions teacher candidly said that the enrollment quota for students in the designated school district was full, and children with household registration after 2018 might be transferred to Siming No. 2 Experimental Primary School. The couple felt heavy-hearted. The husband asked about private primary schools and learned that tuition was about 80,000–90,000 yuan per year. While touring the teaching building and the playground, Song Yajing played on the slide and swing with her daughter to keep her from noticing the tense atmosphere, but the couple's anxiety was still hard to hide when their eyes met.
location: Lujiang New City Primary School, No. 186 Lianxiuli, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: On the way home, dropped by the stationery store and ate ice jelly to comfort herself.
description: After leaving school, the atmosphere was heavy. To distract her daughter, Song Yajing suggested going to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. Her daughter picked out Frozen stickers and a glow pen as rewards. At the entrance of the stationery store, they bought three servings of brown sugar jelly and ate them as they walked, which lightened the mood considerably.
location: South Gongyuan Road Stationery Store, No. 35 South Gongyuan Road, Phase 2, Yubin City, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Staying home alone and calling mother and older sister to greet them
description: After returning home, her husband took the initiative to watch cartoons with their daughter. Song Yajing sat alone on the balcony and first made a video call to her mother in Quanzhou, wishing her a happy Women's Day and confiding her anxiety about visiting schools. Her mother comforted her, saying that things would work out in the end. Then she called her older sister in Shenzhen, and they exchanged holiday greetings. Her sister encouraged her to share more of the burden with her husband.
location: Balcony of the home in the No. 82 community on Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare family dinner.
description: To create a relaxed opening for the evening conversation, Song Yajing decided to prepare dinner with care. She made her husband's favorite satay noodles, cucumber salad, and her daughter's favorite stir-fried shrimp. The process of prepping the ingredients gradually calmed her emotions.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Out shopping and tidying up at home
description: She noticed the soy sauce was almost used up, so she rode a shared bike to the Yonghui Supermarket near Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought light soy sauce and dark soy sauce. She also picked up cod sausages, her daughter's favorite, and seasonal qingtuan. At checkout, she mentally calculated the day's expenses. When she got home, her husband had already cut up a watermelon. She put away her purchases and asked her daughter to help set the table, preparing for dinner.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and after-dinner leisure
description: The dinner atmosphere was warm and pleasant. Song Yajing peeled shrimp for her daughter and refilled her husband's soup, and proactively brought up the salon plan finalized that afternoon. Her husband also shared an article he had seen comparing the strengths of primary schools in Xiamen. After dinner, her husband volunteered to do the dishes, and Song Yajing read a picture book with her daughter.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing to soothe her daughter to sleep.
description: After reading the picture book, she coaxed her daughter into washing up and changing into pajamas on her own, promising her that if she slept well, she would take her to the park tomorrow. This put her in good stead for the important talk with her husband later.
location: Daughter's room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Deep couple communication and building a family financial safety net.
description: After their daughter fell asleep, the couple spread the family ledger out in the study. The husband spoke first, saying he could take on freelance website maintenance work to supplement the education expenses. Song Yajing, moved, finally confided the difficulties of the rejected business loan and the decline in store revenue. Her husband held her hand tightly and said they would face it together. The two made important decisions: each month, 2,000 yuan would be set aside from the husband's salary as a dedicated fund for their daughter's education; any non-essential advance payment over 500 yuan for the store would require discussion between both of them; and each would keep a spending record and reconcile accounts every Sunday. With tears and clasped hands, the anxiety was eased by sharing the burden.
location: The home study at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Nighttime stretching and recording tomorrow's plan.
description: After the conversation, she felt much more at ease and completed the second set of neck and shoulder stretches in the living room. Then she took out her journal and recorded today's key decisions (education reserve, shared finances), and wrote down the things to do tomorrow: contact Susan to check on the progress of the new styles, send the draft salon poster to Zhao Li, and also noted in her phone memo the first step for Monday's community operations—posting the salon preview poster to Moments and the VIP group.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and bedtime reading
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I checked at my daughter's door to make sure she was sound asleep. Back in bed, instead of looking at my phone, I picked up a book about intimate relationships and read a few pages with focus. It was rare to read so calmly since pregnancy. After finishing a section, I turned off the light and fell asleep feeling peaceful and empowered.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning family time and getting ready to go out
description: At 7:15 in the morning, I was woken by the alarm clock. After a quick wash, I walked to the bedroom window for morning prayer, thanking the Lord for granting me a new day. Then I went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family: I warmed milk for my daughter Xuanxuan, fried a runny-yolk egg, made bacon toast for my husband and myself, and made a vegetable salad with cherry tomatoes and cucumbers. At exactly 8 o’clock, the three of us sat around the dining table to have breakfast together. While listening to Xuanxuan talk about fun things at kindergarten, we shared our plans for the day: I would go to church in the morning and learn to make éclairs in the afternoon; my husband would take Xuanxuan to the library to return books and buy fruit, and he promised to take our daughter for her vaccination in the afternoon. After breakfast, I hurriedly packed my belongings, repeatedly checking the insulated bag containing my apron and notebook, then sent a WeChat message to Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, to arrange to meet at the church. She replied that she had already saved me a seat.
location: Home, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive to the church and attend Sunday Mass
description: At 8:50 I drove from home, turned from Hubin South Road onto Siming North Road, and with smooth traffic arrived at the parking lot near Siming Catholic Church at 9:09, then walked into the church. At 9:00 sharp, Mass began with the pipe organ. Father Wang delivered a sermon on the theme "Seeing grace in hardship," which deeply moved me. After Mass, I had a brief conversation with Aunt Lin Xiuying outside the church, and she gave me two handmade glutinous rice dumplings to bring home for Xuanxuan.
location: Siming Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove to Huli District and had lunch
description: At 10:15 I left the church and drove north along Chenggong Avenue. On the way, I called my mother, who lives far away in Quanzhou, through the car's Bluetooth. We talked about Xuanxuan's schooling. My mother comforted me and told me not to worry, and reminded me to take more photos of the baking class. At about 10:58, I arrived at Xinglong Road in Huli District, parked in the Yonghui Supermarket parking lot, and then ordered a bowl of the signature beef noodles with blanched greens at the Weihua Beef Noodle Restaurant by the road. While waiting, I opened my notebook and used my phone's timer to simulate the folding steps for puff pastry, warming up for the afternoon class.
location: Weihua Beef Noodle Restaurant, No. 76 Xinglong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Advanced French pastry workshop and meeting new people
description: At 11:30 I arrived early at Master Chen's baking workshop, helped him knead the dough, and asked for tips on whipping meringue. He answered kindly and demonstrated. The class officially started at 12:00 and was packed with content: under the master's guidance, I completed three four-fold puff pastry laminations, with the dough smooth and elastic; learned to operate the sandblasting machine, mastered the ratio of cocoa butter to chocolate, and sprayed velvet-textured mousse balls; the hardest part was piping éclair choux pastry, which I finally succeeded at after three repeated attempts. During the break, I noticed the young mother Fang Yi at the next workstation feeling discouraged because her meringue had failed to whip up properly, so I proactively handed her some lemon juice and shared my own beginner mishap stories. The two of us chatted about the ups and downs of running a store and raising kids, and discovered that we were both mothers balancing career and family. We felt we had become friends too late, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to practice together in the future.
location: Master Chen's Bakery Workshop, No. 73 Xinglong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning to the store, dessert display, and evening store work
description: At 4:30 p.m., the class ended. I carefully packed the éclairs, sand-sprayed mousse cakes, and other works into insulated bags, thanked Master Chen, and booked next week's glaze-coating class. At 4:40 p.m., I drove along Chenggong Avenue back to Siming District. At 5:10 p.m., I arrived at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, where shop assistant Xiao Mei was wiping the shelves. I took out the desserts, arranged them beautifully on a tray with napkins from the store, found the best lighting spot, and shot close-ups as well as photos with the new dresses. Xiao Mei helped with the lighting and kept praising them. Before 6:00 p.m., I posted the photos to the "Yajing Wardrobe" customer group, suggested adding an afternoon tea corner in the future, and held a vote on flavors. The group reacted enthusiastically, and regular customer Vivian sent a private message saying she wanted to place the first order. Then I contacted the collaborating florist Zhao Li and sent her two salon poster drafts for feedback. I also sent a voice message to supplier Susan in Guangzhou, urging the delivery of new styles such as the heavily embroidered shirts, to make sure the store's operations went smoothly without a hitch.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping on the way home and a warm family dinner
description: At 19:30 I closed the store on time and walked home along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way I called my husband to ask how he and our daughter were doing after returning the books, and following his instructions I bought yeast, milk, yellow peach yogurt, and blueberries at the Yonghui Life convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station. I got home at 20:10. My husband had already prepared tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. I put on an apron and quickly made a loofah and shrimp soup. During dinner I cut up the takeout éclair; Xuanxuan ate it with cream all over her mouth and happily praised me as the greatest pastry chef. I shared how moved I was by Sunday Mass, what I learned in baking class, and the compliments from customers. The whole family was warm and happy.
location: Home, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time, couple's financial review, and personal wrap-up
description: After dinner, I first played with Xuanxuan for half an hour with magnetic tiles, building her a new house for Peppa Pig. Then I took her to wash up and told her two bedtime stories, A Chair for My Mother and The Stubborn Tortoise. Xuanxuan fell asleep contentedly.
