At 21:45, my husband and I went into the study, checked this week's store revenue of about 6,600 yuan and various household expenses, confirmed the advance payment for my husband's side job next month, and set a goal of a 1,500 yuan dedicated education reserve in the family ledger, agreeing that any expense over 500 yuan requires mutual consent. Then in the bedroom, I did three sets of neck and shoulder stretches, opened my journal to record today's inspiration—the “dessert + clothing” cross-industry collaboration could start with offering handmade pastries to customers who come in for fittings—and listed tomorrow's work priorities. Finally, before turning off the light, I prayed quietly, grateful for this full and peaceful day.
location: Home, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning routine: stretching, morning prayer, and washing up
description: She woke up to the alarm and first did two sets of shoulder and neck stretches in bed (about 5 minutes) to relieve everyday soreness. Then she got up, knelt by the bed for morning prayer, asking God to grant her wisdom and peace in handling today's challenges, especially hoping to stay calm and sincere when calling the supplier. After that, she quickly washed up and changed into a thin knit cardigan and dark casual pants. She checked her phone to confirm that her husband Chen Zhiqiang would pick up their daughter, then prepared spare clothes, a water bottle, and a jacket for her daughter's kindergarten, and tidied up the entryway.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and encourage her
description: She walked her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, about 10 minutes away. Along the way, she gently chatted with her about the games she wanted to play and told her to listen to the teacher. When they arrived at the school gate, she gave her a big hug, smiled as she watched her walk into the classroom, and waved goodbye.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Walk from the kindergarten to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, about 15 minutes. On the way, passing a breakfast stall, she bought a tea egg and a cup of freshly ground soy milk. After arriving at the store, she opened the door to air it out, wiped the display counter with a rag, checked yesterday's sales records, and moved several newly arrived early-spring light jackets to the most prominent spot in the window display.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Focus on the core task: calling the supplier.
description: During the quiet period before the official opening, she called the Hangzhou leftover-stock studio and Sister Chen in turn, explaining in a calm tone that the shop was adjusting its product selection in response to spring market changes and needed to cut next month’s orders by 25%. Although Sister Chen was a bit surprised, she said she understood, and they agreed to keep in touch. After making the calls, she felt reluctant but also relieved.
location: Next to the cash register inside Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store opening, handling salon poster and handover
description: Started the morning business, warmly welcoming several regular customers who came in to try on new spring suits and offering styling advice. During the customers' fitting breaks, I looked at the draft poster for the weekend salon sent by florist Zhao Li, wrote down three revision comments on sticky notes (about fonts, color scheme, and QR code position), and sent them to Zhao Li via WeChat at 10:30. Around 11:00, shop assistant Xiao Mei came to take over the shift. I then carefully handed over the morning sales situation and the things to note for the afternoon, and told her I was going to the bank to handle some business and would be back in about an hour. Xiao Mei patted her chest to reassure me. Yajing took her ID card and bank card and prepared to leave.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Printing bank statements and running into a former colleague.
description: Rode a shared bike to the ICBC branch in Qianpu, passing beautiful streets on the way. At the bank, she took a number and waited in line, then asked her familiar account manager, Lin Xiaofeng, to print the past three months' corporate account statements. As she was about to leave, she unexpectedly ran into her former colleague Sun Li, who had returned from Shenzhen to Xiamen to visit relatives. They talked for more than ten minutes. Sun Li shared operational tips from Shenzhen's trendy internet-famous stores and praised her courage in starting a business, which deeply inspired her. They exchanged updated contact information and said goodbye.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Quick lunch
description: After saying goodbye to Sun Li, she walked to the nearby Qianpu branch of China Lanzhou Beef Noodles, ordered a bowl of signature beef hand-pulled noodles, ate quickly, and recharged for the afternoon's work.
location: China Lanzhou Beef Noodles (Qianpu Branch), 498-104-1 Qianpu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Afternoon in-store work: stocking new arrivals, entering customer information, and preparing the community group.
description: After riding a shared bike back to the Zhongshan Road store, she unpacked, sorted, and put on display a new batch of delicate accessories (silk scarves, hair clips) together with Xiaomei. Then she took out the regular customers' contact book, and the two of them worked together at the cash register to enter the names, phone numbers, and consumption preferences of more than 50 regular customers one by one into a new phone contacts group named 'Yajing's Regular Customers.' Afterwards, Yajing sat alone in the quiet VIP fitting lounge. Based on the recorded purchase history and preference tags, she screened out 26 active customers with high purchase frequency and a strong willingness to coordinate outfits, drafted the first invitation list for the 'Yajing's Select Styling Group,' and carefully noted each customer's characteristics (such as 'French-style enthusiast' and 'tall girl'), preparing to send personalized group invitations later.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Short rest and online interaction
description: She got up, drank a glass of warm water, and walked to the store entrance to stretch her neck and shoulders while watching passersby. She scrolled through Moments, liking a regular customer's travel photos, and replied to the good-morning message from Fang Yi, a new friend she had met at the baking class the day before.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-peak tidying and online communication
description: Before foot traffic increased, she quickly put together a first draft of the restocking plan for the rest of the month. On WeChat, she received a message from florist Zhao Li confirming the poster revision; Vivian, a regular customer, sent positive feedback about the last outfit pairing. Yajing thanked her and took the opportunity to ask for her thoughts on the community format, and got a reply saying "can't wait," which made her more confident.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening rush hour business and closing preparations
description: There was a small peak before closing. Yajing and Xiaomei provided professional styling advice to two after-work customers who came together, and successfully sold a French floral-print dress and a versatile thin trench coat. When nearing closing time, they checked the day's cash register records and cash, and Yajing quickly listed tomorrow's to-dos in her journal, such as sending follow-up private messages to customers who hadn't replied to the group invitation.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the store, buying ingredients, and going home
description: After closing the store and saying goodbye to Xiaomei, she walked to the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought whole-wheat bread, a carton of milk, and a bunch of bananas as breakfast and fruit supplies for tomorrow. Then she walked about 10 minutes back to her home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already picked up their daughter and prepared dinner (scrambled eggs with tomatoes, steamed sea bass, and winter melon soup). The family sat around the dining table. Yajing shared the amusing encounter and inspiration from running into Sun Li at the bank, her husband talked about the small progress on his work project, and her daughter Xuanxuan chattered about amusing kindergarten stories. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child time and getting her daughter to sleep
description: Played her favorite pretend-play building blocks with her daughter, read her two picture book stories, then helped her wash up, put on her cute pajamas, and hummed a song to lull her to sleep. Looking at her daughter's sleeping face, she felt a sense of peace.
location: Daughter's room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening relaxation: brewing tea and video chatting with my best friend.
description: She gently closed the door and came out, washed the fruit she had bought, put it in the fridge, boiled water, and made herself a cup of warm, soothing herbal fruit tea. She took a sip while it was hot and felt relaxed in body and mind. Then she made a video call to her best friend Li Meiling, who teaches at an elementary school in Xiamen. Meiling listened to Yajing pour out her struggle about calling the supplier and the inspiration from running into Sun Li, while grading homework, and responded with funny stories from the classroom. Finally she said, 'Do you remember how our handwritten newspapers kept failing in junior high? But later they became models, didn't they? You can do it!' Yajing laughed heartily, her eyes moist, and felt her stress relieved.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street complex, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Writing in a journal to record and reflect
description: While drinking slightly chilled fruit tea, she wrote down today's reflections in her journal: 1) She courageously made the difficult decision to "cut orders" in order to focus more on future directions; 2) Sun Li's experience showed her the possibilities of the Shenzhen market, but Xiamen needs to focus more on localized services; 3) Meiling's "You've got this!" was the best comfort today.
location: At the desk in the bedroom of the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening bedtime routine: washing up, stretching, praying, and reading
description: Seriously completed a set of pre-bedtime neck and shoulder stretches to help relieve the day's fatigue, then said a bedtime prayer, thanking God for the day's arrangements, whether difficulties or surprises, and asking for a better state to devote to work and family the next day. After that, instead of looking at her phone, she flipped through the fashion magazine on her bedside table about spring outfits and store display, reading a few interesting articles to calm her mind. She put down the magazine and turned off the light to sleep before 23:00.
location: Bedroom and bed at No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up in the morning, morning prayer, and breakfast
description: At 8 a.m., the alarm went off. Song Yajing stretched in bed to relieve the tightness in her neck and shoulders, then got up and walked to the dressing table. Facing the statue of the Virgin Mary and the holy water bottle, she said a brief morning prayer in Hokkien, asking for diligence and no wasted time today. Then she quickly washed up and changed into an apricot knit cardigan and black casual pants. After that, she heated up the croissant she had bought the day before at the convenience store in the subway station, brewed a cup of black coffee with freshly ground beans, and checked her phone messages while eating. She replied to the florist Zhao Li's confirmation message about the salon poster. Then she gently pushed open her daughter's door, woke up Xuanxuan, who was still lying in bed, helped her put on her favorite raincoat with a bear pattern, and tied her hair into a small ponytail.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing held a transparent umbrella and walked to the kindergarten with her daughter Chen Lexuan, who was wearing a bear-shaped raincoat and playing in puddles along the way. There were few pedestrians on the rainy street, making it feel rather quiet. On the way, she reminded Xuanxuan to share the dinosaur stickers with the other children today. After watching her daughter be led by the teacher into the teaching building of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, she left reassured.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparation and first short video shoot.
description: Song Yajing walked quickly to her Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, opened the store door and turned on all the lights, making the store bright and cozy on the rainy day. She plugged in the aromatherapy diffuser, added a few drops of sweet orange essential oil, and made herself a cup of hot black tea. She wiped down the phone stand and ring light used for live streaming and placed them beside the cash register for later. Then she reviewed the operating strategy of the internet-famous Shenzhen store that Sun Li had mentioned yesterday, and quickly watched a video by a blogger she followed on Xiaohongshu. After that, she changed into a beige knit top from her own store and paired it with a dusty pink satin skirt. Using her phone's built-in camera, she set it up by the window in natural light and began trying to shoot a short video for the first time. Facing the camera, her smile was a bit stiff and her movements were not fluid; she reshot the video seven or eight times in a row, constantly adjusting her speaking pace and angle. Finally, around 11 o'clock, she recorded a 15-second video showing the outfit, saved it to drafts, and planned to practice more in private and not publish it for now.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing the community list and preparing for the lunch livestream
description: After a short rest, Song Yajing sat down at the cash register, took out the list of 26 active customers she had screened yesterday, and began searching for them on WeChat one by one on her phone, sending friend requests and invitations to join the Yajing Curated Outfit Group, along with a brief self-introduction and invitation message. At lunchtime, she didn't go out; instead, she made a simple salad with the fresh vegetables and chicken breast she had bought yesterday. While eating, she adjusted the angle of her phone stand, found a piece of background music that her husband A Qiang had previously recorded for her, and settled on the audio plan for the livestream. She also wrote a few interactive topics on a note to use during the livestream, such as 'Do you think this trench coat goes better with wide-leg pants or jeans?' and 'What color would you pick for the first dress of spring?' to help overcome her nervousness about speaking.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and quiet prayer
description: The rain outside the shop grew louder. Song Yajing leaned back on the sofa in the rest area and rested with her eyes closed for over ten minutes. Then she opened the e-book version of Proverbs on her phone, read a passage in silence, and prayed for inner peace and guidance for the afternoon livestream.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Second attempt at livestreaming and preparation.
description: Song Yajing changed into another spring work outfit (hazy blue suit jacket + white silk blouse), touched up her lipstick, set her phone on the stand, and checked the camera angle and network connection. She turned off the store's background music, took a deep breath, and started a live stream on WeChat Channels. This time she prepared interactive talking points in advance, so she didn't just stare blankly like last time. Although the number of online viewers remained in single digits, she kept smiling and naturally introduced a trench coat's cut and styling to the camera. She tried asking questions from the sticky note; even though only one viewer replied, she still responded seriously. One viewer commented, 'the host smiles so sincerely, keep it up,' which encouraged her a lot. She kept the live stream going for 25 minutes and felt much smoother than last time. When she ended the broadcast, her palms were slightly sweaty, but she felt fulfilled.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Livestream review and community maintenance
description: After ending the livestream, Song Yajing took a sip of water, watched the replay, and noted a few places where she had stumbled. Then she started handling the friend requests she had sent that morning; several customers had already accepted and asked about the group entry rules, so she replied to each one patiently. She sent a private message to Vivian, the customer who had made a purchase yesterday, asking how the clothes fit and thanking her again for her community suggestions. After that, there were still few customers in the store, so she leaned back on the sofa in the rest area, brewed a cup of hot black tea, and began browsing the spring new-arrival photos sent by supplier Susan, thinking about which styles matched her community customers' preferences. At the same time, she greeted everyone in "Yajing's Curated Styling Group", posted a highlight replay of today's livestream, and @-mentioned all the customers who had joined, asking about their interest in the new trench coat.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: When the time came, Song Yajing hung up the “Temporarily Closed” sign early, closed the store door, and walked with an umbrella to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Aqiang: “I’ll cook tonight. Just bring back a pack of the time-honored oolong tea from that brand we mentioned last time.”
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied daughter to a stationery store
description: After picking up her daughter, Song Yajing did not go straight home but, as promised, took Xuanxuan to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. The rain had just stopped and the air was fresh. Xuanxuan happily browsed in the store and finally chose a pack of dinosaur-themed cartoon stickers. Song Yajing promised she could stick them on her water cup tonight.
location: South Gongyuan Road Stationery Store, No. 35 South Gongyuan Road, Phase 2, Yubin City, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy groceries on the way home
description: Considering there were still enough vegetables in the fridge, Song Yajing only dropped by the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way, buying her daughter's favorite cod sausages, a box of fresh mushrooms, and a bunch of spring onions, planning to make chicken with mushrooms in the evening.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing first let her daughter play with stickers alone in the living room, then put on an apron and began to prepare dinner. She deftly handled the chicken, sliced the shiitake mushrooms, and cooked rice with diced carrots that Xuanxuan loved in the rice cooker. The aroma of food wafted from the kitchen.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner time
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work with a pack of time-honored oolong tea. The family of three sat at the dining table for dinner. During the meal, Xuanxuan excitedly shared the dinosaur stickers she had bought that day with her father, while Song Yajing casually mentioned that only a few people watched the afternoon livestream but she received encouragement. Chen Zhiqiang comforted her, "Take it slow. It will be fine after a few more practices."
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-meal relaxation, keeping my daughter company, and putting her to sleep
description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to do the dishes. In the living room, Song Yajing played with Xuanxuan using newly bought stickers. At her daughter's request, she put a T. rex sticker on her little water cup. Then she read the Dumbo picture book that they hadn't finished the night before, and Xuanxuan listened with great interest. Afterwards, she helped Xuanxuan wash up and changed her into dinosaur pajamas. After the story, she gently patted her and sang a simple lullaby until her breathing became steady and she fell asleep.
location: Living room of home and Chen Lexuan's room, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Participate in the church Bible reading group's online sharing
description: Song Yajing took out her phone, plugged in her earphones, and joined the WeChat group voice call of the church's Bible reading group on time. Following yesterday's @ reminder from Aunt Lin Xiuying, the group owner, she volunteered to read aloud a passage from the Book of Proverbs, and, combining it with her experience of trying new things today (making videos and livestreaming), shared her reflections on the phrase 'the diligent will be satisfied.' Aunt Lin then left a voice message of encouragement: 'Yajing, we have all seen your persistence. The Lord will make a way for hardworking people.' Other church members also sent blessing stickers, and she felt a warmth in her heart.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple taking a walk on a rainy night.
description: After the online sharing ended, her husband Chen Zhiqiang suggested going out for a walk while their daughter was asleep. The night air after the rain was especially fresh and moist. The two walked slowly along the quiet sidewalk of Hubin South Road under the same umbrella. They didn't talk about the shop's revenue or their daughter's education, but chatted about the newly opened bakery on the street, the fruit stall next door that had changed owners, and when they might go to see a movie. This kind of plain companionship made Song Yajing feel grounded.
location: Sidewalk along Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening tea, journaling, and bedtime preparations.
description: After returning home, Chen Zhiqiang brewed a cup of oolong tea for each of them with the newly purchased tea. Song Yajing sat on the sofa, took out her journal, and quickly wrote down today's reflections: "Making videos isn't as scary as I imagined, but I still need to practice my expressions; during my second livestream, someone left an encouraging message, which warmed my heart; Aunt Lin's words really touched me." After writing, she jotted down the day's revenue and new community members. Then she washed up and did a serious 15-minute neck and shoulder stretch. At 10:35 pm, she changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and wrote tomorrow's to-dos in the notes app on her phone: message Susan to confirm the logistics of a batch of spring new arrivals. Then she turned off the bedside lamp, made the sign of the cross in the dark, and prayed softly, grateful for a safe day and asking for guidance for tomorrow's work and family. Before bed, she quickly scrolled through the "Yajing Curated Outfits Group" and saw two newly joined customers greeting the group. She immediately replied with a voice message welcoming them and invited them to visit the store for a fitting another day. Then she set her phone down with peace of mind and fell asleep.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation, school drop-off, and shopping
description: Got up at 7:50 a.m., did some simple stretches in bed, then went to the kitchen to quickly prepare breakfast: oatmeal, fried eggs, and sliced apples. Then I did morning prayers in front of the statue of the Virgin Mary in the living room, asking the Lord for strength and peace. After that, I gently woke my daughter Xuanxuan, helped her wash up and braid her hair, and checked her schoolbag to make sure all her craft materials were packed. After breakfast with my daughter, I set off on foot at 8:20 to take her to school. On the way, she chatted excitedly about the spring-themed painting she would make today. We arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten around 8:35, and I watched her enter the school. Then I walked to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and, at my daughter's request, bought a bottle of children's glue, and also picked up a black marker for myself.
location: Home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District; Gongyuan South Road Stationery Store, Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District

name: Morning store opening and business.
description: After leaving the stationery store, she stopped by Jianmin Tuina Clinic (near Zhonghua City on Zhongshan Road) on the way and took a photo of the doorplate to confirm the afternoon appointment. Then she walked to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After opening the store, she first checked the short video draft shot yesterday, found the lighting too dim, and decided to reshoot in the morning. Then she adjusted the window mannequin's spring lightweight trench coat and floral skirt display to ensure the styling was coordinated. At 9:15, the store officially opened. At 9:30, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, and she quickly went over the day's tasks with her. Around 9:50, she spent 20 minutes setting up her phone again by the window and reshot a 15-second video in natural light featuring a spring knit top with a tulle skirt, smiling naturally. She posted it on the store's WeChat Channels and Moments with the caption: "Good Wednesday! Start a light spring with a trench coat." She then used WeChat to confirm with supplier Susan the delivery of the spring new dress collection, expected to arrive tomorrow. From 10:30 to 11:00, two groups of customers came in, and she successfully recommended and sold a pair of high-waisted wide-leg pants. Around 11:30, nearing noon, she told Xiaomei that she was going for shoulder and neck physiotherapy at noon and expected to be back around 1:30. She left Xiaomei to mind the store alone, briefly handing over the morning sales records and pending community group messages, and told her to actively recommend the newly posted spring styling video if any customers asked about it.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday massage and light meal
description: At 11:40, she walked about 10 minutes to Jianmin Tuina Clinic, and the reserved 60-minute shoulder and neck physiotherapy started on time. When the therapist pressed the Fengchi acupoint and trapezius muscles, she felt severe stiffness. After hot compresses, pressing, and meridian massage, her muscles were sore but she felt much more relaxed. At 12:35, when paying, she set a reminder in her phone memo for physiotherapy on the 12th of every month and recorded it under the 'Health Maintenance' section of the family ledger. After the massage, she rested in the waiting area for 5 minutes, then walked to the 85°C Bakery Cafe next door and ordered a pearl milk tea and a tuna sandwich for lunch. Sitting on a high stool by the window, she replied to a customer's WeChat inquiry about clothing sizes while browsing messages in the community group.
location: Jianmin Tuina Hall near Zhonghua City, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; and 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City, 189 Siming South Road

name: Afternoon operations and salon preparation.
description: After lunch, she walked back to the store holding a milk tea. On the way, she also picked up a black tea latte for Xiaomei at 85°C. She returned to the store at 13:15 and handed the milk tea to Xiaomei. From 13:30 to 14:00, she sorted the storeroom and shelves with Xiaomei, placing best-selling items and slow-moving items in separate areas to make room for the new stock arriving tomorrow. From 14:00 to 15:00, she used WeChat to make final confirmations with florist Zhao Li about the details of the 'Spring Flower Language' crossover salon on March 15 (Saturday): checking the finalized event poster, finalizing the flower list (white tulips, chamomile, eucalyptus leaves), and the venue decoration plan. From 15:00 to 16:30, she posted a message with pictures in the 'Yajing Premium Outfit Selection Group,' recommending a professional look suitable for the recent weather, and chatted with several active customers. During this time she received three customers who came into the store, one of whom bought two dresses. She closed the store at 16:30, asked Xiaomei to tidy the cashier area and the fitting room, and prepared to go pick up her daughter.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and go shopping
description: At 16:30 she walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and picked up her daughter Xuanxuan at 16:40. The mother and daughter walked home, stopping at the grocery store beside Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way. They bought fresh lettuce, a bunch of scallions, and a bag of dried noodles as a backup dinner option, in case they needed to go out to celebrate, and also bought Xuanxuan a box of strawberry yogurt. Then they continued walking home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road

name: Going home and waiting for good news
description: Got home at 17:15 and let Xuanxuan play with building blocks and watch cartoons in the living room. Sent a WeChat message to her husband Aqiang asking when he would be back; he replied that he would be home around seven and had good news, and told her not to cook. So she gave up the idea of cooking, tidied the room a bit, and then read Xuanxuan’s favorite picture book with her. Around 18:45, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home earlier than usual and excitedly announced the company’s annual technical rating results as soon as he walked in: he had been promoted one level, his monthly salary had increased by 8%, and he had applied to transfer all the extra money into the family joint account. The family hugged in happy surprise, and their daughter ran over and climbed onto his leg. The living room was filled with the relaxed laughter that had been absent for a long time.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Celebratory dinner and a walk.
description: The family decided to go out to celebrate. At 19:00, they walked to the Gangtongwu Korean BBQ (Zhonghua City branch), the restaurant Xuanxuan wanted to go to. They ordered pork belly, grilled beef tongue, cheese corn, and bibimbap. Song Yajing made an exception and ordered a small glass of homemade plum wine for herself. The whole family grilled the meat together. Xuanxuan wrapped the meat in lettuce leaves, but the packages came out crooked, making everyone laugh. The meal lasted nearly two hours; they ate a bit too much, but their hearts felt light and warm. At 20:45, after paying the bill, they walked home and deliberately took a detour to Jiaxingyuan Park, letting Xuanxuan run and jump on the lawn to help digest the meal. The family of three sat on a park bench for a while, chatting casually about the future. At around 21:15, they walked home slowly hand in hand.
location: Gangtongwu Korean BBQ (Zhonghua City Branch), No. 195 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; and Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District.

name: Evening family time
description: After getting home, I bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into pajamas. At 21:45 I read her two picture books, gently drew a small cross on her forehead, and watched her fall asleep. At 22:00 I went back to the living room and shared with my husband how the massage felt today and my plan for regular monthly physical therapy. He was very supportive, and the two of us sat quietly enjoying this rare, relaxed evening.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and bedtime preparation.
description: In her journal, she recorded the evening's joy and gratitude: for her husband's promotion and for her body's relaxation. She wrote down tomorrow's to-dos: confirm logistics and follow up on salon materials. Then she did a serious 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch. Afterwards, she said her bedtime prayers, giving thanks for today's blessings and praying for her family's safety and happiness.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime tidying and going to sleep
description: Before turning off the light, I quickly browsed the last few messages in the store's community group and the backend data, confirmed there were no urgent matters, then set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning. I turned off the light and went to sleep at 23:15, ending this full, relaxed, and hopeful day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family routine and breakfast
description: In the early morning, I was woken by the phone alarm. After getting up and washing up, I returned to a corner of the bedroom for morning prayers, giving thanks for the good news of my husband Aqiang's pay raise and praying for peace for today's family health matters and for my parents and older sister far away in Quanzhou. Then I went into the kitchen, took out bread, eggs, cheese slices, and milk from the fridge, and heated the milk while frying eggs. I also went to my daughter Xuanxuan's bedroom and gently woke her, enticing her to get up by promising to buy her stickers. The family of three sat around the table to enjoy sandwiches and milk. Aqiang told us that his technical grade had been upgraded with an 8% salary increase and that he would transfer the money into the joint account. I confirmed with relief that the loan repayment pressure had eased. Xuanxuan praised her dad as the best, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking daughter to school and buying stickers
description: The weather was clear and sunny. Holding hands, we walked Xuanxuan to kindergarten, deliberately taking a detour to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. Amid the dazzling array of stickers, my daughter picked a 3D dinosaur sticker. I paid 5 yuan, and she happily stuck it on her water bottle. Then we delivered her safely to Siming Experimental Kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Teeth cleaning at the dental hospital and family health appointment
description: After scanning the QR code to unlock a shared bike near the kindergarten, I rode along Zhenhai Road for about 12 minutes and arrived at the Douxi Branch of Xiamen Stomatological Hospital. I completed the annual teeth cleaning smoothly in the dental department on the fourth floor. The doctor found wear on the edge of the old filling material on the lower left sixth molar and recommended a check-up in six months. I then asked the nurse to help book dental checkups for my husband and daughter during the summer vacation, and forwarded the booking confirmation text to Aqiang with a message saying the appointments had been made. Walking out of the hospital, I felt a sense of security from building a health defense line for my family.
location: Xiamen Stomatological Hospital (Douxi Branch), No. 2 Douxi West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store work and customer reception.
description: I walked out of the dental hospital and returned to the shop on Zhongshan Road. On the way, I sent a WeChat voice message to my elder sister Song Yawen, arranging to discuss my mother's birthday by video at noon. After arriving at the shop, I sorted the newly arrived spring clothes with the shop assistant Xiaomei and used a steam iron to press creases into the trousers. Regular customer Vivian came with her colleague. I recommended outfit combinations based on their temperaments. Vivian reserved a floral-print dress, and her colleague bought a commuter blazer on the spot.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break
description: At noon she went alone to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City, ordered a Caesar salad and a hot Americano, and sat in a corner by the window on the second floor, browsing fashion news and baking tutorials on her phone while eating, looking for inspiration for the upcoming weekend salon.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video called with my older sister to discuss our mother's birthday gift.
description: Back in the shop's rest area, I video-called my sister Song Yawen, who was far away in Shenzhen. After a brief greeting, I got straight to the point: discussing our mother's birthday gift next month. Yawen suggested we jointly buy a high-end neck and shoulder massager to relieve my mother's back pain. I thought it was practical and heartwarming, so I offered to pay for it while my sister would handle selecting and ordering it, and I immediately transferred my share via WeChat.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon shop operations and online community interaction
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers in the shop, so I focused on preparing for the cross-industry salon on March 15. Based on the plan confirmed with Zhao Li, I sketched the booth layout in my notebook, matched the spring trench coats and dresses, took photos and sent them to Zhao Li to confirm the color scheme, and at the same time updated the new product detail pages in the backend of the online store. Then I shared today's new spring outfit try-on photos and styling suggestions in the "Yajing Premium Outfit Group," patiently answered questions from group members, and replied to styling inquiries in other customer groups.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: As kindergarten dismissal time approached, she tidied up the shop together with Xiaomei and reminded her to remember to put away the delivery note for the salon floral materials tomorrow. Then she walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter and buy groceries on the way
description: After picking up Xuanxuan, she did not go straight home but detoured to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She asked her daughter to help choose the tomatoes she wanted for dinner, while she picked up a box of eggs, a bunch of lettuce, and a bundle of dried noodles. At checkout, Xuanxuan saw the new strawberry milkshake cup and stared at it longingly, so she bought one for her too.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child cartoon time and dinner preparation.
description: After getting home, I let Xuanxuan watch cartoons in the living room for 15 minutes, then changed into loungewear, tied on an apron, and went into the kitchen. I quickly washed vegetables, cut tomatoes, beat eggs, put a pot on to boil, cooked a pot of tomato and egg noodles, and also blanched a small plate of greens.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family enjoys dinner together
description: Aqiang came home from work, and the whole family sat together eating tomato and egg noodles. I casually shared the results of my dental visit and told them I had booked summer oral checkups for the whole family. Aqiang nodded, saying his teeth had indeed been a bit sensitive lately. Xuanxuan excitedly chimed in, reminding us that tomorrow we were going to the science museum to see the big dinosaurs. The atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying science museum tickets and family science warm-up activities.
description: Aqiang cleared the dining table, while I held Xuanxuan and curled up on the sofa. I bought 'two adults and one child' early bird tickets for tomorrow morning's session through the Xiamen Science and Technology Museum official account and completed the payment. Then I cast a science video about dinosaur skeletons and mirror mazes to the screen. Xuanxuan jumped excitedly on the sofa, looking forward to the family outing. I also checked the DSLR camera, confirmed the battery was fully charged, and put it in the backpack by the door.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime activities for daughter and getting her to sleep
description: She sat with Xuanxuan at the little desk playing with the newly bought 3D dinosaur sticker book, guiding her in applying stickers and recognizing numbers. Then she helped her wash up and change into pajamas, picked up the Dinosaur Encyclopedia picture book, and sat by the little bed reading the story in a gentle voice. After finishing the picture book, she gently patted her back and hummed a song. When her daughter's breathing became steady and she fell asleep, she quietly turned off the light and closed the door.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and finishing up household chores.
description: Put the kitchen dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher, and cleaned the stove, sink, and dining table. Then went to the bathroom to wash up, applied toner and eye cream, and did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch using the moves learned yesterday, feeling the soreness in her shoulders and neck noticeably relieved.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening planning and journaling
description: She sat down at the desk and opened her journal, carefully writing down today's keywords: "Dentist visit, family appointment, Sister Wen's video (massage device payment already transferred), science museum tickets. Tomorrow's plan: science museum (camera ready), wrap up Saturday salon, call Mom." After writing, she pressed her palms together and said a brief bedtime prayer of gratitude, thanking [the universe] for all of today's small blessings.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening community interaction and preparation for tomorrow's outing
description: Leaning against the headboard, she shared a photo of Xuanxuan watching a science popularization video in the Yajing's Selected Outfit Group, with a caption to spark a discussion about weekend family activities, while also replying to several customers' late-night outfit inquiries. Then she got up and checked the backpack for tomorrow's science museum trip one more time: water bottle, small snacks, wet wipes, and a DSLR camera — all there on the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: I dimmed the bedside lamp and saw the image my sister posted in the family group showing that the massage device had been ordered, and I replied with a hug emoji. Looking back on this fulfilling day: my dental health was taken care of, family health was included in the plan, my mother's gift was finally settled, tomorrow's family activity was fully prepared, and Aqiang's pay raise brought even more reassurance. I felt grateful and calm inside, my breathing gradually steadied, and I fell asleep at 22:00.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning prayer and morning preparations
description: In the early morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm rang and opened the curtains to greet the sunlight. She first knelt by the bed for morning prayer, thanking the Lord for the peace granted and praying for a smooth visit to the science museum. After praying, she did 15 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on a yoga mat. Then she changed into the family outfits agreed upon with her daughter and husband—cream-colored knit tops paired with light blue silk scarves.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up daughter and have breakfast with the family.
description: Song Yajing walked into her daughter Chen Lexuan's room, gently woke her up, and used the anticipation of seeing dinosaur skeletons to motivate her daughter to get out of bed. In the dining room, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared fried eggs, sausages, and milk. The family had breakfast together in a warm atmosphere. Yajing reminded her husband to fully charge his phone for taking photos, and checked the contents of her own backpack.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off for Xiamen Science and Technology Museum.
description: Song Yajing packed her backpack, putting in a water bottle, a change of clothes, snacks, and wet wipes, and confirmed the tickets and reservation code. The family of three took a ride-hailing car from the community gate to Xiamen Science and Technology Museum. On the way, her daughter Xuanxuan excitedly leaned against the car window asking questions about dinosaurs and the mirror maze.
location: Xiamen Science and Technology Museum, No. 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child exploration at the Science and Technology Museum
description: The family of three scanned the reservation code to enter the Xiamen Science and Technology Museum and headed straight for the Children's Science Paradise. Chen Lexuan excitedly darted through the mirror maze while Yajing chased after her laughing. At the virtual water flow wall, Xuanxuan blocked the water with her hand and watched it overflow the dam; father and daughter marveled. During the simulated earthquake experience, Xuanxuan got scared and hugged her mother's legs. Yajing squatted down to comfort her, calling it the earth dancing a twist. Afterwards they played in the ocean ball pit, and Aqiang used his phone to snap many moments of mother and daughter laughing. The whole morning was filled with scientific exploration and parent-child interaction.
location: Xiamen Science and Technology Museum, No. 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and rest at the Science and Technology Museum
description: The family had lunch at the “Exploration Tribe” themed restaurant inside the science and technology museum. Yajing ordered the “Astronaut Exploration Combo” for her daughter, which included dinosaur rice balls, waffle fries, and orange juice. While eating, Xuanxuan excitedly described the morning’s discoveries to her father. Yajing used her husband’s phone to take photos of her daughter, and when she checked the backpack, she found that her daughter’s spare T-shirt had been forgotten.
location: Exploration Tribe Theme Restaurant, Xiamen Science and Technology Museum, No. 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family separation and the decision to act alone
description: After lunch, Chen Zhiqiang held the somewhat sleepy Xuanxuan and decided to take her home for an afternoon nap. Yajing had wanted to go back with them, but she remembered she needed to go to Zhongshan Road to find accessory inspiration for the clothing store, so she discussed it with her husband. Aqiang thoughtfully let Yajing go on her own and took charge of bringing the child home. The family of three parted at the taxi pickup point. Yajing watched them get into the car, then headed to Zhongshan Road alone.
location: Taxi pickup point near Xiamen Science and Technology Museum, No. 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going alone to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street
description: Song Yajing left the Science and Technology Museum, took Metro Line 2 to Zhenhai Road Station, and then walked to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, she called her shop assistant Xiao Mei to check on the store. After reaching Zhongshan Road, she first bought an iced latte at the 85°C Zhonghua City bakery on the corner to refresh herself and prepare for the upcoming shopping.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Choosing accessories on Zhongshan Road
description: Yajing entered the familiar accessory wholesale area on Zhongshan Road and moved through the various stalls. At a Korean-style shop, she carefully selected a slender scarf clasp in mother-of-pearl color, held it against her chest to check the styling effect, and felt it was perfect for the newly arrived French-style blouses in the store. She used the old phone her husband had left behind to photograph the details and asked the wholesale price, while thinking about how to use these accessories for styling at tomorrow's salon.
location: Accessory wholesale area, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Phone suddenly stolen.
description: As Yajing squatted down to look at the leather card holders on the bottom shelf, she reached into the side pocket of her handbag and found her phone missing. Her mind went blank instantly, and her heart felt like it had been struck hard. In a panic, she searched through every compartment and confirmed that her phone had been stolen. She rushed into the nearby milk tea shop, borrowed the staff's landline, and with trembling hands called her husband, telling him in a tearful voice that her phone had been stolen.
location: In front of an accessory store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband arrived and urgently handled the loss report.
description: In less than twenty minutes, her husband Chen Zhiqiang arrived by taxi, out of breath, and gave Yajing a tight hug first. He calmly asked about the linked bank cards and credit cards, quickly used his own phone to call bank customer service, and helped Yajing report all related accounts as lost. He then dialed 110 to call the police. Yajing gradually calmed down through his handling.
location: A milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reporting the case, replacing the card, and buying a new phone
description: Following the police officer's guidance, the couple walked to Zhongshan Road Police Station to give statements and obtained a case receipt. They then went to the nearby China Mobile branch on Siming South Road and got a replacement SIM card for Yajing. Finally, they went to the Huawei authorized experience store on the first floor of Zhonghua City South Zone. At the salesperson's recommendation, Yajing bought a new phone with HarmonyOS. A Qiang used his phone hotspot to help complete the basic activation of the new phone.
location: Zhongshan Road Police Station, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; China Mobile business hall (Siming South Road store); Huawei authorized experience store (1st floor, South Zone, Zhonghua City, 181 Siming South Road)

name: Returning home
description: After all the procedures were completed, Aqiang drove Yajing home. Sitting in the passenger seat, she finally felt the lingering fear and exhaustion; her whole body went limp and she stayed silent. Aqiang comforted her softly while driving, promising to find a way to recover the data. Looking at his focused profile, Yajing felt a lump in her throat and was deeply moved.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home to rest and starting data recovery
description: After returning home, Yajing first went to the bedroom to check on her daughter, who was sleeping soundly. Aqiang changed clothes, opened the computer in the study, logged into Yajing's iCloud account, and tried to download the backup data. In the living room, Yajing used her new phone to log in to basic apps such as WeChat and Alipay, and sent important chat records to her husband to help with recovery.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Yajing pulled herself together and cooked a pot of tomato and egg noodles with the ingredients in the fridge, plus a stir-fried green vegetable. When her daughter Xuanxuan woke up and saw both her parents at home, she happily recounted what she had seen at the science museum and the fun of the afternoon games. Yajing tried to force a smile and respond, serving food to her family, while Aqiang silently refilled her soup.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Aqiang recovered the data, Yajing accompanied her daughter.
description: After dinner, Aqiang continued debugging the computer and cloud data in the study, but recovery progressed slowly. Yajing bathed her daughter as usual, put her in dinosaur pajamas, and held her while reading “Dinosaur Encyclopedia” to her. After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing returned to the living room and wrote about the day's ups and downs in her diary, thanking her husband for his company. Then she carried warm milk and nuts, walked quietly into the study, and set them down on Aqiang's desk.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night conversation between the couple
description: Aqiang kept organizing customer data and supplier chat records in the study until nearly 11 p.m. After washing up, Yajing said her bedtime prayers on her new phone. Aqiang came out of the study and, with bloodshot eyes, told her that most of the customer data and purchase orders had been recovered, and that photos and videos would continue the next day. The two hugged on the sofa; Yajing buried her face in her husband's chest and softly thanked him. Aqiang comforted her gently, and their bond felt even deeper after getting through the difficulties together.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Yajing let Aqiang take a shower first, and she lay in bed briefly editing some of the photos recovered today on her new phone as a keepsake. When Aqiang finished, the two hugged each other and returned to the bedroom, then turned off the light. In the dark, Yajing silently thanked the Lord for His arrangement. After the ordeal of the stolen phone, the couple leaned on each other more tightly and fell asleep in each other's arms.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning prayer and body awareness.
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, tiptoed to the prayer corner in the living room, lit an aromatherapy candle, and knelt on a soft cushion to begin morning prayer, thanking God for the new day and expressing gratitude for the help received yesterday. Afterward, she stepped on the scale and recorded her weight as 51.2 kg, then did simple shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the tension from yesterday.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare breakfast for the family.
description: She took ingredients out of the fridge, used a mold to make heart-shaped fried eggs for her daughter, toasted bread, and cut strawberries. She gently woke her daughter, helped her wash up, and dressed her in a white T-shirt; she also woke her husband, who had been napping in the study. The family sat around the dining table enjoying breakfast as morning sunlight streamed in, quiet and warm.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Discussed rescheduling the flower-arranging salon
description: After breakfast, she sent a voice message on her new phone to florist Zhao Li, saying that because her phone had been stolen yesterday and she was still feeling unsettled, she asked to postpone the afternoon salon to next week. Zhao Li understood and agreed to reschedule it to March 23. She then noted in her memo to notify the customers who had already signed up.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Get changed and get ready to go out
description: Changed into a light beige cotton-linen dress and a white knit cardigan, and put on dusty rose lipstick. Checked my belongings: new phone, keys, loose change, and a reusable bag. Told my husband, then walked out.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Traveling to Gulangyu Island
description: The weather was fine, so she decided to walk to the ferry terminal along Hubin South Road, Zhenhai Road, and Lujiang Road, enjoying the quiet morning. She arrived at the terminal after about 45 minutes. She took the ferry by swiping her e-Tong Card, sat by the window, and watched the sparkling sea, gradually feeling calmer.
location: Walk from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via Lujiang Road to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, then take the ferry to Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Stepping into Gulangyu Catholic Church, attended the solemn Sunday Mass. After Mass, talked with Father Wang Mingde and mentioned the experience of having my phone stolen; the priest comforted and blessed me. Auntie Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, gave me a silver holy medal, shared her own past experiences, and offered warm encouragement.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return and buy lunch to bring home.
description: After Mass, she went to the takeout window of the Gulangyu Fujian Restaurant on Longtou Road and bought satay noodles and fried five-spice rolls for the family's lunch. She then took a ferry from Sanqiutian Pier back to Xiamen Ferry Terminal and told her husband via WeChat that she would be home soon. After disembarking, she walked home along Lujiang Road and Zhongshan Road, making no stops along the way.
location: From Gulangyu Catholic Church, went via Longtou Road and Sanqiutian Pier, took a ferry to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, then walked along Lujiang Road and Zhongshan Road to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family lunch and a nap.
description: When she got home, her daughter greeted her cheerfully. She set out the bought satay noodles and fried five-spice rolls on the table, and reheated the pork rib and corn soup. The family ate and chatted, and her husband shared the new maintenance project he had taken on. After the meal, she coaxed her daughter to take a nap and they agreed on the afternoon plans.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying phone accessories.
description: While her daughter was taking a nap, she rode a shared bike to the digital accessories store on the second floor of Buynow Electronics City. She carefully picked out a dark green liquid silicone drop-proof case and a high-definition tempered glass screen protector, and had the store owner apply the screen protector. She also bought a car phone mount and a spare data cable to give the new phone complete protection.
location: Buynow (Xiamen Store), 76 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked out picture books for her daughter.
description: I walked from Buynow to Waitu Book City, went straight to the children's science section, recalled my daughter's smile at the mirror maze in the science museum, and carefully picked out two picture books, 'Uncovering Physics: Light and Shadow' and 'How Shadows Are Formed.' I also found them interesting when I flipped through them, briefly forgetting my worries.
location: Wai Tu Xiamen Book City, 809 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase ingredients and walk home
description: Walked to the Yonghui Life convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought dinner ingredients: tomatoes, eggs, dried noodles, lettuce, scallions, as well as the strawberry yogurt her daughter loves and the unsweetened oolong tea her husband prefers. Then carried the shopping bags and walked about two minutes back to the community.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Zhenhai Road Metro Station convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, and walking to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Giving picture books and family time.
description: Back home, her daughter had just woken up from her nap. She mysteriously produced two new picture books, and her daughter was delighted. Holding her close, she looked through Physics Revealed together, explaining how mirror images are formed and revisiting the previous day's visit to the science and technology museum. Meanwhile, her husband was adjusting the projector nearby, preparing for the evening movie.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing and cooking dinner.
description: I put on an apron and entered the kitchen. First, I prepped the ingredients: peeled and chopped tomatoes, beat the eggs, and washed the lettuce and spring onions. Meanwhile, after settling our daughter, my husband came over to help wash the dishes, and the two of us chatted softly about the movie and the salon arrangements. Then I stir-fried seasonal vegetables on my own, cooked noodles in a tomato soup base, drizzled in beaten egg, sprinkled scallions, and drizzled sesame oil, and added a fried egg and luncheon meat for my husband.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family movie night
description: Dinner was brought to the coffee table, the lights were dimmed, and the projector played Zootopia. The family sat together, eating tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables while watching the animation. My daughter imitated Judy the rabbit and Flash the sloth, making the whole family burst into laughter. All the tiredness and unease melted away in the laughter.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daughter's bedtime routine.
description: After the movie, she gave her daughter a hot bath and changed her into pajamas. The mother and daughter picked out a new picture book, How Shadows Are Formed, and she read it in a gentle voice while the daughter giggled from time to time. Finally, they said bedtime prayers, she gently stroked her daughter's head and said goodnight, and the daughter fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family financial reconciliation
description: In the study, she and her husband spread open the account books and bookkeeping app to handle this week's store transactions, the Women's Day profit share of 1,760 yuan, her husband's salary, and estimated income from the new project. They confirmed the education fund was set aside and budgeted for next week's store restocking and household expenses. Finally, she noted in her journal to notify about the salon rescheduling, contact suppliers, and organize photos.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Self-relaxation and journaling
description: On the yoga mat in the living room, she did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and reviewed the ups and downs of the past two days. Then she sat down at her desk, opened her journal, and wrote down the warmth of the day: the priest's blessing, a fellow parishioner's holy medal, her husband's support, and her daughter's smiling face. She noted her to-do items and the reflection, “When the heart faces the light, shadows naturally fall behind you,” and regained her inner calm.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I knelt by the bed holding the rose rosary and said bedtime prayers for my family, the shop, and everyone who has helped us, asking for a safe and smooth new week. Around 22:45 I lay down; my husband had already turned off the light beside me. I felt his breathing, my heart full of gratitude, and silently said 'Thank the Lord.' At 23:00 I closed my eyes and slept soundly, without a single dream.
location: Home, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning prayer and preparations
description: Morning light came through the curtains. After waking up, Yajing habitually whispered the Rosary by her pillow, offering prayers for the day's church Mass and her family's safety. After praying, she got up, opened the curtains, washed up briefly, and changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and enjoying a simple breakfast.
description: Yajing prepared toast, fried eggs, and hot milk for the family. While busy in the kitchen, she gently woke up her husband Aqiang and daughter Xuanxuan. The family of three sat down at the table. Yajing carefully spread Xuanxuan's favorite strawberry jam on her bread, while Aqiang brought up a documentary about data security he had watched last night, and the two chatted a bit more about the importance of backing up phone data.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packing up and heading out.
description: After the meal, Yajing changed into an elegant dress and low-cut shoes, slung her usual commuter canvas bag over her shoulder, which held her beloved rosary beads and a small Bible. She told Aqiang to take Xuanxuan downstairs to play for a while, and mentioned that her Mass would end around 10:30. Aqiang nodded and put a sun hat on his daughter. Yajing kissed her daughter's cheek, picked up her keys, and went out.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the Catholic Church on Gulangyu Island
description: On Sunday morning, the streets were quiet and the air was fresh. Since she had agreed with her fellow church members the day before, Yajing decided to walk there—it would let her get some exercise and also calm her mind along the way. She set off from home, walked east along Hubin South Road, crossed Zhongshan Road, and boarded the ferry to Gulangyu near the ferry terminal (about a 10-minute boat ride). After getting off the ferry, she walked along Lujiao Road, looking at the international-style buildings in the morning light, and felt especially peaceful inside.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with fellow parishioners.
description: Yajing stepped into this familiar century-old church, devoutly made the sign of the cross before the statue of the Virgin Mary, and found a seat near the front. At 9:15, Mass officially began. Father Wang's sermon theme was "Through Tribulations in the Hope of the Resurrection." She thought of the panic of having her phone stolen last week, but at this moment she felt immense peace and surrender. After Mass, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying from the Bible study class in the church courtyard. Aunt Lin asked with concern how the phone matter was going, and Yajing shared how her husband had helped recover the data. Aunt Lin held her hand and said, "Yajing, misfortune and fortune are intertwined. This is God helping you declutter and let go, so you can focus on what matters more. The store and the family are both well; that is the greatest grace." Yajing felt her eyes grow slightly warm, nodded repeatedly, and chatted with Aunt Lin and several other churchgoers under the wisteria trellis for about ten minutes about everyday life.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home on foot and by ferry
description: Coming out of the church, Yajing felt much more relaxed. She slowly walked back to the pier along Lujiao Road. Passing the Gulangyu Min cuisine restaurant, she thought of Aunt Lin's invitation, but she still chose to go home today. She took the ferry back to Xiamen Island, and after getting off, she walked home along the way she had come. On the way, she passed a small flower shop and saw that the gardenias in front of the shop were blooming beautifully, so she picked three buds about to blossom. The shopkeeper gave her one extra. Holding the flowers, she felt filled with anticipation for the upcoming arrangements.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband and wife collaborated to complete cloud backup of customer data
description: After returning home, Yajing put the gardenias into a glass vase, changed the water, and placed them on the living room coffee table. Then she went into the study, where A Qiang had already turned on the computer and her new phone, waiting. A Qiang patiently taught her how to use WeChat Work's backup feature to automatically upload customer contacts from her address book to the cloud. Yajing sat beside him and operated carefully. When they came across a few numbers with unclear notes, she tried hard to recall and checked them together with A Qiang. In less than fifty minutes, the task that had made her anxious all weekend was declared complete. Watching the progress bar finish and the system prompt "Backup successful", Yajing let out a big sigh of relief and gave A Qiang a tight hug.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cooking and enjoying a family lunch.
description: After finishing the backup, Yajing was in a great mood. She tied on an apron and decided to make the seafood soup noodles the whole family loved. She skillfully cleaned the clams, fresh shrimp, and small squid, and used the shrimp heads to simmer a golden, rich broth. Then she added the noodles and finally sprinkled on fresh green scallions and cilantro. Aqiang came back upstairs with Xuanxuan after playing downstairs, and the smell made both of them exclaim that they were hungry. The family of three sat around the dining table and ate the hot seafood noodles heartily with garlic sauce. Xuanxuan's little cheeks were stuffed full, and Aqiang, in a rare moment, praised Yajing's cooking.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon rest and preparation to go out.
description: After the meal, Yajing cleared the dishes and chopsticks, while Aqiang swept the floor. Xuanxuan excitedly hugged her water bottle and small rubber ball, urging everyone to go out and play. Yajing changed Xuanxuan into a light jacket, put on her own sneakers and a sun hat, and packed a bottle of water, a pack of wet wipes, and a spare pair of pants for Xuanxuan into her canvas bag.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family leisure time at the park
description: The family of three walked about half an hour to Bailuzhou Park. The afternoon sun was warm but not scorching, and the grass was a lush green. Xuanxuan, like a little rabbit, immediately broke free from her father's hand and ran onto the grass to chase a white butterfly. Yajing and Aqiang sat down on a bench beside the lawn. Leaning her head on Aqiang's shoulder, Yajing watched their daughter's cheerful figure and chatted about the store's spring renovation plans, such as bringing in French-style spring clothes with floral prints and lace elements, as well as the details of next week's cross-industry salon with Zhao Li. Aqiang also suggested that she use her new phone to shoot more outfit videos and post them in the community. This quiet outdoor afternoon was serene and beautiful.
location: Xiamen Bailuzhou Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Park walk and return trip
description: Tired from playing, Xuanxuan ran back, took her water bottle from her mother's bag, and drank big gulps. The family of three slowly strolled home along the lakeside path in the park. On the way, Aqiang told Xuanxuan a story about the swans in the lake, while Yajing used her phone to take a few photos of her daughter and husband from behind, capturing this warm moment.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child free activities and personal work
description: Back home, the energetic Xuanxuan was taken by Aqiang to ride her little pink bicycle in the open area downstairs in the residential complex. Yajing stayed quietly alone in the living room, opened the photo album on her new phone, and began sorting through some spring outfit notes and inspiration images she had saved earlier. She chose five bright, colorful looks suitable for daily commuting and weekend outings, fine-tuned the colors with a phone photo-editing app, and planned to post them to the customer WeChat group in the evening with a few lines of styling tips. After that, she used her phone memo to write down the list of props she needed to prepare for next week's salon, so she wouldn't forget.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and taking a rest.
description: Aqiang came back with Xuanxuan, who was sweating profusely. Yajing washed her face and hands. Then Yajing began preparing ingredients for dinner. She opened the fridge and took out the tomatoes, eggs, green peppers, and pork tenderloin she had bought earlier. While washing and chopping the vegetables, she planned the evening's menu: garlic broccoli, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, shredded pork with green peppers, and a simple seaweed egg drop soup. After prepping most of the dishes, she covered them with plastic wrap and left them to cook before dinner.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: Yajing put on an apron, turned on the heat, and heated the oil. Soon the kitchen was filled with the aroma of cooking. With quick, nimble hands she stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers and garlic broccoli, and poured a splash of vinegar around the edge of the wok for the tomato and egg dish, giving it a tangy-sweet flavor. When the meal was served, the family of three ate and chatted. Xuanxuan excitedly told her parents that she had made a new friend downstairs, Xiao Mei, who also attends a nearby kindergarten.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-meal cleanup and parent-child baking
description: After dinner, Yajing quickly loaded the dishes into the dishwasher and wiped down the stove. Then she took out a baking bowl, flour, powdered sugar, butter, and cookie cutters from the cupboard and set them on the dining table. Xuanxuan had already moved her little stool over and was waiting nearby with an expectant look. Yajing put the softened butter and powdered sugar into a large bowl and mixed them together with Xuanxuan using an electric hand mixer, watching the butter become fluffy and pale. Next, Yajing added egg yolks and cake flour in batches and kneaded the mixture into a smooth dough. She guided Xuanxuan's hands to roll out the dough with a rolling pin, then used bear, bunny, star, and other shaped cutters to press out cute cookie dough shapes.
