Xuanxuan's little hands were covered in flour, and she even secretly pinched off a small piece of dough and put it in her mouth. Yajing laughed, caught her dirty little hands, and sent her to wash up. After putting the cookies in the oven, the warm light inside and the butter aroma gradually filling the kitchen made the evening feel especially cozy. With a ding, the cookies were done. Yajing put on oven mitts, took out the golden cookies, and let them cool on a wire rack.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bedtime moments.
description: After the cookies were baked, Yajing and Xuanxuan decorated a few cookies with chocolate sauce, then the mother and daughter tasted the freshly baked crispy cookies together, and Xuanxuan got chocolate all over her face. Afterwards, Yajing helped Xuanxuan brush her teeth, wash her face, and change into cute pajamas. Then Yajing read Xuanxuan the newly bought picture book How Shadows Are Formed. She used her phone's flashlight to demonstrate light reflection on the wall. Xuanxuan listened with great interest and giggled from time to time. After the story, Yajing drew a cross on her daughter's forehead and said a short bedtime prayer for her, praying that she would grow up healthy and safe. Xuanxuan soon fell asleep with a smile.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal relaxation and health management
description: Coming out of her daughter's room, Yajing felt somewhat tired but fulfilled. She changed into comfortable pajamas, poured a glass of warm water, and sat cross-legged on the bedroom rug. She opened the fitness app on her phone and followed a 12-minute gentle shoulder and neck stretching routine, focusing on stretching the stiff back of her neck and trapezius muscles caused by looking down at her phone for long periods. After finishing, she felt much less sore in her shoulder blade area, and her whole body relaxed.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening review and community update
description: Yajing opened the customer WeChat group, edited the afternoon's carefully selected and laid-out photos of five spring outfits and text descriptions into one image-and-text message, chose 10 p.m. as the suitable push time, and clicked send. After that, she simply noted in her journal a few small happy things from today: 'Aqiang taught me to back up successfully; I feel at ease,' 'Xuanxuan's little rabbit cookies are so cute,' 'Chatting with Aunt Lin warmed my heart.'
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Yajing knelt by the bed, pressed her palms together, and closed her eyes. She gave thanks for the emotion she felt at today's Mass, rejoiced in her husband's reliability and her daughter's happiness, and felt at peace for having restored a sense of order to her life. She prayed for her family's safety, the smooth running of her store, and asked God to grant her wisdom to face difficulties that might arise in the future. When she finished praying, she softly said goodnight to Aqiang, who was also about to fall asleep, turned off the bedside lamp, and, lulled by her husband's steady breathing and the hazy moonlight outside the window, fell into a deep sleep with a peaceful smile.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, praying, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: At 6:50 a.m., the phone alarm rang on time. Song Yajing sat up, made the sign of the cross in the morning light, and whispered a prayer. After washing up, she deliberately changed into a coral pink knit cardigan, hoping it would bring good luck. Then she toasted bread, boiled milk, and fried a sunny-side-up egg for her daughter Xuanxuan. While the family was having breakfast, her husband Chen Zhiqiang said he would take their daughter to kindergarten today so that she could get to her important business earlier. After Aqiang and Xuanxuan left, Song Yajing checked the items in her bag in front of the mirror in the entryway, confirming that she had brought her ID card, the police station case receipt, and a backup customer list. She took a deep breath to encourage herself.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to the China Mobile service center and got a replacement SIM card.
description: At 7:50, she locked the door and walked along Zhenhai Road to the China Mobile service center. The street in the early morning was gradually coming to life; steam rose from the steamed bun shop. As she walked, she silently reviewed the replacement process. After arriving at the service center, she took a number and waited in line, handed over her ID card, and explained her purpose. Since she had reported the loss online the day before, the process went smoothly, and she got the new SIM card in about half an hour. After inserting it into her phone, the signal returned and text messages flooded in. She immediately sent a WeChat message to her husband to let him know it was done.
location: Walking from the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street to China Mobile Communications (Juxiang Plaza Store) at 625-101 Hexiang West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Walk to ICBC to report the lost bank card and apply for a replacement
description: After getting the new SIM card, she walked briskly along Hexiang West Road, turned onto Hubin South Road, and reached ICBC in a few minutes. She found her familiar account manager, Lin Xiaofeng, skipped the queue to fill out the forms, reported the loss of her debit and credit cards, and had them reissued. During the wait, they chatted about the shop's business, and she just smiled and said it was slowly recovering. About 40 minutes later, she had the new cards in hand, and instantly felt a sense of security return.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Hubin South Sub-branch), 94-104 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy coffee to relax and walk back to the store
description: After leaving the bank, she walked along Hubin South Road toward Zhongshan Road. Passing by 85°C, she went in to treat herself. She bought a salted caramel latte and a tuna sandwich, sat by the street-facing window looking at the gradually bustling street scene, and her tense nerves finally relaxed a little. Then she continued walking back to the store.
location: No. 189 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 85°C (Xiamen Zhonghua City New Store)

name: Arrive at the store, open for business, and re-bind the payment tools and procurement platform.
description: At 10:30, pushing open the shop door, clerk Xiaomei was wiping down the shelves. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register, took out her phone and the shop tablet, and one by one bound WeChat, Alipay, merchant payment codes and other payment accounts, unbinding old cards, binding new cards, and conducting small-amount tests. After that, she reset the passwords for 1688 and Dinghuotong. When everything was done, she breathed a long sigh of relief, gave Xiaomei an OK gesture, and treated her to milk tea.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch, afternoon business, inventory organization, and customer community maintenance.
description: She had Xiao Mei watch the store while she went to the Chahuanong tea shop next door and bought two cups of their signature osmanthus drink. When she came back, she ate a sandwich while replying to regular customer Vivian's WeChat messages, and arranged to show her the new styles tomorrow afternoon. Customers came in one after another in the afternoon. She helped a slightly plump woman put together a slimming spring outfit and successfully made the sale. During a free moment, she and Xiao Mei processed the newly arrived French floral dresses—steam ironing them, trimming loose threads, and putting them on the shelves—and took styling photos to send to the customer group, which drew a lot of praise.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the neighboring Chahuanong milk tea shop

name: Pick up my daughter from school, and buy stickers and dinner ingredients on the way
description: At 16:30, she closed the shop on time and walked along Shibi Road to the kindergarten. Passing a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, she remembered that her daughter wanted Princess Elsa stickers, so she went in and picked one. At the kindergarten gate, she picked up bouncing Xuanxuan. When Xuanxuan saw the sticker, her eyes lit up and she kissed her mother. Then she held her hand and went to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy tomatoes, eggs, pork ribs, and greens.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, from Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, passing by the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road and the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road

name: Return home and prepare dinner together with her husband.
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already come home early and was washing rice in the kitchen. The couple worked in perfect coordination: Song Yajing washed and chopped the vegetables, A Qiang did the cooking and stewing, and their daughter Xuanxuan sat on the living room sofa carefully sticking her new princess stickers onto her homework notebook.
location: In the kitchen of Room 502, Building 3, the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner included her daughter's favorite tomato scrambled eggs, garlic lettuce, and hot pork rib soup. As Song Yajing picked food for Xuanxuan, she chatted with her husband about how smoothly reissuing the card had gone that day. Her husband smiled and said, "The Lord bless you," and promised to help her import the backup data to the new phone tomorrow.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organized the new phone's contacts and security settings.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing leaned back on the sofa and manually added notes for a few important suppliers based on the cloud backup. Her husband came over, helped her enable “Find My iPhone,” and set a new lock screen password, urging her not to use her birthday again. Looking at his focused profile, she felt secure.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: Her phone rang—it was a video call invitation from her mother, Lin Xiuying. Song Yajing gave a detailed account of the process of reissuing her SIM card and bank card. On the other end in Quanzhou, her mother urged her to eat well and sleep well, saying that safety was the most important thing. She also mentioned that the rainbow-striped sweater she had knitted for Xuanxuan had been mailed, which made her feel warm inside.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Played with blocks with my daughter and read picture books
description: After the video ended, Song Yajing played with wooden blocks with Xuanxuan for a while, then read two pages of the newly bought picture book How Shadows Are Formed and did a shadow experiment with a flashlight, making her daughter giggle.
location: Daughter's room, Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up, shoulder and neck stretches, and bedtime prayer.
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing took a hot shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, and stretched her sore neck and shoulders on the yoga mat for ten minutes. Before bed, she knelt by the bedside, clasped her hands together, and prayed softly, thanking the Lord for His guidance and for a smooth day, and asking Him to bless the store and keep her family healthy.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Journaled and browsed fashion news.
description: Song Yajing opened her journal and on the March 17 page wrote that the card replacement was all done, her mother had knitted a sweater, and her husband had helped set a new password. She sighed that today was a day of reconnecting with the world. After closing the journal, she casually scrolled through Xiaohongshu to check this spring's fashion trends.
location: At the desk in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Area, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Falling asleep
description: She turned off the bedside lamp; from beside the pillow came the sound of her daughter's steady breathing. Thinking back to how she had worried that morning about the troublesome card replacement, now everything had settled. Feeling grounded and grateful, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up and prayer
description: Woken by the alarm early in the morning, she did some simple stretches in bed to relieve stiffness in her shoulders and neck. After getting up, she opened the window to feel the morning air, washed up, lit a small candle in front of the Virgin Mary statue in her bedroom, and had a quiet morning prayer, seeking inner peace and guidance.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing breakfast for her daughter and waking her up
description: Went into the kitchen to warm milk for my daughter, toast whole-wheat bread, and fry a sunny-side-up egg. Then I went to her room, gently woke her, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into pigtails.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked her daughter to kindergarten
description: Holding her daughter's hand, she walked along the alleys of Shanggu Street for about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, she reminded her daughter of things to keep in mind at kindergarten, and after arriving, she briefly handed her over to the teacher.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Choosing stickers with my daughter at the stationery store
description: After dropping off her daughter, she stopped by the stationery store on Park Road South on the way. Her daughter picked out a Winnie the Pooh sticker. After paying, she told her to keep it safe, then watched her daughter run into the kindergarten.
location: Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Purchasing from a convenience store on the way to the shop
description: After leaving the stationery store, she walked to the shop. On the way, she made a brief stop at the Yonghui Life Supermarket beside Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought three bottles of water, a small bag of nuts and seaweed rolls, and a small pack of tissues, to prepare for receiving Zhao Li and Weiwei'an in the afternoon. She then continued on foot and arrived at the store at 08:35.
location: No. 35-101, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (260 m walk from Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station)

name: Store opening preparation and inspection.
description: Took out the key, opened the store's rolling shutter door and glass door for ventilation, checked the water and electrical equipment, switched on the store sign light and the cash register computer. Made herself a cup of hot white tea, sat by the cash register browsing her phone, confirmed the WeChat messages from Vivian and Zhao Li, and replied to Vivian welcoming her afternoon visit.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning shop tidying and display adjustments.
description: In the morning, there were few customers, so she thoroughly adjusted the store display, replaced the old window display combination, and reserved the best display spot for the afternoon floral-style showcase. She carefully paired the new spring off-white knit cardigan, floral skirt, and light blue shirt and hung them on the central display rack. In the meantime, she replied to WeChat inquiries from several regular customers and checked the previous day’s sales data.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunchtime and a short break.
description: After shop assistant Xiaomei came on shift, she walked 5 minutes to the 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City and bought a Caesar bread and original milk tea for lunch. She ate quickly in the shade at the store entrance, reading a short article on her phone about community management techniques for physical stores. She returned to the shop at 12:40.
location: No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cleaned up the work area for the flower arrangement activity.
description: Back in the store, she cleaned up together with Xiaomei. She carefully wiped the shelf and small side table next to the fitting room with a cloth, sorted and put away the magazines and miscellaneous items that had been piled up, cleared a tidy area for Zhao Li to arrange the floral decorations, and checked that vases, scissors, and other tools were all in place.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Zhao Li completed the floral arrangement and created a customer group
description: At 2 p.m., Zhao Li arrived at the store carrying white violets, eucalyptus leaves, and dried flower materials. She began flower arranging beside the window display and fitting room, while Song Yajing handed her tools and helped adjust the flowers. After the arrangement was done, the store interior radiated spring vitality, and Song Yajing took photos with her phone. Zhao Li then helped successfully create a customer group on WeChat named Yajing Life Boutique Spring Styles, set up the group announcement and welcome message, and sent invitations to about 30 familiar customers.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A regular customer brought a new colleague to visit, and a sale was made.
description: Around 4 p.m., Vivian, a regular customer, came into the store with her female colleague Xiao Li and was attracted by the new floral arrangements. Song Yajing took the opportunity to introduce the spring new arrival styling concepts to them. After trying on, Xiao Li was satisfied and bought the floral print skirt, while Vivian was particularly fond of the off-white knitted cardigan and placed an order. After the transactions, Song Yajing invited them to scan the QR code to join the new customer group. Vivian readily joined and pulled Xiao Li in as well.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: End-of-day closing and photographing the store.
description: After 5 p.m., customers gradually dispersed. She cleaned up the withered branches and fallen leaves left from the flower arrangements with Xiaomei. Then she carefully took panoramic and close-up photos from different angles with her phone, including the new flower arrangements and spring styling, to build material for that evening's community interaction. Xiaomei tidied the fitting room.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and walk to pick up daughter from school
description: She put on a light jacket, handed over the next day's work to Xiaomei, and left the store. It was rush hour, so she quickened her pace and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving at the school gate at 18:00 sharp.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter and buy groceries on the way home
description: After picking up her daughter, she took her hand and turned into the Yonghui Life supermarket next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought dinner ingredients: a bunch of greens, a box of pork belly, scallions and ginger, along with toast and milk for the next day's breakfast. After shopping, the mother and daughter walked home together.
location: No. 35-101, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (260 m walk from Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station)

name: Prepared dinner together with her husband.
description: When she got home, her husband A Qiang had already arrived and prepared shredded ginger and minced garlic, and had also simmered pork rib and radish soup. Song Yajing tied on an apron and sliced the pork belly to make Twice-Cooked Pork. The two chatted in the kitchen and worked in tacit coordination to finish dinner.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: The family of three sat around the dining table enjoying a hot dinner. Song Yajing picked up her daughter’s favorite spare ribs for her and showed her husband the first interaction in the new client group. After dinner, her husband washed the dishes while Song Yajing played with building blocks with her daughter in the living room, teaching her to recognize colors and shapes.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Put daughter to bed and interact with online communities.
description: After helping her daughter wash up and change into pajamas, she read picture books to her in bed for half an hour to put her to sleep, then quietly left the room. Sitting on the living room sofa, she opened the newly created customer group, sent the floral arrangement photos taken in the afternoon, and interacted with a caption. Soon several regular customers liked and replied.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal journaling and a relaxing bath
description: Back in the bedroom, she briefly recorded the new customer information and transaction amounts from the day in her journal. Then she went into the bathroom to take a hot shower. After showering, she stood in front of the mirror and did ten minutes of shoulder and neck stretches.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening prayer and gratitude
description: She turned off the main light in the bedroom and, under the small bedside lamp, held a wooden cross necklace and faced the night outside the window for her bedtime prayer. She gave thanks for the smooth running of the store today, was grateful for the safety and health of her family, rejoiced in the start of the community, and prayed for peace and guidance tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to bed peacefully.
description: After the prayer, she put the cross necklace back on the nightstand, turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep, feeling calm, content, and joyful.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, morning prayer, and a quick wash
description: Outside the window the sky was gloomy and a light rain was falling. Song Yajing got up quietly without waking her daughter and husband. She first said a brief morning prayer before the holy icon in the corner of the living room, thanking the Lord for giving her a new day and praying for her family and the shop's safety. Then she washed up simply and massaged her stiff neck in front of the mirror.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare breakfast and take care of her daughter
description: Song Yajing walked into the kitchen, cooked a pot of plain rice porridge, and sliced a few pieces of toast. Then she gently walked to her daughter's bedside, felt her forehead, and judging that her temperature was acceptable, decided to let her sleep a bit longer. She kept the breakfast warm to reserve time for the rest of the day's arrangements.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up daughter, take temperature, and communicate
description: Song Yajing gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan and took her temperature — 37.6°C, a slight fever. Xuanxuan rubbed her eyes and said she felt a little tired. Song Yajing softly told her to rest at home today and that Mommy would ask Auntie Zhang to stay with her. Xuanxuan nodded sensibly. Song Yajing gave her a few sips of warm water and sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang to let him know.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact the caregiver and prepare to go out.
description: Song Yajing quickly contacted Aunt Zhang, a neighbor who lived in the next building, and asked her to come over around nine in the morning to help look after Xuanxuan. Aunt Zhang readily agreed. Song Yajing wrote her daughter's medication and precautions on a sticky note and put it on the refrigerator door, then got ready to leave for the shop.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store, prepare for opening, and morning meeting
description: Song Yajing held a transparent umbrella and walked along Zhenhai Road for about 8 minutes to the store, mentally planning the day's community interactions and shopping list. After arriving at the store, she pulled up the rolling shutter door, saw some water stains on the floor, and found that staff member Xiaomei was already waiting outside. The two entered the store together. Song Yajing turned on the air conditioner's dehumidification mode and tidied the clothing racks that had been splashed by rain. She then had a morning meeting with Xiaomei, stressing that they should continue the momentum of the last salon in the WeChat group, and arranged for Xiaomei to handle try-ons and photos.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Second community interaction and try-on photo shoot
description: Song Yajing posted two flat-lay photos of the newly arrived dusty pink and light blue spring/summer dresses in the "Yajing Lifestyle Store" group, recommending them in the caption. Vivian, a regular customer, replied instantly and wanted to reserve the light blue one. Song Yajing then asked Xiaomei to change into the dusty pink dress, paired with the store's pearl earrings and a rattan bag, and took several try-on photos from different angles and posted them to the group, tagging a few customers who like soft, gentle styles. Interaction in the group heated up.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Tidying the shop and receiving customers.
description: Customer traffic gradually increased, and Song Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work: she was in charge of receiving several customers who came in groups, recommending outfits with floral print skirts; Xiaomei continued tidying the newly hung new tops in the side area. Song Yajing also took the opportunity to change the water in the vase arranged by florist Zhao Li yesterday and lightly trimmed the branches and leaves.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Lunch, searched for courses, and enrolled in an online course.
description: Song Yajing had Xiao Mei watch the shop while she walked about five minutes to the 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City. She ordered a baked cheese bread and a hot latte, then sat by the window. While eating, she opened the Tencent Classroom app on her phone, searched for “Community Operations in Practice,” and carefully compared the outlines, reputations, and prices of several courses. Afterward, she returned to the shop, asked Xiao Mei to take a break in the back, and brought her a cup of boba milk tea. Song Yajing continued studying the selected courses at the cash register and finally decided to buy a highly rated series course covering the entire process of user acquisition, engagement, conversion, and viral growth for 199 yuan. During breaks between transactions, she completed the purchase and created a “Study Plan” folder in her phone memo app, writing down that evening's study schedule. She felt fulfilled.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Store operations and community maintenance.
description: The light rain gradually stopped in the afternoon, and more customers came into the store. Song Yajing successfully styled a mother-daughter pair in matching outfits—off-white knit cardigans with floral half skirts—and closed a sale of over 1,000 yuan. During a lull, she opened the WeChat group, replied to several customers' questions from the morning about skirt length and fabric, and gave a preview of the registration information for Sunday's salon.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yajing Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Close the store early, pick up daughter, and buy groceries on the way
description: Song Yajing told Xiaomei to close the store on time at 16:30 and leave work, while she herself left a few minutes early. After walking out of the store, she called her husband Chen Zhiqiang and learned that Xuanxuan had taken a long nap in the afternoon, had just been given medicine by Aunt Zhang, was in better spirits, and was watching cartoons. She told her husband to come home on time. Then she walked about 8 minutes to the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, just in time for dismissal, and picked up her daughter Xuanxuan. Although Xuanxuan was a bit listless, her mood was okay, and she held tightly to her mother's hand. Song Yajing did not go straight home but took her to the Zhenhai Road farmers' market, where she bought fresh tomatoes, eggs, bok choy, and pork ribs, planning to make light tomato-egg noodles and pork rib soup for dinner.
location: Xiashang Zhenhai Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home, preparing dinner, and having dinner with the family
description: Song Yajing brought Xuanxuan home and had her sit on the sofa to watch Peppa Pig. She tied on an apron and began picking vegetables, washing tomatoes, and chopping pork ribs to prepare dinner. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang arrived home at 17:10, saw her busy in the kitchen, and took over cooking the noodles, telling her to go accompany their daughter. The family of three sat around the dining table, and Song Yajing served Xuanxuan a small bowl of noodles and pork rib soup. Xuanxuan was in better spirits than in the afternoon and ate most of the bowl by herself with a small spoon. After the meal, Song Yajing took her daughter's temperature again—37.2—a clear improvement, and the heavy weight in her heart was finally lifted.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-meal cleanup, couple communication, and family interaction.
description: Song Yajing cleared the table with her husband. While washing the dishes, she told him she had bought a community operations course today for 199 yuan. Her husband nodded in support and reminded her not to forget to reconcile the accounts on Sunday evening. Afterward, Song Yajing sat with Xuanxuan on the living room play mat and built LEGO blocks. Her daughter built a crooked little house with the blocks and said it was a castle for Mommy. Her husband watered the flowers on the balcony, and the atmosphere at home was warm and peaceful.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting daughter washed up and putting her to sleep
description: Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a warm bath, helped her into her pajamas, and wiped her down again to lower her temperature. Then she sat by the bed, told her two short picture-book stories, and watched as her daughter's eyelids drooped and she gradually fell into a calm, steady sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Follow up on Sunday salon details
description: Song Yajing sat down on the sofa, opened WeChat, and messaged floral designer Zhao Li to ask when the first draft of the poster for the 23rd's 2 p.m. salon might be ready, as she wanted to finalize the copy and visuals first. Zhao Li replied that she would work overtime on the design tonight and send it to her tomorrow. Song Yajing replied, “Okay, thanks for your hard work.”
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Study time and note organization
description: Song Yajing made a cup of hot tea, opened her laptop, logged into the course platform, and began studying the first lesson of Community Operations from 0 to 1 — Understanding Communities and User Personas. She listened very attentively, noted down key points such as target customer segmentation, value output, and trust building in her notebook, and wrote down an initial user persona for her Yajing Life Studio.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Observing daughter's condition and providing temporary care
description: Song Yajing heard her daughter whimpering in the bedroom, so she quickly put down her computer and went in. The girl was a little fussy, perhaps because of a dream or discomfort. She picked her up and walked around the living room, gently soothing her for about ten minutes. After confirming that her fever had not worsened, she coaxed her back to sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime stretching, prayer review, and nighttime care to help her daughter fall asleep.
description: Song Yajing came out of the study, spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and did 15 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, using a fascia ball to focus on relaxing her shoulder blades. After a quick wash-up, she opened her journal and wrote a brief summary of the day, thanking the Lord for watching over Xuanxuan and bringing down her fever, recording the course progress and salon follow-up. Closing the notebook, she made the sign of the cross and prayed quietly, asking the Heavenly Father to watch over her family and the shop and to keep Zhao Li's design inspiration safe. After turning off the light and lying down, in the middle of the night her daughter woke once again, saying she was thirsty. She gave her warm water, took her temperature (38.0°C), and did physical cooling. Only around midnight did her daughter fall asleep peacefully again, and Song Yajing wearily followed into sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and family care
description: When the morning alarm went off, I first made sure my daughter Chen Lexuan's fever had gone down and her temperature was stable, then gently woke her and helped her put on a jacket. After a quick wash-up, I had breakfast with my husband Chen Zhiqiang (rice porridge, fried eggs, and steamed buns) and reminded him to try to leave work on time today to spend time with the kids, since I planned to focus on studying in the evening.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: After helping her daughter pack her schoolbag and water bottle and placing the pre-portioned fever-reducing Chinese medicine in the side pocket of the schoolbag, she checked her own belongings, and then the mother and daughter walked hand in hand for about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate they met her homeroom teacher, Teacher Chen. She handed over the fever medicine, explained the dosage and precautions in detail, encouraged her daughter, and watched her enter the classroom.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and breakfast run
description: Walk about 8 minutes from the kindergarten to the 85°C Bakery, buy a hot Americano and a butter croissant as a quick breakfast. Then walk about 10 more minutes to Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, along the way seeing shops opening one after another.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and work coordination
description: Arrived at the store early to open it and turned on the air purifier. After clerk Xiaomei arrived, the two did the daily cleaning together: wiping the shelves, steaming the new dresses with a steam iron, and adjusting the displays. Song Yajing discussed the day's work priorities with Xiaomei: promoting the newly arrived woodland-style floral dresses and preparing for next Tuesday's Members' Day warm-up event.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing to study and handling customer consultations.
description: Using the free time before opening the store, she logged into Tencent Classroom on the store computer and confirmed that the Community Operations Practical Course she bought last night had been activated. She took out a notebook and a highlighter, connected her earphones to her phone, and got ready to study at any time. Then, a regular customer in the WeChat customer group asked about newly arrived dresses. Song Yajing replied immediately and asked Xiaomei to try on a green floral dress in the store, take photos, and send them to the group, which received positive feedback.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Studied community operations courses in spare moments
description: She used the gaps between customer traffic to study Lesson 1, 'Seven Strategies for Community New Member Acquisition', from the Practical Community Operations Course. When traffic was light from 9:30 to 9:45, she put on headphones and studied for the first 15 minutes, writing down the 'seed user screening criteria' and 'benefit hook design model' in her notebook. In the gaps while serving customers or waiting for them to try on clothes, she used the memo app on her phone to jot down key points or quickly review screenshots. Although she was interrupted many times, she mastered all the core knowledge points.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break
description: Went to Jiayixiang Satay Noodle Shop, ordered a bowl of satay noodles with squid and fried tofu puffs, and ate it while it was hot. While eating, she sent a WeChat message to her mother in Quanzhou to let her know that her daughter's fever had broken and she was in good spirits, so she could rest assured.
location: Jiayixiang Shacha Noodles (Dazhong Road Branch), Dazhong Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Customer care and lunch break
description: After returning to the store, she first sent a private message to regular customer Vivian from the doorway using the photo album on her phone, sharing photos of other shirt styles and inviting her to come try them on when she had time. Then she went to the rest area inside the store, closed her eyes and rested for about 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store sales service and course study wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased, so she switched to interspersed learning. She warmly received a mother-daughter pair of customers, recommended commuting and date outfits, and successfully closed two sales. During checkout or while customers were trying on clothes, she used her phone to listen to the last 10 minutes of the replay of the first lesson of "Community Operations Practical Course", and added a case study on "online-offline integrated customer acquisition" to her notebook. By about 15:45, she completed the first full viewing of the course.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk to the kindergarten to pick up my daughter.
description: After leaving Xiao Mei in charge of the shop, she took her umbrella and her daughter's water bottle and walked from Zhongshan Road to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on Gucheng West Road.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Arrived at the kindergarten gate on time to pick up Chen Lexuan after school. The daughter was in good spirits and excitedly told stories about kindergarten. Song Yajing kissed her daughter and asked where she wanted to go.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child activities and learning games in the park
description: Walked about 15 minutes from the kindergarten to Jiaxingyuan Park. On a park bench, I took out my phone, found the screenshots about “content interaction” from the course, and played a “class” game with my daughter, having her read the text on the screens. We played for 10 minutes. Then I accompanied her on the swings and slide, enjoying parent-child time and relieving work fatigue.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping on the way home
description: Leaving the park, she passed the convenience store at the entrance of Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Remembering that they were out of eggs and greens at home, she took her daughter inside and bought tomatoes, eggs, and a bunch of choy sum. When she arrived home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already left work early and was boiling water in the kitchen.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner conversation
description: The family of three enjoyed a simple dinner together — tomato and egg noodles with garlic choy sum. At the table, Song Yajing enthusiastically shared the 'benefit hook' concept she had learned that day with her husband, and suggested using a '10-yuan no-minimum coupon for first-time group members' to attract new customers for the shop. Chen Zhiqiang smiled and expressed his support, and offered to use the computer the next day to make a simple promotional poster for her.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanying daughter and helping her wash up
description: Played with her daughter with building blocks, then helped her take a hot bath. After the bath, she read the new edition of 'The Tale of Peter Rabbit' to her daughter, who fell asleep peacefully listening to the story.
location: At home: children's room and bathroom, Residential Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Deep learning and mind map organization
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing opened her laptop in the study, imported the course screenshots from her phone, reviewed the replay of the Seven Strategies for Community User Acquisition course using the speed-playback feature, created a hand-drawn mind map, highlighted the combination of seed users and value hooks, and wrote down a few ideas aimed at the store's customer base.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The couple discusses strategies for attracting new customers to the shop.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought over hot milk, and the two discussed the customer acquisition plan for Jingxin Pavilion using a mind map. Chen Zhiqiang suggested replacing flyers with tabletop signs for scanning QR codes to join the group, and Song Yajing supplemented the idea with two-way referral coupons for existing customers bringing in new ones. They decided to have Xiaomei go to the print shop tomorrow to make the tabletop signs.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening skincare routine and video call with mother.
description: She washed up, did her skincare routine, and did some simple shoulder and neck stretches. During this time, she had a video call with her mother Lin Xiuying in Quanzhou, gave her a detailed report on her daughter's recovery, and let her see the sleeping daughter. Her mother told her to take care of herself and not get too tired.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tomorrow's planning and going to bed
description: On the notebook by the bed, she listed tomorrow's to-do items: arrange for Xiao Mei to make a table sign reading “Scan the QR code to join the group”, confirm the shirt fitting time with regular customer Vivian, and complete the second lesson of the course. She set the alarm for 7:00, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment from the day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake-up, personal preparations, and family breakfast.
description: The alarm rang on time. Song Yajing turned it off and took a deep breath to greet Friday's sunshine. The weather was lovely; she opened the curtains and sunlight poured into the room. She washed up quickly, patted on some rose floral water, and changed into that taro purple knit cardigan. She felt pleased seeing her energetic reflection in the mirror. Then she went into the kitchen, took out toast, eggs, and milk from the fridge, and fried two sunny-side-up eggs and a few slices of bacon. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also got up, and while making coffee he chatted with her about the community group plan they had discussed last night. Both agreed that the "Scan QR Code to Join Group" table sign was a great idea. Song Yajing specifically reminded her husband not to forget to pick up their daughter Xuanxuan after work today. Then she woke up their daughter. Xuanxuan was still drowsy, but immediately cheered up at the sight of fried eggs, toast, and milk. The family of three sat around the dining table. Song Yajing spread strawberry jam on her daughter's toast and asked what craft she wanted to do. Her daughter said she wanted to paint spring flowers. The atmosphere was wonderfully warm.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Escorting daughter to school and commuting to the shop
description: She left right on time at 7:55. Song Yajing put on her helmet and wheeled out her little electric bike. Her daughter Xuanxuan sat behind her, hugging her waist. They rode to the Siming Experimental Kindergarten on Gucheng West Road. On the way, they passed the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road. Xuanxuan said she wanted to paint spring, so Song Yajing stopped and bought a box of new watercolor pens. They arrived at the kindergarten at 8:10. After watching her daughter and the teacher walk into the classroom, she walked 5 minutes to Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station and took the morning rush-hour metro to Zhongshan Road Station. On the metro, she stood and scrolled through her WeChat Moments and the homeowners' group chat. After leaving the station, the smell of coffee drifted over, and she stopped by Luckin Coffee to buy a hot latte, then walked to the shop.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and along the way to Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road

name: Store opening preparation and display optimization.
description: Arriving at the store at 8:25, Song Yajing pulled up the rolling shutter door. Shop assistant Xiaomei was already sweeping the floor. She put the hot latte on the cash register counter, first checked the display that had been arranged the night before, then took out the table sign she had designed last night and printed this morning — “Scan the QR code to join the group and get priority reservations for new styles” — and carefully placed it in the most prominent positions next to the checkout counter and the fitting room.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning operations: practicing new-customer acquisition tips.
description: Friday customer flow was slightly higher than on weekdays, and Song Yajing greeted several batches of customers with energy. She cleverly used the “benefit hook” she had learned the night before. When a young girl who had tried on a French-style dress was paying, she smiled and said, “Pretty lady, add our shop's group chat! Next time new items arrive, I can send photos right away, and I can also reserve them for you in advance.” The girl readily scanned the code and joined the group. In one morning, she successfully got three new customers to join the group, and felt a real sense of achievement. Shop assistant Xiaomei helped with reception alongside her.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and video call to check on daughter
description: While the store was quiet, Xiaomei watched the shop out front, and Song Yajing ordered a light salad delivery on her phone in the small back room. While eating, she made a video call through WeChat to her daughter's teacher. On the screen, Xuanxuan was playing with blocks with other children and looked full of energy. After confirming with the teacher that she would be kept warm during naptime, she reassured her daughter, "Good girl, listen to your teacher, and Mommy will pick you up after work."
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling online matters.
description: After lunch, taking a short rest, Song Yajing picked up her phone and saw an old customer Vivian messaging to ask about the details of the embroidered shirt. She immediately replied with model photos and a material description. Then she handled return and exchange inquiries for two online orders and helped Xiaomei check the afternoon work tasks.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business: steady sales and preparation for learning
description: Customer traffic was steady in the afternoon. Song Yajing and Xiaomei worked in smooth coordination, attending to customers while tidying the shelves that had been rummaged through. She noticed the three new customers who had joined the group chat that morning and proactively sent greetings and outfit recommendations. Around 16:30 she felt a little sore in her lower back, so she walked back and forth in the store to relieve it while there were few customers. Before closing, she confirmed with Xiaomei the details of tomorrow's schedule and the arrival of new styles.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-closing preparations and wrap-up
description: At 17:30, after seeing off the last customer, Song Yajing pulled down the rolling shutter door, tidied the fitting room together with Xiaomei, counted the change and logged it, and made sure all the clothes were hung back in their original places. She took a sip of water, opened the Tencent Classroom app on her phone, and got ready to start the evening's study.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening in-depth learning: community activation course
description: After Xiaomei got off work, Song Yajing was the only one left in the store. She brewed a cup of her own flower tea, put on her Bluetooth earphones, and officially started studying the second lesson, "The Five Engines of Community Activation." The "fixed column design" and "tiered user incentives" mentioned in the lesson inspired her deeply. She immediately thought that her group could share a "Today's Outfit" topic every day, so she took out her notebook and carefully wrote down activity ideas such as "check-in" and "outfit blind box," feeling that she had gained a lot.
location: Shop 18-108, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting home and buying fruit.
description: When the lesson ended, Song Yajing locked the shop door and walked through the bustling pedestrian street. Remembering her morning plan, she deliberately detoured to Pagoda Fruits at No. 69 Gongyuan South Road and picked out a box of fresh loquats and a few strawberries. After buying the fruit, she walked home. The evening breeze brushed her face, and much of the day's fatigue melted away.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: Arrived home at 19:35. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already stir-frying vegetables and shrimp in the kitchen, and her daughter Xuanxuan was in the living room putting together a picture she had painted with her new watercolor pens. Song Yajing washed the fruit and set it on the table, and the family sat together for dinner. After dinner, she played the 'Little Animals Playing House' game with Xuanxuan for 20 minutes, and together they finished the 'Spring Handmade Flowers' homework assigned by the kindergarten.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal care and a healing phone call with her best friend.
description: After getting Xuanxuan bathed and tucked into bed, Song Yajing finally had time to unwind. She took a nice hot bath, put on a hydrating mask, curled up on the living room sofa, and called her best friend Li Meiling on WeChat. Meiling heard the tiredness and excitement in her voice and laughed, 'You've finally found the feeling of being a student again.' They talked for a long time about how to balance family and self-improvement after becoming a mother, sharing stress-relief tips with each other. When she hung up, she felt much more relaxed.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening tidying and daily review.
description: After hanging up, the face mask was also done. Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, picked out clothes for the three of them to wear tomorrow from the wardrobe, and hung them up. Then she wrote today's review in her journal: 'The table-card promotion this morning worked well; 3 people joined the group. The second community course had a lot of useful content; I noted down the ideas of "fixed column design" and "outfit blind boxes." Tomorrow is the weekend, so I can take time to sort out my notes and design the "Daily Outfit" section for the group.'
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, chatting with partner, and going to bed
description: Chen Zhiqiang had also finished his own things, and the two leaned against the headboard. Song Yajing shared what she had learned from today's community course, and her husband said that when he picked up Xuanxuan after work, the teacher praised their daughter for doing very well. They chatted as Song Yajing casually flipped through a few pages of the latest issue of Rayli magazine and browsed window display designs of a few new brands. Then she turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes, and replayed in her mind the moment she had successfully applied the new customer acquisition technique in the store that day, as well as the new knowledge she had learned, feeling very grounded. She had walked about 5,800 steps back and forth in the store today, and slowly drifted off to sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning rhinitis flare-up and plan for washing up and taking medication
description: At 7:10 on Saturday morning, Song Yajing woke up right on time because of allergic rhinitis, sneezing repeatedly with nasal congestion and itchy eyes. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, woke up and helped her find half a box of loratadine. After taking the medicine, Yajing's symptoms did not improve. While washing up, she decided to go to the pharmacy to buy new medicine and saline nasal spray before opening the store today.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the pharmacy to buy anti-allergy medication.
description: Yajing put on a mask and walked about 10 minutes to Guoda Pharmacy Park Store. She described her morning allergy symptoms in detail to the pharmacist, who recommended desloratadine tablets and a saline nasal spray and told her to see a doctor if there was no improvement in two days. Yajing paid with WeChat Pay after purchasing the medicine.
location: Guoda Pharmacy (Park Branch), Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the store and prepare for opening
description: After buying medicine, Yajing walked 5 minutes to the Jingxinge Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, where the shop assistant Xiaomei was already waiting. The two worked together to open the store door, air out the room, wipe the display cabinets, and arrange the new mannequin displays. Because Yajing's voice was abnormal due to rhinitis, Xiaomei thoughtfully let her rest.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle flower material matters at the shop and learn about the Fashion Week exhibition
description: After sitting down in the rest area, Yajing called the florist Zhao Li to confirm the list of dried and fresh flowers and the color scheme for next Monday's window decoration. Zhao Li teased her about having a heavy nasal tone. After hanging up, Yajing saw a link from supplier Susan to a static exhibition of eco-friendly fabrics at Xiamen International Fashion Week. She was very interested, decided to visit in the afternoon, and asked Xiaomei to look after the store.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Busy at the store and fragmented planning at noon.
description: Around noon, customer traffic in the store increased. Yajing perked up and put together a Morandi-colored business outfit for a customer, closing the sale, while another mother and daughter browsed accessories. During a lull, Yajing quickly reviewed her notes from the community engagement course and thought about how to incorporate environmental concepts into her styling column.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple lunch and store handover preparation
description: At noon, when customer traffic decreased, Yajing let Xiaomei go eat first. She watched the store while eating the light salad she had brought (lettuce, chicken breast, and cherry tomatoes), and at the same time used her phone to confirm that her daughter's elementary school enrollment materials were ready. After Xiaomei came back, Yajing explained the location of the afternoon's main featured items and the points to note, prepared her business cards and notebook, and got ready to head to the convention and exhibition center.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Visit the Eco-Friendly Fabric Static Exhibition of Xiamen International Fashion Week.
description: Yajing took a ride-hailing car to Hall A6 of Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center, where she focused on viewing the collections of three designers, such as recycled nylon fabric made from discarded fishing nets and organic cotton dyed with plant-based dyes. She proactively talked with a young designer for more than ten minutes, learning in detail about fabric texture, cost, and supply chain, and exchanged business cards. She came away with new ideas for product selection.
location: Hall A6, Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center, No. 198 Huizhan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Sorted thoughts on the way back and returned to the store to record inspirations
description: At 2:40 p.m., Yajing finished the visit and took a ride-hailing car back to the shop. In the car, she used her phone's memo app to note the designer's contact information and fabric inspiration, marking it 'can be introduced in autumn'. After returning to Jingxinge, she asked Xiaomei to brew monk fruit tea, and used colored pens and a mind map in her notebook to visualize the ideas from the visit, planning to introduce one or two eco-friendly fabric items in autumn and focus on telling the fabric's story.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Received regular customers and engaged with the community.
description: In the afternoon, there were few customers in the store. While tidying the shelves, Yajing sent several close-up photos of fabrics in the customer WeChat group and teased an autumn surprise, and regular customers responded enthusiastically. She also took a photo of the new silk blouse, posted it in the group with styling suggestions, and kept the community engaged.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Had a voice call with supplier Susan about the eco-friendly fabric collaboration.
description: Taking advantage of the quiet store, Yajing called Susan via WeChat voice, excitedly sharing what she had seen and thought at the exhibition, especially her plan to introduce eco-friendly fabrics. Susan said she knew a domestic agent who could help ask about the minimum order quantity. The two tentatively agreed to discuss the cooperation plan after receiving the quotation next weekend.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up and making arrangements for the next day.
description: In the evening, Yajing and Xiaomei put the clothes back in place, tidied the fitting rooms, and counted the accounts. Today's sales were stable, and three new customers joined the group. She hung up the dress she would wear to Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church the next day, and reminded Xiaomei to open the store at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and pick up a package on the way
description: After closing, Yajing walked home carrying her bag. On the way, she stopped at the parcel station at the entrance of the residential community to pick up the children's picture book she had bought for her daughter a couple of days earlier, and texted her husband to ask if he was home and what he wanted for dinner.
location: The parcel station near the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the way home.

name: Warm family dinner
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already reheating food in the kitchen, and her daughter Xuanxuan ran over to greet her. The family sat together to enjoy tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and pork rib soup. Yajing shared what she had seen at the afternoon exhibition, while Chen Zhiqiang talked about the amusing moments during his overtime work today.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening parent-child time and putting the child to sleep
description: After dinner, Yajing played house with her daughter in the living room and read a newly bought picture book. Around 8 o'clock, she helped Xuanxuan wash up and change into pajamas, then leaned against the headboard and told her a story about a little cat's adventure until her daughter fell asleep peacefully.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and community review
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing's nasal congestion, which had worsened from pollen exposure during the day, eased a little after she rinsed her nasal passages with a nasal irrigator and used nasal spray. Then she went to the study, turned her exhibition notes into an electronic file, and sent a goodnight greeting in an online community.
location: Master bedroom bathroom and study at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Before-bed relaxation and decision to see a doctor.
description: At 9:45, Yajing changed into her pajamas and leaned against the headboard, talking with her husband Chen Zhiqiang about her confidence in selecting eco-friendly fabrics. Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her. However, her persistent nasal congestion made her decide to go to the community hospital for medicine after Mass the next day, and Chen Zhiqiang agreed to accompany her. At around 22:10, she turned off the bedside lamp and gradually fell asleep despite slight nasal congestion.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up, rhinitis care, breakfast, getting dressed, and interacting with family
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm went off. Her nose was still stuffy, but slightly better than yesterday. After getting up, she drank a glass of warm water and rinsed her nasal cavity with a nasal irrigator and saline solution, feeling fresher. She then put on a light beige knit cardigan over a white cotton dress, which was easy to move in and looked gentle. In the kitchen, she heated up the millet porridge that had been cooked on a timer the night before and two custard buns. While eating, she went through the day's event schedule in her phone memo and glanced at the community group messages; several mothers were already asking about the afternoon details. Before leaving, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was braiding their daughter Chen Lexuan's hair, and Xuanxuan was chattering about whether she could go to the shop to play in the afternoon. Yajing patted her head and said, 'Mommy has to work today; I'll take you next weekend,' and reminded Aqiang not to forget to take Xuanxuan to her interest class in the afternoon. She checked her bag: face masks, tissues, anti-allergy medicine, a power bank, and stickers for the event.
location: No. 82 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking to the Catholic Church
description: Song Yajing put on a mask and headed out, walking about 35 minutes to the church. The sunshine was nice today. As she passed a roadside breakfast stall, she caught the familiar smell of satay noodles, and her mood brightened. On the way she also saw a few neighbors walking their dogs, and they nodded and smiled at each other.
location: No. 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District.

name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with Aunt Lin Xiuying.
description: Mass began at 8:30. Song Yajing sat toward the back and softly recited along throughout. After Mass, she indeed ran into Auntie Lin Xiuying. Auntie Lin was concerned about her rhinitis and again reminded her that she could soak magnolia flowers in water and drink it. Yajing took her hand and said with a smile that she remembered, and asked Auntie to pray for the afternoon's used-clothing drive. The two chatted briefly for ten minutes, and Yajing felt very much at peace.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop “Jingxin Pavilion”.
description: After leaving the church, she walked about 40 minutes to the store. On the way, she passed a newsstand and bought a copy of Xiamen Daily to use as a liner for a flower pot. Along the way, she enjoyed the morning street atmosphere and felt in a very good mood.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian; Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District.

name: Go to the store and set up the clothing swap area with Zhao Li
description: Zhao Li was already waiting at the door, carrying a bag of fresh flowers (lisianthus, eucalyptus leaves, and daisies) and floral tools. The two of them carefully pushed the display rack in the center of the shop against the wall, clearing an area of about 10 square meters. Then they moved out a 2-meter-long folding table and set it up. Song Yajing neatly arranged the base area by category (spring clothing, summer clothing, accessories), while Zhao Li used the flowers to make a few chic table arrangements for the table corners, and the atmosphere instantly became cozy.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Send community event notifications and make final task assignments and detailed preparations with Xiaomei.
description: Taking advantage of the store already taking shape, Song Yajing opened her phone and sent a carefully formatted event notice poster (including time, rules, and florist support) and a photo of the just-arranged floral decoration to the "Yajing Life Gallery" customer group, and @ everyone: "2 p.m., see you there! Bring old clothes to exchange for 'new clothes.'" Within minutes after the message was sent, more than a dozen mothers replied "Got it" or "Looking forward to it." At eleven, Xiaomei arrived at the store on time. Yajing and she made a detailed division of labor: Xiaomei was mainly responsible for welcoming at the door and distributing stickers, while Yajing took charge of overall coordination and styling advice for the mothers. The two moved out the idle clothes steamer to warm it up, and checked all the clothes to be exchanged to make sure there were no loose threads or stains. Yajing also took a desloratadine pill in advance to prevent afternoon pollen allergies from worsening.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Xiaomei went to the nearby 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery and bought three light salads and two lemonades. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register to eat lunch. Feeling a bit tired, she leaned against the soft stool in the fitting room and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes, silently going over the event flow. Zhao Li, meanwhile, sewed a few fabric brooches from leftover fabric as a backup surprise for the afternoon.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final checks and personal adjustments before the event
description: After waking up, she felt better. Song Yajing checked the stickers, labels, and packaging bags again to make sure the exchange area and the clothes-for-sale area were clearly separated. She also used a garment steamer to iron out a few dresses for the sample outfits. She touched up her lipstick in the mirror and fixed her hair to look energetic.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Core activity: old-clothes swap and floral upcycling
description: Starting at 13:50, two or three moms had already arrived early. Song Yajing and Xiaomei greeted them at the door with smiles and invited them to sit in the store and chat to warm up. By 2 pm, everyone had gradually arrived, and the atmosphere was lively but not noisy. Yajing gave each person a sticker with a handwritten name and guided them to place the old clothes by category. A circle quickly formed around the fitting mirror. The moms helped each other with styling opinions, and Yajing also stepped in to offer matching suggestions. At a small worktable in the corner, Zhao Li used leftover flowers and pins to do mini makeovers on a few plain white shirts and basic denim skirts that had been left behind, sewing on a silk flower or adding a waist button. A young mom saw it, happily picked the revamped shirt, and kept saying she got a good deal. Laughter and praise filled the whole afternoon.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Event wrap-up: cleaning, packing, and putting supplies back in place.
description: The event ended on time at five o'clock. Most of the clothes found new owners, leaving about 10 clean old garments. Song Yajing and Zhao Li carefully folded them together, packed them into large eco-friendly bags, and prepared to send them to the community used-clothing recycling bin tomorrow. Xiaomei was responsible for sweeping the floor and putting the clothing rack and fitting mirror back in place. The store quickly returned to order.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing community event moments, a brief recap, and closing the store
description: Song Yajing picked out the 9 most vivid photos from today's event on her phone (the exchange scenes, close-ups of the flower-arrangement makeover, the mothers' smiling faces), quickly beautified them, and wrote the caption: "Today's little log is woven by everyone with love and clothes~ Thank you to every one of you who came! We've decided that from now on, on the last Sunday afternoon of every month, we'll hold this kind of 'Old Clothes, New Life' party—see you next time!" She posted it to the group and instantly received a flood of likes and "Sign me up for next time!" Afterward, the three briefly reviewed the event. Yajing thanked Zhao Li and Xiaomei and transferred the design fee for this event to Zhao Li. Zhao Li said they could try tie-dye next time. Yajing locked the shop door and said goodbye to Xiaomei and Zhao Li at the entrance to the pedestrian street.
location: 'Jingxinge', Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove home and washed up after arriving.
description: She was too tired today to walk back, so Song Yajing drove home in her own car. In the car, she leaned against the window watching the traffic outside, feeling a sense of accomplishment she hadn't felt for a long time. She sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang a message: “The event was a great success! Wait for me to come home for dinner~” When she got home, as soon as she entered, her daughter Xuanxuan pounced on her and hugged her. Yajing squatted down and hugged her daughter, listening to her talk about learning “Little Swallow” paper-cutting in today's interest class. Then she quickly took a hot shower, changed into comfortable cotton home pajamas, and felt completely relaxed.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Having dinner with family and sharing the joy of the event
description: Chen Zhiqiang made sweet and sour pork ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and also cooked Song Yajing's favorite clam and tofu soup. At the dinner table, Yajing excitedly talked about the details of the event: which piece of clothing was "sold out" on the spot after being altered, and which mother asked her for a store discount coupon. Aqiang said, "You have really given the store a warm touch." Xuanxuan added, "Mommy is the best!"
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Read picture books with my daughter and coaxed her to sleep.
description: After a short rest following the meal, Song Yajing read the picture book Giraffes Can't Dance with Chen Lexuan and told her a little story she had heard at the church today. Xuanxuan held Yajing's arm and gradually fell asleep.
location: Daughter's bedroom at home in the No. 82 Community on Shanggu Street, No. 82, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Personal celebration moment: savoring tiramisu and fruit tea.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing tiptoed out of the room. She opened the fridge, took out the tiramisu she had made on the weekend, cut a small piece, and brewed a cup of warm "non-alcoholic" fruit tea with honey and lemon slices. She sat on the sofa and scrolled through the feedback in the group chat on her phone. Seeing that everyone was very satisfied, she felt delighted. She decided that today she would make an exception and eat the whole piece of cake as a reward for a hard week's work.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 residential complex, home living room/kitchen.

name: Organizing activity ideas and personal care
description: After eating the cake, Song Yajing tucked the business cards from several mothers she had met during today's activity into her notebook, and jotted down a new idea in her phone memo: "Next time, we could add a children's clothing exchange area, or invite Zhao Li to do a livestream showing her floral arrangement makeover process." Then she did a simple facial cleansing and skin care routine, and found that her stuffy nose really seemed to have eased quite a bit.
location: home study, No. 82 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation, preparing for tomorrow, chatting with her husband, and bedtime prayer.
