description: Leaning against the headboard, Song Yajing flipped through the clothes she would wear tomorrow and sent a message to the florist Zhao Li to schedule a time for next weekend. Then she scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while to look at outfits, thinking about next month's community event. After Chen Zhiqiang entered the bedroom, the two leaned against the headboard and chatted for ten minutes. Yajing said she wanted to go to the community hospital next week to see if there were other ways to treat her rhinitis. Aqiang massaged her shoulders and said he supported her. Before going to sleep, Yajing silently recited a prayer, grateful that everything had gone smoothly that day.
location: Home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Lying on the soft bed, her body was a little tired, but her heart was filled with satisfaction. Having successfully taken the first step in community operations today, Song Yajing slowly fell asleep with a smile and anticipation.
location: Home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and family breakfast
description: At 6:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. Song Yajing got up and found it was overcast outside, and her nose still felt stuffy. She got out of bed quietly, washed up, then went to wake up her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and urged her to brush her teeth and wash her face. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang got up early today and fried eggs and toast in the kitchen, and warmed the milk. During breakfast, Song Yajing confirmed again that her husband would pick up their daughter in the afternoon, because he would be responsible for picking up the child from school. The family of three had breakfast together at home, with a warm atmosphere.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take my daughter to school and purchase craft materials.
description: At 7:40, Song Yajing left home with her daughter and walked her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she asked her daughter what gift she wanted to make for Grandma on Mother's Day, and her daughter said she wanted to make a bouquet of flowers. After sending her daughter into the kindergarten, Song Yajing walked on to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, where she bought colored cardstock, crepe paper, children's safety scissors, and a pack of dried flower petals, planning to do crafts with her daughter in the evening.
location: Along the route from the community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (123 Gucheng West Road), and then to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road (Yubincheng Phase 2, 35 Gongyuan South Road).

name: Get her rhinitis checked on the way.
description: Leaving the stationery store, Song Yajing walked to the Lujiang Street Community Health Service Center in Siming District. She registered, found the familiar Dr. Wang. After auscultation, Dr. Wang diagnosed seasonal allergies, advised her to continue using the nasal spray, avoid cold air, and prescribed a new box of medicine. Song Yajing paid with her medical insurance card; the whole process took about 20 minutes.
location: Lujiang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 323 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After leaving the community health service center, Song Yajing walked about five minutes to the Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On Monday morning there were not many pedestrians on the street, and a few fine drops of rain were floating in the air.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the store, holding the morning meeting, and researching and finalizing the promotional copy for the new-customer campaign.
description: She opened the rolling shutter door, and shop assistant Xiaomei was already changing the water in the flower vases. Together they did a quick cleanup and adjusted the displays. Monday morning foot traffic was light, so Song Yajing and Xiaomei had a brief morning meeting. Song Yajing reminded Xiaomei that she would need to leave early in the afternoon to pick up her child and asked Xiaomei to keep an eye on the store. Afterwards, Song Yajing sat behind the cash register, took out her phone, and, using the 'interest hook' template she had learned in the community course, revised the customer-acquisition copy in her notes again and again. She finally set the incentive as: 'Invite two friends to join the group, and you can receive a 15-yuan no-threshold coupon by sending a screenshot.' She sent the screenshot to florist Zhao Li for review. Zhao Li quickly replied that it was attractive, logically clear, and worth trying. Song Yajing felt a little more at ease and saved the final version of the copy.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Received a parcel sent by my mother
description: The courier delivered a package sent by her mother Lin Xiuying from Quanzhou. Song Yajing carefully opened it to find a pink little sweater hand-knitted by her mother with fine stitches, and a large bag of Quanzhou orange-red cakes and garlic sticks. Her heart warmed, and she immediately took a photo of the sweater and the local specialties, sent it to the family group, and casually posted it in the customer group saying: “Mom's warmth has arrived at the store~” Several moms in the group liked it immediately, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch, community interaction, and getting coffee.
description: Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the store while she walked to the satay noodle shop in a side alley of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, where she ordered a bowl of classic satay noodles with tofu and squid. While waiting for the noodles, she scrolled through the reactions in the customer group. Several moms asked where the sweater was bought, and she smiled and replied that it was not for sale, it was a gift made with her mother's love. After finishing the noodles, she stopped by the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City and bought a hot latte to recharge herself. The round trip on foot took about 15 minutes.
location: Satay noodle shop in a side alley of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery at 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sort out materials from the used clothes event, review, reconcile the accounts, and get ready to leave work.
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing sat on the sofa and began reviewing the photos and videos from yesterday's old-clothes swap event. She carefully chose the 9 photos that best captured the warm atmosphere and planned to post them in the group in the evening. She also called florist Zhao Li to recap which segments had drawn the most enthusiastic reactions. Zhao Li's floral makeover segment stood out particularly; many people took photos and posted them on WeChat Moments. After the call, Song Yajing noted two new ideas: set up a dedicated children's swap area next time, and try live-streaming the makeover segment. As it was nearing closing time and there were few customers in the store, Song Yajing and Xiaomei checked the day's accounts together. Revenue was modest, with most expenses going into community operation efforts. They reviewed the list of new items expected to arrive tomorrow. Xiaomei suggested placing the knit cardigans on the most visible shelf, and Song Yajing accepted the suggestion. She locked the cash register, told Xiaomei to lock the door at 5:40, and prepared to leave early.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and buy fruit
description: Song Yajing closed the shop door and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She arrived just in time for dismissal. Her daughter Chen Lexuan was especially happy to see her and ran over to hug her. Holding her daughter's little hand, she walked to the fruit shop on Gugong Road and bought strawberries her daughter loved and green jujubes she wanted herself. On the way home, her daughter chattered about learning a new nursery rhyme at kindergarten today.
location: Along the route from No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), then to a fruit and grocery store (No. 55 Gugong Road), then to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner time
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already stir-frying in the kitchen, and the aroma filled the air. Song Yajing let her daughter wash her hands and washed the fruit herself. She leaned against the kitchen door frame and told her husband about the sweater her mother had mailed today and her idea to test the waters with a community activity to attract new members. Dinner was the braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and seaweed egg drop soup that her husband had made. The family of three ate and chatted. Song Yajing said she wanted to try making chiffon cake again but was afraid of failure. Her husband encouraged her, saying, "Go ahead—if it fails, I'll eat it," and her daughter joined in the teasing. After dinner, Song Yajing cleared the dishes and let her husband go accompany their daughter.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied her daughter with washing up and reading picture books, and published a community member recruitment activity.
description: Song Yajing bathed her daughter first, helped her put on the pink sweater knitted by her grandmother, and it fit very well. Her daughter happily twirled in front of the mirror several times. She lay on the bed with her daughter and read Guess How Much I Love You. Halfway through, her daughter started to feel drowsy. She kissed her daughter's forehead and turned off the bedside lamp. After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing tiptoed out of the bedroom, opened the Jingxinge customer group, edited a message on her phone, attached the 9 warm photos from yesterday's old-clothes swap event selected in the afternoon, and tapped send. After the message was sent, she stared at the screen. Soon an old customer replied that it was a great event and she would bring her bestie. Then two more replies came in, and she felt a little hopeful.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Continue following up on community activities and record bedtime reflections
description: One hour after the event was posted, three regular customers responded, and altogether six or seven new people were pulled into the group. Song Yajing carefully added the new members to the group and sent each of them a welcome message and a 15-yuan coupon. Her husband came over to ask how it was going, and she said it was okay, a few new people had joined. Afterwards, she leaned against the headboard, took out her notebook, and wrote down the event reflection and plan: Event reflection: 1. On Monday evening everyone was busy with their own things, so the willingness to share was not high; 2. The 15-yuan coupon was not very attractive. Improvement: next time, hold it on a weekend evening and try tiered rewards (refer 2 people for 15 yuan, refer 5 people for 30 yuan). She decided to try again next time after making the adjustments.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Song Yajing did a simple skincare routine and applied night cream. She turned off the main light and left only a bedside lamp on. She chatted briefly with her husband; he said he would have to work overtime tomorrow and would be home late. She put her hands together and silently recited a bedtime prayer. Then she checked the time and sent a WeChat message to her shop assistant Xiaomei: "See you at 9 tomorrow, we'll adjust the display together." She also sent her mother Lin Xiuying a voice message: "Ma, the sweater looks nice. Xuanxuan is so proud when she wears it. Love you." After that, she turned off her phone, closed her eyes, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: In the early morning of March 25, 2025, Song Yajing woke up to the sound of her phone alarm and felt her nasal congestion had eased. She washed up briefly, changed into comfortable loungewear, drank some warm water in the kitchen, and then went to her daughter's room to gently wake Xuanxuan, planning to have her wear the sweater her grandmother had knitted.
location: Home at 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Song Yajing helped her daughter Chen Lexuan put on the pink hand-knitted sweater sent by her mother, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang prepared boiled eggs, milk, and toast for breakfast. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Yajing reminded Zhiqiang to come home early in the evening to discuss the financial plan.
location: Home at 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Ride an electric bike to take daughter to kindergarten.
description: Song Yajing rode an electric scooter with Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, about a 5-minute ride. At the kindergarten gate, she straightened her daughter's collar, kissed her forehead, and reminded her that she would pick her up in the afternoon. Xuanxuan happily entered the classroom.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bought rhinitis spray at the community pharmacy.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes to the Lujiang Street Community Health Service Center, where she bought a bottle of the same nasal spray for rhinitis at her own expense at the pharmacy window. She put it in her handbag, feeling that her nasal congestion was not severe and it would last for a while.
location: Lujiang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 323 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the store and have breakfast.
description: Starting from the community hospital, Song Yajing walked along Xiahe Road, turned onto Siming North Road, and then entered Zhongshan Road, taking about 13 minutes to reach the shop. Passing a breakfast stall on Zhongshan Road, she bought freshly made pan-fried buns, eating while walking and savoring the city's morning atmosphere.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near No. 56, Zhongshan Road)

name: Open the store for business, adjust the displays, and discuss community activities
description: Song Yajing opened the roller shutter door of Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store. Shop assistant Xiaomei was already wiping the cashier counter. After checking yesterday's sales receipts, the two moved the light cotton-linen shirts paired with khaki wide-leg pants to a prominent position at the entrance based on feedback, and adjusted the mannequins and racks. Later, standing at the store entrance, they discussed the Monday evening community member recruitment event and thought the results were mediocre. They planned to try a 'Girlfriends' Afternoon Tea' theme next time on a weekend afternoon, and invite florist Zhao Li to provide small bunches of dried flowers as a sign-up benefit. They also recorded the improvement ideas in their memo.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch time
description: At noon, as customers gradually thinned out, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to go eat first. She walked to the 'Chudai' light meal shop near Zhongshan Road and ordered the signature avocado chicken breast salad with vinaigrette. While eating, she scrolled through her phone, saw someone in the customer group showing off a renovated old garment, and casually liked it.
location: Chudai Light Meal Shop, near No. 227 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and contacting the florist
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing leaned on the sofa to rest with her eyes closed. Feeling congested and uncomfortable, she used the new nasal spray she had bought. She then contacted florist Zhao Li by WeChat voice message, asking her to help review the visual style of the community event poster, and praised the photos from the last clothes-swap event, agreeing to talk on the phone at 7 p.m.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking stock of business and family finances
description: In the afternoon, customer flow was sparse. Song Yajing sorted out the day's sales in the shop, having sold only two silk scarves. She took the family ledger, loan repayment records, her daughter's kindergarten payment notice, and shop cash flow screenshots from the locked drawer. Using a calculator, she itemized and calculated the shop's total revenue, purchase costs, rent, wages, utilities, property fees, and more. After calculating, she found disposable cash was tight and every cent needed planning. She made marks in the ledger and prepared the data for the evening conversation.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closed the shop early and went to pick up my daughter.
description: Song Yajing gave Xiao Mei instructions for the evening shift, locked the cabinet, and left the store carrying a document folder containing account books and receipts. She walked about 3 minutes from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, ready to pick up her daughter after school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter from school and playing in the park
description: After picking up Xuanxuan, who was wearing a colorful sweater, Song Yajing walked with her for about 21 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan excitedly fed pigeons under the trees. Yajing bought her a cup of hot corn juice and sat on a bench watching her daughter play, temporarily forgetting her worries.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying fruit on the way home.
description: As it was getting dark, Song Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand and walked back along Bailu Road. Passing a fruit shop near the intersection of Siming South Road and Bailu Road, she bought a box of Dandong strawberries at her daughter's request. Then, carrying the strawberries and a document bag, she walked about 16 minutes back to the home in the community at 82 Shanggu Street.
location: Fruit shop near the intersection of South Siming Road and Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child interaction
description: When they got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already simmered pork rib soup. The family of three had dinner together. Xuanxuan told fun stories from kindergarten, and Yajing praised her for being adorable when she fed pigeons. After dinner, Yajing played LEGO with Xuanxuan to learn colors and shapes. At seven, she helped her wash up and change into pajamas, then sat against the headboard reading the picture book Guess How Much I Love You until her daughter fell asleep.
location: Home at 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After soothing the child to sleep, the couple prepares for a financial discussion.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing gently closed the bedroom door and returned to the living room. Her husband was already seated and had taken out his pay slip. Yajing opened her memo, spread out the account books and receipts, and the atmosphere was serious but united.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the living room of the home at No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Couple discussing family finances and education savings plans
description: Song Yajing calmly but seriously showed her husband the accounting details, pointing out that the store's cash flow was tight and expenses needed to be planned. Zhiqiang told her that after his promotion, his monthly take-home pay increased by 1,600 yuan, and he proposed transferring a fixed 2,000 yuan from his salary every month into Xuanxuan's education savings account. With side jobs, they could save nearly 30,000 yuan a year. They also discussed cutting takeout frequency to once a week, pausing non-essential shopping, listing item by item what could be reduced, and together made an initial plan.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the living room of the home at No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Record the education savings plan and help an unemployed classmate.
description: After the discussion, Song Yajing immediately wrote the education fund savings plan in her phone memo, including terms such as automatically transferring 2,000 yuan on the 10th of each month, checking bills on the 1st of each month, and cutting expenses, then sent it to Zhiqiang via WeChat. Just as she put down her phone, she received a message from middle school classmate Zhang Wei, learning that he had been laid off by a company in Shenzhen and had returned to Xiamen to ask for help finding a job. Yajing quickly contacted an HR friend and connections in the fashion industry, but there was no good news yet. She comforted Zhang Wei not to worry and expressed her support.
location: Home at 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night baking of reduced-sugar banana muffins
description: With mixed feelings, Song Yajing used the remaining ingredients to try making a reduced-sugar banana muffin with chopped walnuts, but after baking, the inside was rather dry—still a failure. She took a photo and posted it to the baking group to poke fun at herself. A group member, Mrs. Liu, suggested adding yogurt to improve the moisture. The baking process helped her release her anxiety.
location: The community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; the kitchen of the home at No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Stretching, journaling, and praying before bed.
description: Back in the bedroom, Song Yajing did a five-minute shoulder and neck stretch, then took out her diary to record the day's fulfillment and reflections, including the implementation of her financial plan, the helplessness of helping an old classmate, and a small baking failure. Afterward, she knelt by the bed for a brief prayer, thanking the Lord for peace and revelation.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Cutting expenses in the early morning and preparing lunch boxes.
description: The morning alarm went off, and Song Yajing immediately remembered the frugality agreement with her husband. She picked up her phone, opened settings, canceled the 25 yuan/month subscription to the video conferencing app, and recorded it in her expense tracker app, feeling a small sense of accomplishment. After washing up, she went to the kitchen, tied on an apron, and prepared two lunch boxes with multigrain rice, sautéed broccoli, and fried eggs. Around then her husband Chen Zhiqiang also got up. Seeing her busy, he proactively paused the auto-recharge on a game account. The two exchanged smiles, silently working together to manage household expenses.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: Yajing gently pushed open the door of her daughter Xuanxuan's room, woke her up by singing a self-made wake-up song, and helped her put on her kindergarten uniform. The family of three sat around the dining table and enjoyed the hot milk, whole-wheat bread, and boiled eggs that Chen Zhiqiang had prepared. Yajing told her daughter that they would see a Chinese medicine practitioner today, hoping it could treat her nose issue. After breakfast, Yajing took Xuanxuan by the hand and walked through the tree-lined streets of Siming District, passing several alleys, and arrived at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten after about 12 minutes. She squatted down to say goodbye with a cheek-to-cheek touch, then watched Xuanxuan run bouncing into the classroom.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping on the way to work
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing walked toward Zhongshan Road. She first turned into the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road and bought a pack of colored cardstock for Xuanxuan to replenish her craft supplies. Then she bought a hot soy milk and a steamed pork bun at the convenience store near Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, eating while walking. On the familiar road from the kindergarten to the shop, she enjoyed her quiet morning time alone.
location: Stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the convenience store at Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the store and asking for help for a classmate
description: Yajing arrived at the Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, opened the rolling shutter door, and wiped the shelves and tidied the displays together with shop assistant Xiaomei, hanging the newly arrived spring dresses on mannequins. After a brief morning meeting, she sat down at the cash register, took out her phone, and composed a message in the “Class of 2006 of Siming Middle School” alumni group asking for help with old classmate Zhang Wei's job search. After giving it some thought, she sent it, hoping to get useful responses.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk to the traditional Chinese medicine clinic.
description: Seeing that customer flow in the store was steady, Yajing said hello to Xiaomei and walked to the traditional Chinese medicine clinic recommended by a customer yesterday. The clinic was on Zhenhai Road, about 1 kilometer from the store. She arrived after a 12-minute walk, registered, and then waited patiently in line to see the doctor.
location: Zhenhai Road Community Health Service Center, No. X, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Traditional Chinese medicine consultation and picking up medicine
description: When it was Yajing's turn, she described in detail the symptoms she had been having over the past few days: nasal congestion, sneezing, and itchy eyes. The old Chinese medicine practitioner took her pulse and examined her tongue coating, diagnosing her with wind-heat attacking the lungs with nasal sinusitis, and prescribed a week's worth of Chinese herbal medicine. Yajing picked up seven doses at the pharmacy, feeling hope for healing rise in her heart.
location: Zhenhai Road Community Health Service Center, No. X, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning to the shop and simmering Chinese herbal medicine
description: Yajing walked back to the Jingxin Pavilion store carrying a bag of Chinese herbal medicine. She didn't go home, but went straight into the store, found a mini health pot, and began to double-boil the first dose of the herbs. A rich herbal aroma soon filled the air.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and group message follow-up
description: After the herbal medicine was done simmering, Yajing poured the liquid into a thermos. She had lunch with Xiaomei, who had just ordered takeout, and they scrolled through their phones while eating. Finally, someone in the classmate group replied, 'Let me ask our HR.' Yajing was delighted, immediately took a screenshot and sent it to Zhang Wei with the message, 'Brother, there's hope!' bringing a glimmer of hope to her old classmate's job search.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Duty and community event preparation.
description: After lunch, Yajing stood at the counter, drinking the slightly bitter traditional Chinese medicine while using her tablet to refine the detailed process for next week's “Gal Pals' Afternoon Tea” community event. Xiaomei teased that the shop was about to become a medicinal food store, and Yajing smiled in response. She also sent a voice message to florist Zhao Li to discuss the floral ambience arrangement for the event.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Receiving customers and deepening the work
description: In the afternoon, customers gradually increased. Yajing drew on her ESFJ social strengths, enthusiastically recommending new products and offering styling advice to several regular customers. Between serving customers, she continued refining the community event plan and saved the resume Zhang Wei had sent, planning to review it for him when she got home that evening.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and do activities at the park
description: At three in the afternoon, Yajing asked Xiaomei to watch the store until 17:00 and walked to the kindergarten by herself. After picking up Xuanxuan, she took her daughter to the nearby Jiaxing Garden Park. Xuanxuan happily played on the slide and swings, while Yajing sat on a stone bench in the sun watching her daughter play. On the way back, they bought a box of fresh strawberries at a fruit stand.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Mother and daughter on the way home and some leisurely time together
description: After leaving the park, Yajing walked home holding Xuanxuan's hand. On the way, Xuanxuan chattered happily, sharing the new nursery rhymes she had learned in kindergarten and the pictures she had drawn. Yajing responded patiently, feeling warm inside. Once home, she had Xuanxuan play with building blocks in the living room and started preparing dinner ingredients herself.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner and share it as a couple.
description: Yajing tied on an apron and washed and chopped vegetables, preparing to make stir-fried seasonal greens and tomato and egg soup. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, hugged their daughter, and went into the kitchen to help. While cooking, Yajing shared with her husband about her visit to the Chinese medicine doctor today, and the anxiety and joy of asking for help for Zhang Wei in the classmates' group. After hearing this, Zhiqiang encouraged her to keep up her momentum.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and time together for the family of three
description: The family of three sat around the table enjoying dinner. Xuanxuan ate very quickly, then pestered her father to play games. After the meal, Yajing cleared the table while Zhiqiang played with building blocks with his daughter in the living room. The home was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Contact mother and work on resume.
description: Yajing sent a voice message to her mother Lin Xiuying, who was far away in Quanzhou, describing in detail her visit to the Chinese medicine doctor today. She laughed and said the medicine was quite bitter, but she hoped it would work. Her mother quickly replied and urged her to take the medicine on time. Then Yajing used the time to process the resume Zhang Wei had sent, briefly organizing his skills and strengths to prepare for a future referral.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Put daughter to bed.
description: Yajing started to get Xuanxuan to sleep. She read her daughter two picture-book stories and sang "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star," and Xuanxuan soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Daughter's bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and rest.
description: Yajing finally had some time to herself. She took a comfortable hot bath and followed a complete evening skincare routine. Looking at herself in the mirror, she felt that her complexion seemed a bit better today than in the past couple of days.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Improved baking experiment
description: After washing up, Yajing's baking urge kicked in. Remembering Mrs. Liu's advice yesterday about sugar and yogurt, she decided to take on the challenge of an improved low-sugar banana muffin. She carefully weighed the ingredients, mashed the ripe bananas into a paste, and mixed them with eggs and yogurt. This time she deliberately added twice as much yogurt, and the batter looked much moister than last time.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tasting the results and making the evening record
description: The oven timer rang, and Yajing took out the muffins. This time they had risen beautifully, with golden tops and a sweet aroma of banana and yogurt. She broke one open—it was soft, moist, and perfectly sweetened. A complete success. Satisfied, she took a photo and posted it to the baking group, then sent a thank-you message to Mrs. Liu. Afterward, she sat at her desk and recorded the fulfilling day in her diary.
location: Room 302, Building 6, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Yajing knelt beside the bed and said a brief evening prayer, thanking God for a fulfilling day and her family's safety. At 10:35 p.m., she turned off the bedside lamp, said goodnight to her husband, and hoped her nose would feel better tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and daughter care
description: Woke up early in the morning and felt lighter than yesterday. First went to the bathroom to wash up, using warm water to wash my face to relieve a stuffy nose. Then went to the kitchen to heat up the Chinese herbal medicine that had been simmered last night, while noting in my phone memo the changes in sneezing and nasal congestion after taking the medicine. While waiting for the medicine to heat, I washed the cup used for roselle tea. After that, I gently pushed open the door of my daughter Xuanxuan's room, helped her put on the pink sweater sent by her grandmother, tied her hair into a ponytail, and took her through her morning wash. The new day began in warmth.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast
description: My husband Chen Zhiqiang prepared breakfast: rice porridge, fried eggs, and an upgraded reduced-sugar banana muffin. I drank the Chinese herbal medicine while it was still hot. The three of us chatted as we ate and agreed to make dumplings together in the evening. My husband promised to bring back Shanxi aged vinegar after work. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: After the meal, she put the schoolbag on Xuanxuan's back, but Xuanxuan insisted on carrying the painting she wanted to give to her teacher herself. Mother and daughter walked hand in hand to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, smelling the fragrance of osmanthus along the way. After arriving, she confirmed the child's health with the teacher on duty, asked the teacher to remind her to drink more water, and watched Xuanxuan happily walk into the classroom before leaving.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy a hot drink
description: After dropping off the child, I detoured to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City and ordered a hot oat milk latte to warm my stomach. The clerk asked familiarly if it was the usual. I took the coffee and strolled leisurely along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street toward the store, enjoying the brief quiet of the morning.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and morning meeting.
description: Arrived at the Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, opened the rolling shutter door, and cleaned and arranged the mannequin displays with shop assistant Xiaomei. The two chatted about the enthusiastic response from yesterday's customer group to the display photos, then held a brief morning meeting to finalize the decoration and gift details for the weekend's “Gal Pals Afternoon Tea” event. I took out handmade flower-pattern paper cards, and Xiaomei sorted the dried flowers.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning work: community operations and contacting classmates
description: At the counter, while drinking coffee, sent new product photos in the customer group to preview the weekend event, sparking customers' interest, while also refining the event flow and reward rules. Later, in the middle school classmates group, asked Zhang Wei about his job search progress. Learning that the HR process was slow, encouraged him to be patient, showing concern for an old classmate.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch
description: She asked Xiaomei to mind the store and walked alone to her usual 'Old Alley' satay noodle shop on Zhenbang Road, where she ordered a bowl of hot satay noodles with pork liver and fried tofu puffs. The rich broth dispelled the chill from the Chinese medicine in her stomach, warming her whole body, and her stuffy nose also felt relieved.
location: Old Alley Shacha Noodle Shop, Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon nap and occasional customer reception.
description: After returning to the shop, she received several groups of customers and styled a young girl in a knit cardigan and a floral skirt, successfully making a sale. During a lull in foot traffic, she leaned back on a soft stool and rested with her eyes closed for about ten minutes, regaining her energy.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store work, feedback, and checklist organization.
description: In the afternoon, while tidying the clothing racks, she sent a health update to the veteran Chinese medicine doctor, reporting that her sneezing had decreased and her sense of smell had improved, and the doctor reminded her to continue avoiding restricted foods. Then she and shop assistant Xiao Mei worked in sync to serve customers. In spare moments, she edited her evening shopping list on her phone, including greens, eggs, dumpling wrappers, shiitake mushrooms, and so on. At exactly 4 p.m., she had Xiao Mei handle the closing tasks and left work early to buy groceries.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping at the market and running into a neighbor
description: Walk to the vegetable market on Hubin South Road. At the stall of Sister Zhao, a familiar vendor, I picked out fresh Shanghai bok choy and free-range eggs, and bought dumpling wrappers and dried shiitake mushrooms from the dried goods stall. While choosing celery, I ran into Aunt Zhang, a neighbor. Hearing my stuffy nose, she warmly recommended honeycomb extract and took me to a dried goods shop to buy it. I gratefully accepted this folk remedy.
location: Hujing Comprehensive Market, No. 101-A17, Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: On the way home and taking honeycomb essence.
description: Carrying the groceries she had bought, she went home and on the way bought a box of Dandong strawberries at the fruit shop at the community gate. After arriving home, she couldn't wait to follow Aunt Zhang's advice and drank a spoonful of honeycomb extract mixed with warm water. The orange-yellow liquid was warm and sweet, instantly soothing her throat, and she hoped it would relieve her stuffy nose.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang had already arrived home, and the two worked together in the kitchen. He was responsible for washing and chopping vegetables and seasoning the meat filling, while I was responsible for wrapping with ready-made dumpling wrappers. We shared amusing stories from the day as we worked. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of garlic and laughter while preparing celery and pork dumplings.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cozy dinner
description: The family of three sat around enjoying steaming hot dumplings, and daughter Xuanxuan praised them as delicious. During the meal, I shared the chance encounter at the market and the honeycomb extract. My husband also mentioned that his company had distributed imported blueberries, which we could share after the meal. The family atmosphere was relaxed and happy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Play and read with my daughter
description: After dinner, I accompanied Xuanxuan in the living room playing with Lego blocks. She built an imaginary big villa for the family. Then I took her back to her room to read the picture book 'Carmela the Little Chicken.' Xuanxuan fell sweetly asleep to the sound of the story, and I kissed her forehead before leaving.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and health records
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she mixed another cup of honeycomb essence in the master bedroom bathroom, then sat at the vanity and recorded the body's improvement in detail, especially mentioning that she could smell floral scents and that nasal congestion had eased by about 30–40%. She then sent the feedback to the old Chinese medicine doctor and received a reply saying, “Continue taking it and watch your diet,” which put her mind at ease.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: In the study, I made a video call to my mother, Lin Xiuying, and excitedly told her about the warm-hearted neighbor I met and the folk remedy, and mentioned making dumplings on the weekend. My mother said she wasn't busy on the weekend and planned to come by bus, bringing some fresh vegetables and homemade turnip cake. My heart warmed.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime chat
description: After washing up, she chatted with her husband Chen Zhiqiang in bed about weekend plans, suggesting the family go to Jiaxingyuan Park for a picnic and kite flying. He considerately agreed and turned off the light, bringing a peaceful end to the day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Closing her eyes for a bedtime prayer, she gave thanks for the kindness she encountered during the day and the company of her family. As her body relaxed, the discomfort in her nose gradually faded, and she fell peacefully asleep in gratitude and anticipation.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 06:45 in the morning. Song Yajing got up and first went to the kitchen to heat the herbal medicine that had been soaking overnight, then took a shower, did her skincare routine, and applied sunscreen. Afterward, in the kitchen, she used eggs, toast, and milk from the fridge, fried bacon and eggs to make a sandwich, made hot milk for her daughter, and by then the herbal medicine was ready. She woke up her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, and helped her daughter get dressed. The whole family sat at the dining table and had breakfast together. Song Yajing drank the herbal medicine and told a joke to amuse her daughter, and the family of three enjoyed a happy and warm time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten and go home to set up the livestream corner
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing helped her daughter put on her schoolbag, and the two walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter mentioned that she wanted sweet and sour ribs for dinner. They arrived at the kindergarten gate at 08:00. After watching her daughter walk into the classroom with the teacher, Song Yajing walked home. After arriving home at about 08:15, she began preparing for the morning livestream: she cleaned up the corner by the living room window, moved in a tea table and laid a linen tablecloth over it, set up a phone stand, freshly brewed hot coffee, and a small vase with eucalyptus leaves, and poured Chinese herbal medicine into a white porcelain cup, placing it beside the stand.
location: The community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road)

name: First morning livestream and follow-up
description: At exactly 09:00, Song Yajing started her first livestream on her phone with the theme 'Coffee After Dropping Off the Kids.' She was a bit nervous at first, but soon talked about her experiences with spring pollen allergies and traditional Chinese medicine treatments. Holding up a white porcelain cup to show the herbal decoction, she struck a chord with her fans, and the comments section became lively. After the livestream, she excitedly reviewed the comments and private messages. An old customer recommended the WeChat contact of a local old beekeeper, so she added it immediately and ordered a bottle of fresh honeycomb essence, arranging same-city flash delivery. Then she quickly packed up her equipment, took her notebook and phone charger, checked her keys and wallet, locked the front door, and prepared to head to the clothing store.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning shop work and supplier communication
description: At 10:20, Song Yajing left home and walked to the Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, arriving around 10:27. The shop assistant Xiaomei was already there. She first checked the group orders, then with Xiaomei organized the new product styling for the weekend 'Besties Afternoon Tea' event, changed the window mannequins to spring outfits, and placed dried flower bouquets beside the cash register. Around 11:30, she contacted supplier Susan via WeChat voice, confirmed the new styles for the weekend event were correct, and urged that the previously reordered floral-print dresses and size S wide-leg pants be shipped before next Tuesday.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunchtime
description: At noon, there were no customers in the store. Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to go to lunch first, then locked the store door herself and walked about 12 minutes to the Old Xiamen Shacha Noodle Shop, ordered a bowl of shacha noodles with tofu and squid, and finished it while it was piping hot.
location: Old Xiamen Shacha Noodles (Zhongshan Road Branch), No. 13 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and community warm-up
description: At 12:52, Song Yajing walked back to the store and rested on the sofa with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes. After waking up, she shared screenshots and photos from the livestream in the 'Yajing Lifestyle Hall' WeChat group, and announced the girlfriends' afternoon tea event for tomorrow afternoon, mentioning that florist Zhao Li would be on-site to guide making small dried flower bouquets, emphasizing that spots were limited and first come, first served, as a warm-up for the event.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon: shop operations and first experience with honeycomb essence.
description: After the store opened for the afternoon, Song Yajing received two groups of customers. A young girl was satisfied and bought the light cotton-linen shirt and wide-leg pants she had tried on. Around 14:00, Shansong same-city delivery sent over the honeycomb extract. She opened the package, brewed it with warm water, and tasted it. It felt sweeter and more refreshing than the one Aunt Zhang had given her, and her throat felt soothed. She happily took a photo of the honeycomb extract and posted it on Moments, sharing her spring health tips and thanking Aunt Zhang for the recommendation. Then Xiao Mei came back from lunch, and the two sorted through the afternoon sales data together. They found that today's two new customers had both come from last weekend's new-customer promotion, which made them look forward to tomorrow's event effects even more.
location: Jingxinge Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: At 15:40, after handing over the store duties, Song Yajing put on her backpack and walked about 17 minutes to Lakeview Comprehensive Market. At a familiar butcher shop, she bought 50 yuan worth of pork ribs and a piece of pork belly, and at a vegetable stall she bought garlic sprouts and scallions, preparing all the ingredients for the evening's sweet-and-sour ribs and braised pork. She finished shopping at 16:05 and walked to the kindergarten.
location: Lakeview Comprehensive Market, 101 Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up her daughter from school and played at the park.
description: After about a 12-minute walk from the market, she arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 16:17 and chatted with other parents while waiting. Her daughter Xuanxuan was delighted to see her mother and ran over happily. Then Song Yajing took her for a walk to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park to play on the slide, enjoying mother-child time in the sunset.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road

name: Return home to prepare a meal.

She immediately perked up, quickly and sincerely introduced Zhang Wei's strengths, and agreed to share his WeChat with the HR rep. After hanging up, she let out a long sigh of relief and continued cooking.

While eating, she browsed her phone, saw spring child allergy prevention tips in a parenting group, and found them useful enough to screenshot and save. After eating, she returned to the shop, drank some water, touched up her makeup, and got ready to meet her best friend.

description: While shopping, Li Meiling accidentally dropped her phone while answering a call, and the screen shattered, leaving her extremely anxious. A thought struck me: the store had a spare Android phone. I immediately led her quickly back to Jingxin Pavilion. With Xiaomei’s help, I found the phone. After confirming it supported all carriers, Meiling inserted her SIM card and successfully reset it, and the phone returned to normal use. Meiling hugged me excitedly and thanked me repeatedly, and agreed to treat our whole family to dinner next weekend.

Xuanxuan, wearing her new hair clip, danced in the living room and made the whole family laugh.

location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

In between, she received two groups of young women who came in to shelter from the rain. They were very interested in a new Chinese-style dress in the window. Yajing warmly invited them to try it on. Although they didn't make a purchase in the end, they added each other on WeChat.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Mother and daughter chatted and laughed, stepping through puddles on the way home. When they got home, her husband Zhiqiang was already busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of braised pork belly filled the air.

Xuanxuan told funny stories from kindergarten, while Yajing and Zhiqiang talked about their daily routines. Yajing temporarily put aside the worries of the account books and enjoyed this warm family moment.

Zhiqiang nodded, telling her not to stay out too late and to be safe. She picked up her umbrella and document bag and went out again.

name: Store account summary and business review
description: After closing, the shop was especially quiet. She opened the unfinished Excel file from the afternoon on her computer and began checking and entering data item by item. When she calculated that March revenue was about 42,000 yuan but net profit was less than 8,000 yuan, her heart truly sank. But she quickly calmed herself down and analyzed in her notebook with a red pen: the coffee corner's nearly 1,000 yuan monthly cost had hardly driven sales; the online traffic investment had also yielded little. She decisively wrote down two adjustments: stop purchasing new products for the coffee corner and instead offer simple drip bags or tea drinks; focus community activities on repeat purchases from existing customers and temporarily stop spending on traffic acquisition. She also planned to discuss with Zhao Li tomorrow changing the flower arrangement collaboration into small bouquets for sale.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Updated her husband on the business results

She picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to Zhiqiang, telling him that March net profit was less than 8,000 yuan and that she had decided to cut the coffee investment to focus on survival. Shortly after, she received her husband's reply saying the final payment for his freelance work had come in and he would transfer 2,000 to the education account the next day. Seeing this message, Yajing's eyes welled up and she took a screenshot of the conversation.
location: Jingxin Pavilion Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Locked the door, got off work, and walked home.

location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road to No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

When she closed the notebook, she felt a heavy clarity, but more than that, the steadiness that came from having reoriented herself. She knelt by the bed and said her evening prayers for her family, for the store, and for her own courage.
location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparations

After breakfast, she prepared washed loquats and throat lozenges.
