description: Song Yajing walked from Zhenhai Road to her shop Jingxin Pavilion at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, she listed the core action items for the day in her phone's memo. After arriving, she opened the door to air the place out, boiled water to make tea, turned on the computer and business ledger, and used a red pen to draft April adjustment details: stop online advertising, suspend purchases of materials for the coffee corner, and shift the budget to restocking three spring clothing items from supplier Susan in Guangzhou. Then she contacted Susan via WeChat to confirm the restocking arrangement.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Held a store meeting with shop assistant Xiaomei.
description: After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, Song Yajing spread open her notebook on the small tea table beside the fitting area and explained the April business strategy to Xiaomei. She said that because the coffee corner was suspended, they needed to focus on guiding customers to try on clothes and maintaining WeChat customer relationships. She also announced a tiered commission plan: monthly sales up to 20,000 yuan earn 3% commission, and the portion above that earns 5%. Xiaomei volunteered to post more outfit videos in the WeChat group.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Adjust product display
description: Song Yajing and Xiao Mei worked together to take out the newly arrived spring items from the warehouse and replace the entrance display. Song Yajing personally adjusted the lighting angle, making the best-selling floral dress the focal point of the entire store.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Normal business hours in the morning.
description: The store opened for business, and customers came in one after another. Song Yajing was responsible for styling consultations, while Xiaomei handled cashiering and tidying. During this time, two transactions were completed, including an old customer who had come specifically to see Song Yajing's preview on WeChat Moments and bought that floral-print dress.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and midday prayer
description: Song Yajing asked a colleague to watch the store and went to the nearby Chudai light meal shop for an avocado chicken breast salad. After returning to the store, she quietly prayed for ten minutes in the corner by the cash register, asking for a safe and smooth afternoon.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Chudai Light Meal Shop, No. 32, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Lunch break and customer maintenance.
description: Song Yajing closed her eyes and rested for 20 minutes on the small sofa by the cash register. After waking up, she sent photos of today's newly styled dresses in the customer WeChat group with the caption, “April brings a new look. Do you 'pink' this gentle floral pattern?” She received likes and inquiries from several regular customers.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and preparations for new product launch plan.
description: During the afternoon business, Song Yajing received customers while checking her phone notes to organize warehouse inventory, noted styles that needed restocking, and started drafting next week's 'eco-friendly cotton and linen' themed new product plan.
location: Jingxin Pavilion, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop, pick up my daughter, buy fruit, and go home.
description: Song Yajing closed the shop 15 minutes early, explained the closing tasks to Xiao Mei, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After picking up her daughter Chen Lexuan, Xuanxuan ran out holding a watercolor painting of 'Spring Flowers'. Song Yajing praised her, and then they walked home together. On the way, they bought fresh strawberries and loquats at the Mingfa Fruit Shop on Hubin South Road.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, and Mingfa Fruit Shop, No. 156 Hubin South Road

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had prepared seaweed egg drop soup and stir-fried greens, and the family of three had dinner together. At the table, Song Yajing shared the progress of the store plan and the recurrence of her rhinitis, and Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her. After dinner, Song Yajing peeled loquats and shared them with the family.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompany daughter
description: Song Yajing played with building blocks with her daughter Chen Lexuan, read the picture book Spring Is Coming, and at around 8 o'clock washed her daughter, changed her into pajamas, and told her a story to put her to sleep.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing Family Financial Communication and Operations Notes
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing took out her laptop and phone and showed her husband Chen Zhiqiang the April store plan and investment budget. The two of them reviewed the April family expenses together and confirmed the transfer amount for the education account. She then organized the day's communications with supplier Susan into the 'April Operations Notes'.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and planning for tomorrow
description: Song Yajing spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and followed an app for a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch to relax her shoulders, which were tense from standing for a long time. Then she made a cup of warm traditional Chinese medicine granules and drank it to relieve her nasal congestion. Afterward, she opened the memo on her phone and wrote down tomorrow’s to-dos: go to the health clinic in the morning to get anti-allergy medication, and contact Susan to confirm the community sharing template. Finally, she said a short prayer of gratitude.
location: Master bedroom, Room 203, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Feeling assured that the plan was taken care of, Song Yajing tidied up and went to bed.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up and preparing medication
description: At 7 a.m., I was woken by the alarm clock and felt my nasal passages were somewhat clearer. I took loratadine tablets from the medicine box, divided them into a portable pill case, put a reminder note on it, checked the remaining amounts of Chinese medicine granules and honeycomb extract capsules, and put the honeycomb extract into my handbag. Then I rinsed my nasal passages with saline spray to be prepared for the dusty weather.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast and family time
description: Her husband made coffee, and Yajing prepared breakfast: toasted whole wheat bread, poured milk, and heated up pig-shaped custard buns for her daughter. The family ate breakfast together, during which she reminded her husband to pick up the air purifier filter that was sent for repair after work.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Helped her daughter put on her schoolbag and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, at her daughter's request, she bought small animal stickers at a convenience store. She took her daughter to the kindergarten gate, handed her to the teacher, and left.
location: From the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten.

name: Commuting to the store
description: She walked from the kindergarten to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Line 1 to Zhenhai Road Station, exited via Exit 2, and walked about 5 minutes to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The weather that day was sunny turning cloudy with floating dust, so she wore a mask while traveling.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten to the shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, via Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Arriving at the store and preparing
description: Opened the store’s rolling shutter door, turned on the air purifier, and watered the pothos. Checked yesterday’s sales ledger to confirm the revenue and petty cash were correct. At the same time, mentally planned the display flow for the new products.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Process newly arrived goods
description: Shop assistant Xiao Mei arrived at the store, and the courier delivered three boxes of goods. The two split the work and opened the boxes. Yajing used a utility knife to open them, while Xiao Mei checked the fabric and workmanship, paying special attention to the floral chiffon dresses and lightweight knit cardigans. After confirming everything was fine, Xiao Mei ironed the clothes, and Yajing dressed the window mannequins in the new outfits, adjusted the main display racks, and created a bright spring-fashion atmosphere. Finally, they took photos of the new products for online promotion.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch time
description: Taking advantage of the lull in customer traffic at noon, I ordered takeout from a newly opened light meal salad shop in Zhonghua City via a mobile app — grilled chicken breast avocado salad, with a special note to put the vinaigrette on the side. After the delivery arrived, I ate it in the store's rest area, and it felt refreshing and healthy.
location: Rest area of the shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday photo retouching and copywriting ideas.
description: She imported the new product photos taken in the morning into a photo-retouching app, selected three main images, and began drafting the accompanying copy: the first outfit, a floral dress with a denim jacket, emphasizes that it is suitable for both commuting and casual wear; the second, a knit cardigan with white straight-leg pants, highlights that it makes the wearer look taller and slimmer and suits pear-shaped figures; the third, a lace shirt with high-waisted wide-leg pants, notes that it is an essential for an elegant look.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon nap
description: Taking advantage of having no customers in the shop, she leaned back on the bean bag sofa in the rest area, set a 20-minute alarm for a nap, to relieve the shoulder and neck stiffness caused by moving goods in the morning.
location: Rest area of the shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Supplier communication and customer reception
description: Contacted supplier Susan via a WeChat voice call, confirmed that the balance payment for the spring clothing had been paid in full, and finalized the next batch of jeans for delivery on April 10. Susan praised my good taste in the previous selection. During the call, I received two young female customers, recommended items together with Xiaomei, and successfully sold a top and a skirt.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: In-store reception and WeChat Moments warm-up.
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. While serving customers, I also guided Xiaomei in adjusting the display of the afternoon's featured items. At the same time, I edited Moments copy for the customer group, selected a nine-grid layout with three outfit photos, and planned to warm things up through guided interaction rather than directly posting a purchase link.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Community management: spring outfit sharing
description: In the customer group "Yajing Life Gallery," I posted a nine-grid outfit collage with a caption inviting everyone to vote and interact. I replied to customer inquiries, reserved a lace shirt for regular customer Vivian, and after communicating via private message, placed it behind the cash register. The interaction boosted my confidence in community management.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wrapping up work and preparing to pick up my daughter
description: Focused on handling online orders and customer inquiries. Her husband sent a WeChat message saying he could leave work on time to pick up their daughter. She asked Xiaomei to mind the store, organized tomorrow's to-do list, and prepared to go to the kindergarten to meet up.
location: Shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter and meet up with family
description: She walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and saw her husband already holding their daughter at the gate. Their daughter excitedly showed off the little rabbit stickers in her sticker book.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: While walking home, the family of three discussed dinner and decided to eat at the Shaxian snack shop at the entrance of the residential complex. They ordered duck leg rice, wonton, and mixed noodles.
location: Haojiyuan Shaxian Snacks, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Split up and went home.
description: After dinner, Yajing took her daughter home first, while her husband went to pick up the repaired air purifier filter.
location: From Haojiyuan Shaxian Snacks to home in No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child puzzle game
description: Accompanied her daughter in the living room playing with an animal jigsaw puzzle. Her daughter playfully insisted on putting together three little animals in a row. Yajing patiently helped her find the pieces and fit them together. In the end, they successfully completed a cat, and her daughter clapped happily. The parent-child time made her fatigue disappear.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting daughter washed up and putting her to sleep
description: Gave her daughter a hot bath, then told two bedtime stories about little rabbits. Her daughter gradually fell asleep clutching the hem of her clothes.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and stretching.
description: Lay out the yoga mat and do a 15-minute pre-bedtime stretch, including shoulder circles and cat-cow pose, to release the shoulder and back tension from moving things during the day. Then take a hot shower, and before bed mix and drink one packet of Chinese herbal granules.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she scrolled through fashion news on her phone and bookmarked the official website of an up-and-coming designer brand. She planned the gifts to bring to her parents' home in Quanzhou tomorrow: Tieguanyin tea for her father, and a newly arrived silk scarf from the store for her mother. At 21:30 she turned off the lights and went to bed, sleeping peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, personal care, and packing luggage
description: At 6:30, the alarm clock rang on time. Song Yajing got up gently and went to the bathroom to wash up. She carefully rinsed her nasal cavity with salt water to relieve spring allergies, then returned to the bedroom and recounted the personal clothes she had prepared last night, Xuanxuan's change of clothes and picture books, as well as the gifts for her parents (two boxes of Xiamen specialty pies, a beige silk scarf, and a light spring jacket for her father). She deftly placed the small medicine pouch containing loratadine, Chinese medicine granules, and honeycomb extract into the side pocket of her handbag.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking Up Her Daughter, Getting Dressed, and Breakfast
description: Song Yajing went to her daughter's room and gently woke up five-year-old Xuanxuan. She helped her put on the pink hoodie and jeans that had been laid out the night before, and tied her hair into pigtails. Breakfast was simple small meat buns and milk. Xuanxuan ate quickly under her mother's urging, because her mother had promised that she could watch her favorite cartoon on the way.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Loading luggage into the car and notifying parents
description: Song Yajing carried the packed suitcase, backpack, and gift bags downstairs and put them in the trunk of the white family SUV. She carefully checked the safety buckle of the child safety seat in the back, then lifted Xuanxuan into the seat. Before leaving, she called her mother in Quanzhou and told her they would probably arrive around noon. Her mother laughed on the phone and said she had already prepared their favorite meat zongzi and mugwort cakes.
location: Underground garage of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Drive to the home appliance store
description: After hanging up, Song Yajing drove from Shanggu Street, via Gongyuan East Road and Hubin South Road, to the Suning.com store on Tiyu Road. The trip was about 5 kilometers, and with moderate morning rush traffic, it took about 20 minutes. Xuanxuan was playing children's songs on her phone in the back seat.
location: On the way from 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Suning.com, 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District

name: Select and order an air purifier
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing made a beeline for the small appliance section. She asked the salesperson about several HEPA-filter air purifiers suitable for the shop’s area, focusing on pollen filtration, noise levels, and the cost of replacing the filter later. After comparing, she chose a mid-priced, low-noise white model and asked the salesperson to deliver it to the shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road after 3 p.m. She told her shop assistant Xiaomei via WeChat that a delivery would arrive in the afternoon, and asked her to be sure to sign for it.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 95 Tiyu Road, Suning.com (Culture Palace RT-Mart Store).

name: Drive to Quanzhou, passing a service area on the way.
description: After leaving the store, Song Yajing set off immediately. She took Xianyue Road through Xiang'an Tunnel and turned onto the Shenhai Expressway. Xuanxuan sat in the back seat holding a plush toy cat. She deliberately stopped at Puli Service Area for 15 minutes to let Xuanxuan use the restroom and stretch her arms and legs, while she herself bought a bottle of water and took a quick look at the shop's WeChat group. Xiaomei had sent a photo of the shop door open, and everything was normal. After a short break, she continued driving north, about 97 kilometers in total.
location: From Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, along the Shenhai Expressway to Licheng District, Quanzhou City, passing by Puli Service Area.

name: Arrive at parents' home in Quanzhou and reunite with both parents.
description: At around 10:30, the car stopped in front of the old residential building where her parents lived. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, was already waiting at the entrance. Seeing her granddaughter Xuanxuan, she immediately came up and hugged her, saying over and over, "You've grown taller." Her father, Song Minghui, smiled and took the luggage, and the family went upstairs. On the dining table in the house, steaming meat zongzi, mugwort cakes, and a cup of Tieguanyin tea had already been placed. While Song Yajing ate, her mother noticed that she looked thinner than during the Spring Festival, and her eyes were full of concern. After the meal, while her father took Xuanxuan to the balcony to look at goldfish, her mother pulled Song Yajing into the kitchen and quietly slipped her a red envelope with 2,000 yuan in cash, telling her not to be too frugal in Xiamen and to take good care of herself. Song Yajing's eyes reddened slightly. She hugged her mother and silently accepted the gesture.
location: At home in the old residential community, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and parent-child interaction
description: After the meal, the family chatted about everyday things. Song Yajing played with Xuanxuan in the living room for a while, then coaxed her to take a nap on grandma's small bed. While her daughter was asleep, she sat on the living room sofa and talked with her father about life after retirement, while her mother prepared ingredients for dinner in the kitchen.
location: Living room and balcony at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Instructed the shop staff over the phone on how to place the air purifier.
description: At about two in the afternoon, her phone rang. It was a WeChat photo from Xiaomei showing that the air purifier had been delivered and signed for. Song Yajing immediately called Xiaomei and instructed her to place the purifier in the corner on the left side of the store near the fitting room area, where it was close to the air conditioning vent and did not block customers' path. She had her plug it in and switch it to auto mode. Xiaomei reported that the machine made very little noise, and only then did Song Yajing feel at ease, confirming that this major worry had been resolved.
location: Living room at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Family craft time—preparing paper flowers for Qingming Festival.
description: After Xuanxuan woke up from her nap, Song Yajing suggested doing some handicrafts together to prepare for the upcoming Qingming Festival. Using colored paper and scissors, with the help of Yajing's mother, they folded a few simple white paper flowers as decorations for the tomb-sweeping visit. Xuanxuan learned very earnestly; although the petals turned out in different shapes, the family was full of joy and laughter.
location: Living room at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Research morning walking routes near home
description: While her father took Xuanxuan downstairs to the small park at the alley entrance, Song Yajing sat at the computer in the study, opened the map app on her phone, and began studying walking routes around her Xiamen residence. Based on last year's allergy attack lessons, she carefully marked the sections where the street trees in front of her home were Bauhinia and white orchids, and planned a new morning walking route starting from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, avoiding these plants, going along East Park Road toward Zhongshan Park, then turning back, about 2 kilometers in total. She recorded the route, estimated time, and precautions in detail in her phone memo, planning to try it once when she returned to Xiamen.
location: Home study, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Take a walk near the neighborhood with her daughter and parents.
description: In the afternoon, the sunlight became soft. Song Yajing and her parents took Xuanxuan downstairs for a walk. The family walked slowly through the streets and alleys near the old neighborhood. Her father pointed to the roadside trees and introduced their names to Xuanxuan. When they passed a vegetable stall, her mother bought a bunch of scallions and a few pieces of tender tofu, saying they could make scallion-braised tofu for dinner. After getting home, Song Yajing helped her mother trim the freshly bought spring bamboo shoots in the kitchen.
location: Old residential community at No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, and the surrounding streets and alleys

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was fresh spring bamboo shoots stewed with pork ribs that father Song Minghui had specially bought at the market, paired with mother's mugwort cakes and a dish of scallion-braised tofu. The family sat around the table; Xuanxuan sat next to her grandfather, eating bamboo shoots heartily. During the meal, father talked about amusing stories of digging bamboo shoots in the mountains when he was young, making everyone laugh. Outside the window were the familiar lights of Quanzhou's old town; inside the house was filled with the aroma of food and the warmth of family reunion.
location: The dining room at home, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Get her daughter to wash up and go to bed.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a hot bath in the guest room and changed her into clean pajamas. She sat by the small bed and told her daughter a story about a little rabbit looking for spring. Xuanxuan gradually fell asleep listening. Song Yajing gently patted her daughter's shoulder until her breathing became steady.
location: Guest room and bathroom at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Personal care, contacting her husband, and a brief stretch.
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing spread out her travel yoga mat on the guest room floor and followed a phone app for 12 minutes of shoulder, neck, and back stretching. Although the day's travel had left her a bit tired and her movements were not as precise as usual, she still managed to finish. She then washed up and took a dose of traditional Chinese medicine granules. Before going to sleep, she sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang a WeChat message asking whether he had arrived on his business trip and letting him know her return plan for the next day. He quickly replied that he had reached the hotel, told her not to worry, and reminded her to drive safely.
location: Home guest room, 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Before bed, browsed fashion news and planned work for the return trip.
description: After lying in bed, Song Yajing did not fall asleep immediately. She opened her phone and browsed several designer brand official accounts and fashion news apps she often viewed, collecting some spring/summer styling inspiration. Then, she opened the store's WeChat community, confirmed that Xiaomei's outfit content posted in the afternoon was complete, and conceived a theme for the next community sharing session after returning tomorrow.
location: On the bed in the guest room at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: On the freshly changed bedsheet at her parents' home, which carried the faint scent of laundry detergent, Song Yajing closed her eyes. The image of her mother pressing money into her hand earlier in the day, and the loving concern in her eyes, flashed through her mind. She felt both warm and a little sad. She secretly resolved that after returning to Xiamen she would live a more regular life, eat well, keep exercising, and stop making her family worry about her. With this resolution, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the guest room at home, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up in the guest room on the second floor of her parents' home. Outside the window, a light rain was falling during the Qingming Festival season. Picking up her phone, she saw a WeChat message from her husband Aqiang, sent from Changsha in the early hours. After replying, she washed up. She used a nasal irrigator to clean her nasal passages to prevent allergic rhinitis.
location: Second-floor guest room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Organize the grave-sweeping offerings and wake up her daughter.
description: Went downstairs to help her mother sort and bag the yellow and white chrysanthemum bouquets, sandalwood incense, candles, apples, and pastries; her father took out an old towel and a small shovel. Went upstairs and gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan, helping her put on a slightly thicker coat.
location: Parents' home at No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province: first-floor living room, kitchen, and second-floor guest room.

name: Family breakfast and preparing to set out
description: The family sat around the dining table eating breakfast. Father confirmed that the cemetery was open, and Mother reminded them to bring an umbrella. She helped Xuanxuan put on her small water bottle and checked the light jacket prepared for her father.
location: Ground-floor dining room at parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Drove to the family cemetery in Majia Town.
description: Drove her father's SUV, carrying her parents and daughter from Baiyuan Village to the family cemetery in Majia Town, Luojiang District. Along the way, the windows fogged up, so she turned on the air conditioning and took turns with her mother explaining the meaning of life and inheritance to her daughter.
location: On the road from Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, to the family cemetery in Majia Town, Luojiang District.

name: Tomb-sweeping activity at the family cemetery.
description: At the cemetery, we divided the tasks: my father cleared weeds, my mother wiped the inscription on the tombstone, and I placed chrysanthemums with my daughter. We set out offerings, lit incense and candles, and the whole family burned incense, bowed, and knelt. While kneeling, I quietly reported the family's recent situation and prayed for blessings for the family.
location: Family cemetery, Majia Town, Luojiang District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Ran into an old friend at the cemetery and had a deep conversation
description: After finishing the tomb-sweeping, I ran into my junior high school classmate Zhang Wei, and we chatted on the stone steps for about 40 minutes. Zhang Wei talked about the difficulties he was facing in Shenzhen, and I listened quietly. In the end, we wished each other well.
location: Beside the stone steps of the family cemetery in Majia Town, Luojiang District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Returned, doing shopping along the way
description: They drove back, stopping at the farmers' market in Majia Town on the way. Her mother selected spring bamboo shoots and mugwort, and her father bought Xuanxuan a candied hawthorn stick.
location: From the cemetery to the farmers' market in Majia Town, Luojiang District, Quanzhou, then back to the parents' home in Baiyuan Village

name: Return home to rest
description: Returned to the home in Baiyuan Village, sorted and put away the purchased items. Father changed out of his soiled pants, and mother washed the spring bamboo shoots.
location: First floor of parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and in-store work
description: For lunch, she had the pork zongzi and vegetable soup her mother made. While eating, she used her phone to guide shop assistant Xiao Mei on arranging the display of newly arrived spring coats, and reminded her to pay attention to community group messages.
location: Ground-floor dining room and kitchen of parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Time alone and spiritual prayer
description: Walked into the small room she and her sister had shared as children, closed the door, and sat on the bed. She prayed to God for her old classmate Zhang Wei, whom she had run into, asking that he get through his difficulties. Afterward, she felt at peace.
location: Small room on the second floor of her parents' home, 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Browsing old photos, casual family talk
description: Sat in the living room with her mother and daughter, flipping through old photo albums and recalling funny childhood moments. Her mother pointed at a photo showing missing front teeth and teased, and Xuanxuan was amused as well.
location: First-floor living room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner and enjoy some family time.
description: Helped her mother make spring rolls in the kitchen and learned the filling ratios. Her daughter also came to help and made lopsided spring rolls. In between, she talked with the shop assistant about tomorrow's business arrangements and ideas for community posts.
location: Kitchen and living room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Full dinner: family hotpot gathering
description: The family sat around the table for dinner, with spring bamboo shoot and pork rib soup, fried spring rolls, mugwort cakes, and more. Xuanxuan shared funny kindergarten stories, and her mother said Xuanxuan loves spring rolls just like I did when I was little.
location: Ground-floor dining room at parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: After-dinner cleanup and evening chat.
description: After the meal, she took the initiative to wash the dishes. Her father accompanied Xuanxuan in the courtyard making a string-can telephone toy, and her mother watered the flowers on the balcony.
location: Living room, courtyard, and balcony of the parents’ home at No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Prepare for tomorrow's return trip.
description: Went upstairs to organize the luggage for returning to Xiamen, carefully placed the spring rolls, spring bamboo shoots, and tea packed by her parents into the suitcase, and confirmed that the car keys and allergy medication were there.
location: Second-floor guest room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Phone call with her husband
description: On the second-floor balcony, she called her husband, who was away on business in Changsha, and told him about today's tomb-sweeping and the chance encounter. He comforted her and shared the project progress.
location: The second-floor balcony of her parents' home at No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Evening washing up and health management
description: Took a hot shower, rinsed the nasal passages with a nasal irrigator, and took traditional Chinese medicine granules to prevent allergies.
location: Guest bathroom on the second floor of parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Settle down before bed and wrap up family matters
description: Took my daughter upstairs to wash up and change into pajamas, told a bedtime story, mother and daughter cuddled, and daughter fell asleep.
location: Second-floor guest room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Pray for family and friends and tomorrow's plans
description: After my daughter fell asleep, I used the memo app on my phone under the bedside light to record today's thoughts, and said bedtime prayers for Zhang Wei, my sister, my husband, and the store's business.
location: Second-floor guest room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: She gathered her sleeping daughter into her arms. Exhausted from the emotional ups and downs and physical exertion of the day, she felt calm and fulfilled inside, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Second-floor guest room at the parents' home, No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Morning activities: getting up, walking, and family breakfast
description: She woke up at 7:00 a.m. at her parents' home in Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou. The weather turned from cloudy to sunny. Because she had forgotten to stretch before bed last night, her neck and shoulders felt a bit stiff. At 7:15, she left the house and walked along Tumen Street toward the Confucian Temple Square, deliberately avoiding the kapok trees on Shigu Road to ease her pollen allergy. After 20 minutes of walking, she felt her breathing become smooth and her nasal congestion ease. On a park bench beside the Confucian Temple Square, she stretched her neck, shoulders, and back. At 7:50, she returned home. Her mother had prepared breakfast such as fried dough sticks and soy milk. She had breakfast with her father and daughter and shared her tip about the pollen-avoiding route, which her father praised. After breakfast, she braided her daughter's hair into pigtails and helped her mother clear the dishes. Her mother again reminded her to take care of herself and her daughter, mentioning the 2,000 yuan she had given the day before, which made her feel deeply warm.
location: No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, and the area around the Confucian Temple Square.

name: Taking her daughter shopping on Licheng Old Street and returning to say goodbye
description: At 9:15, I set off on foot from Baiyuan Village and took my daughter to stroll along Zhongshan Middle Road. At the sugar painting stall at the street entrance, I bought a butterfly sugar painting for my daughter, and then bought a pair of small dough figurines at a handicraft shop. At a time-honored dried goods store, I bought 5 packs of popiah wrappers, 2 servings of garlic dough twists (for my husband), and a few boxes of pies. At 11:15, I returned to my parents' home, portioned and refrigerated the food with my mother, and packed the luggage into the car. My father reminded me to drive carefully. I hugged my parents goodbye and planned to return again next weekend.
location: Zhongshan Middle Road and No. 80 Baiyuan Village, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Return to Xiamen and pack up luggage
description: At 11:45 they set off from her parents' home and drove via the Shenhai Expressway to Xiamen. At about 12:45 they stopped at the Puli Service Area in Jinjiang, took their daughter to the restroom, stretched their legs, and had a simple lunch at the service area restaurant: their daughter had fish ball soup, and she ordered thin noodle soup. At 13:00 they set off again, and at 13:10 arrived at their home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen. She sorted and stored the local specialties they had brought back: the spring roll wrappers and pies went into the refrigerator, and the garlic dough twists were placed in the entryway cabinet. Their daughter could hardly wait to play with her crayons.
location: The Quanzhou-to-Xiamen section of the Shenhai Expressway (via Jinjiang Puli Service Area), finally arriving at the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Let her mother know she is safe and handle store matters.
description: After getting settled, she called her mother in Quanzhou to let her know she was safe. Then she contacted shop assistant Xiaomei via WeChat to ask about the store's foot traffic in the afternoon and asked her to take photos of the crowd at the store entrance to confirm the store was operating normally.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discovered her daughter’s painting, discussed with her husband, and searched for art classes
description: In the afternoon, in the living room, she found her daughter had drawn a rainbow, a kitten, and sunflowers on the wall with crayons, saying, 'I drew our family,' which touched her own regret of not being able to learn painting in childhood because she had to take care of her younger sister. She took a photo and sent it to the family WeChat group. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang replied with surprise and sent a private message. At 4:30 pm, her husband called via video during a work break and formally discussed signing their daughter up for a painting class. She shared her childhood regret, and her husband supported her and proactively offered to look after the shop on weekends so she could accompany their daughter to class. After hanging up at 5:30, she searched the official account 'Siming District Community Art Center' and found a 'Parent-Child Watercolor Class' starting on April 12. She carefully read the course introduction.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: In the evening, I prepared dinner: boiled noodles paired with the spring bamboo shoot stewed pork ribs my mother made and brought back from Quanzhou, and vegetable shreds wrapped in the newly bought popiah skins. My daughter enjoyed it very much, tasting her grandmother's cooking.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband returned home, they admired the painting together, and completed the art class registration.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from overtime work, saw the painting on the wall, and picked up their daughter to praise her. After dinner, the three sat on the sofa and formally decided to sign up for the parent-child watercolor class. She showed the course details, and her husband was satisfied. Then, through the community art center's WeChat official account, she filled in the registration information for herself and her daughter. The course consisted of 6 sessions and included basic painting tools. After paying via WeChat Pay, she quickly received a confirmation text reminding her to bring ID for the first class. She sent the course screenshot to her husband.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bathe the daughter, tell stories, and soothe her to sleep.
description: After giving her daughter a hot bath, she read her the My Little Pony picture book in the bedroom. In less than three readings, her daughter had fallen asleep quietly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching, personal care, and rest
description: She laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did a 15-minute stretch for her neck, shoulders, and back, to make up for skipping it the previous night, and thought about what art supplies she needed to buy for tomorrow's watercolor class. Then she washed up, rinsed her nasal passages with a nasal irrigator, and took traditional Chinese medicine granules. She recorded the details of her Quanzhou specialty purchases in the expense-tracking app. She lay in bed chatting with her husband, sharing what she had seen and heard in Quanzhou and about running into an old classmate; her husband comforted her. They discussed transportation to Gulangyu Catholic Church tomorrow and decided to drive. At 22:30 she turned off the lights to rest, feeling content and calm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, medication, and preparations for going out.
description: Waking up at 7:30 a.m., Song Yajing felt soreness in her right shoulder blade while washing up in the bathroom. She then changed into a plain cotton-linen dress and applied sunscreen. She had breakfast with her husband A Qiang and daughter Xuanxuan in the dining room, drinking hot milk and eating whole-wheat toast, and took Chinese herbal granules dissolved in warm water. After breakfast, she carefully rinsed her nasal cavity with saline solution at the entryway, then checked the contents of her bag: phone, keys, wallet, loratadine box, and folding umbrella. She discussed with A Qiang the plan to take Xuanxuan to buy art supplies in the afternoon, and A Qiang agreed to take their daughter to Jiaxing Garden Park at noon first. Everything ready, she picked up her bag, closed the door, and set off for the church.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycling and taking a ferry to Gulangyu Catholic Church
description: Song Yajing pushed her electric bike out the door and rode to First Pier. About 10 minutes later, she parked the electric bike in the pier's paid parking lot. She walked to buy a ticket and took the 08:50 ferry to Gulangyu. A gentle breeze blew on the boat, and she used her phone to confirm the Mass time. At 09:00 she set foot on Gulangyu, walked about 5 minutes, and arrived at Gulangyu Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attended Sunday Mass and connected with fellow church members.
description: At 9:00, Mass officially began, with Father Wang Mingde presiding. Today's Gospel was taken from Chapter 10 of the Gospel of John, "The Good Shepherd." Song Yajing sat in the third row of the church and listened attentively. The words in the sermon, "The shepherd is willing to give everything for his flock," moved her, and she could not help thinking of her old classmate Zhang Wei, who had encountered difficulties in Quanzhou yesterday, and her heart trembled. She silently prayed for Zhang Wei's family and also thanked the Lord for guarding the harmonious running of the store. After Mass, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow churchgoer, in the small square in front of the church. Aunt Lin asked with concern about her complexion. Upon learning about her allergic rhinitis and store pressure, she invited her to come to her house to drink some pomelo tea to moisten her lungs. Song Yajing smiled and agreed to go next weekend. After chatting for about ten minutes, they said goodbye.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home by boat and bicycle, shopping along the way.
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Lin, Song Yajing walked to Sanqiutian Pier and took the 10:10 ferry back to the main island. After getting off the ferry, she rode an electric bike and, on the way, stopped at the convenience store inside Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought a 500 ml bottle of saline solution (for nasal rinsing) and a mint candy, paying 18.5 yuan with her phone. Then, carrying the shopping bag, she continued riding home.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home to rest and sharing allergy care tips with the customer group
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing put away the saline solution, sat down on the living room sofa, and made a cup of warm water. In the WeChat group “Yajing's Wardrobe Girlfriends Circle” (about 200 members), she composed a long message. Starting from her own spring allergy experience, she shared in detail care methods such as taking traditional Chinese medicine granules and bee comb essence, carrying loratadine when going out, rinsing the nose with saline solution in the morning and evening, and installing an air purifier in the store. She also wrote, “After thirty, a woman's health is her greatest asset.” After the message was sent, she received many comments and likes, and she replied to each one in a friendly manner. The group atmosphere was warm and lively. She felt the satisfaction of serving others, and took a screenshot to record the interaction.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing lunch, having lunch, and taking a lunch break
description: Song Yajing went into the kitchen to prepare lunch. While boiling plain noodle soup, she used her phone memo app to jot down promotion ideas for next week's parent-child outfit theme at the store, and wrote three copywriting directions. After the noodles were ready, she browsed spring outfit trends while eating and saved three sets of outfit collages. After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes, lay down on the living room sofa under a thin blanket and rested for about half an hour, half asleep and half awake as she mentally drafted the afternoon shopping list. At 13:00 she received a short video from Aqiang of their daughter playing on the slide in Jiaxingyuan Park. She felt happy watching it, then got up and did 5 minutes of simple stretching on the bedroom bed to freshen up before going out.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing to go out, contacting husband, and cycling to Zhongshan Road
description: Song Yajing freshened up, took two shopping bags and the saved image of the watercolor class course list, and made a video call to A Qiang. A Qiang was in the park with Xuanxuan eating ice cream. Xuanxuan grabbed the phone and shouted, “Mom! I drew so many flowers!” Song Yajing praised her, then urged them to get to Zhongshan Road early to meet up. After the call, she grabbed her keys and helmet, rode her electric bike via Siming North Road to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, locked the bike in the designated parking area at the entrance about 15 minutes later, and walked into the pedestrian street.
location: Entrance to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to buy watercolor painting supplies
description: At the entrance of Miaocai Art Supplies Store, Aqiang had already arrived early with Xuanxuan to meet up. As soon as Xuanxuan entered the store, she excitedly wanted to touch all kinds of paintbrushes. Song Yajing carefully selected according to the course list: one pack of 200g watercolor paper, one box of 12-color child-safe watercolor paints, three paintbrushes of different thicknesses, a plastic palette, and a water-absorbing sponge. She also chose a waterproof apron for herself and her daughter (bright pink for Xuanxuan, light gray-blue for herself). The total payment was 235 yuan. After paying with WeChat, she took a photo of her purchases, squatted down and asked Xuanxuan if she was looking forward to learning to paint. Her daughter nodded emphatically.
location: Miaocai Art Supplies Store, intersection of Zhongshan Road and Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Strolling along Zhongshan Road and checking on the shop.
description: After the shopping trip, A Qiang took Xuanxuan to buy juice. Song Yajing walked alone along the Zhongshan Road pedestrian street toward the shop she runs. When passing the storefront at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, she stopped to look. The display window featured new spring dresses, and the promotional flyer she designed was posted at the door. She called her store clerk Xiaomei to ask about Sunday foot traffic. Xiaomei said a few regular customers had come by in the afternoon, but sales were mediocre. She told her to keep the displays neat and informed her that she would not come to the store today. Afterward, she met her family at a drink shop. The family of three rested on a bench beside the pedestrian street. Xuanxuan played while drinking juice, and Song Yajing took a photo of her husband and daughter.
location: Pedestrian street near No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycling home
description: Song Yajing rode her e-bike carrying Xuanxuan, while Aqiang followed behind on a shared bike. They headed back to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street along Siming North Road. Along the way, the breeze brushed their faces, and Xuanxuan hummed a nursery rhyme she had learned in kindergarten. The mood was light and pleasant. After arriving at the building entrance, Song Yajing parked the e-bike, took the shopping bags from the front basket, and went upstairs together with Aqiang, who had parked the shared bike.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing art supplies, taking photos to share, and pre-dinner preparations
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing took out all her painting supplies and checked them. She folded the apron and packed it together with the paints into two canvas tote bags, then hung them on the coat hooks in the entryway. Next, she took a photo of the rainbow and sunflower doodles Xuanxuan had drawn on the living room wall, and sent it to the family group along with a screenshot of the watercolor class information from her phone, writing, "Xuanxuan's first masterpiece — she'll officially start learning to paint next week!" She then sat in the living room to rest, scrolled through the group messages on allergy care tips, and replied individually to two important messages. Afterward, she went to the kitchen and took out ingredients from the fridge, such as popiah wrappers, spring bamboo shoot pork rib soup, Shanghai bok choy, and eggs, to prepare dinner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner together as a family.
description: Song Yajing put on an apron and cooked. She first heated the spring bamboo shoot and pork rib soup, then steamed the popiah wrappers until soft over water, cut carrots, cucumber, and bean sprouts and stir-fried them into the filling, and also scrambled eggs with scallion pieces. Aqiang came into the kitchen to help set the table. Dinner began at 6:30 p.m., with vegetable rolls, spring bamboo shoot and pork rib soup, and scrambled eggs on the table. During the meal, Song Yajing shared her feelings about Mass and her prayers for Zhang Wei, as well as the joy she got from community interactions; Aqiang talked about the fun of taking Xuanxuan to the climbing frame in the park; and Xuanxuan excitedly said that her watercolor class was going to paint a big rainbow. Song Yajing reminded her to bring her apron next week. The dinner lasted about fifty minutes amidst warm conversation.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family entertainment and art supply check
description: After the meal, A Qiang washed the dishes. Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to sit on the living room carpet and try the new painting supplies. She let Xuanxuan dip the plastic palette in clean water to test the colors and feel how the brush blends. Xuanxuan casually drew a few water streaks on the paper and laughed happily. Song Yajing checked the two canvas tote bags again, confirmed the watercolor paper was not damp, folded the aprons and put them back, and clipped her daughter's previous crayon doodles into a cardboard sheet and placed them in the bag, planning to show them to the watercolor class teacher. After that, she read the picture storybook 'The Rainbow Flower' to Xuanxuan, and Xuanxuan gradually grew sleepy listening to the story.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal care and nasal cleaning
description: After Aqiang took Xuanxuan to take a bath, Song Yajing went to the bathroom alone for her evening care routine: first she used a nasal irrigator with saline solution to thoroughly rinse her nasal passages, then took her evening Chinese medicine granules. Next, she washed her face with warm water and removed sunscreen, applied a hydrating mask for about ten minutes, then applied a gentle body lotion to her limbs, changed into loose pajamas, and prepared for a pre-sleep stretch.
location: Bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime stretching and shoulder and neck massage for relaxation
description: Song Yajing laid out her yoga mat in the bedroom and did about twenty minutes of stretching and relaxation. She paid special attention to the soreness in her right shoulder blade. She first did regular neck and shoulder stretches, then leaned against the wall and used a massage ball to press on the tender points along the inner edge of her shoulder blade, pressing each point for about fifteen seconds with continuous rolling pressure until the muscle loosened up. When she finished, she put away the massage ball, took a sip of water, and felt noticeably more relaxed in her shoulder.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening bookkeeping and bedtime preparation.
description: Song Yajing leaned back in bed and scrolled through her phone, checking and replying to community messages. Seeing that the post she shared that afternoon already had 32 comments, she responded to them one by one. She opened her expense-tracking app and recorded the day's spending (saline solution 18.5 yuan, art supplies 235 yuan, total 253.5 yuan), wrote down today's reflections in her phone notes, and checked the reminder for opening the store tomorrow. Aqiang came back from their daughter's room, and they briefly discussed changing the air purifier filter at the store and next week's arrangements for picking up their daughter (Aqiang said he could pick her up on Wednesday). At 22:20, Song Yajing turned off the bedside lamp, said goodnight to her husband, and fell asleep quickly.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family life and health care
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. After getting up, Song Yajing found the sky overcast and the air quality mildly polluted, which triggered allergic rhinitis and made her sneeze again and again. She then rinsed her nasal passages with a nasal irrigator and felt a bit relieved. After splashing cold water on her face, she decided to start managing her allergies systematically from now on and took the prepared Chinese medicine granules. Then she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her wash up, get dressed, and braid her hair. Her daughter excitedly mentioned her new watercolor painting set, and Song Yajing promised to paint together in the evening. For breakfast she prepared milk and whole wheat toast with strawberry jam. The mother and daughter chatted while eating about what her daughter had seen in the park yesterday. After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and put a folding umbrella in her commuter bag, ready to go out.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school and heading to the store
description: Walked about 10 minutes to take Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the door, I helped her straighten her collar, kissed her forehead goodbye, and watched her run into the school. Then I walked 3 minutes to Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, I bought a cup of unsweetened soy milk to warm my hands and mentally planned the day's work at the shop.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning shop operations and health management
description: After arriving at the store, she turned on the air purifier; the indicator light showed orange, and she secretly noted that the filter needed cleaning. She took out the medicine kit from under the cash register, divided the Chinese herbal granules into three bags for morning, noon, and evening, and labeled them. She placed the honeycomb essence capsules within easy reach, set three medication alarms, and talked with Xiaomei about the necessity of allergy management. At 9:30 she opened the door and received a young mother pushing a stroller. She recommended cotton-linen wide-leg pants paired with a knit cardigan, helped hold the baby so the mother could try them on, and after the sale, took photos of the outfit for a Moments post. Foot traffic was sparse in the morning, so she brainstormed content for Moments, dug out the contrasting photos of the dirty purifier filter, settled on the theme Spring Commute + Anti-Allergy Good Finds, and drafted three paragraphs of copy. At about 11:00, two white-collar customers came in, recognized the community recommendation, and tried on and bought a knitted jacket and straight-leg pants respectively. At checkout, Song Yajing took the opportunity to share allergy care tips. At 11:45 she edited and published the Moments post, attaching model photos, the filter comparison, and close-ups of customers trying on clothes, with copy emphasizing systematic allergy resistance and outfit styling.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch, midday rest, and business contact.
description: Xiaomei went to lunch first, while Song Yajing stayed at the shop and ordered a vegetable salad and hot honey yuzu tea through Meituan delivery. While waiting for the food, she contacted supplier Susan on WeChat to confirm the final order and size allocation for the No. 10 jeans. She checked community messages; Vivian, a regular customer, privately messaged to book the lace blouse, and she replied to confirm the size and schedule a fitting tomorrow. After the meal, she ate the salad and drank hot tea in the rest area, and after Xiaomei took over the shift, she closed her eyes for a 20-minute nap. When she woke up, her spirits improved and her stuffy nose eased. She replied to Vivian to confirm the after-work fitting, shared her morning outfit-matching tips in the community group, and received likes. She sent a message to her husband Aqiang, telling him she might be home late and asking him to pick up their daughter.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Clean the store's air purifier filter.
description: With few customers in the afternoon, Song Yajing decided to clean the air purifier. She unplugged it and, following the instructions, removed the pre-filter and the main HEPA filter. The filters were covered with gray-white particles, which strengthened her resolve to stick to her medication regimen. She wiped the pre-filter with a damp cloth, gently vacuumed the HEPA filter dust on the lowest setting, and used a soft brush to remove pollen from the crevices. After reinstalling the filters, she powered it on; the air quality index turned from orange to green, and the indicator light turned green. She felt a sudden sense of relief, took a photo of the clean purifier, and posted a private status update to record it.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Adjust the store's spring display.
description: Adjusted the spring new arrival display with Xiao Mei, moving the best-performing outfit according to community feedback to the spot directly opposite the entrance, hanging the reserved dresses in the middle of the second row, and revealing some summer thin and breathable fabrics in advance on the inner display rack. The overall visual effect was fresh and airy.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon community interaction and Moments updates
description: Checked Moments at noon; there were already 16 likes and 2 comments. Former staff member Xiaoli left a comment teasing about the same pill box. In the customer group, I posted a 'Top 3 Spring Commute Looks' recommendation to spark interest and attract private messages requesting pictures. Then I edited and sent a second Moments post with 3 new outfit photos, with copy emphasizing a fresh afternoon look and a week's worth of outfit inspiration.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Picked up her daughter from school and returned to the store.
description: Gave Xiaomei instructions for closing the shop, put on her bag, and took a folding umbrella to go to the kindergarten. She picked up Xuanxuan on time. Xuanxuan excitedly shared that she had learned to paint spring flowers today. After buying cookies as a snack, she took her hand and walked back to the shop. When they arrived, Xuanxuan took out her sticker book and drawing pad in the rest area and drew.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Yajing Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Spent time with daughter at the shop and handled work.
description: In the evening, customer traffic increased. She had Xiao Mei handle reception while she looked after Xuanxuan and replied to online order inquiries on her phone. She noticed the cash register system was lagging again, so she made a note on her phone to have Aqiang check it remotely in the evening.
location: Yajing's Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closed the shop, went home, and prepared dinner.
description: Xiaomei did the finishing work. Aqiang rode the electric bike to the shop entrance to pick them up. He picked up Xuanxuan and asked about the system issues. They agreed that Song Yajing would cook while Aqiang looked after their daughter. Song Yajing put her laptop and the dirty filter into her tote bag, and the family of three squeezed onto the electric bike to ride home to the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street. After arriving home, she helped her daughter change out of her kindergarten uniform and wash her hands, then tied on an apron to prepare dinner: stir-fried spinach with king oyster mushrooms, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and reheated pork rib soup brought back from Quanzhou. Aqiang played with sticker books with Xuanxuan in the living room.

location: Hualuozi Flower Shop at No. 2 Xinyili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the cat café near Siming South Road

name: Cat café gathering with girlfriends for afternoon tea
description: When she arrived at the cat café, her best friend Li Meiling was already seated on a sofa by the window, holding a gentle Ragdoll cat in her arms. Song Yajing handed her the bouquet, and Meiling was pleasantly surprised. The two ordered fruit tea and tiramisu cake to go with the tea, and chatted freely for over an hour amid soothing background music. Meiling vented about the naughty boys in her class, and Song Yajing shared her spring allergy troubles and the detours she had taken in running her shop. Meiling suggested going hiking at Dongping Mountain on the weekend, which is allergy-friendly. Song Yajing happily agreed and said they would finalize the specific time over WeChat.
location: A newly opened cat café near Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Return to the store and the evening peak of customer flow and sales.
description: After saying goodbye to Meiling at the cat café entrance, she walked back to the shop in a happy mood. On the way, she selected two photos of lazy cats taken at the cat café and sent them to the customer group with the caption: “Found today’s ‘little blessing’~ It’s a newly opened cat café, and the cats’ healing power is full marks~” Many customers interacted warmly. Back at the shop, she felt refreshed and divided the work with Xiaomei to welcome the evening peak, warmly receiving customers and proactively offering styling suggestions, successfully selling two French floral dresses and one knitted cardigan.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening store break and dinner
description: At dinner time, she asked Xiaomei to go next door and bring back two steaming bowls of satay noodles; the two took turns eating in the rest area. Meanwhile, Song Yajing checked the day's revenue, which basically met expectations.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening store closing and new product archiving
description: The shop was relatively quiet in the evening. Song Yajing retouched and archived the new-product styling photos taken during the day, preparing for later release. At the same time, she organized the spring new-arrival shelves and placed popular styles in more convenient positions. During this time, she received a voice message from supplier Susan, saying that the factory had notified in the afternoon that a batch of chiffon shirts might be dyed a bit darker, but the goods had already been shipped, possibly the dusty pink style. Song Yajing felt uneasy and immediately called back to ask, but Susan's reply was vague. She made a prominent note in her memo to check when receiving the goods.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store closing and end-of-day cleanup.
description: Closed on time and worked with Xiaomei by dividing tasks: Song Yajing counted the cash revenue and checked it against the cash register system, while Xiaomei was responsible for sweeping the floor and tidying the shelves. After confirming that the power was off, they pulled down the rolling shutter door.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchasing at a convenience store on the way home.
description: On the way, she stopped at the convenience store in Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought fresh milk and whole wheat bread for her daughter's breakfast the next day, and also grabbed two boxes of the probiotic yogurt she likes, then walked home.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending evening time with daughter
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was watching TV in the living room, and her daughter Chen Lexuan had already washed her face and was waiting for her mother to return. Song Yajing changed into home clothes, then helped her daughter wash up with warm water and change into pajamas. She sat by the bed and read her two stories from the picture book series “A Different Carmela” until she fell asleep sweetly.
location: Living room and children's room at home in the residential compound, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Communicated with her husband about finances and recorded education savings.
description: After coming out of her daughter's room, she chatted with her husband in the study, sharing the day's amusing moments at the cat café and Susan's color-difference warning. Her husband comforted her, saying they should carefully check the goods after receiving them before drawing any conclusions. Then Song Yajing took out the family financial ledger and neatly recorded the information about the education savings account opened yesterday (April 9) — the account-opening bank, ICBC Qianpu Branch; the last digits of the account number; the initial deposit of 2,000 yuan; and the automatic transfer set for the 15th of every month — under the “Chen Lexuan Education Fund” column.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime self-care and journaling
description: Carefully did her evening skincare routine, used the nasal irrigator again to rinse her nasal passages, and took traditional Chinese medicine granules. In the bedside journal, she briefly wrote down the day's reflections: "The cat café date with Meiling was very healing; my social battery is recharged. Restock orders and shipping warnings coexist, and my mood is half sunny, half cloudy. I'll decide next steps after the goods arrive." Then she set the alarm for 7:00 the next day.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, residential compound at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Anxiety, difficulty sleeping, and going to bed.
description: Before bed, she prayed for her family's safety and health, the smooth operation of the store, and the upcoming goods inspection. Though her body was tired, Susan's color difference warning made her toss and turn in bed. Her mind kept imagining all kinds of worst-case scenarios, and she did not drift into an anxious sleep until 12:30 a.m., completely forgetting the pre-sleep stretching she had planned.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning care and stretching
description: When the morning alarm rang, Song Yajing struggled to get up. Because the supplier's color deviation warning had kept her up until the early hours last night, her head still felt heavy. She still kept up her morning routine: in the bathroom, she used a nasal irrigator to rinse her nasal passages and took traditional Chinese medicine granules—her daily way of dealing with allergic rhinitis. Then she spread out her yoga mat and, forcing herself to stay alert, did 15 minutes of morning stretches, focusing on releasing her stiff shoulders, neck, and hips, while silently telling herself, 'I must hold on today.'
location: Room 202, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Prepare breakfast and take daughter to school
description: Song Yajing quickly prepared breakfast. She drank a glass of warm milk with two slices of whole-wheat toast, and for her daughter Xuanxuan she warmed up milk oatmeal and a boiled egg. After gently waking her, she helped her put on her kindergarten uniform. At exactly 8:00, holding Xuanxuan's hand, she left home and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The autumn morning light shone on Gucheng West Road. They arrived at the kindergarten gate after about an eight-minute walk. Watching her daughter walk in with the teacher, she habitually reminded her, “Be sure to take a good nap at noon.”
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Commute to the store
description: After dropping off her child, Song Yajing walked to her Yajing Boutique Clothing Store. When passing the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Gucheng West Road, she saw that the stationery store on Park South Road was open, and made a mental note to come buy paint when picking up Xuanxuan in the afternoon. She opened her phone to check the weather forecast, which showed cloudy turning overcast with occasional light rain in the afternoon, so she silently reminded herself to bring an umbrella. This stretch took about 10 minutes on foot.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Morning store-opening preparations and start of seasonal display adjustments
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei began the daily routine. She opened the store door to let in air, used a feather duster to clean the shelves, refolded the clothes customers had messed up, and checked yesterday's accounts. Then she had a brief morning meeting with Xiaomei and officially started the seasonal display adjustment. Together they moved the thick knitwear and fleece hoodies from the back area to the side shelves and counted inventory, while pushing the newly arrived lightweight items — short-sleeve T-shirts, linen wide-leg pants, and camisole dresses — to the front row and the main display rack.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Complete seasonal display adjustments and notify regular customers.
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei continued to work together on the seasonal display adjustment. She personally dressed the window mannequin in a new outfit—light blue wide-leg pants with a white short-sleeved knit top—shifting the color palette from late spring to early summer and giving the store a fresh feel. After finishing, she took photos from multiple angles and selected a few for community promotion. During the process, she noticed that the new white short-sleeved knit top had a cut that would suit regular customer Vivian. She photographed the flat-lay details and the on-mannequin look, sent them to Vivian via WeChat, and offered to reserve a size M for her. Vivian quickly replied to thank her and agreed to come try it on over the weekend. Song Yajing hung the size M white knit top alone on the reserved rack behind the cash register, with a sticky note reading "Vivian - reserved until 4/12".
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch and confirm weekend plans
description: After the food delivery arrived, Song Yajing ate a salad and sandwich while sorting out weekend plans. She called her best friend Zhao Li to confirm they would meet at 6:30 the next morning at Calligraphy Square on Huandao Road for seaside yoga, so they could make the 9 a.m. parent-child watercolor class. Zhao Li readily agreed. After hanging up, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Li Meiling to confirm that Sunday's hike would still be a 9 a.m. meetup at Jiaxingyuan Park, tentatively on Dongping Mountain Trail. Li Meiling replied that it was no problem.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch break and stretching
description: After lunch, drowsiness came over her. Song Yajing lay on the recliner in the rest area with her eyes closed, but because her shoulders and neck were tense, she got up after only 10 minutes. Remembering that she hadn't stretched the night before, she did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching seriously. Feeling the stiffness ease considerably, she then closed her eyes and rested for another 20 minutes to restore energy for the afternoon.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Afternoon store duties and community operations
