description: In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually increased. Song Yajing perked up and received customers together with Xiaomei. Based on the display she had adjusted in the morning, she proactively recommended a pairing of linen wide-leg pants and a short-sleeved T-shirt to customers. After trying it on, the customer was satisfied and bought it. During the customer's fitting break, she handled WeChat group messages, replied to several customers' inquiries about the new dresses, carefully selected 4 photos of the store's new look taken in the morning, adjusted the colors with a photo editing app, paired them with the caption "April season change, welcome summer with a touch of light blue and breathability," and scheduled the post for tomorrow Saturday at 8:00 AM.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Consuming coffee and sweets when fatigued
description: At three in the afternoon, Song Yajing felt her eyelids heavy and her energy flagging, so she finally had the bubble tea shop next door deliver a large iced Americano. Just then, a regular customer pushed open the door and came in, carrying homemade chocolate chip cookies, and gave her two. She thanked her in surprise and ate the cookies with her coffee. The rush of sweetness and caffeine briefly lifted her spirits. She thought to herself that her recent tendency toward stress eating was creeping up again, and reminded herself to start watching it tomorrow.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Wrap-up adjustments and preparation of painting supplies for tomorrow.
description: Taking advantage of a lull in customers, Song Yajing gave Xiaomei instructions on the afternoon display maintenance points and notes on reserved styles. Then she walked to the cashier, opened the shopping app, and prepared to replenish art supplies tomorrow at the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, previewing brands of watercolor paper and pigments in advance and getting a clear sense of what she needed.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Pick up daughter from school and buy art supplies
description: Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, who ran over happily. As planned, she took Xuanxuan to the stationery store on Park South Road and, following the list for tomorrow's parent-child watercolor class, bought 12-color children's watercolor paints, 2 extra brushes, and a small pack of absorbent sponges. Xuanxuan watched curiously and chose a pretty sticker herself. After shopping, she held her daughter's hand and walked back to the store. On the way, a light drizzle began to fall, and she was glad she had checked the weather forecast at noon and brought an umbrella.
location: Park South Road Stationery Store, Phase 2, Yubincheng, No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Took her daughter back to the store and looked after the shop
description: Song Yajing brought her daughter back to the store and let Xuanxuan play with the newly bought stickers and colored pencils in the rest area. Xiaomei was attending to customers. While keeping an eye on her daughter, Song Yajing also received several customers who came in after work. A young girl was very interested in the slip dress Xiaomei recommended, so she walked over and gave advice from a styling perspective, successfully closing the sale.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Dinner
description: Song Yajing ordered two servings of light vegetable porridge and boiled dumplings for dinner, and ate with her daughter Xuanxuan in the store's rest area. While eating, she asked Xuanxuan what she had learned in kindergarten that day; her daughter excitedly told her she had just learned a Tang poem.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Evening business and family matters communication.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing had Xuanxuan read picture books in the rest area while the evening customer flow stayed steady. When the time was about right, she called her husband Chen Zhiqiang to discuss tomorrow Saturday’s arrangements: she would leave at 6:30 in the morning to go to Huandao Road for yoga with Zhao Li, and come back at 9:00 to take Xuanxuan to watercolor class; but since her husband would be off tomorrow morning, she hoped he could take Xuanxuan to the class. Chen Zhiqiang readily agreed on the phone, and she breathed a sigh of relief.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Closing the shop and checking painting supplies.
description: At 7:15 in the evening, Song Yajing began closing the shop. She let Xiaomei leave early and asked her daughter to help tidy up the odds and ends on the checkout counter. She took out Xuanxuan's watercolor painting bag and checked each item against tomorrow's class list: watercolor paper, 12-color paints, brushes, palette, absorbent sponge, and two waterproof aprons — everything was complete. Satisfied, she zipped the bag shut and hung it on the handcart by the store entrance so she wouldn't forget it. Then she checked and recorded the day's revenue and sales, finally turned off most of the lights, leaving only a small lamp on, and locked the store door.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Walking home and shopping along the way.
description: After closing the shop, Song Yajing walked home holding her daughter Xuanxuan by one hand and pushing a small trolley with her painting tool bag by the other. Passing by Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she dropped into the convenience store downstairs on the way and bought fresh milk toast for the next morning and a large bottle of fresh milk. When she saw chocolate by the cash register, she hesitated but did not buy it, the thought of 'a sign of stress eating' flashing through her mind.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Family time and washing up
description: After arriving home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was waiting for them in the living room. Song Yajing chatted with her husband for a few minutes about their respective plans for tomorrow. Then she helped her daughter Xuanxuan take a bath and change into pajamas. Her daughter asked expectantly what she would draw in tomorrow's art class, and she gently reassured her that she would find out tomorrow. In the bedroom, she read Xuanxuan two picture-book stories, and Xuanxuan soon fell asleep listening.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom. Although her body was very tired, she forced herself to spread out the yoga mat, open the stretching app, and follow a 10-minute stretching routine on the bed, focusing on her hips and side waist. She yawned frequently during the routine but managed to finish. Afterward, she almost collapsed onto the bed, set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning, and went over the next day's schedule in her mind: yoga at the Calligraphy Square on Huandao Road at 6:30, and a parent-child watercolor class at 9:00. Then she turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep instantly.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The biological clock woke me up right at 5:45, and I didn't linger in bed. After quickly washing up, I changed into black yoga pants and a light gray sports vest, and put on a thin windbreaker. I picked up the yoga mat bag from the entryway cabinet, drank half a glass of warm water in the kitchen, and took the Chinese herbal granules from the medicine box on the nightstand, preparing for outdoor yoga.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Meet Zhao Li and drive to the yoga studio.
description: She carried her yoga mat bag downstairs and saw her friend Zhao Li's red compact car at the community entrance, then got into the passenger seat. The two chatted along the way and drove south on Siming South Road. With little traffic in the early morning, they arrived at the Calligraphy Square on Huandao Road about 10 minutes later.
location: On the way from the entrance of the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Calligraphy Square on Huandao Road.

name: Outdoor yoga class by the sea
description: She spread her mat on the beach beside Calligraphy Square and attended an outdoor yoga class. The morning sea breeze was salty and damp, and waves lapped the shore. Following the instructor, she moved from Mountain Pose into a Sun Salutation sequence. Although her legs felt a strong stretch in Downward-Facing Dog, her body swayed in Tree Pose, and her arms went sore in Plank in less than half a minute, she persisted through the whole session with the sound of the waves and Zhao Li's encouragement. Finally, in Savasana, she lay on her back and felt her spine open up.
location: Seaside beach at Calligraphy Square, Huandao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shared breakfast with Zhao Li and had a good chat
description: After yoga class, Zhao Li dragged her to the Huandao Fisherman's Snack Shop, where they each ordered a bowl of sha cha noodles and a cup of thick soy milk. While eating, they chatted. Zhao Li admitted that she had initially wanted to refuse the early-morning invitation, but after practice her shoulders felt loose and relaxed. Zhao Li suggested doing it again next time. They chatted until almost eight, then hurriedly paid the bill.
location: Huandao Fisherman's Snack Shop, No. 189 Huandao South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home, shower, change clothes, and prepare to take her daughter to painting
description: Took a 15-minute taxi ride home, quickly took a hot shower to wash off the sweat and sand, changed into an off-white cotton-linen shirt and light blue wide-leg pants, and tied her half-dry hair into a low ponytail. Then she saw her daughter Xuanxuan already carrying her little backpack and holding watercolor markers. She helped straighten her collar, checked her art supply bag, and then took her hand, ready to head out.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the community art center and attend the parent-child watercolor class.
description: Holding Xuanxuan’s hand, we walked along East Park Road with dappled sunlight all the way, chatting about painting ideas. Fifteen minutes later, we arrived at the art studio on the second floor of the community art center for a parent-child watercolor class. The theme was “My Home.” Xuanxuan boldly painted the sky blue and the grass green, but I felt a little awkward—until my daughter’s words touched me: “Painting doesn’t have to be pretty; it just has to be fun.” So I picked up a brush and painted the sun. After that, I became absorbed in mixing colors and painting, forgetting the time. At the end of the class, Xuanxuan proudly showed off her work, and the teacher praised her: “You used colors very bravely.”
location: Painting studio on the 2nd floor of Siming District Community Art Center, 89 Gongyuan East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch and midday family time
description: After class, she strolled home slowly, with Xuanxuan hugging her painting and telling the story along the way. When they got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already busy in the kitchen, having bought fresh shrimp and clams. She had Xuanxuan put the painting on the tea table to dry, then went into the kitchen to help peel garlic, animatedly sharing the morning yoga session and her daughter's witty remark. Her husband teased, "Your daughter has become your life mentor." After that, she cooked seafood misua in pork rib soup, and the family of three had lunch. After the meal, she used a fridge magnet to attach the painting to the center of the refrigerator door. Her husband did the dishes while she took Xuanxuan for a nap. Still full of energy, she used leftover craft materials to make a "palm bunny" handcraft. Half an hour later, Xuanxuan grew sleepy, so she settled her down for a nap, then returned to the master bedroom to rest with her eyes closed.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle shop matters and family interactions at home in the afternoon
description: After waking from a nap, refreshed. Went to the balcony to collect the bed sheets and brewed rose tea. Contacted long-time customer Vivian via WeChat, letting her know the reserved white short-sleeved knit top was still there, and agreed she would come around 4 PM to pick it up. Then received a logistics screenshot from supplier Susan: three boxes of new goods had arrived at the Xiamen distribution center and were expected to be delivered to the store tomorrow morning. Confirmed with her husband that he would take Xuanxuan to the park tomorrow, while she would go to the store early to inspect the goods. Afterwards, took photos of her daughter's watercolor painting and the beige shirt outfit, posted them to the customer group, and prepared material for Moments. After Xuanxuan woke from her nap, they stuck the “palm bunny” on the wall together, then took clams and baby greens from the fridge to prepare dinner ingredients.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner for the family.
description: Chen Zhiqiang also came to help. The cook heated the wok, sautéed shredded ginger until fragrant, then added clams and sliced winter melon, stir-fried and added water to boil, then seasoned it into a light winter melon and clam soup. Her husband cooked rice and mixed tomatoes with sugar. The family chatted and laughed, full of joy. During dinner, they shared painting ideas and the challenge of receiving goods tomorrow, and her husband encouraged her, saying problems can always be solved.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening walk at Jiaxing Garden Park
description: After dinner, the family of three put on comfortable shoes and walked about 14 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park. Under the night sky, the streetlights were warm, and there were people walking dogs and jogging. Xuanxuan excitedly rode her scooter to lead the way, while the couple walked side by side behind, chatting about weekend plans and next week's work schedule, enjoying the breeze and leisure of an early summer evening.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home, washing up, putting her daughter to bed, and personal care
description: After taking Xuanxuan home, Song Yajing gave her a hot bath, changed her into bear pajamas, and sat by the bed reading "Guess How Much I Love You" to lull her to sleep; her daughter soon fell asleep. Then she went back to the master bathroom, carefully removed her makeup and washed her face, applied a hydrating mask, and did bedtime stretches on the yoga mat on the bedroom floor, especially relaxing her hips and back, which were sore from the morning yoga. The movements were slow and deep, and she silently prayed that tomorrow's delivery would have no color difference.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: She had a late-night chat with her husband and then rested.
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard chatting with her husband, who had already washed up, sharing how she felt today: 'Though I'm tired, I feel at peace. I hope the goods will be fine tomorrow.' Her husband comforted her, telling her not to overthink and that doing her best was enough. After agreeing on the next morning's schedule, they turned off the light and fell asleep, quickly sinking into a deep sleep to store up energy for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, breakfast, and communicating with family.
description: She woke up to the alarm, and the sky outside the window looked fine, but the weather forecast of rain cast a shadow over her mood. After getting up, she opened the curtains, washed up, took her Chinese herbal medicine granules, then went to the kitchen to heat a glass of milk and toast two slices of whole-wheat bread for a simple breakfast. Her husband A Qiang and daughter Xuanxuan were already in the living room. Song Yajing checked her bag and explained the day's plans to her husband, telling him to take their daughter to Zhongshan Park to see the pigeons, bring enough water and wet wipes, and that it might rain in the evening. Her husband agreed, and Xuanxuan happily cried out that she wanted to feed the pigeons. She also told him to go after three in the afternoon, but he could see she was distracted and just said to go attend to her own things.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the church and attend Sunday Mass.
description: After saying goodbye to her family, she walked uneasily toward Gulangyu Catholic Church. The walk took about 45 minutes and gave her time to sort out her thoughts on the way. She passed familiar streets and alleys and saw steam rising from breakfast stalls, but her mood remained unsettled. She entered the church on time, and Father Wang Mingde gave a sermon on "obedience and preparation," while her mind was full of the spring clothing about to arrive at the store. After Mass ended, she saw Aunt Lin Xiuying but only greeted her briefly before hurrying away.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the store to receive and inspect spring clothing.
description: After leaving the church, Song Yajing quickened her pace, made her way through the crowd, and walked about 15 minutes to the store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road. When she arrived, Xiaomei had already opened the store and was tidying up; three cardboard express boxes were sitting at the entrance. She used a utility knife to open them. The moment she took out a chiffon blouse, her heart sank—the actual color was far from the sample. After opening all three boxes, she found that nearly 80 percent of the goods had serious color deviation. Xiaomei was stunned too. Song Yajing forced herself to stay calm, told Xiaomei to get back to work, and said she would handle it herself.
location: Inside the Yajing Boutique Clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handling color difference issues, lunch, and supplier negotiations.
description: Song Yajing used her phone in the warehouse to photograph all the defective goods, compared them with samples, and saved the evidence. She sent the comparison photos to supplier Susan on WeChat with a message requesting a discussion. Feeling upset, she asked Xiaomei to go to the 85°C next door to buy a tuna sandwich and lemon tea, then sat in the corner and ate her lunch without tasting it. After lunch, she placed a WeChat voice call to Susan and calmly stated the facts about the color difference. Susan made excuses and refused a full refund. The communication failed, and she hung up feeling deeply helpless.
location: In-store warehouse of "Yajing Boutique Clothing", No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community operations and adjusting mood
description: After hanging up the phone, Song Yajing tried to pull herself away from her negative emotions and forced herself to shift her focus. She opened the customer WeChat group of about 200 people and sent a message saying that the store had just received new arrivals, and that a young woman would be coming in the afternoon to try on clothes and would have outfit photos taken to share, so everyone should look forward to it. At the same time, she began to think about keeping the store running even if her cooperation with Susan ended, and mulled over contacting new suppliers.
location: Inside the Yajing Boutique Clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Receiving regular customer Vivian for a fitting and the subsequent decision.
description: At two-thirty in the afternoon, Vivian arrived at the shop as promised. Song Yajing forced a smile to welcome her, took out the reserved white knit top, and recommended the newly arrived chiffon blouses. After trying them on, Vivian's expression changed. She complained the color was wrong and made her skin look sallow. She tried several pieces and was dissatisfied with all of them. Her tone turned harsh, and she criticized the poor quality of this batch, saying Song Yajing should be more careful with recommendations in the future. These words cut like knives. Song Yajing blushed and kept apologizing, and the atmosphere in the shop turned bad. Vivian bought the white knit top and left displeased. After seeing the customer off, Song Yajing closed the shop door and sat alone in the storeroom for a long time, her emotions churning. She decided to end her five-year partnership with Susan, changed Susan's WeChat note to "[Use with Caution] — 4.13 color difference dispute", removed Susan from her frequent contacts, and felt resolute but uncertain about future supply channels.
location: Fitting room area inside “Yajing Boutique Clothing,” No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Locked up the shop, went home, and did some shopping along the way.
description: Song Yajing looked exhausted. She told Xiaomei to keep an eye on the store, locked the door, and headed home. On the way, remembering it might rain in the evening, she stopped by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy a new umbrella, and also picked up some simple vegetables and noodles, planning to make a light dinner. Then she walked back to her home on Shanggu Street with weary steps.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing the convenience store at 35-101 Zhenhai Road)

name: Returned home to rest and take care of household chores
description: Back home, the house was empty—husband and daughter were still in the park. She changed into loungewear and put the groceries in the fridge. Feeling that she smelled of the shop, she went to the bathroom, took a hot shower, and changed into cotton pajamas, her tense nerves easing a little. Remembering that the air purifier filter needed cleaning tomorrow, she found the tools, disassembled and washed the living-room air purifier, vacuumed the dust, and wiped the casing with a damp cloth. When she finished, she sat on the sofa and sent her mother Lin Xiuying in Quanzhou a WeChat voice message to let her know she was safe. She didn't mention the rough day, only saying that the afternoon's customer fitting had gone smoothly. Her mother reminded her to eat on time and take care of her health.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: Song Yajing tied on an apron and started preparing dinner. She cooked a pot of clear noodle soup with greens, tomatoes, and eggs as the broth, and pan-fried some sausages. Her husband Aqiang came back with Xuanxuan, who excitedly shouted that she had seen many pigeons in the park and had fed them. During dinner, Xuanxuan chattered about what she had seen. Song Yajing forced a smile and replied, but her eyes could barely hide her exhaustion. Aqiang sensed something was wrong, gently held her hand under the table, and asked with his eyes; she shook her head, signaling they would talk later.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family parent-child time
description: After dinner, Song Yajing played with LEGO with her daughter in the living room, then bathed Xuanxuan, helped her change into pajamas, and read two picture books. When "The Rainbow Flower" was finished, Xuanxuan was a little sleepy. Song Yajing kissed her daughter's forehead and coaxed her to sleep. Looking at her daughter's peaceful sleeping face, she felt that no matter how tired she was, it was worth it.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal activities and going to bed
description: After leaving her daughter's room, Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied skincare. At her desk, she opened her journal and recorded the day's expenses (lunch, groceries, umbrella) and the emotional toll of handling Susan's return, writing down 'get to know new suppliers and don't rely on a single channel anymore.' Then she spread out her yoga mat on the floor and did 15 minutes of spinal relaxation and shoulder-and-neck stretches. Feeling somewhat calmer after stretching, she sat back down at her desk and wrote in her journal carefully, listing the core tasks for next week: contact Zheng Kai in Hangzhou to find alternative sources; post photos of the flawless new products in the community to rebuild trust; pack the defective goods and contact logistics for returns; and remind herself to transfer money to the education savings account tomorrow. After finishing the plan, she said her bedtime prayers, thanking God for a safe day and asking for wisdom and courage to face difficulties. Then she turned off the light and lay in bed. As the patter of rain came from outside the window, she thought that the weather forecast had finally been right, and she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Residential Community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning home activities
description: After struggling to get out of bed, feeling a headache and a dry throat, she first drank a cup of warm honey water and used a nasal irrigator to rinse her nasal passages to relieve allergies. The scale showed 49.8 kg, but she had no appetite due to feeling unwell. She then arranged for her husband Chen Zhiqiang to drop off her daughter Xuanxuan at kindergarten on his way, while she packed the morning, noon, and evening doses of honeycomb essence capsules and Chinese medicine granules, and checked the automatic transfer settings for tomorrow's education savings.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store
description: Walking with an umbrella from the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she took Metro Line 1 from Zhenhai Road Station to Zhongshan Park Station, then walked to the store on Zhongshan Road. On the metro, looking at the rainy view outside the window, her mood grew heavier because of the inventory photos on her phone.
location: Metro Line 1 and the walking sections from Zhenhai Road Station to Zhongshan Park Station in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shop Work and Personal Reflection
description: Arriving at the “Yaji” boutique clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, she found that shop assistant Xiaomei had already opened the door. Xiaomei became concerned because her face was pale. She barely managed to say it was nothing and asked Xiaomei to keep an eye on the front desk. She went into the back storage room alone. First she ironed and sorted the knitwear and dresses without quality problems and hung them back in the display area. Then, facing the box of chiffon blouses with serious color differences, she repeatedly calculated the accounts and estimated a direct loss of nearly 4,000 yuan. For the first time, she seriously considered closing the shop. At noon, while Xiaomei was out eating, she locked the shop door by herself, sat on the floor, kept accounts in the memo app on her phone, and looked at supplier Zheng Kai's WeChat but didn't contact him immediately. After Xiaomei brought back a pineapple bun, she barely managed two bites. Later she edited a message to Zheng Kai to probe about new sample styles, sent it, and waited for a reply while continuing to think about the next product selection direction.
location: "Yaji" Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Alone time and rest in the car
description: Claiming she felt unwell, she left the store early. Holding an umbrella, she walked to an open-air parking lot near Zhongshan Road, then drove about 10 minutes to the open-air parking lot at Jiaxingyuan Park. There she reclined her seat in the car and dozed off and stared blankly to the sound of rain. Her mind kept replaying Vivian's complaints from yesterday and the batch of defective chiffon blouses, and she felt low.
location: Open-air parking lot of Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (inside the car)

name: Pick up daughter from school and head home.
description: After being reminded by a message in the kindergarten parent group, she drove to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan happily ran over. After asking about her daytime activities, she walked with her to the 85°C bakery at Zhonghua City on the corner and bought tiger skin cake as a reward. Then they drove back together to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: Went successively to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, and finally returned to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District.

name: Going home for parent-child bonding.
description: After arriving home, she let Xuanxuan watch cartoons alone in the living room, washed some strawberries and blueberries for her, and then collapsed onto the sofa to rest with her eyes closed, occasionally responding to Xuanxuan's laughter.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: After arriving home in the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang noticed that Song Yajing looked unwell and took the initiative to cook a pot of seafood misua noodles. Although Song Yajing had no appetite, she still ate most of a bowl, and Xuanxuan also ate obediently beside her. After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang cleared the dishes, Song Yajing played with building blocks with Xuanxuan, then helped Xuanxuan wash her hands and asked her husband to take her to bathe, while she cleaned the kitchen and dining table.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting daughter ready for bed
description: After her bath, Xuanxuan came out wearing bear pajamas. Song Yajing took her to the bedroom and read two picture books. After Xuanxuan expressed her love, Song Yajing responded emotionally and coaxed her to sleep.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening up to her husband and having an emotional breakdown
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Song Yajing sat on the edge of the bed, repeatedly scrolling through the product photos on her phone. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came over from the study, hugged her, and asked what was wrong. Song Yajing finally broke down and, crying, poured out the color discrepancy incident, Vivian's complaints, Susan's evasiveness, the backlog of sixteen chiffon blouses, and her thought of closing the store. After a moment of silence, Chen Zhiqiang held her hand and said he would support her whether she continued or closed the store—he just wanted her to be healthy. Song Yajing sobbed loudly on her husband's shoulder for nearly half an hour, and her husband gently patted her back the whole time.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Calming emotions and cleaning the filter
description: After crying, her husband handed her warm water, and her emotions calmed a little. She went to her daughter's room, removed the air purifier filter, and in the bathroom, wearing gloves, carefully cleaned the accumulated pollen and dust with a brush and a damp cloth—a task planned for today at the beginning of the month. After cleaning, she reinstalled the filter and saw the indicator light turn green, feeling a bit of order restored.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Staying on medication and maintaining physical health.
description: Back in the kitchen, she took out tonight's honeycomb extract capsules and traditional Chinese medicine granules and took them with warm water. She also checked the next day's pillbox with morning, noon, and evening doses already separated, and recorded in her phone memo today's emotional breakdown, medication, and filter cleaning, reminding herself to reply to supplier Zheng Kai's message tomorrow.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stretching before sleep
description: I spread out the yoga mat and followed the app for 25 minutes of shoulder, neck, and back stretches. But because I was physically and mentally exhausted, my movements were heavy, my breathing was short, and I spaced out several times. Although my muscles were not noticeably relaxed, I barely maintained my daily habit.
location: Living room, Room 302, Unit 2, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep
description: After stretching, she lay on the floor in a daze until her husband pulled her up and guided her into the bedroom. Once she was in bed, her husband turned off the light. Listening to the sounds from the adjacent room, her tense nerves gradually relaxed. She slowly closed her eyes in the dark and, after a long while, finally fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning Preparations and Family Time
description: The alarm went off, and Yajing quickly washed up. She remembered her eyes were still swollen, so she gently pressed a chilled spoon over them for a few minutes to reduce the puffiness. She prepared a simple breakfast for the family, including milk, cereal, and boiled eggs. Her husband Aqiang helped put their daughter's hair into pigtails. The family of three ate breakfast at the table. Yajing reminded Xuanxuan to be good at kindergarten today and made a deal with her to draw together after school.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking daughter to school and commuting alone
description: Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand and walked for 8 minutes to the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watching her wave and run into the school gate. Then she didn't go straight to the store but took a longer walk along Gongyuan South Road. When she passed the bakery beside Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought herself a bottle of mineral water. She deliberately slowed down and walked along the stone-paved Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, using the 15 minutes of alone time to sort out her thoughts, and finally walked about 800 meters to reach Yajing Boutique Clothing Store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Count chiffon blouses and calculate inventory loss
description: Yajing used her key to open the shop door, arriving half an hour earlier than usual. She did not turn on the main lights; instead, she switched on a bright incandescent bulb in the storeroom. She moved all sixteen off-color chiffon tops that had been piled in the corner the day before to the sofa and large table in the fitting area, put on her reading glasses, and checked each one for fabric, workmanship, and degree of color deviation. She carefully noted in the ledger: 4 pieces had severe color deviation and were recommended to be scrapped; the remaining 12, though slightly off-color, had excellent cut and fabric. She calculated the cost of this batch and the potential loss from a discounted clearance sale, with a total loss of about 3,200 yuan. After finishing the sorting, she took a deep breath and wrote in her memo: "Today's goals: stop losses, transform, and rebuild confidence."
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Contact Zhao Li and Zheng Kai for support.
description: Yajing took out her phone and first dialed her best friend Zhao Li. Her voice was steady but a little hoarse as she briefly explained her situation: "Lili, I've run into some trouble. Are you free this afternoon to come to the shop? I want to use your sense of style to help me turn this batch of 'problem' clothes into something amazing." Zhao Li agreed readily. Then she opened WeChat, found the chat with her former Hangzhou colleague Zheng Kai, and sent a voice message: "Zheng Kai, there's a big problem with Susan's goods over here, and my reputation is at stake! Do you have any sample items that haven't been put on the shelves? Send me a batch first to tide me over? I'll settle the payment with you as soon as I sell them." Zheng Kai replied by voice message, saying there happened to be a few nice pieces in the warehouse, and he would send them by SF Express that afternoon, arriving tomorrow.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Rearranged the store display with Xiaomei.
description: After Xiaomei arrived, Yajing worked together with her. First, they temporarily moved the 12 chiffon tops still available for sale to the back storage room so they wouldn't affect the new display. Then the two re-matched and hung the store's intact spring/summer new arrivals, using a steam iron to smooth out the details. Yajing moved the most popular light-colored dresses to the window display, and near the entrance she styled a fresh “commute outfit” corner with a few basic T-shirts and jeans. Xiaomei wiped down the shelves and the floor, and the whole store regained a clean, bright atmosphere amid the busy work.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and browsing social groups.
description: The lunch bread Yajing had Aqiang bring over arrived—it was 85°C's pork floss bread. She sat behind the cash register, eating the cold bread while quickly scrolling through the chat history of the 'Yajing Lifestyle Studio' customer group on her phone. She replied to several regular customers' questions about the dresses from last time, and casually took a photo of the clear sky outside the window and posted it to Moments with the caption: 'Tuesday's sunshine is just as dazzling as the new arrivals in the store.'
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Brainstorming promotional copy for the new products and selecting coordinating items
description: After eating her fill, Yajing felt much better. She took out her phone's memo app and began drafting community post copy for the new shipment that Zheng Kai was about to send, settling on keywords such as “Zheng Kai's Exclusive Selection” and “First Wear in Xiamen.” Then she paced around the store and picked out a few basic jeans, a cream-colored blazer, and a silk scarf—items that could “resurrect” the brick-red chiffon blouse. She organized these accessories and placed them on the mobile rack next to the fitting room, waiting for Zhao Li to arrive.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Zhao Li helped coordinate chiffon blouses and took photos.
description: At two in the afternoon, Zhao Li arrived on time. She brought not only a few dried lavender sprigs and ribbons, but also the enthusiasm of a professional photographer. Yajing put on the most challenging brick-red chiffon blouse. Zhao Li immediately pulled from the selected rack a pair of dark blue wide-leg jeans and a light beige blazer, had Yajing put them on, and tied a small bow at her collar with a ribbon. Her overall vibe instantly changed from "making her look older" to "retro Hong Kong style." Zhao Li then put together three more outfits, and Yajing cooperated in front of the camera, trying hard to pose with a confident smile. Zhao Li took photos from multiple angles with her phone and also taught Yajing how to strike more natural poses. This was not just taking photos, but a "fashion styling makeover class" full of laughter and inspiration.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Posted a frank promotional message in the customer group and interacted with customers.
description: After Zhao Li left, Yajing quickly selected the 12 best photos in half an hour. At 5 p.m., she took a deep breath and posted a long message in the "Yajing Life Studio" group. She honestly explained the color issue, but focused on showing off Zhao Li's styling results, and promised, "The fabric and cut are absolutely fine; the color is just a bit retro." Finally, she announced the plan: "This batch is at 60% of the original price, limited to regular customers in the group." After the message was sent, the group was quiet for a few seconds, then erupted. Some regular customers said, "The styling looks great!", others asked about sizes, and a few regular customers who usually lurked privately messaged her to place orders directly. Yajing replied to each one, and the stone hanging over her heart finally dropped.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wrapping up and reviewing with Xiao Mei, and planning tomorrow's work
description: After the promotion ended, Yajing and Xiaomei cleaned up the “battlefield” together: putting the clothes used for shooting back in place, tidying the fitting room, and counting and packing the sold special-offer items. Yajing and Xiaomei briefly reviewed the day's situation, acknowledged Xiaomei's efforts, and told her the key tasks for tomorrow: first, follow up on Zheng Kai's logistics information; second, prepare the display plan for new stock arriving at the store. She felt that although the day was tiring, it was fulfilling and had direction.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Talked with husband on the walk home.
description: After closing the store, Yajing set off for home. She chose to walk, a distance of about 1.5 kilometers, taking about 18 minutes. On the way, she called her husband Aqiang and excitedly shared today's results: "Aqiang, Zhao Li is amazing. The outfits look completely different now, and a few regular customers in the group have already placed orders." On the other end of the phone, Aqiang encouraged her: "I told you you could do it. Come home tonight and we'll have a nice meal together." A few simple exchanges, yet they made her steps feel lighter.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and quality time with daughter
description: When she got home, A Qiang had already made a simple dinner, including tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a pot of hot soup. Yajing hugged Xuanxuan and gave her several kisses, and chatted with her about the new songs she learned in kindergarten. After dinner, the family of three curled up on the sofa and watched 20 minutes of the animated show 'My Little Pony.' Yajing took out Xuanxuan's doodle pad, and together they used colored pencils to draw a rainbow under a blue sky. The drawing was clumsy, but mother and daughter were both very happy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting my daughter to sleep and relaxing myself
description: Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into pajamas. She read Xuanxuan the newly purchased picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar, then hummed a song softly as she watched her daughter slowly close her eyes. After confirming her daughter was fast asleep, she turned off the light and returned to the living room.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Late-night talk with my husband and looking ahead to tomorrow.
description: Aqiang was looking at his phone on the sofa. Yajing sat down next to him and leaned on his shoulder. She sincerely thanked him again for his support yesterday and his persuasion today. The two talked about how to arrange Zheng Kai's goods when they arrived tomorrow, and also took stock of their cash flow for the period. Aqiang said, "Let's solve the immediate crisis first. You handle the beauty, and I'll handle the books." Yajing laughed at his words.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and self-reward
description: Yajing spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a 15-minute pre-bedtime stretch. Today she could feel her breathing clearly, and the tension in her neck and shoulders was noticeably relieved. After her muscles relaxed, she walked to the scale and saw the number resting at '50.8kg'. She said silently, 'It will be okay; solve the big problem first.' She went into the kitchen, cut herself the last piece of tiramisu she had rewarded herself with today, and savored it—a long-missed, hopeful sweetness.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and relaxing to fall asleep
description: After washing up, Yajing changed into her pajamas and turned off the light. She opened the memo app on her phone and added tomorrow's plan: 1. Follow up on SF Express logistics; 2. Organize and archive today's shooting materials; 3. Preview tomorrow's new arrivals in the group chat. After making the notes, she felt everything was on track. That night, she was no longer swallowed up by boundless anxiety; instead, with the thought "I did pretty well today," she fell into a deep, calm sleep.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and family interaction
description: The alarm went off at 6:50. Yajing didn't laze in bed; she quickly went to the bathroom to wash up and made herself a cup of warm water to take her spring allergy medicine. Today she put on a little light makeup, hoping to meet the demanding promotional day in better shape. Then she went to the kitchen and deftly cooked the pork wontons her daughter loved, and heated milk for herself and Aqiang. Before her daughter woke up, she quietly reminded her husband Chen Zhiqiang that they should review the accounts together in the evening, and checked the tracking number Zheng Kai had sent on her phone. At 7:15, she gently woke the still-sleeping Xuanxuan, braided her hair into two pigtails, and helped her put on a clean kindergarten uniform.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking the child to school and shopping during the commute
description: Yajing took Xuanxuan by the hand and headed out. On the way, she stopped at the convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station at the entrance of the community (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road) and bought a cup of hot soy milk and a steamed bun. Holding her daughter's hand, she walked toward the kindergarten while they ate. At the gate, she helped Xuanxuan straighten her schoolbag, kissed her on the forehead, and said goodbye. Then Yajing walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 to Zhongshan Road Station, and after exiting the station, opened the door of her shop right on time.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparation and logistics follow-up
description: After arriving at the store, Yajing skillfully turned on the air conditioner and the display spotlights, and quickly mopped the floor at the store entrance with a semi-damp mop. She took out her phone and first sent a voice message to Zheng Kai, her Hangzhou supplier, to confirm the logistics. After receiving a positive reply, she felt relieved. At 8:50, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time. The two worked in harmony, thoroughly cleaning the vintage-style display stand that Zhao Li had decorated with dried flowers the day before yesterday, then refolding and rehanging the 12 off-color chiffon blouses selected yesterday into new outfits, ready for today's customers.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Publish special-offer posts and interact with the community.
description: Yajing sat down at the cashier counter and used a photo-editing app on her phone to carefully touch up the most satisfying fitting photos Zhao Li had taken yesterday. She wrote a long post honestly explaining the color difference and styling effect of the chiffon blouses, and announced that all of them were in clearance at 40% off. After the post with photos was released in the customer group, the group immediately became lively; regular customers began @-mentioning her to ask for details. While quickly replying to questions about fabric and sizes, she also recorded the first wave of pre-order information in her notebook.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receiving sample goods and putting them on display.
description: After receiving the text message notifying her that the delivery had arrived, Yajing asked Xiaomei to watch the store, rode the electric bike parked at the store entrance to the SF Express (Houbin Road branch) to pick up a fairly large cardboard box, and quickly returned to the store. She and Xiaomei opened the box together and counted the 7 sample spring outfits sent by Zheng Kai. After confirming everything was correct, they split the tasks: they carefully ironed out the wrinkles with a garment steamer and, following the styling ideas Zhao Li had put together yesterday, placed the newly arrived light-colored spring clothes in the most prominent "New Arrivals" area at the store entrance, forming a display that contrasted sharply yet complemented the brick-red chiffon blouses in the adjacent clearance section.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and online chat.
description: Xiaomei went to the nearby 'Lianhuan Oyster Omelette' shop and packed two servings of satay noodles and some snacks to bring back as lunch. While quickly eating noodles, Yajing replied to customers' outfit advice questions in the WeChat group, and also used her phone to take several panoramic photos of today's new display. After lightly editing them, she posted them on Moments. She sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhao Li, inviting her to come by the shop in the evening to pick up a small gift, and shared the good news that sample goods had arrived at the store.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First-day sales and service for the special promotion
description: Starting at one in the afternoon, regular customers who had seen her Moments posts and group messages began to drop in one after another. Yajing personally greeted every guest, candidly holding up the chiffon blouses to show the color difference in natural light, and proactively shared her styling tips. Vivian, an old customer, came specially to show support. She not only bought a discounted chiffon blouse but also tried on the newly arrived spring collection and decisively added more pieces to her purchase. Between serving customers, Yajing kept replying to inquiries in the community group. Around three in the afternoon, she packed up the orders accumulated during the day and contacted an SF Express courier to pick them up. Since today was a crucial sales push day for the store, Yajing maintained a professional and enthusiastic smile the whole time.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing inventory and store handover.
description: Near closing time, the last group of customers left the store around six. Yajing let Xiaomei leave work first, then took the ledger and began counting the day's revenue. She quickly checked the incoming payments from WeChat, Alipay, and cash, and silently estimated: today she had sold 38 chiffon tops, about 60% of the inventory, and this had also driven sales of 5 new sample pieces—results far exceeding expectations. She marked today's main promoted styles and bestsellers in the notes app on her phone, turned off the last light in the store, locked the doors and windows, and rode her electric bike home.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Homecoming shopping and family time begin.
description: Yajing rode her electric scooter and first went to the underground supermarket on B1 of Zhonghua City, located at the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Siming South Road. She picked out a fresh yellow croaker, a bunch of spring greens, and a few tomatoes, and also specially chose a red-fleshed dragon fruit for her child. When she passed the 85°C bakery at the supermarket entrance, she remembered that Xuanxuan had been asking for cream croissants for days, so she happily bought one for her daughter. When she arrived at the building, her husband Chen Zhiqiang's car was already parked. She carried the shopping bags upstairs and opened the door, and Xuanxuan immediately pounced on her, calling “Mommy” in a sweet voice.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family financial management
description: Yajing put on an apron, cleanly steamed the fish, and stir-fried a plate of tomato and eggs and spring greens. At the dinner table, she excitedly shared the good news from the store with Aqiang: the inventory pressure was not as heavy as imagined, and the special promotion had been very successful. Their daughter Xuanxuan also began performing a newly learned nursery rhyme, and the family atmosphere was warm and joyful. After dinner, Aqiang cleared the table, washed the dishes, and watched cartoons with Xuanxuan. Yajing took out her laptop and account book, sat side by side with Aqiang, carefully checked last month's store revenue and household expenses, and explained that the loss had basically been offset by the special promotion, and that she would pay more attention to cash flow management going forward.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child interaction and household chores
description: After balancing the accounts, Yajing felt much more at ease. She played with Xuanxuan in the living room, building a block castle, and then played the little princess from the cartoon. Afterward, she ran warm bath water for her daughter, gave her a nice fragrant hot bath, and read two newly bought picture-book stories until Xuanxuan fell asleep peacefully. Her husband Aqiang went to the balcony, took in the clothes that had been drying all day, folded them, and put them into their respective wardrobes.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal relaxation and pre-sleep stretching
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Yajing had time that was completely her own. She first made a video call to her mother in Quanzhou and shared the good news from the store today; her mother was happy for her too. After hanging up, she spread out her yoga mat and did 15 minutes of bedtime stretching on the living room carpet, focusing on the relaxation of her muscles and the stretching of her body. The soreness from standing all day seemed to slowly melt away.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare to rest and plan for tomorrow
description: Yajing changed into comfortable pajamas and lay down in bed. She took out her phone and gave the customer groups one last scroll to confirm there were no new after-sales issues. In her memos, she wrote tomorrow's plan: organize today's customer feedback from the community, contact Zheng Kai to discuss sales of the sample styles, and start selecting the next batch of spring clothing. With everything arranged, she set the alarm for 6:50 the next morning and fell asleep peacefully beside her husband, drifting into a familiar dream.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and prepare breakfast
description: The 7:00 alarm went off right on time. After a quick wash-up, she drank a glass of honey water and took her daily loratadine. For breakfast today, she cooked small wontons for Xuanxuan and fried eggs and toast for herself and Aqiang.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and caring for daughter
description: At 7:40 I gently woke up my daughter, helped her put on the little dress she picked out yesterday. While braiding her hair, I coaxed her to eat breakfast: "Xuanxuan, be good. There's a lot to do at the store today. How about I make you egg tarts tonight?" She nodded happily.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Left home with Xuanxuan on time at 8:00. After going downstairs, walked about 10 minutes to send her to kindergarten. On the way, she chattered about fun things at kindergarten, while I quickly took a few flat-lay photos of the chiffon tops to promote today for the group's publicity.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province   No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming Experimental Kindergarten, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and buying supplies
description: After dropping off Xuanxuan at 8:15, I walked 12 minutes to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, swiped my phone to enter, and took Line 1 to Zhongshan Road. On the train, I used Meitu to add a sticker saying "Last day! Great fit" to the photo I had just taken. I got off at Zhongshan Road Station at 8:35 and stopped by the 7-ELEVEn (Zhonghua City Store) at the station exit, buying a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and a pack of soda crackers for an energy boost in the morning.
location: Xiamen Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Zhenhai Road Metro Station; Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Arriving at the store, preparation, and opening
description: Arrived at the shop at 8:45, turned on the lights, wiped the counter, and felt calm. I neatly hung the last dozen or so off-color chiffon tops from yesterday on the special-offer rack by the door and put up the small blackboard: "Last few pieces, clearance at a loss, thanks for the support of our regular customers!"
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online discount clearance and supply chain communication.
description: At 9:00, she posted a photo in the customer group: 'Only 6 pieces left. The colors actually go perfectly with dark bottoms for a retro look. Clearance at 49 yuan.' People in the group gradually placed orders. At 10:30, she took time to call supplier Zheng Kai and confirmed the reorder quantity and delivery date for the sample spring clothing. At 11:00, 3 pieces were sold in the group, inventory dropped significantly, and she felt a little relieved.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: At 11:30, I ordered 'Lao San's Sour Cabbage Fish' from a delivery app. Started eating at 12:00, scrolling through Xiaohongshu while eating to check spring/summer outfit trends. After the meal, leaned back in the chair and rested with eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Clearing out remaining stock, packing and shipping orders, and reconciling payments.
description: At 12:30, I continued updating the remaining stock in the group chat. Around 2 p.m., the last 3 pieces were bought as a combined order by regular customer Vivian and her friend! Stock cleared! I let out a long sigh of relief and started packing the morning and afternoon orders, handwriting a thank-you card for each item. At 15:00, the SF Express courier arrived on time to pick up the packages. After the pickup, I checked the payment records and estimated the loss in my ledger, and my heart tightened.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In-depth accounting and cash flow review
description: At 15:00, I closed the shop door, drew the curtains, and quietly did the accounts. After calculating item by item: the color difference incident caused a direct profit loss of about 4,600 yuan, but the promotions over the past two days brought in over 20,000 yuan in cash. Next month's rent and supplier balance are no worry—cash flow is safe! I was relieved.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize sales data and thank Zhao Li and Zheng Kai.
description: At 16:00, I used Excel to create the 'Color-Difference Chiffon Blouse Promotion Review Form'. Then I sent a voice message to my best friend Zhao Li: “Lili, this time it's all thanks to your outfit-matching photos. The stock is cleared, the losses are settled, and the cash flow is saved! I'll treat you to a big meal another day!” I also sent Zheng Kai a message: “Brother Kai, the stock is cleared and the reorder for the sample styles is confirmed. Thank you for helping me out in times of trouble.” They replied instantly, and my eyes felt a little misty.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy ingredients, pick up daughter from school, and go home.
description: At 16:30, I composed myself and rearranged the regular spring styles. I closed and locked the rolling door early, then walked to the supermarket on B1 of nearby Zhonghua City. I bought sea bass, asparagus, and tomatoes, and at checkout bought two cartons of yogurt for Xuanxuan. At 17:00, I walked about 8 minutes from the supermarket to the kindergarten gate, just in time for dismissal. At 17:15 I picked up Xuanxuan. She excitedly showed me her handmade craft: "Mommy, look at my playdough flower!" I praised her and told her the good news that the clothes in the store had sold out. We walked home holding hands, and a few raindrops began to fall—luckily we made it in time.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Supermarket on B1 of Zhonghua City; Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: At 18:00 I got home, and Aqiang was already preparing ingredients. I changed into loungewear and started making steamed sea bass. At the dinner table, Aqiang and I reviewed today's inventory clearance and accounting. He held my hand and said, "You handled it well. Don't rely too much on that kind of supplier in the future." I nodded. After dinner I did the dishes, and Aqiang played with blocks with Xuanxuan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Keep the promise: bake egg tarts
description: At 19:15, I kept my morning promise and took out the egg tart shells and whipping cream to make egg tarts. Aqiang taught Xuanxuan to recite Tang poems. At 20:00, the egg tarts came out of the oven and the whole house smelled wonderful! The three of us sat on the sofa and each ate two, and Xuanxuan ended up with pastry all over her face. After that, I bathed Xuanxuan, and Aqiang cleaned up the kitchen.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to sleep and personal care
description: At 20:30, I read picture books to Xuanxuan to put her to sleep, and she quickly fell asleep. At 21:00, I started washing up and used a nasal irrigator to rinse my nose and relieve the discomfort.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and relaxation
description: At 21:10, she unrolled her yoga mat and did 15 minutes of stretching. Her body was very tired, but after the routine she felt much less soreness in her waist and legs, and her mind felt much lighter.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening recharging and peaceful sleep
description: At 21:45, leaning on the bed, she first video-called her mother in Quanzhou, her hometown, to share the good news. After hanging up, she wrote down tomorrow's plan in her memo: re-plan the product selection direction and avoid suppliers prone to color deviation; take Xuanxuan to Jiaxingyuan Park in the afternoon. At 22:30, she turned off the lights and lay down, feeling reassured. The stress of the day was finally released, and she soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: She forced herself to wash up and take care of her daughter in the morning.
description: The alarm rang, and her body felt unusually heavy from days of exhaustion. Song Yajing struggled to get up, washed her face with cold water, opened her daughter Xuanxuan's door, and gently coaxed her to get up and get dressed. In the kitchen, she simply heated the bread and milk bought yesterday, fed Xuanxuan breakfast, and forced herself to drink a few sips of milk, but her stomach felt bloated and she had no appetite.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Took my daughter to school and bought breakfast.
description: Holding Xuanxuan's hand, we went out. The sky was overcast with light drizzle. First we walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where I bought myself a hot American coffee and a tea egg, hoping to wake up. Then, holding the umbrella, I walked about 11 minutes to take Xuanxuan to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watched her walk into the classroom, and told her to listen to her teacher.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting to the store
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1, and got off at Zhenhai Road Station after two stops. After exiting the station, walked along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Shop No. 56. Felt dizzy and weak on the way, and silently encouraged myself: after handling the product selection and Zheng Kai's sample goods today, I'll rest early.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store opening preparations and handover with staff
description: After arriving at the shop, she changed into her work uniform, opened the door, turned on the lights, and aired out the space. Staff member Xiaomei arrived shortly after. Yajing told Xiaomei that she wasn't feeling well today and asked her to keep a closer eye on front-area reception and cashier duties, while she herself mainly handled sample goods in the back storeroom. Together they briefly swept up the fallen leaves at the shop entrance.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organizing sample goods and selecting products online
description: Yajing brought the 7 sample spring outfits sent by Zheng Kai to the back storage sorting table, carefully inspected the workmanship, fabric, and cut of each piece, pressed them smooth with a garment steamer, and personally attached security tags. During a break, she returned to the front cashier counter, sat down, and browsed several clothing wholesale platforms on her phone, mainly filtering for dresses suitable for the spring-to-summer transition and lightweight sun-protection tops, and saved screenshots. Feeling tired, she drank half a cup of coffee that had already gone cold.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and a short break
description: Yajing had little appetite, so she asked Xiaomei to bring back a hot preserved egg and lean pork congee and a small cake from the nearby bakery. After Xiaomei returned with the takeout, the two had a simple lunch at the front desk. Yajing barely drank more than half a bowl of the congee and showed little interest in the cake, feeling acid reflux in her stomach. After the meal, she felt even more tired, so she leaned back in the recliner behind the cash register and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business and phone communication
description: There were few customers, and Xiaomei was watching a drama on her phone at the front desk. Yajing forced herself to stay energized and went to the back storage to continue sorting the inventory that had not been fully categorized in the morning. She separated Zheng Kai's sample goods from the store's other spring clothing, put them in hanging bags, and labeled them. At that moment, her phone vibrated—Zheng Kai called back on time. The two discussed the pricing of the 7 sample items and finally confirmed a cooperation model of 'sell first, settle later.' Yajing sincerely thanked Zheng Kai and Zhao Li for their help during the color-difference crisis. After the call, she felt a more obvious wave of dizziness and steadied herself against the wall.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Fainted in the back storage room and was discovered by a store employee who called for help.
description: After hanging up the phone, Yajing wanted to sort out the last box of unsorted tops while she could still hold on. When she bent down to move a relatively heavy cardboard box, her vision suddenly went black and the world spun. She struggled to support herself against the metal shelf beside her, but her legs gave way, and her whole body slid down the shelf to the floor. Her forehead hit hard against a protruding shelf screw with a dull thud, and her consciousness blurred instantly. Xiao Mei, who was at the front desk, heard the strange noise from the warehouse and immediately ran into the back storage to check. Seeing Song Yajing lying on the floor, pale-faced with a red swollen bump on her forehead, Xiao Mei was so frightened that she burst into tears. She tried to calm down, loudly calling Yajing's name while dialing Yajing's husband Chen Zhiqiang's phone with trembling hands, explaining the situation in a tearful voice.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Took her to the hospital for treatment
description: About ten minutes later, Chen Zhiqiang rushed to the store by car. He burst into the back storage room and saw his wife slumped on the floor with a wound on her forehead; he was both angry and anxious. He and Xiaomei, who had also rushed in, helped Yajing up, half carrying and half supporting her into the car parked on the roadside. They drove to the nearest Siming District Zhenhai Road Community Health Service Station. Family doctor Wang Mingyuan received her. After a detailed inquiry, he diagnosed low blood sugar, autonomic nervous system dysfunction, and severe sub-health. He treated and bandaged the wound on her forehead, prescribed Chinese patent medicines for regulation and vitamins, and seriously instructed her to keep a regular schedule and reduce stress.
location: Siming District Zhenhai Road Community Health Service Station, No. 37 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home and erupted into a fierce argument
description: Coming out of the community health center, the sky was gloomy. Chen Zhiqiang drove all the way with a grim face. After getting home, he helped Yajing to the sofa and sat her down, no longer able to contain his worry and anger. He shouted, "Song Yajing, do you want money or your life? Are you never satisfied until this family falls apart? How many times have you fainted this month? Do you even want to keep going?" Yajing felt weak and terribly wronged; tears streamed down her face and she couldn't say a word. The two broke into the fiercest argument of their marriage.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Calming down alone and preparing dinner
description: After the quarrel, Chen Zhiqiang walked into the bedroom and slammed the door shut. Yajing sat alone on the sofa, looking at the empty living room, her heart full of mixed feelings. She walked blankly to the kitchen, boiled a pot of water, and poured herself a cup of hot water. She had no appetite to cook, but thinking that Xuanxuan would be home soon, she opened the fridge and took out the vegetables and eggs she had bought yesterday, planning to cook some noodles for Xuanxuan. Chen Zhiqiang also said nothing and sat alone in the study.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daughter came home and expressed concern, easing the family atmosphere.
description: Auntie Zhang, a neighbor, picked Lele up from kindergarten and brought her home. When Lele came in and saw her mother's forehead covered with gauze and her father with a stern face, she got scared and hid in her own room. After a while, she timidly ran out and handed her mother a drawing—it showed her mother lying in a hospital bed, with the words "Mommy, get better soon" written crookedly beside it. Yajing burst into tears the moment she saw it and held her daughter for a long time. Chen Zhiqiang was also stunned at the scene; he sighed, went to the kitchen, and quietly made Yajing a bowl of light egg noodles.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal reflection and making a health plan
description: After finishing the noodles, Yajing felt a bit warmer. Chen Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan to bathe and read her stories. Yajing lay in bed alone, tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep. She opened the memo app on her phone and deleted the previous unrealistic plan of "taking Xuanxuan to the park in the afternoon." In its place, she wrote a reminder to go to Siming District Central Hospital next Monday to schedule a health checkup, and marked a recurring reminder on her calendar: "Forced rest every week for half a day." Reflecting on her recent busyness, she began to seriously think about the balance between work and health.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Stretching before bed and confirming tomorrow's arrangements.
description: Thinking of her recent persistence, Yajing tried a few minutes of gentle, slow-paced bedtime stretching, but felt some soreness in her lower back. She sent her mother a short WeChat message to let her know she was safe, saying she was just a little tired. She also flipped through tomorrow's plan and decided that Xiaomei would cover the store for a while the next morning while she rested at home for half a day. After doing all this, she set her alarm, turned off the light, and got ready for bed. Her body was tired and her mind was heavy, but she resolved that starting tomorrow, she really needed to readjust the pace of her life.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning washing and morning care
description: Following the doctor's orders, I didn't wake from my deep sleep until 9:20, when my mother called softly. It was overcast outside, and my forehead still ached slightly. My mother helped me slowly get up and go to the bathroom, squeezed toothpaste onto my toothbrush, and handed me warm water. After a quick wash, she brought me warm boiled water and the Chinese patent medicine prescribed by Dr. Wang, and watched me take it.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, home master bedroom and bathroom.

name: Breakfast: mushroom and lean pork congee cooked by my mother
description: Today, my husband Chen Zhiqiang took leave and stayed home. He had gone to the pharmacy in the morning and bought band-aids and disinfectant supplies. He brought to the table the mushroom and lean pork porridge that his mother, Lin Xiuying, had gotten up before dawn to simmer. The porridge was soft, thick, and fragrant. I sat down at the table and managed to drink more than half a bowl. My stomach felt warm, and I felt more energetic. His mother told me with concern to drink slowly.
