My father also called, and I told him I was fine to set his mind at ease.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Stayed in bed to recuperate; contacted suppliers in the morning.
description: After the meal, I went back to bed to continue resting. Remembering that the refund for the problematic goods from Susan's side yesterday had not been fully resolved, I leaned against the headboard, opened WeChat on my phone, found her, and communicated the refund progress for the last batch of payment in a restrained but firm tone, and sent her the transfer screenshot and chat records for verification. Susan replied that the remaining payment was expected to be processed by next Monday. I specifically confirmed the exact amount and the receiving account information, and only after getting a definite answer did I feel relieved and more at ease.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and taking medication
description: Mother and Zhiqiang prepared lunch together, which was light stir-fried seasonal vegetables and a steaming bowl of egg drop soup. I still didn't have much appetite, but I insisted on finishing the soup and eating some vegetables. After the meal, reminded by my mother, I took the Chinese patent medicine prescribed by Dr. Wang on time.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday rest and relaxation
description: After lunch she returned to the bedroom, with the curtains half drawn and soft light inside. She set a half-hour alarm and took a nap. Perhaps because of the medication, she slept more deeply than in the morning. When the alarm woke her, she felt a little lighter, and the tension of the past few days had eased.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Resting alone and envisioning future life.
description: After waking up, I didn't get up immediately. I put on Bluetooth earphones and played some soothing piano music. Listening to the music, I let my mind go blank and began to seriously plan a new way of life: once I feel better, I must insist on doing ten minutes of stretching every morning after getting up, and force myself to rest for half a day every week. I opened the memo on my phone, deleted the original plan, and wrote instead that starting next Monday, after taking Xuanxuan to school every morning, I will leave 15 minutes for my own 'peace of mind' time. This thought made me feel much more at ease.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video called mother at noon to report safety.
description: While I was resting, my mother Lin Xiuying took the opportunity to go to the vegetable market to buy groceries, planning to make me pork rib soup in the evening to nourish me. Shortly after she left, she sent a WeChat video request. I answered the video and, to put her at ease, tried to make my voice sound stronger, reporting that I had eaten porridge and taken medicine and felt much better. Seeing that my complexion had improved, my mother was relieved. She stressed again that health is the most important thing, and said she had already discussed it with my father and would stay in Xiamen for the next few days to help cook and take care of the child, telling me not to worry about anything. My heart warmed, and I agreed.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shop assistant Xiaomei visited to report on store operations.
description: At 2:30 pm, Xiaomei, a store staff member, came to my home to visit me with a bag of fruit and a hot cup of milk tea. She first asked about my health, then gave a detailed report on today's Saturday store operations: 'Sis, everything is normal at the store. I'm taking care of it alone, and I made two sales this morning—it's going well. The new sample spring clothes are hanging over there; two customers tried them on and were very interested, saying they will bring friends next week.' I felt somewhat relieved and told her, 'Message me on WeChat anytime if anything comes up, especially if you are unsure about an outfit.'
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy an aroma diffuser and essential oils online.
description: After Xiaomei left, Yajing went back to bed. Remembering that her friend Lin Yue, a physiotherapist at a traditional Chinese medicine clinic, had suggested buying an aromatherapy diffuser to help with sleep, she opened the online shopping app on her phone and spent over ten minutes browsing and comparing ultrasonic aromatherapy diffusers from several brands and lavender essential oils from different origins. In the end, she chose a minimalist aromatherapy diffuser with good reviews for quiet operation, along with a bottle of lavender essential oil made in France, added them to her cart, and completed the payment, hoping it would help improve her long-term difficulty falling asleep.
location: In the master bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian (online shopping)

name: Discuss store layout adjustments with her husband
description: After seeing Xiaomei off, Zhiqiang returned to the bedroom. Leaning against the headboard, I told him the store adjustment ideas that had been swirling in my mind before I fainted in the warehouse the day before yesterday. I pulled up the store photos on my phone, pointed at the coffee corner, and said: 'Let's focus on clothing. The equipment in the coffee corner is underutilized and takes up space. I plan to remove it all and sell the equipment secondhand. For the freed-up space, I want to make a small community sharing area, where we can hold flower arrangement classes or styling sharing sessions in the future, and also increase customer stickiness.' After listening, Zhiqiang expressed understanding and support: 'Sure, I'll post the listings on a secondhand platform for you.'
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Stayed alone to rest and recuperate, waiting for the family to come home.
description: After talking with Zhiqiang, I felt much more relaxed. He was going to pick up Xuanxuan, and I also needed to rest quietly for a while. I drank a few sips of warm water, lay down again, and set a 20-minute alarm.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Husband took daughter to a painting class at the community art center
description: At 4:30 p.m., her husband Chen Zhiqiang took their daughter Xuanxuan and, according to the class they had registered for, walked to the nearby community art center for the watercolor class. I finally had a full block of time to rest completely quietly. To soothing music, I fell deeply asleep again. More than an hour later, the sound of the door opening came from the living room, along with my daughter's crisp call: “Mommy, I'm back!”
location: Community Art Center, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (about a 15-minute walk from the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street)

name: Family dinner: looking at daughter's rainbow drawing
description: Mother Lin Xiuying had already prepared dinner: crucian carp and tofu soup and several home-style dishes. Xuanxuan ran excitedly into the bedroom and showed me the painting “Little Rainbow” she had just finished in her watercolor class. The colors in the painting were bright. Pointing at the rainbow, she said, “I drew Mommy's body into it too. I hope Mommy gets better soon so we can go to the park together!” I hugged her, my eyes a little moist, and kissed her forehead. Our whole family of four sat around the table and had a warm dinner.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family evening time and bedtime preparation
description: After the meal, Zhiqiang cleared the table, and my mother went to the kitchen to wash the dishes. I sat on the sofa and looked at my phone for a while, confirming the appointment for next Monday's health checkup that I booked yesterday. Xuanxuan snuggled up to me and picked up crayons to draw another picture. Around 8 o'clock, Zhiqiang bathed Xuanxuan, told her stories, and coaxed her to sleep. My mother also went to wash up. With my husband's support, I went to the bathroom and did a simple wash-up myself.
location: Living room, master bedroom, and bathroom at home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and relaxation
description: After washing up, I went back to the bedroom without lying down right away. Remembering that I had kept up a pre-bedtime stretching habit for a while, I decided to do some of the simplest, gentlest movements to relax my tense body. Sitting on the edge of the bed, I slowly turned my neck, stretched my arms, and did a few basic moves. Although I still didn’t have much strength, my body felt more comfortable afterward.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Falling asleep peacefully.
description: She set an alarm for 21:00 to take her medication, and set an alarm for 22:00 to go to sleep. After taking the last dose of the evening, she opened the notes app on her phone, checked the “Today’s Adjustments” section again, and noted down keywords such as “follow up with Susan on payment,” “Xiaomei’s visit,” “planning focus,” and “sandalwood aromatherapy diffuser purchased.” She felt that although she had spent most of today lying in bed, she had still handled many important matters, and the anxiety in her heart had dropped significantly. She turned off the desk lamp and, surrounded by the even breathing of her family, fell into a deep sleep before long.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning medication and simple washing up
description: Felt lighter than yesterday and sat up slowly after the alarm rang. First picked up the water cup on the nightstand and took the Chinese patent medicine her mother had prepared the day before. Then slowly got up, washed briefly with warm water, and felt a little reassured looking at her improved complexion in the mirror.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Praying in bed and meditating while reading Scripture
description: Back in bed, she propped up the pillow, opened the Bible app on her phone, and instead of searching directly, closed her eyes and said a short prayer: 'Lord, I place today and the future of my family and the store into Your hands.' Then, she accidentally scrolled to Matthew 16:26: 'What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his life?' The verse shone into her heart like a light. Recalling the fainting and arguments over the past week, she burst into tears. Scenes of desperately working in the past flashed before her eyes, and the values she had held for so long were thoroughly shaken in that moment.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Communicate candidly with her husband and announce delegating authority
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang walked into the bedroom carrying a bowl of millet porridge that his mother Lin Xiuying had cooked and two boiled eggs, ready to call her for breakfast. Song Yajing stopped him, her voice trembling slightly but her tone firm: 'Aqiang, I want to apologize. I was wrong to push myself so hard before. I want to hand the store over to Xiaomei. From now on, I'll only handle product selection and the community. My health and you all are the most important.' Chen Zhiqiang was stunned for a few seconds, then sat down on the edge of the bed, held her hand tightly, and said with slightly reddened eyes: 'You've finally come around. I support you. Take it slow, no rush.' The two smiled at each other, and the gloom of the past few days melted away in that moment.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Enjoy breakfast and interact with family
description: Supported by her husband, she made her way to the dining room. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, saw that she was in good spirits and quickly put the reheated millet porridge and refreshing stir-fried mustard greens on the table. Her 5-year-old daughter, Chen Lexuan, ran over and said in a sweet, childish voice, "Mommy, I dressed myself today!" Song Yajing smiled and stroked her daughter's hair, praising her for being great. The family sat around the table, and her appetite was much better than yesterday; she finished the entire bowl of porridge.
location: Song Yajing's home dining room, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Schedule a health checkup by phone
description: After finishing the porridge, she leaned back on the sofa and used her phone to call the partner health examination center—the Health Examination Center of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, Siming Branch. She confirmed with customer service a full-body health check package on the morning of May 6, and noted that it needed to include a thyroid color Doppler ultrasound and cardiovascular/cerebrovascular risk screening. After hanging up, she took a screenshot of the appointment information for reference and let out a deep breath, feeling as though a long-carried burden had been lifted.
location: Sofa in the living room of Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Remotely coordinating store matters
description: After her condition stabilized, she contacted the shop assistant Xiaomei through WeChat. She briefly said that she needed to rest for two more days, then formally announced, 'Xiaomei, please take more care of the store's daily operations from now on. I'll decide the plans for stocking and display, and you can contact me when an important customer tries on new items.' Xiaomei was first surprised on the other end of WeChat, then happily agreed, 'Sister Yajing, you rest assured and take care of your health. Leave the store to me!' Song Yajing added that she should take a photo of the new sign at the store entrance saying 'closed for half a day every Sunday' and send it to her for confirmation.
location: Sofa in the living room of Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Noon break and family chat
description: Her mother, Lin Xiuying, was busy simmering chicken soup in the kitchen, while Song Yajing lay on the recliner in the living room. The sheets drying on the balcony gave off the fresh scent of laundry detergent, and a few birds chirped downstairs. She scrolled on her phone for a while and saw that Lin Xiuying had shared a choir recording in the church fellowship group. She replied, "Praise the Lord." When her mother came out to pour water, they chatted about what to have for dinner. Song Yajing smiled and said, "Mom's braised pork is the most delicious." A relaxed smile she hadn't worn in a long time appeared on her face.
location: Living room and balcony of Song Yajing's home, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch and taking medication.
description: At lunchtime, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, under his mother's guidance, made a refreshing loofah and egg drop soup and red-braised prawns. The family sat around the table, and her daughter Chen Lexuan enthusiastically told funny stories about her kindergarten classmates, making everyone laugh. Song Yajing had a good appetite, ate half a small bowl of rice, and after the meal took the Chinese patent medicine her mother-in-law handed her on time.
location: Song Yajing's home dining room, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Napping alone
description: After the meal, she felt a little sleepy and went back to the bedroom alone for a nap. A gentle breeze by the window stirred the curtains, and the room was quiet. This sleep was more peaceful than yesterday, with no dreams. When she woke up, she felt that the heaviness in her body had lightened a little more.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Negotiated the transfer of the coffee machine with a regular customer
description: After waking up, she contacted Vivian, a regular customer and baking enthusiast, via WeChat. She sent a message: "Vivian, do you still want that Italian espresso machine from my store? It's about 90% new. I plan to turn this corner into an activity area, so if you need it, I'll transfer it to you at cost." Vivian replied quickly and showed great interest. After several rounds of voice messages, they agreed on a transfer price of 60% of the purchase price (about 2,400 yuan) and arranged for her to test the machine at the store next weekend and take it away directly. She calculated that this money could be used to replace some materials for the flower arrangement salon.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spent time with my daughter and completed her drawing homework.
description: Seeing her daughter playing with building blocks on the coffee table, she remembered the parent-child watercolor homework left over from last week. She asked her husband to find her daughter's watercolor set, then sat beside her daughter, followed a teaching video on her phone, imitated her daughter's brushstrokes, and painted a simple, warm sunflower stroke by stroke. Her daughter also seriously painted her own little flowers. The mother and daughter often commented on each other's work, and the living room was filled with color and laughter.
location: Song Yajing's living room, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking around the neighborhood.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang suggested she go downstairs for a walk and get some fresh air. She changed into a loose knit sweater and slowly went downstairs with her husband and daughter. In the community garden, she walked slowly along the tree-lined path for about 15 minutes and managed to complete 500 steps today. Midway, she sat on a bench for a while, watching her daughter chase a butterfly, and felt an unprecedented sense of calm.
location: Community garden, No. 82 Shanggu Street, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family members worked together to prepare a warm dinner
description: After returning from the walk, Song Yajing sat in the living room to rest. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang and mother Lin Xiuying went out together, walking to the nearby Eighth Market in Siming District, where they bought fresh shrimp, pork belly, mustard greens, dried shiitake mushrooms, and other ingredients. When they got home, Chen Zhiqiang tied on an apron and plunged into the kitchen to show off his cooking skills. While simmering the satay sauce, he also prepared braised pork. Their 5-year-old daughter Chen Lexuan seriously helped peel garlic and set out chopsticks and bowls. The kitchen was filled with the clatter of spatulas and laughter, and the aroma was mouthwatering.
location: Song Yajing's home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential area, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Eighth Market in Siming District (intersection of Kaiping Road and Kaiyuan Road).

name: The whole family sharing a heartwarming dinner.
description: At dinner time, the table was filled with authentic Southern Fujian home-style dishes: rich and fragrant satay noodles, soft and tender braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and herbal chicken soup her mother had simmered for a long time. Song Yajing was deeply moved looking at the spread. During the meal, Chen Zhiqiang suggested, “How about every Sunday evening, our whole family cooks something nice together and calls it ‘Family Cooking Day’?” Their daughter was the first to raise both hands in approval. Song Yajing smiled and nodded, thinking that this was the life she wanted.
location: Song Yajing's home dining room, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family leisure time
description: After the meal, her husband volunteered to clear the dishes. Song Yajing and her daughter built a "little castle" with LEGO. After Chen Zhiqiang finished washing the dishes, he brought out the computer and played a clip from the animated film "Finding Nemo" that their daughter likes. The family curled up on the sofa, enjoying this rare, completely relaxed evening. Mother Lin Xiuying sat nearby sewing a button that had fallen off Xuanxuan's clothes.
location: Song Yajing's living room, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set up the aromatherapy diffuser and set bedtime rules.
description: She returned to the bedroom early, took out the aromatherapy diffuser that had arrived yesterday, removed the packaging, and placed it on the nightstand. Following the instructions, she added purified water, put in 3 drops of lavender essential oil, and turned on the timer function. At this point Chen Zhiqiang also walked in. She said to her husband seriously, 'Aqiang, let's make a pact from now on: at 10 p.m., phones must be turned off and we prepare for bed together; for the hour before bed, no electronic devices — we can chat or read.' Chen Zhiqiang had no objection, and instead came over and hugged her: 'I'll do whatever you say.'
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and pre-bedtime stretching
description: She began implementing the planned new habit. First, she did a simple wash-up and evening skincare routine, then unrolled the yoga mat and did a gentle pre-bedtime stretch for about 10 minutes. Each movement was slow and extended, and she felt the suppleness awakening in her body. This was completely different from before, when she used to lie in bed with her whole body tense.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and reflection
description: Before turning off the light, leaning against the bed, she wrote a memo on her phone visible only to herself: "I didn't make money today, but I gained the most precious things. I decided to delegate, booked a physical examination, and sold the coffee machine. The whole family is healthy—that's really good." Then she made the sign of the cross, offered a brief prayer of gratitude for the safety of her family and shop, and felt a long-lost peace and serenity.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reading before bed and getting ready for sleep
description: Picked up Allergies and Diet from the bedside and flipped through a few pages to learn how to adjust the family's dietary structure. By this time, her phone had already been placed in the living room to charge, as agreed. The city noise outside the window gradually faded, leaving only the delicate lavender fragrance from the aroma diffuser.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Just as it turned ten, Chen Zhiqiang said proactively, "Yajing, let's sleep." Song Yajing responded, put the book on the bedside table, and turned off the lamp. The room fell silent at once, leaving only the faint hum of the aromatherapy diffuser and their calm breathing. She closed her eyes; every planned change had taken a solid first step today. With anticipation for tomorrow, she quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom in Song Yajing's home, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: In the early morning, Song Yajing woke up to the sound of her alarm clock and felt her strength had recovered a lot. She weighed herself as usual and was reassured to see the number steady at 49.4 kg. After washing up, she deliberately applied a thin layer of scar cream to the scabbed area on her forehead. When she walked into the dining room, her mother Lin Xiuying had already cooked white porridge and fried sunny-side-up eggs. Yajing gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her braid her hair, and the family of five sat around the table enjoying a simple, warm breakfast.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking my daughter to school and a special moment of reassurance
description: Yajing held her daughter Xuanxuan's hand and walked six minutes to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After watching her bounce into the school, she turned and left. She walked five minutes to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park, found a quiet bench, turned off work notifications on her phone, put on earphones to play a soothing piano piece, and rested with her eyes closed for a full fifteen minutes, enjoying a peaceful moment that belonged to her alone. Feeling the morning breeze and sunshine, she was especially calm inside.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commuted to the shop and prepared for opening.
description: After the peaceful moment ended, Yajing set off with energy. She walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Line 1 for two stops, got off at Zhongshan Park Station, and walked another 8 minutes to the small shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She opened the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioner and lights, and while no customers had arrived yet, quickly wiped the display racks and the cash register counter to prepare for business.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Clean up the coffee corner and transfer the coffee machine to a regular customer
description: After staff member Xiaomei arrived at the shop, Yajing and she cleaned up the former coffee corner together, organizing and packing the espresso machine, coffee grinder, mini fridge, cups, and other items. Vivian, a regular customer, arrived as promised. Yajing handed her the packed espresso machine and smiled goodbye. Vivian promptly paid the remaining transfer fee of 2,400 yuan in full, and they agreed to share new coffee beans in the future. After the handover, the two used a wet cloth to thoroughly clean the vacated corner.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went out to purchase decoration materials for the store.
description: After seeing Vivian off, Yajing and Xiaomei locked the store door and went out shopping together. They walked to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and picked out two simple white metal grid display racks and several rattan storage baskets. Then they dropped by the nearby “Little Days” home goods store, chose a large clear vase and a few linen-colored cushions, and pictured a warm layout for the community sharing area. The two stores came to 420 yuan in total, within budget.
location: Gongyuan South Road Stationery Store and nearby home goods store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and a brief rest at the shop
description: It was past 12 when she returned to the store. Xiaomei went to the street corner and bought steamed dumplings and mixed noodles from Shaxian Snacks. Yajing made two cups of hot tea with the store's water dispenser. The two sat in the newly cleared coffee corner area, eating lunch and chatting about the afternoon work arrangements. After the meal, Yajing leaned back in the rest chair and closed her eyes for a 20-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Deep cleaning of the shop and community management
description: In the afternoon, when there were few customers, Yajing began carrying out the deep-cleaning plan. She brought in a stepladder, removed the pre-filter of the air purifier attached to the store's air conditioner, carefully rinsed it in the washroom with a soft brush and clean water, dried it, and reinstalled it. Then she dusted the floral display racks. Afterwards, she sat back at the counter, logged into the store's WeChat group, sent an afternoon tea greeting, and announced that the community sharing area would soon open. Several regular customers immediately responded with anticipation.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Replenish allergy medication, return home, and complete household cleaning and medicine cabinet organization.
description: Yajing left the shop half an hour early, walked to the community pharmacy on Zhenhai Road, bought loratadine tablets and saline nasal spray, and asked the pharmacist for advice on nasal care during the spring season when plane tree catkins are flying. Then she took the bus one stop home. After arriving home, she went into the bedroom, removed the primary filter from the air purifier, rinsed it with a shower head on the balcony, and hung it out to dry. Then she opened the family medicine cabinet, put away the newly bought allergy medicine, checked the expiry dates of the regularly used medicines, threw away the expired ones, and organized the cabinet neatly.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District: Zhenhai Road community pharmacy, and home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community at 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District.

name: Parent-child time, picking up daughter and helping prepare dinner
description: After organizing the medicine cabinet, Yajing met her mother at the community entrance. Her mother had picked Xuanxuan up from kindergarten. Yajing played with Xuanxuan on the slide at the community playground for 20 minutes, then they went home together to wash their hands. Her mother had already prepared several home-style dishes. At 18:40 in the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, carrying a piping-hot takeaway of satay noodles, and the rich aroma immediately filled the house.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and successful self-control around food
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Facing the satay noodles, Yajing took the initiative to scoop only half a small bowl, picked a few pieces of lean meat and pork liver, then filled a bowl with garlic lettuce and stir-fried broccoli. She chewed slowly and savored the rich flavor but strictly controlled the total amount. After the meal, she weighed herself without being prompted. Seeing the number unchanged, she felt full of the sense of control and achievement from "I can control what I eat."
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening family time and playing with daughter
description: After dinner, her husband A Qiang cleared the table, and Yajing played an animal card game with Xuanxuan on the living room floor mat. The room was filled with her daughter's giggles. Around 9 p.m., Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, read a picture book about a little rabbit, and coaxed her into a peaceful sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, taking medication, and self-relaxation
description: After putting her daughter to bed, Yajing returned to the master bedroom, poured a glass of warm water, and took her daily anti-allergy medicine. She took a hot shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, and did a 10-minute pre-bedtime stretch on the floor mat, focusing on relaxing her neck, shoulders, and spine. Then she added water to the aromatherapy diffuser and dropped in lavender essential oil, letting a faint fragrance fill the bedroom. Lying in bed, she wrote down in her phone memo a small thing that made her feel good: "I deliberately ate only half a small bowl of shacha noodles and kept myself from overeating. I'm great."
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime reading and reflection before going to sleep.
description: In the soothing dim light and fragrance of the aroma diffuser, Yajing did not fall asleep right away. Instead, she picked up "Allergies and Diet" from the bedside and quietly read it for 15 minutes. At 22:40, she put down the book, dimmed all the lights, reviewed this fulfilling and peaceful day, said to herself, "Song Yajing, you did very well," and then fell asleep peacefully with anticipation for the new day.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm, weighed 49.6 kg, and recorded it in her memo. After washing up, she applied scar cream to the small scar on her left cheek, took an anti-allergy tablet, and rinsed her nasal passages with saline spray. She then woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into little pigtails. The mother and daughter had breakfast together. Song Yajing drank warm multigrain porridge with a fried egg, while her daughter had milk and cereal. As they ate, she encouraged her daughter to behave well at kindergarten, and her daughter said coquettishly that she wanted egg tarts after school.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked her daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing held Xiao Lexuan's hand and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter excitedly shared the little flowers she had drawn yesterday. After watching her daughter wave goodbye to the teacher and walk in at the kindergarten gate, Song Yajing turned and left with peace of mind.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning solitude, shopping, and walking to the shop
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing sat quietly alone on a bench in Jiaxingyuan Park for about 10 minutes, clearing her mind and feeling the morning breeze. Then she walked into a stationery store on Park South Road and picked out several white label cards with vine patterns. She then walked to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road, passing by 85°C on the way but not stopping.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning store work and rest
description: After arriving at the shop, Song Yajing and Xiaomei quickly swept the floor, wiped down the shelves, and took out rattan storage baskets and cushions to prepare for the renovation. The two worked together to assemble the white iron display racks along the wall, and arranged a comfortable rest corner with the rattan baskets and cushions. Then they moved away the clutter by the window, placed two glass vases at staggered heights, and filled them with lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves, completing the small floral display stand. Next came the detailed decorations: they tied the label cards bought in the morning onto the flower stand with twine, writing words like "Today's Mood" and "Outfit Inspiration." After finishing, Song Yajing took photos, sent them to the customer group, and left a message: "A new little corner of the shop, looking forward to meeting you and talking about fashion and life together," which received many likes. At noon, the two went to a nearby place to order Longjiang braised pork trotter rice to go, and returned to the new sharing corner to eat and chat. During this time, Song Yajing called the community traditional Chinese medicine clinic to book a 14:30 shoulder and neck physiotherapy session, and sent a WeChat message to bank client manager Lin Xiaofeng to confirm the afternoon meeting. After the meal, she rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes on the cushion in the sharing corner. When she woke, she replied to a customer's inquiry about the new dress, and shared a photo of the sharing corner on Moments with the caption: "Today's little happiness is a gentle corner handcrafted by me."
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk to the traditional Chinese medicine clinic.
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing changed into comfortable flat shoes, set out from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, walked west along Zhongshan Road through Siming South Road, and after about 25 minutes on foot, reached the Zhenhai Road Community Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic at No. 303 Siming South Road at 14:00.
location: Zhenhai Road Community Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, 303 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shoulder and neck physiotherapy and health consultation
description: At the traditional Chinese medicine clinic, Song Yajing received about 40 minutes of deep shoulder and neck massage and acupressure from the booked therapist, which effectively relieved the discomfort from long periods of standing and looking down. After the treatment, she learned three stretching exercises that are convenient to do anytime in the store, and recorded the key points in detail in the memo app on her phone and shot demonstration videos. Then she asked the on-duty TCM practitioner to take her pulse and measure her blood pressure. The practitioner said her qi and blood were still a bit weak but her overall recovery was good, and advised her to keep a regular routine. Song Yajing wrote the doctor's instructions in her memo and made an appointment for the next prescription.
location: Zhenhai Road Community Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, 303 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take a taxi to the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China in Qianpu
description: After coming out of the traditional Chinese medicine clinic, Song Yajing hailed a taxi by the roadside and headed to the Qianpu branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China on Lianqian East Road, Siming District. The ride took about 20 minutes and the fare was about 18 yuan.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Consulting about health insurance
description: After arriving at the bank, Song Yajing met with the account manager Lin Xiaofeng and frankly told her about the time she had fainted from overwork. She then asked in detail about critical illness insurance and supplemental hospitalization medical insurance suitable for self-employed individuals. Manager Lin recommended two products based on her situation and printed out detailed materials. The two agreed to finalize the specific insurance plan after the physical examination report came out in early May.
location: ICBC branch at Qianpu, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchased ingredients and took the bus back to the shop
description: After the consultation, Song Yajing walked to the Qianpu North District farmers’ market across the street. She picked out 500 grams of pork ribs, a sweet corn, and a bunch of iron-stick yams, spending about 45 yuan. She then checked today's online orders, packed two pieces of clothing that needed to be shipped, and told Xiaomei to arrange the courier pickup. After finishing the work, she packed her personal belongings and closed the store at 18:00, ready to pick up her daughter.

After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing brewed tea and chatted with her husband in the living room, sharing the progress she had made that day on arranging the community space, her physiotherapy experience, and her insurance consultation. Her husband expressed support and joked that she was the family's guardian of health. Then Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, practiced the three stretching moves she had learned at the Chinese medicine clinic twice, and after showering carefully applied scar cream to the scar on her face. She leaned against the headboard and read the chapter on spring wellness in Allergies and Diet for more than ten minutes, then turned on the aromatherapy diffuser, added lavender essential oil, closed her eyes for a short bedtime prayer, and recorded the day's "small blessings" in her phone memo: "The community space has taken shape, my neck and shoulders have been well taken care of, and insurance now has a clear direction." Finally, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, exchanged goodnights with her husband, and fell asleep feeling grounded and content.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning routine and breakfast

Because of spring allergies, she took loratadine tablets and used a saline nasal spray to rinse her nasal passages. When she came to the living room, her mother Lin Xiuying had already taken care of taking her daughter Xuanxuan to school. Yajing leisurely enjoyed a bowl of milk and cereal for breakfast and chatted with her mother for a bit. Then, she took out the small ceramic incense burner and sandalwood coil incense she had previously bought from the storage cabinet, put them into a cloth bag, and prepared to bring them to the store.

During the 25 minutes of baking, she cleaned the kitchen counter. When the cake came out of the oven, although it was slightly darker in color, it smelled delicious. location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bedtime tidying and going to sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, Song Yajing wrote in her sleep log: Fell asleep at 22:30 for 11 consecutive days. My mind was clear while settling the accounts this afternoon, and this routine is officially confirmed as a lifelong habit. Then she sorted and filed the remaining anti-allergy medication. Before bed, she and her husband softly discussed the store arrangements for tomorrow during the May Day holiday. She felt an unprecedented sense of steadiness and calm. Around 22:25, they said goodnight and turned off the lights.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning refreshment and family finances

After finishing, she recorded the transaction in the ledger on the nightstand. At that moment, her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought her a cup of warm honey water and softly told her breakfast was ready.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

While eating, Song Yajing praised her husband and wiped the rice grains from the corner of her half-awake daughter's mouth. She gently explained that today was Labor Day, and Mom needed to go to the shop for a while, would be back at noon, and could rest at home in the afternoon, so Xuanxuan should behave and play with Dad. Xuanxuan obediently nodded. In her heart, Song Yajing planned to test her husband's ability to take care of the child independently in the afternoon.

name: Commuting to the store

A gentle breeze brushed her face along the way, and there were already many tourists who had set out early for the holiday.
location: Along the route from No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Morning store promotion check and on-site guidance
description: Song Yajing arrived at Yajing Lifestyle Store at 08:35. The shop assistant Xiaomei had already finished opening and cleaning. She checked the May Day promotion display and found that the discount sign reading 'Hard Work Pays Off — Gift with Purchase Over a Certain Amount' on the flower cart by the door had been blown askew by the wind. She immediately used transparent tape to fix it back together with Xiaomei. Then she picked up the inventory management tablet on the cashier counter and gave on-site training on styling tips for the featured French floral dress and apricot knit cardigan, explaining the sales script from fabric and cut to wearing occasions. She also reminded Xiaomei to call her immediately in three situations: customers haggling too hard, not finding stock for a certain sun-protection shirt, or the cash register system freezing. Near 11:00, customer traffic grew, and Xiaomei was already able to greet customers calmly on her own. After confirming everything was fine, Song Yajing prepared to leave at 11:00.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute back home
description: Song Yajing walked out of the store and, along the way on Zhongshan Road, bought two freshly baked Huang Zehe peanut cakes, planning to bring them home as an afternoon treat for Xuanxuan and Aqiang. She walked home along the same route she had come, and the morning's busy work came to an end for now.
location: Along the way from No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to No. 128, Hubin South Road

name: Lunch at home and midday rest.
description: When Song Yajing got home, her husband and daughter were playing with LEGO in the living room. She told her husband she was going to have a simple noodle meal and that they should handle their own lunch. She took tomatoes and eggs from the fridge and cooked herself a bowl of tomato and egg noodles. After finishing lunch at 12:00, she turned her ringtone to max volume and placed the phone on the bedside table, drew the curtains, changed into pajamas, and lay down for a nap. Before closing her eyes, she silently cheered herself on: the most important task for the afternoon was to trust Xiaomei.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Remote support from home in the afternoon
description: The afternoon nap was interrupted at 14:10 by Xiao Mei's first phone call. She anxiously reported that a customer wanted to buy the apricot wide-leg pants at half price. Song Yajing steadied her tone and instructed Xiao Mei to tell the customer that buying two items would include a delicate velvet hair tie as a gift, and to insist on a maximum of 10% off, finally closing the first difficult deal. At 15:25, the second call came: Xiao Mei said she couldn't find the remaining stock of a certain sun-protective shirt in the backend. Song Yajing guided her to use the item number filter on the inventory management page and use a screenshot to find the exact location in the warehouse. At 16:00, the third call: the cash register system briefly froze, and she guided Xiao Mei to quit and restart the program. Every time she was nervous inside but her tone remained calm. Half-reclined on the living room sofa with an art album in her hands, her emotions were pulled by the calls, feeling the anxiety and anticipation of letting go.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter from school and shopping.

At 17:00 the school gate opened, and she saw Xuanxuan, carrying a small schoolbag on her back, run over happily and say that she had drawn a bird. Holding her daughter's hand, she listened to Xuanxuan talk about fun things at kindergarten and the new works from art class along the way. Passing a stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Xuanxuan took a liking to a sheet of Peppa Pig stickers, and Song Yajing bought them with small change as a reward.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the stationery store at Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road

The three of them worked together, and Xuanxuan set the table with bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was braised pork ribs, stir-fried greens, and clam and tofu soup. During the meal, Song Yajing received a draft of today's sales report from Xiaomei. She quickly glanced at it and saw the numbers were good, so she felt relieved. After dinner, she cleared the dishes into the dishwasher, and Aqiang took Xuanxuan to the living room to watch cartoons.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Xiao Mei was organizing receipts. She took the transaction slips, cash register records, and cash, carefully checking each one against the promotional discounts, actual amounts received, and member points, and reviewed a few large purchases with Xiao Mei. The calculations showed that today's turnover reached 80 percent of a normal day's level, and the loss rate of gifts was kept within the ideal range. She looked up and sincerely said to Xiao Mei, "You did better than I expected," and internally confirmed that delegating authority was feasible. Then she quickly handed over, and settled Xiao Mei's wages and holiday red envelope for the day in person.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

After settling their daughter down, Aqiang went to the study to attend to his own matters. Song Yajing went to the bedroom wardrobe, dragged out a dusty canvas bag from the top storage compartment—inside were a cross-stitch kit, embroidery floss, and a 'Peace and Joy' pattern with only a few stitches that she had bought when pregnant. She gently dusted it off. Then she went to the living room bookshelf, pulled out the Bible that had been left untouched for a long time, and neatly placed these two items on the bedside table in the bedroom, as if seeing a serene picture of time alone in the future.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal skincare and scripture reading preparation
description: Song Yajing went into the bathroom to thoroughly remove her makeup, cleanse her face, pat on essence water, and apply a hydrating sheet mask. Lying back on the bedroom bed, she picked up the Bible, turned to Chapter 5 of the Gospel of Matthew, the Eight Beatitudes, and read quietly to herself. When she read, "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God," she felt her heart cleansed, and then recorded her reflection in the Daily Bible Reading Reflection on her phone. Ten minutes later, she took off the mask, washed her face, applied night cream, and everything returned to calm.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

She wrote, "May 1, going to bed at 22:30, the 11th consecutive day," then reviewed the day: finished financial planning in the early morning, successfully directed store operations remotely in the morning, withstood the test of three phone calls from Xiaomei asking for help in the afternoon, and was satisfied with the account reconciliation results in the evening. She felt this was a good start to the practice of delegating authority, and drew a simple smiley face at the bottom of the log.
location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Quiet conversation with her husband, then lights out and sleep
description: Aqiang came in from the study, saw Song Yajing writing, and softly asked how she felt today. Song Yajing closed her notebook, turned sideways toward him, and answered with a smile in her eyes that her heart had been in her throat during the afternoon phone call, but the result was good, and Xiaomei was more reliable than expected. Aqiang gave her a hug and comforted her, saying that taking it slow could also make things easier. The two chatted briefly about plans for where to take their parents for Mother’s Day next Sunday. At 22:25, they put down their phones, adjusted their pillows, and said good night. At 22:30, they turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
