name: Woke up in the early morning.
description: The alarm went off right at 7:15. Song Yajing got up quietly so as not to wake her family, who were still sound asleep. She opened the window and felt the cool morning breeze. It was overcast today, but she was in a good mood. She went to the kitchen, poured herself a glass of warm water, and quietly enjoyed this time that was completely her own.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Making breakfast and helping her daughter get up
description: After washing up briefly, Song Yajing began preparing breakfast, taking sliced bread, eggs, and milk out of the fridge. At 7:40, she woke her daughter Xuanxuan, kissed her forehead, and coaxed her out of bed with honey toast. After helping Xuanxuan get dressed and tying her little braids, the two went downstairs together to eat breakfast.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and buy stationery on the way.
description: At 8:15, Song Yajing left the house holding Xuanxuan's hand, walking a little slower than usual. She first took her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and watched Xuanxuan greet the teacher. On the way back, she stopped by the stationery store on Park South Road and bought Xuanxuan a pack of animal stickers she liked, planning to reward her with them tomorrow morning.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Stationery store, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yubin City Phase 2).

name: Video call with her mother in Quanzhou
description: After returning home, Song Yajing sat on the sofa and called her mother via WeChat video. On the screen, her mother was sitting in the yard picking vegetables. She excitedly shared the good news that Xiaomei had run the shop independently yesterday. Her mother smiled and reminded her not to get too tired during the holiday and to learn to let go. They chatted for more than twenty minutes, and she felt warm inside.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video wrap-up meeting with new employee Xiaomei
description: After hanging up with her mother, Song Yajing immediately contacted Xiaomei via WeChat video. She first praised Xiaomei's ability to think on her feet yesterday, then gently pointed out that the promotional display this morning was a bit slow and that the cash float count during the handover was not careful enough. The two agreed to simulate the cashier process before major events in the future. The meeting was short and efficient.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Quietly reading scriptures
description: After hanging up the video call, Song Yajing walked into the bedroom holding the Bible and a glass of honey water. She turned to Romans, Chapter 5, and read it aloud word by word, feeling the power of the words. Then she wrote in her phone memo: Learn to rest first, then you'll have the strength to continue.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize cross-stitch and draw pattern drafts
description: After reading the Bible, Song Yajing took out her cross-stitch kit from the canvas bag and spread the embroidery cloth and colored threads on the living room coffee table. She felt the original flower sketch was too simple, so she picked up a pencil to revise it, deciding to add an olive branch and embroider the three small characters 'faith, hope, love' below. She drew slowly and carefully, enjoying the unhurried feeling.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch preparation and dining
description: Feeling hungry, Song Yajing went into the kitchen and cooked noodles in the leftover pork rib soup from last night, adding lettuce and a poached egg. She sat alone at the dining table and quietly finished the meal, her stomach warm and comfortable.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: After lunch, feeling a little drowsy, Song Yajing set an alarm for 1:15 p.m., drew the bedroom curtains, and lay down on the bed. From time to time, birdsong came from outside the window, and she soon fell into a light sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cross-stitch craft time.
description: After the alarm went off, Song Yajing felt much more refreshed. She connected the Bluetooth speaker to play soothing instrumental music, then sat on the sofa and, following the revised draft, stitched the outline of an olive branch stitch by stitch. As the needle and thread moved, time seemed to slow down; she was completely immersed in this peaceful moment of handicraft.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go out for a walk and buy groceries at the market
description: After doing crafts for nearly three hours, Song Yajing stood up to stretch. Seeing that the sky outside had cleared up, she changed into flat shoes, grabbed her reusable shopping bag, and walked about ten minutes to the Lake View Comprehensive Market near Shanggu Street. She bought live shrimp that her husband loved, fresh broccoli, tomatoes, and spring onions, planning to make stir-fried broccoli and tomato egg drop soup for dinner.
location: Hujing Comprehensive Market, No. 101--A17, Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Return home and prepare dinner ingredients.
description: After coming back from buying groceries, Song Yajing kept the shrimp in water, washed and drained the vegetables, then tidied up the room, sprayed air freshener, and put away the cross-stitch on the living room coffee table, preparing to welcome her husband home from work.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband comes home from work and reunites with family.
description: Just after 5:30, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home early from work and brought Song Yajing a bouquet of pale pink carnations. Song Yajing was so moved that she gave him a big hug. Their daughter Xuanxuan also ran out to show off today's painting. The family went into the kitchen: Aqiang tied on an apron to stir-fry, Yajing helped as his assistant, and Xuanxuan happily helped on the side.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cozy dinner
description: An hour later, the table was set with boiled shrimp, stir-fried broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three sat together for dinner. Song Yajing picked shrimp for her husband, and Xuanxuan excitedly talked about funny things at kindergarten. The dinner table was filled with laughter and joy, and the stress of work melted away.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stayed with my daughter and told her stories to help her fall asleep.
description: After dinner, her husband proactively washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen, while Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to bathe and wash off all the sweat. After the bath, she read two of Xuanxuan's favorite picture books in her daughter's room. Gradually, Xuanxuan's eyelids began to droop. Song Yajing gently tucked her in, kissed her forehead, and did not leave the room until she was sound asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's late-night talk and relaxation time
description: After coming out of her daughter's room, Song Yajing sat down next to her husband on the sofa and rested her head on his shoulder. The two chatted about his company's recent projects and her own plans for the store's future, enjoying a rare moment of quiet. Then she finished washing up, changed into pajamas, and lay down on the bed.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: At 9:15, Song Yajing turned off the bedside lamp in the bedroom. In the darkness, she reflected on the day. Although nothing major happened, the calm and companionship made her feel grounded and content. She soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, tidying up, and breakfast
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, felt a little reassured after weighing 49.8 kg, washed up and applied skincare, changed into loungewear and tidied the bedroom. Husband Chen Zhiqiang was in the kitchen preparing fried eggs and toast, while I warmed milk for our daughter. The family of three sat together for breakfast, discussed making pork rib noodles for lunch, and our daughter excitedly shared her dream about a flying puppy. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Doing housework and interacting with daughter.
description: After breakfast, she tidied up the living room, putting scattered picture books, building blocks, and dolls into storage bins. Her daughter helped like a little shadow, and the two played a game of "who will find the teddy bear first." The living room filled with her daughter's laughter as they enjoyed a relaxed mother-child time.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tried to read.
description: I picked up a Yi Shu novel from the bookshelf and curled up on the sofa to read it, but after three or four pages my mind drifted away, with thoughts of the promotion details and new-order items flashing through my head. I didn't force myself; I gently closed the book and put it back, deciding to focus on restoring my mood first.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online life planning and health checkup appointment.
description: Sitting by the coffee table, she browsed her saved light-meal restaurants on her phone and planned to switch up her lunch menu the following week. Then she called the Health Examination Center of Zhongshan Hospital Affiliated with Xiamen University and successfully booked a comprehensive physical exam for 9:00 a.m. on May 12, taking a big worry off her mind.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing lunch ingredients
description: She put on an apron and went into the kitchen, took out the prepared pork rib soup base from the fridge to thaw, washed and cut winter melon, carrots, and scallion sections, softly hummed the nursery rhymes her daughter often sang, and enjoyed the peaceful time preparing food while the kitchen filled with the aroma of food.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family lunch
description: Her husband cooked noodles and poured pork rib soup over them. The family of three sat together enjoying a simple, satisfying lunch. She shared the good news of booking her physical exam, and her husband gently reminded her not to overwork herself. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter during the noon break
description: After the meal, her husband volunteered to wash the dishes. She took her daughter to the children's room for a nap, lay beside the small bed, and softly told a story about a little rabbit. Watching her daughter slowly fall asleep, she too drifted into a deep sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with her mother in Quanzhou
description: After waking from her nap, she felt better. She connected with her mother in Quanzhou via a WeChat video call. On the other end of the screen, her mother was watering jasmine on the balcony and asked with concern about her health and Xuanxuan. She briefly shared updates about the shop and her rest. Her mother said cheerfully, "Take it slow, health comes first." After about twenty minutes of the call, her anxiety faded and she felt at ease.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompany daughter in artistic creation.
description: After her daughter woke from her nap, she took her to wash her face, then spread out colored pencils and drawing paper on the living room floor mat. Her daughter excitedly drew a flying puppy and added colorful wings. She herself casually doodled a few small flowers. Her daughter laughingly asked why the flowers had no smiling faces, so she drew big smiles on the petals. The mother and daughter were immersed in the joy of creating.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community management and outfit content planning.
description: After accompanying her daughter in painting, she let her watch cartoons. Sitting on the sofa, she browsed the store customer group chat history on her phone. Seeing an old customer share travel photos, she conceived the next styling note theme "Vibrant Colors for the Spring-Summer Transition" and planned to recommend dresses suitable for outdoor trips, jotting the inspiration into her memo.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing afternoon tea and evening arrangements
description: She cut mango and Hami melon into bunny shapes and served them to her daughter, then discussed with her husband having him take their daughter downstairs to the community garden in the evening to burn off energy, while she wanted to quietly start her cross-stitch. Her husband readily agreed.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked family downstairs and started cross-stitching.
description: Her husband changed their daughter into her sneakers, took the water bottle and Frisbee, and they went downstairs together to the entrance of the building. After watching them walk toward the garden, he returned home. He took out the cross-stitch kit from the bedroom, sat on the sofa beside the floor lamp, studied the revised draft (the olive branch and the “Faith, Hope, and Love” pattern), and solemnly made the first stitch on the upper left of the embroidery fabric. After a few clumsy stitches, he gradually became absorbed and stitched continuously for about half an hour. After outlining a few leaves, a long-lost sense of peace rose in his heart.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Put down the cross-stitch and go into the kitchen. Using the leftover live shrimp and broccoli, I made stir-fried shrimp and garlic broccoli, served with rice. My husband and daughter came back sweating from playing, and the family washed their hands and sat down to dinner. My daughter excitedly shared about meeting a calico cat and a new friend in the garden. I listened while serving food, enjoying a peaceful moment.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied daughter for bathing and helped her fall asleep.
description: After dinner, she bathed her daughter, and the mother and daughter played a bubble fight. Then she changed her into clean pajamas, carried her to the small bed, and read "Guess How Much I Love You." Before the story was finished, her daughter had fallen asleep with steady breathing. She gently planted a goodnight kiss and turned off the night light.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night couple talk and fashion sharing
description: Coming out of her daughter's room, she found that her husband had already brewed two cups of flower tea. The two of them curled up on the living room sofa, browsing fashion news together, chatting about new ways to engage the store's online community, and she shared how it felt to start cross-stitching that day. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up, relaxing, and bedtime diary
description: After showering and changing into comfortable pajamas, she did 5 minutes of simple shoulder and neck stretches and 3 minutes of abdominal breathing on the yoga mat in the bedroom, feeling her body stretch and relax. Then she sat down at the small desk, took out her locked diary, and wrote down her feelings: 'Today I didn't force myself to read, but I felt very calm while embroidering. After video-chatting with my mom, I felt the thread of my emotions reconnected. Xuanxuan's smile is truly the energy that heals everything.' She also briefly planned ideas for tomorrow.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Read scripture before bed.
description: After writing, she picked up the Book of Romans from the nightstand, turned to the marked fifth chapter, and recited it softly. She silently noted a brief reflection in her heart. This was a habit she had developed recently, and it brought her inner peace.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: After exchanging goodnights with her husband, she turned off the bedside lamp. Feeling her daughter's even breathing beside her and her husband's familiar scent, she felt at peace. As drowsiness grew, she fell fast asleep, ending a fulfilling and peaceful Saturday.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and heading out after leaving a note
description: She woke up naturally in the early morning. First, she went to the living room and weighed herself: the scale showed 49.9 kg, the same as yesterday. Then she went back to the bedroom, changed into a light blue dress, and carefully styled her hair. In the kitchen, she quickly drank a glass of warm water and ate two slices of whole wheat bread. Then she left a note on the dining table for her husband and daughter: “Good morning, I’m off to church. Wish me a happy birthday! Love you.” Beside it, she drew a simple smiley face. After checking her canvas bag to confirm she had her phone, keys, and pocket Bible, she quietly changed shoes and slipped out.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to Siming Catholic Church
description: She walked west along Hubin South Road, crossed Hubin East Road, passed Hongxiang Building, then turned onto Siming North Road and headed south. The breeze brushed her face and the temperature was pleasant. Along the way she passed several shops that were not yet open and an elderly person out early walking a dog. When she passed a flower shop, she stopped to buy a small bunch of white lilies, planning to place them in front of the Virgin Mary statue in the church as an offering for her birthday today. After walking for about 81 minutes, she arrived at the Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road at 8:51.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend Sunday Mass and fellowship
description: After entering the church, she tiptoed to her usual seat and placed the white lilies she had brought into the vase in front of the statue of the Virgin Mary. During Mass, she prayed attentively for the challenges of running the store and her physical recovery over the past year, and also prayed for peace and wisdom in the new year of her life. After Mass ended, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, outside the door. Aunt Lin took her hand and said with a smile that she wished Yajing a happy birthday and that God would bless her with a smooth and successful new year. Yajing, moved, hugged Aunt Lin and briefly shared recent updates about the store and her family.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked home, passing by a stationery store.
description: From the church, she walked north along Lujiao Road and turned onto Gongyuan South Road. Sunlight filtered through the leaves of the plane trees onto the ground, and she took out her phone to photograph a roadside flower bed and a lazy cat. At about 10:58, she passed a stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road and remembered that her daughter Xuanxuan had said she wanted to buy new stickers last time. So she went in and picked out a small sheet of animal stickers as a little surprise for today. She continued walking and arrived home around 11:30.
location: Stationery store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Birthday surprise and lunch celebration.
description: When she pushed open the door, pink and silver balloons floating across the living room came into view, with a “Happy Birthday” ribbon hanging on the wall. Her husband Zhiqiang, daughter Xuanxuan, best friend Zhao Min, store clerk Xiaomei, and childhood friend Li Meiling all shouted in unison, “Happy birthday!” Xuanxuan rushed over first, holding up a handmade card with two little hand-in-hand figures drawn on it and the wobbly words “Happy birthday, Mom.” Yajing squatted down to hug Xuanxuan, and when she saw the words “You're not carrying this alone” written in black marker on the largest balloon, her tears immediately welled up. After everyone calmed down a bit, Zhiqiang took a tiramisu cake out of the fridge, lit the candles, and as the “Happy Birthday” song played, Yajing made a wish and blew out the candles. Then everyone moved to the dining table, where the takeout Zhiqiang had ordered in advance — sour cabbage fish, boiled beef, salt-and-pepper shrimp, and more — was already laid out. The five of them ate, chatted, and shared amusing stories, while Xuanxuan kept clinging to her mother, showing off the card.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: See off relatives and friends and tidy the living room.
description: After lunch, Zhao Min, Xiaomei, and Li Meiling said goodbye one after another. Yajing hugged them gratefully, thanking them for their help and company today. Then she and her husband Zhiqiang tidied up the living room, gathered the balloons into a corner, and cleaned the main area. Their daughter Xuanxuan was excitedly playing with her greeting cards and newly bought stickers on the carpet.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening gifts and family games
description: The three of them sat on the sofa and opened and looked at the other gifts. Zhiqiang gave her a portable massage gun. Besides a greeting card, Xuanxuan also gave her mother a "gem" candy she had treasured. Yajing held each gift in her hands and looked at it carefully, then gave her husband and daughter big hugs. Afterward, she suggested playing a game of "You Draw, I Guess". Xuanxuan happily took out the whiteboard markers, and the living room was filled with laughter.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to play in the community garden
description: Zhiqiang suggested Yajing go rest while he cleaned up. Yajing then took Xuanxuan downstairs to the nearby Jiaxing Garden Park. The sun was nice. She taught Xuanxuan the names of several flowers, and the two chased butterflies together. Yajing also used the stopwatch function on her watch to time Xuanxuan's running speed. This simple outdoor activity made her feel relaxed and happy.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Rest and help prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Yajing felt a little sleepy, so she leaned back on the sofa and took a half-hour nap. When she woke up, she found Zhiqiang already busy in the kitchen, preparing ingredients for dinner. She went into the kitchen and helped trim and wash the vegetables. The two chatted, and her husband told her to have a good video call with her parents in the evening and not worry about anything else. Xuanxuan was in the living room watching her favorite cartoon.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family enjoying a warm dinner together.
description: Zhiqiang cooked a few home-style dishes: her favorite steamed sea bass, garlic oysters, and a stir-fried seasonal vegetable. The family of three sat at the table in a warm atmosphere. At dinner, Xuanxuan again told the amusing story of today's 'hiding the balloon,' saying she hid in the small room and jumped out shouting as soon as Mom came back, making the whole family laugh.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening chores and preparations for the video call
description: After dinner, Zhiqiang washed the dishes while Yajing helped Xuanxuan organize her drawings and toys. During that time, she asked Zhiqiang to help adjust the phone holder, preparing for an upcoming video call. Xuanxuan helped put the cake box and the flower bouquet she had received today onto the coffee table as the video background.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
description: After the video call connected, on the other end were her parents and older sister in Quanzhou. Yajing turned the phone camera toward the balloons and bouquets in the living room and described today's surprise in detail. Her father Song Minghui grinned from ear to ear, while her mother Lin Xiuying's eyes turned slightly red. She exhorted her across the screen: 'Now that you're a year older, take care of your health, eat well, and don't push yourself so hard anymore.' Xuanxuan shouted 'Grandpa and Grandma' in front of the camera and showed them her greeting card. It was a very warm scene.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opened her sister's gift and thanked her.
description: After the video call ended, Yajing took out an express package sent from Shenzhen. When she opened it, inside was an exquisite jewelry box containing a delicate silver chain with a small olive leaf pendant. She immediately put on the necklace, took a selfie in the mirror, sent it to her sister Song Yawen via WeChat, and attached a voice message: "Sis, I really like the necklace! The olive leaf meaning is wonderful. You take care of yourself too. Next time you come back, I'll treat you to dinner!"
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Put her daughter to sleep and organized mementos.
description: Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, helped her into pajamas, and picked up 'Guess How Much I Love You' to read to her. Xuanxuan was asleep halfway through the story. She gently left the room, returned to the master bedroom, and carefully put away Xuanxuan's hand-drawn greeting card, her sister's necklace box, and Zhiqiang's fascia gun. Then she sat on the edge of the bed and briefly noted down a few of the most moving moments of the day in her phone memo.
location: Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stretching and weight check before bed.
description: After changing into her pajamas, she did a few minutes of simple shoulder, neck, and leg stretches on the yoga mat to relieve the day's rushing and emotional moments. After stretching, she checked the number on the scale and felt relieved to confirm that there was not much change after eating cake and dinner today.
location: Master bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Before turning off the lights, Yajing said to her husband Zhiqiang, who was still working in the living room, “Thank you, honey.” After Zhiqiang returned to the bedroom, the two hugged each other and fell asleep. This special birthday came to an end filled with deep emotion and love.
location: Master bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Yajing was awakened by the alarm, with the warmth of yesterday's birthday still lingering in her mind. She walked into the living room and saw the greeting card drawn by her daughter Xuanxuan and the note left by her husband Aqiang, feeling warm inside. She went into the kitchen, brewed a cup of red date tea for herself, then heated milk for her daughter, fried two eggs with slightly crispy edges, and toasted whole wheat bread. While waiting for the bread to toast, she tidied up the balloon scraps left from last night. At 7:20, she went to wake Xuanxuan, helped comb her hair, and put on her kindergarten apron. The family of three sat around the dining table to enjoy breakfast. During casual conversation, Aqiang mentioned that he had an important weekly project meeting today and might be home late. Yajing shared the wonderful feelings from yesterday's birthday and the store news from Xiaomei, while Xuanxuan excitedly showed off her new drawing from yesterday.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: At 8:00 sharp, Yajing carried Xuanxuan's little backpack, held her hand, and walked out, heading from home to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the familiar road, the mother and daughter chatted about yesterday's birthday balloons and cake. Xuanxuan kept asking which of her paintings her mother liked best, and Yajing patiently answered every curious question. Xuanxuan laughed especially happily. About 10 minutes later, they reached the kindergarten gate, and Yajing watched her daughter enter the school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy coffee and return home
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing walked along the way to the 85°C bakery at Zhonghua City on Zhongshan Road and bought a hot latte and a mini tiramisu as an afternoon tea dessert. Then she slowly walked home along Zhongshan Road. The morning crowd was still light, and she enjoyed a moment of solitude. After arriving home, she changed into comfortable loungewear, placed the coffee on the table, and got ready to start the day's tasks.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organize the materials needed for the insurance application.
description: Yajing spread out her laptop and phone on the coffee table in the living room and began sorting out the insurance application materials. She took out her ID card, a copy of her business license, bank statements from the past six months, and income proof from the bedroom drawer, checked them one by one, and placed them in a transparent document folder. Then she pulled up screenshots of a few slightly abnormal indicators from her physical exam report at the end of April in her phone album. Next, she carefully compared the terms of several critical illness insurance products sent by Manager Lin Xiaofeng and noted the key differences in her notebook. Finally, she sent Manager Lin a WeChat message to confirm the meeting time at the ICBC branch in Qianpu at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video call with parents
description: After organizing the materials, Yajing made a video call to her mother Lin Xiuying, who was far away in Quanzhou. Seeing that her mother looked well, she shared the joy of yesterday's birthday, reassured her parents, and described in detail how she had organized her insurance materials and her health management plan for next week. Her father Song Minghui nodded frequently beside her, while her mother repeatedly reminded her to take in more nutrition. Xiaomei replied, 'Got it, don't worry, Sister Yajing.'
location: Balcony of Room 302, Building 7, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leisure handicrafts and physical relaxation
description: After taking care of the important matters, I felt especially relaxed. I brewed a cup of fruit tea, took out the cross-stitch (olive branch pattern) I had been working on for days, and sat on the balcony stitching while sipping tea. About half an hour later, I got up to stretch my neck and waist, loosening up my muscles. Outside the window, a light drizzle fell now and then, rustling the leaves.
location: Balcony of Room 302, Building 7, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Home organization and environment upkeep
description: She put on her cleaning apron, gathered up the odds and ends on the living room coffee table, and put away her daughter's scattered paintbrushes. She cleaned the floor with a vacuum cleaner, then mopped it with a flat mop. She tidied the bedroom bedding and opened the windows to air the room, leaving the whole space fresh and bright.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and market shopping
description: She took frozen pork ribs, sea bass, and crown daisy from the refrigerator, thawed the ribs and sea bass, and soaked the crown daisy in water. Noticing she lacked colorful side ingredients such as red bell peppers, she changed into a sun-protective jacket, picked up her reusable bag and phone, and walked 8 minutes to Lakeview Comprehensive Market, where she picked three bright red peppers, along with scallions, ginger, and garlic. Seeing that it was still early, she took two slow laps around the streets near the neighborhood as her light exercise for the day. On the way, she saw a newly opened sweet soup shop and planned to bring her daughter to try it next time. She then walked 5 minutes back home.
location: Hujing Comprehensive Market, No. 101--A17, Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Cooking a hearty dinner
description: She tied on an apron and got busy in the kitchen. After blanching the pork ribs, she caramelized sugar with rock sugar, added spices, and slowly simmered them into braised pork ribs. She cleaned the sea bass, rubbed it with salt and ginger slices, and steamed it in the steamer. She stir-fried a plate of garlic chrysanthemum greens over high heat. The kitchen filled with the enticing aroma of home cooking.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang picked up daughter Chen Lexuan from school and came home. As soon as he walked in, he exclaimed how good it smelled. You brought three dishes to the table and the family sat around it. While eating fish, Xuanxuan excitedly told a new nursery rhyme her kindergarten teacher had taught; Aqiang mentioned that the project was wrapping up smoothly. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child games and putting the child to sleep
description: After the meal, you cleared the dishes while your husband washed them. You played house and built blocks with Xuanxuan on the mat in the children's room, then read a picture book about sharing. Afterwards, you adjusted the water temperature and gave her a hot bath, changed her into pajamas, said bedtime prayers with her, and sang a lullaby. After she fell into a deep sleep, you gently turned off the light and closed the door.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Late-night couple conversation and discussion of plans
description: You sat on the living room sofa with your husband Chen Zhiqiang, showed him pictures of the floral dresses you bought today, and he praised your taste. You shared the fashion trends Susan mentioned and said you had mostly recovered and wanted to go to the store next week. After thinking it over, he said that once the physical exam report comes out on the 12th, if the doctor allows, he will take you to the store, but don't get too tired—if necessary, let Xiao Mei share more of the work. You felt cared for and understood.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal care and social time with close friends.
description: She washed up in the bathroom and applied a hydrating mask while showering. After lying down in bed, she opened the 'Sisters' bestie group and sent a message: 'Girls, how are we arranging this weekend? I'll be at the store next week—I'm finally coming out of seclusion!' The group responded enthusiastically, and her bestie Meiling suggested a get-together at the newly opened Japanese restaurant. She smiled and agreed.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime devotion and gratitude journal.
description: After relaxing, she leaned against the headboard to read and meditate on that day's passage from the Book of Romans. In her small diary, she wrote down three things to be grateful for: the procurement went smoothly and the core business was handled remotely; the family was healthy and safe, and dinner was pleasant; her husband's support was reassuring. Finally, she made the sign of the cross and prayed for a smooth day and the family's safety.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: She turned off the desk lamp, set the air conditioner to a comfortable temperature, and covered herself with a thin quilt. Reviewing her full and peaceful day, she felt content and grounded. She whispered to herself, "Song Yajing, you did well today," and drifted into a sound sleep amid the faint chirping of insects outside the window.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Community 82, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up routine and family breakfast
description: She woke up naturally before the alarm went off, her heart full of anticipation for today's Mother's Day event. After getting up, she got on the scale and weighed 49.7 kg. After washing up, she put on the new off-white floral dress and paired it with ballet flats, feeling fresh and gentle. Then she woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, who immediately became energetic at the mention of the Mother's Day event. She helped her change into her kindergarten uniform and tied her favorite little pigtails. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already warmed the milk and toasted the bread. The family of three sat around the table; Xuanxuan mysteriously said she had prepared a surprise, her eyes sparkling. The breakfast atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Husband takes daughter to school and she walks to the shop
description: It was about time. My husband Chen Zhiqiang changed his shoes and took Xuanxuan by the hand to walk her to school. I kissed Xuanxuan's cheek at the door and told her to be good, then watched them head to the elevator. After that, I picked up my parasol and small crossbody bag and left, walking from No. 128 Hubin South Road to the shop in Hongxiang Building at No. 258 Hubin South Road. The morning streets were quiet. I habitually observed what passersby were wearing, looking for fashion trends, and walked about 10 minutes.
location: Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (along the way from No. 128 to No. 258)

name: Arrive at the store to receive new summer stock
description: Pushing open the door of Yajing Lifestyle Store, the shop assistant Xiaomei was already cleaning. She told Xiaomei in person the details of the summer clothing purchased remotely yesterday: Susan's side had ordered 18 floral dresses and 12 sun-protection tops, to be shipped to the store before May 12. The style drawings had been sent to her phone, and the items should be arranged according to the display diagram upon arrival. She also told Xiaomei to manage the store independently on the weekend and to leave a WeChat message if anything was uncertain. Finally, she looked around the store, confirmed all materials for the weekend event were ready, and left with ease.
location: Yajing Life Gallery, 1st Floor, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walked to the kindergarten and attended the special Mother's Day event.
description: Leaving the store, I quickened my pace and walked along Hubin South Road toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Passing the community park, I saw elderly people doing morning exercise, and arrived at the kindergarten gate early. The activity started on time at 9 o'clock. The classroom was warmly decorated, with the walls covered in children's paintings. Xuanxuan took my hand and led me to sit in her little chair. During the beaded bracelet activity, she carefully threaded small beads into a red-pink bracelet; though it was crooked, the colors were bright. In the "Mom, I Want to Tell You" session, Xuanxuan stood up and said loudly: "My mom runs a beautiful clothing store, but she is most beautiful when she tells me stories." My eyes instantly turned red. I crouched down and hugged her tightly, let her help me put on the bracelet, carefully put the "holding hands card" she drew into my bag, and decided never to take off this bracelet.
location: Senior class classroom, Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home after the event, family time at noon
description: After the event ended, holding Xuanxuan’s little hand, I walked out of the kindergarten. The sunlight was just right, so I went to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park to sit for a while. The park was shaded by green trees; Xuanxuan chased butterflies while I sat on the bench turning the beads, feeling deeply moved. Then I walked home along Bailu Road. When I got home, the first thing I did was carefully place my daughter’s hand-holding card under the clear glass mat on the living room desk, then sat on the sofa quietly looking at the bracelet on my wrist, savoring every moment of the morning, feeling at peace. After my emotions settled, I went to the kitchen and cooked two bowls of light egg noodle soup with blanched greens, and ate with Xuanxuan while listening to her retell funny stories from kindergarten. After eating, I cleared the dishes, let Xuanxuan read picture books for a while, and leaned on the sofa with my eyes closed to rest for a bit.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanied daughter for her afternoon nap
description: I pulled the curtains closed and lay with Xuanxuan on the little bed in the children's room. She quickly fell asleep, her small body curled up in my arms. I wasn't sleepy, so I held her quietly, looking at her sleeping face and savoring every moment of the morning. The answer in my heart about life's priorities became clearer and clearer.
location: Child's room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
description: After waking up, Xuanxuan made a video call to Quanzhou on her phone. She eagerly pointed the camera at the bracelet on her wrist and told my mother, Lin Xiuying, that Xuanxuan had strung it herself. Xuanxuan leaned in and shouted greetings to her grandparents. My mother beamed from ear to ear, and my father, Song Minghui, said from the side that Xuanxuan had grown up. I relayed Xuanxuan's confession that the most beautiful moments are when I tell her stories, and the old couple on the screen felt deeply gratified.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Relaxing and tidying up at home
description: After hanging up the phone, I let Xuanxuan draw by herself. I went to the balcony to water the potted plants, then sat down in the rattan chair and took out the half-finished cross-stitch — the olive branch pattern. Stitch by stitch, with full concentration, I let this tranquility slowly settle the excitement from the morning.
location: Balcony at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to the park to play and bought groceries along the way.
description: In the afternoon, the sun was not so strong, so I took Xuanxuan to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park. She brought her little ball and bubble machine and ran excitedly after the bubbles on the lawn. I sat on a bench watching her, enjoying the pleasant breeze. After leaving the park, I turned to the nearby Lakeview Comprehensive Market to buy groceries. Familiar with the place, I picked a jin of good pork ribs, and bought fresh green peppers, carrots, and tomatoes. Xuanxuan helped carry a small tomato, like a competent little assistant.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Hujing Comprehensive Market at No. 101--A17 Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner, and share the touching moments.
description: When she got home, she put on an apron and started preparing dinner. First she blanched the ribs, cooked the rice, then chopped vegetables and made the sweet-and-sour sauce. Xuanxuan sat on a small stool at the kitchen door drawing the butterfly she had seen in the park, while the kitchen filled with the aroma of sweet-and-sour sauce. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang arrived home right on time from work, and seeing the table full of dishes and his daughter's excited face, he smiled knowingly. At the dinner table, while putting ribs on Xuanxuan's plate, she shared every detail of today's Mother's Day event with her husband: the clumsy cuteness of making bracelets, the childish confessions in the classroom, and tears of joy when receiving cards. Her husband listened intently, gently raised his drink, and wished the two beauties at home a happy Mother's Day.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bonding time
description: After dinner, my husband took the initiative to wash the dishes. I accompanied Xuanxuan in the living room to draw. She was drawing 'Our Home'. While watching her draw, I played house with her, pretending to be a customer who came to buy clothes. She also taught me the new nursery rhyme she learned at kindergarten today, and her childish voice echoed in the room.
location: Home living room and children's room at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Help daughter bathe and soothe her to sleep
description: It was getting late. I took Xuanxuan to the bathroom, filled the tub with bubbles, and she played happily. After her bath, she changed into pajamas, and I read her the picture book 'Guess How Much I Love You'. As she listened, her eyelids grew heavy. I softly hummed a lullaby until her breathing became steady and she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home bathroom and children's room at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Alone time with her husband.
description: After coming out of my daughter's room, my husband had already brewed two cups of tea. We leaned on the sofa and chatted softly. I showed him the bracelet on my wrist and once again mentioned our daughter's comment. He smiled and said he needed to work on improving his standing in their daughter's heart. We also talked about today's store handover and his physical exam next week. Leaning on each other, we enjoyed the quiet.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing in the close-friends group chat, and personal time.
description: Back in the bedroom, I picked up my phone and, in the besties' group chat, tagged Li Meiling, Wang Jia, and others, sharing photos from today's Mother's Day event and Xuanxuan's touching confession. The group instantly blew up; they all said they were moved to tears. Meiling marveled at Xuanxuan's high emotional intelligence. I replied with a smile, reminding everyone not to forget the weekend dinner plan.
location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening pre-sleep activities.
description: She put down her phone, took out her diary, and wrote a gratitude entry, thankful that her daughter's love had made her re-examine the value of life, and that this bracelet was the best gift. Then she opened the Book of Romans, read a chapter, and said a brief prayer. Afterward she got up to wash up and carefully did her basic skincare routine. She changed into pajamas and lay in bed; her husband had already fallen asleep. She turned on her side, pressed the bracelet to her chest, felt its warmth, and her heart was clear and peaceful. Finally, she turned off the bedside lamp and, filled with deep emotion and happiness, drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning chores and breakfast time.
description: Woke up naturally at 7:20 a.m., sunlight streaming through the gap in the curtains. After getting up, took a shower to wake up, washed up, applied skincare, put hair up in a simple bun, and changed into loungewear. Then prepared breakfast: fried egg toast and hot milk. Husband Chen Zhiqiang helped set the table, and daughter Chen Lexuan got up and happily said, "Mom is the best." The family had breakfast together; she reminded her daughter to behave at today's activity with dad. After the meal, helped her daughter pack her drawing backpack, checked her husband's car keys, and saw them off at the door. Then cleared the table, did the dishes, and put the throw pillows back on the living room sofa.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recovery period: organize cross-stitch and keep a spiritual journal.
description: Made a cup of rose tea and spread out the cross-stitch work from the past ten days on the living room coffee table. The olive branch pattern had begun to take shape, and the first character of the word 'Faith' next to it was also starting to form. From the phone notes app, I pulled up the scattered reflections from scripture reading, opened the cloth-covered diary, and wrote: 'Accepting your imperfect self takes more courage than pursuing perfection. Sometimes, slowing down is the way to see the road farther ahead.' During this time, I also repotted a newly bought succulent into a nice ceramic pot and added nutrient soil.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents
description: Guessing that her parents in Quanzhou were done with their busy time, she called her mother on video. On the screen, her mother was watering flowers on the balcony and her father was reading the newspaper beside her. She showed them the bracelet and card her daughter had given her last night, and her mother kept praising Xuanxuan for being thoughtful. She told them that today she planned to go out and pick summer clothes for them and her mother-in-law, and would mail them in the afternoon. Her mother reminded her to take care of her health. After chatting for more than twenty minutes, she felt warm inside.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to Zhonghua City for shopping and lunch
description: Changed into a light blue dress, put on a sun hat, and went out with a canvas bag. After a taxi ride of about 10 minutes, she arrived at Zhonghua City. She went straight to the third-floor women's fashion area and chose a light gray cotton-linen cardigan and dark wide-leg pants for her mother, and a delicate floral mulberry silk top with a matching narrow skirt for her mother-in-law. She asked the clerk to wrap them in gift boxes and handwrite greeting cards — 'Mom, Happy Mother's Day. May you be healthy and at ease' and 'Mother-in-law, thank you for all your support.' Then, on the fifth floor in the home furnishing section, she selected a simple cherry wood photo frame. After shopping, she ordered the signature braised pork zongzi and wonton soup at the first-floor '1980 Braised Pork Zongzi' restaurant, took them out, and quickly ate them in the rest area near the entrance. Then she walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 from Zhenhai Road Station to Wushipu Station, about 20 minutes. After getting out of the station, she walked five minutes to SM City Plaza.
location: Moved from Zhonghua City at No. 195 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to SM City Plaza at No. 468 Jiahe Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Besties' afternoon tea time.
description: Arrived early at Maan Coffee on the third floor of SM City Plaza Phase II, found a quiet window seat, and ordered a pot of fruit tea. Around 2:50 p.m., her best friend Li Meiling messaged saying she was almost there, and arrived exactly at 3:00, holding a pot of crystal-clear succulent plant. The two ordered tiramisu. Meiling shared funny stories about the kids in her class at the end of the semester, while Song Yajing confided her anxiety about delegating to Xiaomei and her nervousness about Monday's physical exam. Meiling listened carefully, then pushed the succulent over and said: “Put it in your office or at home. When you're tired, just look at it and you'll feel much better.” They also agreed to drive to the seaside on Island Ring Road one weekend next month to get some fresh air, and Song Yajing marked it on her phone calendar.
location: Maan Coffee, 3rd Floor, Phase II, SM City Plaza, No. 4688 Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return trip and home preparations
description: At the coffee shop entrance, she hugged Meiling goodbye. Carefully holding the succulent plant and carrying the clothes and photo frame she had bought for the elders, she booked a ride-hailing car on the roadside and went home. After arriving home, she changed into loungewear, unpacked the photo frame, found the beach family photo, put it in, and placed it in the center of the TV cabinet. She set the succulent next to the photo frame, creating a cozy corner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: Her husband and daughter would be home soon, so she took out the thawed pork ribs, prawns, and broccoli from the fridge and prepared to cook her daughter’s favorites: sweet-and-sour pork ribs, boiled prawns, garlic broccoli, and pork rib and radish soup. The kitchen was filled with the clatter of pots and pans and wafting steam. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan arrived home right on time. Xuanxuan excitedly showed off the painting she had made today of the family of three holding hands under a big tree. During dinner, the family chatted as they ate; Yajing shared about buying clothes for her paternal and maternal grandmothers and having afternoon tea with Auntie Meiling, and Zhiqiang told amusing stories from the painting activity.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Time with daughter and evening relaxation
description: After the meal, she played house with her daughter Xuanxuan on the living room floor mat. Xuanxuan built a 'castle' with blocks and said it was home. When they got tired of playing, they read two newly bought picture books together. Watching her daughter's focused little face, Yajing felt a quiet happiness.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal affairs and preparing for bed
description: After bathing and soothing our daughter to sleep, I returned to the desk in the living room and placed the ID card, social security card, and critical illness insurance signing form needed for Monday's physical exam into a document folder. Then I sent a message to the shop assistant Xiao Mei to confirm the store arrangements for Monday. Before bed, I washed up, applied a hydrating mask, and read the Bible quietly, praying for tomorrow's Mass and Monday's physical exam. Then I took out my diary and jotted down my feelings: “I feel supported because of friendship, and loved because of family.” I turned off the main light, leaving the bedside lamp on, and put the plain long dress and white little jacket for church tomorrow on a chair. I touched the bracelet my daughter had given me, said goodnight to my husband, and prepared to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yajing got up quietly so as not to wake her husband and daughter. After washing up, she changed into loungewear, looked at her daughter Xuanxuan's sleeping face, and gently kissed her forehead. At 7:10 she started preparing a hearty breakfast: she cooked sweet potato porridge, fried eggs and bacon, and heated up Xuanxuan's favorite soup dumplings. At 7:30 she woke the family. When Aqiang took the glass of warm water, he said, 'Honey, Happy Mother's Day.' The family of three sat together and enjoyed a cozy breakfast. After the meal, everyone washed up and changed clothes. Yajing put on a dark blue mulberry silk dress with cream-colored flats, put Xuanxuan's hair into pigtails and dressed her in a floral dress, and Aqiang changed into a casual polo shirt. Yajing checked her belongings and got ready to leave.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the church
description: The family of three set off from home and strolled along Hubin South Road toward Zhenhai Road, then turned onto Lujiao Road. The morning breeze was slightly cool. Xuanxuan held her father's hand and shared funny stories from kindergarten, while Yajing felt calm and grateful inside. They walked for about 45 minutes, passing through an old neighborhood full of everyday life.
location: Along the route from South Hubin Road to Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Church Mother's Day special Mass and parent-child activity
description: Arriving at Siming Catholic Church, the family attended a solemn Mother's Day Mass. In his sermon, Father Wang Mingde gave a special blessing to all mothers. Yajing bowed her head and prayed devoutly for her mother in faraway Quanzhou and her mother-in-law in Xiamen, and also gave thanks for her own role as a mother. Xuanxuan sat quietly beside her. After Mass, a parent-child activity was held in the parish courtyard. Xuanxuan drew a picture with crayons and gave it to her mother; on the picture was written crookedly, “My mom is the most beautiful even though she sometimes gets tired.” Yajing was moved to tears and hugged Xuanxuan tightly. Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, came to share her experience of caring for her ailing spouse, quoting, “Love is patient.” Yajing listened carefully and wrote it down in her notebook.
location: Siming Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch, Zhongshan Road stroll, and returning home
description: At noon, the family of three walked about 33 minutes from the church to the Xin Aqiang Ginger Duck and Aqiang Fried Crab Restaurant. Yajing ordered the signature ginger duck, oyster omelet, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and misua soup. During the meal, Aqiang carefully peeled shrimp and put them in her bowl, and Xuanxuan also learned to pick up duck meat for her mother with her children's chopsticks. After the meal, the family strolled along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to aid digestion. Aqiang took the initiative to buy a bouquet of pink-and-white carnations for Yajing, and Xuanxuan got a small serving of ice cream as a special treat. Then they continued walking home.
location: No. 78, Siming East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: Xin Aqiang Ginger Duck and Aqiang Fried Crab; and Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Midday rest and recording reflections
description: After returning home, Yajing changed into loungewear, while Aqiang played with building blocks with Xuanxuan. Yajing sat on the sofa, opened the memo on her phone, and neatly recorded the sentence "Love is patient" that Aunt Lin Xiuying had shared in the morning, along with her own reflections, planning to copy it into her Bible-reading notebook later. Then she took a 20-minute nap to regain her energy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went out to send a Mother's Day gift.
description: At 2:45 p.m., Yajing set out alone carrying two boxes of summer clothes prepared for her mother and mother-in-law, and walked about 15 minutes to the Yunda Express branch at Zhongshan Impression Hotel. She carefully placed blessing cards in each box, filled in the addresses of her parents' home in Quanzhou and her mother-in-law's home in Xiamen, paid, and then photographed the tracking numbers and sent them to "Family Group" and "Mother-in-law" on WeChat, adding, "Moms, happy holidays! The gifts are on the way!"
location: Yunda Express (Zhongshan Impression Hotel branch), near the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Dazhong Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Selecting a vase and arranging flowers at home
description: After mailing the package, Yajing turned into the "An & Design" boutique in the nearby alley and slowly picked out a simple frosted glass vase with smooth lines; the clerk wrapped it in old newspaper. After walking home, she washed her face, then took out the carnations Aqiang had just bought and the new vase, carefully trimmed the stems and leaves, filled it with water, and arranged the flowers. The pink-white carnations looked especially soft against the frosted glass. She placed the vase in the center of the dining table, gazed at it for a moment, and felt that the home had gained a warm and lively touch.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon tea and family time
description: Yajing cut up the mango, brewed a pot of Jin Jun Mei black tea, and invited Aqiang and Xuanxuan to share afternoon tea. Xuanxuan continued painting nearby, Aqiang flipped through phone news, and Yajing browsed a fashion magazine, feeling very relaxed and content. Afterwards, she went to the balcony to water the 'Grow Slowly' succulents that her best friend had given her.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Aqiang preparing dinner and family dinner.
description: At dinner time, Aqiang volunteered to cook. He put on an apron and stir-fried tomatoes with eggs and water spinach, and reheated the ginger duck packed from lunch. Watching his busy back in the kitchen, Yajing felt warm inside. The family of three sat around the dining table with carnations on it and had dinner together. Xuanxuan kept praising her father's cooking, and Aqiang smiled proudly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
description: After dinner, Yajing made a WeChat video call to her parents in Quanzhou. On the screen, her mother Lin Xiuying and father Song Minghui looked well, and Xuanxuan rushed to share with her grandmother the drawing she had made for her mother today. Yajing asked with concern about her mother's knees. When she learned that her mother did have a dull pain going up and down stairs, she frowned slightly, urged her mother to take the stairs less and use knee pads more, and said she would send some joint supplements back home. She then jotted down 'glucosamine chondroitin' in her phone memo.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Schedule a physical examination and inform her husband
description: After hanging up the video call, Yajing immediately called a comprehensive physical examination center in Xiamen and successfully booked a full-body checkup for 8:30 the next morning, including a routine blood test, abdominal ultrasound, and breast color Doppler ultrasound. Then she walked to the study and quietly told Aqiang, who was handling work emails, about the checkup arrangement the next day. Aqiang agreed without hesitation to take leave and accompany her, which finally put her mind at ease.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening parent-child time and bedtime preparation.
description: After Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, the two of them sat on the bed and read the picture book You Look Delicious. Xuanxuan listened carefully and asked questions now and then. Yajing answered softly and kissed the top of her daughter's head. When they finished, the mother and daughter prayed together devoutly: "Thank God for giving Mom such a wonderful Mother's Day. Please bless Grandma and Nana with good health." After praying, Yajing turned off the light, and once Xuanxuan was sound asleep, she quietly slipped out of the children's room.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal night prayer and reflection notes
description: After washing up and doing her skincare routine, Yajing sat at her desk, took out her Bible study notebook, and neatly copied the phrase "Love is patient" that Aunt Lin Xiuying had shared during the day, adding her own reflections. Then she turned off the light and lay down, falling asleep with a mix of nervousness and calm about the next day's health checkup.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: The sky was overcast and the temperature was comfortable. Song Yajing was woken by the alarm, quickly washed up, and went into the kitchen. Because the physical exam required fasting, she only boiled a plain egg for herself to eat after the exam, and prepared ham-and-egg sandwiches and hot milk for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. While her family was eating, she checked the exam bag again, confirmed that she had brought her ID card, medical insurance card, and last time's report, and deliberately put on the beaded bracelet her daughter had given her for Mother's Day the day before to boost her mood.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to school and went to the hospital for a physical examination
description: At exactly 7:00, she woke up Xuanxuan, who was still lying in bed, and helped her get dressed and wash up. At 7:15, the family of three left on time. Song Yajing drove, first taking her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, she reminded her to drink more water and watched her run into the classroom. Then she and her husband Chen Zhiqiang drove to the Physical Examination Center of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, which they had reserved in advance. On the way, her husband held her hand and comforted her, saying, "Don't be nervous, I'm here," which reassured her a lot.
location: First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Full-body checkup
description: After arriving at the hospital at 7:45, she went directly to the health check center front desk to register, and the examinations officially began at 8:00. Song Yajing completed in turn the blood draw (fasting), general examination, ultrasound (liver, gallbladder, spleen, pancreas; uterus and adnexa), breast ultrasound, internal medicine, general surgery, and electrocardiogram. Her husband waited in the waiting area the whole time. When she came out of the ultrasound room, he handed her warm water and a small piece of bread; during the blood draw, she instinctively held his hand. The whole process ended smoothly around 11:00.
location: Physical Examination Center, First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and conversation after the physical examination.
description: After the physical examination, Song Yajing and her husband walked to the 85°C near the hospital. She ordered the signature Sea Salt Green Milk Tea and a Caesar salad, while her husband ordered an Americano and a pork floss bun. As they ate, they talked about how the checkup felt, especially the bloating in her abdomen during the ultrasound, and agreed to go to the pharmacy to buy glucosamine chondroitin for her mother while waiting for the afternoon report.
location: 85°C (Xiamen Zhonghua City New Store), No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waiting for the physical examination report and handling matters.
description: After lunch, she returned to the rest area of the physical examination center to wait for some reports. While waiting, Song Yajing opened the store's WeChat group on her phone, checked the morning sales summary and customer fitting photos sent by employee Xiaomei, replied with styling suggestions, and reminded her to check the express deliveries arriving in the afternoon. Then she opened the "Huian Three Sisters" WeChat group, sharing her anxiety about waiting for the report. Wang Jia sent a voice message to comfort her. Finally, she called her elder sister Song Yawen, briefly explaining the examination status. Her voice was a little strained, and her sister urged her to tell her immediately once the results came out.
location: Rest area of the Physical Examination Center, the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Listen to the diagnosis results and medical advice
description: At 2 p.m., Song Yajing was called into the consultation room. Looking at the report, the doctor calmly told her that in addition to her known hypoglycemia, there was a new diagnosis of "mild breast hyperplasia," and clearly stated that this was highly related to long-term emotional suppression and excessive stress. He advised her to adjust her mood, reduce anxiety, avoid staying up late, and have a follow-up every six months. She pressed her lips together, her fingers rubbing the bracelet her daughter had given her, while her husband held her shoulder from the side.
location: Clinic room, Physical Examination Center, First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase sports equipment and get health consultation.
description: After her husband took a taxi back first because of a sudden work matter, Song Yajing was alone with the doctor's advice. She first stopped by the Anta Sports flagship store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, tried on three light gray lightweight sneakers, and chose the one that felt most comfortable on her feet. Then she walked to Xiagang Street Community Health Service Center, found her family doctor Wang Mingyuan, and handed him her physical examination report. Dr. Wang explained in plain language how breast hyperplasia is related to mood and diet, recommended that she stick to a low-sugar, high-protein, high-fiber diet and get more than 30 minutes of aerobic exercise every day, and also listed a red-yellow-green dietary checklist in the notes on her phone.
location: Anta Sports Flagship Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Xiagang Street Community Health Service Center, 12 Fengchaoshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Made a personal health plan and walked home.
description: After leaving the community health station, Song Yajing sat on a bench in the small park beside it and, following Dr. Wang's advice, carefully wrote out a health plan for the next month: walk at least 6,000 steps a day, change breakfast to multigrain porridge, ensure lunch includes green vegetables and high-quality protein, replace afternoon milk tea and desserts with black coffee or fruit, and go to bed before 11 p.m. Looking at the plan, she took a deep breath and felt she had regained control of her life. Then she walked about 15 minutes home, her pace much easier than usual.
location: Street park next to Xiagang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 12, Fengcaoshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase healthy ingredients and arrange for a neighbor to help.
description: After returning home, she changed into slippers and put her new sneakers in the entryway. With the shopping list in hand, she walked 14 minutes to the Xiashang Minxing Supermarket downstairs. She bought whole-wheat bread, quinoa, salmon, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, blueberries, sugar-free yogurt, and free-range eggs with precision, and also grabbed two bottles of glucosamine and chondroitin at checkout. After getting home, she sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator and stuck the health plan to it with a fridge magnet. Then she called her neighbor, Aunt Zhang, to ask if she could help pick up her daughter Xuanxuan the next day. Aunt Zhang readily agreed.
location: Xia Shang Minxing Supermarket (Wenping Store), 103-106, No. 40 Wenping Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Make a healthy dinner and have a heart-to-heart with her older sister
description: Putting on an apron, Song Yajing tried to make steamed salmon, garlic broccoli, and quinoa multigrain rice according to the health plan. When her husband brought their daughter home, the aroma of dinner was just in the air. During the meal, she announced the “Healthy Family Pact,” and her daughter, half understanding, praised how delicious the fish was. After dinner, her sister Song Yawen called, and she went to the balcony to answer. Her sister softly asked about the diagnosis results. When she said, “The doctor said I have been in a bad mood,” her sister paused and said gently, “Yajing, if you are tired, come back to Quanzhou and stay for a few days. I will pay.” Her nose tingled and tears welled up in her eyes. The two talked for a long time, and her sister also sent a compiled document of supplier resources.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and the couple discussing a rest and recovery plan
description: After hanging up the phone, Song Yajing adjusted her mood and returned to the living room to play with her daughter. She used the healthy ingredients she had just bought to teach her daughter about vegetables, and together they built a “Health Castle” with building blocks. Around 8 o'clock, while her husband was coaxing their daughter to brush her teeth and take a bath, she told him on the sofa about her sister's suggestion to go back to Quanzhou to recuperate. After thinking for a moment, her husband expressed full support, saying it was a great opportunity to relax and reconnect with family, and he offered to adjust his work schedule next week and take on more responsibility for picking up their daughter and doing housework. The two initially finalized the plan.
location: Living room and daughter's room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: At 8:30, Song Yajing told her daughter a bedtime story about a little rabbit building healthy habits. Her daughter listened with great interest and soon fell asleep in her arms. Looking at her daughter's sleeping face, she felt both tender and resolute inside.
location: Daughter's room, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Write the store operations SOP
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing went to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and began writing the outline for the "Daily Operations SOP." She started with "Display Standards," covering color-matching principles and the frequency of mannequin styling; then she moved on to "Reception Script," which included steps such as customers entering the store, trying on clothes, price quotes, and after-sales service; finally, she wrote "Cashier Procedures and Emergency Handling." She specifically recalled the mistake made on May 1 when her employee Xiaomei had a slip-up during independent operation because she was not familiar with the exchange and return process. Using a red pen, she made key notes in the "Emergency Handling" section and carefully filled three pages, preparing for the official delegation of duties.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community study room.

name: Review and relaxation before bed
