description: Before 11 o'clock, Song Yajing put down her pen, washed up, and changed into her pajamas. Then she sat on the edge of the bed and took out a brand-new notebook. On the first page, she wrote today's date and her reflections: "May 12, a turning point. From today on, I will put 'health' and 'family' first in all my priorities." She recorded her weight as 49.7 kg, turned to the diagnosis form, and took a photo with her phone as a reminder. Then she did five minutes of deep-breathing relaxation and felt her tense nerves finally unwind.
location: Master bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: The night was deep. Song Yajing turned off the light and lay down, listening to her husband's steady breathing. Her heart was calmer and more certain than at any time yesterday, and she slowly drifted into sleep.
location: Master bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning routine and low-sugar breakfast
description: Getting up in the early morning, she sat quietly in bed and thanked God for granting a new day. After washing up, she changed into a sports bra and a light blue linen-cotton dress, and recited the 'Joyful Mysteries' of the Rosary by the bedroom window, praying for strength and peace for today's 'letting go' and 'health'. Then she prepared a low-sugar breakfast in the dining room: boiled eggs and warm milk, and checked off 'Breakfast' in her food check-in memo. She called her daughter Xuanxuan to share small bread rolls and milk, quietly enjoying the breakfast time.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to school and commuted to the store.
description: Tied her daughter Xuanxuan's hair into a ponytail, held her hand, and walked about 15 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan excitedly shared the Dumbo she had drawn yesterday. At the kindergarten gate, they hugged goodbye and she watched her walk into the classroom. After leaving the kindergarten, she turned from Gucheng West Road onto Zhongshan Road and walked about 15 minutes to the shop, slowing down to enjoy the quiet of the morning street, passing a breakfast stall and smelling the aroma of steamed buns, cheering herself on.
location: From the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, then to the clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store work and delegation implementation
description: After arriving at the store, she completed opening preparations with Xiaomei: wiping the shelves, counting change, and watering the flowers. She gathered Xiaomei to explain the Daily Operations SOP, going through display standards, the seven-step reception script, and the cashier process page by page; she personally demonstrated how to fold knitwear, and had Xiaomei rehearse the entire checkout process, gently correcting her for skipping the "confirm member points" step, and made her repeat it three times. At 9 a.m., she solemnly handed the store's spare key to Xiaomei and announced that Xiaomei would be fully in charge of sales after 1 p.m. Xiaomei took the key and felt the trust and responsibility. Afterwards, they handled walk-in customers together, and focused on browsing the summer new arrivals catalog sent by Guangzhou supplier Susan, selected 5 styles to reorder, and confirmed prices and delivery times on WeChat.
location: Inside the clothing store at 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Low-sugar lunch
description: She took out the insulated lunch box she had brought from home, which had steamed fish, brown rice, and stir-fried broccoli in it, and invited Xiaomei to have lunch together. Xiaomei ordered satay noodles. While eating, they talked about customer feedback and training experiences. After finishing, she posted 'Lunch' on her diet check-in log.
location: Rest area of the clothing store at 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon handover and going home
description: After lunch, she stayed with Xiaomei through the last half hour of the shift, wrote the afternoon store matters in the handover notebook (such as regular customer Vivian coming to pick up her reserved dress), reminded Xiaomei, and then left on time. She walked 15 minutes home, changed into home clothes, set her phone to vibrate, lay on the bed with her eyes closed, silently repeated in her mind 'have to trust Xiaomei,' and drifted into light sleep.
location: From the clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Relaxing at home and remote confirmation
description: After waking from the lunch break, I played piano music, brewed a cup of rose tea, sat on the sofa reading Spiritual Bread for 20 minutes, and applied a hydrating mask to enjoy the peace. Later, Xiaomei sent a WeChat message saying Vivian had picked up the dress and everything went smoothly. My heart felt relieved; I replied with an emoji and reminded her to mind the air-conditioning temperature. I opened the memo on my phone to organize yesterday's café renovation inspiration and add new ideas.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy health supplements for mother
description: She changed into a Chanel-style jacket, brought a water bottle, and walked about 20 minutes to the Health 99 pharmacy chain on Lianqian West Road. In the health products section, she compared two brands of glucosamine and chondroitin products in terms of brand, ingredients, and price, chose a cost-effective well-known brand for her mother, and carefully asked the staff about how to take it.
location: Health 99 Pharmacy Chain (Yunting Store), Lianqian West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Café rest and capturing decoration inspiration
description: After about a 10-minute walk from the pharmacy, she arrived at Be Normal Cafe on Xiaxi Road. The warm lights, natural wood wall shelves, hanging small green plants, and beige curtains left a deep impression. She ordered a sugar-free latte, used her phone to take photos of the lighting and display details, and wrote in her memo: "Replace cool white lights with warm lights, add texture with wooden shelves, and enhance the atmosphere with plants in corners." She plans to use these ideas for the store's soft furnishing renovation.
location: Be Normal Cafe, No. 69 Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home and preparing before the walk
description: Walked home from the café along Xiaxi Road and Hubin South Road, sat for a while in the corner park, watching elderly people with children and young people walking dogs, and felt a long-missed sense of relaxation. After arriving home, she put away the health supplements and belongings, changed into the newly bought light gray sneakers, drank water, and imported the café photos and notes into her phone memo to prepare for the evening walk.
location: From Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to home at Community 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening walk by the lake
description: Walked about 10 minutes to the Yundang Lake trail, keeping a moderate pace and deliberately straightening the back while relaxing the shoulders and neck. The trail was tree-lined, the lake was calm, and a gentle breeze brushed the face. After about 30 minutes of walking, her forehead was slightly sweaty. She recorded on her phone: “Day 1 of walking, done! My shoulders and neck feel much looser, and I'm in a good mood.”
location: Walking trail around Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Prepare and cook a low-sugar dinner.
description: After the walk, she walked home, took a quick shower, took chicken breast, tomatoes, and lettuce out of the fridge, and made a tomato chicken breast salad with a little vinaigrette. She photographed the dinner and sent it to the family group, and checked in with 'dinner'.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Book next day's high-speed rail tickets and contact family
description: Use the 12306 mobile app to book a bullet train ticket from Xiamen to Quanzhou for around 9 a.m. tomorrow. After booking successfully, take a screenshot and send it to father Song Minghui, and let him know the arrival time. In the family WeChat group 'Warm Song Family', @ mother, explain the plan and reason for returning to Quanzhou to recuperate, and add a hug emoji.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied daughter and talked with husband
description: Picked Xuanxuan up from kindergarten and went home. We sat together on the living room carpet; she drew Dumbo while I read Grimm's Fairy Tales to her. When my husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, he took the initiative to share his good mood from today's delegation of authority and his walk, as well as his plan to return to Quanzhou tomorrow. He smiled with satisfaction and expressed support.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening wash-up and bedtime soothing.
description: Gave Xuanxuan a bath, read stories to get her to sleep, then washed up, cleansed her skin, did her nighttime skincare routine, and applied skin care products. She took a photo of the glucosamine and chondroitin instructions and sent it to her mother, reminding her to take it on time and in the correct dosage.
location: Bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal time and rest
description: At the desk in the bedroom, she recorded her mood rating of 8/10 in the "Health and Growth Diary" notebook and wrote the evening entry: "The first day of trying to let go went more smoothly than I expected. On the walk, I felt my body was alive. Tomorrow I go back to Quanzhou—I'm looking forward to it, but also a little worried about the store. But I know I have to start. Good night." Afterwards, leaning against the headboard, she read the chapters on "letting go" and "trust" in Spiritual Bread and murmured, "True courage is not holding tight, but daring to let go." She had a brief conversation with her husband about his picking up their daughter from school the next day and thanked him for his support. After turning off the light, she prayed in gratitude for a fulfilling day and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Woke up in the waiting hall of Xiamen North Railway Station and tidied up luggage.
description: Woke up on a seat in the waiting hall at Xiamen North Station, wiped her face with a wet wipe, and drank warm water. She sent her husband Aqiang a WeChat message to let him know she had arrived at the station and remind him to wake up their daughter Xuanxuan, and verified the Gate 1 information for Train D6228.
location: Waiting Hall, Xiamen North Station, No. 399 Hangsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Resting and listening to an audiobook in the waiting hall
description: In the waiting room, she found a quiet corner, put on headphones, and listened to the Hokkien audiobook Caigentan. She closed her eyes and rested for 20 minutes, deliberately emptying her mind and telling herself that today she would only do one thing: recuperate.
location: Waiting Hall, Xiamen North Station, No. 399 Hangsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took a bullet train from Xiamen to Quanzhou, reading and thinking.
description: I took the D6228 train from Xiamen North to Quanzhou and read the May 14 entry from 'Bread for the Journey' in Car 3 — 'Love is not merely a feeling, but a decision' — silently reciting and pondering it. Looking out the window at the southern Fujian countryside, I gradually relaxed.
location: Train D6228 (Xiamen North Station to Quanzhou Station), Car 3

name: Exit Quanzhou Station and reunite with father.
description: When the train arrived at Quanzhou Station, I met my father Song Minghui in the arrival hall. He was wearing a sky-blue polo shirt, helped with the luggage, asked with concern in Hokkien, and we walked together to the parking lot.
location: Exit hall, Quanzhou Station, Puxian Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Riding from Quanzhou Station back home, father and daughter chatting idly.
description: Rode in her father's silver Volkswagen sedan to her parents' home in Licheng District, rolling down the window to enjoy the breeze. Her father asked about the family and mentioned that her mother had bought fresh satay sauce and squid. Taking the cue, Yajing said the doctor had advised eating more high-protein food, and squid was perfect, avoiding any mention of breast hyperplasia so her father wouldn't worry.
location: On the way to the parents' home at No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (private car)

name: After arriving home, settle in and meet with mother
description: Returning to her parents' home, she felt the old house's mixed scent of wood and incense. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, leaned out from the kitchen to welcome her warmly. Yajing hugged her mother, put the Xiamen specialty fuling cakes she had brought on the table, and went to her own bedroom to change into loungewear. The room was bright and clean, and a family photo of the three of them sat on the desk.
location: Bedroom and living room at parents’ home, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Assist in the kitchen and discuss the check-up results with mother
description: While helping her mother wash vegetables in the kitchen, she calmly told her about the breast hyperplasia result from the May 12 checkup and the doctor's advice. Her mother put down the spatula, gently patted Yajing's back to comfort her, said she should come home for a few days and eat some nourishing food to recuperate, and mentioned the example of Grandma Li upstairs, who had improved from a similar condition. Mother and daughter talked at length over the steaming satay noodles, and the atmosphere shifted from heavy to ordinary family chatter.
location: Parents' home kitchen, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Satay noodles lunch with parents
description: Tasting the satay noodles made by her mother. The broth was rich, with the aroma of peanuts and shrimp paste, and toppings included fresh squid, lean pork slices, and fried tofu puffs. Yajing followed her low-sugar, low-irritation principle, did not add chili sauce or sweet chili sauce, and praised the noodles many times. Her mother happily added more soup for her.
location: Dining room at the parents' home, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Midday break, download a meditation app.
description: After dinner, she returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and set the air conditioner to 26 degrees. She searched for and downloaded the meditation app "Tide", browsed the beginner's guide and breathing techniques, and set a daily 9 PM practice reminder. Soon feeling sleepy, she turned off her phone and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon low-sugar meal and keeping father company
description: After her nap, Yajing felt better. Seeing pineapples and pineapple cakes on the coffee table, she went to the kitchen, poured herself a cup of Pu'er tea, and took a sugar-free yogurt from the fridge. Carrying the tea and yogurt back to the living room, she sat with her father and watched the news. Her mother tried to give her a pineapple cake, but Yajing politely declined, saying the doctor told her to watch her sugar intake and that she would try the pineapple cake another day, so her mother did not urge her further.
location: Living room and kitchen at parents' home, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Remotely guided store assistant Xiaomei to optimize online operations.
description: After seeing the WeChat Moments likes screenshot and the sales data sent by Xiaomei, Yajing replied with a voice message affirming her work and then placed a voice call. She spent over an hour analyzing the copy, affirming Xiaomei's control of color tone, while giving specific suggestions: change the copy for the street-style photo of the camel coat from simply saying “winter essential” to “My favorite autumn afternoon — a soft camel coat that wraps me in all my good temper.” She also suggested adding an interactive question at the end to prompt comments. Xiaomei repeatedly agreed and took notes.
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Sent greetings to her husband and daughter
description: After finishing coaching Xiaomei, she thought of her husband and daughter. She sent a WeChat message to Chen Zhiqiang asking if he was busy in the afternoon and told him that she had already eaten satay noodles after getting home. Aqiang replied with an emoji and sent a short video of Xuanxuan doing crafts in kindergarten. Yajing missed her deeply while watching the video and replied by voice message that she really missed her daughter and would bring good food when she went back on the weekend.
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Sorting out her thoughts and helping prepare ingredients in the kitchen
description: Sitting on the edge of the bed, I used my phone's memo app to organize the important records for today: pasted the memorable quotes from 'Spiritual Bread' together with meditation reminders, and recorded the doctor's instructions and the dietary remedy suggested by my mother. Then I went to the kitchen to help my mother peel garlic and trim green beans. The mother and daughter chatted about relatives' small matters as they worked, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Parents' home bedroom and kitchen, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: For dinner they had sweet potato porridge, assorted fish simmered in soy sauce broth, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and steamed sausages. Although these were home-style dishes, Yajing felt very comfortable and light. Her father suggested taking a walk in the newly built riverside park after dinner to aid digestion, and Yajing readily agreed.
location: Dining room at the parents' home, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Taking a walk with my father at Riverside Park.
description: She walked slowly with her father along the flagstone path in Jiangbin Park, as the golden evening sunlight spread over the river. Her father pointed to an old banyan tree and told the embarrassing story of Yajing falling out of a tree as a child, then talked about his business trips to Shenzhen when he was young. After about forty minutes of walking, they rested on a bench. Yajing took a photo of their two shadows and sent it to the family group with the caption, 'The sunset is infinitely beautiful, but Dad is still the best.'
location: Jiangbin Park, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: After showering, video-called with her older sister
description: After getting home, she took a hot shower to fully relax her neck and shoulders. While lying in bed in her pajamas, her sister Song Yawen sent a video call request. After answering, they talked about how her day went and the family situation. Her sister asked about her medical checkup results, urged her to rest well at home, and said Xiaomei was at the shop and to let her know if she needed money. Yajing was touched and smiled as she thanked her.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at parents' home, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime meditation and reading
description: She put on her earphones, opened the Tide app, and selected a 10-minute breathing exercise. Leaning against the headboard, she followed the guided audio, slowly inhaling and exhaling. Her thoughts occasionally wandered, but each time she gently pulled them back. The first attempt was modest, but it was a start. Afterward, she read the remaining chapters of 'Spiritual Bread' and wrote in the margin: 'Today, I am wrapped in love.'
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening chat with her husband
description: Before turning off the light, she texted her husband Chen Zhiqiang to get ready for sleep. Aqiang quickly called back, and they chatted about their daughter's funny stories and the shop. They said goodnight to each other. Yajing told him she was doing fine at her parents' home and urged him and their daughter to take good care of themselves. After hanging up, she turned off the bedside lamp and savored the quiet night in the old neighborhood.
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Turned off the lights and went to bed, lying in the familiar covers at my parents' home, feeling the unique stillness of the neighborhood night outside the window. My heart was at ease, warmed by the time with my parents, and I felt confident that I had completed all the important restoration today—rest for the body, emotional connection with family, and attention to my own health—so I fell asleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Bedroom of parents' house, No. 25 Xianhou Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up early, wash up, and do morning stretching.
description: Woke up at my parents' home in Quanzhou, did five minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, then washed up carefully using a soothing morning facial cleanser to start the new day feeling fresh.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Enjoyed a low-sugar breakfast and tidied up the kitchen with her mother.
description: Her mother prepared a low-sugar breakfast, made fried eggs with whole wheat bread, served with milk, and recorded the breakfast on the 'Tide' app. Her mother shared the joy of buying fresh shrimp at the market, and the two chatted about their plan to make red bean cakes. After breakfast, she proactively cleaned up the dishes, helped her mother sort vegetables, and listened to her mother tell interesting community stories, such as Aunt Wang downstairs's grandson learning to call her grandma. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Parents' home kitchen and dining room, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Morning bookkeeping and financial decisions
description: At the desk in the bedroom, she took out the family ledger and calculated May expenses: physical examination, health supplements, transportation costs for the round trip to Quanzhou, and gifts for her mother. Facing the “overseas travel fund” plan, she wrote the note “live well first, then travel far” and decided to postpone the plan. She took a photo of the ledger and sent it to her husband Chen Zhiqiang via WeChat, with a message communicating the decision.
location: At the desk in the old bedroom of her parents' home on Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Following up on store operations and guiding the staff.
description: She looked at the Moments screenshots and sales data of the new outfits sent by staff member Xiaomei, and affirmed the increase in likes and the improvement in the copy. Through WeChat voice messages, she guided Xiaomei to optimize the copy's contextualization, and suggested shooting a 10-second short video to show the fabric texture, and adding screenshots of real customer fitting reviews to make it more convincing.
location: Living room of parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Go to the market to buy red bean cake ingredients.
description: Walked with her mother to West Street market to buy red beans and xylitol for making low-sugar red bean cake, and also bought fresh vegetables and fruit while soaking in the lively market atmosphere.
location: West Street Food Market, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Replied to her husband's message and shared a family lunch.
description: On the way home, she received a screenshot of a bank transfer receipt from her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and learned that he had transferred his extra project bonus into the family shared account. Deeply moved, she replied "Thank you" with a hands-clasped emoji. After getting home, she had dinner with her parents: a special shrimp and asparagus stir-fried whole-wheat pasta made by her mother. She shared her husband's understanding and support, and her parents praised Aqiang for being down-to-earth. After dinner, she recorded her good energy in the "Tide" app and sent a screenshot to her husband.
location: Parents' home dining room, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon nap and reading
description: After lunch, she took a nap of about 30 minutes in the old bedroom. After waking, she read Bread for the Journey, which she had brought with her, savoring short passages about acceptance and the present moment, and gained inner peace.
location: Old bedroom in the parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Made low-sugar red bean cakes and shared them with the community.
description: She asked her mother to help wash and soak the red beans, then followed the recipe step by step to boil, strain, and shape them. The process was laborious, but the finished product had a rich bean aroma and restrained sweetness. She cut the red bean cake into pieces, arranged them on a plate, took photos, and sent them to her husband and the baking group. She also wrote up her production notes and posted them in the Yajing Life Studio customer community, which drew encouragement and interaction from regular customers and Mrs. Liu.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Brief rest, tea, and taking in the clothes
description: After baking, she brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea, relaxed on the living room sofa, and, noticing the sky outside looked like rain, brought the drying clothes inside.
location: Living room of parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: First formal meditation practice.
description: She laid out a thin blanket in the bedroom, opened the "Tide" app, and did a 15-minute basic breathing meditation, sitting quietly and following the guided instructions. Although her thoughts drifted occasionally, by the end her hands and feet were noticeably relaxed, and she had gained initial confidence in this new practice.
location: Old bedroom in the parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Share her first meditation experience with her mother
description: After finishing meditation, she came to the living room where her mother was flipping through an old photo album. She sat beside her mother and shared the sense of relaxation meditation brought her. Though her mother didn't fully understand, she encouraged her daughter not to put too much pressure on herself—a warm scene.
location: Living room of parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Evening walk and chat with father
description: Her father Song Minghui suggested going out for a walk. The father and daughter walked slowly along the Ancient Banyan Alley path to the street park. Her father talked about interesting work stories from his youth, and Yajing shared funny customer stories from the store. When a light drizzle began to fall, they quickened their pace and went home.
location: Street park at No. 19 Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, and the nearby walking paths

name: Help prepare dinner and a low-sugar evening meal
description: After returning home, she helped her mother prepare cold shredded chicken with cucumber and millet porridge, smashing cucumbers and cutting them into pieces. The dinner was light and refreshing. The whole family sat around the table eating amid the sound of rain. Yajing shared how the low-sugar diet had improved her energy, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Parents' home kitchen and dining room, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: After taking a shower, she sat with her parents watching TV and chatting casually on the rainy night
description: After dinner, she took a hot bath, changed into loungewear, and sat on the living room sofa with her parents watching the local weather forecast and news. Her mother talked about how Yajing, as a child, would wait for the rain to stop and then sneak out to play. The three of them laughed, and the rain pattered outside the window.
location: Parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening video call with husband
description: Back in the bedroom, she saw a short video her husband had sent of their daughter Xuanxuan eating dinner in Xiamen. She replied with a photo of her own dinner and shared her thoughts on making red bean cakes, meditating, and adjusting finances today. The two had a brief voice exchange—few words but full of care.
location: Old bedroom in the parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Sharing insights with her sister over video call
description: Had a video call with her older sister Song Yawen, who lives far away in Shenzhen, sharing the benefits of returning to Quanzhou to recuperate, including her health plan and family financial adjustments. Her sister encouraged Yajing to slow down a little and said she was relieved that her husband was understanding, which made Yajing feel deeply warm.
location: Old bedroom in the parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bedtime stretching and essential oil massage
description: After changing into pajamas, she did a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch by the bed, focusing on massaging her tight right shoulder. She put a few drops of lavender essential oil on the back of her neck, and the faint fragrance brought total relaxation.
location: On the bed in the old bedroom of her parents’ house on Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Writing an emotion diary and going to bed
description: In her phone's notes app, she recorded today's mood score as 8, with notes: the ease of being in her hometown, the joy of baking, the reassurance of her husband's transfer, and the relaxation of trying meditation for the first time; after accepting her financial reality, she felt closer to her family. She briefly listed a plan to go grocery shopping with her mother tomorrow, then turned off her phone and fell asleep peacefully in the scent of lavender.
location: Old bedroom in the parents' home, Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Wake-up, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: Woken by the alarm clock at her parents' home, she first weighed herself: 49.8 kg. After a quick wash, she did a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch in the bedroom and changed into a light beige cotton-linen shirt and dark gray casual pants. Then she had a low-sugar breakfast with her parents. Her mother had prepared boiled eggs, unsweetened soy milk, and stir-fried lettuce. During the meal, her parents reminded her to take care of her health. After breakfast, Song Yajing washed the dishes willingly, and her mother slipped a pack of red bean cakes for her to bring to Aqiang and Xuanxuan.
location: No. 60 Daxi Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Accompany Mother to the Vegetable Market
description: Song Yajing walked arm in arm with her mother to the West Street market. Along the way, her mother kept saying she wanted to bring back some local specialties. In the end, she bought a small bag of fresh oysters, planning to have Aqiang make oyster omelet; Song Yajing also helped her mother pick out some seasonal vegetables, and she herself bought tomatoes and cucumbers to take back to Xiamen. Seeing her mother's slightly hunched back, Song Yajing felt a pang of sadness and silently took over the vegetable basket.
location: West Street Vegetable Market, 210 West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Saying goodbye to her parents and heading to Quanzhou Station.
description: Back home, she quickly checked her luggage. Her father insisted on driving her to Quanzhou Station. When saying goodbye, her mother hugged her and gave her reminders, and Song Yajing promised to report her safe arrival in Xiamen. In the car, her father chatted about community news, and the ride made Song Yajing feel especially secure.
location: From No. 60 Daxi Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province to Quanzhou Station, Puxian Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Waiting and boarding
description: After her father saw her off at the entrance, Song Yajing swiped her ID card to enter the station, found a quiet corner in the waiting hall, and used the Tide app for a 5-minute quick breathing exercise to calm her emotions about parting. The shop assistant Xiaomei sent a WeChat message reporting the morning situation at the store. Shortly after she replied, train D6228 began boarding, and she got on smoothly.
location: Waiting hall of Quanzhou Station, Puxian Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: High-speed train trip and meditation.
description: She boarded the D6228 train, found a window seat, put away her luggage, put on earphones, and opened the Tide app for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation. The renovated look of the store surfaced in her mind. After the meditation, her thoughts were clear. She opened the memo app on her phone and jotted down a few outfit styling ideas, ready to discuss them with supplier Susan. The train arrived at Xiamen Station at about 10:40.
location: D6228 train (Quanzhou Station to Xiamen Station)

name: Picking up at Xiamen Station and going home.
description: Arriving at Xiamen Station, her husband Chen Zhiqiang greeted her at the exit. The two hugged, then he took her luggage and drove back to their home at No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District. After getting home, Song Yajing quickly unpacked, put the clothes to be washed into the laundry basket, and drank a glass of water to rest briefly.
location: From Xiamen Station, No. 900 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the store, lunch, and purchase discussions.
description: She changed into flat shoes and walked about 20 minutes to the store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, the clerk Xiaomei told her about the morning business. Song Yajing took out her homemade low-sugar lunch (grilled salmon, steamed pumpkin, and stir-fried spinach) and ate it at the tea table by the window. Afterwards, while eating nuts, she discussed summer outfit ideas and suggestions for stocking new styles with Xiaomei. After the meal, based on sales data and fashion news, she selected several early-summer shirts, wide-leg pants, and floral dresses, contacted Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, via WeChat, and discussed fabric, color, minimum order quantity, and delivery time in detail. She finally placed a medium order of 15 pieces (5 shirts, 6 dresses, and 4 pairs of wide-leg pants), expected to arrive next Wednesday, and transcribed the order information into the ledger.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Plan for store soft decoration renovation
description: In the afternoon there were few customers, so Song Yajing started the cozy soft-decoration renovation of the store. She took out a tape measure to measure the blank wall on the north side of the store (2.8 meters long and 2.5 meters high) and the interior dimensions of the fitting room (1.2 meters wide and 1.5 meters deep), and drew a rough layout plan, planning to set up three layers of light-colored wooden shelves and place a large-leaf pothos in the fitting room. She then made a shopping list: 4 warm-color-temperature LED bulbs, 3 wooden shelves (each 1 meter long), 2 pothos plants, and hooks, and planned to go to the building materials market on Saturday morning.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Send health supplements to her mother-in-law and call to greet her.
description: The renovation plan had come to a temporary end. Song Yajing carefully packed two bottles of glucosamine chondroitin tablets in a shipping box with bubble wrap, walked to the nearby Yunda Express Store, and sent them to her mother-in-law, noting “Please handle with care.” After mailing them, she stood under a plane tree on the roadside and called her mother-in-law, told her the package had been sent, and reminded her to take it on time. Her mother-in-law laughed at her for being fussy, and after chatting for five or six minutes, they hung up.
location: Yunda Express Supermarket and its vicinity, on a branch road of Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Returning to the store to wrap up
description: Back at the store, Xiaomei was serving a middle-aged female customer trying on wide-leg pants. Song Yajing waited nearby. After the customer left, she checked today's payment records and inventory, examined and straightened the slightly wrinkled shirts on the display racks, and made sure everything was in order.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked home and made a detour to the pharmacy.
description: She finished work early and headed home, taking a detour to Hubin Pharmacy (Binnan Branch 2) to buy sugar-free mint candies, but couldn't find them and left empty-handed. On the walk home, Song Yajing noticed that her step count for the day was already close to 7,000 steps.
location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via Hubin Pharmacy (Binnan Branch 2), to No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Discuss travel plan adjustments with her husband
description: Back home, Chen Zhiqiang was already in the study. He told her that the project bonus of 8,000 yuan had been transferred to the family account and suggested putting the travel plan off until autumn. Although Song Yajing was a little disappointed, she said she understood. The two smiled at each other, and she later recorded the decision in the account book.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Helped husband prepare dinner.
description: Changing into loungewear, Song Yajing went to the kitchen to help Chen Zhiqiang wash vegetables and chop garlic. His main dishes were lean meat stir-fried with mushrooms, garlic lettuce, and multigrain rice. As they worked, they chatted about the store renovation. Chen Zhiqiang suggested going to the building materials market together on the weekend to help, and Song Yajing readily agreed. The kitchen was filled with the warm, cozy atmosphere of everyday cooking.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner time
description: The meal was served, and the couple sat across from each other. Song Yajing praised Chen Zhiqiang's cooking, and he asked how she was doing with her low-sugar diet. She proudly said she hadn't touched sugar all day. They discussed the weekend plans: Saturday morning, the building materials market, and Saturday afternoon, church; Sunday morning, the store, and Sunday afternoon, take Xuanxuan to Jiaxingyuan Park. Meanwhile, Xiaomei sent today's revenue—it was looking good, and she felt reassured.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-meal cleanup and health diary
description: After the meal, she took the initiative to clear the dishes and clean the kitchen, and tied up the trash bag. Then she sat down on the living room sofa, opened the health diary app, and recorded her three meals: eggs and milk for breakfast, baked salmon with pumpkin and spinach for lunch, and mixed grain rice with lean meat and mushrooms for dinner. She gave her low-sugar diet a score of 9, noted "steady energy, no hypoglycemic reaction," and logged over 7000 steps, reminding herself to finish stretching and meditation before bed.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening reading.
description: She brewed a cup of unsweetened chrysanthemum tea and curled up on the sofa reading "Spiritual Bread." When she came across the sentence "keep peace in the midst of trivialities," she was deeply touched and saved it in the memo on her phone. During that time, Aunt Zhang next door brought over taro cake. She thanked her and put it in the fridge for Xuanxuan.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching, meditation, and emotional processing
description: She ended her reading early, changed into her pajamas, and in the bedroom first did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the soreness from hunching over her desk. Then she lay flat for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, following the Tide app's guidance to relax from head to toe. After meditating, she leaned against the headboard, rated today's mood 8.5 in her journal app, and noted that she felt family support, saw signs of progress in the shop renovation, had stuck well to the low-sugar diet, and had a smooth transitional day. She sent her mother a WeChat message to let her know she was safe, then turned off the light and got ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Nighttime sleep
description: Closing my eyes, the image of Chen Zhiqiang cooking in the kitchen appeared in my mind, and I felt at ease. Outside the window came the sparse sound of traffic. After adjusting my sleeping position, my breathing gradually steadied, and I fell into a dreamless sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up in the early morning, did simple cat stretches, and after washing up, put on light orange lipstick to start the weekend art day in a pleasant mood.
location: Master bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing family breakfast
description: Song Yajing tied on an apron and prepared milk oatmeal porridge, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of boiling eggs and heating milk, and her daughter Chen Lexuan ran into the kitchen with sleepy eyes and hugged her mother. Song Yajing kissed her and reminded her to change clothes and get ready for painting.
location: Home kitchen in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: The whole family enjoyed a low-sugar, healthy breakfast together.
description: The family of three sat around the table enjoying a low-sugar breakfast of milk oatmeal porridge, eggs, and more. Song Yajing added dried blueberries to her daughter's serving and shared the day's plans with her husband. Chen Zhiqiang reminded them to use sun protection. After the meal, Song Yajing cleared the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping before departure and walking to the community art center
description: Song Yajing, carrying a canvas bag and holding the hand of Chen Lexuan, who was wearing a little dress, went out. First they bought xylitol at the Xiashang Minxing Supermarket at the entrance of the residential community, then mother and daughter walked hand in hand to the Community Art Center at No. 92 South Hubin Road.
location: Walking from Xiasheng Minxing Supermarket on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to the Community Art Center

name: Parent-child watercolor class: Spring garden sketching
description: Attended a parent-child watercolor class in the painting classroom on the second floor of the community art center, themed “Spring Garden Sketching.” Chen Lexuan boldly chose paints to draw flower outlines; Song Yajing helped blend the grass and sky. Teacher Li, the painting instructor, praised Xuanxuan for her clear improvement in color use and water control. The mother and daughter felt warm and proud.
location: Painting classroom, 2nd Floor, Community Art Center, 92 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Walking home and buying ingredients along the way
description: After class, Song Yajing walked home holding Chen Lexuan's hand. On the way, they stopped at a corner fresh produce shop to pick two tomatoes and a few sprigs of cilantro in preparation for the tomato beef brisket lunch. Along the way, her daughter shared her thoughts on drawing, and Song Yajing smiled and responded.
location: At the corner fresh-food store on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the walk home.

name: Assist husband in preparing lunch
description: After returning home, Song Yajing changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen to help Chen Zhiqiang. She was in charge of cooking quinoa rice and cutting tomatoes. Chen Zhiqiang mentioned that he had worked at home in the afternoon and taken their daughter cycling. Song Yajing agreed with this division of labor.
location: Home kitchen in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Healthy lunch and online ticket purchase
description: For lunch, they enjoyed Chen Zhiqiang's specialty, tomato beef brisket stew with quinoa rice, and the family of three ate contentedly. After the meal, Song Yajing bought two tickets for the Monet Light and Shadow Immersive Exhibition on her phone, and notified Aunt Lin Xiuying via WeChat to confirm meeting at 2 p.m. at Powerlong Art Center.
location: Dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and artistic decoration.
description: Song Yajing rested with her eyes closed on the sofa for twenty minutes. After waking up, she picked out a light blue cotton-linen dress and a plain silk scarf, put her notebook and pen into a tote bag, and got ready to record her thoughts at the exhibition.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Song Yajing changed into white flat sandals, slung her tote bag over her shoulder, checked her appearance in the entryway mirror, said goodbye to her husband working in the study and her daughter watching cartoons, and then gently closed the door as she left home.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, home foyer

name: Take a ride-hailing car to PowerLong Art Center
description: Song Yajing ordered a ride-hailing car at the entrance of the residential complex. The drive took about twenty minutes, passing through the Lianban commercial area, and arrived at Powerlong One City, No. 1 Jinshan Road. She walked lightheartedly toward the entrance of the Powerlong Art Center.
location: En route by ride-hailing car from No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to Powerlong One City, No. 1 Jinshan Road

name: Immersive exhibition visit: Monet Light and Shadow Immersive Exhibition.
description: At the main exhibition hall of the Powerlong Art Center, she met up with Aunt Lin Xiuying and visited the Monet Light and Shadow Immersive Exhibition together. In the huge screens and mirrored space, Water Lilies, The Japanese Bridge, and other works turned into flowing light and shadow, accompanied by Debussy's classical music. Song Yajing was completely immersed and released her stress, sometimes quietly appreciating with Aunt Lin and sometimes exchanging impressions in low voices.
location: Main Exhibition Hall, Powerlong Art Center, Powerlong One City, No. 1 Jinshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Select a commemorative painting
description: After the exhibition, they browsed the souvenir shop. Song Yajing took a liking to a reproduction of "Water Lilies" and imagined the peaceful feeling of hanging it above the bedroom headboard, so she asked the clerk to wrap it carefully and bought it, while Lin Xiuying praised it beside her.
location: Souvenir Shop, PowerLong Art Center, PowerLong One City, No. 1 Jinshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Said goodbye and returned home.
description: After a reluctant farewell with Lin Xiuying at the entrance of the art center, and agreeing to meet at the church tomorrow, Song Yajing took a ride-hailing car home carrying the framed painting, savoring moments of the exhibition on the way and feeling joyful and calm.
location: On the way by ride-hailing car from No. 1 Jinshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Making sugar-free fruit tea
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing put the painting away, and in the kitchen made a large pot of refreshing sugar-free fruit tea using pre-prepared watermelon, lemon, orange, mint leaves, and xylitol. After tasting, it was perfectly balanced between sweet and sour, and she was very satisfied.
location: Home kitchen in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Sharing an art experience with the family
description: Song Yajing showed her husband and daughter a reproduction of Water Lilies, shared photos and videos from the exhibition, and described the awe of flowing light and shadow. She also expressed her wish to take their daughter to experience more art in the future. Chen Zhiqiang nodded in support, and the family shared fruit tea together—a warm scene.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Homemade healthy dinner
description: Dinner was a joint effort by Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed shrimp, and steamed sea bass - light, low-fat, and high in protein. During the meal, Chen Lexuan said she also wanted to go see the pretty flowers. Song Yajing smiled and agreed, planning to arrange a visit to the children's art exhibition.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, Shanggu Street 82 Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leisurely family walk
description: After dinner, the family of three changed into comfortable shoes and went downstairs to take a walk in the community and along the Yundang Lake branch trails. Chen Lexuan rode her little bicycle in front to lead the way, while Song Yajing walked arm in arm with Chen Zhiqiang, chatting about everyday things and enjoying the harmony and peace of the family.
location: The No. 82 Shanggu Street community at 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Yundang Lake branch trail.

name: Putting her daughter to sleep and planning parent-child activities
description: After returning home, Song Yajing bathed Chen Lexuan, changed her into pajamas, took out the watercolor painting, and told the story behind it. Her daughter fell into a sweet sleep, and she tucked in the quilt corners for her and gave her a goodnight kiss. Then Song Yajing sat in the living room and searched on her phone for recent parent-child exhibitions and activities, planning to incorporate aesthetic education into the family plan.
location: In the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: daughter's room and living room.

name: Relaxation before bed and private time as a couple
description: Song Yajing first stayed alone in the bedroom to record the day's diet and mood, did 10 minutes of yoga for shoulder and neck stretching, and then used the Tide app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation. Afterward, she exchanged ideas with her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the store renovation and their feelings from the exhibition visit. The two talked softly, washed up together, confirmed the next day's schedule, and turned off the lights at 23:00 to fall asleep peacefully.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: After turning off the alarm, Song Yajing sat on the edge of the bed and did five minutes of deep breathing, savoring the quiet of early Sunday morning. After washing up, she used warm water to wake her skin, then opened 'Bread for the Soul' in the living room and read a passage about hope, repeating it silently to herself to set a peaceful tone. She drew the curtains and stretched her shoulders and neck to relieve the week's fatigue. She took out the eggs to boil, whole wheat bread, and skim milk, boiled the eggs for eight minutes, weighed out 23 grams of mixed nuts, and made unsweetened lemon water. She woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and the family enjoyed a low-sugar breakfast. After breakfast, she changed into an elegant white puff-sleeve shirt with a dark blue long skirt, put on pearl earrings, sorted the dirty laundry and started the washing machine, then checked the kitchen to make sure the stove was off and the trash bag was tied up and placed by the door.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove and walked to the Catholic Church
description: Song Yajing put on her canvas bag containing her phone, keys, and a small Bible, then drove from No. 82 Shanggu Street to the parking lot near the ferry terminal, with soothing hymns playing in the car. After parking, she walked along Lujiang Road to the ferry pier, feeling the morning sea breeze, took the ferry to Gulangyu, walked through the quiet alleys, and finally arrived at the Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road.
location: No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Gulangyu Catholic Church)

name: Attend Sunday Mass and talk with fellow parishioners.
description: Song Yajing entered the Catholic church, dipped her hand in holy water, made the sign of the cross, and sat down quietly. During Mass she read the scriptures attentively, sang hymns, and listened to Father Wang Mingde's sermon on "revealing love in the ordinary," which deeply moved her and reminded her of the shop renovation and small moments with her daughter. At Communion, she received the Eucharist with gratitude, palms pressed together. After Mass she chatted at the door with Aunt Lin Xiuying and other parishioners. Aunt Lin asked about the shop business and her health, and mentioned the church's planned visit to community seniors next Saturday. Yajing said she would like to join, and she and the volunteer team leader added each other on WeChat.
location: No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Gulangyu Catholic Church)

name: Purchased groceries at the supermarket and returned home.
description: After saying goodbye to fellow churchgoers, Song Yajing returned to the ferry parking lot and drove to Xiasheng Minxing Supermarket (Wenping Branch), about a 15-minute drive. In the supermarket, she quickly picked fresh laver, tomatoes, scallions, and two baby cabbages. After paying, she left carrying the shopping bags. She then drove back to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, parked in the compound's parking space, and carried the groceries home.
location: 103-106, No. 40 Wenping Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Xiashang Minxing Supermarket)

name: Prepare a low-sugar lunch
description: Back home, Song Yajing changed into loungewear, tied on an apron, cleaned the three-yellow chicken and patted it dry with paper towels, rubbed it inside and out with salt and ginger slices, and put it in a deep dish to prepare white cut chicken. She soaked and cleaned wood ear mushrooms, tore them into small pieces, blanched them, and rinsed them in cold water. She put whole wheat steamed buns in the steamer to heat. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped smash garlic, chop cilantro, and make the dipping sauce for the white cut chicken.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had lunch together.
description: Lunch was served: glossy and tender white-cut chicken, refreshing cold black fungus salad, steaming whole-wheat buns, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of three sat around the table. Song Yajing tore the chicken thigh meat into small pieces so her daughter Chen Lexuan could eat easily, while she herself ate the black fungus and a steamed bun until she was about 70% full. During the meal, she shared reflections from the priest’s sermon with her husband and mentioned that she might take part in a visitation activity next week.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon parent-child games and getting the child to sleep
description: After the meal, Song Yajing cleared the tableware and told her husband to go rest in the living room. She then sat with her daughter Chen Lexuan on the floor mat and played a “find the color” game using a reproduction of Water Lilies as the background, guiding her daughter to look for various shades of blue. After playing for over half an hour, she held her daughter and read her two picture books, and the child soon fell fast asleep in her arms.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online registration for the industry lecture
description: While her daughter was napping and her husband was taking a short rest, Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa and scrolled through her WeChat Moments and industry news on her phone. Remembering the official account of the Hangzhou Garment Industry Association that she followed, she tapped into it and found a push notification for the online lecture 'Analysis of 2025 Autumn/Winter Women's Fashion Trends.' After carefully reading the outline and the speaker's introduction, she felt it met the store's need for upgrading its product selection, decisively clicked the link to jump to the registration page, and paid the 199 yuan registration fee via WeChat Pay. After the payment succeeded, she received a text message containing the lecture link, exclusive password, and course schedule. She took a screenshot and saved it, and set an alarm reminder for next Wednesday.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and driving to the building materials market.
description: Song Yajing changed into a light T-shirt and sports pants and carried a large canvas tote bag. She opened the notes app on her phone and confirmed the shopping list again: six 3000K warm-white LED bulbs, two 1.2-meter light-colored wooden shelves, four 12-centimeter metal triangular brackets, and three healthy potted pothos plants. After checking that everything was correct, she softly told her husband she was going out, drove using navigation to Huarong Road, Huli District, and arrived at the building materials market area about 30 minutes later, parking in the public parking lot.
location: Huarong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jiayue Home Furnishings and Building Materials Market)

name: Purchasing supplies at the building materials market
description: Song Yajing entered the Jiayue Home & Building Materials Market. She first went to the lighting area to pick warm-white LED bulbs with a color temperature of 3000K, and asked the shopkeeper to test the lighting effect on site, confirming it was soft and not harsh. Then she went to the lumber area, touched the texture of several light-colored pine wood shelves with her own hands, selected two smooth ones without cracks, and had the shopkeeper cut them to size. Finally, in the plant area, she carefully chose three pots of artificial pothos with dense foliage and full shapes (considering the store's lighting and convenience of maintenance).
location: Huarong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jiayue Home Furnishings and Building Materials Market)

name: Transport supplies to the store and put them into inventory.
description: After the purchase was completed, Song Yajing contacted a familiar cargo van driver in the market and carefully loaded the light bulbs, shelves, accessories, and potted pothos plants onto the van together with the driver, Master Li. She sat in the front passenger seat and directed the driver to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street in Siming District. Because of weekend traffic restrictions, they stopped at the Zhenhai Road intersection. Song Yajing asked the driver to wait, hurried alone to the "Tranquil Wardrobe" shop at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, unlocked the shop door with her key, first lifted off the dust cover at the entrance, and then carried the supplies with the driver, trip after trip, into the storage room at the back of the shop, stacking them neatly in the corner. Afterward, she took a photo of the supplies and sent it to the shop assistant Xiaomei via WeChat with the message: "The renovation materials are in place. When we come to work tomorrow, let's clear out the old shelves first and try the new layout!" After confirming everything was in order, she locked the shop door.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: Walking home and buying drinks on the way.
description: After saying goodbye to the driver, Song Yajing strolled home along Zhenhai Road. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road), she went in and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea, opened the cap, and took a sip to quench her thirst. Feeling the cool evening sea breeze and watching the tourists and vehicles pass by, she felt relaxed. About 20 minutes later, she returned home to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to 82 Shanggu Street

name: Assist in preparing dinner and spend time with the family
description: After returning home, the sound of a cartoon came from the living room, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang was preparing seaweed egg drop soup in the kitchen. Song Yajing washed her hands and went into the kitchen, washed scallions and cut them into chopped green onions for Zhiqiang, while taking out sweet potatoes to steam. Her daughter Chen Lexuan ran over and hugged her leg. She wiped her hands with her apron, squatted down and kissed her daughter, then accompanied her daughter to pick up the building blocks and picture books scattered around the living room and put them back into the storage bin.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner was served: seaweed and egg drop soup, steamed sweet potatoes, and the cucumber salad her husband had made in the morning. The family of three sat around the table; the dinner was simple but warm. As she ate, Song Yajing listened to her daughter talk about her afternoon dream. The daughter said she dreamed that her mother had turned into a fairy. Song Yajing and her husband exchanged smiles, feeling the fatigue of the day melt away in the child's innocent words.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-meal household chores.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing was responsible for putting the dishes and chopsticks into the sink, scrubbing them carefully with dish soap, rinsing them with clean water, and putting them into the dish rack. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang wiped the dining table and stove with a cloth, and sorted the garbage (kitchen waste and recyclables) into bags, planning to take it downstairs during a walk later. The couple worked well together and soon had the kitchen neat and tidy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family taking a leisurely walk in the residential community
description: The family of three put on comfortable shoes and went downstairs for a walk in the neighborhood. Song Yajing walked side by side with her husband, chatting about what they had seen at the building materials market in the afternoon and their ideas for the layout of the remodeled 'Jingxin Wardrobe.' Chen Zhiqiang suggested adding a full-length mirror in the fitting room to enhance light reflection. Their daughter Chen Lexuan excitedly ran and jumped ahead, then pulled her father to the fitness area in the center of the neighborhood to play on the slide. Her cheerful laughter echoed in the evening.
location: Community garden, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's evening wash-up and bedtime story
description: Walking home, Song Yajing had her daughter sit on her little potty first, then gave her a warm bath and changed her into clean cartoon pajamas. While drying her hair with a towel, she played the Octonauts audio story. Then she took two picture books from the bookshelf, leaned against the headboard, and read bedtime stories in a gentle voice. Halfway through, seeing her daughter's eyelids droop, she gently put the book down, pressed a goodnight kiss on her forehead, and hummed a lullaby until her daughter fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal washing and relaxing stretches.
description: Song Yajing quietly slipped out of her daughter's room and closed the door, then returned to the master bathroom for a thorough shower, using lavender-scented body wash to relax. After showering, she sat at the vanity and applied skincare products, then did a 10-minute set of shoulder and neck stretches and felt the tight muscles loosen up a lot.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime meditation and plan for tomorrow
description: Leaning against the headboard, she put on Bluetooth earphones, opened the Tide app, and chose the 10-minute 'Sleep' meditation guide. Closing her eyes, she focused on her breathing and felt her abdomen rise and fall. Thoughts scattered like clouds, and her mind grew calm. After the meditation, she opened the memo app on her phone and recorded a health diary: 'Weight 49.8 kg; breakfast: boiled egg, milk, nuts; lunch: white cut chicken, whole wheat bun; dinner: seaweed egg drop soup, sweet potato; walked about 8,000 steps all day; meditation done.' Then she wrote down the next day's to-do list: discuss the weekend store renovation details and division of work with Xiaomei; follow up on the logistics tracking number from Su Shan in Guangzhou to confirm arrival on Wednesday; go to the community health service station in the afternoon to renew Doctor Wang's conditioning prescription.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and picked up 'Allergies and Diet' to continue reading the chapter on 'leaky gut syndrome' and chronic inflammation. After about ten minutes, drowsiness came. She closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, silently made a short prayer thanking God for the safe and fulfilling day, turned over to find a comfortable position, and slowly fell into a dream.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Song Yajing was awakened by the sound of her husband preparing food in the kitchen and the rustling sounds of her daughter getting up. After washing up quickly, she changed into a comfortable linen shirt and jeans for opening the shop, and specially put on the flat cloth shoes she had bought last Sunday. Then she had breakfast with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. The breakfast, prepared by Chen Zhiqiang, was milk, boiled eggs, and a few slices of whole wheat toast with sugar-free peanut butter, strictly following the low-sugar principle. While eating, she quickly browsed the store surveillance feed on her phone and confirmed that the shop assistant Xiaomei had already arrived at the store.
location: Room 301, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and commute
description: The family of three went out. Song Yajing rode her electric bike with her daughter Chen Lexuan, while Chen Zhiqiang took the metro to work. The sky was gloomy as they left, so she grabbed a folding umbrella from the cabinet by the door and put it in the bike basket. On the way, she promised her daughter that she would tell her the story of 'The Undersea Squad' in the evening. After dropping her daughter off at Siming Experimental Kindergarten, she continued riding to the store. On the way, she stopped briefly at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought a roll of wide tape and a bottle of lemon soda that the store urgently needed, then arrived at the store.
location: Starting from No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing through Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province), making a stop at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road), and finally arriving at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: Upon arriving at the store, the shop assistant Xiaomei had already opened the door and was cleaning. Greeting Xiaomei, she counted the renovation materials delivered yesterday (Sunday): warm-color-temperature LED bulbs, wooden shelves, metal brackets, and faux pothos. She took out the reference photos for styling from her phone, briefly discussed today's renovation plan and task division with Xiaomei, and decided to install the bulbs first and carefully measure the shelf positions again.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Doctor appointment scheduling and proactive health management
description: Sitting on the fitting stool in the corner of the store, she made an online appointment through the official service account of “Xiagang Street Community Health Service Center.” She found Dr. Wang Mingyuan's schedule, successfully booked an outpatient appointment for 9:30 tomorrow morning, and carefully listed the questions she wanted to ask in her memo: “1. Is the hyperplasia physiological or pathological? 2. Are there dietary restrictions? Can I drink soy milk? 3. Do I need medication or physical therapy? 4. How often should I have follow-ups?” After finishing, she let out a long breath, feeling as if half the weight had been lifted from her heart.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store soft furnishing makeover (morning)
description: Song Yajing and her husband learned some simple electrical work from online videos at home. With her giving instructions and Xiaomei lending a hand, they started the renovation. First, they worked together to replace the original cool white light bulbs in the fitting room with warm-color-temperature LED bulbs, instantly making the atmosphere cozier. Then they repeatedly measured the wall dimensions with a tape measure, used a mobile app to simulate the effect after installing the shelves, and marked the wall with a pencil. Midway through, she checked her phone and saw a message from Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, confirming that Wednesday's new arrivals (shirts, dresses, and wide-leg pants) had been shipped and were expected to arrive on Wednesday afternoon. She replied with a thumbs-up emoji and reminded herself to prepare the new product display by then.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Lunch was the leftover braised fish pieces from last night (boneless) with brown rice and garlic stir-fried greens, continuing her low-sugar diet. After the meal, she didn't look at her phone. She leaned back in the rattan chair in the store and closed her eyes to rest for about 15 minutes, relieving the fatigue from the morning's renovation.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe rest area, Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store soft furnishing renovation (afternoon)
description: They continued the morning's work. Weaving the faux pothos vines they had bought around a metal stand and a few unused clothes rack poles, they created a lively 'green corner.' They took a few photos and posted them to Moments with the caption 'Little shop under renovation, made just for you,' along with close-ups of the plants and warm lights. The response was good.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Deep work and planning
description: There were few customers in the shop, so she sat behind the cash register, opened her laptop, and used this rare quiet time to do two things. First, she organized this week's healthy recipes and planned to add the doctor-recommended light exercise after tomorrow's doctor's visit — her initial plan was to do 15 minutes of aerobics at home before dinner every day. Second, she sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang a WeChat message: 'Honey, today I successfully completed the first step of the renovation. Want to go for a walk around Yundang Lake this evening?'
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receiving customers and community interaction
description: The store saw a small wave of customers. She got up and attended to two young women who came in together, recommended several summer dresses based on their needs, and successfully sold one. Meanwhile, Sister Zhang, the owner of the shoe store next door, dropped by and they chatted a bit about the recent foot traffic on the pedestrian street, encouraging each other.

participant.name: Sister Zhang
participant.relation: The proprietress of the neighboring shoe store

location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle preparations for tomorrow's outpatient clinic.
description: Back at the cashier counter, she confirmed the appointment information again, put her medical insurance card and the physical examination report done on May 12 at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University into a document folder, ready to take it tomorrow. After that, she used her phone to search for the route to the community hospital where Dr. Wang works, and confirmed that it takes about 15 minutes to get there by electric bike.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went out in the afternoon to buy drinks.
description: The weather improved somewhat, with occasional light drizzle. She had Xiaomei watch the shop, then took an umbrella and went to the nearby 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City to buy a cup of unsweetened oolong tea. On the way back, she noticed a newly opened independent coffee shop with a hand-drip coffee advertisement at the entrance. She silently made a note of it, planning to come and try it next time with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. After returning to the shop, she scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while and saved several posts about "low-sugar afternoon tea" and "self-disciplined daily life for women living alone" to find material for the shop's community sharing.
location: Walk from Serenity Wardrobe to the 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City (189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen), then return to the shop.

name: Wrap-up work and handover
description: Together with Xiaomei, she sorted and discarded today's packaging boxes, old light bulbs, and other trash, and did a quick cleaning. She checked today's revenue, which was slightly better than last Monday, and felt good. She reminded Xiaowen that she would arrive at the store a little later tomorrow morning because she had a doctor's appointment, and Xiaomei readily agreed.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Rode the electric bike to arrive on time at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten and parked. Picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Xuanxuan was holding a drawing in her hand, saying the teacher taught them to draw The Rainbow Flower. Song Yajing squatted down to look at it carefully, praised her for drawing really well, then helped her daughter put on her helmet.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Market shopping
description: On the way from the kindergarten, she stopped by the Eighth Market and bought fresh clams, a bunch of scallions, and two tomatoes, planning to make plain noodle soup for dinner. Then she took her daughter and returned home.
location: Eighth Market (Bashi), No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, then returned home at No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and preparations for a walk
description: After arriving home, their daughter watched cartoons in the living room, and Song Yajing went into the kitchen to start preparing dinner. While she was washing the vegetables, her husband Chen Zhiqiang also arrived home and took over the spatula. She handled the clams, and Chen Zhiqiang cooked the noodles.
