Soon, a pot of light and delicious clam and tomato noodle soup was ready. The family of three sat around the table to eat. She didn’t use too much salt or oil, and their daughter ate with great relish. After the meal, they rested for ten minutes, and Chen Zhiqiang cleaned up the dishes. Song Yajing changed herself and her daughter into thin jackets that were easy to move in, took the scallions she had bought in the evening out of the shoe cabinet, and put her daughter’s water bottle and small towel into the bag.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family lakeside walk
description: The family of three went out for a walk along the trail around Yundang Lake. Their daughter Chen Lexuan ran and hopped ahead while Song Yajing walked side by side with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She pulled up the health diary on her phone and showed Chen Zhiqiang this week's diet records. After looking at it, he smiled and drew a thumbs-up on her diary with his finger. She took the opportunity to say, In the second week I want to start adding some exercise—will you keep an eye on me? Chen Zhiqiang readily agreed: Sure. I'll clean up after dinner, and you go do your workout. They chatted as they walked and completed a walk of about 25 minutes.
location: Yundang Lake Trail (near Hubin South Road), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time: bath and bedtime story.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing first bathed her daughter, dried her off, and changed her into pajamas. Keeping her promise, she told her daughter the story "The Undersea Squad," and the little one listened with great interest. Around 20:30, her daughter fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening self-care and reflective reading.
description: After quietly tiptoeing out of her daughter's bedroom, Song Yajing washed up, removed her makeup, and changed into comfortable pajamas. Then she did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch on the yoga mat, followed by a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation using the Tide app, focusing on "letting go" and "acceptance" to clear away the day's fatigue and hidden worries about her health. Afterwards, she sat down in the study and opened her black hardcover health diary. She neatly wrote down the date and her weight (49.7kg), recorded the day's meals and mood, and added a special note: "Successfully booked an appointment with Dr. Wang for 9:30 tomorrow morning. Got strong support from Aqiang; starting the second week of the plan." She also wrote in the to-do list, "Bring all documents, arrive 15 minutes early." Finally, she returned to the bedroom, picked up the book Allergies and Diet from the bedside table, and flipped through a few pages, mainly about how to improve one's constitution through diet, which fit well with her current health plan.
location: Home: No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bathroom, study, bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also got into bed. She chatted briefly with him about their respective plans for the next day, then turned off the bedside lamp. With her eyes closed, Song Yajing felt, in the darkness, the peace of family life and the certainty brought by her own planning. Accompanied by the faint sound of rain outside the window, she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake-up stretch and breakfast preparation
description: The alarm went off gently at 7:00. Yajing did 10 minutes of simple stretching in bed, moving her neck and shoulders, then washed up and changed into comfortable loungewear. Afterwards, she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she fried sunny-side-up eggs, toasted whole-wheat bread, and paired them with milk and lemon water. She also warmed an extra glass of milk for her daughter. Her husband Aqiang took care of his own breakfast.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Woke up daughter Xuanxuan at 7:35, quickly washed her face and tied her little braids, rode an electric scooter along Hubin South Road then turned onto Gucheng West Road, arriving at Siming Experimental Kindergarten around 7:48. Watched her wave goodbye to the teacher, and reminded her to eat properly at lunch.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy vegetables on the way home and prepare
description: It took about 5 minutes by electric bike from the kindergarten to the Eighth Market. She went straight to the familiar vegetable stall, bought a bunch of spinach, two asparagus spears, and a box of chicken breast, and paid by scanning WeChat's QR code. After returning home, she quickly put the vegetables in the fridge and checked again the document folder prepared last night; it contained her medical insurance card and the physical examination report from May 12. Her phone battery was at 90%, so she plugged in a power bank to ensure it wouldn't run out while she was out.
location: The Eighth Market at No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Go to the clothing store to hand over the work
description: She left home on an electric bike and arrived at 'Serenity Wardrobe' on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street at 8:25. The shop assistant Xiao Mei was already cleaning. Yajing told her she had to see a doctor in the morning and would come to the store later. Together they checked the previous day's cash sales and WeChat receipts, confirmed everything was correct, and Yajing reminded her that the goods from Guangzhou would probably arrive in the afternoon, so she should unpack and count them first.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went to the community hospital for a consultation and met with the doctor.
description: At 8:30, she left the store and rode an electric bike to the Jiangtou Subdistrict Community Health Service Center in Huli District. Arriving 20 minutes later, she took a number at the self-service machine and waited for her appointment, scrolling through outfit-sharing posts on Xiaohongshu on her phone. At 9:25, she was called into Dr. Wang Mingyuan's consultation room. Dr. Wang pulled up her health records and patiently explained that the breast nodule on her physical examination report was benign and related to mood, stress, and diet. He recommended a color Doppler ultrasound every six months, practicing meditation, and regular walking every week. The twenty-minute conversation put Yajing completely at ease.
location: Jiangtou Street Community Health Service Center, No. 331 Taiwan Street, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home and make a healthy relaxation plan
description: At 9:50, I left the community center and rode home by bike, feeling much more relaxed. After arriving home at 10:00, I sat on the living room sofa for a while, took out my planner, and solemnly wrote down “take a 30-minute evening walk three times a week (with Aqiang)” and “10 minutes of meditation before bed every night,” then set phone reminders. After that, I got ready to return to the store.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop and review the financial situation for the past half month.
description: She left home at 10:05 and arrived at the store on her electric bike at 10:15. She opened the Excel spreadsheet on her computer and began checking the revenue, costs, utility bills, and other expenses from May 1 to 15. During the check, she found a corporate account expense that didn’t match, so she immediately contacted Lin Xiaofeng, the account manager at ICBC, via WeChat. After verification, he helped adjust the erroneous entry in the system, and the problem was quickly resolved. With the accounts clear, she felt confident about the performance of the first half of the month.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Low-sugar lunch and adjusting next week's meal plan
description: At 12:00, I used the microwave in the shop's rest area to cook a simple meal — boiled chicken breast, spinach salad, and half a whole-wheat bun. After eating lunch, I leaned back in the rattan chair and rested with my eyes closed for 15 minutes. Then I scrolled through my saved low-sugar recipes on my phone, planned next week's menu in my notebook, and, based on the first week's body feedback, decided to add more leafy greens and high-quality proteins such as shrimp and sea bass. I wrote tomorrow's shopping list for the Eighth Market on a sticky note and pasted it on the back of my phone case.
location: Rest area, Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receiving customers and interacting with the online community.
description: Xiaomei returned to the store at 1 p.m. Two young female customers came in. Yajing warmly received them, recommended the new French-style dresses based on their figures and temperaments, and paired them with necklaces. After trying them on, they were very satisfied and made a purchase. After seeing the customers off, she posted photos of today's adjusted display (the green vitality corner) in the store's customer WeChat group, with the caption: "New low-saturation pieces are here. Welcome to all beauty-loving ladies to come try them on this weekend ~" and quickly received several likes.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon sales and preparations for the evening lecture.
description: There were not many customers in the afternoon. Yajing checked her phone battery (fully charged) and storage space to ensure a smooth livestream in the evening. At 14:30, Sister Zhang, the owner of the shoe store next door, came by to chat about recent foot traffic and ideas for the store renovation. At 15:00, she charged the power bank to full, set up the phone mount, and tested the angle. At 16:00, she began closing tasks: tidying the disheveled shelves, counting the clothes in the fitting room, checking today's revenue with Xiaomei, and reminding her to wait until she returned before closing to adjust the fitting room lighting together.

participant.name: Sister Zhang
participant.relation: The proprietress of the shoe store next door.

location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and go home
description: At 16:35, she left the store on an electric bike and arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten just in time for dismissal. Xuanxuan was delighted to see her mother and excitedly showed off the drawing she made today, "Rainbow and Mommy." Yajing held her hand, thanked and said goodbye to the teacher, and the mother and daughter rode home together, with Xuanxuan chattering all the way about funny things at school.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner and preparing for a walk
description: When she got home at 17:45, her husband A Qiang was already back from work. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of steamed sea bass, and he was stir-frying shrimp with the asparagus bought that morning. Yajing helped cut up a plate of fruit. The family of three sat down to dinner on time at 18:00. At the table, Yajing shared the good news from the doctor, and A Qiang was very happy too. Their daughter suggested going to the lake to see the small fish, and the whole family agreed to take a walk after dinner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk along Yundang Lake.
description: At 18:30, the family of three went out and walked 5 minutes to the Yundang Lake trail (the entrance section on Hubin South Road). The evening breeze was gentle; the daughter ran happily ahead while Yajing and Aqiang strolled side by side. Yajing noted in her phone's health diary: 30-minute evening walk completed. Aqiang gave her a thumbs-up, and she felt warm inside.
location: Yundang Lake Promenade (Hubin South Road entrance section), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home, wash up, put daughter to sleep, and personal preparation.
description: Arrived home at 19:00. Yajing bathed her daughter and changed her into pajamas. At 19:20, she sat by her daughter's little bed and read the story Different Carmela until she fell sound asleep at 19:40. After that, Yajing quickly brushed her teeth, washed her face, applied moisturizer, changed into outdoor clothes, and made herself a cup of rose tea to take to the shop.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the store to watch the online lecture and organize notes.
description: Left home by bike at 19:55 and arrived at the shop at 20:00. Xiaomei had already prepared the computer. Yajing set up her phone on the tea table in the rest area, opened the paid livestream link from the Hangzhou Garment Association, put on Bluetooth earphones, and listened attentively as a well-known buyer explained fall/winter trends such as low-saturation color schemes, functional fabrics, and retro silhouettes. While listening, she jotted down keywords like 'oatmeal', 'recycled fiber', and 'padded-shoulder blazers' in her notebook and screen-recorded the whole session on her phone. After the lecture, she organized clear notes based on the recording, such as adding machine-washable silk substitutes to the product selection direction and focusing on sand and gray-blue tones for colors.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store lighting renovation and closing-up for the day.
description: At 21:15, after turning off some of the shop lights, Yajing and Xiao Mei divided the work and replaced the old cool-white bulbs in the fitting room with the warm-yellow LED bulbs they had bought. When the lights came on, the whole fitting room became soft and warm. Xiao Mei happily said she no longer needed a filter for selfies. The two also moved the artificial pothos stand to make the overall layout more harmonious. Then they checked that everything was back in place, locked the cash drawer and the fitting room door, said goodbye to Xiao Mei at 21:50, and closed the rolling shutter.
location: Fitting room of Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home, meditating, and going to sleep
description: Rode home by bike at 21:50, arrived at 22:00, and Aqiang was already asleep. Yajing quietly washed up, then sat cross-legged on the bed, opened the Tide app, selected the 'Mindful Breathing' meditation course, and meditated for 5 minutes. After finishing, she recorded today's weight of 49.8kg and a mood score of 8, then turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully at 22:30 with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and low-sugar breakfast
description: Song Yajing got up when the alarm went off, did five minutes of breathing meditation, washed up, changed into home clothes, and prepared a low-sugar breakfast with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, eating boiled eggs, oatmeal porridge, unsweetened soy milk, and whole wheat toast. She also used her phone to confirm the time for picking up and dropping off her daughter and reviewed the key points of the lecture.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Send daughter to school and buy oolong tea.
description: Song Yajing woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her wash up, get dressed, and put her hair in a ponytail, then rode an electric scooter to take her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After greeting the teacher and saying goodbye, she went on the way to the Jianfu Convenience Store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy unsweetened oolong tea and daily nuts.
location: From the residential complex at No. 82 Shangu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and then to Jianfu Convenience Store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road.

name: Walk to the store and start work
description: After parking her e-bike at home, Song Yajing walked to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Along the way, she absorbed the street atmosphere and used her phone to reply to supplier Susan in Guangzhou on WeChat, confirming that the new styles were being delivered.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (walking from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street to No. 56 Zhongshan Road)

name: Arrived at the store to prepare for opening.
description: Song Yajing arrived at the Serenity Wardrobe store, unlocked the door and aired the room, changed into her work clothes, and prepared for opening with the shop assistant Xiaomei: wiping the counter and mannequins, cleaning the shelves, steam-ironing and arranging new styles, and adjusting the window-display mannequins.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organizing fashion trend notes
description: The store was temporarily free of customers, so Song Yajing sat behind the counter and reviewed the screen recording of the Hangzhou Garment Association's autumn/winter trend lecture from last night. Combined with her handwritten notes, she reorganized them in her notebook with a highlighter, summarizing them into four sections: key colors, core fabrics, silhouette trends, and product selection suggestions. She focused on recording information such as haze blue, Ancora red, velvet, tweed, and shoulder-padded suits.
location: Counter area inside Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discuss procurement direction with the store staff.
description: Song Yajing clipped her organized notes into the purchasing folder and pointed out to Xiaomei the key selection points, such as low-saturation colors and retro silhouettes, asking her to keep an eye out for such styles on the next trip to Guangzhou Shisanhang. Xiaomei reported customers' demand for Morandi-color knitwear, and the two had an efficient brainstorming session.
location: Workroom in the Jingxin Wardrobe store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning business and serving customers.
description: During the morning business hours, Song Yajing served a young female office worker. Based on her occupation and skin tone, she recommended high-waisted wide-leg trousers with an off-white silk blouse. The customer was satisfied and bought the whole set. Xiaomei handled the payment and wrapping. In a break, Song Yajing replied to the supplier on WeChat and confirmed that the new styles would arrive at the store in the afternoon.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Low-sugar lunch and rest
description: After the customer rush passed, Song Yajing ate her own chicken breast vegetable salad and whole wheat toast in the store's rest area, scrolled through Xiaohongshu to save organization and recipe notes, and then closed her eyes to rest for 10 minutes after the meal.
location: Rest area inside Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business: receiving and sending express deliveries and online orders.
description: The courier delivered three boxes of new arrivals. Song Yajing and Xiaomei unboxed and checked them for defects. Song Yajing took a photo of a misty-blue retro A-line skirt in particular and posted it to the store's WeChat group and Moments to promote it. A regular customer asked about the size. While replying to the customer, she guided Xiaomei to iron the new arrivals and hang them up.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Purchase sports equipment
description: Taking advantage of a lull in the store, Song Yajing rode her electric bike to Jinbu Sports store at No. 38 Tiyu Road, Siming District, picked out a 6mm thick anti-slip rubber yoga mat (rubber pink) in the yoga section, and tried on and bought a pair of black-and-white walking shoes with good rebound in the walking shoe section.
location: Jinbu Sports Store, No. 38 Tiyu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase a week's worth of low-sugar healthy ingredients.
description: Song Yajing brought her newly purchased equipment, rode an electric bike to the Eighth Market, and according to the shopping list bought spinach, broccoli, tomatoes, scallions, basa fillets, and octopus. Then she went to Xiashang Minxing Supermarket (No. 76 Xi'an Road) near Lujiang Road to buy boxed chicken breast, tofu, sugar substitute, and ketchup.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Xiashang Minxing Supermarket, No. 76 Xi'an Road, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store to handle work
description: Song Yajing returned to the store, temporarily stored the ingredients and exercise gear in the cabinet under the counter, then turned on the computer to handle customer inquiries and after-sales issues in a focused manner, sorted out pending orders and sent them to the supplier, and reminded Xiaomei to recommend new styles for tomorrow's regular customer appointment.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: Song Yajing closed the store on time, rode her e-bike to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Her daughter showed her a picture she painted in art class, and Song Yajing encouraged her and mentioned her new shoes.
location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home and parent-child time in the neighborhood
description: Song Yajing took her daughter home, put the fresh ingredients in the refrigerator, and put away the yoga mat and walking shoes. She put on her new walking shoes, took Xuanxuan to the community garden downstairs for a walk, told her stories, played on the slide with her, and enjoyed mother-child time.
location: Inside the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and in the complex garden

name: Family low-sugar dinner
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and took the initiative to cook. Using the ingredients Song Yajing had bought, he made a low-sugar version of chicken breast with broccoli and stir-fried mushrooms, and tomato tofu soup, with brown rice. The family of three sat around the table, chatting about the day's shopping and the new arrivals at the store. Song Yajing reminded her husband to pick up their daughter the next day and mentioned her own community activity.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk along Yundang Lake.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing and her family of three walked to the Yundang Lake trail, entered from the Hubin Middle Road entrance, and strolled along the lake for about forty minutes. Song Yajing shared lecture notes and purchasing ideas with her husband, while her daughter collected leaves by the lake.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Hubin Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Help daughter bathe and soothe her to sleep
description: Back home, Song Yajing helped her daughter take a bath, change into pajamas, and brush her teeth. Then she leaned by her daughter's bedside, read her the picture book Swimmy, and gently patted her back to help her fall asleep.
location: Bathroom and daughter's bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal nighttime relaxation and health review
description: After removing makeup and washing up, Song Yajing did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the new yoga mat in the bedroom, then used the aromatherapy diffuser with lavender essential oil and did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation via the Tide app. Afterward, in the study, she opened her health diary, recorded her weight, diet, and step count, and briefly reviewed her day.
location: At home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: main bedroom and study.

name: Learning and relaxing before bed
description: Song Yajing lay in bed reading 'Allergies and Diet,' learning about the antihistamine effects of vitamin C and quercetin, and chatted with her husband Chen Zhiqiang about tomorrow's arrangements and exercise plan.
location: Master bedroom bed in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: At 22:30, Song Yajing turned off the lamp, exchanged goodnights with her husband, adjusted her sleeping position, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom bed in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The alarm went off right on time. I first checked the kindergarten notifications on my phone and confirmed there were no special activities today. I gently woke Xuanxuan and helped her put on the uniform we had picked out yesterday. Then I changed into loose, comfortable loungewear and headed to the kitchen to start a new day.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing breakfast and packed lunch
description: Aqiang had already warmed the milk. I took over the kitchen and prepared a low-sugar meal: scrambled eggs with spinach and whole-wheat toast, plus a cup of sugar-free Greek yogurt with blueberries for each of Aqiang and myself. Meanwhile, I chopped the broccoli and chicken breast that had been washed the night before, packed them into lunch boxes, and planned to take them to the shop for lunch. I deliberately checked my small handbag and confirmed that a small pack of daily mixed nuts and an apple were both there.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: The whole family got ready and headed out. Holding Xuanxuan's hand, I walked along Gucheng West Road to the kindergarten, about 15 minutes. On the way, she excitedly told me that today's handicraft class would draw “My Dad and Mom”. I encouraged her and agreed to hear about what she drew during the evening walk. After a brief chat with the teacher at the kindergarten gate, I watched her skip into the school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and energy replenishment
description: It takes about 10 minutes to walk from the kindergarten to the store on Zhongshan Road. When I passed the convenience store at the entrance to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, I stopped and bought a cup of unsweetened iced Americano. I needed this coffee to start my day’s work, and I also saved the oolong tea I had brought in my bag for the afternoon.
location: Zhenhai Road Metro Station Convenience Store, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store opening preparation and renovation confirmation.
description: After arriving at the store, I cleaned up with Xiaomei and checked yesterday's sales data. I confirmed with Xiaomei again the details of the afternoon renovation plan: which old iron shelf to dismantle, which wall to install the newly purchased light-colored wooden shelves on, and which main styles to rearrange. Then I started organizing today's new small accessories and sorted them by color.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning business and online communication.
description: In the morning, a few tourists came into the shop to browse. I greeted them warmly and recommended several dresses suitable for early summer in Xiamen. Between serving customers, I sent a WeChat message to Susan, the supplier from Guangzhou, to confirm the colors and size chart of next week's new styles. During that time, I felt slightly hungry and dizzy. I immediately took out a few cashews from my bag and ate them, and the discomfort quickly eased, which made me secretly glad I had prepared.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Low-sugar lunch and short break
description: Using the induction cooker in the store, she quickly stir-fried the broccoli and chicken breast from the lunchbox and seasoned them simply, then had them with a cup of instant sugar-free tomato vegetable soup. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon's physical work.
location: Rest area at Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon operations and preparation work.
description: The afternoon foot traffic was indeed light; only a regular customer, “Vivian,” came to pick up her ordered clothes, and we chatted a little about the lipstick shade she had just bought. Using this free time, Xiaomei and I cleared all the clutter from the old iron shelf and moved the new shelves and tools to the designated spots, completing the preliminary preparations for the renovation.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store soft furnishing renovation
description: Core task started! Xiaomei and I worked together to take down the metal shelves with peeling paint and move them to the storage room. Then we brought out the light-colored wooden boards we had bought two days earlier and installed them layer by layer according to the wall dimensions. I directed and fine-tuned the positions to make sure the boards were level, while Xiaomei held them on the side and carefully checked with a spirit level. After installation, we displayed the merchandise in a sparser, more layered way. The corner instantly became bright and cozy — the effect was immediate!
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking photos for documentation and wrapping up
description: After the renovation was completed, I excitedly took several photos with my phone from different angles. After carefully selecting, I posted a WeChat Moments update: “A new shelf, and a new mood to match. Summer should be fresh and clean!” I also made a point of tagging Aqiang. Then I tidied up the tools and swept away the dust and debris from the renovation site.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organizing data and closing the store
description: Checked today’s sales figures and recorded them. Confirmed two online orders and marked them for shipment tomorrow. Sent Aqiang a WeChat message: “The store renovation is done. I’m heading to Bashi Market to buy groceries right away. Don’t forget to pick up Xuanxuan!” After receiving his cute “OK” emoji reply, I closed the shop door and turned off the power with peace of mind.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Purchasing fresh ingredients
description: After closing the shop, I walked to the Eighth Market with familiar ease. At the usual stall, I bought fresh spinach and button mushrooms, planning to stir-fry them at night. I also saw local cherry tomatoes and, thinking Xuanxuan likes them, bought some as well. I also grabbed a small piece of soft tofu to make soup with tomorrow morning.
location: No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Eighth Market

name: Arriving home and sharing the joy
description: I walked home carrying groceries. Aqiang had already picked up Xuanxuan and was at home. As soon as I walked in, I couldn't wait to take out my phone and show the father and daughter the photos of the renovated store. Xuanxuan exclaimed, "Mom, the store looks beautiful!" Aqiang also looked carefully and said approvingly, "Not bad. It looks much more open and airy, and the lighting looks good too."
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Smoothly coordinated dinner preparation
description: A Qiang took the lead as the head chef, while I was responsible for washing and cutting vegetables. The two of us worked well together and quickly finished dinner: stir-fried spinach with garlic, stir-fried pork slices with mushrooms, steamed sea bass (A Qiang's signature dish), and brown rice. Xuanxuan was playing with her LEGO in the living room, and the kitchen was filled with the sizzling of cooking and our soft chatter.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and family chat
description: The three of us sat around the table eating. At the table, I shared in detail the funny stories from the afternoon's shop renovation, such as the screw being screwed in the wrong direction and Xiaomei almost getting hit on the foot by a wooden board, which made them laugh. Aqiang then talked about the trouble he encountered today when the company tested the new system. Xuanxuan also described with relish the painting she drew called "Mom and Dad holding hands with me," full of childlike innocence.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk by the lake
description: After putting on the new walking shoes, the three of us set out for a stroll. Today we deliberately took a new route, walking farther along the Yundang Lake trail. The early summer evening breeze carried the moisture of the lake, feeling especially pleasant. The lake glittered under the remaining sunlight and the newly lit lights—the scenery was much more beautiful than in the residential area. Xuanxuan hopped and skipped ahead while Ah Qiang and I chatted about next week's plans. After about 30 minutes of walking, we were slightly sweaty, feeling relaxed and refreshed.
location: Lakeside walkway at Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Daughter's bedtime wash-up and bedtime story.
description: After the walk, Aqiang went to take a shower first. I bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into her beloved bunny pajamas. Then I picked up the newly borrowed picture book 'The Little Seed' and told her the life story of how a seed goes through the four seasons and finally grows into a flower. Xuanxuan listened intently, and in my gentle voice, her little eyes slowly drooped, her breathing became even, and she fell asleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal washing up and bedtime meditation
description: I gently closed the door and quickly washed up and removed my makeup. Then I went into the bedroom, spread out the pink yoga mat, and opened the "Tide" app on my phone. I followed the guide for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on my breath and letting my thoughts completely pull away from the day's busyness. After that, I did another 10 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches to relieve the soreness from moving the cabinet and the fatigue of the day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Health diary and tomorrow's casual chat
description: I sat down in the study, opened my health diary, and recorded: weight 49.7 kg, diet (as planned), exercise (30-minute family walk + stretching and meditation). Notes: one hypoglycemia warning, resolved with nuts; the store renovation was a huge success. Aqiang came over and we briefly talked about tomorrow's plans: "Tomorrow is Friday, and in the afternoon there's a free handicraft class in the community. I can leave work early to pick up Xuanxuan and take her to it." I nodded in agreement.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime reading and goodnight prayer
description: I got into bed, leaned against the headboard, and opened the book "Allergies and Diet" to read the sections on "post-meal blood sugar fluctuations" and how to stabilize blood sugar by adjusting the order of eating. At 22:00, I turned off the lights on time and silently said a bedtime prayer: Thank the Lord for everything He gave me today, and give thanks for my family's safety and the smooth renovation of the shop. May our whole family rest peacefully in the Lord's love. Then I fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning gratitude and personal preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Song Yajing didn't linger in bed. She did five minutes of deep breathing and a grateful morning prayer, expressing gratitude for life. Then she washed up, put on a comfortable cotton-linen shirt, and got ready for the day.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Take my daughter to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: Song Yajing woke up her daughter Xuanxuan and helped her tie her little pigtails. After the mother and daughter had a simple breakfast together, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on an electric bike, reminding her on the way to do her best in the handicraft class. After dropping her off, she stopped by the Gongyuan South Road market on the corner and bought half a jin of fresh black fungus and a bunch of baby bok choy, preparing for the precisely adjusted dinner that evening.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Commute and store opening preparation

After arriving, she opened the doors and windows for ventilation, checked whether the wooden shelves that she and Xiaomei had renovated yesterday were sturdy, and wiped them clean one by one. Then she boiled water and brewed a pot of cassia seed tea, filling the shop with a reassuring fragrance.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Record a mood and energy fluctuation log.
description: In the morning there were few customers. Song Yajing sat on the sofa in the work area, took out her phone's memo app, and systematically reviewed the changes in her mood and energy over the past three days (May 20 to 22). She compared her feelings before and after starting the low-sugar diet and meditation, and found that she indeed did not get tired as easily as before; during yesterday's store renovation, her energy was very focused. She recorded these observations in detail and wrote the conclusion: "Low-sugar breakfast + midday meditation, steady afternoon energy, not easily irritated."
location: Rest area behind Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Morning store opening and customer maintenance
description: After store assistant Xiaomei arrived, the two divided the work: Xiaomei was in charge of the cash register and tidying up, while Song Yajing focused on reception and sales. Aunt Zhang praised it and chatted with Yajing about making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival, and they agreed to exchange filling recipes another day. Yajing used her phone to capture the warm moment.

Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family of three sat together enjoying tomato fish soup and stir-fried greens. At the dinner table, Yajing excitedly shared the afternoon's filming results with her husband and played the edited video. He gave professional advice on lighting and texture, and asked about Kuaituantuan traffic. Yajing said she would check the data tomorrow, but felt full of expectation.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying my daughter, washing up, and going to bed.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing played house with Chen Lexuan in the living room. At eight in the evening, she bathed her daughter, changed her into pajamas, and then read two picture books about the moon before Xuanxuan fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home living room, bathroom, and daughter's bedroom in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal review, stretching, and plan for the next day
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing returned to the bedroom to check the views of the new-product video on Kuaituantuan. Although it only had a few dozen views, it received two likes and one positive comment, which greatly encouraged her, and she recorded her weight for the day. She did 15 minutes of pre-sleep stretching and meditation, then took out her planner and wrote down the next day's key tasks: reply to Susan to confirm the reorder, do community interaction based on the video data, and tidy the fitting room. After that, she washed up and applied skincare products.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Lying in bed, Song Yajing opened the podcast app and played the first episode of "Survival Guide for Niche Brands" subscribed that morning, turning down the volume as background sound. She savored the warm feeling of the chance encounter with Aunt Zhang during the day, and after drowsiness surged, she turned off her phone and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woke up before the alarm clock; the sunlight through the curtain gap promised a sunny day. Lying in bed, I checked the weather on my phone: sunny, 28-34, with a brief hot thunderstorm in the afternoon. After confirming I had the large folding umbrella, I got up gently and went to the bathroom to wash up. After washing up, I went into the kitchen, quickly fried a sunny-side-up egg, heated milk, and prepared whole wheat toast with fried egg for myself. I filled my daughter Xuanxuan's children's water bottle with warm water, folded up the large folding umbrella from the balcony and placed it on the entryway cabinet, making sure I wouldn't forget it when going out.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up daughter and take her to kindergarten
description: Gently woke up daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her pigtails. Mother and daughter walked hand in hand along Zhenhai Road to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan mentioned that the watercolor painting she drew yesterday was praised by the teacher, and Yajing promised to take a good look at it in the evening. At the kindergarten gate, she chatted briefly with Teacher Zhang on duty and watched Xuanxuan run into the classroom.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Walked from the kindergarten to 'Jingxin Wardrobe' at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Passing the convenience store at the Zhenhai Road Metro Station exit (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road), she went in and bought a bottle of iced mineral water, saving it for the hot afternoon. After arriving at the store, she opened the door for ventilation with Xiaomei, who had arrived early, and wiped down the mannequins and shelves. Based on yesterday's review of the online product selection, she placed the classic and minimalist pieces for today's key display in the most visible spots and explained today's display priorities to Xiaomei.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online review and inventory check.
description: Turning to a new page in the ledger on the counter, she systematically reviewed this online trial-and-error on Kuaituantuan. She clearly wrote down a few core lessons: 1) differences in customer profiles; 2) online sales need independently planned basic styles; 3) promotion needs content to generate desire. She marked the 2,000 yuan loss clearly in the ledger as "necessary online tuition." Then, in line with the new approach, she opened the Kuaituantuan backend and the computer inventory sheet, checked the online stock one by one, picked out simple basic styles whose sales were showing signs of recovery, marked the styles for which she needed to ask Guangzhou supplier Susan via WeChat about restocking, and recorded them in her phone notes.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and team communication
description: Closed the shop and took a break, and walked with Xiaomei to the familiar satay noodle shop (No. 153, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street). After eating the satay noodles with extra toppings, she shared with Xiaomei the product-selection lessons and adjustment directions from the morning's summary. Xiaomei said she would fully cooperate with the future content marketing efforts. The two chatted as they ate, in a congenial atmosphere.
location: No. 153, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store duty and customer reception
description: Returned to the store and started the afternoon business. When there weren't many customers, she put together three simple, fresh summer outfits in the store and took a nine-grid photo set in natural light, planning to edit and post them to WeChat Moments and her community group in the evening. Customer traffic increased in the afternoon. Several regulars came in, and she skillfully recommended new arrivals to them. She helped one customer find wide-leg pants that make the legs look longer and explained styling tips. One customer was the mother of Xuanxuan's classmate. During casual conversation, she learned that a new rooftop camping-style café had opened nearby, and Yajing noted down the name.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: End-of-shift handover and parent-child lakeside stroll.
description: After handing over the afternoon reminders to Xiaomei, she left work a bit early. While walking home, she sent a message to her husband Aqiang. When she got home, Aqiang had already picked up Xuanxuan from kindergarten, and she was playing with building blocks in the living room. Yajing took a large folding umbrella, then took over from Aqiang, who went out to the supermarket to buy groceries. Afterwards, Yajing took the scooter and the big umbrella and led Xuanxuan out, walking along Hubin South Road to the Yundang Lake trail. In the early summer evening, a cool breeze blew by the lake, and Xuanxuan rode the scooter ahead to lead the way. Yajing opened a podcast and listened to an episode of Random Wave about women’s entrepreneurship. Passing a small flower bed, Xuanxuan pointed out the purple jacaranda blossoms fallen on the ground to her mother. Yajing crouched down to take photos and sent them to her close friends’ group. After strolling along the lake for about 40 minutes, the two walked home along the same route.
location: Lakeside trail along Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and quality time
description: When she got home, A Qiang had already made steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, Yajing mentioned that Xuanxuan's watercolor painting had been praised and suggested that the whole family create a family storybook together. A Qiang happily praised his daughter, and Xuanxuan clapped with joy. The three of them ate and chatted, enjoying a warm dinner time.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Online community operations
description: Taking advantage of a moment when A Qiang took Xuanxuan into the living room to watch TV, Yajing took out her phone, adjusted the tones of the nine-grid photos she had taken in the afternoon with a photo editing app, wrote a caption, added a location, and posted to WeChat Moments, also sharing it to the “Yajing Lifestyle Store” community. Seeing the likes and questions from several regular customers in the group, she felt a bit more at ease.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Neighbor invited to outdoor yoga
description: Her phone vibrated. It was a WeChat message from her neighbor Zhao Li, warmly inviting Yajing again to do outdoor yoga on the big lawn at Bailuzhou Park at 7 a.m. tomorrow. Recalling the stiffness and embarrassment of her first visit more than a month ago, Yajing no longer resisted and readily replied, “OK, see you tomorrow! Do I need to bring a yoga mat?” They agreed to meet at the community gate at 6:50 tomorrow morning.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Bath time with daughter and bedtime story.
description: She bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and carried her to her little bed. Xuanxuan picked a picture book from the Tom the Little Rabbit series, and Yajing read her the story of Tom learning to ride a bike. After the story, Yajing kissed Xuanxuan's forehead, turned off the reading lamp, and said goodnight.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Evening self-relaxation and planning
description: After the house quieted down, she laid out a yoga mat near the window in the bedroom and sat cross-legged. She opened the Tide app, chose a 10-minute 'body scan' meditation, and relaxed her body one by one from the soles of her feet to the top of her head, feeling the muscles in her shoulders and back gradually release with each breath. After the meditation, she lay on the bed and opened her phone's memo app, quickly organizing today's key points for online product selection into several clear rules. Then she replied to a few private messages, browsed Zhao Li's Moments, saw her sharing a weekend yoga event, and tapped a like.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: Went to the bathroom for a quick wash and changed into comfortable cotton pajamas. She felt both nervous and a little expectant about tomorrow morning's yoga class. She set the alarm for 6:20, put on her eye mask, turned over, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Went to Bailuzhou Park in the morning.

At 6:45, she left the house lightly dressed and drove to Egret Island Park for the morning yoga session. The streets were quiet with little traffic in the early morning, and the breeze carried the fresh scent of grass and trees, making her look forward to the upcoming yoga experience.
location: From Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Bailuzhou Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

She still could not stay steady in Tree Pose and joked that she was as stiff as a board, but with the encouragement of the instructor and Zhao Li, she felt the comfort of stretching and the healing quality of the morning air. After class, the two sat on a bench by the lake drinking water and chatting. Song Yajing admitted that she could not say she loved exercise, but this time it felt better than last time. Zhao Li encouraged her to treat exercise like spending time with an old friend, and the two agreed to try different light exercises in the future. They chatted about daily life in the morning light.
location: Lawn of the Fountain Square in Bailuzhou Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and lakeside benches

location: Jukou Mixed Noodles (Zhongshan Road Branch), No. 28 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

Song Yajing used her phone to process orders in the Kuaituantuan backend, confirmed out-of-stock styles, and messaged supplier Susan on WeChat about restocking. Xiaomei helped with receiving customers. During that time, Song Yajing contacted her husband A Qiang on WeChat, confirmed he did not need to work overtime, and asked him to buy light soy sauce on his way home to prepare braised chicken wings.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

In the afterglow of the setting sun, Xuanxuan bounced on the grass and imitated her mother doing yoga on one leg, making Song Yajing laugh out loud. She shared the funny yoga incident from the morning with her daughter, saying her mother was like a crooked little tree.

location: Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

location: Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

In bed, Xuanxuan snuggled in her mother's arms, listened to her read a new story, 'Pumpkin Soup,' and finally fell asleep with a sweet smile.
location: Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Then she sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for 10 minutes, grateful for the sense of accomplishment from stepping out of her comfort zone, her family's love, and her body. Afterward, she saw the hydrangea photos sent by Zhao Li, replied, turned off her phone, and fell asleep feeling calm and fulfilled.
location: Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Enjoying a relaxed family breakfast.

The outdoor yoga done yesterday at Bailuzhou Park left her thighs and shoulders a bit sore, but her mind felt refreshed. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already cooked rice porridge and fried sunny-side-up eggs. The family sat around the dining table, eating breakfast slowly, while her daughter Xuanxuan excitedly planned to “count flower petals” in the neighborhood.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community (No. 128 Hubin South Road), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

They stopped in front of the blooming crape myrtle and rose flowers, guided her to observe the petals and colors, and counted petals together. They also played the "blow up the balloon" deep-breathing game to see who could make their breath both long and steady. Her daughter's giggles intertwined with the sounds of neighbors walking their dogs, and this feeling of "living in the present" was very healing.
location: Central flower bed in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Afterwards, she checked the real-time weather and put a folding umbrella into her bag.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street (No. 128 Hubin South Road), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Aqiang immediately agreed, saying he could take their daughter to look for small crabs. The family chatted and laughed in the car.

A gentle sea breeze blew, occasionally carrying a drop or two of barely perceptible rain. Daughter Xuanxuan leaned over the side of the boat watching the waves, very excited. The family enjoyed the short sea trip.

She walked alone to an independent café called Vinyl Time, which she had saved long ago and was housed in an old foreign-style building. She ordered a light-roast latte and sat in a rattan chair at the entrance. She put on her earphones, opened a guided mindfulness audio, and did 15 minutes of immersive meditation. The daytime environment was quieter than at night; she could clearly feel each breath and the gradual release of her shoulders and neck, and she felt excellent.
location: Fuzhou? No: 'Vinyl Time' café near Longtou Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Family lunch on Longtou Road, Gulangyu, tasting authentic Fujian cuisine.

The family sat down at a local stir-fry restaurant and ordered sea worm jelly, fried noodles, and white-poached shrimp. Their daughter Xuanxuan got food all over her face and kept asking to go see the kittens outside the shop. The family atmosphere was relaxed and happy.

Her husband Chen Zhiqiang took charge of bringing their daughter Xuanxuan to dig in the sand, chase the waves, and pick up seashells, while Song Yajing sat under a beach umbrella on the shore, feeling the sea breeze and watching their playful figures, her heart full of happiness. She took the opportunity to make some simple notes on her phone for next week's store restocking.

name: Attended Sunday Mass at the Catholic Church on Gulangyu Island.
description: When the time came, her husband continued playing with their child, and Song Yajing quietly walked into the Catholic church alone. The solemnity of the Mass completely calmed her down. After the ceremony ended, she felt an unprecedented peace in her heart.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Lin Xiuying introduced the rules of the Bible reading group and the recent study content. Song Yajing accepted her invitation on the spot, and confirmed that starting from the following Sunday (June 15), she would attend the gathering every Sunday at 9 a.m. Aunt Lin handed her a copy of the Bible Reading Schedule, and she felt a sense of belonging to a faith community. She immediately sent a WeChat message to her husband to share the good news, and her husband replied with a 'thumbs up' emoji.
location: The backyard corridor of Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

At their usual stationery store, Song Yajing let her daughter pick out two dreamy stickers, and then next door at the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City, she bought a few loaves of whole-wheat bread for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: Ferry from Sanqiutian Wharf to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, as well as Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) and 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery (No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road)

The kitchen was filled with the rich aroma of seafood and satay sauce.

The whole family sat around the table, enjoying a dinner full of care and the warmth of everyday life, accompanied by braised beef and small side dishes.

After hearing her daughter's even breathing, she chatted quietly with her husband on the living room sofa about next week's store display updates and her daughter's kindergarten activities.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 South Hubin Road).

name: Wrote in a gratitude journal before bed and fell asleep peacefully.

All of this made today feel full of groundedness and belonging." After writing it, she turned off the light and rested, slowly falling asleep in contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community (No. 128 Hubin South Road), Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, preparations, and family breakfast

In the kitchen she made sandwiches with whole wheat bread, eggs, tomatoes, etc., and spread extra peanut butter for her husband Chen Zhiqiang. At 7 o'clock she woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her pick out a pink dress, and the three of them sat together for breakfast. During this time, Yajing confirmed with her husband the time to pick up their daughter and told him she would come home at noon.

name: Taking Xuanxuan to school and morning records

After meditation, she had a simple meal of whole-wheat bread and a cucumber-tomato salad, then video-called her mother in Quanzhou via WeChat. With her hands gently placed on her chest, she guided her awareness to feel the rise, fall, and softness of her chest. The exhaustion and tension of the past few days dissolved, and the faint dull ache she had felt earlier almost disappeared. She gained a lasting calm.

The doctor performed a manual palpation exam, compared it with the May physical examination report, and told her that her breast hyperplasia was stable and did not require medication. He advised her to maintain regular exercise and a positive mood and to take 400 IU of vitamin E daily.
