description: Holding her daughter's hand and walking home, Xuanxuan shared fun stories from kindergarten along the way. After arriving home, Song Yajing let Xuanxuan play with stickers in the living room, while she took thawed pork ribs and tomatoes from the fridge to prepare cola pork ribs and tomato scrambled eggs. At the same time, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang telling him the follow-up went well and that they would have cola pork ribs for dinner.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family cooking together
description: When her husband Chen Zhiqiang got home, he asked about the follow-up examination results, and Song Yajing told him everything was fine. The two put on aprons and cooked together. Chen Zhiqiang helped blanch the pork ribs, and while busy, they chatted about work and plans for tomorrow. Xuanxuan smelled the aroma in the living room and shouted excitedly.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Dinner for a family of three.
description: The family sat around the table enjoying a hearty dinner, with cola pork ribs, tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and seaweed egg drop soup. Chen Zhiqiang raised his glass to toast Song Yajing's successful follow-up examination. Xuanxuan imitated her father and raised her glass, saying, "Mom is the best," and warmth filled the room.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Parent-child picture book creation
description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang cleared the dishes while Song Yajing and Xuanxuan created a new page for the picture book Xuanxuan and Mom Watch Crape Myrtles on the living room carpet. Song Yajing used a new liner pen to sketch the crape myrtles with water droplets after the rain and a little snail, while Xuanxuan did the coloring. Mother and daughter happily worked out the scene together.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Putting daughter to sleep.
description: Helped Xuanxuan take a bath and change into pajamas, then read her the picture book "Pumpkin Soup" in her little bed. Xuanxuan repeated the sentences along with her. When the story ended, she was yawning repeatedly. Song Yajing kissed her forehead and said goodnight, and her daughter replied in a babyish voice, "Goodnight, Mom. I love you, too."
location: Home, daughter's room, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Personal care, meditation, and gratitude journal
description: Returning to the master bedroom balcony, she took vitamin E as scheduled by the alarm clock, then did 15 minutes of mindful meditation, focusing on breathing and relaxation in the chest, shoulders, and neck. After meditation, she sat at her desk and wrote down three things to be grateful for: good follow-up results, ordering a hearing aid for her father, and warm family time. Then she leaned against the headboard and browsed Xiaohongshu, checking autumn fashion trends and baking videos. She saw a no-bake tiramisu and decided to try it on the weekend.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime washing and skincare routine
description: Song Yajing washed up before bed and put on a hydrating sheet mask to relax. While waiting for the mask, she set an alarm on her phone for 7:30 the next morning. After removing the mask, she applied night cream and felt completely relaxed.
location: Home bathroom, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Lying in bed, she habitually picked up her phone to reply to Wang Jia's message in the close friends group chat about Li Meiling's physical exam next week. Then she turned off the bedside lamp, smiled in the darkness, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: Before the alarm went off, I was already awake. Worried about Xuanxuan's school lottery, all sleepiness vanished. I got up quietly, first heated the milk in the kitchen, boiled two eggs, and toasted whole-wheat bread. Then I went back to the room and softly woke Xuanxuan, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and braided her pigtails. Aqiang also got up. The three of us sat around the table, and I deliberately kept the conversation light, saying the weather was nice today and asking what she wanted for dinner, trying not to touch that tense expectation.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Holding Xuanxuan's hand as we left the house, the sunlight was already a bit dazzling. Along the way she chattered about the little flowers she painted last night and the slide at kindergarten. It took us about ten minutes to walk to the kindergarten gate. I squatted down and kissed her forehead, and watched her skip through the gate, feeling both tender and a little tug at my heart.
location: From No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123, Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk to the shop.
description: It takes about 15 minutes to walk from the kindergarten to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. I deliberately walked a little slower. Passing the north gate of Zhongshan Park, I stopped to watch the seniors doing morning exercises and the young people playing badminton for a while, took a few deep breaths of the fairly fresh air, trying to suppress my unease and tell myself to be ready for any outcome.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store opening preparations and checking the lottery result
description: After arriving at the store, I turned on the air conditioner first and, together with Xiaomei, did a simple mopping and wiped down the shelves. Once everything was in place, I asked Xiaomei to first organize the newly arrived tags in the warehouse. I sat behind the cash register and my heartbeat started to quicken. I opened my phone, found the official query entry for the Siming District Education Bureau, and entered Xuanxuan's registration number and ID number. The few seconds it took the page to load felt like an eternity. When the words "Congratulations! Your child, Chen Lexuan, has been admitted to Siming District No. 1 Private Primary School!" appeared, I was stunned and checked it over and over three times; my eyes suddenly grew hot.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing good news and calming down.
description: I immediately called Aqiang. As soon as he answered, I choked up and said, "Aqiang, we made it! Xuanxuan got in!" On the other end of the line, he was silent for a moment, then an uncontrollable cheer burst out, followed by a string of "That's great! Really?!" We were both so excited on the phone that we were incoherent, and we agreed to go home and celebrate properly in the evening. After hanging up, I sat in the chair, half crying and half laughing. Half of my heart was filled with incomparable joy, and the other half was weighed down by the reality of "tens of thousands of yuan in tuition every year."
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning opening and budget discussion
description: I calmed myself down and perked up to start the morning business. The morning foot traffic was light, and I received two regular customers. Sister Zhang, a regular, came to pick up the dress she had previously ordered altered, and I took the opportunity to recommend the newly arrived silk shirt to her. She tried it on and bought one. While the store was empty, I called Xiaomei aside and told her the news that Xuanxuan had succeeded in the lottery draw. She was happy for me too. I said seriously, "Xiaomei, we need to tighten up the store's purchasing from now on. Let's first clear out this batch of summer basic-style inventory. We'll go over next month's restocking list in detail in a couple of days, prioritizing best-selling items." Xiaomei nodded understandingly and said, "Sis, got it. We'll figure it out together."
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and mood adjustment.
description: At noon today, I didn't feel like eating takeout. I asked Xiaomei to watch the store and walked to the nearby Wu Zaitian snack shop, where I ordered a bowl of satay noodles and a portion of taro dumplings. As I slowly enjoyed the familiar taste, I let the huge emotional swings from the morning gradually settle. While eating, I was mulling over in my head how to broach the budget matter with A Qiang that evening.
location: Wu Zaitian Snack Shop, No. 25 Meihu Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon meditation and bookkeeping
description: Back at the store, there weren't many customers. I opened the shop's electronic ledger and began going through the purchasing and operating expenses so far this month item by item. I listed both paid and unpaid orders, and circled a few unnecessary decorations and tentative orders for autumn clothing with a red pen, putting them aside for now. Seeing the loss on Kuaituantuan last month, I gritted my teeth and reminded myself to remember the lesson of trial and error online.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling online orders and promoting on Moments
description: I focused on processing the Kuaituantuan orders, checked the addresses and styles from yesterday's orders, and replied to a few size questions. Then I took out my phone, picked out several good-quality images from the event posters and product photos I had taken earlier, and wrote a WeChat Moments post: "【Jingxin Wardrobe Summer Lucky Bag】Buy two, get one free! Basic white T-shirt, sun-protection jacket, and wide-leg pants — a versatile three-piece summer set, limited-time bundle special. Limited stock, first come first served~" I attached the photos and the purchase link, and clicked send.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store closing preparations.
description: I asked Xiaomei to get ready to leave a bit earlier. I printed out today's cancelled orders and the list of online orders awaiting shipment, planning to take them home to check in the evening. After locking the shop door, I let out a long sigh. There was a strange feeling in my heart — today, some were happy and some were worried. Our joy also brought new worries, but life has to move on.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: I walked quickly to the kindergarten, arriving just in time for dismissal. In the crowd, I spotted Xuanxuan carrying her little backpack and looking around. I smiled and waved at her. She ran over and threw herself into my arms. I picked her up and whispered in her ear: 'Sweetie, I have good news for you — you can start at your new elementary school!' She widened her eyes, not quite understanding. 'Is it the school with the big playground that Mom told me about?' I nodded hard. 'Yes, that one!' She happily kissed me on the cheek.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and a walk
description: I didn't go straight home. Instead, I took Xuanxuan to nearby Jiaxingyuan Park for a walk. The evening breeze was gentle, and the summer heat was gradually fading. We walked a few laps along the shaded path. I pointed out the new leaves and flower buds on the trees, and showed her the crape myrtle flowers by the roadside. Xuanxuan excitedly picked up a few beautiful fallen leaves and said she wanted to take them home to make bookmarks. Holding her hand, I chatted with her casually about kindergarten, and felt a little more grounded because of this peace.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: After getting home, I washed Xuanxuan's hands and let her read picture books in the living room. I opened the fridge and took out the leftover pork ribs from last night, as well as some tomatoes and eggs, and I also washed the greens. Aqiang had said today he would come back early. I estimated the time: first I put the rice on to cook, cut the tomatoes into pieces, beat the eggs, and after blanching the ribs, I started simmering them.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Husband's return home and collaboration
description: Sure enough, Ah Qiang came back early. As soon as he entered, his eyes and brows were full of smiles. At the entryway, he gave Xuanxuan a big hug, then walked into the kitchen, gently wrapped his arms around my waist from behind, and whispered in my ear, "You've worked hard." I laughed and nudged him with my elbow, "Stop it. Go wash your hands and help me peel the garlic." The family worked together in the kitchen with tacit understanding, and the aroma of dinner, mixed with joy and a trace of solemnity, filled the whole house.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was plentiful, with sweet-and-sour spare ribs and scrambled eggs with tomatoes that Xuanxuan loves. At the table, we deliberately avoided mentioning the tuition fees, keeping all the focus on Xuanxuan. A Qiang put food on her plate and asked her what songs she had learned in kindergarten today. Xuanxuan sang us a newly learned nursery rhyme in her babyish voice, making us laugh heartily. But when A Qiang and I caught each other's eyes, we could both see the concerns in each other's heart that needed to be faced alone.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child picture book time
description: After dinner, I sat on the living room carpet with Xuanxuan and continued drawing our family picture book 'Xuanxuan and Mommy Watch Crape Myrtle Blossoms.' Xuanxuan picked up a pen and drew a five-petaled crape myrtle flower, then drew a tiny version of herself. Aqiang also came over and drew a big-grinning sun in the empty space. Our family of three sat with our heads together, enjoying this last relaxed parent-child time of the evening.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Put daughter to bed.
description: I bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into her pajamas. After she lay down, I read her two goodnight stories. She slowly closed her eyes while hugging her favorite teddy bear. I turned off the desk lamp, sat for a while, and after listening to her breathing become steady, I gently closed the door and walked out.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for the family financial meeting
description: While Aqiang went to take a shower, I took out the ledger reports I printed at the shop today, the family daily expense notebook, and the phone calculator, and laid them all on the small desk. I poured myself a glass of water, took a deep breath, and encouraged myself. I knew the words that followed would not be easy to say, but we had to face it together.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Couple discusses financial plans and sets family budget
description: Aqiang came out of the shower, saw the things on the table, and his expression turned serious. We closed the bedroom door and lowered our voices. I spoke first and frankly laid out the year's new tuition increase, the estimated cost of training classes, and the need to tighten the store's budget. Aqiang listened quietly and, instead of complaining, took my hand and said, 'It's okay, we'll figure it out. I can cut down on weekend gaming and apply for one or two out-of-town company projects. The extra income should help cover part of it.' Looking at his determined eyes, my heart warmed, and I said softly, 'Aqiang, thank you. We'll get through this together.' Then we spread out the family ledger and reallocated everything item by item. We listed the monthly fixed tuition, insurance, and living expenses separately, and went over my clothing store's costs and his commuting and socializing expenses. We decided to set aside 3500 yuan from his salary each month as Xuanxuan's dedicated education fund, and I would make sure the store's cash flow stayed stable and not overspend unless it was an emergency. We encouraged each other: since we had made the decision, we would not regret it.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Integrate budget and records
description: Once the general direction was agreed on, I took out a pen and wrote down the key points of the new budget allocation in the ledger. Aqiang, meanwhile, opened mobile banking on his phone and re-planned several fixed deposits. Our heads came together over the numbers written on the paper; beyond the pressure, what we felt more was the reassurance of fighting side by side.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: On Saturday morning, I woke up at 06:40, a little later than usual. After washing up, I tied my hair into a ponytail. Then I went to the kitchen to fry a sunny-side-up egg, toast bread, and heat milk. At 07:25 I went to wake up my daughter Xuanxuan and told her that today she would go to paint a fruit platter; she responded excitedly. The three of us sat around the dining table eating breakfast and discussed what fruit to paint. After breakfast I helped Xuanxuan put on her small water bottle and art kit, and I also checked my phone, keys, wallet, and power bank. I deliberately put April's medical records and May's physical examination report into my bag, planning to look through them carefully at the shop in the afternoon.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Take daughter to class and stop by the morning market for groceries.
description: I held Xuanxuan's hand and walked to the community art center. On the way, she kept saying she wanted to paint fruit. After taking Xuanxuan to the watercolor classroom at 08:10, I walked to Hujing Comprehensive Market and bought fresh yellowfin seabream, greens, ginger, and scallions. Then I went to the shop "Jingxin Wardrobe" on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to drop off the ingredients, and hurried back to the art center to accompany Xuanxuan for her class.
location: Siming District Community Art Center, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near Hubin South Road).

name: Mother-daughter fruit platter watercolor class.
description: I returned to the art center on time and attended the watercolor class with Xuanxuan. The theme was a still-life painting of a fruit platter. The teacher set out strawberries, oranges, and green grapes. Xuanxuan and I painted side by side; she painted red strawberries and a bright yellow orange that looked like a little sun. I painted a pineapple and thought of my father cutting pineapples back home in Quanzhou. The teacher praised Xuanxuan's imagination, and I was very happy. After class I chose Xuanxuan's work and posted it on Moments with the caption, 'The happy time of mother and daughter attending class together on the weekend.'
location: Watercolor Classroom, Community Art Center, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the shop for lunch after class and discussed the shop budget.
description: After class, I helped Xuanxuan put away her painting tools. She was thirsty and wanted orange juice, so I took her hand and walked along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, where I bought a cup of freshly squeezed orange juice. When we returned to the shop ‘Serenity Wardrobe’, the clerk Xiaomei was eating takeout. I had Xuanxuan draw in the rest area, and while eating takeout lunch (shacha noodles) with Xiaomei, I talked about work. I told Xiaomei that because Xuanxuan was about to enter a private elementary school, household expenses would increase, so the shop's purchasing budget needed to be tightened—no purchases unless necessary, and we would clear existing inventory first.
location: “Jingxin Wardrobe,” Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: At the store counter, checked health records and signed up for an English course.
description: After lunch, Xuanxuan drew in the corner while Xiaomei organized the shelves. I sat back at the counter and laid out my medical records and health checkup report side by side. Seeing 'recommend regular follow-up and maintain emotional stability,' and considering the education fund we had discussed last night, I realized the family lacked risk protection and felt a lingering fear. Later, for the overseas travel goal set at the beginning of the year, I opened my phone and signed up for an online intensive English speaking workshop. The first class was on Saturday evening, July 5. After confirming payment, I set a calendar reminder.
location: “Jingxin Wardrobe” counter, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the shop early to buy baking ingredients and returned home
description: Decided to close the store early and let Xiaomei clean up. I took Xuanxuan on foot to the baking supply store in the Zhonghua City commercial area. Following the macaron tutorial, I chose almond flour and red, green, and yellow food coloring, compared brands and prices, and bought them. The owner gave us disposable piping bags. Then I walked home carrying the ingredients in one hand and holding Xuanxuan's hand in the other. After arriving home, I had Xuanxuan wash her hands, put the ingredients in the kitchen pantry, and started preparing dinner, handling the yellow-winged fish bought in the morning and marinating it with salt and ginger slices.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Handwrote a long letter to her father
description: I washed my hands, took out letter paper and a fountain pen at the study desk, and began writing a letter to my father, Song Minghui, in my hometown of Quanzhou. In the letter, I honestly expressed how much it hurt to see his hearing declining and my fear of my parents growing old. I mentioned the memory of him cutting pineapple and urged them to take care of their health. After finishing, I sealed it in an envelope, ready to mail tomorrow together with the hearing aid.
location: Study room at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Building the balcony herb garden together and the watering episode
description: Around 6 p.m., my husband Aqiang got home from work. I suggested we plant mint together. I took out the mint seedlings Xuanxuan had gotten from Aunt Zhang next door, along with new flowerpots and nutrient soil. Aqiang installed the wall-mounted planter bracket while Xuanxuan and I filled the pots with soil and planted the seedlings. After planting, I excitedly kept pouring water, and water quickly pooled at the bottom of the pots. Aqiang laughed, saying I wanted the mint to go swimming. I quickly looked up watering methods on my phone and understood the 'see dry, see wet' principle. Xuanxuan carefully drew a simple watering record chart and stuck it next to the flowerpots. This little episode made us all laugh.
location: Balcony at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and the decision to take on the French macaron challenge
description: For dinner, Aqiang and I cooked together. I made steamed yellowfin seabream in soy sauce and stir-fried greens with garlic; Aqiang made tomato and egg soup. The three of us ate and chatted. Xuanxuan excitedly described her watercolor class in detail, and Aqiang praised the mint on the balcony. After dinner, Aqiang took Xuanxuan to watch cartoons, while I sat at the dining table scrolling through the baking group on my phone. When I saw Chef Chen's finished French macarons and tutorial, I was excited and replied in the group that I wanted to take on the challenge. Then, following the tutorial, I listed the ingredients I needed. I found that I had already bought almond flour and food coloring, but still lacked powdered sugar, egg whites, and granulated sugar, so I planned to go to the supermarket tomorrow to get everything.
location: Home dining room, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Serious discussion about family insurance gaps
description: Aqiang let Xuanxuan watch cartoons in the living room, and the two of us went into the master bedroom and closed the door. I spread the medical records and physical exam reports I had looked at in the afternoon on the bed and seriously said that if either of us collapsed, the family couldn't bear it, so we had to take insurance seriously. Aqiang was silent at first, and after reading the records, he became grave too. We agreed to contact the bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng next Monday to ask about critical illness insurance and women's disease insurance channels, and felt somewhat reassured.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: After the discussion, I went to the kids' room. Aqiang had already told Xuanxuan a story, but she still hadn't fallen asleep. I sat on the edge of the bed and gently patted her, telling her that painting the pineapple today reminded me of Grandpa. Xuanxuan gradually drifted off to sleep to the sound of my soft voice.
location: Child's room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening meditation and taking medication on time.
description: Back in the master bedroom, she took out the vitamin E complex from the pill box, swallowed it, and checked in on the mobile calendar reminder. Then she turned off the main light, left the bedside lamp on, sat cross-legged on the bay window cushion, and opened the Tide app for a 15-minute mindfulness meditation. Reviewing Xuanxuan's painting, the letter to her father, the mint on the balcony, and the insurance discussion, she felt calm and fulfilled. She also noticed that the breast tenderness she had been keeping an eye on recently seemed to have eased.
location: Master bedroom bay window at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Record gratitude journal and plan for tomorrow
description: After meditation, she went to the study and opened her notebook to write in her gratitude journal: gratitude for A Qiang's understanding and support, Xuanxuan's liveliness and cuteness, her parents' health, and her own step toward protecting her family. Then she wrote down her plan for tomorrow: go to Hujing Comprehensive Market in the morning to buy eggs and caster sugar to complete the macaron ingredients, and take Xuanxuan to Jiaxing Garden Park in the afternoon if the weather is good.
location: Study room at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Washing up before bed and chatting with spouse
description: I went to the bathroom to wash up and put on a hydrating mask. When I came back to the bedroom, Aqiang was already in bed. After I lay down, I chatted with him about tomorrow's plans. He said he could take Xuanxuan to the park tomorrow, and I smiled and agreed. We said goodnight and turned off the light.
location: Home bathroom and master bedroom at 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Closing her eyes, she mentally closed the book on everything that happened today. Worries about insurance, longing for her father, and anticipation for macarons all turned into a sense of security about the future and cherishing the present life. She drifted into sleep, feeling fulfilled.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Father's Day morning: waking up, taking medication, packing gifts, family breakfast and farewell
description: Sunlight woke Yajing. After getting up, she drank warm water and took vitamin E, then made a bowl of milk cereal with whole-wheat crackers. She then carefully wrapped the letter to her father and the adjusted hearing aid and placed them at the entryway. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan got out of bed one after another. Yajing suggested that Aqiang take Xuanxuan to the science and technology museum for some special Father's Day time. The family of three had breakfast together. Yajing peeled a boiled egg for Xuanxuan and reminded her to bring her water bottle and snacks. At 8:15, Yajing saw the father and daughter off, hugged them goodbye, and watched until they reached the bus stop.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Walk to Xiamen Ferry Terminal
description: Yajing, carrying her crossbody bag, walked to the ferry terminal against the morning breeze. On the way, she photographed the oleander by the roadside and sent it to the family group, sending holiday greetings to her father.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, No. 15 Lujiang Road, Siming District

name: Take the ferry to Gulangyu.
description: Yajing swiped her card to board the ship, stood on the deck watching seagulls circle overhead, the sea breeze gently blowing, feeling peaceful inside. The boat departed at about 8:45 and arrived at Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu Island 15 minutes later.
location: From Xiamen Ferry Terminal, No. 15 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Gulangyu Island, Siming District.

name: Attend Sunday Mass and receive the spiritual journal
description: Yajing strolled to the Catholic Church on Lujiao Road and attended a solemn Mass, praying for her father's health, her family's safety, and the future of the shop. After Mass, she sat in a circle with members of the Bible reading group to share. Aunt Lin Xiuying asked with concern about Xuanxuan's schooling, and gave Yajing a cream-colored leather-covered 'Spiritual Journal', encouraging her to record things she was grateful for every day. Yajing was deeply moved and accepted it.

participant.name: Member of the Bible study group.

location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take the ferry back and go to the post office
description: Yajing said goodbye to her fellow parishioners, took the 10:30 ferry back to Xiamen, and after getting off the boat walked to the Xinhua Road branch of China Post on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, ready to mail a Father's Day gift.
location: From Gulangyu, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to China Post (Xinhua Road Sub-branch), No. 54 Xinhua Road, Siming District

name: Send out the Father's Day gift and letter.
description: Yajing chose the insured delivery service. Filling out the shipping form, she imagined how pleasantly surprised her father would be when he received the hearing aid. After sending it, she notified her father in the family group chat to watch for the package.
location: China Post (Xinhua Road Branch), No. 54 Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and tidy up briefly
description: Yajing walked home and on the way bought small wontons and greens at the convenience store. After getting home, she washed the breakfast dishes and saw a photo Aqiang had sent of Xuanxuan looking at dinosaur skeletons at the science museum. She smiled with relief.
location: No. 54 Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District

name: Lunch alone and a long afternoon nap

Next, while cleaning the baking tools, she called the insurance broker recommended by her husband's colleague. After the conversation, she scheduled a home visit for Saturday at 10 a.m. to discuss a family critical illness + medical protection package. description: After returning home, Song Yajing started cooking tomato and egg noodles, Chen Zhiqiang helped set out bowls and chopsticks, and Xuanxuan drew with colored pens nearby. Soon three steaming bowls of noodles and dressed cucumber were on the table. Song Yajing raised a glass of green plum wine, while A Qiang and Xuanxuan drank juice. The three clinked glasses to celebrate Xuanxuan's upcoming start of primary school. During dinner, Song Yajing showed everyone the photo of the admission notice and shared her conversation with Vivian about child-rearing. A Qiang said he also wanted to see the time management schedule, and the family chatted and laughed.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: After the meal, showed the stationery and spent parent-child time.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing took out the newly bought Dumbo stationery set, and Xuanxuan's eyes lit up. She sharpened pencils with her, opened the title page, and taught her to write her name. Although the handwriting was crooked, she was very earnest. Song Yajing took a photo of her holding up the new pencil with her phone as a keepsake.
location: Xuanxuan's room at 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Xuanxuan's bath and bedtime story
description: Song Yajing ran warm water for Xuanxuan and helped her bathe and wash her hair. Xuanxuan had fun playing with bubbles. After the bath, she dried her with a large bath towel and changed her into pajamas. Then Xuanxuan climbed into bed, and Song Yajing sat by the bedside reading the picture book The Little Prince, finishing the entire chapter in a gentle voice. Xuanxuan yawned and closed her eyes. Song Yajing tucked the blanket around her and tiptoed out of the room.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Personal grooming and skincare
description: Walked into the bathroom, cleansed face with facial cleanser, applied a hydrating mask, and smoothed body lotion on arms and legs. Hung the apricot-colored dress back in the wardrobe and changed into a comfortable cotton nightgown.
location: Home bathroom, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Journaling, meditation, and socializing
description: In the study, she opened her diary and wrote down how she felt about handling Xuanxuan’s enrollment today, her joy at maintaining her weight, the contentment of catching the quiet fragrance of gardenias, and her thoughts about the family financial adjustments. After writing, she did 10 minutes of meditation on the yoga mat. Then she leaned back on the living room sofa, scrolled through Moments, sent Wang Jia, a childhood friend, a voice message recounting today’s events, and posted a photo of the admission notice in the group chat with her two best friends, announcing that she had officially joined the elementary school parents’ group. The group chat became lively.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Bedtime prayer and preparation for tomorrow
description: She turned off the living room light, lit aromatherapy in the study, and knelt down for a brief bedtime prayer, thanking God that everything had gone smoothly that day and praying for her family and the shop, asking for strength and peace of mind in facing education expenses. Then she took out the light gray suit she would wear tomorrow from the wardrobe and hung it up, placed her commuter bag beside the chair in the entryway, confirmed that her phone alarm was set for 6:55, and went to Xuanxuan's door to listen to her breathing. Reassured, she returned to the bedroom, got into bed, and turned off the light to sleep.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Waking up and morning health routine.
description: The alarm went off, but Yajing did not get up immediately. She felt her chest; the bloated, painful feeling that had lasted for a few days had almost completely disappeared, which put her in a great mood. After getting up, she first drank a cup of prepared warm lemon water, then did 15 minutes of morning stretching on the bedroom carpet, focusing on her shoulders and neck, which were a bit sore from organizing inventory days earlier. Then she stepped on the scale, and her weight stayed steady at 49.4 kg. She nodded with satisfaction and recorded this data in her phone memo.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing breakfast for the child and taking her to school
description: Yajing woke up her 5-year-old daughter Xuanxuan and helped her get dressed. Today's breakfast was the whole-wheat walnut toast she had baked in advance, boiled eggs, and a glass of warm milk. Yajing also quickly ate a serving herself, chatting with Xuanxuan about the primary school registration they had completed yesterday. Xuanxuan excitedly said she was looking forward to the new school. At 7:45, she gave Xuanxuan a folding umbrella, took her hand, and went downstairs. After walking about 8 minutes, they arrived at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She watched Xuanxuan hop in with a small backpack and briefly confirmed with the teacher that there were no temporary pickup arrangements today.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and impromptu shopping.
description: After dropping off her daughter, the sky was somewhat gloomy, and Yajing quickened her pace. On the way, she entered the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road and bought two bottles of mineral water and a box of plain soda crackers. She was thinking about her best friend Meiling, who was going through morning sickness; these crackers would fill her stomach when she was hungry and relieve stomach acid. After paying, she walked for about 8 more minutes and arrived at the shop at 8:25.
location: Zhenhai Road Metro Station convenience store, 35-101 Zhenhai Road

name: Adjusting the store's summer clothing displays and operations
description: When Yajing arrived at the store, Xiaomei had already opened the store and was cleaning. That day, a new batch of dresses from Susan, the Guangzhou supplier, happened to arrive. The two divided the work: Yajing unpacked and checked the clothes for loose threads and flaws, while Xiaomei used the garment steamer to press each dress smooth. Then they rearranged the display window and the main in-store rack by color gradient—from haze blue to deep sea blue—and moved the older, darker-colored slow-moving stock to the clearance area. "When the weather gets hot, the display needs to look lighter and fresher, or customers won't come in," Yajing said to Xiaomei. During a break, she opened the Kuaituantuan backend and found that the return rate for the "Basic Style Lucky Bag" had steadily dropped from 30% in the first week to 5%. She breathed a sigh of relief and said to Xiaomei, "This month's foot traffic and conversion are both good. Next month I'll give you a quarterly bonus." Hearing this, Xiaomei beamed and worked even harder.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Handling online matters and customer communication
description: In the morning, foot traffic gradually increased. Xiaomei was attending to a few customers looking at dresses. Yajing swiftly handled several tasks on her phone: in the customer WeChat group of "Yajing Lifestyle Store," she replied to three regular customers' private messages asking for size recommendations for the new dress styles; she sent a few voice messages to Susan, her Guangzhou supplier, telling her the new styles had arrived and that she had taken display photos, and discussed adding more orders; finally, she glanced at her baking notes and mentally planned her study schedule for after she returned home in the afternoon.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Light lunch and short break
description: Yajing ordered takeout from her usual light-food shop on her phone — chicken breast avocado salad with vinaigrette. She and Xiaomei took turns eating lunch in the shop's rest area. After the meal, she leaned back in the folding chair, closed her eyes, and rested for 15 minutes. She set an alarm for the afternoon study session to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Closed the shop and went home, preparing for the afternoon's study.
description: The shower never did come, and the air felt a bit muggy. Yajing told Xiaomei to take care of the shop on her own (she trusted Xiaomei's reception skills more and more) and walked home herself. She needed the quiet environment of home to focus on studying macaron theory. After arriving home, she changed into loungewear, poured herself a glass of ice water, then dug the oven thermometer and baking notebook out of the cabinet, ready to go.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Macaron theory and systematic learning
description: This was her most important plan of the day. She opened the video tutorial recommended by her baking teacher, Master Chen, and as she watched, she used a highlighter to note key points in her notebook: for Italian meringue, the syrup needs to be cooked to 118; when mixing with the egg whites, use the technique of “pour slowly, whip quickly”; when folding, how to avoid deflating the mixture through the “lift, cut, press” motions. She also pulled out her own oven’s manual and wrote next to the notes: “Before the next attempt, first do an empty bake to measure the difference between the set temperature and the actual temperature.” The whole learning session lasted about two and a half hours. During that time, she paused the video, rewatched the folding technique demonstration three times, and tried simulating the stirring motion with air.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A short afternoon tea break
description: Long periods of highly focused study made her eyes slightly sore and swollen. She got up and walked to the kitchen, brewed a cup of rose tea for herself, ate two soda crackers bought that morning, and then walked to the window to look at the street scene downstairs, letting her brain completely relax for ten minutes.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off to pick up daughter from school
description: Yajing turned off the computer, changed into a pair of light flats, and got ready to go out to pick up Xuanxuan. She had just reached the entrance of the residential community when her phone vibrated. Seeing it was a message from her best friend Li Meiling, she had a feeling.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and comfort pregnant best friend remotely
description: Yajing picked up Xuanxuan at the kindergarten gate. Xuanxuan clamored to buy Frozen stickers. As Yajing was leading her toward the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, her phone vibrated continuously — Li Meiling had sent a long string of tearful voice messages. At the stationery store, Yajing let Xuanxuan pick out stickers while replying to her best friend by voice message: "Meiling, don't rush, listen to me. When I was pregnant with Xuanxuan, I was the same. The first few months I vomited so much that I looked haggard and worn out. Just hold on a few more weeks; once you get past the early-pregnancy hurdle, it'll be fine. I'm free this weekend. I'll bake you some additive-free soda crackers. When you're hungry, have a couple; they should help a bit." After buying the stickers, she held Xuanxuan's hand and walked home. When she ended the voice call, she silently prayed for Meiling.
location: South Gongyuan Road Stationery Store, No. 35 South Gongyuan Road, Phase 2, Yubin City, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up household and baking supplies along the way.
description: On the way home, Yajing stopped by a newly opened 'Neighborhood Select' fresh supermarket near the community. She bought some fresh milk, eggs, and a bunch of scallions, planning to make a scallion omelette for dinner. She deliberately walked to the baking ingredients section, checked the prices of cake flour and almond flour, and mentally calculated that she could buy them directly here when baking cookies for Meiling on the weekend, without having to go far. At checkout, she grabbed a pack of the hawthorn slices Xuanxuan likes.
location: Neighbor's Choice Fresh Supermarket, No. 47 Riguangyan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home, Aqiang had not yet gotten off work. Yajing first had Xuanxuan wash her hands, then started preparing dinner. Using ingredients from the fridge, she stir-fried tomatoes with eggs and garlic lettuce. Aqiang arrived home around 19:10, and the family of three sat around the table, chatting about the day's events while eating. Yajing told Aqiang about Meiling's severe morning sickness, and Aqiang suggested that when she baked cookies on the weekend, she should make extra—they could double as snacks for Xuanxuan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening walk and chatting with neighbors
description: After dinner, the heat gradually faded, and the air after the rain was especially fresh. Yajing suggested taking a walk by the lake, and Xuanxuan happily took her hand and went out. Mother and daughter walked along the Yundang Lake trail for about half an hour. When they passed the blooming gardenia bushes, Xuanxuan leaned in to smell them. Along the way, they ran into their neighbor Aunt Zhang, who was also strolling (she lives at No. 130, Hubin South Road). Aunt Zhang enthusiastically handed Yajing a small bottle of her homemade salted plums, saying, “It's hot out. Steep these in water, and they're the best way to beat the heat. They're good for you too.” Yajing smiled and took it, thanked her over and over, and readily agreed to Aunt Zhang's invitation to go to her home on the weekend to learn the pickling recipe.
location: Yundang Lake Trail on Yanhu West Road, Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and family companionship
description: After their walk, they returned home. Yajing played a spot-the-difference puzzle card game with Xuanxuan for a while, then had her pack her little backpack by herself for kindergarten tomorrow. Aqiang was nearby handling a work document on his laptop. At 21:00, Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, sat by her bed, and told her a picture book story about a little snail persevering in crawling to find its mother, until she fell fast asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and diary organization.
description: Yajing returned to the master bedroom, took a warm shower, and applied a light moisturizing lotion. Then she sat at her desk, opened her hardcover diary, and wrote down her thoughts for the day: 'Week three of the low-sugar diet: my body feels lighter and lighter, and my weight is stable at 49.4 kg. The morning shop display was very satisfying, and the afternoon macaron theory study was mind-boggling but very fulfilling. Meiling's mood worries me; I hope my cookies can help her through this difficult time. In the evening I met Aunt Zhang on my walk, and the sour plums she shared were heartwarming. I want to learn her skill this weekend.'
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime meditation and preparing for sleep
description: After writing in her diary, Yajing turned off the main light and kept only a warm yellow bedside lamp on. Lying in bed, she did 15 minutes of breathing meditation, guiding herself to relax all the day's fatigue, silently feeling grateful that her physical discomfort had disappeared, and praying for Meiling's health. Then she opened her phone and checked tomorrow's (Friday) weather forecast, which showed sunny, and thought that maybe she could arrange an outdoor family activity. At 22:30, she set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow and fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Waking up naturally before the alarm went off, she got out of bed gently. First, she made herself a cup of warm lemon water and played soft music on her phone. After washing up, she prepared breakfast for the family: simple sandwiches made with whole wheat toast (filled with lettuce, fried egg, and low-fat cheese), served with warm milk and a small bowl of fresh blueberries. After A Qiang (Chen Zhiqiang) got up, he watered the potted plants on the windowsill. Xuanxuan (Chen Lexuan) came out rubbing her eyes and coaxingly asked her mother to feed her. The family of three ate breakfast at the table. During the meal, A Qiang mentioned that he would drop by to pick up the newly purchased air purifier filter after work, and reminded Yajing not to be too nervous about the insurance consultation in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Packed Xuanxuan's small backpack and checked that it had a water bottle and spare clothes. Holding Xuanxuan's hand, she went downstairs and walked about 10 minutes from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, Xuanxuan chattered about yesterday's handicraft class, and Yajing responded patiently. At the kindergarten gate, she handed Xuanxuan to the head teacher, reminded her to cover herself with her small blanket during nap time, watched her run happily into the classroom, and then turned and left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store preparation
description: Walk from the kindergarten toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, about 15 minutes in total. The sunshine is just right along the way. At the intersection, she bought a small cup of unsweetened soy milk from a breakfast stall and drank it while walking. At 8:20 she arrived at her clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, opened the rolling shutter door for ventilation, started the cash register system, played light jazz, and prepared for the day's business.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning tidying of the shop
description: Carefully wiped the fitting mirror and the cashier counter, and watered the areca palm plants in the store. Re-hung yesterday's slightly rumpled clothes from customers' try-ons by color. Turned on the computer to check messages on the Kuaituantuan backend, confirmed the shipping status of the lucky bags sent out yesterday, and wrote down the tracking numbers without shipping updates to chase the courier. Xiao Mei arrived at the store at 9:00 sharp. The two had a brief morning meeting. Yajing shared today's work priorities: handling lucky bags in the morning, and the community sharing plan.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Community operations and outfit sharing.
description: Sitting behind the cash register, she opened her phone's photo album and selected five outfit photos of the store's basic styles taken in natural light. She opened her notes app and lightly edited the line from the podcast two days ago: "Building trust with basic styles is like connecting with sincerity—wordless, yet able to give the most reassuring companionship." She added the hashtag "#Today's Outfit Thoughts# Open for Business" and posted it to her Moments and three core customer groups. After posting, her phone chimed with notifications. She patiently replied to each comment. When a young customer asked, "How can you make basic styles stand out?", Yajing took out a white T-shirt and a silk scarf from the store, filmed a 15-second styling demonstration video, sent it over with a text explanation, and the group engagement increased significantly.
location: Workbench, Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Clearance sale and packing of lucky bags.
description: Taking advantage of the light morning foot traffic, Yajing and Xiaomei moved the dozen or so influencer-style dresses returned from Kuaituantuan earlier in the month to the fitting area. They sorted them by color and size, and ironed them one by one. Yajing was in charge of shooting videos on her phone, while Xiaomei quickly used paper cards to note each dress’s suitable body type and styling suggestions. As she filmed, Yajing said: “These styles run small and are suitable for petite girls. Taller or fuller-figured sisters, be careful before ordering — we already have a lucky bag price!” Then they edited and uploaded the videos and photos to Kuaituantuan, set up the lucky bag link for “99 yuan for two pieces, shipped at random,” and emphasized again in the community group that “no returns or exchanges except for sizing issues” to reduce after-sales risk. Under Yajing’s guidance, Xiaomei affixed shipping labels to the two packed lucky bags and waited for the courier to pick them up in the afternoon.
location: Storage area and workbench at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and insurance consultation preparation
description: Xiaomei went out for lunch, so Yajing took out her own light salad (lettuce, chicken breast, cherry tomatoes, and corn) and made do with a simple meal. After eating, she didn't rest. Instead, she took a notebook from her bag and silently reviewed the family's income and expenses, the current investment products (a 50,000-yuan fixed deposit and a small amount of money-market fund), and Aqiang's salary records. On a blank page, she wrote a few key questions she planned to ask the insurance consultant: "How long is the waiting period? What are the waiver clauses? Is the claims process complicated?" At the same time, she used her phone to look up popular-science articles about breast cancer incidence and insurance, building up her knowledge.
location: Rest area at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the café for a face-to-face meeting.
description: She touched up her lipstick in the store, fixed her bangs, and put her notebook and pen into her tote bag. She told Xiaomei, "I'm going to the milk tea shop in the next alley to talk about something. Keep your phone on. Call me if anything comes up. I'll deal with the afternoon customers when I get back." After walking about two minutes, she arrived at the small shop at 225-2 Zhongshan Road, which was quiet and had private booths. She chose a seat in the back, ordered an American coffee, and took a photo to send to Aqiang with the message: "Ready to start!"
location: Milk tea shop at No. 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Meeting with insurance advisor
description: Insurance consultant Li Ming arrived on time. He was articulate and persuasive. Based on the family income and expenditure information Yajing provided (her husband’s monthly income of 18,000 yuan, the store’s average monthly net profit of 12,000 yuan, a monthly mortgage payment of 6,800 yuan, the gap in their daughter’s future education fund, etc.), he quickly prepared two simple proposal documents: Plan A: critical illness insurance with a sum insured of 500,000 yuan (coverage until age 70), annual premium 7,600 yuan; Plan B: a female-specific disease rider (sum insured 200,000 yuan), annual premium 1,500 yuan. Li Ming explained in detail the waiting period (180 days), the mild illness payout ratio (30%), and the premium waiver clause after a critical illness diagnosis. Yajing listened attentively, took out a pen and circled the key points on the proposal, and asked detailed questions such as whether carcinoma in situ was covered. After Li Ming left, she did not leave immediately but sat alone in the café, took a photo of the comparison of the two plans and sent it to Aqiang, with her initial thoughts: “Honey, I think buying Plan A and Plan B together is safer. What do you think?”
location: Milk tea shop at No. 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the store for customer reception and handover.
description: After leaving the café, she walked 2 minutes back to the store, where Xiaomei was serving two young girls looking at dresses. Yajing quietly joined in and, using the store sales techniques she had learned in the morning, successfully recommended a floral print skirt. After the customers left, she and Xiaomei tidied the shelves that had been messed up and packed the two new Kuaituantuan orders placed in the morning. She also reminded Xiaomei that if a fuller-figured customer asked for advice, she should proactively recommend the store's loose-fit T-shirts and A-line skirts, and avoid recommending the fitted styles in the lucky bags.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Closing up the store and preparing to pick up her daughter
description: Yajing began checking the day's accounts and confirmed that the morning's revenue had been recorded. Taking advantage of Xiaomei's absence while she cleaned the fitting room, she checked the group chat messages on her phone and replied to a few questions about styling advice. At 17:10, she turned off the computer and told Xiaomei to close the shop promptly at 6:00 and turn off the water and electricity. She put on her bag, first went to the fruit shop at No. 53 Zhongshan Road to buy a small box of waxberries her daughter loved, then walked toward the kindergarten.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and go for a parent-child walk.
description: When she arrived at the kindergarten gate, Xuanxuan was waiting for parents with her classmates. Seeing her mother, she ran over excitedly and showed off a new drawing of a little rabbit she had made today. Yajing praised her and took her hand to walk home. Instead of going straight home, she took Xuanxuan on two brisk laps along the tree-lined path in the neighborhood, chatting about what happened at kindergarten along the way. When they reached the convenience store in the neighborhood, she took out the bayberries she had just bought. Xuanxuan took them happily and said, "Mommy is the best." Back at the building entrance, Yajing retrieved the day's newspaper and a flyer for a community fitness lecture from the mailbox.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Family dinner preparation and dining
description: After returning home, Yajing first soaked the bayberries in lightly salted water. She quickly started preparing dinner: stir-fried Chinese broccoli, steamed shrimp with garlic and vermicelli (Xuanxuan's favorite), and a large bowl of tomato egg drop soup. After Aqiang came back, he was in charge of chopping and plating the roast duck bought in the morning. Half an hour later, the family of three sat at the table enjoying a warm dinner. At the table, Yajing shared the initial conclusions from the afternoon interview, and Aqiang said they could discuss it in detail in the evening. Xuanxuan picked up a shrimp and said indistinctly: Mom's shrimp is the best!
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanying daughter and putting her to bed
description: After dinner, Aqiang went to wash the dishes, while Yajing played with building blocks with Xuanxuan on the carpet, constructing a 'little house.' At 20:00, Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into cute cartoon pajamas, and then leaned against the headboard to read her two picture books, 'Little Bear Doesn't Brush His Teeth' and 'Guess How Much I Love You.' As Xuanxuan listened, her eyelids began to droop, and by 20:40 she fell asleep with steady breathing.
location: Living room and bedroom of the family home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The couple discussed a protection plan late at night.
description: Gently closing the bedroom door, Yajing spread the two insurance plans on the coffee table. After Aqiang read them carefully, he pondered for a moment, circled Plan A with his pen, and said, 'I am the family's main source of income. If anything happens, it would hit the family the hardest. Buy me 500,000 yuan of critical illness coverage first, then add the female supplemental insurance for you. This combination is more reasonable.' This idea coincided with the suggestion her elder sister Song Yawen had made over the phone. Yajing felt a warmth in her heart. She took out her personal finance ledger from the coffee table drawer and solemnly wrote on a later page, 'Priority: insure Aqiang for 500,000 yuan critical illness + 200,000 yuan female-specific disease coverage for myself.' The two then discussed details such as the payment period (20 or 30 years) and whether to add a policyholder premium waiver for another ten minutes. They reached a preliminary agreement and decided to complete the insurance application online on the weekend.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening meditation, journaling, and going to bed.
description: After the discussion, Yajing felt a sense of solidity she hadn't felt in a long time. She drew the bedroom curtains, lit a lavender aromatherapy candle, sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed, and meditated for 15 minutes. Afterward, she opened her diary and wrote: "June 20, sunny. The insurance plan has taken a key step forward. Being of one mind as a couple makes me feel that we can carry any difficulty together. Today I weigh 49.0 kg, and the breast tenderness is completely gone. A low-sugar diet plus walking is definitely the best decision I've made this year. The lucky bag clearance was tiring but effective. If everything sells out by the end of the month, the cash flow will be healthier. Tomorrow is the weekend. I need to bake soda crackers for Meiling and go to Aunt Zhang's to learn how to pickle green plums. Life is fulfilling and beautiful." After writing, she stretched and took vitamin E with warm water. At 22:45, she lay down, quickly scrolled through her Moments feed, and liked a few interesting posts. At 23:15, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Weekend morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 7:00 on Saturday morning and lay in bed for five minutes enjoying the weekend. After getting up and washing up, she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family: whole-wheat toast with a fried egg and lettuce for A Qiang, with a glass of warm milk; for Xuanxuan, a fried egg pressed into a cute shape with a bear-shaped mold, plus a plate of chilled Chinese bayberries bought yesterday; and a cup of black coffee with a slice of whole-wheat toast for herself. The family of three sat at the table for breakfast, while she peeled bayberries for Xuanxuan and chatted with A Qiang about the general plan for the day. Just then, her good friend Zhao Li called, enthusiastically inviting her to an outdoor yoga class at Egret Island Park. Looking at Xuanxuan and remembering the morning watercolor class, she smiled and politely declined, silently noting the idea of "morning yoga" in her heart.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidy up and walk to the community art center.
description: After breakfast, Aqiang went to the study to handle work emails. You cleared the dishes, helped Xuanxuan change into her favorite floral dress, checked her watercolor class supply bag, made sure the brushes, paints, and paper were all there, and stuffed two bottles of drinking water and a small pack of wet wipes into the bag. At the entryway, you and Xuanxuan put on your sandals for going out, then you took her hand and walked out of the residential complex, along the tree-lined Shanggu Street for about 16 minutes to the community art center on Xiaxi Road. On the way, Xuanxuan chattered about what she wanted to paint today. You smiled and said the theme was Our Weekend, reminding her to think about the bayberries she ate yesterday and the birds she saw in the park.
location: At home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, and on the walk to Xiaxi Road.

name: Watercolor course final parent-child art project
description: At the parent-child watercolor class on the second floor of the community art center, which was the last class of the semester, the theme was 'My Weekend.' You and Xuanxuan divided the work clearly: Xuanxuan used a black line pen to draw the outlines of three small figures holding hands, representing the family of three, and also drew a little cat on the grass; you were in charge of mixing soft colors, and at Xuanxuan's suggestion painted the sky a light mint color—she said it was mint-flavored clouds—and added pink strawberries and purple wildflowers on the grass. When the art teacher passed by, she praised Xuanxuan's bold and expressive lines and encouraged you to maintain this enthusiasm for creating with her. When the class ended, Xuanxuan proudly signed her name in the corner of the painting.
location: Art classroom on the second floor of the Community Art Center, No. 145 Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up a package on the way home and preparing before class.
description: After the class, you walked home with Xuanxuan. Passing the package lockers at the community entrance, you picked up the small bag of cake flour you had ordered online, planning to bake cookies in the afternoon. Once home, you let Xuanxuan play with her toys while you quickly tidied the living room coffee table and boiled a pot of water to welcome the insurance broker.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Signing of family insurance purchase intention
description: Insurance broker Li Ming arrived punctually as scheduled. Aqiang also came out from the study, and the three sat around the living room coffee table. Li Ming took out the formal insurance application and explained the key terms one by one: the 500,000 yuan critical illness insurance with Aqiang as the primary insured, the additional 200,000 yuan women's specific disease insurance for you, and the family's million-yuan medical and accident insurance. You and Aqiang carefully verified the insured persons' information, coverage amounts, waiting periods, and exclusion clauses. After confirming everything was correct, both of you signed the application and agreed to complete the first premium payment through online banking on June 23. The whole process was efficient and smooth.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple lunch
description: After seeing off Li Ming, Aqiang suggested keeping lunch simple. You remembered there was still the satay soup base you had made yesterday in the fridge, so you cooked a pot of satay noodles with shrimp, squid, and bean sprouts, leaving the spice out of Xuanxuan's portion. The three of you sat around the table eating the steaming satay noodles. You took the opportunity to share your watercolor insights with Xuanxuan, while Aqiang remarked that the family protection plan had finally been put in place, which made him feel much more at ease.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday nap and preparing baking dough
description: After lunch, Aqiang took Xuanxuan to the balcony to see the cherry tomatoes he had planted. You quickly cleaned up the kitchen, then took out butter, cake flour, baking soda, milk, and salt from the cupboard and started making the dough for soda crackers. You skillfully mixed the ingredients and kneaded them into a dough, wrapped it in plastic wrap, and put it in the refrigerator to chill, thinking about the afternoon English class.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Baking soda crackers
description: While Xuanxuan was napping, you took the chilled dough out of the refrigerator, rolled it into a thin sheet, cut out bear, star, and flower shapes with cookie cutters, and poked small holes on the surface with a fork. After the oven was preheated, you carefully placed the cookie tray on the middle rack and set it to 190°C for 15 minutes. The kitchen soon filled with the aroma of butter. After baking, you put the cookies on a wire rack to cool. You counted about 30-plus pieces, picked out a few with slightly burnt edges to taste, and they were just the right crispness with a balanced salty-savory flavor.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for English class.
description: You carefully put the cooled cookies into a sealed bag and closed it tightly, planning to send them to Li Meiling in the afternoon or the next day. You glanced at the time—there were still 15 minutes before the English class. You quickly washed your face, combed your hair, cheered yourself up, then went into the bedroom, put on your earphones, and opened your computer to enter the online English workshop meeting room early.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First class of the online English speaking workshop
description: The class started on time, and the theme was 'Hotel Check-in Simulation.' The teacher guided everyone through self-introductions and interaction in English. When it was your turn, you were so nervous that your palms sweated; you quietly muted the microphone and only typed 'I'm ready.' in the chat box. The teacher encouraged you to speak up. You took a deep breath and said to the screen, 'I'd like to check in, please.' Though you stumbled a bit and your pronunciation wasn't very accurate, you finally took the first step. In the second half of the class, you tried repeating the teacher's sentences and answered some simple questions about reservation information in the chat box.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rest after class and packing cookies
description: After the English class ended, you took off your headphones and let out a long breath, feeling both nervous and excited. Walking out of the bedroom, you saw Xuanxuan was already awake and sitting on the sofa rubbing her eyes, so you shared what it was like to 'speak English' with her and teased, "Mommy just said a sentence in English. Do you want to hear it?" You tried saying the phrase 'check in,' and Xuanxuan giggled and said, "Mommy, you sound like you're swallowing a ball!" You laughed along with her. Then you found a small cardboard box, lined it with parchment paper, put the soda crackers from the sealed bag into the box, and sealed it shut, planning to take it to the courier drop-off point early the next morning to send to your good friend Li Meiling.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the neighbor's house to learn how to make pickled sour plums.
description: At 3:45 p.m., when the sun wasn't so strong, you took Xuanxuan out and walked 33 minutes to Aunt Zhang's house on Hubin South Road. She warmly greeted you inside, and on the living room table were already laid out the pickled sour plums, glass jars, salt, and sugar. Aunt Zhang explained in detail her family's pickling method for sour plums: the green plums should be about 70–80 percent ripe, rubbed with salt to remove the astringency, then stacked in jars in alternating layers of green plums and sugar, and finally sealed with a splash of rice wine. As you carefully recorded the steps and proportions in the memo app on your phone, you also tasted the well-marinated plums—sweet and sour, making your mouth water. Xuanxuan sat nearby obediently eating candy. You thanked Aunt Zhang for her generosity and agreed to give her some of the newly pickled plums to try once they were ready.
location: At neighbor Aunt Zhang's home, 130 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child walk, shopping and meditation at Yundang Lake
description: After leaving Aunt Zhang's house, you took Xuanxuan along Hubin South Road toward Yundang Lake, walking about 22 minutes to the lakeside trail. As you strolled, a gentle breeze was blowing and the lake surface sparkled. By the roadside, elderly people were playing chess and young people were jogging. After walking for a while, you happened to meet a mobile fruit vendor pushing a three-wheeled cart. You bought a jin of fresh lychees and a box of blueberries. Xuanxuan happily picked out the biggest lychee, peeled it, and fed it to you. Then you sat down on a bench in a lakeside pavilion. You taught Xuanxuan to close her eyes, take five deep breaths, feel the cool lake breeze on her cheeks, and listen to the distant birdsong and the rustling leaves. Although it was only a few minutes, it made you feel peaceful inside.
location: Lakeside walkway and pavilion at Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near Hubin Middle Road)

name: Returning home
description: After the walk, you carried fresh fruit and walked home. Yundang Lake was not far from home; it took just over 20 minutes. When you got home, A Qiang was watching sports news in the living room. Seeing you return, he asked with a smile, “You had quite a productive day, learning a new skill and visiting the park.”
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cozy dinner and family time.
description: Aqiang took the initiative to put on an apron and showed off his cooking skills, making your favorite stir-fried Chinese broccoli and shrimp with scrambled eggs, while you cooked a pot of rice. The family of three enjoyed the delicious meal and shared the day's experiences. After dinner, you cleared the dishes, and Aqiang played with building blocks with Xuanxuan in the living room. You could occasionally hear their laughter, father and daughter.
location: Dining area and living room at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child interaction and artwork sharing
description: After cleaning up the kitchen, you join their playtime. Xuanxuan excitedly asks both of you to be the audience. She brings her watercolor painting from today and stands in the middle of the living room like a little teacher, explaining the story in the painting: ‘The one in the dress is Mommy, the one next to her is Daddy, and the little one is me. On the weekend we had a picnic on the grass, and the things in the sky are mint-flavored clouds!’ You and Aqiang listen with great interest and give her serious applause.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tucking In and Washing Up
description: It's about time. You take Xuanxuan to take a bath and change into pajamas. Sitting by the bed, you read her a picture book about a little rabbit and listen to her talk about the birds she saw by the lake today. Around 20:45, Xuanxuan falls asleep with a sweet smile on her face. You tiptoe out of the room and close the door, then wash up and change into pajamas yourself. You feel a little tired physically but very content mentally.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal time and journal review
description: You sat down at the desk in your bedroom and took out your diary. You thought of the complete English sentence you had said today—even though you said it to the mirror, you still smiled. The number on the scale was 49.5 kg, and your figure felt light. You wrote down today's reflections: “The insurance was signed, the watercolor class wrapped up perfectly, I took the first step in English class, the cookies were baked, and I also learned to pickle sour plums with Aunt Zhang. This Saturday was like a multi-layered sandwich cookie—every bite tasted different. Full and fulfilled—what a wonderful feeling.” After writing it, you turned off the desk lamp.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Relaxing before bed
description: You leaned against the headboard and watched Aqiang come in from the study. You exchanged a few words of small talk. He said there is a company dinner next Friday, and you can bring family. You acknowledged with a sound to show you understood. Then you closed your eyes and took a minute of deep breaths, savoring the results of today's efforts, feeling especially at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turn off the lights, lie down. Everything today went perfectly according to plan. Though the schedule was tight, every task made you feel one step closer to the ideal version of yourself. Tonight, sleep will surely be sound.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time: waking up, breakfast, and packing cookies
description: Woke up in the morning to the sound of rain. After washing up, I changed into a cotton-linen long dress and pinned up my hair.
