In the kitchen, I washed rice and cooked porridge, prepared toast and eggs, and put the soda crackers baked last night into a sealed bag and then into the parcel box. I woke up my husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, and the family had breakfast together in the dining room. Xuanxuan was a bit reluctant to get out of bed, so I encouraged her to go to church today and listen to the stories, and reminded her to take an umbrella. Aqiang helped serve the porridge, and the family chatted and laughed through breakfast.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the church in the rain.
description: After helping Xuanxuan put on her coat and packing her canvas bag with a biscuit tin, an umbrella, and other items, Aqiang held an umbrella as the family of three walked into the light rain toward the Catholic church in Siming District. Along the way, they told Xuanxuan a story about raindrops.
location: Along the way from Shanggu Street to Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Church Sunday Mass and scripture reading group
description: Attended Sunday Mass at the Catholic Church in Siming District, praying devoutly for Ah Qiang's safety at work, Xuanxuan's healthy growth, and her parents. After Mass, thanked Father Wang Mingde for last month's blessing Mass. Then joined the Bible reading group and shared the passage from Proverbs about the virtuous wife, speaking sincerely from her experience of running a family and a shop. Aunt Lin Xiuying gave her a velvet-covered Spiritual Journal, which she took with surprise and leafed through, feeling it suited her perfectly.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home, mailing cookies, and sharing about resting at home
description: After the rain stopped, the family of three walked home, stopping by the Cainiao Station at No. 12 Sucuo Street on the way. She addressed the cardboard box of cookies to Li Meiling, paid by scanning the QR code, and sent it. Then she took a photo of the shipping label with her phone and sent it to Meiling on WeChat with a comforting message. After arriving home, A Qiang took Xuanxuan to the study to play with puzzles, and you brewed a cup of hot tea, browsed your phone album, sent the photo of Xuanxuan holding up her painting from yesterday's watercolor class to the family group and the relatives-and-friends group, and separately sent a photo of the insurance letter of intent to your parents to report on the progress.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple meal and midday rest
description: For lunch, she reheated the leftover Chinese bayberries from yesterday and cooked clear noodle soup with poached eggs and chopped scallions. The family had a simple meal. After the meal, Aqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, and you watched 15 minutes of cartoons with Xuanxuan, then coaxed her into an afternoon nap.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Healing time in the kitchen: making low-sugar pumpkin steamed cake.
description: While Xuanxuan was napping, you put on an apron and started a baking experiment in the kitchen. Following the recipe, you added steamed pumpkin puree to cake flour, sugar substitute, and yeast, stirred it into a smooth batter, poured it into a mold, covered it with plastic wrap, and waited for it to rise. Watching the batter slowly expand felt especially therapeutic. After 40 minutes, the batter had risen to 80 percent full, so you put it in the steamer and set the timer.
location: In the kitchen of Room 502, Building 3, the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Successful pumpkin steamed cake and community sharing
description: The alarm went off. She lifted the pot lid, and the steamed sponge cake was golden and plump, with evenly distributed air holes on the cut surface. Excitedly, she photographed the cross-section with the macro lens and sent it to the "Song Family Three Sisters" group to share the good news, with the caption "I made it!! Pumpkin sponge cake!" Later, she also posted it to the loyal customer group of "Yajing Living Studio," jokingly calling it the "boss lady's low-sugar hidden menu."
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spiritual journal and customer group maintenance.
description: Sitting on the sofa by the window, she opened the Spiritual Diary that Aunt Lin had given her and wrote down her impressions of today's Mass. Then she replied to messages in the customer group. A regular customer wanted to order custom low-sugar pastries, and she replied that she could discuss it with her friend and first create a sign-up list to count the number of people.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with older sister Song Yawen
description: Your elder sister Song Yawen sent a video call from Shenzhen, and you chatted for nearly an hour. You explained in detail the terms of the insurance for your daughter, and your sister praised you for being decisive. The conversation turned to the children's summer plans. Your sister suggested sending Xuanxuan to swimming lessons to build perseverance. You strongly agreed and opened Dianping right away to look at the prices and reviews of the summer classes at Blue Whale Swimming Pool and Jianti Wuji together, taking screenshots and saving several options.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and parent-child interaction on the balcony.
description: You went to the kitchen to prepare the side dishes for dinner. Aqiang came home from work and took over the stir-frying. You went out to the balcony to tend to the succulents; the air was fresh after the rain. Hearing Aqiang humming in the kitchen and Xuanxuan peeling garlic nearby, you called Xuanxuan over to the balcony to enjoy the fresh post-rain air.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents
description: Before dinner, the family sat together for a video call with their parents in Quanzhou. Father demonstrated the newly adjusted hearing aid, and it worked so well that everyone was delighted. Mother excitedly talked about the square dance she had just learned and told them to come back early for summer vacation so she could prepare meat zongzi for Xuanxuan in advance. Your heart felt warm, and you thought this was the best weekend.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: On the table were stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed egg with minced pork, and homemade low-sugar pumpkin steamed sponge cake. Xuanxuan took big bites of the sponge cake and said it was the best in the world. Aqiang also praised it endlessly, and the whole family was warm and happy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mindful walking in the neighborhood.
description: The night after the rain was quiet and fresh. She put on running shoes and walked briskly alone for 20 minutes along the tree-lined path in the neighborhood. Puddles reflected light under the streetlights. She emptied her mind, felt the contact between her feet and the ground, and breathed the moist air, her heart filled with quiet joy.
location: Tree-lined avenue inside the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time: bath and bedtime story.
description: After getting home, gave Xuanxuan a warm bath. Then read Guess How Much I Love You in bed in a gentle, low voice, and Xuanxuan gradually fell asleep in her arms.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write a gratitude journal and summary.
description: After settling her daughter down, she sat at the desk and wrote a gratitude list in her new devotional journal: her father adapting to his hearing aids, family security in place, Xuanxuan's progress in watercolor, and a successful steamed cake. She felt utterly fulfilled after writing.
location: At the desk in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Area, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime chat between the couple.
description: Aqiang washed up and got into bed. You two leaned against the headboard and talked about the day's events, discussed the swimming class fees, agreed to take Xuanxuan to check it out in person on the weekend, and decided to go pay and consult tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Weighing, washing up, and going to sleep before bed
description: Before getting ready for bed, she stepped on the electronic scale and saw 49.3kg. She smiled with relief, feeling that relaxing on the weekend was no big deal. She squeezed out toothpaste, washed up, then turned off the light and got into bed. Feeling the warmth of the quilt and the steady breathing of her loved one beside her, she soon fell asleep with a smile.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, personal care, and breakfast.
description: The alarm went off. Song Yajing gently touched her phone and caught a glimpse of the scale showing 49.4 kg. The low-sugar diet was beginning to show results, which put her in a good mood. While washing up, she applied toner and sunscreen, and at the same time planned the must-dos for the day: paying the insurance premium was the top priority, and the second was running the store alone for the day. Then she prepared a low-sugar breakfast for the family: whole-wheat sandwiches with sugar-free yogurt for herself and her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and warm milk and pumpkin sponge cake for her daughter Chen Lexuan. During breakfast, her husband apologized that he had to go on a business trip today and would not be back until evening, so the swimming pool plan would be moved to the weekend. Song Yajing said she understood, told him she would take care of the insurance first, and because shop assistant Xiaomei had asked for leave, she needed to stay in the store all day. She reminded him to be safe.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing held her daughter Chen Lexuan's hand and walked along the tree-lined path in the residential neighborhood to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter chattered about the crafts she was going to make today. At the kindergarten gate, she kissed her daughter on the forehead, watched her run toward the teacher, then turned and left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to ICBC to pay the insurance premium and confirm the policy, then walked to the shop.
description: After walking about 12 minutes from the kindergarten, she arrived at the ICBC Xiamen Zhongshan Sub-branch. Song Yajing used mobile banking in the self-service area to complete the transfers: her husband’s critical illness insurance with a coverage of 500,000 yuan had an annual premium of 7,600 yuan, and her own female-specific disease insurance with a coverage of 200,000 yuan had an annual premium of 1,500 yuan. She took a screenshot and sent it via WeChat to insurance consultant Li Ming for confirmation. A few minutes later, Li Ming replied to confirm and sent the official electronic policy. She carefully checked the insured person, sum insured, and coverage period, and after confirming everything was correct, she saved it to the phone's encrypted album. She then called her husband, who was on a business trip, to let him know the insurance had taken effect. He thanked her in a low voice, and she joked that she had also gained a piece of armor. After hanging up, she walked about 9 minutes along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to the store.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Zhongshan Sub-branch), No. 76 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Worked alone at the clothing store all day.
description: Song Yajing worked alone at the 'Yaji' clothing store for 12 hours. After opening in the morning, she sorted the clothes and replied to regular customers' WeChat messages. Around 10:30, regular customer Vivian came in, and the two chatted about styling and parenting for nearly half an hour. Vivian tried on a floral dress and placed a satisfied order. Yajing took the opportunity to recommend Kuaituantuan summer clothing lucky bags. At noon, during a lull, she ate her own light salad (chicken breast, lettuce, cherry tomatoes) while answering outfit-related questions in the customer group. In the afternoon, foot traffic increased. She made patient recommendations and served a mother-daughter pair of tourists, styling them in white dresses and straw hats and making the sale. At 3 p.m., she had a voice call with designer Zheng Kai to discuss the autumn co-branded collection. She liked the cuts of the trench coat and wool skirt and suggested adding oatmeal and navy blue and adjusting the minimum order quantity. They agreed to go to Hangzhou in early July to inspect samples and finalize the styles. Afterward, she packed the day's orders and called SF Express to pick them up (collected around 16:00). To finish up, she sorted the accounts, photographed the new autumn display and posted it to Moments and the customer group, vacuumed the carpet, and closed the store at 17:10.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: After closing the shop, pick up her daughter from school and go home
description: After closing the shop, Song Yajing walked about 30 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. Her daughter Chen Lexuan rushed over to show her the picture she had drawn in kindergarten. She picked up her daughter, gave her a kiss, and listened to her tell the story in the picture along the way. The mother and daughter walked about 10 minutes back to their home on Shanggu Street.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex

name: Evening family time: dinner and helping daughter wash up and get to bed
description: After returning home, Song Yajing quickly prepared a simple dinner: tomato and egg noodles with luncheon meat. She and her daughter chatted about the day's fun moments while eating. Because her husband was on a business trip, it was just the two of them, and the atmosphere was quiet. After dinner, she sent a WeChat message to her husband to let him know how things were and set aside some food for him. Then she ran bath water for her daughter, washed her hair and scrubbed her back, and after changing into pajamas, told her two bedtime stories. Her daughter hugged her and asked when Dad would be home. She reassured her that she would see him tomorrow morning. Around 8 PM, her daughter fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal meditation for relaxation and journaling.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, exhaustion washed over her. Song Yajing changed into comfortable pajamas and used a meditation app for a 10-minute meditation to loosen her tense shoulders. Then she took out her Devotional Journal and wrote down the day's reflections: the insurance policy was finalized, and she felt a great relief; working in the store alone was busy but efficient; her weight was 49.4kg, and the low-sugar diet continued; and she was full of anticipation for tomorrow. After writing, she turned off her phone and checked the alarm clock.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to bed early
description: Song Yajing turned off the light and lay down. Images flashed through her mind: signing the insurance policy, packing express parcels, and her daughter's smiling face while drawing. A faint smile rose at the corners of her mouth, and she sank into sleep amid exhaustion, ending a full and reassuring day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up and prepare breakfast
description: Woke up at 7:00, washed up, went to the kitchen, took butter out of the fridge and left it on the counter to come to room temperature, preparing for the afternoon baking. Prepared a low-sugar breakfast: whole wheat toast, boiled eggs, and pan-fried a few slices of ham for her husband. The sky was overcast; there might be a shower.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up daughter and have breakfast with the family.
description: Woke up her daughter and helped her tie her hair. The family of three had breakfast together, discussing household matters such as Xiao Mei returning to the store and her husband coming home late. Their daughter showed the watercolor painting she had made at kindergarten. Outside, it started to drizzle.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school and walk to the store
description: Helped my daughter put on her backpack, walked her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten with a transparent umbrella, and watched her enter the classroom. Then walked along Zhenhai Road to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, about 20 minutes in total.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and community management.
description: Arrived at the store at 8:50, tidied the shelves with Xiaomei, and steam-ironed the new autumn clothing. Checked Zheng Kai's preferred styles for autumn and taught Xiaomei to use Excel to record customer reservation information. Replied to customer inquiries on Kuaituantuan. At 10:30, regular customer Vivian came in; we chatted about outfits and noted the sample pieces she was interested in.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went home during lunch break to check the butter.
description: She let Xiaomei go eat and walked home by herself. She checked the butter on the kitchen counter that had come to room temperature; it felt soft and had reached the ideal state. Then she returned to the shop.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch and baking preparation
description: Took the salad takeout home and finished the low-sugar chicken breast and vegetable salad. Washed the baking tools, tidied the countertop, and made all the preparations for the afternoon baking.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bake low-sugar butter cookies and make a fail log card
description: Starting at 13:15, she kneaded softened butter with sugar substitute and cake flour, used cookie cutters to stamp out star and heart shapes, and put them into the oven. While baking, she made a hand-drawn fail record card featuring a cracked macaron and encouraging words. After the cookies came out and cooled, she tried one—the crispness was just right—then put them into a transparent jar and tied the fail card to it.
location: Kitchen and dining table at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Sharing baking results and tidying up the kitchen
description: Received photos of successful macarons sent by her friend Mrs. Liu from Hangzhou, sent back photos of her own cookies, and they encouraged each other. Then she quickly cleaned up the kitchen.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Filing insurance contracts and setting up the family insurance ledger.
description: In the study, I took out the printed copies of electronic insurance policies and sorted the contracts and certificates for my husband's critical illness insurance, my own female-specific disease insurance, and the high-limit medical insurance into the "Family Protection" document box in the home safe. Then, using the wealth management app on the tablet, I created a new "Insurance Special" page, entered the insurance type, insured person, payment date, amount, and other information one by one, and set up double payment reminders.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A short break and preparing to pick up her child
description: After finishing the filing, I walked to the balcony and saw that the rain had stopped and the ground was wet. I drank a glass of lemon water, sent a WeChat message to my husband who was on a business trip to update him on the cookies and the insurance progress, and after receiving a positive reply, I got ready to go out to pick up our daughter.
location: Living room and balcony of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Picking up her daughter from school and exploring the community garden.
description: Left early to pick up her daughter from kindergarten, then took her to play for half an hour in the garden of the residential complex. The air was fresh after the rain; while her daughter observed the snails by the flower bed, she told her daughter a story about small animals after the rain.
location: Community garden, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner and mother-daughter interaction
description: After returning home, she prepared a simple dinner: tomato and egg noodles for her daughter and cold buckwheat noodles for herself. While her daughter watched cartoons nearby, she cooked the noodles and looked forward to showing her husband the day's insurance contract sorting results when he came home.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mother-daughter dinner chat.
description: Mother and daughter chatted over dinner; the daughter talked about funny things at kindergarten, and she shared her baking experiences. After dinner, she cleared the dishes while her daughter played with building blocks beside her.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Husband returning home and emotional expression.
description: My husband came back from a business trip, and I had kept dinner for him. After dinner, I took him to the study and showed him the neatly organized insurance contracts and electronic ledgers. After flipping through them, he was deeply moved, held my hand, and thanked me earnestly. The two of us shared a wordless understanding and a quiet sense of security.
location: Home living room and study, Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family garden walk
description: After the rain, the ground had dried. The family of three went downstairs and strolled slowly in the community garden. I walked behind, watching my husband holding our daughter's little hand as they walked ahead. The streetlights stretched their shadows, and my heart was filled with peace and happiness.
location: Garden walkway in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child bedtime preparation
description: After the walk home, she helped her daughter bathe and change into pajamas, told two bedtime stories, and her daughter fell asleep quickly. Her husband also finished washing up.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write a diary entry to record my mood
description: Back in the bedroom, she took out the green-covered diary and wrote down what she had completed today: cookies, filing, and the electronic ledger. She recorded the warm feeling brought by her husband's thanks and noted her weight and the condition of her shoulders and neck.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: After finishing her diary, she leaned against the headboard and meditated for about 15 minutes to let her thoughts settle. At 22:20 she turned off the main light, left the night light on, adjusted her sleeping position, and fell asleep peacefully with love and a sense of security.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, washing up, weight management, and breakfast with my daughter.
description: After waking up to the phone alarm, she washed up and weighed 49.3 kg; satisfied that her weight was stable, she felt secretly pleased. While applying skincare, she thought about the surprise for her best friend. Then she heated milk, toasted thick-cut bread, fried a soft-yolk egg, and helped her daughter, who had just woken up, braid her little pigtails. During breakfast, her daughter nibbled on toast and recited the newly learned kindergarten nursery rhyme "Little Rabbit, Be Good." She smiled and stroked her daughter's head, feeling warm inside.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, and dining room at home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school and walk to the store
description: Holding her daughter's hand, she walked 10 minutes to the kindergarten, crouched down to help her zip up her school uniform, told her to drink plenty of water and listen to the teacher, and watched her high-five the teacher and run into the teaching building before turning to leave. Then she walked toward the store. Passing the flower shop, she saw that the blue plumbago was in full bloom and made a note of the plan to buy flowers to decorate the fitting room.
location: From the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Morning store organization and setup
description: Arrived at the store and opened up, turned on the air conditioner, played soft jazz, and lit scented candles. She carefully wiped the clothing racks and mannequins with a cotton cloth, styled the new mulberry silk shirt with high-waisted wide-leg pants and matching-colored sandals, and created an exquisite featured display. She took a deep breath, ready to welcome the new day.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning shop operation and customer interaction
description: After 9 o'clock, she received a WeChat message from a customer, Sister Wang, saying that her daughter wore the recommended floral dress and was praised by her piano teacher for her elegant temperament. She immediately replied with a voice message to thank her and invited her to post a customer photo in the VIP community, promising to give her a 10% discount coupon. After 10:30, she successively received young office workers and warmly helped them choose clothes and match outfits. At 11 o'clock, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. After handing over the front counter to her, she checked the inventory and found that the cake flour and sugar substitute were almost used up, so she planned to go to the supermarket to restock.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the supermarket to buy baking ingredients.
description: At noon she asked Xiao Mei to mind the shop and walked to the supermarket near Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She went straight to the grain, oil, and seasoning sections, selecting cake flour, sugar substitute, unsalted butter, and fresh blueberries. After comparing the prices of sugar substitutes, she chose a cost-effective one. At checkout, she noticed a new health food counter displaying a trendy low-sugar baking mix. She stopped to take a photo and planned to try it next time.
location: Life Supermarket, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, put away the purchases, and have a simple lunch.
description: Walked home carrying the shopping bags, put the ingredients in the kitchen, and drank a glass of warm water. I saw the photo my sister Yawen sent of the view outside her Shenzhen office window and replied with an 'envious' emoji sticker. Took out the leftover cold buckwheat noodles from last night and quickly finished them. Secretly flipped through the macaron failure card I drew yesterday and couldn't help laughing, silently resolving to bake a successful batch today.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for baking and chatting with neighbor Aunt Zhang
description: She tied on a daisy-print apron and took out the butter to thaw. The doorbell rang, and Aunt Zhang from next door brought over freshly made mung bean cakes to share. She invited her in to sit down, and the two chatted while bustling about the kitchen. Aunt Zhang praised her for being so handy and asked for the secret to the flaky mung bean cakes. She mysteriously told her the trick of replacing some of the butter with lard and adding a drop of white vinegar, and Aunt Zhang immediately jotted it down on her phone. Aunt Zhang also promised to teach her how to make authentic Minnan pies another day. After chatting about everyday life, she left satisfied.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Focus on making low-sugar butter cookies
description: After seeing off Aunt Zhang, she continued with her baking creation, grating fresh lemon zest into the batter to add a fresh aroma. She cut out cookies with star and heart molds, brushed a thin layer of oil on the baking tray, and set the oven to 170°C with top and bottom heat for 15 minutes. The room filled with a sweet fragrance. After the first tray came out, she picked out 20 cookies with the most even shapes to put in a jar, and mixed the remaining broken cookies into plain yogurt as a treat for herself.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Packing cookies and sending them to her best friend
description: She placed the selected cookies one by one into an airtight glass jar, attached a handwritten card with a humorous message, redrew the macaron failure record card by hand, put it into the cardboard box, and stuffed it with bubble wrap. Carrying the box to the Cainiao parcel station at the entrance of the residential complex, she filled in her close friend Li Meiling's school address, drew a big smiley face on the seal with a red marker, took a photo, and sent it to her, predicting that tomorrow she would receive the failed artist's heartfelt gift.
location: Cainiao Station (Gugong Yujing Branch), No. 69-108 Gugong Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Short break and community interaction.
description: When I got home, I collapsed on the living room sofa and poured a glass of warm water. I saw in the community group that Sister Wang had already posted a buyer's photo; the girl in the floral dress was smiling sweetly. I immediately sent her a 10% off coupon and @'d her with thanks. The other mothers in the group gave likes and asked questions one after another. After replying to a few messages, I checked the time and got ready to pick up my daughter.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter from school and playing in the community
description: Put on canvas shoes and left early, tossing out old newspapers on the way, and walked to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter on time. The little girl excitedly showed off the handmade moving caterpillar she had made today. She took her to the community garden to play on the slide and watch the ants moving house. Her daughter picked up a fallen leaf, saying she wanted to give it to Daddy as a bookmark, and then found a heart-shaped stone to give to Aunt Li, saying the stone looked like a heart.
location: In front of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the garden of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Preparing dinner and interacting with her husband
description: After returning home, she had her daughter play with plasticine nearby while she prepared dinner: stir-fried organic spinach, pan-fried hairtail with less oil in the air fryer, and winter melon and dried shrimp soup. Just as she was busy, the sound of keys came and her husband Aqiang returned carrying a bag of small tangerines. Seeing her wearing an apron, he took the knife and helped chop scallions, and their daughter also used toy bowls and chopsticks to learn how to set the table.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family-of-three dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: At the dinner table, her daughter did a lively imitation of the teacher leading exercises, making everyone laugh; her husband carefully removed fish bones and put the fish in their daughter's bowl, while she put a piece of hairtail into his bowl. Aqiang said the project went smoothly today and he could leave work on time. After dinner, her husband took the initiative to read picture books with their daughter, while she washed the dishes efficiently, wiped the stove, and cleaned the trash bin, leaving the kitchen tidy.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk by the lake
description: The family of three put on sneakers and walked to Yundang Lake. The summer night breeze was cool and pleasant, and streetlights were reflected on the lake. Their daughter skipped along like a little butterfly, picking up stones. She excitedly held up a heart-shaped stone and said she wanted to give this heart-like stone to Aunt Li, who had a baby in her belly. Song Yajing and her husband smiled at each other.
location: Lakeside path at Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bathe the daughter, tell stories, and soothe her to sleep.
description: After getting home, gave her daughter a hot bath and blow-dried her hair, then carried her to bed and read Run Run Town. When she read in an exaggerated voice about the kitten and the little eagle bumping into each other and becoming an owl, her daughter laughed and rolled around, saying that if she bumped into Mommy, would they become two mommies? Only when the energetic little one finally fell asleep did she quietly close the door.
location: Bathroom and daughter's bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Write a diary entry to record my mood
description: In the study, she opened the red-covered diary and wrote about today: weight stable at 49.3 kg, Aunt Zhang's puff pastry secret recorded, the cookie packages sent, and her daughter finding a heart-shaped stone. Finally, she wrote that actively caring for friends feels much better than being cared for. While baking cookies she found herself humming a song, and life slowly flows forward in small, warm moments.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening relaxation and preparation for bed
description: She went to the living room to discuss with her husband taking their daughter to the science museum to see the children's exhibition on the weekend, and he nodded in agreement. She checked tomorrow's weather on her phone, which showed cloudy turning overcast, so she decided to bring an umbrella. Then she went to the bathroom to brush her teeth, wash her face, and do basic skincare.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Meditated before bed and fell asleep.
description: Dimmed the lights, opened the meditation app, and followed a 10-minute body scan meditation, ending with a relaxed mind and body. Habitually glanced at the clothing store's community group, no new messages, turned off the phone with peace of mind. Fell asleep quickly on today's sense of accomplishment and contentment, dreaming of the scent of lemon butter and the delighted smile on my best friend's face when she received the package.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Got up, prepared breakfast, and took her daughter to school.
description: At 7:00, she was woken by the alarm on time and felt refreshed. She went to the bathroom to wash up, did a quick skincare routine, and tied up her hair. In the kitchen, she boiled water, took milk, eggs, and whole wheat bread out of the fridge, skillfully fried three eggs, toasted the bread in the toaster, made a cup of children's milk for her daughter Xuanxuan, and poured a glass of warm milk for herself and her husband Aqiang each. At 7:45, Aqiang and Xuanxuan got up one after another and sat down at the table. The family had breakfast while chatting about the day's plans. Xuanxuan said she would be the class helper at kindergarten today and was very excited. Song Yajing reminded her to be responsible. After breakfast, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan put on her little schoolbag, took the water bottle, and the two set out together. After walking about 10 minutes, she sent Xuanxuan to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten before 8:00, watched her skip inside, and waved goodbye to the teacher.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bought fruits and snacks along the way and headed to the store.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She picked out a box of cut melon, a box of cherry tomatoes, and a few bananas, planning to keep them in the store as afternoon fruit. At checkout, she also grabbed a pack of nori snacks her daughter liked. She glanced at the weather forecast on her phone and confirmed it would be cloudy in the morning. After leaving the convenience store, she followed her familiar route through several alleys and walked about 12 minutes to Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, "Jingxin Wardrobe."
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store opening preparation and handover with the staff.
description: After entering the store, Song Yajing turned on the lights and air conditioner first, then began wiping the cash register and shelves. A few minutes later, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. Together, they dressed the mannequins that had been brought in the night before with new outfits and adjusted the window display. While tidying up, Song Yajing explained the day's priorities to Xiaomei: 'The new T-shirts that arrived yesterday — hang them on the recommended rack by the entrance later. Also, I've checked all our materials, so today we'll just work methodically and stay calm.'
location: “Tranquil Wardrobe,” Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Calmly handling a surprise inspection by market regulators
description: At around 10 a.m., two customers had just arrived to look at dresses. Then two staff members from the market supervision office, wearing uniforms, walked into the store, identified themselves, and said they were conducting a routine inspection. Xiaomei looked a bit nervous, but Song Yajing calmly stepped forward, smiled, and said, "Sure, you're welcome to inspect—we've got all our licenses and purchase records ready." Unhurriedly, she took out the business license, the copy of the food business permit, and the past three months of purchase vouchers from a file box under the cash register. While the inspectors were flipping through them, she also proactively led them to the fire safety corner and pointed out the fire extinguisher and its inspection record card. The whole process went smoothly, and in less than twenty minutes, the inspectors expressed satisfaction with the clean environment and standardized management. Before leaving, one senior inspector praised, "The store may not be big, but it's managed in a model way." After seeing them off, Xiaomei sighed with relief and said admiringly, "Boss, you're so calm! My heart was about to jump out!" Song Yajing smiled and patted her shoulder: "It's fine—since we always do things properly, there's nothing to fear from inspections. You take care of the customers; I'll go put the documents back." Afterward, the store returned to normal, and customer traffic gradually increased.
location: “Tranquil Wardrobe,” Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Receiving customers and managing online communities
description: After the inspection incident, the shop returned to normal. Foot traffic gradually picked up in the morning; two or three women in their twenties came in and were very interested in the floral print dresses in the window. Song Yajing enthusiastically recommended outfit combinations and encouraged them to try them on. While helping a customer straighten her clothes, she kept an eye on her phone and quickly replied to two customers' size questions on Kuaituantuan. Near 12 o'clock, there were fewer people in the store, so she told Xiao Mei to go eat lunch first while she minded the shop.
location: “Tranquil Wardrobe,” Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch
description: After Xiaomei finished her meal and came back for the shift change, Song Yajing took out the salad she had bought in the morning (the quinoa chicken breast salad prepared at home the night before) and brewed a cup of mint tea she had dried herself. She sat on the rest chair in the store, eating lunch while scrolling through her phone for a while. Seeing a few fashion bloggers' autumn outfit previews, she quietly noted down some styling inspirations.
location: “Tranquil Wardrobe,” Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Minding the shop and processing online orders in the afternoon
description: After lunch, Song Yajing felt fine. Customer traffic in the afternoon was steady, so she and Xiaomei divided the work. Xiaomei focused on reception while she handled back-office matters: she carefully checked yesterday afternoon's sales data and noted in her notebook the quantities of several basic T-shirt styles that needed restocking; then she opened WeChat, sent an order message to supplier Susan, and sent a screenshot to Zheng Kai asking about a new fabric. During that time, she also managed several new-product preorder messages from online communities on her phone.
location: “Tranquil Wardrobe,” Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went home early, meditated, and trimmed the mint.
description: Looking out the window at the sky gradually growing overcast, and with the weather forecast saying it might rain in the afternoon, plus the morning spot check having taken some energy, Song Yajing decided to go home early to rest and recover. She told Xiaomei, "I'm going home to rest for a while. If it rains this afternoon, close up half an hour early and don't wait for me." Xiaomei readily agreed. After walking about 7 minutes home, she changed into loose loungewear, put a drop of lavender essential oil on the yoga mat in the living room, sat down cross-legged, closed her eyes, and did the planned 25-minute meditation. When it ended, she felt her whole pace slow down. She got up, walked to the balcony, picked up a small pair of scissors, and carefully trimmed the overgrown mint. The cut stems were neatly placed to one side, to be washed and steeped in water for drinking later.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Best friend Li Meiling was moved and replied.
description: After meditating and pruning the mint, Song Yajing had just sat down on the sofa when her phone began vibrating continuously. It was Li Meiling sending voice and picture messages. In the voice messages, Li Meiling's voice was both tearful and laughing: "Yajing! I got the cookies! That 'kitchen fail card' is way too funny! Wuwuwu, how did you know I've been feeling so awful lately... Looking at your handwriting and the cookies, I feel like my morning sickness is half cured!" She also sent a photo of the cupcake she had burnt last time. Song Yajing felt warm inside and immediately replied with a WeChat voice message: "Haha, I knew you'd love it! That burnt cake had me laughing all afternoon. From now on, we have to share all our kitchen failures with each other — no hiding them away!" The two chatted on WeChat for about ten minutes about their baking mishaps, laughing nonstop.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle online orders and prepare lessons.
description: After chatting with her best friend, Song Yajing was in a great mood. She returned to the study, turned on the computer, logged into the store's online mall backend, confirmed that several pre-orders had been paid that afternoon, and followed up with regular customers one by one, asking how the clothes they bought last time fit and looked. Then, remembering that there was an online 'Parent-Child Outfit Sharing Class' for regular customers next week, she spent 20 minutes downloading some outfit pictures suitable for summer family trips from the internet and organized them into a simple PPT outline.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Picking up her daughter from school and playing in the community
description: At 16:20, Song Yajing turned off the computer and walked about 10 minutes to the kindergarten. After picking up the bouncing Xuanxuan, her daughter said she wanted to play for a while in the community garden. Song Yajing then strolled around the neighborhood with her. Xuanxuan and a few classmates played 'eagle catches chicks' next to the slide, while Song Yajing stood nearby chatting with a parent she knew well about where to take the kids on the weekend.
location: Community garden, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner and having dinner together with the family.
description: At 5:15 PM, Song Yajing brought Xuanxuan home. She let Xuanxuan watch cartoons in the living room by herself while she went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She made Xuanxuan's favorite tomato and egg noodles, stir-fried a plate of greens, and sliced a plate of spiced beef. A Qiang got home around 6:40 PM, smelled the aroma as soon as he walked in, washed his hands first, then went to the kitchen to help Song Yajing carry out the dishes. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating and chatting about the day's amusing moments.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband suggested a weekend beach plan.
description: As dinner was drawing to a close, Aqiang noticed that Song Yajing had not said much today but seemed a little relaxed. He took the initiative to suggest, “If the weather is good this weekend, let’s take Xuanxuan to the beach on Huandao Road to play in the sand! In the afternoon we can also drop by the nearby art museum.” Song Yajing’s eyes lit up and she gladly agreed, “Great, I was thinking about that yesterday!” She immediately took out her phone and checked the weekend tide table and the art museum’s parking information. When their daughter heard they could go to the seaside, she jumped off her chair excitedly, hugged her father’s leg, and said, “Daddy is the best! I want to bring my little bucket to dig for crabs!” The small family plan made the whole evening’s atmosphere even more relaxed and warm.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening parent-child reading and putting the child to sleep
description: At 8 p.m., Song Yajing took Xuanxuan into the bathroom for a bath. After she blow-dried her daughter's hair, mother and daughter leaned against the headboard. Song Yajing picked up the book First-Grade Little Pea and began reading a new chapter. She vividly imitated the tone of the Little Pea in the book, and Xuanxuan listened with great interest, giggling from time to time. After finishing a chapter, Xuanxuan rubbed her eyes and felt sleepy. Song Yajing turned off the main light, leaving only a night light on, gently patted her daughter's back, and hummed a lullaby. Within less than ten minutes, her daughter fell into a sweet dream.
location: Daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and writing in her diary.
description: After getting her daughter settled, Song Yajing tiptoed out of the room. She went to the bathroom to thoroughly wash up and changed into comfortable pajamas. Then she sat at the dressing table, took out the delicate diary, and carefully wrote down her feelings for the day: “Thursday, June 26. Today was a very ordinary and heartwarming day. The morning spot check was frightening but turned out fine, and I was calmer than I had imagined. In the afternoon I went home, meditated, and trimmed the mint, giving both body and mind a rest. The happiest part was Meiling’s feedback after she received the cookies; I could feel her joy through the screen. Friendship is so wonderful. In the evening Aqiang suggested going to the seaside this weekend. Seeing Xuanxuan’s excitement, I felt life is full of hope. My weight is 49.5kg and steadily recovering. Tomorrow is the graduation ceremony, so I must get enough rest.”
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation and sleep preparation
description: After finishing her diary, Song Yajing felt that the day had been very fulfilling. She did a few minutes of simple stretching, then checked the camera she needed to bring to the kindergarten the next day (tomorrow was her daughter's graduation ceremony). Aqiang also finished his work and came back to the bedroom. They chatted for a while about Xuanxuan and the weekend arrangements. Song Yajing dimmed the lights, they said goodnight to each other, and at 10:35 p.m. she closed her eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and heading out
description: At 6:45 in the morning, Song Yajing woke up with a mix of excitement and reluctance. She went to the kitchen first and served the multigrain porridge (millet, quinoa, red dates) that had been prepared the night before. At 7:00 she woke her daughter Chen Lexuan on time, helped her put on the light blue doctoral gown, carefully adjusted the bow tie, and moved the tassel to the right side. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang checked the action camera and phone battery on the side. Song Yajing put three handwritten thank-you cards and a L'Occitane hand cream set into a canvas bag printed with the 'Yajing Life House' logo. At 7:30 they began breakfast. Xuanxuan was so excited that she only ate a few bites of porridge, and Song Yajing coaxed her into finishing half a glass of milk. She herself quickly ate a boiled egg and two slices of whole wheat toast. Before leaving, she checked the items in her backpack once more: phone, power bank, tissues, wet wipes, gift bag, and dried blueberries. At 8:05 the family of three locked the door and went downstairs. On the tree-lined path in the residential area, Song Yajing took a pre-departure photo of Xuanxuan in her doctoral gown; her daughter smiled with her eyes curved into crescent moons.
location: Room 402, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (at home and within the residential complex)

name: Commute to the kindergarten.
description: At 8:15, Song Yajing used Didi to hail a car, and the family of three got in and headed to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan leaned by the car window, pointing excitedly the whole way, while Chen Zhiqiang adjusted the filming equipment. Around 8:35, they arrived at Gucheng West Road. Many children and parents dressed in the same graduation gowns had already gathered around the kindergarten, and the air was filled with joy and happiness.
location: In a taxi from Shanggu Street to Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Kindergarten graduation ceremony and group photo session.
description: After checking in, they took their seats in the Little Class One section, and the graduation ceremony officially began at 8:45. After the principal's speech, Xuanxuan went on stage as the class representative to recite the graduation poem "Goodbye, Kindergarten." When she read the line "Thank you, Mom and Dad," Song Yajing held up her phone to record, tears streaming down her face, while Chen Zhiqiang silently handed her a tissue. After the ceremony, Song Yajing was quick to capture a photo of Xuanxuan hugging her good friend Yaya. The family of three took a bright family photo with homeroom teacher Li in front of the graduation backdrop. Song Yajing then sincerely thanked Teacher Li for three years of care and presented the gift and card she had prepared.

The weather was hot; Xuanxuan couldn't wait to take off her graduation gown and change into her favorite little floral dress, and Song Yajing also changed from her refined outfit back to a cotton-linen dress. After a quick face wipe and some water, at 11:55 the family of three got ready to head out again.

name: Family celebration lunch.

Song Yajing ordered tomato pasta, mango pudding, and fresh juice for Xuanxuan, while she and Chen Zhiqiang ordered grilled chicken breast salad and seafood risotto. The whole family raised a toast to celebrate Xuanxuan's graduation from kindergarten and discussed summer plans: swimming lessons in the morning, drawing and reading in the afternoon. Xuanxuan showed her graduation certificate again and again, insisted on hanging it in front of her bed, and also wished to help out at her mother's store, making everyone laugh. Song Yajing had little appetite because she had been emotional in the morning, so she only ate most of her salad, but watching her daughter's contented face was sweeter than anything to her.
location: Little Whale Family Restaurant, No. 19 Hexiang West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China.

name: Afternoon at home: community sharing, handmade photo album, and outing planning

At 14:00, while Xuanxuan played with LEGO alone, Song Yajing quickly browsed the photos on her phone, selected a short video of her daughter reciting a poem, and posted it with the caption "Little eagle, take off! Mom is always behind you!" to the Yajing Life Gallery VIP customer group, drawing dozens of likes and heartfelt comments. At 14:30, Song Yajing and Xuanxuan made a handmade photo album together, using a blank sketchbook, colored pens, and stickers to cut and paste the wirelessly printed graduation photos. Xuanxuan drew little flowers and hearts, and Song Yajing wrote down the dates and notes. At 16:00, after preparing mango for Xuanxuan, Song Yajing sat down at her desk and searched for recent exhibitions at the Xiamen Huandao Road Art Museum. She found the "Children's Art Exhibition on Marine Conservation," checked the tide table to confirm that the afternoon low tide was suitable for beachcombing, and sent a screenshot to the family WeChat group, asking Chen Zhiqiang whether he had brought the homemade cranberry cookies. The whole afternoon was warm and fulfilling.
location: Room 402, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (home)

Xuanxuan soon started chasing and playing with children her age, while Song Yajing sat on a bench under the shade of a tree, feeling the evening breeze, her heart at peace and full of joy. At 18:00, she bought Xuanxuan some sugar-free yogurt and a banana at the convenience store at the park gate as an energy boost, then went home.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

At 18:50, Chen Zhiqiang came in carrying a briefcase and a cake box. Song Yajing, surprised, playfully chided him, and Chen Zhiqiang smiled and said the cake was to go with the day's joy.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Room 402, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Small family evening celebration and video review.
description: Dinner started at 19:10. Chen Zhiqiang proposed a toast to Xuanxuan’s “first graduation in life.” Song Yajing brought out a low-sugar yogurt cake, put a “6” candle on it, and the whole family sang an adapted “Happy Graduation Song” for Xuanxuan, who closed her eyes and made a wish. After dinner, the family of three curled up on the sofa and rewatched the morning’s graduation ceremony video with the projector. When Xuanxuan saw herself, she shyly hid in her father’s arms. While watching, Song Yajing used the notes app on her phone to jot down heartwarming copy to share in the community.
location: Room 402, Building 5, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (home dining room and living room).

name: Parent-child time and Xuanxuan falling asleep

After the bath, mother and daughter read the picture book You Will Soon Grow Tall together in bed. Song Yajing told her daughter that from today she is a primary school student and must be braver and more independent. At 21:00, Xuanxuan fell asleep with a smile in her mother's arms and a soft lullaby.

Thank you, Teacher, for your hard work these three years!" She posted it to the group, which sparked even greater resonance. A regular customer commented that what she bought here was all the emotional outlet she had as a mother. Song Yajing's eyes grew warm, she replied to the blessings one by one, and agreed with everyone to share parent-child outfit tips for the "kindergarten-to-primary-school" transition next week. The interaction lasted until nearly 22:00.
location: Room 402, Building 5, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (at the desk in the bedroom at home)

At 22:20, she took out her diary and wrote: “June 27, 2025, sunny. Today, my little snail poked its head out of the kindergarten shell... I still weigh 49.2kg... Good night, my little graduate. Mom loves you.” After finishing the diary, she did five minutes of simple stretching to relieve fatigue.

Filled with warmth and strength, she soon fell into a deep sleep with a smile, ending a fulfilling day.

After getting up, she habitually stepped on the scale, which read 49.6 kg, slightly up from yesterday but within her satisfactory range. After washing up, she went to the kitchen and began to prepare today's special Minnan misua soup, taking out the stock simmered last night from the fridge, adding shredded misua, oysters, and chopped green onions with practiced skill.

Yajing brought up the touching news from yesterday that her daughter's watercolor painting had been selected, and then took the opportunity to solemnly propose, "How about we try one new thing together as a family every three months? For example, taking a pottery class together, going camping, or learning to cook a foreign dish together." Her husband and daughter immediately applauded in agreement, and the three of them set the first activity on the spot as "Parent-Child Pottery Experience Class" and agreed to book it next weekend.

Her daughter ran over and said she wanted the fabric from the bunny skirt to make clothes for her doll. Yajing smiled, cut off a small piece, and handed it to her.

location: Along the route from Zhenhai Road to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparation and monthly review
description: When I arrived at the store, the shop assistant Xiao Mei was already waiting at the door. Together we pulled up the rolling shutter door. After turning on the lights and air conditioning, I wiped down the cashier counter and display racks while Xiao Mei watered the pothos. We hung up the "Temporarily Closed" sign and officially started the monthly review in the sofa area inside the store. I first affirmed Xiao Mei's patience and ability in handling customer returns last month, as well as her rising conversion rate when managing the store independently, and also pointed out the advantages of the half-day work model. Xiao Mei made suggestions on product displays, and I jotted down in my notebook the idea of giving a year-end performance bonus or promoting her to store manager, encouraging her to continue participating in product selection. A surprised and determined smile appeared on Xiao Mei's face.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning business and customer reception
description: After the debrief, the store resumed business. The young woman who had hesitated last week came in again. I styled her in a basic white silk shirt and navy blue wide-leg pants. She tried them on, was satisfied, and paid. Xiaomei also successfully took care of a pair of best friends and recommended two dresses with a strong design sense. During a lull in foot traffic, I replied to messages in the VIP customer group and handled logistics inquiries for Kuaituantuan orders.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Close the shop, go home, and have lunch.
description: At 12 o'clock she closed the shop on time, explained the afternoon matters to Xiaomei, and walked home. Knowing that her husband had lunch at the company, she made a simple lunch for herself: reheated the leftover tomato and basa fish soup from last night and cooked a small bowl of plain noodles to mix into the soup. While eating, she read several financial news articles on her phone, paying attention to recent consumption trends. After the meal, she brewed a cup of mint tea and leaned back on the sofa, closing her eyes to rest for a while.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Insurance reserve and financial accounting organization.
description: At the desk in the study, she opened the electronic ledger app on her tablet and transferred exactly 633 yuan from part of June's household income to the insurance reserve account. Then she calculated the store's profit, her husband's salary, and the net loss from the Kuaituantuan trial. The loss was within budget, and the shift to basic styles was already showing signs of profit, so she recorded it satisfactorily in her financial diary. Afterwards, she spent half an hour sorting and organizing all June electronic bills (store purchase orders, property and utility fees, daily shopping receipts, etc.) and uploading them to her personal cloud drive for archiving. Along the way, she cleaned up messy screenshots and duplicate photos in her phone album, freeing up storage space.
location: Home study in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take my daughter to the neighbor's house
description: After confirming by phone that Aunt Zhang was home, she held Xuanxuan, who had just been picked up and brought home, and walked to the neighbor's door in the same building. She reminded her daughter to listen to Grandma Zhang and to take the picture book Little Pea in First Grade to continue reading in the evening. Her daughter nodded obediently and ran into Aunt Zhang's house with practiced familiarity.
location: Aunt Zhang’s home, No. 130, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: June review and July planning
description: Back in the study, she opened her spiritual journal and health journal and systematically reviewed her fulfilling June: her daughter's graduation, the insurance secured, a baking failure turning into a community asset, the start of English classes, and the deep friendship with her close friend. Turning every page, she felt deeply moved. On a new page, she wrote "July Key List": keep up daily English shadowing; prepare Xuanxuan's habit adjustments and school supplies before elementary school; schedule a summer trip to Quanzhou to visit relatives; optimize Xiaomei's summer class schedule; and make a second systematic attempt at macarons. Facing the list, she felt a clear direction and full of motivation.
location: Home study in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online business processing and community operations
description: Switched to work mode, processed new orders in the Kuaituantuan backend, and modified an order for a customer who wanted to change sizes. Browsed the active customer community, liked and praised a customer's outfit photo, and replied to several private messages asking about when new arrivals would be in stock.
location: Home study in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare for the evening parent-child activity
description: She went to her daughter's room to check the picture book "Little Pea in First Grade" and laid out comfortable casual clothes for the evening walk on the sofa. At the same time, she took out fresh shrimp, oysters, lean meat and shallots from the fridge for misua noodle soup and started simple thawing and washing preparation. Then she changed into a light set of loungewear herself.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up my daughter and go home
description: Went downstairs to Aunt Zhang's door, rang the doorbell and heard Xuanxuan's happy laughter. Aunt Zhang opened the door and praised Xuanxuan for being well-behaved, saying she had chatted with her all afternoon. I exchanged a few pleasantries with Aunt Zhang, took my daughter's drawing board, thanked her for taking care of Xuanxuan, and walked home holding her hand.
location: Along the route from Auntie Zhang's house at No. 130 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Evening walk around the neighborhood
description: The sunset light was soft, and the mother and daughter strolled leisurely around the neighborhood. I deliberately slowed down and walked behind my daughter, watching her take the initiative to run over and greet the little friend playing on the swing. I sighed inwardly that the child had really grown up. Taking the opportunity, I asked her if she could get up early every morning and go out together after starting elementary school. My daughter nodded seriously and said yes, and then asked whether Mommy would pick her up at the school gate every day. I squatted down, looked into her eyes, and answered firmly: "Yes, Mommy promises you."
location: Inside the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: Returned home, tied on an apron, and started preparing dinner. Boiled a pot of water and marinated the shrimp and oysters with cooking wine and white pepper. After the water came to a boil, she added thin rice noodles, then the marinated seafood, shredded lean pork, and shiitake mushrooms. Before serving, she sprinkled on chopped scallions and cilantro and drizzled with fried shallot oil, finishing a steaming pot of fragrant Quanzhou-style thin noodle soup. She also quickly made a plate of okra tossed with garlic.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and sharing about the day
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang happened to arrive home, and the family of three sat together eating misua noodle soup. Xuanxuan couldn't wait to share how the painting she gave her teacher at today's kindergarten farewell party had deeply moved the teacher; Chen Zhiqiang talked about an amusing incident a colleague had discovered before the system launch; I also talked about the review with Xiaomei and my new ideas for the store for the second half of the year. The warm light and continuous laughter made this the time the whole family cherished most.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child games and washing up
description: After dinner, I played a game of Ludo with Xuanxuan. My daughter cheered and jumped for joy because she won with good luck. Then I ran her bathwater, encouraged her to undress and try brushing her teeth on her own, and hummed her favorite nursery rhyme beside her. After her bath, I dried her hair and changed her into soft cartoon pajamas.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bedtime story
description: After Xuanxuan got into bed, she picked up “Little Pea in First Grade” and read aloud from where she had left off with vivid expression, while my daughter asked innocent questions from time to time. When she finished a chapter, she hugged my neck and wouldn't let go, whispering, “Mommy, although I'm a bit reluctant to leave kindergarten, I want to go to elementary school with you even more.” I felt a whirlwind of emotions, and on the book's flyleaf I wrote: “Sweetheart, let's work hard together.”
location: Daughter's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Meditation and evening journal
description: She gently closed the door and returned to the bedroom, spread out the yoga mat, and sat cross-legged, doing about 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath to clear her mind. After finishing, she felt clear-headed and calm. Then she sat at the desk, took out her diary, and recorded the day's key moments and feelings. She confirmed again that her weight was 49.6kg, the same as yesterday, and smiled with satisfaction. At the end, she drew a period and an arrow and wrote: “Goodbye, June. July, I am ready.”
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, master bedroom and desk

name: Evening free time and getting ready for bed
description: Curled up on the bedroom sofa enjoying some free time, I browsed autumn outfit trends posted by fashion bloggers on my phone, took screenshots of looks that fit the store's style, and replied to messages in my besties' group chat to join the weekend gathering topic. Around 22:25, I received a voice message from my best friend Li Meiling, saying that her prenatal checkup went well, thanking me especially for accompanying her during her difficult time, and looking forward to the children attending the same school in the future. I listened with a smile, replied with a hug emoji, and we said goodnight to each other. Then I set the alarm for 7:00 the next day, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully at 22:40, bringing this month-end workday that links the past and the future to a perfect close.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, preparing breakfast, and having breakfast with family.
description: Woken by the alarm at 06:50, she remembered that the weather forecast said there would be thundershowers in the afternoon, so she put a folding umbrella into the bag by the living room door. In the kitchen, she poured the pumpkin and millet that had been soaked overnight into a pot to cook, and took two plain steamed buns out of the fridge to heat in the steamer. While waiting, she drank a glass of warm water and recorded her weight for today in her phone memo: 49.7kg. At 07:10 she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan and her husband Aqiang. The three sat around the dining table, drinking hot pumpkin millet porridge with soft, fluffy steamed buns. Song Yajing asked Xuanxuan, 'Did you get your painting from yesterday ready for today's graduation farewell party?' Xuanxuan nodded excitedly. Aqiang mentioned that the company project was wrapping up and he might work overtime this week.
location: Home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to kindergarten to attend the graduation farewell party.
description: The family of three went out. Song Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand and walked about 8 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she reminded her that she was the star of the day today and should be happy. At the kindergarten gate, Aqiang waved goodbye and walked to the metro station for work. Song Yajing watched Xuanxuan run into the classroom with her little backpack and hug her teachers and classmates before leaving, reassured.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to Jingxin Wardrobe and organize the morning work.
description: It was about a 3-minute walk from the kindergarten to the shop, passing by breakfast stalls and shops that had already opened. Along the way, she planned today's work in her mind: reconcile June's accounts, set aside the family insurance premium, and ask Xiao Mei for her thoughts on the July new-product display. When she arrived, Xiao Mei had already come in early and finished cleaning. Together, they unpacked, ironed, and re-hung the newly delivered boxes of basic T-shirts and linen shirts, adjusted the window mannequin's outfit, and created a fresh summer atmosphere. She also beat the doormat at the shop entrance clean, ready to welcome the day's customers.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing last month's accounts and setting aside the family insurance premium.
description: After sitting down at the cashier counter, she opened the electronic ledger on her tablet and reconciled the last few transactions of June, confirming that the loss was within budget and that the profitability of the basic models was steadily emerging. Then, according to the special insurance plan, she set aside the family insurance premiums (including critical illness, medical, and accident insurance) from the July budget and transferred them to a dedicated account via mobile banking. She took a screenshot of the successful transfer and sent it to her husband Aqiang, with the message: July coverage is in place, rest easy.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daily operations, serving customers, and maintaining the community.
description: Several regular customers came to the store one after another, and Yajing enthusiastically gave them styling advice. One regular customer tried on some clothes, was satisfied, bought two basic linen shirts, and recommended a friend to come. Taking advantage of the lull in customer flow, she opened WeChat to check the “Jingxin Wardrobe VIP Group,” replied to several customers’ inquiries about shipping times for new arrivals, and announced that she would do a photo-and-text share on “summer commute outfits” in the group tomorrow afternoon. As soon as the announcement was posted, several regular customers immediately replied “Looking forward to it.”
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Booked a personal pottery class online.
description: Taking advantage of the relatively stable morning period, she opened the Dianping app and compared the ratings, environment photos, and adult wheel-throwing course prices of three pottery studios under the categories of "Siming District" and "DIY Craft Workshop". She finally chose a studio called "Nihuoji" on Douxi Road. It had a great reputation, and the environment photos showed a pottery wheel by the window, exactly the style she liked. She booked an adult wheel-throwing experience class from 14:00 to 16:00 on July 26 (Saturday), paid a 20 yuan deposit online, and left a note saying she wanted to try making a teacup. After completing the reservation, she felt delighted and saved a screenshot of the order.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and shift rotation
description: After the morning work came to a pause, Xiaomei went to the Shaxian Snacks at the corner and bought two servings of steamed dumplings and mixed noodles. The two had a simple lunch in the rest area by the fitting room. Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the shop from 12:45 to 14:30, as she wanted to use that time to handle some start-of-month matters and prepare for the afternoon business.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle the July stocking list and communicate with suppliers.
description: Taking advantage of the low afternoon customer flow, she turned on the computer and, based on last month's sales data and this month's plan, drafted a restocking list for mid-July, including basic T-shirts, jeans, and several dresses. Then she sent a message on WeChat to Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou, asking about the inventory of several new products and agreeing to select styles via video call on Thursday evening.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest, afternoon business, and new product display.
