description: 13:30-14:30 was the midday break. She used her phone to browse summer outfit inspiration shared by several fashion bloggers, looking for new styling ideas for her store. During the break, she poured herself a glass of water and stretched her neck after sitting for a long time. At 14:30, she started the afternoon work. Together with Xiao Mei, she unboxed a box of new Guangzhou styles (dresses and wide-leg pants) that Susan had sent last week, styled the new pieces by color and style, hung them in the most prominent spot in the center of the store, and posted two short videos in the community group. During this period, she received three groups of customers and successfully sold one dress and a matching knit cardigan. At 2:30 p.m., the weather turned cloudy and a brief thundershower started. She was glad she had brought her umbrella.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: The rain gradually weakened. She took a long-handled umbrella, left Xiaomei to mind the store alone, and walked about 3 minutes to the kindergarten, by which time the rain had completely stopped. Xuanxuan and her classmates were coming out of the multi-purpose classroom, with stickers on their faces and balloons in their hands. Seeing her mother, she ran over excitedly and said, "Mommy, we gave a choir performance! Teacher Li also gave everyone a hug!" Yajing wiped the sweat from her forehead and held her hand as they walked out of the school gate.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, put down the schoolbag, and change into sportswear
description: Walked about 8 minutes to get home. After entering, she had Xuanxuan wash her hands and use the bathroom by herself, while Song Yajing quickly changed into sneakers and comfortable sweatpants. She greeted her husband Aqiang (who had swapped his shift and gotten off work early today) and said she was going for a walk in the park and would be back in about half an hour.
location: Home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Brisk walking in the park and keeping a health diary
description: After the rain stopped and the sky cleared, the air was fresh. She walked alone to Jiaxingyuan Park beside her residential community. She power-walked along the park path for 30 minutes, about 2.5 kilometers, with a brisk pace. She could feel the results of her recent consistent exercise gradually showing; her body felt lighter and her mind especially relaxed. After the walk, she sat on a bench to rest, opened the memo app on her phone, and recorded today's weight (49.7 kg, steady compared with the beginning of the month) and how the walk felt. She wrote: 'The first day of July, walking after the rain feels wonderful. The breast fullness and pain have almost disappeared, and I have more energy. Keep holding on to this feeling; my body is rewarding me.' After writing, she felt a sense of control over her life and satisfaction.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: Back home, she began preparing dinner. First she cleaned the wuyu (a common sea fish in southern Fujian) bought from the vegetable market, added shredded ginger and scallion segments, and steamed it. Then she washed the romaine lettuce and arugula and tossed them with olive oil and Italian vinegar into a salad as a light evening meal. Her husband Aqiang voluntarily helped peel garlic and set the table, and the two chatted casually about what they had seen and heard that day.
location: Home kitchen, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: At dinner time, the family of three sat together. At the table, Xuanxuan described in detail the process of the morning's graduation farewell party: singing, exchanging gifts, and teacher speeches, and even shared that she felt a little sad. Aqiang comforted her, "You're going to elementary school now. You've grown up, and you'll make more new friends." Song Yajing also shared about booking the pottery class in the afternoon, and Aqiang said he looked forward to the whole family going to experience it together.
location: Dining room at home, Room 502, Building 3, residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Spend time with her daughter: bathing, reading picture books, and bedtime chatting.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a bath and changed her into pajamas. Then the two of them leaned against her little bed and read the newly bought picture book "Little Ali's Big School". Xuanxuan listened very attentively, occasionally pointing at the school bus and classmates in the pictures and asking questions, her eyes full of curiosity about elementary school life. Before turning off the light, Song Yajing and Xuanxuan lay side by side and talked about the happiest thing Xuanxuan did today. Xuanxuan said that she and her best friend Lin Yiyi had agreed to be in the same class when they started elementary school. Yajing told her: "In elementary school, you will meet many more lovely friends, just as warm as the big sisters in Mom's store." She also gently squeezed her daughter's little shoulders and calves to help her relax.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Zhenhai Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Building 3, Room 502: Xuanxuan's bedroom

name: Had a video call with her mother to discuss picking up her parents.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing had just sat down on the living room sofa when a WeChat video call request lit up. It was her mother, Lin Xiuying. In the video, her mother confirmed in detail the exact time to pick them up (after discussion, tentatively set for Saturday morning, July 5). Her father, off to the side, reminded her to drive safely to Quanzhou. Her mother insisted on bringing the Poria powder she had made and a sewing kit. Yajing said with a smile, "Okay, bring them all!" Her mother's hearty laughter came through the phone, and she felt warm inside.
location: Living room at home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening journal and review.
description: After talking with her family, she opened her diary and briefly recorded the day: accounts sorted out, insurance premiums set aside, booked the pottery class she had been longing for, her daughter's graduation party went smoothly, and the family call was warm. She wrote especially: "The first day of July, ordinary and orderly, yet it makes one feel grounded." After that, she opened her electronic calendar and made a note about going to Quanzhou to pick up her parents on the weekend, and also sent a voice message to her best friend Li Meiling, sharing the joy of booking the pottery class today.
location: Home study, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening bedtime routine: wash up, read, and go to sleep.
description: After washing up, she applied a hydrating face mask and lay on the bed, browsing her work plan for the next day on her phone for a while and replying to a goodnight message from a regular customer. Aqiang dimmed the lights nearby. She turned off the phone, picked up the copy of Nutrition and Health from the nightstand, opened it to the folded page, and read a few pages about protein intake. Then she said goodnight to her husband, set the alarm for 6:50 the next morning, and at 22:45, with the peace and satisfaction that all of today's tasks had been completed successfully, she slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Early rising and family breakfast
description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally with anticipation. Hearing her husband Chen Zhiqiang warming milk in the kitchen, she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan, kissed her forehead, and told her that they needed to prepare to welcome Grandpa and Grandma today. The family of three enjoyed the breakfast Yajing had prepared—rice porridge, pork floss, pickled cucumbers, and milk bread—talking about picking up her parents the next day. Yajing reminded her husband to check the car, and Xuanxuan excitedly said she wanted to give Grandma her new drawing.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and walk to the store
description: Yajing put Xuanxuan's sun hat on, held her hand, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, Xuanxuan repeatedly asked when her maternal grandparents would arrive, and Yajing answered patiently. After watching her daughter enter the kindergarten, she walked along the covered arcade toward the shop. Passing a milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she bought a cup of its signature iced lemon tea and drank it as she walked, arriving at Yajing Lifestyle Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road around 8:20 a.m.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road.

name: Shop work and lunch break
description: After arriving at the store, Yajing first turned on the air conditioner, wiped down the display counters, sorted and hung up the new dresses, and sent WeChat messages to the sales clerk Xiaomei to put the new items online early. At 9 a.m., Xiaomei arrived, and the two worked together to arrange and photograph the summer new arrivals: Yajing was responsible for styling and directing, while Xiaomei handled sample preparation and photography. At 10:30, they posted selected pictures to the customer community, announced that the store would close early today and that they might arrive late tomorrow, and customers in the group eagerly asked questions. Afterward, Yajing explained to Xiaomei the precautions for running the store alone the next day, including video displays and customer appointments, and posted the schedule adjustment in the work group. She then settled the day's revenue and checked inventory. After closing at noon, she ate a chicken breast salad as lunch in the store's rest area, while replying to private messages from regular customers, handling stock transfers and appointments, until she left the store at 1:10 p.m. The entire morning was spent efficiently completing the new product launch and customer communication.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying tea and fruit for parents
description: Yajing walked to Zhangji Tea House, her father's favorite, and bought half a jin of premium Tieguanyin; the old shopkeeper gave her tea samples. Then she picked two jin of Guiwei lychees and three Tainong mangoes at the Fresh Fruit Control fruit shop next door, delighted to think of her parents' tastes. Afterward, carrying the items, she hurried back to her home at No. 82 Shanggu Street and put away the tea and fruit.
location: Zhang's Tea House, No. 15 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the nearby Xianguo Kong fruit store

name: Clean the guest bedroom and prepare a shopping list
description: Yajing used a vacuum cleaner and a damp cloth to thoroughly clean the guest bedroom, put on new bedding in off-white with a light green pattern, and set out a night light, mosquito repellent, and a pothos plant. After tidying up, the room felt fresh and clean, freeing up space for her parents. She then rested in the living room, drank water, confirmed the afternoon shopping list (satay noodle ingredients, vegetables, water), and sent her mother a voice message asking about departure time. Her mother replied that they would leave at eight tomorrow, and Yajing said she would go to Quanzhou to pick them up.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Supermarket shopping and contacting in the rain
description: Yajing walked to Yonghui Supermarket and, following the list, bought peanut butter, fresh shrimp, lean meat, fried tofu puffs, bean sprouts, water spinach, loofah, and a case of mineral water, totaling 108 yuan. After leaving the supermarket, she encountered a shower and took shelter under the arcade on Zhenhai Road. She took a photo of the rain scene and sent it to her mother, telling her that the guest bedroom was ready. When the rain eased, she returned home, sorted and stored the ingredients, and changed into a dry casual dress. Then she sent a voice message to her father confirming the pickup details for tomorrow and reminded her mother to bring a coat.
location: Yonghui Supermarket, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Zhenhai Road arcade

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: After the rain stopped, Yajing walked to the kindergarten to pick up Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan asked about the guest room preparations and said she wanted to show her maternal grandparents her toys. Yajing smiled and agreed, and the mother and daughter walked home hand in hand.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Whole family working together on dinner.
description: Xuanxuan was watching cartoons in the living room, while Yajing and Aqiang worked together in the kitchen to make dinner. Aqiang was in charge of handling the fish and cutting vegetables, while Yajing did the cooking, making braised sea bass, stir-fried water spinach, and winter melon tofu soup. During this time, the two discussed the route to pick up her parents in Quanzhou tomorrow and decided to take Xiang'an Avenue to avoid the morning rush. After that, the family of three sat around the table for dinner. Yajing picked food for Xuanxuan, and Aqiang playfully told Xuanxuan to say sweet things tomorrow, making the atmosphere warm. After the meal, Yajing quickly cleared the dishes and organized the leftovers.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Check the vehicle and fill up the tank
description: After dinner, Yajing and Aqiang went to the underground garage and checked the car's tire pressure, brake lights, air conditioning, and fuel gauge. Aqiang used an air pump to inflate the tires. Then Aqiang drove Yajing to the Sinopec gas station on Wenping Road and filled the tank with No. 92 gasoline, ensuring the car was ready for the long trip to pick up their parents the next day.
location: Underground garage of the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Sinopec SenMei Wenping Gas Station, No. 200-1 Wenping Road

name: Burn a CD of the Minnan songs her father loves
description: After getting home, Yajing used her computer in the study to download the Hokkien songs her father loved when he was young, burned them onto a CD, and wrote on the disc, "Dad's songs, safe journey." She planned to play it in the car tomorrow to make her parents' journey pleasant.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Play with daughter and tidy up.
description: Yajing sat on the floor mat and built LEGO with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan built a small car and said she wanted to give it to Grandpa. Then the two tidied up the scattered toys and picture books together. Xuanxuan took the initiative to put the teddy bear on the nightstand to show Grandma, preparing for tomorrow's family reunion.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Help her daughter wash up and read a bedtime story
description: Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a bubble bath, humming a Hokkien nursery rhyme. After the bath, she dried Xuanxuan's hair and changed her into pajamas. In bed, they read the picture book "Reunion." Xuanxuan connected this to the reunion of her maternal grandparents arriving tomorrow. Yajing kissed her daughter's forehead, dimmed the night light, and Xuanxuan gradually fell asleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Confirmed the itinerary with her husband and prepared for bed.
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Yajing and Aqiang sat on the sofa drinking water and chatting, once again checking the details of tomorrow's schedule: Yajing would leave at 7:00, take Xiang'an Avenue, arrive in Quanzhou at around 9:40, and return before 1:00 p.m. She also sent a WeChat message to her older sister Yawen to let her know that their parents would arrive tomorrow, so that her sister could feel at ease. Afterwards, Yajing took a shower, put the CD into her handbag, set the alarm for 6:30, recorded the day's step count of about 8,500 steps, wrote in her health diary, and prayed for a smooth trip tomorrow.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fell asleep with anticipation
description: After turning off the light, Yajing's thoughts wandered—her parents' faces and her daughter's laughter appeared in her mind. Although she fell asleep a little late, she felt grounded and warm inside. She silently recited the Rosary, took deep breaths to relax, hoping to fall asleep soon and conserve her energy for tomorrow's family reunion day.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6 a.m., Song Yajing woke up naturally. She checked the weather, which was cloudy turning clear, and felt delighted. After washing up, she changed into a floral print dress. She then went to the living room to check her belongings: Tieguanyin tea leaves, a CD of old Hokkien songs, her phone, and a power bank. At the door, she checked the bottled water and lumbar pillows in the trunk. Then she went to the underground garage to inspect the car, confirming that the tires, exterior, and fuel level were all normal—everything was ready.
location: Home and the underground garage, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast and farewell
description: At 6:30 a.m., her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared breakfast: millet porridge, fried eggs, and milk. The family of three had breakfast together. Song Yajing told her daughter that today they would go to pick up her maternal grandparents, and her father would pick her up after school. The daughter clapped and cheered happily. After breakfast, Song Yajing helped her husband and daughter organize their things, walked them to the door, and reminded her husband to bring their daughter's water bottle. After saying goodbye, she returned inside to check the water, electricity, doors, and windows.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street, home dining room and entrance

name: Pre-departure preparation and walk to the parking lot.
description: Song Yajing sent a voice message to her mother on WeChat, letting her know she would arrive around 8:30, and received a reply from her mother telling her to take it slow on the road. Then she grabbed her bag and car keys, left the house, walked to the community's underground garage, found her car, put in a CD of old Hokkien songs, started the engine, and drove smoothly out of the community.
location: Home and the underground garage, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Driving to her hometown in Quanzhou
description: Song Yajing drove onto Yanwu Bridge, took Zhenhai Road to enter the Shenhai Expressway, and headed for Quanzhou. Old Minnan songs were playing in the car. Along the way, she received a caring message from her mother on WeChat reminding her to drink water, and she replied via Bluetooth that she had it taken care of. After 1 hour and 30 minutes of driving, she exited the expressway at the Jinjiang exit in Quanzhou and entered Licheng District.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Xiamen-Quanzhou section).

name: Arrived in Quanzhou to reunite with parents
description: Song Yajing parked the car in the usual spot downstairs from her father's building and went upstairs to knock on the door. Her mother greeted her with a smile. Her father, who was reading the newspaper, took off his reading glasses and stood up when his daughter came in. Song Yajing specifically asked about the hearing aid. Her father said the sound was very clear and put it on skillfully. She felt soft and comforted inside, and felt that all the preparation had been worth it.
location: Father's residence, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Accompany parents downstairs for grocery shopping.
description: Song Yajing suggested accompanying her father downstairs for a walk and buying Quanzhou specialties. The three of them walked to the M&G Stationery store (Xinhua Road branch) downstairs, where she bought lens-cleaning cloth for his reading glasses and a coloring book and crayons for her daughter. Her mother bought sewing needles and thread at the adjacent grocery store. Along the way, her father greeted the neighbors with his hearing aid on, and Song Yajing felt deeply at ease.
location: M&G Stationery (Xinhua Road Store) and surrounding area, No. 45 North Xinhua Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Helped pack luggage for the return trip.
description: When she got home, her mother had already packed her luggage: one large and one small bag containing poria powder, a sewing kit, and vanilla seedlings wrapped in plastic wrap. Song Yajing helped carry the luggage downstairs and told her mother that the sheets and duvet covers at home had been changed. Her father confirmed that the gas, water, and electricity were all turned off, and the three of them prepared to set off.
location: Father's residence, No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Drove her parents back to Xiamen.
description: Song Yajing seated her father by the rear window and her mother in the front passenger seat. After they buckled up, she turned up the car stereo. At 10:20 they set off from Quanzhou back to Xiamen. On the way, her father, able to communicate clearly thanks to his hearing aid, happily talked about the changes in Quanzhou's old streets; her mother added posts from the church friends' group. Listening, Song Yajing felt her worries about her father's hearing completely disappear.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Quanzhou-Xiamen section)

name: Arrived home and helped parents settle in
description: At 11:50, they drove safely into the residential community. Song Yajing parked the car, carried the luggage, and brought her parents home. After entering the house, she poured warm tea for her parents and let them rest in the living room. Her mother praised how clean it was in the kitchen; her father sat on the sofa, and she tuned the TV to the news channel for him at a moderate volume.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Considering the fatigue of the journey, Song Yajing quickly cooked her mother's favorite seafood noodles and a few light dishes. After the meal, she cleaned up the tableware, let her parents take their afternoon nap first, and rested on the living room sofa for half an hour herself to store up energy for the afternoon.
location: Dining area and living room at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle store business online.
description: After her lunch break, Song Yajing called her shop assistant Xiaomei to ask about the store situation in the afternoon and told her that she would be at home in the afternoon and could be contacted if anything urgent came up. She then checked the store community and customer messages on her phone and replied to a regular customer's inquiry about coming to the store to try on new arrivals the next day. After that, she made a shopping list for dinner.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went out to buy groceries with her mother.
description: At 2 p.m., after her mother had rested, the mother and daughter walked to the nearby Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market. Following their list, they bought fresh assorted small fish, streaky pork, rice noodles, popiah wrappers, leafy greens, garlic sprouts, and other ingredients. Her mother also deliberately went to a familiar stall to pick out handmade fish balls and squid, saying she would make soup for her granddaughter.
location: Xiasheng (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing dinner together
description: Returning home, Song Yajing tied on an apron and started cooking: she first stir-fried the assorted fish in soy sauce until fragrant, blanched Tong’an braised pork and put it in a clay pot to simmer over low heat, and prepared all the ingredients for fried rice noodles and popiah filling. Her mother trimmed scallions and peeled garlic beside her, helping with the ingredients, and the two chatted about the store’s new styles and funny stories from the church friends group. Her father was watching TV in the living room. Knowing that he wears a hearing aid, she deliberately turned down the TV volume.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Three generations together as daughter returns home from school
description: At 4:40 p.m., the lock turned, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home with their daughter Xuanxuan. As soon as she entered, Xuanxuan rushed to her grandparents, calling out 'Grandma! Grandpa!' Her grandfather was startled at first, then burst into laughter. He touched Xuanxuan's head and said she had grown taller and heavier. Her grandmother squatted down to hug her and took out her phone to share a photo of the mint on the balcony. Song Yajing stood at the kitchen door, watching this scene, her eyes slightly moist.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family enjoyed a hearty dinner together
description: The dinner table was full: Tong'an braised pork, assorted fish in soy sauce broth, fried rice noodles, popiah, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fish ball and squid soup. Song Yajing picked up a piece of her father's favorite braised pork for him. Wearing his hearing aid, he clearly responded that it was soft, tender, and flavorful. Her mother said they shouldn't have gone to so much trouble, but her eyes were full of contentment. The whole family ate and chatted, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening family activities and rest
description: After dinner, Song Yajing and her mother cleared the dishes, while her husband watched cartoons in the living room with her father and daughter. Then her mother took out mint seedlings wrapped in a plastic bag, and the mother and daughter transplanted them into empty flowerpots on the balcony, loosening the old soil and watering them thoroughly. After tidying up the tools and returning to the living room, her husband was already playing Chinese chess with her father. Wearing his hearing aid, her father laughed at every move. Her mother sat on a small stool mending her daughter’s schoolbag with needle and thread, and her daughter leaned over the coffee table drawing with new crayons for her grandma and grandpa. Song Yajing sat nearby replying to a complimentary message from regular customer Vivian.
location: Kitchen, balcony, and living room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime care.
description: At 8:30 p.m., Song Yajing bathed her daughter. After the bath, she specially asked her mother to tell her daughter the story of 'Little Horse Crossing the River,' and the girl giggled at it. Around 9:00, after her daughter fell asleep, she gently closed the bedroom door and went to her parents' room. Her parents had already washed up; her mother was reading articles in the church group on her phone, and her father was reading by the bedside with his hearing aid removed. Song Yajing said goodnight to her parents. Her mother said she would make thin noodle soup the next morning, and she responded as she quietly pulled the door shut.
location: Bathroom, daughter's room, and parents' room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation and preparation for bed
description: After briefly chatting with her husband on the sofa, Song Yajing went downstairs alone and took a slow ten-minute stroll around the neighborhood to stretch her legs, which had been tense from driving all day. After the walk, she went back home and stood quietly on the balcony looking at the two mint seedlings in the moonlight, breathing deeply and taking in the fresh fragrance. Returning to the bedroom, she took out her phone to make a brief health diary entry and record her mood. Seeing 49.9 kg on the scale, she smiled knowingly. At 10:30 p.m., she turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Inside the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the bedroom at home

name: Morning wake-up, family interactions, and a warm breakfast
description: Song Yajing was woken by the alarm clock and felt reassured by the low voices of her parents in the living room and the laughter of her daughter Xuanxuan. When she left the bedroom, her mother had already placed steamed buns and porridge on the table, and her father was pacing on the balcony wearing his new hearing aid, experiencing clear sound. Then the four of them sat around the dining table for breakfast. Yajing asked her father about his first experience with the hearing aid; he said it was clear, but the electric scooter horn downstairs was a bit loud, so Yajing made a note to take it for adjustment. Her mother mentioned that she liked the new buckwheat pillow, while Xuanxuan excitedly shared about the kindergarten's summer garden party. The warm family atmosphere left Yajing content.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking my daughter to school, shopping at the market, and going to the shop
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing walked her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, a 10-minute walk, and watched her skip into the school. Then she walked along the way to the Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, leisurely selecting ingredients for lunch. She bought live shrimp, pomfret, and crushed peanuts that her mother needed to make the popiah filling. She then returned to the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, put away the ingredients, and told her mother they would cook lunch together. After a short rest, she picked up her commuter bag, greeted her father who was on the balcony, and walked to her store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. In the early morning, the pedestrian street was quiet with few people, and the air was filled with the aroma of breakfast shops.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, along the route to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road) and Xiasheng (Zhenhai) Farmers’ Market (No. 56 Zhenhai Road), back home, then to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Handling core tasks at the shop.
description: Song Yajing arrived at Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, where the clerk Xiaomei was already cleaning. She quickly got to work: first, she checked the list of summer clothing that had arrived the day before, found that two dresses were the wrong color, took photos and marked them to contact Susan for an exchange; then she explained the weekend work priorities to Xiaomei, emphasizing keeping the displays tidy and recommending high-profit sets; next, she replied to Susan on WeChat, asking her to send the electronic catalog of the next batch of plus-size women's clothing so she could select styles in advance; finally, she went upstairs and used her phone to take detail photos of the new styles she had organized the day before, and sent them to regular customer Vivian, inviting her to come for a fitting. After the work progressed in an orderly way, she decided to go home early to spend time with her parents.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking home and running into neighbors
description: After finishing the store work for now, Song Yajing walked 7 minutes back to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex. Downstairs in the complex, she ran into Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor who was taking a stroll with a fan in hand. Song greeted her warmly and told her that her parents had moved in to live with them. Aunt Zhang smiled and congratulated her, saying she would come by for a visit another day. The brief neighborhood exchange added a sense of warmth to the community.
location: Downstairs in the residential compound, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing lunch with her mother.
description: Back home, her mother had already washed the rice and was ready to cook. Song Yajing tied on an apron and prepared the fish and shrimp she had bought in the morning. While teaching her mother how to use the new home's high-efficiency gas stove and range hood, she listened to her mother talk about tidying up the balcony clutter that morning and discovering the community library downstairs. The mother and daughter chatted easily, the aroma of dishes filled the kitchen, and their bond warmed through working together.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch, midday rest, and a nap.
description: Lunch was blanched shrimp, steamed pomfret, and water spinach with minced garlic with a light, refreshing taste. After the meal, the family sat on the sofa watching TV news. Outside the window, the sky was getting darker as a hot thunderstorm was approaching. Yajing felt lazy, leaned back on the sofa and dozed off. Her father also rested his eyes in the rattan chair beside her, and her mother went to the bedroom for a nap. Around 13:10 the thunderstorm poured down; the sound of rain became background noise. Yajing slept even more soundly in the bedroom, and the brief rain unexpectedly restored her energy. She woke from her nap feeling full of energy.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying her father to tend the flowers and plants
description: After the rain stopped, the air was fresh. Song Yajing brought tea to the balcony and saw her father straightening the mint seedlings that had been knocked crooked by the rain. Her father advised that mint needs to be pinched at the tips to prevent overgrowth. Taking the opportunity, she asked about the difference between wearing hearing aids in quiet and noisy environments. Her father said that without the hearing aids, the sound of raindrops was muffled, but with them, it felt too loud, so he decided to adapt for a few more days. Father and daughter talked among the flowers, warm and ordinary.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up her daughter from school, showed her mother around the community, and relaxed at the park
description: After the rain stopped, Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, and then went to Jiaxingyuan Park with her mother and daughter. On the way, she introduced her mother to the package pickup method at Cainiao Station and pointed out the nearby medical insurance pharmacy to help her get familiar with the new environment. After arriving at the park, Xuanxuan happily ran to the slide. Yajing and her mother sat on a bench, watching the child and chatting. Her mother marveled at how clean the Xiamen community park was and said she liked the slow pace here. The three of them enjoyed a leisurely afternoon together after the rain.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park and the route along Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First taste of community warmth and returning home to rest.
description: When returning from the park to the residential community, they met Aunt Zhang Xiuying at the gate. Yajing introduced her mother again. Her mother and Aunt Zhang chatted about everything from grocery shopping to grandchildren's education and hit it off very well. Aunt Zhang also gave Xuanxuan some homemade cold rice cake and invited them to visit another day. Her father also walked downstairs and smiled as he watched them chat. After going home, the family rested in the living room, rehydrated, and after a short rest began to prepare dinner.
location: At the community gate of No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and at home.

name: Family works together to prepare dinner.
description: Song Yajing started preparing dinner. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home earlier than usual, arriving at 17:30, and rolled up his sleeves to help pick vegetables in the kitchen. Her mother simmered a pot of kelp pork rib soup, while Yajing stir-fried her signature Tong'an braised pork and greens. The stove was steaming hot; in the living room, her father and husband chatted about current affairs, and Xuanxuan played with building blocks nearby. This was the ordinary, concrete family life scene Yajing longed for most.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Three-generation family dinner time
description: The dishes were served and the family sat around the table. Chen Zhiqiang poured Kinmen Kaoliang liquor for his father-in-law, and the two enjoyed a few drinks. His mother-in-law put food on Yajing's plate, remarking that her daughter's cooking had the same style she had back in the day. The conversation revolved around Xuanxuan's garden party and Sunday plans, with laughter and warm family reunion filling the air.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-dinner family entertainment and quiet time
description: After dinner, her husband volunteered to do the dishes. Song Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan playing with LEGO in the living room, while a children's cartoon was projected on the wall. Her parents sat on the sofa watching TV, occasionally commenting. Father later went to the balcony to look at the night view. Yajing went over to check on him, and Father sighed, wondering whether the mango tree downstairs would bear fruit next year. An ordinary night flowed with the family's tranquility and warmth.
location: Living room and balcony of the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A warm phone call from a church friend
description: Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, called to ask whether her parents were getting used to living there, and warmly invited the family to attend Sunday Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church on Sunday, and then stroll along Longtou Road. Song Yajing handed the phone to her mother, who had a pleasant conversation with Aunt Lin and agreed on a meeting time and pier. After hanging up, her mother beamed and remarked that she now had fellow church members in Xiamen too, and could continue her religious life.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family care and personal time.
description: Song Yajing urged her parents to go wash up and rest first, and after settling Xuanxuan to sleep, returned to her own room. Her husband was already leaning against the headboard. She took out her phone and quickly browsed fashion public account articles, then opened the health app to record the day's step count: 6123 steps, exceeding the community walking plan. This time alone let her sort through the day's sense of fulfillment.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Song Yajing took a hot shower, washing away the day's fatigue. After drying her hair, she felt completely relaxed in both body and mind. From outside the window came the chirping of crickets and the distant sound of traffic. She got back into bed and talked softly with her husband about how her parents were adjusting, then turned off the bedside lamp and got ready to sleep. The peaceful night brought a fulfilling day to a close.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Going to bed
description: In the darkness, Song Yajing truly felt the reassurance of being completely wrapped in family love. The mint her mother had transplanted, the hearing aid her father had adjusted, Aunt Zhang's warmth, the calls from church friends... everything fit together like puzzle pieces to form exactly what 'home' should look like. She drifted off to sleep with a contented heart.
location: Master bedroom bed at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up and tidying up
description: On Saturday morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally, got out of bed quietly, applied light pink lipstick in front of the mirror, thinking that today she would be beaming with energy while spending time with her parents.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Carefully prepared a Minnan-style breakfast.
description: Song Yajing tied on an apron and prepared breakfast in the kitchen. She steamed the meat zongzi she had picked up from her Quanzhou neighbor the night before, skillfully simmered the broth for satay noodles, sliced pork, squid, fried tofu puffs, and duck blood, and also prepared a mango passion fruit tea. The sweet-and-sour aroma spread, waking up the weekend.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A warm breakfast with three generations together.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang led their daughter Chen Lexuan out of the bedroom, and her mother Lin Xiuying helped her father Song Minghui, whose hearing aids had been adjusted, take a seat. Song Yajing served her father the satay noodles she had deliberately made lighter, and he took a taste with a satisfied smile. The family of five ate and chatted, sharing savory rice dumplings and satay noodles in a cheerful and warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-dinner chores and preparations for going out
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang cleared the dishes. She changed her daughter Xuanxuan into a floral dress, filled the water bottle, and took a light jacket, reminding her mother that it would be windy by the sea in the evening. Chen Zhiqiang was watering flowers on the balcony, her father was adjusting his hearing aid in the living room, and Yajing quietly asked whether the volume was comfortable. The family was getting ready for the outing.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked to Zhongshan Road and browsed Yajing Lifestyle Store.
description: The family walked from home to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, enjoying the pleasant morning. Song Yajing held her daughter's hand and walked ahead, while her parents followed slowly behind, taking in the weekend atmosphere of Xiamen's old city. After arriving on Zhongshan Road, they went to Yajing's own shop, 'Yajing Lifestyle Store,' where the clerk Xiaomei was already tidying the shelves. Yajing showed her parents the new autumn silk scarves; her mother waved her hand, but her eyes were full of delight. After browsing for about half an hour, they also stopped at Zhangji Tea House on the street corner, where they bought new Tieguanyin tea, and the owner gave them tea snacks.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the Eighth Market and buy ingredients.
description: After leaving the tea house, Song Yajing suggested going to the Eighth Market to buy fresh vegetables, and her mother readily agreed. Mother and daughter took Xuanxuan through the bustling streets and alleys, immersing themselves in the rich, lively atmosphere of the market. At the seafood stall, they carefully picked two yellow croakers and half a jin of live shrimp, and at the vegetable stall bought water spinach, loofah, and old ginger. Xuanxuan watched the crabs in the tank curiously and clapped her hands excitedly. Mother and daughter enjoyed a harmonious time together bargaining and chatting.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, put away the ingredients, and take a short break
description: The mother and daughter walked home carrying their full bags. After arriving home, Song Yajing put away the ingredients one by one and cleaned the yellow croaker and shrimp; her mother picked over the water spinach, muttering that the stalks were a bit old and should be snapped off. After putting things away, Yajing wiped her face with a damp towel, opened the fridge to check, and found the soy sauce was almost gone, making a mental note to buy some on the way to Gulangyu tomorrow.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A hearty Minnan home-style lunch
description: Lunch was prepared by Song Yajing and her mother together. The dishes included soy-sauce yellow croaker, blanched shrimp, stir-fried eggs with luffa, sweet potato leaves, and meat zongzi—a table full of food. Her father looked at the full table and sighed, "This is what eating at home should be." The family of five sat together, sharing the morning's experiences, with laughter all around.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family midday nap and leisure time
description: After lunch, Chen Zhiqiang took his daughter Xuanxuan to take a nap, promising to take her out for ice cream when she woke up. Song Yajing made up the guest room bed for her mother, then brought water to the balcony, where her father was flipping through an old recipe book. Leaning against the doorframe, she asked softly, "Dad, this afternoon, shall I help you divide the mint into pots?" Her father nodded approvingly. Everyone in the family rested or did quiet activities.
location: Bedrooms and balcony of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child time and casual chat on the balcony
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, Song Yajing and her father divided mint into pots on the balcony. She carefully split one plant into three. Her mother sat nearby picking green beans, listening to them chat. Yajing took the opportunity to say, "Dad, tomorrow for Gulangyu, Mass is at nine in the morning; if we set off at eight, we'll make it." The warm, natural conversation among family members was lovely.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and driving to the seaside along Huandao Road
description: After finishing the balcony activities, Song Yajing returned to the living room and changed into a T-shirt and shorts, then checked the sunscreen and tissues in her backpack. She took a jacket for each of her parents and checked her daughter's car seat. Chen Zhiqiang first went to the garage to back out the car. Then the family drove to the seaside near Dapingshan Park on Huandao South Road. Chen Zhiqiang drove smoothly, while Yajing stayed in the back seat with her parents and daughter, looking out the window at the beautiful view of the setting sun dyeing the sea golden.
location: Seaside near Dapingshan Park, Huandao South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk along the seaside on Huandao Road
description: The setting sun was sinking in the west, and a gentle sea breeze blew. The family strolled along the boardwalk near Dapingshan Park on South Huandao Road. Song Yajing linked arms with her father, her mother held Xuanxuan's hand, and Chen Zhiqiang snapped photos from behind. Xuanxuan chased the waves barefoot, with her mother following close behind, exclaiming in surprise. When they got tired of walking, Yajing and her father sat on a bench. Her father turned his head and said softly, 'You've grown thin. Don't push yourself too hard.' Yajing's nose tingled and tears welled up. She buried her face in her father's shoulder, and the sound of the waves gently embraced her vulnerability.
location: Huandao Seaside Bathing Beach, No. 1 Huandao South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return to the city center and buy fruit on the way.
description: The sun sank below the horizon, and only then did the family reluctantly get back in the car and head home. On the way back, Chen Zhiqiang stopped at the fruit shop at the entrance of the residential community. Song Yajing got out and bought half a watermelon and two boxes of blueberries, thinking that since her mother was suffering from internal heat, eating blueberries would help clear the heat. Then they returned home.
location: Fruit shop at the entrance of the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China.

name: Preparing dinner and getting her daughter washed and settled
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing put the cut watermelon in the fridge. Chen Zhiqiang cooked the green beans that his mother had trimmed in the afternoon, and also made a pot of plain rice porridge. Yajing then bathed her daughter Xuanxuan, washing off the fine sand from playing at the beach. After the bath, she put Xuanxuan, now in pajamas, to bed, told three little stories, and Xuanxuan soon fell asleep hugging the dolphin plush toy.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night talk with parents, regaining direction in life
description: Song Yajing brewed the newly bought Tieguanyin, and the tea fragrance filled the air. She slowly talked about the ups and downs since opening the shop, the anxiety of overstocking, and the guilt of not being able to accompany her daughter. Her mother held her free hand and patted it gently. Her father shared his experience of being transferred to a middle school in his youth and learning physics from scratch, advising her to 'calm her heart and slow her pace.' Yajing's eyes grew moist again, but this time it was with clarity and relief. Through this long talk, she regained her sense of direction in life.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recorded reflections and family plans, and booked Gulangyu ferry tickets.
description: After the long talk ended, her parents went back to their room to rest. Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa, opened her usual notebook, and wrote solemnly: 'First, go back to Quanzhou at least once a month to spend a weekend with Mom and Dad. Second, before the end of the year, arrange a short family trip, even if it's just to Wuyishan.' Looking at these two lines, she felt an unprecedented sense of reassurance. Then she took out her phone, opened the official account of Xiamen Ferry Co., Ltd., and skillfully booked tickets for all five family members for tomorrow at 7:50 a.m. from Xiamen Ferry Terminal to Sanqiutian Pier.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up before bed and checking in with family
description: After washing up, Song Yajing applied toner while sending a WeChat message to her older sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen: "Sis, Mom and Dad were very happy today and their condition is stable. I talked a lot with Dad and feel much better. Yeah, I'll adjust my pace." After sending the message, she turned off her phone, lay down on the bed, listened to her husband's even breathing, felt incredibly peaceful, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, five minutes before the alarm, got out of bed quietly, washed up quickly, and changed into a cotton-linen dress. Placed the scripture booklet and water bottle for her parents' Mass on the entryway shoe cabinet. Then went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: cooked white porridge, fried sunny-side-up eggs and scallion pancakes, and cut chilled mango. Had breakfast with her parents, husband Chen Zhiqiang, and daughter Chen Lexuan. During the meal, she checked with her father about the comfort of his hearing aid and told him today's plans. After the meal, she helped her mother straighten her scarf, re-confirmed the e-tickets for the Gulangyu ferry on her phone, and put on her lightweight canvas tote bag with water, a power bank, keys, and a small box of Xiamen pies for Auntie Lin, a fellow church member.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk and take a ferry to Gulangyu Catholic Church
description: Walked with her parents from home to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, enjoying the blooming flame trees along the way. After arriving at the terminal, they boarded the ferry with ID card scans and took it to Gulangyu Sanqiutian Pier. On the boat, she took a warm photo of her parents' backs as they stood side by side watching the sea. After landing, they walked about ten minutes along alleys paved with stone slabs, passed banyan trees with hanging aerial roots, and arrived at Gulangyu Catholic Church.
location: Walk from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, take a ferry to Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu Island, then walk to Gulangyu Catholic Church (No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District).

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Attended Sunday Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church; the church organ was solemn. Father Wang's sermon topic was 'Family is a safe haven.' Mother was moved and grasped Song Yajing's hand, her eyes moist; Father was not familiar with the hymn melodies but looked focused. After Mass ended, fellow parishioner Aunt Lin Xiuying warmly came over, welcomed the parents, and asked if they would come again next week.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Courtyard socializing and a walk with Mom.
description: Aunt Lin Xiuying and her mother chatted for nearly half an hour in the shade of the church courtyard, with topics ranging from church activities to family matters, while Song Yajing refilled their water. Then she accompanied her parents on a stroll through the alleys near the church, feeling the tranquility of Gulangyu. Passing the 'Most Beautiful Corner,' she suggested taking a photo. Her father rarely took the initiative to hold her mother's arm, and Song Yajing captured this heartwarming moment.
location: The courtyard of Gulangyu Catholic Church and the surrounding alleys, near the 'Most Beautiful Corner' (near Lujiang Road, Siming District)

name: Take a ferry back to Xiamen Island.
description: Walked slowly back from the church to Sanqiutian Pier, buying two bottles of iced mineral water along the way. On the return ferry, my mother dozed off leaning on my father's shoulder. Song Yajing leaned against the ship's rail, watching the gradually receding Gulangyu Island, and thought about the layout of the afternoon photo wall.
location: Take a boat from Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu Island back to Xiamen Ferry Terminal (Siming District).

name: Strolled along Zhongshan Road and walked home
description: After getting off the boat, they strolled along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. At Fuyu Flower Shop, they picked out a small bunch of jasmine flowers to decorate the photo wall. She took her parents to a decades-old, time-honored snack stall and bought two portions of piping-hot, old-fashioned water chestnut cake, which her mother praised endlessly. Then they walked home along Zhongshan Road and Siming South Road. Her father looked at the familiar arcade buildings and marveled at how much Xiamen had changed.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (Zhongshan Road, Siming District) and along the route, finally walking back to the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Prepared and enjoyed a simple lunch
description: After arriving home, she let her parents rest in the living room, quickly cooked noodles using the leftover pork rib soup from last night, stir-fried a green vegetable, and made a simple lunch in ten minutes. She woke up her dozing parents, and the three of them sat together eating the light pork rib soup noodles.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break, preparation, and going to the store to print photos.
description: Her parents went back to their room for an afternoon nap. Song Yajing organized her phone album on the living room sofa, putting the photos to be printed that day – the family portrait, her daughter's quirky shots, and her mother's profile – into a dedicated folder. She also messaged Xiao Mei, the store clerk, telling her to come to the store in the afternoon and prepare tape and scissors. At 13:30, she woke up her parents, and they walked together to the store. On the way, near the store, she printed 15 glossy 6-inch photos at a quick print shop and bought colored paper tape.
location: At home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then walked to "Yajing Life Gallery" at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and the nearby quick-print shop.

name: Decorate the family photo wall in the shop
description: At the entrance of Yajing Lifestyle Gallery, she and Xiaomei used colored paper tape to create the outline of the Chinese character 'home' on the blank wall. Song Yajing was in charge of the layout design; her mother helped pass photos and tape; her father stepped back a few steps to adjust whether the photos were straight. The family portrait was placed in the center, surrounded by Xuanxuan's funny-face photo, her mother's profile in the kitchen, and a group photo with customers. As soon as the wall was arranged, some young women passing by stopped to take photos. Song Yajing handed them sticky notes and invited them to write down their own family stories and stick them nearby.
location: Entrance to "Yajing Lifestyle Store," No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After a short rest at the shop, walked home with her parents.
description: Setup complete. I brewed the store's flower tea for my parents on the sofa in the shop and had iced lemonade myself. Xiaomei excitedly told me that customers had added her on WeChat and praised the photo wall for being touching. After handing over the evening shift to Xiaomei, I walked home slowly with my parents. On the way, my father remarked that young people's ideas are really interesting.
location: Walked back from "Yajing Lifestyle House" at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Balcony mint tea time and park walk
description: After returning home, her mother picked fresh mint leaves on the balcony and made tea. The three of them sat on rattan chairs enjoying the fragrant mint tea. Her father looked at the empty flowerpot and softly said he wanted to add a bougainvillea; Song Yajing silently took note. Around 5 p.m., she suggested a walk in Jiaxingyuan Park across the street. The three walked two slow laps along the cobblestone path, admiring the pink-purple sunset reflected on the artificial lake.
location: Balcony, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; later walked to Jiaxingyuan Park (Bailu Road, Siming District)

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already busy in the kitchen. Song Yajing put on an apron to help, and together they made steamed sea bass (her father's favorite), scrambled eggs with tomatoes (her daughter's favorite), and garlic stir-fried water spinach. Her husband went to the kindergarten to pick up their daughter Xuanxuan, and the whole family of five sat down for dinner. Xuanxuan excitedly showed off the "little cat" she had drawn during the day, making everyone laugh.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family entertainment and bedtime activities with my daughter
description: After dinner, her husband volunteered to wash the dishes, and the whole family sat in the living room watching TV. Her father told Xuanxuan Minnan folk tales, and her mother put on reading glasses and flipped through the photos printed that afternoon, picking the ones she was satisfied with to frame. Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan bathe and change into her bear pajamas, then leaned against the headboard to read 'Guess How Much I Love You.' Xuanxuan stretched out her little hands and gestured, 'I love you this much.' After hearing the story, she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal reflection and handling store affairs.
description: Returned to the study to write in my diary, recording today's reflections: my father wants bougainvillea to make life appear beautiful, and the positive feedback on the store's photo wall strengthened my confidence in pursuing a warm, emotional business approach. Then I sent a WeChat message to my older sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen to let her know I was safe and attached photos from the day. I opened the store's backend management system to check the sales records, sent a message to the supplier of the new autumn styles to confirm the shipment, and jotted down in my memo to go to the flower market next week to find bougainvillea for my father.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bedtime activities and going to sleep
description: She carefully cleansed her face and did her skincare routine, then said a brief bedtime prayer at the bedside, thanking the Lord for keeping the family safe and harmonious. After lying down, she selected 9 photos from those taken during the day (her parents' backs, the church steeple, close-ups of the photo wall, her mother's profile holding a teacup, a funny photo with Xuanxuan, etc.), applied a gentle filter, and posted them to Moments with the caption "Peace of the Sabbath... the years are serene." After turning off the light, she chatted softly with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She told him her father wanted bougainvillea, and her husband agreed to go to the flower market together on the weekend. The two held hands, said "It's so good to have you," and then fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and stretching
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the phone alarm went off, and Song Yajing woke up half an hour earlier than usual. She changed into the quick-drying T-shirt and capri pants she had bought yesterday for workouts, closed the door quietly, and headed to Jiaxingyuan Park. On the loop trail around the park, she walked briskly at a steady pace using the method she had learned online, swinging her arms and feeling her heart rate rise slightly. After two laps, she felt refreshed. Then she stretched her legs on the stone steps of the pavilion. She took a photo of the morning light in the park with her phone, sent it to the family group chat with the caption "Good morning, day one of a new habit." After that, she walked home and bought two cups of hot soy milk at the breakfast stall downstairs. Throughout the whole process, she felt the meaning of her father's advice: "Take care of yourself first."
location: Jiaxingyuan Park and its pavilion, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (returning home)

name: Wake up her daughter and prepare breakfast.
description: Returning home to No. 82 Shanggu Street, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already washed up. Song Yajing first went to her daughter Chen Lexuan's room, gently woke her up, braided her pigtails, and changed her into her kindergarten uniform. Chen Zhiqiang heated up the small buns and milk bought yesterday in the kitchen, and poured the soy milk he had bought that morning into a cup. At breakfast, Song Yajing told her husband that she had tried brisk walking in the morning and felt great. He smiled and said that in the future he could take responsibility for taking their daughter to school, encouraging her to keep up her morning exercise.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (bedroom, kitchen, living room)

name: Changing clothes and commuting to the store.
description: After a quick shower, Song Yajing changed into an off-white linen shirt and dark blue wide-leg trousers and put on light makeup. She took her store keys, phone, and power bank and headed out. She walked from home to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Xiamen Metro Line 1 (toward Yannei) two stops to Zhongshan Park Station, exited at Exit 3, walked along Zhongshan Road for about 5 minutes, and arrived at the Yajing Life Gallery clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street at 8:05.
location: From the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Yajing Life Gallery, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, passing Zhenhai Road Metro Station and Zhongshan Park Metro Station

name: Preparations before opening the store
description: After arriving at Yajing Life Gallery, Song Yajing pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioner and shop lights, and wiped down the display racks. She checked the autumn sample clothing package that arrived yesterday afternoon, unpacked it, quickly ironed and hung up the items, and arranged a few outfit combinations in the window. Seeing the sticky notes left by customers on the family photo wall she had set up yesterday, she felt happy.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store hours
description: Staff member Xiao Mei arrived at the store at 9. There were not many customers on Monday morning. Around 10, several tourists came in, tried on multiple outfits, and Song Yajing recommended combinations based on their styles, successfully closing two sales (a floral print dress and a base top). Between customers, she opened her computer to organize last week's sales data and made a restock list.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and purchasing sports equipment
description: After giving instructions to store clerk Xiaomei, Song Yajing walked about 5 minutes to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City. She ordered a chicken sandwich and iced lemon tea and, while eating, checked her morning exercise data on her phone. After the meal, she walked to the Shengdao Sports store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After trying on several pairs of walking shoes, she chose a pair of light gray walking shoes with good cushioning and also bought two pairs of quick-dry sports socks and a lightweight sports water bottle. She felt satisfied when checking out. Then she walked back to the store carrying her new gear.
location: 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Shengdao Sports Exclusive Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District

name: Afternoon business and call with a supplier.
description: Song Yajing returned to Yajing Lifestyle Studio carrying the newly bought sports gear and put the shoes under the cash register. In the afternoon she continued receiving customers. Around two o'clock, she called Manager Li, the supplier in Guangzhou, to discuss the exchange and restocking schedule for autumn sample garments; the other party confirmed shipment next week. From three to five, several regular customers came in to try on autumn clothes. She helped them with styling and completed two membership top-ups.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up her daughter from school and walk home.
description: Song Yajing told Xiaomei to clean up and finish up, left the store 15 minutes early, and walked through several alleys to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She arrived at the kindergarten gate around 17:20 and picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Xuanxuan wore her hair in two little pigtails and bounced along, sharing that she had learned to fold a paper boat today. Song Yajing held her daughter's hand and strolled along Zhenhai Road, listening to her sing nursery rhymes. On the way, at the Jizheng chain supermarket at No. 76 Zhenhai Road, she bought bread for tomorrow's breakfast and two bottles of water. Then they continued walking back to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, with a stop at Jizheng Chain Supermarket, No. 76 Zhenhai Road along the way.

name: Arriving home and preparing dinner
description: After arriving home, her parents Song Jianguo and Li Xiuzhen were in the living room (her mother watching a Hokkien-language program, her father flipping through the newspaper). Her husband Chen Zhiqiang took the things. Song Yajing changed into loungewear and went to the kitchen to help trim vegetables and rinse rice. Tonight her husband was making yellow croaker in soy sauce water, and she was in charge of cutting ginger into shreds and chopping scallions. Their daughter was in the living room pestering her grandfather to teach her to write numbers.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room, kitchen)

name: Three-generation family dinner
description: Dinner was in the dining room, with dishes including soy-sauce yellow croaker, stir-fried spinach, tomato and egg soup, and the old-fashioned oyster omelet her father loved. At the table, Song Yajing shared how her morning brisk walk had gone. Her father said approvingly, 'So you took that to heart? Then stick with it.' Her mother added a reminder to drink warm water first thing in the morning. The family chatted warmly, supporting her new healthy habit.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Discussing the morning plan with her husband on the balcony.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang carried the mint tea brewed by her mother to the rattan chairs on the balcony and sat down. As the evening breeze blew, she formally proposed that she wanted to continue morning exercise in the long term and that her husband would need to share more of the responsibility for taking their daughter to school. Chen Zhiqiang readily agreed, saying he was an early riser anyway and could take over the school run, and he considerately told her not to push herself if she felt too tired. The two also discussed the store's current situation, and Chen Zhiqiang suggested hanging a small blackboard at the store entrance and setting up a special-price area.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family entertainment time
description: Back in the living room, her daughter Chen Lexuan got the whole family to play the "You Act, I Guess" card game. She hopped around acting like a little rabbit, and when Song Yajing couldn't guess, her daughter stomped her foot in frustration, making the grandparents laugh heartily. Song Yajing also acted out "bougainvillea" for her parents; her mother guessed "moth orchid," and her father added that bougainvillea is better suited for the balcony. The atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up for daughter and bedtime stories
description: Song Yajing bathed Chen Lexuan, dried her off, and changed her into pajamas. After lying down with her, she read her the picture book The World Champion of Not Sleeping. Halfway through, her daughter's eyelids were already drooping. Song Yajing softly asked her if she wanted to go for a brisk walk in the park together tomorrow, and her daughter mumbled "Mm" and fell asleep.
location: Home bathroom at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Chen Lexuan's bedroom.

name: Personal tidying and tomorrow's plan
description: Back in the bedroom, Song Yajing opened her phone to check notifications in the church group and noted that there would be a youth activity next Sunday. She checked her fitness app and felt a sense of accomplishment when she saw she had taken more than 9,000 steps today. She flipped through the All-Round House Renovation King magazine, read a few pages of balcony renovation cases, and planned to go to the flower market on the weekend to buy bougainvillea. Then she took her newly purchased walking shoes out of the bag, placed them neatly on the mat at the bedroom door, and looked at them with satisfaction.
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China.

name: Bedtime prayers and couple's nighttime talk.
description: Song Yajing knelt by the bed, made the sign of the cross, and said her bedtime prayers, thanking the Lord for keeping her family safe and giving thanks for starting new habits. After gently saying goodnight, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came into the room. The two talked about going to the baking studio in Huli District next week to see if they could book a class. Her husband suggested driving the whole family to the flower market on the weekend. As they chatted, Song Yajing yawned. Chen Zhiqiang smiled and turned off the light, and they both went to bed early.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning preparation and living room interaction
description: The sky was just beginning to lighten. Song Yajing was awakened by her internal clock. She picked up her phone from the bedside and got up quietly without waking her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She felt both excited and a little nervous about her first morning brisk walk; the light gray walking shoes she had bought the day before were placed at the bedroom door. She changed into quick-dry sportswear and the new shoes, tied her hair into a neat ponytail, and drank a glass of warm water. When she opened the bedroom door, her father Song Minghui was already sitting on the living room sofa drinking tea, with the electric kettle still steaming. Her father gave a gentle smile and said, 'Awake? Let's go.' Song Yajing felt a warmth in her heart, knowing that her father must have woken up at five o'clock, afraid that she would be alone. She took his arm on her own, quietly closed the door, and went downstairs.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and buying breakfast
description: Father and daughter walked out side by side; the morning breeze was slightly cool and there were few pedestrians. They walked about 14 minutes from the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street to Jiaxingyuan Park. Song Yajing did her first morning brisk walk on the park's lakeside trail, with light and quick steps; her father did simple stretches on a nearby bench, his eyes following his daughter, and handed her a towel halfway through. The half-hour brisk walk made her sweat a little and she felt especially grounded. Afterward, the father and daughter walked about 22 minutes along Bailu Road to Zhen Mo Fang on Gongyuan South Road, bought her father's favorite fried dough sticks and soy milk, and her father insisted on adding a steamer basket of xiaolongbao, saying it was for Xuanxuan and Aqiang. They then carried the breakfast and walked 8 minutes back to the community.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Zhen Mo Fang, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast.
description: After returning home, her father went to wash up, and Song Yajing plated the breakfast and reheated the buns bought yesterday to make the breakfast table more plentiful. The family sat around the table: Yajing, her father, her mother Lin Xiuying, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and her daughter Chen Lexuan. Yajing excitedly talked about her morning exercise experience and the morning plan: cleaning the balcony and buying lounge chairs for her parents. Her mother smiled and said she would help choose, and Aqiang readily said he could take their daughter to school. Xuanxuan talked in a sweet, childish voice about her dream of seeing a rainbow last night, and the atmosphere was cozy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Seeing family off and walking to the shop
description: After breakfast, Aqiang helped Xuanxuan put on her backpack, and the two left first, walking to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Song Yajing watched them go, then turned to head to the shop to open up and deal with things.
