She walked along the old street; from the community to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street took about 15 minutes. On the way, she saw the window of a newly opened milk tea shop and thought she could bring her daughter on the weekend to try it.
location: On the way from the community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact about store opening and inventory count.
description: Song Yajing arrived at the shop, opened the door, turned on the air conditioner and the cash register system, and then shop assistant Xiaomei also came on duty. She briefly discussed the day's key tasks with Xiaomei. Afterward, Yajing took out the purchase order, sat at the cash register, and called the supplier Susan to confirm that the previously ordered summer dresses had been shipped and were expected to arrive tomorrow or the day after. She breathed a sigh of relief.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking home and cleaning the balcony
description: After handling store matters, Song Yajing walked home. Passing the fruit stall at the neighborhood entrance, she saw fresh Kyoho grapes and, remembering that her mother loved them, bought a bunch on the spot. When she got home, her mother had already taken Xuanxuan to the park. Yajing changed into old clothes and started cleaning the balcony with her father. The father and daughter worked together to move away old flowerpots and fold empty cardboard boxes. Yajing played the hymn 'Amazing Grace' on her phone, and her father hummed along. Amid the work and singing, the balcony became spacious and tidy.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Short break and ordering balcony furniture.
description: After the cleanup, looking at the spacious balcony, Song Yajing was in a great mood. She rested on the living room sofa, drank a glass of water, and opened a home furnishing app to choose furniture for the leisure corner. She soon found the rattan leisure chair with a beige cushion and the foldable small coffee table she had liked before. After comparing dimensions and reviews, she decisively placed the order and added the note 'Please be sure to reinforce the packaging.' After the order was placed successfully, she sent a screenshot of the order to her husband Aqiang to share her joy and began to imagine the cozy scene of her parents drinking tea and chatting on the balcony.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Noon preparation and family interaction
description: Her mother brought Xuanxuan back from the park. Song Yajing made a simple lunch of tomato and egg noodles. After the meal, her mother took out her phone and opened a saved tiramisu recipe, then enthusiastically drew her daughter in to study the ingredients and steps together. Although they weren’t making it today, seeing her mother so happy made Yajing feel content as well.
location: Dining area and living room at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and preparing to head out
description: After chatting with her mother, a wave of drowsiness came over Song Yajing. She returned to the bedroom, lay down, and set an alarm for 1:30 p.m. When the alarm went off, she felt much more refreshed, put on a fresh floral-print dress, and got ready to go to the store in the afternoon.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking to the store and afternoon work
description: Song Yajing walked again to her shop on Zhongshan Road with light steps, and on the way sent Xiaomei a WeChat message saying she would arrive in about twenty minutes. After arriving, she and Xiaomei adjusted the displays together, hanging the newly arrived tops in prominent positions. Then she took out the slightly wilted pothos in the shop, repotted it in a slightly larger ceramic pot, went to the flower shop next door to buy potting soil, carefully added soil and watered it, made the pothos look vibrant again, and placed it by the cash register.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Rest and Return Home
description: With the work done for the time being, Song Yajing washed her hands, drank a glass of water, and checked the logistics status of the balcony furniture on her phone, which showed it had been shipped. Feeling delighted, she called her mother to say she was about to finish work and go home, and that they would go for a walk and buy groceries together later. She then closed the shop door and walked home.
location: On the way back from No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Pick up family and take a walk in the park.
description: After arriving home and meeting up with her parents and daughter, the family of four set out on foot toward Jiaxing Garden Park. On the way, her father noticed the bougainvillea blooming brightly by the roadside and muttered that he wanted to grow one in a pot on the balcony. Yajing smiled and agreed to check out the flower market on the weekend. They strolled leisurely along the tree-lined paths of the park, with Xuanxuan running and jumping ahead, while Yajing walked arm in arm with her mother chatting about everyday things. The half-hour walk soothed her calves, which had been slightly sore that morning, and left her in a particularly relaxed mood.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Supermarket shopping and returning home
description: After the walk, the family walked about 10 minutes from the park to the Yonghui Supermarket on Zhenhai Road. Song Yajing pushed the shopping cart, choosing asparagus and shrimp that Xuanxuan loved, and seabass that her father loved, and also bought greens and seaweed. Her mother held Xuanxuan's hand and picked a box of cheese sticks in the snack area. After shopping, they carried the shopping bags and walked home slowly. Xuanxuan was a bit tired and snuggled in her grandfather's arms. Yajing felt she had walked a lot, and the soreness in her legs came back, but her heart was full.
location: Yonghui Superstore (Zhenhai Road Store), Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the way home

name: Preparing dinner together
description: A Qiang also got home from work, and all five family members were busy together in the kitchen and dining room. Song Yajing handled the asparagus and shrimp, A Qiang skillfully cut and steamed the sea bass, and her parents helped pick vegetables and set out dishes and chopsticks. Soon, stir-fried asparagus with shrimp, steamed sea bass, and seaweed egg drop soup were served.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dinner table, chatting about the day's events as they ate. Song Yajing shared the good news that the balcony furniture had been shipped; her father said the cleaned balcony looked pleasing; Xuanxuan kept praising her father's fish dish.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family Fun Time
description: After the meal, Aqiang took the initiative to clear the dishes and went to the kitchen. Song Yajing accompanied her mother and Xuanxuan to play with sticker books in the living room, while her father sat on the sofa watching the news with Aqiang. The living room was filled with the child’s laughter and the adults’ conversation.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretching.
description: After washing up, Song Yajing changed into pajamas, took out her yoga mat and foam roller, and sat cross-legged to do several deep breaths. Then she spent a full 20 minutes stretching and foam-rolling her calves, which felt sore and swollen from today, while replaying the warm details of the day in her mind and feeling full of gratitude.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep.
description: Back in the bedroom, she lit a lavender aromatherapy candle and knelt beside the bed to pray, thanking the Lord for giving her parents health, her husband's thoughtfulness, and small achievements today such as morning exercise, cleaning the balcony, and ordering furniture. Though her body was tired, she felt especially peaceful inside. Then she lay down on the bed. Aqiang, having finished his work, came into the room, and the two quietly talked about plans for tomorrow. She fell into a deep sleep with contentment and a hint of fatigue.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning brisk walk in the park
description: Because her father wanted to rest more, Song Yajing went out alone for morning exercise. She changed into a sports top and shorts and briskly walked along the familiar loop trail in Jiaxingyuan Park. The air was moist and fresh. She walked 3 kilometers at a steady pace in about 30 minutes, and after stretching, she felt invigorated all over and refreshed.
location: Inner loop trail of Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying breakfast for the whole family.
description: After power walking, Song Yajing stopped by Aling's misua soup shop. She packed an order of pork liver misua with egg for her husband, ordered plain congee and pickled vegetables for her parents, bought a jianbing for her daughter, and stood in the shop drinking a cup of hot soy milk while chatting briefly with the owner, Aling, about the weather.
location: Aling Mianxian Hu (Xi'an Road Store), Xi'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast time
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing handed the breakfast to her mother to deal with, then quickly showered and changed into an off-white cotton-linen dress and flat shoes. The family of five sat around the dining table. Her parents discussed bringing pineapple cakes back to Quanzhou, her daughter excitedly performed a newly learned nursery rhyme, and her husband reminded everyone that it might rain in the afternoon and they should bring umbrellas. The breakfast atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing walked hand in hand with her daughter Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, reminding her along the way to drink more water and cover up well during nap time. At the gate, she watched her daughter greet the teacher and skip into the classroom before she turned and left with peace of mind.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and sales data consolidation
description: After walking about 10 minutes from the kindergarten, she entered Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Along the way, she nodded to Lao Zhang, the owner of Zhangji Tea House. After arriving at the store, she made some simple display adjustments with Xiaomei and opened on time at 9 a.m. Then Song Yajing organized the sales data from April to June at the cash register, tallying sales by category, return reasons, and customer feedback. She found that French vintage dresses and flowing tailored shorts were best sellers, while avant-garde styles were slow-moving, which gave a clear direction for autumn collection planning.
location: At the cash register inside Yajing Life Gallery, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Song Yajing asked Xiao Mei to watch the shop, then went to 85°C in Zhonghua City for lunch. She bought a Caesar salad and an iced Americano, sat by the window eating while looking at her phone, browsed the discussion in her close friends' chat about Hangzhou parent-child afternoon tea models, saved the store-visit photos Zhao Min shared, and vaguely had an idea for an event.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon shop operation and planning the parent-child afternoon tea event.
description: In the afternoon, a light rain began to fall, and the store saw few customers. After making tea, Song Yajing sat in the rest area and officially proposed a parent-child afternoon tea event in the besties' group chat. She quickly divided the work with Meiling and Zhao Min: Zhao Min would handle the online process, Meiling would handle the warm-up, and she herself would work out the specific plan—imagining a combination of 'mini flower arranging + low-sugar cupcake DIY,' priced at cost, with the number of spots tentatively set at 6 groups. She also drew a sketch of the event poster by hand. When regular customer Vivien came to pick up her reserved dress and saw the sketch, she praised it repeatedly and was the first to sign up.
location: Rest area of Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing closed the shop early, walked to the kindergarten with an umbrella, and picked up her daughter on time. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her mother, she ran over, carefully took an origami frog out of her pocket, and excitedly showed the paper-folding creation her teacher had just taught her. Mother and daughter shared an umbrella and walked home in the rain.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home to spend time with family and help prepare dinner.
description: After returning home, her mother was accompanying her father watching the news, and the ingredients were already prepared in the kitchen. Song Yajing first settled her daughter to wash her hands and change clothes, then went to the kitchen to help pick vegetables, wash rice, and cook rice. She chatted with her mother and mentioned the plan for the afternoon tea. Her mother reminded her not to work too hard. She personally stir-fried a plate of garlic vegetables and made tomato and egg drop soup. Mother and daughter worked together happily in the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband came home from work on time, and the family sat around the dining table. At the table, they discussed sending her parents back to Quanzhou the day after tomorrow. Aqiang volunteered to take leave and drive them, but her parents politely declined, saying the high-speed rail was convenient, yet they felt gratified by their son-in-law's thoughtfulness. Xuanxuan put a folded paper frog in Grandpa's palm, making the whole family laugh heartily. The dinner was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening family leisure time
description: After dinner, Song Yajing cleared the dishes while A Qiang did the washing-up. Her parents sat on the newly arrived rattan chairs on the balcony, chatting as they listened to the rain. Song Yajing watched cartoons with her daughter for a while, read two picture books, then laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of stretching to relax, enjoying the warm family time.
location: Living room and balcony of the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Created and released the event recruitment poster and responded to inquiries.
description: After Aqiang bathed their daughter, Song Yajing went to the study and used a phone photo-editing app to make a recruiting poster for “Parent-Child Afternoon Tea: Mom's Breather Moment.” She combined images of the shop's exquisite corner, floral material, and desserts with warm copy that included the event time, venue, content, and number of spots. After finalizing the layout, she carefully checked it and posted it simultaneously to the shop's VIP customer group and her personal WeChat Moments. Soon after posting, she received Meiling's registration and payment. When regular customers in the community group asked about details, she patiently replied and, following Zhao Min's suggestion, made a clear event flow chart and replaced it below the poster.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime story and conversation between the couple
description: Aqiang had already coaxed their daughter through her bath. Song Yajing went to her daughter's bedroom, told her two new Grimm fairy tales, and watched her fall asleep sweetly before returning to the master bedroom. After changing into pajamas, she briefly chatted with Aqiang about the day's work and event progress. Aqiang praised her for getting better and better at business, his tone full of encouragement and support.
location: Daughter's bedroom and master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Event planning wrap-up and delayed bedtime
description: After her husband fell asleep, Song Yajing lay in bed wide awake. She opened her phone to go through the event plan, including the materials list, staff assignments, and budget. A mother asked about rescheduling because something came up at the last minute; she patiently explained that the spots for this first trial were precious and suggested waiting for the next time. After confirming that two more people had signed up besides Meiling, she turned off her phone and, in the dark, reviewed the day's busyness: the data sorting clarified the direction, and the event planning had gotten off to a good start. She felt grounded and content, and finally fell asleep around 22:30.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Early-morning wake-up and exercise.
description: At 6:35 the alarm went off for the second time. Because I had stayed up until nearly 11:30 last night planning the parent-child activity, I felt sleepy but still got up. First I weighed myself: 49.4 kg. Then I quickly changed into my workout suit and walking shoes, splashed cold water on my face, put on my sun hat and earphones, and slipped out quietly. I walked 13 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park and did 30 minutes of brisk walking along the lakeside trail, listening to hymns. I gradually became more energetic, and when I completed the 3 km goal, my back was slightly sweaty. Afterward, I stretched for 5 minutes on a park bench, moving my knees and shoulders, and felt relaxed all over. Then I walked home quickly. On the way, I bought two warm soy milk packets at the breakfast stall at the entrance of the neighborhood, planning to let my parents try them.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park (Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Shower and family breakfast
description: After returning home, she quickly took a warm shower and changed into the linen dress that had arrived at the store that day. When she walked into the kitchen, her mother had already made millet porridge, so she put the packaged soy milk on a plate and called the family to eat. At the dinner table, her father mentioned wanting to go for a walk on Gulangyu tomorrow; her mother added, 'We might as well visit the church too.' Their daughter Xuanxuan hummed a song she had learned in kindergarten while eating. The family chatted and laughed, and the atmosphere was especially warm.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Taking daughter to school and heading to the shop
description: Before leaving, she helped Xuanxuan pack her little backpack and water bottle, held her hand, and walked 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan chattered about the "My Mom" drawing she made yesterday, and the mother and daughter agreed to draw Dad today, laughing all the way. After dropping her daughter off at kindergarten, she walked about 3 minutes to Yajing Lifestyle Gallery on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The stone pavement was bathed in morning sunlight, and the shop assistant Xiaomei was already sweeping the entrance.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and customer WeChat replies
description: Together with Xiaomei, she rinsed the doormat in front of the shop, cleaned the wooden floor with a dust mop, rearranged the new dresses that had arrived the night before by color, and hung her favorite French vintage dress in the center spot of the storefront window. Meanwhile, she took out her phone to quickly reply to two regular customers' private messages about sizes and colors, and wrote the information down in her journal.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Held a video conference with suppliers to finalize the autumn orders.
description: Had a video call on time with Guangzhou supplier Zheng Kai, and based on the previous day's data analysis, directly locked in 6 core autumn items: 2 French vintage dresses, 2 simple commuter suit sets, 1 pair of wide-leg pants with a draped feel, and 1 silk shirt. Ordered 20 pieces of each style and paid a 30% deposit. Zheng Kai praised the increasingly accurate selection and agreed that the goods would arrive in mid-August.
location: Rest area on the second floor of Yajing Life Gallery, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Record the order details and share the good news.
description: After hanging up, she recorded the delivery date, amount, and payment voucher number in detail in her journal. Then she took a photo of the journal page and sent it to the besties group chat. Li Meiling replied instantly with a like, and Wang Jia joked that she would come try them on when the new stock arrived. All her friends were excited about the new fall styles.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Make a recruitment poster for the parent-child activity
description: Used a photo editing app on my phone to select sample photos of flower arrangements and cupcakes taken a few days ago from the gallery, and carefully made the second version of the parent-child afternoon tea event poster, adding warm copy and a registration QR code. Checked the poster three or four times, confirmed the information was correct, and prepared to publish it in the afternoon.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receive customers and promote weekend activities
description: Customers kept entering the store. She enthusiastically recommended the day's featured French retro dress and paired a simple necklace for a young woman, who loved it. When a regular customer, Vivian, came to try on clothes, she introduced her to the weekend parent-child afternoon tea event. Vivian said she was very interested and would sign up after discussing it at home.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop, go home, and buy ingredients for Poria cake.
description: Around noon, after telling Xiaomei to watch the store, I closed the door and walked 7 minutes home. When I arrived downstairs at my building, I got on the electric bike and reached Zhenhai Road Farmers' Market in 2 minutes. I went straight to the dried goods stall and, as my mother instructed, bought sticky rice flour, glutinous rice flour, and poria cocos powder. The stall owner also gave me an extra small handful of dried osmanthus flowers. After buying, I rode the electric bike back home, thinking on the way about the taste of my mother's pastries.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Made Minnan poria cake with my mother.
description: After returning home, her mother had already put on an apron and was waiting. The mother and daughter busied themselves in the kitchen. Her mother demonstrated how to mix rice flour in proportion and sift it, and Yajing followed along step by step. As steam rose, the whole room smelled of rice. Her mother laughed about how Yajing used to sneak white sugar as a child, and both of them laughed. Midway, she had her husband help record a short video to send to her sister in Shenzhen.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tasting fuling cake and reliving mother-daughter memories.
description: The Poria cake steamed to perfection, white as jade, giving off the fragrance of rice and Poria. Mother sprinkled crushed hawthorn and dried osmanthus on top. Yajing took a bite—soft, sticky, sweet, and evocative of childhood memories. Both her father and husband praised it endlessly. She quickly wrote down the recipe her mother dictated in her phone's memo app, afraid she might forget.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Use the lunch break to make up for lost sleep
description: Feeling sleepy from staying up late last night, she set a 40-minute alarm, changed into pajamas, lay down on the bed, and slept soundly. After waking up, she felt much more refreshed. She washed her face and felt clear-headed and energetic.
location: Bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Pack the poria cakes, buy tea leaves, and go to the shop.
description: After waking from the midday break, I carefully packed the leftover poria cake in an eco-friendly paper bag, rode the electric bike and stopped by Zhangji Tea House on Zhongshan Road to buy my father a pack of the Tieguanyin he loves; the owner enthusiastically recommended the newly arrived Anxi high-mountain tea. After buying it, I rode a few minutes to near the store, parked, and walked to Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion.
location: From the No. 82 residential complex on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhang's Tea House on Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and then to Yajing Life Gallery at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shared poria cake at the store and posted the event poster
description: When she arrived at the store, Xiaomei was tidying the shelves. She handed her the warm poria cake, and Xiaomei's eyes lit up with surprise. The two chatted while eating. Taking advantage of the quiet store, she posted the parent-child afternoon tea poster she had made in the morning to the VIP customer group and her Moments, with a friendly reminder: “The first five families to sign up will receive a custom eco-friendly bag from our store.” Soon her phone rang with sign-up notifications, and she was overjoyed.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the shop, picked up her daughter from school, and bought bread on the way.
description: When it was almost time to pick up her daughter, she closed the shop and walked to the kindergarten. Passing by the 85°C bakery at Zhonghua City, she bought two bread rolls for tomorrow's breakfast. At the kindergarten gate, she immediately saw Xuanxuan saying goodbye to her classmates. Her little girl fluttered over like a butterfly, took her mother's hand, and said the teacher had praised her today.
location: From Yajing Life Gallery, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via the 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery.

name: Walked home with daughter
description: Holding Xuanxuan's hand, she walked 10 minutes home; along the way, her daughter chattered about the songs and drawings from today. She listened patiently and responded, enjoying the warm parent-child time.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home to help prepare dinner.
description: When she got home, her husband had already started cooking rice. He put on an apron and washed and cut vegetables with her mother. Her father was watching the news in the living room, and Xuanxuan was playing with building blocks nearby. She brewed the newly bought Tieguanyin tea for her father; the tea aroma filled the room, and the whole home was filled with a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family dinner and flipping through old photo albums
description: Dinner included steamed fish, stir-fried vegetables, and Quanzhou-style popiah, and the family chatted and laughed. After the meal, her mother took out an old photo album from an old suitcase, and they sat on the living room sofa to look through it. Her father pointed at a chubby photo of Yajing at age three and joked that she looked like a glutinous rice ball. Xuanxuan looked at it curiously, compared, and said her mother had looked like her as a child. The whole family doubled over with laughter, and the living room was filled with joy.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter through her bedtime routine and bedtime story
description: Accompanied Xuanxuan while she washed up and told her the bedtime story 'Little Rabbit Be Good'. After my daughter fell asleep, I gently kissed her forehead, turned off the bedside lamp, and left the room.
location: Bathroom and children's room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening relaxation, couple communication, and bedtime diary
description: Returning to the bedroom, she changed into loose pajamas and did 15 minutes of pre-sleep stretching on the floor to relax her whole body. She opened the hymn book and listened to "Amazing Grace" to calm her mind. Then she lay in bed with her husband and chatted about the day's fun moments, sharing the joy of making Poria cakes and the progress of the shop's activities, and decided together to go to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass on Sunday as a family. Before sleeping, she put her palms together and prayed in gratitude for the fulfilling day. Then she sat at the desk, opened her journal, and recorded warm moments such as her mother's smile while teaching her to make cakes, Xiaomei's surprise upon eating the Poria cake, and the whole family's laughter while looking through the photo album. She briefly listed tomorrow's to-dos, such as confirming the number of registrations for the parent-child activity and buying mugwort sachets. Finally, at 22:00 she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully with beautiful expectations for the next day.
location: Bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning brisk walk
description: In the early morning, Song Yajing got up, changed into her sportswear, and walked from home to Jiaxingyuan Park for a morning brisk walk. She quickly walked two laps along the park path, breathing in the fresh air, feeling refreshed and physically restored.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home, decide on the division of tasks, and have breakfast together as a family
description: After briskly walking home, Song Yajing changed into home clothes and discussed the day's task division with her husband Chen Zhiqiang in the master bedroom, deciding to assemble the balcony furniture in the afternoon while her parents napped. Then she, her husband, daughter Chen Lexuan, father Song Minghui, and mother Lin Xiuying had breakfast together in the home dining room, with sweet potato porridge and fried dough sticks. During the meal, she confirmed with her parents that they would not return to Quanzhou that day and would continue to stay with them in Xiamen, and told them the chairs she bought online would arrive soon.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing helped her daughter put on her backpack and walked hand in hand with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Along the way, her daughter shared funny stories from kindergarten. When they arrived, Song Yajing kissed her daughter goodbye and watched her walk into the school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking to the store and opening preparations
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Song Yajing walked through Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to her shop, Yajing Lifestyle Gallery. Upon arrival, she cleaned up with her assistant Xiaomei, adjusted the clothing displays, checked the cash register and inventory system, and got ready for business.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store operations and work tasks
description: After opening the shop, Song Yajing used the quieter period to handle the accounts and contacted supplier Zheng Kai to confirm the production schedule and delivery time for the autumn orders, recording the information in the purchase ledger. She also noted August 15 for new arrivals in her phone calendar and began planning a French vintage-themed styling event. During this time, she warmly received several regular customers and recommended newly arrived dresses to them. The whole morning was busy but orderly.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After shopping, went home to prepare lunch.
description: Song Yajing locked the store door and walked to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City to buy the bread her parents liked, then bought a mugwort pack at the traditional Chinese medicine shop next door. Afterward, she returned to her home at No. 82 Shanggu Street and prepared lunch in the kitchen with her mother, Lin Xiuying. The mother and daughter made seafood noodle soup together.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family lunch
description: At lunchtime, Song Yajing, her husband, and her parents sat together enjoying seafood noodle soup. Her father was full of praise for her cooking. After the meal, her mother volunteered to do the dishes, while Song Yajing and her husband prepared to begin the secret balcony renovation operation.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Assembling balcony furniture and decorating with husband
description: After her parents took their afternoon nap, Song Yajing and her husband first tidied up the clutter on the balcony to make space. At about 1:45 p.m., the courier delivered two large cardboard boxes. The couple worked together: her husband used tools to assemble the rattan chairs and coffee table, while she assisted from the side. After the furniture was assembled, Song Yajing laid a cotton-linen tablecloth, placed plants such as jasmine and pothos, decorated the balcony into a cozy and pleasant space, and took photos to record it.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidy up tools and enjoy tea with parents on the balcony
description: After the arrangement was completed, Song Yajing and her husband cleaned up the empty cardboard boxes and tools together and tidied the balcony. Then the couple took a short rest on the new chairs. Soon after, her parents woke up from their nap. Her mother was pleasantly surprised at the balcony's transformation, and her father immediately boiled water to brew Tieguanyin tea. The family sat on the balcony sipping tea and chatting, enjoying a warm moment.
location: The balcony and living room of home in the compound at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop to handle work and plan new arrivals.
description: After enjoying family time, Song Yajing walked back to the store. She checked her phone and confirmed that supplier Zheng Kai had replied that the autumn order would ship on time on August 12, and then checked the purchase ledger. Afterward, she opened her memos, refined the French vintage themed decoration plan for the August 15 new arrivals, and posted a preview in WeChat groups and Moments.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing closed the shop and walked to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. The daughter was very happy to see her mother. Song Yajing picked her up and told her a surprise was waiting for her at home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take my daughter to the park for a walk and admire the sunset.
description: After school, Song Yajing did not go straight home. Instead, she took her daughter to Jiaxingyuan Park. In the evening, a cool breeze blew through the park and the sunset glow was gorgeous. She pointed at the clouds and imagined together with her daughter, enjoying a warm mother-daughter moment.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family admires the sunset glow from the balcony.
description: After returning home, the daughter was thrilled to see the newly decorated balcony, and the whole family sat around it. Her father made tea again, and her mother brought out fruit and snacks. As they chatted while admiring the sunset, the daughter snuggled in her maternal grandfather’s arms, pointed at the clouds, and said they looked like little horses. It was a warm and joyful scene.
location: Home balcony in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: After the evening time together, her husband Chen Zhiqiang cooked dinner, and Song Yajing helped out. Soon a sumptuous dinner was served, and the whole family sat around the table again. During the meal, her parents once again praised the thoughtful balcony renovation, and her father even said that after returning to Quanzhou, he would also renovate the balcony of the old home. The dinner was full of laughter and joy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Teach mother how to back up her phone to the cloud.
description: After dinner, her mother, Lin Xiuying, asked Song Yajing to teach her how to back up the balcony photos to the cloud and send them to her sister. Song Yajing sat beside her mother and patiently guided her through the steps. Mother and daughter, heads close together, chatted while operating. Her mother marveled at how technology had changed their way of life. Finally, they successfully synced all the photos to her sister.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Help daughter wash up and read bedtime stories
description: After teaching her mother, Song Yajing gave her daughter a bath, then read her a bedtime story in the children's room. She told a story about a little bear who arranged a garden and invited friends. After hearing it, her daughter said she also wanted to invite friends to come see the beautiful garden. Song Yajing kissed her daughter and gently coaxed her to sleep.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretching and preparing mugwort packs
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom and did about 15 minutes of evening stretching on the floor to relieve the muscle soreness from a day of assembling furniture. After stretching, she put the mugwort pack she had bought during the day in the bathroom, preparing to use it for her mother's foot soak.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom of the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and gratitude journal.
description: After washing up, Song Yajing knelt by the bed for her bedtime prayer, giving thanks for a peaceful, smooth day and the warmth of family. Then she wrote a gratitude journal, recording her gratitude for her parents' health, her husband's cooperation, her daughter's smiling face, and more. She also noted down the parent-child afternoon tea registration and the Sunday Mass schedule that needed to be confirmed the next day.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After talking with her husband, she turned off the lights and went to bed.
description: After completing all the tasks, Song Yajing lay down on the bed and quietly chatted with her husband Chen Zhiqiang about today's balcony renovation surprise. Both were satisfied with how smoothly the plan had gone and discussed weekend activities. Then Song Yajing turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, feeling content.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: On Saturday morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally. After waking, she habitually checked her phone and confirmed there were no urgent messages. She was thinking about tomorrow's parent-child event at the store, feeling both expectant and a little nervous. Then she washed up briefly, changed into her light blue sportswear, and carefully applied sunscreen, getting ready for her morning exercise.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; master bedroom at home.

name: Couple's morning brisk walk
description: Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang walked together to Jiaxingyuan Park. They walked briskly along the park trail for about 35 minutes, covering about 3.2 kilometers. As they walked, they chatted; her husband mentioned that the weather was nice today and they could take his parents to the seaside for a stroll, while Yajing confirmed with him the parts of tomorrow's event where help was needed. After exercising, she was slightly sweaty and felt refreshed.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning exercise, stretching, and returning home
description: After completing about five minutes of leg stretches at the park pavilion, the couple walked home. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station at the entrance of the residential community, they bought a few lemons and a bottle of yogurt on the way, planning to use them for making a cake in the afternoon.
location: Along the route from Jiaxing Garden Park, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Minnan-style breakfast and a post-meal nap.
description: The family sat around the dining table enjoying a Hokkien-style breakfast. Mother had made sweet potato porridge and fried sunny-side-up eggs, served with pork floss and pickled cucumbers. Father amused his daughter by counting the colors of the food, full of childlike fun and laughter. After breakfast, Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to clear the dishes, and Song Yajing added warm water to her mother's cup and confirmed the plan to accompany her parents to the farmers market in the morning.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, home dining room

name: Accompanied her parents to the morning market and walked home.
description: Song Yajing walked with her parents to the Hubin South Road farmers' market (Hujing Comprehensive Market). Her mother taught her how to choose bitter melons that were not bitter, while her father picked out fresh pork ribs and soybeans at the meat stall. Yajing also bought disposable paper plates and decorative little flags for tomorrow's event. After shopping for more than half an hour, her husband came with their daughter, who had just woken up, and the family completed the lively shopping trip together, then carried their baskets home full.
location: No. 101--A17, Hubin Yili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Hujing Comprehensive Market, and along the route back to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community

name: Go home to prepare the meal and cook a summer cooling soup together
description: After returning home, Song Yajing and her mother went into the kitchen and started preparing the ingredients. Her mother blanched the pork ribs, and Yajing, following her mother's instruction, cut the bitter melon into chunks and rubbed them with salt to remove the bitterness. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang helped peel garlic and slice ginger nearby, while her father played with blocks with their daughter in the living room, laughter coming from time to time. The family worked together to make a pot of bitter melon, soybean, and pork rib soup that clears heat and relieves summer heat.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Enjoyed a refreshing summer soup for lunch.
description: A large pot of bitter melon, soybean, and pork rib soup, which clears heat and relieves summer heat, was simmered to perfection. Her mother also stir-fried sweet potato leaves and made scallion omelettes. The family sat around the table, each with a bowl of soup, and the summer heat completely melted away. At the table, her father talked about how he often drank this soup in summer in his hometown of Quanzhou when he was young. Yajing took the chance to ask her father whether he wanted to go to the shop tomorrow to see the parent-child activity. Although he was afraid of causing trouble, curiosity showed in his eyes.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, home dining room

name: Lunch break and personal time
description: After dinner, she helped her mother clear the table and wash the dishes. Her daughter was coaxed into a nap by her parents. Song Yajing also went back to the master bedroom to rest. First, she checked the final registration status for tomorrow's activity on her phone and confirmed that eight families would attend. Then she sat down on the balcony rattan chair, flipped open the latest issue of Elle, and looked for inspiration for the store's summer-to-autumn display, enjoying a rare half hour of leisure.
location: Home, master bedroom and balcony, in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Preparation and rehearsal of materials for the parent-child activity
description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing prepared the materials for tomorrow's parent-child afternoon tea activity at the store. She divided the daisies, eucalyptus leaves, and floral foam she had bought into six portions, and prepared the baking cups, piping bags, and lemon zest for the low-sugar cakes. Her father took the initiative to help her wipe the floral scissors. Yajing simulated the entire activity flow in the living room, from the welcome speech to flower arrangement guidance to cupcake decorating. Her mother sat nearby picking vegetables, occasionally smiling and offering suggestions.
location: No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; the living room and dining room at home

name: Accompanying daughter and grandparent-grandchild interaction
description: After her daughter woke up from her nap, Song Yajing accompanied her in the living room to play with building blocks and build a castle. Then her father brought out Chinese chess and tried to teach his granddaughter to recognize the 'rook, horse, cannon' pieces. Although Xuanxuan didn't understand, she cooperatively picked up the 'horse' piece and called out crisply, 'Horse!' Yajing captured this warm scene with her phone.
location: Home living room, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: In the evening, Song Yajing and her mother prepared dinner together. There was some leftover soup from lunch, so they reheated it. Her mother stir-fried baby bok choy, and Yajing steamed a yellowfin seabream, served together with an assorted braised platter. Half a bottle of sour plum drink was left in the fridge, just right for refreshing the palate.
location: Home kitchen, Residential Complex No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: The dinner was simple yet hearty, and the family chatted and laughed. Father told an amusing story from his youth about riding a bicycle from Quanzhou to Xiamen to make a living, which made everyone laugh; Mother kept giving her granddaughter pieces of fish. The whole room was filled with a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, home dining room

name: The whole family took a walk on Zhenhai Road to aid digestion
description: Taking advantage of the fact that it wasn't fully dark yet, the whole family went out for a walk along Zhenhai Road. Passing Zhenhai Road Metro Station, her parents got tired and sat down on a roadside bench to rest. Yajing and her husband took their daughter a little farther, and when they passed a pet store, their daughter couldn't move her feet away from the glass watching the kittens. The family enjoyed a pleasant post-dinner time.
location: Around Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tuck daughter in and let the parents rest early
description: After the walk, her parents felt tired, washed up, and went to their room to rest. Her husband helped their daughter wash up. Song Yajing read her two stories from “The Different Carmela,” and the girl quickly fell asleep peacefully.
location: Residential community at No. 82, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province - the children's room and parents' room at home

name: The couple rewatched an old movie
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing and her husband watched an old Hokkien movie "The Story of Time" on the projector in the living room. Curled up on the sofa, they chatted about the fun times when they first met and went looking for an old eatery in an alley in Quanzhou to eat satay noodles. It felt warm and cozy.
location: Home living room, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Phone call with besties to finalize event details
description: In the middle of the movie, her childhood friend Li Meiling called. Song Yajing stepped onto the balcony to answer. The two confirmed tomorrow's arrival time at the shop and the division of tasks, then chatted about their children's funny stories and parenting tips. Finally they recalled embarrassing childhood moments, talking for nearly an hour with endless laughter.
location: Balcony, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime tidying, gratitude, and going to sleep
description: After hanging up the phone, Song Yajing first went to the balcony, brought in the clothes drying there, and folded them. Then she did a 10-minute evening stretching routine to relax. In the bedroom, she wrote a gratitude journal in her diary, recording her family's love that day and the unspoken understanding with her husband, as well as the details of the next day's event. Before bed, she knelt quietly by the bedside to pray, asking for a smooth event and her family's safety. Finally, with peace of mind and anticipation, she turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: The residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; the living room, balcony, and master bedroom at home.

name: Morning wake-up and exercise
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning and felt satisfied after weighing in at 49.5 kg. Grateful for the new day, changed into workout clothes, washed up briefly, then walked to Jiaxingyuan Park. Walked along the tree-lined Hubin South Road; the morning air was humid, and many people were already exercising. Did 30 minutes of brisk walking in the park. On the way, spotted crape myrtle flowers, took photos, and shared them with my sister in Quanzhou. After exercising, walked home and, as I entered, heard my family talking in the kitchen and said good morning.
location: The residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxing Park on Bailu Road

name: Family breakfast
description: The family sat around the dining table, enjoying the sweet potato porridge, fried eggs, pickled cucumbers, and bread bought the previous day that Mother had prepared. I peeled an egg for my daughter and told them about going to Gulangyu Island for Mass in the morning and taking her to a parent-child activity at the flower shop in the afternoon. Father nodded and smiled, and Mother reminded us to be safe on the road.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to Gulangyu for Sunday Mass
description: Her husband drove, and the whole family set out for Xiamen Ferry Terminal. There was quite a bit of traffic on Lujiang Road on Sunday, and their daughter clapped her hands excitedly at the egrets over the sea. After arriving, they bought tickets and waited for the ferry, with the sea breeze brushing their faces. Soon they boarded the ferry to Gulangyu. On the boat, she chatted with her mother about fun moments from the flower shop event, while her husband held their daughter and looked at the sea view. After arriving at Sanqiutian Pier, they walked along a tree-lined path to the Catholic church. Once inside, the whole family attended Sunday Mass. The sermon theme was "small acts of ministry," which touched her heart, and she silently prayed for the afternoon event while receiving Communion. After Mass, her daughter pulled her grandmother to see the statue of the Virgin Mary and the stained glass windows.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family stroll on Longtou Road and return to Xiamen
description: After Mass, the family strolled along the alley to Longtou Road. Father bought a portion of mochi, Mother took a liking to a handmade shell keychain, my husband bought our daughter some snacks, and I used my phone to take a group photo of my parents at the alley entrance and sent it to the family group. Then we slowly walked back to Sanqiutian Pier, enjoying the view along the seaside walkway. Our daughter was a little sleepy. After reaching the pier, we boarded the ferry smoothly, and our daughter leaned against her father to rest. On the ferry, sunlight sparkled on the sea. We talked softly with my parents and felt at ease. We returned to Xiamen Ferry Terminal around 12:38.
location: Longtou Road on Gulangyu Island and Xiamen Ferry Terminal, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A short seaside rest on Lujiang Road and returning home
description: After getting off the ferry, instead of going straight home, they strolled along the seaside promenade on Lujiang Road. They found a bench and sat down, gazing at Gulangyu in the sea breeze. Her father remarked that Xiamen was a place that calms the mind. Her husband bought a few cups of lemon tea, and the family sat chatting. After a short rest, her husband drove, and within a few minutes they were back at their home on Shanggu Street.
location: Lujiang Road and Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch
description: My mother and I quickly put together lunch: we used last night's leftover bitter melon, soybean, and pork rib soup as the base for noodles, and stir-fried some greens. The family quickly finished the steaming hot pork rib soup noodles. At the table, I described the afternoon activity schedule again and asked my daughter to be a little helper in charge of handing out aprons; she nodded excitedly.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Host a parent-child handmade flower box afternoon tea event
description: Rode the electric bike to the flower shop on Zhongshan Road; the shop assistant Xiaomei had arrived early. Together they set up the guidance signs, checked the prepared flower materials (lisianthus, pink carnations, eucalyptus leaves), cake bases, piping bags with cream, and disposable aprons, and played a soft jazz playlist to create the atmosphere. Starting at two in the afternoon, three families arrived one after another. I greeted them warmly, and Xiaomei guided them through sign-in, adding them to the activity group, and giving out eco-friendly shopping bags. After the activity officially began, I first showed the flower materials to teach the children about them, then guided the parents and children to arrange flowers and decorate cupcakes together. One naughty boy got glue all over his hands, and his mother helped him. My daughter Xuanxuan also wore an apron and helped pass tools. At exactly four o'clock, the activity ended on time. I helped each family take photos with their works, and the mothers posted recommendations on their Moments, calling the place a 'hidden gem shop'. I told Xiaomei to lock the shop door and left the rest for her to clean up.
location: Shop 36, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycling Home
description: After the event, I rode my electric scooter back home on Shanggu Street. The breeze brushed my face, and I felt a strong sense of accomplishment. On the way, I checked my phone and found that three mothers had already posted recommendations on Moments, one of which mentioned that her child said on the way home that she wanted to go again. I smiled and liked their posts.
location: Zhongshan Road to Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family Time and Dinner
description: After arriving home, she put her phone on silent and left it at the entrance. Her father and daughter were on the balcony using building blocks to construct a Mediterranean-style model, and her husband was pruning the pothos and boxwood. She pulled up a small stool and sat with her mother to snap long beans, listening to her parents talk about funny stories of past neighbors. At dinner, the table was set with braised hairtail, garlicky water spinach, stir-fried long beans with pork slices, and egg foo young. She vividly described the funny things the boy had done during the afternoon activity, and the whole family laughed heartily. Her father praised her for being suited to this line of work.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-meal family interaction
description: After the meal, my mother cleared the dishes and I helped wipe the table. Then I took out the flower illustrated book and, together with my daughter, learned the flower materials used in the afternoon activity, taught her to recognize characters, and told her that carnations represent motherly love. My husband cast an animated clip of Hachiko from his phone to the screen, and my father watched it with great interest.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helping daughter wash up and keeping her company at bedtime
description: I took my daughter to the bathroom and washed her hair and body with a bubble bath. Afterward, in the kids' room, I read her two bedtime picture-book stories about a little girl and flowers. After she fell asleep, I tiptoed out of the room.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal reflection and gratitude journal
description: Back in the master bedroom, her husband was watching a game replay. She picked up her phone and saw a long thank-you message from a mother, saying the child kept talking about 'Aunt Yajing's flower shop' at home. Her eyes grew moist as she read it, and she took a screenshot and saved it to her 'Achievements' folder. Then she opened her diary and wrote: the first parent-child activity had turned out unexpectedly well; one mother said it had been a long time since she and her child had focused on one thing together so intently. It seemed the Lord was telling her that small acts of kindness are the best ministry. Today's weight: 49.5.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening stretching, prayer, and bedtime
description: Spread out the yoga mat in the bedroom and did 15 minutes of evening stretches to relieve lower back fatigue. Then she knelt by the bed, palms together, and prayed quietly, thanking the Lord for His provision and praying for her family and the families taking part in the event. She laid out the next day's clothes and chatted softly with her husband about the day's event details and the balcony plants, earning his praise. After turning off the light, she reviewed the whole day in the dark, felt grounded and comforted, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning brisk walk and weigh-in
description: Early Monday morning, I changed into sportswear and walked to Jiaxingyuan Park for a brisk walk. The pace was moderate and my heart rate stayed around 120. I worked up a sweat and felt great. After the exercise, I went home and washed up, then weighed myself. The electronic scale showed 49.4 kg, the same as last week. While drying my hair, I silently repeated the number of the dental hospital I needed to confirm tomorrow and wrote in my phone memo: “09:00, Xiamen Stomatological Hospital Main Campus.”
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family breakfast and dental check-up reminder
description: I tied on an apron and started preparing breakfast. While peeling a boiled egg for my daughter Xuanxuan, I reminded my husband Chen Zhiqiang that the whole family had a dental check-up at the main campus of Xiamen Stomatological Hospital at 9 o'clock the next morning, and that he would need to take half a day off from work. I sent the appointment screenshot to the family group and also reminded my parents by voice message. During breakfast, everyone sat around the table. Zhiqiang nodded while drinking soy milk, and Xuanxuan muttered that she wanted to bring her teddy bear.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 6th floor, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school, buying tea, and preparing to open the shop
description: I rode my electric bike to take my daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and bought two cartons of fresh milk at the convenience store at the kindergarten gate. On the way back, I deliberately made a detour to Zhang’s Tea House at the Zhenhai Road Metro Station exit and picked out 500 grams of freshly arrived Anxi Tieguanyin. The owner, Uncle Zhang, gave me a small pack of new tea samples. When I got to the store, I used a cloth to wipe the display shelves and the fitting-room mirror, while the clerk Xiaomei opened the cash register and counted the change. I put the newly bought tea on a corner of the cashier counter, planning to brew it in the afternoon, then quickly browsed group messages and replied one by one to two customers’ messages asking about business hours.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Zhangji Tea House, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community operations and confirmation with the dental hospital.
description: I first called the main hospital of Xiamen Stomatological Hospital, confirmed the appointment information for all three of us, and noted that we needed to arrive 15 minutes early. Then I opened my laptop and first sent thank-you sticker packs to the three mothers from yesterday's parent-child activity via private messages. Next, I created a new Excel spreadsheet, "Parent-Child Afternoon Tea - Participating Family Database", and entered the contact information, children's ages, and preferred activities for the three families one by one. During this time, I replied to a new parent's inquiry, introduced the activity process in detail, and invited her to join the store's VIP group.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (checkout counter of a boutique clothing store)

name: Lunch and points redemption
description: I walked to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, bought a vegetable salad, a smoked chicken sandwich, and an iced lemon tea for lunch. At checkout, I showed my membership code, used points to deduct 5 yuan, and used the coupon for purchases over 30 yuan to redeem a small cake cup. I brought my lunch back to the store, sat at the counter, ate while browsing my phone, and looked at some examples of autumn women's clothing displays to prepare for the seasonal new arrivals.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and autumn display concepts
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic was light. Xiaomei and I adjusted the window mannequin outfits, replacing the light-colored dresses with a combination featuring a lightweight knit cardigan as a preview of the changing season. I took out my sketchbook and penciled a display sketch for the autumn new arrivals on August 15, specifically marking two high-traffic areas: the right side of the entrance and next to the fitting mirror. During a break, Xiaomei and I chatted about my daughter's amusing moments last night, and the shop atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (inside the boutique clothing store)

name: After closing the store, go to Huli to pick up Haohao and have an in-depth talk with a friend.
description: After telling Xiaomei to mind the store, I took the fully charged e-bike from the charging station at the back door, brought the leftover cupcakes from yesterday's event as gifts, and closed early to set off. I rode the e-bike through Chenggong Avenue and arrived at the gate of Huli Experimental Primary School at 15:20. I parked the bike in the shade and waited, and sent a WeChat message to my friend Li Meiling. After the school bell rang, Haohao came out with his schoolbag on his back, and Meiling walked over tiredly with her pregnant belly. We parked the e-bike by the flower bed across the street. Meiling spoke with red eyes about her morning sickness and her husband's business trips. I handed the cupcakes to Haohao, held Meiling's hand tightly to comfort her, and readily agreed to pick up Haohao for her every Tuesday and Thursday. Right away, I set a recurring "Pick up Haohao" alarm in my phone calendar for every Tuesday and Thursday.
location: At the entrance of Huli Experimental Primary School, No. 85 Wutong West Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and beside the flower bed of the parking lot across the street.

name: Take Meiling and her son home and buy stationery on the way.
description: I rode my electric scooter with Haohao, slowly cycling to the bottom of Meiling's building. After watching the mother and son go inside safely, I turned around and rode toward Zhongshan Road. On the way, I stopped by a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and bought five children's picture books and two boxes of water-soluble colored pencils. Remembering that my daughter Xuanxuan had recently become fond of drawing little dresses, I bought an extra box of stickers.

name: Set aside a meal for her husband and handle shop messages.
description: Put her husband’s meal into a fresh-keeping box and stored it in the refrigerator. Via WeChat, confirmed the return list for tomorrow with the shop assistant Xiaomei and replied to a regular customer’s inquiry, then set her alarm for tomorrow morning.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening skincare routine and stretching to unwind.
description: After helping her daughter wash up and finishing the bedtime story, she did a 15-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and calves. Then she did her evening skincare routine and applied a hydrating mask.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime journaling and planning for tomorrow
description: In the study, used a paper journal to record today's weight of 49.2kg and reflections, and listed tomorrow's to-dos: follow up with Vivian on the stock transfer to the store, organize new product photos, prepare materials for Sunday's daughter's birthday party, and remind my husband to pick up the cake on Saturday.
location: The home study at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leisure and social interaction before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard while scrolling on her phone, she browsed Xiaohongshu topics on low-sugar baking and summer dress outfits, and bookmarked a new chiffon cake recipe and accessory styling tips. In the WeChat besties group, she chatted with her Shenzhen friend Wang Jia and confirmed with Li Meiling the time to pick up Haohao tomorrow.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Turned off the phone, dimmed the bedside lamp, and browsed a home magazine. Turned off the light at 22:50. The thought of fertilizing the rosemary on the balcony flashed through my mind, and I fell asleep peacefully around 23:10.
location: Bedroom, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walking and balcony harvesting
description: After the alarm went off at 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing jogged a warm-up loop with her father, Song Minghui, around the residential area. Then they went to Jiaxingyuan Park and briskly walked 3 kilometers at a pace of about 8:30 per kilometer, followed by simple stretching in the park's stretching area. After returning home at 7:10, Yajing went straight to the balcony, carefully cut mint leaves with dew and a few chamomile plants about to bloom with scissors, washed them, and set them aside.
location: From the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to Jiaxingyuan Park (Bailu Road), then back to the balcony at home.

name: Family breakfast and seeing the family off
description: At 7:15, Yajing gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, tied her pigtails, and urged her to wash up. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already warmed up the milk and whole-wheat toast. As the family of three ate breakfast, Yajing confirmed the day's schedule with Aqiang: she would go to the shop in the morning and do pottery in the afternoon, and Aqiang would pick up their daughter. At 8:15, the family left home together. Yajing rode her e-bike to the shop on Zhongshan Road, with mint leaves and chamomile in a fresh-keeping box in the front basket.
location: At home in the community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then set out for Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road) and Zhongshan Road.

name: Store opening preparations and receiving regular customer Vivian
description: Arriving at the Zhongshan Road shop at 8:30, Yajing pulled up the roller shutter, dusted the mannequins, organized the shelves, and arranged mint leaves and chamomile in glass cups and small clay pots on the tea table by the entrance. At 9:30, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, and regular customer Vivian just happened to walk in. Yajing brewed mint tea with homemade mint leaves to host her. Vivian took photos, praised it, and posted on her Moments. The two chatted about fashion while trying on clothes. Vivian eventually bought an off-white dress and left. Afterwards, Yajing briefed Xiaomei on accounts, membership updates, and new arrivals handling. At 10:30, she picked up her canvas bag and left the shop.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 36 Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Learning pottery wheel throwing
description: Yajing walked to the 'Mud Fire Handcraft' pottery studio on Xiaxi Road and started her pottery class at 10:40. At a potter's wheel by the window, she learned wheel throwing with the teacher. Although the clay repeatedly tipped over and deformed, she still enjoyed the pleasure of losing control. She finally completed a rough teacup with uneven wall thickness and a slightly slanted rim. The teacher commented that it had a lot of personal style, like a 'crooked-neck' cup. Yajing decided to keep that naturally unpolished quality and handed the semi-finished piece to the teacher for bisque firing in the kiln.
location: Nihuo Handmade Pottery Studio, Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: After finishing the pottery throwing, Yajing walked out of the studio and ordered a bowl of mixed noodles and a stewed soup at the Happy Sweet Potato snack shop on the street corner next door as lunch. While eating, she scrolled through home decor pictures on her phone looking for coffee table styling inspiration. After the meal, she sat on a bench in the nearby small park and enjoyed the breeze, savoring the peace of the afternoon.
location: Happy Sweet Potato at No. 56 Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the small park nearby.

name: Waiting for the pottery and firing the underglaze pieces.
description: At 13:00 Yajing returned to the studio; the bisque firing would take about an hour. She brewed a cup of chamomile tea for herself, sat in the lounge area, and browsed a Japanese zakka-style home magazine with her phone on silent. At 14:15 the instructor took out the bisque-fired cup. Yajing chose a blue-green glaze and carefully applied it to the lopsided cup; the cup then went into the electric kiln for a second firing. At 15:30 the finished piece came out. The blue-green glaze flowed over the slanted body in natural shades of varying depth, with blue-purple washes, giving it a wonderfully rustic beauty. She paid happily, wrapped the cup in layers of recycled paper, and put it into her canvas bag.
location: Nihuo Handmade Pottery Studio, Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and buy groceries on the way.
description: Yajing carefully carried the cup and made her way back. When she reached Gucheng West Road, she entered Xiamen Seventh Vegetable Market, bought a bunch of fresh spring greens and a few tomatoes, and planned to make stir-fried vegetables and tomato egg drop soup for dinner. On the way home, she sent her husband a WeChat message telling him the cup was ready and urging him to come home early for dinner.
location: Xiamen No. 7 Vegetable Market, Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District.

name: At-home flower arranging and dinner preparation
description: After arriving home at 16:15, Yajing gently placed the newly made crooked cup in the center of the coffee table, cut the chamomile she had picked in the morning, and arranged it in the cup at staggered heights, inspired by a magazine, creating a vibrant corner. Then she washed the vegetables, cooked the rice, and simply prepared some home-style dishes. While waiting for her family, she sat on the sofa and repeatedly admired the cup's unique texture and feel.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and shopping for an electric scooter together
description: At 18:30, husband Chen Zhiqiang arrived home with daughter Chen Lexuan, whom he had picked up from kindergarten, and father Song Minghui also came to the dining room. Seeing the flower arrangement on the coffee table, Aqiang picked up a cup and praised it as more interesting than store-bought ones, saying the texture and the lopsided feel were especially realistic. At the dinner table, Yajing enthusiastically shared the details of making pottery. After dinner, Aqiang pulled her over to the sofa, showed her the project bonus transfer record, and again proposed buying an electric scooter, patiently doing the math to explain its convenience and safety. Yajing finally went from resisting to accepting, and the two compared many models online together, finally choosing a white folding anti-slip one and agreeing that Aqiang would place the order the next day.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying her daughter and sharing the pottery results
description: After 21:00, Yajing drew a picture with her daughter Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan drew a cute little animal friend on her mother's crooked cup.
