Afterwards, Yajing took the cup to the living room and explained the making process to her father in detail. Her father remarked that this was like opening a store—letting things take their course can bring unexpected rewards. Yajing agreed wholeheartedly.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening care and bedtime record.
description: At 22:00, Yajing washed the new cup, dried it, and gently placed it in the center of the coffee table, then did her evening washing, stretching, and basic skin care. At 23:00, leaning against the headboard, she recorded her weight of 49.2kg in her journal and wrote about the satisfaction of receiving the one-of-a-kind cup and her husband's praise, as well as her anticipation of embracing new things and choosing a scooter together. At 23:30, she turned off the light and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and washing up
description: The alarm went off right on time. She stretched comfortably and felt refreshed. She picked up her phone and glanced at it; there were no urgent messages in the family group or the besties group, so she felt relaxed. She went to the bathroom, washed her face with clean water, and applied some simple basic skincare products. Remembering that today was Saturday, her study day, she silently cheered herself on.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Walking into the dining room, she saw millet porridge cooked by her mother, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables brought from their hometown in Quanzhou already set on the table. She drank the porridge while chatting with her parents about last night's news. Seeing her daughter Xuanxuan sitting nicely and drinking porridge attentively with a small spoon, she smiled and praised her: “Xuanxuan is so great!” She also finished her bowl while it was hot, feeling warm inside.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-class preparation and comforting daughter
description: After breakfast, she quickly walked into the study, opened her laptop, plugged it in, and checked whether the camera and microphone were working. Remembering that she hadn't yet reviewed the categorized notebook she had prepared yesterday, she quickly opened it and went over a few key sentence patterns from the last lesson. Then, at the desk, she used Xuanxuan's crayons and picture books to set up a “little classmate seat” and said to her daughter: “Mommy is going to start class. You can be the little class monitor and stay with me, okay?” Xuanxuan nodded excitedly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning Online English Workshop (I)
description: Entered the online meeting room at 9 o'clock sharp, and the workshop began. Today they practiced self-introductions and ordering-food scenarios; the teacher's pronunciation was very standard. Yajing gradually got into the groove and followed along, loudly repeating “I would like a hamburger, please.” Xuanxuan was quietly drawing nearby, and every now and then she would giggle at her mother's odd intonation and mimic in a baby voice, “I want cake.” The mother and daughter kept laughing.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Break between classes and family communication
description: Class was over. She got up and went to the living room to drink some water. Seeing her husband A Qiang absorbed in his tablet, she reminded him, "By the way, don't forget to order the stroller today. I've picked out that white lightweight one—you place the order." A Qiang looked up, made an "OK" gesture, and replied, "Don't worry, I'm looking at it right now. I'll place the order in a while." Relieved, she played a game of pat-a-cake with Xuanxuan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning Online English Workshop (2)
description: Continued the class, focusing on practicing ordering dialogue. Yajing took the initiative to raise her hand and do a role-play with the teacher. Although she didn't speak fluently, she was able to fully express that she wanted a hamburger and fries. The teacher gave her a thumbs-up, and she felt a little proud of speaking English online for the first time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm lunch and parent-child bonding
description: Lunch was the bitter melon and pork rib soup noodles her mother had specially made to clear heat and relieve summer heat. At the table, Yajing used the sentences she had learned that morning to play a “restaurant ordering” game with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan held up the toy menu and said in a cute baby voice, “I want cake.” Yajing smiled and corrected her: “Say, ‘I want cake, please.’” The whole family burst into laughter.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon Online English Workshop (1)
description: The afternoon class began, with the topic of shopping and asking directions. Yajing sat in a more relaxed posture. When she encountered sentence patterns she didn't understand, she would take a screenshot on her phone and then think hard with her fist propped under her chin. When gesturing directions in front of the camera, she looked engaged and focused.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Break between classes and plant care
description: During a break in class, she walked to the south balcony to look at her carefully tended little garden. The mint and rosemary harvested yesterday had already sprouted new green shoots. She reached out and gently touched the rosemary leaves, then lowered her head and inhaled the fresh fragrance on her fingertips, feeling refreshed. She casually picked a few mint leaves to steep in water.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon Online English Workshop (2)
description: In the last class of the afternoon, they practiced comprehensive dialogue. Yajing felt her condition was getting better and better. Although she made occasional grammar mistakes, she managed to finish her sentences. Before class ended, the teacher assigned a speaking recording assignment for after class, and she carefully wrote it down in her notebook.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-class note organization and knowledge consolidation.
description: The class had just ended, and she didn't rush to leave her seat. She took out her beautiful categorized notebook and spent half an hour copying down the key sentence patterns learned today—self-introduction, ordering food, shopping, and asking directions—organizing them by category, and highlighted the key words with different colored highlighters.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family English mini-lesson and leisure
description: After finishing her notes, she walked to the living room and saw that Aqiang had already assembled Xuanxuan's new toy and was playing with Lego with her. She pulled Aqiang over and, putting what she had just learned to immediate use, taught him two English phrases for asking directions: "Excuse me, where is the library?" Aqiang repeated after her haltingly with inaccurate pronunciation, making the parents and Xuanxuan beside them laugh nonstop, and the home was filled with cheerful atmosphere.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family prepares dinner.
description: As dinner time approached, she stopped playing the hands-off boss and took the initiative to go into the kitchen. Her mother was stir-frying; she helped by peeling garlic, passing plates, and handing over seasonings. Her father, meanwhile, was leisurely watching the TV news in the living room, with occasional broadcast sounds coming from it.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner together and family chat
description: Dinner was sumptuous, and everyone chatted while eating. Her father talked about news from his hometown, and her mother asked Xuanxuan how it felt to be 'little monitor' today. Aqiang took out his phone and proudly showed Yajing the order screenshot of the electric scooter: 'The white lightweight one, just ordered. It is expected to arrive tomorrow, just in time for Xuanxuan's birthday!' Yajing carefully checked the order screenshot. After confirming there was no mistake, she happily forwarded the screenshot to the family group.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter and evening entertainment.
description: After dinner, they rested for a while. Yajing sat with Xuanxuan and drew pictures; today's drawing was “The Little Garden of the Kindergarten.” Aqiang also joined in, teaching Xuanxuan how to draw wobbly little flowers and grass. After drawing, the family sat on the sofa and read the picture book “Different Carmela” for half an hour.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal care and relaxation
description: After leaving Xuanxuan with A Qiang to coax her to sleep, Yajing finally had some time to herself. She first did ten minutes of leg stretches on the yoga mat to relieve the soreness from sitting for a long time. Then she carefully removed her makeup, put on a hydrating mask, and lay comfortably in bed, enjoying the rare peace and quiet.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Time for scrolling through social media and interest feeds
description: With a face mask on, she leisurely scrolled through Xiaohongshu, checking out the latest outfit recommendations and some simple baking videos. Then she opened the best friend group chat and saw Li Meiling and Wang Jia discussing which newly opened trendy restaurant to check out next week. She chimed in with a few words and agreed to decide after the weekend. She also replied to Xiaoyu's message from the Sanmei Pavilion baking studio, confirming whether she would be free to meet after tomorrow's Sunday Mass.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's late-night chat and plans for tomorrow.
description: A Qiang settled his daughter down and went into the bedroom, and the two lay in bed chatting. A Qiang said that when the scooter arrived, he would assemble and check it himself first to make sure it was safe before letting Xuanxuan use it. Yajing mentioned that tomorrow, Sunday, she was going to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass, and planned to check on the shop in the morning and, in the afternoon, take a photo of the kiln-transformed cup she had brought back from the pottery studio yesterday and post it on Moments.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: After the two finished chatting, she turned off the main light, leaving only a warm night light. She was happy that she had successfully completed a whole day of English classes today, and was also looking forward to the scooter that would arrive soon. Filled with a sense of achievement and anticipation for tomorrow, she quickly fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning meditation and gratitude prayers.
description: Waking up in the early morning, Song Yajing, wearing a morning robe, stood by the window gazing at the morning light, silently grateful for the new day. Then she sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed and did five minutes of gratitude meditation, praying for her daughter Chen Lexuan's birthday and family gathering, hoping for clear weather and everything going smoothly.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family morning prayer and breakfast
description: Song Yajing changed into home clothes and woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. The whole family gathered in the living room, and Song Yajing led a brief morning prayer, telling Xuanxuan that the meaning of a birthday is gratitude. Then her parents Song Minghui and Lin Xiuying helped prepare the meal: frying sunny-side-up eggs, bringing out pickled radish, and setting the table. The family sat around the table and enjoyed a warm breakfast.
location: Living room and kitchen at the home in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go with mother to Red Strawberry Supermarket to buy party supplies.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing changed into a light T-shirt and wide-leg pants, put on a canvas bag, and rode an electric bike with her mother Lin Xiuying to Red Strawberry Supermarket, Hubin South Road store. The two selected fresh strawberries, mangoes, imported cream, and butter in the fresh food section; her mother chose fruit, drinks, and cold dishes. In the baking section, they picked up cake flour, fine sugar, and a number 6 candle, then added balloons, letter banners, and ribbons in the party supplies section.
location: Red Strawberry Supermarket (Hubin South Road Branch), 110-116 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home to rest and set up the party venue.
description: After returning from shopping, Song Yajing and her mother sorted and put away the items. The strawberries and cream were refrigerated. The two drank lemonade and rested briefly, and she confirmed the balloon hanging position with her father Song Minghui. Then the whole family pitched in on the decorating: her father moved the coffee table and chairs aside, her husband Chen Zhiqiang set up a ladder and put up the balloon arch, Song Yajing hung the letter banner, her mother arranged daisies and lisianthus, and her daughter Xuanxuan helped pump air with an air pump. The living room was decorated into a pink fairy-tale world.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's nap and a simple family meal
description: After a busy morning, Chen Zhiqiang cooked hanging noodles, Song Yajing and her mother prepared cold dishes, and the family had a simple meal: tomato and egg noodles, cucumber salad, and spiced beef. After the meal, Xuanxuan felt sleepy, so Song Yajing coaxed her into a nap to save energy for the afternoon party.
location: Dining room and living room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Carefully baking a birthday cake.
description: While her daughter was napping, Song Yajing tied her hair up, put on an apron, and following her exclusive recipe, separated the egg whites and yolks, beat the egg whites to soft peaks, gently folded the batter, and put it into the oven. She stayed by it, watching the cake rise. After taking it out, she inverted it to cool, preparing for the subsequent frosting.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday break and personal errands
description: While the cake cooled, Song Yajing took wabi-sabi style photos on the balcony using the kiln-transmutation teacup, and her husband helped adjust the lighting until she was satisfied. Then she leaned against the sofa scrolling through her phone, used Alipay to book a follow-up appointment at the dental hospital for the next morning (slot at 9:30 AM), and replied to a birthday greeting voice message from her best friend Wang Jia.
location: The living room and master bedroom balcony of her home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Final decoration and refrigeration of the cake
description: Once the cake sponge had completely cooled, Song Yajing sliced it horizontally into three layers and filled them with cream and diced strawberries. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, cut fruit and washed cups beside her. Using a piping bag, she piped shell patterns, stuck rainbow candy beads around the edges, and inserted a number 6 candle, making a low-sugar strawberry cream castle cake. She carefully moved it into the refrigerator to chill and set.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Greet guests and organize children's craft activities
description: The doorbell rang, and Song Yajing's close friend Li Meiling with her son Haohao, and classmate's mother Zhao Li with her daughter Tongtong, were the first to arrive. Song Yajing greeted them warmly and hung up their coats. Xuanxuan was woken up and immediately perked up at the sight of her friends. Song Yajing spread out a play mat, laid out fabric scraps, buttons, stickers, and other 'Little Designer' materials, and guided the children to sit around and create. Meanwhile, the adults sat on the sofa, enjoying mint tea and fruit and chatting happily.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Birthday party highlight moments.
description: The party reached its climax. Song Yajing brought out the decorated cake, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang turned off the main light, leaving only the colorful string lights. Everyone sang the birthday song together. Xuanxuan closed her eyes in the candlelight, made a wish, then puffed out her cheeks and blew out the candles, sparking cheers and applause. Chen Zhiqiang captured the precious moment. Song Yajing cut the cake; the children got first pick of the piece with strawberries and candy, and the adults all praised how delicious the cake was.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Party wrap-up and sharing with neighbors.
description: The guests took their leave, and the whole family cleaned up the venue: her father put the tables and chairs back, Song Yajing and her mother cleared the cups, plates, and craft scraps. Her husband packed the remaining half of the intact cake into a cardboard box. Song Yajing took her daughter to Room 302, Entrance 6, of the neighboring unit and gave it to their neighbor, Aunt Zhang. Aunt Zhang thanked them in surprise, played with Xuanxuan, and gave them a red string peace knot she had made herself.
location: The living room of the home in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and Room 302, Entrance 6 of the compound

name: Preparing dinner and gathering with family.
description: After returning from the neighbor's house, Song Yajing and her mother prepared dinner, using the remaining ingredients to cook steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and loofah egg drop soup, along with the soy-braised beef left over from lunch. The family sat around the table, chatting about the funny moments from the party as they ate, and her parents' faces were filled with gratified smiles.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening chat with husband and planning new store activities.
description: Xuanxuan was taken by her maternal grandparents to wash up and hear stories. Song Yajing and her husband sat leaning on the sofa, browsing through the party photos on the camera, laughing without pause. She pointed at a photo of the children focused on doing handicrafts and suggested bringing that idea to the shop by launching a parent-child afternoon tea activity. The two had an initial discussion about material preparation, pricing, and promotion. Afterwards, she opened WeChat and replied to her best friend Susan and the unread greetings in the group chats.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home in the community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothing daughter to sleep and completing personal care routine.
description: Song Yajing walked into the children's room, lay down next to Xuanxuan who was almost asleep, stroked her forehead, and told a bedtime story about Peppa Pig's birthday until her daughter was breathing evenly and sound asleep. After leaving quietly, she returned to the master bedroom bathroom to carefully remove her makeup, apply a hydrating mask, and do a ten-minute full-body stretching relaxation.
location: Child's room and master bedroom bathroom in the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reflecting before bed and winding down to sleep.
description: After lying down in bed, Song Yajing posted the carefully photographed kiln-changed teacup photo on Xiaohongshu, with the caption, "Life is like the glaze of this cup, always holding unexpected beauty." Then she turned off her phone and, in the darkness, recalled the beauty of the whole day: her parents' help, her husband's cooperation, her daughter's smile, friends' praise... Warmth flowed through her heart. She said to herself, "You've worked hard," and fell peacefully asleep.
location: Master bed at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning weigh-in, washing up, and preparations
description: The alarm went off on time. Out of habit, she stepped onto the scale; the needle stopped steadily at 49.4 kg, and she nodded with satisfaction. She quickly changed into the sportswear and running shoes she had prepared the night before, sprayed a little water on the mint and chamomile on the windowsill, and quietly went out.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Community on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Walk to Jiaxingyuan Park
description: As I walked out of the community gate, I happened to meet my father Song Minghui. He was wearing a white tank top and stretching his legs. We smiled and greeted each other, then jogged along Hubin South Road toward Jiaxingyuan Park. The morning air was fresh, and the mango trees on the roadside gave off a faint fragrance. After about 13 minutes, we arrived at the park entrance.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Jiaxing Garden Park entrance

name: Morning brisk walk and family communication.
description: She power-walked 3 kilometers around the park's rubber track. Her father, while regulating his breathing, asked about the follow-up to the "Little Designer" segment at yesterday's party. Yajing adjusted her stride and excitedly described how she wanted to replicate the craft activity in the store as an "August parent-child afternoon tea." Her father's experience as a teacher in his youth made him blurt out: "You need to sort the material kits by age — what a five-year-old and a seven-year-old can play with is different. And add a little certificate; kids get a real sense of achievement." Yajing nodded repeatedly, feeling the idea suddenly became clear.
location: Walking trail in Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home
description: After the brisk walk, she walked home with her father. On the way, her father stopped at the mailbox near the entrance of the residential community to pick up the newspaper. When they reached the front door, they could already smell the aroma of millet porridge wafting from the kitchen.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and recording inspirations
description: She quickly took a shower and put on a clean T-shirt and jeans. Her mother had already laid out breakfast: boiled eggs, millet porridge, and a plate of pickled vegetables. While eating, Yajing took out her phone and recorded in her memo app the key points she had just discussed with her father: "age-group material kits", "T-shirt doodling", and "artwork display wall". She also scrolled through yesterday's party photos on her phone, picked a few where the children were smiling the happiest, and quietly began to compose a WeChat Moments post in her mind.
location: Dining room and balcony at home, in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to Saide Sunshine Dental (Kempinski branch) for a follow-up visit.
description: Put on the helmet and wheeled out her small green e-bike. She rode along Hubin South Road, turned a corner, and reached Hubin Middle Road. The whole trip took about 15 minutes, and she parked at the non-motor vehicle parking spot under the Kempinski.
location: Non-motor vehicle parking spot downstairs of Kempinski, 98 Hubin Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dental follow-up
description: Arrived on time for the appointment. After registering at the front desk, the nurse guided her to take a small dental X-ray. After a careful examination, the doctor told her that her teeth were in very good condition and that she just needed to keep them clean, and made an appointment for a checkup in six months. Yajing breathed a sigh of relief and reported to her husband Aqiang on WeChat: 'My teeth are super strong, I can eat everything!'
location: Saide Sunshine Dental (Kempinski Branch), Unit 01, 2nd Floor, No. 98 Hubin Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycled back to the Zhongshan Road store
description: After leaving the hospital, she got on her electric scooter, rode through Hubin Middle Road and Siming North Road, and arrived at the entrance of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She parked the scooter in the designated parking area behind the shop, picked up her canvas tote bag, and walked to the shop entrance.
location: At the entrance of Jingxin Wardrobe, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: She pulled up the metal rolling shutter door and turned on all the lights and air conditioning in the store. First she wiped the cashier counter and display countertops, carefully steamed flat the two new dresses that Xiaomei hadn't had time to hang up yesterday, and adjusted the scarf on the mannequin. After finishing these, she poured herself a glass of warm water, opened the cash register system, and started a new day's work.
location: Inside the Jingxin Wardrobe store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shop operations, online promotion, and event planning.
description: The shop assistant Xiao Mei arrived on time. The two rearranged the outfits on the mannequins at the door while discussing the weekend sales. Yajing opened her phone album, carefully selected 9 photos from yesterday's party showing the children most engaged and smiling brightest while doing crafts, and wrote a caption: "Sharing the joy of 'Little Designers'! Our little princesses have more flair than their moms when doing crafts~ A heads-up: see you in August!" She posted it to Moments and the VIP customer group. As soon as the message was sent, several mothers liked it and asked questions. Yajing patiently replied to each one and took the opportunity to ask about the children's clothing sizes.
location: Inside the Jingxin Wardrobe store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and refining the plan
description: Xiaomei watched the store. Yajing had the nearby satay noodle shop she frequented deliver a bowl of their signature satay noodles with tofu and pork liver. While eating the steaming noodles, she opened a WPS document on her laptop and, drawing on the discussion with her father that morning, began drafting the initial plan for the "August Parent-Child Afternoon Tea" event. She detailed segments such as "fabric collage" and "children's T-shirt doodling," and outlined the process and timing for check-in, craft guidance, tea break, and group photo.
location: Rest area inside the Jingxin Wardrobe store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon at the store: serving customers and writing poster copy
description: In the afternoon, the store mainly had a few passing tourists. A young woman came in to try on a dress. Drawing on her experience, Yajing paired it with a polka-dot top and an A-line denim skirt. The girl looked in the mirror and was very satisfied, so she bought both outfits. During a free moment, she opened the design app Canva on her phone, chose a warm macaron color scheme as the background, tried making a draft poster for a parent-child afternoon tea event, and repeatedly mulled over the promotional text on the poster. During this time, Aqiang called to ask about her plan to practice on the scooter tonight and reminded her to be sure to wear protective gear.
location: Inside the Jingxin Wardrobe store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing-up preparations and inventory count.
description: As it got dark, Yajing and Xiaomei began preparing to close the store. Xiaomei checked today's cash register system data and printed out the sales report. Yajing went into the warehouse, carefully counted the inventory of several best-selling styles from the weekend, and noted the sizes and quantities needing replenishment in the restocking notebook. The two worked together to tidy the fitting rooms and display areas, hanging up the clothes customers had left after trying them on.
location: Inside the Jingxin Wardrobe store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing the shop and walking to the practice location.
description: She pulled down the rolling shutter door right on time. Yajing wheeled out the white electric scooter that her husband Aqiang had already fully charged and adjusted. Chatting as they went, they walked along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street toward the less crowded Jukou Street alley, and after about 20 minutes of walking they found a relatively open and flat corner in the alley.
location: Inside the alley on Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Practiced on the electric scooter for the first time.
description: With Xiaomei cheering her on, Yajing put on her helmet, elbow pads, and knee pads. She took a deep breath and, following the steps in the video Aqiang had sent, first pushed off the ground with one foot to glide, then tried to put the other foot on the pedal and pressed the start button. At first balance was extremely hard to keep, and her arms were stiff. She had barely gone two or three meters when she toppled sideways due to an unstable center of gravity, landed on her right knee, and scraped a bit of skin. Xiaomei rushed over to help her up and encouraged her to try again. Yajing gritted her teeth, rubbed her knee, and continued practicing. After more than ten attempts, she finally managed to wobble forward five or six meters, and the two of them laughed out loud with joy.
location: Inside the alley on Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: On the way home: pharmacy restock
description: After practicing for 40 minutes, although her technique was still rusty, Yajing already found some feeling for it. She pushed the scooter and parted ways with Xiaomei at the intersection. Walking alone along Siming North Road toward home, she passed a pharmacy near Hubin South Road, stopped the scooter, went in, and bought a box of adhesive bandages and a small bottle of povidone-iodine for treating wounds.
location: The pharmacy and the route near Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and sharing fun stories
description: Pushing the scooter home, she found her husband A Qiang and daughter Xuanxuan already sitting at the dining table waiting for her. At the table, Xuanxuan curiously touched the scooter while Yajing, eating and talking animatedly, described how she had “used both hands and feet” during practice and nearly hit the wall, making her daughter giggle. A Qiang laughed and encouraged her, saying it was already pretty good for a first try, and promised to take her to the more open Bailuzhou Park on the weekend to practice again. After dinner, Yajing rolled up her pant legs, revealing a scraped patch of skin on her knee. A Qiang stopped Xuanxuan from reaching out to touch it, disinfected it with iodophor, and put on a bandage they had just bought.
location: Dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening time with Xuanxuan and personal care.
description: Yajing sat with Xuanxuan on the living room play mat and played for a while with the pop-up picture book that arrived yesterday, and told her two stories about little rabbits. After that, she had Xuanxuan brush her teeth and wash her face on her own. She herself went to the balcony, watered her beloved mint and chamomile, and picked off a few slightly yellowed leaves. After taking a shower, she sat on the edge of the bed and did a simple set of leg stretches, relaxing the muscles that were a bit sore from the day’s tension.
location: Living room, balcony, and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and inner reflection
description: Xuanxuan fell asleep first, accompanied by A Qiang. Yajing returned to the master bedroom, turned off the main light, and left only a warm bedside lamp on. She opened the locked diary on the nightstand and jotted down a few lines: "First day of riding practice, I fell and scraped my knee, but that last glide felt amazing! The parent-child afternoon tea plan has taken shape, and I'll keep refining it tomorrow." After that, she knelt on the bed, closed her eyes, and said a brief prayer. Then she turned off the light and fell asleep, ending this fulfilling and brave day.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning household chores, comforting her daughter, and giving instructions to the store clerk.
description: After the alarm went off, Song Yajing pressed snooze gently so as not to wake her daughter, then washed up and changed into long pants to cover the scrape on her knee. She checked her backpack to confirm the vaccination record book and medical insurance card were in the inner compartment, then went into the kitchen to take out ingredients. She made an egg sandwich and warm milk for her daughter Chen Lexuan. She softly woke her up, used the picture book "I'm Not Afraid of Shots" to prepare her mentally, and promised they would go eat tiramisu after the shot. After breakfast, Song Yajing sent a message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang to confirm the pickup arrangement, then called the shop assistant Xiaomei, explaining that she would arrive at the shop late in the morning because she was taking her daughter for a shot, asked Xiaomei to feature the floral dress on the mannequin, and said she would be there in the afternoon. Finally, she checked her backpack once more.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Went to get the diphtheria-tetanus and MMR vaccines and stayed for observation.
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove Song Yajing and Chen Lexuan to the Zhonghua Street Community Health Service Center. On the way, Song Yajing diverted Xuanxuan's attention by letting her look at cats and a sprinkler truck out the window, and confirmed the appointment on her phone. They arrived at 8:20. After registering, Dr. Wang Mingyuan checked the information and administered the diphtheria-tetanus combined vaccine and the second dose of the measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine to Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan cried loudly; Song Yajing held her and distracted her with a picture book. The family of three then waited 30 minutes in the observation area, letting Xuanxuan watch cartoons on the phone. After confirming no abnormalities, they left.
location: Zhonghua Street Community Health Service Center, No. 60 Ding'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the dessert shop to fulfill the tiramisu promise
description: After the vaccination showed no abnormal reaction, the family of three walked to the "Sweet Heart" dessert shop on Siming West Road. Song Yajing ordered tiramisu and warm milk for Xuanxuan, and Xuanxuan's tears turned into a smile. Chen Zhiqiang finished his coffee and left early for work. The mother and daughter enjoyed a warm moment.
location: “Sweetheart” Dessert Shop, No. 76 Siming West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Escort daughter home and hand her over to her maternal grandfather.
description: Song Yajing and Chen Lexuan slowly walked home along Siming West Road. When they arrived, Song Yajing's father Song Minghui was already waiting at the door, and Xuanxuan happily ran into her grandpa's arms. Song Yajing told her father to give Xuanxuan plenty of water at noon, and after checking the band-aid on her knee, she prepared to start work.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Refine the parent-child afternoon tea plan, handle store affairs, and take a lunch break
description: Song Yajing opened her laptop at home and refined the parent-child afternoon tea activity plan. Following her father's suggestion, she sorted the craft materials into three age groups, and compared prices of colored non-woven fabric from suppliers on the 1688 platform. At the same time, she replied to the VIP customer inquiries sent by her shop assistant Xiaomei. Afterwards, she had lunch alone, heating up leftovers: garlic lettuce and pesto pasta. After the meal, she rested on the sofa with her eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Prepared and rode the electric bike to the store.
description: Song Yajing put on light shoes, wheeled her electric bike out of the shed, checked the battery, told her father to call if anything came up, and set off. After riding for about ten minutes, she arrived at the "Serene Heart Wardrobe" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road. After parking, she opened the rolling door, went in, checked the morning sales records and inventory changes, and watered the green plants.
location: “Serenity Wardrobe” store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon in-store work: recording community content, receiving customers, and editing videos
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing and Xiao Mei recorded a parent-child afternoon tea handmade demonstration video together. Song Yajing explained the steps while Xiao Mei filmed. During this time, two out-of-town tourists came into the store. Song Yajing enthusiastically put together floral dresses, white sneakers, and straw hats for them, and successfully sold one item. In the afternoon, a thunder shower arrived. Song Yajing used this time to edit the video, add ukulele music, and add the text "Rewards from leveling up must be won back by yourself" before posting it to her Moments and community groups, where it received many likes and comments.
location: “Serenity Wardrobe” store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up Li Haoyu and take him home, and say goodbye to Meiling
description: As the rain gradually eased, Song Yajing put on her raincoat, told Xiaomei to watch the store, and rode her electric bike to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she passed the craft store but did not stop. She picked up Li Haoyu on time, and Haohao shared the Super Wings he had drawn in kindergarten. Song Yajing took Haohao to the downstairs of Meiling's home in Xiagang New Village. Li Meiling, though pregnant, was still waiting at the door and handed Song Yajing a homemade passion fruit tea. The two chatted for over ten minutes. Song Yajing said with a smile, 'That's what friends are for,' and they agreed to go for Japanese-style afternoon tea together after Meiling gives birth.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Xiagang New Village residential area near Zhenhai Road

name: Return to the store for evening work, dinner, and handover.
description: Song Yajing rode her electric bike back to the store in a happy mood. On the way, she stopped by the post office to mail clothes that a regular customer had forgotten to bring. After arriving at the store, customer traffic increased during the evening rush. She and Xiaomei divided the work of receiving customers, matching outfits, tidying tried-on clothes, and replying to parents’ comments about the parent-child afternoon tea video. Around 6 p.m., when customers were fewer, they ordered takeout satay noodles and ate them in turns at the back door. Afterward, they checked the day’s revenue and the inventory of best-selling styles to prepare for the next day’s restocking.
location: “Serenity Wardrobe” store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Practice skateboarding in Jukou Street lane and pack up to go home
description: After closing the shop, Song Yajing changed into skate shoes and put on protective gear, then walked with Xiaomei to Jukou Street alley. She focused on practicing straight-line gliding and managed to slowly move about 100 meters without falling. Xiaomei cheered and encouraged her. After half an hour of practice, despite a dull pain in her knees, she felt joy at the progress. She packed up the scooter and walked home, messaging her husband Chen Zhiqiang on the way to ask about dinner.
location: From Jukou Street Lane to No. 82 Shanggu Street Community on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and warm parent-child time
description: When she got home, Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared dinner: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and braised pork ribs. The family sat together, and Xuanxuan talked about the big castle she built with blocks. After dinner, Song Yajing watched a video about getting an injection with Xuanxuan, guiding her to say she was brave, and Xuanxuan nodded happily.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Evening routine: tending to plants, washing up with her daughter, and putting her to bed
description: Song Yajing checked the mint and chamomile on the balcony and was relieved to see the soil was moist. Then she bathed Xuanxuan, told her a bedtime story, and coaxed her to sleep. After that, she washed up, changed the band-aid on her scraped knee, and stretched.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Evening personal relaxation and going to bed.
description: Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and scrolled through Xiaohongshu. Seeing the complimentary comments under the parent-child afternoon tea video she had posted, she felt warm inside. In the close friends group, she replied to Meiling's fruit tea photo, saying, “Sweet to the heart.” Then she wrote a gratitude journal in her phone memo: grateful for her daughter's bravery, her friend's trust, her father's help, and her skateboarding progress. Finally, she chatted with Chen Zhiqiang beside her pillow about plans for the weekend at the beach, and fell into a deep sleep filled with happiness.
location: Room 501, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:30 in the morning, I stretched and got out of bed. I weighed myself and found that I was 49.3 kg, as stable as yesterday. After washing up, I made a cup of honey water, did some simple exercises on the balcony, and started a new day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and asking for baking tips online.
description: Walked 13 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park to meet my father, and power-walked 3 kilometers together, keeping a pace of 8:30 per kilometer. On the way, I asked my father about yesterday's failed macarons. He reminded me that Fujian's weather is humid and the shell drying time needs to be long enough. After the power walk, I sat on a bench and sent Master Chen a voice message. Master Chen advised working in an air-conditioned room and extending the shell drying time to over 45 minutes. I immediately saved the suggestion in my phone memo.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home, wash up, have breakfast, and take daughter to school
description: After power walking, I went home, took a quick shower, woke up my daughter Xuanxuan, and helped her tie her hair into pigtails with bows. The three of us had breakfast together: milk, fried eggs, and whole wheat toast. I discussed with my husband Aqiang that he would take our daughter to kindergarten, while I focused on practicing macarons at home.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparation and emergency restocking
description: Rode an electric scooter for 10 minutes to the clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The clerk Xiaomei was already cleaning. Together they reviewed the sales records and found that two hot-selling dress styles were low in stock. She immediately contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou for an urgent restock, with an expected arrival the next day. Then she and Xiaomei styled the mannequins and window displays with the new summer styles, completing the pre-opening preparations.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home from the store to prepare for baking.
description: After briefing Xiao Mei on the morning's business matters, I rode my electric scooter home. On the way, I kept thinking about Master Chen's shell-drying trick, feeling both nervous and excited to take on macarons again.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Another attempt at French macarons
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen, where the air conditioner was set to 22 degrees. She strictly followed Master Chen's instructions: sift the almond flour three times, beat the egg whites to stiff peaks, mix the batter, pipe small rounds onto a silicone mat, and set a timer to let them rest for 45 minutes. After resting, the tops were no longer sticky to the touch. She carefully put them into the oven, watching nervously as the macarons slowly developed their feet. But when they came out, she was disappointed again—most had no feet at all, and only a few had puffed up slightly. She sighed, her enthusiasm mostly cooled, but she still recorded the failed process.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shared the failed baking creations in the baking group.
description: Looking at the collapsed macarons, she took a photo and sent it to the Mom Baking Study Group, with a caption poking fun at herself for still failing on the fourth attempt, with only a tiny bit of lacy edge. Group members all shared their own failed creations—sunken chiffon cakes, cracked bagels, and scones hard as rocks—teasing and comforting one another. The mood was cheerful, and she felt relieved, replying that she would keep trying next time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and learning to bake
description: After chatting socially, her mood settled. She reheated the pork rib soup she had made yesterday and had a simple lunch with boiled eggs and rice. While eating, she opened her tablet and watched an episode of a baking master’s video tutorial, focusing on the explanation of meringue stages to build up theoretical knowledge for her next attempt.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare materials for daughter's primary school enrollment.
description: After the lunch break, I went to the study, took out a new document folder, and focused on organizing the materials for my daughter Xuanxuan's elementary school enrollment. I found the vaccination record booklet, household registration booklet, and birth certificate, photographed each page and saved them to a dedicated album, and made two copies of the key pages. I put the originals and copies into separate transparent document sleeves, then placed them into a large archive folder, and marked it with a marker: "Chen Lexuan - Elementary School Registration Materials (Originals + Copies)." I confirmed in the parenting app that the latest vaccination records had been synchronized, and sent a screenshot to my parents in Quanzhou. After finishing, I felt a weight lifted off my mind.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store and purchase supplies.
description: After finishing organizing the materials, she felt light and rode her e-bike back to the store. On the way, she bought 2 bottles of water and a pack of wet wipes at the convenience store by Zhenhai Road Metro Station, preparing for the evening scooter practice.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store operations and regular customer follow-ups.
description: Back at the store, customers gradually increased in the afternoon. I sent a WeChat message to a regular customer, Vivian, inviting her to see the new French floral dresses. At 4 PM, Vivian arrived. I styled her with a floral dress and an off-white knitted cardigan; she was very satisfied and bought it immediately. The two of us also chatted about baking and shared stories of failed macarons, which made her laugh. At 5:30, my husband Aqiang texted saying he had picked up our daughter, telling me to focus on work.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing preparations and scooter warm-up
description: After the customers thinned out, she tidied the shelves and counted the revenue with Xiaomei. After pulling down the store door, the two rode kick scooters to Jukou Street alley. First they glided back and forth on the open ground to refresh the feeling of riding in a straight line, their bodies gradually relaxing, as a warm-up for practicing turns.
location: Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Scooter turning practice
description: After warming up, she began trying to turn, laying empty mineral water bottles on the ground as obstacles. At first her body was stiff and she nearly hit the wall. Xiaomei reminded her to shift her center of gravity inward. After adjusting, she slowed down before the turn, leaned her body, and pushed off the ground with her back foot. After repeated practice, she was finally able to smoothly go around the obstacles. Her movements were still clumsy, but it was a big improvement over yesterday, when she could only ride in a straight line. Xiaomei helped her record a video and sent it to Aqiang, who immediately liked it.
location: Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Shopping at the community supermarket on the way home.
description: After practice, she said goodbye to Xiaomei at the entrance of the alley and walked home. On the way, she stopped at the small supermarket at the entrance of the community and bought her daughter’s favorite yogurt, a bunch of greens, and a few tomatoes to prepare for dinner and the next day.
location: Community supermarket near Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Warm family dinner
description: Pushing the door open to go home, her husband had already prepared dinner: cola chicken wings, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. Her daughter Xuanxuan ran over holding up a drawing—it was Mommy wearing skateboard shoes. At the dinner table, they shared the funny story of the macaron failure again, making the whole family laugh. Her husband comforted her, saying that next time he would take her to learn from Master Chen. The family enjoyed dinner with laughter and joy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family time and getting daughter ready for bed
description: After the meal, I cleared the dishes, washed some fruit, and brought it to the living room. My husband played with building blocks with our daughter. At 8:30, I gave our daughter a bath, read two picture books, and listened to her talk about the funny stories from her kindergarten competition. Around 9, she fell asleep peacefully. Afterward, I went to the balcony to water the mint and rosemary and relaxed by looking at the night view. My phone received a message from my friend Li Meiling asking about the macaron result. I replied with a facepalm emoji, and she joked that we should go cause some mischief at Master Chen's place another day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and going to bed.
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she carefully did her facial care routine and leg stretches. Lying in bed, she chatted with her husband. They talked about how the macarons weren't successful, but the joy in the group chat made it interesting instead; she felt at ease after organizing the school enrollment materials, and the scooter riding had also improved. It was a full day. She turned off the light at 22:30, thought back over the day's experiences, felt genuine and satisfied, and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and balcony herb pruning
description: The alarm rang right at 6:30. Song Yajing put on her workout clothes, drank a glass of warm water, and went out. She walked 13 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park, power-walked 3 kilometers along the park trail at an 8:30 per kilometer pace, and felt the morning breeze. She got home at 7:10, took out her tools to divide the mint that had overgrown its pot on the balcony, carefully split it into three small pots, pulled out weeds from the chamomile and rosemary pots, watered them thoroughly, and planned to bring two pots of mint to the store next week.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the home balcony at 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Woke daughter up and took her to kindergarten.
description: After washing up, Song Yajing gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her tie her pigtails, quickly made fried egg toast and milk, supervised her finishing breakfast, and checked her little schoolbag. At 8:00, she set off on her e-bike, detouring to the Gongyuan South Road stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, where she bought Xuanxuan a sheet of her favorite cartoon stickers as a reward for brushing her teeth on her own last night. At 8:15, they arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and she watched her walk into the school gate with her teacher.
location: Home at the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; passing the Park South Road Stationery Store at No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen; arriving at Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Store opening preparation and business plan writing
description: Arrived at Jingxin Wardrobe at 8:30, turned on the air conditioner after opening the door, and wiped the shelves. At 9:00, shop assistant Chen Xiaomei arrived, and the two organized the newly arrived summer dresses and accessories together, using a garment steamer to remove wrinkles and adjusting the displays. Yajing selected a few featured floral dresses and versatile white shirts and took photos on her phone in front of the mannequins for later use. After 10:30, customers gradually dwindled. At the cashier counter, she opened her laptop and focused on refining the proposal for the "Little Designer Summer Fabric Workshop": detailing the activity schedule (two Saturday afternoons in August), material list (cotton fabric, buttons, needles and thread, hot glue guns, etc.), target age group (4-8 years old), pricing (128 yuan per child), and process steps.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunchtime and soliciting opinions on the plan.
description: At 12:00, Chen Xiaomei went to lunch first, while Song Yajing stayed in the store and used her phone to order delivery from the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City, choosing a Caesar salad and an iced latte. During lunch, she sent the completed draft proposal to her childhood friend Li Meiling and her sister Song Yawen via WeChat: “My two advisers, help me check whether there are any flaws in the pricing and the process?” While waiting for their replies, she responded to inquiries from several VIP customers.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon operations and inventory check
description: At 13:30, Chen Xiaomei came back after eating, and Song Yajing continued to watch the store. Several groups of customers came in during the afternoon; she enthusiastically recommended outfits and successfully sold two dresses. During breaks, she replied to online messages, opened the inventory system to check the stock of best-selling summer styles with Chen Xiaomei, and noted the styles that needed restocking. At 16:00, she tidied the checkout counter in advance and got ready to pick up her child.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up Li Haoyu and arrange afternoon tea with Li Meiling.
description: At 16:00, Song Yajing arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten on time on her electric bike. After picking up her daughter Chen Lexuan, she waited for Li Meiling's son Li Haoyu. This was the last time she would regularly pick up Haohao. The two children chattered away on the bike. Yajing parked in front of Li Meiling's building, where Meiling was already waiting. She handed her a box of homemade mung bean cakes: 'You've worked hard! His dad can take over the pick-ups and drop-offs normally next week.' Yajing took the box, feeling warm inside. The two chatted briefly at the entrance of the building and agreed to go for afternoon tea at the newly opened Japanese-style tea house on Zhongshan Road at the end of the month.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to downstairs of Li Meiling's home in a residential community on Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Back at the shop to handle business and tidy up in the evening.
description: At 17:10, Song Yajing returned to the store with her daughter and mung bean cakes. She had Xuanxuan draw on a small stool behind the cash register, while she replied to feedback from Li Meiling and her elder sister (Meiling suggested adding a display segment, and Yawen thought the pricing was too low) and wrote it down. Around 18:00, taking advantage of no customers in the store, Yajing and Chen Xiaomei did a simple count and verification of the day's revenue and inventory.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing the shop and practicing on the electric scooter
description: At 18:30, she closed the store on time. Song Yajing took out the electric scooter, put on her protective gear, and had Chen Xiaomei act as a "traffic controller." On the side of Jukou Street with fewer pedestrians, she practiced long-distance gliding and simulated stopping and starting at traffic lights. When Xiaomei shouted "red light," she braked steadily; when she shouted "green light," she slowly accelerated. Although she wobbled a little when starting, she never fell and could glide nearly 200 meters continuously, greatly boosting her confidence.
location: Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Bought household supplies on the way home.
description: At 19:20, Song Yajing rode the scooter slowly home carrying her daughter. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she stopped and bought two packs of toilet paper, a large bottle of laundry detergent, and whole-wheat bread and fresh milk for tomorrow's breakfast, and also grabbed a yogurt for her daughter.
location: Convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Arrived home at 19:50, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared dinner: steamed sea bass, tomato scrambled eggs, and pork rib soup. The family sat around the table eating, in a warm atmosphere. Song Yajing enthusiastically shared today's 'highlights': Haohao had 'graduated', and he could now ride the scooter 200 meters in a row. Her daughter Xuanxuan also brought out a drawing: 'Mom, I drew you riding the scooter!' Aqiang laughed and said, 'Looks like both of you made great progress today.'
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and daughter’s bedtime preparation
description: After dinner, Song Yajing played a sticker game with Xuanxuan for a while. At 20:40, she took Xuanxuan to bathe and wash her hair; they fooled around together. After the bath, she took out a dinosaur picture book, leaned against the headboard, and told Xuanxuan a story until she gradually fell asleep. At 21:20, Xuanxuan was in a deep sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care, stretching, and reflection record
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom. She carefully completed her evening skincare routine, then did 15 minutes of full-body stretching to relieve muscle soreness. Afterwards, she took out her diary and wrote: "The task of saying goodbye to Haohao is done; although I feel a little sad, I feel more relieved. The initial plan for the handicraft workshop got everyone's ideas, which was great. The scooter red-light simulation practice succeeded, so she is not far from riding on her own." She took photos of the mung bean cakes Li Meiling had given her and posted them to the "Sisters Chat" group: "A close friend's handmade treat—that's tomorrow's breakfast!" It drew envious comments from the sisters.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Before bed: chatting with her husband and browsing on her phone.
description: At 22:00, her husband Chen Zhiqiang also finished work, and the two lay in bed chatting. Song Yajing shared the details about the scooter and the craft workshop plan; Aqiang offered a few technical suggestions. At 23:00, she picked up her phone and scrolled through parent-child activity cases on Xiaohongshu, then checked the group messages. At 23:20, after saying goodnight, they turned off the lights and fell into a deep sleep, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning wake-up and morning preparations
description: After waking up with her body clock, Yajing did some simple stretches, checked the weather on her phone and confirmed it would be cloudy turning sunny, weighed herself and recorded her weight at 49.2 kg. After washing up, she changed into comfortable workout clothes, drank a glass of warm water, and got ready for her morning exercise.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk with her father and discuss outfit inspiration.
description: Yajing walked to Jiaxing Garden Park to meet her father and started a 3.5 km brisk walk. Noticing a girl's dress as she exercised in the morning, she talked with her father about how to style French tea dresses for autumn. Her father shared stories from his youth about choosing fabrics. Without realizing it, they took an extra lap around the park, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home, washed up, and had a simple breakfast.
description: After speed-walking home, Yajing was drenched in sweat. She took a quick shower and changed into a linen shirt and wide-leg pants. On the dining table, her husband had prepared boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and milk. While eating, she reminded her daughter Xuanxuan to use bold colors in her crafts class, and they agreed that if the work turned out well, the weekend reward would be digging in the sand at the beach.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took daughter to school on an electric scooter.
description: Yajing rode her electric scooter to take her daughter Xuanxuan to kindergarten. On the way, she asked about the handcraft class plan. Xuanxuan said she wanted to make a flying butterfly, and Yajing encouraged her to try colored cardstock collage. At the school gate, she watched her daughter run happily into the classroom.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Visiting a creative product store along the way to buy handicraft materials
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing stopped by the "Yiyu Handcraft" creative shop on Zhenhai Road on the way, browsed the handmade accessories area, and selected animal-shaped wooden buttons and floral-and-bird cotton linen fabric, preparing them for the store's workshop activities and birthday party decorations.
location: One Corner Handcraft, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Arrive at the store and handle daily tasks
description: Yajing rode her electric scooter through the early morning on Zhongshan Road to reach Jingxin Wardrobe. She opened the door to air it out, checked cleanliness, watered the green plants, put the chamomile she had brought into a vase, and simply tidied the fitting room.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning meeting to check data and prepare for restocking.
description: After shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, Yajing spent 20 minutes with her checking recent sales data and try-on rates, recording best sellers and out-of-stock sizes. They paid special attention to feedback on the French-style retro dresses and compiled a list of sizes that needed restocking, preparing for subsequent orders.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with the supplier to place an additional order
description: Yajing contacted Hangzhou supplier Zheng Kai via WeChat video, showed sales data and customer feedback, and explicitly placed an additional order for 7 plus-size and 7 mini-size French vintage-style dresses. After bargaining, she paid a partial amount in advance to confirm the order. Zheng Kai mentioned that there would be an avant-garde design ordering fair in Hangzhou next month. Yajing noted down the date and planned to possibly attend and meet her best friend along the way.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize the craft workshop list, plan the display, and take a lunch break
description: After hanging up the video call, Yajing took out the handicraft workshop materials list, supplemented and optimized it based on what she had found in the cultural and creative store, and marked the core fabrics to purchase in red pen. Then she and Xiaomei readjusted the store display, hanging the French-style dress on the window mannequin and pairing it with a straw bag and silk scarf. As the midday customer flow dwindled, she took out her homemade sandwich and cold-brewed tea, scrolled through Little Red Book for autumn outfit inspiration while eating, and replied to customer WeChat inquiries.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business: receiving customers and detailed display
description: Opening the store in the afternoon, Yajing received regular customer Vivian, who tried on a French-style dress, was very satisfied, bought two in different colors, and recommended them to friends. After seeing the customer off, Yajing and Xiaomei spent over an hour arranging sample fabrics, buttons, and other items from the craft workshop on the central display stand in the store, attaching handwritten descriptive labels to create a warm handmade atmosphere.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying fresh flowers to decorate the shop.
description: Taking advantage of the quiet time in the store, Yajing walked to the nearby Flower Time flower shop. She originally wanted to buy chamomile, but was attracted by the newly stocked warm-toned pompon chrysanthemums. She chose a bouquet of light orange and white pompon chrysanthemums with eucalyptus leaves, planning to replace the old bouquet in the window.
location: Flower Time Flower Shop, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and bond with her.
description: After changing the flower arrangement, Yajing rode her electric scooter to the kindergarten on time. When she picked up Xuanxuan, her daughter excitedly showed her a paper butterfly craft with sequins as wings. Yajing praised her warmly and rewarded her with ice cream, and together they shared the joy of after-school time.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Play with her daughter in the park.
description: Instead of going straight home, Yajing took Xuanxuan to Jiahangyuan Park. Xuanxuan played on the slide and swings with her little friends, while Yajing sat on a bench keeping watch, replying to customer group messages and ordering the most important cotton fabrics needed for the handicraft workshop, arranging for them to arrive at the store tomorrow.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Cozy family dinner and companionship
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already made steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato scrambled eggs. During dinner, the whole family shared about their day. Yajing mentioned that she might go on a business trip to Hangzhou, and her husband expressed support. After dinner, Yajing helped Xuanxuan stick her handmade butterfly craft on the headboard, and they read a butterfly growth picture book together.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening return to the shop to make up work hours for the handmade workshop sprint.
description: After her husband took over to accompany their daughter, Yajing rode her electric scooter back to the shop. Using the quiet time, she turned on her computer and organized the complete workshop process, material kit contents, cost accounting, and guiding scripts into a polished PDF. She also photographed the new store display details and sent them to the membership group to warm up the weekend event, receiving inquiries and reservations from several mothers.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home, prepared, and had an in-depth video conversation with a close friend about midlife confusion.
description: After closing the shop and going home, Yajing made a cup of chamomile tea to soothe her nerves, took a hot shower, and changed into loungewear. Then she made a video call on time to her best friend Zhao Min in Hangzhou. Zhao Min vented about the rat race at her advertising agency and the crushing overtime. Yajing listened quietly, shared her own experience last year of feeling anxious and wanting to close the shop during the off-season, and comforted her, saying, “I know that feeling of powerlessness, but we're both still moving forward.” The originally planned half-hour chat stretched to an hour and a half. Zhao Min said she felt much better after being understood, and the two agreed to meet for a meal in Hangzhou next month.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wrote in her diary to record the warmth of friendship.
description: After hanging up the video call, Yajing was still immersed in the conversation. She took out her diary and wrote: 'Friendship doesn't have to mean meeting often; when we're on the same wavelength, it still feels warm. Minmin's struggle reminds me of my past self and makes me cherish even more the little shop at hand and the lights of home. Being able to give a friend strength also makes me feel healed.' After writing, she looked out at the quiet street and felt full of contentment.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime care, stretching, and couple chat until falling asleep
description: Yajing did a few bedtime stretches to ease muscle soreness and carefully followed her evening skincare routine. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, was already lying in bed. Yajing chatted with him about the next day's plans and a possible trip to Hangzhou next month. Her husband was supportive and suggested he take Xuanxuan to the science museum. They also discussed taking Xuanxuan to the seaside or the coffee street on the weekend. As they chatted warmly, drowsiness crept in. Yajing turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of her husband's even breathing.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A Warm Morning Prelude
description: At 7:00, the alarm went off right on time. Outside the window was the bright, clear sunshine unique to Xiamen summer. Yajing habitually stepped on the scale first—49.1 kg—and gave a satisfied little smile. While washing up, she patted her face with cold water to wake herself up. Then she prepared breakfast for the family: milk oatmeal and boiled eggs for her daughter Xuanxuan, a fried egg sandwich for her husband Aqiang, and an American coffee with whole wheat toast for herself. At 7:15, she gently woke Xuanxuan, and the mother and daughter tied playful buns in front of the vanity mirror. At 7:45, the family of three sat around the dining table. Yajing carefully went over the day's plans with Aqiang, focusing on the evening scooter plan and reminding him about Xuanxuan's afternoon schedule. Aqiang patted her hand and said with a smile, 'Don't worry, I'm here.'
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time and getting ready to go out
description: After breakfast, Yajing did not rush out. She played the "Little Designer" game with Xuanxuan on the living room floor mat for a while, using silk scarves to design dresses for dolls, and Xuanxuan happily styled outfits for her. At 8:20, she checked the waist bag she had prepared the night before, making sure the power bank, keys, and phone were all there, and also tried on her helmet to feel how tight it was. She patted Xuanxuan's head and said, "Mommy will ride her scooter home this afternoon. You should cheer me on!" Xuanxuan nodded heavily.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: At 8:30, Yajing put on comfortable flat shoes and walked out. From home to the 'Serene Closet' at No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she deftly cut through several alleys—exiting Shanggu Street, turning into Siming South Road, and then passing through an alley full of bougainvillea to reach Zhongshan Road. In the early morning, the pedestrian street was still quiet, with only a few sanitation workers and elderly residents doing morning exercises. After about 15 minutes, she arrived at the store entrance.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and getting ready to open the store
description: Pushing open the shop door, she first turned on the small speaker and played a light French chanson. Then she began her daily upkeep: changing the water for the chamomile on the windowsill, gently brushing each displayed dress with a duster, rearranging the display racks by color, and hanging the few new French blouses that arrived yesterday in prominent positions, giving the shop a fresh look.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and deep customer relationship maintenance.
description: At 9:00, Xiaomei arrived at the store on time. The two had a brief morning meeting while tidying up, and Yajing shared the scheduling plan for the coming week. Around 9:30, an old customer, Vivian (who lives in Haicang and comes every month), happened to come in. Yajing warmly greeted her and recommended the newly arrived French vintage linen shirts, styling two outfits for her based on her temperament: one for commuting and one for vacation. Vivian tried them on and was very satisfied, paying in full for both sets on the spot. Around 10:30, when the store became quiet, Yajing sat at the cashier counter and began one-on-one follow-up messages on her phone with the mothers who had attended last week's parent-child afternoon tea.
