She carefully noted feedback such as "the flower arrangement steps are a bit complicated" and "looking forward to adding a children's handicraft session," and in her notebook she distilled two core improvements: "add child safety seat buckles" and "simplify flower arrangement steps to sticker DIY."
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunchtime recharge and rest
description: At lunchtime, Xiaomei went to the satay noodle shop downstairs and brought back two takeout bowls—one was Yajing's favorite shrimp and pork liver noodles, and the other was her own beef noodles. The two chatted about the afternoon's stocking plan while eating. After the meal, Yajing leaned back in the rattan chair in the shop, closed her eyes, and rested for 15 minutes to recharge for the afternoon challenge.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home to accompany family and planning a cycling route.
description: At 13:00, Yajing said a word to Xiaomei and walked home. When she got home, Aqiang was looking at his phone in the living room, while Xuanxuan was taking a nap in the bedroom. Yajing tiptoed back to the bedroom, opened her phone's map, and traced with her fingertip from the back section of Zhongshan Road all the way to Hubin South Road. She repeatedly checked the non-motorized lanes on Wenyuan Road and Hubin Erli, confirming that the Wenyuan Road section had steady traffic and a smooth road surface, making it the best choice for a beginner. She took a screenshot of the planned route and sent it to Aqiang on WeChat, with the note: "Master, help me check if this road is safe?" Then she put the prepared waist pack around her waist, checked the positions of her keys, power bank, and phone, and confirmed they would not affect her cycling posture.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk back to the shop
description: At 14:00, Yajing said a quiet goodbye to Aqiang and Xuanxuan, who was still sleeping, and walked out again. The afternoon sunlight was a bit strong, so she put up a small parasol and walked back along the familiar morning route to Zhongshan Road.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business and new product warm-up
description: At 14:15, Yajing returned to the shop full of energy. In the afternoon, there were more tourists and walk-in customers. While skillfully greeting customers, she used her tablet to take photos of several newly arrived French floral-print dresses, adjusted the colors with a photo-editing app, and posted them to her Moments and VIP group with the caption 'New arrivals at the little shop — a soft style for this weekend.' Within minutes, she received several comments asking for prices. Around 16:30, taking advantage of a lull, she called Xiaomei over and shared the activity improvements she had summarized in the morning. The two chatted enthusiastically and decided to run next weekend's parent-child activity according to the new plan.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing inventory and ritual preparations.
description: At 17:30, Yajing began taking inventory and closing the store. After checking the day's revenue, she felt pleased—today's sales were good, up 20% from last Saturday. At 18:00, Xiaomei helped her push the brand-new white electric scooter onto the flat sidewalk in front of the store. Yajing took a deep breath and checked again that the helmet strap was tight and the knee and elbow pads fit snugly. She took out her phone and had Aqiang send a message saying "Ready to go!" in the family group chat, prompting a string of encouraging emojis from her parents and sister.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Historic first ride: scooter home
description: At 18:15, the sunset glow was gentle and a soft breeze brushed her face. Yajing tightened her waist pack, stepped onto the pedal, and gently turned the throttle; the e-bike glided out smoothly. She strictly followed the route she had planned, always keeping to the right and riding slowly on Wenyuan Road, slowing down in advance at traffic lights, and keeping a close eye on vehicles coming from both sides when crossing intersections. The wind brushed her cheeks, and the sound of the wheels rolling filled her ears, bringing a sense of freedom she had never felt before. The distance of about 3 kilometers took her 20 minutes. When she finally saw the familiar entrance to the Shanggu Street Community on Hubin South Road, she was so excited she almost cried out. She parked the e-bike downstairs and took off her helmet; her bangs were damp with sweat, but her face was a smile she couldn’t contain.
location: From Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, via Wenyuan Road and Hubin Erli, to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home to share the good news and receiving congratulations from family and friends
description: Yajing parked her scooter and bounded up the stairs two steps at a time. The first thing she did after getting home was sit on the low stool in the entryway and take a selfie: helmet on, making a peace sign, her cheeks flushed with excitement. She sent the photo to the family and friends group with the caption: “At 38, I learned a new skill with zero crashes! Thanks to Coach Chen for the technical guidance and to my family for the moral support ~” The group instantly went crazy. Her father back home in Quanzhou immediately made a video call and said with a laugh, “My daughter has guts!” Her older sister in faraway Shenzhen also left a teasing message: “Next time I come back, you can take me for a ride along the seaside!”
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and warm time
description: After finishing the phone call with Dad, the aroma of food came from the kitchen. A Qiang had already come home from work; tonight he specially made a few extra dishes: steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and Xuanxuan’s favorite cola chicken wings—a small celebration. The family of three sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan kept asking her mother to tell the story of cycling home, Yajing described what she saw along the way with animated gestures, while A Qiang sat beside them listening with a smile, his eyes full of pride.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband's 'safety add-on'
description: After dinner, Aqiang mysteriously pulled a roll of yellow reflective stickers out of his bag and said he was going downstairs to stick them on the scooter. Yajing followed behind holding Xuanxuan, watching her husband squat in front of the scooter, carefully measuring, cutting, and pasting. His focused profile warmed her heart. She quietly took out her phone, photographed the scene, and sent it to the family group chat with the caption: "My personal safety consultant is now online." The group burst into laughter again.
location: Downstairs of the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child reading and putting the kids to bed
description: After going upstairs, Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a bath and changed her into her favorite cartoon pajamas. Tonight, she chose Xuanxuan's favorite picture book, "Duck on a Bike," and told the adventurous story of a duck riding a bicycle in a relaxed and exaggerated tone, making Xuanxuan giggle. When the story ended, Xuanxuan kissed her mother and said, "Mommy is also a brave duck!" Yajing felt warm and sweet inside. She turned off the light and gently patted Xuanxuan to sleep.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal care and accumulated sense of achievement.
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Yajing returned to the master bedroom, removed her makeup, and took a comfortable hot shower. While applying a hydrating mask, she did a set of leg stretches on the yoga mat to relieve the tension from cycling. Then she sat at the desk, opened her diary, and recorded the challenges and gains of the day. Finally, she wrote neatly: 'July 26, 2025, sunny. I did it. From today on, I feel like I am not afraid of anything anymore.'
location: Master bathroom and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime chat and a good night's sleep
description: At 21:45, A Qiang also finished washing up, and the two leaned against the headboard. Yajing rested her head on his shoulder, talking about the gains from today's follow-up visits at the store, the praise in her father's phone call, and Xuanxuan's phrase “brave duck.” A Qiang, like an engineer, began analyzing today's cycling route with her and suggested that next time they could try another route with more beautiful scenery. The night was quiet, and as they talked, their voices gradually faded. In great satisfaction and happiness, they fell asleep in each other's arms.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations and family greetings.
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, weighed 49.1 kg, then went to the balcony to water the mint and rosemary. Hearing her parents talking softly in the kitchen, she felt a deep sense of peace and warmth.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family breakfast.
description: Mother has prepared white congee, pork floss, preserved radish omelet, and chiffon cake. The family sits around the table; the daughter excitedly shows off a small flower wreath; the father and son-in-law chat about the news; the mother hums a Hokkien nursery rhyme. They enjoy breakfast in the relaxed Sunday atmosphere.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Get ready to go out and walk to the church
description: Helped her daughter put on a floral dress and a flower crown. On the way out, they met neighbor Aunt Zhang downstairs, shared the good news about riding the scooter last night, and received praise. Then the whole family walked to Siming Catholic Church. Their daughter bounced along ahead, the parents chatted side by side, she walked arm in arm with her husband, and sunlight cast dappled shadows through the trees.
location: Walk from No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Sunday Mass and fellowship with fellow parishioners
description: Attended Mass celebrated by Father Wang Mingde. The homily theme was "discovering the presence of the Holy Spirit in ordinary daily life." While praying alone, she sincerely prayed for her parents, husband, daughter, and the store's operations. After receiving Communion, she felt especially peaceful. After Mass, she chatted with Auntie Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner. Auntie asked how her parents were adjusting to Xiamen and shared summer heat-relief dietary suggestions. She also happily shared yesterday's scooter progress and was praised as "really amazing."
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked home to shop, rest, and tidy up.
description: After Mass, the whole family walked home. On the way, they turned into the Lakeside Food Market, where her parents picked out live shrimp and small yellow croaker to make soy-sauce-braised mixed fish. Once home, she played with her daughter in the living room while sorting through last week's event photos on her phone, deleting the blurry ones and picking out a few to post on Moments later.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and afternoon leisure
description: Lunch was the assorted fish in soy sauce made by her father, and her mother's stir-fried seasonal vegetables and tomato scrambled eggs. She showed her father a scooter selfie, and he gave a thumbs-up in praise. After lunch, they chatted in the living room. She used a photo retouching app to adjust the colors of her daughter's birthday photos and wrote a draft caption: “Happy sixth birthday, my little princess! And Mom's new skill breakthrough at 38...” Then she set some photos to private as a diary backup.
location: Dining area and living room at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time at the park and scooter practice
description: While the family napped, I walked with my daughter to Jiaxing Garden Park. She ran on the grass while I practiced scooter turns on the flat path, trying to turn smoothly before the leaf piles. Though there was a slight wobble, I was more composed than yesterday and felt much more confident.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child baking: light mango cheesecake
description: After returning home from the park, she invited her mother to try the mango light cheesecake recipe together. Her daughter helped wash the mangoes and pass the tools, her mother guided her in whipping the cream cheese, and after preheating the oven, they poured the batter into the mold, full of anticipation for the finished cake.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Enjoying the results of baking and family dinner
description: When the cake came out of the oven, the whole house was filled with its fragrance. She cut a slice for her father to taste, and he praised its delicate texture. She also showed her father the cycling photos and was told that her hairstyle looked pretty cool. Then came dinner: they ate the leftover assorted fish and vegetables from lunch, with the cake as dessert. While eating, they discussed the online warm-up plan for the store's craft workshop. Her husband took the initiative to clear the dishes.
location: Living room and dining room of the home at the No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family video call
description: After dinner, the whole family watched TV. She made a video call to her aunt in Quanzhou, handed the phone to her parents so they could chat, and sat by smiling while listening, also replying to several customers’ inquiries about new products.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime routine.
description: After the video call ended, she bathed her daughter and then read the picture book Duck on a Bike, telling the story in a lively voice. Her daughter asked curious questions from time to time, and after the story finished, she fell asleep sweetly.
location: Home bathroom and daughter's bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening self-care and reflection
description: After settling her daughter down, she took a hot shower, applied a hydrating mask, and did simple stretches to relieve fatigue. Then she opened her diary and recorded the day's little blessings: the peace of Mass, the lively energy of the market, progress on the scooter, and the sweetness of the family-bonding cake.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night chat between spouses and relaxing before sleep.
description: Lying in bed with her husband for a late-night chat, discussing next week's store work arrangements and the details of the handmade workshop warm-up, and planning a family outing for the coming weekend. After the chat, she scrolled through her phone looking at summer outfits and baking recipes, replied to regular customers' messages, turned off the light when she felt sleepy, and fell asleep peacefully amid the steady breathing of her family.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, master bedroom

name: Morning brisk walk exercise.
description: After the 6:15 alarm went off, Song Yajing changed into workout clothes and running shoes, set out from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, and walked about 10 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road. She briskly walked three laps around the lake in the park, completing her 3-kilometer check-in. The morning breeze carried the scent of grass and trees, cicadas sang in bursts, and the scale showed 49.1kg. She felt satisfied with her persistence.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home, wash up, and prepare breakfast.
description: At 6:45, Song Yajing walked home, took a 5-minute warm shower, and felt refreshed. Then in the kitchen, she sliced and steamed the Poria cake her parents had brought from Quanzhou yesterday, boiled three eggs, warmed two glasses of milk, and prepared breakfast for herself and her daughter. Without her parents' lively presence, the house was quieter, but it had a calm that belonged to her.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: At 7:00, Song Yajing gently woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and tied her hair into a ponytail. She quickly finished her breakfast and grabbed the shop keys. At 7:15, she set off with her daughter on a scooter and arrived at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten 5 minutes later. Along the way, Lexuan chattered about the games she played with her grandmother yesterday. At the school gate, Song Yajing kissed her cheek and watched her skip into the kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chatting with neighbor Auntie Zhang.
description: After cycling back from the kindergarten to the residential community, she met Auntie Zhang Xiuying downstairs, who was just about to go buy groceries. Auntie Zhang asked whether Song Yajing's parents had a smooth trip back to Quanzhou yesterday. Song Yajing parked the bike, and the two chatted beside the flower bed for about ten minutes. She said her parents were doing fine, though the house felt a little quiet. Auntie Zhang smiled and comforted her, 'With a child around, how could it be quiet?'
location: Downstairs in the residential compound, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go to the Eighth Market to purchase supplies and arrive at the store.
description: Song Yajing went home, changed out of her sports shoes, picked up her canvas bag, and rode her bicycle along Zhenhai Road, turning onto Siming North Road, arriving at the Eighth Market around 8:00. She went straight to her familiar vegetable stall, picked two bunches of fresh mint leaves, and bought three fresh lemons, a small basket of longan, and a few mangosteens, to restock the mint tea for the shop and let the staff have a taste. After bargaining with the stall owner, she cycled for 5 minutes via Kaihe Road and Datong Road to the entrance of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, then walked to Store No. 36.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arrive at the store and prepare for business
description: Arrived at the shop at 8:30; shop assistant Xiao Mei had already opened the door and was cleaning. Song Yajing first went to the back kitchen to wash mint leaves, made a large pot of iced mint lemon water and placed it in a prominent spot at the front counter, then shared longan and mangosteen with Xiao Mei and the younger girl at the neighboring milk tea shop. She sat down and opened her phone, ready to reply to messages she had missed last night.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Reply to my best friend's thank-you message
description: Song Yajing read a long thank-you message from her best friend Li Meiling, and her eyes felt slightly hot. She quickly typed a reply: 'Oh my, so formal I almost thought you were going to confess! Friends are meant to be troubled. When I first opened the shop, you also helped me hand out flyers until midnight, so we're even~ Next time you need someone to accompany you for a prenatal checkup, just say the word—your big sister will always be there for you!' Then she took a screenshot, sent it to their three-person close friends group, and attached an animated sticker that said 'May our friendship last forever.'
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Mind the store, receive customers, and organize the shelves
description: After 9:30, several customers came into the shop one after another. Song Yajing enthusiastically recommended two floral print dresses and successfully closed a sale. During a lull, she and Xiaomei refolded the remaining winter sample garments from last week and prepared to put them into the storeroom, chatting about the popular "linen-style" look as they tidied up. The morning's business went on amid busy work and conversation.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch time
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei did not order takeout. They simply cooked two bowls of tomato and egg noodles in the shop. As they ate, Xiaomei shared food short videos from her phone, and Song Yajing teasingly asked her whether she was planning to switch careers to become a food blogger. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Take a lunch break and browse fashion news.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing leaned back in the rattan chair in the store, opened her phone, and browsed the fall new arrival previews and styling suggestions from the designer bloggers she follows. Noticing that the 'old money' element was becoming popular again, she planned to order a batch of versatile linen shirts next month and saved several original design stores.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Discussed herbal tea options with the shop assistant.
description: In the afternoon, there were fewer customers. Song Yajing took out her tablet, and Xiaomei excitedly showed her a five-star review on Dianping that praised the quality of the clothes in the shop and the refreshing sweetness of the mint tea. Song Yajing took the opportunity to show Xiaomei the herbal tea recipe she had thought of at noon. The two discussed it with great interest and decided to make Lemon Mint Iced Tea the initial signature drink, and switch to Peach Oolong next week so customers would find something fresh when they visited. Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to prepare a list of material costs before Friday.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Continue minding the shop and managing the online community
description: In the afternoon, regular customers kept asking about new arrivals on WeChat. Song Yajing replied to several VIP customers' private messages and recommended a matching style for a regular customer who wanted to buy a laid-back long dress. Around 17:00, she shared a beautiful sunset photo of the store entrance in the customer group and left a message welcoming everyone to come by and check in.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 17:00, Song Yajing handed over the shop to Xiaomei on time and rode her scooter to pick up her daughter from kindergarten. At 17:10, she arrived at the kindergarten gate. The moment she saw her, Yuexuan ran over and threw herself into her arms, clamoring for doughnuts from the cake shop next door. Song Yajing promised to buy them after picking up Grandma, and first took her back to the shop.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening peak business hours
description: Song Yajing brought her daughter back to the shop and let her eat small snacks and draw in the corner. After 17:30, Zhongshan Road began to get lively. Song Yajing and Xiaomei worked in perfect coordination, with Xiaomei mainly handling reception while she handled the cash register and answered questions. Yuexuan was very well-behaved, occasionally making heart gestures at customers, which charmed several young women and indirectly helped close a sale.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Husband came to the store to install the bicycle bell.
description: At 19:30, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came straight to the store after work, holding a clip-on reflective bell. He had heard Song Yajing say a few days earlier that she wanted to install a bell, so on his way home from work he deliberately went to a hardware store to pick one out. At the store entrance, he squatted down and installed the bell on the handlebar of Song Yajing's newly bought kick scooter, and also tightened a bracket she had bought online. Song Yajing stood by, feeling warm inside.
location: Outside the store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A family of three had dinner together.
description: Chen Zhiqiang helped watch the store for over ten minutes while Song Yajing took her daughter to the noodle shop in the next alley, ordered two bowls of satay noodles and one small bowl of beef noodles, and packed them up to bring back to the store. The family of three squeezed around the small tea table, with Lexuan eating with sauce all over her mouth. Song Yajing took a warm photo and sent it to the family group: "Today's cozy dinner."
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Closing inventory
description: As customer traffic gradually dwindled, Song Yajing and Xiaomei settled the day's revenue together, checking the WeChat and Alipay transaction records. Today's sales were good. At 21:15, they locked the glass door and pulled down the roller shutter. Xiaomei took the bus home by herself, while Song Yajing and her husband and daughter got ready to go home.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Returned home and took care of daughter's bedtime
description: At 21:30, Chen Zhiqiang rode an electric bike with Yuexuan on it, while Song Yajing followed on her scooter, which had a newly installed bell. The family of three slowly made their way back to their home on Shanggu Street. Along the way, the ringing of the bell made the night breeze feel light and pleasant. After arriving home, Song Yajing helped Yuexuan take a bath, changed her into pajamas, and told two stories. The daughter soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal grooming and online shopping
description: After Song Yajing and her husband finished washing up, she leaned against the headboard, opened a shopping app, and compared several waterproof and shockproof phone mounts and foldable bike baskets. She finally ordered a highly rated product. After placing the order, she took a screenshot and sent it to her husband, teasing, “Bro, you installed your bike bell nicely, and my accessories are in place too! We can arrange delivery tomorrow.” Her husband replied with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's bedtime conversation
description: Before 23:00, Song Yajing turned off the lights and lay down, with the faint sound of traffic drifting in from outside the window. She whispered to her husband that Li Meiling had sent her a message today to thank her, and she was quite moved. Then she asked if he was tired from working overtime. Her husband said it was okay, he had just taken care of a bug on the spot. Song Yajing squeezed his hand and thanked him for the particularly useful bicycle bell he had bought specially that day. The two fell into a deep, warm sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and package pickup
description: At 6:30 a.m., Song Yajing woke up naturally with the morning light outside her window, feeling energetic. She changed into workout clothes and walked about 15 minutes from home to the Railway Culture Park, where she completed a 3-kilometer brisk walk on the greenway. With a gentle breeze on her face, she felt refreshed. After exercising, she stopped by the nearby Jizheng Chain Supermarket's Zhenhai branch and picked up the packages she had ordered online last night: a waterproof phone mount for her scooter and a canvas basket. Feeling delighted, she returned home with a brisk step.
location: Railway Culture Park, 439 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jizheng Chain Supermarket (Zhenhai Branch), 76 Zhenhai Road

name: Family morning time
description: After returning home, Song Yajing first took a shower, feeling fresh and comfortable, then woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and braided her little pigtails. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared breakfast, with plain rice porridge, fried eggs, and homemade pork floss. The family of three sat around the table. Xuanxuan shared that there was a handicraft class in kindergarten today, and Yajing encouraged her to do well. After the meal, Yajing cut a few chamomile stems in full bloom from the balcony, wrapped their roots in a damp tissue, and planned to bring them to the store to add a touch of life.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: At 7:50, she left on time. Song Yajing held Xuanxuan's little hand and walked about 5 minutes to take her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, she briefly exchanged a few words with the teacher about her child's recent situation, watched Xuanxuan skip into the classroom, then turned and started a new busy day.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning commute and market shopping
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing decided to go to the Eighth Market to shop first. She walked about 18 minutes to the bustling Eighth Market, skillfully picked out fresh green mint leaves and local lemons at her familiar stall, and also bought some mangosteen and longan, planning to bring them back to the shop for tea and as afternoon fruit. After shopping, carrying her full haul, she walked about 15 minutes to the shop.
location: Eighth Market (Bashi), No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning tidying and decorating of the shop
description: Arrived at the shop at 8:45; the shop assistant Xiaomei was already cleaning. The two divided the work: Xiaomei mopped the floor and wiped the shelves, while Yajing washed the mint and lemons, brewed a large pot of iced mint lemon water, and added a spoonful of honey as the shop's signature complimentary drink of the day. Then she took out the chamomile she had brought, trimmed it carefully, and tied it into two bundles with thin twine. She hung one on the wrist of the mannequin in the window and put the other in a small vase by the cash register. This touch of fresh natural style instantly made the whole shop feel lively.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store photography and community interaction.
description: After finishing the decoration, Song Yajing stepped back a few steps to adjust the lighting and took several close-up photos of the window display and the store from different angles with her phone. She chose the photo with the most beautiful light and shadow and posted it to the store's VIP customer group and Moments with the caption, “A little summer joy—the chamomile from the balcony came to visit the store~ Outfit styled~!” It quickly earned several likes and comments like “So beautiful” and “I want to come check it in,” and the good mood for the new day spread from there.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and rest
description: At lunchtime, Song Yajing and Xiaomei ordered takeout from a nearby light salad place they often ate at; it was refreshing and healthy. While eating, she sent a voice message to her husband Aqiang, telling him she wanted to go for a bike ride in the evening and asking him to pick up Xuanxuan. Aqiang readily agreed, and Yajing felt much more relaxed.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store operations and supplier coordination.
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic at the store was steady. Song Yajing received several waves of customers trying on clothes while also contacting Zheng Kai, a supplier from Hangzhou, on WeChat. The two had a detailed discussion about the ordering fair in mid-August: confirming the specific dates as August 13 to 14, the venue at Hangzhou International Expo Center, and the list of exhibitors. Zheng Kai suggested that the two of them could stay at the same hotel to make it convenient to exchange ideas on selecting styles at night. Yajing agreed and made a note on her phone calendar. She mentally calculated that if time allowed, after placing orders she might take the chance to visit her college roommate Zhou Ting in Shaoxing.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and online event planning
description: After finishing the business discussion, Song Yajing continued working. She sorted out the afternoon's online orders and replied to several customers' inquiries about sizes and styling. Then she opened the community group and began planning the August "Late-Summer Color Outfits" online interactive activity, coming up with a few prompts to encourage customers to share. Xiaomei, the shop assistant, was ironing a new batch of summer clothes nearby, while soft jazz played in the store. The whole afternoon had a relaxed yet organized atmosphere.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing preparations and confirming family plans
description: Toward evening, when there were fewer customers, Song Yajing began making preparations for closing. She and Xiaomei tidied up the fitting room and counted the change needed for tomorrow. At the same time, she sent another WeChat message to her husband Aqiang to confirm: “Honey, please pick up Xuanxuan straight after work. I want to ride to Egret Isle Park this evening for a quick visit before coming home for dinner~” Aqiang quickly replied, “Okay, be safe on the road. I’ll wait for you to come back for dinner.”
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening leisure scooter ride and going home
description: At 18:00, she closed the shop on time. Song Yajing changed into sports shoes, put on her helmet and knee pads, and rode her beloved electric scooter slowly along Hubin South Road to Egret Island Park. The sun had just set, and the sky was filled with brilliant sunset clouds; a gentle summer breeze blew. She glided easily along the lakeside path in the park, enjoying the twilight view of the lake, occasionally getting off to walk the scooter and watching the people dancing in the square and the children playing. The one-hour ride gave her a long-missed feeling of freedom and joy. At 19:00, she returned home satisfied, heading back along Hubin South Road and arriving about 15 minutes later. She felt a light sweat and was refreshed in both body and mind.
location: Bailuzhou Park on Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family evening time.
description: As soon as she entered the house, Xuanxuan rushed over and shouted, “Mommy’s home!” Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared dinner in the kitchen: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised fish, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of three had a cozy dinner together. After dinner, Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and then read two picture books with her. Meanwhile, Aqiang installed the newly bought phone holder and basket onto her scooter. The family was filled with joy and harmony.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and bedtime interaction
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Song Yajing also went to wash up and did half an hour of pre-sleep stretching. Lying in bed, she showed her husband Aqiang photos of the newly assembled scooter. Aqiang laughed at her, saying she was 'like a teenager after school'. After a few casual exchanges, Yajing looked back on this fulfilling day full of small blessings and got ready to sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to bed and rest
description: After chatting with her husband for a few moments, Song Yajing set her alarm for 23:10, turned off the light, and went to bed. In her dream, she rode a scooter along streets blooming with phoenix flowers, moving forward all the way.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning exercise and family interaction.
description: I was woken by my phone alarm at 6:30 a.m. While washing up, I noticed dark circles under my eyes, but I was in good spirits. I changed into cotton-linen sportswear and applied medicated oil to my knees and ankles. Then my father and I set out from the east gate of the compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street and walked briskly along Zhenhai Road toward Bailuzhou Park. As we walked, we talked about savings plans. My father told stories of setting up a stall when he was young to save money for a house, and I shared my plan to divide our savings into shop reinvestment, family emergency funds, and my parents' pension. My father patted the back of my hand and reminded me to take good care of my health. After arriving at Bailuzhou Park, we did stretching exercises in front of the Egret Goddess sculpture. During this time I received preview images of the new autumn clothing samples from Susan, our Guangzhou supplier, and replied by voice message that I would confirm the order after arriving at the shop.
location: From the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Bailuzhou Park (Bailuzhou Road, Siming District)

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: After morning exercise, I went home and took a hot shower, then changed into loungewear. My mother had prepared sweet potato porridge, fried eggs, and soy-sauce meat. Seeing my husband Chen Zhiqiang clumsily tying our daughter's hair, I took over and gave her two buns. The family sat around having breakfast, and my mother mentioned that my father was going back to Quanzhou tomorrow, planning to have him accompany her to the Eighth Market to buy dried goods to take back to their hometown. The breakfast atmosphere was warm. Afterwards, at eight o'clock, I took my daughter Chen Lexuan out and walked along Gongyuan South Road to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she excitedly told me that she had been praised for making a little rabbit out of modeling clay. At the kindergarten gate, I briefly exchanged a few words with the head teacher, Teacher Zhang, about my daughter's performance.
location: The community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road)

name: Market shopping and walking to the store
description: After dropping off her daughter, she went to the Eighth Market, bought fresh mangosteen (20 yuan) and longan (15 yuan) at Granny's stall, planning to have her parents bring them back to Quanzhou, and also ate fish balls while she was there. Then she walked through Yingping Road toward Zhongshan Road, bought hot soy milk on the way, and ran into Sister Wang, a regular customer, who asked whether the French shirts had arrived. She replied that they would arrive next week and she would set one aside for her. She reached the store before 8:35.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, from the Eighth Market (No. 44 Kaihe Road) to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: Arrived at Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, raised the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioning and lights, and trimmed the withered asparagus fern at the entrance. At 8:50, shop assistant Xiao Mei arrived. The two wiped the shelves, organized the try-on clothes, checked the day's to-do list, and instructed Xiao Mei to go to the warehouse to get blank canvas tote bags in preparation for tomorrow's event.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Event wrap-up and new product preview.
description: Starting at nine o'clock, she handled the wrap-up work for the last parent-child afternoon tea event of July at the checkout counter using her laptop and phone, checking off the list of 12 mothers who had confirmed attendance last Saturday. Then she designed the poster for the August 'Little Designer' event, posted it in the VIP group and on Moments, with the caption: "The last month of summer vacation, bring your little one to the shop to be the cutest designer!" Within half an hour, she received private messages from three mothers reserving seats.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Morning Business and Customer Interaction
description: From ten to noon, the shop had a steady stream of customers. I helped a young woman who had just graduated put together a floral dress with a beige knit cardigan, and she happily bought it; Xiao Mei skillfully helped regular customers find their sizes. In between, I replied to logistics inquiries about online orders and sent discount coupons to out-of-town customers. After 11:30, the flow of customers eased. While scrolling through WeChat Moments, I saw a birthday cake photo posted by regular customer Vivian, left a blessing comment, and sent a private message saying I would give her a French-style shirt as a birthday gift. She happily agreed to come to the store on the weekend.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Lunch with shop assistant Xiaomei.
description: At noon, with few customers in the shop, she and Xiaomei took turns going to Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop at No. 78 Zhenbang Road for lunch. She ordered satay noodles with squid and tofu, while Xiaomei ordered misua. While waiting for the food, she reminded Xiaomei that next week the shop's free tea drink would be changed from red dragon fruit tea to peach oolong, and asked her to prepare the cost list for the peach oolong for review in the afternoon. Xiaomei nodded and said she had already organized it.
location: No. 78 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop, Zhongshan Road Branch)

name: Afternoon business and event preparation.
description: At 12:50 p.m., she returned to the store, and customer traffic gradually increased. While receiving customers, she used the computer to compile the list of craft materials needed for the August 'Little Designer' event: 50 blank canvas tote bags, about 400 yuan; 5 sets of children's safety scissors, about 100 yuan; 10 tubes of fabric paint, about 150 yuan; and so on. The total estimated cost was about 800 yuan, and she planned to send it to a friend in the wholesale business to ask for quotes. Meanwhile, Vivian replied on WeChat to thank her for the gift. After two in the afternoon, she used the store's ice and mint leaves to make iced lemonade. Xiaomei brought out the printed peach oolong cost list. After checking it: tea bags cost 98 yuan per box, flavorings about 20 yuan, plus consumables, so the cost per cup was about 2.5 yuan. The price was reasonable, so she signed off and asked Xiaomei to go to the Eighth Market next Monday to purchase supplies.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Closing preparations and daily revenue reconciliation
description: After 3:30 in the afternoon, customer traffic gradually decreased, and she started closing preparations. She checked the real-time afternoon sales records; Alipay and WeChat together received 1,260 yuan, which matched the cash register system. She noted the styles that needed to be restocked tomorrow and sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, telling him that she would be doing accounts late into the night and asking him to pick up their daughter and handle his own dinner. Her husband replied, "You've worked hard." Then they cleaned up: Xiaomei mopped the floor, and I tidied the fitting room and put the hangers back. At 5:10, she let Xiaomei leave early, pulled the rolling shutter door halfway down, and prepared for the evening accounting.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Dinner alone and a brief moment to empty the mind.
description: At 5:20, she ordered a takeout of Zhangzhou braised noodles (19 yuan) with fried vinegar pork using her phone. While waiting for the food, she scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saw a blogger sharing autumn outfit trends featuring earth tones and velvet textures. She immediately forwarded it to her supplier Susan to ask about autumn clothing styles. When the braised noodles arrived, she ate while thinking about the accounts she needed to reconcile next.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Monthly revenue calculation and fund allocation.
description: At six in the evening, after cleaning up and putting on my glasses, I sat at the cash register and opened the bookkeeping software and online payment platform on my laptop. It took nearly two hours to check the July sales revenue entry by entry: 58 online orders, 262 offline payments, and 4 refunds/exchanges totaling 350 yuan. I confirmed that July's total revenue was about 148,000 yuan, up 15% from June. I allocated the net profit as planned: transferred 3,200 yuan to the family emergency reserve fund, reserved 6,000 yuan for next quarter's goods payments, and set up a separate 5,000 yuan pending transfer for Xuanxuan's fall 2025 tuition. After all the figures were clarified, I took a screenshot, sent it to the family WeChat group, and captioned it: “July accounting is done, revenue up 15%, tomorrow I'll start calculating August's accounts!”
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (cashier counter at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Shopping on the way home and arriving home
description: At 8 p.m., she locked the rolling shutter door, took out her electric scooter, and rode home along Zhongshan Road via Zhenhai Road. The night breeze carried dampness, and she saw a man walking his dog and talking to it. Around 8:20 she arrived at the entrance of her residential compound, then turned into the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought potato chips and oolong tea. She noticed the "August New Arrivals" poster at the entrance and took a photo of it to recommend to customers later. Then she entered the compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street. Pushing open the door, she saw her husband Chen Zhiqiang playing with their daughter, building a Lego castle on the carpet. She put down the fruit and snacks and saw that in the family group chat, her husband had already replied to the accounting message and sent a thumbs-up.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, 35-101 Zhenhai Road convenience store and the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Syncing family finances with husband
description: Just as I sat down on the sofa, my phone received a bank notification that 8,000 yuan had been credited, with the note 'Project bonus - transferred to joint account.' My husband Chen Zhiqiang said that last month's project delivery went well, so he had received a bonus and transferred it all to the joint account. I checked the bank balance, replied with a hug emoji in the WeChat group, and then sent a private message to thank my husband. He patted my shoulder and said, 'Our family nest egg keeps growing.'
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Playing with her daughter, bathing her, and putting her to sleep
description: At nine, I played house with my daughter Xuanxuan. She built a "clothing store" out of LEGO and pointed at the blocks, saying it was Mommy's shop. At 9:15, I took her to bathe, and we sang "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" in the bathroom. After the bath, she changed into rabbit-patterned pajamas and chose "Guess How Much I Love You" and "The Very Hungry Caterpillar." When we got to the part about the caterpillar turning into a butterfly, she asked if it was like the bow on Mommy's dress. I kissed her little face. At 9:40, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: In the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room, bathroom, daughter's room)

name: Help mother pack luggage and accept the recipe
description: After putting Xuanxuan to sleep, I went downstairs. Seeing the light on in my mother's room, I pushed the door open and helped her pack for her trip back to Quanzhou tomorrow. As she folded clothes, she took out a yellowed piece of notebook paper neatly written with three Minnan summer recipes for dispelling dampness: Poria cake, Four-Herb Lean Pork Soup, and Bitter Melon, Soybean, and Pork Rib Soup. She handed it to me and told me to keep making soup in autumn and order less takeout. Moved by the handwriting, I hugged her gently and helped pack her coat and charger into the suitcase.
location: Mother's room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up before bed and late-night talk between husband and wife
description: Back in the master bedroom, I washed up and applied skin care products, then got into bed and chatted with my husband Chen Zhiqiang. He shared that our daughter had made progress in drawing today; she drew a picture of daddy wearing glasses, and he found it adorable. I shared the store accounting results and the recipe my mother had given me. My husband suddenly suggested seriously that we take our daughter to Gulangyu by ferry this weekend. I agreed with a smile, since I happened to want to go to church too.
location: Master bedroom, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lights out and sleep
description: Aqiang reached out and turned off the light, and I whispered goodnight. As I closed my eyes, moments from the day flashed through my mind: my father's encouragement, my mother's reluctance to part, my daughter's sleeping face, and the solid numbers in my account. The scent of jasmine from the neighbor's house drifted in through the window. Thinking that tomorrow I would take my parents to the station and then go to the store to prepare the new season's display, life felt busy yet full of hope, and I soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: Yajing woke up naturally and gently roused her father. The two put on their sneakers, walked about 5 minutes to the Binzhong Safety Culture Demonstration Park in Siming District, and briskly walked 3 kilometers along the tree-lined path. Her father urged her to keep up the exercise. Then they walked home. Yajing took a quick shower, then went into the kitchen to boil water and started preparing her father's favorite Quanzhou misua soup for breakfast.
location: No. 82 Community on Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Binzhong Safety Culture Demonstration Park in Siming District.

name: Minnan-style family breakfast
description: The family of five sat around the dining table, enjoying the Quanzhou misua soup cooked by Yajing and freshly fried dough sticks. Little Xuanxuan was reluctant to let her grandparents leave, and her mother smiled and reassured her. The atmosphere was warm with a touch of parting sadness.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helping mother pack her luggage and passing down family recipes.
description: After breakfast, Yajing and her mother packed their luggage in the guest bedroom, sorting clothes, local specialties, and blood pressure medication into separate bags. While her mother wasn't looking, she secretly slipped red envelopes and thank-you cards into the lining of two bags. Before leaving, her mother took her to the kitchen and solemnly brought out a yellowed handwritten recipe book, teaching her the secrets of Poria cake and Ginger Duck, emphasizing that the rice milk must be strained three times to be smooth and tender. Yajing was deeply moved and hugged her mother tightly.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Carefully prepared a farewell lunch
description: After inheriting the recipe, Yajing put on an apron and, under her mother's guidance, started preparing the farewell lunch. She first simmered a clay-pot bitter melon pork rib soup, then prepared the ingredients for the oyster omelet her father had specifically requested. Her mother stood by, smiling and pointing out cooking tips. Yajing completed the blanched shrimp and stir-fried seasonal vegetables on her own, and a hearty Minnan-flavored lunch was ready.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family farewell lunch
description: The family sat together for a farewell lunch. Yajing opened a bottle of red wine her father had collected. After tasting the oyster omelet she made, her father couldn't stop praising it, which made her mother pretend to be angry, and little Xuanxuan giggled along. At the table, they finalized the plan to go back to Quanzhou for a week during the National Day holiday, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and preparation for departure
description: After the meal, Yajing quickly cleared the dishes. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the underground garage to get the car, while Yajing helped her parents with a final check, reminding them to bring their phones, ID documents, and umbrella. The sky outside was getting overcast, and she silently prayed that it wouldn't pour while seeing them off at the station.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take parents to Xiamen Station
description: At 13:20, Yajing's family of five set off. Chen Zhiqiang drove along Zhenhai Road, Lujiang Avenue, and Xiahe Road and reached Xiamen Station in about 10 minutes. A light drizzle began to fall. Xuanxuan hugged her grandmother's legs with red-rimmed eyes, and her grandfather crouched down to comfort her. Yajing hugged her parents goodbye and, through the rain, watched them swipe their ID cards and walk through the ticket gates until their figures disappeared.
location: No. 900 Xiahe Road, Wucun Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Xiamen Station)

name: Returning home in the rain
description: On the way back, the car was a bit quiet; Xuanxuan fell asleep in the back seat. Yajing looked out the window at the street scenes brightened by the rain, feeling a little empty inside, but she also understood this was a necessary part of growing up. They arrived home around 15:00.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidying up the house and having quiet time.
description: After returning home, the rain grew heavier. Yajing asked her husband to put their daughter down for a nap, then she removed and washed the guest room sheets and quilt covers that her parents had used, choosing a laundry detergent that smelled like sunshine. Afterward, she moved the snake plant from the balcony to the guest room windowsill, hoping it would purify the air and keep a trace of familiarity.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Draft the August to-do list.
description: Amid the sound of rain, Yajing made a cup of tea in her study, took out a new notebook, and carefully wrote down her August plan: including the first parent-child handicraft workshop event, confirming the itinerary for the Hangzhou ordering fair, scheduling a full-family medical check-up after National Day, and negotiating the lease renewal with the landlord. After writing, she looked at the streaks of rain outside the window and felt extraordinarily calm.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ride a scooter to the shop to pick up the documents
description: After the rain stopped, the air was fresh. Yajing put on a waterproof jacket and rode her electric scooter about 2 kilometers along Zhenhai Road, Siming South Road, and Zhongshan Road to Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She spoke briefly with the shop clerk Xiao Mei, reminding her to change to peach oolong tea the next day, then found the forgotten folder with the August event materials checklist at the cash register. Before leaving, she stood at the store entrance and took a photo of her scooter with the store's lit neon sign to send to her husband.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Rode home slowly and bought braised food on the way.
description: After leaving the shop, Yajing rode her kick scooter slowly home, taking in the moist air after the rain and the evening breeze. Passing a braised food shop, she bought some duck necks and lotus root slices, planning to enjoy them with her husband in the evening.
location: Braised food shop near Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the way home

name: Simple family dinner
description: Husband Aqiang had reheated the leftover bitter melon pork rib soup from lunch and stir-fried some greens. The family of three ate a simple dinner, with Xuanxuan chattering about the local specialties that her maternal grandparents had promised to bring. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time: playing with daughter and washing up
description: After dinner, Yajing played LEGO castle building with Xuanxuan on the living room mat and read two of her favorite picture books. Then she helped her take a bath and blow-dry her hair. Mother and daughter lay on the bed playing a quiet finger game, and Xuanxuan soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening skincare and mood journaling
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing returned to the master bedroom, did her evening skincare routine carefully, and poured herself a glass of warm water. She opened her phone's photo album, sorted through today's recipe photos and the group photos with her parents, and posted a mood note visible only to herself, thanking her parents for their company and love.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bed preparation and couple chat
description: Yajing changed into her pajamas, and her husband was already leaning against the headboard reading. They talked about the day's events, and she shared the little secret of slipping red envelopes to her parents. Aqiang teased her, saying she was "still so full of ideas." The sound of light rain outside the window started again. She leaned on her husband's shoulder, said "This is nice," then turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk of 3 km.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing woke naturally, washed up briefly, changed into sportswear, and walked about 5 minutes to Binzhong Safety Culture Demonstration Park on Hubin South Road. She completed a 3-kilometer brisk walk at a steady pace, with a pace of about 8 minutes per kilometer, and recorded the data on her mobile app. The road was lined with lush greenery; breathing in the fresh air, her mood brightened with the arrival of the new month.
location: Binzhong Safety Culture Demonstration Park, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping on the way and scooter inspection
description: After the brisk walk, Song Yajing walked to the Eighth Market on the way. She first bought 10 free-range eggs at an egg stall she often went to, and then bought a block of unsalted butter at a dried goods store. On the way home, she specifically checked the new electric scooter her husband Chen Zhiqiang had installed yesterday downstairs in the residential community. After confirming the battery was sufficient and the brakes were responsive, she locked the scooter and went upstairs.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the downstairs area of the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Handling family finances, breakfast, and repotting the vanilla plant.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing first opened mobile banking and transferred the August family insurance reserve (about 3,200 yuan) from the current account to a dedicated family protection savings card. Next, using the fresh free-range eggs and milk she had just bought, she made fried egg toast for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, and cut up mango as a side. While the family was eating breakfast, she went to the balcony, carefully divided the overgrown basil and mint into 3 small terracotta pots, and used markers to write care cards for each pot (name, sunlight preference, watering frequency), planning to take them to the store to give to regular customers.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting by scooter and preparing to open the store.
description: Carrying the herbs she had split into pots and shouldering her commuter bag, Song Yajing set off from home on an electric scooter for the first time at 8:40 a.m. She rode along the small streets and lanes of Hubin South Road–Zhenhai Road–Zhongshan Road, covering about 3.5 kilometers in 15 minutes and nimbly avoiding the morning rush hour. A gentle breeze brushed her face, and she felt a sense of novelty and ease. She arrived at the store before 9:00, skillfully unlocked the door, raised the rolling shutter, turned on the lights, started the cash register system, and placed the three pots of herbs on the plant shelf at the entrance.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shop operations and month-end inventory count
description: After opening the store, Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei started the month-end comprehensive inventory count together. They divided the work: Yajing was responsible for counting the summer dress and top inventory, checking the tags against the computer system data one by one; Xiaomei was responsible for the number of items in the accessories area (belts, bags, hats). During the inventory count, Yajing sorted out the old styles that needed to be taken off the shelves for the season change, and used her tablet to record her display adjustment ideas for the August ordering fair in Hangzhou (such as moving the slimming A-line skirts to the golden display rack near the entrance).
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After the noon rush, Song Yajing and Xiaomei went to the newly opened "Old Xiamen Home-Style Cuisine" restaurant on the street next to the shop for lunch. She ordered a bowl of satay noodles with pork liver and tofu, chatted with Xiaomei while eating, and instructed her about the online orders she'd need help organizing in the afternoon. After the meal, she returned to the store, sat on the rattan chair behind the cash register, rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes, and regained her energy.
location: Old Xiamen home-style cuisine in a side alley near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business hours and online service.
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing kept an eye on incoming customer traffic while using spare moments to handle online matters. She first replied to three outfit consultation questions in the VIP customer group, and privately sent a regular customer named Vivian, who had pre-ordered a new Chinese-style top, photos of the latest matching skirts in the same color palette. Then she opened WeChat, posted the morning-inventory photo of the soon-to-be-discontinued special offers to her Moments, and replied to three interested regular customers in the comments.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 16:30, Song Yajing instructed Xiaomei on the store closing tasks, having her take charge of final cashier reconciliation and turning off the lights and locking the door. She rode her electric scooter along Zhongshan Road–Gucheng West Road and arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten in about 10 minutes, just in time for dismissal. She picked up her daughter Chen Lexuan at the classroom door and walked out of the school gate holding her little hand.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Food Market Shopping and Going Home
description: On the way home, Song Yajing took Chen Lexuan to the Zhenhai Road farmer's market near the neighborhood. As planned, she bought mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, cake flour, and strawberries (for decoration) for baking that evening. Chen Lexuan looked around curiously, touching things here and there, and her mother took the chance to teach her the names of several vegetables. After shopping, the mother and daughter walked five minutes back home.
location: Zhenhai Road Farmers' Market in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Balcony herb harvest and parent-child baking
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing first changed into loungewear and took her daughter to the balcony. She taught her daughter how to carefully use scissors to cut fresh mint and rosemary sprigs, and her daughter helped rinse the picked leaves clean. Then mother and daughter tried making mint tiramisu and rosemary cookies for the first time together in the kitchen. Although the process was a bit hectic (for example, the mascarpone mixture in the tiramisu was slightly runny), her daughter had fun helping to sprinkle cocoa powder.
location: Kitchen and balcony of the home in the compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tasted the baked goods and shared them with family.
description: When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, the vanilla cookies had just come out of the oven, filling the room with fragrance. Song Yajing brought the baked rosemary cookies and the freshly chilled mint tiramisu to the table. Their daughter grabbed a cookie and said dramatically, "Mom is amazing!" Chen Zhiqiang tasted the tiramisu, gave a thumbs up, and said the mint flavor was refreshing, encouraging her to try making basil pesto pasta next time. The family ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family time and preparation for the next day
description: After finishing the snacks and cleaning up the kitchen, the family went to the living room. Chen Zhiqiang played with building blocks with his daughter, while Song Yajing sat on the sofa and sent a voice message via WeChat to her supplier Susan in Guangzhou, confirming the specific high-speed train schedule and arrival time for the trip to Guangzhou two days later (August 3), and asking which metro exit to take for the supplier's showroom. After that, she opened the notes app on her phone and jotted down the time for taking her daughter to art class the next day, as well as the need to pick up the weekend's floral materials from the flower shop.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and relaxation
description: At 21:10, after giving her daughter a bath and reading a bedtime story, Song Yajing put her to sleep and began her evening skincare routine. She removed her makeup, applied a hydrating mask, then took out her yoga mat and did a 15-minute full-body stretch and a 5-minute simple meditation in the bedroom to clear away the day's fatigue.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bed check and goodnight
description: After stretching, Song Yajing changed into her pajamas and lay down beside her husband. She softly talked with him about the fun experiences of today's scooter commute and baking, then picked up her phone to glance at the shop's daily revenue and confirmed that Xiaomei had sent a WeChat notice that the store was closed. She yawned and said to her husband, “Today was quite fulfilling. Good night.” Then she turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Brisk weekend morning walk.
description: On Saturday, after getting up half an hour later than usual, Song Yajing and her husband Aqiang changed into sportswear and walked about 7 minutes to the community park. The two walked briskly side by side for about 2.5 kilometers at a pace of 8 minutes per kilometer. The morning breeze brushed their faces and their steps were light. Aqiang praised her for keeping up the exercise over the past two days, saying her stamina had clearly improved. They talked about the mint tiramisu they had tried last night and the plan to use the balcony herbs to entertain their old customer Vivian today.
location: Binzhong Safety Culture Demonstration Park, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and a hearty family breakfast
description: After exercising, Song Yajing went home and took a hot shower, then immediately prepared a hearty breakfast. She fried golden toast, cut up mangoes, poured milk for her daughter Xuanxuan, and took out the thawed egg tart shells and homemade red bean filling from the refrigerator. She baked a tray of mini egg yolk pastries, fulfilling the promise she had made to her daughter the night before to make a nice breakfast the next morning. The whole family sat around the table, enjoying the leisurely weekend.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to activity class and commute by scooter
description: Song Yajing helped her daughter Xuanxuan change into a dress and took her to the "Little Scientists" interest class at Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After watching her daughter bounce into the classroom, she returned to the residential area, got on her electric scooter, put on her helmet, and started a podcast about "women's community operations." She rode along Zhenhai Road and South Siming Road toward Zhongshan Road, enjoying the ease of weaving freely through the streets.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian; Yajing Lifestyle Gallery, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Store opening preparations and morning cooking
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work with tacit coordination: she placed the three pots of basil and mint she had prepared the day before in a prominent spot on the cashier counter, with a small card reading "A gift for you who love life" beside them; then she washed the glass teapot and took out the chilled mint leaves to prepare for making tea in the morning. Xiaomei tidied the shelves and wiped the display counters.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning business operations and community warm-up.
description: After officially opening for business, Song Yajing sent a photo in the WeChat group showing morning light streaming into the store and shining on the potted herbs, with the caption: 'Good morning! The little spring from the balcony, I've brought it to the store~ There's a mint tea surprise for those who come in today!' This lightly kicked off the day's community interaction. At the same time, she privately messaged several regular customers with a preview of the potted plants and replied to a few online order inquiries.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Hosted regular customer Vivian and shared mint tea.
description: Vivian, a regular customer, arrived at the shop on time with two friends. Song Yajing warmly invited them to sit down, then skillfully boiled water and brewed tea, blending mint leaves with green tea in a transparent glass teapot and filling the room with fragrance. While serving tea, she shared amusing stories about creating a mini herb garden on the balcony. Vivian's friends were very interested in the shop's bohemian-style dresses, so she naturally guided them to try them on. Before they left, Song Yajing gave each of them a pot of basil and invited them to join the community.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Community balcony flower-sharing chain activity
description: Vivian's friends had just left, and one of them posted a photo of a basil pot in the group with the caption, "Thanks to the boss lady for the balcony spring—I'm going to make my balcony green too!" It instantly set the community abuzz. Group members responded one after another, posting photos of their own plants, and pictures kept pouring in. Song Yajing watched the group messages with a smile, liking posts and asking about plant care tips at the right moments, and the group quickly became a lively "online gardening expo".
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: At lunchtime, Song Yajing let Xiaomei take a rest first and watched the shop herself. She went to A Jie's satay noodle shop on the next street and ordered two bowls of their signature satay noodles to go, with pork intestines and tofu added. After Xiaomei finished eating, she enjoyed her own portion with peace of mind, accompanied by iced lemonade, browsing updates from fashion styling bloggers as she ate.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon business and online operations
description: After lunch, the flow of people gradually increased. Song Yajing and Xiaomei each served several groups of customers and successfully sold two new cotton-linen shirts. The "Balcony Spring" sign-up chain in the group was still going, so she posted a small activity — "Show off your plants and enter a lucky draw for the store's handmade vanilla cookies" — to push the excitement even higher. During a break, she stood behind the cash register and went through the purchase list in her phone notes again, the list she needed to confirm with supplier Susan in Guangzhou tomorrow.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Landlord Sister Li came to discuss expanding the store
description: In the afternoon, the landlady Sister Li walked into the shop with a friend, smiling. She first looked around and praised the improved display, then pointed to the closed rolling shutter door next door and gently asked Song Yajing whether she would be interested in combining the adjacent shop to expand, with a preferential rent. Song Yajing's heart skipped a beat, but she kept a polite smile on her face, poured them tea, and tactfully said that expanding the shop was a big decision and she needed to discuss it with her husband at home before replying. Seeing her sincerity, Sister Li said she understood and left.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle online orders and prepare for purchasing trip to Guangzhou
description: After seeing off Sister Li, Song Yajing composed herself and focused on handling online tasks: she packed up the accumulated online orders and contacted the usual courier to pick them up; then she opened her laptop, systematically organized the Guangzhou purchase memo, listed the styles, colors, and quantities to be confirmed the next day, and saved screenshots.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Picking up her daughter and having a family hot pot dinner
description: When the time was about right, Song Yajing rode her scooter to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, who had finished class. On the way, she called her husband Aqiang, and the family of three decided to have dinner at the newly opened 'Guoju' hot pot restaurant on Zhongshan Road. She ordered a double-flavor broth and her daughter's favorites, shrimp paste and fatty beef. Amid the lively dining atmosphere, she quietly mentioned to Aqiang that Sister Li had come by in the afternoon to ask about expanding the store, and the two agreed to discuss it in detail at home after closing.
location: Guoju Hotpot Restaurant, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening rush hour business and closing preparations
description: After finishing the hot pot, Song Yajing asked Aqiang to take their daughter home to bathe first, while she hurried back to the store.
