During the evening rush hour, Zhongshan Road was crowded with people, and several waves of customers poured into the store. Without stopping to rest, she and Xiaomei warmly received them, patiently helping customers try on and match outfits. Around 8 p.m., the crowds gradually thinned, and the two began closing preparations: counting the cash, checking sales receipts, and tidying the clothes that had been rummaged through.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Called on the way home after closing to decline expanding the shop.
description: After closing, Xiaomei got off work. Song Yajing locked the shop door and rode her scooter home. On the way, she called the landlord Sister Li. Following the plan she had discussed with her husband, she calmly and firmly declined the proposal to expand the shop, citing pressure on family finances. Sister Li said she understood and hung up politely. After hanging up, Song Yajing took a deep breath, feeling a weight lifted off her mind.
location: On the way from outside Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family Financial Review and Security Fund Plan
description: When she got home, her daughter was already asleep. Song Yajing and her husband spread out a tablet and a paper ledger on the living room coffee table and went through the items one by one: the 100,000 yuan in liquid funds that needed to be reserved for their daughter's primary school enrollment in September, the store loan repayment date in August, and living expenses in recent months. Looking at the clear figures, the two felt reassured. Aqiang suggested setting up a family safety fund, depositing a fixed amount each month to be used only for designated purposes. Song Yajing enthusiastically agreed. Using a calculator to match income and expenses, they initially worked out a three-year plan of saving 3,000 yuan per month and decided to go to the bank the next day to ask about account opening details.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packing for the Guangzhou trip and confirming ticket reservations
description: After reaching an agreement on saving, Song Yajing felt confident. She went into the bedroom, took out a lightweight carry-on suitcase, and packed clothes for the next two days, a toiletry bag, a charger, a notebook, and a wallet. Then she sat at the desk, opened the 12306 app, searched for and bought a first-class high-speed rail ticket from Xiamen Station to Guangzhou East Station for 7:10 tomorrow morning. She then opened the WeChat chat with her supplier Susan, confirmed the plan to meet at a café near Guangzhou Shisanhang at 3 p.m. tomorrow, and sent a message: “Ticket bought, see you tomorrow!”
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Relaxing before bed and late-night conversation with my wife.
description: After tidying up, Song Yajing changed into her pajamas and casually put the egg yolk pastries she would bring to her daughter tomorrow into her bag. She did a few simple stretches and climbed into bed. Aqiang had also finished washing up and was lying beside her. She rested her head on her husband's shoulder and softly said that today had been truly fulfilling and that she felt she had sorted out a lot of future matters. Aqiang patted her shoulder and told her to have a safe trip to Guangzhou. After chatting about the next day's plans, they turned off the lights and got ready to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights, Song Yajing lay quietly in the dark. Reviewing the day: the lively interactions with the community, the decisive choices for the store's future, and the initial blueprint for the family safety fund gave her an unprecedented sense of security and clarity. With a smile on her lips, listening to her husband's soft snoring, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 5:30 in the early morning, the alarm clock rang. Song Yajing got up quickly, opened the curtain, and looked at the sky. After washing up, she changed into a light T-shirt and wide-leg pants and tied her hair into a ponytail. She checked the contents of her backpack: phone, power bank, wallet, notebook, pen, folding umbrella, a bottle of mineral water, and the order list.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning devotion and prayer
description: Because she could not go to church, Song Yajing did her devotions by the living room window. She read several passages from Proverbs in a Bible app on her phone, then closed her eyes and prayed, asking for a smooth trip to Guangzhou to select good styles, for her family's safety, and for the store's future. Finally, she encouraged herself.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off for Xiamen North Station.
description: Song Yajing booked a ride-hailing car in advance, went downstairs, and took the car to Xiamen North Station. The traffic was fairly clear, and she arrived about 25 minutes later. After getting in the car, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Aqiang to report her whereabouts.
location: From the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Xiamen North Station, No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Houxi Town, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Entering the station and waiting for the train
description: Song Yajing dragged her suitcase through security and entered the waiting hall of Xiamen North Railway Station. She found the ticket gate, sat down in a quiet corner, used a power bank to charge her phone, and opened 12306 to confirm the ticket gate and departure time of train G1609.
location: Waiting hall of Xiamen North Railway Station, No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Houxi Town, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking the high-speed rail to Guangzhou
description: She took the G1609 high-speed train from Xiamen North Station to Guangzhou South Station. On the train, Song Yajing put on her earphones and browsed fashion official accounts and apps, noting down autumn trend keywords such as 'saddle shoulder', 'workwear style', and 'earth tones'. She also scrolled through Xiaohongshu to follow Guangzhou fashion bloggers. Around 11 o'clock she dozed off for 20 minutes.
location: G1609 high-speed train (Xiamen North Railway Station to Guangzhou South Railway Station)

name: Arrived at Guangzhou South Railway Station and transferred to the metro
description: The high-speed train arrived at Guangzhou South Station on time. Without leaving the station, Song Yajing transferred directly to Metro Line 2, buying soy milk and bread at an in-station convenience store. She took Line 2 to Gongyuanqian Station, transferred to Line 1, and finally got off at Changshou Road Station, heading to Shisanhang.
location: Guangzhou South Railway Station, Nanzhan North Road, Shibi Subdistrict, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, and Guangzhou Metro Lines 2 and 1

name: Having lunch with supplier Susan
description: Song Yajing met with supplier Susan at the Thirteen Factories Food Plaza, and they had wonton noodles and herbal tea together. While eating, they exchanged views on Xiamen customers' preferences and new autumn styles. Susan shared the key silhouettes and popular colors from her booth.
location: A casual dining restaurant inside the Shisanhang Food Plaza on Jianglan Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Visited Shisanhang stalls for initial style selection.
description: After lunch, Song Yajing and Susan visited five or six partner booths in the New China Building and the Hongbantian Building. She felt the fabrics of sample garments, used her phone to take photos of dozens of desired styles and their item numbers, and recorded fabric composition, wholesale price, minimum order quantity, and more in her notebook, with special notes on utility trench coats and earth-tone knitwear.
location: Shisanhang Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province (stalls such as New China Building and Hongbiantian Building)

name: Exploring shops and resting at Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street
description: To find inspiration, Song Yajing went alone to the nearby Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street to observe the window displays and outfit pairings of boutique select shops, taking reference photos. Then she ordered coconut milk sago at a dessert shop and sat by the window observing passersby’s outfits, noting down styling ideas.
location: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Returned to the hotel to check in and freshen up
description: Song Yajing booked the nearby Nantie Grand Hotel, about a 15-minute walk away. After checking in, she put away her suitcase, washed her face, changed into comfortable clothes, and prepared for the evening's online work.
location: Guangdong Province, Guangzhou City, Liwan District, Kangwang South Road, Nantie Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch)

name: Community operations and customer interaction
description: In the hotel room, Song Yajing posted a message in the VIP customer group about sourcing goods in Guangzhou, shared detailed photos of the sample garments, interacted with regular customers like Vivian, collected feedback, and launched a summer clearance event with a small gift. The atmosphere was lively.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Video call with her daughter.
description: At her daughter's dismissal time, Song Yajing video-called her husband Aqiang and saw Xuanxuan showing off the little red flower she had gotten, and she interacted with her by drawing. Although she could not pick her up in person, the video call made her feel the warmth of her family.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Remotely participating in parent-child time at the park
description: Her husband took their daughter to Jiaxingyuan Park to play. Song Yajing watched Xuanxuan go down the slide via video and chatted with her husband about the gains from selecting styles in Guangzhou. The remote companionship made her feel at ease.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Dinner and reviewing and refining the clothing selection list
description: Song Yajing bought oden and rice balls from the convenience store and brought them back to her room for dinner. After eating, she opened the spreadsheet app on her iPad, sorted through the photos and notes she had taken that day, and organized detailed candidate lists by category for trench coats, knitwear, skirts, and dresses, dividing them into must-buy, backup, and pending selections.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Remotely help daughter fall asleep
description: At 8:30 p.m., Song Yajing had a video call and saw that her husband had already bathed her daughter and was getting her ready for bed. She told her daughter a bedtime story about a little rabbit picking mushrooms. Her daughter fell asleep quickly, and she whispered goodnight.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Pre-sleep stretching and late-night couple conversation
description: After removing her makeup, she did some pre-sleep stretching on the bed, then had a voice call with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, sharing in detail the high-tech workwear trench coats and other fabrics and designs she had seen that day. Her husband reminded her to focus on a few specific styles tomorrow.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Organize tomorrow's plan and rest.
description: After hanging up, Song Yajing marked down on the spreadsheet the key points for tomorrow's key negotiations on the TOP 10 styles, such as room to push down prices and minimum order quantities. She set the alarm for 7:30 in the morning, turned off the light, and rested.
location: In the room at Nantie Grand Hotel (Guangzhou Shangxiajiu Branch), Kangwang South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Wake up, pray, and have an efficient breakfast.
description: After being woken by the phone alarm, she prayed briefly in bed for five minutes, asking for smooth shopping today and the safety of her family. After getting out of bed, she quickly washed up, changed into black jeans, a white T-shirt, and a thin knit cardigan, and put on knee pads. Then, in the ground-floor dining room of the apartment, she quickly ate a bowl of century egg and lean pork congee and half a char siu bao, and drank a cup of soy milk. During this time, she used her phone to reply to her family's "Good morning" WeChat message, and checked the route map on her phone for today's shopping list again.
location: Guest room on the 12th floor, Tianfu Building Serviced Apartment, 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Metro commute and preparation before purchasing
description: After walking about 5 minutes from Tianfu Building to Guangzhou Railway Station Metro Station, she took Line 2, transferred to Line 8 at Changgang Station, got off at Cultural Park Station, and walked about 5 minutes to Shisanhang. The carriage was not too crowded, so she put on her Bluetooth earphones and sent Susan a message about the meeting time and place. She also checked her phone notes again to confirm the TOP 10 must-buy booth numbers and negotiation points marked yesterday, and reminded Susan to bring an umbrella.
location: Inside the train cars of Guangzhou Metro Line 2 (from Guangzhou Railway Station to Changgang Station) and Line 8 (from Changgang Station to Cultural Park Station), Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Shisanhang selected autumn new arrivals (morning session).
description: She met up with Susan on time at Gate 1 of Shisanhang. With clear goals, the two of them revisited the five stalls they had focused on yesterday one by one. At a stall specializing in knitwear, they repeatedly touched three cashmere-blend cardigans of different weights, compared the yarn density and hand feel, and finally settled on one of medium thickness as the featured item. At another trench coat stall, they asked the stall assistant on the spot to take off the trench coat from the mannequin, carefully checked the inner stitching and button texture, and took photos to send to Xiaomei at the Xiamen store for reference. After a nonstop morning, they initially confirmed 18 styles (including 5 must-buy items) and recorded detailed item numbers and minimum order quantities.
location: Stalls on the 1st to 3rd floors of the Thirteen Hongs Clothing Wholesale Market, No. 1 Shisanhang Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province.

name: Lunch and purchasing review
description: The two found a roast meat restaurant under a residential building on Jianglan Road near the market. Song Yajing ordered a roast pork and roast goose rice. While waiting, she quickly opened her tablet and compared the 18 styles preliminarily confirmed in the morning with yesterday's list, marking in red the 3 styles that needed focused price negotiation in the afternoon due to high minimum order quantities. She discussed price reduction strategies for these 3 styles with Susan: using 'long-term cooperation as a regular customer' and 'first large order' as leverage to try to lower the unit price by 5% or reduce the minimum order quantity.
location: A Cantonese-style roast meat casual restaurant on Jianglan Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Negotiate bulk discounts store by store and finalize orders (afternoon session).
description: In the afternoon, she moved to the 4th and 5th floors of the market and the more upscale stalls in the adjacent office building. Song Yajing fully leveraged her status as a regular customer and patiently communicated with the owner of each stall. At a skirt stall, she pointed to an order of 30 pieces and said, 'Sister Li, this is the first time I've ordered this many from you. From now on, I'll mainly rely on you for new styles in Xiamen. Think of this 3% discount as making a friend.' In the end, the owner agreed to give her a 3% bulk discount. At a boutique in the office building, she negotiated with the owner to have the loose goods shipped together via the Xiamen logistics line she works with, with centralized settlement. Before 15:45, she successfully finalized orders for the remaining 12 styles and paid the deposit. She received all stamped sales lists. Together with the 18 styles from the morning, she finalized more than 30 styles of autumn women's clothing in total today.
location: Floors 4-5 and the office area of Shisanhang Clothing Wholesale Market, No. 1 Shisanhang Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Organizing orders and taking a short break in the market.
description: The market was bustling with people. Song Yajing pulled Susan to sit on a bench beside the corridor of an office building. She quickly took out a pen and notebook, and while comparing with the electronic list on her phone, she wrote down by hand all the total amounts of the finalized orders, photos of deposit payment receipts, agreed logistics milestones, and delivery times, ensuring everything was foolproof. Susan was also confirming her own records alongside. The two bought two bottles of mineral water from a vending machine in the market and took a short 5-minute break.
location: Rest area, office building, Shihang Clothing Wholesale Market, No. 1 Shisanhang Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Saying goodbye to Susan and walking back to the hotel
description: She said goodbye to Susan at the entrance of Shisanhang. Song Yajing decided not to squeeze onto the metro; instead, she walked back to the hotel along Renmin South Road, hoping that walking would relax her body and eyes after a day of purchasing. On the way, she passed a time-honored pastry shop, went in and bought some chicken cakes and wife cakes to bring back to Xiamen for her family to try. At the same time, she took out her phone and sent her husband A Qiang a WeChat message: “The purchasing is almost done. Let's have our video chat at the usual time tonight~” Then she replied to a few customers asking about the launch time of new items. The sky was beginning to look gloomy.
location: Along Renmin South Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Returning to the hotel to rest and preparing for the evening
description: Back at the apartment, the shower ran with a loud splashing sound. After showering, she applied the body lotion provided by the apartment to her calves, which were tired from walking so much, and changed into comfortable pajamas. She brewed a cup of jasmine tea, sat by the window, and put foot patches on the soles of her feet to relieve the fatigue of the day. While sipping tea, she used her phone to check tomorrow's weather in Xiamen and browse autumn outfits and accessories for the store, looking for inspiration for new pairings.
location: Guest room, 12th floor, Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Simple dinner and preparation before the video call.
description: Since the procurement task had been successfully completed, she felt relaxed. Instead of ordering takeout, she went to the Chinese restaurant on the second floor of the apartment and ordered a light bowl of wonton noodles and a plate of blanched lettuce. While eating, she took out the account book again and, on the “Family Protection Fund” page, wrote “August 4, final plan confirmed with Aqiang,” making thorough mental and material preparations for the upcoming video call.
location: Chinese restaurant, 2nd Floor, Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Finalized the family protection fund plan with her husband over a video call.
description: She started the video call on time. On the other end, Aqiang had just put his daughter to sleep, and the familiar living room of their home was in the background. Without beating around the bush, Song Yajing took out the notebook she had prepared in advance and clearly restated the plan they had discussed before: a fixed 4,000 yuan per month, to be used primarily for family emergencies, with each person automatically transferring from their salary card. She detailed the plan: Aqiang would transfer 2,400 yuan from his salary card each month, she would transfer 1,600 yuan, and all funds would be deposited into a new joint account. After listening carefully, Aqiang had no objections, and together they each took out a paper copy of the plan and signed it on the video call. Song Yajing felt a great weight finally lift from her heart.
location: Guest room, 12th floor, Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Organize all of the day's orders and report data
description: Feeling pleased, she opened the Feishu document on her phone and methodically entered all of the day's handwritten order details, payment screenshots, and logistics information into a spreadsheet named “2025 Autumn - Guangzhou Purchasing.” After checking that everything was correct, she sent the spreadsheet to Susan for backup and left her a voice message: “Thanks for your hard work today—we're really efficient!” Then she organized the total amount of the first-phase purchases and the remaining budget, and sent them to her work WeChat as a reference for tomorrow's restocking.
location: At the desk in the guest room on the 12th floor, Tianfu Building, 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Pre-bed relaxation and family bonding.
description: After finishing all her work, she began her personal wind-down time before bed. First, she did 15 minutes of bedtime stretching, focusing on relaxing her tense waist and feet. Then she tried to mentally simulate the steps for making lemon tiramisu. Next, she had a 5-minute video call with her mother to let her know she was safe and tell her that she had bought some chicken biscuits for the family. Finally, she lay in bed, browsed Taobao, and favorited three Baroque-style earrings that would go with the knit sweaters she had purchased today, thinking of putting them in the store as styling recommendations.
location: On the bed and by the window of the guest room on the 12th floor of Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Planned the return trip and preparations for the next day.
description: There is still a restocking task tomorrow, but she is used to planning ahead. She checked the high-speed train schedules to Xiamen for tomorrow afternoon on the "12306" app on her phone, filtered out a few suitable time slots, and felt reassured. Then she placed the power bank, shopping list, and some cash she would need tomorrow on the bedside table, turned off the main light, and left only a bedside lamp on.
location: On the bed in the guest room on the 12th floor of Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Reading and getting ready for bed
description: Her pre-sleep reading habit led her to take out The Belly of Paris and read a few pages. It is documentary literature about the central market in France, which oddly matched her mood from visiting the wholesale market today. At 10:30, she put down the book, turned off the light, took a deep breath, and silently said to herself: "Smooth purchasing, family secure, keep working hard tomorrow." She fell deeply asleep in the quiet night.
location: On the bed in the guest room on the 12th floor of Tianfu Building, No. 58 Zhanqian Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Morning tidying and prayer
description: The phone alarm went off on time. Pulling open the curtains, I saw a Guangzhou morning turning from cloudy to sunny. After a quick wash, I began packing the clothes and documents from these days into my suitcase, making sure I hadn't left out the Cantonese culture pop-up book I bought for my daughter Xuanxuan last night. Standing by the window, I closed my eyes for a brief morning prayer, thanking the Lord for a safe journey and asking for everything to go smoothly today. Stepping on the scale, I saw 49.6 kg and silently thought that after returning to Xiamen I should adjust my diet.
location: Room 1218, Garden Hotel, 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Hotel breakfast and account-opening preparations.
description: At the hotel restaurant, she picked a black coffee and a chicken sandwich to refresh herself. As she ate, she took out her phone and sent a WeChat voice message to her husband A Qiang: "A Qiang, I've finished breakfast. I'll video-call you from the room around 8:30 to open the account. Have you arrived at the ICBC branch over at Qianpu?" Meanwhile, she mentally confirmed that her ID card and bank card were at hand.
location: Garden Restaurant, Garden Hotel, 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Final preparations before opening an account via video
description: Returned to the room and checked the phone network and power bank again. Put the ID card and bank card on the table, then silently went through the account opening process in her mind. Sent a video invitation to her husband Aqiang and, while waiting for him to answer, took a deep breath to make sure she was in the best state.
location: Room 1218, Garden Hotel, 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Remotely open a dedicated family security fund account
description: Her husband, A Qiang, answered the video call, and his phone screen showed the background of an ICBC branch. She sent him photos of her ID via WeChat, and he showed them to the bank teller at the window. Under the teller's guidance, A Qiang completed the facial recognition and signature confirmation. Across the screen, they jointly opened a dedicated "family security fund" account and set up an automatic transfer of 2,000 yuan from each of their salary cards on the 10th of every month. After hanging up, she felt a sense of reassurance—another line of defense had been built against family financial risks.
location: Guangdong Province, Guangzhou, Yuexiu District, No. 368 Huanshi East Road, Garden Hotel, Room 1218 (remote collaboration with Qianpu ICBC branch, Lianqian East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Check out and head to the clothing expo.
description: She packed her daypack, went downstairs to the front desk to check out, and left her large suitcase with the hotel concierge. Then she booked a car through a ride-hailing app at the hotel entrance, setting the destination to 'Canton Fair Complex Area B'. The drive took about 20 minutes. Along the way, she leaned against the car window, watching the streetscape of Guangzhou and conserving her energy for the upcoming exhibition.
location: Garden Hotel, 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province (travel by car to Area B, Canton Fair Complex, 382 Yuejiang Middle Road, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province)

name: Visited the clothing expo to research trends
description: Arrived at the Pazhou Exhibition Hall and entered using the QR code from the earlier electronic registration. With clear goals, I headed straight to the sustainable fabric exhibition area and the guochao design exhibition area. In the sustainable fabric area, I had detailed discussions with two exhibitors about the processes of recycled fiber and plant dyeing, and collected fabric samples; at the guochao design booth, I took many photos with my phone of embroidery details, frog button designs, and new Chinese-style silhouettes, occasionally discussing styling with the booth designers. Around 10:30, feeling a bit tired, I bought an American coffee at the café inside the exhibition hall and rested for 20 minutes. Afterward, I continued browsing other exhibition areas and took notes on the season's metallic color palettes and exaggerated sleeve trends.
location: Zone B, Canton Fair Complex, 382 Yuejiang Middle Road, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China

name: Simple lunch on the way back to the hotel.
description: Reluctantly left the exhibition hall, hailed a taxi on the roadside, and returned to the hotel. In the car, I opened a tuna rice ball and a bottle of mineral water bought from the convenience store at the entrance of the exhibition hall, making do for lunch.
location: Canton Fair Complex Area B, No. 382 Yuejiang Middle Road, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, to Garden Hotel, No. 368 Huanshi East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Picked up luggage and headed to Guangzhou South Railway Station.
description: Retrieved the stored luggage from the hotel concierge, then walked about 24 minutes with the luggage to the nearby Nonglinxia Road Metro Station. Took Metro Line 5 and transferred to Line 2, setting off for Guangzhou South Railway Station, with an estimated arrival in about 60 minutes.
location: Nonglinxia Road Metro Station, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province (traveling to Guangzhou South Railway Station, Nanzhan North Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province)

name: Sorting photos while waiting at Guangzhou South Railway Station
description: Passed through security smoothly and found the corresponding boarding gate in the waiting hall according to the e-ticket information. With nearly 40 minutes before departure, she took out her phone and transferred the photos taken at the exhibition this morning to the tablet she carried with her via Bluetooth, so she could organize them on the high-speed train.
location: Waiting hall of Guangzhou South Railway Station, Nanzhan North Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Taking the high-speed rail back to Xiamen and sorting out materials.
description: The train departed on time. She took out her tablet and began systematically organizing the hundreds of photos and notes from the Guangzhou trip. First she deleted all the blurry and duplicate photos, then sorted the clear, inspiring style shots, fabric detail shots, and color pairing shots into folders such as "New Chinese Style," "Sustainable Fabrics," "Color Trends," and "Display Inspiration." Feeling drowsy midway, she put on an eye mask and U-shaped pillow and napped for about 40 minutes. After waking up, she briefly checked today's store situation with the shop assistant Xiaomei via WeChat and replied to a few regular customers' inquiries. The high-speed train arrived at Xiamen North Station on time.
location: On the G1609 high-speed train from Guangzhou South Railway Station to Xiamen North Railway Station

name: Warm pickup at Xiamen North Railway Station
description: Dragging her suitcase through the exit gate, she immediately saw her husband Aqiang waiting in the crowd and her daughter Xuanxuan waving her little hand excitedly. Xuanxuan shouted “Mommy!” and threw herself into her arms like a little cannonball. She crouched down, hugged her daughter tightly, and kissed her little cheek. Aqiang smiled and took the suitcase, and the family walked happily toward the parking lot.
location: Xiamen North Railway Station exit, 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home by car
description: My husband Aqiang drove, and Xuanxuan and I sat in the back seat. Xuanxuan couldn't wait to share the fun things from the past two days at kindergarten, saying the teacher had praised her painting and that she had gone with her dad to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park. I listened patiently and responded now and then. Aqiang asked whether my trip to Guangzhou had gone smoothly. The family decided to keep dinner simple and cook at home.
location: En route from Xiamen North Station, 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and gift time
description: After arriving home, I took out the gifts I'd brought for Xuanxuan and Aqiang — a Cantonese culture pop-up book and a gift box of chicken cakes from a Guangzhou time-honored brand. Xuanxuan was fascinated and kept flipping through the book, while Aqiang made tea. The family sat together in the living room opening gifts and chatting. Aqiang cooked three bowls of Fuzhou fish-ball vermicelli in the kitchen, served with the chicken cakes brought back from Guangzhou, making for a simple, warm dinner.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending time with my daughter and reading together
description: Because Mom had come home, Xuanxuan was overexcited and wouldn't let go of me. I played with building blocks with her, then we read two picture books together — Guess How Much I Love You and My Dad. After washing up, she still refused to sleep, so I sang two lullabies until, at nearly 9:45, the little one finally fell into a deep sleep in my arms.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bathing, skincare, and late-night conversation with spouse.
description: She quietly came out of her daughter's room, drew a comfortable hot bath for herself, and washed away the fatigue of the journey. She put on a hydrating face mask and applied a simple layer of skincare products. Then she leaned against the headboard and shared with her husband A Qiang, who was already in bed, what she had seen and heard in Guangzhou over the past few days: the gains from the new fabrics, the friendliness of supplier Susan, and the various trends she had seen. The two chatted about family arrangements and ideas for the future business, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: She turned off the desk lamp and closed her eyes in the darkness. Thinking back on the day, she had successfully opened the guarantee deposit account, gained a lot from the trade show, and most importantly, returned safely to her family. In her mind, she planned to share today's inspiration photos with the shop assistant Xiaomei as soon as she arrived at the store tomorrow, and to start working on an autumn display plan. With satisfaction and anticipation, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Resume brisk morning walks
description: After getting up at 6:30 in the morning, I quickly washed up, changed into sportswear, walked 13 minutes to Jiaxing Garden Park, and completed a 2.8 km brisk walk. Because I had slacked off a bit during the previous few days of business travel, I deliberately slowed the pace to 9 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer to find my rhythm again, feeling the summer morning heat gradually rising along the way.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home to shower and prepare.
description: After finishing the brisk walk, I walked 13 minutes back home, showered and washed my hair, and felt completely refreshed. Then I prepared a simple, nutritious breakfast: yogurt mixed with the mango and blueberries brought back from Guangzhou, along with a cup of black coffee. I watered the mint and basil on the balcony, picked a few of the freshest mint leaves, put them in a small fresh-keeping bag, and planned to take them to the store to make cold drinks.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: At 7:45, woke up daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her wash up and tie her little braids. The mother and daughter went out together, walked about 10 minutes to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watched her wave goodbye to the teacher, and reminded her to mind the teacher and that Mom would pick her up after school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store
description: Set off from the kindergarten, ride an electric scooter along Gucheng West Road, pass through the lively morning market, then turn into Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and reach the shop. The summer morning sun is already a little dazzling; put on sunglasses and enjoy the short commute with the breeze on your face.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Organize samples and new-goods orders
description: After arriving at the store, opened the door with shop assistant Xiaomei, turned on the air conditioning, and wiped down the shelves. The main task was to process the samples brought back from Guangzhou: steamed and ironed more than a dozen autumn sample garments one by one with a steam iron, and sorted them into office commuter, elegant casual, and designer-style categories. Checked the order list and tracking numbers sent by supplier Susan, confirmed that the new styles were expected to arrive next week, and arranged for Xiaomei to enter the arrived style numbers into the inventory system to prepare for the autumn new arrivals in September.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Prepare a special cold drink
description: After wrapping up her organizing work, she took out the mint leaves she had brought in the morning, washed them clean, put them in the store's glass pitcher, added pre-chilled boiled water, a few slices of lemon, and a little honey, made a pitcher of mint lemon special drink, and put it in the refrigerator to chill.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store operations and display adjustment.
description: Customers began trickling into the store. While attending to them, I communicated with Xiaomei about the display ideas for the new season. I opened the photos taken at the Guangzhou exhibition on my phone and shared the new trends I saw this time from the perspectives of color, fabric, model styling, etc. (the combination of sustainable fabrics and China-chic elements), and planned specific display area adjustments after next week's delivery.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, customers gradually dwindled, and I took turns eating lunch with the shop assistant Xiaomei. Xiaomei went to the adjacent Shaxian Snacks and bought two servings of scallion oil noodles and one serving of blanched greens. After finishing lunch behind the counter, she quickly browsed the latest typhoon track map she had been following last night on her phone, and found that it had strengthened into a tropical storm with a westward shift in its track. She silently noted this and planned to study it in detail in the afternoon.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Personal break and review of the ordering meeting notes.
description: After lunch, she took a 20-minute nap on the sofa in the store. After waking up, she took out her iPad to review notes from the Guangzhou trade show, especially the design details of the booth at the Hangzhou International Expo Center, and gained a clearer plan for the route for the Hangzhou ordering fair on August 13-14.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Received regular customer Vivian
description: Shortly after the store opened in the afternoon, Vivian, a regular customer, came in as promised with a close friend. Song Yajing greeted them warmly and served ice-cold mint lemon special drinks from the refrigerator. The three sat on rattan chairs in the store's rest area, drinking and chatting about the new season's fashion trends. The friend praised the drink, shared a tip for making mint beverages, and promised to give her a few cuttings next time. Vivian tried on a newly arrived linen shirt in the store and paid for it on the spot.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Monitoring the typhoon updates
description: After seeing Vivian off, there were not many customers in the shop. She took out her phone and carefully checked the latest updates on the tropical storm from the Central Meteorological Observatory and a local weather official account. She took a screenshot and sent it to her husband Chen Zhiqiang with the message: "Darling, this typhoon seems to be heading our way; we need to be careful." At the same time, she saw an educational article forwarded by Aunt Lin in the fellowship group, tapped in to read it and learn more about typhoon defense, and began to mentally calculate whether the shelves in the shop needed reinforcement and how the warehouse waterproofing was.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Seeing that it was about time, she gave the shop assistant Xiaomei a few instructions, rode her scooter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. Arriving at the school gate ten minutes early, she stood in the line of parents and exchanged a few words with the mothers next to her.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying dinner ingredients
description: After picking up her daughter, she took her to Zhenhai Road Farmers Market on the way. Her daughter was very interested in the aquatic products area and pulled her mother over to look at the lively jumping shrimp and crabs. To prepare a light dinner, she bought small cucumbers, tomatoes, eggs, a fresh yellow croaker, and a box of silken tofu.
location: Zhenhai Road Farmers' Market, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: It takes about 10 minutes to walk home from the market. After arriving home, she let her daughter play with building blocks in the living room. She cleaned and marinated the fish first, washed the vegetables, and planted a few sprigs of the mint she had bought in an idle flowerpot, placing it on the kitchen windowsill.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work. He deftly made steamed yellow croaker, stir-fried cucumber with eggs, cold tofu salad, and tomato egg drop soup. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. She shared the news of hosting Vivian at the store today and the typhoon alert. Her husband said he would keep an eye on the doors and windows and the balcony flower pots at home.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time
description: After dinner, her husband cleared the dishes while she accompanied their daughter in the living room reading her current favorite picture book, The Crocodile and the Dentist, imitating different voices as she read and making her daughter giggle. After reading, the family of three spent half an hour building a LEGO castle together.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call and family care
description: Initiated a video call with my parents, who are far away in Quanzhou. My mother, Lin Xiuying, answered and asked whether the trip to Guangzhou went smoothly, reminding me to guard against heatstroke; my father, Song Minghui, asked how business at the store was doing. I responded to each and also asked whether they were hot in Quanzhou and told them to take care of themselves. My daughter also leaned into the camera and sweetly called out "Grandma, Grandpa" — a warm scene.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and family wrap-up
description: After hanging up the video call, she took her daughter to bathe and brush her teeth, then changed her into pajamas. Her husband went to the balcony to check the placement of the flower pots. After the bath, she told her daughter one last story about the stars.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal time and winding down before bed
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she sat down on the living room sofa, opened her phone, and checked the latest tropical cyclone forecast again, finding that its intensity had increased and its path indeed could affect Fujian. In her phone memo she wrote a simple plan: go to the shop tomorrow morning to check the warehouse roller shutters and drainage, and if there were any issues on the weekend, bring in the easily tipped mannequins displayed at the storefront ahead of time. Only after doing these did she feel at ease, and then she washed up and did her skincare routine.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's night chat and rest
description: After her husband finished washing up, the two lay in bed together. She briefly shared her plans and thoughts about the typhoon, and her husband agreed, adding, 'I'm on duty this weekend. If anything really happens, call me.' They chatted about funny things their daughter did at kindergarten, then turned off the lights and went to rest.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woken by the alarm clock, she habitually picked up her phone to check the latest push from the Xiamen Meteorological Observatory and confirmed that the tropical cyclone had been officially upgraded to Typhoon Kalmaegi. The track showed it might directly affect southern Fujian. She felt a little uneasy but not panicked. After a quick wash, she changed into light gray quick-dry sportswear and prepared to go out for morning exercise.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk in the muggy weather
description: The air was unusually stuffy and humid. I persisted in completing a 2.5 km brisk walk on the park's lakeside trail, but because I sweated a lot, my pace dropped to about 10 minutes per kilometer, and it felt harder than yesterday. After returning home, I immediately took a hot shower, changed into loungewear, and only then did I feel refreshed.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Having breakfast and discussing typhoon prevention plans with her husband.
description: In the kitchen, I cooked sweet potato porridge, fried sunny-side-up eggs, and served them with crispy cucumbers bought from the Zhenhai Road market. During breakfast, I brought up the typhoon warning: “Aqiang, have you seen the forecast? ‘Haiou’ might really be heading our way.” Chen Zhiqiang put down his phone and confirmed, and the two reached an agreement: if the yellow typhoon warning was upgraded, I would close the shop early in the afternoon, and he would leave work early too, to go home and reinforce both the house and the shop. This consensus put my mind at ease.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: I got on the electric scooter and took Xuanxuan to kindergarten on the way. I deliberately stuffed a children's umbrella into the side pocket of Xuanxuan's backpack and told her, “It's going to rain today. Don't run around; stay with your teacher.” After watching my daughter run into the school gate, I rode to the store.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shop operations and inventory check of typhoon preparedness supplies.
description: Arrived at the shop early, turned on the air conditioning, and cleaned up with Xiaomei. The top priority was to carry out typhoon preparedness. Xiaomei and I went into the warehouse, dragged out the windproof panels, checked the sandbags, and counted stock items such as wide tape and zip ties. After confirming that all supplies were complete and undamaged, I took photos with my phone and sent them to the family group, and @Chen Zhiqiang: "The shop's gear has been inventoried, don't worry." My husband replied with a thumbs-up emoji. After that, I started tidying the shelves and serving the occasional customer, while mentally planning how to bring the unsteady mannequins near the door inside in advance in the afternoon.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and posting a typhoon reminder to the community group.
description: Today I didn't want to eat satay noodles, so Xiaomei went next door to pack some Zhangzhou braised noodles. After lunch, I sat behind the cash register and used my phone to compose a detailed disaster-prevention reminder, covering checking doors and windows, putting away balcony flowerpots, fully charging power banks, and storing drinking water and dry food. I first posted it in the "Yajing's Select VIP Customer Group," then specifically forwarded it to the "Siming Catholic Church Congregation Group" with the note, "May the Lord keep you safe; everyone please take precautions." As soon as the message was sent, both groups became active, and neighbors reminded each other, which made me feel warm.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Outfit matching and online promotion.
description: Taking advantage of the fact that the wind and rain had not yet arrived in the afternoon and the store was not busy, I took out the autumn sample clothes I had just brought back from Guangzhou a few days ago, chose a linen shirt and a pair of wide-leg pants, tried them on as an outfit, and took a few lifestyle photos and a short video in the store with my iPhone. I carefully edited the photos and posted them on WeChat Moments and in community groups, with the caption: "A typhoon day can't stop autumn from arriving #NewArrival #GuangzhouGoods", intending to use the new styles to divert everyone's anxiety about the typhoon.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reinforcing the shop in response to the peripheral effects of the typhoon.
description: A little after two in the afternoon, the rain became dense and fierce, slanting into the shop. Xiaomei and I immediately moved the two tall mannequins and the advertising signboard from the entrance back inside, and tested the circuit breaker for the rolling shutter door to make sure it was working properly. We also stuffed old towels into the gap under the door to prevent rainwater from backing up. After all this, watching the wind and rain rage outside, I felt a sense of calm instead: I had done everything that needed to be done.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Let the store clerk leave early
description: Considering that the wind and rain were getting stronger and there were few pedestrians on the street, I decided to let Xiaomei leave work early and go home. I told Xiaomei to be safe on the way and text me when she got home. After that, I did a final check of the store alone and got ready to pick up my daughter.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up my daughter from school in the rain
description: I put on a rain poncho, got on the scooter, and carefully rode along the water-covered roads to pick up Xuanxuan. The road was slippery, but I rode slowly and steadily. After picking up Xuanxuan, she chattered about making origami frogs at kindergarten today, and the worry the typhoon had brought me was washed away. We arrived home safely.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family wind safety check.
description: After getting home, I sent my husband a WeChat message saying "Home safe." Chen Zhiqiang arrived home soon after. I made a simple dinner (tomato and egg noodles, stir-fried seasonal vegetables). After dinner, my husband and I checked all the windows in the house again, making sure they were closed and locked, and that the flower pots on the balcony had been moved indoors.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family parent-child time
description: On a typhoon day indoors, keeping An Xuanxuan company was the main activity. I picked a picture book about how little animals worked together to survive a storm, and read it to her while leaning on the sofa. Xuanxuan listened very attentively and even asked, 'Do frogs get scared of typhoons too?' The whole family had a warm evening together. Afterwards, I washed Xuanxuan up, told her stories, and got her to sleep around 8:30.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal grooming and skincare
description: After getting my daughter to sleep, I made time to wash my face, apply a sheet mask, and put on skincare products—this was one of the few relaxing moments in the day that was all my own.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with best friend Zhao Min
description: I was wearing a face mask when my phone rang. It was a video call from my college best friend Zhao Min in Hangzhou. With a worried face, Zhao Min asked, "Xiaojing, is the typhoon severe over in Xiamen? The news looks so scary!" I smiled and reassured her, saying that both home and the store were well prepared, and told her not to worry. The two of us chatted for nearly an hour, moving from the typhoon to our kids, then to Zhao Min's new job. My friend's concern completely dissolved the anxiety in my heart.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Checking weather information and preparing for bed
description: After hanging up the video call, I opened the weather app again and checked the latest track of Typhoon Kalmaegi and tomorrow's weather forecast. I already had a sense of it: tomorrow I most likely won't be able to open the shop normally, and I'll have to wait until the warning is lifted before going to handle it. I took out my phone memo and wrote down the items to follow up on tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Before turning off the bedside lamp, my husband and I softly exchanged our thoughts about the day, both feeling that the preparations were fairly adequate. Although the typhoon was approaching, we no longer felt panicked inside. I fell asleep around 23:30.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early rising and family division of labor under a typhoon warning
description: I was woken early in the morning by the typhoon "Haiou" warning. The sky was gloomy and the air pressure was extremely low. I immediately checked the typhoon path map on my phone and confirmed it had been upgraded to an orange alert, with the typhoon center expected to make a direct landfall in the afternoon. I gently woke my husband Chen Zhiqiang and briefly explained the division of labor for the day: he would reinforce the windows at home and take care of our daughter Xuanxuan, while I needed to rush to the store before the wind and rain intensified to handle emergencies. Then I quickly prepared a simple breakfast (fried egg toast and hot milk), woke up my daughter, and told her kindergarten was canceled because of the typhoon. While drinking milk, I called shop assistant Xiao Mei, told her about the orange alert, and asked her to go straight to the store to meet up.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: She changed into a durable dark T-shirt and sports pants, checked her phone and keys, and decided to walk to the store because the scooter was unsafe in the typhoon weather. Holding an umbrella, she set off from home and walked briskly along Zhenhai Road toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. There were few pedestrians along the way, many shops had closed, and some merchants had piled sandbags at their doors. She arrived at the store after about 15 minutes of walking.
location: Along the way from Shanggu Street to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Final store reinforcement and community reminder
description: Upon arriving at the store and meeting up with Xiaomei, she took immediate action. She put up a sign reading "Temporarily Closed Due to Typhoon" and locked the rolling shutter door. Using storm panels, a screwdriver, and heavy-duty tape, she reinforced the street-facing glass display windows and the gaps in the rolling shutter door. She moved the cash register, computers, and other electronic equipment to the highest shelf in the loft and covered them with waterproof tarpaulin; moved the boxes of new autumn clothing to the middle shelves and covered them tightly; and used sandbags to block the gaps under the door to prevent rainwater from backing up. After checking repeatedly, she turned off the main power. Before locking the door, she posted an urgent typhoon alert in the customer group and the church community group: "Typhoon 'Seagull' will be here soon. Don't go out unless necessary. Close the windows and doors, and stock up on water and dry food. The store is temporarily closed. Stay safe." She urged Xiaomei to go home right away.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked home in the rain
description: She locked the store door and added an extra lock. The wind and rain had intensified, so she held her umbrella and walked home quickly. On the way, she saw street trees swaying violently in the wind and felt an even greater sense of urgency. When she got home, her husband had already moved all the potted plants from the balcony into the living room.
location: Along the route from Zhongshan Road to Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family typhoon preparedness.
description: Back home, she quickly divided tasks with her husband: he used X-pattern tape to reinforce the glass windows in the living room and bedroom, while she carefully checked the locks on every window. Working in sync, they finished the main protection in less than half an hour. Then she asked her husband to call the community property management to report the situation and confirm the community emergency contact number. She crouched down to comfort her daughter Xuanxuan, telling her she had to be a little brave warrior today and couldn't go out. The girl nodded, half understanding.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchasing emergency supplies and helping neighbor Aunt Zhang
description: While the wind and rain were not yet out of control, her husband drove to the Yonghui Supermarket on Zhenhai Road. The supermarket was quite crowded and the shelves were somewhat messy. They quickly bought bottled water, instant noodles, biscuits, ham sausages, a high-capacity power bank, candles, and a flashlight. At checkout, she deliberately grabbed an extra set of supplies, thinking of Aunt Zhang, the solitary neighbor next door. After driving back to the residential complex, she had her husband carry the items home first, while she took the supplies and knocked on the door of Room 302, Aunt Zhang’s place. Aunt Zhang looked surprised when she opened the door. Yajing handed her the supplies and loudly reminded her to keep the doors and windows closed and to knock or call at any time if she needed anything. Aunt Zhang thanked her again and again.
location: Yonghui Supermarket on Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Room 302, Building 1, Residential Complex No. 82, Shanggu Street

name: Returning home to rest and parent-child time.
description: Back home, the wind and rain outside had clearly intensified, with raindrops hammering against the window. Feeling a little tired, she rested on the sofa for a while, then perked up and played with her daughter on the living room mat. She held her and read the picture book Not a Single Feather Can Move, and sang her favorite song "The Snail and the Oriole." The tense typhoon day softened with the sound of her child's laughter.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare voice livestream content for the community.
description: After arranging for my daughter to watch cartoons, I prepared in advance for the evening community voice livestream. I opened the notes app on my phone and wrote down the key points: today's shop and family protective measures, a list of essential emergency supplies, and electrical safety tips, and I planned to invite my daughter to sing and interact. I took out my Bluetooth earphones, tested the voice livestream function in a WeChat group, and posted a preview in the customer group: “Dear friends, the wind is really howling outside. At 8 p.m. tonight, I'll do a voice livestream in the group. Let's talk about how we're 'fighting the typhoon' today. My daughter Xuanxuan will also sing a song for everyone! Be there or be square!”
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family moments during the typhoon's landfall.
description: "Sea Gull" officially made landfall, with howling winds and torrential rain, and the windows rattled loudly. The living room light flickered twice, so I immediately took out a power bank. My husband lit the prepared candles, adding a touch of warmth to the room. The three of us sat around the dining table, using a desk lamp for light, and brought out biscuits and ham sausages. Our daughter felt it was like a special "indoor picnic." It was warm inside, while outside wind and rain raged.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple dinner
description: Her husband went to the kitchen to boil frozen dumplings, while she made instant noodles and cut up a plate of fruit. The family had dinner by candlelight and lamplight. Her husband talked about his colleagues, while she scrolled through Moments on her phone. Seeing customers posting about the heavy rain outside their windows, she casually replied to a few, reminding them to stay safe.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discuss the livestream with my husband and encourage my daughter.
description: After dinner, she cleared the dishes with her husband, briefly told him about the livestream plan, and asked him to play with their daughter to make room for the livestream. Then she reviewed "The Snail and the Oriole" with her daughter in the living room and encouraged her to sing loudly during the livestream. She softly said to her daughter, "Mommy is going to sing for the uncles and aunts in the group to help them not be afraid of the typhoon. Would you like to help Mommy?" Her daughter nodded vigorously.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final preparations before the livestream
description: Pour yourself a glass of warm water, put on Bluetooth earphones, and check your phone battery and network again. Cheer yourself on inside, determined to accompany everyone through the stormy night with the warmest and most powerful voice.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community voice livestream — typhoon response experience sharing and donation collection
description: At 8 p.m., she started a voice livestream in the customer group as scheduled. Outside the window was a violent storm, but her warm voice shared the day's experiences: from reinforcing the store to delivering supplies to neighbors; she also combined her own situation to share three practical tips: the X-pattern taping method for doors and windows, an emergency supplies checklist, and protecting electrical appliances from water. Group members sent short videos of the wind and rain outside their windows, sharing the dangers. She invited her daughter to join in, and the little girl sang 'The Snail and the Oriole' in a sweet baby voice, and the group was flooded with 'What a great kid!' In the second half, more than a dozen regular customers and church friends sent care red envelopes ranging from 6.66 to 88.88 yuan. She solemnly announced that the total amount of all red envelopes that day would be used as the group's 'typhoon mutual aid fund,' donated in full to the community flood prevention emergency fund, and she posted screenshots showing every red envelope detail, winning a storm of likes from the group members.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ending the livestream and settling the family
description: The livestream ended with warmth and gratitude. I took off my headphones and let out a long sigh of relief. My husband had already taken our daughter to brush her teeth and change into pajamas. I made hot milk for the family, and we sat in the living room chatting for a while, feeling especially grounded tonight. I reminded my husband to check the windows and door gaps for seepage, and confirmed everything was fine. I carried my daughter to the bedroom, told her a story, and gently patted her to sleep.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal tidying up and rest.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she talked quietly with her husband in the living room about how they felt today. Feeling her throat dry, she drank a glass of warm water. She washed up quickly. Because today's physical exertion was huge (moving goods, reinforcing, etc.), she canceled the stretching and meditation plans and just wanted to lie down and rest.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: Lying in bed, the howling wind outside the window had not let up, but she felt very calm inside. She chatted a little more with her husband and thanked him for his efforts at home today; he squeezed her hand. Although she was tired, being together as a family made her feel secure, and she soon fell asleep.
location: Room 304, Building 1, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and home safety inspection.
description: Yajing was awakened by the occasional birdsong outside the window; the morning after the storm was especially peaceful. She first carefully checked every corner of the house: windows, balcony, bathroom, confirming there was no leakage or damage. Seeing the list on the refrigerator of emergency supplies she had bought on behalf of her neighbor Aunt Zhang last night, she took a photo with her phone to keep as a reminder.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing to enjoy a warm breakfast with the family
description: Yajing cooked a pot of steaming brown sugar ginger tea, and fried sunny-side-up eggs and toast, filling the room with a rich aroma. She woke up A Qiang and Xuanxuan, who were still lying in bed. At the dining table, she shared the funny story of Xuanxuan singing 'The Snail and the Oriole' during last night's live stream. The family of three burst into laughter, and the home was filled with a warm and cozy atmosphere.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commuted to the store, checked safety, and took photos.
description: After breakfast, Yajing changed into sneakers, put on her helmet, and rode her electric scooter. The air after the rain was especially fresh, and she reached the store in 5 minutes. She pulled up the rolling shutter door and carefully checked the doors, windows, ceiling, and floor. There was only a small puddle and a few fallen leaves at the entrance, and the drainage was smooth. She took photos and videos of the scene and sent them to the family group chat and the shop assistant Xiaomei's WeChat to report that all was safe.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Riding a scooter to the farmers' market.
description: Yajing rode her scooter, starting from Zhongshan Road and heading east along Zhenhai Road toward the Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market. With the breeze on her face, she felt refreshed.
location: Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (cycling to the farmers' market)

name: On the way, purchase supplementary emergency supplies for the family.
description: At the farmers' market, Yajing judged that vegetables might not be fresh after the typhoon, so she only bought some good-quality dried goods and seasonings such as shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and red dates. Then she went to a small supermarket inside the market and bought a bag of cake flour along with fresh cucumbers and tomatoes, planning to bake some small cakes for Xuanxuan once she was done.
location: Xiasheng (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Riding the scooter home
description: After finishing the shopping, Yajing rode her scooter straight home. With one hand on the handlebar and the other holding a large bag of supplies, she thought she could rest for a while.
location: Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (while cycling home)

name: The community launched a 'safety check-in' chain and mutual aid, and disclosed donation receipts.
description: After arriving home, Yajing put the purchased supplies away. She sat on the sofa and opened the WeChat VIP customer group for her shop. “Dear friends, is everyone safe? Let's do a ‘safe check-in’ chain – one sentence per person is enough!” Soon, the group became lively. After tallying, she found that 2 households living in old residential communities reported power outages and water accumulation. Yajing immediately coordinated in the group, tagging group members who lived nearby and asking them to help deliver power banks and hot meals. Afterwards, she called the person in charge of the Flood Prevention Emergency Fund of Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, and confirmed that the 2,680 yuan red packet amount donated on behalf of everyone last night had arrived in full. She then sent the transfer screenshot to the group and said sincerely: “Thank you all for your kindness. Together we have done a good thing for the community.” She also carefully reviewed her experience organizing last night's livestream in her phone memo and recorded small tips for improvement next time.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing lunch ingredients
description: After dealing with community matters, Yajing went into the kitchen and began preparing lunch. She washed and cut the small cucumbers into sections for dipping sauce; took out the tomatoes and eggs, planning to make a bowl of egg drop soup at noon. At the same time, she moved the yellow croaker that needed to be thawed from the freezer to the refrigerator, preparing for the soup in the evening.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Have lunch with family and book diving by phone
description: Yajing cooked a simple lunch: tomato and egg soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and pan-seared chicken breast. The family of three chatted while eating, and she shared a heartwarming story about mutual help in the group with Aqiang. After the meal, taking advantage of the quiet lunch break, she called the 'Deep Blue Diving Club' near Wutong Wharf to book an introductory diving experience for 2 p.m. tomorrow (August 10), confirming the price at 480 yuan per person, including a one-on-one instructor and full equipment. After hanging up, she saved the reservation in her phone's calendar, feeling both nervous and excited.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Xuanxuan went to the living room to play with building blocks, and Aqiang was in charge of clearing the dishes. Yajing returned to the bedroom, set a 30-minute alarm, and took a short nap. Lying in bed, she planned in her mind how to rearrange the display in the store that afternoon and make the newly arrived autumn clothes more attractive.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Ride a scooter to the store.
description: After waking from her lunch break, Yajing changed into a fresh cotton-linen shirt, packed a spare power bank and a bottle of water, and rode her scooter to the shop. On the way, sunlight shone through the clouds, and the streets had regained their vitality after the typhoon.
location: Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (biking to Zhongshan Road).

name: Deep-cleaned the shop with Xiaomei and restored the displays
description: When Yajing arrived at the store, Xiaomei also showed up. The two had a clear division of labor: Yajing put the sandbags at the door back in place and moved them to the back alley with a handcart; Xiaomei used a dry mop to wipe away the water marks on the floor. Then they carried the mannequins and goods that had been moved inside back outside. Yajing deliberately placed several new autumn trench coats and knitwear in the most visible positions and adjusted the lighting and background board, making the whole store look completely refreshed. On the blackboard by the door, she also drew a cute sun in colored chalk with the words "Normal business resumes tomorrow, welcome!"
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Riding a scooter to the kindergarten
description: After tidying up the shop, Yajing hopped on her scooter, turned right along Zhongshan Road, and arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten on Gucheng West Road in five minutes. While riding, she wondered what story Xuanxuan would share today.
location: Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (cycling to kindergarten)

name: Picking up daughter from school and enjoying parent-child baking time together
description: When Yajing arrived at the kindergarten gate, Xuanxuan was playing with other children at the entrance. Seeing her mother, she ran over excitedly and told her about sharing her typhoon experience with classmates at school today. Yajing listened patiently and praised her for being a brave big girl. At home, Yajing took out the cake flour she had bought that morning, tied a small apron on Xuanxuan, and the mother and daughter baked a tray of butter cookies together. The kitchen was filled with a sweet milky aroma and laughter.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner (with Ah Qiang's help)
description: During dinner, Yajing was the head chef and Aqiang helped as her assistant—he was in charge of cleaning the shrimp and peeling. Yajing fried the yellow croaker until golden on both sides, and also stir-fried Xuanxuan's favorite shrimp with broccoli. The family of three sat at the table, eating and chatting about the plans for tomorrow. Yajing told Aqiang that she had already booked the diving for tomorrow afternoon. Aqiang patted his chest and said he would take good care of Xuanxuan, and joked, “Remember to take some underwater photos.”
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Enjoying a family dinner
description: During dinner, Yajing again mentioned the details of mutual help in the group chat, and Aqiang also praised her community cohesion. Xuanxuan kept asking her mother what fish they would see in the sea tomorrow, and the whole family of three was full of anticipation for this little adventure.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family leisure: parent-child reading and simple stretching
description: After dinner, Yajing read two picture books with Xuanxuan: Swimmy and When the Wind Stops. In a gentle voice, she explained to the child that typhoons are also a natural phenomenon. After reading, Yajing did a few simple yoga stretches on the play mat, and Xuanxuan imitated her with wiggly movements, filling the living room with the laughter of mother and daughter.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal time: skincare, light study, and online interaction.
description: After Aqiang put Xuanxuan to bed, Yajing went back to the master bedroom. She washed her face carefully and put on a hydrating sheet mask.
