While doing her skincare routine, she opened her phone, replied to a few messages in the group chat that she had not seen until then, and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, looking at photos other women's clothing shop owners posted about reopening after the typhoon and learning from their display and copywriting techniques. She also sent screenshots of today's diving reservation and the donation receipt to her close friends' group chat, which drew a string of likes and comments saying 'Can't wait!'.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Put together simple gear for tomorrow's outing.
description: Before bed, Yajing took out a vacation-style one-piece swimsuit, a quick-dry towel, a waterproof phone pouch, and a clean T-shirt from the wardrobe and put them into a waterproof bag. She pushed the scooter to the hallway and plugged it in to charge, ensuring a worry-free outing the next day. She also stuffed a bath towel and a small bottle of sunscreen into the bag.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night talk between husband and wife, rest at ease.
description: After Aqiang finished washing up and got into bed, Yajing shared with him what she had learned about the water accumulation in the neighboring building during today's community mutual-aid activity, and once again confirmed his plan to take Xuanxuan to Jiaxingyuan Park tomorrow afternoon. The two chatted for a while about their plans for Sunday, then said goodnight. Yajing turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, in calm and anticipation of tomorrow's little adventure. Thus ended this fulfilling day.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Xiagang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning chores and herb trimming.
description: She got up early in the morning and moved quietly so as not to disturb her husband Aqiang and daughter Xuanxuan. Wearing loungewear, she went to the balcony and silently recited the Rosary in the morning light while checking on the herbs after the typhoon. Later, after Aqiang and Xuanxuan got up and the family had eaten the oatmeal Aqiang cooked, she went back to the balcony alone for the final herb end-of-season pruning of the summer. She cut off withered yellow leaves and trimmed overgrown branches, took photos of each pot of herbs, and posted them to Moments with a caption recording this beautiful final chapter.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Making mint tea bags
description: In the kitchen, she patted the washed mint leaves dry with kitchen paper towels, cut them into pieces, divided them into 10 small gauze sachets, tied them tightly with thin string, and neatly placed them in a small wicker basket. Aqiang and Xuanxuan were playing in the living room, and she told Aqiang to take their daughter to Jiaxingyuan Park in the afternoon.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ride a bike to the store
description: Change into going-out clothes, take the small wicker basket loaded with tea bags, and ride the electric bike from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, along Zhenhai Road past Zhonghua City, to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Making tea bags for the shop and preparing to resume business
description: Met up with store clerk Xiaomei at the shop. Together they turned the remaining mint leaves into 10 tea bags, bringing the total to 20 portions, placed them in a rattan basket at a prominent spot on the cashier counter, and wrote a promotional sign on a small blackboard. Then the two wiped down shelves and floors, checked the doors and windows, and made full preparations for officially reopening tomorrow.
location: Shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rode back home.
description: After saying goodbye to Xiaomei, she rode her electric bike back from Zhongshan Road to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex. When she got home, Aqiang had already changed Xuanxuan's clothes and was about to take her to Jiaxingyuan Park.
location: Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Diving preparations and family arrangements
description: After Aqiang took Xuanxuan out, she stayed home alone and took a hot shower, then put on a one-piece swimsuit with a loose T-shirt and shorts over it. She carefully packed her diving gear bag: a large bath towel, spare underwear, a waterproof bag, and a waterproof phone case. Once ready, she sent Aqiang a WeChat message saying she was about to leave, and wished them a fun time.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch alone
description: At home, she cooked a bowl of Minnan satay noodles with prawns and tofu, simple and quick. After the meal, she cleaned up the kitchen and saw that the time was just right.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycle to Wutong Wharf
description: Putting on a helmet, she rode an electric bike from Shanggu Street in Siming District, heading east along Huandao Road toward Wutong Passenger Terminal in Huli District. The sea breeze blew hard; she felt both excited and nervous. Along the way, she sent a message to the diving instructor to confirm the arrival time.
location: Huandao Road, Siming District to Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arrived at the diving club and attended pre-dive training.
description: Arrived on time at the Undersea Diving Club beside Wutong Wharf, checked in at the front desk and filled out the health declaration form, then changed into a black wetsuit. The young instructor Zhang Wei patiently taught techniques such as mask clearing, underwater breathing, and ear pressure balancing. Although she felt uneasy when putting on the oxygen tank, she remained determined to complete the challenge.
location: Undersea Diving Club, Wutong Passenger Terminal, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First-ever diving experience.
description: Accompanied by the instructor one-on-one, I slowly walked into the water from the dock. When the seawater covered my mask, the only sound was my own breathing coming through the regulator, and the world suddenly went quiet. Following the instructor, I descended slowly. Colorful tropical fish darted among the coral, and sea anemones swayed with the current. I was completely amazed by the underwater scenery, forgetting my nervousness and feeling only excitement. When the instructor used hand signals to check on me, I excitedly gave a thumbs-up, and he helped take many photos underwater.
location: The waters near Wutong Wharf, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Resting and sharing the joy after diving
description: After returning to the club to shower and change, she connected to Wi-Fi in the lounge and received the underwater photos sent by the instructor. She then picked out the best ones and sent them to her husband Aqiang, sending several voice messages in an excited, trembling voice describing the wonders of the seabed. Aqiang replied with amazement and said he would bring their daughter along next time. She also shared the photos to her bestie group and the store's regular-customer group, drawing a warm response.
location: Rest area, Undersea Diving Club, Wutong Passenger Terminal, Huli District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Preparing to leave the club and taking a friend's call.
description: Packing up her things and getting ready to leave the club, she had just stepped out the door when she received a call from her friend Zhao Li, who told her that her studio urgently needed calla lily flower materials. Since it wasn't far, she readily agreed to help pick them up.
location: Undersea Diving Club, Wutong Passenger Terminal, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Riding a scooter to the flower market to pick up floral materials
description: Getting on the electric scooter parked at the club entrance, I quickly arrived at Huli Hongtang Flower City following Zhao Li's directions. I found the designated flower shop, gave Zhao Li's name and order number, and the shop owner Li Ming carefully wrapped a bouquet of calla lilies in damp newspaper and handed them to me.
location: Huli Hongtang Flower City, 180 meters northeast of the intersection of Jinshan Road and Jinfang Road, Huli District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Deliver flower materials and cycle back home
description: Continuing on the scooter, she followed the location to find Zhao Li's studio near Jinshan Road, and handed her the calla lilies. Busy Zhao Li, grateful, gave back a bouquet of cream-colored daisies. Then, holding the bouquet, she rode along the coastal greenway back to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District. After arriving home, she sent a message to A Qiang to let him know she was safe.
location: From Jinshan Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District

name: Resting at home and handling social media.
description: She flopped onto the living room sofa, drank a large glass of warm water, and opened WeChat. She found nearly a hundred likes and comments on her Moments and replied one by one to friends' compliments about being "brave" and "the seabed was so beautiful." Then she went to the balcony to check on the trimmed herbs and mused that the summer harvest had come to a satisfying end.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family reunion.
description: A Qiang brought Xuanxuan back from Jiaxingyuan Park. The daughter rushed over and excitedly asked about what he had seen underwater, so he picked her up and vividly described the little fish and coral. A Qiang cooked tomato and egg noodles in the kitchen. Although he did not have much appetite, he still joined them for a bowl of soup, and showed them the diving photos on his phone.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child interaction and preparing for an early bedtime
description: After the meal, Xuanxuan drew a picture in the living room of 'Mom swimming with little fish under the sea,' with a big heart next to it. It melted my heart. But then fatigue hit hard, and I yawned nonstop. After kissing my daughter, I asked Aqiang to handle bedtime, and I quickly brushed my teeth and changed into pajamas.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to bed very early.
description: Turned off the alarm, didn't even have time for stretching, consciousness blurred as soon as her head hit the pillow. Though her body was exhausted, her heart was filled with unprecedented satisfaction and excitement from completing her first-ever dive and helping a friend.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning stretching and hot compress
description: Waking up in the early morning, her legs and lower back were still sore. She skipped the morning brisk walk, soaked a towel in hot water, and applied it to the sore muscles. Then she did cat-cow stretch and child's pose on the bedroom floor, which relieved much of the muscle tension.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up her daughter and get ready for school.
description: Gently woke up her sleeping daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on a matching blue floral dress, and tied her hair into two ponytails. In the bathroom, she encouraged Xuanxuan to squeeze toothpaste and wash her face by herself. Although her movements were not yet skillful, she already looked very much like a primary school student.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street, home in the 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying ingredients at the community supermarket.
description: Holding her daughter's hand and carrying a reusable shopping bag, she walked to Jiajiafu Fresh Supermarket, playing a game of “whoever spots a red fruit first” on the way. In the supermarket, she followed a light meal recipe to pick lettuce, arugula, cherry tomatoes, chicken breast, whole wheat bread, and low-fat Caesar dressing. Xuanxuan helped choose her favorite blueberries and pork floss buns.
location: Jiajiafu Fresh Supermarket, 28 South Park Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: After shopping, she rode the electric scooter with Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, humming nursery rhymes along the way. At the kindergarten gate, she handed her daughter to the teacher and watched her wave goodbye and run into the classroom before leaving.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: After leaving the kindergarten, she rode the scooter along Zhenhai Road and turned onto Zhongshan Road. On the way, she sent a voice message to the shop assistant Xiaomei: “Xiaomei, I’ve brought the mint tea bags I dried yesterday. Please brew them in the glass teapot first, put it in a prominent spot on the counter, and write a small label beside it: ‘New customers can help themselves — it cools and soothes the throat.’” After arriving at the store, she wiped down the shelves with Xiaomei, checked the plants at the entrance, brewed the mint tea and attached the label, then arranged the new dresses and the window display, easily welcoming the first batch of customers.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch preparation and a simple meal with friends
description: She had just arrived at the rest area and was about to wash vegetables when a regular customer, Vivian, came by. The two chatted about Vivian's experiences on a business trip to Shanghai and the typhoon weather. After seeing the customer off, she washed the chicken breast, lettuce, and cherry tomatoes in the rest area and made a light salad: arugula as the base, topped with sliced chicken breast and cherry tomatoes, drizzled with low-fat Caesar dressing, and served with two slices of whole wheat bread. For the first time, she enjoyed a refreshing homemade lunch at the store. She felt satisfied and believed she wouldn't feel drowsy in the afternoon.
location: Rest area, Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Afternoon store operations
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Song Yajing received regular customers and recommended new styles, while Xiaomei tidied the clothes that had been tried on. The mint tea bags were well received, and she took the opportunity to exchange styling tips with customers. She also found time to reply to supplier Susan's WeChat message, letting her know that next week's new styles could be arranged for shipment.
location: Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out for an eye exam consultation and preparing to wrap up work
description: Taking advantage of a lull in the store, she walked to Baodao Optical (Zhongshan Road branch) on the next street, asked the staff about her dry eye problems caused by long screen time, and made an appointment for a comprehensive eye exam tomorrow afternoon. After returning to the store, she called her husband Aqiang, confirmed that he didn't need to work overtime, and told him there was something important to discuss in the evening. Then she handed over the accounts to Xiaomei, reminded her of the next day's precautions, settled the accounts for the day, and left; Xiaomei was responsible for locking up.
location: Baodao Optical at No. 108 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Song Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Bought fruit on the way home from work
description: After getting off work, she rode her electric scooter home along Zhenhai Road. When passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she stopped and picked out fresh crisp pears and blueberries, planning to bring them to her daughter as after-dinner fruit. Then she rode to the building entrance of the residential complex, locked the scooter, and carried the bag of fruit and the ingredients bought that morning upstairs.
location: No. 35-101, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province; the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and the No. 82 residential community on Shanggu Street.

name: Returned home to tidy up and rest
description: After arriving home, I changed into comfortable loungewear, washed the fruit and placed it in a fruit bowl, and put the ingredients away in the refrigerator. Collapsing onto the sofa, I quickly browsed short-term wealth management products recommended by several bank apps on my phone, and formed an initial idea for the family financial plan.
location: Living room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: Husband Aqiang had already made tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and the family of three had dinner together. Daughter Xuanxuan excitedly shared that she had painted an “Underwater World” at kindergarten today and was praised. Song Yajing told them the good news that the mint tea bags were popular and that she had made herself a light lunch. Aqiang smiled and teased, “My Yajing really juggles chicken soup for the soul and healthy living!”
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child painting time.
description: After dinner, the family of three spread out drawing paper. Xuanxuan wanted to draw the Nemo fish from yesterday's diving photos. Song Yajing helped draw the outline while describing the colorful corals and schools of fish under the sea. Xuanxuan's eyes lit up as she listened and drew with unusual care. Aqiang recorded the warm moment on his phone and occasionally helped pass the brushes.
location: Living room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discussing the family financial plan.
description: While Xuanxuan was playing with building blocks, Song Yajing pulled Aqiang over to the sofa, opened the mobile banking app, and proposed that, on the premise of keeping 20,000 yuan as emergency funds, they take 20,000 yuan from the reserve fund to buy conservative low-risk short-term wealth management products, and transfer the monthly 2,000 yuan savings into a more liquid money market fund. She showed several products she had favorited in advance and analyzed the advantages and risks of each. Aqiang agreed with the analysis, and together they selected a short-term fixed-income product with an annualized return of about 3.5%.
location: Living room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Update household accounts and memos
description: After the discussion, I went to the study and opened the family bookkeeping app to record tonight's wealth management allocation plan in detail. Then I set a reminder in my phone calendar: tomorrow morning go to the bank to handle investment procedures, and at 2 p.m. go to Baodao Optical for an eye exam. Noticing it was already late, I decided to end my current work immediately.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: She spread the yoga mat on the bedroom floor, followed a soothing meditation in the phone app, and focused on stretching the backs of her thighs and her lower back. She could feel the tight muscles being pulled apart bit by bit, and the soreness eased considerably.
location: Home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she placed a glass of warm water on the nightstand. Reflecting on the day, she felt at ease: she had started a new habit of healthy lunches and reached a family consensus on financial management.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street, home

name: Listen to my daughter's little secrets.
description: Xuanxuan snuck into the master bedroom hugging her little bear plush, leaned close to Song Yajing's ear and whispered, "Mommy, half of the underwater world I drew today was meant for you and Daddy." Song Yajing's heart melted instantly. She kissed her daughter's forehead and promised to take her to the beach to collect seashells on the weekend.
location: Home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Turning off the light and lying down, listening to her daughter's even breathing beside her and the occasional sound of cars outside the window, she felt tired in body but enriched and content because of the new habits she had formed and the progress in her financial planning. She drifted off to sleep with a faint expectation for the new day.
location: Home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up in the morning and get the family ready
description: At 7 a.m., sunlight streamed through the curtains into the bedroom as you woke up naturally. The soreness in your legs had eased a lot compared with yesterday, lifting your spirits. You didn't linger in bed; you got up gently and went to the kitchen, where you packed the lettuce, arugula, cherry tomatoes, and boiled egg that had been washed and prepared the night before into a lunchbox, and sliced half an avocado. Then you woke your daughter Xuanxuan, tied her hair with the “Frog Prince” hair elastic she requested today, and urged her to quickly finish half a bowl of milk cereal. Your husband Ah Qiang also got up. He would have breakfast a bit later today because he had to deal with a work system that was going live this morning.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: At 7:35, you took Xuanxuan's hand and went downstairs. The morning breeze in the neighborhood carried the scent of grass and trees, and she chattered on about how she had dreamed the night before that she turned into a flying fish. You listened patiently and reminded her to listen to the teacher and take a good nap at kindergarten today. Ten minutes later, you arrived at the kindergarten gate. Watching her run happily through the school gate, you waved.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home to change shoes and head to the bank.
description: After dropping off your daughter, you walked home. At the convenience store downstairs, you bought a bottle of room-temperature mineral water. At home, you took off your canvas shoes, changed into lightweight sneakers, brought your wallet and phone, and walked to the ICBC Siming Sub-branch near home. On the way, you sent a WeChat voice message to your husband Aqiang: 'I'm heading out now to sort out the wealth management thing at ICBC. See you later at the store.'
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Siming Sub-branch), 270 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling family financial planning
description: At 8:15, you arrived at the bank. Several people were already waiting in the lobby. You went straight to your designated account manager, Lin Xiaofeng. He explained in detail the plan that you and Aqiang had discussed on Monday evening. You made a decisive choice: withdraw 20,000 yuan from the family protection fund account to purchase a conservative wealth management product with a 6-month term and an expected annualized return of 3.2%. At the same time, you set up an automatic monthly transfer of 2,000 yuan from your salary card to the money market fund account on the 1st. Manager Lin skillfully handled the computer and mobile banking for you, and by around 9:40 all procedures were completed. You looked at the newly generated wealth management holdings in your mobile banking app and felt a sense of security—the family's money had begun to 'breathe.' You sent Aqiang a WeChat message: "Done!" He quickly replied with a yellow thumbs-up emoji.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Siming Sub-branch), 270 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: From the bank to the shop.
description: After coming out of the bank, you walked along Lujiang Road in the direction of Zhongshan Road. The morning sea breeze carried a trace of salt and felt pleasant against your face. You passed the ferry terminal and saw several ferries sailing slowly across the calm sea. It took you about half an hour to walk to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and then you turned into Shop 36 with practiced ease.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparation and customer maintenance.
description: Xiaomei had already arrived at the store early and turned on the air conditioning and music. Together with her, you wiped the display shelves with a soft cloth and adjusted the positions of a few new items hung before closing yesterday to create a softer color palette. Noticing the mint tea bags on the counter were almost empty, you reminded Xiaomei to brew another batch next week. While there were few customers, you opened WeChat, replied to friends' comments on yesterday's "Today's Light Lunch" Moments post, and privately messaged several high-spending VIP regulars to recommend the new French minimalist summer clothes, attaching a few carefully taken detail photos. One regular, Vivian, replied that she would come in the afternoon to try them on.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Homemade light lunch and midday rest
description: At noon, you took the lunchbox you had prepared in the morning from the refrigerator in the rest area. You boiled water with the electric kettle, slightly heated the egg and chicken breast, and tossed them with lettuce, arugula, cherry tomatoes, and avocado in a vinaigrette. You also brewed yourself a cup of refreshing mint water. Xiaomei went to a shop on the next street and brought back a bowl of satay noodles. You sat in the rest area and enjoyed your lunch slowly, feeling completely fresh and comfortable, without any greasiness. After lunch, you stood for a while to help digestion and browsed today's fashion news on your phone.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Choose a birthday gift for my father
description: After the lunch break, you asked Xiaomei to mind the store, sat at the cash register, and opened Taobao on your phone. Imagining that the day after tomorrow is your father's birthday, you decided to pick out a practical polo shirt for him. You carefully browsed several old-brand menswear stores he often wore, compared fabrics and colors, and finally chose a slim-fit style in a subdued dark blue made of piqué cotton. You placed the order decisively and selected SF Express to deliver to your hometown in Quanzhou, ensuring it would arrive on time the day after tomorrow. When ordering, you noted, "Works for both business and casual wear; looks sharp and feels comfortable," as if you could already see your father's satisfied look when wearing it.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Optometry and Eye Care Consultation
description: When the appointment time came, you left the shop in Xiaomei's care and walked to Formosa Optical on Zhongshan Road. The optometrist was an experienced practitioner. After a careful examination, he told you that because you had recently spent long hours looking at your phone and using the computer for bookkeeping, your mild eye strain had worsened, but it had not developed into myopia. He suggested you look into the distance for 5 minutes every 40 minutes of work and keep a proper distance from the screen. You took his advice and also bought a bottle of preservative-free artificial tears at the store to have on hand.
location: Baodao Optical (Zhongshan Road Store), near No. 121 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store
description: You walked back to the shop along Zhongshan Road holding the artificial tears you had just bought. As you walked, you reminded yourself that starting tonight, you must strictly follow the plan to look into the distance and never let your eyes get overworked again.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Check the ledger and the restocking plan.
description: Back at the shop, you sat at the cash register, took out last week's sales ledger, and carefully checked every transaction. You noticed that several displayed cardigans and wide-leg pants needed restocking. You recorded the styles, colors, and sizes in detail, planning to send them to Susan, the supplier in Guangzhou, in the evening to arrange next week's restocking order.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon peak business hours
description: After 3:30 p.m., foot traffic on Zhongshan Road gradually increased. You met Vivian as planned. She tried on the two French blouses and a skirt you recommended, and ended up buying a blouse and a pair of basic tailored trousers. You put together a look that was perfect for commuting, and she was very pleased. Then you received two more groups of tourists. You patiently helped them with styling, and although only one T-shirt was sold, they said they would visit your shop again next time they came to Xiamen. You and Xiaomei worked in sync—receiving customers, introducing items, trying on, packing—and the shop was busy yet orderly.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the store early and going to the appointment
description: At exactly 17:00, you glanced at the time and decided to close the shop early. You hung up the "Temporarily Closed" sign, tidied the counter briefly, and put away the day's takings and receipts. You said goodbye to Xiaomei and reminded her to arrive on time tomorrow. You walked quickly out of the shop and headed along Zhongshan Road toward Yanwu West Road. On the way, you called Aqiang to confirm: "I'm on my way. Have you arrived?" He told you that he and Xuanxuan were already at the mall, playing in the children's play area.
location: Wanda Cinema, No. 182 Yanwu West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family gathering and preparation for watching a movie
description: After about a 20-minute walk, you arrived at Wanda Cinema. You found the father and daughter in the children's area of the mall. As soon as Xuanxuan saw you, she ran over and hugged your leg, pointing upstairs excitedly and saying, "Mommy! We're going to watch a big movie!" Aqiang was already holding the movie tickets and a cup of juice for Xuanxuan. You went to the counter and bought a large bucket of popcorn and two cups of cola. The three of you sat for a while on the sofa outside the screening hall, while Xuanxuan chattered about the toys she and Aqiang had seen in the mall.
location: Wanda Cinema, No. 182 Yanwu West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family watched the rerelease of Inception.
description: The movie started on time. The visuals and sound of the IMAX giant screen stunned Xuanxuan. She leaned against you the whole time, and during tense scenes she would grab your arm and whisper, "Mom, is this real?" "Can they wake up?" Aqiang patiently explained the "dream within a dream" and the "spinning top" in a simple way she could understand. Although you had seen this movie before, revisiting it in the theater with your family felt completely different. Looking at your husband's profile and your daughter's focused expression, you felt filled with a calm happiness.
location: IMAX Theater, Wanda Cinema, No. 182 Yanwu West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Strolling around the cinema and returning home
description: After the movie ended, Xuanxuan was still not satisfied and, as she walked through the mall corridor, imitated the protagonist's parkour moves. You walked around the first floor of the mall, and at a claw machine, Aqiang spent 10 yuan to win a tiny spinning top, which Xuanxuan treated as a treasured find. Considering it was getting late, you didn't linger and walked straight out of the mall, heading home along Yanwu West Road. On the way, Xuanxuan hugged the spinning top in the back seat and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting daughter washed up and putting her to sleep
description: Arrived home at almost 9:15. Aqiang carried the sleeping daughter into the room, but she woke up when he put her down. She rubbed her eyes drowsily and refused to go back to sleep. You quickly helped her wash up and change into her pajamas, then spent ten minutes making up a simple bedtime story, turning the Inception you had just watched into a fairy tale about a little rabbit searching for a dream castle. As she listened, her eyelids began to droop, and she finally fell into a deep sleep at around 9:50.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Private time and stretching relaxation.
description: After your daughter fell asleep, you gently closed the door. Aqiang was working overtime in the study handling an urgent fault. You didn't disturb him. On the yoga mat in the living room, you did a simple 15-minute leg stretch, focusing on the muscle groups that were still sore. After stretching, you tied your hair up with a headband and took a nice hot bath.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing to rest and fall asleep
description: After coming out of the bathroom, you feel refreshed all over and growing sleepy. Aqiang has also finished work and returned to the bedroom. You chat with him a bit about today's events: the bank's wealth management was done, Dad's Polo shirt was bought, and Xuanxuan looked so cute watching the movie today. He asks if your leg still hurts, and you say it's much better. Around 23:15, you say goodnight to each other, and with a full sense of security and satisfaction, you quickly fall asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time
description: Song Yajing was woken by her phone alarm. After weighing 48.8kg on the bedroom scale, she washed up, checked her skin, and applied skincare products. Then she went into the kitchen to make egg pancakes for her daughter Xuanxuan and prepare milk. On the refrigerator door, she wrote a reminder on a sticky note to buy tomatoes. At 7:40, she walked into her daughter's room, gently woke her, helped her get dressed, tied her hair into a high ponytail, and asked about her dreams.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: School drop-off and commute
description: The mother and daughter walked out hand in hand, walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, exchanged a few words with the teacher on duty, and said goodbye to Xuanxuan. She then walked to the stationery store on Park South Road to buy colored card stock, rode an electric scooter to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy a folding umbrella, and finally arrived at the store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District: starting from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten on Gucheng West Road, the stationery store at No. 35 Park South Road in Yubincheng Phase 2, and the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, arriving at Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Store autumn new product display
description: Prepared for opening with part-time clerk Xiaomei: wiped the display counters, watered the plants, and put the purchased cardstock and umbrellas into the storage locker. Sent the restocking list via WeChat and verbally explained the tasks. Starting at 9:00, led the unpacking of the autumn new arrivals and window display design, choosing brown-orange tops paired with beige wide-leg pants, decorated with faux fallen leaves, and briefed Xiaomei on handling incoming calls in the afternoon.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bringing a light lunch from home
description: At the small table in the back room of the store, enjoyed a homemade avocado egg sandwich (with less salad dressing) and fruit cucumber slices, browsing fashion news on her phone while mentally composing birthday greetings for her father the day after tomorrow.
location: Back room, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday interaction with friends and neighbors.
description: In the afternoon, when the shop was idle, Song Yajing went to the neighboring flower shop and chatted with the owner about flower material prices and popular color combinations. She noticed the newly arrived orange spray roses and considered using them to decorate the fitting room to complement the autumn display.
location: The flower shop next to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Answer the diving club's follow-up call
description: At 14:15, at the store entrance, she received a follow-up call from the diving club. She spoke highly of the instructor's professionalism and patience, and successfully secured a returning-member discount slot for her best friend Lingling. After hanging up, she looked through the underwater photos from her previous dive and felt very happy.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business operations and customer service
description: Worked with Xiaomei to serve customers in the store, helping two young women try on new arrivals and offering styling advice. When the afternoon thunderstorm came, reminded Xiaomei to move the long dresses by the window further inside to keep them from getting splashed.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online warm-up and restocking follow-up for the store
description: After the rain let up, she used her phone to photograph the autumn window displays and in-store outfits, selected 9 photos, and posted them on WeChat Moments to preview the new autumn collection, with the caption, “Autumn is quietly arriving; embrace the gentle early autumn with a touch of warm brown.” She then asked her supplier, Susan, via WeChat about the shipping progress of several popular pants styles, and while doing so, she occasionally looked into the distance at the arcade buildings on Zhongshan Road to rest her eyes and quietly refined the birthday wishes for her father.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call test with mother.
description: At 17:35, contacted her husband Aqiang via WeChat to confirm his off-work time. At 17:45, had a video call with her mother Lin Xiuying in Quanzhou, confirmed the contact window of 11:30-12:00 noon the day after tomorrow, and reminded her to ensure her phone had sufficient battery. After testing the network was smooth, she shared a few photos of the shop's new autumn products.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Finishing work and tidying up.
description: After the rain stopped, together with Xiaomei, who had changed into casual clothes, she put away the summer clothing samples that had been replaced during the morning display, swept the floor, checked the store door and the power, and ended the day’s work.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home and running into a neighbor
description: At 18:30, she rode her kick scooter home. Around 19:00, she met Aunt Zhang, a neighbor returning from a walk, downstairs in the residential area. Aunt Zhang praised her for looking well and told her that tomorrow the community has an activity teaching how to make Minnan snacks. At 19:15, she arrived home, where her husband Aqiang had already prepared spaghetti with tomato meat sauce, and her daughter was helping set the table.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child painting
description: The family of three had dinner together and shared what they had seen and heard during the day. After dinner, Song Yajing and her daughter Xuanxuan used the colored card paper bought that morning to draw a birthday card for Grandpa. Xuanxuan drew Grandpa and a cake, and Song Yajing taught her to write "Happy birthday, Grandpa."
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime story and yoga relaxation
description: At 20:15, she bathed her daughter and changed her into pajamas, told her the story of a little rabbit collecting fallen leaves for winter in bed, and stayed with her until she fell asleep. After 21:15, she spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of gentle stretching, focusing on her lower back and legs.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal evening planning and rest
description: Did a short 5-minute meditation on the sofa, then edited the memo on her phone for the video call with her father the day after tomorrow, adding points such as thanking him for his support and praising his flowers and calligraphy. After 22:00, she showered and did her skincare routine, said goodnight to her husband at 22:45, and fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning brisk walk and stretching
description: She woke up naturally at 6:30 a.m., feeling that her body had recovered well. She changed into sportswear and walked to Jiaxingyuan Park, where she completed a 2-kilometer brisk walk along the tree-lined path, keeping the pace at 10 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer and making sure she felt no soreness in her thighs. After returning home, she stretched and relaxed her calves and thighs, and her body felt comfortable.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family breakfast in the morning and taking her daughter to school.
description: After returning home, I quickly prepared breakfast: using the leftover tomato pasta from last night as the main dish, cooking milk oatmeal for myself and my daughter, and frying a sunny-side-up egg with bread for my husband. After tying two pigtails for my daughter, the three of us ate quickly. I rode my electric scooter with my daughter along Zhenhai Road, dropped her off at Siming Experimental Kindergarten around 8:00, told her to be good, and left.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute, shopping, and store-opening preparations
description: After dropping off my daughter, I rode the electric scooter to the shop on Zhongshan Road. On the way, at the convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station, I bought a bag of sliced bread and a bottle of mineral water. After arriving at the shop, Xiao Mei and I pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the shop lights, wiped the cash register and fitting mirror, and Xiao Mei watered the plants. We discussed the day's work priorities: organize the new autumn arrivals in the morning and receive booked regular customers in the afternoon.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Organized autumn clothing and received walk-in customers.
description: Xiaomei and I restyled the knit cardigans and wide-leg pants that arrived last week and hung them in the display window and prominent shelf spots. In the meantime, two tourists came into the store. I greeted them warmly and recommended slimming dresses, and successfully closed a sale.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Making mint tea bags and calling Mom
description: Taking advantage of a lull in customers, she took out the slightly wilted mint leaves, rinsed them with clean water, then dried them in the back room with the microwave in two short low-temperature cycles until crisp, wrapped them in kitchen paper, and divided them into small resealable bags to make simple mint tea bags. Just as she finished tidying up, her mother Lin Xiuying sent a WeChat voice message to confirm the video time for tomorrow again. I told her the alarm was set and said mysteriously that there would be a surprise tomorrow. She laughed and replied that Father often talked about my tea leaves.
location: Rest area at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Received regular customer Vivian
description: Regular customer Vivian brought a friend into the store. The friend immediately took a liking to the camel-colored wool-blend suit jacket. I paired it with a white silk blouse and dark blue wide-leg trousers for her. She was very satisfied after trying it on and bought the jacket and blouse on the spot. I then recommended a brooch, and Vivian’s friend also bought a scarf.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch break and catching up with close friends.
description: I poured the homemade quinoa and roasted pumpkin salad into a bowl and added a few cherry tomatoes and half a boiled egg. I took a photo and posted it to the three-person bestie group with the caption “Today's light meal, healthy and delicious.” Li Meiling replied instantly, marveling at the combination, and Wang Jia teased me about transforming from the baking queen into a light-meal blogger. After the meal, I closed my eyes and rested for 20 minutes, then opened my phone to browse outfit ideas from fashion bloggers and saved two color schemes that suit petite women as backup options.
location: Rest area at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packed mint tea bags and organized the blessing process
description: Put 10 self-sealing small bags of mint tea into kraft paper envelopes and wrote with a ballpoint pen: 'Dad: remember to brew some to drink.' Opened the memo on her phone and organized tomorrow's video birthday celebration procedure: first have Xuanxuan show the greeting card, then I show the polo shirt, and finally the whole family sings the birthday song together.
location: Rest area at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store operations and data review
description: In the afternoon, two groups of young girls came to the store. Xiaomei and I recommended they try on the new hoodies and corduroy skirts. After Xiaomei styled one girl, I took outfit photos from multiple angles and posted them on Moments and in the customer WeChat group. Later, I opened the tablet and reviewed the sales data with Xiaomei. We found that basic layering tops were selling well, so I decided to contact the supplier to reorder 20 pieces and asked to list the dress inventory that needed reordering.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Pick up my daughter from school and buy groceries on the way.
description: Around 16:30, I asked Xiaomei to watch the shop, then rode my scooter ahead to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up my daughter Xuanxuan. After picking her up, Xuanxuan wanted candy, so on the way we stopped at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought her a lollipop, and also bought eggs and green onions as dinner ingredients.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: After getting home, I changed out of my work clothes, tied on an apron, and prepared a simple dinner: tomato and egg noodles with stir-fried greens. My husband Aqiang came home from work and helped pick and wash the vegetables, while Xuanxuan played with building blocks in the living room. During dinner, the three of us sat around the table eating steaming noodles. Xuanxuan excitedly told us a finger rhyme from kindergarten, Aqiang shared the amusing story of the company switching to a new system, and I also mentioned the preparations for Dad's birthday tomorrow. Aqiang supported the idea and promised to come home early tomorrow to help set up the camera.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family craft time: making greeting cards and gifts
description: After clearing the dishes, I took out colored cardstock and watercolor pens and made a birthday card for Grandpa with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan drew a crooked cake and balloons and wrote, "Grandpa, I love you." I carefully wrapped the dark blue polo shirt in gift paper and tied it with a bow. Aqiang recorded the heartwarming moment on his phone.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Coaxing daughter to take a bath and telling her stories
description: After giving Xuanxuan a hot bath and putting her in dinosaur pajamas, I told her the Dumbo story in bed. She asked several questions before gradually falling asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretching and meditation.
description: After my daughter was sound asleep, I laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of full-body stretching. Then I sat cross-legged for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, reviewing the day with a heart full of gratitude.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Writing a gratitude journal and browsing news.
description: In the study, she wrote down three small things to be grateful for in her diary: her body had fully recovered, the tea bag making went smoothly, and family time was warm. Then she opened her phone and quickly browsed the latest posts from fashion public accounts for inspiration for next week's product selection.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed

At 7 o'clock she woke her daughter Xuanxuan and told her that today they would give Grandpa a birthday surprise. The three had breakfast together, and she braided Xuanxuan's hair. They left at 7:45, walked 10 minutes to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and after a few reminders, Xuanxuan ran happily into the campus.

She restyled the new autumn floral shirts and adjusted the window display. At 9:30 she called supplier Susan to discuss a reorder of the waist-cinching floral dresses, requesting 30 pieces each in beige and blue. Susan promised to ship them next week, which made her feel much more at ease.

Yajing showed the card and the shirt, and the family of three sang the birthday song. Her father reminded Yajing to take care of her health. After the video call, Yajing immediately contacted Xiao Li, the SF Express courier, packed the polo shirt and dried mint tea to send to Quanzhou, and reminded him to handle with care.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and online socializing

After the meal, she sat at the cash register, replied to WeChat customers' inquiries about new products, and shared the joy of celebrating her father's birthday with Li Meiling and Wang Jia in the close friends' group chat, chatting about recent happenings, feeling light-hearted.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon peak business hours
description: On Friday afternoon, there were more customers in the store, including office workers off duty and tourists. Yajing warmly received customers, helped a girl trying on a dress match a necklace, and recommended a comfortable knit top to a mother. Xiaomei took photos of the new clothes and posted them on Moments, receiving inquiries. It was busy but fulfilling.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up my daughter from school after work and did some shopping on the way
description: Yajing finished work early and rode an electric scooter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the kindergarten gate, she picked up her daughter Xuanxuan, who excitedly said she had drawn a sunflower for her grandfather. Yajing had Xuanxuan sit on the back seat. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought Yakult and green vegetables.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and handicraft time at home
description: Got home at 18:15; her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already making tomato beef brisket. Yajing helped in the kitchen, and the three of them had dinner together, chatting about sales anecdotes and the video birthday celebration. After dinner, Yajing accompanied her daughter in the living room making handmade lanterns while her husband watched the news. Around 20:00, Yajing received a WeChat group invitation on her phone for 'Class 6, Class of 2007, Quanzhou Experimental Primary School.' A mix of emotions welled up inside her — expectation and hesitation — but she continued to stay with her daughter.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: At 8:30 p.m., after coaxing her daughter through a bath, Yajing took her phone to the study to find her husband Chen Zhiqiang. She told him about the weekend gathering invitation in the primary school classmates group, and said she was worried about store staffing and picking up their daughter. Chen Zhiqiang encouraged her to go and promised to take leave to look after their daughter. Yajing signed up in the group on the spot and felt relieved.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothe daughter to sleep
description: Yajing helped her daughter bathe and change into pajamas, then told the story of Dumbo in bed. Xuanxuan's eyelids grew heavy as she listened, and she soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening meditation
description: Yajing sat cross-legged on the yoga mat in the living room and meditated mindfully for 10 minutes, but her mind was filled with scenes from elementary school. Her thoughts were scattered, and she couldn't focus on her breathing. The effect was mediocre, yet her mood was warm.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Staying up late due to catching up with old classmates in the group chat.
description: After meditation, Yajing lay in bed and couldn't help opening the classmates group chat. She shared old photos with former classmates such as Liu Fang and Wu Xiaoli, chatting about past memories like secretly picking mangoes and being made to stand as punishment. She was immersed in pleasant reminiscence. It wasn't until nearly midnight, after her husband urged her, that she put down her phone and fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Lujiang Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning prayer
description: Early Saturday morning, Song Yajing woke to the sound of her alarm. She didn't have to rush to take her daughter to school, but her mind was filled with store matters and the mother of her good friend Zhao Li. After washing up briefly in the master bathroom, she walked to the window, faced the morning light, opened her mini prayer book, and sought inner peace and strength for everything today, tomorrow's class reunion, and the health of Zhao Li's mother.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Communicated with her husband and prepared ingredients for lunch
description: The aroma of coffee filled the kitchen as her husband Chen Zhiqiang was cooking breakfast. While drinking her pour-over coffee, Song Yajing quickly synced her plans with her husband: she would cover the shift at the store today, and tomorrow afternoon she had a class reunion; Xuanxuan and Sunday dinner would be handled by her husband, and he would pick up their daughter tomorrow afternoon. After confirming the logistics, she quickly washed the lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and corn kernels, packed them into a lunchbox, and prepared to make a salad at noon.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared breakfast for her daughter and checked the fridge inventory
description: Daughter Chen Lexuan stayed in bed over the weekend, so Song Yajing left a strawberry jam toast and a glass of warm milk on the table for her, covered with plastic wrap. Then she opened the fridge to check: there weren't many eggs left, not enough to make sandwiches tomorrow; the butter and dried cranberries were almost used up too, and they were key ingredients for baking cookies tonight. She silently noted that she needed to go to the convenience store to restock in the evening.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuted to the store and replenished supplies.
description: Song Yajing put on a sun hat and sun-protection arm sleeves, hung the lunch box and scooter helmet on the handlebars, and set off on her electric scooter. Passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she stopped and quickly picked up a folding umbrella (to prepare for the afternoon thundershowers), a box of unsalted butter, and a pack of dried cranberries, then continued riding for about 15 minutes to arrive at the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then to Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare for opening the store and communicate tomorrow's plan
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing turned on the air conditioner, watered the pothos, and put the ingredients she had bought into the fridge in the break room. She called over Xiaomei, the shop assistant who was wiping the fitting mirror, and told her that she had a class reunion tomorrow afternoon and needed Xiaomei to run the store alone for half a day. The two decided that, since the morning was not busy, they would organize the 12 new autumn dresses planned for tomorrow's display in advance, attaching price tags and styling labels so that Xiaomei could introduce them easily tomorrow.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Organize and tag new items to be listed tomorrow.
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei hung the new dresses one by one on the ironing board and pressed out every wrinkle with a steam iron. Song Yajing handwrote a label for each dress in neat regular script, clearly marking the item number, price, and fabric composition, and attached sticky notes with recommended pairings, such as "Pairs with a khaki trench coat" and "A pearl necklace adds a more sophisticated touch." Finally, they hung the dresses neatly in the "Tomorrow's New Arrivals" section, ensuring that Xiaomei could introduce them with confidence even when running the store alone.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Attended to weekend customers and closed the first sale.
description: She had just finished organizing the new arrivals when a few weekend shoppers streamed into the store. Song Yajing noticed two young girls pausing in front of the polka-dot dress in the window, so she took the initiative to recommend it and suggested pairing it with the new white one-strap sandals in the store. After trying them on, the customers were very satisfied, and the first sale of the day was successfully made, leaving Song Yajing in a happy mood.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch break and say hello to good friend Zhao Li.
description: The midday customer flow eased a bit. Song Yajing took out the salad she had brought in the rest area, mixed in ready-to-eat chicken breast, and had a simple lunch. After eating, she leaned on the sofa and scrolled through her phone. Remembering that she had been concerned about her friend Zhao Li’s mother’s health, she sent a WeChat message: “Li, how is Auntie doing these past two days? Let’s chat when you have time. Don’t carry it all by yourself.”
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Urgently responding to Zhao Li's request for help and comforting her.
description: Less than ten minutes after the message was sent, Zhao Li replied with a tearful voice message, saying that her mother had suddenly suffered a stroke this morning and was receiving emergency treatment, and she had no idea what to do about the afternoon orders at the studio. Song Yajing's heart sank. She immediately put down her chopsticks, walked to the place at the store entrance where the signal was good, and called her back. In a steady voice she comforted her: 'Stay calm, don't panic, I'm here! I'll figure something out for the studio orders.' She asked in detail about the number of confirmed flower bouquet orders for the afternoon and made a decision in her mind.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Coordinate resources and dispatch Xiaomei to help
description: After hanging up, Song Yajing quickly called Xiaomei over and explained that something urgent had happened at Zhao Li's home, so she needed Xiaomei to go to the studio to help pack flower materials. Xiaomei agreed at once, took off her work uniform, got on her bike, and hurried to Zhao Li's studio. Song Yajing decided to cover the shift herself and would handle the afternoon store operations alone.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Mobilize the online community to help Zhao Li.
description: Taking advantage of a lull with no customers in the store, Song Yajing posted a sincere message in the store's VIP customer group, attaching the group-buy mini program link from Zhao Li's studio, asking the sisters to support the pre-sale flower bouquets, and simultaneously shared it to her Moments. Within less than 15 minutes, three regular customers placed orders. One customer working in healthcare voluntarily provided the number of an acquaintance in the ambulance convoy, and she immediately forwarded it to Zhao Li.

participant.name: Social groups and friends on Moments

location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Covered the shift alone and followed up on Zhao Li's situation
description: The store was busy with customers in the afternoon. Song Yajing skillfully handled everything on her own—finding styles, recommending outfits, and packing purchases—while keeping an eye on her phone. During a break while a regular customer was trying on a floral dress, she quickly glanced at the screen and sent Zhao Li a message asking about the payment and how she was feeling. She only felt settled after receiving a hugging emoji reply from Zhao Li. Throughout the afternoon, she balanced running the store and remote coordination.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Wrapping up work and confirming everyone's status.
description: As the customers gradually thinned out, Song Yajing began to check today's online and offline orders and revenue, preparing to close up. She called Xiaomei. Xiaomei's voice sounded tired but full of a sense of accomplishment; she said she had helped Zhao Li pack the last batch of flower bouquets and sent them out via flash delivery. She then sent Zhao Li a voice message to confirm the situation, and soon received a reply: the surgery went well, and she is under observation in the ICU. Seeing this message, Song Yajing let out a long sigh of relief.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Buying dinner ingredients on the way home.
description: After locking the shop door, Song Yajing got on her electric scooter and headed home. She stopped at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, quickly picked up a bunch of fresh watercress for soup, and bought strawberry yogurt for her daughter, then continued riding for about 10 minutes to get home.
location: Convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then to No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Arriving home to prepare dinner ingredients
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already picked up their daughter and was reheating the leftover tomato beef brisket from lunch in the kitchen. Song Yajing put the purchased ingredients in the fridge, checked the freezer compartment to make sure there were enough frozen dumplings and fish balls for the father and daughter to eat the next day, then washed and cut the watercress into sections for later use.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and discussed the day's events.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Their daughter Chen Lexuan was enthusiastically recounting how her father had taken her to Jiaxingyuan Park to feed the fish that afternoon. Song Yajing listened with a smile, then briefly told her husband about Zhao Li's mother's stroke and how she had urgently deployed Xiaomei and mobilized the community to help. Her husband held her hand, affirmed her approach, and reminded her to take care of herself.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handle family logistics and contact the kindergarten teacher
description: Her daughter was watching cartoons in the living room. Song Yajing took out her phone and sent a message to Teacher Lin at the kindergarten, telling her that her husband would pick up their daughter tomorrow afternoon and asking the guard to let him through. After sending it, she took butter out of the refrigerator, cut it into small pieces, and placed it in a stainless steel basin to soften at room temperature, preparing for baking later.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied her daughter to wash up and told her stories to help her fall asleep
description: Song Yajing gave her daughter a hot bath, applied body lotion, then lay in bed and told two stories from the Tom Rabbit books. Her daughter fell asleep sweetly in her arms, breathing evenly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bake and package cranberry cookies.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing began preparing desserts for tomorrow's class reunion. She whipped softened butter with powdered sugar until light and fluffy, added beaten egg in batches, sifted in cake flour and folded it in, mixed in dried cranberry pieces, then kneaded the dough into a log and froze it for half an hour. While waiting, she washed the dessert box, then took out the dough, cut it into pieces, arranged them on a baking tray, and baked them. When the cookies came out golden and crisp, she carefully let them cool, lined them up neatly in an iron tin with parchment paper, tied a ribbon around it, then cleaned all the baking tools and restored the kitchen to its original state.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal rest and pre-bedtime reflection.
description: After tidying up the kitchen, Song Yajing took a hot shower, blow-dried her hair, put on a face mask, and lay in bed stretching and relaxing. She took out her phone to reply to unanswered messages in community groups and on Moments, and especially reminded the customer who would pick up a bouquet tomorrow. After finishing her bedtime prayer, she silently took stock of the day: she handled shop matters in the morning, dealt with Zhao Li's urgent request at noon by dispatching Xiaomei, covering the shift herself, and mobilizing the community, and prepared snacks and family logistics in the evening. It was busy but orderly, and she truly helped a friend. A sense of satisfaction and calm rose in her heart, and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, morning prayer, and family breakfast
description: Morning light filtered through the curtains, and Yajing woke up at 7:30. She did some simple stretching, then had her morning prayer in the corner of the living room, thanking the Lord for peace and the gathering today. Afterward, she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan and helped her change into a rainbow-striped T-shirt. The family of three prepared breakfast in the kitchen. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang fried sunny-side-up eggs, Yajing heated milk and toasted whole-wheat bread. At the table, she confirmed with her husband his plan to take their daughter on a picnic at Jiaxingyuan Park, and told him that her class reunion would end around 2:30, agreeing to meet at the park then.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Weighing, washing up, and preparing gifts
description: After breakfast, Yajing weighed herself; the needle stayed steady at 48.8 kg. She took a shower, put on an elegant floral-print dress, and while doing her makeup, she shaped her eyebrows and applied dusty rose lipstick. Then she took the cranberry cookies baked last night from the kitchen counter, neatly arranged them in a vintage printed tin box, and placed a note with a drawn heart and "Happy Reunion" as a small token for the class reunion.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Confirmed the arrangements with family and said goodbye.
description: After getting ready, Yajing sent a WeChat message to her husband, telling him that the gathering would end around 2:30 PM, and that she might check on the shop afterward before meeting up at the park. She hugged her daughter and told her to be good. Finally, she checked her belongings and headed out with cookies and a good mood.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove to the class reunion restaurant
description: Yajing drove her white sedan, going straight along Zhenhai Road, turning right onto Lujiang Avenue, and in traffic that had eased after the morning rush hour, arrived near Changxi Private Kitchen on Hubin North Road about 10 minutes later, parking in a roadside paid parking space.
location: Driving route from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Changxi Private Kitchen at No. 118 Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arriving at the restaurant and exchanging pleasantries with old classmates
description: Yajing arrived earlier than the agreed time, and five or six classmates were already chatting in the lobby. She recognized her elementary school friends Liu Fang and Wu Xiaoli, and took out a box of cookies to share with everyone. They chatted about how things were going and waited for the other classmates.

participant.name: More than ten primary school classmates.

location: Changxi Private Kitchen, 118 Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Classmate dinner gathering and surprise reunion
description: Nearly twenty classmates gathered in a private room for dinner, reminiscing about their elementary school days with constant laughter. Yajing noticed a quietly smiling woman, struck up a conversation, and recognized her as her third-grade deskmate, Lin Wei. Lin Wei had quit her accounting job and become an independent children's book illustrator. The two caught up excitedly and shared their respective lives.
location: Private room at Changxi Private Kitchen, No. 118, Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

description: Before the meal ended, Yajing and Lin Wei added each other on WeChat and showed their illustrations and baked goods. Suddenly inspired, they agreed to hold an online Creative Exchange Plan every quarter to share new paintings and dessert or pairing ideas, with the first session scheduled for the end of next month.
location: A corner of a private room at Changxi Private Kitchen, No. 118 Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Said goodbye to classmates and drove to the clothing store
description: Yajing said goodbye to her classmates, especially hugging Lin Wei. She drove along Lujiang Road toward Zhongshan Road. The afternoon sun was blazing, and about 15 minutes later she arrived at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: The route from Changxi Private Kitchen at No. 118 Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store Inspection and Staff Communication
description: Yajing pushed open the shop door and saw the clerk Xiaomei professionally helping a customer try on a dress. Satisfied, she waited until the customer left before going over to praise Xiaomei, and they discussed tomorrow's delivery and next week's promotion plan. She felt pleased with the in-store displays.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle online customer maintenance and messages
description: Yajing sat in the store, replying to VIP group inquiries about outfit recommendations and browsing Moments, leaving a blessing on her friend Zhao Li's update that her mother had been moved out of the ICU. She also asked Xiao Mei to organize customer information from the flower pre-sale group so they could follow up on Monday.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Drove to the park to meet up with family
description: After finishing the store work, Yajing said goodbye to the staff, drove along Zhongshan Road and turned onto Zhenhai Road, and a few minutes later arrived at a parking lot near Jiaxingyuan Park, then walked into the park.
location: Driving route from Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family fun time at the park
description: Yajing found her husband and daughter on the park lawn and helped her daughter fly the kite; it finally took off. The family of three shared their experiences on the picnic mat. Yajing told the amusing story of her reunion with Lin Wei and showed Lin Wei's watercolor paintings, and Xuanxuan was captivated.
location: Lawn of Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping at a convenience store on the way home
description: After leaving the park, the family of three walked to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought whole wheat toast, milk, unsweetened oolong tea, seaweed rolls, and other snacks. Yajing also added beer and peanuts for her husband. Then they walked home.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: After returning home, Yajing changed into loungewear and drew a new kite pattern with her daughter using crayons on rice paper, sketching a cartoon puppy. As they drew, she listened to her daughter talk about fun moments at the park. Her husband checked the weather forecast nearby.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A light family dinner.
description: To balance out the hearty lunch, dinner was kept light. Her husband made tomato and basa fish soup; Yajing made a cucumber salad and stir-fried baby bok choy, and the staple was switched to sweet potatoes and corn. At the table, the two discussed their plan to go to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass next Sunday.
location: Home dining table, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Lin Wei quickly replied, promising to come up with the idea for the first painting as a gift next week. Afterwards, they took turns using the dishwasher to clean the dishes.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province
