Using the puppy kite she had drawn in the afternoon as a prop, she made up a story about a puppy flying into the sky and meeting a little bird. Her daughter gradually fell asleep during the story, and Yajing gave her a goodnight kiss.
location: Daughter's room in the family home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Self-care and art reading
description: Back in the master bedroom, her husband was already watching a game live stream with headphones on. Yajing went to the bathroom to remove her makeup, cleanse her face, and apply a face mask. Then she lay on the bed, opened her tablet, and read the autobiography of an illustration artist recommended by Lin Wei, gaining new insights into art.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gratitude journaling and evening relaxation
description: After removing the mask, Yajing opened her phone notes and wrote a gratitude journal, recording what she had learned from reuniting with an old friend, the competence of her store clerks, and the company of family, and summarizing her reflections on life. Afterwards, she did some light stretching and browsed autumn outfit combinations on social media for inspiration.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Yajing set her alarm for 7:00 the next morning, turned off the bedside lamp, and said goodnight to her husband. With gratitude for the day's wonderful experiences and anticipation for tomorrow, she soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning family time

Song Yajing got up, first weighed herself (48.5kg), then gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, braided her hair into two pigtails, and tied them with pink hair elastics. The family of three had breakfast with pure milk, whole wheat bread, freshly fried eggs, and blueberries. During the meal, Yajing reminded her husband Chen Zhiqiang to pick up Xuanxuan from school at 4 p.m. sharp; Aqiang nodded while eating his bread.
location: Room 302, No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Along the way, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about the fun of flying a kite yesterday, and Yajing listened with a smile. When they arrived at the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, Yajing squatted down to straighten her daughter's collar and watched her skip into the classroom.
location: Walk from No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commute to the store and shop along the way
description: Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes back to the convenience store at the Zhenhai Road metro station entrance, bought a spare folding umbrella and a box of mints. Then she unlocked a white electric scooter parked on the roadside, put on her helmet, and rode about 15 minutes to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Passed by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and finally arrived at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daily shop affairs and online customer service handling
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing wiped down the shelves and mopped the floor with store clerk Xiaomei. She opened her computer and entered last weekend's sales records into Excel, then replied to customers' questions about the autumn new arrivals one by one in WeChat communities, and reserved the new floral print dresses for three regular customers in the backend. Afterwards, she contacted supplier Susan to follow up on the delivery of the additional fitted floral print dresses ordered last Friday, and learned that they had been shipped from Guangzhou and were expected to arrive tomorrow.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Adjust window display
description: Taking advantage of the lull in customers, Song Yajing rearranged the store window. She paired the featured floral dress with a light-colored knit cardigan, used a floor clothing rack and artificial plants to create an early-autumn atmosphere, and repeatedly adjusted the angles of the mannequin's arms to increase foot traffic into the store.
location: In front of the storefront window of Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday light meal and social catch-up.
description: At 12 o'clock, Song Yajing heated the chicken breast salad (lettuce, cherry tomatoes, eggs, corn kernels) prepared last night in the microwave and made a cup of homemade mint fruit tea. She took a photo to record her second week of light eating, and sent a WeChat message to her elementary school deskmate Lin Wei, sharing her motivation for organizing the displays. The other person replied that she was refining the watercolor sketch of the old house.
location: Rest area inside Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon work.
description: A passing rain shower began to fall. Song Yajing reminded Xiao Mei to lay an anti-slip mat at the door and move the umbrella stand to a prominent place. With few customers in the afternoon, she browsed fashion bloggers' pages, screenshotted autumn outfits, and saved them as sharing material for the store's VIP group.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon store operations and customer reception
description: As the rain gradually let up, more customers entered the store. Song Yajing kept smiling as she served customers. She helped a middle-aged female customer put together two office outfits and recommended a wide belt to match a floral dress for a young girl. Meanwhile, she received a reply from Lin Wei saying she was inspired by her drive and that the sketch was almost done.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon tea break and work memo
description: When customers were few, Song Yajing let Xiaomei rest. She drank a glass of warm water, opened the calendar on her phone, marked tomorrow (August 19) as needing to follow up on order logistics, and reminded Aqiang to go to Gulangyu to attend Mass this Sunday.
location: Cashier counter at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparations for closing up.
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei checked today's sales; the revenue was slightly higher than a typical Monday, which was satisfying. She told Xiaomei to first organize the newly arrived summer clothes into storage and keep the anti-slip mats laid out tomorrow, then called Chen Zhiqiang to confirm he was already on his way to pick up Xuanxuan.
location: Cashier counter at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing up, resting, and preparing to set off
description: After seeing Xiao Mei off, Song Yajing locked the shop door and sent a voice message to her friend Zhao Li asking about her mother's condition. When she learned Zhao Li was still overwhelmed, her heart tightened. She quickly packed her bag, filled her thermos with hot water, and brought a few homemade mint tea bags before setting out.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Rode a scooter to Huli District.
description: Song Yajing put on her helmet, got on her white electric scooter, and merged into the evening traffic. She chose secondary roads such as Siming North Road and Huli Avenue to avoid congestion, checked the navigation when waiting at red lights, and was especially careful at every turn.
location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, along Siming North Road and Huli Avenue, to No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Support Zhao Li's floral design studio
description: Song Yajing arrived on time at Shaonian Youhua Flower Studio. Seeing Zhao Li looking tired, she washed her hands without a word and plunged into work: helping trim and sort newly arrived flowers, tying bouquets according to order requirements, replying to online customer messages, and also answering phone calls from Zhao Li's mother's caregiver. The two chatted while working, and Yajing brewed Zhao Li a cup of homemade mint tea, moving Zhao Li so much that her eyes reddened slightly. With their joint efforts, all orders were completed before 10 o'clock.
location: Shaonian Youhua (Zhao Li Florist Studio), No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li and telling her to rest early, Song Yajing rode her scooter back to Siming District in the night breeze. The streets were quiet with little traffic. When she arrived at the building, she folded the scooter and carried it upstairs.
location: Returning from No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Household wrap-up and personal care
description: After gently opening the door, she saw that the living room light was off, but the bedroom light was still on. Chen Zhiqiang was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone, and told her that Xuanxuan had already fallen asleep. Song Yajing felt tired and quickly took a shower. When she came out, she briefly told her husband about Zhao Li's situation. Aqiang patted her hand to comfort her. Yajing drank a glass of water, pushed the scooter to the corner, and plugged it in to charge.
location: Room 302, No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: After turning off the lights, Song Yajing did a five-minute pre-sleep meditation, focusing on her breathing to release fatigue, and organized the next day's work in her mind: following up on Susan's logistics, replying to Lin Wei on WeChat, and planning Moments content. After saying a quiet bedtime prayer, she fell asleep peacefully, filled with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time and getting ready to go out
description: At 7 a.m. the alarm went off, and I got up quietly; my daughter Xuanxuan was still fast asleep. I went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge and arranged Xuan Ma egg yolk pastries and homemade cranberry cookies on a plate. At 7:10 I woke Xuanxuan and put her hair into two neat ponytails. My husband Chen Zhiqiang also got up; today he was responsible for taking Xuanxuan to kindergarten. The three of us chatted while eating breakfast at the table. I reminded him to pick up Xuanxuan at 4 p.m. and reminded him that we were all going to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass this Sunday. After seeing my husband and daughter off, I hurried to get myself ready, changing into a cream-colored knit cardigan and khaki wide-leg pants, putting on light makeup, checking the electric scooter's battery, and picking a few fresh mint leaves from the balcony to add to my water glass, all set for the day's work and errands.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute, shop opening preparation, and booking a health checkup.
description: At 8:10, I got on my electric scooter and headed out. On the way, I stopped at the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought the mint candies I eat every day and a few dried lemon slices, and also grabbed a newly arrived small fan. Then I continued riding to the shop on Zhongshan Road. I arrived at the store at 8:30. The clerk Xiaomei was already waiting at the door. We silently divided the tasks: she wiped the display window and the cash register, while I watered the wrought-iron flower stand at the door and tidied the pothos plants. The air conditioning had been turned on early to drive away the muggy 35-degree heat. I opened my computer and checked yesterday's sales records with Xiaomei, then logged into WeChat to reply to several customers asking about the new autumn styles. At 9:15, while there were still few customers, I sent a message to my family doctor, Wang Mingyuan, to make an appointment for my annual checkup. He replied that 8:30 on the morning of August 25 was fine and that I needed to come on an empty stomach. I immediately recorded the appointment in my phone calendar and set a reminder. The health concerns I had put off for months were finally on the schedule.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shooting outfit content for the new autumn collection
description: With few customers in the store, it was the perfect time to shoot photos of the new arrivals. Xiao Mei and I cleared a clean backdrop area behind the fitting room and set up a tripod. I changed into the newly stocked floral wrap dress with a cinched waist, layered with a light knit cardigan, while Xiao Mei helped adjust the hem and lighting. We took turns shooting videos and photos of several outfits, carefully capturing a warm and stylish autumn vibe to build up plenty of material for the online pre-sale.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and logistics handling
description: At 11:15, the shooting ended. Xiaomei went out for lunch, and I stayed in the shop to look after it. I took the quinoa salad I had prepared last night out of the fridge—with chicken breast, avocado, and cherry tomatoes—drizzled with the vinaigrette Mrs. Liu recommended, and made a cup of mint lemon water. While eating, I arranged the past week's light meal photos into a nine-grid collage and posted it to the baking enthusiasts group, with the caption: “#Light Meal Check-in Week 2# Today's quinoa salad was learned from Mrs. Liu, and it tastes amazing!” The group immediately became lively. Mrs. Liu gave a quick like and shared her fat-loss recipe. Right after the meal, as I put down my bowl and chopsticks, I received a delivery notification on my phone. I opened the app and saw that the 60 waist-cinching floral dresses Susan had sent were marked as delivered. I went to the storeroom immediately, checked each box against the colors and quantities, and after confirming everything was correct, hung them neatly on shelves by size and color, marked the prices, and got ready to put them on sale before the summer clothing sales period ended.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business, handling exchanges, and preparing to close the store
description: In the afternoon, more customers came in, and Xiaomei came back to help. While I was recommending new styles to a regular customer, a young woman walked in and said impatiently that the size M dress she had bought online was too small and she wanted to exchange it for a size L. I recognized her as an online customer from a few days ago, smiled to reassure her, and patiently took her measurements. I found that it might be a fit issue, so I recommended another dress that suited her better. She tried it on and was very satisfied—not only did she exchange the dress, she also bought a matching belt. After 4 p.m., I let Xiaomei rest, and I sorted through the footage I had shot today, selecting photos and videos to post to the VIP customer group and Moments, with the caption “The first floral dress of autumn, save it to your wishlist early~”. Then I sent Zhao Li a voice message telling her I would arrive at the store around 5:30, and asked what she needed help with tonight and how her mother was doing. Afterward, I checked the scooter's battery level and put mint tea bags and a power bank into my bag. At 4:30, Xiaomei and I did the final pre-closing check, walking around the store to confirm the displays were neat, and I reminded her to put the newly arrived summer clothes into storage tomorrow and keep the afternoon's non-slip mat for now. At 5:00 sharp, I locked the store door.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the floral design studio
description: I put on my helmet, rode the scooter, and went along Siming North Road, turned onto Huli Avenue, and headed for Xinfeng Road in Huli District. On the way, I received a voice message from Zhao Li saying that her mother was in stable condition today and that she might arrive a bit later, asking me to help keep an eye on the orders first. I replied telling her to rest easy—I've got it. With the evening breeze carrying the melody of a hymn, I arrived at Shaonian Youhua Floristry Studio about 45 minutes later.
location: 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Assisted Zhao Li with her floral work.
description: Arrived at the flower studio at 5:45. After washing my hands, I immediately got to work: sorting the freshly arrived flowers and skillfully trimming the branches and leaves. There were quite a few orders tonight, and I completed tying 7 bouquets on my own. From the spiral technique to wrapping, my movements were smoother than yesterday. At the same time, I also responded to online customer inquiries promptly. When Zhao Li rushed back from the hospital at nearly 8:00, she saw the studio was well-organized and filled with the bouquets I had wrapped. Her eyes turned slightly red, and she kept thanking me.
location: 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Had dinner with Zhao Li
description: After finishing the last batch of orders, Zhao Li and I went to the familiar Shaxian Snacks at the corner of the street. We ordered two bowls of fragrant mixed noodles and a plate of blanched greens, eating and chatting. I asked about her mother's condition, and after learning that it had stabilized, I patted her on the shoulder and quietly listened as she talked. I also shared my small sense of accomplishment from completing a flower bouquet wrapping independently today, and both of us smiled.
location: 301-403 Malong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening commute home
description: At 8:50, I said goodbye to Zhao Li and told her to get some rest early. The night breeze was cool, so I got on my scooter and headed back. There were fewer and fewer cars on the street. I rode for about 40 minutes under the light and shadows of the street lamps. After reaching the entrance of the building, I folded up the scooter and carried it upstairs.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family evening chat and bedtime preparations
description: I opened the door quietly. A small night light was on in the living room, and the bedroom door was ajar. I peeked in and saw that my daughter Xuanxuan was fast asleep, while my husband Chen Zhiqiang was using the computer in the study. I took a quick shower, walked over to him, and briefly talked about the store today and Zhao Li's mother. I drank a glass of warm water, moved the scooter to the corner, and plugged it in to charge. Then I went back to the room, took out my diary, and wrote a gratitude journal: 1. Successfully booked the health checkup; a weight off my mind. 2. Helped Zhao Li make the bouquet and felt I had really improved. 3. The customer who came for an exchange was satisfied in the end and even bought a belt. After writing, I said a brief bedtime prayer, thanking God for today's peace and grace, then turned off the light, lay down, and drifted into sleep feeling fulfilled and hopeful.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and preparing for the family morning.
description: The alarm went off right at 7:00. I turned over and got out of bed gently, afraid of waking Aqiang. After washing up, I stepped on the scale—48.4 kg, the same as yesterday, which made me feel reassured. I quickly prepared breakfast: I steamed Xuanxuan's favorite custard buns and quail eggs, made instant coffee for myself and Aqiang, and toasted whole wheat bread. Then I pushed open Xuanxuan's door and called her in the softest voice, 'Xuanxuan, little princess, time to get up! Today we have your favorite little buns!'
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: We finished breakfast together, and I checked Xuanxuan’s little schoolbag to make sure nothing was left behind. Then I took her little hand and went downstairs, walking along the familiar Gucheng West Road to the kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan chattered like a little sparrow, saying that today there was an outdoor activity class. I smiled and reminded her to listen to the teacher and pay attention to safety. At the kindergarten gate, I watched her finish the morning health check, wave her little hand, and say “Bye-bye, Mommy,” and only then did I turn and leave.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Commute with a stop for supplies
description: After leaving the kindergarten, I didn’t hurry to the store. Instead, I walked to the convenience store at nearby Zhenhai Road Metro Station. I bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and a box of mint candies to refresh myself for this afternoon’s pre-order event. Then I skillfully unfolded the folding scooter at the roadside, put on my helmet, and rode smoothly along Siming North Road toward the store.
location: From the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Shop opening preparations and account verification
description: Around 8:20, I arrived at the store entrance, and Xiaomei had also just arrived. We pulled up the rolling shutter door and turned on the lights and air conditioner. I asked Xiaomei to clean and wipe the shelves first, while I turned on the computer at the checkout counter and quickly checked yesterday's sales records and cash flow. The accounts were clear and in order. I opened the curtains to let the morning sunlight in, and a new day began.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Launch a lighting initiative and call property management.
description: I sat down in the rest area, opened the photo album on my phone, and found several photos I had taken earlier of dark spots in the community's nighttime lighting. I first posted a message in the homeowners' group, attaching the photos and text, pointing out safety hazards such as the parking space corner and behind the flower bed at the north gate, and suggested installing motion-sensor streetlights. As soon as the message was sent, a few early-rising neighbors responded immediately. I then called Manager Zhang from the property management office and described the specific locations and lighting suggestions in detail. Manager Zhang was very agreeable and promised to arrange for a technician to inspect the site soon. After hanging up, I immediately shared the outcome of the call in the group.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Sent a caring WeChat message to her best friend.
description: After finishing the neighborhood matters, I remembered that Li Meiling said yesterday that her morning sickness was uncomfortable, so I sent a WeChat message: "Lingling, how are you today? Are you okay? I'm done here. Get some rest and don't eat anything too greasy." Soon, she replied with a sticker saying "still a bit dizzy." I said a few more words to reassure her, then put down my phone.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Organizing goods and online warm-up.
description: I asked Xiaomei to take out the 60 floral-print dresses that arrived last week, and we hung them by color in the newly created "Fall New Arrivals" section. As we hung the clothes, I was mentally working on the pre-order copy for noon. Around 11 o'clock, I asked Xiaomei to watch the front desk while I took several close-up shots of the dresses with my phone, including the unique collar design and try-on shots under the store's soft lighting, to make final preparations for the noon official promotion.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Launch limited-time pre-order for autumn new arrivals and lunch
description: At noon, I sat down in the rest area on time. I opened the carefully edited copy, images, and videos, and tapped send to the VIP community: "The first dress of autumn — we're wearing the whole garden! Pre-orders for the 2025 autumn 'Garden Stroll' collection are now open. Order before midnight tonight to enjoy a 10% discount, and the first 10 spots get priority shipping～". After sending, I opened the homemade light lunch I brought in the morning (quinoa avocado salad), eating while staring at my phone. People in the group had already started asking about sizes, so I immediately switched into work mode and replied to each one professionally.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (rest area) (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province)

name: Afternoon store hours and community interaction
description: In the afternoon, customers came into the store one after another. I enthusiastically recommended outfits to them while checking my phone in every spare moment. The number of inquiries in the VIP group surged. Vivian, a regular customer, directly @'d me in the group: "Yajing, keep three of those floral dresses for me, one in each color!" I immediately replied: "No problem, Vivian, I'll note it down for you!" It felt so good to be trusted. Meanwhile, I asked Xiaomei to lay the non-slip mat at the entrance again.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Sorting orders and reviewing business.
description: Taking advantage of the lull after the small rush of customers, I opened the pre-order dashboard on the cash register computer and counted the orders up to 3 p.m. — 12 orders! This result gave me a lift, especially Vivian's big order. I recorded the order details in my notebook and marked the customers who needed priority shipping. During a spare moment, I also browsed a few nearby light-meal delivery shops, planning to try a different flavor tomorrow.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Assist staff and prepare to depart
description: I noticed Xiaomei hesitating while recommending a skirt to a customer, so I stepped in and gave suggestions based on the customer's body type and skin tone, successfully closing the sale. After the customer left, I briefly exchanged styling tips with Xiaomei. Around 17:00, I checked the scooter battery (fully charged) and sent Zhao Li a voice message: 'Lili, I'm all packed up here and heading to your place. There are quite a few orders today, so I should be able to help share the load.'
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province).

name: Closing the shop and commuting to the next stop.
description: At 17:30, I explained tomorrow's shipping arrangements to Xiaomei and locked up the shop. I got on the electric scooter and put on my helmet. The sky was a bit overcast today, as if it was getting windy. I rode along the familiar route from Siming North Road to Huli Avenue. About 40 minutes later, I arrived at the office building where Zhao Li's studio is located around 6:10 p.m.
location: From Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) to Zhao Li Floristry Studio (No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Provide full support for Zhao Li's floral studio.
description: When I got to the store, Zhao Li, though tired, smiled gratefully when she saw me. Without another word, I washed my hands and put on an apron. Today's main job was to rush hand-tied bouquets for tomorrow's wedding clients. I skillfully helped her trim roses, pair eucalyptus leaves, and also completed three small hand-tied bouquets with delicate structures on my own. We chatted while working, encouraging each other.
location: Zhao Li Floristry Studio (2nd Floor, No. 205, Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Dinner together and comfort from friends
description: A little past eight, we took a short break and went to the Shaxian snack shop at the entrance for a simple meal. I ordered a bowl of wonton and a plate of mixed noodles, and listened as Zhao Li talked about her mother's recovery. I didn't offer any high-minded advice; I just listened quietly, nodding occasionally, giving her an emotional outlet.
location: Authentic Shaxian Snacks (Malong Road) (301-403 Malong Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Returning to the studio to wrap up and say goodbye.
description: After eating, I returned to the studio and helped Zhao Li check and package each of today's completed orders one by one, then cleaned the workbench. I took a moment to glance at my phone; several late-night inquiries had appeared in the VIP group, and I patiently replied to them all. At exactly 10 p.m., all work was wrapped up. I urged Zhao Li to rest early and not forget to soak her feet. Then I hopped on my scooter and hurried home in the night breeze.
location: Zhao Li Floristry Studio (2nd Floor, No. 205, Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Returning home, washing up, and family warmth
description: At 22:40, I got home. The living room light was left on for me, and a bowl of hot soup sat on the dining table under a thermal cover. A Qiang heard me and came out of the bedroom, saying softly, “You're back? Xuanxuan is already asleep. Drink the soup while it's hot.” I felt a warmth in my heart. I quickly took a shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, then sat at the table and slowly sipped the pork rib soup A Qiang had kept for me. Much of my fatigue instantly melted away.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community (Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian)

name: Gratitude journal, evening prayer, and going to bed
description: After finishing the soup, I returned to the bedroom, took out my diary, and wrote down the three things I was most grateful for today: 1. The lighting initiative received positive responses from neighbors and property management; 2. The first day of autumn new-product preorders brought in 12 orders, an encouraging result; 3. My husband's considerate hot soup and silent support. Closing the diary, I made the sign of the cross on my chest and said a quiet bedtime prayer, grateful for everything today. After the prayer, I turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully at 23:30, amid my husband's even breathing, feeling content and a little tired.
location: Bedroom at No. 82 Shanggu Street Community (Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Family morning time
description: The alarm went off in the early morning; after lingering in bed for a while, she got up and washed up while a light rain fell outside. After weighing herself, she prepared breakfast for the family and had white congee and fried eggs with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. During the meal, they discussed the day's arrangements. Her husband promised to pick up their daughter after school. She reminded her daughter to drink more water at kindergarten and checked her schoolbag.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Taking her daughter to kindergarten
description: The family of three walked with umbrellas to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she again tidied her daughter's collar and reminded her to drink plenty of water, and watched until her daughter was led into the classroom by the teacher before leaving. Her husband then went directly to work.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and supply runs.
description: Walked from the kindergarten to the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought sugar-free oolong tea and mint candies, and picked up a spare folding umbrella. Then rode an electric scooter along the quiet early-morning streets to the store.
location: Convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Batch process pre-orders
description: After arriving at the store, checked 12 pre-orders with shop assistant Xiaomei, picked and packed goods from the warehouse, and inspected them with ironing. Handwrote thank-you cards for three regular customers and enclosed them in the packages. At 11:30 called SF Express to come pick up, helped verify the packages, and sent them all out.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Light lunch and rest
description: While Xiaomei was out, I ate my homemade chicken breast salad in the store's rest area. As I ate, I scrolled through my phone, saw a new recipe shared in the baking group, and saved it. After the meal, I closed my eyes and rested for over ten minutes.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recording business data and analysis
description: After the lunch break, she copied recent pre-order data into a dedicated notebook and analyzed best-selling styles and customer preferences. She found that the lapel-collar double-breasted trench coat and the openwork knit cardigan were very popular, and based on this, she compiled a list of specific styles and sizes that needed restocking.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contacting suppliers and afternoon business
description: Contacted supplier Susan via WeChat to inform her that autumn trench coats and knitwear need additional orders and restocking, asked about arrival times, and inquired about new-season trends. During business hours, greeted customers in the store, posted packing tips on Moments, and reminded Xiaomei to lay down non-slip mats. At 15:50 received a call from her husband and learned that her daughter had a slightly elevated temperature; she was getting ready to pick her up and go home.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the store in an emergency and went home.
description: After learning that her daughter had a fever, she decided to close the shop early and left Xiaomei to handle the closing tasks. Riding an electric scooter with an umbrella through the light rain, she hurried home and reached the building entrance about 25 minutes later.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Caring for daughter with a fever
description: After arriving home, I took over the care duties. My daughter's temperature had risen to 38.2. I gave her fever medicine and applied physical cooling, then held her and softly told her the story of Dumbo. After the medicine took effect, her temperature dropped to 37.6, and she fell into a deep sleep. I talked quietly with my husband in the living room, and we decided to go and help our friend once our daughter was settled.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Set off to support a friend.
description: After her daughter fell asleep soundly, she reminded her husband to check her temperature regularly, put on her raincoat, and rode her scooter to Zhao Li's flower studio in Huli District. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh, so she went along North Siming Road and turned onto Huli Avenue.
location: Shaonian Youhua Flower Studio, No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Assist with corporate group purchase orders
description: After arriving at the studio, she worked in cooperation with Zhao Li. She carefully verified the details of group-buy orders from several companies, including flower quantities, styles, delivery addresses, and notes, merged orders from the same residential community, and marked urgent orders. During this time, Zhao Li received a call from the caregiver and learned that her mother's condition had fluctuated; she was anxious and uneasy. She comforted her softly and promised to come help again tomorrow. In the end, all the verification was completed.
location: Shaonian Youhua Flower Studio, No. 205 Xinfeng Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home late at night and pre-bedtime activities
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, she rode her scooter home and arrived around 10 p.m. Learning that her daughter's fever had broken, she washed up and changed into loungewear. In the study, she wrote in her gratitude journal, recorded three things she was grateful for, and prayed softly. Then she got into bed and flipped through a fashion magazine for about ten minutes. At 11 p.m. she turned off the light, planned the next day's tasks in her mind, and fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Morning family time and the school run.
description: After waking up naturally, she took her daughter's temperature and confirmed the fever had gone down, then measured her weight: 48.6 kg. She prepared breakfast: sweet potato porridge, fried eggs, and milk. She woke her daughter, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and braided her hair. The family of three ate breakfast; she reminded her daughter to drink more water, and her husband mentioned stewing pork rib soup in the evening. She walked her daughter to kindergarten and then left.
location: Home (Room 502, Building 3, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Returning home and preparing for commute
description: Walked home, wheeled the electric scooter out of the hallway, checked the battery, brought eco-friendly shopping bags, put on a sun hat and sunscreen, organized my belongings, then rode the scooter to the store.
location: Home (No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Morning work period at the store
description: After arriving at the shop, I opened up with clerk Xiao Mei, tidied the shelves, moved the autumn trench coats and knitwear to the prime display area based on pre-order data, and checked the previous day's revenue. Then I replied to customer inquiries on WeChat and posted a Moments notice that the shop would close early in the afternoon. I called Manager Zhang of the property management office to confirm the plan to install 4 LED sensor streetlights in the community. Later, during the morning rush, I received customers, successfully sold a khaki trench coat set, and reserved a knit cardigan for a regular customer. After stepping out to purchase supplies and returning to the shop, I posted the lighting plan confirmation in the owners' group and replied to neighbors.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Buying macaron ingredients and picking up supplies on the way.
description: Rode the scooter to a baking ingredient store and bought almond flour, powdered sugar, liquid egg whites, and a silicone mat. The owner gave me a sample of vanilla pods. On the way back, I bought unsweetened oolong tea and mint candies at the convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station to restock the store.
location: Xiao Su Baking Ingredients Store (No. 22, Section 1, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, near Hubin Yili) Zhenhai Road Metro Station Convenience Store (No. 35-101, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Lunch break and afternoon work handover
description: Ate the homemade quinoa, shrimp, and avocado salad for lunch, while watching a macaron recipe video and noting key points. After a 15-minute nap, she took stock of inventory with Xiaomei, gave instructions for closing the shop in the afternoon, and sent her sister a WeChat message to tell her the pickup time.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store rest area (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Closing the shop, receiving customers, and preparing to leave.
description: Finally received a customer on lunch break, recommended and sold an A-line skirt. Counted the cash register and recorded the accounts, then briefed Xiaomei on closing tasks. Rode a scooter home, changed clothes, reapplied sunscreen, brought homemade lemon mint water, and used a mobile app to hail a ride to Xiamen North Station.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) Home (82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Going to Xiamen North Station to reunite with her sisters.
description: I took a ride-hailing car to Xiamen North Railway Station, feeling excited along the way. After arriving, I walked quickly to the exit and, when I saw my sister, smiled and hugged her in greeting. She said there was a little moisture in my eyes, and I handed her the homemade lemonade. The two of us chatted warmly.
location: Xiamen North Railway Station Exit (No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Return trip and haircuts with sisters
description: Taking an express ride back to the city from Xiamen North Station, her sister told her how much she understood her, which moved her deeply. She made a spur-of-the-moment decision to get a haircut and asked the driver to stop at the barbershop on Zhongshan Road. Under the hands of a familiar barber, she had her hair cut short to shoulder length, and her sister also had her bangs trimmed. They took photos to remember the moment, and she felt a weight lifted.
location: Harajuku Styling (near the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Dazhong Road, on the Dazhong Road side, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Walking to dinner and having a deep talk with sisters.
description: After getting a haircut, strolled on Zhongshan Road and called to book a restaurant. At the A Dai Ginger Duck Restaurant, they enjoyed dinner such as ginger duck and soy-sauce yellow croaker. While peeling shrimp, they shared their life and growth over the past six months, and her sister praised her insight and maturity.
location: Adai Ginger Duck (No. 332-101 Datong Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province)

name: Returning home from a walk and enjoying warm family time.
description: After dinner, walked home and sent husband a voice message to let him know where she was. When she got home, her daughter happily greeted her sister, and they played with puzzles and picture books together. Prepared the guest room for her sister, and her husband brought out pork rib soup, and the family shared the warm soup together.
location: Home (Room 502, Building 3, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Late-night girl talk with close friends and bedtime gratitude
description: After her daughter and husband fell asleep, the two sisters lay in bed talking about childhood, family, and the future, confiding in each other about their pressures and joys. After her elder sister fell asleep, she quietly reflected on the day, felt grateful and prayed, felt understood and healed, and fell asleep content.
location: Master bedroom at home (Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Wake up in the early morning to prepare breakfast and see off my sister.
description: Song Yajing was woken by her alarm clock in the early morning. After washing up, she went into the kitchen, steamed the sweet potatoes, heated the milk, and checked the temperature of the red date tea she had prepared for her sister Song Yawen. She then lightly tapped on her sister's door, and after confirming she was ready, returned to the master bedroom to gently urge her husband Aqiang and daughter Xuanxuan to get up. At the dining table, the family enjoyed a breakfast of steamed sweet potatoes, boiled eggs, and hot milk. Her sister praised the sweet potatoes for being sweet, and Xuanxuan acted cute and asked to be fed by her mother, only to be stopped by Aqiang with a smile. During the meal, Yajing talked with her sister about their heart-to-heart talk the night before and asked whether she had forgotten any luggage, while Aqiang looked at the route to Xiamen Station on his phone. Again, her sister pushed a box of chocolates to Yajing and told her to take better care of herself. The atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family drove to Xiamen Station to see off her elder sister, who was returning to Shenzhen.
description: Ah Qiang drove, Yajing rode in the passenger seat, and Yajing's sister and Xuanxuan sat in the back. Xuanxuan pestered Yajing's sister to tell the story of seeing snow in Shenzhen last time, and the car was filled with laughter. After arriving at the South Square of Xiamen Railway Station, Ah Qiang went to park the car, while Yajing and Xuanxuan walked her sister into the waiting hall. The three of them waved goodbye through the glass. Her sister mouthed the words 'Take care of yourself.' Yajing's eyes grew slightly moist as she watched her sister leave, reluctant to part but wishing her well.
location: Xiamen Railway Station, No. 900 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home to tidy up and prepare baking materials.
description: On the way home from Xiamen Station, Yajing gradually calmed down and began to plan today's baking session. After arriving home, Aqiang took Xuanxuan to the room to change clothes and get ready to go out. Yajing neatly cleared the dishes and cleaned the kitchen. She then opened the refrigerator and took out the pre-purchased almond flour, powdered sugar, aged egg whites, and silicone mat, and carefully reviewed the experiment notes from previous failed attempts, gaining a sense of how much her home oven's temperature deviates.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Her husband took their daughter out, and Yajing made her first macaron attempt but hit a snag.
description: Aqiang put a sun hat on Xuanxuan and rode the electric bike to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park to play in the water. Yajing put on an apron alone and began making macarons. Strictly following the steps taught by her master, she mixed the batter, tinted it a soft pink-orange, and carefully squeezed it into the piping bag. When the first tray went into the oven, she deliberately lowered the temperature by 5 degrees, but when she took it out at 11:15, the macaron shells had cracked tops and no feet—another failure.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Calmly analyze the reasons for failure, adjust the approach, and try again
description: Faced with the failure, Yajing was not discouraged. She quickly used her phone to take photos of the failed macarons and sent them to the baking group for help. Then she tested the oven with a thermometer and found that the internal temperature was 10 degrees higher than the setting. Following the suggestions from friends in the group, she lowered the temperature to 130 degrees and placed an empty baking pan on the lower rack to insulate it. After getting back in the right frame of mind, she weighed the ingredients again, whipped the egg whites, and started making a second tray of macarons.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The second batch of macarons turned out perfectly, and she excitedly shared them.
description: Yajing brought a stool over and sat in front of the oven to watch. After about 12 minutes, the feet slowly appeared, and she was so excited she almost jumped up. After they were out of the oven and cooled, a plate of perfect macarons with a pinkish-orange color and full, even feet appeared before her eyes. She immediately took photos and posted them to her Moments and the baking group with the caption 'I! DID! IT!', and privately messaged her mentor Master Chen and her friend Mrs. Liu to share the joy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The family sat together tasting macarons, sharing the sweetness.
description: Aqiang brought Xuanxuan home covered in sweat, and they smelled the sweet aroma filling the house. Xuanxuan ran into the kitchen and exclaimed, “Mom is a superhero!” Yajing poured cold-brewed tea for everyone, and the family sat around the coffee table tasting macarons. Xuanxuan ate two in a row, and Aqiang praised them as being as good as the ones from a cake shop. Proudly, Yajing shared the twists and turns of the process and her successful tips, and the room was filled with laughter and joy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Clean, put away, and pack the macarons to get ready to go out.
description: Yajing scrubbed the kitchen thoroughly and washed all the baking utensils. She selected 8 of the prettiest macarons, carefully packed them in an oil-paper box to bring to her friend Zhao Li, and kept a few in an airtight jar for the family's breakfast the next day. Then she returned to the bedroom, changed into a light floral-print dress, applied sunscreen, checked the electric scooter's battery, and finally placed the macaron box carefully into a canvas tote bag.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the clothing store to update the autumn window display.
description: Yajing rode her electric scooter along Zhenhai Road to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Together with shop assistant Xiaomei, she changed the mannequins from summer clothes to the autumn pre-order styles: an oat-colored knit cardigan and high-waisted khaki wide-leg pants. Yajing personally adjusted the mannequin poses and the spotlight angles, while Xiaomei took photos from different angles beside her. Passing customers were attracted by the new window display and came in to ask.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rest at the store and handle online orders and customer inquiries
description: When the customer flow slowed down, Yajing rested on a bar stool behind the cashier counter, and Xiaomei handed her a cup of iced fruit tea. She posted the newly taken autumn new arrival photos to the customer group and WeChat Moments, with the caption "The first coat of autumn is waiting for you~", then replied one by one to customers' inquiries about pre-sale sizes and shipping times.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to Zhao Li's floral studio to help and shared macarons.
description: Yajing rode her electric scooter to the floral design studio in a ground-floor shop at Jiaxingyuan Residential Community, where Zhao Li was busy with the next day's wedding order. After washing her hands skillfully, Yajing began helping trim stems, remove thorns, and make spiral bouquets. The two only rested after 8 p.m. Yajing opened a box and handed over macarons; Zhao Li was so moved that her eyes turned red after tasting them. The two chatted about recent news over tea, and afterward Yajing continued helping arrange flowers and clean the workbench.
location: Zhao Li Floristry Studio, ground-floor shop, Jiaxing Garden Community, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daily necessities on the way home.
description: It was almost 10 p.m. when she left the studio. Riding her scooter past Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Yajing went into the convenience store, bought a carton of fresh milk and a bag of whole wheat sliced bread, and also took a pack of spicy beef jerky that A Qiang loved, as a reward for his hard work taking care of the kids. After paying, she walked back to the residential community.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, wash up, and do the evening skincare routine
description: Yajing walked in quietly and found the lights off in Xuanxuan's room, while Aqiang was scrolling on his phone in the living room. She put the milk and bread in the fridge and the beef jerky on the coffee table, then went back to the bedroom for a quick shower and shampoo, and carefully applied body lotion and serum. Feeling pleased after successfully baking macarons, she was especially patient even with her skincare routine.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Nightly chat with her husband and planning the next day's schedule
description: After Aqiang entered the bedroom, Yajing leaned against the headboard and told him about the ups and downs of making macarons that day and how touched Zhao Li was when she ate the dessert. Aqiang shared that he had seen a notice in the park about a thank-you letter regarding the community owners' committee's lighting plan. The two chatted casually, and Yajing casually browsed autumn outfits on her phone, planning the matching photos and text for tomorrow's new arrivals.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fell asleep peacefully, completely content
description: After turning off the desk lamp, the room quieted down. Yajing felt warm inside, full of pride at overcoming the baking challenge and the warmth given by family and friends. She said softly to A Qiang, 'Today was really nice,' and with that peace, she soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up, prepare breakfast, and do the morning preparations
description: The phone alarm rang. Song Yajing got up gently and kissed her daughter Xuanxuan, who was still fast asleep. After washing up, she drank a glass of warm water as usual. Today was Sunday, so she specially prepared a hearty breakfast for the family: pan-fried bacon, sunny-side-up eggs, toasted bread, and hot milk. At the same time, she carefully packed the 8 macarons that had been successfully baked yesterday — 4 to give to Aunt Lin and 4 to keep for sharing.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Helping daughter wash up and get dressed, having breakfast together as a family.
description: She gently woke Xuanxuan, helped her change into a white dress, and put her hair in a neat bun. The family of three sat around the dining table. Her husband Aqiang planned to rest today and fix the ceiling light in the study. Song Yajing reminded him to buy sea fish for steaming at noon. While eating, she softly taught Xuanxuan a short prayer: "Thank the Lord for giving us today's daily bread."
location: Daughter's bedroom and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Departing and commuting to Gulangyu Island.
description: It was hot, so Song Yajing decided to drive to Dongdu Cruise Center Terminal. She put her tote bag (containing a Bible, a wallet, a water bottle, and macarons) in place, took Xuanxuan by the hand, and went downstairs. On the way, Xuanxuan curiously asked about the elevated bridges outside the window, and Song Yajing patiently answered. After parking, they took the early ferry, and the sea breeze on their faces refreshed their spirits.
location: From the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Dongdu Cruise Center Pier, then take a ferry to Gulangyu

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: She arrived early at the Gulangyu Catholic Church and sat in her usual spot in the front. The Mass was led by Father Wang Mingde. Song Yajing was fully immersed, singing hymns and praying, her heart filled with peace. Xuanxuan looked curiously at the stained glass and the holy images, and Song Yajing gently guided her. When receiving Communion, she felt the fatigue and anxiety of the week being washed away, and gained inner tranquility.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Had a heart-to-heart talk in the courtyard with Aunt Lin, a fellow church member.
description: After Mass, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying, who was watering flowers in the courtyard, and the two sat on a stone bench and talked. Song Yajing confided that she had been busy lately between stocking the new arrivals at the shop and supporting Zhao Li, and that she felt she had let her family down. Aunt Lin comforted her kindly: “You are practicing charity in action, and that is a good thing. When you are tired, pray more; don't carry it all by yourself.” Song Yajing quietly put the macarons she had brought into Aunt Lin's basket.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Catholic Church courtyard

name: On the way back, stopped by Longtou Road on Gulangyu Island.
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Lin, she turned with Xuanxuan into the bustling Longtou Road. They had a steaming bowl of fish ball soup at 'Linji Fish Balls'. Xuanxuan took a liking to a shell-clay photo frame at a handmade craft shop, and Song Yajing happily bought it, promising to make it together at home. The mother and daughter strolled around leisurely, enjoying the rare time alone, and then took a ferry back from Piano Pier.
location: No. 8 Longtou Road, Gulangyu Waves Folk Boutique Street and the Longtou Road area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home, buying supplies on the way.
description: On the drive home from Dongdu Wharf, she remembered Aqiang said fixing the light needed electrical tape, so she stopped at a convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought a roll of electrical tape and a bottle of soy sauce. After getting home, she had Xuanxuan change shoes and wash hands first.
location: Convenience store at 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; home at 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family lunch
description: Aqiang had lunch ready: steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and seaweed egg drop soup. Song Yajing praised his cooking and shared her experiences on Gulangyu Island. Aqiang said he had successfully fixed the lamp and had also handled a small glitch at the company remotely. Xuanxuan couldn't wait to show off her new photo frame, and the family of three was full of joy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Accompanying my daughter during her afternoon nap.
description: After dinner, Xuanxuan became sleepy. Song Yajing read two pages of The Little Mermaid to her, and she soon fell into a deep sleep. Song Yajing gently closed the door, leaving a crack open.
location: Daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling store and personal matters.
description: She brewed a cup of flower tea and set her phone to Do Not Disturb. She checked the weekend foot traffic and sales report sent by store assistant Xiaomei, and replied online to inquiries from several VIP customers. Then she opened her tablet, browsed new posts from fashion bloggers for autumn outfit inspiration, and noted the styling plan "relaxed knit sweater + high-waisted wide-leg pants" in her memo. She also took out her newly bought Macaron Bible and carefully studied the recipe variations for lemon-basil and Earl Grey tea flavors, making pencil annotations in the margins.
location: Living room and study at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family craft time
description: After Xuanxuan woke up, the family of three opened the shell photo frame craft kit and sat cross-legged on the floor mat to get creative. Xuanxuan carefully applied glue, Aqiang clumsily pasted the shells askew and then re-pasted them, while Song Yajing guided from the side. The finished piece was proudly placed by Xuanxuan in the most prominent spot in the living room.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: Song Yajing and A Qiang prepared dinner together, stir-fried a plate of greens, and reheated the soup from lunch. After a simple meal, they cleared the table together and cut up a plate of Hami melon. The whole family watched TV while eating the fruit.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Support Zhao Li and accompany her through her breakdown night.
description: She boxed the carefully prepared macarons and drove to Zhao Li's floral design studio. The studio was a bit messy, so Song Yajing helped deal with the remaining bouquet orders and tidied the desk. After they finished around 9 PM, Zhao Li suddenly broke down in tears and poured out her marital misery. Song Yajing quietly stayed with her, handed her tissues, and listened attentively for over two hours without judging, offering support through warm looks and gentle pats on the back. She also shared how she relieved stress through prayer and walks, and promised, "No matter what happens, I will be by your side." Near midnight, Zhao Li's emotions calmed a little. Song Yajing helped lock the studio door and drove her back to her residence at Xiamen University student apartments.
location: Zhao Li Floral Art Studio, inside Shapowei Art West Zone, No. 60 Shapowei, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Xiamen University Student Apartments, Zengcuo'an Xili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home late at night and went to sleep.
description: After sending Zhao Li to her place, Song Yajing drove alone on the empty streets. Her heart felt heavy, and she ached for Zhao Li, but she was firmly determined to stay by her side. When she got home, she opened the door quietly, saw her sleeping husband and daughter, and felt a complex sense of peace. After a simple wash-up, she lay in bed reviewing the full and eventful day, and fell into a deep sleep before midnight.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early-morning wake-up, breakfast, and family interaction
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally before her alarm. After a quick wash, she prepared for the health checkup and left a note for her husband Chen Zhiqiang reminding him to take their daughter Chen Lexuan to school and bring the handmade craft. Then her husband and daughter got up. Song Yajing only ate two slices of whole wheat bread and warm water (because she needed to fast for the checkup). At the table, she repeatedly reminded her husband and daughter to bring the paper cup penguin craft today, helped wipe a milk stain off her daughter, and kissed her daughter.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the physical examination center for a full check-up
description: Song Yajing took her ID card and medical insurance card, rode an electric scooter along Siming North Road, Xiahe Road, and Jiahe Road to Huli Avenue, and arrived at Huli District Community Health Service Center after about 35 minutes. After registering on the first floor, she went to the second floor to have her height, weight, and blood pressure measured. Nurse Xiao Chen skillfully drew three tubes of blood. During the wait, she used her phone to check the shop's backend data and replied to VIP customer messages on WeChat. Then she went to the third floor for an abdominal ultrasound and an electrocardiogram. The ultrasound showed her liver, gallbladder, and other organs were in good condition, and the ECG was normal. After all the examinations, she took the reports to Dr. Wang Mingyuan for interpretation. The doctor told her all core indicators were normal—blood sugar, blood lipids, and complete blood count all showed no problems—but noted that prolonged sitting had caused the natural curve in her lumbar spine to straighten, and advised her to do more stretching exercises such as the little swallow exercise. After learning the results, Song Yajing finally let go of her worries and felt happy.
location: Huli District Community Health Service Center, 120 Huli Avenue, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stop at a convenience store on the way home, and work out a health plan and lunch.
description: After the physical exam, Song Yajing rode her scooter back the same way in a relaxed mood. Passing Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought 3M electrical tape, blueberries, and unsweetened yogurt at a convenience store. When she got back to the residential complex, she charged the scooter. At home, she changed out of her sportswear and solemnly wrote down her physical exam summary and health plan in the study: weight 48.3 kg, exam normal, lumbar spine needs attention. She made a plan to take a 30-minute walk after dinner every day and do 15 minutes of stretching on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, then posted the schedule on the refrigerator. Afterward, she made a simple lunch with yogurt, blueberries, and whole wheat bread.
location: Room 602, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; via the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, 35-101 Zhenhai Road.

name: Lunch break and household tidying
description: After lunch, Song Yajing put the dirty clothes into the washing machine, then leaned back on the living room sofa and scrolled on her phone. She saw a video posted in the family group chat by her aunt of her daughter Chen Lexuan playing in the yard and couldn't help smiling. At 13:00 the alarm rang, and she got up to get ready to go to the shop.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the store and handled store business.
description: Song Yajing changed into a black A-line skirt, put on a choker, applied lipstick, and rode her scooter to the Yajing Life Gallery at 56 Zhongshan Road. After arriving, she dealt with 11 online orders that had piled up over the weekend together with Xiaomei, checking addresses and styles and packing them. She discussed with Xiaomei a plan to change the window display next Saturday to showcase the new autumn trench coats and knit cardigans sent by Sister Susan from Guangzhou. Then she organized the shelves and received two young female customers, recommending high-waisted wide-leg pants, ankle-length cigarette pants, and silk blouses to them; she successfully sold two outfits and added them on WeChat. After the customers left, she counted the cash, watered the pothos, reminded Xiaomei to close the door punctually at six in the evening, and then got ready to leave.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the flower studio to accompany my best friend Zhao Li
description: Song Yajing rode her scooter along Daxue Road to the Shapowei Art District and arrived at Zhao Li's Huajian Art Studio. Zhao Li was sitting at the door trimming rose thorns and was very happy to see Song Yajing. Zhao Li told her that her mother had been moved to a regular ward and could drink rice soup. The two trimmed the newly arrived lisianthus and roses together, chatting while arranging flowers. Zhao Li shared her plan to convert the back part of the studio into a floral salon area for teaching flower arranging, and Song Yajing strongly agreed. The studio was filled with the scent of flowers and hope.
location: Zhao Li Huajian Art Studio, No. 63, Shapowei Art Zone, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter and walk home.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, Song Yajing sped up on her scooter and rushed to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving on time at 18:20. Her daughter Chen Lexuan ran out of the kindergarten happily, showing off her drawing "A Family of Three Collecting Seashells at the Beach." Song Yajing squatted down to hug and kiss her daughter, and then the mother and daughter walked home hand in hand along Gucheng West Road, with Chen Lexuan chattering about funny things at kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and evening parent-child time
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared dinner. Song Yajing helped pick vegetables and serve rice. Dinner included braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed eggplant with garlic sauce, and winter melon and pork rib soup. The family of three sat around the table, and Song Yajing shared the good news that her health check-up was normal. Her husband toasted with soup in place of wine. After dinner, her husband did the dishes, while Song Yajing helped her daughter stick her paintings on the refrigerator door, and together they watched a documentary about marine life. Later, she helped her daughter take a bath and change into pajamas. Leaning by the bed, she read 'The Little Prince' to her. Her daughter said she wanted to take care of her mother just like the Little Prince took care of his rose. Moved, Song Yajing kissed her daughter on the forehead. At 20:40, the daughter fell asleep.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal relaxation, reading, and going to bed
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing did a 15-minute evening yoga session in the living room, then took a shower and put on a face mask. When she lay down, she sent the news of her normal physical examination results to her best friends' group chat, confirmed the situation with Zhao Li on WeChat, and then flipped through the magazine Coffee Slow Life. At 22:30, her husband came into the room. She wrote a summary of the day in her diary, then dimmed the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 602, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family activity
description: The alarm went off at 6:55 in the morning. Feeling that her back was a bit lighter than yesterday, Yajing got out of bed quietly without waking her sleeping husband. She first went to the kitchen to boil water, then washed up in the bathroom and carefully applied skincare products, nodding approvingly at the mirror. Afterward, she prepared a quick breakfast in the kitchen: boiled small wontons with seaweed and dried shrimp, fried two sunny-side-up eggs, and warmed up milk. While cooking, she checked the weather forecast on her phone and learned that it would be sunny turning cloudy during the day with light rain at night, so she silently made room for her raincoat. At 7:45, she opened her daughter Xuanxuan's door and gently woke her, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into double braids. The mother and daughter then sat at the dining table and finished breakfast together. At 8:15, her husband Aqiang got up to pack his suitcase. She helped check the charger and documents for the business trip, and mentioned that the light at the entrance was too dim and she wanted to buy a smart doorbell. Aqiang readily agreed. The two hugged goodbye and told each other to take care on the road.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school, go shopping, and head to the store
description: Set off on the electric scooter with Xuanxuan. The morning breeze was pleasant, and Xuanxuan hummed the new song she had learned yesterday along the way, making Song Yajing feel warm inside. At 8:35, they arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She watched her daughter greet her teacher and classmates and then walk into the classroom. Afterwards, on the way, she stopped at a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and bought the colored cardstock and child-safe scissors Xuanxuan had been asking for. At 8:45, she continued riding the scooter from the stationery store to the store on Zhongshan Road. With the breeze brushing her face, she mentally planned the day's key tasks: taking inventory, planning the spring clothing promotion, and sorting out the smart doorbell.
location: From the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, via Siming Experimental Kindergarten (123 Gucheng West Road) and Gongyuan South Road Stationery Store (Phase 2, Yubincheng, 35 Gongyuan South Road) to Yajing Lifestyle Store, 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Arrive at the shop to prepare and conduct the spring inventory count.
description: After arriving at the store, she parked the scooter, opened the door, turned on the lights and the air conditioner, quickly cleaned the floor inside, and rearranged the clothing displays to make the window display fresher. She watered the potted plants in the corner, turned on the cash register computer, and logged into the WeChat work account. After Xiaomei arrived, they began taking inventory of the spring stock. They checked the physical items against the computer records, pulled out the spring dresses and blouses with incomplete sizes or dated styles, and hung them together in the “Summer Prelude Spring Clearance Area” at the entrance. Yajing guided Xiaomei to attach discount tags to attract passersby.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online operations guidance and customer interaction.
description: Taking advantage of the sparse customer flow in the store, she took the time to personally teach Xiaomei how to run the customer group more actively, taught her to pair attractive captions with photos, had her try posting a few spring clearance posts with images and text in the group, and encouraged her to proactively message a few VIP regular customers privately. Xiaomei was a bit shy at first, but did very well with encouragement.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch, smart doorbell order, and short rest
description: With Xiaomei having gone to lunch first, she watched the store alone, opening an e-commerce app on her phone to compare several smart doorbells, focusing on night vision, doorbell volume, and remote viewing via phone. She decisively ordered a video doorbell with comprehensive features and stable connectivity, chose next-day delivery, and after paying sent a screenshot of the order to her husband, who was on a business trip. After Xiaomei came back, she went to the dessert shop next door, bought an iced Americano and a croissant, ate them quickly to recharge, then returned to the store, leaned back on the small sofa in the corner, and rested with her eyes closed for fifteen minutes to regain energy.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store operations and customer reception
description: In the afternoon, the number of customers gradually increased. Acting as a professional stylist, I warmly greeted every customer. I successfully put together a shirt and wide-leg trousers suitable for commuting for a young woman, and recommended a floral print dress suitable for vacation to a regular customer. During this time, I took the opportunity to screenshot several messages Xiao Mei had posted in the group and send them to the close friends' group chat, praising her for becoming more and more impressive, and proactively led several waves of group discussion.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up my daughter from school and buying groceries on the way home.
description: After telling Xiao Mei to mind the store, I packed my bag in advance, rode my electric scooter, and hurried to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. I picked up my daughter Xuanxuan, and the little one excitedly showed off today's painting from kindergarten, so I praised her. Then I took her along to a convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought tomatoes, eggs, a bunch of greens, and a small pack of frozen dumplings, planning to make tomato and egg noodles for dinner. The two of us continued riding home, with Xuanxuan humming a nursery rhyme she had just learned. I felt especially warm and settled inside.
location: From Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (123 Gucheng West Road), then via the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (35-101 Zhenhai Road) to the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street

name: Dinner preparation and parent-child evening time
description: After getting home, she first let Xuanxuan watch fifteen minutes of cartoons in the living room, then quickly went into the kitchen to wash and chop tomatoes and beat eggs. After the water boiled, she put in the noodles and cooked two steaming bowls of balanced tomato and egg noodles.
