Mother and daughter sat at the dining table, eating and chatting about the fun things that happened at kindergarten and the shop that day. After the meal, she played with Xuanxuan with the new cardstock, taught her to fold paper airplanes and paper boats, and read two picture books together. Then she bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into cute pajamas, told an original story called “The Little Raindrop's Journey” on the bed, and ended the parent-child time to the sound of Xuanxuan's sweet breathing.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Assisting Zhao Li with her floristry work and returning home
description: After quietly closing her daughter's door, she quickly changed into a T-shirt, sweatpants, and canvas shoes, checked her backpack for her phone, wallet, keys, and a disposable rain poncho, and before leaving sent Xiaomei a WeChat message encouraging her and saying she'd worked hard tonight. She rode her electric scooter through the night and arrived at Zhao Li's flower studio in Shapowei twenty minutes later. The studio was brightly lit. She skillfully picked up scissors and helped Zhao Li trim flower stems and arrange them in a spiral, and the two worked together to wrap bouquets, chatting about family life as they worked. Zhao Li said her mother was recovering well and would be discharged soon. She also shared the funny story of her daughter folding paper airplanes, and laughter filled the room. After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, she set off on her way back. Sure enough, a light rain began to fall. She calmly put on her rain poncho and rode home slowly.
location: From No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Zhao Li's flower art studio at Shapowei.

name: Arriving home, washing up, and pre-sleep activities.
description: After arriving home, she first went to her daughter's room. Seeing that Xuanxuan was sleeping soundly, she tucked the kicked-off blanket over her. Then she took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue, changed into pajamas, and sent a voice message to her husband, who was away on a business trip, to report that all was well—saying the doorbell would arrive home tomorrow and everything at home was fine—and telling him to rest early. Before bed, she did the lower-back stretches the doctor had suggested on the carpet, then picked up the small notebook by the bed and briefly wrote down her feelings for the day: "A day taking care of the child alone, though busy and flustered, was quite fulfilling. Xiaomei's performance today comforted me, and Zhao Li is getting better and better. Light rain at night, returned safely." She put down the diary, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up and prepare breakfast
description: The sky was gloomy and the air pressure was a bit low, but she woke up on time. After washing up, she took blueberries and yogurt out of the fridge and toasted two slices of bread, preparing a fresh breakfast for herself and her daughter. She also boiled water, made a cup of tea for her husband, and left it to cool for him to drink when he got up.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up her daughter and finish the morning routine.
description: Gently pushed open her daughter's bedroom door, drew the curtains, and softly woke her up. Helped her brush her teeth and wash her face, then quickly tied two cute pigtails. The mother and daughter had breakfast together at the table, and she reminded her daughter to behave at kindergarten.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and stop by the stationery store on the way.
description: She put on her commuter bag, took her daughter's hand, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, chatting along the way. At about 8:10, she dropped her daughter off at the kindergarten gate and watched her enter happily. Then, on the way, she swung by a stationery store on Park South Road. Remembering that her daughter wanted colored cardstock, she picked out two bright sheets and a pack of cartoon stickers, planning to surprise her in the evening.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen, Siming District, No. 123 Gucheng West Road and No. 35 Gongyuan South Road

name: Commute to the store
description: Walk 5 minutes from the stationery store to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, take Line 1 for two stops, get off at Zhenhai Road Station, exit from the Zhongshan Road exit, then walk 3 minutes and arrive at Yajing Life Gallery at about 8:40.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Open the shop and stock up.
description: Opened the store door, turned on the cash register, lights, and air conditioning. Looked around the store, put the clothing racks that had been organized yesterday back in place, checked and replenished missing sizes, and got ready for business.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Running the shop alone, online operations, and lunch
description: Xiaomei asked for leave in the morning, so I was the only one in the store. There were not many customers in the morning, so I made use of the good light: I selected three new autumn outfits, hung them up, and carefully took try-on photos. I posted them with a warm filter and captions to my WeChat Moments and customer group, and received quite a few likes and inquiries. During that time, two young women who came in together entered the store. I received them warmly, helped them try on and coordinate outfits, and sold a knitted cardigan and a skirt. At 11:30 a.m., I ordered a chicken breast salad takeout from a light meal shop on my phone. After the food arrived, I ate while replying to online inquiries, sent size recommendations and detail photos to two interested customers, and recorded their preferences and arranged for them to come to the store for fitting.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon discomfort and early handover, leaving the store
description: Shortly after lunch, I felt slightly dizzy and my temples felt tight. Given the gloomy weather and yesterday's fatigue, I didn't dare take it lightly. I contacted Xiaomei via WeChat and learned that she had completed the lease renewal and was on her way back, so I decided to wait for her to take over. At 1:10 p.m., Xiaomei arrived at the shop and saw that I looked unwell. I quickly briefed her on the afternoon's scheduled customers, key online consultation points, and packages to be received, then picked up my bag and left the shop early.
location: 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked home and replenished her energy
description: After leaving the shop, she walked to the nearby FamilyMart convenience store and bought a bottle of mineral water and a small bag of daily mixed nuts. Then she slowly walked home along Zhongshan Road and Zhenhai Road, about 25 minutes. After being in the breeze, the dizziness eased somewhat.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Home rest and recovery
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear, lay on the living room sofa to rest, listened to soft piano music on her phone, drank the bottled water, and ate some nuts. The fatigue in her body gradually faded, and her spirits recovered somewhat.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Researched smart doorbells and prepared tools.
description: After she felt better, she opened the package for the smart doorbell that arrived yesterday and took out the device and the manual. Her husband had previously told her the package had been signed for. While watching the video tutorial, she studied the installation steps, found the household toolbox, confirmed that screwdrivers, an electric drill, and other tools were all available, and planned to wait for her husband to get off work and install it together.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared a simple dinner.
description: Checked the fridge and found vegetables and frozen sea fish, so decided to make steamed fish, garlic lettuce, and tomato egg drop soup. Thawed and marinated the fish, washed and cut the vegetables, finished all the meal prep, and waited for her husband to arrive home before cooking.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband came home to have dinner together.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work and was pleasantly surprised to see her in good spirits and with the ingredients prepped. She told him about coming home early in the afternoon to rest, and he voiced concerned reminders. The couple stir-fried dishes together in the kitchen, quickly prepared dinner, and chatted about their work over the meal.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Install a smart doorbell together.
description: After dinner, I couldn't wait to install the doorbell. My husband handled drilling and wiring, while I assisted by handing tools and watching the tutorial. About forty minutes later, the doorbell lit up and connected successfully to the phone app. I happily shot a short video and sent it to the family WeChat group.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Resting after a meal and getting ready to go out.
description: Put the toolbox away, change into light pants and sneakers, and bring your phone and keys. Tell your husband that you are going to your friend Zhao Li's flower arrangement studio and may be back a little late, and ask him to help their daughter take a bath.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycle to the floral design studio
description: Hopping on her electric scooter and setting off from home, she rode along Zhenhai Road, past Yanwu Bridge, with the cool evening breeze, and arrived at Zhao Li's floral studio near Shapowei after about 20 minutes.
location: Room 101, No. 14 Xiawozi, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Assisting the floral studio with planning a Teachers' Day event
description: When I arrived at the studio, Zhao Li was arranging newly arrived flower materials. She told me her mother might be discharged from the hospital next week, and she wanted to revitalize the studio. Drawing on my own shop promotion experience, I suggested she start warming up for Teachers' Day in advance. The two of us opened our laptops and brainstormed a plan: we designed three small bouquets at different price points, paired with simple packaging and handwritten warm cards to add a personal touch. We also discussed a 'regular customers bring new customers' pre-sale strategy, and Zhao Li was very excited when she heard it.
location: Room 101, No. 14 Xiawozi, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Completed exercise by walking on the way home
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, she didn't ride the scooter directly home. She parked and locked it by the roadside, then strolled leisurely along the seaside path on Daxue Road to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road. The walk took about 15 minutes, and she felt relaxed and refreshed, completing her evening exercise plan. Then she unlocked the scooter and rode home.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up, skincare, and casual family chat
description: After returning home, I tiptoed to look in on my daughter's room. My husband had already put our daughter to sleep, and I felt a warmth in my heart. Then I took a shower and dried my hair. Sitting in the living room with a face mask on, I talked quietly with my husband about the Teachers' Day event we had planned at Zhao Li's place that evening. He laughed and said I was a "cross-disciplinary director."
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and preparing for bed
description: Before bed, I unrolled the yoga mat and did 10 minutes of gentle stretching, focusing on relaxing my lower back. In the phone's Notes app, I wrote in my diary: 'Felt dizzy and rested early; it was scary but ended up fine. The doorbell was installed successfully, which gave me a sense of accomplishment. I had a new idea for helping Zhao Li's flower shop plan a Teacher's Day campaign; I feel very happy and hope I can help her get through this.' I set the alarm for the next day, lay down, and got ready to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, have breakfast with family, take daughter to school
description: Woke up on time at 7:00, and after a quick wash prepared breakfast (warm milk, fried eggs, whole wheat toast). At 7:20 woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her wash up, and tied her hair into two braids. The family of three had breakfast together at 7:40; she asked her husband Aqiang if he would work overtime, and he said the project was wrapping up and he would leave on time. After breakfast, Aqiang left for work first, and Yajing took Xuanxuan downstairs at 8:00.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk daughter to kindergarten
description: Holding her daughter Xuanxuan's hand, she walked along the familiar street for about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, she briefly told Teacher Wang that Xuanxuan had been a bit excited last night, then watched her run into the classroom with her classmates.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase ingredients at the fresh food supermarket.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, I walked about 14 minutes to Mintianyuan Fresh Supermarket. Thinking that my husband Aqiang had been saying he wanted to eat braised pork, I bought a piece of pork belly, and also picked some fresh water spinach, tomatoes, and pork ribs for soup. At the checkout, I saw the newly arrived sweet potatoes and grabbed a small bag.
location: Mintianyuan Fresh Food Supermarket, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store
description: Carrying the purchased ingredients, she walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Xiamen Metro Line 1, got off at Zhenhai Road Station two stops later, exited from Exit 2, and walked a few minutes to Yajing Lifestyle Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Open the store for business, meet with shop assistant Xiaomei, and plan the seasonal transition and online operations.
description: At 9:00 she arrived at the shop, opened the door, turned on the lights, and checked the displays. At 9:20, staff member Xiaomei arrived, and the two of them sorted and ironed the newly arrived early autumn knitwear and long skirts, then changed the mannequins into new outfits. At 9:45, taking advantage of the few customers, Yajing and Xiaomei sat by the cashier counter drinking homemade lemon mint water while discussing next month's autumn collection display plan and the Mid-Autumn Festival promotional purchase-with-gift event. Xiaomei shared how smoothly the lease renewal had gone yesterday, and Yajing took out her phone to chat with Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai on WeChat about the logistics progress of the new sample garments, which were expected to arrive next week. At 10:30, she posted the in-store photos and text about autumn styling that she had edited last night to her WeChat Moments and VIP customer group.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and learning the good news that Zhao Li's mother is recovering
description: At 12:00, Yajing let Xiaomei go to lunch first. At 12:15, she locked up the store and went alone to A Jie's Shacha Noodles (Old Eighth Market Landmark Store) near the pedestrian street to have the long-craved traditional shacha noodles. Just after she sat down, her phone vibrated with a WeChat message from Zhao Li. She opened the voice message and heard Zhao Li's choked-up joy: 'Sis, my mom can walk a few steps in the hallway by herself with the walker today! The doctor said she can be discharged next week!' Yajing's heart, which had been hanging for two days, finally settled, and her eyes grew warm. She replied in a series of voice messages: 'That's really great! Great! You get some rest, and when Auntie is discharged, I'll go visit her!' The noodles tasted especially good, and she felt so light-hearted she wanted to hum a tune.
location: A-Jie Shacha Noodles (Old Eighth Market Landmark Store), Kaiyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon cashiering and handling online orders
description: Back at the store, Xiaomei had finished eating and began tidying the shelves. Yajing opened the store's inventory management app on her phone, checked the morning sales records, and replied to inquiries from three regular online customers, one of whom ordered a complete outfit.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon nap to regain energy
description: Xiaomei was mainly watching the store. Yajing felt the afternoon drowsiness coming on, so she told Xiaomei, lay down on the fabric single sofa in the store, set a 20-minute alarm on her phone, and closed her eyes peacefully. She fell asleep before long, and seeing her asleep, Xiaomei tiptoed over to tidy the shelves. When the alarm went off, Yajing woke up and felt much more refreshed.
location: The sofa in the rest area of Yajing Lifestyle Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store hours and community interaction
description: After recovering her energy, Yajing changed into a new modal-cotton long dress and acted as her own walking advertisement. In the afternoon, several groups of customers came into the store one after another. Around 15:30, a regular customer A came in. Yajing greeted her warmly and, based on her pear-shaped figure and personal style, successfully put together an early-autumn office look for her (structured blazer vest + silk ribbon blouse + high-waisted wide-leg jeans). The customer was very satisfied and paid on the spot. When things slowed down, Yajing shared the good news about Zhao Li's mother in her close girlfriends' group chat on her phone, and Li Meiling and Wang Jia both sent blessing and hug emoticons.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leave the store early and pick up my daughter from school.
description: At 16:30, Yajing handed over to Xiaomei and left the store early. She walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station and took Xiamen Metro Line 1 back to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. As soon as she saw her mother, Xuanxuan chattered away about the new finger rhyme she had learned today.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shop on the way home
description: Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand and on the way dropped by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy butter and cheese slices, planning to make Xuanxuan her favorite cheese-filled sandwich the next morning. After arriving home at 17:30, she let Xuanxuan read picture books and play with building blocks in the living room while she started preparing dinner.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal together.
description: First blanch the pork ribs, then put them in the electric slow cooker with corn and carrots to make soup. Next, following the morning plan, cut the pork belly into cubes, stir-fry sugar to make the caramel color, and cook Aqiang's favorite braised pork belly. Then stir-fry a plate of garlic water spinach and tomato scrambled eggs. Around 18:40, Aqiang came home and smiled as soon as he smelled the braised pork. The family of three sat down at 19:00 and enjoyed a warm dinner. During the meal, Xuanxuan seriously performed the newly learned finger rhyme "Little Mouse Climbs the Lampstand," making everyone laugh.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The couple worked together to install a smart doorbell and shared access with their parents.
description: After dinner, Aqiang cleared the table, and Yajing brought out the smart video doorbell that had arrived the night before. The two of them went to the front door together. Aqiang was in charge of drilling holes with a screwdriver, installing the doorbell, and connecting it to Wi-Fi, while Yajing handed him tools and downloaded the corresponding app. The doorbell came online smoothly, and the front-door picture was clear and smooth. After debugging, they returned to the sofa in the living room, and Aqiang used his phone to generate a sharing QR code. Yajing made a WeChat video call to her parents in Quanzhou. During the video call, Yajing patiently taught her mother, Lin Xiuying, how to scan the code with her phone. After successfully sharing access, Auntie Xiuying looked at the front-door image on her phone, surprised and delighted: "Oh my, it's so clear! Now your father and I can see who's at the door even from inside the house!" Her father, Song Minghui, leaned in to look as well, grinning from ear to ear, and kept saying, "Now we can rest easy."
location: At the doorstep of the residence in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and in the living room

name: Played with her daughter, helped her wash up, and coaxed her to sleep.
description: After the video call, Yajing played with Xuanxuan in the living room, building an imaginary 'princess castle' with LEGO, then gave her a bath and changed her into pajamas. At 9:00 p.m., Xuanxuan lay in bed, and Yajing told her a story about 'the little doorbell helping the grandpa look after the house.' The little girl listened with great interest and fell asleep sweetly after the story.
location: Secondary bedroom and living room of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal care and evening stretching
description: After washing up, Yajing changed into comfortable workout clothes, spread out a yoga mat in the living room, put on earphones, and followed a mobile app to do a 20-minute full-body stretching and core workout, making up for yesterday's health plan that was left unfinished due to dizziness. During stretching, she felt her shoulders and lumbar spine loosen up. Afterwards, she stood on the balcony for a few minutes, enjoying the midsummer evening breeze and looking at the lights in the neighborhood, feeling extremely at ease and content.
location: Living room and balcony of the home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Mobile socializing and diary
description: After lying down in bed, she first replied to a few messages from customers and Zhao Li. Zhao Li sent a group photo of her mother walking in the ward while holding a walker. In the photo, the auntie looked hale and hearty, so Yajing replied with a big thumbs-up and a heart. Afterward, she opened the memo on her phone and briefly noted down today's feelings: Auntie Zhao's good news, the doorbell connected successfully, and dinner was very enjoyable. Finally, she jotted down the idea she had learned today about how to create an atmosphere in the store with herbal tea, planning to discuss it with Xiaomei later for use in the new season's customer experience.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare to rest
description: Turned off the light, put down the phone, and closed my eyes. My heart was filled with a sense of stability and happiness from the upgraded family safety net, the improving health of relatives and friends, and the steady running of the store, and I soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing breakfast and washing up.
description: The alarm went off at exactly 7 o'clock, and Song Yajing got up to wash up. The aroma of whole wheat bread and fried eggs filled the kitchen; together with the fresh milk bought yesterday, it made up the simple breakfast today. After her husband Chen Zhiqiang (Aqiang) got up, Song Yajing reminded him that he could take their daughter Xuanxuan out for a stroll this evening, and he nodded in agreement.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Woke up her daughter and washed up.
description: At 7:40, Song Yajing gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan and helped her tie her little pigtails. As usual, Xuanxuan took a star sticker from the handmade star stickers she had brought from kindergarten, stuck it on her mother’s collar, and said, “Mommy, you have to be brave today.” She smiled, kissed her daughter, and felt warm inside.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten and walk to the subway station.
description: Song Yajing and her daughter left early. On the way, they talked about starting elementary school, and she told her daughter that her stationery and schoolbag would be ready soon. Xuanxuan excitedly gestured that she wanted a schoolbag “with a little princess” on it. After sending Xuanxuan into the kindergarten, Song Yajing walked along Gucheng West Road toward Zhenhai Road Metro Station, enjoying the morning breeze and the sound of cicadas, then headed straight into the station.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhenhai Road Metro Station

name: Commuted to the store and made opening preparations.
description: Song Yajing took the metro at Zhenhai Road Station to Zhongshan Road. The carriage was not very crowded, so she took out her phone to check WeChat messages from regular customers asking for autumn outfit matching advice, mentally planning her replies after arriving at the store. After exiting the station, she walked to Yajing Lifestyle Store, skillfully pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioner, hung up the 'Open' sign, and prepared to start the day's business.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning business and work arrangements.
description: Xiaomei, the shop assistant, arrived at the store on time at 9 o'clock. The two of them unpacked and ironed the early autumn new arrivals from last night, adjusted the window mannequin display, and Xiaomei took photos and edited them while Song Yajing posted previews of the new products on WeChat Moments and in the VIP group. During this time, she received the logistics tracking number for next week's new styles sent by Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai and confirmed the arrival time. A regular VIP customer who had made an appointment came to pick up her order. Song Yajing also helped her put together a weekend vacation casual outfit, and the customer left satisfied.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and division of duties for minding the shop
description: Noon was hot and muggy. The two used their phones to order chicken breast avocado salad and iced lemon soda. While eating, they discussed the afternoon plan: Song Yajing decided to take advantage of the reduced afternoon foot traffic to go out and buy back-to-school stationery for her daughter, while Xiaomei would mind the store and contact her via WeChat if anything came up.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchasing back-to-school stationery for her daughter
description: After giving Xiao Mei instructions, Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to Bocheng Stationery Store. Following the list sent by the teacher, she carefully selected 2B pencils, 4B erasers, washable watercolor markers, drawing books, and Chinese character grid notebooks, and specially chose a pink two-layer pencil case printed with a deer pattern and a backpack with spine protection and weight reduction.
location: Bocheng Stationery (Sixian Street Store), No. 57 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Returned to the store and handled online matters
description: After purchasing the supplies, she immediately rode back to the store. She photographed the stationery and schoolbags and sent the photos to her husband A Qiang, joking, 'Time to get to work! From now on, I'm appointing you as our daughter's study committee member.' Then she began replying to several online customers on WeChat about sizing and fabric, guiding them on choosing styles.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store work and customer reception
description: During the afternoon peak, the two took turns serving customers. They recommended a high-waist A-line skirt to a petite girl, and for an office worker, they put together a commuter shirt with wide-leg pants. After the sale, Song Yajing posted the customers' outfit photos to the VIP group and received likes from regular customers.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Left the store early to pick up her daughter
description: At 16:20, I tidied up the store, said goodbye to Xiaomei, scanned a shared bike on the roadside, and hurried to the kindergarten to pick up Xuanxuan. I rode carefully along the way, thinking about the look on Xuanxuan's face when she sees the new stationery.
location: Along the route from Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road.

name: Picking up her daughter and sharing a surprise
description: When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, Xuanxuan was waiting eagerly. Seeing Song Yajing, she rushed into her arms. Song Yajing showed her the new pencil case and new schoolbag, and Xuanxuan screamed with joy, hugging the schoolbag and refusing to let go. The mother and daughter chatted and laughed, stopped at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy yogurt and bananas, and then walked back home on Shanggu Street.
location: Along the route from Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Initially set up her daughter's study corner.
description: As soon as they entered the house, mother and daughter got busy. They wiped the small desk in the living room clean and laid out a cartoon dinosaur desk mat. Xuanxuan excitedly arranged her new stationery one by one, put her new schoolbag behind the chair, and stuck a kindergarten sticker on it. Looking at the little study corner, Song Yajing felt very at ease.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: Aqiang got off work on time and came home. Seeing the brand-new study corner, he praised his daughter with exaggerated enthusiasm. For dinner, he stir-fried broccoli, Song Yajing pan-fried yellow croaker, and made tomato egg drop soup. At the table, Xuanxuan kept bragging about starting elementary school with a new schoolbag, and the family of three laughed heartily.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rest in the evening and cycle to the flower studio.
description: After dinner, Aqiang took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. Song Yajing changed into a light T-shirt and long pants, reapplied sunscreen, and took her electric scooter charger. She told Aqiang that she was going to Zhao Li's place tonight to finish up some loose ends and would be back around 9:30. Then she rode the scooter along Huyuan Road and Daxue Road toward Shapowei. The evening breeze was pleasant, and she finally arrived downstairs of Zhao Li's studio in the Art West District, Shapowei.
location: Along the route from No. 82 Shanggu Street to Room 101, No. 14 Xiawozi, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening support for the floral work and a warm handover
description: Pushing open the studio door, Zhao Li was checking orders in front of her computer. The two worked together to tie the remaining dozen or so pre-wrapped bouquets with hemp twine, attach the bases, and pack them up. Zhao Li's mother had been discharged from the hospital yesterday, and next week Zhao Li would move in with her to take care of her, so the studio would return to normal operation. After finishing up, Zhao Li showed Song Yajing a video of her mother walking at home with a walker. She was happy for her but also a little reluctant. The two agreed to talk on Sunday evening. Before leaving, Zhao Li gave Song Yajing a small bouquet of lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves, saying it was a back-to-school gift for Xuanxuan.
location: Room 101, No. 14 Xiawozi, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Xiayuhua Life Floral Aesthetics (Xiamen University Branch)

name: Return and buy extra food on the way
description: Holding the bouquet, she slowly rode back to Shanggu Street. Passing the 85°C that was still open, she went in and bought an original-flavored donut and hot milk as a snack. When she got to the apartment building, she habitually looked up at the window of her home; the light was still on.
location: Along the way from Shapowei to No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing the 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery at No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road

name: Washing up, weighing, and pre-bed snack
description: After returning home, she tiptoed over to check on the sleeping Xuanxuan and tucked her in. Then she recorded her weight, 48.1kg, on her phone. Worried about not having enough energy, she heated milk in the microwave and slowly finished a meal of milk with a donut and whole-wheat bread at the dining table.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bed stretching, logging, and going to sleep
description: After finishing her snack and letting it settle, Song Yajing unrolled her yoga mat and did a 15-minute stretching routine, focusing on her lower back, since her lumbar spine had felt fairly stable these past two days. Then she took out her phone, opened the journal app, and recorded today's mood: "Another fulfilling day! Xuanxuan's study corner is ready, and I said a proper goodbye to A Ling. I hope our future days are as comfortable as tonight's breeze." After that, her phone played Catholic evening prayer audio. She turned off the main light, left the bedside lamp on, prayed quietly, then turned off the phone alarm, closed her eyes, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up and prepare breakfast and picnic gear
description: At 7:30 in the morning the alarm went off. Since the shop didn't need to open today, Song Yajing stayed in bed for 5 minutes before getting up to wash up. She went to the kitchen, saw her husband Chen Zhiqiang grinding coffee, and joined him in preparing breakfast. Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of frying eggs and toasting bread, while Song Yajing washed the blueberries and strawberries brought back from the shop and mixed them with yogurt to make a fruit salad. At the same time, she quickly took out the mango, dragon fruit and other fruits cut the night before, made sandwiches with ham slices, cheese and lettuce, and wrapped them in plastic wrap. She also put a picnic mat, wet wipes, garbage bags and her daughter's colorful water bottle into the picnic basket, fully preparing for the morning park picnic.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family sets off for the park.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing helped her daughter Chen Lexuan put on her sneakers. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought Xuanxuan's small bicycle out from the balcony, carefully checked the screws on the training wheels, and helped her put on a helmet printed with a Little Mermaid pattern. Once everything was ready, Chen Zhiqiang drove while Song Yajing sat in the back seat holding Xuanxuan. On the way, the sky was clear. Song Yajing looked out the window and said to Chen Zhiqiang in the front seat, "What a lovely day today—Xuanxuan will definitely learn to ride!" Xuanxuan hummed a children's song excitedly, and the family drove to Bailuzhou Park.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, on the drive from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community to Bailuzhou Park.

name: Teach daughter to ride a bicycle.
description: After arriving at Bailuzhou Park, the family picked a spot on the flat lawn in the shade by the lake. Chen Zhiqiang held the back of the bicycle from behind, Chen Lexuan gripped the handlebars nervously and excitedly, and Song Yajing crouched a few meters away recording with her phone and encouraging her: “Don't be afraid, sweetie! Keep your eyes forward! Daddy's holding you!” After Xuanxuan wobbled a few meters, her parents cheered excitedly. Around 10 a.m., Chen Zhiqiang secretly let go, and Xuanxuan rode nearly 10 meters on her own. After stopping, she turned around and shouted excitedly, “Mom! I did it! I rode by myself!” At that moment Song Yajing's eyes welled up and she quickly snapped a photo of her daughter's proud expression. The bike-learning process was full of warmth and a sense of accomplishment.
location: Lakeside lawn area, Xiamen Bailuzhou Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lawn picnic and neighborhood warmth
description: After playing, the family spread a picnic mat under the shade of a tree and started to picnic. Chen Lexuan had a big appetite; while eating a sandwich, she got salad dressing all over her face, and Song Yajing wiped her clean. Xuanxuan then ran off to chase butterflies. Song Yajing and her husband sat side by side, talking about their daughter's upcoming elementary school life. Chen Zhiqiang held her hand and expressed gratitude. Song Yajing also shared the fulfillment she felt from helping her friend Zhao Li. Around 12:40, Auntie Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor, happened to pass by on her walk and handed over a pot of mung bean soup, saying, "Yajing, I heard you've been helping a friend lately and have lost weight. This mung bean soup clears heat and relieves summer heat—drink more of it!" Song Yajing thanked her repeatedly. Drinking the lightly sweet soup, she felt very warm inside. The picnic atmosphere was pleasant and harmonious.
location: Lawn area of Xiamen Egret Island Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Packing up and saying goodbye to the park
description: The sun was getting quite strong, and the whole family started packing up. Chen Zhiqiang put the picnic mat and bicycles back into the trunk. Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to throw the trash into the bin. Xuanxuan hugged the leftover half bottle of mung bean soup, reluctant to leave. At 13:30 the car drove out of the parking lot. On the way home, Xuanxuan dozed off in her safety seat in the back.
location: Xiamen Bailuzhou Park, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the way back home.

name: Afternoon rest and personal time at home.
description: After getting home, Song Yajing changed the sleeping Xuanxuan into pajamas, and Chen Zhiqiang put away the picnic gear. Song Yajing also closed her eyes and rested on the sofa for half an hour. After waking up, Chen Zhiqiang dealt with emails in the study, while she opened the CapCut app on her phone, edited the video of Xuanxuan learning to ride a bike taken that day, added light-hearted music, and sent it to the family group and the close friends group, earning admiration from her good friend Xiaomei. Then she went to the kitchen to check the fridge and decided to make tomato and egg noodles for dinner. This afternoon time was hers, balancing personal relaxation with household responsibilities.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Household tidying and preparing support supplies.
description: After Xuanxuan woke up from her nap, she played with building blocks in the living room. Song Yajing used this time to take in the dry clothes from the balcony and fold them, and changed the water for the sunflowers Zhao Li had given her yesterday. Then she took a brand-new apron and a pair of durable gloves out of her bag, planning to bring them to Zhao Li in the afternoon so she could use them while working. Amid the household chores, preparing to support her friend showed her warmheartedness.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Change clothes to prepare to help a friend.
description: At 16:15, Song Yajing washed her face, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen floral dress, and put on a sun hat. She said to her husband and daughter, "Mommy is going to Aunt Zhao's place to help for a while. I'll bring you something tasty when I come back, so be good and listen to Daddy!" Xuanxuan nodded understandingly, and Chen Zhiqiang told her to be safe. She was fully prepared to go and support the flower arrangement studio.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to Zhao Li's floral design studio
description: Song Yajing got on her electric scooter and rode south along Siming South Road, passing through the lively Ding'aozai Cat Street, with a gentle breeze on her face and a cheerful mood. After about 16 minutes, she arrived at the Xiayuhua Life Floral Aesthetics Studio near Daxue Road and parked the scooter in the electric vehicle parking area at the entrance.
location: On the way along Siming South Road in Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, riding an electric scooter to Xiayuhua Life Floral Aesthetics (Xiamen University Branch).

name: Support Zhao Li and bid her a fond farewell
description: Song Yajing pushed open the glass door. Zhao Li was arranging the last few bundles of loose flower material and smiled when she saw her. Without a word, Song Yajing put on new gloves, tied on an apron, and skillfully helped trim branches and leaves, remove thorns, and sort the flowers. They chatted while working. Zhao Li said her mother was recovering well and could finally breathe a sigh of relief. At 17:50, all the flower material was processed, and together they wiped the workbench clean and mopped the floor. At 18:10, Zhao Li suddenly put down her rag, hugged Song Yajing tightly, and said in a choked voice, "Yajing, without you, I really don't know how I would have gotten through this past week and more." Song Yajing's eyes reddened, and she gently patted her back, saying, "What are you talking about? We're sisters. Your business is my business." Finally, Zhao Li picked up a carefully selected peace lily from beside the sink and handed it to her, saying, "This is for you. Wishing you smooth sailing. Come by often, and I'll make you some flower tea." Song Yajing nodded firmly and took the heavy potted plant, which carried the deep friendship between the two.
location: Room 101, No. 14 Xiawozi, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Xiayuhua Life Floral Aesthetics (Xiamen University Branch)

name: Return trip and shopping along the way
description: At 18:50, carrying the peace lily, Song Yajing carefully rode her scooter back. When passing Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she remembered that the blueberries and throat lozenges at home were almost gone, so she stopped at the convenience store at the intersection. She bought fresh blueberries and a box of Golden Throat lozenges, and also picked out a pack of animal crackers for Xuanxuan. At 19:05, she rode back to the entrance of the Shanggu Street community.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province. On the way back, passed by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road) and then returned to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Enjoying a family dinner
description: As soon as Song Yajing entered the house, she smelled the aroma. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already cooked tomato-and-egg noodles and stir-fried a plate of garlic broccoli. She placed the peace lily in a prominent spot in the living room and changed into loungewear. The family of three sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan, while eating big mouthfuls of noodles, excitedly told them about the white water bird she had seen in the park during the day. Seeing her family's satisfied faces, Song Yajing felt immensely happy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bath time and picture book story
description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang went to wash the dishes, and Song Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan to the bathroom for a bath. Xuanxuan played with the bubble bath for a while and was overjoyed. After bathing, they changed into pajamas and curled up together on the small bed. Song Yajing took out the newly bought picture book “My First Bike Ride” and told Xuanxuan the story. Xuanxuan listened with great interest and asked many details about riding a bike. At 20:50, after the story was finished, Xuanxuan fell asleep sweetly holding her arm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretching exercise
description: After quietly slipping out of Xuanxuan's room, Song Yajing came to the living room and unrolled her yoga mat. Considering that she had already been quite active during the day, she didn't do high-intensity exercise, but followed a Keep course on her phone to do a 15-minute full-body stretching and shoulder-neck relaxation routine. Every movement made her body feel stretched, and after finishing, she had worked up a light sweat, feeling that the day's fatigue had melted away.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening review and reflection.
description: Sitting on the sofa, Song Yajing opened her phone and first sent a WeChat message to Zhao Li: "Zhao Li, I've put the peace lily on the TV cabinet. Every time I see it, I think of you. Get some rest—a new life is beginning!" Zhao Li quickly replied with a hugging emoji. Then she began to organize today's photos and videos and saved them into a folder named "2025 Summer Xuanxuan Driving Lessons." Finally, she opened her phone memo and jotted down a few ideas for the shop's autumn/winter new arrivals: use warm-toned scarves with knitwear for window displays, and post the friendship story with Zhao Li on Moments to promote the "warm company" theme of the autumn/winter clothing. Through this review, she sorted out both the shop and the friendship.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washed up and relaxed to music.
description: Song Yajing went to the bathroom to wash her face and put on a sandwich-style hydrating mask. After washing up, she lay in bed, put on her earphones, listened to some soothing piano music for a while, let her mind slowly empty, and got ready to fall asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep.
description: Song Yajing turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside night light. She set her phone alarm for 6:30 the next morning (tomorrow was Sunday; she needed to get up early to take the ferry to Gulangyu for Mass). The last images flashing through her mind were Xuanxuan's proud smile when she learned to ride a bike on the lawn during the day, and the warmth of Zhao Li's hug. With a contented smile on her lips, she fell peacefully asleep at 23:30.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning preparation and going to church.
description: After quickly tidying up the kitchen and reminding my husband to buy pork ribs at noon, I took two Bibles from the living room cabinet (my own and my daughter's children's picture-book edition) and put them into a large tote bag, along with the garlic crisps brought back from Quanzhou to share with church friends. I checked my daughter's small water bottle and filled it with warm water. After putting on flat sandals at the entrance, I took my daughter's hand and left, walking 8 minutes to the “First Hospital” bus stop and taking Bus No. 29. My daughter sat by the window watching the street scene, and I played hymns for her. After arriving at the ferry terminal, we took the ferry to Gulangyu Island. My daughter excitedly leaned over the side of the boat watching seagulls and waves, while I held her and enjoyed the sea breeze. We stepped onto Gulangyu Island around 8:50, and the air was filled with the scent of flowers.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Entering the historic Gulangyu Catholic Church, she sat down in the front-middle seat, helped her daughter open the children's Bible, and the girl quietly stayed by her side. When the organ music began to resound, she devoted herself to prayer, giving special thanks for her daughter's upcoming elementary school life and the recovery of Zhao Li's mother. After Mass, she shared garlic crisps with familiar parishioners in the square. Aunt Lin Xiuying affectionately stroked her daughter's head and praised her for remembering old friends. Her daughter chased pigeons with the other children in the square, and the parishioners kept laughing.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return and buy groceries on the way
description: After saying goodbye to her church friends and holding her daughter's hand, she took the 11:10 ferry back to the Siming District ferry terminal, then walked through Zhenhai Road to the Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers Market. At the market, following the plan, she selected one jin of fresh ribs, one iron-stick yam, and a few red dates for soup, and also bought some crisp water spinach, three Red Fuji apples, and a small bunch of emperor bananas. Carrying vegetables in one hand and holding her daughter with the other, she walked 5 minutes back to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: Xiasheng (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare and enjoy brunch.
description: After returning home, she let her daughter play with a new picture book in the living room while she quickly washed the ribs, blanched them, and put them in an electric slow cooker with Chinese yam and red dates, setting the timer. While the soup simmered, she made two bowls of scallion noodles and fried a runny-yolk egg for her daughter. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, voluntarily came out of the study to help set the table, and the family of three ate and chatted together. The daughter excitedly described the stained glass and pigeons at the church, while her husband shared news about a new smart plug he had bought online. After the meal, she didn't rush to clear the dishes. Instead, she took out the picture book “The First Bike Ride” and read it with her daughter for 15 minutes, using the story to encourage her to be as brave as the little bear.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothing daughter to sleep and analyzing store sales
description: After getting her daughter to brush her teeth, she lay on the small bed with her, patting her back and humming songs to lull her to sleep, then quietly closed the door and went to the living room, took out her laptop, and pulled up the August sales report. Using Excel to filter and analyze the data on key items such as 'early-autumn French-style dresses,' she found that online pre-orders contributed 30% of the month's revenue. She also reviewed VIP customers' purchase records and noticed that the landlady Sister Li had bought two outfits last month, so she planned to give her a homemade mooncake gift box before the Mid-Autumn Festival. Then she wrote down the September marketing theme 'Autumn Commute New Look' and two small plans in her notebook: 'Teacher's Day VIP Appreciation' and 'Mid-Autumn Gift-with-Purchase Event.'
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare the complete set of back-to-school items for her daughter

She hand-washed the uniform and shoes with warm water and laundry detergent and hung them on the balcony. Then she took out the label maker and printed name stickers for “Chen Lexuan,” sticking them one by one on each watercolor marker, pencil, eraser, ruler, pencil case, and the schoolbag flap. Her daughter acted as a little helper throughout, handing her things and pressing the label maker button to make it beep. Finally, she neatly placed the stationery into the schoolbag, put it on her back, and walked around the living room showing it off.

Like a little host, she introduced one by one the pencil case made by her grandparents and the unicorn pencil. Mom beamed and kept saying how nice, while Dad kindly told me to take care of myself and not to be careless about the cool autumn weather. The call lasted about 20 minutes before hanging up.

Zhao Li said in a cheerful voice that her mother had walked several laps with a walker and had also drunk yam porridge. The two chatted for about 40 minutes, from her mother's recovery to the autumn collection of the floral design studio. Zhao Li once again sincerely expressed her gratitude, and I seriously replied that from now on we should meet at least once a month, and see each other next Sunday on Zhongshan Road. After hanging up, I stood on the balcony looking at the sunset afterglow and felt that all the exhaustion for family and friends was worth it.

She cut carrots and braised them with ribs, then trimmed the water spinach and washed tomatoes for egg drop soup. Humming while chopping, she enjoyed the time spent busy for her family.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

I filled my bowl with soup, ribs, and yam to reward myself, and my daughter also had a small bowl, scooping up the yam pieces with her little spoon and eating with relish. After dinner, my husband volunteered to do the dishes.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

My daughter nodded firmly. Then I discussed with my husband checking the smart doorbell's battery and connection status once every Sunday evening starting today, and formally wrote it into the home security checklist.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

I picked up the picture book about Little Rabbit's first day at school and read it gently. Afterward, I held her little hand and prayed together, thanking the Lord for such a wonderful weekend and asking Him to bless her first day of school tomorrow and help her make good friends. She put her hands together and learned to say 'Amen.' I kissed her forehead and turned off the bedside lamp, and within 5 minutes she was fast asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

After finishing, she sat cross-legged for a 5-minute meditation. Closing her eyes, she reviewed the fulfilling day: the sea breeze on Gulangyu Island, the prayers at the church, her daughter's smiling face, friends' gratitude, and the family dinner. She decided to restart her morning brisk-walking plan in September.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

I replied to questions about the new product launch time in the VIP customer group, read a WeChat article about first-graders adapting to elementary school, and then opened Notes to write tomorrow's to-do list: Take Xuanxuan to school / Open the store / Confirm the autumn clothing display plan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Her body gradually relaxed and she soon fell into a deep sleep. Outside the window all was still, and the faint sound of waves in the distance accompanied her into a brand-new day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

After washing up, Song Yajing changed into a comfortable linen shirt and cropped pants, took milk, bread, and eggs from the refrigerator, and prepared breakfast. At 7:20 she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on thin trousers and sneakers, and carefully braided two pigtails. In front of the mirror, Xuanxuan nervously asked whether the teacher would like her. Song Yajing squatted down, kissed her forehead, and encouraged her. Then mother and daughter had breakfast at the table. Xuanxuan drank her milk slowly, and together they reviewed the new daily schedule. Finally, they checked the schoolbag for stationery, a water bottle, tissues, and other items, making sure nothing was left behind.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Song Yajing opened a large umbrella and walked with her daughter to Xiamen Experimental Primary School, pointing to a lush green bougainvillea on the way to ease her daughter's nerves. Around 8:10 they arrived at the school gate. Seeing the bustling crowd, Xuanxuan clung to her mother and cried. Song Yajing crouched down, took the picture book 'The Kissing Hand' from her bag, and softly told the story of Mama Raccoon by the flower bed, then pressed a kiss into her daughter's palm and told her to press her palm to her cheek whenever she missed her. Xuanxuan, sobbing, closed her little hands and followed the teacher into the school. Song Yajing watched her daughter's figure disappear, her own eyes filling with tears.
location: Fujian Xiamen Experimental Primary School, No. 5-1 Tong'an Li, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.
