location: No. 56, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion'

name: Lunch and brief socializing
description: She and Xiaomei took turns going to lunch. They went to the nearby 85°C and bought a Caesar salad and an iced latte. They found seats by the window, and while eating she texted her husband Aqiang to share that Xuanxuan had done an amazing job today. Then she briefly reported the good news of her daughter's independent start at kindergarten in the "Hot Moms Group" and got a lot of likes.
location: 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Golden product selection time and VIP reception.
description: Back at the store, she focused her energy. She took out her tablet and began creating the formal "2025 Autumn Product Selection Requirements List". Fusing data with inspiration, she listed about 30 candidate styles in detail, highlighting three major directions — New Chinese style, light retro, and versatile wide-leg pants — and appended customer feedback screenshots and fabric reference images. During this period, a little after 2 p.m., regular customer Vivian came to pick up a dress and mentioned the New Chinese style pants she wanted. Yajing showed her the draft list she had just organized and listened to her opinions; Vivian praised it again and again.
location: No. 56, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion'

name: Early checkout and preparing to pick up the child.
description: At 15:30, save the sorted product selection list as an electronic file, and make a paper copy to put in your bag. After explaining the store matters to Xiaomei, leave the store early. Walk to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, and stop at the convenience store inside the station to buy a small bag of Xuanxuan’s favorite seaweed crispy crackers and a bottle of yogurt as a little surprise for when you pick her up from school.
location: 35-101 Zhenhai Road, convenience store at Zhenhai Road Subway Station.

name: Picked up her daughter from school and listened to interesting campus anecdotes.
description: Arrived at the kindergarten gate on time at 16:00. Xuanxuan and the other children came out in a line, and as soon as she saw Yajing, she ran over excitedly. On the way home, Xuanxuan chattered nonstop, sharing about drawing with her deskmate, eating curry rice for lunch, and helping the teacher hand out snacks. Yajing gave her yogurt and seaweed. Listening to the childish voice, she felt the day's fatigue disappear.
location: On the way from Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner and heartwarming moments.
description: When she got home, her husband Aqiang was already busy in the kitchen. He had made cola chicken wings, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg drop soup. Yajing helped set the table, and the family of three ate and chatted. Yajing shared the progress of the store's product selection, Aqiang shared funny stories from work, and Xuanxuan performed the new nursery rhyme she had learned, filling the room with laughter.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family time: companionship, bath time, and bedtime stories
description: After the meal, Aqiang cleared the dishes, while Yajing played with Xuanxuan with a new jigsaw puzzle of a little princess castle. Xuanxuan could complete half of it by herself. Around 19:30, they bathed Xuanxuan, and she played with bubbles and hummed songs in the tub. After the bath, Xuanxuan took the picture book The Kissing Hand on her own initiative, and Yajing read it together with her, then they said a bedtime prayer.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tucking her in and deep sharing in the moms' group.
description: After Xuanxuan lay down in bed, Yajing tucked her in and gently patted her back until she fell asleep. Once she confirmed that her daughter was sound asleep, Yajing went to the sofa in the living room, opened her phone, and spent nearly half an hour carefully editing a long post in the "Hot Mom Help" WeChat group, sharing the whole process of her daughter going from resistance to proactive adjustment, with special emphasis on the importance of the picture book "The Kissing Hand" and the ritual. She included a photo of the book and a snapshot she had taken that morning of her daughter waving goodbye (with the face blurred). After the post was sent, the group discussion was lively, and she was nominated as a "parenting-sharing whiz."
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Unit 3, Room 602, daughter's bedroom and living room

name: Contacted the supplier and scheduled a video conference.
description: After seeing the discussion in the group gradually calm down, she turned to contact supplier Susan in Guangzhou. She sent the '2025 Autumn Product Selection Requirements List' she had organized in the afternoon as a clear PDF image, with a note saying she wanted to schedule a video conference at 10 a.m. the next day. Susan quickly replied that she received it, and that the new season's design drafts and samples were ready to be viewed during the video call tomorrow.
location: Living room, Room 602, Unit 3, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and bedtime relaxation.
description: Changed into comfortable pajamas, spread out the yoga mat in the living room and performed a pre-sleep stretch, including the usual 10-minute stretch and an extra 5 minutes of shoulder and neck relaxation. After stretching, sat cross-legged for 10 minutes of meditation, recalling Xuanxuan's confident smile today, with a heart full of gratitude and peace.
location: Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, living room and bedroom

name: Browse messages and fall asleep peacefully
description: After meditation, feeling at ease in body and mind, she returned to the bedroom, where her husband Aqiang was already reading. After lying down, she briefly scrolled through Moments and the latest posts from several fashion bloggers. At 22:15, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, feeling proud of Xuanxuan's growth, clear about tomorrow's career plans, and content with family life.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early Morning Family Routine
description: After getting up at 6:45, Song Yajing stretched, filled her daughter Chen Lexuan's thermos with warm water, then washed up, did a quick skincare routine, and changed into a breathable linen shirt and wide-leg pants. Next, she prepared breakfast, taking cartoon-shaped buns, eggs, and milk from the fridge. While the buns were steaming, she fried eggs. At 7:15, she gently woke her daughter, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into two little ponytails. At 7:25, the family of three sat around the table. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang drank black coffee, while Song Yajing chatted with her daughter about kindergarten life as she ate her bun. The daughter said excitedly that she would teach her classmates the new nursery rhyme she had learned. Song Yajing reminded her that she would buy her snacks after school in the afternoon. After breakfast, her husband left for work first.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school, morning commute, and store opening preparations
description: At 7:40, Song Yajing held her daughter's hand and walked through the streets. On the way, her daughter asked for a "magic kiss." After she kissed her daughter's palm, the girl confidently walked into Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Watching her daughter enter the kindergarten, Song Yajing walked about 20 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park, walked briskly along the tree-lined path for about 15 minutes, took a photo of the sky and posted it on Moments, and browsed the hot mom group chat. At 8:15, she took Metro Line 1 from Zhongshan Park Station to Zhenhai Road Station, using the ride to review livestream key points and sample photos sent by supplier Susan. At 8:35, she arrived at Yajing Life Studio, turned on the lights and air conditioner, checked the display, adjusted the ring light angle and phone livestream settings, and hung up three early-autumn layered sample outfits.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province. From the residential compound at 82 Shanggu Street, passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten, Jiaxingyuan Park, Zhongshan Park Station, and Zhenhai Road Station, to Yajing Lifestyle Store at 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Live stream preparation and morning live stream.
description: From 9:00 to 9:25, Song Yajing drank warm boiled water and black coffee backstage, reviewed the word-for-word live stream script, marked pause symbols, and noted the launch times of New Chinese-style items that fans frequently asked about. At 9:30 she started the live stream "A Cup of Coffee After Dropping Off the Kid," and with up to 22 online viewers, she presented three early autumn layering looks and shared styling tips. At fans' request, she promised that the New Chinese-style modern cheongsams would arrive next week. During the live stream, interaction was good; at the end she showed the coffee cup and gave a preview of next week.
location: Live-streaming area, Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video ordering meeting with suppliers and placing orders
description: After the livestream ended, Song Yajing quickly video-called her Guangzhou supplier Susan on her tablet. Susan showed the new season's sample garments, including modern Chinese-style cheongsams, lightly retro knit cardigans, versatile wide-leg pants, and more. Song Yajing checked against her candidate list and asked in detail about fabrics, color differences, minimum order quantity, and shipping lead time. She finally selected 20 styles to order, focusing on 6 modern Chinese-style pieces and 4 modernized knitwear styles, and confirmed delivery before September 7 with an additional 3.5% discount. She then organized the Excel order, calculated the deposit, and transferred it via mobile banking to Guangzhou Kaiqi Garments Co., Ltd. She sent a screenshot to Susan and got confirmation, while also entering it into the store's financial system.
location: Back-of-house and checkout area, Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and return
description: At 11:30, she walked to the Japanese-style canteen on the basement floor of Zhonghua City, ordered a teriyaki chicken thigh set meal and Calpis, and ate quickly in about 15 minutes. During that time, she replied to questions in the Hot Mom Group about her daughter's school enrollment and attached a photo from the morning. After the meal, she returned to the shop, buying a box of cut cantaloupe at a fruit stand on the way.
location: Hefeng Canteen, B1, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, then returned to No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Discuss autumn inventory with the shop clerk.
description: Returned to the store at 12:15, and store clerk Xiao Mei came on duty at 12:30. Song Yajing printed out the order list, guided Xiao Mei to clean the warehouse, move summer leftover stock, and wash the wooden props and rattan baskets used for autumn displays, and proposed a window display concept: warm lighting on the left with new Chinese-style pieces, and light retro knitwear with pleated skirts on the right. Xiao Mei recorded the tasks in a notebook.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon store work and customer reception
description: During the afternoon rush hour, Song Yajing actively received customers in the front area. She recommended a navy blue lightweight commuter blazer to a young girl and styled it three ways, successfully closing the sale. At the same time, she patiently replied via WeChat to three regular customers asking about the arrival of new items. With Xiao Mei's help, she refreshed the window-side display, adjusted the hanging of long skirts, and recorded a checklist of color combination adjustments.
location: Yajing Life Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Purchased sports gear.
description: At 15:30, she left the store and walked to the Nike flagship store on Zhongshan Road. After trying on three pairs of running shoes, she chose the light gray Pegasus running shoes and also picked out two sets of breathable, quick-dry workout clothes. At checkout, she asked the clerk for beginner running tips and noted them in her phone memo, then left carrying the shopping bags.
location: Nike Flagship Store, No. 78 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and go home.
description: At 4 p.m., she arrived at the kindergarten. Her daughter Chen Lexuan rushed over to show the two little red flowers she had earned today and, as they walked, shared how she had shared a nursery rhyme with her classmates. The mother and daughter passed the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where her daughter picked out strawberry yogurt and mini cookies as snacks. Then they walked home. On the way, Song Yajing told her daughter that she had bought new running shoes and planned to go morning running from now on.
location: Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province: from Siming Experimental Kindergarten, passing the metro station convenience store at 35-101 Zhenhai Road, returning to the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street

name: Prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing checked the ingredients in the fridge — Chinese yam, pork ribs, tomatoes, and so on — and decided to make yam and pork rib soup, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried water spinach. She put on an apron and, while washing and chopping the vegetables, played mindfulness meditation music, feeling relaxed.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner for a family of three.
description: At 17:20, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work. After changing into loungewear, he went into the kitchen to help cut tomatoes. They cooked while chatting; Song Yajing shared the progress of the morning livestream and orders, and her husband said the project was going smoothly. At 18:00, dinner was served. Their daughter Chen Lexuan insisted on performing a finger rhyme she had learned in kindergarten, waving her hands and dancing. The couple looked at each other and smiled, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening activities with daughter
description: After the meal, she did crafts with her daughter in the living room, using colored cardstock and stickers to make a picture for Grandpa and Grandma depicting the family of three on Gulangyu Island. Then she read a sequel story to "The Kissing Hand." At 19:00, she ran bath water for her daughter, washed her hair and scrubbed her back, and her daughter played and splashed in the water. At 19:20, she carried her daughter out, dried her off, and put her in pajamas, then asked her husband to read the last storybook while she cleaned up the bathroom.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact parents to schedule a weekend video call
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing sent a WeChat voice call from the living room sofa to her father Song Minghui back home in Quanzhou. After exchanging pleasantries, they agreed to have a family video call at 8 p.m. on Saturday. They talked about their daughter's performance at school and the autumn ordering situation. Afterwards, she also sent a WeChat message to her mother Lin Xiuying to let her know.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening travel magazine reading
description: Leaning against the headboard of the bed in the bedroom, she browsed Lonely Planet magazine, focusing on the family travel special features on Hokkaido, Japan and the Maldives. She photographed hotels and attractions she was interested in, and noted in her memo, “Hokkaido is suitable for in-depth family trips, while the Maldives is more suitable for couples.” She also browsed articles on saving up a travel fund.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and running plan
description: Spread the yoga mat on the carpet and did a 5-minute full-body stretch, focusing on relaxing the shoulders, neck, and legs. Then, excitedly tried on the new running shoes, opened the mobile map to plan the next morning's running route: from Shanggu Street Community via Bailu Road, around Zhongshan Park and back, about 2 kilometers, and set alarm reminders in the fitness app for morning runs every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening skincare and a chat between husband and wife
description: Went to the bathroom for the evening skincare routine: cleanser, serum, lotion, eye cream. Back in the bedroom, her husband was already lying down scrolling through his phone. Song Yajing slipped under the quilt and leaned against him. They chatted about the weekend plans — a video call with her parents on Saturday evening and taking their daughter to Zhongshan Park on Saturday morning. She also replied to a VIP customer's WeChat message about when the new styles would arrive.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting sleepy and falling asleep
description: At 21:30, she turned off the main light, leaving the small bedside lamp on. Closing her eyes, she quickly reviewed today's achievements: the livestream made progress, the order was confirmed, the exercise gear was bought, her daughter happily started kindergarten, and a video call with her parents was scheduled... A smile curled at the corners of her mouth, feeling content. She turned off her phone and placed it on the nightstand, took a few deep breaths, and gradually fell asleep, drifting into dreamland in the moonlight at 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and a simple breakfast.
description: At 6:50 a.m., the alarm went off right on time. Song Yajing rubbed her eyes, feeling a little nervous at the thought of starting her first morning run that day. She quietly pulled open the curtains and let the sunlight pour into the room. After a quick wash-up, she drank a glass of warm water and had two slices of whole-wheat bread and a glass of milk for energy. She glanced back at her sleeping daughter Chen Lexuan and gently closed the bedroom door.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her get dressed and braided her little pigtails, and the two of them grabbed their bags and headed out. Holding her daughter's little hand, she walked along the familiar streets to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter chattered about dreaming last night that her mother could fly, and Song Yajing smiled in response. At the kindergarten gate, watching her daughter greet the teacher and walk into the classroom, Song Yajing felt warm inside.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to Zhongshan Park
description: Leaving the kindergarten, Song Yajing walked to Zhongshan Park for her morning run along the route she had planned the night before. On the way, she passed a convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought a cup of soy milk. After arriving at the park, she sat down on a bench and changed into the new running shoes she had specially bought, making final preparations for the upcoming run.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First morning run and stretching.
description: Song Yajing put on her running shoes, took a deep breath, and started her first formal morning run. Following the sports store clerk's advice, she warmed up with a 5-minute brisk walk, then alternated between 3 minutes of jogging and 2 minutes of brisk walking. Although running was very tiring and her lungs felt like they were burning, she gritted her teeth and kept going for 20 minutes. Afterward, she stretched carefully for 10 minutes in the park fitness area, focusing on relaxing her calves and thighs. Though tired after the run, she felt much more energetic overall, and her neck and shoulders felt lighter. She took out her phone, took a photo of the park's blue sky and green trees, and posted it to Moments to check in, with the caption: “First day of morning run, check-in! Today's air is sweet.”
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and morning meeting.
description: After finishing her morning run, Song Yajing walked from Zhongshan Park to her store on Zhongshan Road. On the way, she sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang a WeChat message sharing that she had completed her morning run, and he replied with a thumbs-up. When she arrived at the store, she changed into clean clothes in the small room in the back, then cleaned up, organized the shelves, and checked yesterday's sales. Around 9 a.m., the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, and together they changed the seasonal clothing on the mannequins and cleaned the carpet. Afterwards, Song Yajing brewed two cups of coffee and held a morning meeting with Xiaomei to discuss the day's priorities.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Core store operations meeting: new product promotion planning.
description: Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei used the new product images on their phones and the store floor plan to start detailed planning for the fall new product promotion. They decided to place the 20-piece new Chinese-style series on the golden display rack to the right of the entrance, presenting knitwear and wide-leg pants together, and worked out a community promotion plan: starting next Monday, they would 'preview' one new product in the VIP group every day and accept limited pre-orders. The two gestured and took notes as they talked, and the whole process was exciting and lasted nearly 2 hours.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Display adjustment and customer reception
description: After the meeting, Song Yajing and Xiaomei adjusted the displays, putting away some summer clothes to make room for the new Chinese-style series. During this, a friend introduced by regular customer Vivian came over. Song Yajing put together a commuter outfit based on her needs. The customer was very satisfied and paid directly, and Xiaomei praised Sister Yajing's keen eye.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Lunch break and business communication.
description: Song Yajing asked Xiao Mei to go eat first while she watched the shop. During the lunch break, she called supplier Susan over WeChat voice and discussed in detail the customization requirements for the fifth-anniversary commemorative silk scarf: 60 cm square, silk, Morandi blue background, with the store logo, the words 'Yajing Lifestyle Store', and fifth-anniversary elements. The two parties settled on a minimum order of 100 scarves, with delivery in about 10 days. After hanging up, Song Yajing ordered a takeout bowl of satay noodles and savored the day's plans while eating, feeling that everything was full of promise.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Afternoon operations and community warm-up
description: After Xiaomei came back, Song Yajing continued to attend to customers in the store. In a spare moment, she tried on her 3 favorite new autumn styles and had Xiaomei take photos and short videos from different angles. Then she carefully wrote the copy and posted it to her Moments and VIP customer group, announcing that the items would arrive next week and that pre-orders were welcome. As soon as she sent it, she received likes and private message inquiries from several regular customers.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing set off from the shop and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. On the way, she called her husband to tell him she would be the one picking her up. When she arrived at the kindergarten, her daughter Chen Lexuan ran out excitedly, holding up a Chinese homework sheet with a red five-pointed star; neatly written pinyin and a drawing of a little girl with pigtails were on it, along with the word 'Mom.' Song Yajing squatted down and kissed her daughter on the forehead, praising her for getting her first reward since starting primary school. The daughter beamed with joy.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child time at the community park.
description: After picking up her daughter, Song Yajing and Chen Lexuan walked hand in hand to the small park near the community. They sat on a bench, and her daughter took out a small bread roll given by her teacher from her backpack, broke it in half, and shared it with her mother. As she ate, she told the story of playing on the slide with children in kindergarten today. Looking at her daughter's happy smiling face, Song Yajing also felt especially relaxed and fulfilled.
location: Community park near Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening store operations
description: Song Yajing walked back from the community park to her shop on Zhongshan Road with her daughter, arriving around 18:30. The shop assistant Xiaomei helped look after Xuanxuan and let her draw at a corner table. Song Yajing received the evening customers and showed them the new-product preview photos taken that afternoon. A regular customer, Sister Liu, pre-ordered a new Chinese-style dress on the spot. The warm yellow lights in the shop and the smiles of the regular customers made Song Yajing's exhaustion from the day fade away.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Coming Home and Family Time
description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing counted the day's revenue, confirmed it was correct, then turned off the lights, locked the door, and left work with her daughter and shop assistant Xiaomei. She walked home with Xuanxuan. When they arrived, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already waiting at home. Song Yajing showed her husband their daughter's homework with a five-pointed star, and he happily lifted her up high. The family of three sat on the sofa sharing funny moments from the day. Song Yajing especially boasted about sticking with her first morning run, and her husband encouraged her to keep it up tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family time and bedtime preparation
description: After returning home, Song Yajing helped her daughter Chen Lexuan wash up, told her the bedtime story "Little Rabbit Tom," and watched her daughter fall asleep sweetly. Then she returned to the master bedroom and had a brief chat with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, leaning against the headboard. After changing into pajamas, Song Yajing did pre-sleep stretching, focusing on massaging the legs she had used for running today. She wrote tomorrow's to-do items in her phone memo: follow up on the custom silk scarf design draft and reply to new-product community inquiries. Then she closed her eyes and said a bedtime prayer, thanking God for keeping the family safe through the day and asking for a smooth tomorrow. At 23:00 sharp, she turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally in the morning light, and the weather outside was clear. She got out of bed quietly, first went to her daughter Xuanxuan's room to tuck her in, then poured herself a glass of warm water in the living room. She checked the weather forecast on her phone—sunny turning cloudy, with thundershowers in the afternoon—and silently noted that she needed to bring in the clothes early. After a quick wash, she unrolled the yoga mat and did 5 minutes of simple stretches to wake up her body.
location: Bedroom and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare and enjoy a family weekend breakfast
description: Aqiang and Xuanxuan woke up one after another. Yajing prepared a hearty weekend breakfast for the family: whole wheat toast lightly crisped, served with fried eggs, avocado slices, and fresh blueberries; she heated milk and cut a plate of oranges. The family sat around the dining table chatting leisurely. Xuanxuan excitedly mentioned the 'Story King' competition to be held at kindergarten next week, and Yajing encouraged her to choose a story that Grandma often told. Aqiang then shared an interesting technical problem he had recently encountered at work.
location: Dining room, Residential Complex No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Equipment setup and pre-class preparation
description: After clearing the dining table, Yajing went to the study and put on her Bluetooth earphones. She opened her laptop and double-checked that the internet connection and microphone on the English online course platform were working. She took out the notebook and pen prepared last night, and reviewed the preview materials one last time—common English dialogues for the airport and hotel. She silently followed along with her finger several times, feeling both nervous and expectant.
location: Study, residential complex at No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Attended the first online English speaking class.
description: The class started on time. It was a small-group Travel English scenario class with the theme "Airport and Hotel." Six students from different cities formed pairs and did role-plays under the guidance of foreign teacher Anna. At first, Yajing was so nervous that her palms were sweating. When it was her turn to practice the "check-in" conversation with a young man from Shanghai, her mind went blank for a moment, but Teacher Anna patiently encouraged her: "Take your time, Jing." She finally managed to stammer out, "Excuse me, where is the check-in counter?" After class, she took careful notes, completed the voice check-in assignment on the app, and downloaded the day's read-along materials.
location: Study, residential complex at No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Break between classes and sharing
description: The class was over. Yajing walked out of the study and stretched. Aqiang handed her a glass of water and asked with a smile, “How was it? How do you feel?” Yajing smiled shyly and said, “My tongue is all tied in knots, but it feels great! It’s like I’ve become a student again.” Aqiang encouraged her, “It’s your first time, and it was great! From now on, we’ll rely on you to lead the way when we go abroad.” The two leaned on the sofa and chatted for a few minutes, and Yajing felt warm in her heart.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompany her daughter to finish her weekend homework.
description: Yajing sat down beside Xuanxuan and took out the weekend homework book. The Chinese homework was to copy the pinyin 'bpmfdtnl'. When writing 'f', Xuanxuan always got the direction wrong. Yajing didn't get impatient. She held Xuanxuan's little hand and taught her stroke by stroke, and made up a mnemonic: 'a walking cane f f f'. The two practiced repeatedly on paper, and Yajing also designed a small game called 'Spot the Difference in Pinyin' to reinforce it. After finishing all her homework, Xuanxuan took the initiative to practice the pinyin recitation she would perform for her grandparents in the evening.
location: Living room desk, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and enjoying a family lunch
description: At lunchtime, Yajing planned to make a simple and nutritious "tomato and egg noodle soup." She tied on an apron while Aqiang helped by washing the greens. While the noodles were cooking, Yajing chatted with Aqiang about the "ordering food" dialogue she had learned in English class, saying that at least she would be able to understand the menu at foreign restaurants in the future. When the steaming noodles came out of the pot, served with a plate of cucumber salad, the family of three ate contentedly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, kitchen and dining room.

name: Lunch break and social time on the phone.
description: After lunch, Yajing cleaned up the kitchen. She leaned back on the sofa and picked up her phone, first replying to a few WeChat messages she had not had time to look at last night. Seeing the weekend food photos sent by her best friend Li Meiling, she replied with a crying-with-craving emoji and made an appointment to meet up for a meal when free next week. Then she browsed her supplier Susan's Moments, saw the preview of the new cashmere items she posted, and gave it a like.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street No. 82 community, living room sofa

name: Organizing marketing materials for new autumn products and confirming custom order progress
description: Yajing opened her laptop and phone, and imported the new Chinese-style collection design images that supplier Susan had sent earlier into a photo editing app. She carefully selected the 5 photos with the best lighting and composition, and adjusted the color tones to make them look more premium. Next, in her phone memo, she planned the next week's Daily Teaser posts, pairing each photo with an appealing keyword and a small styling tip. Afterward, she sent Susan a WeChat voice message asking about the progress of the sample for the store's fifth anniversary commemorative silk scarf. Susan replied that the sample was already being made and that she expected to send her the detailed photos the day after tomorrow. Yajing said she looked forward to it.
location: Study, residential complex at No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handling community group matters
description: Yajing opened WeChat and posted a teaser message in the “Jingshang VIP Customer Group”: “Dear friends, we're actively preparing for the store's fifth anniversary celebration. There is a little mystery gift being made, so look forward to it!” She paired it with an image of a Morandi blue color palette for silk scarves. Several regular customers immediately responded, asking if it was a scarf. Yajing smiled and kept them guessing, and the group became lively.
location: Study, residential complex at No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family parent-child craft time
description: Seeing the sky begin to cloud over outside, Yajing decided to hold the afternoon parent-child activity early. She took out the maple leaf pattern stickers and colored cardstock she had bought at the stationery store yesterday, and made "autumn bookmarks" with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan was responsible for decorating with stickers, while Yajing helped cut the cardstock and wrote pinyin such as "a, o, e" on the bookmarks. As mother and daughter did the craft together, they discussed what to show Grandpa and Grandma during the evening video call. Outside, raindrops began to tap gently against the window.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing the wardrobe and planning for seasonal changes
description: As the rain got heavier, Yajing decided to organize the master bedroom wardrobe. She folded the summer clothes and put them into compression bags, and hung Xuanxuan's and her own thin autumn jackets and pants within easy reach. She found that several of Xuanxuan's autumn clothes from last year had already become too small, so she took photos with her phone, noted the sizes and colors, and planned to go to the store next week to see if there were suitable matching pieces or to pick some from a children's clothing store. She also picked out a few wool coats that needed dry cleaning and put them into a bag. Thunder rumbled outside the window.
location: Main bedroom, 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare family dinner together.
description: The rain was letting up, and the aroma of food wafted from the kitchen. Tonight's theme was home-style Minnan dishes: Yajing was in charge of steamed sea bass and stir-fried water spinach with garlic, while Aqiang showed off his specialty—stir-fried clams. Xuanxuan also joined in, helping wash cherry tomatoes and set the table. The family chatted and laughed, enjoying the joy of working together.
location: Kitchen, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Enjoying a family dinner
description: When dinner was served, the clams were plump and the fish was tender. Yajing shared a funny story from her English class, saying that when she practiced asking for directions, she said 'living room' instead of 'restroom', which made everyone laugh. Xuanxuan also tried to say 'Excuse me', and although her pronunciation was not quite standard, her adorable manner made the atmosphere even merrier. After the meal, Aqiang voluntarily took on the dishwashing task.
location: Dining room, Residential Complex No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare for video call
description: Getting ready for the video call. Yajing checked the iPad's battery and Wi-Fi signal. Aqiang brightened the lights in the living room sofa area and cleared the clutter from the coffee table, revealing a tidy background. Xuanxuan eagerly changed into the new floral print dress her grandmother had mailed last week, held up a practice sheet filled with pinyin, and practiced her expressions and recitation tone over and over in front of the black TV screen.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with parents in Quanzhou.
description: At exactly 8 p.m., the video call connected. Father Song Minghui appeared on the screen in his pajamas, while mother Lin Xiuying peered from behind wearing reading glasses. Xuanxuan was the first to lean toward the camera, loudly and fluently reciting the complete pinyin table, and even used pinyin to spell out "grandma and grandpa," making the two elders grin from ear to ear. Yajing then shared the nervousness and gains from her first English class that day, as well as the progress on the custom silk scarf for the store's fifth anniversary. Mother Lin Xiuying excitedly held up her phone to show off her freshly baked, not-too-sweet tiramisu, and explained the recipe and steps in detail. Father reminded them to take care of their health and not to work too hard. The atmosphere of the call was warm and lively.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recording recipes and sorting out WeChat
description: After ending the video call, Yajing immediately received the tiramisu recipe with photos and text from her mother. She opened the notes app on her phone, carefully saved the information, and mentally went through the ingredient list: "Mascarpone cheese, ladyfingers, black coffee, eggs, cocoa powder... Right, we don't have any coffee powder at home, so I need to buy some." Then she quickly glanced through the other WeChat group messages, and there was nothing important that needed an immediate reply.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street No. 82 community, living room sofa

name: Putting daughter to sleep.
description: Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into pajamas. She leaned against the bedside and read Xuanxuan her favorite picture book, “Guess How Much I Love You.” After finishing the story, Yajing softly asked, “Little bunny, what was the happiest thing today?” Xuanxuan blinked her big eyes and said, “Making bookmarks with Mommy and performing pinyin for Grandma and Grandpa—they all praised me!” As she spoke, a satisfied smile on her face, she soon fell asleep. Yajing gently kissed her forehead.
location: Daughter's bedroom in the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night private time with her husband
description: After settling their daughter down, Yajing returned to the living room, where Aqiang had already poured two cups of hot tea. The two curled up on the sofa and talked about how concerned their parents were during the evening video call, and sighed at how fast time flies. Yajing brought up the idea of taking a few days during the National Day holiday to go back to Quanzhou and visit her parents. Aqiang agreed without hesitation and said he could look into the adjusted work schedule to try to stay one more day. The two began to plan, and initially agreed to buy some good tea leaves for her father and a cashmere scarf for her mother. Finally, they also talked about their recent work situations; Aqiang shared new progress on his project, and Yajing told him some initial ideas for the fifth anniversary event.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street No. 82 community, living room sofa

name: Wind down before bed and wrap up the day.
description: Back in the bedroom, Yajing did a short pre-sleep stretch in front of the mirror again, focusing on releasing the stiffness in her lower back and shoulder-neck area caused by sitting for too long, and took a few deep breaths for a brief meditation. After her body relaxed, she took out her phone and wrote tomorrow's to-do list in her memo: “1. Buy black coffee powder for tiramisu; 2. Go to the children's clothing store to look at autumn clothes for Xuanxuan; 3. Confirm the autumn display details for the store on Monday.” After writing it, she turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep, full of the day's fulfillment and happiness.
location: Main bedroom, 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up, getting ready, and having breakfast with the family.
description: On Sunday morning, I woke up to weather turning from overcast to cloudy. After changing into a clean dark-blue floral dress, I went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: hot milk, fried eggs, and toast. At 7:50 I woke up my daughter Xuanxuan, helped her wash her face, and tied her hair into a ponytail. My husband Chen Zhiqiang got up afterwards. The family sat around the dining table. I reminded my husband to accompany us to church today, and also shared my plan to make the tiramisu my mother taught me in the afternoon.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Walk to the ferry terminal and take the ferry to Gulangyu Island
description: After breakfast, the family of three left at 8:20, walked through the neighborhood, and headed along Shanggu Street toward Xiamen Ferry Terminal. On the way, she chatted with her husband about preparations for next week's shop work. They arrived at the ferry terminal about 12 minutes later, tapped a transit card, and boarded the 8:40 ferry. They chose seats by the window, and she held her daughter while admiring the sea view and passing boats; her husband took a few photos with his phone. About 15 minutes later, the ferry arrived at Gulangyu Piano Wharf. After disembarking, they walked along Lujiao Road toward the church.
location: From Xiamen Ferry Terminal, No. 15 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Gulangyu Piano Pier.

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Entered Gulangyu Catholic Church right at 9:00. Father Wang Mingde celebrated Mass, and the sermon topic was 'Finding Grace in the Ordinary Details of Daily Life.' During silent prayer, she felt peaceful and calm inside. After Mass, she met Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow parishioner, in the church courtyard. Lin warmly asked how the shop was doing and mentioned that her little granddaughter also studied at Siming Experimental Primary School. When Father Wang passed by, she sincerely invited him to say a blessing for the shop's fifth anniversary celebration on September 15. The priest happily agreed and told her to let him know the specific arrangements in advance.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gulangyu Island stroll and baking ingredient shopping.
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Lin and Father Wang, the family of three strolled on the island. Walking along Lujiao Road toward Longtou Road, they passed many old villas and courtyard walls covered with bougainvillea. Their daughter looked around curiously while her husband patiently explained. On Longtou Road, they found the familiar baking ingredient store and bought the black coffee powder and sugar-free cocoa powder needed for tiramisu. When they passed a children's clothing store, they glanced at the new autumn styles in the window and planned to bring their daughter for a fitting next time.
location: Longtou Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned by ferry and walked home.
description: At 11:00 we returned the same way and took the 11:05 ferry from Piano Pier back to Xiamen Island. My husband said today's Mass made him feel relaxed, and our daughter leaned against me, a little tired. After disembarking, we walked about 15 minutes back to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street and went upstairs home. Our daughter went to the living room to play with toys by herself, while my husband and I prepared lunch.
location: Gulangyu Piano Pier to Room 502, Unit 3, Residential Block 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing lunch and having lunch together
description: It was almost 12 when I got home. My husband helped wash the rice and cook it, and I quickly made a pan of stir-fried vermicelli and seaweed egg drop soup. At 12:15 the whole family sat down to lunch. I shared the good news that I had invited the priest to bless the store, and my husband said it was a great idea. My daughter chattered about the patterns in the church’s stained glass windows.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Lunch break and baking preparations
description: After lunch, my husband took our daughter to the living room to watch cartoons. I quickly cleaned up the kitchen, set a 20-minute alarm on my phone, and closed my eyes to rest for a while in the bedroom, storing up energy for the afternoon baking. When the alarm went off at 13:20, I washed my face, took out the mascarpone cheese, eggs, and whipping cream I had prepared last night from the refrigerator, and got ready to make tiramisu.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Made tiramisu together with her daughter
description: Took out the recipe sent by my mother and tied a small apron on my daughter. I was responsible for whisking the egg yolk mixture, cheese mixture, and meringue, while my daughter carefully dipped ladyfingers briefly into the black coffee and lined the bottom of the mold with them. A few drops of coffee splashed, but the kitchen was filled with aroma. My husband passed by and took a few photos of the mother and daughter working intently. At 15:30, I guided my daughter to pour the mixed batter layer by layer into a glass square container and put it in the refrigerator to chill and set. After that, I quickly cleaned up the kitchen, washed my face, changed into comfortable loungewear, and was ready to take the family downstairs for a walk.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After tidying up, went downstairs for a walk and interacted with neighbors.
description: At 16:15, the family of three went downstairs to the central garden of the residential complex for a walk. The weather had cleared up and the sunlight was warm. Near the pavilion, we ran into Aunt Zhang Xiuying, a neighbor. She had just come back from the vegetable market and gave my daughter a box of homemade mung bean cakes. I took out the tiramisu sample pack I had brought in the morning and invited her to taste it. She praised its smooth texture and said her mung bean cake recipe could be made healthier with less sugar. That remark inspired me: the celebration gift could be homemade low-sugar mung bean cakes.
location: Central Garden of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner
description: After the walk home, I prepared dinner with my husband. I did the cooking, making stir-fried seasonal vegetables and steamed sea bass, while my husband helped. In the living room, my daughter used her new mung bean cakes and sticker book to set up her little 'tea party'.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Dinner and tasting tiramisu
description: Dinner started at 18:00. At the table, she shared the gift bag inspiration she got from Aunt Zhang, and her husband was very supportive. After the meal, she took out the chilled tiramisu, dusted it with cocoa powder, and cut it into pieces. Although it didn't look delicate, the taste was amazing when eaten — the mascarpone cream was fine and silky, with the slight bitterness of coffee blending with the sweetness of cream. Their daughter ate two pieces in a row, and her husband sincerely praised her, saying her skills were getting better and better.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Help my daughter organize her schoolbag and review her lessons.
description: After dinner, I accompanied my daughter back to her room and started packing her schoolbag for tomorrow. Following the class schedule, I checked whether Monday's textbooks, pencil case, and homework notebooks were all there. Then my daughter took out her Pinyin textbook to review the initial consonants "b p m f," and I used my phone to record her reading aloud as a keepsake of her growth. Before bed, she wrapped her arms around my neck and said, "Mommy, I was so happy today! Tomorrow I'm going to tell my classmates that I made tiramisu with my mom!"
location: Daughter's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: Helped her daughter change into pajamas and told her a fairy tale about a little rabbit learning to bake a cake. Watched her fall asleep with a sweet smile, then gently turned off the desk lamp and closed the door.
location: Daughter's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Watching a baking documentary with her husband and exchanging thoughts
description: After settling our daughter in, I went to the living room and brewed two cups of goji berry tea. I suggested watching a short documentary about the making of traditional Italian desserts, and my husband readily agreed. The two of us snuggled on the sofa, watching the authentic recipe and evolution of tiramisu, discussing the afternoon's baking experience as we watched. My husband joked that my work could rival the one in the documentary. This quiet time alone together made me feel especially content.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 3, 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Review English notes and plan next week's schedule.
description: At the desk, she opened her English notebook and reviewed common airport-scenario sentences recorded in yesterday's English class. She opened the course app on her phone, completed a voice-reading assignment, practiced the sentence for asking about the boarding gate repeatedly, and submitted it. Then she opened the calendar on her phone and checked next week's schedule: Monday afternoon to the store, Tuesday and Thursday evenings to prepare for the live stream, Saturday the second English class, and most importantly, next Monday (September 15), the fifth anniversary celebration. Looking at the packed schedule, she felt life was full of purpose.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-sleep stretching and bedtime preparation
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she laid out the yoga mat on the floor and did 10 minutes of pre-sleep stretching to relax the muscle soreness from standing during the morning Mass and the afternoon baking. While stretching, she reviewed the fulfilling day: spiritual nourishment, successful baking, warm neighborly interactions, and sweet family time. In her phone memo, she wrote down tomorrow's to-dos: contact Father Wang to confirm the celebration blessing details, prepare new products at the store, and find packaging inspiration for celebration gifts. Then she turned off the light and returned to the bedroom; her husband was already lying down. They chatted softly for a few sentences about the next day, and amid the autumn night insect chirping, she gradually drifted into sleep with contentment and calm. Around 22:15, she turned off the light and officially went to bed.
location: Bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: In the morning, she got up, washed up, prepared breakfast for her daughter, and watched her husband take their daughter to school.
description: I woke up to the alarm, washed up quickly, and changed into workout gear. I prepared breakfast for my daughter Chen Lexuan, including hot milk, toasted whole-wheat bread with strawberry jam, and sliced kiwi. I gently called her to get up, braided her little pigtails, and told her to listen to her father. My husband Chen Zhiqiang was responsible for taking our daughter to kindergarten. I watched from the doorway as father and daughter left chatting and laughing. Since my husband had enough time before work today, he took on this task on his own initiative, giving me more time for my morning run.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning run at Zhongshan Park; physical fitness improved noticeably
description: Jogged to Zhongshan Park in new running shoes. Today I successfully ran two full 5-minute intervals without stopping, with only a 2-minute brisk walk in between to recover, and the pace was nearly 30 seconds faster than last time. After the run, I stretched carefully on a park bench and recorded it with a running app, shared it to the newly joined “Zhongshan Park Morning Jog Group,” and received likes from neighbors. Although my calves were a bit sore, I felt a great sense of achievement.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bought handmade soap materials at a stationery store and ran into a neighbor to exchange tips
description: After my morning run, I stopped by the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road on the way. Following an online tutorial, I carefully selected milky-white soap base, lavender essential oil, dried rose petals, heart-shaped molds, and gift wrapping paper. In the store I ran into a regular customer, Sister Lin, who was also buying craft materials for her child. We chatted for a while, and she shared her tips for making handmade soap successfully. I then bought an extra set of molds, thinking that if it worked, I could make a few more bars to give to other regular customers.
location: Stationery store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walked to the store and made opening preparations and pre-livestream arrangements with Xiaomei.
description: Carrying a bag of handicraft materials, she walked to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, she put things down and cleaned up and organized the displays with Xiaomei. We held a brief morning meeting, and I updated her on today's work priorities: a store livestream at 10 a.m., early promotion for the fifth anniversary celebration, and launching a story collection in the community group. After that, I touched up my makeup in the fitting room, adjusted the fill light and phone stand. Taking advantage of the gap before the livestream, I called Father Wang Mingde, thanked him again for agreeing to say a blessing for the store anniversary yesterday, and confirmed the specific schedule for the celebration day. I felt very reassured.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Conducting a store livestream, previewing the fifth anniversary celebration, and launching a story collection
description: The livestream started on time. Wearing the store's new autumn shirt, I first shared my successful morning running experience with everyone to bring us closer. Then I got to the main topic: for the first time, I officially gave a preview of the store's fifth anniversary celebration next Monday (September 15), excitedly recalling the scene on opening day five years ago. In the second half, I officially launched the "Your First Piece of Clothing with Yajing" story collection campaign in the community, promising that the five selected storytellers would each receive a 100-yuan store coupon. Xiaomei helped by displaying products and replying to comments beside me. The livestream received an enthusiastic response, and community interaction rates instantly soared.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receiving midday customers and interacting with regular customers in the community group.
description: After the livestream ended, foot traffic in the store began to increase. I attended to customers while finding small gaps to @ the regular customers who had already sent long recollections in the group, thanking them for sharing. Xiao Mei cooperatively teased the detail photos of the autumn camel trench coat that had just been hung up that day, and many customers asked about sizes and prices in the group.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Learning English and taking a nap during lunchtime
description: As the midday customer flow gradually slowed, we ordered two servings of shacha noodles for delivery. While eating, I opened an English learning app and spent 15 minutes reviewing the travel-scenario dialogues I learned yesterday. Then I closed my eyes and rested on the sofa in the shop for 20 minutes, storing up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the supermarket to buy ingredients for low-sugar mung bean cakes and returned to the store.
description: While Xiaomei minded the store, I walked to the Tesco convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Following the list I made last night, I carefully picked out peeled mung beans, xylitol, unsalted butter, and mooncake molds. Before checking out, I remembered that the new quarter's shop rent was due soon, so I used the ICBC ATM next to the supermarket to transfer the rent to the landlord Li Jie's account and took a screenshot. Then I carried the bag of ingredients back to the store and, on the way, stopped at a milk tea shop to buy a lemon tea for myself and one for Xiaomei to quench our thirst.
location: Tesco Convenience Store, No. 78 Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize community story collection feedback, and adjust the autumn new product display.
description: Back at the store, I immediately opened my phone and organized the feedback from the community story collection into a table. Nearly 20 customers left comments. I selected the 5 stories that moved me the most, sent private messages to contact them, and mailed them coupons. Then, Xiaomei and I moved the autumn trench coat that had received a strong response during the livestream to the most prominent gold display rack in the store, and readjusted the outfit.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with daughter and plan details for the store's fifth anniversary celebration.
description: My husband Aqiang posted a photo of picking up our child from school in the group chat, and I used this free time to make a video call. My daughter Chen Lexuan happily showed me a painting she had drawn and said that the teacher had praised her. I complimented her and told her that Mommy would go back in the evening to play with her. After hanging up, I wrote down the framework of the celebration day's activity flow in my memo, including the time for the priest's blessing and the method for distributing guest gifts.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening peak hours: receiving regular customers and closing multiple orders
description: It was closing time, and the store welcomed a small rush. Several regulars who had seen the trench coat preview in the community group came directly to the store to try it on. I helped them match different pants and skirts and made three successful sales. I also received a couple traveling to Xiamen. They picked out two modern-style cheongsams and said they wanted to wear them to take photos on Gulangyu Island.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: During dinner, reviewed the livestream data, then handled messages and organized tomorrow's to-do list.
description: We ordered two light salads on our phones and quickly finished dinner in the store. While eating, we reviewed today's livestream and community data and discussed the new products we could tease tomorrow. Xiaomei suggested posting a teaser video of making handmade soap tomorrow, and I thought it was a great idea. After dinner, while there were fewer customers, I carefully replied one by one to all the unresponded messages about the anniversary celebration in the community group and thanked everyone for their enthusiastic participation. Then I wrote down tomorrow's main tasks in my work log: contact the wedding dress shop to confirm the bridesmaid dress order, test-make low-sugar mung bean cakes, and prepare for the day after tomorrow's video shoot of handmade soap for Teacher's Day.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After closing, walked home and contacted her husband on the way.
description: After confirming that the shop door was locked and the water and electricity were turned off, I hung up the "Closed" sign and said goodbye to Xiao Mei. Carrying the handicraft materials and mung bean cake ingredients I had purchased, I walked home for fifteen minutes. On the way, I sent a message to my husband Chen Zhiqiang to let him know I was almost there.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Playing with her daughter and discussing the store anniversary preparations with her husband.
description: When I got home, my daughter Chen Lexuan was still awake and playing with building blocks with her dad in the living room. I squatted down and hugged her, listening to her sing the new nursery rhyme she had learned in kindergarten today. My husband Chen Zhiqiang poured me a glass of warm water and asked how my live stream went today. I showed him the enthusiastic response from the online community, and he was happy too. We bathed Xuanxuan together, and I told her two bedtime stories, watching her fall asleep sweetly. After she was asleep, Ah Qiang and I leaned against the headboard. I showed him the ingredients I had bought today for making low-sugar mung bean cakes. He suggested adding a little matcha powder to adjust the color and make the finished product look better. We talked about the progress of the celebration preparations. Then I wrote down tomorrow's to-do list and softly asked him whether we should record a blessing video for Xuanxuan's teacher the day after tomorrow, which is Teachers' Day. He agreed.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Do some pre-sleep stretching to relax, then wash up and fall asleep peacefully.
description: Before bed, I did a 15-minute full-body stretching and relaxation routine on the exercise mat, especially for my calves after running today—they felt wonderfully sore and soothing. Then I washed up quickly, changed into comfortable pajamas, and lay in bed reviewing the day. Though busy, it was extremely fulfilling; all my plans came together perfectly, and I felt grateful and hopeful. I turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.

She pressed the mixture into a triangular mold; the edges were a bit rough and a few pieces cracked, but the texture was soft, sticky, and pleasantly sweet. She noted the details to improve in her memo.

location: Xiamen North Railway Station and Metro Line 1, 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up her mother and take her home, hand over daughter-related matters, and box the mung bean cakes
description: She took her mother's suitcase and took the subway together back to the home in Siming District, chatting about news from their hometown in Quanzhou along the way. Once home, her mother first tasted a piece of homemade mung bean cake and praised it repeatedly. Song Yajing put the pre-written 'Xuanxuan Weekend Schedule' on the refrigerator and explained in detail the pick-up/drop-off times, piano lessons, and snack restrictions. Her mother read it carefully and promised with confidence that she could handle it. Then she went to the kitchen, took out the mung bean cakes that she and Zhao Li had made and refrigerated the day before to set, removed them one by one, applied the custom sticker 'Yajing Life Gallery 5th Anniversary,' and layered them in fresh-keeping boxes by date—120 pieces in total—to prepare for the celebration.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mother-daughter collaboration: Minnan lunch and family dinner
description: Her mother was the main cook, and Song Yajing helped as the sous-chef. Together they made the signature Minnan rice noodles, with shrimp, cabbage, and shredded carrots, plus a plate of dressed cucumber salad. A little after 11, her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought Xuanxuan home after picking her up from kindergarten. Xuanxuan jumped with excitement when she saw her grandmother. The whole family sat around the table eating, lively and warm. Before the meal, Song Yajing took a photo of the lunch to check in on the health app and showed it to her mother.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday chores and handling online work
description: After lunch, I took the initiative to wash the dishes and let my mother go tidy up on the balcony. Back in the living room, I picked up my phone to check messages, replied to Zheng Kai with a 'Got it' emoji, and confirmed with supplier Susan the delivery status of the custom silk scarves, which showed they were already out for delivery. Then I texted store clerk Xiaomei to confirm the afternoon parcel arrival time and store conditions, preparing to head to the store.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the clothing store to take care of business.
description: Rode the e-bike to the Jingshang boutique clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. When she arrived, shop assistant Xiaomei was attending to customers. After a quick greeting, she adjusted the shelf displays and moved the two newly arrived light Chinese-style shirts to the central display stand. Then, under the store lights, she took photos with Xiaomei's phone and posted a Moments update promoting the fifth anniversary celebration and the new shirts.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packing luggage for the hot spring vacation with her husband
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already laid the suitcase open on the bed. The two divided the work: Song Yajing folded her own and her husband's swimsuits, and her daughter's pink swimming ring and beach shoes, while her husband packed the sunscreen, charger, and band-aids. When her husband was not looking, Song Yajing quietly stuffed the fifth anniversary celebration plan book into the side pocket of her backpack. He saw her and shook his head with a smile, and she explained with complete confidence that she was using fragmented time.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up daughter from school and bought stationery
description: Rode her electric bike to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. As soon as she saw her, Xuanxuan held up her pinyin workbook and shouted that she had earned two stars. Song Yajing squatted down, hugged her, and praised her. Then she took her to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and bought a new sticker book and a box of colored pencils. Xuanxuan picked out one with a pink bunny herself.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the stationery store at Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road

name: Warm family dinner
description: After arriving home, Xuanxuan threw herself into Grandma's arms. Mother had already made dinner, including tomato scrambled eggs, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and clear stewed pork rib soup. The whole family sat around the table eating and chatting about tomorrow's hot spring plan. Xuanxuan excitedly said she wanted to soak in the fish therapy pool with "little fish nibbling at your feet." After dinner, Song Yajing did the dishes on her own initiative, while her husband played with Xuanxuan in the living room with the newly bought stickers.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to sleep and arranging alone time
description: Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a hot bath and told her a bedtime story from "The Little Rabbit's Hot Spring Journey." After she fell asleep, she tiptoed to the living room and told her husband she wanted to go out to see a movie and relax. Her husband nodded understandingly and told her to go without worry, he would take care of things at home. Song Yajing felt warm inside, changed into comfortable casual clothes, grabbed her phone and keys, and went out.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Treating herself to a solo movie.
description: She walked about 33 minutes to Wanda Cinema, used a mobile app to buy a ticket for the 22:10 showing of Free Guy, and also bought a small bucket of popcorn and a cup of sugar-free cola. Laughter kept breaking out in the theater, and she was completely absorbed in the plot, feeling the tense nerves of the whole day relax. After the movie ended, she walked out of the cinema, looked up to see a bright clear moon, took a photo of the night sky, and posted it on Moments with the caption "Smile, keep going tomorrow" along with a photo of the ticket stub.
location: Wanda Cinema, No. 182 Yanwu West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking home and resting
description: On the walk home, she received a caring WeChat message from her husband and replied that she was already on the way. When she got home, her mother and daughter were both fast asleep, but her husband was still waiting for her. After a brief chat about the movie, she quickly washed up, did her skincare routine, and did ten minutes of stretching. Lying in bed, she felt a long-absent, fulfilling calm, grateful to her family and to herself. She slept unusually soundly that night.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, morning routine, and family handover.
description: At seven in the morning, soft morning light streamed in through the bedroom window. Yajing woke up naturally, feeling cheerful. Out of habit, she stepped onto the scale; the needle stopped steadily at 47.3 kg, and she was satisfied with the results of several consecutive days of morning runs. She first went to check on her daughter Xuanxuan’s room; the little one was still fast asleep. Then she quietly went to the kitchen and made herself a cup of honey water. Her husband A Qiang was washing up in the bathroom, and they softly discussed the day’s plans. Then Yajing went to her mother Lin Xiuying’s room, and her mother was awake too. She asked her mother to take extra care of Xuanxuan today and confirmed again her daughter’s breakfast and nap arrangements. Her mother smiled and told her to go enjoy herself without worry, and Yajing felt warm inside.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning prayer and English review
description: Family members got up one after another, and the sound of mother and Xuanxuan talking came from the living room. Yajing went to the study without turning on the lights, letting the morning light stream in through the curtains. She knelt quietly before the cross and began today's morning prayer. She first gave thanks for the time she spent with her mother, husband, and child yesterday, and also prayed especially for the smooth progress of her English class this morning and the hot spring trip with her husband. After the prayer, she took out her English class notebook from her backpack and quickly reviewed the vocabulary and sentence patterns from last week's first lesson on 'ordering at a restaurant' and 'shopping scenes' to boost her confidence.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family breakfast.
description: Aqiang had already prepared a simple breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, pork floss, and a dish of Minnan pickled cucumber brought by his mother. Xuanxuan had already had her little braids done and was sitting at the table drinking congee with a small spoon. While eating breakfast, Yajing used her phone to confirm the matter of asking Zhao Li to receive the commemorative silk scarf on WeChat the day before; Zhao Li replied with an 'OK' emoji. Thinking about how reliable her friend was, she felt more at ease.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: English class preparation
description: After breakfast, Yajing quickly got ready and changed into comfortable home clothes. She entered the study early, opened her laptop, logged into the live-streaming platform for the English class, and tested the microphone and camera. Then she took out a notebook and a pen, placed them on the desk, and set a 9:00 reminder for the class. She felt a little expectant and also slightly nervous, so she took two deep breaths and encouraged herself: "Today I'll speak up!"
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Second online English course
description: The class started on time. Today's topic was "Shopping Scenarios: Asking About Sizes and Materials." With last week's foundation and this week's daily fragmented follow-along practice, Yajing felt much more relaxed than last time. When foreign teacher Anna asked a question, she raised her hand proactively for the first time and simulated a conversation in a mall asking about the size of a silk shirt in slightly rusty but fluent English. Although there were a few minor grammar errors, her clear pronunciation and poised manner made Teacher Anna praise her in front of all the students, saying she had "improved very obviously." After class, she spent 5 minutes completing the day's pronunciation practice homework on the course app.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Packing up and saying goodbye to family.
description: As soon as the class ended, Yajing immediately stood up and started packing her luggage. She put the toiletry bag, swimsuit, sunscreen, and a beautiful dress she had organized the night before into the travel bag. Aqiang had already driven the car downstairs to wait. She walked into the living room, crouched down and hugged Xuanxuan, who was happily playing with building blocks, and kissed her cheek: 'Mommy and Daddy are going out for a day and will be back tomorrow.
