Be good and listen to Grandma, okay?' Xuanxuan nodded obediently. She then briefly told her mother a few things, mainly reminding her that Xuanxuan needed to drink some warm water in the afternoon. Only then did she feel relieved and go out the door with her luggage.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive to Haicang Hot Spring Resort
description: Yajing sat in the passenger seat, and Aqiang started the car. They drove out of Shanggu Street, looped onto Chenggong Avenue, and headed toward Haicang District. Outside the window were Xiamen's familiar streetscape, and a soothing piece of light music played in the car. The two hadn't traveled alone together like this in a long time, and their conversation was light and pleasant. Zhu Qiang shared an amusing story about a recent project that had gone online smoothly, while Yajing talked about the details of preparing for the store's fifth anniversary and how funny the movie Free Guy, which they had seen the day before, was. The pleasant chat made the drive feel especially short.
location: Xiamen, Fujian Province, along the route from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, to Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort, Haicang District, via Chenggong Avenue

name: Arrived at the resort and checked in
description: The car drove into the Sun-Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort in Haicang and parked in a tree-shaded parking lot. Yajing got out and felt the resort’s distinctive leisurely atmosphere, which made her mood even more relaxed. The two walked into the spacious, bright lobby, and Aqiang checked in with his ID. They had booked a suite with a private hot spring soaking pool. Guided by a staff member, they walked through the tropical-style gardens and arrived at the room. The room was warmly and elegantly decorated; outside the floor-to-ceiling window was a small private courtyard with a gently steaming pool in the middle.
location: Lobby of Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Two-person lunch at the resort
description: After putting down their luggage and washing up briefly, the two went to the resort's Chinese restaurant. The restaurant was elegantly decorated, and outside the window was a carefully trimmed Japanese-style garden. They chose a seat by the window and ordered a bowl of satay noodles, a plate of blanched shrimp, and a seafood appetizer platter. As she ate, Yajing said with emotion, 'Since Xuanxuan was born, we really haven't traveled this far on our own together.' Aqiang held her hand: 'Let's try to make it once a year from now on.' They smiled at each other.
location: Riyuexuan Chinese Restaurant, inside Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889, Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning to the room to change and prepare for the hot spring soak.
description: After lunch, the two strolled leisurely back to the room. Yajing took out the new swimsuit from her luggage, tried it on in front of the mirror, then carefully took sunscreen out of her bag and applied it thoroughly from head to toe, especially on her shoulders and back. Aqiang laughed at her for being too dramatic, and she retorted that UV rays don't care about the occasion. When they were ready, the two put on bathrobes, changed into the cotton slippers provided by the resort at the entrance, and got ready to head to the hot spring area.
location: Inside the suite at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Heading to the hot spring area
description: The two walked along the flagstone path of the resort to the entrance of the hot spring area. At the entrance stood a huge wooden waterwheel, next to it a stone dragon spouting water. They handed in their room cards, received wristbands, and officially stepped into the hot spring world surrounded by tropical plants.
location: Entrance to the hot spring area of Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Hot Spring Time: Relaxing Mind and Body and Catching Up
description: The afternoon sun cast dappled light and shadows through the gaps in the leaves. Yajing and her husband tried several hot spring pools with different functions one after another. They relaxed in the lavender spring, where the soft fragrance made them drowsy; in the red wine spring, Yajing recalled the time ten years ago when the two had just started dating and often strolled on the beach at Gulangyu. Ah Qiang laughed and said that back then even eating a steak counted as a "big meal." They also talked about the memory in 2020 when Yajing decided to quit her job to start a business, and Ah Qiang quietly saved startup funds from his salary to support her. In the misty steam of the hot springs, these memories seemed especially precious, and the intimacy and trust between them deepened.
location: Hot spring area of Sun Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (including lavender spring, red wine spring, herbal bath pool, etc.)

name: Resting after the hot spring and remotely confirming the store's silk scarves
description: After finishing the last round of herbal bath, both of them felt their whole bodies relaxed and their joints loose. They went to the lounge in the hot spring area and had some ginger tea and fruit provided by the resort. Yajing picked up her phone and saw a message from Zhao Li sent about 40 minutes ago: “I’ve picked up the scarves and I’m now in the store sorting and packing them for you. I’ll send a photo—check it!” In the photo, beautiful scarves were neatly folded and being packed into individual gift bags. Yajing replied: “You’re so reliable, love you! The packing bags are in the second drawer under the cash register.” She then shared Zhao Li’s photo with Aqiang and remarked that only with a good friend’s help could she relax on vacation.
location: Rest area and suites in the hot spring zone of Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return to the room to shower and change clothes
description: Returning to the suite with her husband, Yajing took a quick shower to wash off the minerals left by the hot spring. She changed into the dress she had brought—a simply cut dark blue knee-length dress—and applied light makeup and lipstick. Aqiang also changed into a clean polo shirt.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the suite, Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Rest in the room and browse information
description: With half an hour left before the dinner reservation, Yajing sat down on the sofa in the room and opened her phone to browse Moments for a while. She saw Zheng Kai had posted a Moment about "Xiamen International Fashion Week," with a forum invitation as the accompanying image. She liked it and thought to herself that she should learn more about this event next week. She also called her mother and learned that Xuanxuan had already taken her afternoon nap and was watching cartoons in the living room, behaving very well. She hung up with relief.
location: Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort Suite, 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Candlelit dinner for two
description: Night fell, and the lights of the resort came on one by one. Yajing took her husband's arm and walked to the French restaurant in the resort. The lighting inside was soft; each table had a candlestick and a red rose, and the fountain outside the window looked romantic under the lights. Following the order of the set menu, the two enjoyed appetizers, main courses (lamb chops and pan-seared salmon), and delicate desserts, accompanied by a glass of Merlot chosen by A Qiang. During the meal, Yajing said to her husband seriously, "Thank you for arranging this trip." A Qiang smiled and squeezed her hand. "We can do this every year from now on."
location: The "Fasong" Western Restaurant at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take a walk in the garden after dinner.
description: After dinner, the two decided not to rush back but to take a walk around the resort grounds. The early autumn evening breeze carried a hint of coolness, gently brushing their cheeks. They walked along the garden path; it was very quiet around them, with only the sound of water trickling from the hot spring area in the distance and insects chirping in the grass. Yajing leaned on Aqiang's shoulder, feeling a long-lost sense of peace and happiness. The two chatted about simple plans for the future, such as taking Xuanxuan hiking when she gets a little older.
location: Garden, Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretching and relaxation, and late-night balcony talk.
description: Back in the room, Yajing felt a bit full from dinner, so she did a few simple stretches on the yoga mat to relax her back and waist. Aqiang sat by the window and dealt with a few work messages on his phone. After stretching, Yajing brewed two cups of green tea and went to the balcony. There was a small night light beside the chair. In the cool night breeze, the city lights in the distance twinkled, and the hot spring pool at the resort nearby was shrouded in steam. The two sat side by side, talking about their wishes for five years from now, and the conversation was deeper and more relaxed than ever. Yajing felt that this hot spring trip was not just physical relaxation but also a recharge for the soul.
location: In the suite and on the balcony of Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening pre-bed activities: washing up, gratitude journaling, and reading together as a couple.
description: As the night grew deeper, the two got ready for bed. Yajing carefully cleansed her skin, applied a hydrating mask, and put on night cream. Aqiang lay down in bed first and watched TV news for a while. Then Yajing sat at the desk, took out the diary she carried with her, and wrote down what she was grateful for that day: being praised by her teacher in English class, the deep conversation in the hot spring, the generous help from friends, and the peace and happiness she felt at this moment. At the end of the diary entry, she wrote: "Thank the Lord for giving me all of this." After closing the diary, she got into bed and leaned against Aqiang. Aqiang had already turned off the TV and was reading a short story on his phone. The two exchanged a few scattered playful remarks until drowsiness set in. Yajing turned off the bedside lamp and whispered in the dark, "Goodnight, dear." Aqiang softly replied, "Goodnight." The room fell completely quiet, with only the faint sound of wind outside the window. The couple, filled with contentment and joy, fell into a deep sleep.
location: Inside the suite at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888-1889 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Natural awakening.
description: The sunlight softly woke me through the gap in the curtains. I stretched comfortably and saw on my phone that it was 08:28. The resort's distinctive scent of flowers and trees mixed with the morning air was refreshing. I gently nudged my husband Aqiang beside me; he turned over and mumbled that he wanted five more minutes. Smiling, I got up and did a few simple stretches by the window, savoring the lingering warmth of the hot spring.
location: Guest room at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leisurely buffet breakfast
description: After getting dressed, we strolled to a garden restaurant surrounded by greenery and filled with birdsong. I took a bowl of hot oatmeal fruit porridge and a freshly made oyster omelet, while Aqiang brought over satay noodles and coffee. We chose a seat by the window, enjoying the food and quietly reviewing yesterday's conversation in the hot spring. Aqiang smiled and said I wasn't allowed to back out of last night's promise. I nodded, feeling warm inside, and we agreed to set aside at least two or three such moments for just the two of us every year.
location: Garden Restaurant, Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, No. 1888 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Packing luggage and strolling in the garden
description: After breakfast, they returned to the guest room and slowly packed their luggage, folding the clothes they had changed out of into the suitcase. A Qiang went to the balcony to bring in the dried swimsuits. Once packed, they strolled hand in hand along the resort's garden paths to aid digestion. The air was fresh and the morning dew was still wet. They took a few photos together as mementos, and also used her phone to handle a few work-related WeChat messages, confirming that the photos of the scarf packaging Zhao Li had sent last night were fine.
location: Guest rooms and garden at Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Check out and prepare for departure.
description: After the walk, I went to the front desk to check out and got a parking voucher. I checked the trunk to make sure nothing was left behind. Aqiang started the car, I opened navigation and entered the home address, and the estimated drive was 30 minutes.
location: Lobby of Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, 1888 Fulian Road, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home.
description: The car drove steadily across Haicang Bridge, with the blue sea and Xiamen's city skyline outside the window. My favorite light music was playing in the car, and I leaned back in my seat scrolling through this morning's photos on my phone. Aqiang asked whether everything was ready for tomorrow's celebration. I smiled and replied that everything was ready except one last thing—after going back and seeing my mother off, I would go to the shop in the afternoon for one final check.
location: From Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring Resort, Haicang District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District (while driving)

name: Gather with family and thank Mom.
description: When she got home, her mother Lin Xiuying had already prepared a hearty lunch with Minnan specialties: oyster omelet, yellow-fin fish simmered in soy sauce water, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Her daughter Xuanxuan pounced over like a little sparrow and chattered about her glorious deeds of the past two days, saying Grandma had taken her to the science museum to see robots and bought her a new hair clip. I gave my mother a big hug and sincerely thanked her for all her hard work these two days. My mother smiled and said, 'Silly child, there is no need to be so polite with your mother,' and reminded me not to get too tired today since tomorrow was a big day. The family sat together and happily finished the warm lunch.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take mother to the station.
description: After the meal, my mother packed her simple luggage and insisted that we not see her off too far, but I still insisted on driving her to Xiamen Railway Station. I helped her carry her luggage. Before parting, my mother held my hand and reminded me of many things, asking whether we should invite the priest to tomorrow's celebration, telling me not to get heatstroke since there would be so many people, and saying to call her if I got too busy to handle things. I agreed to each one, watched her enter the station, and felt full of gratitude and reluctance.
location: Xiamen Railway Station, No. 900 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Brief rest and getting ready to go out
description: After seeing my mother off and returning home, Aqiang was watching cartoons with Xuanxuan. I changed into a comfortable cotton-linen dress and prepared water bottles and hats for both Xuanxuan and myself for going out in the afternoon. Aqiang said he would stay home with Xuanxuan in the afternoon to do crafts, so I could go to the store with peace of mind. I kissed Xuanxuan and told her that Mom was going to the store in the afternoon to prepare for tomorrow's party, and that she and Dad would be good at home.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to Sunday Mass
description: Since I missed Mass at the resort in the morning, I found out there was an additional Mass in the afternoon. I walked with Xuanxuan to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 and transferred to Line 2 to Cruise Center Station, then took a ferry to Gulangyu Island. Entering the quiet and solemn church, we devoutly participated in Mass together. Xuanxuan was exceptionally well-behaved, sitting quietly beside me the whole time. During the offertory, imitating the other churchgoers, she stood on tiptoe and put the prepared coins into the offering box. Seeing her earnest expression, a warm feeling rose in my heart. I silently prayed for tomorrow's fifth anniversary of the shop and for the safety and health of my family, feeling peaceful and strengthened inside.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take Xuanxuan home.
description: After Mass, I took Xuanxuan on the ferry back to the Cruise Center, then took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 1 to return to Zhenhai Road Station. On the way home, Xuanxuan leaned against my arm and was getting sleepy. I softly asked her if she wanted to come and be a little helper tomorrow when there would be an event at Mom's shop with many guests and delicious food. As soon as she heard this, she perked up again, clapped her hands happily, and said yes. After taking Xuanxuan home and handing her to Aqiang, I went to the shop alone.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arriving at the shop and checking supplies
description: I arrived at the shop at 3:30 pm. First, I unlocked the refrigerated cabinet with the key and took out the low-sugar mung bean cakes needed for tomorrow. I checked each box carefully and confirmed that the packaging stickers were not curled and the quantity was exactly 120. Then I checked the commemorative silk scarves delivered by Zhao Li. She had carefully wrapped each scarf in an individual packaging bag and sealed it with a wax stamp bearing the shop's logo. After counting, the quantity and quality were flawless.
location: The "Jingshang" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Set up the message wall area
description: Cleared the most prominent wall on the right side of the entrance, took out the pre-customized white backdrop with pink artistic lettering reading "Five Years: Hearing Your Stories." Carefully fixed branch-shaped hooks onto the board to hang customers' note cards. Then brought several lush monstera and eucalyptus plants from the storage room and arranged them around the display board at staggered heights. Finally, took out the prepared assorted-color sticky notes and several markers from the drawer.
location: The "Jingshang" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Sound system testing and atmosphere preparation
description: Connected the Bluetooth speaker used for background music in the shop to my phone, opened the carefully selected playlist from last night, which was filled with soothing, healing jazz and French chansons, and listened to a few tracks to confirm the volume and sound quality were perfect. The entire shop was now filled with a warm and beautiful atmosphere, waiting only for tomorrow's guests.
location: The "Jingshang" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Notify regular members
description: Sat down at the cashier counter, opened the store's backend management system and WeChat, and used the business tools to filter out members who had spent at least 5,000 yuan cumulatively over the past two years; there were about 25 people on the list. One by one, I opened their chat windows and sent a carefully edited WeChat message: "Dear, tomorrow is the fifth anniversary celebration of my little shop 'Jingshang'. Thank you for your continued support! I've prepared an exclusive commemorative scarf and low-sugar mung bean cakes for you. Be sure to come and claim them! We'll be open from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM tomorrow. Looking forward to seeing you in the store." After sending the last message, I felt an unprecedented sense of groundedness and anticipation.
location: The "Jingshang" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store closing and unexpected discovery
description: Everything was ready. She looked around the brand-new shop and was about to lock up and leave when she habitually checked the calendar on her phone. She suddenly realized that today was Sunday, September 14, and that two supplier payments were due before Monday morning the next day; otherwise, late fees would be incurred. She slapped her forehead and immediately added a bold note in her memo.
location: The "Jingshang" shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handling supplier payments and returning home
description: She locked the shop door, got on the electric bike, and headed home. While waiting at a red light, she took out her phone and opened the mobile banking app. She skillfully entered the account details of the two suppliers, carefully checked the amounts, and completed the transfer payments one by one. Seeing the "transfer successful" notification on the screen, she let out a long sigh of relief - as if a heavy stone had finally been lifted from her heart.
location: From No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District (while cycling).

name: Warm family dinner
description: When I got home, Aqiang was busy in the kitchen wearing an apron, and on the table he had already laid out his signature dishes — braised pork ribs, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg drop soup. Xuanxuan had helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and as soon as she saw me come home she shouted, "Mommy's back, time to eat!" I washed my hands and sat down at the table. The three of us could finally enjoy a peaceful dinner. I shared the results of today's store display, while Aqiang talked about the fun he had in the afternoon building a little castle with Xuanxuan using LEGO. The dining room was full of laughter.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter with washing up and bedtime stories
description: After dinner, I accompanied Xuanxuan to the bathroom to wash up. She squeezed out her own toothpaste, brushed her little teeth, and washed her face. I changed her into cute pajamas, then leaned against the bed and told her favorite story, "Dumbo." When I got to the part where Dumbo flies with his big ears, her eyes sparkled and she asked, "Mommy, what are my big ears? Do I have magic too?" I kissed her forehead and said, "Xuanxuan's magic is kindness and bravery." She closed her eyes contentedly and quickly fell asleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and personal time.
description: A Qiang was working overtime in the study. I quietly closed my daughter's door and returned to my own room. I first did a few minutes of simple bedtime stretches to relieve the day's fatigue, then carefully removed my makeup and applied a hydrating mask to let my skin relax. Lying on the sofa, I took out my phone and wrote today's gratitude journal: grateful for this rare hot spring trip with A Qiang, grateful for Mom's dedication, grateful that everything is ready for tomorrow's celebration.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to bed peacefully.
description: After Aqiang finished his work and was also getting ready for bed, I turned off the bedside lamp, and the whole room was enveloped in gentle darkness. Tomorrow is the fifth-anniversary celebration. I went through tomorrow's schedule once more in my mind and confirmed that nothing was missed. I felt no nervousness, only full anticipation and calm. After Aqiang and I said goodnight to each other, I slowly fell asleep to the sound of his even breathing, storing up energy for tomorrow's wonderful day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and taking my daughter to school.
description: Morning sunlight streamed into the bedroom. Yajing woke to her phone alarm, silently gave thanks, then changed into workout clothes and went downstairs to jog along the green belt around the residential community, passing the entrance of Jiaxingyuan Park and enjoying the fresh air. After washing up, she carefully picked a beige linen shirt and a dark green skirt, and paired them with pearl earrings. In the kitchen, she quickly prepared whole-wheat toast, fried eggs, and milk, while her husband Aqiang was braiding their daughter Xuanxuan's hair. Xuanxuan handed her a hand-drawn card reading 'Happy Fifth Anniversary.' Yajing reminded Aqiang to pick up their daughter from school on time. Then they walked hand in hand to take Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about dinosaur fossils at the museum. At the school gate, Yajing exchanged a few words with the teacher and then watched her daughter enter the classroom.
location: From the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 West Gucheng Road, Siming District

name: Bank transfer and commute.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Yajing rode her electric scooter to the ICBC branch on Zhongshan Road. Along the way, she listened to a podcast about brand stories of community shops through Bluetooth earphones. At the ATM, she skillfully completed two corporate transfers for supplier payments and printed the receipts. Then, with nervousness and anticipation, she sped toward the shop.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Zhongshan Sub-branch) at 76 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and en route to 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Final preparations on the eve of the celebration.
description: When she arrived at the store, Xiao Mei had already finished the final cleaning. Her college friend Zhao Min had come from Hangzhou, bringing hot coffee and buns. The three quickly aligned on their roles: Zhao Min handled photography and reception, Xiao Mei handled checkout and packing, and Yajing directed the overall operation. Yajing personally checked the sticky notes and pens at the message wall, the soft music playlist on the speakers, and confirmed that the custom silk scarves and low-sugar mung bean cakes were properly placed.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning celebration highlights and welcoming longtime members
description: Yajing hung up the anniversary sign on time and welcomed the first batch of customers with a bright smile. Throughout the morning, regular members who had booked appointments arrived one after another. She gave custom silk scarves to customers who spent 5,000 yuan or more and took Polaroid photos with them to post on the memory wall. Sister Wang, one of the first customers at the store's opening, wrote a touching note: “From a young girl to a mother, I've been buying here. Thank you, Yajing, for being with me.” Yajing's eyes welled up. Zhao Min captured many warm moments from the side.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday rest and community interaction
description: Customer traffic had decreased a bit, and the three of them had a simple meal in the store's fitting area, eating the baozi brought by Zhao Min and takeout salad. As she ate, Yajing scrolled through community messages to reply to celebration inquiries, and took a group photo of the three of them to post on Moments, with the caption "Thank you for all the encounters."
location: Rest area of the "Jingshang" boutique clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon celebration and sales peak.
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic increased, and walk-in customers and new customers were drawn into the store by the anniversary atmosphere. Yajing guided customers in filling out story notes, recommended outfits for them, and entered the information of customers eligible for the gift-with-purchase into the backend; Xiaomei efficiently packed multiple group-buy orders. Yajing posted photos of the touching notes to the customer group, sparking warm memories and interactions from regular customers, and the voice message wall was almost half covered with notes.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening rush-hour reception and surprise moments
description: In the evening, a regular customer who had just gotten off work came by to check in. Yajing personally gave her mung bean cakes and took a photo together. A regular customer who had not been invited passed by and expressed regret. Yajing took out a reserved silk scarf and a handwritten thank-you card from the storeroom and gave them to her, and the customer was pleasantly surprised. Yajing took separate photos of the touching notes from Sister Wang and this customer, thinking about how to share them with the community later.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Celebration finale and grateful perseverance.
description: In the evening, customer traffic dropped and only melodious light music remained in the shop. After seeing off the last customer, Yajing stood in front of the message wall and admired the sticky notes one by one, feeling warm and fulfilled. She estimated that revenue had far exceeded expectations. Touched by the feelings customers had left behind, she discussed with Xiaomei and Zhao Min about organizing the stories into a themed share for the community the next day.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Post-celebration wrap-up and review
description: After closing, the three cleaned up the venue, removed the sticky notes, arranged them by number, took photos for the record, and counted the remaining souvenirs (over 30 scarves were given away, and fewer than 20 mung bean cakes were left). Xiaomei suggested inviting the regular customer community to share online next time, and Yajing noted it in her phone memo. The three agreed to celebrate at the newly opened Japanese restaurant on Daxue Road tomorrow noon, and Zhao Min helped put away the decorations.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Late-night journey home
description: Yajing rode off on her electric scooter; the evening breeze was slightly cool. She called Aqiang and learned that Xuanxuan was already asleep. Aqiang reminded her to pay attention to safety. After hanging up, she felt utterly at ease.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Bedtime tidying and gratitude
description: After quietly entering the house, Yajing sat at her desk, sorted and clipped all of the day's receipts, used a calculator to total them, and wrote the sum on the flyleaf of her notebook. She flipped through the celebration photos and videos on her phone and saved the most touching ones to a dedicated folder. Finally she wrote a gratitude journal entry: “In memory of our first five years. Grateful to every witness.” After doing a simple stretch, she turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning routine.
description: At 6:45 in the morning, the alarm rang on time. After getting up, Song Yajing prayed by the bedside, then weighed herself and recorded 47.3 kg. She then tiptoed into the kitchen to prepare a ham and lettuce sandwich and warm milk for her daughter Chen Lexuan. At 7:00, she woke her daughter, and the two chatted about fun stories about kindergarten paintings while eating breakfast, marking the start of a warm family time.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school and heading to the store
description: At 7:30, Song Yajing carried her daughter's small schoolbag and walked her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After saying goodbye at the gate, she walked along Gucheng West Road toward her shop on Zhongshan Road. On the way, she passed a convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought mineral water and tissues. This nearly half-hour commute gave her time to organize her thoughts, and she arrived at Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store before 8:00.
location: Starting from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing by Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District), and arriving at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store opening preparation, pre-livestream preparation, and handover.
description: Song Yajing opened the store's rolling shutter door and did routine preparations such as turning on the lights, airing out the space, and cleaning the shelves. She checked the previous day's revenue and put it into the cash drawer, then stopped at the message wall to read the new sticky notes customers had put up. Starting at 8:40, she hung the anniversary commemorative silk scarves and new autumn styles on the live-stream rack, checked the fill light and phone holder, brewed jasmine tea, and sorted out key points for the live stream. At 9:25, Xiaomei arrived, and the two quickly handed over the day's tasks: Xiaomei would be responsible for in-store reception and order packing; Zhao Li would come in the afternoon to decorate the window display; and remember to receive the ingredients for the Good Neighbor Festival.
location: Jingshang Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tuesday regular live stream: autumn outfit sharing
description: At 9:30, Song Yajing started the livestream on time, with the record wall and the warm lighting of the store in the background. She interacted with the audience while drinking jasmine tea, explaining the "lazy autumn style" styling of the oatmeal-colored knit cardigan, and shared the story of customer Wang Jie and the commemorative silk scarf, sparking a flurry of messages from regular customers. The livestream had a warm atmosphere and effectively conveyed both emotion and product value.
location: Livestream corner inside Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Routine tasks after the livestream ends
description: After the livestream ended, Song Yajing replied to customer messages on WeChat, reserved an oat-colored cardigan for the regular customer Vivian, and agreed on a pickup time. She chose a celebration sticky note, took a photo, and posted it on Moments and in the customer group with a caption expressing gratitude. At 11:15, she sent a good-afternoon message in her close friends' group to keep up daily interaction with her friends.
location: Rest area inside Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handled in-store reception and went out for a lunch date.
description: A young couple came into the store, and Song Yajing enthusiastically recommended early-autumn dresses. Around 11:45, she asked Xiao Mei to look after the store, then rode her electric scooter to the Japanese restaurant on University Road to have lunch with her friend Zhao Min.
location: Set out from Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and headed to the Japanese restaurant on Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch with best friend Zhao Min
description: At noon, Song Yajing arrived at the Japanese restaurant, where Zhao Min was already waiting. The two ordered a sashimi platter, sukiyaki, and plum wine, and chatted freely about the details of yesterday's celebration. Song Yajing thanked Zhao Min for coming all the way from Hangzhou to help, while Zhao Min shared funny stories from her new course, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Japanese restaurant on Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop and rest briefly.
description: After lunch, Song Yajing rode her scooter back to the store. Xiaomei had brought her a latte and a tuna sandwich. She ate while browsing Xiaohongshu in the rest area, checking out autumn outfit pairings. After a short break, she was ready for the afternoon's work.
location: Rest area inside Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Designing the autumn window display with Zhao Li
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei cleared the window display area in advance. At 14:00, her friend and designer Zhao Li arrived with dried flowers, fallen leaf specimens, and other materials. The two worked together on the display. Song Yajing was responsible for hanging hemp ropes and specimens, while Zhao Li arranged the dried flowers and wooden blackboard. During the process, Zhao Li occasionally seemed absent-minded, but Song Yajing didn't ask much and simply coordinated. Xiaomei helped take photos to document the process. In the end, they completed an autumn-themed window display full of artistic flair, which attracted passersby to stop and look.
location: In front of the display window of Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Purchase ingredients for the Good Neighbor Festival.
description: After arranging the window display, Song Yajing said goodbye to Zhao Li and rode her kick scooter to Walmart on Zhongshan Road. Following the memo on her phone, she bought baking ingredients such as cake flour, red dates, and xylitol, and also picked up green vegetables and fresh shrimp for dinner. After checking out, she returned to the store, put the baking ingredients in the storage room, used old clothes to protect the eggs, and temporarily placed the vegetables under the cash register.
location: From Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Walmart Shopping Plaza (Xiamen Zhongshan Road Store) and back to the store.

name: Check the new shop window and take commemorative photos.
description: Song Yajing turned on the display window spotlights and gave the newly arranged window one final look in the evening light. Under the warm light, the dried flowers and fallen leaves cast gentle shadows, and she was very satisfied with the effect. She took a photo and sent it to Zhao Li, with a message praising it and telling her to rest well.
location: In front of the display window of Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Exchanging messages in the besties group and comforting Zhao Li
description: Song Yajing checked the messages in her close-friends group and happened to see Zhao Li pouring out her marital difficulties in the group. Song Yajing immediately sent voice messages to comfort her and expressed unconditional support. Friends in the group, including Li Meiling and Wang Jia, also chimed in with encouragement. Zhao Li's response made Song Yajing feel the warmth and strength of friendship.
location: Cashier counter inside Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner for a family of three.
description: Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, rode an electric bike to the store with their daughter Chen Lexuan, and the three went to the nearby Jinxi Shacha Noodle Shop for dinner. The steaming noodle soup dispelled the autumn evening chill. Their daughter ate happily, the couple smiled at each other, and the family time was warm and harmonious.
location: Jinxi Shacha Noodle Restaurant near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Calculate the cost of the celebration
description: After dinner, Song Yajing calculated the cost of the fifth anniversary celebration at the store's workbench. She carefully checked all expenses such as custom silk scarves, mung bean cake ingredients, coupons, and equipment rental; after confirming each item, the total cost was about 8,000 yuan. She then entered the details into the financial software and generated a report, filed the original receipts, and wrote down her reflections in her business notes.
location: Workbench inside Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up and heading home, shopping on the way
description: At 21:00, Song Yajing handed over the Neighborhood Festival tasks to Xiaomei and closed the shop, then walked home with her husband and daughter after turning off the lights and locking the door. On the way, she pushed her scooter and walked side by side with her husband, draping a jacket over their sleeping daughter. Passing a fruit stand, she bought pomegranates and kiwifruit, and returned to the residential compound around 21:50.
location: Walked from Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street back to the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Evening skincare and bedtime ritual
description: After settling her daughter down, Song Yajing washed up and applied a face mask, then sat at the dressing table to reflect on the day. She exchanged feelings with her husband on WeChat and felt each other's support. After finishing her skincare routine at 22:30, she knelt by the bed and prayed, giving thanks for everything and blessing friends and family. She turned off the light and fell asleep at 22:50, ending a fulfilling and moving day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparations to take her daughter to school
description: She naturally woke up at 6:50 a.m., weighed 47.4 kg in the bathroom, and did a brief morning prayer before the mirror, asking the Lord to guide her to create heartwarming flavors today. Then she heated milk, toasted whole wheat bread, and made instant coffee, finishing breakfast quickly. At 7:20 she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her change into a floral little dress, and while braiding her hair listened to her mumble about dreaming of eating rainbow cake. She fed her daughter half a small bowl of oatmeal and half a boiled egg while packing her schoolbag for school.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked her daughter to kindergarten
description: At 7:38, holding my daughter's hand, I walked 8 minutes to the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After a brief exchange with the teacher, I watched my daughter skip into the classroom, then left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning run at Zhongshan Park and cycling commute.
description: Walked 10 minutes from the kindergarten to Zhongshan Park and took a deep breath of the dew-laden air. Jogged for 20 minutes on the park's rubber track, with a pace of about 8 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer and good heart rate control, then did 5 minutes of stretching on a bench after the run. At 8:25, took the electric scooter out of the park parking lot, turned from Gongyuan South Road onto Zhongshan Road, rode for 5 minutes to the back door of the store, and parked the scooter in the charging area.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Try making low-sugar jujube cake
description: After arriving at the store, she immediately went into the kitchen and carefully weighed the cake flour, pitted red date paste, xylitol, eggs, and other ingredients. She strictly followed the recipe, preheated the oven, and baked at 170°C, staying nearby to watch the browning. After the finished product came out of the oven, she tasted it to confirm the texture was fine and the sweetness moderate. She carefully selected two pieces, packed them in a bamboo food box, and attached a handwritten card: 'Low-sugar pastry developed for my father.'
location: Kitchen of the shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Participate in the community Good Neighbor Festival baking competition.
description: Putting on a sun hat and carrying a food box, she walked five minutes to Xiaxi Community Activity Square. She sent her husband a WeChat message to cheer him on. The competition was lively, with more than twenty residents participating. After tasting, the judges commented that the texture was fine and the sweetness well controlled, breaking the impression that low-sugar pastries are dry, but she did not make the top three. After the competition, a community newspaper reporter did a brief interview. Grandma Chen, in her seventies, had slightly red eyes after tasting, and sighed that it reminded her of the jujube paste cake her grandmother used to make when she was little, which touched Song Yajing deeply.
location: Xiaxi Community Activity Square, No. 68 Xiaxi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop for work and lunch break
description: Walking back to the store, she reflected on Grandma Chen's words all the way, thinking about the 'Minnan Cakes in Memory' series. After arriving at the store, she cut the remaining date paste cake into pieces with Xiaomei for customers to taste and shared stories from the competition. Vivian, a regular customer, came to pick up her oatmeal-colored cardigan. She was satisfied after trying it on, praised the craftsmanship after tasting the date paste cake, and was looking forward to the new series after hearing Grandma Chen's story. At lunchtime, Xiaomei brought back satay noodles, and the two chatted while eating in the rest area. After the meal, Song Yajing opened the Bible app and read a passage from Proverbs to restore her inner peace.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon shop operations and display arrangement
description: In the afternoon there were not many customers, and around 14:30 it began to drizzle. Taking advantage of the rain, Song Yajing and Xiaomei rearranged the autumn new-arrival display according to their inspiration, pairing an oatmeal cardigan with dark brown wide-leg pants to create a lazy, warm feel. At the same time, she replied to several regular customers on WeChat asking about jujube paste cake, saying that the new product was under development.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: During a break in the rain, she called her mother Lin Xiuying, who lives in their hometown of Quanzhou, via video call. She excitedly shared the competition process and Grandma Chen's feelings. After listening, her mother smiled and said that making pastries requires patience; using a wood fire and slow cooking makes the aroma richer, which gave her new inspiration.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First round of development for 'Minnan Cake in Memory'
description: After hanging up, she went into the back kitchen and checked the ingredients such as red dates and dried longan. Based on forum reviews and her mother's advice, she reorganized her thoughts on "improving the traditional method." Then she officially launched the first round of development: she greatly increased the proportion of red date paste to intensify the date sweetness; lowered the baking temperature to 160°C and extended the time by 15 minutes so the date aroma could fully release; and chopped the soaked dried longan and mixed it into the batter. She strictly recorded the ingredient weights and mixing times. After it came out of the oven, she tasted it: the date aroma was richer, and the dried longan added a pleasantly chewy surprise, but the overall flavor could be better balanced. She marked it as version 1.0 and felt it was a promising start.
location: Kitchen of the shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store closing and tomorrow's plans
description: Helped Xiaomei complete the cash register settlement, floor cleaning, and putting clothes back in place. Confirmed the task of sorting out new accessories together tomorrow morning, locked the store, and rode the kick scooter home.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Cycled home and phoned her husband.
description: Riding a scooter along Zhongshan Road toward home in the evening breeze, she called her husband Chen Zhiqiang to ask about dinner and learned that he had made her favorite steamed sea bass. The sky gradually darkened, and the streetlights were soft.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: After getting home, the family sat around the dining table, sharing the day's experiences over steamed sea bass. Her husband encouraged her, saying it was normal not to win an award, but the idea for the pastry was great. After dinner, she played with blocks with her daughter Xuanxuan for half an hour and told her the story of The Little Black Fish.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting my daughter settled and washing up.
description: Helped her daughter wash up and change into pajamas, then coaxed her to sleep. After watching her daughter fall asleep sweetly, she took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Signed up for an online English speaking workshop.
description: In the study, she opened her laptop, searched and compared, then chose a four-week intensive English speaking workshop focused on travel topics (Wednesday and Friday evenings) and paid 980 yuan tuition. Then she tested the computer camera and microphone, and after confirming they worked, she wrote in her phone memo: 'For the overseas trip in three years, keep going!'
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gratitude journal and stretching before bed
description: She calmed her mind and wrote down things to be grateful for in her notebook: grateful for Grandma Chen's words that pointed her in a new direction, grateful for Xiaomei and Vivian's support, grateful for her family as her backbone, and grateful for herself for taking the first step in learning. After writing, she did a few minutes of gentle stretching by the window.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayers and late-night talk with my husband.
description: After saying goodnight to her husband, she lay in bed and said her bedtime prayers, thanking the Lord for granting a fulfilling day and asking for protection tomorrow. After her husband turned off the light, the two softly chatted a few amusing things about their daughter Xuanxuan in the dark, their voices gradually fading, until they finally fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and breakfast with family.
description: At 6:55 in the morning, Song Yajing got up, washed up, and groomed herself, then changed into a comfortable light apricot knit cardigan and an off-white dress. She cooked wontons and steamed buns in the kitchen, and specially put two extra buns into an insulated bag for her husband Chen Zhiqiang. At 7:20, she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and braided her hair. The family of three sat around the dining table: Xuanxuan ate small wontons, Yajing drank milk and reminded her husband to take the buns. Xuanxuan excitedly shared a fun story about drawing yesterday, and the atmosphere was warm. After breakfast, Yajing took Xuanxuan's hand and headed out to take her to kindergarten.
location: Home at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: At 7:45, Yajing walked with Xuanxuan along Hubin South Road, turned into Gucheng West Road, and walked toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The autumn morning air was slightly cool, and osmanthus fragrance drifted from the roadside. When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, Xuanxuan happily waved goodbye to her mother and ran skipping into the classroom. Yajing watched her daughter's lively back, smiled, and left to start her day's work.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuted by scooter and bought baking ingredients.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing took out her folding scooter and scooted along Zhenhai Road toward Zhongshan Road. Passing a convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she stopped, went in, and picked out xylitol, glutinous rice flour, and indica rice flour for making Minnan cake according to her memo list, plus a bottle of mineral water. After paying, she put the ingredients in her backpack, continued scooting for about 5 minutes, and arrived at the Elegant Clothing Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street at 8:15.
location: Convenience store at 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Shop opening preparation and live-stream warm-up
description: After arriving at the store at 8:15, Yajing opened the roller shutter and turned on the lights, put on her work apron, and started the opening tasks: cleaning the floor with a dust mop, wiping down the counter and fitting mirror, and watering the pothos. Then she checked the fall new-arrival display, ironed the wrinkled shirts, and adjusted the mannequin's outfit. Around 9:00, she brought out the phone tripod for livestreaming, placed it in the best area with the new arrivals as the backdrop, adjusted the angle of the fill light, and tested the microphone and internet. At 9:20, she sat down to rest and drink water, and posted a livestream preview in a WeChat group and on Moments: “Livestream starts at 9:30 sharp — let's talk about the heartwarming stories and delicious secrets of the Good Neighbor Festival.” Soon she received likes and replies full of anticipation.
location: Inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Thursday regular livestream: sharing stories from the Neighborhood Festival
description: At 9:30, Yajing started her livestream on time. With a warm smile, she opened by talking about her experience in yesterday's community Neighborliness Festival baking competition, sincerely relaying an old woman's exact words: 'Young lady, the red date cake you made tastes exactly like the one my grandma made when I was little.' Her eyes grew slightly red as she became emotional. The fans were moved and left messages one after another encouraging her to launch a Minnan cake. She showed the shop's new autumn items while responding to comments; the livestream was heartwarming and lively, and the originally planned half hour was extended until 10:05 before ending.
location: Live-streaming area of Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After the live stream, tidied up and processed online orders.
description: After the livestream ended, Yajing drank some water to calm down, returned to the cashier counter, and opened the computer backend to process several online orders generated during the livestream. She checked the product style, size, and delivery address for each order one by one, printed shipping labels, and placed the pending items in the packing area. At the same time, she noted the autumn clothing styles that viewers asked about most, preparing to increase restock quantities later.
location: At the cashier counter inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Selecting and organizing customer stories.
description: At 10:30, Yajing switched to the community management interface and focused on reading the dozen or so customer stories collected yesterday and during the fifth anniversary event. She was moved by the sincere writing, and selected five of the most representative stories, with themes including “From a Girl to a Mom”, “A Must-Visit When Returning Home from Another City”, and “Wedding Dress Purchased Here”. Then she carefully crafted the community posting copy, paired with coupon images, to make sure the posts were warm and formal.
location: Workbench inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break: relaxing at 85°C Bakery and browsing industry news
description: At 11:50, Yajing locked the store door and walked to the 85°C Zhonghua City bakery at the corner of Zhongshan Road. She ordered a kumquat lemon tea with less ice and sat in a quiet seat by the window. While sipping the tea, she browsed fashion outfit public accounts and women's apparel industry news on her phone, and saved two articles about autumn color trends. After 20 minutes, she put down her phone, cleared her mind, and watched the pedestrians coming and going on Zhongshan Road outside the window, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Leisure area of 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Returning to the shop to hand over lunch to the staff member
description: At 12:20, Yajing returned to the store. The shop assistant Xiaomei had just finished lunch and was attending to a customer. After the customer left, Yajing briefed Xiaomei on the afternoon arrangements: Xiaomei would go to lunch first while Yajing kept the store; after Xiaomei returned, Yajing would start dessert development. She also reminded Xiaomei to watch the group messages around 3 p.m. Once everything was clear, Yajing stayed in the store alone, sorting through the accounts while waiting for the occasional customer until Xiaomei returned.
location: Inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First round of Hokkien cake development: rice cakes and date-paste cakes.
description: At 13:00, while the store was free of customers, Yajing came to the mini workbench at the back of the store and started her development work. She mixed glutinous rice flour and indica rice flour in three ratios — 1:1, 1:2, and 2:1 — with water and xylitol to make rice cake batter, and labeled the containers. At the same time, following the low-sugar recipe adjusted yesterday, she made an upgraded version of date paste cake batter with dried longan. After an hour of busy work, she put the batters into the steamer one by one. She checked on them every few minutes and took photos to record the process. At 14:15, all the samples were steamed and neatly placed on the cooling rack to cool before tasting.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province - back kitchen work area of Yazhi Clothing Store

name: Optimized the community posting copy and set a scheduled task.
description: At 14:15, kitchen work came to a temporary pause. Yajing returned to the cash register and, while the rice cakes were cooling, used the computer to give the final polish to the community post copy scheduled for 3 p.m. She went through the story title, body paragraphs, and coupon instructions word by word to ensure there were no typos, and adjusted the layout to make it more comfortable to read. At 14:30, in the community management backend, she set the final content and images to be published on schedule at exactly 15:00, and double-checked it twice to make sure everything was correct.
location: At the cashier counter inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Second round of Minnan cake R&D and official community launch.
description: At 14:45, the cooled samples had dropped to a suitable tasting temperature. Yajing returned to the back kitchen and used a fork to taste the three rice cakes and the upgraded jujube paste cake one by one, noting the detailed textures in her notebook: the 1:1 glutinous rice/indica rice cake was too soft and sticky; the 1:2 was fragrant but too firm; the 2:1 was too soft and collapsed; the jujube paste cake was moderately sweet and rich in jujube aroma, close to the goal. She quickly mixed a peanut-crunch cake batter and steamed an extra small batch of the improved rice cake at a 1:2 ratio. As it approached 15:00, her phone alarm rang. She wiped her hands and hurried to the work desk, where she found that the compilation of 5 customer stories had been posted on time in the “Yajing Lifestyle Club” community. The accompanying illustrations and coupon posters immediately attracted attention. Yajing added a thank-you message in the group and began @-mentioning the winning customers.
location: Back kitchen and work counter of Yazhi Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Send coupons in private chats and respond to interactions in the group
description: Starting at 15:20, Yajing privately messaged the 5 winning story authors one by one, sending customized thank-you messages and a link to claim a 100-yuan electronic coupon, and sharing how moved she was reading their stories. The winning customers were pleasantly surprised and spontaneously thanked her in the group, and other group members, infected by the atmosphere, began sharing their own first encounters with the store or shopping experiences. Message notification sounds in the community group kept ringing out. While replying to messages and questions, Yajing also tallied the new interaction volume and the initial intention to redeem the coupons.
location: Inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Third round of Minnan cake development and summary
description: At 16:10, taking advantage of the stable community buzz, Yajing returned to the back kitchen for the last batch of attempts — recreating the bowl cake and improving the fa gao. She referenced yesterday's failure experience and adjusted the water-to-flour ratio of the bowl cake and the yeast amount for the fa gao. When the finished products came out of the steamer 20 minutes later, tasting found that the bowl cake was slightly dry in the center, while the fa gao had improved in fermentation but was inconsistent in sweetness with a slight sour aftertaste. Looking through the recipe notes that had already filled 5 pages, she decided to eliminate the bowl cake and fa gao and focus on continuing to optimize the retained rice cake, crushed peanut cake, and upgraded jujube paste cake. At 16:45, Yajing returned to the workbench, opened her business diary, recorded today's explosive community operation results (over 200 messages), and took photos to archive the afternoon's R&D process and elimination decisions, clarifying the adjustment direction for tomorrow.
location: Back kitchen and work counter of Yazhi Clothing Store, 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school, buy stationery on the way, and go home to prepare dinner
description: At 17:00, Yajing closed the store on time and walked to a long-established stationery store on Park South Road, where she picked out two animal stickers, a princess sticker, and a box of watercolor pens for Xuanxuan. After paying, she quickened her pace and arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 17:20. When Xuanxuan saw her mother, she ran over like a little swallow. Yajing gave her daughter the new stickers and watercolor pens, and Xuanxuan happily hugged her mother. At 17:25, the mother and daughter walked home chatting and laughing. After arriving home, Yajing had Xuanxuan wash her hands and play with the stickers, while she tied on an apron and prepared dinner: she took out pork belly, blanched and cut it into pieces, caramelized sugar, added star anise, cinnamon bark, and soy sauce, and simmered it slowly into red-braised pork, while also stir-frying baby bok choy. The kitchen filled with the aroma of meat, and a warm atmosphere spread through the home.
location: Stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Siming Experimental Kindergarten; home at No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community.

name: Waiting for her husband to come home and having dinner with the family.
description: At 18:10, the meal was ready. Yajing brought the two dishes and a soup to the table and sent a WeChat message to her husband. While waiting, she chatted with Xuanxuan in the living room, listening to her daughter talk about playing games with new friends at kindergarten and commenting together on new stickers. The room was filled with laughter. At 18:40, Chen Zhiqiang arrived home, and the family of three sat down to dinner. A Qiang praised the braised pork for being rich and tasty. The couple exchanged updates on their work: Yajing shared how her community operations were booming, while A Qiang talked about the progress of his company's new project. Xuanxuan earnestly reported on a new nursery rhyme she had learned and performed it. After dinner, A Qiang voluntarily cleared the dishes, and the whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Home at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-dinner walk and parent-child time; help daughter wash up and soothe her to sleep.
description: At 19:40, it was getting dark but a gentle breeze was blowing. The family walked out to Jiaxingyuan Park for a stroll. Xuanxuan excitedly stepped on the brick patterns ahead, while Yajing and her husband walked side by side, chatting about National Day plans. After one lap around the park, they returned home at 20:30. Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into bear pajamas. At 21:00, she sat by the bed reading the picture book Guess How Much I Love You. When she read the little rabbit spreading its arms and saying 'I love you this much,' Xuanxuan also stretched out her little hands. Before the story ended, Xuanxuan had closed her eyes and fallen asleep. Yajing kissed her daughter's forehead, turned off the light, and left.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Bailu Road, Jiaxing Garden Park, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128, home

name: Nighttime community wrap-up and personal relaxation.
description: At 21:10, after Xuanxuan fell asleep, Yajing went to the study, opened her laptop, and logged into the community backend. She patiently replied to evening questions from group members about coupon validity periods, tallied today's intentions to redeem the e-coupons issued, sorted them into a table, and photographed and archived her R&D notes. At 21:40 she closed her laptop, took a hot shower, applied a hydrating mask, and changed into loungewear. At 22:00, she leaned against the headboard and called her best friend Li Meiling on WeChat voice, excitedly sharing the huge success of today's community story collection and the fans' comments encouraging her to make Minnan-style cakes. They chatted for more than ten minutes and hung up laughing.
location: Home at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Browsing before bed and going to sleep
description: At 22:10, after hanging up, Yajing opened the “Yajing Life Gallery” community group and found that night owls were still discussing stories. Someone shared photos of getting married in clothes bought at the store years ago. She was moved, replied, and gave a like. Then she scrolled through updates from a few fashion outfit bloggers and saved an article titled “100 Ways to Style a Trench Coat”. The screen light made her eyes sore. At 23:15 she turned off her phone, thought back on the busy yet fulfilling day, and with a satisfied smile amid all the heartwarming scenes, she gradually fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wake up, morning preparations, and reminders for family members.
description: At 6:45 a.m., Song Yajing woke up naturally and found her husband Aqiang had already risen. After washing up briefly, she gently woke her daughter Xuanxuan, reminded her that Mommy would pick her up a little later in the afternoon, and told her to remember to take an afternoon nap. She then prepared a thin jacket for Xuanxuan to cope with the cooler evening weather, and made Aqiang a simple sandwich breakfast, confirming once again that Aqiang would be responsible for putting their daughter to bed tonight.
location: No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking daughter to kindergarten and morning jog in the park
description: At 7:25, Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten holding her daughter Xuanxuan's hand. On the way, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about how the teacher would teach them to make origami boats today. After a brief conversation with the teacher at the kindergarten gate, she watched her daughter run into the classroom. Then she changed into her running shoes and jogged for 20 minutes on the path in Zhongshan Park, sorting out the adjustment details for today's Minnan cake proportions while running and recalling the community's response from last night.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home for a shower, breakfast, and shopping during the commute.
description: After the morning run, Song Yajing went home and took a quick shower, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen shirt and casual pants, and had a simple breakfast of unsweetened soy milk and whole-wheat toast. She checked her backpack, packed her phone, power bank, notebook, baking records, and sample packaging boxes, then rode her kick scooter to the shop. On the way, she stopped at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy disposable piping bags and square paper baking cups needed for stocking the Minnan-style cakes, and also grabbed a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arrive at the store to prepare and follow up on the previous day's work
description: After arriving at the store at 8:30, Song Yajing turned on the air conditioner and tidied up yesterday's displays. She logged into the store's WeChat and handled several unanswered customer inquiries. One regular customer asked about the details of the wedding photos in last night's community story; she replied earnestly and shared how moved she was at the time. Then she communicated with the shop assistant Xiaomei about today's reception priorities and points to note.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Apparel'

name: Completed the final recipe proportions for the Minnan Cake in Memory series.
description: At 10:00, Song Yajing entered a highly focused development state and finalized the Minnan cakes in the living area behind the shop. She adjusted the recipe for the low-sugar jujube paste cake, reducing the dried longan from 15g to 12g and adding 5g of goji berry water to make the texture moister. For the traditional-flavor rice cake, she precisely mixed glutinous rice and indica rice in a 3:2 ratio, using stone-ground rice milk to replace part of the water. For the crushed-peanut steamed sponge cake, she stir-fried the peanuts over low heat, then pounded them into coarse pieces in a stone mortar and sprinkled them on top. She weighed all the ingredients precisely, recorded the final recipes, photographed the freshly baked products with her phone, and hand-drew three sketches of product introduction cards, writing the product stories on them.
location: Living quarters behind Yazhi Clothing, Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Noon break and anniversary ideas.
description: At 12:30 noon, after handing over with Xiaomei, Song Yajing walked to the 'HOT MATE' milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to rest. She ordered a season-limited longan and red date fruit tea, opened her phone notes, and began planning arrangements for National Day and the tenth wedding anniversary. She sent a WeChat message to her close friend Wang Jia asking whether the environment of Haicang Hot Spring Resort was suitable for a family of three. Afterwards, in the close friends group 'Old Iron Trio,' she shared the joy of finalizing the Minnan cake today and the positive response to the community story collection. Lingling and Jiajia both liked it.
location: The "HOT MATE" milk tea shop at 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen

name: Store operations, customer reception, and online interaction
description: At 1:30 p.m., customer traffic in the store gradually increased. Song Yajing provided styling advice to the female customers entering the store (putting together a mother-daughter matching shirt dress set for a pair of mother and daughter) while guiding Xiaomei in handling an online return/exchange order. During this time, she logged into the community group backend and issued 50-yuan no-threshold coupons to the three customers whose stories had received the most likes the night before, and replied to discussions in the group. She also pulled A Kai, a former colleague working as a designer in Hangzhou, into the "Former Employer Trio" group and shared photos of the successfully developed Minnan-style rice cakes.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Apparel'

name: Preparing in advance to pick up daughter
description: At 4 p.m., taking advantage of a lull in customer traffic, Song Yajing checked Xuanxuan's little backpack and made sure the jacket was inside. She reminded Xiaomei about handling the shop in the evening, and sent the link and handouts for tonight's English class to her own phone so she could review them on the way.
location: Shop 36, Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 'Elegant Apparel'

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 4:20, Song Yajing arrived on time at Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan ran out happily, holding a folded paper airplane.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying stationery on the way
description: After picking up her daughter, the mother and daughter walked hand in hand to the M&G stationery store on South Gongyuan Road. Xuanxuan chose a box of 24-color water-soluble colored pencils and a unicorn-themed coloring book. Song Yajing paid readily and promised to draw with her as soon as they got home.
location: Chenguang Stationery Store, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Yubincheng Phase 2, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Play with her daughter in the park.
description: As the temperature cooled in the evening, Song Yajing put a jacket on Xuanxuan and went to Jiaxing Garden Park. Xuanxuan had a great time playing in the sandpit and used her newly bought colored pencils to draw a crooked little flower. Song Yajing sat on a bench watching her daughter and silently went over tonight's self-introduction for her English class in her mind.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walk home
description: At 5:15, Song Yajing walked home along familiar streets, holding Xuanxuan's hand. Along the way, Xuanxuan chattered about fun things at kindergarten.
location: Walked from Jiaxing Garden Park to No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Song Yajing quickly prepared dinner. She made braised pork ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, which both her daughter and husband loved. Her husband Aqiang got off work on time and arrived home around 6, and was playing with building blocks with Xuanxuan in the living room.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 128, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner for three and family time
description: At 6:20, the family sat together for dinner. Song Yajing shared her excitement about finally finalizing the Minnan cake and her nervousness about the English class. Aqiang teased that she must be the prettiest student in the class, which made her laugh. After dinner, Xuanxuan volunteered to help clear the table and showed off her newly drawn 'family portrait.'
location: Home dining room, No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's washing up and preparation for English class
description: After dinner, Song Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and told her a story from Sofia the First about bravely trying new things. Then she handed off to A Qiang, who was in charge of putting their daughter to sleep.
