She went to the study, turned on the computer, adjusted the camera and microphone, took out her English lecture notes, silently rehearsed her self-introduction one last time, and took a deep breath to prepare for the class.
location: Home at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Attend the first online class of the English speaking workshop
description: At 7:50 p.m., the spoken English workshop started on time, with the theme Self-Introduction in Travel Scenes. Under the gaze of 15 online classmates, Song Yajing was still nervous when it was her turn to unmute. In a trembling but clear voice, she said: Hello, I'm Song Yajing. I'm from Xiamen. I love seafood and I want to travel to Italy with my family to see the Colosseum. The teacher encouraged her: Excellent first try! Your pronunciation is clear and the sentence is great! Her confidence instantly increased.
location: The study at home, No. 128, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-class review and community engagement.
description: After the class, Song Yajing immediately repeated the five core words marked by the teacher in the courseware three times and took notes. She sent a friendly greeting sticker in the course WeChat group and introduced herself, and soon several classmates responded. She browsed the other students' self-introductions and found that everyone came from different fields such as finance, design, and education, and felt the course atmosphere was very good.
location: The study at home, No. 128, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's late-night conversation and family sharing.
description: At 9:30, Song Yajing walked into the bedroom. Aqiang had already put Xuanxuan to sleep and was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. She excitedly shared her experience from tonight's English class: "Honey, I actually spoke! My legs were shaking, but the teacher praised me!" Aqiang smiled and squeezed her hand: "I told you you could do it! Next time I'll drive you to the offline class and be your chauffeur." They then chatted about where to take Xuanxuan tomorrow morning. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 128, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal hygiene and community group wrap-up.
description: At 10:10, Song Yajing took a relaxing bath and did her daily skincare routine. Before bed, she looked through her phone; in the community group, customers had already shown great interest in the preview photo of the Minnan cake. Some guessed it was a pastry, others thought it was the color of a knit sweater, and the comment section was full of joy. She replied to several inquiries one by one and announced that it would be available in limited quantities tomorrow.
location: Home at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Reading and preparation before bed
description: At 10:40, Song Yajing changed into her pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and opened 'Taste of Minnan,' reading two pages about the origin of traditional Quanzhou pastries. At exactly 23:00, she turned off the light, set the alarm for the next morning, thought about taking Xuanxuan to Sunday school the next day, said a quiet bedtime prayer in her heart, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 128, Compound 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: On Saturday morning, sunlight streamed in through the curtains. Song Yajing got up, washed up and tidied herself, put on a light linen shirt and dark jeans, and fixed her hair. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang got up and dealt with work emails on the balcony. Song Yajing fried eggs and bacon, warmed milk, and sliced whole wheat bread. Their daughter Chen Lexuan woke up at the smell. At breakfast, Song Yajing confirmed with her husband the plan to take their daughter to the community library in the afternoon and reminded him of the details. After the meal, Song Yajing cleared the dishes, wiped down the kitchen, checked her phone and replied to customers' WeChat messages, told them when the new products would be available, and browsed Xiaohongshu for outfit inspiration. At the same time, she recalled last night's English class and decided to review it later.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Song Yajing changed into canvas shoes, put on her canvas bag containing a notebook and a power bank, wheeled out her scooter, and set off from home on Hubin South Road. She followed Hubin South Road, turned onto Siming North Road, and then turned into Zhongshan Road. She bought a hot Americano at a coffee shop along the way and arrived at the shop at 9:10.
location: From No. 128 Hubin South Road to No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the shop and arranging new products
description: After arriving at the shop at 36 Zhongshan Road, Song Yajing opened the doors and windows for ventilation and started the cash register system. Then she went into the preparation room, took out the three kinds of Minnan cakes to be put on the shelves today—low-sugar date paste cakes, old-fashioned rice cakes, and steamed cakes with crushed peanuts—and tasted each one to confirm the quality. Next, she wrote on the wooden introduction board with chalk: 'Memories of Minnan Cakes: Limited Handcrafted Batch, Today's Debut' along with a short story for each cake. At 10 o'clock, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. Song Yajing explained the division of work: the new products should be placed in the middle of the front counter, the price tags were already written, Xiaomei would be responsible for customer service and cashiering, and she told her that she would be going to the forum in the afternoon. Together they neatly placed 60 cakes into bamboo baskets.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Supplier and designer communication.
description: Using the lull before the flow of customers, Song Yajing had a WeChat call with supplier Susan in the back office of the shop, discussing sample images for new Chinese-style tea sets and storage baskets. They finalized three samples: a matte white porcelain side-handle teapot, Minnan red-brick-pattern teacup coasters, and a handmade rattan storage basket, and agreed to send the samples next week. Afterwards, she communicated via WeChat with her former colleague and designer Zheng Kai to ask about the afternoon forum arrangements. Zheng Kai said he would arrive a little later and encouraged Song Yajing to listen to the idea of "product is content"; the two arranged to meet at the venue.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receive customers and promote new products
description: Store foot traffic increased. Song Yajing stood in front of the new products area and warmly invited customers to sample southern Fujian pastries. She introduced each pastry's features in detail: the low-sugar jujube paste cake is made using traditional methods, and the old-fashioned rice cake is infused with osmanthus. Many customers praised the pure flavors after tasting and bought them one after another. The first batch of old-fashioned rice cakes was mostly sold out before 11:30.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short video production
description: After the flow of customers eased a bit, Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to pack a portion of satay noodles as lunch. While waiting for the food, she took out her phone stand, development notes, and competition photos, and brainstormed a short-video script. After finishing lunch quickly, she set up the filming environment in the back of the shop and recorded a video telling the original intention behind developing "the Minnan cake in memory," showing the drafts and competition photos, and ending with a close-up of the pastry. She posted it with the caption "Some flavors are gifts of time" to the WeChat customer group and Moments.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon tidying and departure preparations
description: Song Yajing packed her canvas bag, made sure the electronic invitation to the forum was saved on her phone, and told Xiao Mei about the afternoon plans: “I'll be at the Convention and Exhibition Center at 2 PM and finish around 4:30. The shop is in your hands. Call me if anything urgent comes up.” Then she brought out her scooter and left the shop.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ride a bike to the Convention and Exhibition Center
description: Song Yajing rode a scooter along Lujiang Road and Yanwu Bridge to the Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center. On the way, she stopped to send her husband her location, asked about their departure to the library, and after receiving his reply that he had already left, continued riding with peace of mind.
location: No. 198 Huizhan Road, from Lujiang Avenue, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend the International Fashion Week opening forum and exhibition.
description: After entering with the electronic invitation, Song Yajing attended the forum “Commercial Practices of Neo-Chinese Style and Local Culture” in the forum area of Hall C3 at the Convention and Exhibition Center. Sitting in the front row, she listened attentively and took notes on key takeaways such as “modern reinterpretation of Minnan architectural motifs”, “bottlenecks in the sustainable fabric supply chain”, and “community-based retail as a cultural carrier”. During the tea break, she talked with Lin Yue, an independent designer wearing a pressed-flower brooch in the next seat. They appreciated each other's accessories, exchanged WeChat contacts, and agreed to follow up later. Former colleague Zheng Kai also stopped by briefly, and they had a short chat. After the forum, Song Yajing strolled through the static exhibition area and photographed several design details she liked, including improved pipa buttons and pleated hems, as inspiration for future product selection.
location: Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center, No. 198 Huizhan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return bike ride and phone call
description: After the forum ended, Song Yajing rode her scooter along Huandao Road and Hubin South Road back home. On the way, she called her husband and learned that her daughter was reading and playing with blocks in the library and having a great time, so she told the father and daughter to keep playing and she went home first to cook.
location: From Huandao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 128 Hubin South Road.

name: Family dinner and post-dinner interactions
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing took a shower and changed into loungewear, then started preparing dinner: cooked rice in the rice cooker, marinated the ribs for sweet and sour ribs, and prepared garlic water spinach and tomato egg soup. In the evening, her husband brought their daughter home, and the daughter excitedly talked about what she saw at the library. The family sat around the table for dinner, and Song Yajing shared what she gained from the afternoon forum, mentioning the concept of 'product is content.' After the meal, her husband voluntarily washed the dishes, and Song Yajing read the borrowed picture book 'The Little Seed' with her daughter, asking interactive questions to guide her observation.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Getting the family washed and ready.
description: Her husband brushed their daughter's teeth, washed her face, and changed her into pajamas, while Song Yajing organized the clothes and scriptures for tomorrow's visit to Gulangyu Catholic Church in the bedroom.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Community voice sharing and interaction.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing sat on the sofa in the living room and sent a five-minute voice message in the "Yajing Life Boutique" WeChat group. She excitedly shared her insights from the forum, especially the inspiration for incorporating Minnan elements into everyday outfits, and suggested that the store could design products with Minnan DNA in the future. The voice message sparked a lively discussion among group members. Vivian, a regular customer, suggested launching an everyday modern cheongsam and said she would be the first to buy it. Song Yajing felt the warmth of the group members and was deeply moved.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Organizing study notes and inspiration
description: Back in the study, Song Yajing opened her notebook, circled “product is content” in red pen, and jotted down inspirations in her phone's memo: 1. Discuss the possibility of a co-branded design with Lin Yue; 2. Find sample images of improved everyday qipao based on Vivienne's suggestion; 3. Add a humanistic touch to the store and implement the community-based retail concept.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Evening leisure and relaxation
description: To calm her excitement, Song Yajing watched about 20 minutes of Season 2 of the documentary Breakfast in China on the living room sofa, then got up to wash up and do a quick skincare routine.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime reading and insomnia
description: After lying down in bed, Song Yajing scrolled through short video comments and saw a customer say she would bring her mother to buy tomorrow, which made her happy. Then she picked up the bedside book 'The Taste of Minnan' and read stories about making traditional Minnan flavors. But her mind was still active; the day's impressions from the forum, Lin Yue's design, and community discussions lingered in her head. She conceived a collaborative design with Vivian and thought about how to integrate community-based retail. Excitement and anticipation kept her tossing and turning, and she did not fall into a deep sleep until around 11:30 p.m.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7:30, the alarm clock rang softly, and Yajing woke up. She gently patted her sleeping husband Aqiang and daughter Xuanxuan beside her. She went to the bathroom first and took a warm shower, changed into a comfortable off-white cotton-linen dress, and then picked out a pink T-shirt with a bear print and a denim pinafore skirt for Xuanxuan.
location: Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple family breakfast
description: Yajing quickly prepared a simple breakfast: toast, fried eggs, milk, and a small plate of fruit. Aqiang made the coffee. The family of three sat around the small dining table, and Aqiang reminded Yajing that afternoon thundershowers were forecast, so she should remember to take an umbrella when going out. Yajing carefully packed the two portions of red date cake she had made last night into prepared kraft paper boxes and tied them with thin twine, one to take to Aunt Lin and one to keep for the family to try in the afternoon.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive to Dongdu Wharf and take a ferry to Gulangyu Island.
description: Yajing took Xuanxuan downstairs, got into the family car, and drove to Dongdu Passenger Terminal, a ride of about 12 minutes. On the way, Xuanxuan hummed a new song she had learned in kindergarten in the back seat. After arriving at the terminal, Yajing parked the car in a nearby lot, took Xuanxuan by the hand, and bought two ferry tickets for 08:40 to Sanqiutian Pier on Gulangyu Island at the self-service ticket machine. The ferry departed on time. They chose seats by the window. The sea breeze was gentle, and Xuanxuan excitedly pointed outside. During the roughly 50-minute ride, Yajing felt herself gradually calm down.
location: By car from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Dongdu Passenger Terminal, No. 2 Donggang Road, Huli District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, then by ferry to Sanqiutian Pier, No. 199 Yanping Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Walked to the church and attended Sunday Mass.
description: After getting off the ferry, Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand, walked through Longtou Road, turned into Lujiao Road, and after about 10 minutes arrived at Gulangyu Catholic Church. Mass began on time to the accompaniment of the pipe organ. Yajing and Xuanxuan sat on a back pew. Father Wang Mingde preached alternately in Minnan dialect and Mandarin, with the theme “small gratitudes in daily life.” Yajing closed her eyes and silently prayed for Zhao Li's marriage, the store's new products, and her own inner peace. Xuanxuan imitated her mother, pressing her little hands together, looking very cute. The Mass lasted about an hour and twenty minutes. When the hymn sounded, Yajing felt a deep sense of peace.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shared with fellow churchgoers and took the boat back home
description: After Mass, Yajing found Aunt Lin Xiuying in the church courtyard. She handed Aunt Lin a box of date paste cakes. After tasting, Aunt Lin praised her for making better and better pastries — not too sweet, not greasy, with an old-fashioned flavor. They chatted about family matters. Aunt Lin asked about the shop's business, and Yajing shared her new product ideas. Aunt Lin encouraged her to make what she loves and suggested she bring pastries to share at next month's parish gathering. After saying goodbye to Aunt Lin, Yajing took Xuanxuan's hand and walked along the seaside path to Sanqiutian Pier, boarding the 11:35 return ferry. Yajing took a few seascape photos with her phone and sent them to her close friends' group with the caption 'Sunday peace.' After about 50 minutes, the ferry arrived at Dongdu Passenger Terminal, and then Yajing drove home with Xuanxuan.
location: Walk from Gulangyu Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Sanqiutian Pier, take the ferry back to Dongdu Passenger Terminal in Huli District, and then drive back to the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District.

name: Return home and enjoy a family lunch together
description: Yajing drove Xuanxuan home. After arriving, Xuanxuan couldn't wait to show Aqiang the seashells she had picked up. Yajing changed into comfortable loungewear and put the second box of red date paste cakes on the coffee table. Aqiang had already simply prepared lunch in the morning, cooking noodles and fish ball soup, and stir-frying a plate of greens. The family sat around the dining table. Yajing shared her insights from the morning Mass, while Aqiang talked about a documentary about the ocean he had watched last night, saying they could take Xuanxuan to the aquarium next time. The lunch was simple and warm.
location: Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Noon break and preparing to go out
description: After dinner, the family of three curled up on the sofa in the living room. Xuanxuan leaned against her mother and watched cartoons for a while, while Yajing leaned on Aqiang's shoulder, scrolled through her phone, looked at the messages in the community group, and replied to a few customers asking about what time tomorrow's new products would be available. Aqiang was fiddling with his fishing rod, saying he wanted to go sea fishing in autumn. At about 13:50, Yajing woke Xuanxuan, who was about to fall asleep, and changed her into comfortable sneakers. Aqiang put the fish food he had bought in advance and a small bag of nuts into the small backpack. The family of three walked hand in hand from the neighborhood to Zhongshan Park.
location: Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family afternoon stroll at Zhongshan Park
description: The park was shaded by trees and the air was fresh. They found a bench by the lake, sat down, took out fish food and fed the red koi in the lake, and Xuanxuan yelled happily. Later, Xuanxuan chased butterflies on the lawn while Yajing and Aqiang sat nearby talking about next week's plans. Aqiang suggested sending the Minnan cake link to the WeChat group of his company department; Yajing thought it was a good idea and wrote it down in her phone memo. They also met a balloon vendor, and Xuanxuan picked a pink bunny balloon. Yajing took a few photos of the father and daughter with her phone to record this warm moment.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shopping at the market and resting at home
description: After leaving the park, the family of three dropped by the Zhenhai Road vegetable market on the way. Aqiang bought fresh pork ribs and streaky pork. Yajing picked a bunch of tender water spinach and a few tomatoes, and bought a live fish for Xuanxuan. After coming out, they walked about 7 minutes home. Once home, Aqiang put the groceries away in the kitchen, and Xuanxuan drew pictures with crayons in the living room. Yajing washed her face, changed into casual outdoor clothes, grabbed her phone and keys, and got ready to go to the store.
location: Xia Shang (Zhenhai) Farmers Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and home at No. 82 Shanggu Street community

name: Store product packaging optimization and community warm-up
description: In the evening, a light rain began to fall. Yajing walked with an umbrella to the "Yazhi Apparel" store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After opening the door, she first checked the Minnan cake samples placed next to the cash register to confirm that the texture had not become damp and soft. Then she took out the prepared handwritten labels and wrote in delicate regular script: "Minnan Low-Sugar Jujube Paste Cake in Memory," "Inspired by the Taste of the Older Generation," and other phrases. She carefully pasted the labels onto the packaging boxes of three kinds of cakes, then tied a beautiful bow with fine hemp rope. The whole process was quiet and focused. When done, she took three photos from different angles and posted them to the store's community group. Then she sent a message in the group: "Tomorrow is Monday, the family taste continues to be available! The limited-edition Minnan cakes have been repackaged, lovingly handmade, reservations welcome in advance." As soon as the message was sent, she received several likes and reservation comments from regular customers. She happily replied to each one and confirmed the quantities. At about 18:15, she closed the store and left satisfied.
location: Inside "Elegant Clothing" at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: When Yajing got home, Aqiang was already washing vegetables. She tied on an apron and started making the sweet and sour pork ribs that Aqiang loved. The pot was bubbling with aroma. Yajing asked Xuanxuan to help wash tomatoes, saying she would help Mom make tomato egg drop soup. The kitchen was filled with the clatter of spatulas and the family's laughter. Dinner was served: sweet and sour pork ribs, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. Yajing also cut two pieces of the jujube cake she had newly packaged at the store and put them on a plate as dessert. Aqiang tasted a rib, gave a thumbs-up, and said, “This is the taste!” The family ate and chatted, with Xuanxuan talking about the butterflies and balloons she had seen at the park. The atmosphere was warm and cheerful.
location: Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child drawing and reading, and helping Xuanxuan wash up and get to sleep
description: After the meal, Aqiang was in charge of washing the dishes. Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan to her little room to read picture books and draw. Xuanxuan drew a picture with the sun, grass, balloons, and three little figures holding hands. Yajing put the drawing on the refrigerator door and praised Xuanxuan for drawing so well. After that, Yajing gave Xuanxuan a bath and changed her into pajamas. She sat by the bed and told Xuanxuan a story about a little bear going to church. As Xuanxuan listened, she slowly closed her eyes and fell asleep. Yajing gently closed the door and went to the living room.
location: Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal reading and bedtime preparation
description: Yajing made herself a cup of warm herbal tea and opened her laptop. She first organized the notes from yesterday's forum, writing the concept "product is content" and the contact information of independent designer Lin Yue in a dedicated notebook. Then she picked up a copy of "Taste of Minnan" and leafed through it. When she came to the section about "the symbolic meanings of traditional pastries in festivals," she nodded thoughtfully, thinking she could incorporate these stories into her product introductions. Around 22:00, Yajing went to wash up. Back in the bedroom, she turned off the main light and kept only a small bedside lamp on. She knelt by the bedside and prayed for all the wonderful encounters of the day, the safety of her family, and the smooth running of the shop, and also asked for wisdom and strength for the new week's work the next day.
location: Study and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Community No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Yajing lay down, and Aqiang happened to be done with his work. She softly said goodnight to him, turned over, and fell asleep peacefully, filled with gratitude and contentment.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up in the morning and get the family ready
description: The autumn morning light was faint, and you woke up right on time at 6:50. You gently woke your sleeping daughter Xuanxuan and helped her change into the light blue cotton dress you had ironed last night. In the kitchen, you made yourself a warm cup of honey water and prepared a simple breakfast for the family: toast, fried eggs, and milk. Aqiang also got up, washed up, and got ready for work. The family began a new day in this warm little home.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: You got on the light electric bike, took Xuanxuan on the back, and rode along Hubin South Road toward Gucheng West Road. The morning breeze brushed your face as Xuanxuan chattered away on the back seat, sharing the fun of feeding fish at Zhongshan Park over the weekend. At 7:35 you arrived at the kindergarten gate. You watched her walk happily through the school gate with her little backpack, following the teacher, and only left with peace of mind after her small figure disappeared into the teaching building.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning jog at Zhongshan Park
description: Walk about 10 minutes from the kindergarten to Zhongshan Park. You change into the running shoes you had placed in the electric bike basket, and start jogging along the park’s tree-lined path. Your pace stays steady at 8 minutes per kilometer, and you run about 2 kilometers. The autumn air is crisp, a light sweat breaks out, and after stretching your limbs, you feel refreshed and full of energy.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home to tidy up and prepare for the contract signing
description: After the morning run, you walked about 12 minutes home. You quickly showered and changed into a new outfit from your own store — a light gray knit cardigan and dark straight-leg jeans — sharp and comfortable. From your bag, you once again took out the labor contract you had carefully confirmed the night before, with a hint of solemnity and expectation. Everything was ready.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the store
description: You walked to Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, tapped your card, and entered the station. You boarded Line 1 toward Yan Nei and got off at Zhongshan Park Station two minutes later. After exiting the station, you turned from Park South Road onto Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The commute took about 25 minutes. On the metro, you briefly browsed the messages in the shop's community group and saw that several regular customers had already booked today's new arrivals online, which made you feel reassured.
location: From Zhenhai Road Metro Station in Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Park Station (Xiamen Metro Line 1), then walk to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Store opening preparation and peak-hour management
description: You arrived at the store first, skillfully opened the rolling shutter door, and started the air purifier and the cash register system. Xiaomei arrived shortly after at 8:50, and she first carefully wiped the display window glass. Together you rearranged several new autumn knitwear and A-line skirts by color scheme, and checked the weekend new product sales data — 48 pieces of Minnan cake were sold, and the restocking plan was noted in the memo, scheduled for Wednesday.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Signed a long-term labor contract and mentored Xiaomei.
description: After finishing the preparations for opening the store, you called Xiaomei to the back storeroom and sat down solemnly. You took out the labor contract you had personally drafted and explained it item by item: the monthly salary would be adjusted from 3800 yuan to 4500 yuan, social insurance would start being paid from next month, at year-end 5% of the annual net profit would form the employee bonus pool (distributed according to years of service and performance appraisal), and there would be 5 days of paid annual leave. Xiaomei listened carefully, asked about the social insurance deduction method and bonus calculation details, and you patiently answered each question. Then you solemnly signed the labor contract in duplicate. After signing, you patted her on the shoulder and said, “From now on, we are long-term comrades in arms; let’s work hard together.” Xiaomei’s eyes turned slightly red and she nodded firmly. Next, you personally taught her how to use the downloaded “Guanjiapo” financial software for daily bookkeeping, and demonstrated in detail the complete process of confirming orders with the supplier Susan via WeChat, filling in order forms, tracking logistics, and inspecting and accepting goods into inventory. Xiaomei took out her small notebook and recorded everything carefully, very focused.
location: The back warehouse of the "Elegant Clothing" store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Work handover and peak-hour warm-up
description: Xiaomei continued practicing bookkeeping on the computer and, under your guidance, entered this morning's purchase order. You received several regular customers and recommended layering outfits suitable for early autumn. You noticed Xiaomei observing and learning attentively, and felt gratified, thinking you had found a capable partner.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and editing the community preview
description: You asked Xiaomei to eat first at Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. You stayed in the store to mind it and ordered a light salad delivery on your phone. Taking advantage of the quiet time, you organized the key points and a few photos from last Sunday's fashion forum, and composed a community announcement: 'Sisters, at 8 pm tonight, Sister Yajing will share her experiences and thoughts from the fashion forum she attended on Sunday, especially her ideas on how to combine New Chinese Style with local culture. Don't forget to come watch~' Then you set it to be sent at a scheduled time.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon customer care and Xiaomei's independent hands-on practice
description: The afternoon sunlight streamed in through the storefront, and customers came in one after another. You let Xiaomei serve them on her own while you stepped aside to tidy the shelves and observe quietly. Xiaomei was poised and confident. For a regular customer in her 30s, she put together two knit tops in different styles and an A-line skirt. The customer was very satisfied and bought them on the spot. Then she recommended a light blue shirt and black cigarette pants to a young girl preparing for an interview, and offered two pairing options: high heels or loafers. Watching Xiaomei's confident and composed manner, you couldn't help thinking of how a senior colleague named Sun Li had guided you step by step when you first entered the industry 12 years ago, and you were filled with emotion.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon peak hours and store operations
description: The afternoon customer flow was nonstop. You and Xiaomei worked together seamlessly: you handled high-level styling and gave exclusive advice to VIP regulars, while Xiaomei dealt with routine consultations and sales transactions. You squeezed in time to reply to several important WeChat messages and processed an online return order. When you saw a regular customer in the community group asking about tonight's sharing content, you smiled and replied, Exactly, see you at 8 PM~
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up the shop and Xiaomei leaving work
description: As evening approached, customer traffic gradually decreased. You asked Xiaomei to first check the day's cash and WeChat payments, enter the sales data into the system, and then let her leave early. After Xiaomei left, you were alone in the store. You took a few photos of the autumn new arrivals display with your phone, checked the inventory of Minnan cakes reserved for the weekend, and confirmed that all orders were ready. After everything was handled, you closed the store on time.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter after school and reward her with stationery.
description: You rode your e-bike from Zhongshan Road to the kindergarten, arriving just in time for the 5:00 PM dismissal and picking up the bouncing Xuanxuan. You deliberately detoured to a stationery store on Park South Road and let her choose a sheet of her favorite 3D animal stickers as a reward for behaving well in kindergarten today. Xuanxuan was overjoyed and clutched the stickers tightly in her hand. Then you rode home with her.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road

name: Family time and a warm dinner
description: When you got home, A Qiang was already washing and chopping vegetables in the kitchen. Xuanxuan had spread out her LEGO toys on the living room floor. You changed into home clothes and helped her build a little cat's play castle. A Qiang made steaming hot mushroom chicken noodle soup tonight; the broth was delicious, simple yet warm. At the dinner table, you shared the happy news of signing with Xiao Mei today. A Qiang was genuinely happy for you and said, "With the team stable, the store's development will be even smoother from now on."
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bonding and evening routine
description: After dinner, Aqiang took the initiative to clear the table and do the dishes. You accompanied Xuanxuan in drawing on paper. She drew the three of us holding hands, and you felt warm inside. Then you bathed her, dried her hair, and read two of her favorite bedtime picture books, 'The Different Carmela,' before gently coaxing her to sleep. Watching her sleeping face, you tiptoed out of the bedroom. It was already 8 PM.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community content curation and in-depth sharing
description: You tiptoed to the study and turned on the desk lamp. You carefully organized the PPT photos taken at Saturday's forum on your phone, the on-site layout pictures, and the memorable quotes and reflections recorded in your notebook into a richly illustrated post. You sent the content to the "Yajing Life Studio" community and wrote affectionately: "Many people ask me why I keep persisting with this little shop. I think it's because I've always believed that clothes are not just merchandise, but an expression of the person. Today I'd like to share some takeaways from last weekend's forum, about how to integrate Minnan local culture into our everyday outfits—perhaps a direction our store can try in the future." You also attached several New Chinese-style outfit pairing photos.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community interaction and the sprouting of creativity.
description: The community group quickly became lively. Old friend Vivian was the first to leave a comment: "I've been waiting for you to bring up this direction! Sister Yajing, this idea is amazing! I remember the silk scarf we talked about last time using Minnan floral tile elements — I think that would be a great attempt!" Seeing this message, a warm current and a strong sense of agreement rose in your heart, and you immediately replied to her: "Yes! Let's talk more about this idea in the store tomorrow?" The other sisters also liked and discussed it one after another. You replied and interacted with each of them, feeling that the store's "brand upgrade journey" had gotten a very beautiful start because of Vivian's positive response.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write a diary entry to record the inner journey
description: You open the diary you've used for three years and write the date: September 22, 2025. As the pen tip moves across the paper, you review the journey from coming to Xiamen from Quanzhou in 2009 to becoming an independent shop owner. You write: 'Watching Xiaomei receive customers from behind today, I seemed to see myself being taken under Sister Sun Li's wing twelve years ago. Now I too have become that guide and helmsman. The word team has gained real weight today. I have gone from a naive girl who was looked after to a woman who can take care of others and make promises. Thank God, none of the steps I took over the past sixteen years have been wasted. Good night. Tomorrow will be a better day.' After writing, you feel especially calm and clear.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation, prayer, and going to sleep.
description: You closed your diary and went to wash up. After a simple facial care routine, you changed into comfortable cotton pajamas, sat on the edge of the bed, and quietly looked back over the day. You made the sign of the cross and prayed softly: 'Loving Heavenly Father, thank You for pouring Your grace on our team today and enabling us to take this solid step. Please continue to guide the way ahead for our store, bless Xiaomei, and watch over my family with peace and joy. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.' Then you turned off the lamp, got under the covers, and felt Aqiang's steady breathing. With a clear and tranquil heart, carrying the joy of a formed team and certainty about the future, you slowly drifted into sleep.
location: Home bedroom in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and taking her daughter to kindergarten
description: The phone alarm went off at seven in the morning. After getting up, she washed up quietly and put last night's clothes into the washing machine for a quick wash. Remembering that the weather forecast said it might rain in the afternoon, she put a folding umbrella and her daughter's cardigan into her bag. Then she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, and used the promise of visiting a newly opened sticker shop on the way home from school to lift her spirits. She helped her wash up, tie her braids, and change into her kindergarten uniform. After that, holding Xuanxuan's little hand, she walked along Hubin South Road and turned onto Gucheng West Road. After about fifteen minutes, she sent her to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watched her put on her backpack and wave goodbye, and only then left.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community at No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 West Gucheng Road, Siming District.

name: Morning commute and breakfast
description: She walked about eleven minutes from the kindergarten to the Jianfu Convenience Store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station and used mobile payment to buy a cup of hot soy milk and a ham sandwich for breakfast. Eating as she rode the scooter she had picked up from the charging station beside the convenience store, she went along Zhenhai Road and Siming South Road through streets that were gradually growing livelier, and arrived about ten minutes later at Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Jianfu Convenience Store, No. 35-101, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China; and Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District

name: Morning store-opening preparation and community livestream.
description: After arriving at the shop, she pulled up the roller shutter, turned on the air conditioner and lights, and checked the displays. Then she took out her phone and laptop, sat down at the cash register, refined the framework she had prepared yesterday for the weekend forum and for notifying the community about today’s live stream, and wrote the 9:30 live stream outline in her memos: share insights from the fashion forum, tell the behind-the-scenes story of the Minnan rice cakes, and bring up the co-branded collection topic to gauge reactions. As the live stream approached, she opened the live streaming app on her phone to test the network and sound quality, secured the phone to a tripod, and adjusted the angle. She started the stream right at 9:30, opening in a warm and natural tone. She first shared how moved she was by the “New Chinese Style and Local Culture” forum at the international fashion week, then held up samples of the traditional-flavor rice cakes and honestly recounted the whole journey from the inspiration at the Neighborly Festival, through three rounds of recipe adjustments, to the limited release last Saturday. To wrap up, she mysteriously mentioned the co-branding ideas she had recently received and asked fans what they thought about wearing the taste of Minnan; the bullet comments were enthusiastic. The live stream ended successfully at 10:30.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Post-live review and customer interaction
description: After ending the livestream, she immediately checked the backend data. Switching to the shop's community group, she saw comments discussing the collaboration and felt more confident, so she @-mentioned that fan to say thanks. She then replied by private message to several customers asking about shipping and pre-ordering Minnan cakes, noted their contact information and needs, and promised to notify them first after making an additional batch on Wednesday. Next, at the cashier's computer, she processed five online orders that had piled up from last night and this morning, checked the addresses, and printed shipping labels. She also browsed popular posts on Xiaohongshu about Minnan floral tiles and modernized qipao, saved outfit ideas, and replied from the shop's official Xiaohongshu account to several customer inquiries about the new autumn styles.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Lunch break and gathering inspiration.
description: After asking the familiar shoe shop owner next door to keep an eye on the shop, I walked about three minutes to the Yi Dian Dian milk tea shop in the middle of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, ordered a passion fruit double blast fruit tea, and sat in a corner by the window. While sipping the cold fruit tea, I scrolled through the Xiaohongshu and WeChat official accounts of several independent designer brands I had saved, studying how they combine traditional patterns with modern clothing styles. In my mind, the scene of discussing the co-branded collection with Vivian in the afternoon kept coming to mind.
location: Yi Dian Dian milk tea shop, 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Afternoon restocking plan and store tidying.
description: After finishing the fruit tea and returning to the store, she used the relatively free afternoon time to reorganize the rumpled clothes on the racks by color and style, and pasted the fabric swatches from the weekend fashion week onto the inspiration board, writing "New Chinese style for everyday wear" beside them with a highlighter. She took out two exquisite glass teapots and teacups from the back room and washed them carefully, preparing to host Vivian in the afternoon. After that, while watching the store, she took out her business notebook and sketched an outline for cooperating with designer Lin Yue, writing down keywords such as "floral tile patterns," "modernized qipao," "everyday wearability," "limited edition," and "co-branding," while also thinking about how to ask more targeted questions about New Chinese style sourcing details when communicating with supplier Susan in the evening.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Meet with Vivian to discuss the co-branding direction.
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, she began preparing for the upcoming meeting. She took out honey and fresh passion fruit, brewed two cups of passion fruit honey tea by hand, and placed the low-sugar jujube paste cake she had brought that morning on the cozy tea seating area in the corner of the store. At 3:30, fashionably dressed Vivian arrived as promised and said excitedly that she had been thinking about the co-branded collection all night. The two sat down in the tea area and talked in depth for an hour. Vivian showed the photos of Minnan patterned tiles saved on her phone and strongly suggested starting with a modified qipao, emphasizing that “it must be wearable in daily life, not too theatrical.” Geometric tile patterns or Hui'an women elements could be incorporated, and the fabric could be skin-friendly, comfortable cotton-linen or Tencel. She even volunteered to be one of the first fitting models. Yajing nodded as she listened and quickly jotted down “Direction: new Chinese-style everyday modified qipao with patterned tile motifs.” They agreed to invite Vivian to visit a local intangible cultural heritage exhibition before the weekend for inspiration. After seeing Vivian off, she felt especially cheerful. She quickly tidied the tea table, washed the cups, photographed the discussion notes to back them up on her phone, checked the cash register system, turned off some of the lights, and prepared to close the shop for the day.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Picking up daughter from school, shopping, and playing in the park.
description: Riding a scooter along Zhongshan Road and Zhenhai Road, she first went to the M&G Stationery Store on Park South Road to fulfill her morning promise and let Xuanxuan pick a set of "Princess Elsa" stickers as a reward. Then she continued riding the scooter along Park South Road and Gucheng West Road straight to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and found Xuanxuan waiting eagerly among the crowd. After picking up her daughter, it was still early, so instead of going straight home she took her on foot to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan happily played with the new stickers on a park bench while Yajing sat beside her watching tenderly. As it got darker and the wind turned cool, she put on the light jacket she had prepared in the morning for Xuanxuan, and mother and daughter walked home hand in hand along Bailu Road and Hubin South Road.
location: M&G Stationery Store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China; Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District; Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District; and the residence at No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Preparing dinner and video-calling to discuss orders.
description: Back home, she changed into loungewear, put on an apron, and started preparing dinner ingredients: she washed and scored the chicken wings, marinated them with cooking wine and light soy sauce, and rinsed the rice and cooked it. While the rice was cooking, she made a video call on WeChat on time with Susan, a supplier from Guangzhou. Based on sales data, she added five best-selling summer styles and early-autumn dresses, then shifted the topic to the new-Chinese-style direction discussed in the afternoon and asked whether there were factory sources for modern qipao or frog-button shirts. Susan immediately sent several sample images. Combining Vivienne's suggestions, Yajing initially selected one modern qipao and two frog-button shirts, ordering five pieces of each to test the market, and confirmed delivery for next week. After the call, she returned to the kitchen, fried the chicken wings in hot oil, poured in cola and braised them; meanwhile she blanched broccoli and stir-fried it with minced garlic. Soon the kitchen was filled with the aroma of caramel and garlic, and the meal was done.
location: Residence, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Family dinner and putting daughter to bed
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang happened to get home too. The family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying cola chicken wings, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. While Yajing put food into Xuanxuan's bowl, she eagerly shared how she had discussed the co-branded collection with Vivian in the afternoon. Zhiqiang smiled supportively, and Xuanxuan piped up, 'Aren't the patterned tiles like building blocks?' making everyone laugh. After dinner, Zhiqiang volunteered to clear the table and wash the dishes. Yajing played with new stickers with Xuanxuan on the play mat in the living room, and then together they drew an imaginary picture of a 'patterned-tile cheongsam.' At exactly eight, Yajing bathed Xuanxuan. After changing into pajamas, she read the picture book 'Little Rabbit Tom' by the bedside. After two stories, Xuanxuan closed her eyes contentedly, and Yajing gently turned off the lamp and closed the door.
location: Residence, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Evening note organization and community interaction
description: She sat down at the study desk, turned on the desk lamp, and organized today's discussion notes with Vivian and the order communication records with Susan into categories in her phone memo. She wrote down the follow-up plan: “Direction: New Chinese-style everyday modified qipao with decorative tile patterns. Need to schedule an offline intangible cultural heritage exhibition this week and contact designer Lin Yue.” Then she opened the store's community group and saw that after the afternoon livestream, there was heated discussion about the co-branded collection, with more than a dozen new messages. She browsed and replied to them one by one, and announced that more detailed progress would be shared after National Day. Closing her notebook, she let out a satisfied sigh and felt that the day had been exceptionally fulfilling.
location: Study in the residence at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Pre-bedtime activities and rest
description: After stretching, she got up to wash up, carefully completed her evening skincare routine, and changed into comfortable pajamas. Kneeling beside the bed, she said her evening prayers, thanking the Lord for the smooth communication and clear thinking He granted her today, and also praying for tomorrow's work and her family's health and safety. Then she leaned against the headboard, picked up her phone, and took one last look at a set of new designer photos shared by Zheng Kai in the Former Boss Trio group chat, silently noting the highlights. Remembering that tomorrow is Wednesday and she still needed to get up early to take her child to school and go back to the store to make more Minnan cakes, she set her phone to Do Not Disturb, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully in the quiet night.
location: Residence, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Morning washing and taking care of my daughter
description: At 6:45 in the morning, the alarm went off. It was raining outside. Song Yajing lingered a little before getting up and washing up. Then she went to her daughter Chen Lexuan's room and gently woke her. Her daughter asked whether she could see snails in the rain, and Song Yajing smiled in response. She helped her daughter put on her kindergarten uniform, helped her wash up, and got her ready for kindergarten.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to kindergarten and went to Zhongshan Park.
description: Song Yajing and her daughter walked for 10 minutes under a transparent umbrella to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After watching her daughter walk into the teaching building with the teacher, she stopped for a moment, then walked along Gongyuan South Road to Zhongshan Park. The air was fresh after the rain, and on the way she thought about taking her daughter to a stationery store on the weekend.
location: Along the route from Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning jog at Zhongshan Park
description: After doing some simple stretching at the entrance of Zhongshan Park, Song Yajing jogged along the greenway at a pace of about 7 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer for about 2 kilometers. The trail was slippery after rain, so she was careful, but the fresh air relaxed her body and mind, and she felt great.
location: Walking trail in Zhongshan Park, Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, take a shower, and have breakfast
description: After her morning run, Song Yajing relaxed briefly on a park bench and walked home. Once home, she took a quick shower, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen shirt and jeans, took milk and toast from the fridge for a simple breakfast, and checked her phone, keys, and notebook to get ready to go out.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the store to carry out morning work
description: The weather cleared up. Song Yajing rode a scooter to the Yazhi Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road. After arriving, she turned on the lights, played music, carefully arranged Minnan cakes on a white porcelain plate with dried flowers, took product photos, and also photographed the autumn window display. At 9 o'clock, staff member Xiaomei arrived, and together they sorted new shirts and adjusted the displays. Then Song Yajing sat at the cash register to review recent sales data, focusing on calculating the total sales of the Minnan cake series since it went on sale on the 19th, about 1,800 yuan. The profit margin was much higher than clothing, which strengthened her determination to promote it.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Had a video call with fellow church member Lin Wei during lunch.
description: At noon, Song Yajing was eating a bento in the back storeroom while video-chatting on WeChat with fellow church member Lin Wei. She excitedly showed photos of the Minnan rice cakes and the autumn window display she had taken that morning. Lin Wei shared her own watercolor flower paintings, "Four Seasons of Minnan," and suggested incorporating a hand-painted style into the pastry packaging to elevate the quality of the gifts. The idea made Song Yajing's eyes light up. After the call, she immediately noted down keywords in her notebook: "hand-painted packaging," "gift box," "co-branded item," and so on.
location: Back warehouse of Yazhi Clothing, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store open in the afternoon
description: After the lunch break, Song Yajing returned to the store. With more customers in the afternoon, she warmly received them and offered professional styling advice. In spare moments, based on the morning's financial data, she and Xiaomei moved the discounted summer items to a prominent spot by the entrance and placed the autumn key knit cardigans and trench coats on the center island for a featured display. Around 3 p.m., she sent a WeChat message to her supplier Susan to discuss restocking several best-selling shirts.
location: Inside the Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school
description: When the time came, Song Yajing handed over the next day's notes to Xiaomei, locked the store door, and rode her scooter toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The sky had cleared, and the setting sun shone with golden light. When she arrived at the kindergarten gate, she saw her daughter walking carefully with a friend beside the puddles left by the rain. Her daughter ran over excitedly and said she had found a snail. Song Yajing squatted down to hug her, then took her hand and walked home.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to play at Jiaxing Garden Park.
description: Passing by Jiaxingyuan Park, there were several small puddles on the rain-soaked ground. When her daughter saw them, she refused to move and begged to play for a while. Song Yajing smiled and agreed, standing by and watching her daughter, wearing little rain boots, stomp excitedly in the puddles, splashing water and letting out crisp laughter.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home to prepare and enjoy dinner
description: She took her still-unsatisfied daughter home. Her husband Aqiang worked overtime that night, so the mother and daughter prepared a simple dinner. Song Yajing quickly washed the rice and cooked it, took pork ribs and vegetables out of the fridge, and made sweet and sour pork ribs and garlicky water spinach. At the table, her daughter described the big snail family she had discovered at kindergarten. Song Yajing shared her discussion with Lin Wei about packaging design, and her daughter suggested drawing little rabbits on the packaging.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending evening time with daughter
description: After dinner, Song Yajing cleared the dishes, played a sticker storytime game with her daughter using the newly bought stickers, then bathed her, carried her to bed, and read two picture books. Her daughter soon fell asleep as she listened.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: English course preview and preparation
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing went to the study, opened her laptop and entered the English workshop course platform early, browsed the evening's courseware “Transportation and Asking for Directions”, familiarized herself with the key sentence patterns, and silently practiced them. After previewing, she got up to drink some water and stretch, then returned to the study, neatly arranged her notebook, textbook, and pen, and waited for the course to begin.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community study room.

name: Attend the English speaking workshop.
description: The class started on time, with the theme "Transportation and Asking Directions." The teacher taught key sentence patterns through pictures and role-play scenarios, and students worked in pairs for role-playing. Song Yajing was paired with a student from Fuzhou to simulate scenes such as asking for directions and checking routes. Her speaking speed was not fast, but she made progress. The teacher commented: "Fluency is improving, keep practicing."
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community study room (online classroom)

name: After-class review and creative notes
description: After the class, Song Yajing copied key words and sentences from the courseware into her notebook, then went to her daughter's room door to confirm she was fast asleep, returned to the study, and quietly tried to retell the conversation from that evening, feeling that it was smoother than last time. During a break in reviewing, she thought of using Minnan rice cakes paired with Lin Wei's watercolor style to shoot an artistic short video to post in the community, so she jotted down the idea in her phone memo.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community study room.

name: Washing up and praying before bed
description: Song Yajing tidied up her desk, went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into her pajamas, and knelt by the bed to make the sign of the cross for her bedtime prayers. She gave thanks for a fulfilling day and prayed for her daughter's health, her husband's hard work, and new inspiration for the store.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening leisure and community interaction.
description: Leaning against the headboard, Song Yajing picked up her phone, opened the close friends' group chat and exchanged a few words with Wang Jia and Lingling, replied to her mother on WeChat to let her know she was safe, browsed discussions about the co-branded item in her community, saw that regular customer Vivian expressed anticipation, casually sent a goodnight sticker and teased a little surprise for tomorrow. Then she picked up The Taste of Southern Fujian from the nightstand and browsed the chapter on the history of traditional pastries, looking for inspiration for developing new flavors of Southern Fujian cakes.
location: Bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Feeling her eyelids grow heavy, Song Yajing closed the book and turned off the bedside lamp. In the darkness, she savored the cross-disciplinary aesthetic inspiration from today and the small progress in her English class. Feeling that her life was full and layered, she fell asleep quickly, contentedly.
location: Bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up in the morning, washing up, and having breakfast with her daughter.
description: The alarm went off. After getting up, Yajing opened the window and saw it was partly cloudy outside. After washing up, she put on a light blue cotton-linen shirt and khaki cropped pants, and applied light makeup. Then she went to her daughter Xuanxuan's room, gently woke her up, and helped her change into her kindergarten uniform. The two went to the dining room, where Yajing had prepared hot milk, toast, and boiled eggs. Xuanxuan ate quickly and said excitedly that today she was going to have a ball-bouncing contest with her classmates. Yajing encouraged her.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Yajing helped Xuanxuan put on her little backpack and walked hand in hand with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, they met Aunt Zhang, a neighbor, walking her pet dog, and Xuanxuan happily played with the little dog for a while. At the kindergarten gate, she greeted the teacher on duty, watched Xuanxuan bounce into the classroom, then turned and left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and buying breakfast.
description: After dropping off her child, Yajing got on her folding scooter and rode along Gucheng West Road toward Zhongshan Road. When passing Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought a cup of hot soy milk and a tuna rice ball for breakfast at Jianfu Convenience Store, spending 12 yuan. Then she continued riding and arrived at the store around 8:15.
location: Jianfu Convenience Store, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store preparation and pre-opening tidying.
description: After arriving at the Yazhi Clothing Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Yajing unlocked the rolling shutter door and turned on the lights and air conditioning. She quickly finished breakfast, then checked yesterday's sales records, ironed the newly arrived autumn shirts and hung them in the new arrivals section, adjusted the window mannequin outfits, and finally checked the phone stand, fill light, and sound equipment used for livestreaming to make sure everything was normal.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Regular Thursday live stream
description: The livestream started on time at 9:30, themed National Day Outfit Inspiration. Yajing enthusiastically presented two outfits suitable for short trips in and around Xiamen: a navy blue knitted top with beige wide-leg pants, and a floral dress with a denim short jacket over it. She mentioned that the shop would have little surprises during the National Day holiday and guided viewers to add her on WeChat to reserve items via private message.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Post-livestream operations and customer maintenance
description: After the livestream ended, Yajing browsed and replied to comments and direct messages in the live room, handled inquiries about deposits for pre-orders, and then posted the livestream outfit photos and links in the shop's WeChat group. During this time, she handled after-sales inquiries from two regular customers and confirmed the sizes for exchanges. Around 10:30, clerk Xiaomei arrived at the store. Yajing greeted her and continued with the work at hand.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and gathering suggestions in the group.
description: There weren't many customers in the store, so Yajing told Xiaomei and walked to the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, ordered a sea salt caramel latte, and sat down by the window. She posted a message in the 'Siming District Moms Mutual Aid Group' asking for recommendations for a two-day, one-night trip around Xiamen with her family during the National Day holiday, suitable for a 5-year-old child and with a budget of around 3,000 yuan. Moms in the group quickly responded.
location: 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City, 189 South Siming Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Interaction records, preliminary screening, and return-to-store handover.
description: As Yajing drank coffee, she checked the group replies, carefully noted each mother's suggestions, including Zhangpu Volcano Island Resort and Zhangzhou Ancient City, and sincerely replied with thanks. She initially felt that Volcano Island best suited the parent-child trip. When it was about time, she packed up and walked 5 minutes back to the store. When she arrived, it happened to be Xiaomei's break time. Yajing briefly briefed her on the afternoon inventory work and reminded her that customers might come to pick up ordered clothes.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Greeting customers and organizing inventory.
description: In the afternoon, customers came to the store one after another. Yajing enthusiastically put together three best-friend outfits for two young women and successfully sold two blouses and one skirt. During a lull, she and Xiaomei checked the inventory sheet and organized the model numbers and quantities of best-selling styles that needed restocking, preparing to send them to supplier Susan later.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Taking stock of promotional materials with Xiaomei
description: After arriving at the store, Yajing and Xiaomei counted the inventory in the small warehouse and found that only a dozen or so gift boxes were left (only 5 in the red festival theme), and the "National Day Special" hanging tags were also almost used up. The two compared prices and materials among three suppliers on a wholesale app, and finally ordered 30 red gift boxes and 50 small hanging tags, spending 76 yuan. Afterwards, at the front desk, they discussed the National Day duty schedule. Yajing volunteered to be on duty from the 1st to the 3rd, and Xiaomei would handle the 4th to the 7th with triple pay. Xiaomei readily agreed.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wrap up work before leaving.
description: Yajing edited and posted a National Day promotion update on WeChat Moments, accompanied by three outfit photos and a preview of next week's special offers. She then replied to supplier Susan's WeChat message, confirming that the previously replenished shirts had been shipped and were expected to arrive tomorrow or the day after.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter and playing at the park
description: At 16:35, Yajing rode her scooter to the kindergarten to pick up Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan excitedly told her that she had won the ball-bouncing game. The two went to Jiaxingyuan Park on the way. Xuanxuan ran off to play on the slide and in the sandpit, while Yajing sat on a bench watching over her. At the same time, she thanked the mom who recommended Volcano Island in the moms' group and added her on WeChat for further consultation.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner
description: After returning home at 17:15, Yajing let Xuanxuan watch the cartoon "Peppa Pig" in the living room, and put on an apron to start preparing shacha noodles. She took shrimp, lean meat, bean sprouts, and oil noodles out of the fridge, skillfully started the pot to boil water, stir-fried the shacha sauce until fragrant, and prepared the toppings, waiting for her husband Aqiang to come back before cooking the noodles.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang got home at 18:10, and the family of three sat around the table eating steaming-hot shacha noodles. During the meal, Yajing shared the plan for Zhangpu Volcano Island recommended by the moms' group. Aqiang agreed and suggested searching for tips online over the weekend, adding that they could bring a portable gas stove and cook noodles by the sea. Yajing smiled and reminded him to keep the budget within 3,000 yuan and not to forget to save for the travel fund.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Spending time with her daughter and preparing for bedtime
description: After dinner, A Qiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Yajing stacked building blocks with Xuanxuan on the play mat. At 19:00 she bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and then read The 100-Story House Under the Sea to her in the small bed. Xuanxuan fell asleep before the story was finished. Yajing gently kissed her forehead and tiptoed out of the room.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle online matters and interact with the community
description: Yajing came to the study, opened the store's online backend, packed and processed 3 new orders and printed shipping labels. Then she browsed and replied to customers' inquiries about outfits and sizes, and posted three outfit video clips from today's live stream in the store's community group, guiding everyone to discuss which one is most suitable for going to Volcano Island.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Design a sketch for wrapping paper.
description: After handling online matters, Yajing relaxed and took out colored markers and A4 paper to design wrapping paper incorporating Minnan floral tile elements. She drew several sheets, chose the one she liked most, and photographed it to send to church friend Lin Wei. Lin Wei replied quickly, saying the floral tile elements were great and suggesting that the colors could be bolder and the lines smoother.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: While waiting for Lin Wei to reply, Yajing took a hot shower and applied a hydrating mask. Then she got back into bed to check her messages and, after seeing Lin Wei's encouragement, replied with an emoticon. She said a brief bedtime prayer, grateful for the fulfilling day, and wrote a summary for the day in her phone memo: the livestream went smoothly, the initial intention for Volcano Island was confirmed, packaging design had taken a new direction, and she would follow up on the materials tomorrow.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Going to bed
description: At exactly 22:30, she turned off the bedroom light. After lying down, the images of the volcanic island's beach and the color scheme of the floral-tile packaging still surfaced in her mind. With anticipation for the next day and the National Day holiday, she quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast.
description: The alarm clock rang. Song Yajing got up, opened the curtains to feel the sunlight, washed up quickly, and changed into sportswear. She gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan and helped her change into her kindergarten uniform. They enjoyed a simple breakfast together: her daughter drank warm milk and ate cookies, while Song Yajing ate whole-wheat bread and urged her daughter to step it up.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and go for a morning run.
description: Song Yajing rode an electric scooter to take her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, told her to listen carefully in class, and watched her enter the classroom. She then went to Zhongshan Park, stretched, and went for a morning run of about 2 kilometers at a pace of 7 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. Afterward, she walked by the lake, enjoying the tranquility of the early morning.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province  Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home for a shower and a change of clothes
description: Rode the scooter home, took a quick warm shower, changed into an off-white linen shirt and dark blue wide-leg pants, put on light makeup, drank a glass of warm water, took her work notebook and key pouch, and got ready to go out.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and online tasks.
description: Song Yajing rode her scooter to the shop. After opening the door, she checked the cleanliness, turned on the air conditioner and lights. In the backend system, she confirmed the delivery status of the new Chinese-style items, then replied to community group messages, and called Master Chen to reconfirm the request to make 40 additional Minnan-style cakes for the weekend (20 pieces of low-sugar jujube paste cake, 10 pieces of old-fashioned rice cake, and 10 pieces of steamed sponge cake with crushed peanuts).
