location: Yazhi Clothing, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: New Chinese-style new arrivals display and photo warm-up
description: The delivery person brought three new Chinese-style sample garments (a modernized qipao, a frog-button shirt, and a tie-dyed half skirt). Song Yajing signed for them and ironed them carefully. In the central display area of the store, she used a dress form to showcase the modernized qipao, arranged autumn leaf decorations and hanging banners, hung up the frog-button shirt and tie-dyed half skirt, and created an early autumn atmosphere. Then she took close-up and styling photos with her phone. After retouching the photos, she posted the new arrival update on Moments and in the customer group: “Today’s new arrivals | New Chinese-style early autumn attempt | When the modernized qipao meets Minnan patterned tile inspiration—elegant and serene, waiting for you to try it on,” which attracted customer inquiries.
location: Yazhi Clothing, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and return to the store.
description: Song Yajing walked to the 85°C Bakery Cafe in Zhonghua City, ordered a sea salt caramel coffee and honey bean bread, and sat by the window to enjoy them. During that time, she shared a family trip guide to Volcano Island in the moms' mutual help group and replied to inquiries, then switched to the shop's WeChat to reply to customers. At 12:15 she walked back to the shop, taking about 15 minutes, and saw that employee Xiaomei had already arrived. She briefed Xiaomei on the morning's online interactions and the time to pick up the Minnan cake the next day, and emphasized that Xiaomei should communicate with suppliers independently in the afternoon.
location: 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province  Yazhi Clothing, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Guide Xiao Mei to communicate with suppliers independently
description: Xiaomei communicated with supplier Susan via WeChat about the arrival time of regular autumn clothing and the shipping status of new Chinese-style samples, while Song Yajing sat nearby observing. After the communication, Song Yajing gave Xiaomei suggestions for improvement: proactively ask about discounts, add a warm closing, and fully record the arrival date. Xiaomei carefully wrote them down in her notebook.
location: Yazhi Clothing, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Receiving customers and fine-tuning the display
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Song Yajing mainly served customers trying on new Chinese-style clothes and gave styling advice, while Xiaomei took care of walk-in customers. During that time, she adjusted the mannequin's sleeves according to customers' body shapes, moved the tie-dyed skirts, and adjusted the window display together with Xiaomei, adding decorative items.
location: Yazhi Clothing, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and play in the park.
description: Song Yajing closed the shop early, left the cleanup to Xiaomei, and rode a kick scooter to the kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. On the way, they stopped at Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan played on the slide and chased pigeons, while Song Yajing sat on a bench checking the cleaning photos Xiaomei had sent, confirming everything was fine. After 15 minutes, she called her daughter to come home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province  Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Return home to prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After returning home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already gotten off work. Song Yajing asked her husband to read picture books with their daughter, while she went into the kitchen to prepare tomato-and-egg noodles with seasonal vegetables and pan-fried small wontons. During dinner, the family of three sat together and shared funny moments from the day: Song Yajing mentioned that the new Chinese-style arrivals were well received, her husband said he was planning the Zhangpu Volcano Island trip for the weekend, and their daughter said her painting had been praised by her teacher.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter and putting her to bed
description: After dinner, her husband cleared the dishes. Song Yajing took her daughter to the room to paint with watercolors, and her daughter drew the family of three. Then she bathed her daughter, told her a story, and watched her fall asleep sweetly.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: English speaking class review and lesson.
description: After leaving her daughter's room, she made herself a cup of tea, went to the study, and took out the English course materials to review vocabulary and sentence patterns for simulated scenarios. At 20:00 she entered the online meeting room on time and took part in an English speaking practice that simulated comprehensive travel scenarios, including airport, hotel, and restaurant situations, as well as handling emergencies such as lost luggage and room problems. In the end she received an electronic certificate of completion and sent a screenshot to her husband.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidying up after class and replying to messages.
description: After the class ended, she closed the software and tidied up the desk. She said goodbye to the students in the course group chat, then sent a WeChat message to her friend Vivian to arrange the time and place to meet tomorrow to see the intangible cultural heritage exhibition. Seeing the thumbs-up emoji sent by her husband, she replied jokingly: "Then you need to learn to drive well and be the driver."
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening wash-up, reading, and bedtime
description: In the bathroom, she carefully washed her face, applied a face mask, and did shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to relax. After washing up, she changed into pajamas and lay in bed, reading 《The Taste of Minnan》 to learn about the history of Minnan pastries. Then she said her bedtime prayers, thanked God for his protection, and prayed for her family's safety. She set the alarm for 7:00 the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep after reviewing a fulfilling day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early morning wake-up and preparation
description: Song Yajing was awakened by the sunlight on a weekend morning. After getting up, she first weighed herself: 47.8 kg. Then she washed up, did basic skincare, and pinned up her hair. At 7:45 she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her change into going-out clothes, and braided her hair into little pigtails. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare a simple breakfast: she toasted two slices of bread, made herself a cup of black coffee, and warmed a glass of milk for her daughter.
location: Home, No. 128, No. 82 Community on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out to the pastry shop
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing urged her daughter to put on her own shoes, took her commuter bag, her daughter's small water bottle, and wet wipes, and rode an electric scooter with her daughter from home to the reserved pastry shop of Master Chen.
location: On the way from the community at 82 Shanggu Street to Master Chen's pastry shop (in an alley near Zhongshan Road) in Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up the reserved Minnan cake
description: Arriving at Master Chen's pastry shop, Master Chen had already packed the 40 cakes she ordered: 20 low-sugar jujube paste cakes, 10 old-fashioned rice cakes, and 10 steamed cakes with crushed peanuts. Song Yajing checked the quantity and paid, then chatted with Master Chen, mentioning that she might order another batch before National Day. Her daughter Chen Lexuan looked curiously at the cake molds, and Master Chen gave her a small piece of steamed cake with crushed peanuts as a snack.
location: Master Chen's pastry shop in the alleyways near Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Trip to the library and community warm-up
description: After picking up the pastries, Song Yajing rode her scooter with her daughter to Siming District Library. On the way, she told her daughter to listen to the teacher's storytelling obediently. While waiting for the red light at the intersection, she quickly took photos of the just-picked Minnan cakes with her phone and posted them to the store's VIP community, promoting that they were freshly baked and available in the store in the afternoon. She also forwarded them to her mother's
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, on the way from near Zhongshan Road to the Siming District Library at 848-1 Xiahe Road

name: Parent-child reading activity at the library
description: Arrived at the children's reading area on the second floor of Siming District Library to attend the "Autumn in Picture Books" event. The librarian vividly explained The Falling Leaves Dance and Frederick. Her daughter Xuanxuan listened attentively and actively raised her hand to answer questions. During the craft session, they made fallen-leaf bookmarks. Xuanxuan used colored paper and dried leaves to make a bookmark with a heart pattern and gave it to Song Yajing, saying, "Mommy, this is for you! I love you the most!" Song Yajing was deeply touched and took photos to post on WeChat Moments to record the warm moment.
location: Children's Reading Area, 2nd Floor, Xiamen Siming District Library, No. 848-1 Xiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leisure time at the dessert shop
description: After the library event ended, the mother and daughter walked to the nearby 160 Degrees Cheesecake Shop. Song Yajing kept her promise, ordering a slice of tiramisu and a cup of yuzu tea, and a strawberry milkshake for her daughter. Her daughter ate with cream all over her mouth; Song Yajing wiped her clean with a tissue and took a photo of her daughter's adorable eating expression, sending it to the family group chat. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang immediately replied with a heart emoji. The mother and daughter enjoyed a warm, cozy time together.
location: 160 Degrees Cheesecake Shop, No. 15 Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and hand over to family.
description: Walk home from the cake shop (about 10 minutes). After arriving home, first settle the daughter and the pastries. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already at home, watching a car maintenance video. Song Yajing put the Minnan cake in the refrigerator and told her husband that in the afternoon he should first get the vehicle checked and then go shopping at the supermarket, and reminded her daughter that she needed to take a nap at noon.
location: Home, No. 128, No. 82 Community on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared lunch: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic stir-fried lettuce, and leftover pork rib soup from yesterday. The family of three ate and chatted. Song Yajing shared funny moments from the morning at the library, while her husband said he would go to the auto repair shop for a check-up first. After the meal, Song Yajing washed the dishes, and her husband took their daughter to wash her hands.
location: Dining room at home, No. 128, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and online store maintenance
description: Her husband watched the animated series PAW Patrol with their daughter in the living room and put her down for a nap. Song Yajing used this time in the bedroom to handle store matters. She replied to the morning's messages in the community group about Minnan cake, confirmed customer Vivian's message about coming on Sunday for a fitting, and sent her a private message to set aside size M and tell her that the new items were ready. At the same time, she checked the calendar to plan the route for tomorrow's intangible cultural heritage exhibition and look up the Mass time.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 128, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Vehicle maintenance and supermarket shopping
description: In the afternoon, the family of three first drove to Wei Zai Club Luxury Car Repair Shop. The husband discussed the inspection items with the mechanic (tire pressure, engine oil, brake pads, spare tire, antifreeze, etc.), while Song Yajing took her daughter to browse in a nearby convenience store. After the vehicle inspection, everything was normal. Then they drove to the Walmart Ruijing Commercial Plaza store, where Song Yajing pushed a cart to buy travel supplies: children's sunscreen, mosquito repellent, band-aids, beach toy set, cookies, jelly, seaweed, and a transparent waterproof phone pouch. The shopping was efficient, totaling 143.5 yuan, within budget. Then they drove home.
location: No. 52 Houbin East Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, Weizai Club Luxury Car Repair; and No. 288 Lianqian West Road, Walmart (Ruijing Commercial Plaza Store)

name: Organizing travel supplies and taking a short rest
description: After returning home, Song Yajing let her daughter play with the newly bought beach toys in the living room, while she sorted and stored the travel supplies she had purchased: sunscreen and mosquito repellent went into the travel bag, snacks on the coffee table, and beach toys on the balcony. She also took a photo of the waterproof phone pouch and sent it to the family group, saying, 'Beach gear Get!' Then she poured a glass of water, sat on the sofa to rest, and browsed Xiaohongshu on her phone to check tips for Volcano Island.
location: Living room of the home at No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community sharing and customer interaction
description: Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa, focused on community management. She selected three photos with good lighting from the 'New Chinese Style Early Autumn Try-On' display area photos in her phone album, carefully wrote the caption, and posted them to the 'Yajing Lifestyle Store' customer group, introducing new items such as modified qipaos and knot-button shirts. The group responded enthusiastically as soon as the message was sent, and Vivian confirmed her size right away. Song Yajing interacted in the group and also privately messaged Vivian to arrange a fitting at the store at 2 p.m. the next day. She also noted down the customer request 'Can New Chinese style be paired with jeans?' in her memo and sent it to the shop assistant Xiaomei to prepare in advance.
location: Living room of the home at No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child painting time.
description: After taking care of community matters, Song Yajing put down her phone and focused on spending time with her daughter. She took out watercolor pens and drawing paper and drew 'The Volcanic Island in My Heart' with her daughter. Her daughter drew a smoking volcano and the three of them holding hands; Song Yajing helped her add the sea and the beach. When her husband came over and saw the drawing, he laughed and said he'd take them to a real beach to dig for treasure.
location: Living room of the home at No. 128, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: At dinner time, Song Yajing was the main cook, and her husband helped as her assistant. She made assorted fish simmered in soy sauce water, steamed egg custard, stir-fried greens, and sweet potato porridge. The family of three sat around the table, eating and chatting. Her husband reported that the vehicle inspection went well, and Song Yajing shared the community's positive response and the plans for tomorrow. The dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, No. 128, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime wash-up and bedtime story.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing cleared the dishes while her husband washed the dishes. Then she took her daughter to bathe, and the mother and daughter played with bubbles together. After the bath, she dressed her daughter in pajamas and laid her on the bed. Song Yajing took out the picture book Frederick and reviewed the story they had listened to that day with her daughter. Her daughter quickly became sleepy and, under gentle soothing, fell asleep peacefully at around 20:20.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at No. 128, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening self-improvement and work review
description: After confirming that her daughter was sound asleep, Song Yajing went to the study and continued handling customer questions in the community group. She replied to inquiries about new-Chinese-style outfit pairing, organized 'pairing suggestions' and 'customer size needs' into a table, and sent it to the shop assistant Xiaomei, asking her to prepare the accessories or trousers needed for the next day. Afterwards, she prepared for tomorrow's intangible cultural heritage exhibition, searching the browser for materials such as 'Zhangzhou woodblock New Year pictures' and 'Xiamen flower-tile patterns', and jotting down details worth photographing for reference. Finally, she leafed through the book 'Taste of Minnan', then washed up and did her skincare routine, applying a hydrating and repairing sheet mask.
location: Home study/bedroom, No. 128, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: After removing the face mask, she completed her basic skincare routine. At 10 p.m., Song Yajing knelt quietly by the bed for her bedtime prayer, grateful for the family's safety and happiness today, and praying for tomorrow's Mass and for the meeting with Vivian to go smoothly. Then she set the alarm for 7:15 tomorrow, turned off the light, and fell asleep on time at 22:00.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 128, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: On Sunday morning, Song Yajing got up at 7:15, washed up, and went to her daughter's room. She found that her daughter Chen Lexuan was already awake, so she changed her into a floral-print dress and tied her hair into little braids. She herself changed into an off-white cotton-linen long skirt with pearl earrings. While getting ready, she told her daughter today's schedule: going to Gulangyu to attend Mass, and guests visiting in the afternoon.
location: Home, No. 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Cozy family breakfast.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang prepared millet porridge, fried eggs, and ham slices, and the family of three sat around the table. Their daughter shared the fallen-leaf bookmark she made yesterday; her husband reminded her to bring a sun umbrella; Song Yajing shared the news that her good friend Liu Fang was coming. Her husband offered to take their daughter to Xinhua Bookstore in the afternoon.
location: Home restaurant, No. 128 Shanggu Street, No. 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Set off for Dongdu Tongyi Wharf.
description: After packing up, the mother and daughter rode scooters to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 to Cruise Center Station, walked to Dongdu Tongyi Pier, and prepared to take the ferry to Gulangyu. On the way, the daughter asked a question about the church.
location: From Zhenhai Road Metro Station to Dongdu Tongyi Pier, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Take the ferry to Gulangyu.
description: The mother and daughter boarded the ferry by tapping their e-Tong cards and chose window seats. Song Yajing pointed out the red-tiled roofs, green trees, and the Bagua Building on Gulangyu Island across the water, and her daughter took photos. The ferry ride took about 20 minutes, arriving at Sanqiutian Pier at 9:20.
location: On the ferry from Xiamen Dongdu Tongyi Pier to Gulangyu Sanqiutian Pier, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: At 9:30, she walked to Gulangyu Catholic Church and attended Sunday Mass. Father Wang Mingde's sermon was themed 'The Blessing of Friendship.' Song Yajing prayed for her friends, the shop staff, and the shop's fifth anniversary. After Mass, in the courtyard, she gave Auntie Lin Xiuying some jujube paste cakes, and Auntie gave her fig soft cookies and a handwritten recipe in return. The two shared church anecdotes.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Strolling and resting on Gulangyu Island.
description: Took her daughter for a walk near Longtou Road. Her daughter was very interested in an orange cat. Song Yajing bought her daughter a bowl of fish ball soup and tried a few bites herself. During this time, she sent a WeChat message to her husband, sharing her feelings about the Mass and her gratitude, and reminded him about taking care of their daughter in the afternoon.
location: The area around Longtou Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Take the ferry back to Siming District.
description: Took the ferry from Sanqiutian Pier back to Dongdu Tongyi Pier. The daughter was tired and dozed off leaning against her mother's shoulder. Song Yajing thought about the simple lunch and the afternoon arrangements.
location: On the ferry from Sanqiutian Pier, Gulangyu, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Dongdu Tongyi Pier

name: Returning home for handover and preparing a simple meal
description: After getting off the boat, she walked home and arrived at 11:55. She put her sleeping daughter on the bed, quickly cooked some plain noodles, and ate with her husband. They went over the afternoon arrangements. Her husband said there were pork ribs and winter melon at home, so making soup would do.
location: Home, No. 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Quiet afternoon time alone, preparing.
description: Daughter asleep, husband watching the game. In the study, Song Yajing photographed and saved the fig soft cookie recipe, searched for time-honored satay noodle shops on Zhongshan Road, and settled on Yuehua and Wutang. She changed into flat shoes, touched up her makeup, sprayed a light citrus perfume, and got ready to go out.
location: Home study, 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the store and preparing to welcome customers.
description: Rode an e-scooter to the Elegant Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, arriving in less than 10 minutes. Opened the door, turned on the lights, adjusted the air conditioning, checked the New Chinese-style Early Autumn display area, and brought out hibiscus tea, glass cups, and a new mung bean puff pastry platter, ready to welcome customers.
location: Inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receiving Vivian, a VIP regular customer
description: Vivian, a regular customer, came to the store to try on a champagne-colored new Chinese-style jacquard qipao. Song Yajing helped her adjust it, and Vivian was satisfied and bought it. The two then drank hibiscus tea in the tea break area, and Song Yajing shared what she had seen at the intangible cultural heritage exhibition, including lacquer thread sculpture and gold-thread embroidery, giving Vivian outfit inspiration. They chatted for more than twenty minutes.
location: Inside Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reunite and catch up with elementary school classmate Liu Fang.
description: Liu Fang arrived at the shop, and the two hugged. Song Yajing showed her around the shop and shared her story of starting the business, while Liu Fang talked about her work in Shenzhen. Around 16:00, they went together to Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop for satay noodles. After the meal, they took a walk along Zhongshan Road, took photos under the arcade, and asked a passerby to take a group photo in front of the shop. Afterwards, she walked Liu Fang to the entrance of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, and they agreed to meet again later.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, Yazhi Clothing Store; No. 78 Zhenbang Road, Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop; Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street; Zhenhai Road Metro Station entrance.

name: Market shopping and returning home.
description: After seeing Liu Fang off, she went to Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market to buy water spinach, baby cabbage, and dried shrimp, planning to make garlic water spinach and baby cabbage with dried shrimp. Then she walked home, messaging her husband along the way to let him know.
location: Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market at No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the route back to home at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Warm parent-child and dinner time.
description: After arriving home, her husband and daughter were playing Ludo, and her daughter greeted her. Song Yajing started preparing dinner while her husband heated up the winter melon rib soup. While cooking, she shared the stories of her day: Mass thoughts, a satisfied client, and reuniting with Liu Fang. During dinner, the family of three sat together, eating garlicky water spinach, baby cabbage with dried shrimp, and rib soup, chatting.
location: Home, No. 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Time spent with daughter and doing household chores
description: After dinner, her husband washed the dishes, and Song Yajing helped her daughter complete the themed painting 'National Day Experiences.' Her daughter drew the family standing at the entrance of Volcano Island Resort. After finishing, she helped her daughter take a bath, changed her into pajamas, and told her a bedtime story.
location: Daughter's room at home, No. 128 Shanggu Street, No. 82 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting her daughter to sleep and preparing for the family meeting
description: Her daughter gradually fell asleep listening to the story. Song Yajing tucked in the blanket corners for her, turned off the light, and closed the door. Then she went to the living room, opened her laptop, found the screenshots of the Volcano Island guesthouse, and used a supermarket receipt as scratch paper to prepare for the trip.
location: Daughter's bedroom and living room at home, No. 82 Hubin South Road, No. 128 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discussed National Day travel plans with her husband.
description: Her husband brewed some flower tea. The two spread out a map and notes, and decided to leave on the morning of October 1 for Zhangpu Volcano Island, spend the afternoon on the beach, and return after the morning parent-child activities on October 2. Song Yajing listed the essential items in her memo app: swim ring, sunscreen, mosquito repellent, waterproof phone pouch, first-aid kit, and snacks. Her husband reminded her to check the tire pressure and the spare tire.
location: Home living room, No. 128 Shanggu Street, No. 82 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal socializing and pre-bedtime preparation
description: Back in the bedroom, Song Yajing selected a selfie with Liu Fang and old primary school photos, and posted a heartfelt message on Moments. She soon received likes and comments from her close friends, and replied to each one. Then she began her skincare routine and washing up.
location: Home bedroom, 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daily review and bedtime prayer
description: Lying in bed, reviewing the day: church bells, embraces from old friends, family laughter. Flipped through the satay noodle chapter in 'The Taste of Southern Fujian.' At 21:50, turned off the light and said a bedtime prayer to God, giving thanks for the encounters and praying for safe travels.
location: Home bedroom, 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Home bedroom, 128 Shanggu Street, 82 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning prayers.
description: At 6:45 a.m., Song Yajing woke up to the sound of her alarm. After washing up briefly, she went to the prayer stand in the corner of the bedroom, lit a small white candle, and said her morning prayer with her hands together, grateful for the new day and praying for peace for her family and smooth business at the shop. She felt calm and strong inside.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Morning run and breakfast preparation
description: After changing into sportswear, Song Yajing walked to Zhongshan Park, jogged about 2.5 kilometers on the park's loop trail at a pace of 7 minutes 40 seconds, and stretched by the lake, enjoying the fresh morning air and birdsong. Then she walked home, showered, changed into casual clothes, and prepared breakfast for herself: milk, whole-wheat toast, and fried eggs. Meanwhile, she placed her daughter Xuanxuan's kindergarten backpack and coat in the foyer, getting ready for the busy day ahead.
location: Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up my daughter and breakfast time.
description: Song Yajing gently woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, dressed her, and tied her hair into pigtails. The mother and daughter had breakfast together in the dining room. Xuanxuan ate cartoon-shaped steamed buns and drank milk. Song Yajing reminded her daughter that she would pick her up early after school to buy new stationery. Xuanxuan nodded happily, and the warm morning unfolded through their interactions.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Take my daughter to school and practice English.
description: Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on a scooter. On the way, she practiced the travel dialogues from last night's English class. Although she stumbled over a few words, her overall fluency improved. Xuanxuan listened carefully and praised her mother for sounding like a tour guide. The parent-child interaction made the practice relaxed and enjoyable. After arriving at the kindergarten, she watched her daughter go in.
location: Along the way to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Song Yajing rode her scooter along Gucheng West Road and Zhongshan Road to the Yazhi Clothing Store. In the early morning, Zhongshan Road was quiet and orderly. After arriving, she opened the door, turned on the air conditioner and speakers, played jazz, checked the awning, and prepared to welcome customers.
location: Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-holiday store affairs and communication with suppliers.
description: After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, Song Yajing began handling important pre-holiday work: sending National Day opening notices to VIP customers through the WeChat customer management system and greeting them kindly by nickname; organizing last week's store financial report, with total sales of 18,320 yuan and net profit of 6,580 yuan, and transferring 2,000 yuan into the family security fund account as usual; and checking the National Day shift rotation schedule with Xiaomei, who voluntarily covered shifts on the 4th and 5th, which Song Yajing greatly appreciated. Then, via a WeChat call, she confirmed the trial order details for two new Chinese-style knitted vests with Guangzhou supplier Susan, fully discussing pattern issues such as the neckline and sleeve length, and finally placed an order for 5 pieces of each in size M, agreeing to ship after the holiday.
location: Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and travel guide research
description: Song Yajing locked the shop door and walked alone to 'Taste Bud Time' handmade yogurt shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She ordered a signature fruit-and-oat yogurt cup and sat by the window, enjoying a leisurely lunch. At the same time, she opened her phone to browse guides to seafood restaurants near Zhangpu Volcano Island, saved three locally recommended spots, and felt excited about the next day's trip.
location: “Taste Bud Time” Handmade Yogurt Shop, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store reception, adjustments, and closing
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing returned to the store. As the flow of customers increased, she warmly received them and gave styling suggestions, while also working with Xiaomei to adjust the display area—moving the autumn trench coats to a prominent spot and putting out new arrivals. During a lull, she unboxed a new brown suede shoulder bag, tied a ribbon on it, and placed it on the display shelf. At 3 p.m., she posted the National Day opening notice and a nine-grid photo of new products in the customer group, which drew likes and inquiries from regular customers, and she replied to each one. Around 4 p.m., she and Xiaomei finished the inventory count and cashier settlement, put the cash into her bag, reminded Xiaomei about holiday matters, closed the store early, and rode her scooter to the kindergarten.
location: Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter from school and going to the stationery store
description: Song Yajing picked up her daughter Xuanxuan on time. Xuanxuan excitedly pulled her mother to go buy new stickers, and the mother and daughter went to the "Little Doctor Stationery Store" on Gongyuan South Road. Xuanxuan chose a pack of dinosaur stickers and a box of 24-color watercolor pens. Song Yajing picked out a canvas-covered pocket notebook for herself to record inspiration during the trip.
location: Little Doctor Stationery Store, Yubincheng Phase 2, 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Reviewed travel preparations on the way home.
description: The mother and daughter walked and chatted while carrying the stationery. Song Yajing asked Xuanxuan which toy she most wanted to bring, and Xuanxuan said she wanted to bring the little shovel and castle molds. Song Yajing silently checked the packing list in her mind: clothes for three, swimsuits, beach towels, sunscreen, toiletry bag, first-aid medicine, etc., and confirmed nothing was missing.
location: Near No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Family evening time: checking travel plans, dinner, and parent-child interaction
description: Back home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already finished work. After settling Xuanxuan down to watch cartoons, Song Yajing sat on the sofa with her husband to check the details of tomorrow's trip: confirming the booking of the seaside B&B in Quanzhou (check-in October 1, check-out October 3), e-tickets for Chongwu Ancient City (2 adults, 1 child), and reviewing the planned driving route. Then the couple prepared dinner together. A Qiang stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers and lettuce with minced garlic, while Song Yajing cooked rice and steamed egg custard. The family of three sat together for a warm dinner, and Xuanxuan excitedly described what she imagined the sea to be like. After dinner, Song Yajing played dinosaur stickers with her daughter and read the picture book The Little Turtle's Journey, enjoying quality parent-child time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Pack travel luggage
description: Song Yajing settled her daughter beside her to play with building blocks, then took out her suitcase and began packing according to the checklist: she placed the three people's change of clothes (thin jackets, swimsuits, beach towels), sunscreen supplies, toiletry bag, and so on into the suitcase in separate categories. Then she took out six carefully made Minnan jujube paste cakes from the kitchen, wrapped them in oil paper, and put them in the snack box to take to the B&B owner for tasting. Xuanxuan also helped by putting in her favorite cookies.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Vehicle pre-trip inspection.
description: Song Yajing and her husband went to the underground parking garage of the residential complex. Chen Zhiqiang checked the tire pressure and spare tire and confirmed the fuel tank was full. Song Yajing adjusted the straps of the child safety seat and made sure they were secure. Together they put the luggage in the trunk, locked the car doors, and felt confident about the trip the next day.
location: Underground parking garage, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shared the travel plan with her family.
description: Back in the study at home, Song Yajing shared a photo of the printed itinerary in the family WeChat group and sent a voice message telling her parents tomorrow's departure time and the homestay address. Her mother in her hometown of Quanzhou replied with a blessing emoji, which filled her heart with warmth.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Evening washing up, bedtime preparations, and going to sleep
description: After putting Xuanxuan to sleep (her husband had volunteered to take over the bedtime story), Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied a hydrating mask to relax her skin. She changed into her pajamas and checked the ID documents, power bank, and other items in the backpack by the bed again. After turning off the light, she said her bedtime prayers in the dark, thanking God for a safe day and praying for a smooth trip and the safety of the whole family. She fell asleep peacefully around 22:30, filled with contentment and anticipation.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 128 Hubin South Road)

name: Waking up and morning prayers.
description: In the morning, sunlight streamed into the bedroom. Song Yajing woke up feeling energetic. She said her morning prayers in front of the statue of the Virgin Mary in her bedroom, giving thanks for September and praying for a safe trip. Then she washed up and changed.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Woke up my daughter and had a cozy mother-daughter breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, who was excited about going to the sea tomorrow. She helped her wash up and braid her hair. For breakfast, she prepared whole wheat toast and black coffee, and for her daughter, milk oatmeal, boiled eggs, and a banana. The mother and daughter chatted about Volcano Island while eating, and her daughter sang 'Little Conch Horn'.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Ride a scooter to take daughter to school and commute to the store
description: Song Yajing rode a scooter with her daughter Chen Lexuan from home, teaching her English conversation along the way. They arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 7:55. After seeing her daughter off, she rode to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought mineral water and throat lozenges. Then she arrived at Yazhi Clothing Store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, opened the windows for ventilation, turned on the air conditioner, and prepared for business.
location: Starting from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road and the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, and ending at Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Shop opening preparation and morning tidy-up
description: Song Yajing was tidying the shelves in Yazhi Clothing Store, checking inventory, adjusting the autumn new-arrival displays, and wiping down mannequins and shelves to ensure the store greeted National Day in its best condition.
location: Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparations before the livestream
description: At the workbench in the back area of the store, Song Yajing brewed honey fruit tea, adjusted the live-streaming equipment, reviewed her live-stream outline, and fixed her outfit.
location: Back warehouse of Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Last themed livestream of the month
description: Song Yajing hosted a livestream themed “September Review and October Preview,” sharing September moments with about 28 fans and previewing the co-branded collection plans. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Back warehouse of Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing notes on the co-branded collaboration framework
description: After the livestream, Song Yajing organized the framework for the co-branded collection, confirmed the designer Lin Yue, set the product direction as modern qipao with patterned tile motifs, knot-button shirts, and silk scarves, made a mood board, and wrote down a plan to contact them after the holiday.
location: Workbench at Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Healthy lunch and monthly dietary review.
description: Song Yajing ate a homemade vegetable salad and chicken breast, and used a diet tracking app to review the results of three weeks of dietary adjustments. Her weight returned to 48.2 kg, and her body was more toned. She sent the record to the family group; her mother liked it.
location: Back warehouse of Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and browsing the news
description: After lunch, rested with eyes closed for 15 minutes, then watched National Day outfit videos by fashion bloggers and replied to messages in the customer group and the besties group.
location: Back warehouse of Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business operations and National Day shift handover preparations
description: In the afternoon, I received customers at the store, offered styling advice, and sold two knit cardigans and a skirt. In my spare time, I prepared handover materials, wrote down important notes, and organized the spare keys and inventory sheet.
location: Elegant Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the shop early and did some shopping on the way.
description: Closed the shop at 16:00 sharp, rode a scooter to the stationery store on Park South Road to buy a waterproof phone pouch and a dinosaur-shaped spring pen, then hurried to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan.
location: Starting from Yazhi Clothing Store, via the stationery store at 35 Gongyuan South Road, Phase 2, Yubin City, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten

name: Quality parent-child time on the way home from school.
description: After picking up her daughter, she rode the scooter home. Her daughter showed her a drawing of the sea and beach as a National Day gift. Song Yajing was moved and hugged her daughter.
location: On the way from Siming Experimental Kindergarten to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community.

name: Handle gifts and book the anniversary dinner.
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing wrapped a camel cashmere scarf in wrapping paper in the bedroom and attached a handwritten card as a gift for their 10th wedding anniversary. Then she called to reserve a table for two at a French bistro and arranged the anniversary dinner.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Reading in spare moments and recording inspirations
description: Reading "The Taste of Minnan" on the living room sofa, when she came to the chapter on decorative tiles, she sketched the tile patterns in the book to capture inspiration for the co-branded collection.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and warm interactions.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang cooked seafood misua, and the family had dinner together. The daughter excitedly talked about tomorrow's trip, and the family atmosphere was joyful and warm.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending time with daughter and the bedtime routine.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing bathed her daughter, who played with a dinosaur spring pen. After changing into pajamas, she told a picture book story about the sea, and her daughter fell asleep at 19:30.
location: Bathroom and children's room in the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Best friend sharing and social media updates.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing shared her travel plans via voice messages in the bedroom with her close friends' group chat and received their blessings. Then she posted a September recap on Xiaohongshu with five photos, and edited and published a short video.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Final checks and reading before the trip.
description: Song Yajing checked her travel backpack and suitcase, went through the packing list, and confirmed that everything was complete. Then she leaned against the bed and continued reading "A Taste of Minnan."
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Washing up, evening prayer, and diary
description: Wash up, apply a face mask, review the day's completed tasks, say evening prayers of gratitude for September, and write in my diary to record a perfect close.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the light and lay down, thought about tomorrow's itinerary, and fell asleep around 22:30 with a smile, bringing September to a perfect close.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and a light morning run
description: On the crisp National Day morning, Song Yajing changed into her workout clothes and set out from her home in the residential compound at 82 Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, and walked six minutes to Zhongshan Park. There were already many citizens exercising in the park. She jogged slowly along the stone path for about 15 minutes, enjoying the quiet of being alone. After running, she bought soy milk and youtiao at the "Apo Guzaowei" stall at the park's north gate.
location: Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Zhongshan Park, Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family Finance Steward
description: After returning from her morning run, Song Yajing wiped her face with a wet towel and sat down at the kitchen table. She opened the mobile banking app and, according to the "insurance special" plan in the family electronic ledger, transferred this month's family insurance premium to the designated deduction account on time, saving a screenshot of the transfer receipt for future reference. Meanwhile, her mother-in-law Lin Xiuying sent a WeChat voice message; she replied while drinking soy milk, mentioning the arrangements for the tenth anniversary dinner that evening.
location: Home kitchen table, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Retrospective and outreach
description: Song Yajing sat in the study at home, opened her laptop, and organized the livestream data from the past month, including the number of viewers, interaction rate, and conversion rate. Then she sent a WeChat message to her loyal fan Lao Lin, asking him to meet at the Wu Zaitian snack shop on Zhongshan Road at noon to thank him in person. She also wrote an email to the independent designer Lin Yue, explaining her ideas for the co-branded collaboration, including the shop's style, customer profile, and design direction, and sent it.
location: Study room at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Warm family time
description: Song Yajing gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan and changed her into a red dress with a National Day theme. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came to the dining room wearing casual loungewear. Her mother-in-law Lin Xiuying had already served soy milk and youtiao, and the family sat around the table. While eating, Song Yajing shared today's plan and promised to finish work at the shop before 7 p.m. to attend the tenth-anniversary dinner. Chen Zhiqiang nodded, saying he would take their daughter to Egret Island Park today. Their daughter Xuanxuan excitedly took out crayons, drew a greeting card, and gave it to her parents.
location: Home dining room, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Drive to the shop
description: Song Yajing drove out of the neighborhood parking lot. On the morning of National Day, the roads were clear, and after about a 15-minute drive she arrived at the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-holiday store preparation and reception
description: After arriving at the store 'Elegant Clothing', Song Yajing adjusted the window displays with the shop assistant Xiaomei, pairing the new autumn trench coats and knitwear with gold accessories. While arranging, they reviewed the past month's livestream data. During that time, several walk-in customers came, and Song Yajing and Xiaomei took turns serving them, jotting down the review points in their phone memos.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Sincere thanks and lunch
description: Song Yajing walked about 24 minutes to Wu Zaitian Snack Shop to meet her fan Lao Lin. She ordered two servings of satay noodles and oyster omelet, and took out a carefully chosen knit cardigan from her bag to give to Lao Lin, expressing gratitude for his long-term support. Lao Lin shared his story of watching the livestream while taking care of his kid alone, and promised to have his younger sister add her on WeChat to send back try-on photos.
location: Wu Zaitian Snack Shop on Meihu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return to the store
description: After lunch, Song Yajing walked along Meihu Road for about 24 minutes back to her shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: From Meihu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A short rest at the store and future planning
description: Back at the store, the shop assistant Xiaomei had already finished lunch. Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and, combining the morning customer feedback with the previous week's fitting data compiled by Xiaomei, sorted out a detailed list of autumn style preferences. She also took three bridesmaid dress samples in different color schemes from the stockroom and hung them next to the fitting room. Then she drank a glass of warm water, closed her eyes, and rested for 15 minutes.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon fitting reception
description: Long-time customer Vivian came to the store with her best friend, who had just gotten engaged. Song Yajing greeted them warmly and, after asking about the seaside wedding, personally measured the bride-to-be and recommended three bridesmaid dresses: light blue, gray-green, and gradient purple. The guest tried them on one by one, and Song Yajing helped adjust the straps and waistlines and matched them with different styles of wedding shoes. In the end, the guest chose the gray-green knee-length dress and paid a deposit. The fitting session was lively, and Song Yajing took the opportunity to share the store's styling experience.
location: Yazhi Clothing, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Rushed wrap-up and heading to dinner.
description: After seeing off the guests, it was already 6 p.m. Song Yajing quickly tidied up the fitting room and locked the rolling shutter door. Because Zhongshan Road was congested on the National Day evening, she used a mobile app to hail a ride by the roadside and waited nearly 15 minutes before getting in. In the car, she sent her husband Chen Zhiqiang two WeChat voice messages explaining the reason for being late, but only received a cold "OK" emoji in reply. She watched the flowing car lights outside the window, feeling deeply guilty.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian to No. 19, Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian - Xiamen Pan Pacific Hotel (Caesar Western Restaurant)

name: Anniversary dinner and a couple's confrontation.
description: Song Yajing arrived at Caesar Western Restaurant about 45 minutes later than the agreed time. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang, wearing a dark blue shirt, sat alone by the window; his wine glass was already noticeably empty. He looked up at her and said calmly, "You're here." Song Yajing apologized repeatedly. Chen Zhiqiang was silent for a moment, then pointed out that she always put work last. The two enjoyed the appetizers and main course in a somewhat heavy atmosphere; Song Yajing tried to lighten the mood with funny stories from the shop, but with little effect.
location: Caesar Western Restaurant, Pan Pacific Xiamen, No. 19 Hubin North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: A proposal to mend the relationship on the way home.
description: After dinner, the two walked about 20 minutes along the shore of Yundang Lake to the parking lot on Bailuzhou East Road. The lake breeze carried a chill in the autumn night. Song Yajing took her husband's arm and softly suggested that from now on, the first day of every month be set aside as exclusive couple time—the shop would close early, and family members would help take care of her daughter. Chen Zhiqiang's eyes reddened slightly; he nodded firmly and held her hand tightly. This agreement became an important healing ritual in their marriage.
location: Bailuzhou Park and the Yundang Lake waterfront to the Bailuzhou East Road parking lot, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home and getting daughter settled
description: The couple drove about 14 minutes back to their home on Hubin South Road. Her mother-in-law, Lin Xiuying, was sitting on the sofa watching TV and told her that her daughter had already fallen asleep. Song Yajing walked quietly to her daughter's room and kissed her on the forehead. Her mother-in-law then went back to her own room to rest.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Home organization and work review.
description: After a hot shower, Song Yajing sat on the edge of the master bed in her pajamas, opened the notes app on her phone, and systematically organized the day's takeaways—including follower feedback, customer fitting data, bridesmaid dress order information, and the autumn preference list she had compiled in the afternoon—into an Excel spreadsheet to prepare for tomorrow's video meeting with supplier Susan.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Solitude and reflection before bed
description: Song Yajing turned off the computer and saw her husband beside her already asleep, so she lay down gently. She still felt somewhat guilty about being late today, but was also filled with the warmth and emotion of their reconciliation. She took out her phone and wrote 'October 1 Monthly Exclusive Time Agreement Established' in her memo, then turned off the light. Feeling the warmth of her husband beside her, she gradually fell asleep with mixed feelings.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and washing up
description: Waking up in the early morning, she saw the empty bed beside her and knew that her husband Aqiang had already gone out to buy breakfast. Her mood was calm and light; last night’s commitment to repair things made her feel at ease. She took the initiative to open the curtains. It was the second day of the holiday, and the sunshine was just right. After a simple wash, she neatly tied up her hair with a hair tie.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Agreed on a video call time with the supplier
description: Before her husband Aqiang came back carrying soy milk and fried dough stick pancakes, Yajing took out her phone and sent a WeChat message to her Guangzhou supplier Susan, asking whether 10 a.m. would be convenient for a video call to finalize the autumn new arrivals and the co-branded fabric. Susan quickly replied OK and sent the electronic catalog for the autumn new arrivals. Yajing replied with a smiley face and felt half relieved.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Couple's division of labor for breakfast and morning family time
description: Yajing plated the fruit she had washed the night before, while Aqiang set out the soy milk, fried dough sticks, and pancakes. The two set the table together in easy coordination and woke their sleepy daughter Xuanxuan. While eating breakfast, they briefly discussed the plan for the day: Yajing would have a video call with a supplier in the morning, and in the afternoon the family of three would pack for tomorrow's trip to Volcano Island. When their daughter heard they would be digging in the sand, she got so excited she nearly knocked over her soy milk; Yajing smiled and wiped it up with a napkin.
location: Home kitchen and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning parent-child walk in the park
description: After breakfast, Yajing suggested taking Xuanxuan to the park downstairs for a walk to help digestion. Wearing comfortable casual clothes and sneakers, she held Xuanxuan's hand and walked to Jiaxingyuan Park. On the park path, Yajing played chase with Xuanxuan and also briskly walked two laps herself. Pointing at the bougainvillea by the roadside, her daughter asked whether there would be this kind of flower at the seaside tomorrow. Yajing smiled and explained the common seaside plants to her. Half an hour later, the two walked home, slightly sweaty.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Browsing the autumn new arrivals catalog to prepare for product selection.
description: Her husband was watching the news in the study, and Xuanxuan was building with LEGO in the living room. Yajing carefully browsed the new fall catalog sent by her supplier Susan on her phone and cast it to the TV to enlarge the details. Combining the customer preference list she had organized the day before with seasonal characteristics, she noted in her notebook the points that might appeal to customers for the 15 styles she had selected—trench coats, knit tops, and skirts—and also sketched three knit tops, considering co-branded redesigns.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Discussing post-holiday arrangements with shop assistant Xiaomei
description: Before the video conference, Yajing took time to send a WeChat voice message to Xiaomei, the shop assistant, telling her about the goods she had checked in the morning. She said she would be busy after the holiday and that a batch of new styles would arrive around the 10th, so she asked Xiaomei to come to the store half an hour early to unpack and hang the new items together. She also sent photos of a few pieces she had her eye on for Xiaomei's opinion. Xiaomei quickly replied, praising Sister Jing's good taste, saying she also liked the khaki trench coat, and confirming she had remembered.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video meeting with supplier Susan to select goods.
description: At exactly ten o'clock, Yajing sat at her desk and connected to Susan's video call. They first chatted about amusing moments of taking care of kids during the holiday, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Once they got down to business, Yajing, no longer her easygoing self, was very professional and quick: she confirmed style by style the order quantities and size ratios for the 15 styles previously selected, and specifically emphasized that the first batch of goods absolutely had to arrive in full during the first week after the National Day holiday. Then the two focused on the poplin and jacquard fabrics for the co-branded collection. Susan admired Yajing's sketches and promised to send color swatches and fabric samples next week.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize orders and enter them into the system.
description: As soon as the video call ended, Yajing opened the store's backend management system. While recalling the meeting details, she re-entered and checked the order details for the 15 styles just confirmed, and generated a pre-order. Then she emailed Susan's assistant to confirm the shipping address for the fabric swatch cards and the preliminary intention for style revisions. After finishing, she closed her laptop and let out a long breath, feeling that most of the key work for the National Day holiday was done.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child baking: butter cookies
description: The sweet aroma of butter wafted from the kitchen. Yajing tied on a floral apron and had Xuanxuan put on her little gloves too. Yajing weighed out all the ingredients, while Xuanxuan used star and bear molds to press out cookies in various shapes. Mother and daughter put the baking tray into the oven together. When the butter cookies came out, the whole room was filled with fragrance. Yajing let Xuanxuan taste one first, and she squinted with satisfaction. The remaining cookies were packed into an airtight jar and labeled as snacks for tomorrow's trip.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Residential Community 82 Shanggu Street, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and parent-child movie learning
description: Lunch was a simple Minnan-style pork misua soup made by A Qiang, with cookies baked by Yajing as dessert. After the meal, the family of three snuggled on the sofa and watched an episode of a documentary about volcanoes and the ocean, as a warm-up for tomorrow's trip. Xuanxuan was absorbed and kept asking whether the volcano would erupt on them, making her parents laugh heartily.
location: The dining room and living room at home, the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family worked together to pack for tomorrow's trip to Volcano Island
description: The division of labor officially began. Aqiang was in charge of logistics: he went downstairs to check the car's tire pressure and fuel, and in the living room used screen casting to find and download offline maps of Volcano Island and popular hiking routes, confirmed the tickets and homestay QR codes, took screenshots, and sent them to the family group chat. Yajing was in charge of the main luggage: she took out a 24-inch suitcase and skillfully folded and packed quick-dry T-shirts, light jackets, sunscreen, sun hats, Xuanxuan's small bucket and shovel, as well as the cookies baked that morning and a bag of bottled water and snacks. Xuanxuan put her little water bottle, drawing book, and little donkey plush toy into her own small backpack and announced that she was ready, too.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Private relaxation and sharing on Moments
description: With packing done, Yajing returned to the bedroom. Remembering that the photos from yesterday's anniversary had not yet been posted on Moments, she picked two: one was the night view of Yundang Lake, and the other was Xuanxuan's smiling face as she ate cookies today. She added the caption: "A special day, a precious family; tomorrow, we continue on." After posting, she leaned against the headboard and browsed other bloggers' recommendations for niche knitwear brands this season on her phone, looking for outfit inspiration for the store's post-holiday new arrivals.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The family drove to Tesco supermarket
description: The check found that there was not enough milk and bread for tomorrow's breakfast at home, so Yajing decided the whole family would go to the supermarket together. Aqiang drove, while Yajing and Xuanxuan played rock-paper-scissors in the back seat. After about a five-minute drive, they arrived at the Tesco convenience store and parked in a temporary roadside space nearby.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (along the route from Shanggu Street to Xinhua Road)

name: Purchase travel food at the Tesco convenience store.
description: Xuanxuan sat in the shopping cart. Yajing skillfully picked out NFC juice she wanted to drink on the road tomorrow, a box of strawberries, and sandwich bread, while A Qiang went to grab a few packs of the seaweed snacks his daughter loved. At checkout, Xuanxuan grabbed another box of yogurt, and the family of three returned home fully loaded.
location: Tesco Convenience Store, No. 78 Xinhua Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove home and put away the items she had purchased.
description: Aqiang drove, and they arrived home 5 minutes later. Yajing sorted and put away the purchased items, placing the milk and strawberries in the fridge, and the cookies and bread in the snack bag. After parking, Aqiang also went upstairs to help.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a simple dinner
description: For dinner, they decided not to make anything complicated. Aqiang fried a few sunny-side-up eggs and boiled some frozen dumplings. Yajing washed some strawberries, brewed a pot of light tea, and added a plate of local cold mixed shredded kelp. The family of three sat at the table, eating and chatting about tomorrow's plans, relaxed and happy.
location: Home kitchen and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime parent-child games and putting the child to sleep.
description: After dinner, Xuanxuan pestered her father into playing Ludo in the living room, while Yajing sorted out tomorrow's clothes nearby. Around eight, Yajing gave Xuanxuan a bath and changed her into cute animal pajamas. Before bed, she picked up the picture book The Little Prince and read a chapter to Xuanxuan, softly saying they would go to a magical island with black-sand beaches and volcanic rocks, and letting Xuanxuan close her eyes to go on an adventure in her dreams. Xuanxuan obediently closed her eyes and fell asleep soon after.
location: Home at No. 128 South Hubin Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: living room and children's room.

name: Personal evening relaxation and travel check
description: Yajing first checked that the power bank, ID card, keys, and sunscreen spray needed for going out tomorrow were all in her tote bag. Then she put on a hydrating mask, leaned back on the bean bag sofa in the living room, played her usual R&B playlist on the Bluetooth speaker, picked up A Turn in the South and began to read, enjoying the rare tranquility of this holiday.
location: Master bedroom and living room at home in the residential compound, No. 82 Shanggu Street, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Saying goodnight and going to sleep.
description: Aqiang also finished work and walked into the bedroom. The two smiled at each other, chatted about tomorrow's weather and general itinerary. Aqiang said softly to get some rest early, and that he would drive tomorrow. Yajing responded with a warm smile and turned off the bedside lamp. The air was filled with a subtle joy and anticipation, and she soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and pre-departure check
description: Song Yajing woke up naturally and quietly got out of bed. She went to the kitchen first to boil some water, and checked the insulated bag that held the pre-chilled bottled water, fruit, and the butter cookies she had baked yesterday. Then she returned to the bedroom and softly woke the still sleepy-eyed Chen Zhiqiang and Chen Lexuan. The family of three washed up in tacit coordination. Song Yajing helped Chen Lexuan tie her pigtails, while Chen Zhiqiang loaded into the car the three backpacks they had packed last night (Song Yajing's large bag, Chen Zhiqiang's camera-and-drone bag, and Chen Lexuan's small backpack). A simple meal was laid out on the table: milk, whole-wheat bread spread with jam, and the cookies baked yesterday.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, home at No. 128 Hubin South Road

name: Simple meals and breakfast
description: The family sat around the dining table. While eating, Song Yajing reminded Chen Lexuan: "Remember to bring your hat and sunscreen later, or you'll get as dark as little charcoal." Chen Lexuan nodded obediently and, imitating Song Yajing with squinted eyes, said, "Mom is right." Chen Zhiqiang smiled and recorded a video with his phone, sent it to the family group chat, and received a series of like emojis from Song Yajing's mother.
location: Dining table at home, 128 Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Final check and departure
description: Song Yajing quickly checked each bag: in Chen Lexuan's small backpack, the water bottle, sand toys, and sun hat were all there; in her own handbag, the power bank, sunscreen spray, and wet wipes were all in place. Chen Zhiqiang was warming up the car in the garage. Song Yajing locked the door and led the bouncing Chen Lexuan downstairs. Before setting off, she sent a WeChat message to her mother in Quanzhou: "Mom, we're setting off now, don't worry!"
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, home underground garage.

name: Driving to Zhangzhou Volcanic Island
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove, Song Yajing sat in the passenger seat, and Chen Lexuan sat in the back holding her little water bottle. Once they got on the highway, Song Yajing brought up the playlist of children's songs Chen Lexuan loved. As the melody of "Little Jumping Frog" started, Chen Lexuan hummed along. The family chatted about everything from "One Hundred Thousand Whys" to volcanic eruptions. Song Yajing seized the moment: "In a little while, we'll see a model of a volcanic eruption at the museum, even cooler than a cartoon!" They made a brief 5-minute stop at a service area along the way, and Chen Lexuan happily ate a few butter cookies.
location: Starting from No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, drive via the Xiamen-Zhangzhou Bridge and arrive at the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area in Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Arrive at the scenic area, check into the B&B, and rest.
description: After arriving at the scenic area, the car drove smoothly into the parking lot of the reserved Muxi Homestay. Song Yajing got out of the car holding Chen Lexuan, who stared curiously at the landscape built from volcanic rocks in the courtyard. Song Yajing took her to the front desk to check in, while Chen Zhiqiang went to the trunk to bring in the luggage. After getting the room card, the family of three entered the clean and tidy guest room, and they could see the distant sea from the window. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang quickly unpacked their luggage. Song Yajing carefully applied sunscreen to Chen Lexuan and put her favorite pink sun hat on her, while Chen Zhiqiang also sprayed sunscreen spray on his own and Song Yajing’s arms.
location: Muxi Homestay, Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian

name: Visited the Volcano Island Geological Museum.
description: Song Yajing held Chen Lexuan's hand and walked to the museum (about a 5-minute walk). Inside, there were sharp-edged black columnar basalt specimens, and in the center was a huge dynamic model of a volcanic eruption. Chen Lexuan was completely awed, tugging Song Yajing's hand and asking nonstop: "Mommy, why do stones shoot out from under the ground? Are there dinosaurs?" Song Yajing crouched down, pointed at the model, and patiently explained, from plate tectonics to magma cooling. Although she didn't know much herself, Chen Lexuan listened with sparkling eyes. Chen Zhiqiang, carrying a camera, took photos endlessly—of Song Yajing, of his daughter, and of their silhouettes as they looked at the display boards head to head. The family stayed in the museum for nearly an hour and a half, and before leaving, Chen Lexuan also asked for an ore postcard.
location: Volcanic Island Geological Museum (Geoscience Museum) within the Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Rest and lunch in the scenic area
description: As they came out of the museum, the sunlight was just right. The family bought two large coconuts at a coconut stall nearby. Chen Zhiqiang inserted the straws and handed one to Chen Lexuan; the little girl drank with such delight that her eyebrows shot up. They walked to a bench under a big banyan tree and sat down. Song Yajing opened the insulated bag and took out the prepared lunch (sandwiches, fruit salad, braised chicken wings) and cookies. The family of three ate and chatted while Song Yajing often wiped Chen Lexuan's sweat, reapplied sunscreen, and fed her a piece of apple. After resting for nearly an hour, they continued on their way, fully satisfied.
location: The bench under the shade of a tree by the coconut stall outside the Geology Museum in the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area

name: Walk along the cliff trail and admire the sea-eroded landforms.
description: It was a bit hot in the afternoon, and the family walked slowly along the cliff trail. Ahead were black sand beaches and rugged sea-eroded landforms; waves crashed against basalt columns, sending up white spray. Song Yajing pointed out to Chen Lexuan a rock in the distance that looked like a 'big egg' and taught her what 'stones formed after a volcanic eruption' were. Chen Zhiqiang found an angle and flew the drone a few times, overlooking the coastline and filming a spectacular video. Chen Lexuan, meanwhile, picked up small stones of various shapes along the way, saying she wanted to bring them back to Xiamen to show her grandma.
location: Cliff trail in the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area

name: Return to the homestay for a lunch break and some rest.
description: When the sun was at its strongest, the family returned to the homestay. Chen Lexuan took off her shoes, lay down on the tatami, and opened the mineral booklet she had bought at the museum, drawing a blob of red magma in the margin with a crayon. Song Yajing leaned against the bed and dozed for 20 minutes, feeling much more refreshed. Chen Zhiqiang was on the terrace testing his drone and flew a short seaside shot. When Song Yajing woke up, she brewed a pot of tea, browsed her phone contacts, and saw the reminder Susan had sent last night about shipping samples after the holiday. She replied “Got it.” Then she opened WeChat Moments, selected a few landscape photos taken by Chen Zhiqiang and mother-daughter photos, and posted a nine-grid post with the caption “Looking for a volcano on Volcano Island.” She soon received likes and comments from Meiling and Wang Jia.
location: Tatami room in the Muxi Guesthouse within the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Family beach time
description: In the evening, when it had cooled down, the family changed into slippers, brought Chen Lexuan's sand toys, and went out again.
