On the black sand beach, stepping barefoot on the sand felt fine and slightly cool. Chen Lexuan squatted where the waves were crashing, using her small bucket and shovel to build castles and pick up seashells. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang sat side by side on the beach, watching the sunset gradually dye the sea a gentle golden orange. Chen Zhiqiang quietly recorded a video of Chen Lexuan singing and sent it to the family group chat, and Song Yajing's mother immediately replied with a rose. The sound of waves and laughter interwove throughout the entire evening.
location: Black sand beach inside the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area (designated safe area in the scenic zone)

name: Returning to the homestay, washing up, and checking email in the evening
description: When it got dark, the family returned to the homestay. Chen Zhiqiang first took Chen Lexuan to take a shower, while Song Yajing emptied the wet towels and sand from the backpack and packed up the clothes everyone had changed out of. She opened the email on her phone and found that designer Lin Yue had replied to her co-branding collaboration email at 18:10. The letter said she was very interested in the styles Song Yajing had proposed earlier and asked for details such as the first order quantity, transaction method, and target price. Song Yajing suddenly became excited, leaned against the sofa, and read it over and over. When Chen Zhiqiang came out with the clean and fragrant Chen Lexuan, she couldn't help holding up her phone to show him: "Look, Lin Yue replied to me! She said she's interested!" Chen Zhiqiang also said happily: "I told you you had good taste. Discuss it with her properly after the holiday."
location: Room at Muxi Homestay, Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Seafood dinner
description: The family of three changed into clean clothes and walked to the seafood stall recommended by the homestay. They ordered steamed squid, salt-and-pepper shrimp, garlic oysters, and a bowl of seaweed fish ball soup. Chen Lexuan wore her little bib, scooped up fish balls with her own spoon, and with sauce all over her mouth, kept saying, "Today I picked so, so many shells." Song Yajing wiped her mouth, while Chen Zhiqiang opened a bottle of beer and clinked glasses with Song Yajing. They chatted happily about the day's interesting moments and also briefly discussed how to reply to Lin Yue after the holiday. Song Yajing even jotted down her thoughts in her phone's memo app.
location: Fujian Province, Zhangzhou City, Zhangpu County, Qianting Town, about 200 meters outside the Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, "Sea View Food Stall"

name: Family parent-child time at the homestay.
description: Back at the homestay, Song Yajing ran a tub of warm water and gave Chen Lexuan a nice, comfortable bath. She played with bubbles at the edge of the tub while Song Yajing washed her hair. After the bath, she changed into pajamas, and Song Yajing held Chen Lexuan in her arms and read her a book brought from home, The Little Dinosaur Adventure. She leaned against Song Yajing's chest, her eyes slowly growing heavy. Just before falling asleep, she whispered, "Mom, today was the happiest day of my life." Song Yajing's heart melted. She kissed her forehead, and after she was sound asleep, gently turned off the main light, leaving only a nightlight on.
location: Room at Muxi Homestay, Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening couple conversation and discussion on co-branding ideas
description: After Chen Lexuan fell into a deep sleep, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang walked out to the terrace. The sea was quiet under the night sky, and a lighthouse light flashed in the distance. The two sat in rattan chairs, and Chen Zhiqiang handed Song Yajing a can of ice-cold beer. She pulled up Lin Yue's email again and analyzed it item by item with him: What's the minimum order quantity? What style of fabrics is she good at? If they collaborate, should the first batch include three tops? They took out their phones and shared their views. Song Yajing jotted down her thoughts and items to confirm in her memo app, then mentally planned how to coordinate with her colleague Susan next week. As they talked, the sea breeze grew cooler. Chen Zhiqiang put his hand on Song Yajing's shoulder and said softly, “Today was really nice.” Song Yajing leaned on his shoulder and replied, “Mm, really nice.”
location: Sea-view terrace of the Muxi Homestay guest room, Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Chen Zhiqiang went to wash up first. Song Yajing did a final check of the things they needed to bring for the return trip the next day, confirming that the insulated bags and backpacks were emptied and put back in place. She walked into the bedroom, where Chen Lexuan was already sleeping spread-eagled. Smiling, she tucked in her daughter's quilt. Song Yajing turned off the living room light, feeling the sound of the waves and the slightly salty air, and lay down on the pillow contentedly. She thought: Tomorrow I need to take Chen Lexuan to watch the sunrise again. With that expectation, she closed her eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Muxi Homestay guest bedroom, Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Qianting Town, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Got up in the early morning, washed up, and got ready.
description: Woke up in the unique sea breeze of the homestay, with sunlight streaming through the curtains. After getting up, I washed up quickly, changed into a light casual T-shirt and shorts, and walked to the window to enjoy the calm sea in the distance, feeling cheerful.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast at the homestay
description: The family went to the homestay restaurant for breakfast, which included rice porridge, egg pancakes, side dishes, and milk. My daughter Chen Lexuan was very happy to see the steamed sweet potatoes. While sipping milk, I browsed messages on my phone, confirmed that there were no urgent shop matters, and replied to my mother's good-morning WeChat message. During the meal, I discussed the itinerary with my husband Chen Zhiqiang and confirmed the beach shell picking that our daughter was looking forward to.
location: Restaurant, Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Pre-departure preparation and packing.
description: Returned to the room to check the backpack, put in sunscreen, drinking water, my daughter's plastic bucket and beach shovel, cookies, and wet wipes. My husband Chen Zhiqiang put the sun hat on our daughter, and I handed the room key to the homestay front desk.
location: Room and front desk, Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian Province

name: Beach four-person bike ride and salt field exploration
description: At the entrance of Volcano Island scenic area, we rented a four-person bicycle with a canopy. My husband and I pedaled on either side, and our daughter sat in the middle singing. After about 15 minutes of riding, we stopped at the low-tide salt pan area. My husband led our daughter over and used a small shovel to scoop up salt crystals for her to taste. She scrunched up her face at the saltiness, and the whole family burst out laughing. I took out my phone to capture the moment. Then the family took photos in front of an old fishing boat on the shore and walked along the beach for another half hour, picking up a few volcanic rocks.
location: Fujian Province, Zhangzhou City, Zhangpu County, Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, coastal trail and salt pan area

name: Returned to the guesthouse to shower and rest
description: Rode back to the guesthouse and took turns rinsing off the sand. Changed my daughter into dry clothes. I sat on the room's balcony and used my phone to reply to the shop assistant Xiaomei's greeting, telling her that I would discuss the display matters after returning to Xiamen tomorrow. At the same time, I replied to designer Lin Yue's email, thanked her for her interest, and said I would proactively contact her after the holiday for detailed communication. After handling work, I focused on being with my family.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch: trying the fresh fare at a small fisherman-run restaurant
description: Following the B&B owner's recommendation, they walked to a nearby small restaurant run by local fishermen. They ordered steamed grouper, boiled shrimp, and assorted small fish in soy sauce water. Their daughter loved the boiled shrimp, and her husband drank an ice-cold beer to refresh himself. The family ate to their hearts' content. When paying the bill, the owner gave them two tangerines.
location: Laozhang Seafood at Fisherman's Wharf near Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: After dinner, took a walk and ran into a regular customer.
description: After leaving the restaurant, we took a walk along the black reef beach to aid digestion. Passing by a snack stall, we ran into a regular customer, Vivian, and her boyfriend, and both sides greeted each other with surprise. Vivian enthusiastically recommended a good spot for picking seashells, and her boyfriend took a group photo for us. I bought freshly grilled squid strips and dried scallops as snacks.
location: Snack stall near the black reef beach in the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Picking up seashells on the beach after low tide.
description: We arrived at Lover's Bay Beach recommended by Vivian. In the afternoon, the tide went out, leaving a large stretch of sand exposed. My daughter excitedly used her little bucket and shovel to collect scallops, clam shells, and smooth obsidian. My husband helped her dig in the sand for small crabs, and I picked a few special shells to bring back to the store for decoration. The family played and built sandcastles on the beach until my daughter's little bucket was almost full, and then we left.
location: Lovers' Bay Beach, Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the homestay for a nap and tidy-up
description: After returning to the homestay, I first gave my daughter a thorough shower, changed her into pajamas, and let her rest. Then I showered and changed into loungewear. Seeing my husband scrolling through his phone on the balcony, I took a 20-minute nap to recover my energy. My husband went to the front desk to ask about tomorrow's checkout and the route back to Xiamen.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Purchased local dried seafood.
description: Walked to a Zhangzhou specialty shop near the homestay and picked up dried scallops, dried shrimp, dried seaweed, and fish floss. She bought two extra sets to give to Aunt Lin, who often looks after her daughter, and their neighbor Aunt Zhang. Her husband bought a shell wind chime for their daughter.
location: Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province (160 meters east of the south gate of Yeshi Haiyan Homestay) Zhangzhou specialty shop

name: Dinner: a light meal near the guesthouse.
description: At a small restaurant recommended by the homestay owner, we had seafood misua soup with rich toppings and fried vinegar pork. My daughter wasn't very hungry and only ate half a bowl, so I finished the rest. The whole family shared photos as we ate, and laughter filled the air.
location: A roadside food stall near the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Online English speaking class
description: My husband took our daughter to the homestay courtyard to look at the stars, while I put on headphones in the room and attended the third session of the Spoken English Crash Course Workshop, themed 'Asking for Directions and Emergency Help.' The course began with a 5-minute warm-up discussion. During the role-play segment, I teamed up with a participant from Anhui to complete a direction-asking simulation. After class, I spent ten minutes practicing the pronunciation of key sentence patterns in front of the mirror.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: After class, met up with family and went for a walk
description: After the class ended, she went to the courtyard and found the father and daughter looking at the stars. She held her daughter in her arms, and the family walked around the guesthouse to help digestion. Her daughter pointed at the Big Dipper, and her husband told star jokes.
location: Courtyard and surrounding area, Coconut City Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian Province

name: Help daughter take a bath and read bedtime stories
description: After returning to the room, I gave my tired daughter another shower and changed her into a clean nightgown. I lay down beside her and read aloud from The Sound of the Ocean. When I got to the part about the little seahorse in the deep sea looking for its mother, my daughter had already fallen asleep clutching the shell wind chime. I kissed her forehead and dimmed the light.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Couple's private review time
description: My husband made two cups of tea, and we sat on the balcony, sending photos and videos to the family group and the customer group while reviewing today's itinerary. My husband said our daughter had a great time, and I shared her progress in English class. We discussed tomorrow's return trip: check out at 9, take the Xiazhang Bridge back to Xiamen, and after arriving in Xiamen I'll stop by the shop first.
location: Terrace, Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian Province

name: Wash up and rest
description: After drinking tea, she brushed her teeth, did a simple evening skincare routine, and set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning. Lying down, she felt relaxed all over. Thinking the holiday was about to end, she felt both nostalgic and looking forward to work. After saying goodnight to her husband, she turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Room at Yeshi Haiyan Homestay (Zhangzhou Volcano Island Branch), No. 8 South Gate, Zhenhai Village, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Early morning checkout from the homestay and departure preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Song Yajing woke up in her room at Muxi Guesthouse on Volcano Island, savoring the lingering feeling of the holiday. She gently stretched her sore body, picked up her phone, and saw a message sent in the early hours by former colleague Zheng Kai. She immediately replied to thank him for making the introduction, and proactively added Chen Siyuan, an independent designer from Hangzhou, on WeChat, sending a brief self-introduction to express her interest in collaboration. She then began to tidy up the scattered clothes and belongings. At 7:20, her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan were woken up, and the family took turns washing up. Song Yajing finished packing the suitcase before breakfast, while Aqiang checked the drone equipment. At 7:45, the family enjoyed a simple breakfast in the guesthouse dining room, including white rice porridge, fried eggs, pickled vegetables, and homemade meat buns. During the meal, Song Yajing received a reply from Chen Siyuan: “OK, looking forward to talking,” which made her happy. After breakfast, she took her daughter to the front desk to check out, while Aqiang did a final check of the room to make sure nothing was left behind. Then the family prepared to head to the basalt platform.
location: Muxi Homestay, Volcano Island, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Drone family group photo shoot on the basalt tableland.
description: After checking out, the family of three drove about 13 minutes to the iconic black basalt platform of the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area. There were few tourists in the early morning, and the view was magnificent. Aqiang chose a spot and unfolded the drone. Song Yajing held her daughter's hand, and the daughter excitedly waved the long shell she had picked up yesterday. The drone lifted off, and Aqiang adjusted the composition through his phone screen, guiding the family to smile naturally, and took more than a dozen shots from different angles and heights, successfully capturing a satisfying family photo. During a break in shooting, Song Yajing bought her daughter a cup of freshly squeezed sugarcane juice from a stall in the parking lot. Finally, the family lingered briefly at the edge of the platform, feeling the sea breeze, bringing the trip to Volcano Island to a close.
location: Basalt platform, Volcanic Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Left Volcano Island and drove toward the expressway.
description: After taking the group photo, the family enjoyed the sea breeze one last time by the terrace, then got into the car and set off from the parking lot of the Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, officially starting the return trip. Aqiang drove smoothly along the coastal thoroughfare and merged onto the G15 Shenhai Expressway. Daughter Chen Lexuan sat in the car seat listening to a story and gradually fell asleep to the rhythm of the trip. Song Yajing sat in the front passenger seat, using this brief moment of calm to organize the travel photos on her phone.
location: Parking lot of Volcano Island Natural Ecological Scenic Area, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, to the entrance of G15 Shenhai Expressway

name: Work coordination and couple chat during the highway drive back
description: After entering the expressway, Chen Zhiqiang focused on driving, while Song Yajing sorted travel photos on her phone in the passenger seat. She took a screenshot of the reply from designer Chen Siyuan received that morning and sent it to the introducer, Zheng Kai, with thanks. Then she talked with her husband about this Hangzhou designer and discussed the possibility of developing a “New Chinese-style co-branded collection” in the future. A Qiang expressed support and offered some suggestions from the perspectives of community operations and offline activities. The two also planned the store’s work arrangements after the National Day holiday, completing efficient work communication during a relaxed drive.
location: G15 Shenhai Expressway, Zhangzhou section.

name: Stop at Tianfu Service Area to rest.
description: The car pulled into the Tianfu Service Area on the Zhangpu section of Zhangzhou for a rest, and their daughter happened to wake up. The family got out to use the restroom and stretch. There were many vehicles returning from the National Day holiday at the service area, so they queued to buy four-fruit soup and hot milk tea. Song Yajing used her phone to capture a shot of her daughter drinking milk tea and the distant service area sign, adding closing material for the travel video. A Qiang charged the electric car at the service area for a while to ensure ample range for the rest of the trip. After a short break, the family continued on the road.
location: Tianfu Service Area, G15 Shenhai Expressway, Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Smooth arrival at home in Xiamen after a congested return trip
description: After setting off again from the Tianfu Service Area, the highway began to get congested. Aqiang focused on driving, while Song Yajing briefly recorded her travel impressions in her phone's memo app. She also sent screenshots of her morning WeChat conversation with the designer to her close friends' group chat, with the caption, "Last day of the holiday, give me a big-project warm-up!" and received likes from the group. The car crossed the Xiazhang Bridge before evening and entered Xiamen, with a light drizzle beginning to fall. They finally arrived at Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District around 16:45, and the family was back in their familiar home.
location: From the G15 Shenhai Expressway via the Xiazhang Bridge to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home to unpack luggage and put items away.
description: After arriving home, A Qiang carried the luggage out of the trunk, while Song Yajing held an umbrella and hurried inside with her daughter. Once inside, she first changed her daughter into comfortable loungewear, then sorted the dirty clothes from the suitcase into the laundry hamper and put skincare products, chargers, and other daily necessities back in place. A Qiang took out the drone and camera bag, plugged in the devices to charge, and prepared to copy the footage to the computer. Xuanxuan, their daughter, sat on the living room sofa hugging a plush toy and watching TV, enjoying the relaxation of being home. Outside the window, a fine rain continued to fall, while the home was filled with the peace of returning to the nest.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shared a simple dinner after returning home.
description: Tired from the trip, the family did not feel like going out to eat. Aqiang searched the refrigerator and cooked a pot of frozen dumplings with the ingredients left before departure, and also made a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup. Song Yajing used the air fryer to heat up dried sweet potatoes and hairtail fish crisps brought back from Volcano Island as a snack. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting about little things from the trip, in a warm atmosphere. Song Yajing opened her phone and saw her college classmate Zhou Ting saying in the group chat, 'I'm taking the high-speed rail back to Xiamen tomorrow and officially starting my new working life in Xiamen.' She was sincerely happy for her friend and replied with a congratulatory emoji.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mother-daughter collaboration on editing a travel short video.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing and her daughter snuggled together on the living room sofa, opened a mobile video editing app, and imported all the footage shot over the past three days. She taught her daughter hands-on how to pick good clips; her daughter did the selecting and said, “This part can be cut,” while Song Yajing handled adding subtitles and choosing background music. Her daughter insisted on writing “Chen Lexuan’s Trip” in large font at the beginning of the video. When the short film was finished, the whole family previewed it on the living room TV. Seeing the warm scenes from the drone footage, A Qiang walked out of the kitchen carrying freshly cut pomelo, completely absorbed. Outside the window the rain had stopped, and the home was filled with laughter and warmth.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to sleep and late-night conversation between husband and wife.
description: After watching the short film, Song Yajing urged her daughter to take a bath and helped her change into pajamas. Before bed, her daughter insisted on hearing the story Little Bear and the Best Dad. Song Yajing sat beside the small bed and gently finished reading a chapter, watching as her daughter's eyelids grew heavier and she quickly fell asleep. After settling her daughter, she returned to the master bedroom, showered, applied a hydrating mask, and leaned against the headboard scrolling through her phone, again welcoming Zhou Ting back in the close friends' group chat. Then A Qiang lay down, gently held her hand, and seriously asked whether she had ever thought about giving Lexuan a little brother or sister. The two exchanged views on practical issues such as shop operations, energy allocation, and living space. Though they did not reach a clear conclusion, the expectation in A Qiang's eyes made Song Yajing feel a mixture of happiness and pressure. Eventually, they fell asleep in each other's arms in a tender silence.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and having breakfast with the family
description: Waking up early, she found that her husband Aqiang had covered her with a small blanket, and the smell of sweet potato porridge came from the kitchen. The family of three sat around the dining table. Aqiang had prepared sweet potato porridge, fried eggs, and pork floss, while their daughter Xuanxuan told kindergarten stories as she drank her porridge. Yajing announced today's Mid-Autumn Festival plan: group buying in the community in the morning, grandparents arriving in the afternoon, and watching the moon on the balcony in the evening.
location: Home dining room, Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Initiate a Mid-Autumn Festival group order in the community.
description: After breakfast, Yajing launched a group-buying event for the "Zhao Li Floral Art Co-branded Mooncake Gift Box" in the customer group on WeChat from the living room. First she sent a Mid-Autumn Festival red envelope to liven up the atmosphere, then introduced the gift box features: linen fabric shell with dried flowers, good-looking, and suitable for keeping or giving as gifts. When the group order reached 20 boxes, each box could save 30 yuan. She sent private messages to active regular customers such as Vivien, and the group responded enthusiastically, finally reaching the goal of 20 boxes. Yajing compiled the list, thanked the group members, and wished everyone a happy Mid-Autumn Festival.
location: Living room at home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child drawing and certificate awarding
description: After the group buy ended, Yajing took out crayons and colored paper and drew with her daughter Xuanxuan in the living room. Xuanxuan drew a simple portrait of someone wearing glasses, wrote Most Handsome Dad and many stars on it, and raised it high, announcing that she was giving Dad an award. Aqiang was moved as he took the drawing, carefully taped it to the most prominent spot on the refrigerator, and said it was the greatest award he had ever received. Yajing used her phone to capture this warm scene.
location: Living room at home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Try making snow skin mooncakes
description: Yajing put on an apron and ambitiously tried making snow skin mooncakes in the kitchen. She spread glutinous rice flour, rice flour, condensed milk and other ingredients across the counter. The batter was too watery and barely formed a dough; when filling, the filling leaked out, and the resulting mooncakes came out lopsided. Xuanxuan and Aqiang sat at the kitchen door watching, laughing nonstop. Despite the failure, Yajing still shaped all the ingredients into a few snow skin mooncakes in pastel colors and put them in the fridge to set.
location: Home kitchen at Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go out to check the store and buy ingredients
description: Yajing changed clothes and drove to the clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, checked the pre-holiday displays, tidied up the unevenly stacked clothes, confirmed inventory, and locked the door. She then walked to the convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station and, following her memo, bought baking ingredients such as cream, matcha powder, condensed milk, and glutinous rice flour, plus the jelly her daughter loved and nuts for her husband. At checkout she also grabbed a box of egg yolk pastries for her parents.
location: Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road

name: Lunch and Tasting the Failed Creations
description: After returning from shopping, the mooncakes in the fridge still had not fully set, so the family simply cooked some noodles for lunch. After the meal, Yajing cut open a few of the ugliest failed snow-skin mooncakes, and the whole family tasted them together. Xuanxuan took a bite and loudly praised her mom for making them delicious. Although the flavor was ordinary, the father and daughter's enthusiastic support made Yajing feel sweet inside.
location: Home dining room, Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidy up the house to welcome my parents.
description: After resting, Yajing began tidying up the house to prepare for her parents' visit. She folded the sofa blanket, wiped down the coffee table, and put away her daughter's building blocks; Aqiang cleaned the balcony rattan chairs and tea table, preparing for the evening moon viewing. The two also previewed the travel short film they had edited last night and confirmed it was all good.
location: Home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drove to pick up her parents and take them home.
description: Yajing drove alone to Xiamen North Railway Station to pick up her parents. Taking Chenggong Avenue, it was about a 35-minute drive. She parked in the underground garage and waited at the station exit. Soon she saw her father Song Minghui and mother Lin Xiuying approaching, carrying bags of all sizes. She stepped forward and took their luggage. Her mother had also brought taro paste cakes and fried vinegar pork from a time-honored Quanzhou brand. Yajing playfully scolded her but felt warm inside. Then she drove her parents home together.
location: Xiamen North Railway Station, No. 399 Hengsheng Road, Jimei District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the route to and from.

name: The whole family gathered and shared travel stories.
description: When they got home, as soon as her grandparents entered, Xuanxuan rushed over. After the grandparents hugged their granddaughter affectionately, they took out the taro paste cakes and fried vinegar pork they had brought. Everyone sat together in the living room; Yajing poured tea for her parents, and Aqiang used his tablet to show photos and drone videos from the trip to Volcanic Island. The grandparents beamed with joy and kept praising how cute their granddaughter was.
location: Living room at home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing the Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner.
description: After chatting, Yajing put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables and cut scallions. Her father Song Minghui took charge of cooking his signature Southern Fujian dishes: ginger duck, soy-sauce-braised seafood, and oyster omelet. The kitchen filled with the rich aroma of ginger, garlic, and soy sauce. The whole family squeezed together to work, chatting and laughing, full of festive atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen at Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner and sharing of the travel short video.
description: After the dishes were served, Yajing and A Qiang set the dining table, laying out nice napkins and arranging the bowls and chopsticks. A Qiang adjusted the screen casting to play the travel short film of Volcano Island. The reunion dinner officially began. The ginger duck made by her father was flavorful and tender, and the oyster omelet was widely praised. During the meal, the short film played, showing the family running on the beach and watching the sunset. Xuanxuan acted as narrator, telling the fun story of stepping on waves, which made everyone laugh heartily.
location: Home dining room and living room, Hongxiang Building, 258 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Cleaned up after the meal and shared the travel journal with the community.
description: After dinner, her parents played with Xuanxuan while Aqiang cleared the table. Yajing curled up on the sofa, edited and published a travelogue of the Volcano Island trip in the parenting group. The travelogue included a guide of about 500 characters, recommending a guesthouse, the geology museum, Lovers' Bay Beach, and more, along with photos and booking links. After it was published, several group members asked questions, and she answered them one by one. One mother said she would bring her child next week.
location: Living room at home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Viewing the moon on the balcony and having a warm family chat.
description: A full moon hung high in the night sky, and the whole family moved to the balcony to admire the moon. They set out a small tea table, and Yajing cut up her homemade snow-skin mooncakes and Dahongpao pomelo for everyone to taste. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, said with a smile that she hoped to hold a second grandchild next year, and Yajing responded vaguely. Xuanxuan then praised her mother's mooncakes as the best, and her innocent words made Yajing's eyes slightly red, her heart filled with her daughter's innocence.
location: Home balcony at Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Put her daughter to bed and replied to Zhou Ting's messages.
description: After moon watching, Yajing took Xuanxuan to wash up and told her a bedtime story, coaxing her daughter to sleep. Just as she left the children's room, her phone vibrated. Zhou Ting, a college classmate, sent a message in the three-person group chat saying she had completed her resignation procedures and her high-speed train was about to arrive at Xiamen Station. Yajing immediately replied with a welcome and suggested meeting up another day. She then called a Minnan-style private restaurant to book a table for the evening of October 11 and shared a location screenshot in the group chat.
location: Children's room and living room at home, Hongxiang Building, 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Record Mid-Autumn Festival reflections and share on Moments.
description: Leaning against the headboard, Yajing wrote in her phone memo her thoughts of the day: Xuanxuan said the broken-corner mooncakes taste the best, and Ah Qiang stuck the childlike certificate on the refrigerator. All these years of pursuing perfection almost made her miss real life. She added photos of the certificate on the refrigerator and the broken-corner mooncake and posted them on Moments, quickly earning dozens of likes and comments, with everyone praising her daughter for being heartwarming.
location: Master bedroom at home, Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and getting ready for bed.
description: Yajing washed up, took a warm shower to wash away her fatigue, and did a few stretching moves before bed to loosen her shoulders and neck. Lying in bed, moonlight streamed in through the sheer curtains. She felt calm and content and silently prayed, thanking the Lord for the warm Mid-Autumn Festival and asking Him to protect the whole family.
location: Master bedroom at home, Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After washing up, A Qiang lay down, took Yajing's hand, and softly said, "You've worked hard. Today was perfect." Yajing responded, and the two closed their eyes, listening to the occasional sound of fireworks outside the window, gradually drifting off to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Hongxiang Building, No. 258 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up in the morning, preparing breakfast, and checking on her daughter.
description: Woke up naturally at 7:30 a.m., feeling refreshed. She opened the curtains—it was a clear, beautiful day. She first went to check on her daughter Xuanxuan, who was still sound asleep with even breathing; her cough seemed much better. After a quick wash-up, she changed into comfortable home clothes. She made breakfast for the family using the Quanzhou zongzi her father had brought and the white porridge cooked last night. After heating the zongzi, she cut and divided them. Then she went to wake Xuanxuan, who coughed twice after waking up but was in good spirits and said she would dress herself. Yajing prepared warm water for her and planned to have her drink more later.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take my daughter to the park to play on the slide and buy yogurt on the way.
description: After breakfast, her husband Aqiang stayed home to deal with work emails. She packed Xuanxuan's water bottle and jacket, then drove her to Jiaxingyuan Park. The sunshine was just right, and Xuanxuan had a great time on the slide. She ran into Aunt Zhang, who was also out walking her grandson, and they naturally sat in the shade chatting. She brought out the meat rice dumplings she had brought and offered Aunt Zhang a taste. Aunt Zhang praised her cooking, shared some parenting tips, and recommended a Chinese medicine massage therapist, saying he was especially effective for children's coughs. They chatted so pleasantly that she didn't leave with Xuanxuan until almost 9:45. On the way home, she stopped by the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought Xuanxuan her favorite strawberry yogurt, and grabbed a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea for herself.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: At home, organizing co-branded design materials and warming up the community group.
description: After getting home, she let Xuanxuan read picture books and play with building blocks in the living room by herself. In the study, she opened her laptop, spread out the inspirational photos and sketches from the Volcano Island trip on the 5th, and carefully worked on the first draft of the co-branded collection. With the fountain pen she liked best, she quickly jotted down a few keywords in her notebook: earth tones, Minnan patterned tile motifs, loose silhouettes. Drawing on the chat records she had previously had with designer Chen Siyuan, she spent half an hour writing about a page of design sketch descriptions and style copy, ready for the first warm-up post in the community the next day. While working, she also sent a message in the best friends' 'Iron Triangle' group chat, inviting Li Meiling and Wang Jia to come to the store in the afternoon to see the family portrait if they were free. Li Meiling replied instantly that she could come, while Wang Jia said she could only watch online.
location: Home study, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare lunch and interact with daughter
description: After finishing her work, she quickly tidied the dining table and reheated the leftover Quanzhou rice dumplings for lunch. Xuanxuan, tired from playing, came over to cling to her, so while heating the food she told her stories from a picture book. The two of them had a simple but warm lunch, eating the rice dumplings and the leftover porridge from the morning.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Noon break and preparing to go out
description: After lunch, she urged Xuanxuan to take a nap. She lay on the bed and read two pages of a story to her, and in less than ten minutes Xuanxuan fell asleep. She gently closed the door, returned to her own room, changed into casual clothes for going out, put on a canvas tote bag, took her phone and keys, and got ready to go out and take care of a few things while Xuanxuan napped.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go out to pick up the family portrait and stop by the shop on the way to set up the photo wall.
description: Walking 15 minutes to the old-fashioned photo studio near home that has been open for over 20 years, the familiar smell of developing chemicals still in the air. After giving my name, the owner took out a brown paper envelope from behind the counter, containing the 12-inch family portrait taken on the 5th at Volcano Island. The photo used matte paper, with soft colors. In the picture, the family stands on a basalt terrace, smiling with complete ease. I felt this photo turned out really well—it was the most precious takeaway of the whole vacation. Then I walked to our own shop on Zhongshan Road. Today was the last day of the National Day holiday, and foot traffic on the pedestrian street had already eased. Only the shop assistant Xiaomei was on duty, tidying the shelves. I went straight to the iconic family photo wall in the store, replaced the old family portrait, carefully fitted the new photo into the frame, and hung it in the most prominent spot. The photo wall has recorded many moments since the store opened in 2020, and now it has one more perfect family portrait. I stepped back two paces and looked at it with satisfaction.
location: Her own store at 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out to buy sports equipment, afternoon tea, and honey lemon
description: Before leaving the store, thinking that Xiao Mei was working alone and it was tough, she went to the 85°C bakery on Zhongshan Road to buy herself an iced Americano, and also brought Xiao Mei her favorite egg tarts and a cup of sea salt green milk tea. Then she went to the Li-Ning store with a clear goal: to buy gear for the morning run plan starting tomorrow. With the staff's advice, she tried on several cushioned running shoes, walked a few laps on the store treadmill, and finally chose a pair of entry-level running shoes that felt most comfortable, plus two sets of breathable, quick-drying T-shirts and shorts. She felt both nervous and excited about tomorrow's first run. After checking out, she saw the Tesco Express convenience store next door, remembered Xuanxuan still had a slight cough, so she went in and bought a jar of raw honey and a few fresh lemons to make honey lemon water for her in the evening.
location: Li-Ning Store, 195 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned to the store to catch up with close friends, then walked home.
description: After finishing the shopping, I returned to my shop and handed the egg tarts and milk tea to Xiaomei. Just as I sat down to rest, my close friend Li Meiling arrived. She spotted the new family portrait hanging on the wall and kept saying it was a great photo. The two of us sat on the sofa in the shop, drinking and chatting. Song Yajing shared the embarrassing story of putting too much sugar in yesterday's mooncakes, the morning-running plan starting tomorrow, and her conflicted feelings about having a second child. Li Meiling listened with a smile and encouraged her: "Whatever you decide, I support you!" After chatting for half an hour, she felt warm inside. After resting enough, she said goodbye to Xiaomei and Li Meiling and walked home. On the way, the sun was no longer so harsh, and a gentle breeze was blowing.
location: Her own store at 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: At-home baking consultation and playing with daughter after her nap
description: Back at home, Xuanxuan was still asleep. Sitting on the living room sofa, she sent a WeChat message to her baking teacher, Master Chen, asking for advice on adjusting the recipe to make a low-sugar tiramisu, because she had used too much sugar in yesterday's mooncakes and wanted to improve this time. Master Chen replied quickly, suggesting replacing part of the sugar with a sugar substitute, and shared a few formula ratios that had worked in experiments. They chatted for about ten minutes, and she felt inspired. Xuanxuan woke up and came out to find her mother, still drowsy. She poured Xuanxuan a cup of warm honey lemon water, and Xuanxuan gulped it down. Seeing that she was in good spirits, she played two rounds of Ludo with her on the carpet, and together they read a dinosaur picture book her daughter had recently taken a liking to.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner and checking daughter's homework
description: After playing with Xuanxuan for a while, she got up and went to the kitchen to prepare dinner. Her husband Aqiang had said last night that he wanted to eat shacha noodles, and conveniently, her father had taught her the trick to simmering the shacha broth. She took out shrimp heads, dried scallops, and bones from the fridge, stir-fried them slowly over low heat until fragrant in the Minnan style, then added ready-made shacha sauce, peanut butter, and milk, and patiently simmered a rich pot of broth. The kitchen filled with a tempting aroma. While waiting for Aqiang to come home from work, she packed Xuanxuan's schoolbag for the first day of school tomorrow with her, putting in the pencil case, drawing book, and watercolor pens according to the class schedule, carefully checked her homework, confirmed it was all done, and praised her for writing her characters more neatly.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner for three and family time
description: Her husband Aqiang came home from work and smelled the aroma of satay noodles as soon as he entered, praising it repeatedly. She cooked the noodles fresh with shrimp, lean pork slices, and fried tofu puffs, then poured the steaming hot soup base over them. The family sat around the dining table, eating contentedly. After dinner, Aqiang did the dishes, while Song Yajing played with Xuanxuan with building blocks in the living room for a while, then gave her a bath.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting daughter to bed and late-night talk between husband and wife.
description: After taking a shower, she told Xuanxuan the story of "Goodnight Moon," and she fell asleep as she listened. Gently closing the door, she returned to the master bedroom. A Qiang had already showered and was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. Song Yajing lay down and started chatting with him. First they confirmed the next day's shop opening arrangements, then naturally moved on to the dinner gathering with Zhou Ting when she returns on October 11. She also brought up the second-child topic that her mother had mentioned yesterday, and asked him what he thought about it today, wanting to hear his true feelings. The two discussed it for a while. Though they still hadn't made a decision, the communication was candid, and she felt much more at ease.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening self-relaxation, trying on shoes, polishing work, and bedtime
description: After talking with her husband, she went to the living room floor and did 15 minutes of gentle yoga stretching to relax her legs, which had done a lot of walking today. Then she returned to the study, turned on the computer, read through the co-branded material files she had organized in the afternoon, corrected two awkwardly worded spots, and saved them to the corresponding folder for tomorrow. Next, she excitedly took out her new running shoes, walked back and forth across the living room several times to feel the fit, and silently planned the route for tomorrow morning's run in her mind. Finally, she took a hot shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, set the alarm on her phone for 6:30 tomorrow morning, and checked tomorrow's weather forecast — sunny, perfect for starting her morning running plan. She turned off the light with anticipation, lay down, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: First-day morning run plan launched
description: After the morning alarm went off twice, I finally dragged myself out of bed. I drank a large glass of warm water, put on my new running shoes and sportswear, and walked about 10 minutes to the Yundang Lake trail. A thin mist floated over the lake in the early morning, and the air was crisp. At a very slow pace, alternating walking and jogging, I completed about 2.5 kilometers of morning running and stopped twice to rest. After running, I stretched by the lake. I felt clearheaded and satisfied that I had stuck with it, and it injected energy into the day.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home for a shower and a nutritious breakfast
description: After finishing her morning run, she returned home, took a quick shower, and changed into comfortable casual clothes. For breakfast, she drank a glass of warm milk, ate two slices of whole wheat toast, and fried herself a sunny-side-up egg, replenishing the energy consumed by the morning run and getting ready for the day's work ahead.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Review the plan to prepare for opening the store
description: In the study, she checked today's to-do list and phone memos, confirmed that the community warm-up copy and video materials were all ready, then packed the store keys, a power bank, and her daily commuter bag. Before leaving, she sent a WeChat message to her husband A Qiang, reminding him to take their daughter Xuanxuan to school today, and telling him she would pick up the child after school.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walked to the shop and bought a drink on the way
description: Walked from home to the shop on Zhongshan Road. When passing the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, I bought a bottle of sugar-free oolong tea to stay alert for video editing in the afternoon. Along the way, I enjoyed the streetscape of Xiamen on the morning of the first working day after the National Day holiday, feeling relaxed.
location: Convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store preparations and starting work with Xiaomei
description: After arriving at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road, she first greeted the shop assistant Xiaomei and briefly exchanged the day's work priorities. Together they opened the windows for ventilation, wiped the shelves, tidied the clothes scattered from the previous day, and checked new styles for sizes, ensuring the store was in the best condition to welcome customers.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Morning community promotion and shop operations.
description: Sitting in the rest area behind the shop's cash register, she opened her phone and posted a carefully prepared presentation of the co-branded new Chinese-style women's clothing line in the core customer group "Yajing Lifestyle Club" (about 200 people). The content included hand-drawn sketches inspired by earth tones and Minnan patterned tile motifs, accompanied by a sincere message: "I want to design clothes with warmth for the women in our community." The group immediately became lively after the message was sent, and a dozen or more regular customers expressed strong interest. After 10:40, customers began coming into the store one after another. Song Yajing and Xiaomei warmly received customers and introduced the new autumn styles while using their phones to shoot in-store outfit demonstrations as daily promotional material. At the same time, the warm-up effect in the WeChat group continued to build, and five regular customers followed the instructions to add the WeChat Work account, expressing further interest.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Lunch and business follow-up
description: Seeing the flow of customers in the store ease a little, she called Xiaomei and went to the nearby Linjia Minnan Restaurant for lunch. They ordered ginger duck, oyster omelet, and two servings of sweet potato starch jelly, chatting while eating about the enthusiastic response from the community in the morning. While walking back to the store, she checked her phone and found that four regular customers had each paid 100 yuan as the “priority purchase deposit for the co-branded collection” as instructed, totaling 400 yuan. Song Yajing transferred the money into her mobile electronic ledger separately and made a note, feeling more confident. At the same time, she sent a voice message to Lin Yue, the designer assistant in Hangzhou, briefly describing how the community had responded that day.
location: Linjia Minnan Restaurant, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Editing the Volcano Island outfit vlog
description: In the afternoon, with few customers in the shop, Song Yajing sat behind the cash register and used her phone to edit outfit footage from the earlier trip to Volcanic Island. Using the CapCut app, she quickly edited it, added light music and text, and made a 1-minute-30-second short video titled "Save on Airfare, Travel with a Sense of Occasion." In the video, she wore two autumn casual women's outfits from her own shop and showed them on location at the seaside and the basalt terrace of Volcanic Island, with voiceover explaining layering techniques and fabric features, preparing it for promotion.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Published the video and saw a surge in group-buying orders.
description: After finishing the video edit, Song Yajing published it to the 'Yajing Life Studio' community and her Moments. The comments section immediately became lively, and in less than half an hour it generated interest in group buying for autumn outing outfits. She and Xiaomei promptly responded, replying to customer inquiries while sorting out the group-buy orders. Within just one hour, 18 groups of customers had placed orders, and the shop's online sales reached a small peak.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Peak-hour customer reception and packing shipments
description: The group-buying boom also drove in-store traffic, with customers constantly coming in to try on clothes. Song Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work: one received customers in the store, while the other packed the group-buy parcels generated in the morning and afternoon in the back storage room and contacted the SF Express courier to pick them up. They were extremely busy but inwardly happy about the store's performance.
location: No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yajing Boutique Clothing Store

name: Buy baking ingredients for tomorrow
description: After the busy period, customer traffic in the shop leveled off. Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the store and walked to the Xiashang Minxing Supermarket at Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Following the recipe she had looked up the night before, she bought sugar substitute, low-fat cream, ladyfingers, mascarpone cheese, and concentrated espresso, preparing to recreate a low-sugar tiramisu at home on the shop’s day off tomorrow.
location: Xia Shang Minxing Supermarket, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and rest for a while
description: Carrying the purchased baking ingredients, she walked back to her home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, sorted the ingredients, and put them in the refrigerator. She drank a large glass of lemon water, took off her work shoes, changed into comfortable house slippers, sat on the sofa for a while, replied to a few WeChat group messages, and took a short break.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up Xuanxuan from school
description: After a short rest, she changed clothes and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Xuanxuan was thrilled to see her mother, and along the way excitedly shared the new nursery rhyme she had learned in kindergarten. The mother and daughter chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Park outing and dinner preparation.
description: On the way home, she took Xuanxuan to play on the slide at Jiaxingyuan Park for twenty minutes, enjoying some parent-child time. After arriving home, she let Xuanxuan play with building blocks in the living room by herself. Song Yajing put on an apron and started preparing dinner ingredients: she blanched the frozen pork ribs, cut up potatoes and carrots, planning to make a simple potato-braised pork rib dish and stir-fry some greens to cook a healthy meal for the family.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park on Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner time
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family sat around the dining table for dinner. During the meal, Song Yajing shared how the community warm-up and group buying had taken off. A Qiang also told some funny stories from work, and Xuanxuan excitedly showed the “family portrait” she had drawn in kindergarten. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bonding and getting her to sleep
description: After dinner, Song Yajing played Ludo with Xuanxuan and read her two bedtime stories, The Rainbow Flower and The Very Hungry Caterpillar. At eight o'clock in the evening, she started washing Xuanxuan up and coaxed her into bed. After three minutes of whispered goodnight talk, her daughter fell asleep peacefully, and Song Yajing quietly turned off the light in the children's room.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal organization and inventory plan
description: After her daughter fell asleep, the time that belonged to Song Yajing herself began. She sat in the study and opened her baking notebook, carefully reviewing the steps and precautions for making low-sugar tiramisu the next day. She wrote out the ingredient list and stuck it on the refrigerator. Then she leaned back on the sofa and, one by one, replied on her phone to the messages in today's 'Yajing Lifestyle Studio' group that she had not been able to answer in time because she was busy packing during the day. She thanked everyone for their support and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gentle stretching and schedule confirmation
description: Unrolled a yoga mat in the living room and played a 10-minute full-body stretching video, focusing on relaxing her calves, shoulders, and neck that were still sore after the morning run, relieving the fatigue of standing all day. After stretching, she checked tomorrow's store closure arrangement on her phone calendar—she would try to recreate a low-sugar tiramisu at home, and planned to go to the vegetable market in the morning to buy some fruit, preparing for the new day.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening washing up, bedtime, and rest.
description: She took a comfortable hot shower, applied a hydrating sheet mask, blow-dried her hair, changed into cozy pajamas, and set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow. In bed, she browsed a fashion news app for a little while, looking at outfit inspiration for the new season. At 22:15 she turned off the lights on time. Her husband Aqiang was already lying down. Song Yajing softly said goodnight to him and fell asleep with a mixture of joy and fulfillment from the morning run and the group-buying results, having successfully switched from holiday mode to work mode.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and taking my daughter to school.
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off twice before she finally got up. The soreness in the front of her thighs and hips was obvious. Once out of bed, she used a hot towel in the bathroom for five minutes to soothe her muscles. When she left the bedroom at 7:15, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had just finished washing up, and her daughter Chen Lexuan was still lying in bed. Song Yajing quietly got dressed. Seeing the gloomy sky outside, she remembered there would be a shower in the afternoon, so she took a folding umbrella from the storage basket in the shoe cabinet and tucked it into her bag. Then she sat on the sofa for two minutes scrolling through her phone, confirming that last night's preview of the new product in the community group had received a good response. At 7:30, her husband had already helped their daughter wash up and was urging her to eat breakfast. She quickly tied her daughter's hair into a ponytail and helped her put on her backpack, and the family of three headed out. Chen Zhiqiang drove along Hubin South Road for about 10 minutes and arrived at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She squatted down, kissed her daughter on the cheek, watched her walk through the gate with the teacher, then waved goodbye to her husband.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking commute, volunteer decision, and store preparation
description: She walked from the kindergarten to the store, and the morning walk gradually loosened her sore thighs. Around 8 o'clock, at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she bought a hot Americano and a tuna rice ball, eating while walking and checking her phone. The church Bible reading group chat popped up a notification: the group leader was recruiting volunteers to visit Uncle Chen, a fellow church member who lives alone and had just been discharged from the hospital. Her first reaction was to reply that she couldn't attend, but then she remembered that her mother had been seriously ill at the beginning of the year and her father's hearing had declined. If one day her parents also lived alone and longed for someone to visit, she felt moved. After hesitating at the alley entrance, she deleted the refusal and replied that she could attend and would bring homemade cookies. When she arrived at the store at 8:30, the shop assistant Xiao Mei was wiping the display shelves. She changed into her work apron, poured a glass of warm water, and took out her notebook behind the cash register to handle store affairs.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Handle core store operations
description: In the morning, there were few customers in the shop, so Song Yajing focused on online matters. She opened the customer group and copied the list of four regular customers who had paid a 100-yuan deposit the day before, along with their notes, into the intention register. She then sent a private message to regular customer Lin Weian, thanking her for her support and giving a preview of the co-branded collection details. Next, she made a WeChat voice call to the assistant of Hangzhou designer Lin Yue to discuss the co-branded collection design draft, confirming revision directions such as adjusting the position of the decorative tile pattern and optimizing the neckline cut. In between, she also squeezed in replies to several customers' private inquiries about when the new autumn styles would arrive.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Midday handover and shopping errands
description: At noon, Song Yajing told Xiaomei that she needed to go out for shopping, asking Xiaomei to mind the store and arrange her own lunch. She picked up a reusable tote bag and left, walking to the nearby Xiashang Minxing Supermarket Zhongshan Road branch. Following the recipe saved on her phone, she moved between the shelves and precisely purchased cake flour, unsalted butter, fresh basil leaves, sea salt, and a small bag of cheese powder. In the fruit and vegetable section, she picked up the basil leaves and smelled them carefully, only putting them into the basket after confirming the leaves were fresh and fragrant. She thought to herself that Uncle Chen might have poor teeth, so the cookies would need to be crisp enough. After checking out, she carried the shopping bag and walked back to the store.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian (Xiashang Minxing Supermarket, Zhongshan Road Branch)

name: Return to the store for work and delegate tasks before leaving.
description: At 1:15 p.m., she returned to the shop and temporarily placed the baking ingredients in the corner by the cash register. As the afternoon customer flow gradually increased, she got into working mode, patiently recommending outfit combinations and answering questions for customers, while using spare moments to handwrite a few price tags and adjust the display positions of the new hanging garments to highlight the visual effect. By 2 p.m., she decided to leave early and go home to bake. She called Xiaomei over and carefully told her: call if there are any orders you can't handle or if customers need help with fitting, and remember to change the mannequin at the door into the newly arrived velvet dress before closing. After Xiaomei nodded and noted it down, she left carrying the baking ingredients.
location: No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Went home and baked cookies
description: After locking the shop, she got on the electric bike parked at the shop entrance and rode along Zhongshan Road, Zhenhai Road, and Hubin South Road, returning home at No. 128 Hubin South Road about 15 minutes later. She changed into loungewear, tied on an apron, preheated the oven, and followed the recipe: beat softened butter with sea salt, gradually add sifted cake flour, and finally mix in chopped basil and cheese powder. While kneading the dough, she remembered her mother teaching her to make pineapple cakes when she was young, and she hummed with a smile. After the dough was shaped, she cut it into evenly thick slices and baked them for 18 minutes, filling the house with the aroma of butter and basil. Once the cookies had cooled completely, she carefully packed them into four small transparent baking bags, tied each with a twine bow, and attached a handwritten card that read, "Peace in the Lord, respectfully prepared by Song Yajing." Looking at the neat little bags, she felt a long-lost sense of steadiness and satisfaction.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daughter returning home and family preparations
description: Just after she finished cleaning up the kitchen, the doorbell rang. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had picked up their daughter from school and came home. Chen Lexuan ran into the kitchen sniffing like a puppy as soon as she entered. Seeing the bag of cookies on the counter, she reached out to grab one. Song Yajing laughingly swatted her hand away and explained that this batch was for Uncle Chen, and that a few pieces had been left on the dining table. The daughter happily ran off to eat cookies. Song Yajing let her watch cartoons in the living room, then went back to the bedroom and lay down for fifteen minutes, browsing fashion news on her phone. Afterwards, she went to the kitchen, saw her husband already cutting vegetables to prepare dinner, and helped wash the greens and gave the kitchen a quick cleaning.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and parent-child time.
description: Dinner was the vegetable and egg noodles made by Chen Zhiqiang, simple and heartwarming. At the table, Song Yajing talked about the plan to visit Uncle Chen tomorrow, including the arrangement to meet at the church at 10 a.m. Her husband expressed support and asked how the store would be arranged. She explained that she had already told Xiaomei she would arrive late tomorrow morning and make up the time in the afternoon. The family chatted and laughed together. After clearing the dishes, her daughter pulled her to play Ludo, and then she read her two picture books, The Taste of the Moon and The New Things on Tooth Street. At 8 p.m. on the dot, she bathed her daughter, brushed her teeth, changed her into pajamas, and told her a story to lull her to sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Confirm tomorrow's visit arrangements.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom, picked up her phone, and contacted Wang Jianhua, the leader of the church scripture-reading group. Through a WeChat group voice call, she confirmed the next day's arrangements: meet at 10 a.m. at the entrance of Gulangyu Catholic Church, and the group leader would accompany her to Uncle Chen's home. The group leader reminded her that Uncle Chen had poor hearing and that she might need to speak louder when communicating. She saved the address in her phone map, then checked the cookie bag on the bedside cabinet to make sure the hemp cord was tied tightly.

participant.name: Wang Jianhua
participant.relation: Leader of the church Bible reading group.

location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal time review and relaxation.
description: At 9 p.m., Song Yajing put on a sheet mask and lay in bed picking up her phone. She opened the health app on her watch and saw that today's step count had already reached more than 9,000, which made up for the exercise she missed by not going for a morning run. Then she quickly reviewed the day: the community group orders were all handled, the co-branded design communication had made new progress, and the cookies had come out perfectly. She took a photo of the items she needed to bring to church tomorrow and posted a WeChat Moments entry visible only to herself: 'Today's little blessing: from hesitation to action, I took a small step.'
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and stretching before bed
description: After the mask had been on long enough, she went to the bathroom to wash it off and did a quick wash-up. Then she walked to the bedside and did a simple five-minute pre-sleep stretch to relax her calves, which were sore from walking for a long time today.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After changing into her pajamas and lying down in bed, she couldn't help looking again at the neatly arranged cookie bags on the nightstand, and a warm sense of accomplishment from having done something good welled up in her heart. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang turned off the light and lay down. She turned on her side and softly said goodnight, and her husband held her hand. She closed her eyes and savored today's brave decision. It turned out that caring for others wasn't as hard as she had imagined. She felt a little braver than yesterday and soon fell asleep.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning run
description: The early morning alarm rang. I changed into sportswear and went to Jiaxingyuan Park for a morning run, completing 2.5 kilometers smoothly. The morning breeze brushed my face, and the elderly exercising and neighbors walking their dogs in the park felt reassuring. After the run, I stretched my legs on a bench to cool down, then walked home.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning housework and breakfast
description: Back home, I took a shower and washed up, then changed into an off-white linen shirt and dark gray wide-leg pants. I took a Quanzhou rice dumpling from the fridge and heated it up, and made a cup of drip coffee for breakfast. While eating breakfast, I woke up my daughter Xuanxuan, helped her pack her schoolbag, and put in the nap mat, water bottle, and snacks. Xuanxuan said she needed to make a leaf collage today, and I promised to pick leaves with her after school.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Carrying a bedding bag and holding Xuanxuan's hand, she walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan chattered nonstop along the way. Only after watching her follow the teacher inside did she leave with peace of mind.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning store work
description: Walked from the kindergarten to the store on Zhongshan Road, passing the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and buying a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea. When she arrived at the store, store clerk Xiaomei was already cleaning. After checking the newly arrived packages, she began preparing for the remote video contract signing with Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai, setting up the phone stand and checking the network. At exactly nine o'clock, she connected with Zheng Kai on video and went through the co-branding contract item by item, including the initial order quantity, delivery time, payment milestones, and revenue-sharing ratio, then completed the signing through the e-signing platform. Afterwards, she paid the initial deposit via online banking and saved the electronic contract and payment screenshot to her work folder and cloud drive. Next, she dealt with leftover issues from yesterday's group-buying event, printed shipping labels, helped Xiaomei pack and ship orders, and replied one by one to customers' WeChat inquiries, confirming sizes and shipping times.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Going home preparations and lunch
description: Since she had a visiting task in the afternoon, she walked home ahead of time. Passing the flower beds in Jiaxingyuan Park, she wanted to find fresh mint but did not see any. After getting home, she took out the basil savory crackers baked last night from the cupboard and repackaged them with baking paper and a cloth bag; then she cut a few sprigs of mint from the balcony and wrapped them in kraft paper as a simple bouquet. At noon, she made braised beef shank misua with the beef shank Aqiang had braised last night, a simple lunch. While eating, she rehearsed the topics for the visit and wrote down the insight in her notebook: 'companionship itself is already language.' After the meal, she changed into a light blue cotton-linen dress and soft-soled flats, checked her hair and collar in the mirror, and brought an eco-friendly bag, a parasol, a bottle of water, and her notebook. Aqiang sent a WeChat message telling her to take it slow on the road.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Took a bus and ferry to Gulangyu Island.
description: Walked from home to the Hubin South Road bus stop, took bus No. 19 for about 20 minutes to Lundu Ferry Terminal Station, and on the way read a saved article on her phone about communicating with elderly people with aphasia. After getting off, she swiped her eTong card through the gate, boarded the ferry to Gulangyu, stood at the stern enjoying the view of Lujiang Road, feeling the sea breeze, and her nervousness gradually calmed down.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road bus stop to the ferry terminal, then take a boat to Sanqiutian Wharf, No. 199 Yanping Road.

name: Gulangyu Island Visit
description: After getting off the boat, she walked to the entrance of Gulangyu Catholic Church and met Sister Wang, the Bible reading group leader. She introduced Uncle Chen's situation and the precautions for the visit. Then they walked together through several quiet old alleys and arrived at Uncle Chen's home at No. 47 Huangyan Road. The old man was hard of hearing due to health reasons. At first, attempts at small talk didn't work well. At Sister Wang's cue, she noticed a Teresa Teng CD on the bookshelf, and after getting his permission, played the music. The old man relaxed, tapping his fingers lightly to the beat, and she quietly accompanied him through the entire disc. Before leaving, she gave him basil cookies and mint leaves, and the old man smiled and nodded. After the visit, she returned to the church alone, sat quietly on the last row of benches, and wrote her reflections in her diary: 'When Uncle Chen tapped along to the music, I didn't feel awkward at all. It turns out that quiet companionship itself is a language.' Then she briefly reported on the visit in the WeChat group.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the old leisure house at No. 47 Huangyan Road

name: Returning by boat and walking back to the store
