description: She walked from the church to Sanqiutian Pier and took the ferry back to Xiamen Island. After getting off the boat, she strolled slowly back to Zhongshan Road. Passing her favorite milk tea shop on Zhenhai Road, she rewarded herself with a cup of sea salt green milk tea. Carrying the milk tea, she returned to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store in a cheerful mood.
location: From Sanqiutian Pier, No. 199 Yanping Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, passing by the milk tea shop at No. 225-2 Zhongshan Road.

name: Afternoon shop work and confirming the gathering
description: Back at the shop, Xiaomei had already organized the afternoon orders. After checking the group-buying orders and shipping records, she confirmed everything was correct. She then worked out the details for tomorrow’s gathering with Zhou Ting and Liu Lei: first she confirmed the restaurant and time in the “Iron Triangle” WeChat group, then she separately contacted Liu Lei, who was coming from Quanzhou, to ask whether he needed help booking a hotel. He replied that he had already arranged it himself, so she sent the final time and location to the group.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and play at the park.
description: She left the shop early to pick up Xuanxuan from Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She saw her standing with the teacher, with a bedding bag at her feet. Holding her hand and carrying the bag, they walked back. When they passed Jiaxingyuan Park, Xuanxuan wanted to play on the slide, so she put the bedding bag on a bench, sat beside it, and watched her climb up and slide down like a happy little bird.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road

name: Returning home to do housework and prepare dinner
description: It was getting late, so she called Xuanxuan home. After arriving home, she stuffed her kindergarten bedding into the washing machine and started preparing dinner. Using the fresh tomatoes and beef brisket A Qiang bought yesterday, she made tomato brisket noodles: cut the brisket into pieces and blanch, stir-fry the tomatoes until the oil turns red, then add water and simmer. Meanwhile, A Qiang came home from work.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family dinner
description: The dinner was served — steaming hot tomato and beef brisket noodles. Xuanxuan ate until her little face turned red, saying it was delicious. At the table, she shared her feelings about visiting Uncle Chen that afternoon; Aqiang listened attentively and praised her. The family was full of warmth and laughter.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Playing with daughter and helping her fall asleep
description: After dinner, she played Ludo with Xuanxuan for a while, then read two of her favorite picture books. After reading, she helped her take a bath, change into pajamas, and coaxed her to sleep.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Personal time review and work check
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, she made a cup of tea in the study, opened her diary, and recorded in detail the insights from today's visit. Then she picked up her phone to confirm whether there were any changes to tomorrow's dinner with Zhou Ting and Liu Lei, and replied to some customers' late-night inquiries.
location: Study room at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family Time and Bedtime Stretching
description: A Qiang came out of the study. The two leaned against each other on the living room sofa and chatted, sharing the day's exhaustion and fulfillment. They talked about the next day's arrangements and the store's plans for the next quarter after National Day. Afterward, they did 10 minutes of bedtime stretches on the floor to relax.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: She put tomorrow morning’s running clothes by the bedside and hung the outfit she had matched for tomorrow’s gathering nearby to save time. Then she washed up, changed into pajamas, and felt tired but calm and fulfilled inside.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Couple's late-night talk and going to bed
description: Lying in bed in the dark, she and Aqiang talked again about the details of the afternoon visit. She said with feeling, “Real care is the time spent together, not the words spoken.” Aqiang held her hand in agreement. As they chatted, their voices gradually grew softer. She turned off the bedside lamp and had a good night’s sleep.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up and body stretching.
description: Early Saturday morning, sunlight streamed through the curtains. I woke up on time, stretched in bed first, then got up, drank a glass of warm water, and did 10 minutes of simple stretching to loosen my leg muscles, which were a bit tense from yesterday's morning run.
location: Master bedroom, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare breakfast and preview English lesson.
description: I quietly prepared breakfast for myself: I toasted the cranberry bagel I bought yesterday at the 85°C Bakery in Zhonghua City, paired it with fried eggs and avocado, and brewed a cup of pour-over coffee. While preparing and eating breakfast, I sat at the living room coffee table, opened my iPad, and quickly browsed the courseware for today's online English lesson on 'Shopping and Returns.' In my notes, I wrote down a few keywords related to my store, such as 'exchange policy' and 'fitting room,' and silently rehearsed the dialogue scenarios in my mind.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Household chores and communication with family.
description: After breakfast, I put the clothes I had changed out of last night into the washing machine. I walked to the balcony, watered the thriving mint plant, picked a leaf, crushed it, and smelled its fresh, cool fragrance. Then I sent my mom in Quanzhou a good-morning voice message on WeChat, telling her that I would be meeting classmates this evening to reassure her, and reminding her to add clothes tomorrow as the temperature drops.
location: Balcony and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online English speaking class
description: I put on my headphones on time, opened my tablet in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room, and joined the fourth online English speaking class. Today I was paired with a student from Guangdong to simulate the scenario of "handling an exchange for a friend at a clothing store." I had a sudden inspiration and wove a real case from last week, when a customer came to exchange an item, into the dialogue. The teacher commented that my expression was very natural and vivid. After class, I checked my pronunciation score and found it had improved by 5 points compared to last week. I was quite happy, feeling that this kind of professional scenario practice is very practical.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase breakfast ingredients.
description: During the free time after class, I hung up the clothes from the washing machine. Noticing that my daughter Xuanxuan's oatmeal for next week's breakfasts was almost gone, I went downstairs and strolled to the convenience store near the community at Zhenhai Road Metro Station. I bought a box of strawberries and blueberries, and also ordered a piece of butter and a bottle of whipping cream, thinking to myself that tomorrow morning I could try making a simple fruit tart as a breakfast surprise.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Shop management and customer reception
description: I changed into a comfortable off-white linen shirt and dark blue wide-leg pants and walked seven minutes from home to the store. After arriving, I first organized the routine weekend restocking with Xiaomei, my in-store assistant. We brought out a new batch of silk scarves from Hangzhou designer Lin Yue's studio and folded them into different shapes by color scheme and pattern, placing them on the display stand near the entrance. As I was adjusting them, Vivian, a regular customer, arrived as promised. As soon as she came in, she took a liking to a scarf decorated with ginkgo leaf patterns. I helped her try two ways of tying it—around the neck and on a handbag handle—and she loved it, buying three on the spot to give to her best friends as birthday gifts.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and work discussion
description: At lunchtime, there weren't many customers in the store. I first went to the 85°C bakery at Zhonghua City on Zhongshan Road and bought a large Caesar salad and two warm cream buns, took them back to the store, and sat in the rest area with Xiao Mei, eating and chatting. I also discussed with her the display plan for the newly arrived autumn clothes. After the meal, I asked Xiao Mei to take a nap, then sat behind the cash register and used my phone browser to read reviews and fee introductions of the merchant POS systems of the banks that Zhou Ting had mentioned on WeChat last night. I developed a preliminary preference for the electronic inventory management system.
location: Rest area inside Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 36 Stall, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling online store matters
description: After Xiaomei came back, I continued handling online matters. First, I sent today's order product photos and size sheets for Vivian via WeChat to the assistant at the studio of our collaborating Hangzhou designer Lin Yue, and confirmed the details and shipping time of the group-buy order with them. Then, in the store's VIP customer WeChat group, I shared a few styling photos of the real silk scarves that had just been displayed, along with a short voice message: "Ladies, the newly arrived scarves can be worn as neckerchiefs or tied onto bags — very autumnal feel~"
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home
description: At 3 p.m., I let Xiaomei watch the shop alone. I changed into comfortable flat shoes, walked back along Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, cut through two alleys, and returned to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street seven minutes later.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dressing up to prepare for the gathering.
description: Back home, I took a hot shower, changed into the newly bought white silk blouse and light khaki cropped trousers, and put on a light, natural makeup look. Looking at my energetic self in the mirror, I nodded with satisfaction. Before going out, I checked my small bag and made sure I had brought the power bank, lipstick, and the rosemary lemon hand cream I had made myself and planned to give to Zhou Ting.
location: Master bedroom and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying flowers and heading to the gathering restaurant
description: I took a taxi to the Minnan home-style restaurant on Daxue Road, Siming District. On the way, we passed a small, lovely flower shop. I asked the driver to wait a moment, got out, and picked out a bouquet of light purple forget-me-nots with a few white chamomile sprigs. I felt Zhou Ting would definitely like these gentle, vibrant flowers. I got back in the car, and 15 minutes later we arrived at the reserved restaurant.
location: Minnan Private Home Restaurant, No. 15 Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Welcome gathering for a classmate.
description: I arrived at the restaurant 15 minutes early and found Zhou Ting and Liu Lei already there. We hugged warmly, and I handed her the bouquet; Zhou Ting smiled with surprise and joy. We ordered classic Minnan dishes such as ginger duck, oysters in soy sauce broth, blanched shrimp, and oyster omelet, chatting as we ate. The conversation moved from Zhou Ting's hard work in Shenzhen's finance circle to Liu Lei's cultural and creative shop in Quanzhou, and then to our embarrassing moments of staying up late together to study for exams in college. Laughter never stopped. Zhao Min, a classmate far away in Hangzhou, also called by video right on time, and the four of us toasted across the screen, as if we were back in our student days.
location: Minnan Private Home Restaurant, No. 15 Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Financial discussion in the parking lot.
description: The gathering ended with everyone still wanting more, and we said goodbye in the parking lot. Liu Lei drove off first. I leaned against Zhou Ting's car and chatted with her for nearly another half hour. I took the opportunity to show her the simple cash flow records I had noted in my phone's memo app. This elite friend from the financial industry spotted the problem at a glance: "Yajing, the repayment periods of these two cash receipts are misaligned. There is an obvious gap between the cash flows on day four and day five, which will affect your short-term turnover." Based on my business model, she recommended two easy-to-use electronic inventory management systems suitable for small merchants. I listened very attentively, quickly jotted down a few keywords in my memo, and sincerely thanked her for her advice.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 15 Daxue Road, Minnan Private Home Cuisine Restaurant parking lot

name: Discussing store financial improvements with her husband
description: I took a taxi back to my home on Hubin South Road. My husband Aqiang was reading picture books with our daughter Xuanxuan on the sofa. After Aqiang coaxed Xuanxuan to sleep, I couldn't wait to sit on the living room sofa and told him in detail about the financial issues Zhou Ting had pointed out and the system she recommended. Aqiang comes from an IT background, and he had a detailed discussion with me from the perspectives of data security, system compatibility, and ease of use. We reached an agreement: we could pick a piece of software and run a one-month trial first, then see how it worked before deciding whether to use it long-term.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bed financial planning and going to sleep
description: Before bed, leaning against the headboard, I used my phone to look in detail at the features and user reviews of the two cash register systems Zhou Ting had recommended. In my phone memo, I solemnly wrote down tonight's reflections and a few to-dos for next week: '1. Contact Lin Xiaofeng, the customer manager at ICBC, to ask about the merchant version cashier system activation plan for the corporate account; 2. Confirm the replenishment list for next week with the assistant at Lin Yue Studio; 3. Make an appointment with Manager Lin to discuss the installation details.' I felt extremely fulfilled and full of drive for the store improvements in the coming days. Then I set my alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow, turned off the light, and fell asleep contentedly. Zhou Ting's return made me feel warm about reuniting with an old friend, and the half-hour financial guidance in the parking lot was worth far more than that meal. I felt that my little store had taken another big step forward.
location: Master bedroom, residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up in the morning, morning run, and breakfast.
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. After doing some light stretching in bed, Song Yajing knelt by the bedside for her morning prayer and made the sign of the cross for a smooth meeting with Chen Siyuan today. After washing up, she changed into her sportswear, drank a glass of warm water, and weighed herself (49.1 kg). She then walked five minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park near her home, jogged 2.5 kilometers along the park trail in about 25 minutes, stretched in the fitness area, and took photos of the blue sky and green trees to post on WeChat Moments with the caption: "Sunday morning, starting with sunshine and a run." After the run, she went home, took a quick shower, and changed into an off-white linen dress with pearl stud earrings. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already gotten up and was warming milk for their daughter Chen Lexuan. Song Yajing toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread, spread homemade mulberry jam on them, and ate quickly. She reminded her husband to take good care of their daughter and got ready to pick up the designer.
location: Home at 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road, Siming District

name: Went to Gulangyu Island to attend Sunday Mass and returned.
description: At 9:20, Song Yajing rode her e-bike for 5 minutes to Xiamen Ferry Terminal and took the 9:30 ferry to Gulangyu. On the ferry, she looked at the sea and prayed silently, hoping the afternoon negotiation would go smoothly and her family would be well. After arriving at Gulangyu, she walked to the Catholic church, took her seat at 9:55, and attended Sunday Mass, listening devoutly and singing hymns, feeling peaceful inside. After Mass, she briefly greeted fellow churchgoer Aunt Lin, then hurried to the pier and boarded the 10:45 ferry back to Xiamen Island. After landing, she rode her e-bike home. When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was playing with building blocks with their daughter in the living room. Song Yajing kissed her daughter, took the basil savory crackers out of the fridge and put them in a jar, and after confirming that her husband would handle lunch on his own, she put on her backpack and got ready to go out.
location: Xiamen Ferry Terminal, No. 15 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province; Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District; Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District

name: Meeting, lunch, and cooperation discussion with designer Chen Siyuan
description: At 11:15, Song Yajing rode her e-bike for about 10 minutes to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (No. 56 Zhongshan Road) and parked it in the back alley. When she arrived, the clerk Xiaomei had already done a simple cleaning. The two adjusted the mannequin at the entrance, changing it into an autumn outfit of an oat-colored cardigan and khaki wide-leg pants, wiped the office coffee table clean, brewed jasmine tea, and placed basil savory crackers on it. At 12:00, she greeted Chen Siyuan at the shop entrance. After warm greetings, she took her to soak up the vibrant atmosphere of Zhongshan Road, and they walked to Jinxi Shacha Noodle Shop for lunch, chatting about Xiamen's slow life and local women's spending habits. At 13:15, they returned to the office behind the shop for an in-depth discussion, with Xiaomei occasionally coming in to add tea. Song Yajing explained her idea of combining earth tones with Minnan patterned tile elements, while Chen Siyuan showed design sketches. The two reached consensus on the design direction, the first batch of 8 styles, and the retail price range, in a warm and cordial atmosphere. At 14:50, Song Yajing received a call from her husband and learned that her daughter had a fever, so she ended the discussion.
location: Clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road and Jinxi Satay Noodle Restaurant at No. 105 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rushed home because daughter had a fever
description: While the discussion was underway, at 14:50 Song Yajing received a call from her husband Chen Zhiqiang and learned that her daughter Chen Lexuan had suddenly developed a low-grade fever of 38 degrees and was not in good spirits. She immediately apologized and explained to Chen Siyuan, who said he understood and suggested they continue the discussion online in the evening. After instructing Xiaomei to look after the designer, Song Yajing quickly ran to the roadside, hailed a taxi, got in at 15:00, and arrived home at 15:35.
location: En route from No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District

name: Cared for her daughter with a fever at home.
description: After arriving home at 15:35, their daughter was crying and saying she felt awful, her little face flushed. Song Yajing took the child in her arms sympathetically, and with her husband measured her temperature again (38.5°C), applied a fever-reducing patch, and gave children's fever medicine. She walked back and forth in the living room cradling her daughter and soothing her softly. Half an hour later the medicine took effect, her temperature gradually dropped, and her daughter fell into a deep sleep in her arms. After gently laying her daughter on the bed, Song Yajing sat on the sofa to rest briefly, drank some water, and sent Xiaomei a message to confirm that Siyuan had returned to the hotel. She then sent Siyuan a WeChat message suggesting a video call at 8 pm, and got a positive reply.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Preparing dinner, a family meal, and evening companionship and bedtime soothing
description: After sleeping for a little over an hour, her daughter woke up in better spirits and clamored that she was hungry. At 16:30, Song Yajing went to the kitchen to cook porridge with greens and lean pork, and stir-fried two light home-style dishes. Her husband set up their daughter's small dining table. The family of three sat around the table. The daughter finished most of a bowl of porridge, and Song Yajing fed her steamed sweet potato. During dinner, she briefly told her husband about the afternoon's cooperation progress. After the meal, she accompanied her daughter in the living room watching cartoons and playing Ludo. After 8 p.m., her husband bathed and washed their daughter, and Song Yajing coaxed her to sleep by reading a picture book about little animals visiting the doctor, and the daughter gradually fell asleep.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Had a video call with designer Chen Siyuan and signed a preliminary cooperation agreement
description: After her daughter fell asleep, at 20:00 Song Yajing started a WeChat video call with Chen Siyuan as scheduled. The two efficiently sorted out and finalized the direction of the joint collaboration: earth-tone colors, Minnan floral tile elements, an initial batch of 8 styles, and a mid-range, affordable retail price. Chen Siyuan said that strolling through Zhongshan Road in the afternoon gave her a better understanding of the community's character. Chen Siyuan then sent a letter of intent through an electronic platform, and Song Yajing read it carefully and signed it with an electronic signature.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video calling her husband to discuss cooperation progress.
description: Right after finishing a call with Chen Siyuan, her husband Chen Zhiqiang video-called from the company. Song Yajing told her husband the news that the collaboration had been reached and read out the key terms of the letter of intent. Her husband expressed support but cautiously reminded her that the collaboration's inventory purchase and initial investment might require tapping into the fixed deposit. Song Yajing agreed, and they arranged to go over the project and family finances in detail together when her husband came home the next day.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal wrap-up: organizing records and making plans for tomorrow.
description: After hanging up the video call at 21:00, Song Yajing opened the memo app on her phone and recorded the key points of today's discussion and tomorrow's to-do list: contact Manager Lin at ICBC to inquire about the merchant cashier system; confirm the restock list with Lin Yue Studio; go to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City to buy bread; and schedule Manager Lin from the bank to come to the shop for a face-to-face meeting. After recording, she felt at ease. She walked to the bedroom, glanced at her sleeping daughter, and gently kissed her forehead.
location: At home, in front of the dressing table in the study and in the bedroom, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bed stretching, prayer, and bedtime.
description: At 21:45, Song Yajing changed into her pajamas and did some simple stretching to relax. Then she knelt by the bed, made the sign of the cross, and offered a bedtime prayer for the smooth communication today, her daughter's recovery, and her family's safety. Afterward, she turned off the light, lay down, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Main bedroom at home, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning home life and caring for daughter
description: After getting up early in the morning, she first took the temperature of her daughter Chen Lexuan, who had a slight fever (37.9). Since it was raining outside, she completed a 20-minute strength training session in the living room following Keep. Afterward, she prepared millet porridge for her daughter, fed her, and called the kindergarten to ask for leave. During this time, she also contacted Manager Lin of ICBC to schedule an afternoon meeting and handled messages in the work WeChat group. She then worked from home sorting through sales data, went to the balcony to pick mint and brew tea, and sent a good-morning red envelope in the store's VIP group announcing the upcoming upgrade. After her daughter's fever went down, she played with her and finished household chores such as laundry and cleaning.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Purchased supplies on the way to the store and arrived.
description: After settling my daughter, I rode my electric bike out. First I went to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City to buy a sea salt green milk tea and cheese bread for lunch, then cycled along Zhongshan Road to Yajing Life Gallery, locked my bike, and entered the store.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Midday work and study at the shop
description: After arriving at Yajing Life Gallery, she communicated with Xiaomei about the morning business situation. Xiaomei proposed using her 10,000 yuan savings to invest in the co-branded project. During lunch, the two discussed input costs, expected profits, etc. in detail and reached a verbal investment agreement. After the meal, classmate Zhou Ting connected via video call to remotely guide the download and installation of the inventory management app and the creation of product categories.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Going to the bank to discuss the cash register system
description: Leaving the store, she cycled to the ICBC Xiamen Hubin South Sub-branch, talked to Manager Lin about different cash register solutions, compared the pros, cons, and costs of the all-in-one barcode scanner and the touchscreen, and finally chose the basic barcode scanner package and booked an installation appointment for Wednesday.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Hubin South Sub-branch), 94-104 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store to continue work and the afternoon business
description: After returning to the store from the bank, following Zhou Ting's guidance, she entered inventory such as silk scarves and knit tops into the inventory management app. In the afternoon, regular customer Vivian brought a friend to try on autumn trench coats; she warmly received them and offered styling advice, using the app to record sales in between.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Close the shop and go home.
description: After closing, checked the day's revenue with Xiaomei (1870 yuan in total) and entered it into the app, tidied up the store and locked up, rode the electric bike home, and bought groceries at the entrance of the community on the way.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: After returning home, she reunited with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan and had an affectionate interaction with her daughter. Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared dinner. At the dinner table, she shared the day’s progress on Xiaomei’s equity investment, the bank meeting, and digital management. Her husband listened attentively and raised the issue of data security.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family financial review meeting.
description: With her husband in the study, they calculated the start-up funds for the co-branded project (about 45,000 yuan). After evaluation, they deemed it to be about 15% of the family safety fund, with controllable risk, and decided to transfer this amount from bank time deposits.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tried out the inventory management app to record transactions.
description: In the study, she entered all of the day's store sales and purchase data into the inventory management app on the computer, experienced the convenience of automatic inventory and balance synchronization, and decided to run a trial starting the next day, in parallel with manual bookkeeping for one week.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Spending time with daughter and getting ready for bed
description: Read picture books with my daughter, helped her wash up, played the game “Guess Who I Am” together, and after confirming her fever had completely gone, settled her into bed.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening review and personal time
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she made tea in the study and double-checked the day's transaction records in the app, enjoying the sense of security brought by digital management. She then recorded the day's reflections in her diary, feeling fulfilled and empowered.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Finished 10 minutes of pre-bed stretching, chatted with her husband leaning against the headboard and settled that he would draft the electronic agreement for Xiaomei's equity investment over the weekend, reviewed the busy and fulfilling day, turned off the lights and went to bed.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations, morning run, and breakfast.
description: She got up while her daughter Chen Lexuan was still asleep, and first went to check on her to make sure her fever had gone down and she was doing well. After drinking a glass of warm water and eating a banana, she changed into sportswear and jogged from home to Jiaxingyuan Park, ran three laps along the trail for a total of 3 kilometers, and did five minutes of stretching by a bench in the park. After the run, she returned home, took a quick shower, and changed into home clothes. She boiled two free-range eggs, toasted whole wheat bread, and made hot milk for breakfast, while replying to customer inquiries on the shop's WeChat.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Building 1, Room 302; Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Bailu Road, Jiaxing Garden Park

name: Taking her daughter to school and heading to the store
description: Woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and helped her get dressed, then walked hand in hand to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she listened to her daughter talk about the cartoon she watched yesterday. After dropping her off, she continued walking to the store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The street was still quiet in the morning. As she passed 85°C, she decided on her lunch treat plan.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning shop work: preparation, financial handling, and organizing agreements
description: After arriving at the store, she opened the windows for ventilation and turned on the air purifier. When staff member Xiao Mei arrived at 8:30, they tidied the shelves together and displayed the newly arrived autumn items. She also told Xiao Mei that she would go out in the afternoon to meet a close friend. After that, she logged into mobile banking and transferred about 30,000 yuan, 15% of the family protection fund, to the store's corporate account. She processed the 10,000 yuan investment Xiao Mei transferred, marking it in the electronic ledger as 'Crowdfunding Project - Xiao Mei's Equity.' Then she turned on the computer and, based on the consensus with designers Chen Siyuan and Zheng Kai, drafted the 'Draft Joint Design Cooperation Agreement,' verifying core terms such as design categories, initial order quantities, and revenue-sharing ratios. She printed four copies and put them in a folder for signing tomorrow.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Customer reception and store operations.
description: In the morning, customer traffic gradually picked up. She received a customer looking for workwear and helped her put together an outfit with an oat-colored wool blazer and off-white wide-leg trousers. The customer was very satisfied. Xiaomei also successfully sold a new knitted scarf.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Taking advantage of the lunch break, she went to the familiar satay noodle shop and ordered satay noodles with tofu, squid, and vegetables, asking the owner to put less peanut butter. While eating, she thought the morning run had been effective. After returning to the store, she used her lunch break to organize the photos on her phone, turned the earlier Volcano Island photos into an electronic album, and sent it to her bestie Li Meiling via WeChat with a note inviting her to look at the Volcano Island memories.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, 118-1 South Siming Road, Xiamen Satay Noodles (Zhongshan Road branch); Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Afternoon tea with best friend and the round trip.
description: She put on a newly listed khaki trench coat, tidied herself up, and walked from the store to the milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. At Mixiang Licha, she and Li Meiling each ordered a cup of the signature fruit tea, and she excitedly showed her photos of Volcano Island and talked about her daughter's fun chasing waves on the beach. After Li Meiling complained about the school inspection, she recommended an independent accessories designer from Guangzhou, Vivian, and Song Yajing quickly noted down her WeChat. After afternoon tea, walking back to the store, she recalled how frail Uncle Chen had been when she visited him and her mother's hospitalization earlier this year. Her heart tightened, and she immediately called the physical examination center of Xiamen First Hospital to book a comprehensive checkup for the morning of October 22. After receiving the confirmation text, she screenshotted it and sent it to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, telling him the checkup was booked.
location: 'Mixiang Tea', No. 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Stall 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store work and online learning.
description: After returning to the store, she and Xiaomei processed two online orders and entered Vivian's contact information into the store's supplier address book. Then she opened the inventory management app installed yesterday and tried entering a few of the day's transactions; it went much more smoothly than yesterday.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Pick up daughter from school and shop on the way
description: After telling Xiao Mei in advance, she walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and bought her daughter a cotton candy at the gate. After picking up Chen Lexuan, she stopped by the stationery store on Park South Road and bought her a new box of watercolor pens, then took her daughter back to the store.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Stationery Store, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Spending the evening with my daughter: in-store handover and dinner
description: Back at the shop, Xiaomei was about to get off work. After a brief handover, she let her daughter watch PAW Patrol on an iPad in the rest area while she continued checking the day's accounts. When there weren't many customers, she closed the shop early and took her daughter to the Shaxian Snack restaurant downstairs for dinner. She ordered her daughter's favorite steamed dumplings and wontons, and a bowl of noodles with greens for herself. She also packed a portion of steamed dumplings for her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who might not have eaten dinner yet.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Haojiyuan Shaxian Snacks, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family activity: going home and parent-child time.
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had just arrived from work, and she handed him the takeaway steamed dumplings. She first helped her daughter take a bath and change into pajamas, then played a 20-minute 'little doctor' role-playing game with her in the living room, with her daughter playing the doctor using a stethoscope. After that, she told her two stories from the 'Different Carmela' series to lull her to sleep. After closing the door, she went to the living room and talked with her husband about the afternoon gathering with her girlfriends, and showed him the WeChat contact of the new designer she had added. Her husband also supported the decision to book the physical exam.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Nighttime personal review and going to bed
description: Lying in bed, she opened the Health app to review the week's exercise: ran 4 times on October 8, 10, 12, and 14, totaling 11 kilometers. When she stepped on the scale, the number hadn't changed, but her energy was much better. In the diary app, she wrote about feeling grounded because she could stick with running and the collaboration had been finalized, and decided to run at least 3 times next week. She put the Draft Co-branding Agreement to take tomorrow into a document folder and placed it in the backpack at the entrance, set the alarm, then turned off the light and prepared to sleep, ending a busy and fulfilling day.
location: Room 302, Building 1, No. 82 Residential Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning run and breakfast preparation
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning, changed into workout clothes, jogged through Shanggu Street to Jiaxingyuan Park, and ran an easy 3 kilometers along the park track, finishing in about 23 minutes. Then I stretched on a bench, enjoying the autumn sunshine and breeze. After the run, I walked home, took a quick shower, and changed into an off-white linen shirt and dark casual pants. In the kitchen, I prepared breakfast: coffee and whole-wheat toast for myself, and warmed milk and sliced kiwi for my daughter.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park on Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten.
description: At 7:40, she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan on time, helped her get dressed, and tied two braids. The mother and daughter had breakfast together at the table, then walked hand in hand for 8 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and watched as her daughter greeted the teacher and walked into the school gate.
location: From No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road

name: Store opening preparation and contract review
description: After a 10-minute walk from the kindergarten to the Yaji clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she bought a tea egg at a breakfast stall at the alley entrance on the way. When she arrived, she opened the rolling shutter door and turned on the lights, wiped the counter and tables, and turned on the computer and speakers to play soft music. After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, the two took out the formal agreement prepared yesterday and spent half an hour turning the lounge area at the back of the store into a simple "signing corner," decorated with dried flowers and exquisite notebooks. Then Song Yajing and Xiaomei checked the key figures in the agreement item by item again, and after confirming they were correct, Song Yajing opened the mobile banking app and confirmed that Xiaomei's 10,000 yuan investment had arrived.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Signing ceremony and fund verification
description: At 10:00, Hangzhou independent designer Chen Siyuan arrived at the store as scheduled. Song Yajing brewed him a cup of Tieguanyin tea. The three of them solemnly signed the co-branding agreement and equity investment agreement at the signing corner and affixed their seals. Xiaomei took a group photo with her phone. After signing, Song Yajing and Xiaomei immediately checked the startup funds, confirming that the 30,000 yuan withdrawn from the family fixed deposit and the store's own working capital had been allocated. Then, in the inventory management app, they set up sub-accounts for the "Co-branded New Chinese-style Women's Wear Project" and clearly recorded the three startup fund transactions.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post the co-branding preview and welcome customers.
description: Once the funds were confirmed, Song Yajing and Xiaomei selected the contract-signing photo and two close-ups of design sketch details. Song Yajing wrote the brand-upgrade copy announcing the November offline appreciation event. The content was simultaneously posted on the store's WeChat official account, her personal Moments, and the core customer WeChat group. After posting, there were immediately several congratulatory messages in the group; a few regular customers came to the store upon hearing the news to show support and curiously asked about the co-branding details. Song Yajing warmly received them and introduced the design concept. During this period, three customers made intention-to-purchase reservations in the group.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch
description: After the lunch rush, Xiaomei went to the 85°C next door and bought two sandwiches and drinks. Song Yajing quickly finished her lunch in the shop's rest area, while not forgetting to reply to private messages from several customers and setting a reminder in her phone calendar for the physical exam on October 22.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, rest area of the 'Yaji' clothing store

name: Contact Lin Wei to discuss illustration collaboration
description: Taking advantage of the relatively quiet midday time, Song Yajing thought of her elementary school classmate Liu Fang (pen name Lin Wei). After sending a WeChat greeting, she expressed her idea of sharing Liu Fang's floral watercolor paintings in the customer community, and tentatively asked about the possibility of a future joint design collaboration. Lin Wei readily agreed and immediately sent several high-resolution original images.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Completed the electronic contract signing with Zheng Kai.
description: After receiving Lin Wei's reply, Song Yajing immediately logged into the electronic signature platform on her computer and completed the final electronic signing with Zheng Kai, her former Hangzhou colleague and independent designer. She carefully checked the contract terms, clicked 'Sign' after confirming everything was correct, and then paid Zheng Kai the initial deposit from the store's corporate account.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact accessory designer Vivian
description: After handling Zheng Kai's signing, Song Yajing found the contact information of Vivian, the Guangzhou accessory designer recommended by Li Meiling yesterday, sent a friend request, and left a message introducing herself and her store, expressing her intention to communicate and cooperate if there is an opportunity.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organize work progress and reply to customers
description: While waiting to pick up her daughter, Song Yajing sorted out the afternoon's work progress: she saved a screenshot of Zheng Kai's deposit payment confirmation and updated it, along with Xiaomei's investment transaction records, into the project ledger in the inventory management app. After that, she replied to messages in the customer group and had further communication with Lin Wei, asking her to select several paintings with “colors suitable for autumn” as material for tonight's community sharing.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: At 16:00, Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. On the way, she bought a box of strawberries from a roadside fruit stand. Mother and daughter walked hand in hand back to the store, and her daughter was very interested in the dried flowers placed on the table in the shop.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Organize Lin Wei's paintings and prepare the copy
description: Back in the shop, Xiaomei played with her daughter while Song Yajing carefully selected illustrations Lin Wei had sent on her phone. She chose three pieces—sunflowers, osmanthus, and camellias—and paired each with a warm floral message and a little story about her and Lin Wei's friendship in elementary school, compiling them into a heartfelt community sharing post.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sharing Lin Wei's illustrations in the community group.
description: At 5:30, Song Yajing posted the carefully prepared photos and text to the core customer WeChat group and her Moments. Immediately after posting, a customer left a comment praising, "So beautiful, can it be used as a wallpaper?" Another customer suggested printing the flowers on T-shirts or canvas bags. Inspired by this, Song Yajing quickly wrote a new idea in her phone memo: "Collaborate with Lin Wei to launch a floral co-branded cultural and creative product series — feasible?"
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mother-daughter dinner
description: Before closing, Song Yajing took her daughter to Dazhong Shacha Noodles at 49 Zhongshan Road for dinner. She ordered a non-spicy seafood noodle bowl for her daughter and the classic shacha noodles for herself. The two chatted as they ate, and her daughter excitedly told her about the new song she learned in kindergarten that day.
location: Dazhong Shacha Noodles, 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Close the store, go home, and call Mom
description: After dinner, Song Yajing, her daughter, and Xiaomei returned to the store to tidy up, and at 19:15 sharp pulled down the rolling shutter door and closed for the day. On the walk home, Song Yajing called her mother and tried to calmly share the day's "big move." Her mother was silent for a few seconds, then choked up and said, "You've loved beautiful clothes since you were little, and now you've really built a career. I'm so happy." Hearing this, Song Yajing's eyes welled up beneath the streetlight.
location: On the residential road from No. 49 Zhongshan Road to No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Playing with daughter and helping her wash up.
description: After arriving home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was reading in the living room. Song Yajing played house with her daughter for a while, then bathed her and changed her into pajamas. The daughter pestered her father to listen to two bedtime stories with her before she would sleep.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write a diary entry to record the milestone
description: After coaxing her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing went to the study, took out her brown leather diary, and solemnly wrote the date and the title "Second Shop Opening Day" in red pen. She recorded in detail today's signing details, her inner feelings, and the new idea about a cultural-creative co-branding collaboration from her phone memo. Finally, she drew a little star beside it, closed the diary, and felt an unprecedented sense of grounding and satisfaction.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Chatting with husband and personal care
description: Song Yajing returned to the living room, sat down next to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and softly shared more of her feelings and future plans. Her husband was happy for her too. Around 22:00, she went to wash up, did her skincare routine, and did 15 minutes of stretches before bed to relax the muscles that had become tense from the morning run and long periods of standing.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: Lying in bed, Song Yajing looked back on this fulfilling and meaningful day, feeling empowered. From a shop owner fighting alone to now having partners, two co-branded lines, and even a new direction inspired by cultural creativity, she felt it was all worth it. With a smile on her lips, she silently planned tomorrow's to-do items in the dark and gradually fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning home stretching and neck-shoulder relaxation
description: After getting up in the early morning, she felt some tightness in her shoulders and neck from yesterday's contract signing, so she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and followed a mobile app for a 15-minute stretching session, focusing on neck circles and shoulder open-close movements. Her body relaxed, and she decided to make morning stretching a regular habit.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child wake-up and breakfast time.
description: Entered her daughter Chen Lexuan's room and gently woke her, helped her put on the prepared thin fleece hoodie. Mother and daughter had breakfast together in the kitchen; she herself drank a cup of hot soy milk with strawberry jam toast, while her daughter ate millet porridge and a boiled egg. After the meal, she packed her daughter's little schoolbag, checked the water bottle and toys, and then put on her commuter bag, ready to go out.
location: Bedroom and dining room, 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Holding my daughter's hand, I walked 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. After a brief chat with the teacher on duty, Teacher Li, at the school gate, I watched my daughter run lively into the classroom. Then I walked along Gucheng West Road to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening and co-branding signing announcement
description: After arriving at the store 'Yaji', she turned on the spotlights with the shop assistant Xiaomei, tidied the shelves, and shared the excitement of yesterday's signing. Then, at the cash register, she found a close-up photo of the signed handwriting, posted the good news of the co-branded signing in the core customer group, and previewed the sample pattern-making schedule.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: One-on-one notification to customers interested in co-branding
description: I took out my notebook and checked the list of 8 regular customers who had expressed interest in the co-branded item since October 8. I notified Vivian, Sister Zhou, Xiao Lin, and the others one by one via WeChat private messages, officially locking in their priority spots and attaching the first-batch pre-sale pricing rules and personalized thank-you messages. The customers' positive responses made the whole morning pleasant.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend to customers coming into the store.
description: Two young female customers were attracted into the shop by the new window display. She proactively offered styling advice, and eventually succeeded in recommending an autumn dress and a knit cardigan. The customers checked out satisfied, and the small sale made her happy.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the bank.
description: The shop assistant Xiaomei offered to mind the store, so she walked to the ICBC Xiamen Huaqiao Sub-branch along the familiar Zhongshan Road, taking about 10 minutes and replying to several customer WeChat messages on the way.
location: Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opened a dedicated overseas travel account.
description: At ICBC Xiamen Huaqiao Sub-branch, account manager Lin Xiaofeng explained in detail the difference between installment fixed deposits and ordinary time deposits, and suggested an automatic monthly transfer of 2,000 yuan as an overseas travel fund. After carefully asking about the rules for early withdrawal, she filled out the application form with her ID card, opened an installment fixed deposit account, and immediately used mobile banking to set up an automatic transfer of 2,000 yuan from her main card on the 10th of every month.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Huaqiao Sub-branch), Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: For lunch, enjoyed Minnan satay noodles.
description: After finishing banking business, I felt hungry. I sat down at my usual Minnan satay noodle shop near Zhongshan Road and ordered a bowl of satay noodles with extra toppings, including squid, shrimp, and tofu. I finished it quickly and felt refreshed.
location: Southern Fujian satay noodles near Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Midday rest and private time
description: Back at the shop "Yaji," Xiaomei was tidying the accessories area. She leaned on the sofa and took a 15-minute nap to recover her energy. After waking up, she scrolled through Moments, saw the lunch her best friend Li Meiling had made, liked it, and planned to invite her out for milk tea on the weekend.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon supply chain communication and new product follow-up
description: After the break, follow up on business: send a voice message to supplier Su Shan in Guangzhou to discuss sending fabric samples and restocking for the new season; open the design draft from designer Zheng Kai, confirm the cuff and collar modification details via WeChat text, and arrange to see the physical samples next week.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Because her husband had something to do at his company, she hurried to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and made it in time to pick up her daughter after school. Her daughter excitedly showed her a sunflower drawing she had made in art class.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying daily necessities on the way home
description: With her daughter, stopped by the convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way, bought family-size fresh milk and animal crackers for the next day's breakfast and snacks. Her daughter used her own pocket money to buy a lollipop.
location: Convenience store at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the shop to tidy up and spend some mother-child time.
description: After returning to the store, her daughter sat obediently in the rest area drawing. She accompanied her while using her phone to handle return/exchange and address-change requests for online orders. Staff member Xiaomei was tidying clothes nearby, and the store had a warm atmosphere.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner packed as takeout and shared with family.
description: Near closing time, after giving Xiaomei instructions for the next day, she took her daughter to the usual Shaxian snack shop Haojiyuan, ordering a bowl of mixed noodles for her husband and one for her daughter, and wontons for herself, all to go. The mother and daughter carried the dinner home on foot under the evening lights, laughing and chatting along the way.
location: Haojiyuan Shaxian Snacks, near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family dinner and sharing
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already returned. The family of three sat around the dining table enjoying the takeout dinner. While eating, she talked about the positive reactions from the morning's customer group and how smoothly opening the bank account at noon had gone; her husband listened with great interest.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-dinner financial discussion and parent-child time
description: After dinner, her husband took the initiative to wash the dishes, while she took out a bank brochure and solemnly introduced the overseas travel fund plan to him, showing the auto-transfer confirmation page on mobile banking. The two sat on the sofa calculating the total after three years, dreaming of going to Hokkaido or Singapore. Then she accompanied her daughter in the living room playing with animal puzzles and read her two volumes of the 'Little Bear Baby' picture books.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, living room and children's room

name: Personal financial records and schedule setting
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, she opened the family electronic notebook in the study and created a new page for the 'Overseas Travel Fund', recording in detail the new account information, the goal of saving 2,000 yuan per month, and the total projected amount over three years. At the same time, she set a recurring reminder on her phone calendar for the 10th of each month: 'Check the travel fund deposit'. After completing this, she felt reassured.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Work review and evening preparation.
description: At the dresser in the bedroom, she opened the store inventory management app, quickly went through the day's transactions and customer consultation records, and closed her phone after confirming everything was fine. Then she showered, applied night cream, and relaxed her whole body.
location: Bedroom and bathroom in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Exchange a few words before bed and fall asleep
description: Lying in bed, she talked quietly with her husband, remarking that the day had been fulfilling and that having the travel fund plan set gave them real hope for the future. Her husband held her hand, responded, and said goodnight. With expectations for the future and a sense of contentment, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning jog around Yundang Lake at dawn
description: In the early morning, Song Yajing walked about 5 minutes from home to the Yundang Lake trail, then jogged 3 kilometers along the lakeside through the Egret Island Park section, taking about 25 minutes. Her breathing rhythm was good. After the run, she did 5 minutes of stretching by the lake and felt relaxed and refreshed.
location: Yundang Lake walking trail (Bailuzhou Park section), Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Walk home
description: After her morning run, Song Yajing walked home along the Yundang Lake promenade, about 5 minutes, passing through familiar alleys back to the Shanggu Street No. 82 complex.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, wash up, prepare breakfast, and wake up your daughter
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing quietly washed up without disturbing her sleeping husband and daughter. Then she busied herself in the kitchen, frying two fried eggs, toasting corn bread, warming up milk, and preparing breakfast for the family. At 7:30, she went into her daughter's room, gently woke Chen Lexuan, and helped her put on her kindergarten uniform.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: After the family of three finished breakfast, Song Yajing held her daughter's hand and walked through the back street of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, taking about 10 minutes to send Chen Lexuan to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan turned back, waved, and said goodbye. Song Yajing told her daughter to listen to the teacher.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes along the familiar street to her 'Yaji' shop. When passing the newly opened steamed bun shop at the intersection, she bought two pork buns on the way, planning to have them as a morning snack.
location: Yaji, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (passing by a baozi shop on the way)

name: Preparing for store opening and tidying the shop
description: After arriving at the shop, Song Yajing pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioner and lights, checked last night's payment records, then carefully dusted the shelves with a duster. She rearranged the autumn jackets that Xiaomei had organized the night before by color, making sure every clothing tag faced the same direction, and got everything ready for business.
location: Inside the 'Yaji' shop, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store operations and coordinating the co-branded line.
description: After opening at 9 o'clock, Xiaomei arrived to help. Song Yajing asked her to hang the newly arrived Chinese-style jackets in a prominent spot, and together they put up the inspiration board with Lin Wei's floral paintings. Customer flow was steady during that time. Around 11 o'clock, Song Yajing contacted Hangzhou designer Chen Siyuan via WeChat to discuss confirming the color samples for the first batch of fabric for the co-branded collection. He sent photos of three color swatch samples. After carefully comparing screen color differences, she chose cream apricot and notified him to send fabric samples next week.
location: Inside the 'Yaji' shop, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and afternoon tea restaurant exploration plan
description: As the number of customers decreased at noon, Song Yajing let Xiaomei go eat first, while she went to Dazhong Shacha Noodle Shop on the next street and brought a serving of its signature satay noodles back to the store. During the meal, she searched on Meituan and Dianping for newly opened light meal cafes on Zhongshan Road, browsing the ambiance and online recommendations. She saved two highly rated places to plan for tomorrow's gathering with her best friend.
location: Inside Dazhong Shacha Noodles / "Yaji" shop, near Yingkai Hotel, No. 49 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and summarizing online English class notes
description: After lunch, Song Yajing rested in the small office area behind the counter, opened the memo on her phone, and reviewed the notes for Lesson 3 of the online travel English course. She carefully copied down high-frequency sentence patterns for restaurant ordering and hotel check-in, and practiced pronunciation in a low voice, preparing for the final lesson tomorrow.
location: The small office area inside the 'Yaji' shop, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Train Xiaomei to use the inventory management app
description: After Xiaomei came back from eating, Song Yajing guided her to download and use the inventory management app recommended by Zhou Ting, and demonstrated in detail how to enter sales orders and return orders, and how to filter daily/weekly reports. Xiaomei picked it up quickly, and Song Yajing, satisfied, assigned her the inventory reconciliation permission in the app backend.
location: Inside the 'Yaji' shop, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon shop operations and fabric detail handling
description: Customer traffic increased in the afternoon. Xiaomei independently received several regular customers, while Song Yajing worked in the small office area in the back. Based on the color samples confirmed that morning, she recorded the follow-up production details of the co-branded items—such as stitching color and button material—in the project document and sent it to designer Zheng Kai for confirmation. During that time, she also came out and helped a young female customer put together a work outfit, and the customer was satisfied and placed an order.
location: Inside the 'Yaji' shop, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: After telling Xiaomei what to do, Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on time to pick up the bouncing Chen Lexuan. On the way back to the store, Xuanxuan wanted to go to the stationery store to buy a cute eraser, so Song Yajing took her to the stationery store on Park South Road, where she chose a fruit-shaped eraser. Xuanxuan happily shared a new nursery rhyme she had learned at kindergarten with her mother.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming Experimental Kindergarten / Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Yubin City Phase 2, Gongyuan South Road Stationery Store

name: Return to the store to handle pre-closing tasks and finalize afternoon tea with her best friend

At this moment, her best friend Li Meiling started a voice call in the three-person best-friend group, suggesting a get-together on Saturday afternoon at the newly opened light meal cafe "Encounter Flower House." Song Yajing confirmed she was free after tomorrow's English class, readily agreed, and took the initiative to book a table.

Then she tidied up Xuanxuan's little backpack, locked the shop door, and walked home holding her daughter's hand.

Song Yajing quickly stir-fried garlic water spinach and tomato scrambled eggs; the rice cooker had rice that had been pre-scheduled that morning. The family of three sat around the dinner table. Chen Lexuan chattered away about funny stories from kindergarten, Chen Zhiqiang shared the progress of his company's new system launch, and the table was full of laughter.

She apologized sincerely, explained the exchange process in detail, and proactively offered a free replacement with the same new item, plus a store coupon giving 10 yuan off on any purchase of 50 yuan or more with no usage restrictions. The customer calmed down and agreed. Song Yajing then left a message for Xiaomei, arranging to handle the exchange at the store the next day.

At 8 p.m., Song Yajing took her daughter for a bath, applied body wash, and washed her until she smelled nice. Then the mother and daughter lay in bed and read a picture book, "Little Rabbit Tom," together, and Xuanxuan gradually fell asleep.

Then she opened a phone app to record the day's store revenue and confirmed the amount was correct. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also walked into the bedroom; the two leaned against the headboard and chatted about the next day's schedule and what Xuanxuan needed to prepare for next week's autumn outing.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bedroom at home)

description: After Chen Zhiqiang went to the study to work overtime, Song Yajing did a 10-minute pre-bedtime stretch on her yoga mat in the bedroom to relieve the day's fatigue. After stretching, she put the notebook she needed for tomorrow's English class into her commuter bag, preparing for the next day's study.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bedroom at home)

name: Going to bed
description: Song Yajing turned off her phone and set the alarm for the next morning. With relaxed and expectant feelings about the afternoon tea with her best friend after English class tomorrow, she soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bedroom at home)

name: Woke up in the morning, prepared breakfast for the family, and had breakfast together
description: Song Yajing got up early in the morning, drank a glass of warm honey water after washing up, and prepared a hearty breakfast for the family, including milk cereal, a fruit platter, and cartoon-shaped pasta for her daughter, accompanied by fried eggs and blanched broccoli arranged in a kitten face. Then she gently woke her husband and daughter, and the family of three enjoyed a warm breakfast together in the dining room, talking about the daughter's morning art class schedule and the shop's fashion trends, enjoying family time.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: After her husband took their daughter out, Song Yajing closed the door of the study and practiced the online sharing session in front of the mirror, adjusting her tone and facial expressions, and focusing on the two-minute self-introduction about the origin of the name of the Yaji clothing store. Fifteen minutes early, she turned on her laptop, used Tencent Meeting to test the camera, microphone, and network connection to make sure everything was normal, poured a glass of warm water, took a deep breath, and waited for the sharing session to begin.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Participated in the online travel oral English workshop graduate sharing session
description: I joined the online meeting room on time and listened to several classmates share. When it was my turn, I confidently turned on my microphone and camera and, in slightly nervous but fluent English, talked about how my original motivation for persisting in studying was to have better family trips, and about the experience of squeezing in study time while busy running the shop. I vividly described the connection between the small Yaji shop and my travel dreams, and earned the foreign teacher's praise: Great story!

participant.name: Classmates from the online English class and the foreign teacher

location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (online meeting)

name: Share English learning progress with family and prepare lunch
description: After her husband picked up their daughter from her drawing class and came home, Song Yajing excitedly pulled the father and daughter to sit on the sofa and confidently performed her English self-introduction from beginning to end. The daughter was amused and giggled, clapping and shouting, 'Mommy is amazing!' Her husband also gave a thumbs-up in encouragement. Afterwards, the family divided up tasks in the kitchen: Yajing cooked noodles, her husband sliced braised beef and blanched greens. Then they chatted over dinner about the afternoon plans with her best friend. Yajing also sent screenshots of the sharing session to the family group and the parents' WeChat group.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In the afternoon, she accompanied her daughter for a nap and handled community group affairs.
description: After lunch, her husband cleared the dishes. Yajing watched a 15-minute cartoon with her daughter, then coaxed her to take a nap. After her daughter fell asleep, she went back to the living room and scrolled through WeChat Moments. Seeing multiple likes and questions on the morning's new product photos, she replied to them one by one. Then she opened the customer group to browse the chat and formed an initial idea about the candidates for the afternoon party. Afterward, she leaned back on the sofa and rested for 20 minutes.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: Song Yajing changed into flat shoes, walked through the old street, and arrived 10 minutes early at the 'Meet Flower House' cafe on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to meet her best friend Li Meiling. The two discussed enthusiastically and finalized the plan item by item: the party theme would be 'Vivian's Next Stop to Happiness'; the venue would be the community shared space behind the Yaji store; the time would be after closing next Monday evening; the fee would be a voluntary pay-as-you-feel contribution, with the payment QR code and banner already prepared; the donation recipient would be a center for children with disabilities in Siming District; for games and video materials, Yajing would collect 'first impressions of Vivian' videos, while Lingling would handle decorations and supplies. After finalizing, Yajing immediately posted the official party notice and sign-up link in the customer group with lively, warm copy, then privately messaged five familiar group members to ask them to record short blessing videos, and pulled Lingling into the temporary group chat 'Vivian Party Urgent Trio.'
location: Meet Flower House Café, middle section of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Selecting scented candle party favors at a boutique store.
description: After saying goodbye to Lingling, Song Yajing walked alone toward home. On the way, she entered the newly opened 'Three Lives Story' boutique accessory store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The store had an artistic style. She browsed carefully in the aromatherapy section and finally chose 5 cute miniature scented candles, with scents including sea salt, vanilla, white peach, etc., to supplement the party favors, matching the customized engraved bracelets.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, middle section of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Sansheng Wuyu Boutique Accessories Store

name: On the way, I stopped by Xinji Roast Meat Shop to take out roast meat as an extra dish for home.
