She sent her husband a voice message saying she had bought the roast meats and that he could simply make a soup.
location: No. 8-51, Hexiang West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Xinji Roast Meats (Lianbang Plaza Branch)

name: The family shared a hearty roast meat dinner and reported on the progress of party preparations.
description: Back home, rice and meatball soup prepared by her husband were already on the table. Song Yajing plated the roast meat, and the family of three sat around the table warmly. She happily shared the results of the afternoon discussion, took out the scented candle for her husband and daughter to smell, full of the little joys of life.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Played LEGO with her daughter, bathed her, and read a bedtime picture book.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing played LEGO with her daughter for half an hour, building a "little garden." Then she helped her take a bath and change into pajamas, and sat by the bed reading a picture book about animal travels. After listening, her daughter gave her a kiss and said, "Good night, Mommy," then fell into a sweet sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Carefully chose a party background music playlist and shared it to the group.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing curled up on the living room sofa, put on her earphones, opened the music app, searched for keywords such as cozy, cheerful, and party, chose 16 upbeat and warm songs, created a playlist called “Vivian's Next Stop to Happiness,” and shared it to the “Party-Eager Trio” group chat.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening face mask and body stretching to relax.
description: Song Yajing applied a hydrating mask, lay in bed and did 10 minutes of leg stretches, listening to soft instrumental music while savoring the day's fulfillment and sense of achievement, easing the fatigue of the day.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Chatted with her husband, recorded accounts, and got ready for bed.
description: After her husband finished his own things, the two leaned against the headboard and chatted. Song Yajing shared her takeaways from the day's online sharing session and her excitement about finalizing the party plan. Her husband told her that their daughter had been praised by the teacher in art class for her great sense of color. She used her mobile expense-tracking app to record the 98 yuan spent on party candles, then casually scrolled through local news and saw an outdoor market in Siming District, thinking she could take her daughter there next week. After setting the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, she turned off the light and fell asleep with satisfaction and peace.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning chores and breakfast.
description: Woke up naturally in a relaxed state without setting an alarm. First went to the kitchen to brew a cup of fruit tea, then enjoyed a simple and warm breakfast with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, including fried egg toast and milk. During the meal, she shared her slow-paced plan for today: studying in the morning and going to the bookstore in the afternoon. Her husband supported her and offered to cook lunch. After breakfast, she quickly cleaned the table and put the dishes into the dishwasher, then went into the study, turned on the desk lamp, neatly arranged her English notebook, baking handouts, highlighters, and other items on the desk, and refilled her fruit tea, ready to immerse herself in the morning study time.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Organize English notes and make a practice plan
description: Sitting at the desk, she merged yesterday's new notes from the English sharing session with her previous travel conversation notes. Using a pink highlighter, she marked 30 high-frequency everyday sentences such as 'daily check-in' and 'could you recommend,' and on the last page of the notebook wrote a follow-up practice plan: read along with an app for 10 minutes every night before bed, play a 15-minute English role-playing game with her daughter on the weekend, and also added a memo to the planner for next Wednesday at 9 PM for an online group speaking practice.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Review baking notes and prepare questions for the course
description: After finishing the English study, she took out the handouts from Chef Chen's basic pastry course from earlier this year, and focused on reviewing the basics: the differences among whipping states of cream (soft, medium, stiff) and the conversion ratio and usage differences between gelatin sheets and gelatin powder. She compared the outline of the mango mousse course coming up on the 26th with her notes, and wrote down a few questions on a sticky note, such as: “How can I prevent gelatin from clumping in mango mousse?” “If the mango has a lot of water, do I need to adjust the amount of gelatin?” Then she photographed the sticky note and sent it to Chef Chen via WeChat.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family late-morning time: drawing with daughter and lunch
description: Leaving the study, I sat down next to my daughter Xuanxuan, who was drawing on the living room floor mat. She took out her watercolor markers and enthusiastically wanted to draw “Our Family.” I patiently guided her to draw the sun, little flowers, and Mom and Dad holding hands, and encouraged her to give her painting a title. When it was done, my daughter proudly stuck the painting on the refrigerator and showed it off to Dad, who was preparing lunch in the kitchen. Later, my husband Chen Zhiqiang made a simple tomato egg noodle soup and a stir-fried seasonal vegetable. The three of us sat at the table, eating and chatting. I shared what I had gained from organizing my notes that morning, my husband talked about his company's new project next week, and my daughter kept chattering about the “Princess Mom” in her painting.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Lunch break and getting ready to go out.
description: After the meal, she and her husband put their daughter down for a nap, and then she rested briefly on the sofa for 20 minutes. After waking up, she confirmed the afternoon childcare arrangements with her husband: after their daughter woke up, she could build with LEGO or go to the park to play on the slide, and there was some washed fruit in the fridge. Then she changed into a light off-white knit top and linen wide-leg pants, tidied her hair in front of the entryway mirror, and applied sunscreen and a brightening lipstick. At the same time, she took out her phone and sent a message in the "Anxious Party Trio" group chat, telling her girlfriends that she was heading out to the bookstore to recharge, then picking up the necklace and buying decorations, and inviting everyone to come up with the background music playlist.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Go to Xinhua Bookstore to read and buy books
description: Starting from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, I walked along Gucheng West Road toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, I passed a flower shop and stopped to take a look, thinking that a bunch of chamomile could be placed on the table at tomorrow's party. After walking about 15 minutes, I arrived at Xinhua Bookstore. I first chose Aoyama Nanae's healing novel Gentle Sigh in the literature section on the second floor, then went to the lifestyle section and found a Korean baker's Popular Cake Classroom, which detailed the basics of cake layers and pairings with different fruits. After paying, I bought a freshly ground hot latte downstairs and sat down by the window in the bookstore's café area, reading the novel for over an hour, feeling calm and healed. Then I carefully browsed the baking book's chapters on mango and peach cakes, and jotted down the Tropical Fruit Mille Crêpes idea in my phone notes.
location: Xinhua Bookstore (Zhongshan Road Branch), No. 151-159 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up the custom necklace
description: After finishing the book, she contentedly put it into her canvas tote bag, walked out of the bookstore, and continued along the pedestrian street for about 300 meters until she reached the custom jewelry store "Left Bank Imprint" at the end of the street. After presenting the pickup voucher, the store owner brought out an exquisite dark blue velvet gift box containing a silver collarbone necklace engraved with the letters "Y.J", which had a soft luster under the light. She carefully checked the clarity of the engraving and the smoothness of the clasp, and after confirming everything was in order, she thanked the owner with satisfaction and carefully tucked the gift box into the inner layer of her canvas tote bag.
location: Left Bank Imprint Custom Jewelry Store, 262 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchase party decorations and order desserts
description: First, she went to the Japanese-style grocery store "Slow Life" she often visits, where she picked out macaron-colored balloons, a string of gold letter beads reading "HAPPY ENDING," and a vintage checkered tablecloth, spending 85 yuan in total. Then she walked to the nearby bakery "Sweet Find Workshop," found the familiar staff member, pre-ordered an 8-inch tiramisu and 6 fruit tarts to be baked tomorrow afternoon, and agreed to pick them up after 3 p.m. tomorrow, paying a 50 yuan deposit in advance.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store to store the party supplies.
description: Carrying the decorations and the dessert order, she walked five minutes back to her own clothing store, Yaji. Shop assistant Xiao Mei was just about to receive a customer, so Yajing put the party supplies and necklace in the storage cabinet at the back of the store and told Xiao Mei, "These are for tomorrow's party, so leave them here for now. After you pick up the desserts tomorrow afternoon, please put them in the fridge together with the cake." Xiao Mei readily agreed.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Buying dinner ingredients on the way home
description: After leaving the store, she walked toward home. Passing a familiar roast meat shop, she had half a roast duck sliced, and bought some fresh green grapes and pomegranates from the fruit stall next door, thinking they could serve as after-dinner fruit for the family in the evening.
location: Near the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner

I plated the roast duck, stir-fried a simple green vegetable, and served it with the leftover noodles from lunch. The three of us enjoyed a relaxed Sunday evening family dinner. I talked about an interesting plot from the novel I'd read at the bookstore, and my husband told us how Xuanxuan had bravely tried the new slide at the park in the afternoon. Our daughter and I both laughed happily.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Evening parent-child time: bathing, reading picture books, and putting the child to sleep
description: After dinner, I bathed my daughter Xuanxuan. She played with a little duck in the water while I washed her and reviewed the color words from today's painting with her. After her bath, I changed her into pajamas, read her a story passage about family love from the newly purchased 'Gentle Sighs', and patiently answered all kinds of whimsical questions she asked. After the story, I kissed her forehead and coaxed her to sleep. Seeing my daughter's serene sleeping face, I felt a sense of satisfaction.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Evening family exchange and final confirmation of the party
description: Back in the living room, I took out the necklace, took a close-up photo in the soft light, and sent it to the 'Party Urgent Trio' group with the caption: 'Necklace picked up, perfect! See you all tomorrow!' Then in the group, I confirmed with everyone again that we would gather at the shared space behind the store at 6 p.m. tomorrow, and divided up each person's preparation tasks (who would bring the speaker, who would bring the Polaroid camera, etc.) to make sure everything was foolproof. After that, I sat on the sofa with my husband and chatted about the details of tomorrow's party and next week's schedule. My husband said he would get off work early tomorrow to pick up our daughter, so I could set up and attend the party with peace of mind. He also reminded me that next week's physical exam requires fasting. After chatting for a while, we got up and washed up.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Stretching and reflection before bed
description: After washing up, she did 10 minutes of pre-bedtime stretching on the bedroom carpet, relaxing her calves that were a bit sore from walking in the afternoon. Lying in bed, she reviewed her fulfilling day: she had completed her self-improvement study, spent time with family, and prepared for tomorrow's party, feeling calm and content inside. She picked up her phone, set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (No. xx, Bailu Road)

name: Return home to wash up and prepare breakfast.

She set the breakfast on the table while the sky outside gradually brightened.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: Gently woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and the family of three sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan shared funny stories about yesterday's painting class at kindergarten, and her husband Chen Zhiqiang responded with a smile. She reminded him to pick up Xuanxuan early today. After the meal, she checked Xuanxuan's schoolbag to make sure the water bottle and sweat-absorbing towel were all packed.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, she turned from Gucheng West Road onto Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and walked ten minutes to the shop, checking her phone along the way to quickly scan the party group messages and plan the day's to-dos.
location: From Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store opening preparation and handling online matters
description: Arrived at the store on time, opened the door, turned on the lights, started the cash register system, and gave the shop a quick cleaning. Held a morning meeting with staff member Xiaomei, informing her about Zhou Ting's visit in the afternoon and the plan to close early in the evening, and discussed display ideas. Then brewed a drip-bag coffee and handled online messages at the small round table next to the fitting room: notified the sisters' group chat of the evening party's time and place, contacted the florist to confirm picking up the flower materials, and contacted Tianmi Workshop to confirm picking up the desserts.

After arriving at Xi'an Road Flower and Bird Market, she successfully picked up three bunches of lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves.
location: Xi'an Road Flower and Bird Market, No. 121 Xi'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

description: Back at the store, she carefully put away the flower materials. Together with Xiaomei, she greeted the morning customers as the flow gradually picked up and recommended pairings for shoppers. In the gaps, she unpacked and ironed the autumn knitwear, rearranged it by color, and designed several new outfit combinations for the entrance display.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

While waiting for the food, she asked in the 'Three Sisters' group whether Meiling and Vivian could arrive earlier in the afternoon or if they needed her to bring anything. Meiling said she would bring sparkling water, and Vivian replied with a playful emoji.
location: Linjinji Shacha Noodles (Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street Store), Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reviewed English notes.
description: After the meal, she returned to the shop, opened the English notes app on her phone, and as planned reviewed 30 high-frequency everyday sentences and read along with each one twice. The half-hour of continuous study made her feel fulfilled.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Mind the store and preview party music
description: In the afternoon, the store saw more customer traffic. Between attending to customers, she put on earphones to preview the party playlist, nodding gently to the beat, and removed two songs with noisy, chaotic rhythms to ensure the overall atmosphere was warm and touching.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

description: My old classmate Zhou Ting arrived at the store on time. I poured her a cup of homemade fruit tea. After a few minutes of catching up, she couldn't wait to open the inventory management app and ask how to classify the dresses that blend French and new Chinese styles. Zhou Ting adjusted the custom categories and demonstrated how to use barcode scanning to quickly enter new items. She promised to send an illustrated guide of the key steps after returning to Shenzhen.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up desserts and return to the shop to prepare for closing.
description: Escorted Zhou Ting to the store entrance and hugged her goodbye. Then I walked quickly to Tianmi Workshop, showed my reservation information, and picked up an 8-inch tiramisu and 6 fruit tarts. After checking them carefully, I carried them back to the store with satisfaction and put the desserts in the fridge. Back in the store, Xiaomei and I started tidying up early. We put the clothes back, turned off some lights, hung up a Temporarily Closed sign, and took the party supplies to the community shared space.
location: Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, passing Tianmi Workshop and Yaji Clothing Store

name: Set up, host, and clean up after a bachelorette party.
description: Entering the shared space on the third floor of the community activity center, Xiaomei blew up balloons while she hung up the letter banner reading “Vivian’s Next Stop: Happiness.” Soon they arranged a balloon arch, a dessert table, and a photo backdrop; placed lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves in vases beside the dessert table; and tested the Bluetooth speaker. After six o’clock, the sisters arrived one after another. The icebreaker game “Guess Who She Is” livened up the atmosphere, and they played a memory video everyone had recorded in advance. Vivian’s eyes turned red after watching it, and she personally put a silver choker engraved with “Y.J” on her and hugged her tightly, announcing that all 400 yuan raised tonight for the emotional event would be donated in full to the community center for children with disabilities. The whole room applauded. At the end of the party, everyone gathered around Vivian for photos, helped pack the remaining party favors, and said goodbye to the sisters. Afterwards, Li Meiling volunteered to stay and help. Together they took down the decorations, returned tables and chairs to their places, and swept the floor. After confirming everything had been restored, they turned off the lights and returned the keys.
location: Shared space, 3rd floor, Zhongshan Road Community Activity Center, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking home and having a phone call with her husband
description: Carrying the remaining gifts and odds and ends, she walked home. The night breeze was slightly cool, and the streets were quiet. She called her husband Chen Zhiqiang to ask how Xuanxuan was doing; he said their daughter had eaten dinner and taken a bath and was watching cartoons while waiting.
location: Alley on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompany daughter in washing up and tell bedtime stories
description: After getting home, she saw her husband hanging clothes on the balcony. She went straight to the living room, picked up Xuanxuan, who ran over, gave her a kiss, and took her to the bathroom to wash up. Before bed, they leaned against the headboard and read the picture book 'Gentle Sigh' together. Xuanxuan was fascinated, said goodnight sweetly, and fell deeply asleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Share stories from the party with her husband
description: She moved from the bedroom to the living room, curled up in her husband's arms, and shared the most touching moments from the party that night: Vivian's tears and the decision to donate. Her husband smiled and said he had the ability to warm everyone, and that the donation idea was especially good. Nestled together, she felt a sense of fulfillment.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and pre-bedtime stretching
description: After washing up, she applied new night cream, did a set of simple bedtime stretches on a yoga mat to relieve fatigue, then opened the memo app on her phone to record her feelings: felt energetic after the morning run; Zhou Ting helped solve the inventory classification problem; the party was successful and the donations warmed everyone; she felt loved and loved everyone; today was fulfilling.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Confirm tomorrow's to-do list and go to sleep
description: Before turning off the light, she checked tomorrow's weather forecast and saw it would be cloudy, then confirmed tomorrow's to-dos in her phone calendar: reply to the party group with feedback and photos in the morning, check inventory with Xiaomei in the afternoon, and pick up Xuanxuan in the evening. After setting the alarm for 6:40 the next morning, she fell asleep at ease.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Early rising, breakfast, and family interaction
description: The alarm went off, and it was drizzling outside. Song Yajing washed up quickly and prepared boiled eggs and milk oatmeal for her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, while having an extra glass of warm water herself. Then she gently woke her husband and daughter. Xuanxuan wanted to wear her bunny dress, and Aqiang said he could pick up their daughter in the evening. The family sat around the table for breakfast. Song Yajing reminded Xuanxuan to put on her raincoat properly and confirmed the afternoon pickup time with Aqiang.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Indoor yoga and parent-child interaction
description: Because it was rainy and outdoor exercise was not possible, Song Yajing spread out a yoga mat in the living room and followed a phone app to do shoulder and neck relaxing yoga. Her daughter Xuanxuan curiously joined in, imitating her mother's stretching movements, and the mother and daughter completed 30 minutes of exercise with laughter and joy.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washed up and changed clothes, took my daughter to kindergarten, and walked to the store.
description: After yoga, she took a quick shower, braided Xuanxuan's hair, put on her bunny dress and pink raincoat, and checked the contents of her schoolbag. Holding an umbrella and holding her daughter's hand, she walked 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, handed her over to the teacher, and watched her enter. Then she continued walking 15 minutes to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The air was fresh on the stone-paved road after the rain.
location: Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, via Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), to Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Morning preparations at the shop and casual chatting
description: When they arrived at the store, shop assistant Xiaomei had already opened up. The two wiped down the shelves, tidied the clothes, and hung the new sweaters in the featured area. Song Yajing told Xiaomei she would need to leave early tomorrow for a medical checkup, and Xiaomei readily agreed. The two chatted while they worked.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sending feedback to her florist friend and completing the donation disclosure
description: There were no customers in the store, so Song Yajing used WeChat to send yesterday's party floral arrangement photos to her florist friend Lin Yue, thanking her for the wonderful decoration. Lin Yue proposed a long-term collaboration. Then, through mobile banking, she transferred the 400 yuan emotional fee received from yesterday's party plus 100 yuan of her own, 500 yuan in total, to the Siming District Service Center for Disabled Children, and posted a screenshot in the customer group as public disclosure, receiving enthusiastic likes from group members.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daily product updates and online replies.
description: After handling the donation, she threw herself into work. She ironed and styled the newly arrived knitwear, replied to multiple WeChat inquiries from regular customers, and successfully closed a deal. She tried using the inventory management app to mark the newly arrived accessories as in stock, but she was still unfamiliar with the operation. In between, she also found time to reply to designer Lin Wei's WeChat about an illustration collaboration and arranged to meet next week.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch
description: With fewer customers at noon, she had Xiaomei watch the store and went to the nearby 85°C Bakery to buy a ham sandwich and hot oolong tea. She sat by the window to eat and browsed the group's feedback on the donation, feeling fulfilled.
location: 85°C Bakery Cafe (Zhonghua City store), No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organizing lunch break and party photos
description: Back at the store, she sat on the sofa in the rest area and flipped through photos from yesterday's party. She picked out the few with the best composition and atmosphere, planning to post them on Moments in the afternoon to record a warm moment.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store duty and customer reception.
description: Afternoon rush hour was moderate; I warmly recommended commute clothes to customers, and one lady was satisfied and bought two pieces. I continued replying to WeChat messages, followed up on illustration collaboration details, and planned to contact Susan about restocking in the evening.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon tea, community content publishing, and closing preparations
description: Customer flow gradually slowed. She went to the independent café next door and bought an Americano. Using the store's Wi-Fi, she edited party photos with a collage app, posted them on Moments, and forwarded them to customer groups. Then she briefed Xiaomei on tomorrow morning's physical exam and afternoon arrival at the store, sorted out the cash register and keys, and completed the closing handover.
location: Shop 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and nearby independent cafés.

name: Walked to pick up daughter from school and chatted
description: Walked with an umbrella to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, about 25 minutes. At the gate, picked up Xuanxuan, who came bouncing out, and listened to her excitedly tell about learning to draw a rainbow and helping a classmate pick up crayons today. Song Yajing praised her, and the mother and daughter chatted as they walked.
location: From Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 West Gucheng Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to buy groceries on the way home
description: Holding Xuanxuan's hand, she walked from the kindergarten to Minfeng Fresh Supermarket, where they bought tomatoes, eggs, dried noodles, and green vegetables. Xuanxuan proactively helped carry a bag of cherry tomatoes. After shopping, they walked home; the whole trip took about 25 minutes.
location: Minfeng Fresh Supermarket (Xinming Building Branch), No. 2 Tong'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Shanggu Street No. 82 Community.

name: Preparing dinner and having the family dinner
description: After getting home, she had Xuanxuan play with building blocks while she tied on an apron and went into the kitchen. She boiled water, cut tomatoes, and beat eggs, making a light tomato and egg noodle soup and blanched greens. When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, the family of three sat together for dinner and listened to Xuanxuan perform a nursery rhyme.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidying up, bathing, bedtime story, and coaxing to sleep
description: After dinner, she had her husband do the dishes while she bathed Xuanxuan, dried her hair, and changed her into pajamas. Then, in the bedroom, she told her a story from the picture book “Gentle Sigh”. After hearing it, Xuanxuan wanted to be as gentle as a little rabbit. Then she hummed a Hokkien lullaby until Xuanxuan fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing for tomorrow's physical examination
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she checked the appointment order on her phone, put her ID card, social security card, etc. into a small handbag, confirmed that she needed to fast and avoid water the next day, set a 6:30 alarm, and made a note.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family matters, personal care, and a call with her mother
description: After preparing for the medical checkup, she went to the living room and shared the donation feedback with her husband, then washed up and did her skincare routine. She called her mother, who is far away in Quanzhou, via WeChat, told her that the checkup was tomorrow, and her mother advised her to stay relaxed.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In the evening, study baking skills and inventory management applications.
description: In the study, she watched baking expert videos on a tablet, learning mirror glaze techniques for mango mousse and fruit cutting, and recording key steps. Then she practiced using the inventory management app, continued processing the accessory parts into inventory, and basically mastered the classification logic.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime review, relaxation, prayer, mood journaling, and sleep.
description: Back in the bedroom, she turned off the main light and left the bedside lamp on, briefly reviewing the fulfilling experiences of the day: the well-received donation, the illustration collaboration, preparation for the physical exam, and learning to bake. She closed her eyes and prayed for the physical exam and her family's safety. She wrote down her feelings in her journal, then turned off the light, did abdominal breathing to relax, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Get up early and go to the hospital for a physical examination.
description: On an autumn morning, Song Yajing got up immediately after the alarm went off, on an empty stomach and without eating or drinking anything. Seeing the family of three that her daughter Xuanxuan had drawn with crayons, she felt warm inside. She washed up quietly so as not to wake her sleeping husband and daughter, and after reconfirming her medical insurance card, ID card, and appointment slip, put them into her small bag. On the dining table she left a note for her husband Chen Zhiqiang: “A Qiang, I've gone for my physical exam. For breakfast, take Xuanxuan to have shacha noodles, and remember to add a fried egg for her. I should be able to get back to the shop by noon. Call me if anything comes up. — Yajing.” Then she picked up her canvas bag and light jacket, checked the doors and windows, and slipped out quietly. She walked to the open-air parking lot outside the residential complex, started her own car, and drove along Siming South Road, where traffic had already increased during the morning rush hour. Following Zhenhai Road, she soon entered the parking lot of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University; parking took a few minutes.
location: Room 401, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University (No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Completed comprehensive physical examination.
description: After arriving at the health checkup center early, the reception desk told her she could begin. Song Yajing completed all the scheduled items one by one according to the procedure: blood draw, electrocardiogram, abdominal ultrasound, internal medicine, general surgery, ophthalmology, and so on. The nurse drew blood gently, and the ultrasound doctor asked her to take deep breaths and cooperate. Throughout the process, she waited patiently in line and quietly followed the instructions, finishing all the examinations at around 8:40.

participant.name: Medical staff at the physical examination center.

location: Health Examination Center, First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University (No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Waiting for the report and listening to the doctor's advice.
description: After the examination, the hospital told her that some routine reports would take about 1-2 hours. Song Yajing sat down on a chair in the waiting area, took out her phone, replied to a few online inquiries from the shop, and flipped through the hospital's Women's Health Management Handbook, focusing on the chapter about blood lipid control. She endured hunger during this time. At about 10:30, she was called into the doctor's office, and the doctor told her the preliminary results: apart from total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein being slightly above the ideal range, all other indicators were normal. The doctor recommended increasing regular aerobic exercise, controlling her diet, and reducing intake of fried food and desserts. She carefully noted every suggestion and strengthened her determination to go for morning runs.
location: Rest area and doctor's office at the Physical Examination Center, First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University (No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Drive back to the store.
description: After leaving the hospital, Song Yajing drove back to Zhongshan Road. Turning right from Zhenhai Road onto South Siming Road, the traffic was smooth, and about 5 minutes later she arrived at a parking lot near Zhongshan Road. She parked, then walked about 5 minutes back to her clothing store.
location: From the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University to the "Yaji" Clothing Store (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Lunch and store affairs
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing confirmed the morning business situation with shop assistant Xiaomei. Then she went to the 85°C next door and bought a vegetable salad, a boiled egg, and a cup of unsweetened soy milk, then returned to the store and ate behind the counter. At the same time, she opened her phone to deal with the backlog of online messages, replied to three customers asking about the collaboration item, and confirmed the arrival time for an afternoon batch of autumn clothing restock. Xiaomei was arranging the new arrivals display nearby, and she occasionally offered styling suggestions.
location: 'Yaji' Clothing Store (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) and 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery (No. 189, Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Have a phone call with my older sister.
description: Her older sister Song Yawen called from Shenzhen to ask about the medical check-up results, and Song Yajing shared the doctor's advice in detail. Her sister also talked about her habit of getting a physical exam every year and reminded her to watch her sugar intake and cut back on late-night snacks. The sisters also talked about their father's recent stable blood pressure and Double 11 shopping plans, and agreed to reunite at their hometown in Quanzhou for New Year's Day.
location: "Yaji" Clothing Store (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Watching the shop and resting
description: After finishing the call, there were not many customers in the afternoon. Song Yajing guided Xiaomei on how to recommend suitable colors based on customers' skin tones. Around 15:00 she felt tired, so she sat behind the cash register and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes. After waking up, she took some photos of the newly arrived autumn clothing items in the store, wrote captions, and posted them to her Moments and customer groups.
location: "Yaji" Clothing Store (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province)

name: Pick up daughter from school and buy groceries on the way
description: At 16:00, Song Yajing walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, queued up to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, who was wearing a yellow vest, and helped her put on her small schoolbag. Holding her daughter's hand, she stopped by the fresh produce market near the kindergarten on the way and bought fresh sea bass, baby bok choy, and a few tomatoes. She planned to make light and healthy steamed fish and seasonal vegetables for dinner.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province) and the nearby vegetable market

name: Returning home to prepare dinner, with her husband assisting.
description: Song Yajing brought Xuanxuan and the groceries home, let her daughter watch cartoons in the living room, put the ingredients in the kitchen, and began washing vegetables and slicing ginger to prepare dinner. Soon her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work earlier than usual, proactively tied on an apron, took over the kitchen work, and let her go rest.
location: Room 401, Building 3, Community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had a light dinner together.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Tonight's menu was steamed sea bass, garlic baby bok choy, tomato egg drop soup, and multigrain rice. Song Yajing shared her experience at the health checkup. Her husband Aqiang also mentioned that he had been having lower back soreness recently from sitting for long periods. Their daughter Xuanxuan seriously told a story about a child at kindergarten losing a tooth, which made everyone laugh heartily.
location: Room 401, Building 3, Community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-dinner walk and family health pact.
description: After the meal, the family of three went out for a walk to aid digestion, following the path outside the residential area toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Along the way, Song Yajing again relayed the doctor's advice in detail. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang agreed and suggested going home to make a plan together. After returning home, the two of them wrote down a "Family Health Covenant" on sticky notes in the living room. They discussed and decided that the husband would go for night runs by Yundang Lake every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday evening, while Song Yajing would increase her morning runs from three times a week to four, and they both promised to keep their diet light. They stuck the agreement on the refrigerator door and pressed their fingerprints as a seal.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Spending evening time with daughter
description: After the health pact, Song Yajing devoted herself wholeheartedly to her daughter. She first played a Spot the Difference card game with Xuanxuan, then drew her a bath and bathed her with bubble bath. After the bath, she read her the new picture book A Gentle Sigh, and Xuanxuan fell asleep to the gentle story.
location: Room 401, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (children's room, bathroom).

name: Community sharing and personal care.
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing leaned back on the sofa and sent a message in the customer group: "Ladies, I went for my annual checkup today. The results are reassuring, but with a few reminders. No matter how busy you are, remember to take care of yourself and get regular checkups!" She also attached a photo of a glass of water. After seeing replies from several group members, she sent them private messages with recommended booking channels. Then she did her personal care routine, applied a seaweed mask, and did some simple stretches for her body stiff from sitting too long.
location: Room 401, Building 3, Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room and bedroom)

name: Write a diary and review
description: After washing up and changing into her pajamas, Song Yajing sat down at the desk, opened her diary, and recorded the day's health checkup experience, the doctor's advice, and the process of making a health agreement with her husband. She wrote: "The body's warning bell is gentler than a siren. Turn 'should' into 'must,' and only by going together with family can you go further."
location: Room 401, Building 3, Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bedroom desk)

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Before turning off the light and lying down, Song Yajing made the sign of the cross and said a brief prayer for her family’s health and safety, feeling grounded and clear-headed, storing up energy for tomorrow morning’s run. At 22:15 she switched off the bedside lamp and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Room 401, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up, morning jog, and returning home
description: The phone alarm went off. Song Yajing got up quickly, changed into a neon pink sports hoodie and running shoes, drank a glass of warm water, and did some simple stretches of her wrists and ankles. She then left from the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, jogged slowly to the Yundang Lake trail, deliberately keeping a slow pace, and ran 3 kilometers, recording it with a mobile fitness app and updating her morning run goal progress to "1/4" in her memo. After the run, she stretched fully on a lakeside bench, then walked home along the street, feeling the cool, damp morning air and feeling fulfilled and peaceful inside.
location: Starting from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the Yundang Lake walkway (from Hubin North Road to Bailuzhou in Siming District), then back to the community.

name: Go home to wash up, have breakfast, and take her daughter to school.
description: When she got home, Song Yajing took a quick shower. She fried an egg with slightly browned edges and made a quick sandwich for her daughter and herself using toast, lettuce, and salad dressing. She woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her wash up and get dressed, and the mother and daughter sat at the table eating breakfast while chatting about today's handcraft class plan at the kindergarten. After breakfast, Song Yajing rode her electric scooter to take her daughter to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She spoke briefly with the teacher and only left after confirming her daughter had entered the kindergarten.
location: The community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road)

name: Cycling to the shop, opening preparation, and morning meeting
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing rode a scooter along Gucheng West Road and turned onto Zhongshan Road, arriving at Yaji Clothing Store ten minutes later. Shop assistant Xiaomei was already tidying the clothing racks. Together they re-ironed and put back the display garments that had been hastily packed away when the store closed the day before. After turning on the cash register system at 8:30, they spot-checked the sweaters and jeans inventory to confirm the remaining quantities matched the displayed items. After Xiaomei finished entering yesterday's sales, Song Yajing checked against the receipts and found a missing entry. She calmly and seriously suggested optimizing the two-person verification mechanism, added the missing entry, and set a recurring review reminder in her phone memo for 10 a.m. every day.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: Handling personalized customer needs and community maintenance
description: After opening the store, Song Yajing focused on online affairs: she replied to three regular customers who had sent private messages asking about the co-branded items, providing photos of fabric swatch cards and price ranges; she pulled out the list of three group members who had ordered the same trench coat after the community sharing on the health check-up day the day before yesterday, thanked each one, and gave them store points; she contacted the supplier Susan to replenish 5 more pieces of one of the autumn trench coats; she opened the order form and added a note for two made-to-measure clients: 'Expected to arrive next week; we will notify you first and present a custom brooch upon arrival,' then took a screenshot and sent it to the clients for confirmation.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: A break at the dessert shop and inspiration
description: Song Yajing went to the nearby Sweet Find Workshop, ordered a sugar-free iced Americano, and sat by the window for a ten-minute break, while browsing a few new French dessert designs for inspiration for the weekend dessert class.
location: Sweet Finds Workshop, middle section of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Midday supermarket shopping
description: Leaving Tianmi Workshop, Song Yajing walked to the Xiashang Fresh Supermarket on Xiaoxue Road and shopped strictly according to her diet plan: she bought a 2-liter bottle of fresh milk, a box of salad greens, two chicken breast fillets, a bag of whole wheat bread, a box of fresh blueberries, and a bottle of low-fat yogurt.
location: Xiashang Fresh Supermarket, No. 37 Xiaoxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing put the food away and made an energy bowl for lunch with yogurt, blueberries, and the half avocado left over from last night. After eating, she leaned back on the sofa in the store and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes, without scrolling on her phone, letting her eyes and mind completely empty out.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: Afternoon data organization and display adjustment
description: After the lunch break, her energy recovered. Song Yajing opened the inventory management app and carefully cross-checked the sales data that Xiao Mei had retroactively entered against the system inventory, confirming everything was correct. Then she spent half an hour exporting the past week's sales report, focusing on the sales trends of dresses and knit jackets, and briefly noted the data in her notebook to prepare for the evening discussion. Afterward, she and Xiao Mei changed the mannequins in the welcome area by the entrance into the new autumn styles and adjusted the window display.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: Receiving walk-in customers and interacting with the online community
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Song Yajing received four groups of customers in succession. For a tourist from Beijing, she recommended and successfully sold a work suit skirt set and a versatile knit cardigan. At 3:30 p.m., she launched the 'Wednesday Outfit Challenge' topic in the WeChat customer group, posting three autumn outfit combinations in different styles for everyone to vote on. The group atmosphere was lively.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Yaji Clothing Store)

name: Pick up daughter from school and shop at convenience store
description: Song Yajing rode a scooter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her, she excitedly showed off the little pinwheel she had made in arts and crafts class. On the way back, they stopped at a convenience store next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Her daughter helped pick out a bottle of strawberry-scented shampoo and a pack of tissues, and Song Yajing bought two boxes of overnight sanitary pads for herself.
location: Along the way from Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the convenience store at 35-101 Zhenhai Road

name: Parent-Child Nursery Rhyme Time on the Way Home
description: Walking along the tree-lined road home, the mother and daughter reviewed the Hokkien nursery rhyme The Sky Is Dark from last week, taking turns with each line, full of childlike charm.
location: Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian (en route)

name: Dinner preparation and discussion of family business
description: After returning home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already come back. Song Yajing made a simple tomato and egg noodles, and used the air fryer to roast a few pieces of chicken breast to go with salad. At the dinner table, she took out the sales report she had recorded in the afternoon, and Chen Zhiqiang used the calculator on his phone to help her estimate the cost and expected profit of the first co-branded collection. He suggested setting an early-bird price and collecting deposits first to recover capital. The two had a brief discussion about the deposit ratio and the community warm-up plan.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family activities and communication with the designer
description: After dinner, her husband Chen Zhiqiang washed the dishes. Song Yajing played house with her daughter Chen Lexuan in the living room for a while. Around 7 p.m., her husband suggested taking their daughter downstairs to ride the scooter. Taking advantage of this time, Song Yajing sent the "early bird price" strategy and the estimated figures discussed during dinner to Hangzhou designer Zheng Kai via WeChat to ask for his opinion.
location: At home in the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian (living room and downstairs).

name: Accompanying daughter with washing up and bedtime stories
description: After the father and daughter returned home, Song Yajing bathed her daughter and then read two picture books from the Warm House series until her daughter fell asleep quietly.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening study and preparation of dessert class materials.
description: Song Yajing returned to the living room and listened to the mango mousse recipe voice message from the pastry chef, carefully learning the skill of mirror glazing and taking screenshots to save the recipe. Then she opened her phone calendar and set an alarm for 7:30 Saturday morning with the note "Prepare dessert class materials and set off." After that, she bought a bag of imported gelatin sheets online, expected to arrive on Friday, and reconfirmed the materials list for Sunday's dessert class.
location: Living room/study at home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Store review and family health pact update.
description: Song Yajing recorded the day's store revenue in her ledger, highlighting the initial idea for the 'early bird price.' Then she took out the 'Family Health Pact' she had made with her husband and updated the progress under the morning running goal to '2/4.' She looked at the paper with satisfaction, realizing that as long as she kept at it, many things were moving in a good direction.

He then gave a complete demonstration of the whole process, from simmering the mango puree, mixing in the gelatin, whipping the cream, to pouring into molds and refrigerating, breaking down the key points at every step. Song Yajing was fully focused, filling her notebook with key steps and temperature parameters, and filmed several key mixing videos with her phone.
location: Xianhou Baking Studio, No. 120 Xianhoushe, Huli District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

Master Chen walked over to her and guided her to stop as soon as the streaks disappeared, ensuring the mousse mixture was in perfect condition. She carefully poured the mousse mixture into a 6-inch mold, gently tapped it to release air, and put it in the refrigerator to set. While waiting, she thoroughly cleaned the mixing bowl, spatula, and other tools, and observed the other trainees' creative mold designs.

description: The new window display attracted several young female passersby, who stopped to admire it and take photos. One of them immediately asked about the pre-sale method for the collaboration collection. Song Yajing warmly received them and took the opportunity to introduce the store's new autumn arrivals. When there were few customers, she took a moment to take a few photos of the new window display with her phone and posted them to the store's community group and Moments, with the caption: “A new week, a new look. Let linen and nature open a peaceful day for you.” In addition, she replied to several regular customers' WeChat inquiries, one of whom, Vivian, asked about a new sweater. Song Yajing promised to notify her first when it arrived next week.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch and nap, organizing recipes
description: At lunchtime, Xiaomei stayed behind at the store, and Song Yajing went alone to her favorite Minnan satay noodle shop at the end of the pedestrian street and brought a takeout portion of satay noodles back to the store. She specifically asked the boss to add more tofu and bean sprouts and less noodles. Back at the store, she sat on a chair behind the counter and quietly finished her lunch with a glass of warm water. After eating, she did not rest immediately. Instead, she took out her phone, opened the memo app, and began organizing the mango mousse recipe she had learned from Chef Chen the day before. She recorded the ingredient list, key steps, and precautions item by item, and added the photos of the finished product she had taken the day before, planning to later compile everything into a complete illustrated tutorial and share it in the community.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Afternoon work: handling orders, store operations, and closing preparation.
description: In the afternoon, as her energy recovered, Song Yajing began the main part of her work. She contacted the supplier Susan via WeChat, and Susan sent over pictures of a batch of heavy coats and sweaters. Based on her knowledge of the Xiamen market, Song Yajing focused on selecting several lightweight but well-tailored double-faced wool coats and quality cashmere-blend sweaters, and removed a few long styles that were, in her view, too heavy and had a short selling period. After choosing 8 styles as the first round of winter pre-orders, she confirmed the prices and estimated arrival time with Susan, then paid a deposit. After handling the order, Song Yajing continued to welcome several customers and helped them put together outfits. At 3:30 p.m., when the store became quieter, she told Xiaomei she was stepping out, went to the milk tea shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street across the street, bought a jasmine green milk tea with less sugar, and rested on a high stool by the window for 15 minutes. She took a photo of the bustling street outside the milk tea shop and sent it to her close friends group chat. Li Meiling replied instantly: “Slacking off again!” She smiled and sent back a playful “nya nya nya” emoji. Back at the store, she thought about the progress of the co-branded collection and proactively sent a WeChat message to the designer in Hangzhou, asking about the confirmation of fabric samples. In polite but tactful terms, she expressed her hope to finalize the fabric as soon as possible to avoid delaying the sampling progress. The designer replied that they would make a final confirmation today and get back to her. Afterward, she and Xiaomei tidied up the store together, and she instructed Xiaomei to close up as usual at 5:30.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Closed the store and walked to pick up her daughter.
description: At 4:30 p.m., Song Yajing left the store. She deliberately detoured to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and used loose change to buy Xuanxuan a small pack of her favorite animal stickers, as a little reward for behaving well at the dentist today. Then she walked quickly to the kindergarten.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up Xuanxuan and take her to the dentist for fluoride treatment.
description: After picking up her daughter, Song Yajing held her little hand and walked toward the community dental clinic while chatting. On the way, she took out stickers, and Xuanxuan laughed happily. At the clinic, Xuanxuan was still a little nervous about the dental chair and instruments in the treatment room, and tightly gripped her mother's hand. Song Yajing squatted down and gently reassured her: Xuanxuan is a brave little princess, just like your favorite Elsa. It will be over soon. The fluoride application was very quick, and the dentist's movements were skillful; it was done in less than five minutes. After the examination, the dentist said her daughter's teeth were developing well, and she just needed to keep up the brushing habit.
location: Community dental clinic near Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bought bread as a reward and walked home
description: After leaving the clinic, Song Yajing kept her promise and took Xuanxuan to the 85°C Bakery in nearby Zhonghua City, buying a bag of Xuanxuan's favorite whole wheat toast and a box of plain yogurt as a reward. On the way home, as the sun was setting and the evening breeze gently blew, Xuanxuan sipped her yogurt and told her mother about the painting she did in kindergarten today, saying she painted yesterday's mango mousse cake. Song Yajing smiled in response, feeling incredibly tender at heart.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner and eat together as a family
description: When she got home, Aqiang was already off work and at home. Song Yajing tied on an apron and started preparing dinner. She made tomato scrambled eggs, which Xuanxuan loved, and stir-fried pork, which Aqiang liked, plus a plate of sautéed seasonal vegetables and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. The family of three sat around the dining table, sharing what each of them had seen and heard that day over the meal. Aqiang talked about his new colleague at the company, while Xuanxuan recounted what she had seen at the dental clinic. The atmosphere was warm.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening parent-child time: drawing, reading picture books, bathing, and tucking in
description: After dinner, A Qiang cleared the dishes, while Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to her little desk. They took out crayons and drawing paper and together drew their experience at the dentist that day. Xuanxuan used crayons to draw a big chair on the paper and colored it in seven colors, saying it was a rainbow dentist chair. Song Yajing sat beside her, recording her daughter's focused expression with a brush. After drawing, she read two picture books to Xuanxuan: one was The Fresh Things on Tooth Street, and the other was Little Bear Doesn't Brush His Teeth. After reading, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to bathe. She applied her daughter's favorite strawberry-scented body wash, washed her hair, and rinsed it off. After the bath, she helped Xuanxuan into her pajamas, told a little bedtime story, and watched her daughter's breathing gradually steady, her eyelids slowly droop, and finally fall into a deep sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handled the fabric color difference issue.
description: Just as Song Yajing was about to wash up, her phone vibrated. It was a WeChat message from the Hangzhou designer saying that the silk fabric sample for the co-branded collection had obvious color deviation and could not be used, so an alternative needed to be confirmed urgently. She immediately got up, walked to the study, and started a video call with the designer. In the video, they compared the color cards of several alternative fabrics one by one, discussed how different colors would affect the design, and finally chose an alternative fabric with a similar color and texture. They agreed to send out the sample for confirmation early the next morning.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal washing up and pre-sleep relaxation.
description: After finishing work, Song Yajing let out a long sigh of relief, feeling she had overcome another small challenge. She went to the bathroom to wash her face, brush her teeth, and do her skincare routine. Before bed, she thought about the next day's plans and left a sticky note for A Qiang on the refrigerator: 'Please bring back a box of eggs for me tomorrow morning, thanks, husband.' Back in the bedroom, she leaned against the headboard, picked up a book she had been reading recently about balancing life and work, and flipped through a few pages. Ten minutes before sleep, she turned off the light, took a few deep breaths, and reviewed the fulfilling day in her mind. Although she was going to bed late because of work, she felt a sense of calm and satisfaction at having finished.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning family time.
description: At 6:35 a.m., the alarm went off. Although Song Yajing had gone to bed a little later than usual because she had been discussing fabric samples the night before, she insisted on getting up. She did 10 minutes of gentle stretching in bed for her shoulders, neck, waist, and back to wake up her body. Then she washed up, changed into loungewear, and went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: hot milk and toast slices she had made herself spread with peanut butter. At 7:00 sharp, she woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into little pigtails. Mother and daughter sat at the table together and enjoyed breakfast. Xuanxuan reminded her mother to make cookies in the evening, and Yajing smiled and agreed.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting
description: At 7:30, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan by the hand and walked south along Hubin South Road to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, they passed the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, where she bought her daughter a box of the yogurt she liked. At 7:45, she watched Xuanxuan go in with the teacher at the kindergarten gate, waved goodbye, then walked through the back street to her shop on Zhongshan Road, about four minutes on foot. Along the way, she sent a WeChat voice message to the designer in Hangzhou to confirm the fabric replacement plan and inform her that the samples had been packed and would be sent via SF Express.
location: From 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Store opening preparations, shipping, and community warm-up
description: Arrived at the store at 8:10. After opening the door to air out the space, she cleaned the floor, wiped the display racks and the cashier counter, and changed the water for the potted plants in the store. She adjusted the window display, featuring a newly arrived linen shirt as the main item, paired with a plain scarf. Then she packed up the fabric samples, walked to SF Express at No. 133 Gugong Road to send them, saved the tracking number, and photographed it to send to the designer. The round trip took about 35 minutes. Back at the store, she brewed a pot of rose jasmine tea, briefly browsed yesterday's community chat logs, then drafted the teaser for the afternoon's 'mystery guest' and posted a preview in the group: 'A mystery guest is coming this afternoon to give everyone a treat. Stay tuned~' This sparked curiosity among the group members.
location: SF Express at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province; and 133 Gugong Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning operations and customer complaint handling
description: The store officially opened for business at 9:30, and soon a customer who had made an appointment for a return or exchange arrived. Song Yajing received her warmly. After carefully inspecting the loose thread at the collar of the dress, she immediately apologized sincerely and proactively offered a full refund or an exchange for another style. The customer was moved by her sincerity and ultimately chose to exchange it for a new-style knit cardigan, and also received a 20-yuan no-minimum voucher. In a good mood, the customer then tried on and bought a coat, and praised the store's beautiful displays as she left. Yajing smoothly resolved the customer complaint and facilitated an additional sale.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch break, lunch, and private chat between the couple.
description: At 11:30, shop assistant Xiao Mei arrived for the shift handover. Song Yajing ate takeout satay noodles in the rest area, replying to regular customers on WeChat between bites, asking for their opinions on the new autumn clothing and sharing styling photos. At 12:15, her husband Chen Zhiqiang sent a WeChat message saying he had been lurking in the group and observing, and felt the atmosphere was great. He wanted to join the community and occasionally help answer computer and network questions. Yajing felt warm inside, instantly replied "Welcome", then added him to the group and briefly told him the group's daily rules, letting him lurk first to get familiar with the vibe.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: In the afternoon, opened the shop and made an appearance in the community group with her husband.
description: Business continued in the afternoon. Song Yajing and Xiaomei sorted and put on the shelves the newly arrived new Chinese-style accessories (pearl hair clips, velvet headbands, etc.), while also thinking through the welcome process for Ah Qiang joining the group. Customers who had seen the morning preview in the group kept asking questions. At 14:30, Yajing formally welcomed Chen Zhiqiang, who joined the group under the nickname "IT Old Chen". After introducing himself confidently, he shared a method for enabling minimalist reading mode, which immediately sparked the group members' interest. They all @'d him to ask about phone cleaning, Wi-Fi speed-up, and other issues, and addressed him as "brother-in-law" to show their gratitude. Yajing privately messaged him to praise his perfect performance, and he replied with a smug emoji.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Closing the shop, shopping, and picking up the child
description: She closed the shop early at 16:00 and walked to the stationery store at Phase 2, Yubincheng, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, where she bought Xuanxuan a box of watercolor pens she had been asking about for a long time and a small pack of animal stickers as a reward. Then she walked about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and waited to pick up her child.
location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via the stationery store at Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child time and preparing dinner
description: Picked up Xuanxuan on time and handed her the stickers and colored pencils. The child jumped for joy. The mother and daughter walked home hand in hand. After arriving home, Song Yajing started preparing dinner: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steamed sea bass. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came home, helped Xuanxuan wash her hands, and prepared fruit. The atmosphere in the kitchen was harmonious.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Family dinner and parent-child activities
description: The family of three sat around the dinner table. Song Yajing shared how well Aqiang had performed in the group that afternoon, and Chen Zhiqiang looked embarrassed but had a smile on his lips. After dinner, Yajing kept her promise and took Xuanxuan to make cartoon bear and star-shaped cookies with the newly bought molds. Her daughter was overjoyed. Chen Zhiqiang cleaned up the kitchen nearby.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Washing up and putting the children to bed
description: Gave Xuanxuan a bath and changed her into pajamas. Mother and daughter read the picture books When Sophie Gets Angry and The Hungry Little Snake together. After reading, Yajing held Xuanxuan's little hand and said a simple bedtime prayer for all the happy things that happened today, gently coaxing her to sleep.
location: Home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Deep conversation between husband and wife.
description: After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang leaned back on the living room sofa and brewed a pot of Tieguanyin tea. Yajing opened her phone and showed Aqiang the lively screenshots from the afternoon group chat, photos of past community activities, and thank-you messages from customers. Chen Zhiqiang looked through them carefully and, for the first time, truly felt that what his wife ran was not just a clothing store but a warm community of mutual support among women. He held Yajing's hand and said sincerely, "So your world is this interesting. In the future, if you run into difficulties in your career, share some with me; don't carry them all alone." Yajing's eyes were warm, and the two had a deep exchange of ideas about future community operations and new Chinese-style clothing. Understanding and recognition flowed between them in their words.
location: Living room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to bed
description: After washing up and getting into bed, Song Yajing savored the moments of the day, especially her husband's words "Share a little with me," and felt deeply moved. With a sense of steadiness and happiness, she held Chen Zhiqiang's hand and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Indoor core, glute, and leg strength training
description: Outside the window a fine rain was falling, so I gave up the morning run plan. I spread the yoga mat in the living room and followed the phone app to complete a 20-minute core, glute, and leg workout. During the plank, I felt my core strength was more stable than at the beginning of the month, and my squats and glute bridges were more standard. A rainy day was exactly a good time to consolidate training.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and preparing breakfast
description: After training, I took a quick hot shower. Then I prepared breakfast for the family: toasted two slices of homemade whole-wheat toast, fried a sunny-side-up egg, served with hot milk, and cut apple slices into bunny shapes for Xuanxuan.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking daughter Xuanxuan to kindergarten.
description: At 7:25 I woke Xuanxuan up on time, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and put her hair in two little pigtails. Before leaving, each of us took a small umbrella and we walked to the kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan looked up and asked, “Mommy, will the rain stop after school today? I want to go buy the giraffe stickers we saw last time.” I smiled and promised her that if the rain stopped, I would take her.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chatting with neighbor Aunt Zhang at the school gate
description: After dropping off Xuanxuan, I ran into my neighbor Aunt Zhang at the school gate. She had just come back from the vegetable market and insisted on giving me a bag of piping hot chive pockets, saying, 'Yajing, I just made these this morning. Eat them while they're hot! You're busy all day long, so take care of yourself.' I thanked her again and again. The warm neighborly kindness made the autumn morning especially heartwarming.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the store and preparing for the day
description: After a two-minute walk to the store, the shop assistant Xiaomei was already wiping the display window. We placed our umbrellas on the umbrella stand, and I changed out of my rain-soaked canvas shoes into the store's new wool slippers. I then adjusted the display of the new Chinese-style coats in the window, moving a cream-white one to the most prominent position. Meanwhile, I boiled water, brewed a cup of jasmine tea, and quickly browsed last night's messages in the customer group.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Had a video conference with the Hangzhou designer team to follow up on sample production.
description: Had a video call with the Hangzhou design team via WeChat. They told me the fabric samples sent yesterday had been received, and the first sample garment of the new Chinese-style women's line had entered the cutting stage, expected to arrive in Xiamen around November 3. I carefully checked the cutting diagrams, fabric color differences, and measurement data they sent, and marked on my phone calendar: On the afternoon of November 5, invite Vivian and 3 other core community members to the store for in-person fitting feedback.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: In-store customer reception and community operations.
description: After 10 o'clock, a few tourists sheltering from the rain and regular local customers came in one after another. While helping a slightly plump woman find a slimming A-line skirt, I took a moment to send a good-morning greeting in the customer group and announced that a batch of new minimalist commuter-style items would be available this Saturday. At the same time, I contacted supplier Susan to confirm that the fabrics for the eight winter pre-sale styles agreed on last Friday had been put on the looms and were expected to ship by October 31.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch time: takeout shacha noodles
