description: Around noon the rain grew heavier, and there were very few customers in the store. Xiaomei and I ordered takeout from a nearby time-honored satay noodle shop and sat in the rest area eating and chatting about the morning's work. Xiaomei said that a customer had just taken a fancy to the new Chinese-style jacket in the window and asked whether it could be reserved. My confidence in the co-branded collection grew a little more.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Organize October exercise and baking notes and November plans.
description: The store was quiet in the afternoon. I made a cup of hot milk tea, pulled up the morning running log app and baking notes, and calculated that my cumulative mileage in October was about 35 kilometers. On the baking front, I successfully unlocked mango mousse. On a clean A4 sheet, I drew a simple November calendar and marked four major goals: 1. Increase morning runs to four times a week; 2. Learn to make a matcha opera cake; 3. Arrange the second offline community tasting event; 4. Complete the pre-launch copy for the co-branded community campaign.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Formally welcome IT Lao Chen in the customer group and interact.
description: Opened the customer group and saw that Aqiang's computer tips shared yesterday had received an enthusiastic response. I then officially welcomed "IT Old Chen" (Aqiang) in the group and organized a small activity: "Welcome our new friend, the tech guru 'IT Old Chen'! From now on, if any sisters have a slow phone, a computer malfunction, or can't find coupons when shopping online, they can @ him in the group. Brother-in-law will do his best to help everyone!" The group members all sent flowers to welcome him, and the atmosphere was very lively. I also reinforced Aqiang's image as the "reliable brother-in-law" in the group.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Video call with college classmate Zhou Ting to discuss financial management
description: At the scheduled time, I had a video call with Zhou Ting, my college classmate in Shenzhen. I asked her about the calculation logic for gross margin and turnover rate in the inventory management app. Zhou Ting was very patient and even shared a simple report template she had put together, suggesting that I use these data at the end of the month to analyze which styles are truly profitable and which should be discounted for clearance. I took careful notes and felt that this month's financial data finally had a professional analytical perspective.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Afternoon tea and store tidying
description: When it was almost time to pick up the child, Xiaomei and I hung back the clothes that customers had tried on and unpacked and organized the new packages that arrived in the afternoon. I went to the milk tea shop next door and bought two cups of grass jelly, gave one to Xiaomei, and told her she could wrap up early if there were fewer customers.
location: Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the nearby milk tea shop

name: Picked up her daughter from school and went to the stationery store to buy stickers
description: The rain had stopped, and the air was full of the fresh smell of earth. I walked to the kindergarten to pick up Xuanxuan and, keeping the promise I made in the morning, took her into the stationery store on South Park Road. Xuanxuan happily picked out a sheet of giraffe stickers she had been longing for, and also used her pocket money to choose a pink strawberry hair clip for her mother.
location: South Gongyuan Road Stationery Store, No. 35 South Gongyuan Road, Phase 2, Yubin City, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home to prepare dinner and discuss returning to Quanzhou for New Year's Day with my husband
description: After returning home, I first dealt with the chive pockets Aunt Zhang gave me in the morning, cutting them and arranging them on a plate. For dinner, I planned to make simple tomato and egg noodles, plus a cold cucumber salad. While busy in the kitchen, I chatted with Aqiang, who was fixing Xuanxuan's toy in the living room, about the New Year's Day plans: 'Aqiang, I want to take three days off while the store is quiet during New Year's, and let's drive back to Quanzhou to see Mom and Dad. I'll bring back the batch of warm clothes that arrived at the store for them.' Aqiang immediately agreed: 'Okay, I'll drive, and Xuanxuan can also play more with her grandparents.'
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner together and syncing the family calendar
description: The whole family sat around the table eating noodles, and the atmosphere was warm. After the meal, I took out the family electronic calendar, marked the three days from December 31 to January 2 as "Quanzhou Trip", and reminded myself to buy tonics for my parents in advance, as well as the shop's new cashmere scarves.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Played with daughter, read picture books, and put her to sleep.
description: After the meal, Xuanxuan couldn't wait to take out her newly bought stickers and stuck them all over our old picture books. I played a role-playing game with her for a while and then read two picture books about the kingdom of teeth. At 8 p.m., I gave her a hot bath, dried her hair, and after finishing the bedtime story, she fell sweetly asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Review the day's work and confirm tomorrow's to-dos.
description: Returned to the study, opened the phone notes app, reviewed today's work, and made a to-do list for tomorrow: 1. Confirm the winter pre-sale logistics tracking number with Susan; 2. Import the October notes compiled today and Zhou Ting's report template into the computer for backup; 3. Take some time in the evening to think about New Year gifts for Mom and Dad.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening chores, skincare, and relaxing reading
description: She sorted the clothes she had changed out of during the day and put them into the washing machine. Then, on the balcony, she did a simple evening skincare routine while enjoying the evening breeze. Afterward, she leaned against the headboard and read half an hour of the urban romance novel she had been following, completely relaxing her nerves that had been tense all day.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and bedtime prayer
description: She closed her novel, felt grateful for all the wonderful encounters and smooth communication today, said a brief bedtime prayer for her family's health, the steady development of the shop, and the upcoming trip to Quanzhou. At 10:30 p.m. she turned off the lights and went to bed on time, looking forward to another fulfilling and beautiful day tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early Morning Preparation
description: Woke up to the alarm clock. It was drizzling outside and the air felt fresh. After a quick wash-up, I put on a waterproof and windproof trench coat, tied my hair into a high ponytail, and drank a glass of warm honey water to prepare for my morning run. My body felt awakened, and I was full of anticipation for running in the rain.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Morning run in the rain and making the monthly plan
description: Put on my running shoes, walked to Yundang Lake, and jogged 3 kilometers in the light rain. The raindrops hit my face, my steps were light, and after the run I felt refreshed both physically and mentally. When I got home and stretched, I opened the phone memo and wrote down the November morning running plan: every Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday, at least 3 kilometers each time, monthly goal 50 kilometers. I took a screenshot and sent it to my husband Chen Zhiqiang with the note 'Please supervise~'. He immediately replied with an OK hand gesture.
location: At home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, and the Yundang Lake walkway, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China.

name: Shower and prepare a nutritious breakfast
description: Take a hot shower and change into comfortable loungewear. Toast two slices of whole-wheat bread and make a cup of hot milk. Meanwhile, put the fresh lemon slices and honey prepared last night into a small glass jar, ready to bring to the store to make a drink with water.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Gently wake up daughter Xuanxuan, help her put on her Thursday activity uniform for kindergarten, and braid her hair. The two of them go out sharing one transparent umbrella. On the way, she excitedly says there is a painting class today. Check her little backpack and remind her that after school she will be taken to the stationery store to buy stickers. She nods happily.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Walk to the clothing store
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Yazhi Boutique Clothing Store. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to supplier Susan asking for the logistics tracking number for the fabric shipment, and replied to messages from several regular customers.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Shop opening preparation and morning tidy-up
description: After opening the shop, she turned on the lights, boiled water and made a cup of jasmine tea, checked yesterday's messages, tidied the shelves, and got ready for the day's business, feeling relaxed.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Handling returns and exchanges and VIP follow-up calls
description: A customer asked for a refund after comparing prices online. Song Yajing invited her to the rest area and patiently explained the return and exchange policy, then proactively offered a free professional alteration service, which the customer gladly accepted. Afterwards, she called the three customers who had made appointments for the co-branded item, confirmed their sizes one by one, and told them they could try the sample in store on November 5th.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Communicated with store staff and handled store operations.
description: After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, the two had a quick meeting. Xiaomei shared the community group's response to the teaser poster. Song Yajing presented her tea-break ideas: milk roll cake, osmanthus oolong tea jelly, and mini Nanputuo vegetarian cakes, with printed silk scarves and custom sachets as souvenir gifts. Then they sorted the newly arrived accessories together and received several groups of customers.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Lunch break and releasing the tasting event poster.
description: Xiaomei brought back two takeout boxes of satay noodles, and the two ate and chatted. At exactly 12:00, the teaser poster for the "First Look at New Chinese Style for Late Autumn and Early Winter" was released on schedule in the customer community group. Within 5 minutes of the message being sent, all 15 spots were filled through the sign-up chain. She immediately posted a thank-you message and follow-up arrangements in the group.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Sales follow-up and financial organization.
description: After lunch, while looking after the store, she handled some matters: confirmed the fabric logistics sent by supplier Susan via SF Express, with the tracking number already sent and the shipment expected to arrive at the store tomorrow afternoon; at 2 p.m., used the inventory management app to generate the October sales and inventory report, exported an Excel backup to iCloud and the computer's hard drive, and after reviewing the profit analysis, decided to completely give up handwritten ledger bookkeeping starting tomorrow.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Phone call with mother and store reception.
description: In the afternoon, customers came to the store one after another. Around 14:45, her mother Lin Xiuying called to ask about the weather and clothing. Song Yajing shared her morning run and the good news that her daughter Xuanxuan had won an award for her drawing. Her mother happily promised to make something delicious for her granddaughter on the weekend, and the call lasted about 15 minutes. Song Yajing felt warm inside.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Store closing preparations and planning for tomorrow's date
description: After seeing off the last customer, she started closing the store. She had Xiaomei put the merchandise back in its place, while she planned tomorrow's date night, considering the newly opened “Cuowei” restaurant in Zhonghua City. She jotted down outfit ideas in her phone notes: a modern Chinese-style xiangyunsha shirt with black wide-leg trousers.
location: Elegant Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Close the store and go shopping
description: After handing over to Xiao Mei, she closed the shop on time; walked to the stationery store on Park South Road and bought a set of giraffe 3D stickers for her daughter Xuanxuan; then picked three bright yellow lemons at the corner fresh fruit stall, and the owner gave her a few lemon slices as a bonus.
location: The stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Yubin City Phase 2, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, and the nearby fresh fruit stall.

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Arrived at the kindergarten on time to pick up Xuanxuan and asked the homeroom teacher whether she had coughed during the day. The teacher said there were one or two light coughs in the morning but she was in good spirits. After thanking her, she took Xuanxuan's hand, and Xuanxuan excitedly showed off the 'Mushrooms in the Rain' painting she had drawn today.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Making dinner and caring for daughter
description: On the way home, she replied to messages in the community group. After arriving home, she prepared dinner; her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already at home playing with their daughter. She made a pot of tomato and egg dough-drop soup and stir-fried greens. After dinner, she filled her daughter’s small water bottle with freshly made honey lemon water and applied a warm towel to her back as her daughter leaned comfortably against her, watching cartoons.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: A family of three sat around the table eating dinner; after the meal, the husband washed the dishes, and Song Yajing read her daughter a picture book about "being brave at the doctor," then accompanied her in building LEGO. After their daughter yawned, she took her to wash up early and read a bedtime story, and she fell asleep peacefully around 20:05.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Evening tidying and community wrap-up
description: After confirming her daughter was sound asleep, she quickly washed up and did her skincare, then handled the day's wrap-up work: counting the number of sign-ups for the tasting event (15 people, full), posting the activity schedule preview and a warm reminder in the community; listing tomorrow's plans in her journal: picking up fabric, confirming the restaurant for the date, and preparing tasting event favors.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Evening prayer and communication with spouse
description: She turned on the bedside lamp, said her bedtime prayers, and gave thanks for the day's safety and care. She shared the good news that registration for the tasting event was booming with her husband, and he smiled in praise. The two briefly discussed tomorrow's date night; Song Yajing suggested going to "Cuowei", and her husband readily agreed.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Falling asleep peacefully.
description: After turning off the light, listening to the rain gradually fade outside the window, she felt at ease and content. Recalling the sense of accomplishment from her morning run, the day's gains at the shop, and her daughter sleeping peacefully, her body relaxed and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

name: Getting up and morning prayer
description: At 5:30 in the morning, just at dawn, Song Yajing woke up on time by her biological clock. She didn't rush to get up; instead, she gently closed her eyes and silently recited her morning prayers, thanking God for granting another peaceful day, praying that today's switch to electronic bookkeeping in the store would go smoothly, and asking for the safety of her family. After praying, she felt especially calm inside. She quietly got out of bed, washed up, and changed into comfortable sportswear.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning jog around Yundang Lake
description: It takes a 5-minute walk from home to reach the shore of Yundang Lake. Today was the last day of the one-month morning-running plan. The goal was to steadily complete 3 kilometers at a stable pace of 7 minutes per kilometer. Song Yajing opened the running app and jogged along the familiar route by the lake. She felt an unprecedented sense of ease, and every step was steady and powerful. After finishing, she checked the app: the average pace was exactly 7:02, even more consistent than yesterday. She stretched by the lake for 10 minutes, took deep breaths, and savored the cool early-autumn morning air and the shimmering lake surface, her heart full of affirmation for her persistence.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shopping at the Eighth Market
description: After her morning run, Song Yajing walked about 25 minutes to the nearby Eighth Market. The market was lively at this hour. She headed straight to her usual meat stall, greeted the owner, picked two pork ribs and two fresh sweet corn cobs, and also bought some scallions and ginger. Remembering that her daughter Xuanxuan had a slight cough last night, she decided to stew a light and sweet corn and pork rib soup for her this evening. She chatted a bit with the stall owner auntie, mentioning that the store would be trying a new ledger today. The auntie said cheerfully, “You're always making things happen, but the more you do, the better it gets!”
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going home to shower and prepare breakfast
description: It takes about 22 minutes to walk home from Bashi Market. After arriving home, Song Yajing first put the pork ribs and corn in the refrigerator, then took a quick shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. The timing was just right: she toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread and warmed three cups of milk, and a simple yet nutritious breakfast for three was ready.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking Up Her Daughter and Family Breakfast
description: At 7:20, Song Yajing gently pushed open the door of her daughter Xuanxuan's room and softly woke her up. The little one still wanted to stay in bed a bit longer, so she coaxed, 'Mommy will take you to buy new watercolor pens today, but you can only pick one box, because you just recovered from a cough yesterday and we can't spend too much money.' Hearing this, Xuanxuan immediately became wide awake and nodded happily. She helped Xuanxuan put on her favorite pink floral dress and tied her little braids. When the family was eating breakfast in the dining room, Song Yajing reminded her daughter again to buy watercolor pens after school. Xuanxuan took a big sip of milk and said in a sweet, babyish voice, 'OK!'
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Taking daughter to school and buying school supplies
description: At 7:50, Song Yajing and Xuanxuan set off hand in hand and walked about 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, she briefly told the teacher that Xuanxuan had still had a slight cough the night before and asked the teacher to keep an eye on her and let her drink more water. After watching her daughter run into the classroom, Song Yajing continued to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, just a few steps away. As agreed, she let Xuanxuan go into the store and choose by herself. Xuanxuan made a careful selection and finally happily picked out a box of 24-color watercolor pens, which cost 15 yuan.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province   Stationery Store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Head to the store and prepare for opening.
description: It takes about 10 minutes to walk from the stationery store to Yazhi Fashion Store. After arriving, Song Yajing opened the rolling shutter door with her key. The first thing she did was turn on the small spotlights in the store and play light, upbeat music, making the whole space bright and cheerful. Then she picked up a cloth and wiped the counter, cash register, and desktop, and adjusted the autumn outfit matching on the mannequin in the window, making sure everything was in perfect condition to welcome the new day.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sealing the manual ledger and starting electronic bookkeeping.
description: The atmosphere was solemn and quiet. Song Yajing took out the handmade ledger she had used for nearly a year; the cover was already somewhat worn. She picked up a marker and carefully wrote 'As of 2025.10.31' on the cover, then took a photo as a keepsake. As if saying goodbye to an old friend, she solemnly locked it in the very back of the filing cabinet. Just then, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. Song Yajing opened the inventory management app on her phone, sat down beside her, and demonstrated step by step in detail how to enter sales, inventory, and returns, emphasizing repeatedly: 'From now on, every single transaction is recorded only here. We are completely saying goodbye to the paper era. Starting today is the new epoch!'
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning business and electronic ledger process verification
description: The store had few visitors that morning, and Xiaomei was in charge of receiving the occasional customers who came in. Song Yajing sat behind the counter and carefully checked every order Xiaomei had entered into the system. Sure enough, she found a sales amount that looked abnormal because the decimal point had been misplaced by one place. She immediately called Xiaomei over, used a pen to show the correct position on paper, and stressed the importance of double-checking again. Xiaomei stuck out her tongue sheepishly. Meanwhile, Song Yajing took the time to send supplier Susan a WeChat message to confirm the logistics tracking number for the winter pre-order fabric to be shipped next week. Susan said it had already been arranged.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and WeChat socializing
description: At noon, Xiaomei went out to buy lunch. Song Yajing ordered a takeout of her usual satay noodles. While waiting, she quickly replied to several regular customers' inquiries about the sizes of new products, and also sent a voice message to her elder sister Song Yawen, sharing the joy that the first day of the electronic ledger had passed without major errors: "Sis, on the first day, I surprisingly made no major mistakes—I can finally put my mind at ease!" Her sister was happy for her too. Song Yajing also liked the photo of Shenzhen food that Wang Jia had posted in the besties' group chat.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon business operations and focused work
description: In the afternoon, two female customers came in together. Xiaomei enthusiastically styled outfits for them and successfully sold three pieces of autumn clothing. Song Yajing used this relatively quiet time to observe sales through the surveillance camera while carefully studying the various reporting functions in the app's backend. She tried out the inventory alert and income-expense statistics modules to prepare for more refined management next month. Around 4 p.m., the customers left satisfied, and the store became quiet again.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: App month-end automatic inventory check and results sharing
description: With half an hour left before closing, Song Yajing tapped the “month-end inventory count” button in the inventory app ahead of time. The system ran for a few minutes and popped up a precise inventory report. She looked nervously and found the discrepancy rate was only 0.5%! A hat had shown as abnormal because a child tried it on and put it back on the wrong shelf. She quickly found it in a corner of the fitting room and restored the inventory. Barely able to contain her excitement, Song Yajing immediately took a screenshot of the discrepancy report and sent it privately to her financial mentor Zhou Ting: “Ting, look! 0.5%! I'm completely saying goodbye to muddled accounts!” Zhou Ting replied instantly: “Now this is my good student. Congratulations!” She was so happy she could hardly stop herself from humming.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the store and handing over the shift
description: At 16:30, Song Yajing and Xiaomei did the final closing tasks together. She checked the power supply, doors, and windows, and verified the day's total takings with Xiaomei; everything matched. She told Xiaomei, "Tomorrow is Saturday and there may be a lot of customers, so please work hard too." Xiaomei smiled and said no problem, then left work first. Song Yajing locked the shop door, and as the day's work came to an end for now, she felt especially lighthearted.
location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and buy more stationery
description: Walked to the kindergarten, timing was just right, and Song Yajing picked up the bouncing Xuanxuan. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her mother, she proudly handed her a drawing: three little figures holding hands, with crooked characters reading "home". Song Yajing felt a warmth in her heart, squatted down, and kissed her. Then, as they had agreed in the morning, they went to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road. Xuanxuan was again well-behaved this time, taking only a box of watercolor pens. Song Yajing smiled and paid, fulfilling her little wish.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province   Stationery Store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Song Yajing put on an apron and got busy. First she blanched the pork ribs, then put them in a clay pot with corn and ginger slices to simmer. Before long, the whole house was filled with fragrance. Next, she quickly stir-fried a plate of garlic broccoli and a signature dish of assorted fish in soy sauce broth. Xuanxuan was quietly watching cartoons in the living room, occasionally running over to look at her mother and calling out, 'Mom, it smells so good!'
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang returned home from work, and the family of three sat around the dining table. The corn and pork rib soup was indeed the most popular. Xuanxuan drank two full bowls and said in a sweet, childlike voice, "The soup mommy makes is the best!" Chen Zhiqiang was also full of praise. Song Yajing also drank a big bowl of soup. The family of three chatted and laughed, sharing stories about their day. Smiling, Song Yajing mentioned today's 0.5% discrepancy rate in the electronic accounts. Chen Zhiqiang gave a thumbs-up and said, "Honey, you're amazing!"
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-dinner walk and family time.
description: After dinner, Chen Zhiqiang suggested going out for a walk before dark. The family of three walked to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan ran across the lawn chasing a few dragonflies, her laughter crisp and bright. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang sat side by side on a bench, watching their daughter and chatting about the funny things that had happened in the shop that day. Her husband also shared the news that a project at his company had just gone live. On the autumn evening, with a gentle breeze, it felt especially pleasant and warm.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Helping her daughter take a bath and reading picture books
description: Back home, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan wash up and take a bath, then changed her into clean cartoon pajamas. That day, she specially chose a picture book about "the little rabbit looking for autumn" and told her daughter the story in the gentlest voice. Xuanxuan leaned against her, soon calmed down, her breathing gradually steadied, and she drifted into a sweet dream.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Verify personal accounts and report to the family group
description: Looking at her daughter's sleeping little face, the day's fatigue seemed to vanish. Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, sat back against the headboard, opened the inventory management app, and carefully checked the day's operating revenue transactions against the total amounts received via Alipay and WeChat Pay—every item matched exactly. She let out a satisfied sigh and took a screenshot of the day's business report. Then she sent a message in the 'Happy Family' group: 'Day one of electronic bookkeeping, a perfect wrap-up! Tonight's pork rib soup was also super delicious! Good night, everyone!' and attached the report screenshot. Her mother, Lin Xiuying, quickly replied with a voice message: 'A-Jing is getting more and more impressive, we're so proud of you!' After that, Song Yajing suggested to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was scrolling on his phone: 'Tomorrow is Saturday and the weather is nice. Let's take Xuanxuan to Gulangyu for a walk? We haven't been there in a long time.' Chen Zhiqiang put down his phone, nodded, and said, 'Sure, I'll drive to the ferry terminal tomorrow morning.'
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp. Song Yajing closed her eyes and prayed silently, grateful for today's smoothness and her family's well-being, asking for her family's safety and steady career progress. After praying, she softly said goodnight to her husband and fell asleep peacefully with a satisfied feeling about the day.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning care and financial handling.
description: Song Yajing woke up in the caregiver chair and immediately checked on her mother, confirming that the monitor showed stable vital signs. While her mother was sleeping soundly, she opened the family electronic ledger, transferred the reserved premium to a dedicated bank card, and sent a screenshot with the note 'November premium has been set aside, rest assured' in the family group 'Our Home'. Afterwards, she went to the hallway to fill her thermos with warm water, ready for her mother to drink when she woke up.
location: Neurology ward, Dongjie Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dongjie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Communicating with family and arranging the day's affairs.
description: Yajing sat on a bench in the hallway and sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, telling him that her mother's condition was stable and asking him and their daughter to come at noon and bring millet porridge. She then contacted her elder sister Song Yawen, who was far away in Shenzhen, to confirm the time of her arrival at Jinjiang Airport in the afternoon. Finally, she called her father Song Minghui, telling him to rest first and come to the hospital together with her sister after her sister arrived, to avoid excessive anxiety.
location: Corridor of the Neurology Ward, Quanzhou First Hospital (East Street Campus), No. 250 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Morning prayer and personal reflection.
description: Yajing walked to the small garden outside the inpatient building. In a quiet pavilion, facing east, she silently recited the morning scripture, praying for strength for her mother’s recovery, her family’s safety, and her own heart. When she finished, she watched the elderly doing morning exercises in the hospital, took a deep breath, and told herself that, as the backbone of the family, she must be strong.
location: Pavilion in the small garden outside the inpatient department, East Street Campus of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 250 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: In-depth communication about the condition and treatment plan.
description: After the doctor's rounds, Yajing took the initiative to find the attending physician, Dr. Wang, and asked in detail about all her mother's test results, the rationale for thrombolytic treatment, the risk points for the coming week, and the possibility of rehabilitation. Dr. Wang told her it was a mild cerebral infarction, not life-threatening, but required hospitalization for at least a week. Yajing took careful notes and asked about the possibility of transferring to Xiamen for rehabilitation. The doctor advised getting through the acute phase first before considering it.
location: Department of Neurology doctor's office, East Street Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 250 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Remotely handle shop, church, and daughter-related matters
description: Yajing returned to the hospital room and made quiet phone calls while her mother dozed. She first instructed shop assistant Xiaomei on weekend store operations, using the inventory management app to monitor sales, process orders, and follow up on the logistics of the co-branded items. Then she contacted Father Wang at Gulangyu Catholic Church to ask for prayers and request leave from this Mass. Finally, she sent a WeChat message to her daughter's homeroom teacher to ask for leave for Xuanxuan and request this week's study materials.
location: Neurology ward, Dongjie Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dongjie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Comforting and taking care of her mother.
description: Mother woke up and her spirits improved. Yajing used a straw to feed her mother a few sips of warm water, held her hand, forced a smile, and chatted about everyday things, reassuring her that it was just a minor ailment and telling her that the family would come to see her soon. Her mother's eyes moistened and she nodded slightly.
location: Neurology ward, Dongjie Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dongjie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Handle care matters and facility purchases.
description: Yajing went to the nurses' station to ask about long-term caregiver costs, and contacted caregiver Aunt Liu to start the noon shift. Then she bought care supplies such as bed pads and wet wipes, as well as personal daily necessities, at the hospital convenience store. After returning to the ward, she checked her mother's IV catheter, wiped her face and hands with warm water, then looked up the commercial medical insurance claim process for cerebral infarction on her phone and saved a screenshot.
location: Quanzhou First Hospital East Street Campus (Neurology Nurse Station and in-hospital convenience store), No. 250 Dongjie, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch and a brief reunion
description: Her husband Aqiang brought their daughter Xuanxuan to the hospital. Yajing asked the caregiver to watch over her mother and took the family to have lunch at Hao Cuobian Minnan Cuisine. She ordered clear soup noodles, satay noodles, and the like. During the meal, she discussed the follow-up arrangements with Aqiang: she would continue to stay overnight with her mother, while Aqiang and Xuanxuan would stay at her mother's old house so they could come over easily during the day. She also told Aqiang to clean the old house in the afternoon.
location: Hao Cuobian Minnan Cuisine (Quan'an North Road Branch), Quan'an North Road, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Deep communication therapy and family meeting
description: Her elder sister Yawen rushed over from the airport to the hospital. After a brief hug, the two sisters went together to find the head of the neurology department. Yajing explained their mother's condition and raised questions about transferring her for rehabilitation. Taking into account the opinion of the Shenzhen specialist that Yawen had brought, the head advised them to first settle down with conservative thrombolytic treatment, and to consider transferring her for rehabilitation only after her condition stabilized. The two sisters reached a consensus.
location: Director's Office, Neurology Department, East Street Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dong Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Handling miscellaneous chores and taking a short break
description: Yajing and her father discussed the follow-up care arrangement in the hospital pavilion: her father and the caregiver would handle the day shift, and she would take the night shift. Afterwards, she walked back to her mother's old house on Xinhua North Road, tidied the balcony plants, and packed a change of pajamas for her mother. After returning to the hospital, she sat alone on a garden bench for a while and sent WeChat messages to a few of her mother's old friends to let them know she was safe.
location: No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, mother's home

name: Companionship and care.
description: Yajing returned to the ward; her father and Aqiang were both there. Her mother's IV drip had finished, and she was visibly better, able to half-sit up in bed. Yajing patiently fed her mother millet porridge with a spoon, while her daughter Xuanxuan sang the children's song 'Good Mother' beside her, drawing a smile from her mother. A rare relaxed atmosphere filled the ward.
location: Neurology ward, Dongjie Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dongjie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and getting the family settled
description: Yajing asked her father to stay with her mother, while she took A Qiang, Yawen, and Xuanxuan to the "You Fuqi" Fujian restaurant on East Street for dinner. She ordered her mother's favorite dishes to take out, and during the meal she had a preliminary discussion with Yawen about sharing the follow-up treatment costs; Yawen said she would bear the larger share. After dinner, A Qiang took his daughter back to the old house to rest, while Yajing and Yawen returned to the hospital.
location: Lucky Fujian Restaurant, East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening care and sisterly late-night chat.
description: Yajing and Yawen quietly discussed their mother's future rehabilitation plan in the hospital ward corridor, including physical therapy, speech recovery, and dietary care. Yajing also opened the inventory management app and asked Xiaomei to send today's sales data and shop photos. After confirming everything was normal, she felt relieved for the time being.
location: Corridor of the Neurology Ward, Quanzhou First Hospital (East Street Campus), No. 250 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and personal time
description: Yajing saw her sister off back to the hotel, then helped her mother wipe her body and change the care pad, carefully checking the IV drip and oxygen connection. After washing up and changing into her pajamas, she sat on the companion bed, opened the Bible verses stored on her phone, and silently read a short passage, bringing a peaceful end to the day.
location: No. 250 East Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province; East Street Campus of Quanzhou First Hospital, Neurology Ward and Family Companion Area.

name: Night-shift care and dynamic monitoring
description: After the ward lights went out, Yajing lay on the accompanying bed and set an alarm for every hour. Each time the alarm rang, she got up quietly, checked her mother's chest rise and fall and temperature by the faint light from the corridor, checked the IV drip, and only lay back down after confirming everything was normal. She stayed by her mother's side, just as her mother had watched over her during her childhood.
location: Neurology ward, Dongjie Campus, Quanzhou First Hospital, 250 Dongjie Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Early morning awakening and gratitude prayer
description: Song Yajing woke up in the caregiver's chair and first checked whether her mother Lin Xiuying's breathing was steady. After confirming her mother was sleeping soundly, she tiptoed to the window, looked out at the drizzly gray sky, and silently made the sign of the cross in her heart, thanking God for turning her mother's condition around and praying for strength for recovery and her family's safety. After praying, she tucked the corner of the blanket around her mother, picked up the thermos, and got ready to fetch hot water.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Doctor's rounds and discussion of the condition
description: The attending physician arrived on time for the ward round. Song Yajing stood nervously by the bed. After examining her mother Lin Xiuying's pupil reflexes and limb muscle strength, the doctor smiled and told them that her recovery was better than expected: her limb muscle strength had recovered to grade 4, and the vascular unblocking had been very successful. After two more days of observation, she could be discharged to recuperate. Hearing this, her mother broke into a relieved smile, and Song Yajing thanked the doctor repeatedly, tears welling up in her eyes.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Tender care: sponge bath and hair combing.
description: After the doctor left, Song Yajing poured warm water into the washbasin, carefully wrung out a towel, and gently wiped her mother Lin Xiuying's face, hands, and arms. Then she took out the wooden comb her mother had used for over a decade, sat by the bed, and combed through her mother's slightly disheveled graying hair, strand by strand. The mother and daughter talked about memories from when her grandmother was ill, and the ward was filled with the warmth of remembrance.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Breakfast and brief work transition
description: Song Yajing went downstairs to the cafeteria in the inpatient building and bought light white porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed dumplings. Back in the ward, she cooled the porridge by blowing on it and fed it to her mother Lin Xiuying spoonful by spoonful. While her mother rested with her eyes closed, Yajing quickly checked her phone and sent a WeChat message to Xiaomei, the clothing store clerk, to ask about the shop. Xiaomei replied that everything was normal and some regular customers had sent their regards, which put Yajing's mind at ease.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Phone work interactions between caregiving tasks
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing tidied up the dishes, adjusted the height of her mother's headboard, turned on the TV to the Minnan opera channel, and lowered the volume. Then she sat in the caregiver chair, took out her phone, and posted several photos of the new outfit combinations she had organized the previous night in the "Elegant VIP Guest Group." Regular customers immediately liked and commented. Song Yajing replied to them one by one and promised to keep their sizes for them after returning to Xiamen.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Older sister delivers meals; sisters rotate shifts.
description: Her elder sister Song Yawen walked into the ward carrying an insulated container with crucian carp and tofu soup she had made at home, along with a few small dishes. Song Yawen sat on the edge of the bed, holding their mother's hand and asking how she was feeling, while Song Yajing took the opportunity to quickly wash up in the bathroom and hand-wash and hang up the clothes she had changed out of the night before. The two sisters agreed that Song Yajing would keep watch during the day and Song Yawen would stay overnight, so everyone could catch their breath.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon rehabilitation exercises and caregiving
description: Elder sister Song Yawen chatted with Mother, while Song Yajing helped Mother slowly walk a few laps around the ward. Although Mother's steps were still a bit unsteady, she could already stand independently, and Song Yajing kept encouraging her. Afterwards, she helped Mother sit in a chair and massaged her slightly stiff calves and arms to promote blood circulation.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch alone and a brief rest
description: Her elder sister Song Yawen continued to chat with their mother in the hospital room. Song Yajing left the hospital and walked to the nearby Guangyuan Congee Noodle House, where she ordered a steaming hot bowl of Quanzhou misua paste, added an order of vinegar pork and a youtiao, and ate slowly, enjoying a moment of relief from the pressure of the hospital.
location: Guangyuan Congee and Noodle Restaurant (Binhai Huating Community branch), No. 37 Ruitai Street, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the ward to take over from her sister.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing packed a serving of light vegetables and rice and walked back to the ward to bring it to her elder sister Song Yawen. When she returned to the ward, her sister had already fed their mother Lin Xiuying lunch. Song Yajing asked her sister to go back to the hotel to rest and took over the work of caring for her mother.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: A heartwarming visit from her husband and daughter.
description: In the afternoon, her husband Chen Zhiqiang brought their daughter Chen Lexuan from the hotel. As soon as Xuanxuan entered the ward, she sweetly called out "Grandma," ran to the bedside, and kissed her grandma. Her mother grinned from ear to ear. Xuanxuan then sang the children's song "Little Hand, Big Hand" for her grandma and performed a cute dance. Her mother clapped for her granddaughter with somewhat unsteady hands. Song Yajing took out her phone to capture this heartwarming moment. Zhiqiang walked over and gently put his arm around her shoulder.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening care and delivering meals with her husband
description: After the visit, her husband Chen Zhiqiang took their daughter back to the hotel. Song Yajing wiped her mother's body and changed her into a clean hospital gown. In the evening, Zhiqiang returned with a newly bought insulated lunch box containing fish maw chicken and soft, tender seasonal vegetables. Song Yajing playfully scolded him for spending too much, and Zhiqiang replied earnestly that he wanted to nourish her and her mother. The family of three had a quiet dinner in the ward, and her mother had a good appetite, eating about half a bowl of rice.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Walk after dinner and rehabilitation exercises.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing helped her mother walk slowly along the hospital corridor. Her mother moved forward step by step, using one hand to support herself against the wall, while Song Yajing carefully supported and encouraged her, saying that perhaps tomorrow they could go downstairs to see the flowers. After the walk, she massaged her mother's hands and feet and moved her joints.
location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City, Fengze District, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Quanzhou First Hospital Chengdong Branch, ward building, neurology ward and corridor.

name: Father's visit and family rehabilitation discussion
description: Father Song Minghui also arrived at the hospital, accompanied by elder sister Song Yawen. Father sat by the hospital bed, chatting with mother about everyday things, his eyes full of concern. Song Yajing discussed with her sister and father the upcoming rehabilitation arrangements for mother and the details of returning home to recuperate after discharge. They all agreed that after mother is discharged, she should first rest at home in Quanzhou, with the two sisters taking turns going back to care for her. In the evening, when the sister and father were about to leave, the sister again reminded Song Yajing not to get too tired at night and to call anytime if anything came up.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Evening wind-down and quiet prayer
description: In the evening, Song Yajing helped her mother wash up, wipe her body, and change into pajamas. After laying her mother down, she played some soft music, sat by the bed holding her mother's hand, and gently read a passage from the Bible to her. Her mother gradually fell asleep to her voice. Song Yajing drew the curtains, set her phone to silent, sat in the caregiver chair, closed her eyes, and silently prayed that her mother would sleep well tonight.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Late-night phone call confiding in her sister
description: After her mother fell asleep, Song Yajing quietly walked out of the ward and went to the small garden downstairs in the inpatient department, where she called her elder sister Song Yawen. On the phone, the sisters talked about the day's events and Yajing's worries and exhaustion. Her elder sister listened patiently, offering comfort from time to time, and promised to ask for leave and come back in a few days to help. After hanging up, Song Yajing sat for a while in the silent night and felt the heavy burden in her heart lighten considerably.
location: The small garden downstairs of the inpatient department, Quanzhou First Hospital Chengdong Branch, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the ward and settled down for the night
description: Back in the ward, Song Yajing made sure her mother was sleeping soundly, then quietly tidied the companion bed, set an alarm on her phone for the next morning, and sent her husband a text to let him know all was well. After lying down, listening to the rain outside the window and her mother's even breathing, she fell into a deep sleep feeling warm and grateful.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Building, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm vibrated softly, and Song Yajing woke up immediately. She tiptoed to her mother's bedside and saw that her breathing was steady and her complexion was a bit rosier than yesterday. She went to the public washroom on the floor to freshen up, splashing cold water on her face to wake herself up. When she came back, the caregiver had arrived for the shift change, and in a low voice she quickly handed over the details of her mother's urination last night and her stable sleep.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Assist mother with morning care and breakfast
description: Mother woke up in good spirits. Song Yajing wiped her face and hands with warm water and combed her hair. She could sit up more steadily by holding the bed rail by herself — a big improvement. The hospital delivered breakfast of multigrain porridge and steamed egg. Song Yajing cooled the porridge by blowing on it and fed her spoonful by spoonful. She ate faster than yesterday and even reached out to grab the spoon herself. Song Yajing smiled and encouraged her to take it slow. Seeing her eat with such an appetite, she felt glad inside.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Morning prayer and spiritual recharge
description: Her mother leaned against the headboard watching the morning news. Song Yajing sat on the companion chair by the window, opened the Bible app on her phone, and softly read Isaiah 40:31 to her mother. Then she closed her eyes and prayed silently, thanking God for giving her mother strength and peace today, asking Him to continue healing her body, and blessing Zhiqiang, Xuanxuan, and the small shop in faraway Xiamen with safety.
location: Window-side caregiver area, Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Morning rehabilitation session (first time)
description: Following the nurse's guidance, Song Yajing began passive rehabilitation for her mother in bed. She first massaged her mother's calf muscles, then held one hand under her ankle and the other on her knee, gently performing flexion, extension, and internal/external rotation while talking to her mother to distract her. After finishing the legs, she moved her fingers and wrists, making sure each movement was done properly. Her mother cooperated well and later even tried to exert a little effort herself.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Handling store affairs remotely (1)
description: Mother is taking a nap. Song Yajing takes out her phone, opens the "Yazhi" store's inventory management app, and checks yesterday's sales data; inventory is all normal. Then she opens WeChat and sees the store display photos sent by the clerk Xiao Mei, looking very fresh and neat. She replies: "Great! Thanks for your hard work. Is the group chat quiet this morning?" Xiao Mei replies instantly: "Don't worry, Sister Yajing, everything is normal. A regular customer is asking about the new styles."
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Discussed family matters with her husband.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang drove over from Xiamen, bringing fruit, Xuanxuan's snacks, and a few changes of clothes for Song Yajing. The two sat down on a bench in the corridor outside the ward and quickly discussed in low voices. Song Yajing said she needed to stay with her mother for a few more days; the doctor said she should at least be observed until the 4th or 5th. Zhiqiang nodded, saying that a batch of sample garments would arrive at the shop today and that he would drop by to help Xiaomei unpack and inspect them, so she could rest assured. Seeing that he had arranged everything properly at home and in the shop, Song Yajing felt much more at ease.
location: Bench in the corridor outside the neurology ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing and taking care of mother's lunch
description: When her mother woke up, Song Yajing helped her adjust to a sitting position. Lunch was steamed sea bass and soft noodles. She carefully removed every bone from the fish, then mixed the fish with the noodles and divided them into small bowls. As she fed her mother, she said, "Mom, when I was little and sick, did you feed me like this too?" Her mother, holding a mouthful of noodles, gave a soft "mm-hmm," and the two smiled at each other, warmth filling the hospital room.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and personal rest
description: After lunch, her mother took her medicine and fell asleep. Song Yajing lay down on the caregiver bed. Although her body was tired, her heart was at ease. She set a 30-minute alarm and closed her eyes to rest. Even though she was lying down fully clothed, being able to quietly rest for a while restored a lot of her energy.
location: Companion bed in the neurology ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon rehabilitation activity (second session)
description: After her mother woke from her nap, she was in good spirits. Song Yajing, again following the nurse's instructions, focused on moving her mother's ankles and hip joints, trying to make each movement gentle and accurate. This time her mother cooperated very well and even helped her with the movements. She joyfully encouraged her: "Mom! You really are getting better day by day! The doctor said after another two or three days of observation, we can walk home on our own!" Hearing this, her mother's mouth curved into a slight smile.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Handling Shop Affairs Remotely (2)
description: Her mother leaned against the headboard listening to Nanyin on the radio. Song Yajing opened the store’s VIP community on her phone and posted a teaser message: “Dear all, the early autumn new-style sample garments co-designed with our designer arrived at the store today! Tomorrow (November 4) I’ll have our shop assistant Xiaomei put together some simple styling displays and post them in the group for you to get a first taste. Stay tuned~!” She also attached a design sketch previously sent by the designer.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Video-called the store clerk to check on the store's situation
description: Song Yajing called Xiaomei on WeChat video. The camera swept across the store; the lighting was good and the displays were neat. Xiaomei reported in a clear voice that customer traffic today was decent—she had just sold a knit top and a skirt—and Brother Aqiang had also come to help receive the parcels, and the sample garments were all placed in the storeroom. Song Yajing told her to keep the displays in good order, chat more with regular customers about outfit matching, and not forget to make the lookbook images tomorrow. Seeing that the store was in perfect order, she finally felt completely at ease.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Keep mother company and let father know we are safe.
description: Song Yajing sat down by her mother’s bedside, watched local news with her, chatted about amusing things she had seen on the street, and tried to cheer her up. Afterwards, she called her father Song Minghui in their hometown and told him in detail about her mother’s recovery progress today and the doctor’s positive assessment, asking him not to worry. On the phone, her father reminded her to take care of herself too. After hanging up, she felt warm inside.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Assist mother with dinner and evening care.
description: During dinner, her mother was able to hold the bowl and slowly drink soup by herself. Her hands were still a bit shaky, but it was a huge improvement! Song Yajing's eyes welled up as she watched from the side, helping steady the bowl. After the meal, she fetched hot water, helped her mother wash up, and changed her into a clean hospital gown, making her feel fresh and comfortable.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Personal walk and simple dinner
description: The caregiver said she could help watch for half an hour. Song Yajing went downstairs alone and walked slowly a few laps around the hospital's central garden. The air was fresh after the rain; she took a few deep breaths and stretched her sore neck and shoulders. Then she went to the canteen and simply had a bowl of tomato and egg noodles to reward herself for the day.
location: Garden and cafeteria of the Inpatient Department, Chengdong Branch, Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Called family, emotional connection
description: Her mother was watching TV. Song Yajing first had a video call with her husband and saw her daughter Xuanxuan. The little one sweetly called "Mommy" from the other side of the screen, asked if Grandma was better, and said that today she had drawn a picture at kindergarten of Grandma picking flowers in the garden. She smiled and promised to put it up on the wall at home when she got back. After hanging up the video call, she called her sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen and described the progress of the past two days in detail. The two sisters talked for half an hour, cheering each other up, and she no longer felt so alone.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Evening prayer and journaling.
description: After settling her mother down to sleep, the hospital room grew quiet. Song Yajing sat on the companion bed, took out her phone's memo, and briefly noted down today's care points (her mother could hold her own bowl and her hip joint mobility had increased), store to-dos (remind Xiaomei tomorrow to take photos of the sample clothes), and family reminders (craft materials Xuanxuan needs to bring to kindergarten tomorrow). Afterwards, she silently prayed again in her heart, grateful for the day's peace and blessings.
location: Companion bed in the neurology ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: Song Yajing finished washing up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and lay down on the foldout bed. Before going to sleep, she sent WeChat messages to her husband and Xiaomei: A Qiang, thanks for your hard work today, good night. Xiaomei, I'll leave the store to you tomorrow. Then she dimmed her phone screen, turned her head to listen to her mother's steady breathing, felt very reassured, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital, No. 1028 South Anji Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation for hospital discharge.
description: At 06:30 in the early morning, as dawn was just breaking, Song Yajing woke up on the caregiver bed. The first thing she did was touch the cross around her neck and offer a brief morning prayer, thanking the Lord for keeping her mother safe through the night. She quickly washed up and tidied the hospital room. At 06:50 her mother woke up. Song Yajing helped her to the bathroom, washed her face, combed her hair, and took her blood pressure: 120/78 mmHg, a good reading. Seeing her mother in good spirits, she felt a heavy weight lifted from her heart. As she packed up, she began planning how to arrange things back in Xiamen to make things easier for her mother.
location: 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital).

name: Hospital breakfast and ward handover
description: Her father brought steaming hot plain congee and boiled eggs early in the morning. The three of them sat around the hospital bed and ate breakfast. Her father peeled eggs for her mother, while Song Yajing fed her mother congee spoonful by spoonful. During the meal, she again went over the discharge procedure and the doctor’s orders with her father, including key points such as a low-salt, low-fat diet, daily blood pressure monitoring, and a follow-up head CT one month later. She also saved the key instructions and her own phone number as a note on her phone so that her father could check it at any time.
location: 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (Neurology Ward, Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital).

name: Complete discharge procedures and pick up medication
description: After the doctor came on duty at eight, Song Yajing went to the doctor's office to get the discharge summary and diagnosis certificate, then queued at the first-floor window to settle the bill, and went to the pharmacy to pick up all discharge medications — antiplatelet drugs and blood pressure medication. At around nine, all the procedures were completed. She put the discharge summary, invoice, and drug instructions into a document folder and handed it to her father for safekeeping.
location: No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (Inpatient Department, Medical Insurance Settlement Window, and Pharmacy of the Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital)

name: Escort mother back to the old family home
description: At 9:50, Song Yajing called a ride-hailing car. Around 10:00, she and her father supported her mother on each side as they slowly walked out of the inpatient department and got into the car. The ride took about 21 minutes. She held her mother's hand the whole way and talked about the painting Xuanxuan had made in kindergarten yesterday. They arrived at the old house at about 10:20. She helped her mother sit on the sofa and covered her with a blanket.
location: The journey from No. 1028 Anji South Road, Fengze District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (Chengdong Branch of Quanzhou First Hospital) to No. 45 Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (old residence).

name: Settling Mother In and Handing Over Care
description: After settling her mother in, Song Yajing pulled her father to sit in the kitchen, opened the memo on her phone, and carefully explained every item the doctor had instructed, including how and when to take each medication. She stressed taking the medicine on time every day and measuring blood pressure once each morning and evening. She also wrote the hospital's contact number and follow-up appointment time in large letters on a sticky note and put it in the most visible spot on the refrigerator door. Her father thumped his chest and promised to be more careful.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (old family home)

name: Lunch and brief time spent together
description: Father cooked misua paste that the whole family loved, adding lean meat and eggs. Mother was in good spirits and ate most of a bowl. At the table, Song Yajing deliberately brought up the painting Xuanxuan had drawn of 'Grandma picking flowers,' which made her mother laugh heartily. This simple meal greatly eased the tension of the past few days.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (old family home)

name: Bidding farewell to parents and preparing to return to Xiamen
description: Just after 12:30, her husband Chen Zhiqiang's car stopped downstairs. Song Yajing did one last check of the notes and medications on the refrigerator and repeatedly reminded her father to call if anything came up. She hugged her mother, exchanged a deep look with her father, and then got into the car. Zhiqiang started the engine, and the car slowly drove away from the old house.
location: No. 45, Xinhua North Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (old family home)

name: On the way back to Xiamen, with bursts of inspiration
description: The car smoothly merged onto the Shenhai Expressway, with red-brick traditional houses and golden rice fields flashing past the window. Song Yajing leaned back in the passenger seat as the fatigue of the past few days gradually melted away. In her mind appeared the image of her mother as a young woman baking cakes in a floral apron, and that handwritten red baking notebook. She blurted out the idea of scanning the notebook and compiling it into a booklet to sell in the shop, with the proceeds donated to a foundation for the elderly. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang squeezed her hand in support.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Quanzhou-Xiamen section)

name: Returning home to rest and checking on the store remotely
description: They arrived home at about 2:30 p.m., and Zhiqiang helped carry the luggage upstairs. After Song Yajing washed her face and changed into loungewear, she sent a voice message to the store clerk Xiaomei to ask about the situation at the store. Xiaomei quickly replied that everything was normal and sent photos of the new styles, which made her feel much more at ease.
location: 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home)

name: Refining inspiration and preparing dinner
description: Song Yajing sat at the small desk in her study, opened the memo on her phone, and refined the plan for the baking recipe booklet she had conceived on the highway into specific steps: return to Quanzhou to find the red notebook, scan and organize the recipes, and find a designer for layout. She shared the idea with her sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen on WeChat. Her sister replied instantly and offered to help with the layout design, and the two had a lively discussion about the style and content of the booklet. After chatting, she glanced at her watch and decided to make sweet and sour spare ribs, Xuanxuan's favorite, for dinner tonight.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home study)

name: Prepare family dinner.
description: Song Yajing tied on an apron, blanched the pork ribs, and skillfully prepared the sweet-and-sour sauce. The oil sizzled in the pan, and the sweet-and-sour aroma filled the kitchen. She also washed the greens and tomatoes, ready to make a light seaweed and egg drop soup, using the taste of home to heal from several days of rushing around.
location: No. 128, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home kitchen)

name: Taking on household chores and enjoying dinner
description: At 5:20, her husband Chen Zhiqiang picked up their daughter Chen Lexuan from Siming Experimental Kindergarten. As soon as Xuanxuan entered the door, she threw herself into her mother's arms and asked about her grandmother's condition. At the dinner table, Song Yajing put a pork rib in her daughter's bowl and listened to her talk excitedly about the new children's song she learned in kindergarten. It was the most reassuring and comfortable meal in days.
location: 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home)

name: After-dinner family time and planning
description: After the meal, Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy up. Song Yajing sat on the sofa scrolling through old photos in her phone album of her mother making cakes, and the outline of a baking booklet became clearer and clearer. She opened the chat history with her sister, highlighted 'find Mom's red notebook' as a key task, and decided to go back to Quanzhou on the weekend to find the treasure.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room at home)

name: A warm time with my daughter before bedtime.
description: Song Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and leaned against the headboard. Xuanxuan showed off her new drawing full of cakes and a chubby grandma. She held her daughter and told a story about "a magical grandma and the world's most delicious cake." Xuanxuan drowsily asked when Grandma would make a cake. Song Yajing said softly that they could make one together once Grandma was a little healthier. Xuanxuan soon fell asleep with a sweet smile.
location: 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home)

name: Phone call with mother and personal reflection
description: Song Yajing gently closed her daughter's bedroom door and went back to her room to make a video call to her mother. Her father answered and said her mother had taken her medicine, her blood pressure was normal, and she had just lain down. Seeing her mother wave at her from the screen, her voice weak but calm, she gave her father a few instructions and hung up. Outside the window, the night was as tranquil as water. Right after that, a delivery rider in a yellow windbreaker arrived with two large jars of pickled sour plums made by Li Meiling, with a note: 'I'm seven months pregnant, so I can't come see you. Here's something to whet your appetite.'
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street complex, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Posted an 'admitting defeat' Moments post and interacted with her father.
description: You were amused by your two close friends' thoughtful gifts and felt warm inside. You arranged the protective gear and sour plums into a lively, homey display on the bay window and took a photo with your phone. Opening WeChat Moments, you wrote: “Backing down is a philosophy. I used to think backing down was a sign of weakness, but after turning 38 I realized that backing down means letting yourself off the hook. Thank you, my ladies.” You clicked send. Before long, likes and comments came pouring in. Your father, Song Minghui, commented: “That's right, take care of yourself.” You immediately replied with a “hug” emoji.
location: Bay window in the living room, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Video call with father.

During the call, you asked in detail about your mother's condition today and shared today's meal adjustment plan and the amusing story about receiving a gift from your best friend. On the other end, your father chuckled and said, "Your mom heard about your healthy eating thing and asked me to see if you want some free-range eggs from home." The two of you chatted for more than twenty minutes, and you felt even better.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street complex, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

I drew our home!” You showed them the results of today's shopping and the gifts from your close friends, and announced the upcoming “one-week experimental menu.” Xuanxuan asked curiously, “Mom, what is ‘li-mai’?” You smiled and explained that it was quinoa, telling her it was a very healthy superfood.

Then you stir-fried a plate of seasonal vegetables. Xuanxuan was in charge of setting the bowls and chopsticks. It was simple, but rich in color and nutritionally balanced.

Xuanxuan poked at the salmon with her fork and happily ate it dipped in lemon juice. You looked at them, and a sense of satisfaction welled up in your heart. This meal had no white rice, but no one complained.
location: Dining room, 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

It indeed supported your lower back better than your usual waist cincher. You decided to wear it to work tomorrow.

You plan to look through their résumés carefully tomorrow.

name: Writing a gratitude journal and organizing to-do items.
description: In the diary app, I recorded today’s three small blessings: the electric scooter made the commute easy, the Mediterranean dinner was accepted by the family, and my sister readily shared our mother’s medical expenses.
