My daughter wanted new stickers, so I stopped and let her pick two. Then we continued riding. I delivered her safely to the kindergarten gate, watched her say goodbye to her teacher, and then left.

Using mobile banking, she transferred 4,000 yuan to her father and sent a voice message saying it was half of her mother's medical expenses. We also neatly arranged all the samples in the live-streaming area within easy reach.

Xiaomei tried on the clothes and displayed them in front of the camera, while she professionally explained the fabrics, cuts, styling, and exclusive Double 11 discounts, guiding viewers to click and order via Kuaituantuan. The number of online viewers once reached 200. When the French floral-print dress sold out in an instant, she honestly apologized to the audience, explained that the conservative inventory had only been 20 pieces, and reassured everyone to check out other products or new product previews.

She promised that affected orders would receive a 20-yuan no-threshold coupon and a beautiful brooch as a gift with the shipment. Then she privately messaged regular customers who were upset one by one, sincerely explaining and apologizing.

Alone, she reviewed the events in her phone memo and wrote down the lessons: stocking up should be based on pre-sale data, crisis handling must be quick and sincere, and sales forecasts need to be recorded systematically. She saved screenshots of pending orders as records and reflected late into the night.

After washing up, she walked into the kitchen, put Greek yogurt, blueberries, and walnuts into a bowl, and made herself a Mediterranean-style breakfast. At the same time, she glanced at the milk and cereal that her husband Aqiang was already preparing. Then she gently woke their daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on her school uniform, and combed her hair. Before leaving, Xuanxuan reminded her about the strawberry cake promise. She squatted down and pinky-promised her daughter that she would definitely keep it on the weekend. On the walk to take Xuanxuan to kindergarten, she deliberately detoured into the M&G Stationery Store on South Park Road and let Xuanxuan pick out a pack of dinosaur stickers. Her daughter's face immediately lit up with a bright smile.

She opened the WeChat customer group 'Yajing Lifestyle Store' and began drafting an apology notice. At 8:50, she officially posted and pinned the apology in the group, sincerely apologizing for the stock-outs of some styles during last night's Double 11 livestream, and promised affected customers free shipping on their next order plus a handwritten thank-you card. After posting, she proactively sent a private message to the customer who had complained the most fiercely the night before and sent a long voice message with a sincere explanation. Seeing replies of 'I understand' and 'hugs' in the group, her taut heartstrings loosened a little.

The two of them worked together to check last night's Double 11 livestream orders on the iPad and computer, carefully marking about 30 orders that could not be fulfilled because the French-style floral print dresses and cardigans were out of stock. After checking them all, Yajing immediately contacted supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat, sent screenshots of the names and sales data of the out-of-stock styles, and followed up by voice message asking when the earliest restock would be, learning that the earliest restock would be next Wednesday.

name: Write a business reflection log and create a community pre-order management template
description: After hanging up Susan's voice message, Yajing took out her dark blue A5 ring-bound management notebook and wrote a serious reflection under the "Growth Notes" category: she realized that she needed to shift from intuitive purchasing to data-driven rational stocking, and before the next big promotion she must first run a community voting pre-order and inventory stress test. After writing, she took a photo to archive it, opened the memo app on her phone, and began to create a "Community Pre-order Process" template, writing down the steps one by one.

She took out her pocket notebook and wrote down the third small blessing of the day: after handling the community crisis, she gained the understanding of most customers.

Yajing took out her phone and tripod, and using the natural afternoon light at the store entrance, took several outfit photos of the new coats and scarves. Afterward, she sat at the cashier counter, browsed the 2025 winter trends report sent by Guangzhou-based designer Zheng Kai on her iPad, and saved the recommendation notes about the "new Minnan style."

name: Store closing tasks, receiving afternoon customers, and community maintenance.

During a lull, she also posted detail photos of some of today's new arrivals in the group chat. Afterward, she started to prepare for closing the shop: she quickly swept the floor and counted the day's revenue.

Yajing changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen. She made garlic stir-fried greens and braised pork ribs with rice for A Qiang, noodles with tomato and scrambled eggs for Xuanxuan, and for herself slowly simmered yellow croaker with olive oil, diced tomatoes, and herbs, served with quinoa rice. The family of three sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan shared how she had been praised by her teacher at kindergarten, and Yajing felt much more relaxed seeing her family eat happily.

She spent half an hour building LEGO with Xuanxuan on the living room play mat, putting together a little castle, and then drew a picture of 'a family of three on Gulangyu' together. At 20:15, she bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into dinosaur pajamas, and read two picture books. After Xuanxuan closed her eyes, she gently made the sign of the cross on her daughter's forehead and prayed in a low voice.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (daughter's room, living room)

name: Rewarding herself by making satay noodles
description: Seeing her daughter sound asleep and her husband working overtime in the study, Yajing hesitated briefly before quietly slipping into the kitchen. She took out oil noodles from the cupboard and the satay soup base and sliced meat brought back from Quanzhou from the freezer, turned on the stove, and cooked the noodles. Fifteen minutes later, she had a steaming bowl of Minnan satay noodles. She sat alone in the living room, lifted a chopstickful of noodles to her mouth, and the rich flavor almost moved her to tears. Her husband smelled the aroma, poked his head in, and gave a helpless smile. She knew clearly that the pure Western-style Mediterranean diet experiment was temporarily on hold, but the overall direction of finding a balance between health and reality would not change.
location: Home (kitchen), No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wash up and write a gratitude journal.
description: After eating the noodles to her heart's content and cleaning up the kitchen, she took a quick shower. Once washed up, she sat down at the desk, opened her "Three Little Blessings" diary, and wrote: 1. Most customers forgave her after her apology in the community; 2. The evening shacha noodles healed her mood; 3. Her daughter put on her shoes by herself today. After writing the diary, she relaxed on the bed and picked up her phone.
location: Home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bathroom, master bedroom)

name: Learned that a high school classmate's father had passed away and contacted classmates to discuss paying condolences
description: Before going to bed, she habitually opened the high school classmates WeChat group and saw that classmate Wu Xiaoli had posted an obituary saying that her father had passed away this morning in Quanzhou due to worsening advanced lung cancer. The funeral Mass was scheduled for November 15 at a church in Quanzhou. Yajing's heart clenched; the memory of her father cooking noodles when she visited Wu Xiaoli's home in high school came to mind, and her eyes moistened. She exited the group chat and sent Wu Xiaoli a heartfelt message of condolence, expressing her wish to go and pay her last respects. Wu Xiaoli replied with a crying emoji and said she hoped she could come. After confirming that she would go, Yajing contacted Li Meiling and Zhang Wei, who were also in Xiamen. The three discussed in a small group and agreed to jointly pay for a funeral wreath, with Zhang Wei responsible for contacting the florist.
location: At home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (on the master bedroom bed).

name: Communicated with husband about going to Quanzhou on Saturday to offer condolences and asked him to take care of their daughter.
description: After confirming the funeral arrangements, Yajing walked to the study door, knocked lightly, and told her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was working overtime, that she needed to go to Quanzhou on Saturday for the funeral of a classmate's father, and asked him to take care of their daughter all day. A Qiang pushed up his glasses and asked with concern whether she was sure she could go. After she affirmed, he readily agreed and told her not to worry.
location: Home at No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (outside the study and in the bedroom)

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Lying in bed, she turned off the bedside lamp and closed her eyes, silently praying for Wu Xiaoli and her deceased father. She recited a few short Catholic evening prayers, feeling sad but with a hint of relief. Then she adjusted her sleeping position and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: At home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (on the master bedroom bed).

name: Morning family time and healthy eating announcement
description: After waking up at 7, Song Yajing did some light stretching and washed up, then went to the kitchen to start implementing the improved Minnan health plan. Seeing her husband Chen Zhiqiang eating bread, she formally announced the family dietary adjustments: use olive oil or camellia oil for stir-frying and reduce the amount by one-third, eat sea fish two or three times a week, keep eating rice as usual and keep simmering soups, and allow satay noodles occasionally. Her husband expressed support. Then she woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan, put a light jacket on her, combed her hair and tied it into braids, made a low-oil, low-salt egg-and-vegetable omelet with olive oil as breakfast, and reminded her daughter to drink plenty of water at kindergarten.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and buy stickers
description: Song Yajing rode her electric bike to take her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watched her enter the school gate with the teacher, and then left. On the way back, she stopped at the Chenguang Stationery Store on Park South Road and picked out several Princess Elsa stickers that her daughter likes, planning to use them as a small reward in the evening.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then on the way to the M&G Stationery Store at Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road.

name: Store opening preparation and teaser material preparation
description: Song Yajing arrived at the "Yajing Wardrobe" clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road and opened the store with clerk Xiaomei. She turned on the computer and the cashier system, while Xiaomei cleaned and wiped down the shelves. The two quickly checked the previous day's sales orders and inventory, noting the remaining stock of best-selling items. Then Song Yajing organized the shelves, hung the newly arrived autumn clothing in prominent places, and adjusted the window mannequin styling. Afterwards, she picked out photos of her mother's handwritten recipe and the booklet mockup images from her phone, preparing to edit the pre-promotion content.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, "Yajing's Wardrobe" clothing store.

name: Purchase healthy ingredients at Yonghui Supermarket and withdraw cash.
description: Song Yajing rode an electric scooter to the Yonghui Supermarket on Hubin West Road. She first withdrew 4000 yuan in cash from the ATM on the first floor using the store's cash reserve card, then entered the supermarket to shop: extra virgin olive oil, fresh salmon fillets, dried chickpeas, and various fresh vegetables. When passing the seasoning aisle, she did not buy ready-made satay sauce packets and decided to make a low-salt version herself in the afternoon.
location: Yonghui Supermarket, Hubin West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Transferring medical expenses, recording accounts, and publishing pre-launch promotions
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing used mobile banking to transfer 4,000 yuan to her mother, Lin Xiuying, with the note ‘medical expense sharing’, and recorded it under the ‘Health Expenses’ category in the family emergency ledger (Excel spreadsheet). Then she drafted a Moments post and a group announcement, uploaded her mother’s handwritten recipes and sample images of the booklet, and wrote a caption announcing that the handwritten recipe booklet ‘Mom’s Recipes, the Sweetness of Time’ would go on sale the next day, with proceeds donated to the Xiamen Municipal Elderly Foundation. After posting, the response in the group was enthusiastic, and many regular customers left messages to pre-order.
location: Inside the Yajing Wardrobe store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare low-salt satay sauce and lunch, and handle online matters
description: In the small rest room behind the store, Song Yajing used the dried flat fish, dried shrimp, crushed peanuts and other ingredients she had bought in the morning, along with reduced salt and soy sauce, to successfully make a fragrant low-salt satay sauce. She cooked a small serving of vegetable noodles with the sauce for lunch, and while eating, she replied on her phone to customers' private messages about the brochure, and browsed the photos of winter new arrivals sent by Guangzhou supplier A Kai. She didn't select any, but decided to save them for later.
location: Small back rest room behind the Yajing Wardrobe store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and preparation of supplies for the visit
description: Song Yajing took a 20-minute nap on the sofa in the break room. After getting up at 13:10, she took out the low-sugar sponge cake she had baked at home the night before and carefully packed it into a box. Then she picked some fresh apples and oranges from the shop's fruit basket and put them into a reusable cloth bag, as gifts for visiting Grandma Wang, an elderly fellow church member who lived alone, in the afternoon.
location: Inside the Yajing Wardrobe store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Visit Granny Wang, a longtime church member who lives alone
description: Song Yajing rode her electric bike to meet Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow church member, and together they went to an old residential building near Dashengli on Siming South Road to visit Grandma Wang, a woman of nearly 80 living alone. Song Yajing gave her fruit and cake, held Grandma Wang's hand, and listened as she recounted her younger days studying at a church school on Gulangyu. As they left, Grandma Wang tremblingly made the sign of the cross over her and said, 'May the Lord bless you and your mother.' Song Yajing was moved and hugged the old woman.
location: Old residential building near Dashengli, Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bought a strawberry cake roll for her daughter on the way home
description: On the way back, Song Yajing made a special detour to the 85°C bakery in Zhonghua City on Zhongshan Road and bought a delicate strawberry cake roll, her daughter Xuanxuan's favorite, to surprise her that evening.
location: 85°C Bakery, Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling store tasks, handover, and final checks upon return
description: Back at the store, Song Yajing put the cake roll in the refrigerator and started dealing with the online customer inquiries that had accumulated in the afternoon, answering questions about sizes and styling. Around 5 p.m., she handed over work to shop assistant Xiaomei and instructed her to come and help set up the booklet sales counter the next morning. After Xiaomei left, Song Yajing tidied the fitting room by herself, hung up the clothes that had been messed up from try-ons, checked the booklet proof on her phone once more, and then contacted the print shop owner near the Xianhou Bakery Studio in Huli District via WeChat to confirm pickup tomorrow morning.
location: Inside the Yajing Wardrobe store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Closing the store and buying groceries on the way
description: At 6 p.m., after pulling down the rolling shutter and closing the store, Song Yajing rode her electric bike to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way, bought lean meat and greens, and planned to go home and cook a simple, healthy Minnan-style home meal.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Check the mailbox and walk home
description: Cycling to the entrance of the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Song Yajing parked the bike, checked the community mailbox, and took out this month's property management payment notice. She found no notification of church activities. Then she carried the groceries and walked home.
location: From the mailbox at the 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to home

name: Prepare dinner and share today's experiences.
description: After returning home and changing into loungewear, Song Yajing washed vegetables and cut meat in the kitchen while chatting with her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was in the living room watching cartoons with their daughter, about her afternoon visit to Grandma Wang and the preparations for tomorrow's booklet charity sale. She cooked stir-fried vegetables, lean meat soup, and rice. The dishes were low in oil and salt, keeping the home-style flavor of Minnan.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and parent-child bonding time.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table for dinner. Song Yajing brought out a strawberry cake roll as a surprise for her daughter Xuanxuan, and the child was so happy she danced with joy. After dinner, she accompanied her daughter playing with building blocks on the crawling mat and reading the picture book 'Dumbo,' while her husband Chen Zhiqiang worked on work documents on his computer nearby.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's bedtime routine
description: Song Yajing took her daughter to the bathroom, washed her hair, scrubbed her back, and put her in dinosaur pajamas. Then she went to the children's room and told two bedtime stories, and her daughter quickly fell asleep listening to the stories.
location: Children’s room and bathroom at home, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community maintenance and discussing weekend arrangements.
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa and replied to private messages and words of encouragement from long-time customers in the customer community, thanking them for their support and previewing the specific release time of tomorrow's brochure. Around 21:30, she discussed with her husband Chen Zhiqiang the arrangements for attending the funeral of her classmate Wu Xiaoli's father in Quanzhou on Saturday. Her husband confirmed that he could take care of their daughter all day, allowing her to go with peace of mind.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared materials for the next day and recorded gratitude and prayers.
description: Song Yajing first went to the kitchen, took out the flour, eggs, sugar, and other ingredients for making the cake the next day, and arranged them. Then she returned to the bedroom and wrote down three small things to be grateful for today in her diary: Granny Wang's blessing, customers' warm support, and her family's well-being. Finally, she knelt by the bed and prayed, especially asking God to give strength and peace to her classmate Wu Xiaoli and her family.
location: Kitchen and bedroom of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and stretching before bed
description: Song Yajing went into the bathroom to take a shower. After washing away her fatigue, she changed into pajamas. She did shoulder, neck, and lower back stretching on the yoga mat in the bedroom, then turned off the light, lay down, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the home at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and having family breakfast.
description: When the morning alarm rang, Song Yajing got up, feeling some soreness in her lower back but in good spirits. She first boiled hot water, then quickly washed up. She then woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her change into casual weekend children's clothes and tied her hair into a ponytail. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had also finished washing up and was looking at his phone in the living room. Yajing simply prepared breakfast: she served the pre-made white porridge, cut whole wheat bread, heated milk, and fried a sunny-side-up egg. The family of three sat at the table for breakfast. While eating, Yajing explained to her daughter that today Mommy's shop would be selling Grandma's recipe booklet, so she needed to leave early, and Daddy would pick her up in the evening.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten and pick up the booklet.
description: Song Yajing rode her e-bike with her daughter, stopping on the way at the M&G Stationery Store in Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, to buy her daughter a sheet of Princess Elsa stickers as a weekend reward. Then she arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road) and handed Chen Lexuan to the teacher on duty. After that, she turned the e-bike around and rode to Changqing Print Shop on Siming West Road to pick up the 150 booklets that had been printed after she confirmed the proof was error-free the previous day; the feel of the covers pleased her.
location: Along the route: M&G Stationery Store, Phase 2, Yubincheng, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road; Evergreen Print Shop, Siming West Road

name: Arrive at the store early to set up the sales display
description: Song Yajing arrived at her clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, twenty minutes earlier than the agreed time. After opening the door, she quickly placed the brochures neatly on a standalone display rack beside the cash register, then handwrote a promotional slogan on the small blackboard at the entrance with chalk: "Mom's recipe, the sweetness of time — officially on sale today!" and drew two hearts to create an atmosphere for the launch.
location: Her own clothing store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning peak sales
description: The store officially opened, and the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time. There were more customers than on a typical Saturday; many were drawn in by the small blackboard. Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work: Xiaomei handled regular clothing sales, while Yajing focused on introducing and selling the booklet. She enthusiastically explained that the booklet compiled her mother's handwritten Hokkien dessert recipes, and that the proceeds from every sale would be donated to a foundation for the elderly. A white-haired old lady looked through it carefully and remarked that the handwriting was beautiful. After 10 a.m., Aunt Lin, a fellow church member, came specially with three elderly church members; each bought a copy and encouraged Yajing. In between, Yajing found time to post photos and updates in the customer community, respond to online purchase inquiries, and record every sale in a dedicated ledger.
location: Her own clothing store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home at noon to cook and eat a healthy lunch.
description: After the morning rush, Yajing asked Xiaomei to mind the store and walked about 12 minutes back to her home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential compound. She took extra virgin olive oil, spinach, and salmon out of the fridge, and following the healthy low-oil improvement plan, quickly stir-fried garlic spinach in olive oil, pan-seared the salmon with little oil, and made a tomato and lettuce salad. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home for lunch. Yajing had him taste the spinach first and told him it was the low-oil version. He said it tasted great. The two chatted while eating about how business was going at the store and the next day's trip to Quanzhou.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon: returning to the shop, selling, and lower back relief
description: After lunch, Yajing cleared the dishes, stuffed the electric heating lumbar belt into a canvas bag, and walked back to the shop. The afternoon customer flow was still good, with regular customers who had seen the Moments posts arriving one after another. While greeting customers, Yajing also processed online catalog orders and tallied the total donations. By a little after 3 p.m., the soreness in her lower back became obvious. She took advantage of a lull in customers to put on the lumbar belt, leaned back in a chair in the rest area, and applied heat for more than twenty minutes, feeling much relieved. During that time, she also replied to two friends' inquiries about details for Wu Xiaoli's father's funeral the next day.
location: Her own clothing store and the rest area at the back, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wrap-up, shop handover, and going home to change clothes.
description: After the peak sales period passed, Yajing briefly handed over that day's booklet sales to Xiaomei and reminded her to close the shop on time at 6:30. Then she walked home. Once inside, she immediately rushed into the bedroom and changed into the dark, elegant dress she had hung out in advance. In front of the mirror, she quickly touched up her lipstick and fixed her hair, getting ready for the couple's dinner later.
location: The store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and home at the No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community.

name: The couple went out for dinner together and took a walk after the meal.
description: When Yajing came downstairs, her husband was already waiting at the entrance of the residential complex. The two walked about fifteen minutes to the "Old Quanzhou Flavor" private restaurant on Shengping Road. Today was the agreed couple-only day. Zhiqiang ordered specialty dishes including Quanzhou zongzi, misua soup, fried vinegar pork, and oyster omelet. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. Yajing talked about how the booklet had sold well and her experience stir-frying with healthy oil at lunch, and suggested that the whole family take a half-hour walk after dinner every day. Her husband agreed and mentioned that the lakeside greenway behind the residential complex had good lighting and that one loop around the lake was exactly three kilometers. The two checked the route on a map app and agreed to start the next day. After dinner, they didn't go straight home but walked along Shengping Road toward Zhenhai Road, chatting about the next day's plans under the moonlight. Zhiqiang promised to take good care of their daughter. The walk of about two kilometers made Yajing's body feel much more relaxed.
location: The “Old Quanzhou Flavor” private restaurant on Shengping Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the street section leading to Zhenhai Road.

name: Family time after returning home
description: After returning home, her daughter Xuanxuan was in the living room with her husband. Yajing picked up her daughter and gave her a kiss, then together they decorated the drawing book with the Elsa princess stickers bought in the morning. Zhiqiang was clearing the dining table nearby. Yajing asked Xuanxuan what was fun at kindergarten today, and her daughter gestured excitedly as she talked about building blocks with the other kids; the living room was filled with laughter.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening personal time: washing up, hot compress, prayer, and bedtime journal
description: While her husband accompanied their daughter to wash up and told her a bedtime story, Yajing prepared for the funeral she would attend the next day, making sure the dark dress and black coat were hung on the coat rack. Then she showered, changed into pajamas, and sat in the massage chair in the living room. She put on the electric heating waist belt again on low heat. Her husband brought her warm water and reminded her to use a back cushion when driving the next day. Yajing closed her eyes and prayed silently, grateful that the store and the booklet had gone smoothly, and asking for peace at Wu Xiaoli's father's funeral the next day. Then she went to the dressing table in the bedroom, took out her account book, carefully recorded the day's booklet sales and income, the total donation amount, and wrote a gratitude diary. She glanced at the scale showing 47.8 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday, and smiled with satisfaction. It was past 10:30. She turned off the desk lamp and fell asleep to soft music.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: master bathroom, living room massage chair, and bedroom vanity

name: Early morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 6:15 in the morning, Yajing woke up naturally with slight soreness in her lower back. She first put on her electric heating lumbar support belt and did some simple stretching. After washing up, she changed into a black business suit and checked her handbag (wallet, phone, keys, and a Virgin Mary image card). She then went to the garage, checked the family car, confirmed that the fuel was sufficient and the tire pressure was normal, set the navigation on the center console to Huaxiang Catholic Church in Quanzhou, and placed a bottle of mineral water and a small bag of snacks in the back seat. At seven, she returned home; her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared breakfast: fried eggs, warm whole wheat bread, and milk. Yajing chatted with her husband while eating and reminded him to take care of their daughter. Before leaving, she gently kissed the forehead of their daughter Chen Lexuan, who was still sleeping, then took her bag and went out.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Hubin South Road, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, home (including garage)

name: Drive to Quanzhou.
description: At 7:30, Yajing drove out of the residential area, merged into weekend traffic, and headed toward Quanzhou along the Shenhai Expressway. Autumn sunlight streamed through the car window as she drove and prayed silently. According to the navigation, the whole journey took about 73 minutes, with the scenery along the way gradually changing from city high-rises to southern Fujian countryside.
location: From the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the Zhongmin Baihui parking lot in Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, via the Shenhai Expressway

name: Attend the farewell Mass for Wu Xiaoli's father.
description: At 8:43 in the morning, Yajing arrived in Licheng District, Quanzhou. She parked her car in the Zhongmin Baihui parking lot and then walked about 8 minutes to the Flower Lane Catholic Church at No. 25 Xucuocheng. At exactly 9:00, she pushed open the church's wooden door, and the familiar smell of wood and candle flame greeted her. Thirty or forty relatives and friends were already seated inside the church. She quieted her steps and, seeing her old classmate Wu Xiaoli sitting in the front row in the distance, quietly chose a seat in the back row. The Mass was led by Father Wang, and the choir's singing echoed through the dome. Yajing clasped her hands and lowered her head, praying for the deceased and also blessing her living parents. She participated quietly throughout, expressing support through silent presence.
location: Quanzhou Huaxiang Catholic Church, No. 25 Xucuocheng, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province (walk there after arriving at Zhongmin Baihui parking lot).

name: Accompany Wu Xiaoli and sort through her father's belongings.
description: After Mass ended, Yajing waited until the crowd had thinned, then walked up to Wu Xiaoli and gave her a long, firm hug. She took a small holy card of the Virgin Mary from her bag, pressed it into Xiaoli's palm, and whispered words of comfort. Then Yajing walked with Xiaoli about six minutes back to the old house set deep in Gurong Lane. In the living room were books that Xiaoli's father had loved to read and clothes that needed sorting. Yajing rolled up her sleeves and helped categorize them—which could be donated and which should be kept as mementos. As they sorted, they chatted about the Nanyin music her father liked to listen to and funny childhood stories. When Xiaoli came across one of her father's old sweaters, she finally couldn't hold back her tears. Yajing put down what she was holding, moved close, and wrapped her arm around Xiaoli's shoulder, letting her cry for a long time. At 2 p.m., seeing that Xiaoli's emotions had settled a bit, Yajing said goodbye and promised to stay in touch.
location: The old Wu family residence in the small alley inside Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian (and the corridor in the church).

name: Drove back towards Puli Service Area
description: At 2 p.m., Yajing left the old house and walked about 14 minutes to the Zhongmin Baihui parking lot. At 2:15 p.m., she drove out of the parking lot, heading toward Xiamen along the Shenhai Expressway, bound for Puli Service Area, with soothing hymns playing in the car. The drive was expected to take about 37 minutes.
location: From Gurong Lane, Licheng District, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, to Puli Service Area on the Shenhai Expressway (driving via the Zhongmin Baihui parking lot)

name: Rest at the service area and call her father
description: At 2:52 p.m., Yajing drove into the Puli Service Area, parked the car, and sat on an outdoor bench to rest. She called her father, Song Minghui, and said, "Dad, I just attended the funeral of a classmate's father, and I miss you." Her father responded gently, telling her to drive carefully and mind her back injury. Yajing urged her father to make sure to have a physical examination every year, and they agreed that she would bring her daughter and stay for a few extra days during the Spring Festival. After hanging up, she wrote a reflection in her phone memo: "The child wants to care for them, but the parents are gone. From now on, I will go back to Quanzhou at least once every quarter, even if only to have a meal with them."
location: Puli Service Area, Shenhai Expressway, Jinjiang City, Fujian Province

name: Drove back to her home in Xiamen
description: At 3:15 p.m., Yajing continued driving back to Xiamen from Puli Service Area. According to the navigation, it would take about 69 minutes. Along the way she played hymns and savored the morning's experiences.
location: From Puli Service Area, Shenhai Expressway, Jinjiang City, Fujian Province, to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home to tidy up and rest
description: Around 4:30 p.m., Yajing returned to her home in Xiamen. She changed into loungewear, wiped clean and put away the leather shoes she had worn today, poured herself a glass of warm water, and sat on the sofa for a while to calm her emotions. Then she walked into the kitchen and saw that her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already prepared the dinner ingredients, and felt a warmth in her heart.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: In the evening, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had prepared dinner: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, soy-sauce-braised mixed fish, and a bowl of hot soup. The family of three sat around the dining table. Her daughter Chen Lexuan excitedly asked where her mother had been, and Yajing gently explained that she had gone to comfort a good friend. The dinner atmosphere was warm and cozy. Yajing felt the warmth of family, and her mood gradually brightened.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk at Nanhu Park
description: After dinner, Yajing announced the start of the new walking habit they had discussed the day before. The three of them changed into sneakers and walked about five minutes from home to the lakeside greenway of Nanhu Park near the neighborhood. The autumn evening breeze was cool. Their daughter alternately ran ahead to pick up fallen leaves and jogged while holding her father's hand. Yajing walked behind, watching her husband and daughter's backs, feeling her lower back gradually relax with the easy pace. Half an hour later, the family returned home contentedly.
location: Lakeside Greenway of Nanhu Park, No. 7 Huguang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter during her bedtime routine
description: After returning home from the walk, Yajing helped her daughter take a bath and change into pajamas. In the children's room, they read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You together. Yajing read softly, and her daughter listened intently. After the story, Yajing turned off the light, sat on the edge of the bed, gently patted her daughter, and hummed a Hokkien nursery rhyme until her daughter fell asleep with even breathing.
location: Children's room and bathroom, home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store matters handling and diary
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Yajing tiptoed out of the room. She opened her laptop, logged in to the store's backend, and checked the day's sales transactions (mainly handling the settlement of the balance payment from yesterday's brochure sale and a few online orders). She then replied in the store's WeChat group to a customer's inquiry about when the new styles would arrive, and posted a small note of gratitude for the day. Finally, she recorded today's feelings in a diary app: “I bade farewell to one father and called another. On the first day of walking, the whole family was together, and I felt very at peace.”
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Talking with her husband and preparing things for tomorrow
description: After finishing work, Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sat on the living room sofa and chatted, sharing what she had seen and felt in Quanzhou that day. Her husband asked about her back condition, and Yajing said she felt much better after walking. Before bed, she prepared simple clothes and a bag for tomorrow's Mass on Gulangyu Island on Sunday, and checked her keys and bus card.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and stretching
description: At 10 p.m., Yajing did her bedtime washing and skincare routine. Afterward, she knelt by the bed and said her evening prayers, praying for Xiaoli's family, for her own parents, and for everyone who had helped her that day. Then she did a 15-minute yoga stretch to relax her lower back, which was tense after the long drive. At 10:30 p.m., she turned off the light, lay down beside her husband, and, calm and grateful, soon fell asleep.
location: Main bedroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up and lower back care
description: At 7 a.m., Yajing woke up, the soreness in her lumbar spine reminding her that the old injury had not healed. She reached out to the bedside table, took out the electric heating waist belt, plugged it in, set a 15-minute timer, and closed her eyes to enjoy the warmth penetrating her lumbar muscles, letting her body gradually wake up.
location: Main bedroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a Mediterranean breakfast
description: After washing up, Yajing put on her medical lumbar support belt and walked into the kitchen. She toasted the whole-wheat bread until lightly browned, spread it with mashed avocado, sprinkled a little sea salt and black pepper, and served it with two boiled eggs. Aqiang helped warm the milk and asked softly, 'Is your back okay?' Xuanxuan was playing with building blocks in the living room, and Yajing called her to come eat breakfast. The family sat together, eating and chatting about the afternoon get-together with her best friend. Xuanxuan pestered to come along, but Aqiang pacified her by saying, 'Daddy will take you to Jiaxingyuan Park to see the birds.'
location: Home kitchen and dining room in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Talked with my father.
description: After breakfast, A Qiang cleared the dishes, and Yajing sat on the living room sofa and called her father, Song Minghui. When the call connected, she asked with concern about her mother's health and reminded her father to take his blood pressure regularly. Her father's voice was cheerful; he told her that she had been very well-behaved after returning from Quanzhou yesterday, and that everything was fine at home. Yajing felt warm inside and chatted about family matters for ten minutes. Before hanging up, she wrote in her phone memo: "Go back to Quanzhou in mid-December to visit Mom and Dad."
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Market shopping and ingredient pre-processing
description: Yajing changed into light outdoor clothes and walked to the Meirengong Farmers' Market near her home. She moved deftly between the stalls and, according to her list, bought: fresh salmon fillets, live clams, fresh shrimp, tomatoes, onions, celery, lemons, and whole-wheat bread. She also made a special trip to a dried goods store for some dried chickpeas. After returning home, she marinated the salmon with olive oil, sea salt, rosemary, and lemon juice, added salt to the clams to let them expel sand, and soaked the chickpeas in advance, preparing for lunch and dinner.
location: Meirengong Farmers' Market, No. 49 Xi'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the home kitchen

name: Baking salmon for the first time and preparing lunch side ingredients.
description: Yajing tried cooking with the oven for the first time. She preheated it to 200°C, placed the marinated salmon fillet on a baking tray lined with foil, and baked it for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, she boiled the soaked chickpeas and blended them into a fine paste in a food processor, then mixed in honey and lemon juice to make a refreshing cold sauce. Xuanxuan was called over by her mother to be a little helper and was in charge of tearing washed lettuce and cherry tomatoes into pieces for plating. The oven gave a ding, the whole room filled with a delicious aroma, and Xuanxuan clapped happily.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Enjoying a creative lunch
description: The highlights of lunch were the first successful baked salmon and dressed hummus, paired with a warm salad made from leftover vegetables, chicken breast, and olive oil, with whole-wheat bread slices soaking up the juices. Xuanxuan took the initiative to set the table and even arranged the cherry tomatoes into a smiley face. Aqiang tasted the baked salmon and was full of praise: 'This dish can become our family specialty!' The family finished the meal in a relaxed and happy atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and getting ready to go out
description: After lunch, Yajing felt somewhat tired, and her lower back was also sending signals. She leaned back on the sofa with a lumbar cushion and napped for about an hour, recovering a good deal of energy. Waking up at 13:15, she changed into a dark blue knit top and beige trousers, and tried on the camel-colored scarf that had arrived yesterday in front of the mirror. After thinking it over, she switched back to her old scarf in the same color, feeling it looked better. She checked her bag: phone, wallet, lumbar support belt, tissues, and a few throat lozenges.
location: The bedroom and entryway of the home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Commuting to the date location
description: Yajing said goodbye to Aqiang and Xuanxuan, reminding Aqiang not to forget to take Xuanxuan to the park. She walked six minutes to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, used her phone to enter the station, and took Line 1 in the direction of Yannei. On the train, she received a WeChat message from Li Meiling: 'I'm here, waiting for you at UNIQLO's entrance.' Yajing immediately replied: 'Okay, I'll be there in about 15 minutes.'
location: From Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Exit 4A of Wushipu Metro Station, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A get-together with her best friend Li Meiling
description: Yajing met Li Meiling, whose pregnant belly was already showing, at SM City Plaza, and the two hugged with smiles. They first browsed fast-fashion brands on the first floor, and Meiling helped Yajing pick out a pink tulle dress at 50% off for Xuanxuan, while Yajing bought herself a camel cashmere scarf. Tired from shopping, they bought two hot drinks at a milk tea shop on the third floor. Yajing chose unsweetened oolong tea, and Meiling ordered hot milk. The two caught up, with Meiling sharing funny stories from her pregnancy and Yajing confiding the pressure of running the store and her sadness at attending a funeral. At 15:00, they went to the cinema on the fifth floor to watch the movie Warm Hugs, releasing their emotions through laughter. After the movie, Meiling said she wanted something spicy, so Yajing accompanied her into a Sichuan restaurant; she ordered tom yum rice noodles, while Meiling ordered pickled fish.
location: SM City Plaza, No. 468 Jiahe Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returning home
description: As the streetlights came on, Yajing said goodbye to Meiling at the subway station. She boarded the train home, looked through today's photos, and sent Aqiang photos of the new scarf and the pink dress. Aqiang replied instantly: "They all look good. Xuanxuan will definitely love that dress. I'll make seafood soup when you get home." She couldn't help smiling, her heart full of warmth.
location: Exit 4A, Wushipu Metro Station, Huli District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Cook and enjoy Mediterranean seafood soup
description: When Yajing got home, Ah Qiang had already prepared the water for washing vegetables. She tied on an apron and started making the finale of her dietary experiment — Mediterranean seafood soup: she stir-fried minced garlic, onion, and tomato in olive oil, added chicken stock, and after bringing it to a boil, put in cleaned clams and fresh shrimp and cooked until their shells opened, then sprinkled with chopped parsley. The soup was served in a large bowl with whole-wheat bread and lettuce salad. Xuanxuan played with clam shells using a spoon, and Ah Qiang took a sip and said with satisfaction, "It tastes like the sea!"
location: Home kitchen and dining room in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family discussion and summary of this week's diet experiment
description: After the meal, Yajing pulled up the dietary records on her tablet, and the whole family reviewed them together. They unanimously decided to keep the olive oil replacing part of the peanut oil, have grilled fish two to three times a week, and make the chickpea hummus salad a regular cold dish. Yajing wrote the adjustment plan in her memo. Aqiang volunteered to do the dishes on weekends from then on to support her cooking. Xuanxuan was also promised, "If you try eating okra once next week, you'll get a box of strawberry cake as a reward."
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Played with Xuanxuan, washed her up, and coaxed her to sleep.
description: Yajing accompanied Xuanxuan in building a block castle and listened to her excitedly talk about the puppy she had seen in the park. At 21:00, she helped Xuanxuan take a bath and change into pajamas printed with little dinosaurs. In bed, she read two stories, "Guess How Much I Love You" and "Dumbo." Xuanxuan soon snuggled in her mother's arms and fell asleep.
location: Children's room and bathroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Before-bed waist care and communication with partner
description: Yajing returned to the bedroom, and Aqiang had already prepared her electrically heated lumbar belt. She lay on the bed, applying heat to her lower back, while showing Aqiang the photos and videos she had taken during today's shopping and sharing the funny moments from the afternoon. Aqiang listened while gently massaging her sore and swollen shoulders.
location: Main bedroom at home, 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime ritual and going to bed.
description: Yajing got out of bed, washed up, and applied moisturizer. Back in bed, she opened her diary and wrote down today's small gratitudes: successfully baking salmon for the first time, Meiling's company and listening, and the warmth and support of family. Then she said a brief prayer to God, asking for peace for Wu Xiaoli's family and all friends and relatives. At exactly 23:00, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home, master bedroom bathroom and bed, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning lower-back care and breakfast preparation.
description: At 7:10 the phone alarm went off. Because her lower back still felt stiff, Song Yajing took out the electric heating lumbar belt and applied a 15-minute hot compress. She then changed into comfortable loungewear and went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: whole wheat bread toasted until slightly crisp, served with boiled eggs and warm milk, and quickly stir-fried asparagus in olive oil. At 7:40 she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, tied her braids, and the family of three enjoyed breakfast happily at the table.
location: No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and do some shopping on the way
description: At 8:00, Yajing put on her commuter bag, took her daughter’s hand, and walked out. She strolled along Hubin South Road for about 10 minutes to the stationery store on Park South Road. Xuanxuan picked out an Ultraman sticker, and Yajing also bought three black marker pens as store supplies. At 8:20, they arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten. She handed her daughter to the teacher and kissed her forehead goodbye.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (stopping en route at the stationery store, Yubin City Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road)

name: Cycling commute to the store
description: After saying goodbye to her daughter, Yajing rode her folding electric scooter from the parking spot near the kindergarten, traveled along Gucheng West Road and turned into Zhongshan Road for about 8 minutes, and arrived at her Yaji Boutique Clothing Store before 9 o'clock.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Arriving at the shop to tidy up and prepare displays
description: After arriving at the shop, Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei divided the work: Xiaomei wiped down the shelves and the mannequins, while Yajing went to the back stockroom to check the delivery boxes that had arrived over the weekend, and carefully placed the handmade rosary the pastor had given her yesterday into the cash register drawer. Together they ironed and hung up the newly arrived corduroy skirts and wool-blend cardigans, and adjusted the window display to add warm winter tones.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discussed the details of the co-branded item with the designer.
description: At 10:30, Yajing made a video call to designer Zheng Kai in the back storage work area of the shop. She took out her notebook with fabric swatches and confirmed sampling details item by item, discussing issues such as the improved frog buttons on the hem of the beige-apricot dress, the drape of the fabric, and the reduced scale of the embroidery pattern. The call lasted nearly 40 minutes. She recorded the revision comments and the new sampling schedule in detail in her notebook, and they agreed to check the second 3D renderings before next Monday.
location: Back warehouse work area of Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video calling with her mother during the lunch break.
description: At 11:45, she had Xiaomei eat lunch first. At 12:10, wearing her lumbar support belt, Yajing sat on the sofa in the back storeroom and ordered chicken breast salad for delivery on her phone. While waiting, she made a video call to her mother in Quanzhou. Her mother was trimming bougainvillea on the balcony and said her blood pressure was normal, telling Yajing not to worry. Yajing told her mother not to climb high to clean windows, and they chatted about family matters for ten minutes. After finishing lunch at 12:40, she leaned against the sofa pillow and closed her eyes for a 20-minute nap.
location: Rest area in the back warehouse of Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling orders and receiving customers
description: After lunch, Yajing used her computer to organize the key points from the morning discussion into a Co-branded Product Development Memo and attached the digital fabric swatch cards. Then she handled the customer orders and after-sales left over from last week, replied to three customers' exchange inquiries, and handwrote thank-you cards for customers who complained about slow logistics, sending them with the reshipped goods. At around 2 p.m., she enthusiastically styled a young girl in a crisp interview-appropriate suit dress and successfully made the sale.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter from school and enjoying dessert time
description: At 15:20 Yajing left the store early, rode a scooter, and arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 15:45. After picking up her daughter, the two turned into the 85°C Zhonghua City Bakery at the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Siming South Road. Xuanxuan chose a small croissant, and Yajing bought a sugar-free hot latte. They sat in the store, eating while listening to her daughter share the new nursery rhyme she had learned at kindergarten. At 16:10 the mother and daughter walked home hand in hand.
location: No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City (passing Siming Experimental Kindergarten)

name: At home with daughter and work planning
description: After returning home, Xuanxuan drew sunflowers at the small desk in the living room. Yajing took out her tablet and sat beside her daughter, keeping her company while opening her memo app to draft an outline for the co-branded short video script. She listed five shooting directions, including everyday styling, fabric analysis, and scenario-based outfit matching.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing a healthy dinner
description: At 17:00, Yajing entered the kitchen to prepare dinner. The menu was: stir-fried broccoli and shrimp with garlic and olive oil, steamed sea bass (with only shredded ginger and scallion segments and a drizzle of steamed fish soy sauce), a cold salad of black fungus, snow peas, and chickpeas (dressed with lemon juice and a little soy sauce), and a pot of millet multigrain rice cooked in a pressure cooker.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: At 18:30, her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home; dinner was already on the table. Xuanxuan shared her sunflower painting that the teacher had praised. Aqiang praised the steamed fish and broccoli for being tender and free of fishy smell. Yajing suggested steaming purple sweet potato for Xuanxuan as a snack tomorrow morning; Aqiang nodded and after dinner took the initiative to clear the dishes and put them into the dishwasher.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family took an evening walk at Jiaxingyuan Park.
description: 19:40 The family of three put on comfortable shoes and went out, walking slowly from the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street along the sidewalk of Bailu Road to Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan walked in the middle holding her parents' hands and counting streetlight poles. Yajing walked slowly due to back discomfort, and Aqiang asked with concern whether she needed a pain patch. Yajing replied that walking actually made her feel better. After arriving at the park, they sat on a bench at the entrance looking at the stars, and started back at 20:10.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daughter's bedtime bath and story time
description: After returning home at 20:15, Yajing bathed her daughter, and while washing her hair, taught her to hum a church hymn. After the bath, she changed into bear pajamas. Yajing took Guess How Much I Love You from the bookshelf and held her daughter close while reading. After reading, she guided Xuanxuan in an evening prayer, thanking God for letting them paint sunflowers and take a family walk today. Xuanxuan repeated the prayer and soon fell asleep.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal gratitude journal and plans for tomorrow
description: At 20:45, Yajing left her daughter's room, went to the study, took out her gratitude journal, and wrote down three small blessings: the co-branded item communication went smoothly, her mother was in good health, and the whole family was happy at dinner. Then she used her phone's memo app to plan tomorrow's store work, reminded Xiaomei to receive the restock and listed the unshipped orders. At the same time, she sent a message to her sister in the family group to discuss a time to go back to Quanzhou to visit their parents in mid-December. Finally, she used a heating pad for her lower back for 15 minutes.
location: The home study at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stretching and relaxing before bed, then going to sleep.
description: At 21:30 Yajing turned off the heating pad, got up to wash up, and did a few simple waist stretches in front of the mirror. At 22:00 she lay in bed and hung the prepared outfit for the next day (an oat-colored turtleneck and navy blue wide-leg pants) on a hanger. At 23:00 she turned off the light, made the sign of the cross over her chest, whispered goodnight, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 community, Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Getting up, applying a hot compress to the lower back, and morning preparations
description: She woke naturally in the early morning. Outside the window the sky was gloomy, and fine rain tapped against the glass. The soreness in her lower back was obvious, so she first used an electric heating lumbar support belt for a 15-minute hot compress. While leaning against the headboard, she quickly browsed the overnight inquiries for the shop on her phone and replied to Susan's confirmation message about restock delivery times.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Taking care of her daughter and preparing breakfast
description: After the hot compress, she felt her lower back relax, got up, and woke her daughter Xuanxuan. She helped her get dressed and tied her braids. For breakfast, she prepared whole wheat toast with fried eggs, and specially packed two steamed small purple sweet potatoes for her as a snack. She reminded her daughter that it was raining today and that she should wear her little raincoat when going out.
location: Kitchen and daughter's room in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: The rain wasn't heavy, but to keep her lower back from getting chilled, she chose to walk Xuanxuan to school. On the way, she counted raindrops with her daughter, and Xuanxuan sang the nursery rhyme she had learned yesterday. At the kindergarten gate, she briefly talked with the teacher about Xuanxuan's painting being praised yesterday.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the shop and took care of opening matters
description: Walked from the kindergarten to the store. There were few pedestrians on the road because of the rain. After arriving at the store, together with Xiaomei, I moved the rain-soaked promotional posters and standing signs from the doorway inside and wiped them clean. Then I boiled water, made a pot of hot tea, turned on the computer, and got ready to start the day's work.
location: "Yaji" Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning shop work: receiving restock, organizing inventory, and handling online inquiries.
description: Susan's restock package arrived on time. Together with Xiaomei, she checked the packing list, counted the quantities, and inspected for defects. After confirming everything was correct, she entered it into the inventory management system, and printed the pending order list to give Xiaomei priority packing. Then, taking advantage of the light morning customer flow, she put on her lumbar support belt and began systematically organizing the inventory accounts, noting out-of-stock and missing-size styles in a memo for the next restock. During this time, she responded to three customers' online exchange inquiries and reserved an upcoming sweater for a regular customer.
location: "Yaji" Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking lunch and midday break in turns
description: She first let Xiaomei go to lunch and stayed in the store herself. At 11:50 it was her turn. She ordered takeout of clear soup noodles from her usual place on her phone, ate in the rest area in the back, then leaned against a sofa with cushions and dozed for about 20 minutes to relieve her lower back fatigue.
location: Rest area in the back warehouse of the "Yaji" boutique clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Staying in the store alone and chatting with a staff member
description: After Xiaomei finished eating and came back, the two did the handover. During a quiet moment, Xiaomei talked about the plot of the TV series she had been watching last night, and they chatted about it for a while to relax.
location: "Yaji" Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Left the store early and went home to review family income and expenses.
description: In the afternoon, the rain gradually lightened, and the store was expected to have few customers. After leaving the shop in Xiaomei's care, I walked home early. Once home, I took out the ledger and the mobile banking app, spread them out in the study, and began carefully checking the household income and expenses for November.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Carefully calculating income and expenses and adjusting the savings plan
description: She carefully checked the various out-of-pocket items from her mother's hospitalization, the medical insurance reimbursement rate, and the total amount she had advanced. After calculating the portion of expenses that exceeded expectations, she felt a bit heavy-hearted. Then she opened the bookkeeping app and began planning how to adjust the savings structure from everyday expenses over the next few months to make up the shortfall.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Consulting about insurance products on WeChat.
description: She contacted Lin Xiaofeng, an account manager at ICBC, via WeChat voice call. She asked in detail about critical illness insurance and accident insurance suitable for her family, and specifically asked whether people of her parents' age could still apply for coverage, the underwriting conditions, and the premium situation. Lin Xiaofeng patiently answered and promised to put together a product comparison table and send it to her WeChat.
location: Community reading room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go to the convenience store to pick up pre-ordered items and review insurance documents
description: After hanging up, she walked to the convenience store beside Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She checked her phone and saw that Lin Xiaofeng had already sent the comparison table. After a quick browse, she marked it as “to discuss with A Qiang tonight.” At the convenience store, she picked up the box of pure milk she had pre-ordered earlier.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned to the store and did the handover with Xiaomei
description: After picking up the milk, she walked back to the store. She briefly discussed the afternoon customer flow and pending tasks with Xiaomei, and told her to send the hanging photos of the new corduroy skirts to the customer group tomorrow. She packed up her things and got ready to leave work.
location: "Yaji" Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying groceries on the way home
description: After work, she walked to the Xiashang Farmers Market beside Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She picked fresh baby bok choy, lean meat, and a small bunch of scallions, planning to stir-fry the baby bok choy and make lean meat soup for dinner. After shopping, she walked home.
location: Xia Shang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, No. 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared dinner; husband picked up daughter and brought her home
description: After getting home, she started preparing a simple dinner: she washed the rice and cooked it, and washed vegetables and cut meat. Around 17:50, her husband Chen Zhiqiang picked up their daughter Xuanxuan from kindergarten, and the daughter ran into the kitchen excitedly to share with her the new story she had learned in kindergarten that day.
location: Kitchen of the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The family sat around together for dinner. At the table, Xuanxuan performed the finger rhyme she learned today, and Aqiang told a few funny things that happened at the company. Song Yajing brought up the family accounts she had checked in the afternoon, and signaled to Aqiang that after Xuanxuan went to bed at night, there was something important to discuss with him.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter and putting her to bed
description: After dinner, she played with building blocks with Xuanxuan for a while, then bathed her. After the bath, she read her the picture book "Guess How Much I Love You" and guided her in a bedtime prayer. After watching her daughter fall asleep, she gently closed the door.
location: Living room and daughter's room, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's family financial meeting.
description: Aqiang brewed a pot of tea. Song Yajing spread out the accounting book and the comparison table on her phone, starting with the hospital bills from her mother's hospitalization, and explained in detail the health risks and financial pressure the family would face in the future. After a serious discussion, the two reached three important agreements: 1) Starting this month, they would deposit 3,000 yuan into Xuanxuan's education fund every month; 2) In the first half of next year, they would increase the budget by 10,000 yuan to upgrade the family's insurance, especially health insurance for her parents; 3) Aqiang volunteered to use his upcoming year-end bonus as the "seed money" for the education fund. The two high-fived to seal the agreement.
location: Living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Implement the financial plan and keep a gratitude journal
description: After the meeting, Song Yajing felt a great weight lifted off her mind and became much more settled. She took out her phone, created a folder named [Family Finance 2026] in her notes app, and wrote down the key points of the evening's discussion and the three monthly review goals. Then she took out her gratitude journal and wrote down the one thing that made her feel most at ease today: together with her husband, she had made a rational plan for the family's future.
location: Living room and study at the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal hygiene and waist care.
description: After washing up, she again used the electric heating waist belt to apply heat to her lower back for 15 minutes. As she did, she performed a few simple waist stretches. Seeing her relaxed brow in the mirror, she felt a long-missed sense of certainty.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and prayer
description: Slipped into her pajamas, turned off the main light, and turned on the small bedside lamp. She said a brief bedtime prayer for today's smooth communication, her husband's understanding, and her family's peace, then fell asleep contentedly.
location: Bedroom in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The alarm went off on time. Outside the window, the sky was faintly bright and it was cloudy. Song Yajing took a moment to wake up, then got out of bed sideways, did a few simple waist stretches, and relieved the soreness from yesterday's shoot. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Master bedroom, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Preparing breakfast and family chores
description: Song Yajing entered the kitchen, boiled water in the electric kettle, then took whole wheat toast, eggs, milk, and dragon fruit out of the fridge. She deftly fried two sunny-side-up eggs, warmed the milk, and toasted the whole wheat bread until lightly browned. Meanwhile, she took out her phone, opened the banking app, and, following the agreement with A Qiang last night, initiated the education fund transfer. She carefully entered the note "Chen Lexuan Education Fund - November 2025" and transferred 3,000 yuan to the dedicated account. After the transfer succeeded, she took a screenshot and sent it to the family WeChat group with a heart emoji. Chen Zhiqiang immediately replied with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 502, Building A, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast and warm interaction
description: Song Yajing gently woke Chen Lexuan and helped her put on the dinosaur-patterned hoodie she had prepared the night before. The family of three sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan drank warm milk and happily talked about funny things at kindergarten. Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang discussed the evening dinner plan. Chen Zhiqiang said he got off work early and could buy some beef noodles on the way. The breakfast atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Restaurant, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: School drop-off for daughter and commute preparation.
description: Song Yajing put the little backpack on Xuanxuan, and the mother and daughter set off hand in hand. On the way, she asked Xuanxuan what she wanted to draw in the afternoon. Xuanxuan said she wanted to draw “our family at the church.” Song Yajing felt warm inside. After safely handing Xuanxuan to a teacher at Siming Experimental Kindergarten and kissing her little cheek goodbye, she walked back to the bike shed in the residential complex, got on her electric scooter, put on her helmet and gloves, and headed to the store.
location: From the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, then back to the bike shed at the No. 82 Shanggu Street community

name: Store opening preparations and team morning meeting.
description: Song Yajing arrived at the shop on time on her scooter, skillfully opened the door, and turned on the stereo to play soothing light music. She and Xiaomei reorganized the display area that had been messed up by the previous day's video shoot, hanging five New Chinese-style sample outfits according to the styling plan. Xiaomei brought Yajing a glass of warm water and reported feedback from yesterday's customer group about the coffee-colored corduroy skirt—two customers had already made appointments to try it on over the weekend.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online communication and daily store operations
description: Song Yajing turned on her computer and first handled the message from supplier Zheng Kai. Zheng Kai confirmed the restocking logistics tracking number and reminded her that the second 3D rendering discussed yesterday would be sent tomorrow morning. Then Song Yajing attended to a few walk-in customers who came into the store that morning, patiently offering styling suggestions. While the customers were browsing, she and Xiaomei moved several autumn styles they had predicted would sell well to prominent positions.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-shooting preparation for the video
description: Following the optimized schedule, Song Yajing decided to move the video shooting time up so that the afternoon would have more time for editing and interaction. She and Xiaomei went into the back storage room, prepared all five co-branded sample outfits with matching wide-leg pants, silk scarves, and earrings, and set up the phone gimbal and fill light. Song Yajing also practiced her introduction a few times in front of the mirror to ensure smooth delivery.
location: Back warehouse and main display area of Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Xiaomei went out for lunch first. Song Yajing took out the hummus whole-wheat flatbread and dragon fruit she had prepared that morning from her bag. While eating, she quickly scrolled through recent outfit videos by fellow shop owners on her phone to find inspiration for her own videos. After eating, she leaned back on the bean bag sofa, supported her waist with a lumbar belt, and rested with her eyes closed for about 15 minutes, saving energy for the upcoming shoot.
location: Rest area in the back warehouse of Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Co-branded outfit video shoot
description: After a short rest, Song Yajing recovered her energy. She called over Xiaomei, who had returned from lunch, and officially started the shoot. Song Yajing first put on a modified Song brocade vest paired with velvet wide-leg pants, stood under the main light in the store, and explained the craftsmanship and styling points to the camera. Xiaomei was responsible for shooting and directing. With each outfit change, Song Yajing carefully adjusted her state. Although she stood for nearly two hours and her waist felt a bit sore, she used the portable massager Xiaomei provided to relieve it slightly and persisted through all five outfits.
