location: Main display area and in front of the fitting mirror of Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video editing and caption writing
description: After filming, Song Yajing relaxed her lower back and sat on a bar stool. She put on her earphones, opened the CapCut app, and imported the footage. She skillfully cut out the stutter and redundant parts, added uniform retro subtitles reading 'Yaji New Chinese Style' and a soft filter, and adjusted the overall rhythm to be brisk and bright. Meanwhile, she wrote the posting caption in her notes, highlighting trending topics such as 'weekend limited-time in-store discount' and 'Xiamen women's clothing store visits'.
location: Cashier counter at Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video release and initial promotion
description: Song Yajing published the edited video and caption via mobile data to the store's certified Xiaohongshu account and WeChat Channels account, both named "Xiamen Yaji Clothing." After publishing, she immediately forwarded the link to the store's main WeChat customer group and @everyone: "Here's a brand-new video, everyone! Come guess which outfit I like the most?" Xiaomei also updated her personal WeChat Moments at the same time, with the caption "Our boss is acting true to herself; I'm not leaving until you like it," along with a funny emoji.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Online consultation processing and data observation
description: After the video was posted, new likes and comments kept coming in from the backend. While replying to customers' questions about fabric and sizes, Song Yajing guided interested users to send private messages or come to the store for try-ons on the weekend. Seeing the like count steadily rise, she felt a great sense of achievement. At the same time, she processed orders from two online customers, printed out the day's shipping list, and handed it to Xiaomei for packing.
location: Cashier counter at Yaji Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wrap-up tasks and contacting the designer
description: After Xiaomei got off work, Song Yajing carefully hung up and put away the sample garments she had tried on today, and moved the best-selling styles on the display rack to more prominent positions. Then she made a WeChat video call to designer Zheng Kai, thanking him for confirming the restocking logistics on the one hand, and on the other hand expressing her expectations for the second 3D renderings that would be sent tomorrow.
location: Yaji Boutique Clothing Store and back warehouse, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Closing the shop and shopping on the way home
description: Song Yajing confirmed the shop door was locked, turned off the lights, and rode her scooter home. Passing the Suning convenience store near Zhenhai Road Metro Station, she stopped and went in to shop: she bought a bunch of fresh spinach, a bottle of soy sauce, a dragon fruit, and whole-wheat bread for tomorrow morning.
location: From No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Zhenhai Road Metro Station Convenience Store, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, then return to the No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community.

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: Song Yajing arrived home and saw that Chen Zhiqiang had already heated up the beef noodle soup and placed it on the table, while Xuanxuan was building a castle with blocks in the living room. She put down the groceries, washed her hands, and joined Xuanxuan in building blocks. The three chatted while eating dinner, and Xuanxuan said she learned a new nursery rhyme, "Little Swallow," at kindergarten today. Song Yajing and Xuanxuan agreed to go to Jiaxingyuan Park together on the weekend to collect fallen leaves.
location: Living room and dining room, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Video data monitoring and in-depth interaction
description: Song Yajing curled up on the sofa, took out her phone, and scrolled through Xiaohongshu and WeChat. The video was doing even better than she expected, with likes already exceeding one thousand and a lot of comments. She replied carefully one by one, and to customers who were interested in buying, she sent them more detailed size charts and styling suggestions via private messages, and successfully scheduled three customers to come in for try-ons over the weekend.
location: Living room sofa, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family activities and prayer.
description: Song Yajing called Xuanxuan over, and they brushed their teeth and washed their faces together. Then Chen Zhiqiang and Song Yajing sat beside Xuanxuan's bed, and Song Yajing led the bedtime prayer. She gave thanks for the day's safety and smooth progress, and was grateful for the good results of the video. Then she hugged Xuanxuan tightly and said goodnight. Back in the master bedroom, she put on the electric heating lumbar belt and applied a warm compress to her lower back before bed.
location: Daughter's room and master bedroom, Room 502, Building A, Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal review and gratitude journal.
description: Song Yajing tiptoed to the study and opened a document on her computer. She sorted out today's video data (likes, comments, new followers) and planned content ideas for the regular updates on Wednesday and Saturday. Then she opened her diary and wrote three small blessings under the 'gratitude journal' section: 1. The education fund was officially launched, and the heavy weight in her heart was lifted. 2. The video shoot exceeded expectations, and online traffic generation was starting to show results. 3. Coming home to a hot meal made by her husband and the love castle made by her daughter. After writing, she felt full of strength and peace.
location: Study, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Browsed news and went to bed.
description: Song Yajing changed into her pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on. She and Chen Zhiqiang chatted quietly about the next day's schedule for a few minutes, then picked up her phone and glanced through some fashion news. After confirming there was nothing special tomorrow, she turned off the light and went to sleep at 21:30. Before going to sleep, she felt that her lower back was much more comfortable after the hot compress, and she felt calm and content.
location: Master bedroom, Room 502, Building A, No. 82 Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning routine and caring for my daughter.
description: At 06:50 the alarm went off. Song Yajing got up, went to the bathroom, rinsed her lower back with hot water for 5 minutes to relieve soreness, and weighed herself at 48.1 kg. She drank a 300 ml glass of warm water in the kitchen, then returned to the bedroom, applied an electric heating waist belt to her lower back for 15 minutes, and did 3 sets of side and forward waist stretches. At 07:20, after turning off the waist belt, she went to the kitchen to prepare a simple breakfast: boiled egg, whole wheat toast, warm milk, and red-fleshed dragon fruit. At 07:35 she went to her daughter Xuanxuan's room, gently woke her up, helped her change into her kindergarten uniform, and combed her hair into two small braids. At 07:40 the mother and daughter had breakfast together. Xuanxuan excitedly described the ideas for her earlier painting, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walked her daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing put on her commuter bag and electric bike helmet, took Xuanxuan by the hand, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Passing the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, she bought a new set of watercolor pens for Xuanxuan and encouraged her to draw the pictures she wanted to draw at kindergarten today. At 08:05, after a brief handover with the teacher at the kindergarten gate, she watched Xuanxuan go inside.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: On the way to work by bike, contacted the account manager to confirm insurance details.
description: After walking back from the kindergarten to the building, she took out the electric scooter and rode to the Yaji Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road. She parked safely on the roadside of Zhenhai Road, contacted Lin Xiaofeng, the client manager at ICBC, via WeChat voice, raised questions about the payout ratio for minor illnesses under the critical illness insurance, and agreed to make a final decision before noon. After the call, she continued riding and locked the scooter at the designated parking spot outside the store.
location: Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near Zhenhai Road Metro Station, pulled over to the side of the road during the call)

name: Arriving at the store to open up and preparing for the morning meeting
description: At 08:30 she arrived at the store, opened the door, aired the room, and started the cash register and computer. Shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time at 9:00. At the morning meeting, Song Yajing emphasized the importance of the arrival of the co-branded collection and divided the tasks: Xiaomei would be responsible for ironing after unboxing, and she herself would be responsible for display and photography. She also checked the pre-printed thank-you cards exclusive to the co-branded collection, ready to put one into each shopping bag.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Researching insurance plans and replying to customer inquiries
description: While Xiaomei was cleaning, Song Yajing sat at the cash register and carefully compared the insurance comparison table on her phone, focusing on the minor illness payout ratio and waiver clauses of critical illness insurance. She took screenshots, marked her questions, and prepared to send them to Lin Xiaofeng. She also replied to several regular customers' WeChat inquiries about the arrival time of the co-branded items.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Receiving and inspecting the co-branded New Chinese-style women's clothing upon arrival.
description: At 10:00, the delivery truck arrived punctually at the store entrance. Song Yajing and Xiaomei carried the 10 large cardboard boxes into the store together, opened them, and checked each item one by one. After confirming that the styles, colors, and sizes were correct, they signed for the delivery. She took photos of the stacked boxes and sent them to the customer group as a preview, and excitement in the group soared.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Ironing, displaying, and online pre-launch promotion of the co-branded collection.
description: After acceptance, Song Yajing and Xiaomei divided the work: Xiaomei was responsible for hanging all the co-branded items on racks and pressing them smooth with a steam iron; Song Yajing, according to the plan, displayed the featured embroidered frog-button cardigan with a dark green satin skirt at the center of the central island display, adjusted the window lighting to cool white, and placed the co-branded coat on a mannequin in the most prominent position. Starting at 11:15, she shot short videos and photos of the arranged central island and window display, used a mobile app to process the background, and posted an arrival notice in the customer group, along with a pre-sale benefit of 10% off for in-store try-ons. She instantly received reservations from more than a dozen regular customers and replied to each one.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Hosting a local fashion blogger for a store visit and promotion.
description: At 11:45, local fashion blogger Xiao Chen arrived at the store as scheduled. Song Yajing personally recommended three different styles of co-branded outfits for her: commuting, dating, and casual. Xiao Chen was very satisfied and took a large number of photos and videos in the fitting room and the central island area. Song Yajing helped adjust the lighting and angles, and the atmosphere was harmonious. Xiao Chen said on the spot that she would post the social media content right away.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and checking social media.
description: After seeing Xiao Chen off, Song Yajing told Xiaomei to go eat first. She herself went to the rest area in the back storage room and used the microwave to heat up the homemade bento she had brought from home (asparagus stir-fried in olive oil, pan-fried sea fish, and mixed grain rice). While eating, she scrolled through her phone and saw that Xiao Chen had already posted a shop visit note on Xiaohongshu with photos and text, and the likes were climbing. She felt relieved. After the meal, she leaned against the sofa cushion with her eyes closed and rested for about 20 minutes.
location: Rest area in the back stockroom of Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling the afternoon customer rush and restocking bestsellers
description: Starting at 13:15, many customers came drawn by the blogger’s posts and community previews, and the store saw a continuous flow of customers. Song Yajing put her styling expertise to work, recommending co-branded pieces to customers of different body types and explaining the embroidery technique. Xiaomei assisted with fitting, retrieving items, and writing up orders. The part-time packer arrived around 16:00 and handled the backlog of online orders. Meanwhile, Song Yajing used breaks between serving customers to reply to online size inquiries. She found that S/M sizes were in critically low stock, so she immediately checked through the ERP system, urged restocking in the supplier group, and jotted down the best-selling styles and quantities by hand. Busy and tired, she habitually touched her slightly sore lower back.
location: Yaji Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Closing up, counting the day's sales, and buying fruit on the way home by bike
description: At 17:30, Song Yajing let Xiaomei and the part-time packer leave work. She began organizing the clothes scattered in the fitting room, used a lint roller to clean the center island table and the floor, and replenished empty hangers. At 18:00, she sat at the cash register and used Excel to tally the day's sales and the sales of the co-branded items. The data showed that daily sales of the co-branded items exceeded 100 pieces, and she excitedly took a screenshot to remember it. At 18:20, she closed the shop door and turned off the power, then rode an electric scooter home, stopping on the way at a fruit shop near Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy dragon fruit and kiwifruit.
location: Yaji Clothing Store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the fruit shop near No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, finally returning to the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex.

name: After arriving home, apply a hot compress to the lower back and relax briefly.
description: Arrived home at 18:30, changed out of work clothes, and immediately took out the electric heating waist belt and wrapped it around her waist for a warm compress. Her husband Aqiang was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Song Yajing leaned on the living room sofa, applying the warm compress while scrolling through her phone, and felt happy seeing that the customer group was still enthusiastically discussing the co-branded items.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family has dinner together and shares their daily news
description: At 19:00, Aqiang prepared dinner: blanched shrimp, stir-fried Chinese broccoli, and tomato pork rib soup. Song Yajing excitedly shared the news that the co-branded item had sold like crazy, and her husband and daughter were happy for her. Xuanxuan took out a painting she made in kindergarten called 'The Family at Church.' The colors were bright, and she had painted the church's stained glass in rainbow colors. It was warm and lovely.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Published a thank-you announcement in the community to celebrate sales exceeding 100.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing cleared the table, sat on the living room sofa, and edited and posted a carefully crafted thank-you announcement, thanking the designers, store staff, bloggers, and customers, along with screenshots of the co-branded product sales data and visual display photos. The group chat was instantly flooded with congratulations and blessings.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanied daughter in washing up, reading picture books, and saying bedtime prayers.
description: At 20:05, Song Yajing took Xuanxuan to wash up, helped her brush her teeth and wash her face, and changed her into bear-print pajamas. Then she leaned against Xuanxuan's small bed and read the picture book You Look Yummy! with great expression. After reading, she guided Xuanxuan through a bedtime prayer, thanking God for giving them a wonderful day and especially praying for the aunties who had bought beautiful clothes. At 20:30, Xuanxuan fell asleep peacefully, and Song Yajing quietly slipped out of the room.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Try lumbar spine rehabilitation exercises for the first time and record how I feel
description: Back in the master bedroom, following the doctor's advice and the rehabilitation tutorial on my phone, I first lay on my stomach to relax for 5 minutes, then tried the cat-cow pose for the first time: inhale and arch the lower back while lifting the head, exhale and round the back while lowering the head. I slowly completed 3 sets of 10 reps. During the exercise, I felt a slight stretch in the muscles on both sides of the lumbar spine, with no pain. Afterward, I recorded my feelings in the notes app on my phone: the movement was not difficult, my lower back felt a bit looser, and I plan to continue tomorrow.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night chat with husband and planning weekend arrangements.
description: Song Yajing and her husband A Qiang leaned against the headboard and chatted. A Qiang marveled at the day's grand occasion and reminded her to take care of her health. Song Yajing mentioned that she wanted to take the child back to Quanzhou next Saturday to visit her parents and attend Sunday Mass, and A Qiang said he could adjust his leave in advance to support her. They also briefly went over the next day's arrangements: Xiao Mei would take two hours off in the morning, and Song Yajing would need to run the store alone.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Write a gratitude journal and list tomorrow's tasks.
description: At 21:30 went to the study, opened the gratitude journal and wrote down today's three small blessings: the co-branded collection sold over 100 units, a business milestone; the first lumbar spine training felt comfortable; her husband's hot soup and daughter's smile. Then created tomorrow's to-do list in the phone memo: follow up with supplier restocking, reply to Lin Xiaofeng about the insurance decision, watch the store alone at noon, and prepare snacks for Xuanxuan to bring back to Quanzhou in the evening.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After washing up in the evening, praying before bed, and confirming the insurance plan, she went to sleep.
description: At 22:00, she went to the bathroom to wash up and apply face cream. Back in the bedroom, she took out the off-white acetate shirt and dark blue wide-leg jeans she planned to wear the next day, placed them on the bench at the foot of the bed, and checked her phone, power bank, and other items to carry. At 22:20, she turned off the main light and kept the night light on, knelt by the bed for bedtime prayers, thanked God for His grace, and prayed for her family's safety. After lying down, she picked up her phone to reply to Lin Xiaofeng's question about the minor illness payout ratio, and finally decided to choose the critical illness insurance under Plan 1. She used a WeChat voice message to arrange to go to the branch the next morning to sign the contract. After confirming, she put down her phone and at 23:00 fell asleep peacefully, filled with a sense of accomplishment.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Woke up at 7:05, weighed 48.0 kg, then washed up first, rinsed my lower back with hot water, and used a heated waist belt for 15 minutes of heat therapy, while doing deep breathing to wake up my body. I changed into casual pants and a knit top. Then I woke up my daughter Xuanxuan and helped her pick out a sky-blue little jacket and a plaid skirt. I prepared breakfast for the family: whole wheat toast with fried egg and cheese slices, milk with cereal for Xuanxuan, and an unsweetened black coffee for myself. My husband Aqiang got up, and the three of us quickly ate breakfast together. During the meal, Xuanxuan excitedly said that her kindergarten teacher was going to teach them to make leaf collages from fallen leaves, and she planned to pick some red leaves.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Put Xuanxuan's little yellow hat on her, took her hand, and walked along Hubin South Road toward Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, when passing the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, Xuanxuan wanted to buy colored cardstock, so she took her inside to choose a pack, and also bought a sheet of stickers on a whim.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commutted by bike and confirmed the contract signing matters.
description: After dropping off Xuanxuan, she rode an electric scooter along Zhenhai Road and turned onto Zhongshan Road toward the store. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to Lin Xiaofeng, the ICBC customer manager, confirming she would arrive at the branch in half an hour to sign. He replied that the contract was ready and she could come over anytime.
location: The "Yaji" Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: After arriving at the store, she quickly turned on the lights and computer and played soothing light music. She checked yesterday's sales records and unread community messages, and used a small spray bottle to mist the pothos and eucalyptus leaves in the central island area. She packed her ID card and bank card, ready to go to the bank to sign the contract.
location: The "Yaji" Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Signed a critical illness insurance contract
description: After walking about five minutes from the store, she arrived at the ICBC Zhenhai Sub-branch, where account manager Lin Xiaofeng was already waiting in the VIP room. She carefully checked the contract terms, especially confirming the details of minor illness benefits and premium waiver. Satisfied, she signed and completed the first premium payment by card transfer, adding a sense of security to her family.
location: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Xiamen Zhenhai Sub-branch), Room 102, 279 South Siming Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buying coffee and chatting on the way back to the store
description: Feeling relaxed after signing the contract, on the way back to the store I passed the boutique coffee corner on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street that I often go to, and ordered an iced Americano to go. While waiting for the coffee, I chatted with the shop assistant Sister Chen, showed her the photos of the co-branded items posted yesterday. Sister Chen praised the colors and said she would bring her daughter this weekend.
location: Boutique Coffee Corner, No. 225-2, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling community group messages and restocking communications.
description: After returning to the shop, she drank coffee while handling messages in the customer group and private messages. She gave a unified reply to the most frequently asked restocking question and registered names on the reservation list. Then she had a 15-minute phone call with designer Zheng Kai to finalize the shipping time (next Wednesday) and quantity for the second batch of co-branded restock items. He assured her that he would give priority to ensuring no stockouts. Finally, she tallied the online orders to be shipped today and printed the shipping labels.
location: The "Yaji" Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Had a casual meal date with her best friend.
description: She locked the shop door and walked to the milk tea shop in the next block, where her best friend Li Meiling was already sitting by the window. The two each ordered a cup of the signature fruit tea and shared a waffle. During the chat, she shared the sense of security she felt after signing up for critical illness insurance. Meiling complained about the naughty students in her class recently. She also asked Meiling for acupressure methods for lower back pain caused by prolonged sitting, and Meiling taught her a few simple moves hands-on.
location: Milk tea shop, No. 225-2 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy sugar substitute on the way back to the store.
description: After saying goodbye to Meiling, on the way back to the shop she stopped at a roadside convenience store and bought two packs of erythritol sweetener to prepare for the afternoon baking experiment.
location: Convenience store on Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Adjusting displays, tallying sales, and restocking via group sign-up chain
description: After returning to the store, she turned on the computer and organized yesterday's co-branded sales data into a table by style and size, and found that the S and M sizes of the shirt dress were sold out. Then she adjusted the displays: she removed the original items from the central island area and replaced them with the new co-branded shirts and skirts. She combined eucalyptus leaves and cotton to create a modern Chinese literary atmosphere, took photos, and posted them in the customer group with a caption. Afterwards, she posted a restock registration sign-up, highlighting the style numbers and sizes that would soon be out of stock for everyone to pre-order. After replying to online inquiries, she packed her bag, checked the doors, windows, water, and electricity, locked the door at 15:25, and rode her electric scooter home.
location: The "Yaji" Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tried low-sugar Minnan cake for the first time and prepared dinner.
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, she couldn't wait to start experimenting with the low-sugar Minnan steamed cake. Following her mother's recipe, she replaced brown sugar with erythritol, carefully weighed the flour, glutinous rice flour, and sugar substitute, mixed them with warm water and yeast into a batter, and placed it beside the heater to rise until doubled in size (about 45 minutes), then steamed it for 25 minutes. When it came out, the cake was slightly pale in color and a bit dry and not fluffy. She recorded the ingredient amounts, fermentation time, and texture issues in detail in her baking notebook, planning to adjust the water quantity next time. Then she let the cake cool and started preparing dinner: steamed sea bass, stir-fried lettuce with minced garlic, and sweet potato rice. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of the food.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner together and a walk in the park.
description: A Qiang picked Xuanxuan up and brought her home. As soon as she came through the door, Xuanxuan shouted, “It smells so good!” During dinner, they ate and chatted. Xuanxuan showed the collage she had made in kindergarten from fallen leaves and cardboard, with an oak tree and red and yellow leaves. I mentioned this afternoon's baking failure, and A Qiang comforted me, saying next time we should try adding a bit more water. After dinner we rested for a while, then at 19:00 the whole family changed shoes and went for a walk in Jiaxingyuan Park. A Qiang walked in front holding Xuanxuan's hand, while I slowly walked beside them. We walked around the central flowerbed for about 25 minutes, totaling about 4,000 steps. My lower back was a bit tired but felt easier than yesterday.
location: From the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road, Siming District.

name: Family interaction and daughter's bedtime routine
description: After the walk, we got home and had Xuanxuan take a bath first. I cut the low-sugar cake I had made in the afternoon into small pieces and put them on a plate. Aqiang tasted a piece and said it was like the steamed cake from his childhood but not soft enough, a bit dry, probably because there was too little water. After her bath, Xuanxuan also took a curious bite and said it tasted like rubber and was not good, but she immediately encouraged me, saying we can try again. Then I helped Xuanxuan brush her teeth and read her Guess How Much I Love You. She imitated the little bunny and interacted with the story. At 8:45 p.m. I kissed her forehead, and we said our bedtime prayer together: Thank You, Lord, bless Mom, Dad, and Grandma with health, and make tomorrow happy.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lumbar rehabilitation training, gratitude journal, and bedtime preparation
description: Back in the bedroom, she laid out the yoga mat and did 3 sets of cat-cow pose, 10 reps each. She felt her spine slowly stretching and the soreness in her lower back ease. Then she used an electric heating lumbar belt to apply heat for 15 minutes. Afterwards, she went to the study to write in her gratitude journal, recording three things: 1. successfully signed the critical illness insurance; 2. her daughter encouraged her to try baking again; 3. she kept up her 25-minute walk. After washing up, she applied moisturizer and changed into pajamas. At 22:00 she lay down in bed and quietly chatted with Aqiang about restocking the store and his company. At 22:20 she said her bedtime prayers, thanking the Lord for a peaceful day and praying for a smooth tomorrow. After setting the alarm, she turned off the lights at 22:30 and rested.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning stretches, family breakfast, and taking daughter to school
description: At 07:30 she was woken by the alarm clock. She did simple lower back stretching and rehabilitation exercises in bed, then washed up and changed into home clothes. At 07:40 she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: cheese omelet, hot milk, and oranges. Meanwhile, her husband Chen Zhiqiang washed up, woke up their daughter Chen Lexuan, and helped her comb her hair. At 08:00 the family of three had breakfast on time, chatting about the day's plans while eating. At 08:05 breakfast ended; she helped her daughter put on her backpack, and her husband cleared the dishes. At 08:10 she took her daughter out and walked along Zhenhai Road and Park South Road to the kindergarten. On the way, she bought her a small red bean paste bun at Laosiming Steamed Bun Shop. At 08:20 they arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At 08:25 she handed her daughter to the teacher on duty and watched her run happily into the classroom.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Commute to the shop and be on duty for the morning
description: After dropping off her daughter, she walked to the shop. At 08:40, she bought bottled water and a magazine at the FamilyMart on the corner of Zhongshan Road. At 08:50, she arrived at "Yajing Collection," opened the rolling shutter door for ventilation, and checked the accounts and displays. Then she picked out the new styles reserved by community customers and hung them on the small blackboard. At 09:30, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, and together they organized the newly arrived Neo-Chinese co-branded items, took photos, posted them in the VIP group, and replied to inquiries. From 10:30 to 12:00, she received customers in a steady stream, sitting down every hour to rest her lower back. During that time, she also checked next month's restocking list and confirmed the shipping date with the Guangzhou supplier Susan over WeChat. At 12:30, customer traffic decreased, and after handing over to Xiaomei, she closed the shop early and left.
location: Yajingji, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closed the shop and went home for lunch and rest.
description: 12:30 left the store and walked home, buying soy sauce at the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station on the way. Arrived home at 12:50; her husband was still working overtime at noon and had not returned. She cooked tomato and egg noodles and blanched a plate of greens for a simple lunch, light and satisfying.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Experimenting with and tasting improved low-sugar Minnan cakes
description: At 13:10, she finished lunch and rested briefly. At 13:30, she went into the kitchen and started the second low-sugar Minnan-style cake improvement experiment. Following last night's list, she weighed out rice flour, glutinous rice flour, sugar substitute, and honey again, mixed the honey with the other liquids, added them to the flour mixture in batches, stirred to the right moisture, poured it into a baking pan, and baked it. At 15:00, the oven beeped on time to signal it was done. The surface was golden with no cracks, and the toothpick test showed it was fully cooked. She took it out to cool, cleaned the counter at 15:10, and then tasted a bite. The texture was fine and soft, the honey's light sweetness blended with the rice aroma, and the moisture level was successfully improved. She took a photo, posted it to the family group, and announced, "Development successful!" From 15:20 to 15:30, she leaned back on the sofa, scrolled her phone, and replied to customers' messages about the new collaboration items, feeling pleased.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Picking up her daughter from school and playing in the community
description: At 15:30, she left home with her keys and a thermos and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At 15:40, she picked up her daughter, who excitedly shared that she had painted a castle in the after-school care class today. On the way home, they walked along Gucheng West Road and Gongyuan South Road and reached the residential complex at 15:55. Her daughter wanted to play on the slide at the children's playground downstairs. After about 15 minutes of playing, they ran into Duoduo's mom, their neighbor, and chatted about their plans for choosing primary schools for their kids next year.
location: The community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family tasting pastries and preparing dinner.
description: At 16:15, I took my daughter home, and my husband also arrived home from working overtime. I served sliced pieces of the improved Southern Fujian cake. After tasting it, both father and daughter praised it repeatedly. My daughter said it was better than the kindergarten's, and my husband commented that the texture was comparable to the ones sold outside. At 17:00, I began preparing dinner, heated up home-style dishes, and featured the Southern Fujian cake as the highlight dessert. My husband stayed in the living room reading picture books with my daughter.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: At 17:30, the family of three enjoyed dinner. The dishes included assorted fish simmered in soy sauce broth, stir-fried Chinese broccoli, tomato and scrambled eggs, and clam and tofu soup. They chatted as they ate; their daughter shared her experience as the class monitor, and her husband talked about funny work stories. After dinner, they served a modified Southern Fujian rice cake as dessert. Her husband had another piece and suggested it could be a gift from the shop.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family evening walk
description: At 18:30, the family of three went out for a walk. The daughter led the way on a small pink bicycle, while the couple walked shoulder to shoulder behind her. They walked along Zhenhai Road and Bailu Road to Jiaxingyuan Park, strolling on the pedestrian path for nearly 30 minutes and circling the park twice. The husband shared the small prize he had drawn at the company annual party, and Song Yajing talked about improving her pastry recipes and the latest trends she had noticed in the afternoon. Her waist felt relieved.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Going home to rest and video chatting with Mom
description: At 19:15 she walked home, asked her husband to take their daughter to wash up, and washed her face and rested briefly. At 19:40 she started a WeChat video call with her mother Lin Xiuying in Quanzhou, excitedly showing the improved golden, soft Minnan cake. Her mother affirmed her work and taught her an old trick: adding a little rice wine to the batter during fermentation enhances the aroma and makes it fluffier. Song Yajing took careful notes. Mother and daughter, separated by the screen, recalled the days of hands-on teaching and talked for nearly 40 minutes.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Evening chores and spending time with daughter
description: After hanging up at 20:30, she cleaned up the dishes and utensils in the kitchen and wrapped the improved Southern Fujian rice cake in plastic wrap before putting it in the fridge. At 21:00 she accompanied her daughter to wash up, then read two “Little Bear Baby” picture books, mimicking animal sounds to make her laugh in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Late-night couple talk and store review
description: After their daughter fell asleep at 21:30, she returned to the master bedroom. Her husband was using his computer to finish up loose ends from work. Song Yajing lay down to chat with him, while also handling unread messages in the store community and making a to-do note for the next day. They also discussed initial plans to return to Quanzhou to see their parents during the Spring Festival, and her husband expressed support.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and restful reflection.
description: At 22:00 she got up to wash up, soaked her feet in hot water, and applied a heating pack to her lower back for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue. At 22:25 she went back to bed and turned on the nightlight, recalled the process of improving the pastries, picked up her phone and jotted down her thoughts in the Notes app: ‘The honey version worked! Mother suggested the rice wine method; I’ll try it next time.’ She also looked through photos of the baked goods and felt content. At 22:40 she put down her phone, turned off the light, and fell into a deep, fulfilling sleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Compound, Zhenhai Road, Zhonghua Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family time.
description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing got up after praying devoutly in bed, and prepared breakfast for her daughter Chen Lexuan: she fried a soft-yolk egg, toasted bread, and poured warm milk for her daughter. Then she gently woke her daughter, helped her put on a pink floral dress and tied her little braids, telling her they were going to the church today. After packing everything, she boxed the improved low-sugar Minnan cake she had made the day before, ready to share.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Gulangyu Catholic Church
description: Song Yajing walked with her daughter to Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 1 to Lundu Station, walked to Xiamen Ferry Terminal after exiting, and took the citizens' special ferry to Neicuo'ao Pier on Gulangyu. After getting off the ferry, they walked along Lujiao Road for about five minutes and arrived at Gulangyu Catholic Church.
location: From No. 82 Compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, via Zhenhai Road Metro Station, Xiamen Ferry Terminal, and Gulangyu Neicuo'ao Pier, to Gulangyu Catholic Church (34 Lujiao Road, Siming District)

name: Attended Sunday Mass and fellowship with fellow parishioners.
description: Song Yajing took her daughter to the 9 a.m. Sunday Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church, officiated by Father Wang Mingde. She devoutly prayed for her family, the store, and her mother. After Mass, in the courtyard, she shared her homemade low-sugar Minnan cake with fellow churchgoer Lin Xiuying and was praised for it; they also shared the good news that her mother’s health was improving.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return trip and winning a prize at the supermarket
description: After Mass, Song Yajing and her daughter took the ferry back to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, then walked to the Tangchao Shengqian Supermarket on Zhongshan Road to buy baking supplies. At checkout, they used membership points to enter a lucky draw. Her daughter pressed the button and unexpectedly won the grand prize: a multifunctional electric oven. Song Yajing excitedly shared the joy in her close friends group and church group, then took a taxi home with the ingredients and the new oven.
location: From Neicuo'ao Pier on Gulangyu Island via Xiamen Ferry Terminal to Tangchao Money-Saving Supermarket (No. 7, Siming North Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province), then returned to her home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 residential community.

name: Lunch and trial baking with the new oven.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing shared her excitement about winning the prize with her husband Chen Zhiqiang. The family had a simple meal of noodles, with Minnan cake as dessert. After the meal, she couldn't wait to clean the new oven and run it empty to remove the odor, then mixed up egg tart filling and baked a tray of golden, crispy egg tarts in the new oven. Her husband and daughter were full of praise after tasting them.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon baking and Thanksgiving planning
description: After finishing the egg tarts, Song Yajing planned a Thanksgiving customer appreciation event for the store in her study, selected VIP members, designed handwritten thank-you cards to go with homemade nut and oat crunch gift packs, and made a shopping list. She then returned to the kitchen and, using techniques passed down from her mother, made a proper low-sugar Minnan cake. After adjusting the recipe, the finished cake was fluffy and soft. She took a photo and saved it as a backup gift option for Thanksgiving.
location: The study and kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Going out to buy Thanksgiving supplies
description: Song Yajing took a short rest, then drove to the baking studio in Xianhou, Huli District. She carefully selected nuts such as almonds, pumpkin seeds, and dried cranberries, as well as cake flour and packaging supplies; she then drove to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road, picked out dried-flower stickers and blank thank-you cards, and finally returned home with a full car of materials to prepare for making Thanksgiving gift bags.
location: Starting from the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, to the Xianhou Baking Studio at No. 120 in Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, then to the Yubin City Phase 2 stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, and finally returning home

name: Making Thanksgiving thank-you cards
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing sorted and stored the purchased materials, then began designing thank-you cards in the study. She carefully combined and pasted ginkgo leaf and maple leaf pressed-flower stickers onto blank thank-you cards, and handwritten warm, personalized thank-you messages for each VIP member, while also planning the specific production process for the nut and oat crunch gift packs.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner time
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang cooked stir-fried asparagus, pan-fried pomfret, and radish pork rib soup. The family of three sat around the dining table, sharing their day's experiences while eating: Song Yajing talked about what she saw while shopping and Aunt Lin's praise for the Minnan cake, while her husband mentioned the thank-you oranges he received for helping the community security guard fix his computer. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk and evening parent-child time
description: After dinner, the family of three walked to Jiaxingyuan Park for a stroll. The evening breeze gently blew, and the couple discussed the details of the Thanksgiving event as they walked. After the walk, they went home. Song Yajing bathed her daughter and told her favorite bedtime story, "The Bremen Town Musicians." Her daughter soon fell asleep with a sweet smile.
location: Walked from home to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and returned home after a stroll.

name: Evening tidying and mood journaling.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing went to the study and organized the Thanksgiving event plan she had perfected today into a computer document, refining the thank-you card design and gift bag production process. Then she took out her notebook and wrote down the joy of winning the prize and successfully making pastries, leaving a mark on this fulfilling day.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal care and bedtime prayer before sleep
description: Song Yajing soaked her feet comfortably in hot water with a mugwort foot soak bag, applied a heat pack to her lower back, and did a few stretching exercises following a rehabilitation app. Before going to bed, she said her evening prayers devoutly, thanking God for the grace and smoothness of the whole day. After setting the alarm for seven o'clock the next morning, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: The phone alarm went off on time. Song Yajing got up, washed up, and changed into loungewear. The millet porridge she had scheduled the night before was already cooked. She quickly fried a sunny-side egg, toasted whole wheat bread, and served it with homemade low-sugar Minnan cake. She woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, braided her little pigtails, and changed her into her kindergarten uniform. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already left for the company's morning meeting. Mother and daughter sat at the dining table eating breakfast, while Xuanxuan chattered about weekend church activities and the funny story of winning an oven.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten and go to the store
description: Song Yajing walked with her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan recalled the oven grand prize and said she would bake a cake for her mother in the future. At the kindergarten gate, she briefly handed her daughter over to the teacher. After watching her daughter enter the classroom, Song Yajing walked to the shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, passing a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road without stopping.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store opening preparation and product display adjustment
description: Song Yajing arrived at the Yajing Lifestyle Store, swiped her card to open the door, turned on the soft lighting and light music, and checked the cash register system and change. Taking advantage of the quiet morning, she restyled the entrance mannequin with the newly arrived silk scarves and dried-flower stickers, creating a warm autumn-winter look and a cozy vintage atmosphere.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Photographing Minnan Rice Cakes and Writing Reflections.
description: Using the natural light that streamed through the display window in the morning, Song Yajing arranged low-sugar Minnan cakes on the rattan placemat at the counter, garnished with dried osmanthus flowers and mint leaves in small white porcelain dishes, and took photos from multiple angles. Afterwards, she wrote and shared her reflections, candidly recounting her journey from pursuing Western pastries to returning to traditional Minnan cakes, mentioning the detail that her mother suggested adding rice wine to enhance the aroma, as well as the health philosophy behind the low-sugar recipe.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daily business operations and handwritten thank-you cards
description: After the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, the two made a brief handover. Song Yajing attended to the occasional customers and recommended new styles while writing Thanksgiving gift bag thank-you cards by hand behind the cash register. On each card, she wrote the customer’s name and a warm, thoughtful thank-you message in neat, elegant handwriting.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out for lunch and purchasing packaging materials
description: Song Yajing asked Xiaomei to watch the store and strolled alone to an old-established satay noodle shop at the end of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, where she ordered a classic satay noodle with tofu and squid. After the meal, she stopped by the nearby Niumi Jiangzao Community Life Supermarket and bought small food sealing bags and simple kraft-paper label stickers to prepare for the evening baking.
location: The satay noodle shop near Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Niumi Jiangzao Community Life Service Supermarket, 76 Xiaqi Road, Siming District

name: Community post and initial engagement
description: Back at the bar area in the store, Song Yajing combined the edited photos and her reflections into a photo-text post titled 'The Birth of Mom's Kitchen Low-Sugar Minnan Cake' and published it in the WeChat group and Moments of Yajing Lifestyle Pavilion. In less than half an hour, it received many likes and comments. Regular customers expressed their intention to place custom orders one after another, and she replied to each one while also previewing the Thanksgiving gift bag event.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon Shop Operations and In-Depth Customer Care
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Song Yajing and shop assistant Xiaomei divided the work, one attending to customers choosing new clothes and the other handling the cash register and tidying up. During gaps between serving customers, she proactively chatted with a few regular customers, showed them photos of Minnan cakes, and invited them to come and taste them at the shop in the future. At the same time, she kept interacting in the group, answering questions about the low-sugar ratio. Group members also shared their own low-sugar attempts one after another, creating a lively atmosphere.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing the shop and preparing to go home
description: As the evening customer flow gradually thinned out, Song Yajing checked the revenue report, then cleaned up with Xiaomei and put the tried-on clothes back in place. She packed the ten thank-you cards written during the day and the packaging materials bought in the afternoon into a large cloth bag, then turned off the lights and locked the door.
location: Yajing Lifestyle Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing walked back to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and arrived just in time for school dismissal. Her daughter Xuanxuan ran over excitedly and held up a painting, saying it was a "new oven" she had drawn. Song Yajing praised her for drawing well and walked home with her, chatting while holding her hand.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner and doing housework
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing asked her daughter to wash her hands and eat some fruit, while she tied on an apron and prepared dinner. Tonight's menu was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised pork ribs, and tomato egg drop soup, with rice as the staple. At the same time, she sorted the dirty laundry and put it in the washing machine. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came home from work at that moment.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table for dinner. Song Yajing shared the enthusiastic response from the community to the Minnan cakes that day and the customers' expectations for the Thanksgiving gift packages, and also mentioned her plan to bake oat crisps in the evening. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang said he would do everything to help, while her daughter Xuanxuan said eagerly that she wanted to help too.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk
description: After dinner, the family rested briefly, then changed into comfortable shoes and went out for a walk. Following their nightly routine, they walked along the usual route to Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan led the way on her kids' scooter, while Song Yajing and her husband walked side by side behind her, stretching their shoulders and necks that were a bit stiff from standing for a long time and discussing tips for using the new oven. They walked about 4,100 steps today, her lower back was stable, and she felt very relaxed.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Evening family time and putting the child to sleep
description: After returning home, her husband read picture books with their daughter in the living room while Song Yajing prepared her daughter's bath clothes. Then she bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into cute pajamas, and sat by the bed, softly reading her a new picture book until her daughter fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Baking nutty oat crisp
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went to the kitchen to prepare supplies for Thanksgiving gift bags. She took out the rolled oats, almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, honey, and olive oil bought the day before. Her husband was responsible for mixing the oats and nuts, while she precisely controlled the ratio of honey and olive oil to ensure a low-sugar, healthy result. Using the newly won multi-function electric oven, they baked in batches at 180°C for about 15 minutes, filling the house with aroma. After cooling naturally until crisp, they packed each 50 g portion into food storage bags, sealed with kraft paper labels and hemp twine, making exactly 50 portions.
location: Home kitchen, 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Organized materials and prepared for rest.
description: Song Yajing neatly placed the 50 packaged portions of crispy oats into a storage box with a lid and put it in the corner of the living room. Then she washed the mixing bowls and baking trays, and wiped down the kitchen stove. Back in the bedroom, she did some simple stretches and soaked her tired feet in hot water.
location: At home in the No. 82 residential community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayers and diary
description: After changing into pajamas and leaving only a bedside lamp on, Song Yajing knelt by the bed and prayed quietly, thanking the Lord for His grace and her family's health, and asking for a safe tomorrow. Then she recorded today's feelings in her phone notes: "The sharing of Minnan cake was unexpectedly popular, and the community interaction was lively; half of the Thanksgiving gift bag materials are ready, which puts my mind at ease. Though tired, I feel fulfilled." After writing, she set the alarm for 7 o'clock the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom in the family home at No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared a nutritious breakfast and sampled the cookies.
description: After being woken by the alarm at 6:55 in the morning, Song Yajing finished washing up, put the soaked millet and pumpkin cubes from last night into a pot to cook porridge, and at the same time took out the low-sugar nut oat crisp cookies baked last night from the fridge and steamed them with eggs. While waiting, she took out paper and pen to quickly organize the day's to-do items, and left a message for her husband Zhiqiang reminding him to prepare for the Thanksgiving gift pack event. After breakfast was ready, she also tried two pieces of the cookies to confirm they were still crispy after sealed storage.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family breakfast and reminders
description: Song Yajing woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and helped her put on a warm jacket. The family of three enjoyed millet pumpkin porridge, boiled eggs, and oat crisp cookies at the table. During the meal, she reminded her husband Chen Zhiqiang to check whether the newly delivered gift packaging materials at home were intact after work, and made an appointment with her daughter to go for a walk and look at fallen leaves after school.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Took her daughter to school and started shopping.
description: Song Yajing walked out holding her daughter's hand while a light drizzle was falling. After taking her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, she bought a warm glutinous rice ball from a breakfast cart on the street as a snack, then headed toward Zhongshan Road to begin her shopping run.
location: At the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Purchased packaging materials at the Eighth Market.
description: Song Yajing walked to the Eighth Market and bought 100 off-white thick kraft paper bags, 50 meters of fine twine, and 10 packs of dried flower stickers at Lao Zhang's stall. Then she replenished 5 gold gel pens at the stationery wholesale store at the alley entrance, ensuring the handwritten card session in the afternoon would be colorful.
location: Eighth Market, No. 44 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up flower materials at the flower shop and make an invitation
description: Song Yajing walked to Zhao Li’s boutique flower shop “Huajianji.” Zhao Li had already prepared a large bundle of fresh eucalyptus leaves and assorted dried flowers. Song Yajing found the variety of dried flowers richer than expected and immediately invited Zhao Li to come to the shop in the evening to help with the floral arrangement for the Thanksgiving gift if she was free.

participant.name: Zhao Li
participant.relation: A friend who runs a flower shop.

location: Zhao Li's flower shop Huajian Ji, near Lujiang Road/Kaiyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the store for handover and morning meeting.
description: Song Yajing stacked the purchased materials in the storage room of Jingxin Wardrobe and held a brief morning meeting with store assistant Xiaomei: confirmed normal business operations, distributed flowers, told Xiaomei that Zhao Li might come to the store before noon, and instructed that the afternoon priority was to follow up on the delivery logistics of Susan's new arrivals from Guangzhou.
location: Serenity Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home to arrange floral materials and set up a writing space.
description: Song Yajing took the bus home, arranged eucalyptus leaves in a vase, sorted the dried flowers, set out kraft paper bags, twine, and a gold pen on the dining table, and spread a clean tablecloth. She brewed a cup of jasmine tea, took out the first unwritten name from the thank-you card list she had compiled yesterday, and officially began her handwritten thank-you card project.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Focused on handwriting thank-you cards (morning)
description: Song Yajing sat at the dining table, opened the VIP member list on her phone, and started writing from entry No. 16. For each card, she carefully recalled the details of how she had met that customer, and warm words flowed from her pen. Midway through, her wrist began to ache, so she stood up and moved around for a while.
location: Home dining table, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and customer community interaction
description: Song Yajing put down her pen, cooked a bowl of clear broth noodle soup, and had it with a boiled egg and cucumber salad for lunch. While eating, she opened the customer community, sent encouraging emojis to members who posted breakfast photos, and replied to a young mother's question about winter innerwear, recommending the store's new cashmere knit sweater.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Writing cards and trying out flower arrangements.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing continued writing thank-you cards. When she reached the 25th one, inspiration struck. She used twine to paste eucalyptus leaves and dried flowers onto the outside of a kraft paper bag and took a photo of the floral packaging. Then, at the dining table, she used the floral materials to make a simple bouquet sample, tied with coffee-colored twine, and felt fresh and satisfied.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rest, relaxation, and store monitoring.
description: After writing continuously for nearly 4 hours, Song Yajing went to the living room to stretch her shoulders and neck and do lateral waist bends. She boiled water again and made a fresh cup of Da Hong Pao, while reviewing the store's surveillance footage to confirm that the morning customer flow had been normal.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Finish the thank-you card and pre-assemble the gift bags.
description: After relaxing mentally, Song Yajing focused on writing the remaining 15 thank-you cards and checked the list to make sure none of the 50 members were missed. Then she took out the nut and oat crisps packaged the night before, tucked a handwritten card into each bag, folded the kraft paper bag shut, tied it with twine, and inserted a eucalyptus leaf. She completed 10 full gift packages and took photos as a keepsake.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picking up daughter from school and taking a walk in the neighborhood.
description: Song Yajing left early to pick up Xuanxuan from kindergarten and ran into neighbor Aunt Zhang at the entrance, chatting about the kindergarten's parent-child handicraft activity. After picking up her daughter, the two took a walk in the community garden. Xuanxuan picked up fallen leaves, and Song Yajing told her these were the colors of autumn.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the small garden in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street

name: Preparing a creative dinner
description: After returning home, Song Yajing set about preparing dinner: for the first time, she tried a cold chickpea salad with honey and lemon zest, mixing cooked chickpeas with fresh lemon juice and honey-rubbed lemon zest; for the other half, she pan-seared salmon with just a thin layer of oil and a little sea salt. After work, her husband Chen Zhiqiang took over caring for their daughter and was responsible for making seaweed egg drop vegetable soup. The kitchen was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family Thanksgiving Dinner
description: The family of three sat together to enjoy dinner. The daughter liked the cold chickpea salad, and the husband praised the pan-fried salmon as tender and fresh. Song Yajing shared the flowers and the content of the thank-you card sent by Zhao Li, and the whole family was happy that the Thanksgiving event was about to take place.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family after-dinner walk.
description: After the rain, the air was fresh. The family of three strolled around the neighborhood and the surrounding alleys for about 30 minutes. Song Yajing and her husband discussed how to finish packing the remaining gift packs in the next couple of days, and she asked him to help move some of the gift packs to the shop.
location: The residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the surrounding lanes.

name: Parent-child time and putting her daughter to sleep
description: After walking home, Song Yajing used bubble clay with Xuanxuan to shape a little rabbit, then helped her bathe and change into pajamas. Xuanxuan picked two picture books; Song Yajing read them patiently and taught her a simple prayer of gratitude. At 21:00, Xuanxuan fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gratitude journal and meditation
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing used a diary app in the study to record three things she was grateful for today: Zhao Li generously lending her the flower materials; the thought that customers might smile knowingly when they receive the cards; and her husband's support in packing the gift boxes. Then she played a 10-minute guided meditation audio in the bedroom to fully relax.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and skincare.
description: Song Yajing soaked her feet in a mugwort foot bath, put on a steam eye mask, and applied a moisturizing mask. Reviewing today's completed checklist—purchases finished, 50 cards written, and 10 gift bags pre-assembled—she felt satisfied. At 22:40, she turned off the light, said a brief silent prayer, and went to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time.
description: The phone alarm rang, Song Yajing woke up, and the light rain outside made her feel at ease. After washing up, she stood by the window in silent prayer, thanking God for a new day. Then she cooked millet porridge in a clay pot in the kitchen, fried sunny-side-up eggs and bacon, and, in between, sat down at the dining table with champagne-colored stationery and a gilded pen, focusing on writing the last 15 Thanksgiving thank-you cards. When she wrote about the regular customer who had quietly sent masks during the pandemic, her eyes welled up. At 7:45, she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her put on her coral fleece pajamas, and braided her hair into two pigtails. After her husband Chen Zhiqiang got up, the family sat around the table. Xuanxuan drank her hot porridge and happily recited the new nursery rhyme she had learned at kindergarten, filling the home with warm laughter.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Community 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking daughter to school and running shopping errands on the commute
description: The rain eased. Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan put on her raincoat and rain boots, held up a transparent long-handled umbrella, and took her hand to walk her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Watching her daughter skip into the teaching building with a small backpack, she turned and left. On the way home, she stopped by the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station and bought two large bottles of mineral water, wet wipes, dish sponges, and tea bags on promotion. Then, carrying the items, she walked through familiar alleys at a leisurely pace toward the shop on Zhongshan Road. Along the way, the aroma of breakfast shops filled the air as the neighborhood gradually woke up—everything was a familiar and beloved rhythm of life.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, via Zhenhai Road Metro Station Convenience Store, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, to Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Shop opening preparation and display adjustments
description: Song Yajing used her key to pull up the rolling shutter door and turned on the store's soft warm lighting. She quickly mopped the floor and ran a dusting feather duster over every corner of the display shelves. Then she removed the original trench coat from the mannequin at the store entrance and dressed it in a newly arrived oatmeal-colored wool-blend cardigan and a pair of off-white wide-leg pants, creating a cozy, relaxed atmosphere.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning customer reception and daily operations
description: The shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time. Song Yajing held a brief morning meeting, assigned the task of packing gift bags in the afternoon, and asked Xiaomei to send messages to a few regular customers on WeChat. In the morning, four or five customers came in one after another. Song Yajing greeted them warmly, recommended outfits based on their body shapes and temperaments, successfully sold a wool coat, and pre-ordered next season's new styles for a regular customer.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Xiaomei took her break first and went to eat. Song Yajing asked her to bring back a portion of the signature char siu rice from the "Weiyi" tea restaurant. While there were no customers in the shop, she sat on the sofa in the rest area and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, looking at the popular "Maillard" styling trend to gather outfit inspiration for the afternoon's work.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Jingxin Wardrobe, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (in-store rest area)

name: Confirm the mailing list and appointment communication.
description: After Xiaomei finished her meal and came back, Song Yajing opened her laptop, exported the guest list for the Thanksgiving event from the membership system, and carefully checked the addresses and phone numbers of 50 VIP customers. She then contacted Mr. Zhang from SF Express to schedule a pickup at 9:30 tomorrow morning. After that, she sent a voice message to her fellow church member Zhao Li: “Lili, around what time will you get here this afternoon? Looking forward to your skilled hands!”
location: Jingxin Wardrobe (back storage room in the store), No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Collectively packing Thanksgiving gift packs
description: At 1 p.m., Zhao Li arrived as promised, bringing several dried flower stickers she had designed. The three divided the work clearly: Zhao Li was responsible for creatively combining thank-you cards with the dried flower stickers to beautify the cards; Xiao Mei quickly and deftly packed the pre-ordered nut oat crunch into kraft paper bags; Song Yajing tied a chic bow on each bag with twine and eucalyptus leaves. They chatted while working, from church ceremonies to trending milk tea, with constant laughter. The remaining 40 gift bags were also neatly sealed and stacked in the corner.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe (back storage room in the store), No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community interaction and sharing.
description: After wrapping up the packages, Song Yajing took out her phone and saw that several group members in the WeChat group "Yajing Life Studio" had posted photos of their low-sugar baked goods. She scrolled through carefully and replied with praise one by one: "Wow, this pandan cake roll is so creative, the color is gorgeous!" "Your whole-wheat bagels look more professional than the ones sold in stores!" She also took a photo of the gift packages she had just wrapped and posted it to the group, drawing a wave of admiration and anticipation.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe (back storage room in the store), No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up the shop and setting off to pick up my daughter.
description: The three carefully moved all the gift packages to the open space beside the cashier counter, making it convenient for the courier to pick them up tomorrow. Song Yajing reminded Xiaomei to close the doors and windows and turn off the water and electricity, then changed her shoes and set out early to pick up her daughter, walking a little faster than usual, afraid of missing the school dismissal bell.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, from Jingxin Wardrobe on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to the road

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten on time and saw her daughter Chen Lexuan standing with her classmates, carrying a small backpack. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her mother, she happily rushed over and excitedly shared today's drawing—umbrellas and a rainbow on a rainy day. Along the way, her daughter chattered about fun little events, and Song Yajing held her hand, her heart full of gentle happiness.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the way home.

name: Prepare dinner
description: After getting home, Song Yajing put on an apron and took out the fresh yellowfin fish and broccoli she had bought at the market yesterday from the refrigerator. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came home early from work and voluntarily took on the work of washing the rice, cooking the rice, and cleaning the vegetables. Song Yajing steamed the yellowfin fish, stir-fried the broccoli, and made a bowl of tender steamed egg with dried shrimp for Xuanxuan using a few eggs and some dried shrimp. The kitchen filled with the aroma of cooking food.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Residential Compound No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (kitchen)

name: Warm family dinner
description: Dinner time, the family sat together. Song Yajing shared the fun story of packing gift bags with Zhao Li and Xiaomei in the afternoon, and Chen Zhiqiang smiled and said he had seen the photos in the group chat. Xuanxuan proudly showed off her painting and insisted on explaining the story in the picture to her father. The dining table was filled with laughter and joy, and the fatigue of the day faded away at that moment.
