location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk after dinner, following the rain
description: The air after the rain was moist and fresh. The family of three put on comfortable shoes and went out for a walk to the nearby Jiaxingyuan Park. Xuanxuan was like a happy little sparrow, deliberately stepping into puddles, giggling at the splashing water. Chen Zhiqiang took Song Yajing's arm and said considerately, “Tomorrow is the Thanksgiving event, so you'll surely be busy all day. Tonight I'll put Xuanxuan to bed, and you can rest early.” Song Yajing leaned on his shoulder and felt warm inside.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park and surrounding streets, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bathed daughter, read picture books, and put her to sleep
description: After returning home from the walk, Chen Zhiqiang took Xuanxuan to bathe as promised, and laughter from the father and daughter playing with water came from the bathroom. Song Yajing used this time to organize in the living room the items she needed to take to the store the next day. After the bath, Chen Zhiqiang read two of his daughter's favorite picture books to her, and before long, the room was quiet.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (bathroom and daughter's room)

name: Soaked feet, did skincare, and wrote in her gratitude journal.
description: Song Yajing made herself a cup of rose tea, filled a basin with hot water, added lavender essential oil, and sat down comfortably to soak her feet. While applying a face mask, she opened the diary app on her phone and recorded three things she was grateful for today: thanking Zhao Li and Xiaomei for their full support today; thanking her husband for being so considerate and proactively sharing family responsibilities; and thanking the sisters in her community for filling her social circle with warmth.
location: Unit 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (living room and bedroom)

name: Relaxing before bed and chatting with her husband
description: After soaking her feet, her whole body felt warm and cozy, and Chen Zhiqiang also came out of their daughter's room. The two leaned against the headboard. Song Yajing shared some touching moments from packing the gift sets today, while Chen Zhiqiang showed her a video he had come across about AI-assisted fashion design. They chatted for a while about possible new directions for the store in the future.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (bedroom)

name: Got ready for bed and said good-night prayers.
description: Feeling sleepy, Song Yajing did one last check of her phone to confirm the next morning's alarm and package delivery appointment were correct. Then she prayed softly, thanking God for everything He had given her and for all of today's smoothness and safety. With a calm expectation for tomorrow's Thanksgiving, she exchanged goodnights with Zhiqiang.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (bedroom)

name: Lights out and sleep
description: The lights in the room went out, and the night outside the window returned to calm. Song Yajing, with a full sense of satisfaction from the day and beautiful hopes for tomorrow, fell into a peaceful sleep together with her husband Chen Zhiqiang.
location: Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (bedroom)

name: Morning wake-up and morning prayer
description: Yajing woke up at 6:30 on Thanksgiving morning and opened the curtains to see the sky gradually clearing. She knelt at the small prayer stand by the bed and offered a morning prayer for all the encounters and connections of the day, thanking the Lord for peace, praying for everything to go smoothly, and passing on her gratitude.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning family time
description: Yajing quickly prepared millet porridge and fried eggs for breakfast while hearing her husband Aqiang take a work call in the living room. She ate breakfast while it was hot, washed up, and changed into an oatmeal-colored knit cardigan. Then she gently woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her put on her kindergarten uniform and tie her hair into pigtails, and Aqiang also came over to help apply children's face cream. The whole family sat together and quickly finished breakfast. Yajing told Xuanxuan to be a good girl, and Aqiang confirmed that he would pick up their daughter in the afternoon.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparations before going out and community posting.
description: Yajing saw her husband and daughter to the door and watched them get into the elevator. Back in the living room, she immediately used her phone to send out the Thanksgiving community post, the image of the 50-member member list, and the photo of the stacked gift boxes that she had edited the night before, hoping that commuting customers would see them right away. Then, checking against the list, she verified the addresses for the 17 gift boxes to be sent elsewhere and affixed SF Express waybills, quickly completing the packing.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk to the shop.
description: Yajing slung her commuter bag over her shoulder, carried the 17 packed and labeled gift packages, and walked from Shanggu Street along Zhenhai Road to the shop on Zhongshan Road. The streets in the early morning were not yet noisy, and her steps were brisk.
location: From Zhenhai Road to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Arriving at the store and preparing
description: Yajing arrived at Jingxin Wardrobe, quickly checked the displays and confirmed that Xiaomei had tidied up properly the night before. She neatly stacked the 17 gift packages to be sent in the pickup area at the store entrance. At 8:55, Xiaomei arrived at the store on time, and the two briefly reviewed today's Thanksgiving activity process.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: SF Express pickup and delivery of customer gift bags
description: At 9 a.m., the SF Express courier arrived on time. After checking 17 parcels, he scanned and loaded them, and the long-distance gift packages were sent out smoothly. The first customer, retired teacher Aunt Chen, arrived. Yajing handed her the gift package and a handwritten card with both hands. Aunt Chen was moved and hugged her after reading the card. Then regular customer Vivian and several longtime customers came in together. Yajing handed each of them a gift package and chatted about styling. Meanwhile, a new customer came in and Xiaomei attended to her. Yajing took the opportunity to share warm photos of customers receiving gift packages on Moments and in the community group.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Scheduled customer reception and online interaction
description: A regular customer who had made an appointment to look at sweaters arrived as scheduled. Yajing recommended the newly arrived oatmeal cardigan based on her body shape and skin tone, and the customer tried it on and bought it satisfied. Meanwhile, Yajing saw several customers in the community group posting photos of their gift packs, replied to thank each one, and launched a small “Thanksgiving photo-sharing chain” activity.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and rest
description: Yajing told Xiaomei to go have lunch first. While the store was quiet, she ordered char siu rice takeout from the neighboring Hong Kong-style tea restaurant, and ate while browsing community updates and replying to customers' likes.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon store reception and new member conversion.
description: Xiaomei came back after lunch. Customer traffic gradually increased in the afternoon; many new customers came after seeing friends' photos online. Yajing warmly introduced the store, guided them to follow the community and join as members, and by 2:30 p.m. successfully converted five new members.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handling online chores and following up on logistics.
description: Before the next wave of customer rush, Yajing used the SF Express app to track the logistics status of 17 remote gift packages, while opening her digital notes to organize the healthy eating screenshots she discussed with customers yesterday and update them into the healthy living document.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school, send a package, and return to the shop
description: After instructing Xiaomei to mind the store, Yajing left early. She arrived at Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 15:45 to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, and then they walked to the SF Express pickup point on Gongyuan South Road to send out the remaining 16 gift packages to destinations in the city and nearby provinces. Xuanxuan helped hand over the waybill and looked very proud. After mailing the packages, Yajing bought Xuanxuan a lollipop, and they slowly walked back to the store.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the SF Express pickup point on Gongyuan South Road, and back to Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road.

name: Close the store and do the daily tally in the evening
description: Yajing and Xuanxuan returned to the shop. Xiaomei was attending to a new customer, and Xuanxuan quietly drew pictures in the corner. Yajing checked the sales records and foot traffic and found that customer flow had increased about 35% compared with usual. At 17:30 she began guiding the last customers to check out and turned off some spotlights. Xiaomei cleaned up and then got off work. Yajing used the inventory management software to tally: 8 new members, foot traffic up about 35%, and revenue up 25%, and she recorded it in her phone memos. At 17:45 Yajing took Xuanxuan by the hand, closed the shop, and went home.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: When Yajing and Xuanxuan got home, her husband Aqiang had already reheated stir-fried Chinese broccoli and shrimp tofu. Xuanxuan stuck her Thanksgiving drawing on the refrigerator door, and the family sat around the dinner table. Yajing shared a touching review from a customer at the store, and Aqiang was happy for her success.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk on gratitude night.
description: Even though her waist was sore from standing all day, Yajing still took Aqiang and Xuanxuan for a walk around the community garden and Jiaxingyuan Park. She pointed at the sunset glow and told Xuanxuan the meaning of gratitude; Xuanxuan nodded half-understanding and held her mother's hand tightly.
location: Near the community garden at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Jiaxingyuan Park

name: Evening family and relaxation time.
description: After the walk home, Aqiang took the initiative to bathe Xuanxuan and read the bedtime story "The Rainbow Fish." Yajing rested for a while in the living room. After Xuanxuan fell asleep, Yajing used her phone in the study to save photos of customers' order shares from the community group, organize diet discussion insights, and write a gratitude summary. She also sent a thank-you WeChat message and a red envelope to Zhao Li, who had helped the day before. Then she prepared hot water to soak her feet and ease soreness, and chatted with Aqiang about the day's feelings and inquiries from new customers. Aqiang suggested making a collection of the shared photos on the official account, and the two talked with great engagement.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After washing up, Yajing changed into pajamas and did a simple facial care routine. Before bed, she prayed softly, giving thanks for this peaceful, loving day. Then she picked up a book about balancing life and read a few pages. As fatigue set in, she closed the book, turned off the light, and gradually fell asleep to Aqiang's steady breathing.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family time
description: Waking up early in the morning, Yajing washed up and walked to the living room window for morning prayer, thanking the Lord for a new day and praying for her family's safety and the smooth running of the store. Then she prepared breakfast for the family, frying eggs and bacon, and heating milk and freshly baked bread. After her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan got up, the family had breakfast together at the table. Listening to her daughter describe the "Thanksgiving rainbow" she had drawn the night before, Yajing felt the warmth of family.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Song Yajing tied her daughter Chen Lexuan's hair into pigtails, helped her put on her little backpack, and walked hand in hand with her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she reminded Xuanxuan to listen to the teacher. After watching her daughter go into the school, she nodded to the security guard in greeting.
location: Along the route from the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and at the kindergarten entrance.

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: She walked from the kindergarten to the Jingxin Wardrobe shop, stopping on the way at Bapopo Grass Jelly to buy a cup of warm honey grass jelly. After arriving, Yajing pulled up the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights, aired out the room, and wiped down the cash register counter and clothing racks to prepare for business.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the route.

name: Store business and Thanksgiving event review
description: Yajing opened her computer and exported the data from yesterday's Thanksgiving event. At 9:30, after the shop clerk Xiaomei arrived, she held a morning meeting to review the event: foot traffic increased by about 35%, and 47 new WeChat contacts were added. Then Yajing categorized and labeled the new customer profiles, selected screenshots of shared orders from the community group, and edited a WeChat Moments post with thanks and a lucky-draw preview. During this time, two customers came because of the shop's reputation, and Yajing warmly received them and successfully sold a new coat.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handling logistics and online matters
description: Prepared the 3 remote gift packages from yesterday's event that needed to be shipped. After checking the recipient information, she placed an online order for SF Express door-to-door pickup. At the same time, she replied on WeChat to supplier Susan about the arrival time of the new batch of autumn/winter coats and confirmed they would arrive at the store next Wednesday.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Yajing asked Xiaomei to go to Yuehua Shacha Noodles across the street and pack a serving of classic shacha noodles to bring back to the store for lunch. During lunch, she ate noodles while browsing Xiaohongshu, and bookmarked two light French-style outfit bloggers as a way to relax.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle payment for goods and visit Aunt Zhang
description: With fewer customers in the afternoon, Yajing used mobile banking to pay the remaining balance to a Guangzhou supplier that had been overdue for a few days. Then she remembered that Aunt Zhang hadn't come to yesterday's event, so she took a bag of homemade nut and oat crisps to visit her next door at Zhang's Fabric Shop. Aunt Zhang said she hadn't gone out yesterday because she wasn't feeling well. The two chatted about everyday things for half an hour, and Yajing told her to rest and take care of herself.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Zhang's Fabric Store next door.

name: Store operations and sales data analysis
description: Yajing returned to the shop, where Xiaomei was attending to a young woman trying on a dress. Yajing sorted through yesterday's sales data at the cash register, analyzed which styles were most popular during the event, and took notes for next week's product selection and ordering. During this time, two or three regular customers came in; Yajing helped them with outfit matching and shared event photos.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Close the shop early to pick up her daughter.
description: Yajing told Xiaomei to mind the store alone until closing time. She put the newly bought picture book Alice in Wonderland into her bag and left the store early, walking to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter.
location: Along the route from Jingxin Wardrobe at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian

name: Picked up her daughter, learned about the painting competition, and coordinated the work schedule
description: When Yajing arrived at the kindergarten, the art teacher, Teacher Wang, stopped her and told her that her daughter Chen Lexuan's painting 'My Family's Thanksgiving Dinner' had been selected to represent the kindergarten in the citywide 'Painting Dreams with a Childlike Heart' children's painting competition on December 6. Yajing hugged her daughter excitedly. Then at the kindergarten gate, she called Xiaomei, the shop assistant, and asked Xiaomei to cover the full day shift on Saturday, December 6. Xiaomei readily agreed, and Yajing promised to treat her to milk tea and arrange compensatory time off as thanks.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province – Siming Experimental Kindergarten and the school gate.

name: Celebration and Homecoming
description: To celebrate the good news about her daughter's competition, Yajing took her daughter on a detour to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and bought her a box of 24-color premium watercolor pens as a reward. Along the way, her daughter excitedly described her artworks and competition ideas, and the mother and daughter laughed continuously as they walked home to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street.
location: From 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the stationery store at Phase 2, Yubincheng, 35 Park South Road, and then home to the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street

name: Going home to rest and prepare dinner
description: Back home, her daughter was drawing in the living room. Yajing started to prepare dinner: she cooked rice, steamed the previously thawed yellow croaker, and stir-fried a plate of garlic lettuce. While cooking, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, telling him the good news about their daughter's competition and asking him to buy a roast duck on his way home from work to add a dish for celebration.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang brought home roast duck, and the family of three sat around the dinner table. Yajing solemnly took out the competition notice and explained the competition time and requirements in detail. Her husband was also happy. The family discussed the transportation arrangements and decided that Yajing would stay with her throughout the competition day, her husband would join after work, and afterwards they would go to a pizza restaurant to celebrate. The dinner atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk in the park
description: After dinner, the whole family changed into comfortable shoes and walked to Jiaxingyuan Park for a 30-minute stroll. A gentle evening breeze blew as their daughter ran and jumped ahead. Her husband chatted with Yajing about interesting things at work today, and Yajing enjoyed a rare moment of family relaxation.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Putting daughter to sleep.
description: After getting home, Yajing bathed her daughter and read the newly bought picture book “Alice in Wonderland.” Her daughter kept talking about the competition again. By 20:30, she had fallen asleep with a sweet smile.
location: Daughter's bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Planning the VIP dinner and contacting the designer
description: After making tea in the study, Yajing opened her laptop and accessed the store's backend, filtered the top 20 members by spending, exported the list, and worked out the budget. Based on the cost of a high-end Western restaurant in Xiamen and custom gift souvenirs, she estimated about 500 yuan per person and about 10,000 yuan in total, and decided to allocate it from this month's store profit. She then called designer Zheng Kai, thanked him for the successful collaboration on the co-branded product last time, and proposed customizing exclusive "Jingxin Wardrobe" silk square scarves as gifts for the VIP dinner guests, hoping to print the two characters "Jingxin" on them. Zheng Kai said he would have a sketch ready by the weekend.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime rehabilitation exercises and praying for sleep
description: Yajing completed her lumbar rehabilitation exercises on the yoga mat in the living room: 15 glute bridges and 5 rounds of cat-cow, each movement slow and focused. Then she recorded her thoughts in her phone memo: her daughter's competition gave the family new expectations, and the dinner party idea filled her with energy. Finally, she turned off the light and lay in bed for a bedtime prayer, grateful for the joy of the day, asking for safety tomorrow, and slowly fell asleep with hope for the future.
location: Living room and bedroom of the family home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning stretching, rehab exercises, and breakfast
description: On Saturday morning, after waking up naturally at 7:30, Song Yajing laid out a yoga mat on the living room balcony and did 10 minutes of glute bridge and cat-cow rehabilitation exercises to relieve tension in her lower back. After washing up, she cooked millet porridge, fried eggs and bacon, and brewed a pot of Tieguanyin tea. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan got up one after another, and the family sat down at the dining table. Song Yajing peeled an egg for her daughter and listened to her excitedly share the good news that her painting had been selected for a competition. The warm breakfast time was full of happiness.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-departure preparations and community confirmation.
description: After putting away the dishes, Song Yajing changed into an off-white knit top and dark casual pants, put cash and bank cards into her bag, and prepared to pay the banquet deposit. She reminded her husband that he could take their daughter to Jiaxingyuan Park today, then walked out with her bag. At the bulletin board in the building corridor, she noticed a community notice: tomorrow's church Mass was still at 8:30 in the morning, and she silently noted it. She walked along the street for 7 minutes to the shop, passing steaming breakfast stalls on the way, in high spirits.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along Zhongshan Road

name: Morning store work
description: At 9:00 sharp, Song Yajing pulled up the rolling shutter door of the 'Serenity Wardrobe' boutique clothing store and wiped down the cash register and shelves. Her colleague Xiaomei arrived at 9:30, and the two handled the after-sales follow-up for last week's co-branded collection. Song Yajing called five customers to ask how the clothes felt on them, noted that the cuffs were pilling, and promised to contact the supplier. Then she logged into the backend to check the remaining balance for the restock from Guangzhou and completed the payment. Xiaomei showed the data on 47 new members from the Thanksgiving promotion, 25 of whom had already made their first purchase, and excitedly said that this stack of record sheets carried the customers' trust.
location: The “Jingxin Wardrobe” boutique clothing store at the south-side storefront of No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and market observation.
description: At noon, Song Yajing strolled alone to the newly opened Old Street Shacha Noodles shop on Siming South Road and ordered the signature shacha noodles with seafood. While waiting, she observed the retro decor and menu design, thinking about whether she could borrow ideas for the VIP dinner setup. The rich broth satisfied her. She paid the bill at 12:20 and slowly walked back to the store.
location: “Old Street Satay Noodles” shop, No. 118-1 South Siming Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Finalize the banquet venue
description: In the afternoon, Song Yajing walked from the store to the Minnan private-cuisine restaurant "Siyuan House" on Zhenbang Road. Store Manager Chen, who had taken her reservation, received her and showed her the bookable private room on the second floor. She proposed the theme "Gratitude and Serenity," requesting a buyout format, a fusion menu, and nostalgic décor. Adjusting the signature dishes such as sea worm jelly and satay hot pot to suit members' tastes, they also confirmed the pre-meal drinks. In the end, she settled on the "Classic Minnan Meets Serenity" set menu and readily paid a 1,000 yuan deposit.
location: The 'Siyuan Building' Minnan home-style restaurant, 2nd Floor, No. 112 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Ran into Zhao Li and chose flower materials together.
description: After leaving the restaurant, Song Yajing walked along Gongyuan South Road. When she passed the 'Huajianji' flower studio, her friend Zhao Li warmly called out to her. Learning that she was preparing a dinner party, Zhao Li pulled her into the shop and suggested using dried flowers with ribbons for the table arrangement to match the winter atmosphere, and together they put together several color schemes. Song Yajing chose eucalyptus leaves and white hydrangea dried flowers as samples, praised Zhao Li's professional advice repeatedly, and agreed to finalize the flower order another day.
location: 'Huajianji' Floristry Studio, No. 33 Gongyuan South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Stop at the supermarket for groceries on the way
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Li, Song Yajing walked to the Yonghui Life Supermarket on Zhenhai Road. Pushing a shopping cart, she quickly picked up household supplies: facial tissues, kitchen paper towels, and garbage bags. She also chose sugar-free yogurt for her daughter and bought broccoli and pork ribs to prepare dinner. A quarter of an hour later, she checked out and carried her shopping bags home.
location: Yonghui Life Supermarket, 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went home, handled some chores, and had a phone call with my sister.
description: Song Yajing strolled back to her home in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street. When she got home, her husband and daughter had not yet returned. She put away the shopping, tied on an apron, blanched the pork ribs, sliced the ginger, and prepared the ingredients for the soup. Then she curled up on the sofa and called her elder sister Song Yawen in Shenzhen. After asking how she had been, she excitedly invited her to come back to Xiamen for Christmas to attend the VIP appreciation banquet. Her sister readily agreed and said she would help make the event a success. The two also talked about their parents' health and agreed to get in touch after booking the flight.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: Starting at 5 p.m., Song Yajing simmered corn and pork rib soup in the kitchen, stir-fried broccoli, and made shrimp scrambled eggs. Around 5:30, Chen Zhiqiang brought their daughter home. As soon as Xuanxuan came in, she praised how good Mommy's cooking smelled. Her husband helped set the table. At exactly 6 o'clock, the family sat around the table, eating while listening to Xuanxuan tell funny stories about watching snails and ants in the park. Chen Zhiqiang also shared humorous things from his work group chat. The warm dinner was full of laughter.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family walk
description: After resting for 20 minutes after the meal, Song Yajing suggested taking a walk to aid digestion. The family walked along the path behind the community to Jiaxing Garden Park and strolled on the trail. Song Yajing told her husband in detail about the dinner party concept they had finalized that afternoon, including the menu, decorations, and party favors. Chen Zhiqiang suggested editing the store's journey into a short video to play at the dinner party. Her eyes lit up, and she thought it was a brilliant idea. Their daughter suddenly pointed at the moon and shouted, 'Mommy, the moon is so round! Let's invite it to the dinner party too!' The couple smiled at each other.
location: Jiaxingyuan Park trail, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying daughter and putting her to bed
description: After returning home from the walk, Song Yajing bathed her daughter and changed her into bunny pajamas. Then she sat with her at the small desk to draw. Xuanxuan drew a picture of “the dining table at night with the moon and Mom and Dad.” After finishing, Song Yajing told two bedtime stories, watched her daughter fall asleep contentedly, and then quietly turned off the light and closed the door.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal evening tasks
description: After confirming that her daughter was sound asleep, Song Yajing went back to the study, turned on her computer, and organized her notes on the restaurant negotiation details, saving the pattern photos Zhao Li had taken. Then she followed a cervical and lumbar rehabilitation exercise video for 15 minutes to stretch her body. Afterward, she curled up on the sofa and used her phone to handle store community messages, replied to several customers' inquiries about new products, and liked a customer's outfit photo.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night couple talk and community maintenance
description: Chen Zhiqiang came out of the study and brewed a pot of fresh tea. The couple sat facing each other and savored the tea. Song Yajing shared her idea for the dinner party video and discussed whether to hire a professional editor or try it on her phone first; her husband gave technical advice. She then opened the store management group, updated Xiaomei on the dinner party preparations, and reminded her to cover the full shift next Saturday. Chen Zhiqiang tinkered with new computer accessories nearby, and the two chatted occasionally, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation, prayer, and going to sleep.
description: In the evening, Song Yajing washed up alone in the bathroom. After carefully doing her skincare routine, she changed into long-sleeved pajamas. She knelt by the bed and prayed softly, giving thanks for the smooth day and preparing for the next day's Mass. After praying, she took out a plain long dress and veil from the wardrobe and hung them up, then turned off the light and lay down. Her husband was already breathing evenly. Outside the window, the moonlight was peaceful. She thought back over the day: the banquet venue had been confirmed, her elder sister had agreed to attend, Zhao Li had helped with the flowers, and her husband had suggested using a video as the finishing touch. Feeling grounded and hopeful, she drifted off to sleep.
location: Room 403, Building 2, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast.
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. After getting up, Song Yajing prepared millet and pumpkin porridge and toast and eggs for her family, then woke her daughter Xuanxuan and helped her get dressed and wash up. During breakfast, the family of three chatted while eating. Song Yajing confirmed the afternoon arrangements with her husband and reminded him to pick up the package, then checked her daughter's schoolbag.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Drive and take a ferry to Gulangyu Catholic Church.
description: Song Yajing and her daughter Xuanxuan drove to the Gulangyu Catholic Church. They first drove to the ferry terminal, parked, queued to board the ferry, and after getting off, walked to the church.
location: No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Catholic Church).

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Father Wang Mingde celebrated Mass, and the sermon's theme was "Gratitude and Daily Life." Song Yajing participated attentively, praying for her mother's recovery, the store, and her family, while her daughter Xuanxuan remained quiet the whole time.
location: No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Catholic Church).

name: Communicating with fellow parishioners after Mass
description: After Mass, Song Yajing chatted with Aunt Lin Xiuying, a fellow churchgoer, in the church courtyard. She shared the good news about her mother's recovery and the joy of the Thanksgiving family reunion. Aunt Lin invited her to next Thursday's Bible reading group sharing session, and Song Yajing gladly agreed and wrote down the time.
location: No. 34 Lujiao Road, Gulangyu Island, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Catholic Church).

name: Drove home with her daughter, talking in the car.
description: Leaving the church, Song Yajing walked with her daughter to the pier, took a boat back to the ferry terminal, then drove home. On the way, she talked with her daughter about her reflections on Mass. Her daughter said, "When there is gratitude in your heart, you should say it out loud." Song Yajing told her that this is prayer.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family free time and lunch preparation.
description: After returning home, Xuanxuan drew pictures while Song Yajing started preparing lunch, making shrimp and egg rice with vegetables and shrimp, and washed the morning's dishes to keep the kitchen tidy.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family lunch together
description: The family of three sat together to eat, enjoying shrimp and scrambled egg rice. Song Yajing shared her reflections on Mass, and after the meal she urged Xuanxuan to wash her hands and rinse her mouth to get ready for her nap.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal leisure and shop work during daughter's nap time
description: After settling Xuanxuan down for her nap, Song Yajing made a cup of honey water and sat on the sofa browsing fashion bloggers' updates to relax. Then she opened her laptop, logged into the store's inventory management system, and carefully checked all November payment and receipt records and bank statements, finding that net profit had grown 5%, reaching a record high. After that, she opened WeChat and replied to customers' inquiries about the year-end new product launch event in the 'Serenity Closet VIP Member Group' and the 'Xuanxuan's Mom Sharing Group'.
location: Living room in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and interacting with my daughter after she woke up.
description: Song Yajing went to the kitchen, blanched the pork ribs, corn, and carrots before simmering them into soup, and sliced the snow peas. Hearing Xuanxuan wake up, she went to the bedroom to help her daughter get dressed and braid her hair, then returned to the kitchen to continue preparing.
location: Kitchen and living room at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go to Jiaxingyuan Park
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also put down his work. The family of three put on their coats and walked about 13 minutes to Jiaxingyuan Park.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk and monthly reflection sharing
description: At sunset, the family took a walk in the park. Song Yajing and her husband talked about their experiences in November, reflecting on the stress and gains. Her husband comforted her, and Xuanxuan pointed at the moon and said, "The moon has been watching us for a whole month." The atmosphere was warm.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home and continue preparing dinner
description: After the walk, the family of three headed home on foot. Once there, Song Yajing asked her husband to take Xuanxuan to wash their hands, while she went to the kitchen to turn off the heat under the pork rib soup and started stir-frying snow peas and steaming the sea bass.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner together
description: At the dinner table, Xuanxuan shared the colorful window she had drawn and received encouragement from her parents. Song Yajing mentioned an invitation from fellow church members to join a Bible study group and planned to attend next week. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walked around the neighborhood to aid digestion.
description: After dinner, the family slowly walked around the community garden. Song Yajing and her husband discussed their December plans, including their daughter's drawing competition and the store's VIP dinner. Her husband suggested making a growth video to show at the dinner, and Song Yajing was very happy.
location: 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gave her daughter a bath, read picture books, and put her to sleep.
description: After returning home, Song Yajing helped Xuanxuan take a hot bath, then read the picture book No, David! and Xuanxuan quickly fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, residential community at 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal lower back rehabilitation training and meditation.
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing unrolled her yoga mat in the master bedroom and did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation exercises (cat-cow pose, glute bridge, child's pose), then meditated cross-legged for 10 minutes, focusing on her breath and relaxing her body and mind.
location: Main bedroom of the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Write a gratitude journal.
description: After meditating, Song Yajing took out her lambskin journal and recorded three things she was grateful for today: the peace during Mass, the precious family walk moment, and the store's net profit reaching a new high. She also wrote down her feelings.
location: Desk in the master bedroom of the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street on Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Chatted with her husband and planned matters for December.
description: Song Yajing made tea for her husband. The two chatted in the living room about December plans: their daughter's painting competition, new winter styles from the supplier arriving at the store, and the VIP appreciation dinner. They also discussed the growth-video script her husband had been drafting.
location: Living room in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washed up, did skincare, and prepared the next day's plans.
description: Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied a face mask in the bathroom. Remembering that the store clerk Xiaomei would come tomorrow to organize the new stock, she sent a voice message on her phone to confirm meeting at the store at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Bathroom, 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pre-sleep prayer and goodnight
description: Before bed, Song Yajing said a brief prayer for her mother’s health and her family’s safety, exchanged goodnights with her husband, turned off the lights, and went to sleep, ending a fulfilling Sunday.
location: Main bedroom of the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Wake-up, morning routine, and family breakfast
description: On a winter morning, the sunlight was faint. Song Yajing first did a simple 5-minute waking stretch in the bedroom. After washing up, she heard the aroma of fried eggs coming from the kitchen and felt very cheerful. After changing into the off-white knit top and wine-red skirt she had prepared in advance, she went into the kitchen and served breakfast at the table with her husband: rice porridge, side dishes, fried eggs, and toast. While eating, she gently woke her still-drowsy daughter Xuanxuan and helped comb her hair. Her husband shared today's work plan, and Yajing mentioned that she was going to meet Jiajia and Meiling in the evening.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school and discuss the schedule.
description: After breakfast, she packed Xuanxuan's little schoolbag and grabbed her water bottle. Mother and daughter walked out hand in hand, taking about 10 minutes to reach the kindergarten. On the way, Yajing crouched down and gently explained to Xuanxuan, "Xuanxuan, Mom's good friend Auntie Jiajia is coming from Shenzhen today. Tonight Mom will go to Auntie Meiling's place for a gathering. Daddy will play on the slide with you, okay?" Xuanxuan nodded obediently and shared that their teacher would take them to do crafts this afternoon. When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, Yajing watched her daughter go into the classroom, exchanged a brief greeting with the teacher, and left.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commute and shopping on the way
description: Starting from the kindergarten, she walked to the store on Zhongshan Road. Along the way, Song Yajing made a special point of stopping into the Jianfu Convenience Store (Zhongshan Road branch) and bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of throat lozenges so she could stay in good form while receiving customers in the afternoon.
location: Jianfu Convenience Store (Zhongshan Road), No. 32 Ding'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store opening preparations and staff communication
description: Arrived at the store at 8:20, unlocked the door, turned on the lights, and started the cash register system and computer. First checked last night's messages, then adjusted the winter coat display near the entrance, putting the caramel-colored wool-blend coat that arrived last week on the mannequin in the window. At 9:00, Xiaomei arrived. Yajing briefly met with her and reminded her: "Xiaomei, today is the first day of December. We can readjust the morning and evening shift schedule. In particular, I need to accompany Xuanxuan on Saturday the 6th. Could you cover my full shift that day? Let's see how to arrange it best." At the same time, she took out the pork floss cakes she had made and handed them to her: "Try them while they're hot, and thanks for covering my shift!"
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Early-month financial work and family budget adjustments
description: When there were few customers, Song Yajing opened her laptop at the small table behind the cash register and logged into the family electronic ledger. She carefully checked and exported November's store revenue and operating expense records. Then she opened mobile banking, calculated, and set aside the rent and family insurance premiums due in December. Considering the recent 'weight gain plan,' she increased this month's family food budget by 200 yuan. She also added a new commercial health insurance budget for herself and completed the payment. After that, she sent the screenshots and explanation of the entire financial adjustment plan to her husband via WeChat for confirmation.
location: Back room of the Jingxin Wardrobe boutique clothing store, 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch and browsing fashion updates
description: Yajing asked Xiaomei to go to the nearby "Xincheng Shacha Noodles" to pack two portions of shacha noodles. The two took turns eating in the back room of the store. While eating noodles, she used her phone to browse Xiaohongshu and Instagram, looking at current winter outfit trends and bloggers' styles. At the same time, she brainstormed the invitation copy and visual style for the regular customer appreciation dinner, and captured some screenshots of photos from the store's events and customer reviews during 2025.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Create and send the electronic invitation for the VIP appreciation dinner.
description: During the afternoon lull, Yajing did not rest; instead she sat on the sofa in the back room and focused on making an e-invitation on her phone with the Canva app. She chose warm-toned annual photos of the store, warm moments from the Thanksgiving event, and an interior photo that best captured the spirit of Jingxin Wardrobe. She carefully edited the thank-you message and repeatedly adjusted the fonts and layout. After finishing the invitation, she created a new tag, VIP Dinner Invited, and sent it via WeChat private messages to her 18 core regular customers (originally planned 20, excluding 2 recent customers who had deactivated WeChat), and briefly answered individual customers' questions. For those who did not reply, she marked them as phone follow-up tomorrow.
location: Back room of the Jingxin Wardrobe boutique clothing store, 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Attended to customers and interacted on Moments.
description: At two or three in the afternoon, a few customers trickled into the store. Yajing greeted them energetically and put together a French floral dress with a wool cardigan as a winter commuting outfit for a young office worker, successfully making a sale. Another regular customer picked up a predetermined winter coat. During the gap when Xiaomei was attending to other customers, she used her own phone to edit and post a WeChat Moments post: 'On the first day of December, may all good things arrive as promised. Thank you, my dear customers, for your support that gives me the strength to become a better version of myself. Looking forward to our gathering at the end of the year!' The accompanying images were a nine-grid photo collage of the store's warm moments in November.
location: Front area of Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: During business hours, got in touch with her close friends
description: In the afternoon, there were more pedestrians on the street, and waves of customers came to the store one after another. Yajing and Xiaomei divided their work clearly and took turns attending to customers. During this time, Xiaomei put together matching outfits for two women who came together and sold two knit sweaters. While taking a break from receiving customers, Yajing received a WeChat message from Wang Jia saying she was at Xiamen North Station and could arrive at Li Meiling's home around 17:30 (the address has been confirmed as: Room 702, Unit 3, Kangle New Village Phase II, 287 Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province). Yajing replied: "Okay, I'll go over tonight! Let me finish the work at hand first."
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: End-of-day closing and handover before shutting the store
description: Considering the gathering in the evening, Yajing arranged Xiaomei to do the closing work half an hour earlier: tidying the warehouse, checking returns and exchanges, and cleaning the floor. She herself checked tomorrow's appointments and to-do items again, confirmed the arrival of supplies from Supplier No. 3, and reminded Xiaomei to adjust the details of the shift schedule. Yajing changed out of her work uniform and put on a more casual camel-colored cardigan.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 56 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Travel to close friend's home and buy a gift
description: At 17:15, said goodbye to Xiaomei and walked to Zhenhai Road Metro Station. Took Line 1, transferred to Line 2 at Lücuo Station, and arrived at Xianyue Road Station, with the whole commute taking about 40 minutes. After exiting the station, on the path to Li Meiling's home, I saw a trendy handmade tea shop called 'Xunyu' and went in to buy 3 cups of signature milk tea in different flavors and a batch of freshly baked handmade cookies as snacks for tonight's gathering.
location: Xunyu Tea Shop, No. 209 Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and along the metro route

name: Three close friends meet up for a heart-to-heart talk
description: Arrived at Li Meiling's home at 18:00. Wang Jia was already there. The three, reunited after months apart, hugged excitedly. They sat together in Li Meiling's living room; on the coffee table were the milk tea cookies Yajing had brought and Li Meiling's homemade lemon-roasted chicken wings. Their topics ranged from work, family, and parenting to personal life. Wang Jia shared her experience running a short-video account in Shenzhen and suggested that Yajing's boutique could try making practical short videos such as "Style Guide for Women Over 40" or "Elegant Winter Outfits for Petite Women," and recommended that she use Xiaohongshu to post unboxing videos and "one piece, multiple looks" content to increase online customer loyalty. Yajing listened with great interest and took out her phone memo to jot down the key points. The three laughed from time to time, and the atmosphere was warm. In the middle, Yajing sent her husband a message and learned that Xuanxuan had already eaten, washed up, and was listening to his bedtime story, so she felt reassured.
location: Li Meiling's home, Room 702, Unit 3, Phase II, Kangle New Village, 287 Xianyue Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Said goodbye to friends and took the subway home.
description: After chatting until nearly 10 p.m., the three said goodbye reluctantly, knowing they had to work the next day. Wang Jia walked Yajing to the entrance of the residential area, and they agreed on the dinner party on December 25. Yajing walked to Xianyue Road Metro Station, returned the same way, and briefly replied to a few messages in work group chats on the train. At 22:40, she exited Zhenhai Road Metro Station and walked briskly home.
location: Xiamen Metro Line 1 and Line 2.

name: Return home, greet family, and stretch before bed
description: She opened the door softly and found the warm-colored little light still on in the living room. Her husband Aqiang was leaning on the sofa looking at his phone, waiting for Yajing. She tiptoed to the bedroom to check on Xuanxuan, confirmed she was sleeping soundly, and tucked her in. Back in the living room, Aqiang briefly asked about the gathering, and Yajing shared Wang Jia's idea; the two chatted a little more. Then she went to wash up and changed into comfortable pajamas. To relieve the fatigue of sitting for a long time in the evening, Yajing spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 10 minutes of lower back, neck, and shoulder stretching exercises, focusing on glute bridges and the cat-cow pose.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Gratitude journal and bedtime prayer
description: After stretching, her body felt much more comfortable. Yajing took out the gratitude journal by her bedside and recorded three things she was grateful for today: 1. Her good friend Wang Jia suddenly returned to Xiamen, and the three of them chatted freely like old times; 2. She smoothly completed the early-month financial work and dinner invitation letters; 3. Her husband was understanding and supportive of the family. Then, kneeling beside the bed with her palms together, she softly prayed to God for today's peaceful gathering, her friend's good words, and her family's health.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After finishing the diary, she turned off the bedside lamp, exchanged goodnights with her husband, and closed her eyes to sleep, full of energy and with a slight 'guilt' about staying up late.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and family breakfast
description: She got up after the second alarm, washed up, applied moisturizer, tied her hair into a ponytail, and did a simple morning routine. Then she had breakfast with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. A Qiang had already prepared white porridge and fried eggs. Song Yajing ladled out the porridge, set out pickled cucumbers and pork floss, fed her daughter some egg, and reminded her that it might rain in the afternoon and that the raincoat was already in the inner pocket of her schoolbag. A Qiang also reminded Song Yajing to bring an umbrella so she wouldn't get caught in the rain.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Residential Community No. 82, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and shop at the convenience store on the way
description: She walked her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Her daughter kicked fallen leaves along the way, and Song Yajing held her hand tightly and hurried her along. After handing her daughter to the teacher at 8:10, she walked less than 10 minutes from the kindergarten to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of mint candy, planning to refresh herself when opening the shop. The cashier auntie reminded her that it would rain.
location: From the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), then to the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station (No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road).

name: Walking commute to the store
description: Walked with an umbrella from Zhenhai Road to the Jingxin Wardrobe store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, about 15 minutes. Passed Jiaxing Garden Park and watched elderly people doing morning exercises, observed other clothing store window displays along the way, and thought about how to adjust her own storefront window.
location: Zhenhai Road to No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Opening preparation, morning meeting, and initial display arrangement
description: After arriving at the store, she turned on the lights, opened the cash register system, and boiled water to make tea. At 9 a.m., shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. She held a brief morning meeting, instructing Xiaomei to focus that day on assisting with the display adjustment of the plus-size women's clothing area, and informed her that yesterday's online orders had been packed and were ready for pickup. Then Song Yajing steamed the oat-colored coat with a garment steamer, while Xiaomei wiped the shelves, mopped the floor, and put away the try-on pile to make space for the upcoming adjustment.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Contact the baking teacher, prepare community materials, and start a sign-up chain.
description: In the store's break area, she contacted her baking teacher, Master Chen, via WeChat to confirm that tomorrow's French mille-feuille class is scheduled for 14:00-16:30, and, as instructed, set a memo reminder to refrigerate the butter two hours in advance. Then she took a selfie in the oatmeal-colored long coat in front of the fitting mirror and shot a panorama of the store. After adjusting the lighting with a photo-editing app, she saved the materials. At 10:40, she started a 'Favorite Winter Item' chain in the VIP customer group and the new-customer sharing group. She shared the photos, which drew enthusiastic responses, and Vivian commented with praise.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Receive customers in the shop and interact with the community in real time
description: Regular customer Vivian saw the coat photo in the community group and came to the store to try it on. Song Yajing enthusiastically helped her with styling and accepted the compliments, while Xiaomei assisted other customers. In between, she replied in real time to styling questions in the group and liked every photo posted by the sisters.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch, group chat interaction, and short video learning
description: Xiaomei went to lunch first. Song Yajing reheated last night's leftovers (scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried greens) and ate while scrolling on her phone. Seeing the lively discussion in the group chat, she announced that in the afternoon she would open a "Beauty of Inclusivity" plus-size section and invite people to book appointments. After lunch, during her break, she downloaded CapCut and browsed tutorials on shooting winter-vibe outfit videos, thinking about trying short-video marketing in the future.
location: Rest area of Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Adjusting displays on rainy days, setting up a plus-size section, and taking promotional photos
description: In the afternoon it rained and there were few pedestrians, so Song Yajing and Xiao Mei took the chance to iron the new winter items, changing the window mannequins into new coats, cashmere scarves, and dark wide-leg pants to create a warm atmosphere. Then, beside the fitting room, they cleared a wall, hung a sign reading "Every Line Is Beautiful," decorated it with pink and blue balloons, hung the newly arrived plus-size knitwear and straight-leg pants by color, sorted the size labels, and opened a "Beauty of Inclusion" plus-size section. After finishing, they photographed the overall effect, close-ups, and a 30-second panoramic video, sent them to the customer group and @'ed the sisters who had joined the sign-up, announcing that the section was ready. Two sisters made appointments to come to the store tomorrow afternoon.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: In-depth online community interaction and styling consultation.
description: In the store, she continued replying to winter outfit-matching questions in the customer group, such as how petite women should wear coats and how plus-size women's clothing can look slimming. She also privately messaged three plus-size customers who had shown interest, sending photos of the special section and reference images of outfits she styled herself. One of them booked an appointment to come on Saturday. The group was lively, and five new members joined.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Closing up the store and preparing to leave
description: When it was almost time to pick up her daughter, Song Yajing gathered her belongings and took an umbrella, while Xiaomei was responsible for sweeping the floor, turning off the lights, and locking the door. Song Yajing reminded Xiaomei that she might arrive late the next afternoon because she had a baking class, and asked Xiaomei to look after the shop on her own. Xiaomei readily agreed.
location: Jingxin Wardrobe Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Picked up her daughter from school, returned home, and started preparing dinner.
description: Song Yajing walked with an umbrella to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Her daughter ran out holding up a drawing to show her; Song Yajing praised her and kissed her. Then the mother and daughter walked home. After arriving, she had her daughter wash her hands and go draw in the living room, while she tied on an apron, rinsed the rice and cooked it, took out a sea bass to thaw, and washed the vegetables. Her husband Aqiang came home from work at 17:35, took over handling the fish, and Song Yajing focused on preparing the stir-fry.
location: From No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (No. 123 Gucheng West Road), then to home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: Song Yajing made steamed sea bass and garlic stir-fried greens; A Qiang made tomato and egg soup. At 18:00, the family of three started dinner, chatting while eating. Song Yajing shared how lively the community event was that day and the good reviews of the plus-size section. A Qiang was pleased and encouraged her to try making short videos, and he took the initiative to help set up the phone.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home in the No. 82 community on Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-dinner rest and family walk in the rain
description: After dinner, the family of three rested on the living room sofa. Her daughter showed off today's drawing, and Song Yajing praised her progress with lines. After the rain outside lightened, Aqiang suggested putting on raincoats and going out for a walk to aid digestion. The three put on two-piece raincoats and briskly walked along South Hubin Road for 20 minutes. Her daughter excitedly stomped in puddles, and Song Yajing kept reminding her to be careful. They turned back at the Hubin East Road intersection. On the way, Aqiang asked about tomorrow's baking class, and Song Yajing felt relaxed.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, home living room, then to Hubin South Road (the section near home)

name: Bathing her daughter.
description: After walking home, Song Yajing helped her daughter take off her wet raincoat and ran hot water for her bath. While playing in the water and humming a nursery rhyme, Song Yajing washed her hair, rinsed her off, changed her into warm pajamas, and dried her hair with a hairdryer.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community - home bathroom

name: Parent-child picture book reading and bedtime soothing
description: Her daughter chose two picture books, 'Guess How Much I Love You' and 'Rainy Day'. Song Yajing sat by the bedside in her daughter's room, holding her and reading page by page. When the little rabbit jumped in the story, her daughter also tried to bounce along, and was laughingly pressed back into her arms. After finishing the book, she also made up a little adventure story about a rainy day. Then she turned off the main light and left the night light on, gently patted her daughter's back and hummed a Minnan nursery rhyme. After about fifteen minutes, her daughter fell asleep peacefully. Song Yajing tucked in the quilt corner and left the room.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, home, daughter's bedroom

name: Lumbar rehabilitation training
description: Changed into a sports bra and yoga pants, spread out the yoga mat in the living room, and did glute bridges (3 sets of 15 reps), cat-cow stretches (10 reps with breathing), and several lower back stretches. Today my lower back felt good with no soreness, and I feel that consistent training is working.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Took a hot shower, applied body lotion and basic skincare toner and moisturizer, blow-dried her hair. She looked in the mirror and found her skin was in good condition, without any acne breakout from staying up late, and felt satisfied.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community - home bathroom

name: Write a gratitude journal.
description: Sitting at the desk in the bedroom, she opened the diary app and recorded three things to be grateful for: the successful community interaction, the good response to the plus-size section; the warmth of the family of three taking a walk on a rainy night; and the baking class materials ready for tomorrow, making life fulfilling. After writing, she closed her eyes and prayed silently, thanking the Lord for a bountiful day.
location: Desk in the home bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chatting with my husband, meditating to relax, and going to bed
description: The couple lay in bed chatting. Song Yajing shared a short-video tutorial she watched during the day. Aqiang said she was suited for making short videos and suggested filming rainy-night outfits. The two confirmed that Aqiang would pick up their daughter tomorrow afternoon. Then Song Yajing put on a yoga eye mask, dimmed the lights, and did 5 minutes of meditation, then turned off the lights and fell asleep before 11 PM, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom at home, residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Song Yajing did a simple stretch in bed and got up. She opened the window, saw mist outside, and said a quiet morning prayer, thanking God for the new day. Then she went to the kitchen, took out the soybeans that had been soaked overnight, started the soy milk maker, and began preparing breakfast: fried bacon and eggs, toasted bread, and cut apples. At 7:00, she woke up her daughter Xuanxuan, helped her brush her teeth, wash her face, and tie her little double ponytails. Her husband Zhiqiang had also finished washing up, and the family of three sat around the dining table. During breakfast, Song Yajing poured Xuanxuan some warm milk, shared the funny mishap from yesterday's group chat, making her daughter giggle, and told Zhiqiang that she planned to learn mille-feuille in the afternoon and was prepared to mess up again.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten and commute to the store.
description: At 7:25, Song Yajing left home holding Xuanxuan’s little hand, with the morning mist shrouding the old street. She followed the familiar route, passed the Zhenhai Road subway station entrance, and after walking about 10 minutes took her daughter to the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan excitedly said that today the teacher would teach everyone to make little handmade snowmen. After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing strolled leisurely toward the store. Passing the corner of Zhongshan Road, she bought her favorite glutinous rice roll and a cup of hot soy milk from the Zaolong breakfast cart, planning to have them later as a snack. At 8:00, she arrived at Jingxin Wardrobe, No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: Store opening preparations and morning meeting.
description: At 8:00, Song Yajing opened the store, turned on the lights, and played her favorite light music. She began wiping the cash register, fitting mirror, and display racks, and recorded the customer information from yesterday's reception in her notebook. At 9:00, the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived on time. The two held a brief morning meeting. Song Yajing emphasized the morning's priorities: receiving the VIP customer with an appointment, and receiving the new coats sent from Guangzhou and completing the display.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: Receiving and organizing new coats
description: At 9:15, the logistics company delivered the coats on time. Song Yajing and Zhimei opened the box together, carefully counted 12 camel-hair and wool coats in different styles, checked each one for loose threads, buttons, and fabric details, and registered them in the shop's inventory system. She picked out three most versatile designs, carefully ironed them with a garment steamer, and prepared to hang them in the most prominent spot in the window.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: VIP customer reception and community warm-up
description: At 10:30, Xiao Lin, the VIP customer who had made an appointment the day before, arrived at the store. Song Yajing received her warmly and, based on her slightly plump figure, recommended three outfits in different styles. Xiao Lin was very satisfied with the professional-style suit and closed the deal on the spot. At 11:00, another regular customer, Sister Zhang, also arrived as promised. Song Yajing and Xiao Mei divided the work: Song introduced the outfits while Xiao Mei served tea. During this time, Song took several flat-lay and try-on photos of the coats with her phone, edited them, and sent them to the customer group with the message: "The big winter move is here! Great new items have just arrived, ladies, come try them on!" Immediately, several customers in the group responded.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: Lunch and preparation for the baking class
description: At 12:00, Xiaomei went for her lunch break and Song Yajing stayed in the shop alone. She took out the glutinous rice rolls and hot soy milk she bought in the morning to quickly finish lunch, and while eating, she watched the video of Chef Chen's French mille-feuille operation posted yesterday on her phone, focusing on reviewing the key points of laminating dough. At 12:45, after Xiaomei returned, she set the 13:00 alarm to go out.
location: Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Jingxin Wardrobe)

name: Commuting to the baking workshop
description: At 13:00, Song Yajing left the shop on time, walked 2 minutes to the Sibei Intersection bus stop, and took the No. 43 bus. The ride was fairly smooth; she got off at Xianhou Station about 43 minutes later, then walked 2 minutes to the Xianhou Baking Studio in Huli District.
location: No. 120 Fanghu Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Xianhou Baking Studio)

name: French Mille-Feuille Making Course
description: Entering the studio, Song Yajing greeted Master Chen with an apologetic bow, and the class officially began at 13:50. Master Chen demonstrated the new recipe, and Song Yajing tried it herself. The first time, because the butter softened too quickly and got mixed into the dough during folding, the baked pastry collapsed and leaked oil. The second time she learned from the mistake, but the rolling pressure was uneven, and the finished product came out crooked. Looking at the two trays of failed products, she didn't know whether to laugh or cry. During a break in the class, she photographed her works and posted them in her best-friend group and baking group as a self-mockery. To her surprise, the group members began posting their own failed creations one after another, unexpectedly triggering a 'fail contest,' and the group was filled with laughter. Song Yajing felt relieved, wrote down her feelings in her notes, and expressed her determination to continue learning to Master Chen.
location: No. 120 Fanghu Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Xianhou Baking Studio)

name: Return trip and pick up daughter from school
description: At 16:15, when the class ended, Song Yajing walked out of the studio carrying her packaged thousand-layer pastries. She texted her husband Zhiqiang on WeChat to say she was going to pick up their daughter, then took the No. 42 bus in the opposite direction home. At around 17:00, she arrived at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, where she met her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and together they picked up their daughter Xuanxuan.
location: No. 123, Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Siming Experimental Kindergarten)

name: Prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Song Yajing immediately went into the kitchen to prepare dinner ingredients: steamed a yellow croaker, stir-fried a plate of garlic lettuce, and reheated the leftover pork rib soup from yesterday. Her husband Zhiqiang helped peel garlic and set the table, while her daughter Xuanxuan drew pictures at the dining table nearby.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Warm family dinner
description: At 17:45, dinner was served. Song Yajing took out her phone and vividly recounted the whole process of the afternoon baking failure, making her husband and daughter laugh. Xuanxuan imitated the way she sighed and said, "Mom, did you blow air today?" This made the couple laugh until tears came. Zhiqiang comforted her, saying, "It tastes good; appearance doesn't matter. Our family has an extra meal today."
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Post-meal rest and getting ready to go out.
description: After the meal, Song Yajing quickly cleared the dishes and put them in the dishwasher, while Zhiqiang wiped Xuanxuan's face. The family changed into comfortable walking shoes and got ready to go out for a stroll to help digestion.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk at Yundang Lake
description: At 19:00, the family of three went out and walked to Bailuzhou Park in Xiamen. The evening breeze was gentle, and the lake shimmered. They walked slowly along the lakeside boardwalk for about 40 minutes. Song Yajing held Zhiqiang's arm and talked about the follow-up reactions to today's fail contest in the group. Xuanxuan skipped ahead, imitating her mother's flustered movements, which made the couple smile at each other.
location: Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Xiamen Bailuzhou Park).

name: Daughter's bedtime moments
description: At 19:40, back home, Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a hot bath. Zhiqiang wrapped her in a bath towel and carried her to bed. At 20:00, she read her daughter her favorite picture book, "The Big Bear's Hug," and Xuanxuan quietly fell asleep as she listened.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal rehabilitation training and relaxation
description: At 20:30, Song Yajing did a 15-minute lumbar rehabilitation routine on the yoga mat in the living room, performing several sets of glute bridges and cat-cow poses, and felt much more relaxed in her lower back. Zhiqiang sat nearby reading and keeping her company. After the workout, she went into the bathroom to wash up and do her skincare routine, applying body lotion and enjoying this time alone.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Community interaction and gratitude journal.
description: At 21:15, Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and opened her phone. The buzz from the afternoon's fail contest hadn't faded yet; she scrolled through the group chat to catch up and replied to a few sisters' complaints. Then she looked back at the coat teaser post she had shared on Moments; several customers left messages asking if she would be in the store tomorrow, and she replied to each one. Finally, she opened the memo on her phone and wrote today's gratitude journal: Thanks for Master Chen's patience, the warmth of the group friends, and the family's love and tolerance.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple's evening conversation and weekend plans.
description: She closed her diary, and Zhiqiang also put down his phone.
