The two talked about their daughter's painting competition on Saturday, confirmed that Zhiqiang could take leave to accompany her, and planned the art supplies and clothing they needed to prepare. Song Yajing also mentioned next Thursday's scripture reading group and the end-of-month VIP appreciation dinner, and Zhiqiang said they would discuss it further on the weekend.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: At 22:00, Song Yajing quietly completed her bedtime prayer, giving thanks for this fulfilling and laughter-filled day. At 22:15, she and Zhiqiang said goodnight to each other, turned off the lights, and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Early in the morning, Song Yajing woke up in natural light. She first said a brief morning prayer for her family, then did 5 minutes of glute bridges and cat-cow stretches on the bed, feeling that her lower back was in good condition. Afterward, she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan and helped her change into her kindergarten uniform. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was in charge of cooking rice porridge and fried eggs, while Song Yajing prepared sliced bread and milk. As the family of three sat together eating, she talked about the day's work arrangements and gently encouraged her daughter to take tomorrow's drawing competition in stride.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to school and buy coffee
description: Song Yajing walked her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The sun was bright on the way; she guided her daughter to observe the small flowers by the roadside and told her that tomorrow's competition is like drawing — expressing your own ideas is what matters most. Xuanxuan happily waved goodbye to her mother at the kindergarten gate. After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing walked along Gucheng West Road toward Zhongshan Road, and on the way bought a hot latte at the 85°C Zhonghua City bakery and chatted casually with the staff.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store arrival preparation, morning meeting, and leave arrangements
description: Song Yajing arrived at the 'Serenity Wardrobe' store at 56 Zhongshan Road. After opening, she turned on the air conditioner and watered the pothos plants. Then she and clerk Xiaomei adjusted the winter outfits on the window mannequins, putting the new caramel-colored coat forward as the main featured style. At 9:15 the two held a brief morning meeting. Song Yajing told Xiaomei that she needed to take leave the next day to accompany her daughter to a competition, and made it clear that Xiaomei would be fully responsible for store operations while she assisted online. They also reviewed yesterday's community interaction and decided to extend the 'baking fail' topic into the day's offline promotional activity.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning Business and Customer Interaction
description: During normal business hours, regular customer Sister Lin came to try on suit jackets and complained that clothes bought online never fit well. Song Yajing smiled and shared her failed attempt at making puff pastry the day before, using the saying “Life can't be perfect in everything” to emphasize the importance of trying clothes on in person. They had a delightful conversation, and Sister Lin happily bought a suit and an inner top. Song Yajing interacted with other customers in a similarly relaxed and humorous way, creating a relaxed shopping atmosphere.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and community warm-up
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei took turns eating in the back room of the store. Song Yajing had the seafood porridge Xiaomei had brought for her. While eating, she replied to several customers' inquiries about the sizes of the new styles, and posted a teaser message in the customer group: “At 2 p.m. there’s a little game about ‘the stories of fitting-room fails.’ Share a photo from your wardrobe that you most want to return, and one of you will be drawn to win a new silk scarf!” People in the group responded quickly, and the atmosphere began to warm up.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Afternoon community event and inventory count.
description: At two in the afternoon, Song Yajing started the "trying-on fails" topic in the customer group on time, with funny memes. The group immediately became lively: some members shared photos of online-bought "fairy dresses" turning into "mops," while others laughed at the awkward moment when a zipper burst open. She replied to each one humorously, and the interaction was lively; in-store customers were also drawn into the discussion. The activity not only boosted the group's energy but also brought in natural foot traffic. During a lull in customers, she took stock of the store's basic styles with Xiaomei to prepare for next week's restocking and confirmed the next day's opening process.
location: Tranquil Wardrobe, 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gym fitness assessment and training plan.
description: Song Yajing changed out of her high heels, put on sneakers, and walked to the Lujiang Street Community Fitness Center in Siming District. She met her personal trainer David on time, and David gave her a comprehensive fitness assessment, including body fat percentage and muscle mass, and the results met expectations. Song Yajing honestly mentioned her old lumbar issue and said she hoped to gain weight for a fuller figure. Based on this, David designed a low-impact core training plan centered on bridges, bird-dogs, and planks, and personally demonstrated and explained in detail how to protect the lower back in each movement. She booked the first official session for the following Tuesday (December 9) on the spot.
location: Siming District Lujiang Street Community Fitness Center, No. 96-2 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returned home, picked up daughter, and prepared dinner.
description: After leaving the gym, Song Yajing walked home along Lujiang Road, stopping at the vegetable market on the way to buy greens and mushrooms. She called her husband Chen Zhiqiang and learned that he had left work early and already bought pork ribs and broccoli. The two discussed making a newly learned garlic pork rib dish. After getting home, she took a quick shower, then went downstairs to pick up her daughter, who came home on the school bus. As soon as Xuanxuan entered the door, she happily talked about being praised by her teacher for her painting in kindergarten. Song Yajing played with Lego with her daughter, then prepared dinner with her husband: she was in charge of marinating the ribs and stir-frying the broccoli, while her husband made tomato and egg soup.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of three had a warm meal together in a relaxed atmosphere. Chen Zhiqiang asked his daughter what she planned to draw for tomorrow's painting competition. Xuanxuan said she wanted to draw a rainbow-colored dinosaur, and both parents praised the idea as creative. Song Yajing told her daughter that she would accompany her through the whole competition tomorrow to put her at ease.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Helping Her Daughter Prepare Art Supplies and Giving Encouragement
description: After the meal, Song Yajing and her daughter spread old newspapers on the living room floor and checked the art box together: whether the watercolor pens had enough colors, whether the paints had dried, and whether the drawing board was clean. Xuanxuan excitedly tried drawing a mother dinosaur on scrap paper, and Song Yajing encouraged her,
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Daughter's washing up, picture-book story, and putting her to sleep.
description: After checking the painting supplies, Song Yajing bathed Xuanxuan and changed her into her favorite pajamas. Xuanxuan chose the picture book Guess How Much I Love You, and Song Yajing read it to her gently. When it came to the little rabbit's love for its mother, Xuanxuan hugged her mom tightly and said, "Mommy, I love you so, so much too." After the story, Xuanxuan quickly fell into a sweet sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Rehabilitation training and gratitude journal
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation exercises in the bedroom, carefully completing the moves taught by her gym trainer, then did some stretching. After washing up and doing her skincare routine, she sat down at her desk, opened her journal, and wrote a gratitude entry: gratitude for the trust of her regular customer Sister Lin, the interaction from the community sisters, the professional guidance from her trainer, her husband's thoughtfulness, and most importantly, her daughter's healthy and happy growth.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Chatting with husband and bedtime reading.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang brewed a pot of Tieguanyin, and the couple curled up on the sofa to chat. Song Yajing explained the next day's schedule in detail (what time to leave, the competition venue, the lunch spot, etc.), and her husband confirmed he would pick them up directly after work. After the serious topics, Song Yajing picked up Yi Shu's new book The Story of a Rose and leaned back on the sofa to read, while Chen Zhiqiang browsed tech news on his phone.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She had originally planned to go to bed at 22:30, but the book's plot was so engaging that Song Yajing read for another half hour. She only put the book down after her husband reminded her. She did a few simple neck stretches, said a bedtime prayer, offered blessings for tomorrow's competition and the people she cares about, and finally, after confirming the alarm was set, turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Waking up naturally at 6:45, she felt full of energy and first did some simple stretches for her lower back. After checking the weather forecast and learning it would be cloudy, 12–18°C, with light rain in the evening, she chose a beige knit top and dark blue casual pants. Then she prepared a nutritious breakfast in the kitchen: a fried egg sandwich with whole wheat bread, warmed milk for her daughter Xuanxuan, black coffee for herself and her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and cut apples and oranges. She also took out butter and left it at room temperature to soften, preparing to make cookies tomorrow. At 7:35, she went to the room to wake Xuanxuan, who was reluctant to get out of bed, and helped her brush her teeth and wash her face. The family of three sat around the dining table and had breakfast. She reminded Xuanxuan that there was a painting competition tomorrow morning and she needed to sleep early. Aqiang promised to take her to the competition venue tomorrow morning.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Seeing daughter off to school and walking to the shop
description: She packed Xuanxuan's little backpack and the painting supplies for tomorrow's competition, then walked her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about making Christmas cards in today's craft class. The banyan trees lining the street looked especially green in the overcast weather. At the kindergarten gate, she handed Xuanxuan to the teacher, told her to listen carefully in class, and watched her skip through the school gate before turning to leave. From the kindergarten, she walked to her shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, passing breakfast stalls that had just opened and parents taking their children to school. A gentle breeze blew, and the weather was pleasant.
location: On the way from Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Store opening preparations and sales data analysis.
description: Arrived at the shop at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District. Unlocked the door, turned on the air conditioner and lights, briefly swept the floor, and wiped the fitting mirror and cashier counter with a wet cloth. Turned on the computer, logged into the shop management system, checked yesterday's revenue and customer messages, and confirmed that staff member Xiaomei would arrive at 10:00. Starting at 8:30, conducted in-depth data analysis, pulling up sales reports for the past month and focusing on spring clothing, especially plus-size women's wear. Found that plus-size women's wear accounted for 15% of sales but only 8% of inventory, and more than 10 customers in the community had inquired about new plus-size styles. So I decided to increase the plus-size proportion to 20% in the next restock and wrote down customers' needs for soft, supple fabric and waist-fitted cuts, ready to send to Sister Susan, the supplier in Guangzhou.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Morning customer reception and community interactions
description: Xiaomei arrived at the store at 10 o'clock sharp to take over the shift. The street had good foot traffic on Friday. Song Yajing was in charge of receiving customers. Based on the morning data analysis, she proactively recommended a newly arrived plus-size knit sweater to a woman with a fuller figure, and the customer was very satisfied. In her spare time, she shared funny screenshots about yesterday’s “fitting room fail” topic in the customer group and teased that a new batch of products would go on sale tonight, and the group was lively.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch break and healthy light meal
description: After letting Xiao Mei go to lunch first, Song Yajing stayed on duty at the store. She used her phone to order takeout from a nearby light meal shop: avocado chicken breast salad and unsweetened soy milk. While eating, she scrolled through Xiaohongshu to check the latest outfit trends, looking for inspiration for the next clothing selection, and enjoyed a moment of rest.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Driving to purchase baking and packaging materials
description: After asking Xiaomei to watch the store, Song Yajing drove a white Toyota Corolla from the parking lot on Zhongshan Road to Walmart (Ruijing Commercial Plaza store) at No. 288 Lianqian West Road. On the way, she exchanged voice messages with her supplier Sister Susan about restocking details. At Walmart, she bought cake flour, New Zealand butter, and Taikoo icing sugar, and in the imported food section found low-GI coconut sugar to replace part of the white sugar. In the stationery section, she grabbed two rolls of ribbon. After shopping, she drove back toward Zhongshan Road, parked in the parking lot near Zhong'an Lane, and walked to the "Paper Craftsman" handmade workshop on Gift Street, where she picked out 20 sturdy kraft paper gift boxes and 3 rolls of plain hemp rope. The owner threw in two handmade stickers as a bonus. She then carried the materials back to the store on foot.
location: Walmart (Ruijing Commercial Plaza store), 2F, No. 288 Lianqian West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Paper Craftsman Studio, Zhongshan Road Gift Street

name: Returned to the store to sort inventory and warm up the community group.
description: She put the purchased materials into the store warehouse and then began organizing inventory. Based on the data analysis from the morning, she placed several best-selling plus-size items in prominent shelves in the store. She used her phone to take photos of the newly purchased kraft paper gift boxes and sent them to the church fellowship group, letting everyone guess what she planned to do, to warm up for the upcoming event.
location: Warehouse of Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Handling online matters and planning new products
description: After a short rest, she opened WeChat and had a voice conversation with Susan, the supplier from Guangzhou, about plus-size restocking needs. The other party said the new fabric looked good and could arrange shipment next week. Then she sorted the afternoon's purchase receipts, recorded them in the accounts, and refined the new product plan.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Making blessing cards and handing over work.
description: At the store, she used ribbons and stickers bought earlier to make two simple blessing cards, writing “The Lord's love is always with you” and “Get well soon” on them, to prepare for the hospital visit on Sunday. At 17:00, she handed over the store duties to Xiaomei on time, ready to leave.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Picked up her daughter from school and confirmed the visit.
description: After work, she walked quickly to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and picked up Xuanxuan at the gate. She then received a call from Aunt Lin, a fellow church member, who told her about a hospital visit on Sunday. Song Yajing immediately signed up and said she could bring homemade cookies and cards. Aunt Lin was very happy, and they agreed to meet at Gulangyu Catholic Church on Sunday morning. After hanging up, she walked home holding Xuanxuan's hand. On the way, Xuanxuan shared the Christmas card she had made and planned to hang it in the bedroom.
location: At the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and on the way home

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: When she got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang was also back. Song Yajing asked Aqiang to keep Xuanxuan company watching cartoons while she put on an apron and prepared dinner: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried pork with green peppers, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of three sat around the table, chatting about the day's experiences as they ate. Song Yajing shared her decision about data analysis and plus-size women's clothing. Aqiang expressed support and suggested opening a recommendation column in the store's mini program. Before bed, she reminded her daughter to wear an extra jacket tomorrow morning.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family walk around Yundang Lake
description: After dinner, she cleared the table with Aqiang. Noticing that although a light rain had been forecast for the evening, the ground was still dry, they added a jacket for Xuanxuan and brought an umbrella. The family of three walked to the Yundang Lake trail. Strolling along the lake, the night breeze was slightly cool, and the reflections of the lights from both shores on Yundang Lake were very tranquil. Song Yajing took the opportunity to discuss tomorrow's arrangements with Aqiang: he would take Xuanxuan to the painting competition and prepare water and snacks, while she would visit the church on Sunday. Aqiang readily agreed to stay home and take care of things. Xuanxuan walked ahead, counting the streetlights. After the walk, they walked home.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Yundang Lake lakeside footpath (near the Shanggu Street section)

name: Daughter's bedtime wash-up and bedtime story.
description: After returning home, she helped Xuanxuan take a bath and blow-dried her hair, then accompanied her to bed and read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You. After that, Xuanxuan quickly fell asleep, still holding the card she had made in her little hand.
location: Children's room at home, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Couple alone time and personal time
description: Ah Qiang was watching the news in the living room. Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom, took out the kraft paper gift box and twine she had bought during the day, searched online for beautiful cookie packaging ideas, and saved them. Then she took out her Bible and notebook to prepare scriptures for Sunday's visit, choosing a comforting passage from the Gospel of Matthew. The two of them enjoyed a quiet time alone together.
location: Home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province—master bedroom and living room.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She got up, washed up, applied skincare, and did a 5-minute breathing meditation in bed to relax. Although she knew she should sleep, she still calmly prepared for Sunday by running through the key steps for making cookies the next day in her mind, then wrote a reminder note and stuck it on the fridge to soften the butter in the morning. She turned off the light at 23:15 and lay beside Aqiang, feeling fulfilled and secure, looking forward to the coming day.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30. It was sunny outside, with the soft warm winter sun. After some gentle stretching, she quietly got out of bed and washed up. In the kitchen, she heated milk, toasted a few slices of bread, and deftly fried two eggs. She specially put the millet and red dates that had been soaked last night into the rice cooker to cook a pot of stomach-warming porridge for the family.
location: Bedroom and kitchen in the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up the family and a warm breakfast
description: Gently woke up the still sleepy-eyed Xuanxuan and helped her change into the rainbow sweater and white sneakers that had been matched the night before. The family of three sat around the dining table, eating a simple and nutritious breakfast. While drinking porridge, Yajing used her phone to contact Xiaomei on WeChat, confirmed the store opening matters for today, reminded her again to handle the return orders left over from yesterday, and asked her to find time in the afternoon to call a few VIP customers. Aqiang filled his daughter's water bottle with warm water.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off for the botanical garden.
description: Yajing checked Xuanxuan's art supply bag and confirmed that the paints, brushes, and easel were all ready. Aqiang ordered a ride-hailing car through a mobile app, and they got in at the entrance of the residential community. On the way, Xuanxuan looked out the window excitedly. Yajing snapped a photo of her radiant smile with her phone and posted it to the “Three Besties” group with the caption “Go! Accompany the little painter to the competition!” According to AMap data, the drive would take about 17.8 minutes, but in reality, with red lights and traffic, it took about 20 minutes in total.
location: En route from the entrance of the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to the Xiamen Botanical Garden (West Gate) at No. 25 Huyuan Road, Siming District.

name: Pre-competition preparation and companionship.
description: They arrived at the botanical garden, where the air was fresh and the sunlight was warm. They found the araucaria lawn area designated for the competition, surrounded by tall araucaria trees and various strangely shaped desert plants. Xuanxuan immediately took a liking to a cactus with a peculiar, charmingly cute shape. Yajing helped her daughter set up the easel and secure the drawing paper, while A Qiang handed over water and painting tools from the side. The family of three waited contentedly together for the whistle to start the competition.
location: Xiamen Botanical Garden - Araucaria Lawn, 25 Huyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Painting competition
description: The competition began, and the young painters soon immersed themselves in their creations. Yajing sat on a bench not far away and shifted her attention to the Complete Novels of Yi Shu she had brought. Sunlight cast dappled shadows through the leaves. She occasionally looked up to see her daughter focused on mixing colors and painting, and that earnest little expression softened her heart. During the break, she took out her phone and snapped a few close-ups of Xuanxuan and the “model” cactus, sending them to the family group chat. Her mother immediately replied with a like and flower emoji.
location: Xiamen Botanical Garden - Araucaria Lawn, 25 Huyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: End of the competition and award ceremony
description: The music marking the end of the competition played. The judges began evaluating the works. Soon after, the host started reading the winners. When he read, 'Little Chen Xuanxuan, "The Big Cactus," receives the Commemorative Award,' Yajing excitedly grasped Aqiang's hand. Xuanxuan ran onto the stage like a joyful little bird and accepted a certificate and a beautiful set of watercolor paintbrushes. Yajing's eyes felt a little warm; she immediately recorded the precious video of her daughter receiving the award with her phone and sent it to the family group and her best friends' group.
location: Award podium area, Araucaria Lawn, Xiamen Botanical Garden, No. 25 Huyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Celebration lunch with Minnan cuisine.
description: After the award ceremony, Yajing suggested going to Xuanxuan's favorite Minnan cuisine to celebrate. The family of three walked to the "Minwei Bistro" next to the west gate of the Botanical Garden. They ordered ginger-duck pot, oyster omelet, satay noodles, and sweet-and-sour fish. During the meal, Aqiang raised his cup and toasted his daughter with tea instead of wine. Xuanxuan happily announced, "I'm a painter now!" Yajing and Aqiang smiled at each other, and the private room was filled with a warm and happy atmosphere.
location: Minwei Bistro, Huyuan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Strolling by the lake in Nanhu Park.
description: After the meal, the sunlight was just right, and the family decided to take a walk to aid digestion. Since the originally planned Donghu Park was far away, they adjusted and took a taxi to the closer Nanhu Park instead. They walked along the lake, and Xuanxuan was still immersed in the joy of her award. Yajing held Aqiang's hand and felt that such moments were especially precious. They sat for a while in the pavilion at the center of the lake, watching egrets skim across the water.
location: Lakeside trail at Nanhu Park, No. 7 Huguang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took a taxi home and had a brief rest.
description: After the walk, seeing that Xuanxuan was a little sleepy, the family of three took a taxi home. Amap data showed that driving home from Nanhu Park took only 10.5 minutes. After arriving home, Yajing let Xuanxuan take a short rest on the sofa, while she and Aqiang tidied up and put away the painting tools, certificates, and other items.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Putting up the award certificate and making a video call.
description: After a good rest, Xuanxuan was full of energy and solemnly stuck the certificate on the most prominent wall in her room. Yajing took a photo of her and connected with her parents in faraway Quanzhou via WeChat video. Her father beamed when he saw the certificate, while her mother urged Yajing to nurture her daughter's painting talent. In the family group chat, her sister Jiajia also sent a voice message: “Wow, our family's art master is born!” Yajing replied to each one, feeling warm inside.
location: Living room and bedroom of the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child bonding and baking ingredient preparation
description: After the video ended, Yajing played with modeling clay with Xuanxuan for a while. Xuanxuan used her newly won prize—a set of watercolor pens—to draw a childlike "portrait of Mom" for Yajing. Then Yajing went to the kitchen to check the ingredients for tomorrow's low-GI coconut cookies: the butter had already softened at room temperature, and the low-GI coconut sugar bought yesterday was ready. She nodded with satisfaction.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street—living room and kitchen

name: Prepare dinner
description: Aqiang voluntarily came over to help wash and cut vegetables. The couple chatted and laughed in the kitchen, one at the wok and the other prepping ingredients. Tonight's menu was Min Nan misua soup, served with stir-fried seasonal vegetables and a steamed sea bass—nutritious and cozy.
location: Kitchen of the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: The family of three sat at the table enjoying dinner. At the table, Yajing and A Qiang talked about how they felt about today's competition, and she used the opportunity to express her lingering fear of having almost missed her daughter's important moment because she was busy running the shop. A Qiang comforted her and suggested that from now on they mark all important dates on the family calendar and make "Family Day" a sacred commitment. Yajing nodded solemnly in agreement.
location: Community restaurant at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk by Yundang Lake
description: After dinner, the family of three changed into comfortable shoes and walked to the nearby Yundang Lake for a stroll. It took only about 15.8 minutes to walk there from home. The lake breeze gently blew as Xuanxuan ran around happily ahead. Yajing and A Qiang walked slowly along the shore with their fingers interlaced, talking about future plans and how to better balance work and family. Yajing felt a peace and contentment she had not experienced in a long time. After walking for about 50 minutes, they walked home.
location: Lakeside trail along Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child baking and card making
description: After the walk home, Yajing put on an apron and started making low-GI coconut cookies for tomorrow's visit to the church hospital. Xuanxuan also put on her little apron to help, and although her hands were covered in dough, she was thoroughly enjoying herself. During a break in baking, Xuanxuan remembered that they had agreed this morning to draw a card for her sick grandparents, so she carefully drew a sunflower and wrote 'Get Well Soon' in wobbly characters.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up and goodnight stories.
description: After the cookies were baked and cooled, Yajing gave Xuanxuan a comfortable hot bath. Then she nestled beside Xuanxuan's little bed and read her a passage from The Little Prince as a bedtime story. Xuanxuan drifted off to sleep as she listened, with a sweet smile at the corners of her mouth.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the residence at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Solitude for reflection and preparation for tomorrow
description: After settling her daughter down, Yajing returned to the study, opened her diary, and wrote down the day's reflections: "December 6. My daughter drew a cactus. The light in her eyes when she received the award shone brighter than any sales figure. Today, I found what matters more." Then she put the ferry ticket, simple visit cards, and scripture passages she would need for tomorrow's Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church and hospital visit into her bag, set the alarm, and with a heart full of happiness turned off the light and fell asleep at 23:00.
location: Study and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up early, preparing breakfast, and having breakfast with the family.
description: In the early morning, she woke up naturally after the alarm went off. After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear and made quick pancakes with coconut sugar and whole wheat flour, paired with fried eggs, milk, and black coffee. Then she gently woke her husband Aqiang and daughter Xuanxuan, and the family sat around the table to have breakfast together. During this time, she checked the visiting items: homemade coconut cookies and the card Xuanxuan had drawn. After confirming the words "Wish you a speedy recovery" on the card were clear, she finished the last sip of milk with peace of mind.

At the entrance of the ticket hall, she met Aunt Lin and two other fellow church members. They bought tickets online for the 8:45 ferry and bought water at a convenience store. After taking the ferry to Gulangyu Island, they walked about 10 minutes to the Catholic church. At 9:00 Mass began on time. Inside the church, the organ music sounded melodious, and everyone sang hymns together. When receiving the Eucharist, she felt calm and grateful, and prayed for strength for the upcoming visit.

She took the 10 o'clock ferry back to Xiamen Ferry Terminal, then walked about 12 minutes to the inpatient department of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University. She visited three elderly church members separately, offering homemade coconut cookies and cards drawn by Xuanxuan, and softly recited the Hail Mary for a bedridden church member, whose eyes glistened with tears. After the visits, she said goodbye to the churchgoers at the hospital entrance and took a taxi to the Lujiang Street Home-Community Elderly Care Service Center. At the center, she found Granny Zhang's room, sat with her by the window listening to her talk about memories of her youth on Gulangyu Island, and carefully trimmed her fingernails. Granny Zhang said with emotion, "You're as considerate as my own daughter."

participant.name: Grandma Zhang
participant.relation: Elderly people at the community senior care center.

location: The First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, No. 55 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China, and the Lujiang Street Home-Community Elderly Care Service Center, No. 160 Lujiang Street, Siming District.

Aqiang gently patted her shoulder and said, 'You've changed — you've become softer.'

Her voice choked up when she mentioned Grandma Zhang's words. Aqiang held her hand tightly and said, "You've changed—you've become softer and stronger." During the walk, she paid attention to maintaining proper posture to protect her lower back.

This is the best Christmas gift this year.' After writing the diary, she did 15 minutes of gentle stretching on the bedroom floor, focusing on relaxing her lower back. Finally, leaning against the headboard, she flipped through VOGUE magazine, looked at spring/summer trends, and conceived ideas for the store display. name: Leave the shop early, go home to change, and pick up daughter from school.
description: 16:30 Song Yajing told Xiao Mei to watch the shop and left first, hurried home, and took 10 minutes to change into the wine-red knitted dress prepared for the birthday dinner and touch up her lipstick. At 17:00 she left on time, walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan, and on the way bought a box of small sparklers at a convenience store.
location: From Shop No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, to the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, then to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing a birthday surprise at home and going to the banquet
description: After picking up Xuanxuan, the mother and daughter bought a small balloon at the convenience store downstairs. Back home, Yajing had Xuanxuan hide the hand-drawn birthday card in her small backpack. Yajing took the tiramisu out of the fridge, sprinkled cocoa powder on it, and put it into a cake box. Chen Zhiqiang called to say he was on his way home; the mother and daughter smiled at each other and began preparing for the dinner party.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Birthday dinner at Wutong Western Restaurant
description: The family of three walked to the booked Wutong Western Restaurant. The window seat was decorated with a small lighted sign reading 'Happy Birthday'. During the meal, Chen Zhiqiang ordered his favorite steak, while Xuanxuan urged her father to eat more vegetables. At the end of the meal, Xuanxuan solemnly took out a greeting card and read the blessing aloud. Yajing hinted for him to look at the back. When Chen Zhiqiang saw the message, his eyes reddened, he hugged his wife and daughter tightly, and thanked them again and again.
location: Wutong Western Restaurant, Huiwen Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go home, cut the cake, and unpack the protein powder delivery.
description: After dinner, they walked home. Song Yajing brought out a tiramisu cake and placed a '35' candle on it. Xuanxuan led the singing of the birthday song, and after Chen Zhiqiang made a wish, the three of them shared the low-sugar tiramisu. Xuanxuan ended up with cocoa powder all over her mouth, making everyone laugh. Yajing picked up a protein powder package from the security guard, and Chen Zhiqiang hugged the package, saying that now he had even more motivation to work out.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Night walk on the Yundang Lake trail
description: After cutting the cake, the family of three changed into comfortable shoes and went for a walk along the Yundang Lake promenade. The lake breeze was slightly cool on the winter night. Chen Zhiqiang held Yajing's hand tightly the whole time, while Xuanxuan hopped between them, waving a small sparkler and drawing trails of light. When they sat down on a bench by the lake, Chen Zhiqiang told Yajing that this was the day that felt most like home. Yajing leaned gently against his shoulder, and they walked ten minutes longer than usual.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Cozy bedtime moments
description: After returning home, Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a bath and read a picture book story about 'love and sharing.' Xuanxuan fell asleep at 21:45. Yajing went to the living room, leaned on Chen Zhiqiang's shoulder while he was watching TV, and softly shared the touching moments of the day. At 22:00, she checked in her high-protein diet in her close friends' group chat and shared the great success of the birthday plan, then made a note for tomorrow's delivery arrival. The two said goodnight to each other and fell asleep in an embrace.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning family ritual and dropping off daughter at school.
description: At 6:50 in the morning, Song Yajing was woken by the alarm clock. After washing up, she prepared breakfast for the family: shrimp scrambled eggs, multigrain toast, and rabbit-shaped rice balls. At seven o'clock she woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan, and the family of three sat around the table for a warm meal, noticing that the sky outside was cloudy and turning cooler. After breakfast, she helped her daughter pack her schoolbag, reminded her to put on extra clothes, and then took her daughter by the hand and walked about ten minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, Chen Lexuan recalled the fun of blowing out candles at her father's birthday party yesterday. After arriving, she safely handed her daughter to the teacher.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Purchasing ribbons and morning store preparation
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing stopped by a stationery store on Gongyuan South Road and picked up a roll of vintage kraft paper twine for tying gift boxes. Then she walked to the boutique clothing store at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, opened the store on time at eight, played soft piano music, sorted customer orders, replied to morning greetings in the community group, and changed the flowers. At nine, shop assistant Xiaomei arrived. Song Yajing briefed her on the day's priorities: she would bake the gift cookies for the thank-you dinner in the small kitchen behind the store, Xiaomei would be in charge of the front counter, and she also told her about the spring clothing delivery, Susan's call, and the appointment customers. The handover was complete.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Baking the first round of low-sugar cookies.
description: Song Yajing entered the small kitchen at the back of the store, put on an apron and baking gloves, and used low-GI flour, sugar substitute, butter, and other ingredients to mix and shape the dough according to the recipe. After preheating the oven, she put in the first batch of cookie dough. About five minutes later, she noticed the edges were browning too deeply, so she immediately lowered the temperature by ten degrees, avoiding burning. The first batch of cookies came out slightly darker in color but richly aromatic, and she placed them on the cooling rack with satisfaction.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Midday store help and sharing with her best friend
description: While the cookies were cooling, Song Yajing went to the front to help Xiaomei receive customers. She recommended a dark green floral long dress to a customer and made a successful sale. Afterward, she ordered a low-fat chicken breast salad and coffee for Xiaomei, and had her own lunch in the rest area. She sent a photo of the first batch of cookies cooling to the besties group. Meiling and Jiajia humorously commented that they had an elegant caramel flavor. The three chatted pleasantly, which eased her tense mood.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Continue baking and packaging cookies as gifts
description: After a short break, Song Yajing focused on baking the remaining two batches of cookies. After adjusting the oven temperature, the cookies came out golden and perfectly crisp. Around three in the afternoon, all three batches were finished, and she transferred them to a cooling rack. Then she took out kraft paper boxes, neatly arranged the cookies in them, tied each with a bow using the new kraft paper string, and put in handwritten thank-you cards reading "Thank you for being there." She prepared 24 gifts in total and kept a spare box on hand.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Afternoon store wrap-up and spring clothing confirmation
description: After packing the cookies into boxes, Song Yajing proactively called the supplier Sister Susan to confirm that the new spring clothing line would be shipped on time on December 15, and asked in detail about the improvements to the camel coat's cut. She then counted the gifts and packed them for later use, and helped Xiaomei tidy the shelves, clean up, and check the day's business accounts. Considering there was an important dinner the next day, she let Xiaomei leave half an hour early, and she herself left the shop at 17:00 sharp to pick up her daughter.
location: China, Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Picked up my daughter after school and went to the gym.
description: Song Yajing arrived on time at Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Chen Lexuan. Her daughter excitedly showed off the “flying house” she had drawn that day. The mother and daughter took a taxi to the community gym near Jiaxingyuan Park, arriving at 17:25.
location: Community gym near Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Second core rehabilitation training session
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already waiting at the gym. He took their daughter to the children's play area, while Song Yajing did her second core rehabilitation session under the coach's guidance. The bird-dog exercise was stable without shaking, and her endurance in the bridge exercise improved. The coach praised her obvious progress. After the training, she mixed her own protein powder with water at the gym counter to replenish her energy. Though her waist and abdomen felt sore, she felt fulfilled inside.
location: Community gym near Jiaxingyuan Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Family dinner and final confirmation of the evening banquet.
description: After the training, the family of three took a taxi to the Old Xiamen Shacha Noodle Restaurant on Zhongshan Road and enjoyed shacha noodles, seafood fried rice noodles, and fried five-spice rolls. During the meal, Song Yajing sent the final list for the next evening's dinner to her husband and reviewed it again while eating. After dinner, the three walked along Yundang Lake. She checked details item by item, including the dinner photography, seating chart, number of party favors, restaurant menu, and decorations. Her husband affirmed her thorough preparation. The lakeside night view was charming, and the family strolled for about 40 minutes, enjoying the warm time together.
location: Lakeside trail around Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China.

name: Going home and evening family time
description: After the walk, she took a taxi back to the home in the Shanggu Street No. 82 community. Song Yajing bathed her daughter Chen Lexuan, changed her into cartoon pajamas, and read 'The Little Rabbit's Goodnight Stories' to lull her to sleep. After her daughter was sound asleep, she removed her makeup, washed up, applied moisturizing serum, and organized the gift boxes and spare clothes needed for the next day at the entrance. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang was already lying in bed reading.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: After getting into bed, Song Yajing shared the thrilling and funny story of baking cookies during the day, and her husband gave her encouragement and comfort. The two talked about the next day's banquet in a warm atmosphere. At around 21:20, she fell asleep peacefully beside her husband with a smile, looking forward to a successful banquet.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Early morning wake-up, family breakfast, school drop-off, and flower pickup.
description: At 06:30 in the morning, Song Yajing was woken by her phone alarm. She got up quietly and prepared breakfast for her family. She took out the low-sugar cookies baked yesterday and tried one; they were crispy and fragrant. Then she made soft scrambled eggs with shrimp, toasted whole wheat bread, sliced strawberries, and arranged them on her daughter Chen Lexuan's plate in the shape of a smiling bear face. At 07:00, she woke her husband Chen Zhiqiang and their daughter, and the family sat down together to enjoy a loving breakfast. During the meal, Song Yajing reminded her daughter to listen to her father and go to Grandma's house tonight, and promised to take her for mango shaved ice tomorrow. At 07:35, the family of three left the house. Chen Zhiqiang drove their daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten first, watched her skip through the school gate, then drove Song Yajing to Hualuozi Flower Shop. At the shop, Song Yajing picked up the pre-ordered light purple hydrangeas and eucalyptus leaves. The shop assistant Xiao Lin recognized her and smiled, wishing her a smooth dinner party.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (home), then went to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, and then to Hualuozi Flower Shop at No. 2 Xinyi Lane.

name: Pick up the flowers and walk to the restaurant to set up the dinner venue.
description: At 08:10, after picking up the flowers from the flower shop, Song Yajing walked to Haijingxuan Private Dining on the 4th floor of Xinlinghui Plaza to prepare the banquet venue. At 08:30, her best friend Li Meiling and the shop assistant Xiao Mei also arrived one after another, and the three quickly divided the work. Xiao Mei was responsible for adjusting the sound system and projector in the private room, repeatedly testing the wireless microphone effect and the playback smoothness of the PPT photo collection. Li Meiling used the restaurant's existing light-green tablecloths and arranged the brought flower material at varying heights in vases, placing them as decorations beside the seats. Song Yajing took out the 24 thank-you gifts she had prepared at home the previous night according to seating order — cookies in kraft paper bags tied with twine and handwritten thank-you cards — and placed them one by one in front of the corresponding seats. She also kept adjusting the projector's focus and brightness, striving to make the photos full and vivid. At 10:30, the supplier Sister Susan sent a WeChat voice message saying that the new spring clothing styles would be shipped from Guangzhou on time next Monday. She replied briefly and continued decorating, feeling even more reassured.
location: Walk from Hualuozi Flower Shop, No. 2 Xinyili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Haijingxuan Private Dining, 4th floor, Xinlinghui Plaza, No. 18 Lujiang Road

name: Work lunch and dinner flow check
description: At 12:00, the morning setup work came to a close. Song Yajing felt hungry, so she suggested going to Bashi A-Jie Wu Xiang on Kaihe Road nearby for lunch. The three walked for 13 minutes to this Xiamen time-honored restaurant. Each ordered a bowl of satay noodles, plus the signature five-spice rolls. Song Yajing specifically asked the owner to add an extra serving of fried bean curd and lean meat. While eating, they went over the dinner party procedure again, including the schedule for greeting guests, giving a speech, serving tea, taking group photos, and other parts. Li Meiling praised her for looking well, and Xiaomei also guaranteed that the sound equipment would be absolutely no problem. Song Yajing felt especially reassured by the company of her best friend and the shop staff.
location: Eighth Market Ajie Five-Spice, No. 111 Kaihe Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Back to the store for a rest and personal preparation.
description: After lunch, Song Yajing and Xiaomei walked back to her clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She changed into the off-white knitted dress she had brought, touched up her makeup lightly and elegantly, and pinned the pale purple hydrangea flower at her collar as a brooch. Seeing her refreshed self in the mirror, her confidence doubled. Xiaomei tidied the shelves. At 14:30, Song Yajing shared photos of the decorated venue in the close-friends WeChat group with Jiajia, who couldn't attend, teasing her that she must come next time. Then she posted behind-the-scenes photos in the customer WeChat group with the caption: 'Tonight, we'll see you there!' The enthusiastic responses gave her a boost. At 15:00, she closed the shop early, hung up a 'closed for tonight's dinner' sign, let Xiaomei go home to rest, and asked her to come back to the restaurant at 5:30 p.m. to help.
location: Shop at No. 36 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return to the restaurant for the final check.
description: At 15:30, Song Yajing returned alone to the Haijingxuan private banquet ahead of time. The restaurant was very quiet, with only the waitstaff making final preparations. She checked each private room carefully: whether the return gifts were neatly placed, whether the seating cards matched, whether the projector was working properly, and whether the sound system had any static. She checked the spare batteries and USB drive to make sure everything was foolproof, and on the title page of the guest book prepared by the restaurant, she wrote an opening thank-you message in beautiful handwriting. Everything was ready, and she felt both calm and full of anticipation.
location: Sea View Pavilion Private Dining, 4/F, Xinlinghui Plaza, 18 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-banquet Final Push and Guest Greeting Preparations
description: At 16:30, Song Yajing sat for a while in the restaurant's lounge area, taking deep breaths to compose herself, and a server brought her a cup of warm water. At 17:00, Xiaomei also arrived. She had changed into the store's newest autumn suit dress and began greeting a few regular customers who had arrived early. At 17:45, Song Yajing stood at the entrance of the banquet hall, adjusting her hem and flower accessories, ready to welcome every friend in her best state.
location: Sea View Pavilion Private Dining, 4/F, Xinlinghui Plaza, 18 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The entire evening banquet: welcoming guests, giving a speech, offering tea, and taking a group photo
description: At 18:00, the dinner officially began welcoming guests. Song Yajing stood smiling at the door, hugging and greeting every old friend who arrived. Everyone praised her beauty, and she responded warmly. At 18:20, a familiar voice sounded—her regular customer and close friend Vivian had come back from Shanghai especially for her, giving her a big surprise. Song Yajing rushed over excitedly and hugged her tightly, her eyes a little wet. Vivian handed her a small bunch of daisies wrapped in kraft paper and said softly, "You are worth me coming all the way back." At 18:30, Song Yajing invited everyone to take their seats. Under the soft lighting, she walked up to the microphone, looked at the familiar faces in the audience, took a deep breath, and began her speech. Her voice was a little choked, but she kept smiling, thanking everyone for accompanying her through the store's confusion as customers and friends, and for witnessing her growth. After the speech, she pressed the remote control, and the projection screen began playing a carefully edited annual review video, recording everything from the new product launch at the beginning of the year to the smiles of customers, accompanied by gentle piano music. Many customers were moved to tears. When the video ended, everyone spontaneously raised their glasses, and the scene was moving. At 19:00, the banquet began. Song Yajing held a glass of black tea and, accompanied by Xiaomei, went table to table to toast and thank the guests, chatting warmly with each table and asking about their recent situations and styling needs. She personally handed each customer a low-sugar cookie as a gift, explaining that it was an additive-free healthy snack. Everyone loved it and took photos to share. At 20:00, she returned to her seat, quickly ate a few bites, then went backstage to confirm the follow-up arrangements. At 20:30, she invited all guests to stand in front of the backdrop for a group photo. Everyone was in high spirits, and a guest by the window suggested using the Gulangyu night view as the background. As the photographer's shutter clicked, she caught sight of her husband Chen Zhiqiang—he had made a special trip after work and smiled, giving her a thumbs up. After the group photo, Song Yajing once again expressed her thanks to all the guests, and the dinner came to an end amid laughter and joy.
location: Sea View Pavilion Private Dining, 4/F, Xinlinghui Plaza, 18 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wrap-up work and a seaside walk
description: At 21:00, after seeing off the last guest, Song Yajing, her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and Li Meiling and Xiaomei helped give the restaurant a quick tidy-up. At 21:15, the couple said goodbye to their friends and walked to the nearby Mountain-Sea Health Trail for a stroll. The early winter night breeze carried a chill, and as she held her husband's arm, she felt the fatigue of the day melt away in the sea breeze. Her husband asked if she was tired. She said that seeing everyone happy made it worth it, though her waist was a bit sore, so he thoughtfully gently massaged her side. They walked along the trail for about twenty minutes, chatting about the fun moments at the dinner and the customers' lovely feedback, enjoying some rare time together as a couple.
location: Xinlinghui Plaza, No. 18 Lujiang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the adjacent section of the Xiamen Mountain-Sea Health Trail

name: Returning home, family time, and late-night gratitude.
description: At 21:40, the two took a taxi near the trail and went home. After getting home, Song Yajing first went to her daughter's room and saw Chen Lexuan sleeping soundly with her grandmother. She gently kissed her daughter's cheek. Back in the living room, she poured herself a glass of hot milk, and her husband cooked her a bowl of instant noodles as a midnight snack. At 22:00, she curled up on the sofa and checked her phone. Photos and videos of the dinner party were flooding her Moments and customer groups. The overwhelming praise and gratitude warmed her heart, and she took screenshots to save them. Then she copied and modified the thank-you template and sent sincere thank-you voice messages one by one to more than a dozen regular customers who could not attend today, explaining the dinner situation and sending her best wishes. By the time she finished, it was 23:00. After a quick wash, she wrote in her diary that on December 12, 2025, the dinner party had been a complete success, that her heart was full and grateful, and that the day belonged to them. At 23:30, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Natural wake-up and morning log.
description: She woke up naturally in the Saturday morning light, without the urging of an alarm clock. Song Yajing leaned against the headboard, took out her phone, and briefly recorded last night's touching moments in her memo—Vivian's surprise appearance and the smiling faces of the customers when they received the gifts. She also drew a little sun in her notebook, kicking off this "Family Day."
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A loving breakfast and time with family.
description: Song Yajing put on an apron and used last night's leftover pumpkin puree and whole wheat flour to fry several bear-shaped pumpkin pancakes. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang made her coffee, and she warmed milk for Zhiqiang and her daughter Xuanxuan. At 7:50, she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan. When Xuanxuan saw the bear-shaped pancakes on the table, she clapped happily. She told Xuanxuan: "This afternoon, we have a special task — making cookies with Mommy!" Xuanxuan cheered excitedly.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Get ready to go out, walk to commute, and warm up the community
description: Song Yajing quickly tidied up the dining table and kitchen, changed into a comfortable off-white knit cardigan and dark blue jeans, and checked the camera memory card and power bank from last night's dinner party in her bag. Then she took her daughter Chen Lexuan's hand and walked to the clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Along the way, the bauhinia trees were in full bloom. As she walked, she sent a morning greeting in the "Yajing Life Gallery VIP Customer Group" on her phone: "Saturday in Xiamen is really beautiful! Before the store opens today, let me quietly share a wave of last night's sweet overload—are you ready?" She also shared the preview content from last night's dinner party, and early-rising customers in the group responded immediately.
location: From the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (about 7 minutes on foot), finally arriving at Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District.

name: Compile dinner feedback and community management
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing settled her daughter Chen Lexuan and handed her a box of colored pencils and drawing paper, asking her to draw the beautiful ladies she had seen at the dinner party the night before. She turned on her computer, sorted through the photos and video clips sent by the photographer last night, carefully selected 9 of the most representative group photos, close-ups of the gifts, and warm moments, paired them with the long thank-you letter she had written, and posted it in the customer group and on Moments: “Every moment of companionship deserves to be cherished. Last night’s lights and laughter are memories we wove together…” After posting, she replied to over a dozen private messages one by one and once again expressed gratitude to several core customers (such as Vivian).
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (small work area behind the clothing store)

name: Spring clothing preview and material archiving.
description: Striking while the iron is hot, Song Yajing posted a new message in the group: "Sneak peek! On December 20, our 'Early Spring Prelude' collection will officially go on sale! At the same time, the highly requested plus-size exclusive upgrade zone will also debut, with more sizes and trendier styles~" She attached a close-up photo of spring clothing sample fabric taken the day before. The group was instantly flooded with replies like "Want to try it on" and "Can't wait." Then she woke up Xuanxuan, who was drawing with great enthusiasm, and while tidying up the paintbrushes, she took a few photos of the new spring display corners in the store with her phone to keep as material, and checked the community operation results.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (inside a clothing store).

name: Take daughter to eat mango shaved ice
description: Song Yajing hung up a small sign reading 'The owner is out,' took Chen Lexuan by the hand, and walked to Yang Xiaoxian Dessert Shop (about a 2-minute walk). Because it was Saturday, the shop was full of young people. Xuanxuan skillfully pointed at 'Super Mango Snow Mountain Shaved Ice' on the menu and said, 'Mommy, I want this one!' Song Yajing ordered a cup of mango pomelo sago with less sugar for herself. Watching Xuanxuan scoop up a big spoonful of shaved ice and squint with enjoyment, she felt sweeter than honey inside.
location: Yang Xiaoxian (Zhongshan Road Branch), Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home to rest
description: The mother and daughter strolled home slowly. The sunlight was just right, and the little dogs and flowers along the way made Xuanxuan curious. When they reached the entrance of the residential community, Song Yajing had Xuanxuan get on her small electric scooter and gave her a ride home. After arriving home, she let Xuanxuan rest and watch some cartoons while she went to the kitchen to prepare the ingredients for the afternoon baking.
location: Residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (walking home from Yang Xiaoxian)

name: Parent-child baking time
description: Song Yajing took the pre-prepared cake flour, unsalted butter, eggs, and powdered sugar out of the refrigerator. Chen Lexuan brought over a small stool, washed her hands, and put on a cartoon apron. She taught Xuanxuan to weigh the flour with a digital scale, and Xuanxuan was in charge of mixing the butter and powdered sugar. The happiest part was cutting out cookies with molds: dinosaurs, stars, little cars... Xuanxuan excitedly showed her mother every single one she pressed out. Song Yajing was responsible for putting the baking trays into the preheated oven and controlling the heat. When the first batch of dinosaur cookies came out of the oven, the whole room was filled with a wonderful aroma. She set aside about twenty cookies to cool, put them into a beautiful tin, and planned to bring them to church the next day to share. The rest were eaten by the mother and daughter as they kept baking, and they also left a small plate for Dad.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take a short break and prepare dinner.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang sent a message saying he had gotten off work and was on his way home. Chen Lexuan was tired from playing and took a nap on the sofa. Song Yajing used the time to take out the dishes for dinner to thaw, and mentally ran through the evening video call and walking plan.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Family dinner
description: Chen Zhiqiang came home, saw the cookies on the table and his sleeping daughter, and smiled knowingly. Song Yajing quickly made a few dishes: steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and tomato egg-drop soup. During dinner, Zhiqiang excitedly talked about how his colleagues had envied the photos on Yajing's Moments the previous night, while Chen Lexuan animatedly recounted the fun of making cookies. The whole family was full of laughter and joy.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Video call with parents to report weight gain.
description: After dinner, Song Yajing video-called her parents in Quanzhou. On the screen, her father first asked about the dinner party the night before; she shared photos, and her father kept saying, "Well done, that did us proud." Her mother immediately noticed her and said, "Yajing, you've lost weight again—your chin is so pointy." She was prepared and quickly took out the protein powder canister from her bag and held it up to the camera, saying with a smile, "Mom, look, this is the high-protein powder Aqiang bought me. I drink it every day. I also follow the diet, making sure to have fish, shrimp, or beef every day!" Her father nodded on the screen and said, "As long as you know how to balance your nutrition, that's good." Only then did her mother show a satisfied smile: "That's right, health is the foundation of everything." The family chatted about everyday things for half an hour.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discussing the New Year's Day family visit plan.
description: After the video call ended, as Song Yajing was clearing the dishes, Chen Zhiqiang picked up the calendar on his phone. She sat down beside him, and referring to the store's spring clothing launch (December 20) and the busy month-end inventory period, the two decided to set their return to Quanzhou to visit relatives for January 3, 2026 (Saturday) and January 4 (Sunday). Zhiqiang marked on the calendar: "1.3-1.4 Return to Quanzhou (Yajing's family + in-laws' family)". They also discussed what gifts to bring and decided to buy a few boxes of Xiamen specialty pies and bring a plus-size wool scarf newly stocked at Yajing's store for her mother.
location: home living room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk
description: The sky had darkened and the evening breeze was cool. Song Yajing put a jacket on her daughter Chen Lexuan, and the family of three went out for a walk. They strolled slowly along the community walking path while Xuanxuan rode her little scooter ahead, scouting the way. Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang chatted about the details of going back to Quanzhou for New Year's Day and the upcoming spring clothing season in the shop. She felt grounded, wrapped in happiness.
location: From the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Jiaxingyuan Park on Bailu Road, Siming District, then back to the community.

name: Going home and preparing for bed
description: After returning home, Song Yajing asked Chen Zhiqiang to bathe Chen Lexuan, while she went to the kitchen to check the tin of cookies to take to church tomorrow, confirmed the lid was sealed, and put it back in a cool place. Then she found the Bible and hymnbook for herself and Zhiqiang to use for tomorrow's Bible reading, and placed them in a cloth bag. After washing up and changing into pajamas, she looked at her rosy face in the mirror and smiled with satisfaction.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal reflection and bedtime
description: Song Yajing leaned against the headboard and used her phone to record today's feelings: "The dinner party cleanup went perfectly, and the community response was enthusiastic. The cookies Xuanxuan made were especially fragrant. In the video, Mom finally smiled, and I feel like I have more energy too. The New Year's Day plans are set as well — a very fulfilling Saturday." She put down her phone, and before turning off the light, glanced at a picture Xuanxuan had drawn today on the bedside table — it showed three little figures holding hands, with the words "Mommy, Daddy, and Me" written on it. The corners of her mouth lifted, and she drifted off to sleep with this warmth.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up, washing up, and morning preparations
description: The winter morning sunlight streamed through the curtains into the bedroom, and Song Yajing woke up naturally before the alarm rang. Today was Sunday, also the church visitation day, and she felt peaceful and devout. She got up quietly, washed up first, looked at her complexion in the mirror, and felt it was not bad. Then she changed into comfortable house clothes and got ready to start the new day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared and enjoyed breakfast for the whole family
description: Song Yajing opened the refrigerator and took out the fresh eggs, whole-wheat toast, and milk she had bought yesterday, then began making zucchini egg pancakes and warm milk. She skillfully shredded the zucchini, mixed it with eggs and flour, and pan-fried it into golden thin pancakes in a skillet. The family of three then sat around the table to enjoy breakfast, and Xuanxuan ate with gusto. Song Yajing told her daughter that they would visit Grandma Zhang at the elderly care center in the afternoon and bring the dinosaur painting she had drawn. Chen Zhiqiang reminded her that the spring clothing would arrive tomorrow and that she could think more about the store display plan.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home, Room 502, Building 3, community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family parent-child baking: making cookies for the visit
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing tied on an apron and, together with her daughter Xuanxuan, began baking cookies for the visit. Following the low-sugar recipe she had optimized last week, she mixed butter, powdered sugar, eggs, and cake flour into dough, and specially prepared a batch of soft cookies with walnuts for the elderly at the care center. Xuanxuan was in charge of pressing out little star and flower shapes with cookie cutters; her movements were clumsy but very earnest. When the cookies came out of the oven, the whole house filled with fragrance. After they cooled, Song Yajing carefully packed the leftover cookies from yesterday and the freshly baked ones: some went into kraft paper bags tied with twine, and the rest went into small clear gift boxes. Xuanxuan wrote "Jesus loves you" on little cards with colored markers. Chen Zhiqiang helped sort today's visit supplies in the living room.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Residential Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Remote handling of store matters and insurance information lookup
description: While her husband played with their daughter, Song Yajing sat at the computer, opened the customer feedback form from last night's dinner, and entered the information of key customers into the shop's CRM system. She then used her phone to search for introductions to several family health insurance products, getting a general sense of the scope of children's critical illness and inpatient medical coverage, to prepare for a consultation at the drugstore in the afternoon. She also used the time to quickly sketch in her mind a window display plan for the spring clothes arriving tomorrow.
location: Home study, Room 502, Building 3, Community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking out for shopping and a quick store check.
description: Song Yajing changed into going-out clothes and walked to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. She first bought sea bass and green vegetables for dinner at a fresh supermarket on the pedestrian street, then walked to the door of her boutique clothing store, used the tools she carried to tighten a slightly loose glass door handle, and glanced through the glass window at the neat interior. After confirming everything was normal, she walked home and put the ingredients in the refrigerator.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, fresh food supermarket, and clothing store at No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple lunch, nap, and organizing visit supplies
description: After returning home, Song Yajing made a simple bowl of satay noodles, added a few shrimp and some vegetables, and had lunch together with Xuanxuan. After the meal, she coaxed Xuanxuan to take a nap and also leaned back on the sofa to rest her eyes for a while. When Xuanxuan woke up, Song Yajing began final preparations: she checked the cloth bag full of cookies and confirmed that the dinosaur painting Xuanxuan had drawn was also placed inside. She herself changed into an off-white knitted dress and paired it with a camel-colored coat, looking gentle and elegant, and tidied Xuanxuan's clothes, reminding her to behave when going out.
location: Home, Room 502, Building 3, the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Walk to Gospel Church to gather and pray
description: Song Yajing carried a cloth bag full of cookies and walked to the Gospel Hall. The weather was fine and sunny, and she arrived early. At the entrance of the Gospel Hall, she met up with several fellow believers. They greeted each other, and the leading elder believer led a brief departure prayer, asking for peace and joy for the elderly and sick people they were going to visit today.

participant.name: Member of the church visitation group.

location: Gospel Hall, 139 Siming East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Visiting a fellow believer at the hospital and moving on to the elderly care center
description: The visiting group drove to Zhongshan Hospital Affiliated with Xiamen University, visited two hospitalized fellow believers, offered them greetings and prayers, and gave them some cookies. Song Yajing patiently listened to the concerns of a sister who had just undergone surgery and encouraged her to stay optimistic. After leaving the hospital, the visiting group continued driving to the Binhai Street Home and Community Elderly Care Service Center. The winter sunlight streamed through the car windows, and soothing hymns played in the car. Song Yajing felt calm and expectant.

participant.name: Member of the church visitation group.

location: Zhongshan Hospital Affiliated to Xiamen University, No. 201-209 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Binhai Street Home Community Elderly Care Service Center, No. 87 Zengcuo'an Xili, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (on the way between locations)

name: Visiting Grandma Zhang at the elderly care center and interacting in the activity area
description: As she walked down the familiar corridor of the elderly care center, Song Yajing saw Grandma Zhang practicing walking with a walker and a caregiver beside her. Surprised and delighted, she hurried over. Grandma Zhang recognized her and said excitedly, 'The children are here again!' Song Yajing held Grandma Zhang's arm and walked slowly with her, then took out the dinosaur drawing Xuanxuan had made and the beautifully packaged low-sugar walnut cookies. Grandma Zhang grinned from ear to ear. After saying goodbye to Grandma Zhang, Song Yajing went to the activity area and shared the remaining cookies with the other residents. She also played two games of chess with an elderly man who had been playing alone. Although she wasn't very good at chess, the old man was very happy, and the whole activity area was filled with laughter and cheerful voices.
