name: Went to the pharmacy and asked about health insurance
description: After the visit, Song Yajing said goodbye to the church friends and drove on to Guoda Pharmacy Xinte Store. As she walked in, the female pharmacist (store manager) who had received her yesterday greeted her warmly. Song Yajing consulted in detail about health insurance plans suitable for her 5-year-old daughter and a couple in their 30s, especially children's critical illness and supplementary hospitalization medical insurance. The pharmacist gave several options based on her family situation. Song Yajing listened carefully, took a brochure and a business card, and agreed to contact her after deciding on the plan.
location: Guoda Pharmacy (Xinte Store), No. 97 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walk home and prepare dinner
description: From the pharmacy, Song Yajing walked home. In the winter evening, the sky was gradually darkening and the streetlights came on one by one. Her heart was filled with the gratification of today's two good things: Grandma Zhang's recovery and the insurance consultation taking shape. After arriving home, her husband Aqiang was reading a picture book with Xuanxuan. Song Yajing changed into her loungewear, steamed the fresh sea bass she had bought in the morning, stir-fried a plate of garlic seasonal vegetables, and heated up multigrain rice. The fragrance of food wafted out of the kitchen.
location: Home, Room 502, Building 3, the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner, walk, and financial discussion
description: The family of three sat around the dining table enjoying dinner. Song Yajing shared the exciting moment of seeing Grandma Zhang recovering at the elderly care center that afternoon, and Xuanxuan was also happy to hear that her painting was liked. After dinner, as usual, Song Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang went out for a walk to the nearby Bailuzhou Park. The winter evening breeze carried the scent of the lake and was refreshing. During the walk, Song Yajing talked in detail about today's insurance consultation and showed Aqiang the photos of the brochure she had taken. As they walked and discussed, they initially agreed to prioritize arranging children's critical illness insurance for their daughter Xuanxuan, and then consider adding hospitalization medical insurance for the couple. Chen Zhiqiang affirmed her thoughtfulness for the family's future, and Song Yajing felt very secure.
location: Bailuzhou Park Trail, Bailuzhou Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family entertainment and parent-child time
description: After returning home from the walk, Xuanxuan dragged Mom and Dad into a game of Monopoly. The game was filled with childish chatter and laughter. Chen Zhiqiang also took the chance to check Xuanxuan's handmade homework that she needed to bring to kindergarten the next day.
location: Living room at home, Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: I put my daughter to bed and prepared for tomorrow's store work
description: At nine o'clock, Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a bath, then read her the bedtime story The Little Seed. Xuanxuan was completely absorbed, and fell asleep sweetly after a light kiss. After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom and began preparing for the next day: she went through the preparation checklist for the spring clothing arrival, confirmed the arrival time of shop assistant Xiaomei, and set up the spring display reference images she would need in the morning.
location: Children's room and master bedroom at home, Room 502, Building 3, 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Journaling, washing up before bed, and praying
description: After the busy day came to an end, Song Yajing sat at her desk and opened her diary, writing today's reflections: "Today's happiest thing: Grandma Zhang can walk now! The joy gained from serving is so real. I am also building health security for myself and my family, and life is moving in a steadier direction. Tomorrow the spring clothes will arrive, and new challenges will begin. Good night, world." After writing the diary, she went to the bathroom to wash up and put on a hydrating face mask. Then she returned to the bedroom, where Chen Zhiqiang was already lying in bed reading. She got into bed quietly, nestled beside her husband, and said a simple bedtime prayer, thanking for the day's blessings and gains. Then she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep in contentment and peace.
location: Home study, bathroom, and bedroom — Room 502, Building 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning Wake-Up and Health Assessment
description: The alarm went off right at 06:50, and Yajing woke from her sleep. The sky outside the window was overcast, but she felt full of energy. She walked into the bedroom, stepped onto the electronic scale, and the screen showed 47.8 kg — compared with the beginning of the month, her core training was beginning to show results. She took a photo of the scale with her phone, opened the health journal app and recorded: "Monday, December 15, 47.8kg, feeling good, core training is starting to pay off." She planned to steadily work toward her goal of 48.5 kg by the end of the year.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing to go out and interact with family
description: Yajing walked out of the bedroom and saw that her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already woken up their younger daughter Chen Lexuan and was helping her find a sweater. She quickly put the prepared whole-wheat sandwiches and hot milk on the dining table, then combed Xuanxuan's hair while reminding her, "It's cloudy today and it might drizzle. Take the thin cardigan Mom put in your backpack and put it on if you feel cold. What dish do you want for lunch? Mom will make it for you tonight." Xuanxuan happily said she wanted sweet-and-sour spare ribs, and Aqiang smiled and said he would be the chef tonight.
location: Living room and kitchen at home in the residential compound at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: The family of three left on time. Yajing held Xuanxuan's hand, and A Qiang walked beside them. Passing the breakfast stall on the corner, Xuanxuan was attracted by the aroma of freshly cooked pan-fried buns. Yajing smiled and bought her one. When they reached the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, Xuanxuan waved goodbye and skipped into the school.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Commuting and buying breakfast
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yajing walked to her clothing store. She went along Zhenhai Road, turned into the convenience store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, and bought a hot soy milk and a tea egg. After leaving the convenience store, she replied to a few good-morning greetings in the customer group on her phone, warming up for the day's business.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Opening the shop and preparing for business.
description: At 8:25, Yajing arrived at the entrance of "Elegant Wardrobe" and pulled up the rolling shutter door with a key. After entering, she turned on the air conditioner, then carefully wiped the cashier counter, fitting mirror, and display racks with a damp cloth, and checked the winter clothes hung up yesterday for wrinkles. Once everything was ready, she sat on the sofa, sipping soy milk and eating a tea egg while keeping an eye on her phone for the spring clothing shipment notice from Sister Susan, a supplier in Guangzhou. At the same time, she browsed the winter-sale information in the customer group and quietly planned the display layout for the spring clothes when they arrived.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Spring clothing shipping notice and pre-sale
description: At 9:05, Susan's WeChat message arrived on time, saying that all the spring clothing had been packed and dispatched, expected to arrive tomorrow afternoon, with the tracking number and photos of several new styles attached. Yajing instantly brightened. She quickly saved the photos and edited a teaser poster on her phone saying "Spring fashion is about to land!" with the caption: "Dear friends, the 2026 spring collection you've been looking forward to will arrive at the store tomorrow! Limited pre-sale: 5 spots available. If you want one, DM me the code 'spring'!" She posted the poster and message to four customer WeChat groups, and within 10 minutes all 5 pre-sale spots were snapped up. Then she confirmed sizes and style preferences with the customers who secured spots and recorded them in her memo.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Organize pre-orders and handle in-store tasks
description: After finishing the pre-sale processing, Xiaomei, the part-time store clerk, arrived. Yajing exported the customers' pre-order details from her phone and printed them out, then categorized them with different colored label tags according to types such as regular customers first, high order value, and designated new styles, and posted them on the dedicated work whiteboard. Then she and Xiaomei refolded and neatly arranged several sale items in the winter clothing display area, reserving prime display positions for the spring clothing arriving tomorrow. She also used a tape measure to check the dimensions of the center island, thinking about the best display angles and hanger spacing for the spring clothing.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Lunch break recharge and work discussion
description: Around noon, a light rain started to fall in the street and the temperature dropped. Yajing gave up her plan to eat out, opened a food delivery app on her phone, and ordered a light salad and a hot Americano for herself, while Xiaomei ordered a bowl of beef noodles. The two sat on the sofa in the shop, eating and chatting. Yajing took out her tablet and showed the spring display sketches she had in mind, suggesting combining several tops with skirts into an 'Early Spring Commute' theme. Xiaomei suggested drawing winter jasmine and butterflies on the blackboard wall by the entrance to attract young customers. They had a lively discussion and basically finalized the promotion plan for the weekend's spring collection launch, including the photography style and key copy points.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Afternoon business operations and customer service
description: In the afternoon, the rain gradually stopped, and sunlight occasionally broke through the clouds. Three or four groups of customers came into the store one after another. When regular customer Sister Lin came in, Yajing warmly greeted her and, based on her figure and everyday style, recommended several turtleneck sweaters suitable for winter layering. Sister Lin tried them on, was very satisfied, bought two on the spot, and praised Yajing's good taste. During a lull in customer flow, Yajing used WeChat to follow up with several customers who had pre-ordered in the morning, confirming their contact information and pickup times, and told them they could pick up their items at the store tomorrow afternoon.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Closing the shop early and preparing to leave
description: After the afternoon customer rush passed, Yajing checked the time and prepared to pick up her daughter from school. She reminded Xiaomei, ‘I'm leaving now. You'll watch the store on your own. If there aren't many customers this afternoon, clean up a bit earlier and leave early too—there's no need to stay until six.’ She picked up her cardigan, checked her phone and keys, confirmed the cash register drawer was locked, and left the store.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Yajing walked quickly to the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, arriving just in time for dismissal. When Xuanxuan saw her mother, she happily ran over and hugged her. Yajing squatted down to tidy her wind-blown hair, kissed her little cheek, and asked, 'Were you happy today? What fun games did you play?' Holding hands, the mother and daughter slowly walked back.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family walk by Yundang Lake and insurance discussion
description: On the way, Yajing sent a message to her husband Chen Zhiqiang, agreeing to meet on the walkway by Yundang Lake. About a dozen minutes later, the family of three met by a lakeside bench at the entrance to Egret Islet Park. Aqiang was holding an insulated cup and small bread rolls. As it began to get dark and the lake breeze turned cool, the three strolled leisurely along the path. Yajing naturally brought up the family health insurance materials she had brought home yesterday. She opened a screenshot of the materials on her phone, pointed to the critical illness insurance section, and said, "Look, the children's critical illness insurance coverage seems quite comprehensive, and the premium is acceptable. Can we meet that account manager Lin Xiaofeng in person this week?" Aqiang looked carefully, nodded in agreement, and the two briefly compared the hospitalization reimbursement rates. Meanwhile, Xuanxuan chased the egrets and pigeons by the lake, laughing happily.
location: Yundang Lake Trail near Bailuzhou Park, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home with a stop for shopping along the way
description: It had gotten completely dark, and the family of three ended their walk and headed back. When they passed the fresh food supermarket at the entrance of the residential complex, Aqiang went in to buy pork ribs, rock sugar, black vinegar, and a few side dishes, ready to fulfill his "sweet and sour pork ribs" promise from noon. Yajing played with Xuanxuan by the slide downstairs in the complex for five minutes while waiting for Aqiang to finish shopping.
location: Fresh food supermarket near the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the community's downstairs area.

name: Family dinner and parent-child interaction
description: After getting home, A Qiang put on an apron and began to show off his cooking skills. From the kitchen came the sizzle of stir-frying and the aroma of sweet and sour sauce, along with A Qiang humming now and then. Yajing helped Xuanxuan wash her hands, took out her daughter's drawing book, and sat at the dining table to help her finish today's homework—drawing an autumn tree. Around 7 p.m., steaming sweet and sour spare ribs, garlic lettuce, and seaweed egg drop soup were served. The whole family sat around the table, eating and chatting while Xuanxuan excitedly shared funny stories from kindergarten.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening leisure and family matters
description: After dinner, Yajing washed the dishes and tidied the kitchen, while Aqiang took out the trash and tidied up. Then the family of three snuggled up on the living room sofa and watched cartoons for a while. At 8 p.m., Yajing took Xuanxuan to take a bath, while Aqiang went to the balcony to bring in the clothes and fold them. After the bath, Yajing told Xuanxuan a bedtime story about a little fox and a chipmunk, watching her slowly fall asleep.
location: Living room, bathroom, and bedroom at home — No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Discussing family health insurance.
description: After putting their daughter to sleep, Yajing and her husband Chen Zhiqiang sat down at the desk. Yajing took out several insurance brochures brought back from Guoda Pharmacy and the comparison notes she had made on her phone. The two quietly studied for more than half an hour, focusing on comparing the coverage, claim conditions, and premiums of children's critical illness insurance. Yajing thought one product offered the best value for money and suggested inviting the account manager Lin Xiaofeng over for a consultation tomorrow. Aqiang agreed and reminded her not to forget the adults' supplementary medical insurance. Yajing noted in her phone memo: 'Meet account manager Lin Xiaofeng within this week to confirm the family insurance plan.'
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal adjustment and gratitude journal.
description: After settling the insurance matters, Yajing felt a weight lifted from her mind. She returned to the bedroom, spread a yoga mat on the floor, and did a ten-minute pre-bedtime stretch to relax all her muscles. Then she sat at the desk, opened her gratitude journal with a kraft-paper cover, and seriously wrote: "December 15, Monday. My weight is back up to 47.8, and my body feels stronger every day. The spring clothes will arrive tomorrow, and the presale sold out—thank you for the trust of my regular customers. In the evening, I planned our family's future with my husband by Yundang Lake, and I felt truly secure. What matters most is still being able to hold my family's hands every day. Goodnight, this December that makes me feel so grounded."
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: After finishing her diary, Yajing washed up, changed into her pajamas, and lay down on the bed. A Qiang also turned off the light in the study and walked into the bedroom. Outside the window was the faint glow of traffic on a Xiamen winter night; inside, it was warm and quiet. The two spoke softly for a few minutes about the next day's work plans. Yajing turned over and fell asleep peacefully at 23:00.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast preparation, and waking up daughter
description: The phone alarm went off, Song Yajing got up and felt that the soreness in her lower back from yesterday's training had basically disappeared. She weighed herself at 47.8kg and felt more confident about today's workout. Then she went to the kitchen, took eggs, milk, and whole wheat bread from the fridge, and prepared a high-protein breakfast. Meanwhile, she walked to her daughter Chen Lexuan's room, opened the curtains, gently woke her up, helped her find her kindergarten uniform, and reminded her that it was cold and windy and she should wear her little rabbit scarf.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table, eating fried eggs, milk, and multigrain toast. While peeling an egg for Chen Lexuan, Song Yajing confirmed the insurance plan with her husband Chen Zhiqiang and asked him to carefully review the premium during his evening walk. After the meal, she helped her daughter tie her scarf and, together with her husband, walked their daughter the 10 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, watching her enter the school.
location: Home dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

Under the guidance of her personal trainer, she did her third core training session, trying to extend her plank from 30 seconds to 45 seconds. She completed bridges, bird-dogs, and modified planks, and felt her lower back was more stable. After training, she quickly took a hot shower, changed into clean clothes, and put on light makeup. Then she walked about 15 minutes to the "Elegant Wardrobe" shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Opening preparations, sorting spring clothing arrivals, and communicating with the community.

Her shop assistant Xiaomei came to work, and the two reviewed yesterday's sales, took the new spring items out of the warehouse, and cleaned the display stands. Song Yajing opened the WeChat community, replied to a regular customer's inquiry about the sizes of the co-branded hoodie, and confirmed the shipping progress of the third batch of co-branded items with supplier Susan in Guangzhou via WeChat. Knowing that they would be on the shelves before the weekend, she felt at ease.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

Meanwhile, she flipped through the insurance brochure from Guoda Pharmacy, combined it with the key points discussed with her husband, and listed a few of her biggest concerns in her notebook to prepare for the afternoon insurance consultation.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Afternoon store operations and insurance appointment
description: In the afternoon, customers came to the shop one after another. Song Yajing received them warmly, styled a young girl in a commuting winter outfit, and made a successful sale. In her spare time, she followed up with an old customer who had pre-ordered the co-branded item, confirming whether they would pick it up or have it delivered after it arrived on the weekend. At about 14:00, she contacted bank account manager Lin Xiaofeng via WeChat to book a family insurance consultation for 3 p.m., and sent a screenshot of the appointment to her husband Chen Zhiqiang.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Online insurance consultation
description: At 3 p.m., Song Yajing asked shop assistant Xiao Mei to watch the store and went into the small back warehouse, where she had an insurance consultation with Manager Lin via WeChat video. Taking into account Song Yajing's chronic lumbar spine condition, her mother's recovery from a cerebral infarction, and the fact that her daughter was still young, Manager Lin explained in detail a combined plan of critical illness insurance plus accidental injury insurance. Song Yajing listened and took notes on premiums, coverage, and key claims points, and specifically asked about the coverage for lumbar-related conditions.
location: Small storage room inside the shop at 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street)

name: Post-consultation organization and daily shop work
description: After the consultation, Song Yajing came out of the small storage room and forwarded the electronic plan sent by Manager Lin to her husband via WeChat, adding a note that they would discuss it in detail during their evening walk. Afterwards, she and the shop assistant Xiao Mei ironed, removed tags from, matched, and displayed the newly arrived spring clothing, while keeping the store running.
location: No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street).

name: Close the shop and pick up daughter from school.
description: At closing time, Song Yajing gave Xiaomei instructions for tomorrow and left the store, walking about 3 minutes to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Her daughter Chen Lexuan ran out excitedly. Song Yajing took her hand and said they would go together to find Dad and take a walk at Yundang Lake.
location: From 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Yundang Lake stroll and insurance discussion
description: Song Yajing walked with her daughter for about 23 minutes to Yundang Lake to meet her husband Chen Zhiqiang. The family of three strolled along the lakeside path. The night breeze by the lake was slightly cool. Chen Zhiqiang took Song Yajing's bag, and Song Yajing checked her daughter's scarf. On the way, their daughter spotted blooming bougainvillea, and the couple discussed the afternoon's insurance plan while walking, using a phone calculator to estimate household expenses and concluding that the plan was reasonable and feasible.
location: Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home to buy groceries and prepare dinner
description: After the walk, the family walked about 22 minutes to the 99 Convenience Supermarket (Xinhua Store) to buy pork ribs and vegetables, then walked about 6 minutes home. After arriving home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang took the initiative to cook sweet and sour pork ribs, while Song Yajing washed vegetables and prepared garlic lettuce, and their daughter played with building blocks in the living room.
location: No. 99 Xinhua Road Convenience Store (Xinhua Branch), Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, and the home kitchen in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and parent-child time.
description: During dinner, Song Yajing put ribs on her daughter's plate and chatted with her husband about how the training felt and that her core strength was recovering. The couple confirmed the insurance plan and decided to sign in person with Manager Lin during the New Year's Day holiday. After dinner, her husband cleaned up and did the dishes while Song Yajing bathed their daughter, playing with bubbles using body wash, and then read the picture book "Little Dinosaur's Wish" until the girl fell asleep.
location: Home dining room and daughter's room in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening family discussion and personal relaxation
description: After settling her daughter down, Song Yajing sat on the living room sofa with her husband, took out the printed insurance proposal, and went through the details item by item. They finally decided to contact Manager Lin to sign the contract on New Year's Day. Afterward, Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom and wrote in her gratitude journal at the small desk, recording the fulfilling feeling from the training, the arrival of the spring clothing line, and finalizing the insurance, as well as the bougainvillea her daughter had discovered. After finishing the journal, she did a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch on her yoga mat.
location: At home in the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province: living room and master bedroom.

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied night cream. Her husband had already lain down. She changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on. Then she said goodnight to her husband, reflected on the fulfilling day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom bathroom and bed at home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, breakfast, and morning interaction
description: Waking up early in the morning, she washed up and prepared breakfast for the family: hot milk, toasted whole-wheat toast, a soft-boiled egg for her daughter, and bear-shaped rice balls with pork floss made using a mold. She woke her daughter and helped her wash up, braid her hair, and change into her kindergarten uniform. While the family of three was having breakfast, her husband Chen Zhiqiang confirmed the insurance details again and agreed to go to the bank to sign the contract on the weekend. Her daughter excitedly shared that she had been praised by her teacher for yesterday's painting and asked for new watercolor brushes. Song Yajing promised to buy them after school.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Took her daughter to kindergarten and bought stationery.
description: After her husband left for work first, Song Yajing took her daughter's hand and headed out, walking along Gongyuan South Road toward the kindergarten. When they passed the stationery store at No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, she kept her promise and let her daughter choose a set of 24-color watercolor markers. Her daughter happily said she would draw the most beautiful picture at kindergarten and give it to her mother. Then she took her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten on Gucheng West Road.
location: Stationery store at No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road.

name: Commuting and morning store work
description: After dropping off her daughter, Song Yajing first went to the FamilyMart at Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy hot soy milk to warm up, then walked to Elegant Wardrobe on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, she opened the roller door, turned on the air conditioner, wiped the counter and shelves, checked previous day's customer orders, and noted down the day's tasks. When the shop assistant Xiaomei arrived, they worked together to adjust the window display, replacing the heavy wool coats with co-branded lightweight jackets paired with bright silk scarves, and putting the thick coats with low try-on rates into storage with a note to adjust prices after the New Year. While Xiaomei was ironing clothes, she chatted with Song Yajing about TV dramas; the shop had a relaxed atmosphere.
location: FamilyMart at No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and Elegant Wardrobe at No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road

name: Lunch, video call, and online matters.
description: At noon, Song Yajing had a takeaway shacha noodle dish in the back area of the shop, while making a WeChat video call to her mother, Lin Xiuying. She asked about her mother's knee recovery and urged her to attend the church Christmas event. Seeing that her mother was in good condition, she felt relieved. After hanging up, she replied to several customers' inquiries about winter and spring clothing pre-orders, and selected seasonal display photos and close-up photos of new spring styles to share in the customer community, with the caption: "There's a surprise on the 20th — get a sneak peek at the spring new arrivals~" to build anticipation for the upcoming event.
location: Logistics area of Elegant Wardrobe, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up my sister's package and afternoon store operations
description: The courier delivered a package from Shenzhen — homemade cured sausages and a Gongfu tea set sent by her older sister, with a note saying, “Winter Solstice is coming; one portion for Mom and Dad, and one for your family.” Song Yajing immediately portioned out the sausages, labeling one portion “Quanzhou Mom and Dad” and keeping one for her own family, and cut a small piece to cook for dinner. In the afternoon, more customers came to the store. She gave a young girl advice on putting together commute outfits and gave a small box of sausages to the owner of the next-door accessories shop to taste, while chatting about recent business. Xiaomei also tasted the sausages and praised how delicious they were.

participant.name: The owner of the accessory shop next door.

location: Yazhi Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, No. 56 Zhongshan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Picked up my daughter from school and enjoyed parent-child baking time.
description: Song Yajing closed the shop early and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. As soon as they met, her daughter excitedly showed off her watercolor painting of 'a family of three.' Song Yajing kept her midday promise and took her to the nearby 85°C bakery to buy a croissant as a reward. The mother and daughter sat by a window table in the shop; her daughter ate the bread, Song Yajing drank warm water, and listened to her daughter talk about the new nursery rhymes she had learned, enjoying a warm afternoon.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the 85°C Bakery at Zhonghua City, No. 189 Siming South Road, Zhongshan Road

name: Return home and prepare dinner
description: Mother and daughter walked hand in hand back to their home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street. Song Yajing arranged for her daughter to draw in the living room, then put on an apron and went into the kitchen. She took out the pork ribs bought yesterday, blanched them, and prepared braised pork ribs. Meanwhile, she sliced the cured sausage her sister had sent and stir-fried it with snow peas, and set the rice cooker to cook rice on a timer, busying herself with dinner for the family.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, steaming dishes were already laid out on the table. Song Yajing's braised pork ribs were glossy red, and the Chinese sausage stir-fried snow peas were savory and delicious. The family ate and chatted. Her daughter proudly showed off her new watercolor markers and the painting that had been praised by her teacher that day, repeating the teacher's praise. Song Yajing mentioned that her sister had sent sausages and a tea set, and the couple discussed bringing some along when they visited her parents in Quanzhou on the weekend.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-meal cleanup and family walk around Yundang Lake
description: After dinner, her husband took the initiative to clear the dishes and clean the kitchen, while Song Yajing picked up her daughter's toys and helped her daughter and herself change into thick jackets and sneakers. Around 7 p.m., the family of three went out and walked along the familiar Yundang Lake promenade. The night was slightly cool, the lake breeze fresh, and their daughter excitedly hopped along the stone-paved path, holding her parents' hands. Song Yajing felt her lower back was lighter than usual and tried to quicken her pace; her husband smiled and told her not to overdo it. The streetlights stretched the family's shadows long, the lake reflected the lights of countless homes, and the atmosphere was warm and peaceful.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the Yundang Lake trail along Bailuzhou Road (near the Bailuzhou Park section)

name: Daughter's bath and bedtime story
description: After returning from the walk, Song Yajing drew a bath for her daughter, helped her enjoy a comfortable hot bath, and changed her into bear pajamas. Then the mother and daughter snuggled on the small bed in the bedroom, reading the picture books The Very Hungry Caterpillar and Guess How Much I Love You together. After the stories, her daughter fell sweetly asleep in Song Yajing's arms.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening stretches and gratitude journal.
description: After putting her daughter to sleep, Song Yajing returned to the living room and first sent a thank-you message to her older sister, telling her that the cured sausage had been received and that she would bring a portion to their parents. Then she did 10 minutes of gentle stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on her waist. After washing up, she sat at the desk in the bedroom, opened her notebook, and wrote a gratitude journal, recording three things she was grateful for that day: her mother recovering well, the store's new display being satisfying, and the whole family taking a lakeside walk together again.
location: Living room and bedroom of the family home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Couple's late-night talk: planning the weekend and their careers
description: After her husband Chen Zhiqiang finished the housework, the two leaned against the headboard and chatted. They reconfirmed the details of going to the bank to sign the insurance contract with Manager Lin on the weekend, and discussed gifts to prepare for visiting his parents in Quanzhou. Song Yajing also shared her ideas for the spring clothing launch on the 20th, and her husband gave suggestions for online promotion. The couple felt confident about their future life and careers.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After the chat, Song Yajing set an alarm for 7 a.m. the next day and turned off the bedside lamp. In the darkness, she reflected on the plain yet fulfilling day, felt especially at peace, and soon fell into a sound sleep, storing up energy for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up, preparing breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Song Yajing was woken up by the alarm at 7 a.m. It was drizzling outside the window. She moved her waist and felt it was more flexible than yesterday. After getting up, she first drank some warm water, then went to the kitchen to cook red bean congee with the red beans that had been soaked the night before, and fried two eggs. Because it was raining, she put on slip-resistant sports shoes and took out a large folding umbrella. At 7:15, she woke her daughter Xuanxuan. At about 7:30, the family of three had breakfast. Her husband Aqiang handed her warm water, and she reminded him to confirm the year-end physical examination appointment. After breakfast, she helped Xuanxuan put on a raincoat and rain boots, then took her umbrella and gym bag, and the three went out together.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Took daughter to school and returned home.
description: Song Yajing held a large umbrella and walked with her daughter Xuanxuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The camphor trees along the way were washed shiny by the rain. At the kindergarten gate, she squatted down to zip up Xuanxuan's raincoat, watched her daughter walk into the teaching building, and waved goodbye. Afterwards, she walked home alone under her umbrella, left the wet umbrella outside to drain, changed into dry house shoes, drank some water, checked her gym bag, and sent a WeChat message to shop assistant Xiaomei saying she would go to the shop after training.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and then back home.

name: Rehabilitation training at the gym and return
description: Song Yajing walked to the Jiahe Fitness Center near her home. After changing clothes, she did her fourth core rehabilitation training under the coach's guidance, focusing on the balance and stability of the bird-dog pose. In the first two attempts, her pelvis kept tilting; after the coach corrected her, she successfully held it steady for 10 seconds on the third try, and the coach praised her obvious improvement. She was in a great mood and used her phone to record the coach's standard demonstration video. After the training session, she walked home, took a hot shower, changed into clean clothes, and organized her heat packs and documents.
location: Jiahe Fitness Center on Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the residential community at 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Go to the store and handle customer complaints about the co-branded collection and contact the supplier
description: Song Yajing walked with an umbrella to her own store at No. 36 shop on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After arriving, shop assistant Xiaomei reported that yesterday a customer complained that the co-branded sweatshirt shrank slightly after washing, and the customer was upset. Yajing proactively called the customer, sincerely apologized, promised a free replacement of the new style and a 50-yuan coupon, and the customer's mood eased. Then she organized photos of the problem sample and feedback records, sent them to supplier Susan via WeChat, and the two had a voice call for nearly twenty minutes to discuss fabric standards and pre-shrinking technology. Susan agreed to improve. After the call, Yajing took screenshots of the chat history and filed them in the "Supplier Tracking" folder.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidying up the store and preparing for new arrivals.
description: After handling the customer complaint, Song Yajing used the time before noon to organize the newly arrived knitwear with Xiaomei. She checked the stitching and fabric of each piece, used a garment steamer to iron them smooth, and adjusted the display to a prominent position. While working, they chatted about the amusing incident of watching snails during last night's walk.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and interaction in the baking group's fail contest
description: Xiaomei ordered takeout: two bowls of satay noodles with duck leg and braised egg. The two sat in the rest area at the shop entrance to eat lunch. Song Yajing scrolled through the baking group on her phone. The group was holding a baking-fail contest, and seeing hilarious entries such as burnt cakes and collapsed chiffon cakes, she laughed so hard she nearly choked. After finishing and cleaning up, she leaned back in the chair at the cash register and browsed the records, remembering that it was she who had started this trend by having once baked a bad batch of puff pastry and poked fun at herself. Feeling warm inside, she replied to the posts one by one to encourage the group members.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Learn the bird-dog exercise and record it in the rehabilitation journal
description: While there were no customers in the store, Song Yajing took out her rehabilitation journal and pen from her bag, opened the trainer's demonstration video on her phone, and drew step-by-step diagrams of the bird-dog pose on paper as she watched. She used a red pen to draw a wavy line under 'pelvis level' and wrote the note 'imagine a cup of water on your back.' Then she wrote down her training experience: '10 seconds! I've got it! The instant I engage my core, I can control my body — it gives me even more of a sense of accomplishment than selling a piece of clothing.' She closed the journal and let out a satisfied sigh.
location: Cashier counter, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tending the store, processing online orders, and receiving customers
description: There weren't many customers in the store that afternoon. Song Yajing kept an eye on the shop while packing online orders. At one point, two young women came in. She put down her work and enthusiastically recommended the new knit cardigans and wide-leg pants, helping one of them put together an outfit. The young woman was pleased and made the purchase. During a lull, she confirmed the weekend shift schedule with Xiaomei and organized the copy for next week's community new-product preview.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy fruit and pick up my daughter from school.
description: The rain had stopped, but the ground was still wet. After greeting Xiaomei, Song Yajing walked to Pagoda Fruits (Houbin Road store), carefully selected five navel oranges and a box of strawberries, planning to make hot orange juice and strawberries for Xuanxuan. Then she carried the fruit and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan and the other children were looking around at the entrance by the security booth; when she saw her, she ran over and threw herself into her arms, saying, "Today I drew a snail!" She kissed Xuanxuan on the forehead and walked home holding her hand.
location: No. 10-3 Houbin Road, Baiguoyuan (Houbin Road store), and Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, returning to the residential complex at No. 82 Shanggu Street.

name: Go home to prepare dinner and have dinner with the family.
description: After arriving home, her husband A Qiang had already gotten off work early. The aroma of pork rib soup wafted from the kitchen, and he was reheating yesterday's leftover braised pork. Yajing praised him for doing a great job, tied on an apron, quickly washed the wok and chopped garlic, and stir-fried a plate of water spinach. Xuanxuan was in the living room drawing a wobbly snail with crayons. Once the dishes were on the table, the family of three sat down to dinner together. During the meal, Yajing shared funny stories from the baking group's kitchen-fail contest, and A Qiang said his coworkers' group had similar 'kitchen catastrophe' photos. Xuanxuan didn't understand but giggled anyway, and even picked up a piece of braised pork to feed her mother. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: After the meal, the rain had stopped and the sky was clear, and the air felt fresh. A Qiang suggested taking a walk around Yundang Lake, and Yajing agreed. The family of three changed into comfortable shoes, walked to the lakeside, and strolled slowly along the lake. As she walked, Yajing rotated her lower back and felt it responding more flexibly than yesterday. A Qiang talked about being busy wrapping up the company's year-end projects, and Yajing shared amusing stories from her community group and the smooth resolution of the co-branded product issue. Suddenly Xuanxuan squatted down and noticed a little snail crawling on the path. The family of three quietly watched this tiny creature, and Yajing felt that all her worries were insignificant.
location: Yundang Lake, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return home to accompany daughter, wash up, and tell bedtime stories
description: After the walk, the family returned home. Aqiang went to the study to handle work emails, while Yajing stayed with Xuanxuan in the living room drawing the snail they had just seen with colored pens. Xuanxuan drew a big shell, Yajing helped her draw the antennae, and the mother and daughter burst into laughter. Then Yajing bathed Xuanxuan, changed her into pajamas, and sat by the bed reading a picture book story about good habits. Xuanxuan gradually fell asleep. Yajing turned off the lamp and kissed her on the forehead.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal care and recovery log
description: Yajing returned to the master bedroom and first did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on loosening her lower back. Then she took a hot shower and applied body lotion. While her hair was still wet, she opened her rehabilitation journal and recorded today’s training insights, community anecdotes, and feelings from the walk. Then she silently did two bird-dog exercises in front of the mirror to feel the support in her back.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Organized tomorrow's work, personal time, and pre-bedtime interactions.
description: Yajing used her phone's memo to list tomorrow's tasks: track the logistics for the new batch of co-branded fabrics sent by Susan, and organize the screenshots from the fail contest to send to the customer group to liven up the atmosphere. Afterward, she applied a hydrating mask, leaned against the headboard, listened to a few English songs, and enjoyed some alone time. A Qiang finished work and returned to the bedroom. Yajing asked about the medical check-up appointment and confirmed it was booked for next Wednesday. She poured him warm water and placed it by the bedside. The two briefly chatted about Xuanxuan's drawing.
location: Master bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: Yajing took off her face mask, washed her face, and did her skincare routine. She picked up the essay collection on the bedside table and read for over ten minutes until drowsiness came over her. She turned off the light, muted her phone, and closed her eyes, recalling the 10-second bird-dog pose from the day, Susan's promise, and Xuanxuan's gaze as she watched the snail. Feeling grounded and calm, she soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Get up and prepare breakfast
description: She woke up naturally in the early morning and prepared breakfast in the kitchen: heated milk, toasted golden bread, fried the sunny-side-up egg her daughter loved and the bacon her husband enjoyed. Her husband Chen Zhiqiang also came out to help set the table, and her daughter Xuanxuan walked out of the bedroom rubbing her eyes and called out in a childish voice, “Mom, you smell so good today.” The whole morning was filled with warmth and happiness.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Helped my daughter Chen Lexuan put on her coat and little backpack, held her hand, and walked to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. On the way, she chattered about the new nursery rhyme she had learned yesterday, and I patiently responded. At the kindergarten gate, I watched her run into the classroom smiling and wave goodbye to the teacher.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home and freshen up
description: After dropping off her daughter, she returned home feeling cheerful, brewed a pot of pour-over coffee, and, while waiting, answered several customers' WeChat inquiries. Then she calmly washed up, did her skincare routine, and planned today's outfit.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Store operations, online work, and rehabilitation community interaction.
description: She rode a shared bike to her boutique clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. The shop assistant Xiaomei was already waiting. Together they unboxed the newly arrived cashmere cardigans, ironed and hung the samples. She gave detailed instructions about notifying regular customers of reserved items and handed over full responsibility for the afternoon checkout and reception to Xiaomei. They also discussed the window display, and she specifically asked for the new dark green midi skirt to be displayed with a white top underneath. Afterwards, she handled online orders, checked the styles and addresses, and shipped them. She replied to customers asking about how to style the new items and sent close-up photos. Meanwhile, she received positive feedback from a customer who had previously complained that a co-branded item shrank, and the customer also booked an appointment to try spring clothes next weekend. In her spare time, she opened the rehabilitation community on her phone, watched a core activation video the coach had shared, discussed advanced movements with the coach, and took screenshots to save for later records.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Solo brunch
description: Feeling a bit hungry, I decided to go to the nearby time-honored Jukou Noodle Shop for brunch. After giving Xiao Mei instructions, I locked the cash register drawer and walked to the shop. I ordered a bowl of their signature mixed noodles with freshly sliced squid soup, and slowly savored it in the bustling little shop, enjoying some relaxing time alone.
location: Jukou Mixed Noodles, Jukou Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to Shapowei and stroll around Art West Zone.
description: Starting from Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, she took Bus No. 1 to Shapowei. Sitting by the window and soaking up the sun while watching the street scenes, she looked forward to meeting her best friend Li Meiling. When she reached the entrance of the Shapowei Art West Zone, she soon saw Li Meiling walking over in a mustard-yellow coat, and the two high-fived and cheered. They then walked along the alleys of the West Zone browsing independent designer shops. She tried on an asymmetrically cut navy blue coat, and Meiling helped her decide. Although she liked it a lot, she didn't buy it because the price was quite high. Meiling bought a hand-dyed scarf instead as a sample for her handicraft club.
location: Shapowei Art West Zone, Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon tea and heart-to-heart talk at a sea-view café
description: After getting tired from shopping, she and Meiling walked into the Sea-View Cafe near Shapowei Harbor, took a window seat on the second floor, and ordered hot fruit tea and the signature chestnut cake. The two chatted about everything from work trifles to family stories. Meiling shared a comical mishap from her class's rehearsal for the New Year's Day program, and they laughed so hard they doubled over. She herself told an embarrassing story from the "fail contest" in her baking group. She also admitted that her back recovery had made her better understand the importance of a slower pace. Laughter never stopped as they enjoyed pure best-friend time.
location: Sea View Café near Shapowei Typhoon Shelter on Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Seaside stroll and receiving gifts.
description: After drinking tea, she suggested going for a walk by the sea. They strolled along the wooden boardwalk at Shapowei Harbor. The sunlight was just right, and the sea breeze brushed their faces. Then Meiling suddenly took out a kraft paper bag and gave her an early Christmas gift — a soft creamy-white hand-knitted scarf. She put it on with surprise, hugged Meiling in gratitude, and listened as Meiling said she had knitted it off and on for a month. The two joked with each other on the boardwalk and agreed to meet again in Quanzhou during the Spring Festival.
location: Wooden boardwalk at Shapowei Harbor, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return trip, food market shopping, and heading home.
description: After parting reluctantly with Meiling, she took Bus No. 86 on the way back, got off at Meirengong Stop, and went to Meirengong Farmers Market. Familiar with the place, she bought fresh sea bass, spinach, tomatoes, eggs, and ginger; the vegetable vendor also kindly threw in a bunch of scallions. Then she walked home cheerfully carrying the groceries, and on the way she checked the mailbox at the entrance of the residential community.
location: Meirengong Farmers' Market, 49 Xi'an Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the way home

name: Prepare dinner and pick up daughter
description: After getting home, I changed out of my going-out clothes, tied on an apron, and started preparing dinner: I cleaned the sea bass, scored and marinated it, and trimmed and washed the vegetables. Around 17:30, my husband Chen Zhiqiang sent a WeChat message saying he had picked up our daughter Xuanxuan on his electric bike and was on his way home. I put the soup on to simmer and began stir-frying. Soon, the door lock clicked, and I heard my daughter's voice calling, 'Mommy, I'm back!' I poked my head out, smiled, and called her to wash her hands for dinner.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: Dinner was three dishes and a soup: steamed sea bass, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic spinach, and pork rib soup. During the meal, she excitedly showed the family the scarf Lingling had given her. Her husband deliberately teased that the scarf “weighs almost half a closet,” then smiled and praised it for being pretty and warm, saying her happiness was what mattered most. She also shared amusing stories from the afternoon shopping trip, and her daughter listened with great interest.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Leisure after dinner and a walk with the whole family.
description: After dinner, her husband volunteered to do the dishes, and she sat on the sofa to rest. Aqiang told her he had used his year-end bonus to buy a down jacket. She pretended to be angry, and he soothed her by saying, 'What's mine is yours.' The little quarrel was sweetly resolved. Then the family of three went for a walk on the Yundang Lake boardwalk. She deliberately wore her new scarf, and her daughter innocently asked why the scarf was so long, wondering if it could be used as a blanket. The whole family laughed. Aqiang held her hand with one hand and their daughter's hand with the other, walking slowly by the lake, feeling the tranquility of the night and the warmth of family.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Soothing daughter to wash up and bedtime story
description: After returning from the walk, she accompanied her daughter Xuanxuan through the bedtime routine, brushing her teeth and washing her face, and changing into pajamas. Her daughter picked out the picture book "Little Rabbit Tom" for her to read. Leaning against the headboard, she read the story softly while her daughter snuggled close and soon fell asleep peacefully. She gently kissed her forehead and turned off the bedside lamp.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Self-assessment and record of rehabilitation training
description: I went to the study, turned on the computer, and compared the photos of my core training two weeks ago with today's post-workout selfie. I could clearly feel that when standing, my shoulders were more open and my pelvis more stable. In my rehabilitation journal I wrote: "Bird-dog hold achieved for 10 seconds, pelvic stability improved by 70%, lower back weakness reduced. Coach feedback says I can try advanced moves; next session I plan to add 2kg of weight." Then I asked the coach in the rehabilitation group whether I could try the weighted bird-dog next week, and felt a solid sense of achievement.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Personal nighttime care and relaxation
description: Did a simple facial cleanse and body care. Because she walked a lot today, she deliberately soaked her feet in hot water and applied massage cream to relax her calf muscles. Afterward she lay on the sofa browsing her phone, replied to unread messages, and sent her mother a message to let her know she was safe.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Casual chat with my husband and getting ready to sleep
description: After her husband finished washing up, the two leaned against the headboard and talked about Saturday plans: she planned to go to the store in the morning and take their daughter to a painting class in the afternoon; her husband wanted to take their daughter to the park in the morning. As they chatted, drowsiness crept in. Looking at the scarf on the nightstand, she felt warm inside and said to her husband, 'Today was so comfortable.' He smiled and turned off the light.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Sound sleep
description: In the quiet night, lying beside her husband, she reflected on the day: the store affairs had been properly handled, the date with her best friend was full of laughter and emotion, she had received a warm hand-knitted scarf, a small quarrel with her husband had turned into sweetness, and she had taken another step forward on the road to recovery. Deeply nourished by family love and friendship, she slowly drifted into sleep with contentment and peace of mind.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up in the morning and spending time alone.
description: At 7:30 on Saturday morning, Song Yajing woke up naturally and stretched lazily, enjoying the leisure of the weekend. She picked up her phone and saw a message in the family group: photos of a walk in Quanzhou Park shared by her mother. She smiled, liked them, and replied.
location: Main bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Preparing and enjoying a family breakfast
description: Song Yajing, wearing loungewear, walked into the kitchen and used a star-shaped mold to make star-shaped fried toast with a sunny-side-up egg, paired with hot milk and blueberries. After making it, she woke up her daughter and husband, and the family of three sat around the dining table for breakfast. The daughter was thrilled with the star toast, the couple praised it, and they chatted about the day's Christmas decoration plans while eating.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family prepares and sets up Christmas decorations.
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing and her husband moved the Christmas tree components and decoration boxes out of the storage room, and their daughter excitedly passed small boxes. Chen Zhiqiang checked the string lights and replaced the burnt-out bulbs. Then the family played Christmas music in the living room. Chen Zhiqiang assembled the trunk and wrapped the string lights around it, Song Yajing held the tree steady to adjust, and their daughter hung small snowflakes and colorful ornaments. When they plugged it in, the lights twinkled, the living room was filled with festive atmosphere, and their daughter cheered.
location: Living room and storage room in the residential compound at 82 Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Framing her daughter's painting and taking photos to document it.
description: After the basic decorating was done, Song Yajing took out a picture frame, placed her daughter's painting 'Cactus on the Windowsill', which won a commemorative award in the drawing competition on December 6, flat into the frame, hung it on the wall next to the Christmas tree, and told her daughter it was the most meaningful Christmas decoration. Then she adjusted the ornaments, used her phone to take photos of the living room panorama, the decoration details, the warm moment of her husband and daughter in front of the Christmas tree, and a close-up of the painting.
location: Living room at home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family lunch and rest
description: Lunch was the tomato and egg noodles cooked by her husband Chen Zhiqiang, and her daughter ate a big bowl. After lunch, Song Yajing asked her husband to watch cartoons with their daughter while she quickly cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the kitchen.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Daughter's afternoon nap and organizing diet records
description: Her daughter was taking a nap in her own small bed. Song Yajing opened her tablet on the glass coffee table in the dining room, opened the family health diet ledger Excel, reviewed the diet records since December 8 in detail, wrote a summary in the review column, and sent a screenshot of the summary to the family group. Her parents responded with likes.
location: Home dining room and study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing for a family photo in the afternoon
description: After her daughter woke up, Song Yajing helped her comb her hair and put on a red knit dress, while she herself changed into an off-white cashmere cardigan and jeans. She suggested going to buy fruit, and her daughter nodded excitedly. Before going out, Chen Zhiqiang suggested taking an official family photo. Using a tripod, the family of three stood in front of the Christmas tree and took several shots in a row. Song Yajing chose the happiest one and sent it to the family group and the bestie group, captioned: The simplest decorations, the warmest home. It received likes and comments.
location: Daughter's room and living room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going out to buy fruit and returning home for a rest
description: The family of three walked from home, crossed Hubin South Road, and walked along Houbin Road to Baiguoyuan (Houbin Road store). On the way, their daughter hopped and skipped while the couple chatted about their evening walk plan. In the store, Song Yajing carefully selected cherries, strawberries, and imported kiwifruit. At checkout, remembering her rehabilitation coach's reminder, she also grabbed a banana. Then they walked back home. Song Yajing washed the fruit, arranged it on a plate, and placed it on the coffee table. The daughter played with clay and paintbrushes creating a Santa Claus, while the couple rested on the sofa and chatted.
location: Pagoda (Houbin Road Branch) (10-3 Houbin Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province) and on the way home and in the living room at home

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: Song Yajing went into the kitchen early to prepare dinner: she soaked dried shiitake mushrooms, cut the tofu into pieces, and reheated the leftover steamed sea bass from last night; her husband made garlic lettuce. During dinner, the family of three sat around the table, eating sea bass, lettuce, and mushroom tofu soup. At the table, Song Yajing talked about the afternoon's dietary summary, her husband supported replacing regular oil with olive oil, and her daughter described the little snowman wearing a Santa hat that she had made out of modeling clay. There was constant laughter.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-meal cleanup and walk preparation
description: Chen Zhiqiang volunteered to wash the dishes while Song Yajing cleared the table. She prepared thermos cups filled with warm water for the whole family, took her daughter's water bottle, changed into her own sneakers, reminded her husband to bring the keys, and got ready to go out for a walk.
location: Kitchen and entryway of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: The family of three walked to the shore of Yundang Lake, strolling along the footpath beside Hubin South Road. Song Yajing shared her diet optimization plan with her husband, and he suggested buying healthy ingredients. Their daughter ran ahead in fits and starts, shouting excitedly when she saw the colorful lights on the lake.
location: Yundang Lake walkway (near the Hubin South Road section), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking home, buying tickets, and settling daughter down
description: On the walk home, Song Yajing used her phone app to buy tickets for the 8:30 showing of 'Her Story' at Wanxiang Cinema, choosing back-row corner seats. After arriving home, she and her husband bathed their daughter, read her a bedtime story, kissed her on the forehead and said goodnight. Then she changed into a light coat, grabbed her phone and keys, and quietly went out.
location: At home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and on the road to and from there.

name: Watching a movie alone
description: Song Yajing walked about 10 minutes to MixC, bought a large bucket of popcorn and a Coke, and entered Hall 2 of MixC Cinema, taking a back-row corner seat to watch the movie Good Things. It was a lighthearted domestic comedy, and the humorous plot and performances fully immersed her. She laughed until she doubled over, and in this darkness that belonged only to her, she felt immensely relaxed and stress-free.
location: MixC Cinema, No. 99 Hubin East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (back-row corner seat in Hall 2)

name: After the movie, browsing the mall, running into an old acquaintance and catching up, and the return trip
description: After the movie ended, Song Yajing strolled around MixC, admiring the Christmas decorations. At the window of a women's clothing store, she was drawn to a purple cashmere cardigan. As she hesitated, her former colleague Sun Li called out to her. The two hugged excitedly and caught up over hot drinks in the atrium coffee corner. Sun Li encouraged her to do well in community management. As it approached 11 p.m., Song Yajing put the cardigan back, exchanged goodnights with Sun Li, and agreed to meet in Shenzhen. Then she called a ride-hailing car at the MixC entrance. After getting in the car, she selected the movie ticket stub and night views of the mall on her phone and posted to Moments with the caption: 'Give yourself at least one cinema trip a month — this is a ritual that belongs only to me. Tonight's Her Story was very satisfying.' She soon received likes. Leaning against the car window watching the city night scene, she felt calm and content.
location: Inside and at the entrance of MixC, No. 99 Hubin East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; then back to the car at home.

name: Washing up and going to sleep before bed.
description: After arriving home, Song Yajing entered quietly, quickly washed up and changed into pajamas, went to her daughter's room and kissed the sleeping Xuanxuan on the forehead, then returned to the master bedroom and lay down. Recalling the fulfilling and warm day, she fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in the community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Winter Solstice morning preparations and breakfast
description: On the morning of the winter solstice, after getting up, Song Yajing first went to her daughter's room to tuck her in, then cooked black sesame glutinous rice balls as the festive breakfast. During breakfast, the family chatted while eating. Song Yajing reminded her husband Chen Zhiqiang that Mass today was at 9:30, and told her daughter that the winter solstice night was the longest, and that they would make gingerbread men in the evening. Afterwards, she helped her daughter change into a red sweater, put on her own cream-colored coat, checked the eco-friendly shopping bag and the shopping list in her phone memo, making sure all the ingredients such as cake flour and butter were noted. Everything was ready.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went to the Catholic church and attended Sunday Mass.
description: At 08:40, the family of three left home, walked 5 minutes to Exit 2 of Zhenhai Road Metro Station, took Line 1 (toward Zhenhai Road), arrived at Zhenhai Road Station after 2 stops, and walked about 5 minutes after getting out, reaching the Catholic Church at No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District at 09:05. The Mass officially began at 09:15. Father Wang Mingde shared a sermon about hoping for light, incorporating both Advent and the winter solstice. Song Yajing prayed for her mother's health, her daughter's growth, and the shop's business. After Mass, she chatted with Aunt Lin, a fellow parishioner, and was invited to a sharing event after the Christmas Eve midnight Mass, promising to bring homemade gingerbread men.
location: Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and shopping on Zhongshan Road, then home.
description: After leaving the church, the family walked to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (about 39 minutes), passing Jukou Mixed Noodle Shop, where they had lunch, ordering the signature mixed noodles, seafood soup, and blanched greens. After lunch, Song Yajing asked her husband to take their daughter to the stationery store on Gongyuan South Road to buy colored paper, while she went to the nearby Xiashang Minxing Supermarket to buy ingredients for making gingerbread men: cake flour, butter, brown sugar, ground ginger, honey, and eggs. She also added cinnamon powder on Mrs. Liu's recommendation. Afterwards, she met up with her husband and daughter on Zhongshan Road, and at about 12:50 they walked back to their home in the Shanggu Street residential community.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street and the nearby Xiashang Minxing Supermarket, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and personal matters
description: After returning home, Song Yajing coaxed her daughter to take a nap, then changed into loungewear and rested on the living room sofa. During this time, she browsed the church photos taken in the morning, replied to Moments comments, and jotted down initial ideas for the Christmas online lucky draw.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepared dinner ingredients in advance and made gingerbread man dough
description: After her daughter woke up from her nap, Song Yajing cut strawberries for her. To free up time for the evening, she prepared dinner ingredients in advance: she marinated the sea bass and washed and chopped the vegetables. At 15:00 she started making gingerbread man dough, reading the recipe aloud and having her daughter help crush the brown sugar lumps. When kneading, she found the dough too sticky, so she sprinkled more dry flour, and finally wrapped it in plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator to rest.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Husband had to handle work at the last minute
description: Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, received an urgent operations call from the company and needed to remotely handle a system failure. He went into the study and worked on his laptop.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family makes gingerbread men together.
description: After finishing work, her husband joined in. The family of three spread plastic wrap on the dining table, rolled out the dough together, and used cookie cutters to shape gingerbread men, Christmas trees, and stars. Their daughter Xuanxuan pressed too hard and made several lopsided, deformed cookies, and the whole family laughed. Then they put the cookies into an oven preheated to 180 for baking.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner
description: During the break while baking the gingerbread men, Song Yajing quickly prepared steamed sea bass, garlic spinach, and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. At 18:40, the gingerbread men came out of the oven, with slightly burnt edges but a rich aroma. The whole family sat around the table enjoying dinner, and her husband joked that the gingerbread men had a "unique artistic quality."
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: After dinner and a short rest, the family put on coats and went out for a walk. On winter solstice evening, it was already completely dark, and the streetlights by the lake and the lights from distant buildings were reflected on the water. Their daughter Xuanxuan, wearing a small red cotton-padded jacket, walked in the middle and curiously asked why there were no stars. Song Yajing explained that the winter solstice is the longest night of the year. The family walked by the lake for about half an hour, enjoying the cool yet cozy time.
location: Yundang Lake, Huguang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Recorded and shared photos of the gingerbread man.
description: After returning home from the walk, her husband took their daughter to bathe. Song Yajing, under the warm yellow light, picked the most abstractly shaped gingerbread men to photograph, carefully chose a filter, and wrote the caption “Perfect or imperfect, they are all shapes of love. Wishing everyone a healthy Winter Solstice.” Then she posted it to Moments and the family group chat. Immediately she received likes and voice-message replies from her best friend Wang Jia and her mother Lin Xiuying.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Sorting and packaging gingerbread men
description: After her daughter finished bathing, she and Song Yajing carefully packed the completely cooled gingerbread men into airtight jars, preparing for the Christmas Eve visit to the homeless care center; every jar was filled to the brim.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Song Yajing helped her daughter brush her teeth and change into pajamas, and told her the story of the little gingerbread man until she fell asleep. Then she went back to the master bedroom to take a hot shower and apply body lotion. Her husband cleaned up the remaining flour and molds in the kitchen.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bedtime reading and conversation between husband and wife
description: After getting ready, her husband returned to the bedroom and saw Song Yajing leaning against the headboard reading an essay collection. They chatted softly for a while, including the arrival of new stock at the store tomorrow and her husband's annual meeting arrangements next week.
