With everything settled, she felt at ease and content. At 23:15, Song Yajing turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully to the steady rhythm of her husband's breathing.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wash-up and preparation of the Winter Solstice breakfast.
description: The alarm went off on time. Song Yajing threw off the warm down comforter and got up. Before washing up, she did five minutes of gentle cat-cow stretches and pelvic tilts on the bedroom carpet, feeling the flexibility of her old lower-back injury and confirming that she was in good shape today. Then she went to the kitchen, sliced a few pieces of the gingerbread man cookies the whole family had baked yesterday, and paired them with hot milk and some strawberries for a simple winter solstice breakfast. Opening the fridge, she saw the leftover dough from last night and thought about teaching Xuanxuan to roll tangyuan in the evening; the corners of her mouth curled up.
location: Home bedroom and kitchen, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Shanggujie 82 community).

name: Wake up the family and have breakfast together.
description: Song Yajing woke up her sleepy-eyed husband Chen Zhiqiang and daughter Chen Lexuan. At the table, she excitedly told her daughter, “Honey, today is the Winter Solstice. Tonight we'll go home and make glutinous rice balls by hand. Mom will teach you to make ones as big as dinosaur eggs!” Xuanxuan immediately woke up, clapped her little hands and cheered. Her husband smiled and reminded her not to forget to video-call her parents in the evening. The family of three enjoyed gingerbread man cookies, milk, and strawberries in a warm atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road (No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Taking her daughter to school and heading to the store
description: Song Yajing wrapped Xuanxuan in a scarf and gloves and wheeled out the small electric bike. The morning breeze in Xiamen was cool, but the mother and daughter huddled close together. She parked the electric bike in the designated area at the entrance of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, squatted down, and kissed her daughter's cheek: "Be good, listen to the teacher. Mommy will be the first to pick you up this afternoon!" Then she walked along Gucheng West Road through the alleyways toward Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street to her clothing store. On the way, she took out her phone and checked the calendar, confirming that today was the Winter Solstice, and mentally planned the glutinous rice flour and sesame filling she needed to buy in the afternoon.
location: On the electric bicycle route from No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Siming Experimental Kindergarten at No. 123 Gucheng West Road, and on the walking route from Gucheng West Road to Shop No. 36 on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street.

name: Morning store work (inventory check, supplier communication, online orders)
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and Xiaomei pulled up the rolling shutter door together, turned on the heating, and tidied the cashier counter. The two then checked the sales ledger for the weekend (December 20-21), focusing on reviewing the sales of the co-branded lightweight jackets. Four pieces were sold in total, better than expected, so she asked Xiaomei to move this batch of clothes to the most prominent spot in the store. Afterwards, she walked over to the small sofa against the wall and made a WeChat voice call to Susan, her supplier in Guangzhou. The two discussed in detail the sampling details for the plus-size spring styles finalized last week. Susan sent four new fabric swatch cards and confirmed that the second sample garments could be ready before Friday this week. She rubbed her brow, took a sip of warm water, and felt much more at ease. Just after hanging up, a number of messages popped up in her WeChat community groups and private messages. She replied one by one to customers' questions about the release timing of new styles and handled 3 online orders. In the meantime, she noticed that regular customer Vivian had posted photos on Moments of taking her child to the park, so she casually tapped a like and commented, "The little one is having so much fun!"
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Song Yajing and Xiao Mei took turns eating. Xiao Mei went to the 85°C next door and brought her a Caesar chicken salad and a hot Americano. While eating, she browsed several fashion bloggers' winter outfit recommendations on her phone to find inspiration for the upcoming display.
location: Rest area in the back of Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Afternoon store work and display adjustments.
description: After the lunch break, Song Yajing and Xiaomei paired the newly arrived scarves with the featured cashmere cardigans, arranging a more layered winter stacking demonstration in the window. She personally adjusted the angle of the accessories on the mannequin. During this time, she received two groups of customers, patiently recommending styles based on their body shapes and skin tones, and successfully sold one co-branded coat.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Checked out early, bought Winter Solstice ingredients at the market, and went home
description: After handing the shop over to Xiaomei, Song Yajing put on her coat and walked to the Xiashang Farmers Market next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station. She went straight to the familiar dried-goods stall and bought 500 grams of water-milled glutinous rice flour and 250 grams of freshly ground black sesame filling, plus a small bag of dried osmanthus to sprinkle over the glutinous rice balls for extra fragrance when cooking. Then she walked home, put the rice flour and filling on the kitchen counter, washed her hands, opened the refrigerator to check, and confirmed that she had all the ingredients for the garlic lettuce and glutinous rice balls she planned to make that evening.
location: Xiashang (Zhenhai) Farmers' Market, 56 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and the walk back to home at 128 Hubin South Road.

name: Preparing sticky rice balls and resting the dough
description: Song Yajing put on an apron, took out a large bowl, and gradually added warm water to the glutinous rice flour, stirring with chopsticks into flaky pieces, then kneading by hand into a smooth, soft dough. She covered it with a damp cloth and let the dough rest at room temperature for 15 minutes, getting ready to shape the glutinous rice balls.
location: Home kitchen, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 82 Shanggu Street Community)

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing appeared on time at the gate of Siming Experimental Kindergarten. As soon as Xuanxuan saw her, she ran over excitedly. Song Yajing picked up her daughter in one motion, felt that her little face was icy cold, and quickly wrapped her in a scarf. She said to her daughter, "Come on, let's go home and make dinosaur eggs!" The mother and daughter returned home happily.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child tangyuan rolling, making winter solstice balls.
description: Back home, Song Yajing tied a small apron on her daughter and had Xuanxuan wash her little hands. She divided the rested dough into small pieces and showed her how to roll them into little balls. Sure enough, Xuanxuan made several oddly shaped 'dinosaur eggs' and 'hearts', and even carefully pinched little tails onto the 'dinosaur eggs'. Song Yajing patiently taught her daughter how to seal the opening and wrap in the black sesame filling. The two rolled and laughed together, the kitchen filled with the aroma of glutinous rice flour and the sound of the child's laughter.
location: Home kitchen, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 82 Shanggu Street Community)

name: Making Tangyuan and Preparing Dinner
description: After the water boiled, Song Yajing put the hand-rolled tangyuan into the pot and watched the white, plump balls tumbling in the boiling water. She asked her daughter to sprinkle dried osmanthus flowers and brown sugar on top. Meanwhile, she quickly stir-fried a plate of garlic lettuce to go with the tangyuan, so it wouldn't be too sweet and cloying.
location: Home kitchen, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 82 Shanggu Street Community)

name: Having a video call with parents in Quanzhou to 'virtually eat' tangyuan
description: On the other side of the dining table, a tablet showed her parents in faraway Quanzhou also holding bowls of steaming hot tangyuan. Xuanxuan could not wait to hold up her own little bowl and shouted at the screen, “Grandpa! Grandma! Look at my dinosaur egg!” Her mother Lin Xiuying was grinning from ear to ear, while her father Song Minghui reminded Song Yajing to keep her lower back warm: “It's colder today—don't just worry about looking nice.” Song Yajing replied with a smile, “Dad, I'm wearing really thick clothes. You and Mom don't worry!” The family shared this heartwarming winter solstice moment across the screen.
location: Dining room at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road (No. 82 Shanggu Street residential compound), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Tidying up and post-meal preparation.
description: After the video call ended, Song Yajing put the dishes into the dishwasher, wiped her daughter’s little hands and the glutinous rice flour off her face. She also changed into a hoodie and yoga pants that were easy to move in, ready to go out for a walk later.
location: Home at No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (Shanggu Street No. 82 Residential Community)

name: Family nighttime walk and stretching at Yundang Lake.
description: The temperature suddenly dropped to 9°C. Song Yajing wrapped herself and her daughter in down jackets and knit hats, and the family of three walked slowly along the Yundang Lake trail. Her husband talked about their daughter's on-camera performance and said she was becoming more assertive. Song Yajing linked her arm through her husband's and said emotionally: "Even though we can't go back to Quanzhou often, seeing Mom and Dad doing well on video calls puts my mind at ease." The lake sparkled, and the cold wind could not blow away the warmth in her heart. After the walk, in a lakeside pavilion, she held the railing and did several sets of lunges and side stretches, focusing on her waist, abdomen and hips. She felt no discomfort during the entire stretching session and was very satisfied with her recovery progress.
location: Yundang Lake walkway and the pavilion beside it, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Returned home, helped her daughter wash up and put her to bed.
description: After returning from the walk, Song Yajing gave Xuanxuan a hot bath and changed her into soft pajamas. Her husband read two storybooks to their daughter by her side. She then sat down beside her daughter's bed and gently patted her until she fell into a sweet sleep.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, No. 128 Hubin South Road (No. 82 Shanggu Street Community), Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Late-night conversation between husband and wife, foot-soaking relaxation, and bedtime reading
description: After their daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing and her husband soaked their feet in hot water in the living room and chatted about the shop's spring clothing plans and her husband's work schedule for the next week. She opened the memo app on her phone and jotted down today's "small blessings": the "dinosaur egg" tangyuan that her daughter had rolled, her parents' smiling faces, and her increasingly better waist. Afterward, she returned to the bedroom, picked up Danshari from the bedside, and flipped through a few pages to relax her tense nerves. Then she turned off the bedside lamp and got ready to sleep. Before sleeping, she confirmed tomorrow's alarm, thinking that she still needed to keep an eye on the progress of the spring clothing samples the next day.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (No. 82 Shanggu Street Community)

name: Morning washing up and preparing breakfast
description: The 7 o'clock alarm went off right on time. The day was cloudy with soft morning light. After washing up, Song Yajing went to the kitchen, took out the leftover tangyuan from the winter solstice from the fridge, and cooked them into brown sugar ginger soup to warm up. Meanwhile, she toasted whole-wheat bread and heated milk. She planned to do core training today, and with her lower back feeling good, she was in a relaxed mood.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Waking up daughter, having breakfast together, and taking her to kindergarten
description: At 7:45, she gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan, helped her tie her pigtails, and the mother and daughter enjoyed breakfast together. The tangyuan were sweet, and Xuanxuan ate happily. At 8:00, she put on a thick coat, rode an electric bicycle to take her daughter to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, and reminded her to drink plenty of warm water.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went home to change clothes and do some light stretching
description: After sending her daughter off and returning home, she changed into a sports bra and leggings, and put on a workout jacket. She drank half a glass of warm water, then did a 5-minute Cat-Cow and Child's Pose warm-up on the yoga mat in the living room. With her lumbar spine loosened up, she prepared for the core workout ahead.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking to the gym
description: Walk from home to Jiahe Fitness Center near the community, about 15 minutes. On the way, send a WeChat message on my phone to supplier Susan, asking whether the color cards for the new spring fabric have been sent, and reminding her to confirm the second sample appointment before Friday. Susan quickly replied, "Sent via SF Express this morning."
location: On the way to Jiahe Fitness Center, Jiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fifth core rehabilitation training session.
description: Song Yajing arrived at the gym on time, and the trainer led a 10-minute dynamic warm-up. Today's focus was an advanced plank—lightly touching the opposite shoulder with one hand. At first her body swayed a little, but she quickly adjusted her breathing and stabilized her core. Then they tried the farmer's carry: holding a 10 kg dumbbell in each hand, she walked several laps with her abs tensed and felt stable in her lower back. After the session, the trainer praised her core strength for improving significantly and suggested she could slightly increase the weight next week. Song Yajing noted the suggestion in her phone memo.
location: Private training area, Jiahe Fitness Center, Jiahe Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Walking to the store with a purchase on the way
description: After training ended, her body felt light, and she walked to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store. On the way she passed Yonghui Life, went in, and bought a dozen bottles of mineral water and a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea to replenish the shop's drinks.
location: On the way to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Return to the store to handle routine tasks and fine-tune the display
description: After arriving at the store, shop assistant Xiaomei had already started cleaning. She put the newly arrived Christmas-red sweater in the store's prime spot, pairing it with a Santa Claus figurine to create a festive atmosphere. She then instructed Xiaomei to organize the storeroom and pack the delisted T-shirts with a high return rate separately for disposal after the New Year. At noon, Xiaomei went to the 85°C next door and bought sandwiches and coffee, and the two had a simple lunch in the store. While eating, Song Yajing mysteriously said to Xiaomei: “Tomorrow is Christmas Eve, and the store will hold an 'Imperfect Works Exhibition' — you can help set it up too.”
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Watch the store and edit teaser copy
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers. Sitting behind the cash register, I opened my phone's memo and started editing the teaser copy for the 'Imperfect Works Exhibition'. It read: “Tomorrow, our store will hold a special exhibition. The exhibits are not perfect new clothes, but photos of 'failed' cakes, cups that came out crooked, and my daughter's discarded calligraphy practice paper... They are imperfect, but behind them are love and stories. Welcome to the exhibition tomorrow and share your 'imperfect' stories.” Then I sent the copy to the VIP customer group and Moments, along with a display photo of the Christmas-red sweater I took this morning.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Leaving the store early and purchasing materials.
description: At 3 p.m., after greeting Xiaomei, she left the store early, walked 15 minutes to the convenience store inside Zhenhai Road Metro Station, and bought a pack of light-colored cardstock, a new utility knife blade, and a small pack of band-aids. She laughed at herself, thinking that buying band-aids was really being prepared just in case.
location: Convenience Store at Zhenhai Road Metro Station, No. 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: On the way home, handling WeChat messages
description: On the walk home, she picked up her phone and saw that the teaser copy had sparked a small discussion in the VIP group. Several regular customers replied that they would come to take a look tomorrow. She was in a good mood and walked briskly.
location: On the way to the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: While selecting and organizing exhibition items at home, she accidentally cut her finger.
description: After returning home, she opened the storage cabinet and, like a treasure hunt, dug out the long-hidden 'treasures': a Polaroid photo of the 'Grand Canyon' from her first chiffon cake, a mug from her pottery class that warped in the kiln and ended up with a lopsided grin, the wobbly 'Mom' written in her daughter's handwriting practice book, and a dress she had redesigned herself but the company had sent back. She used light-colored card stock to make labels and handwrote the stories on them. While cutting the paper, she accidentally cut her left index finger with a utility knife. After rinsing it under running water and putting on a Band-Aid, she smiled at the wound and said, "Well, 'imperfection' is also one of the exhibits." Then she made a label for the mug: "Heaven made you crack open, probably because it wanted you to look like a smiling face."
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: Dinner was simple and warm. She took out the pork rib soup made the night before from the fridge, cooked noodles and greens in it, and quickly stir-fried two quick dishes: garlic lettuce and shredded pork with green peppers.
location: Home kitchen in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family dinner and exhibition announcement
description: After her husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, the family sat around the table to eat. Song Yajing officially announced, "Tomorrow is Christmas Eve, I'm holding an 'Imperfect Works Exhibition' at the store." Chen Zhiqiang smiled and praised her for being very creative, saying he would support her. Their daughter Xuanxuan curiously asked what 'imperfect' meant. Song Yajing patiently explained, "It's like the picture you drew a little crooked or the cookies Mommy burned. They may not be perfect, but they are real and interesting."
location: Dining room at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After-meal rest and changing clothes
description: After dinner, they cleared the dishes and the family of three changed into comfortable walking shoes. It was cloudy tonight, with the moon hiding behind the clouds, but the streets were brightly lit and a gentle breeze brushed their faces.
location: Home, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: The family of three arrived at Yundang Lake, its surface sparkling. Xuanxuan held her mother's hand, chattering all the way and full of imagination about tomorrow's exhibition. Song Yajing walked slowly side by side with her husband. Chen Zhiqiang suggested that the 'imperfection' story could be made into small posters and placed next to the clothing racks to add a sense of detail. The two chatted as they walked, while Xuanxuan chased falling leaves by the lake. Song Yajing felt that her waist was stable, and the walk was very relaxing.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go home, bathe daughter, tell stories, and put her to sleep
description: Back home, she gave her daughter a warm bath. After that, the mother and daughter read two books from the "Different Carmela" series in bed, and Xuanxuan fell asleep while listening. She gently turned off the bedside lamp and left the room.
location: Home bedroom in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal hygiene, daily review, and sharing with family
description: After washing up, she put on a moisturizing mask and sat at the dressing table, reviewing the whole process of today's exhibition preparation in her phone memo to make sure nothing was missed. Then she sent a voice message to her parents in Quanzhou to share interesting stories from the exhibition preparation, especially mentioning the part where she joked about hurting her finger, which made her mother send a string of “hahaha” emojis in the group chat.
location: Home bedroom in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: After the mask time was over, she washed off the essence and applied face cream. After getting into bed, she picked up the copy of 'Danshari' on the bedside table and flipped through a few pages. At 22:55, she turned off the lamp to save energy for tomorrow's Christmas Eve 'Imperfect Works Exhibition' and slowly fell asleep with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Home bedroom in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: I got up and prepared breakfast for the family
description: Song Yajing woke up to the sound of the alarm clock. She first checked the scratch on her left fingertip that had completely healed. After a simple stretch, she began preparing breakfast for the family, making bacon cheese fried egg sandwiches and hot apple cinnamon tea. She tied her daughter Chen Lexuan's hair into double ponytails and reminded her husband Chen Zhiqiang about the Christmas Eve Mass arrangements tonight, telling him not to schedule work in the afternoon.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: Song Yajing walked hand in hand with her daughter Chen Lexuan to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. Xuanxuan excitedly talked about making gingerbread men in the afternoon. At the kindergarten gate, Yajing confirmed with the head teacher, Ms. Li, that she would pick up Xuanxuan early at 4:30 PM, and thanked the teacher for taking care of her.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Go to the supermarket to restock baking ingredients and buy label paper.
description: Song Yajing walked from the kindergarten to the XiaShang Minxing Supermarket next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station and quickly bought butter, bread flour, ginger powder, brown sugar, and two tubes of colored icing pens according to the list. After paying, she stopped by the M&G Stationery Store on Gongyuan South Road, where she picked out some warm-toned cardstock and cute Christmas-themed stickers for the “Imperfect Works Exhibition,” and then returned home.
location: Xiashang Minxing Supermarket (Zhenhai Road Store), 35-101 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home to organize raw materials and make exhibition labels.
description: Song Yajing sorted the newly purchased materials into the storage cabinet, then sat in front of the living room coffee table and spread out the exhibits she had found the day before—photos of the baking fail cake, the crooked ceramic cup, and so on. Using new cardstock and stickers, she neatly wrote story labels for each exhibit, noting the date and her own reflections, with a gentle and earnest touch.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Checked the stock of the first batch of gingerbread men and communicated with the shop staff
description: Song Yajing opened the sealed jar containing the first batch of gingerbread men she had baked last night and carefully counted them, confirming there were only 15 portions. She called Xiaomei, the shop assistant, and learned that foot traffic on Zhongshan Road had increased, but Xiaomei could handle it alone for now. Yajing reminded Xiaomei to contact her via WeChat if needed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal lunch, phone call with mother.
description: Song Yajing simply reheated last night's leftover black chicken soup and rice for lunch, and while eating, sent a WeChat voice message to her mother in Quanzhou, sharing the family's Christmas Eve plans and confirming her mother was in good health. In the voice message, her mother told her to dress warmly for the evening Mass and said she would pray for them, leaving Yajing feeling warm inside.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Lunch break and free-time organizing
description: After lunch, Song Yajing took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa and felt re-energized after waking up. She neatly arranged all the ingredients needed for the afternoon baking on the kitchen counter, then repacked the first batch of gingerbread men from last night into resealable bags and put stickers bearing the word Peace on them.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner ingredients in advance and set up the display area.
description: Song Yajing took out tomatoes, eggs, greens, and frozen dumplings from the fridge and did the prep work for a simple dinner. Then she chose a corner by the window in the living room, moved over a small side cabinet, covered it with a white lace tablecloth, and set out the old items she had found yesterday and the labels she had just written, forming the early shape of a warm “Imperfect Works Exhibition”.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Song Yajing arrived on time at Siming Experimental Kindergarten to pick up Chen Lexuan. Xuanxuan excitedly asked her mother if she could start making gingerbread men. Yajing smiled and nodded, holding her little hand and chatting about fun things from kindergarten as they walked home.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Making gingerbread men with the whole family again
description: Song Yajing, Chen Zhiqiang, and Chen Lexuan were making gingerbread men together in the kitchen. Yajing was in charge of kneading the dough, Zhiqiang of rolling it out, and Xuanxuan pressed the molds firmly with Christmas tree, snowman, and bear cookie cutters. The warm aroma of ginger and brown sugar wafted from the oven again. Though the baked cookies were still lopsided, they came out an even golden brown, and the family was full of laughter and joy.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family decorating and packing gingerbread men with icing
description: After the gingerbread men cooled, the whole family sat around the dining table to decorate them. Xuanxuan carefully used a frosting pen to draw crooked smiling faces and stars on the cookies, while Yajing wrote the words love and peace on them, and Zhiqiang helped sprinkle colored sugar beads on top. Finally, the three of them packed the decorated cookies into 30 small resealable bags and tied them with red-and-green ribbon bows.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Early dinner
description: Since the evening Mass was late, the family had dinner early. Song Yajing cooked three-delicacy boiled dumplings with tomato and egg drop soup — simple and warm. During the meal, they talked about looking forward to handing out gingerbread men in the evening, and Xuanxuan said she would give the cookies to "the grandparents on the street who have no home." The atmosphere was cozy.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Free time and Mass preparation
description: After dinner, Song Yajing made final adjustments to the exhibition area. She used her phone to take a warm family photo of making gingerbread men in the afternoon, and posted a Christmas Eve warm-up update on Moments with the caption 'Imperfect gingerbread men, the most perfect Christmas Eve.' Then she found a thick wool coat and a cashmere scarf for herself, and for Xuanxuan she found her favorite red down jacket. Zhiqiang checked the foldable outdoor cart to transport the 30 bags of gingerbread men.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Set off for Siming Catholic Church.
description: The family of three dressed neatly, Zhiqiang pulled a folding cart full of gingerbread men, and they walked to Siming Catholic Church. The street was quieter than usual tonight; the streetlights stretched the family's shadows, and Xuanxuan hopped and skipped in the lead.
location: Siming Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend the Christmas Eve midnight Mass and take a group photo.
description: Mass began with solemn hymns. Father Wang Mingde, dressed in white vestments, preached on the theme “perfected in the grace of weakness,” which coincided with Song Yajing's own inner reflection on “imperfection.” She quietly tightened her grip on Zhiqiang's hand, feeling calm and moved. After Mass, fellow parishioners exchanged “Merry Christmas” greetings. Yajing specifically took a group photo at the church entrance with Aunt Lin Xiuying, Father Wang, and several members of the visitation group. Aunt Lin reminded her to dress warmly in the cold weather.
location: Siming Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Heading to the homeless care center to distribute gingerbread men
description: After Mass, the family of three walked to the church-affiliated homeless care center, pulling a handcart. At first, Xuanxuan was a little shy and hid behind her mother, but with Yajing's encouragement, she finally mustered the courage to hand a small bag of gingerbread men to an old man curled up in a corner and said in a sweet, childish voice, “Merry Christmas, here are some candies for you.” The old man took the cookies with his rough hands and thanked her repeatedly. Yajing looked at her daughter's face and felt this was more precious than any Christmas gift.
location: Homeless Care Center, 48 Bishan Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home from a late-night walk.
description: After handing out the gingerbread men, it was almost midnight. The family of three slowly walked home along the quiet Bishan Road and Zhenhai Road. Xuanxuan, half asleep, lay on her father's warm back. Yajing gently held her husband's arm, looked up at the cold clear moonlight on Christmas Eve, and felt full of steady happiness and contentment.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Washing up, bedtime gratitude, and going to sleep
description: After getting home, Song Yajing gently wiped the face and hands of the half-asleep Xuanxuan, carried her to the small bed, kissed her forehead, and whispered, “Good night, baby, Mommy loves you.” After washing up herself, she sent a Christmas Eve blessing voice message to her mother in Quanzhou, and jotted down the day’s touching moments in her phone memo. Then she turned off the light, lay down, and soon fell asleep contentedly.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Community 82 on Shanggu Street, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting up and personal preparation
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. She got up, washed up, and checked that the index finger cut by the gingerbread man the day before yesterday had healed. She weighed 48.2 kg, which remained stable. She did 10 minutes of morning stretching, focusing on relaxing her lower back to prepare for the upcoming core training.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Preparing and enjoying Christmas breakfast
description: Took out the gingerbread men portioned last night from the fridge, reheated them in the oven for 3 minutes, and the whole room was filled with the warm aroma of ginger and sugar. Paired them with hot milk and sliced strawberries, and plated them carefully. Woke up daughter Xuanxuan and husband Zhiqiang, and the family of three sat around the table enjoying a Christmas breakfast. Xuanxuan happily shouted 'Merry Christmas,' and Song Yajing reminded her to also greet her teacher and classmates at kindergarten.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Dropping daughter off at school and getting ready for fitness.
description: After breakfast, I set off with my daughter on the electric bike. On the way, I stopped briefly at Bocheng Stationery (Sixian Street store) next to Zhenhai Road Metro Station to buy my daughter a set of 12-color watercolor pens. Then I took her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten and watched her run happily into the classroom. Afterward, I rode home, quickly changed into a sports bra and leggings, checked that my water bottle was full, and put a towel and my phone into my gym bag. I sent a WeChat message to the shop assistant Xiaomei: 'Merry Christmas! I'll be at the shop in an hour. I have a special plan today~'
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Sixth core rehabilitation training session
description: After a 7-minute walk, she arrived at Jiahe Fitness Center and did weighted training under the coach's guidance. The focus was on the "farmer's walk": holding a 6 kg dumbbell in each hand, she kept her core tight and walked steadily for three laps while the coach filmed her progress. After training, she checked in on her phone calendar: 'No break on Christmas, sixth time!'
location: Jiahe Fitness Center, No. 58, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Went home, took a shower, and sorted out the exhibition items.
description: After training, walked home, took a quick shower, and changed into clean, comfortable casual shirt and jeans. Put the prepared exhibition items—a warped clay cup, photos of a burnt cake, waste paper from her daughter's handwriting practice, a long skirt ruined by a failed alteration, handwritten labels, and the remaining 5 gingerbread men—into a large canvas tote bag, preparing for the shop exhibition.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Go to the shop and set up the exhibition with Xiaomei.
description: Riding an electric bike to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. When she arrived, Xiaomei was changing the holiday displays while listening to Christmas songs. The two spread a linen cloth on the best window-side spot, neatly arranged four display items, put up handwritten labels, placed sticky note boards and colored pens nearby, and hung a hand-drawn themed poster on the wall: 'You are perfectly imperfect.'
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Exhibition opening and deep customer interaction
description: The exhibition officially opened. Song Yajing shared gingerbread men with Xiaomei and told the touching story of Christmas Eve. She contacted her regular customer Vivian via WeChat. When Vivian arrived, she was given a gingerbread man, and the two chatted about Christmas stories and the exhibition ideas. At 10:45, Xiaomei watched the store while Song Yajing and Vivian went to the Shachalin snack shop on the next street and each ordered a bowl of satay noodles for lunch. They returned at 11:25. The exhibition attracted many customers, and the message board quickly filled up. A young girl wrote, 'I keep failing at my internship, and I'm so afraid someone will find out that I don't understand anything.' Song Yajing's nose stung and she silently took a photo. A middle-aged aunt wrote, 'It turns out not everyone is perfect; I feel much better now.' During that time, a girl teared up in front of the altered dress 'One Centimeter Short.' Song Yajing gently stroked her back to comfort her, and the two added each other on WeChat.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store operations and afternoon conversations while keeping the shop.
description: During the exhibition’s quiet period, Song Yajing tended the store while handling messages in the store’s online community groups. She sent Auntie Lin Xiuying a long voice message sharing funny stories about the exhibition, and ordered lettuce and broccoli through the Pupu Supermarket app with delivery scheduled for 17:30 to the house. In the afternoon, customer traffic slowed, and she helped several customers style winter outfits while chatting with them about the original intention behind the exhibition. Xiaomei teased, “Boss, your exhibition is even more eye-catching than the clothes in the store!” Song Yajing smiled and replied, “It’s from the heart.”
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Hold a charity sale and tally the proceeds.
description: At 2:30 p.m., Song Yajing announced the start of the charity sale, with symbolic prices affixed to the bottoms of the displayed items. A regular customer bought the redesigned dress called One Centimeter Short and said: This kind of imperfection is very real. I also have a dress that was ruined by a bad alteration; I'm going to take it out and wear it when I get home. In addition, customers took the initiative to scan the code and donate. After checking with Xiaomei, Song Yajing received a total of 500 yuan. She posted an update in the community group announcing the follow-up donation.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Going to the pet store to buy cat food.
description: Song Yajing said goodbye to Xiaomei and rode her electric bike to the Pet Lovers pet supply store on Gongyuan East Road. She used 500 yuan from the charity sale proceeds to buy three large bags of cost-effective adult cat food, planning to donate them to a stray animal rescue station.
location: Aichong Yizu Pet Supplies Store, Gongyuan East Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Donate cat food to the stray animal rescue station.
description: Rode 5 minutes from the pet store to the Chenhui Stray Animal Rescue Station on Houdaixi Road, personally handed three large bags of cat food to the person in charge, and received a donation certificate stamped with the official seal. Song Yajing took a photo and immediately uploaded it to the store's community group, drawing a wave of likes and a screenful of 'the boss is so kind-hearted' comments.

participant.name: Person in charge of the rescue station
participant.relation: Person in charge of the rescue station

location: Chenhui Stray Animal Rescue Station, 35-1 Houdaixi Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pick up daughter from school and go home to prepare the meal
description: Setting off from the rescue station, she cycled to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, just in time for the 17:00 school dismissal to pick up her daughter Xuanxuan. She excitedly shared that she had received a beautiful hair clip in the gift exchange. After getting home, while her daughter watched cartoons, Song Yajing tied on an apron, put the chicken wings that had been marinated the night before into the oven, then washed vegetables and chopped garlic to prepare a stir-fry. The scheduled Pupu Fresh delivery arrived on time.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Simple family Christmas dinner.
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family of three sat together to enjoy the Christmas dinner. The roasted chicken wings were golden and fragrant, with refreshing stir-fried vegetables on the side. Song Yajing toasted with milk to celebrate Christmas and showed her family the donation certificate from the rescue station. Her daughter asked, 'The little cats have food now, right?' She smiled and nodded. Zhiqiang praised, 'The exhibition you held today is truly meaningful.'
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: After clearing the dishes, the family of three went out for a walk as usual. The winter night was slightly cool, the lake breeze gentle. Their daughter Xuanxuan, wearing a new hair clip, hummed a tune as she walked. Song Yajing held her daughter and said, "Mommy received a gift today too—it was the heartfelt words of many strangers. They told Mommy that it's okay not to be perfect." Her daughter nodded, half understanding.
location: Hubin Middle Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Yundang Lake

name: Daughter's bedtime moments
description: After the walk, she helped her daughter bathe and read her two favorite picture books from the Different Carmela series. Her daughter gradually grew sleepy, and Song Yajing gently patted her until she fell asleep.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Personal time and family connections
description: Back in the master bedroom, after washing up and doing her skincare routine, she called her mother, Lin Xiuying, on WeChat video and shared today's experience of holding the exhibition and the charity sale to help stray animals. Her mother praised her: "Your father is over there listening and nodding!" After hanging up, she opened her diary app and recorded the moments today that made her nose tingle and her heart warm, especially the girl who teared up in front of the exhibition and the young woman who wrote "afraid others would discover I don't understand."
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Reading and planning for tomorrow
description: After changing into her pajamas, she leaned against the headboard and leafed through 'Decluttering.' Remembering that she needed to deal with the spring color cards and Susan's order form tomorrow, she wrote in her memo: 'Confirm the shipping tracking number for Susan's new style, and organize the color card sample sizes.'
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: Opened the meditation app for a 10-minute guided relaxation, focused on breathing, and reflected on the strength that today's 'imperfection' brought. Afterward, did 5 minutes of simple stretching by the bed to relax the core muscles that had been trained, preparing for sleep.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Falling asleep
description: Turning off the bedside lamp, she savored the tremendous relief of being accepted today and fell into a deep sleep. She went to sleep at about 23:00, 20 minutes earlier than planned, making up for the previous night's late bedtime.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, she got up and washed up, then prepared breakfast for the family: fried eggs, warmed milk and toast. She cooked oatmeal for her daughter, cut an apple, and brewed black tea for herself and her husband. Then she woke her husband and daughter, and the family of three sat around the table eating breakfast, chatting about the day's plans. Her daughter asked about the taste of the cookies.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Helped her daughter put on a helmet and rode an electric scooter to take her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. At the gate, she crouched down to tidy her collar, kissed her cheek, told her to be good, and watched her enter the school gate before leaving.
location: No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, Siming Experimental Kindergarten

name: Handle logistics information while cycling to work
description: While riding from the kindergarten to the shop, she checked WeChat while waiting at a red light, saw Susan's message about the color card logistics, replied to confirm, and felt much more at ease.
location: Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (along the cycling route)

name: Morning store work
description: After arriving at the store, held a morning meeting with staff member Xiaomei to understand holiday customer traffic. Then took down the Christmas decorations, ironed the new spring clothing and put it on display, checked inventory and found that several sweater styles were missing sizes, and made notes to prepare to contact the supplier.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch
description: Walked to the satay noodle shop at the end of the street, ordered a bowl of satay noodles with extra toppings, and while eating replied to WeChat messages from regular customers, enjoying a brief outing for some fresh air.
location: 118-1 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province; Xiamen Shacha Noodles (Zhongshan Road Branch)

name: Afternoon store tidying and supplier communication
description: After returning to the store, she went into the warehouse, sorted the color swatch samples Su Shan had sent by color family, and pasted them into a notebook to record them. She called Su Shan to discuss restocking the sweaters with incomplete size ranges and the shipping time for spring clothing. Then she took a canvas bag from the storage locker, packed 20 sealed bags of gingerbread men, drank some water, and after a short rest got ready to leave.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Distribute gingerbread men to homeless people
description: Carrying her canvas bag, she walked to the underpass near the intersection of Datong Road and West Siming Road. She handed gingerbread men with both hands to an old man wrapped in an old quilt. The old man softly thanked her and offered his blessings. A nearby shopkeeper saw this, brought over a thermos, and poured hot water for the old man. Then she distributed gingerbread men to several other homeless people who had gathered around, wishing them good health and peace in the new year, and noted the location, planning to come again during the Spring Festival.
location: Under the bridge near the intersection of Datong Road and Siming West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (near the Love House)

name: Returning to the store to wrap up
description: Returned to the store, wiped my face with a wet wipe to refresh myself. Confirmed the weekend shift schedule with Xiaomei, picked out a few new spring styles and took photos at the store entrance, wrote a caption and posted it to Moments and the VIP customer group, reminded Xiaomei to arrive on time tomorrow, then got off work.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, Shop 36, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After getting off work, walk home and rest
description: Walked home along the old street, and on the way saw a newly opened sugar-roasted chestnut shop, so bought a small bag to try. After arriving home, her husband had already taken their daughter to a painting class, and the house was quiet. She changed into comfortable loungewear, then drank water and listened to English songs in the living room, enjoying a moment to herself.
location: Home at the 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Walking alone at Yundang Lake and reflecting
description: She put on her earphones and walked along the lakeside trail around Yundang Lake, watching the reflections of lights on the water as her thoughts wandered, thinking about the shop's transformation, the loan signing, and the meaning of sharing cookies in the afternoon. She sat down on a viewing bench, used the memo app on her phone to record key thoughts, then got up and slowly walked home, feeling relaxed in body and mind.
location: Yundang Lake and surrounding trails, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare dinner
description: In the kitchen, she cooked with the chicken breast and baby bok choy from the fridge: stir-fried chicken breast with vegetables, pan-fried tofu, and seaweed egg drop soup, preparing a simple, nutritionally balanced dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband picked up their daughter from painting class and came home. The daughter excitedly said she had drawn a little deer. The family sat around the table eating. Song Yajing shared what she had seen and heard while distributing cookies that afternoon, saying she felt very at ease. Her husband listened attentively.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: The family of three put on their jackets and went for a walk on the central square and the lake island path of Yundang Lake. The daughter hopped and stepped on fallen leaves. Song Yajing walked arm in arm with her husband and shared her thoughts about faith, saying that the moment you reach out your hand is the moment faith becomes real. Her husband gently put his arm around her shoulder. While chatting, she did chest expansion exercises, stretching her body.
location: Yundang Lake Central Plaza and the Lake Islet Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Getting daughter washed and off to bed, plus personal care
description: First ran hot water for her daughter's bath, then leaned against the bed and read 'Different Carmela' to lull her to sleep; her daughter fell asleep quickly. After that, she removed her makeup, washed her face, applied skincare products, and did 5 minutes of facial stretching to relieve the day's fatigue.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Evening tasks and going to sleep.
description: In the study, she organized color card samples, compared ideas from her phone memo, and then sent her mother a voice message sharing how the cookie distribution went. Afterwards, she leaned against the headboard scrolling through Xiaohongshu to save spring outfit inspiration, and chatted with her husband about their daughter’s painting class and New Year’s Day plans. After saying goodnight, she said a brief prayer in her heart, took a deep breath to adjust her sleeping position, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home study and bedroom, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast preparation
description: At 7:05 on Sunday morning, the alarm went off right on time. Song Yajing got up and did five minutes of simple stretching to loosen her spine and shoulders, then washed up and changed into comfortable loungewear. Afterwards, she prepared a special breakfast for her family in the kitchen, using leftover toast crusts and flour to make mini gingerbread-man-shaped toast, pan-fried until lightly golden, and served it with fried eggs and hot milk. The kitchen was filled with a warm, cozy aroma.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Song Yajing gently woke her daughter Chen Lexuan and husband Chen Zhiqiang. The family of three sat around the dining table enjoying gingerbread-man toast for breakfast. While eating, she shared the day's plan: go to church alone in the morning, take her daughter to buy a bag in the afternoon, and take a family walk in the evening. Her husband expressed support and said he would be responsible for lunch and taking care of the house in the afternoon.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Changed clothes and went to church
description: After breakfast, Song Yajing changed into a cream-colored cashmere coat and a dark long skirt, and put her phone, wallet, car keys, the Gospel, and the nut cookies prepared for parishioners into her commuter bag. At 8:40, she said goodbye to her family and walked to the bus stop on South Hubin Road, then took the bus to the First Pier. On the way, she closed her eyes and prayed, blessing her mother and close friends. After arriving at the First Pier, she took the 9:00 ferry to Gulangyu and arrived around 9:10.
location: From No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province to Gulangyu Catholic Church

name: Attend Sunday Mass.
description: Song Yajing attended Sunday Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church, standing to take part in the service as the music played. During the special prayer, she prayed quietly for her mother and her good friend Zhao Li. After Mass, she chatted with familiar parishioners, shared the nut cookies she had brought, and learned that the sharing session would be held in the meeting room.
location: Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Attend the annual visit sharing session
description: At 10:30, the sharing session began in the church meeting room. Song Yajing stood up and sincerely shared how she went from being nervous at first to learning to help patients through listening and companionship, and told the story of trimming Grandma Zhang's nails, her voice choking up at times. Her sincere and down-to-earth sharing won the applause and recognition of the church members present.

participant.name: Member of the Aide visiting group.

location: Meeting room, Gulangyu Catholic Church, No. 34 Lujiao Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Bid farewell to fellow church members and returned by ferry
description: After the sharing session, Song Yajing briefly chatted with Auntie Lin and other members and agreed on the time for the next group activity. Then she composed herself, followed the crowd out of the church, and went to the ferry terminal to catch the 11:50 boat back to Xiamen Island. During the crossing, she gazed at the sea and felt peaceful and fulfilled.
location: From Gulangyu Catholic Church to Xiamen No. 1 Pier

name: Enjoyed lunch alone
description: It was nearly noon when she returned to Siming District. Song Yajing went to her familiar Yuehua Shacha Noodle Shop near Zhongshan Road, ordered a classic bowl of shacha noodles with tofu and lean meat, and while waiting for the food, sent a WeChat message to her husband to let him know she was safe and to tell him about her afternoon plans.
location: Yuehua Satay Noodle Shop, 78 Zhenbang Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take a taxi home and plan a healthy menu.
description: After lunch, Song Yajing took a ride-hailing car and arrived home in about 12 minutes. Her husband was handling emails in the study, and her daughter was watching TV in the living room. She changed into slippers, drank a glass of water, rested on the sofa for ten minutes, then went into the study, took out her tablet, and, based on the previous diet summary, planned a healthy menu for January 2026, adding dishes such as chickpea salad and lemon-herb roasted salmon. She then placed an order for the needed ingredients on the Pupu Supermarket app.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Organize the delivered ingredients.
description: About half an hour later, the PUPU delivery rider delivered the groceries. Song Yajing checked the order one by one, portioned and froze the salmon steaks, neatly placed the olive oil and canned goods into the storage cabinet, and washed and drained the fresh produce before putting it in the fridge. Looking at the tidy fridge and the planned menu, she felt a sense of orderly satisfaction.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Go to the shop and complete the year-end stocktake
description: After changing into a pair of comfortable white shoes, Song Yajing walked to Yajing Boutique Clothing Store at 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. Upon arriving, she closed the door, sat down, and opened Excel and her account books to carefully check the 2025 income and expenses. Midway, she found that an entry error in the purchase price of goods from Guangzhou had made the net profit falsely low. She patiently checked the invoices and transfer records one by one and corrected it. In the end, she calculated that the annual revenue increased 18% year-on-year. Although it did not reach the 20% target, the co-branded products had high profit margins, net profit grew significantly, and the co-branded line contributed 22% of sales, making her more confident about future product selection.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up my daughter and head to SM City Plaza.
description: After closing the books, Song Yajing locked the shop and walked home. On the way, she sent her husband a voice message saying she was done. When she reached the neighborhood gate, her husband was already waiting with their daughter, who was wearing a pink coat. She took her daughter's hand, said goodbye to her husband, and drove with her daughter to SM City Plaza. On the way, her daughter excitedly asked if they were really going to buy a bag. She laughed and said it was bought with money she had earned through her own efforts, and asked her daughter to help pick it out.
location: From No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to SM City Plaza, No. 468 Jiahe Road, Huli District.

name: Shopping for a Coach bag
description: At the Coach counter on the second floor of SM City Plaza Phase I, Song Yajing asked the sales associate to bring out several classic tote bags and tried them on carefully, asking her daughter for her opinion. Xuanxuan liked an oak-brown bag, thinking it looked like the color of her mother's favorite chestnuts and cashmere coat. After trying it on, Song Yajing found it versatile and practical as well, so she decided to buy it. While the sales associate was wrapping it, she said softly to herself in the mirror, "You deserve it," which amused her daughter and the sales associate.
location: Coach counter, 2nd Floor, Phase 1, SM City Plaza, 468 Jiahe Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Buy craft materials and return home.
description: After paying, Song Yajing and her daughter went to the basement level to buy milk tea. She then drove to Bocheng Stationery Store at No. 57 Zhenhai Road, Siming District, which was on the way, to buy Xuanxuan some colored cardstock, creative pom-poms, and glitter glue for New Year crafts. Afterward, she drove straight home.
location: From SM City Plaza, via Bocheng Stationery, to No. 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Returning home and sharing the joy.
description: As soon as she entered the house, Song Yajing showed her husband Chen Zhiqiang, who was reading in the living room, the newly bought Coach bag and excitedly recounted the results of the account check and the significance of the new bag. Her husband smiled and said she should have bought it long ago, then took out a lightweight down jacket he had ordered with his year-end bonus and gave it to her as a surprise New Year gift. Overjoyed, Song Yajing gave him a big hug. Their daughter fiddled with the shopping bag nearby.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Song Yajing, in a cheerful mood, tied on an apron and prepared dinner in the kitchen: stir-fried asparagus with shrimp, steamed sea bass (to celebrate the smooth accounting), plus a tomato and egg drop soup. Her daughter Chen Lexuan helped wash tomatoes beside her, and the mother and daughter chatted and laughed.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner was served and the family sat together. Song Yajing turned the living room lights to a warm tone. While eating, she shared her feelings from the sharing session at the church, and her husband talked about a set of business management books he had seen at the bookstore that morning. The atmosphere at the table was harmonious, filled with family warmth and the simple pleasures of life.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: After-dinner rest and family walk
description: After dinner, Song Yajing put the dishes in the sink, and her husband volunteered to wash them. She changed into thicker coats for herself and her daughter and thanked her husband for his help. After a short rest, the family of three walked to Yundang Lake. Song Yajing felt so good that she even jogged a short distance by the lake to test that her lower back was fine. She described in detail to her husband her plan to focus on product selection and community operations after partnering with Xiaomei, and he listened carefully and offered suggestions. Their daughter swung on a swing in the small square by the lake, her laughter drifting in the wind.
location: Yundang Lake walkway, Xiamen, Fujian Province (entrance on the Hubin Middle Road side).

name: Giving her daughter a bath and putting her to sleep
description: After the walk, Song Yajing bathed her daughter in warm water, changed her into dinosaur pajamas, and then leaned against the headboard to read two picture-book stories about imperfection. As she listened, the daughter slowly fell asleep hugging the newly bought Coach bag.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Personal washing and evening planning
description: After settling her daughter in, Song Yajing carefully removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied a rose essential oil mask in the master bedroom bathroom, playing soft music to relax while the mask was on. After 15 minutes, she took off the mask and felt her skin moisturized. She then went to the study and used her phone to take photos of her new bag and down jacket, sharing them with her mother and elder sister. In her memo, she planned the next day's tasks: go to Jiahe Fitness Center in the morning for core training, organize her new-bag outfit photos in the afternoon and post them to her social community, and remind herself to call Xiaomei to discuss the handover details.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime prayer and going to sleep
description: Song Yajing returned to the master bedroom, changed into pajamas, and leaned against the headboard with her husband. She closed her eyes and prayed, giving thanks for the year's grace and the day's gains. Afterward, they chatted. Her husband reminded her not to strain herself during tomorrow's workout, and they also talked about their plan to go to the bank for the in-person signing on New Year's Day and then visit IKEA. Near 11 p.m., she said goodnight, turned off the light, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: The Shanggu Street No. 82 Community, 128 South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast.
description: In the early morning, the alarm went off. I habitually stretched and felt that my lower back was in good shape. The weather was slightly cool, so I put on a jacket to wash up, then went to the kitchen to warm milk, soak instant oatmeal, and fry soft-boiled eggs to prepare breakfast. Then I gently woke up my husband Zhiqiang and daughter Xuanxuan, who were still lying in bed, and the family of three sat around the dining table. I mysteriously told Xuanxuan that there was a secret coming from Hangzhou after school. She asked curiously, and I smiled and kept her in suspense. The breakfast atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Xuanxuan put on her little backpack. I fastened her safety helmet for her, then rode the electric scooter against the cool morning breeze and warm sun, arriving at Siming Experimental Kindergarten five minutes later. Watching her skip through the school gate, I waved goodbye and then rode on to the clothing store.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Store arrival preparations and handling spring clothing pre-sales
description: I arrived at Yajing Boutique Clothing Store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, and together with Xiaomei I pulled up the rolling shutter door, organized the cash register, checked the change, and hung the newly arrived spring sample garments in prominent positions. Then I opened the official account backend, edited an elegant image-text post, used the plus-size sample sent by Su Shan as the cover, published the spring pre-sale information, and added a line welcoming orders. An hour later, we received 5 pre-orders and excitedly high-fived each other to celebrate. At the same time, I began sorting out documents such as community management and supplier contact forms to prepare for the formal handover to Xiaomei tomorrow.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Morning store work: organizing data and replying to customers
description: Taking advantage of a lull in the store, I sat down at the computer in the storeroom, exported the December sales report, community interaction data, and expense details, and organized them into the annual review folder. I also saved the recent rehab workout check-in photos and weight curve screenshots there, to prepare for the year-end review. Then I went back to the front desk and answered customers' WeChat inquiries one by one about sizes and fabrics for the spring clothing pre-sale, and logged the reservation information from the official account into my memo, ready to contact them in the afternoon to confirm sizes and colors. Xiaomei was helping regular customers choose outfits nearby, and the atmosphere in the store was pleasant.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch and discussion about year-end bonus allocation.
description: At lunchtime, Xiaomei brought braised chicken feet her mother had made. I heated up last night's leftover rice. We ate and chatted about the store's future while I waited for news from Zhiqiang. At 12:40, Zhiqiang called to tell me that his year-end bonus, more than 20,000 yuan after tax, had arrived. I walked to a quiet spot outside the store and excitedly discussed with him: we decided to take out 5,000 yuan to increase the coverage of the family health insurance we were about to buy, prepare thoughtful gifts for both sets of parents, and put the rest into the family security fund account. After hanging up, my heart felt warm, and my plans for the future became clearer.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Gym core training
description: With fewer customers in the afternoon, I walked to the Jiahe Fitness Center next door, changed into my workout clothes, and completed my seventh core training session under the coach's guidance, including planks, glute bridges, bird-dog, etc. My waist stability has noticeably improved, and the coach praised my progress.
location: Jiahe Fitness Center, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: After exercising, return to the store and receive Zhao Min's local specialties.
description: After exercising, I returned to the shop. Xiaomei had already organized the morning reservation information into a table. I drank some water, instructed her to take charge of the shop starting tomorrow, and went over the key tasks for the next day. At 14:00, the courier delivered a package from Hangzhou; opening it, I found West Lake lotus root powder and Longjing tea sent by my college classmate Zhao Min, along with a handwritten card asking after my back recovery. My heart warmed, and I took a photo and sent it to the college classmates group to thank her, and invited her to get together in Xiamen during the Spring Festival. The lotus root powder was carefully put away, and I planned to brew it for Xuanxuan tomorrow morning.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Handle store matters in the afternoon
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers in the shop. I brewed some Longjing tea sent by Zhao Min, and while savoring the tea fragrance, I contacted each spring clothing pre-order customer by phone or WeChat one by one to confirm sizes and colors; I also replied to several customers who had asked questions in the afternoon and handled reserved orders. Xiaomei was busy matching spring new arrivals for regular customers. Everything was well organized.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Pick up daughter from school and pick up turnip cake
description: Seeing it was about time, I changed out of my work clothes, said goodbye to Xiaomei, and rode my electric scooter to the kindergarten gate on time. Xuanxuan ran out happily. I squatted down to pick her up and handed her a carton of yogurt. Then I detoured to Aunt Zhang's house in the next building, knocked on the door, picked up the turnip cake she had specially saved for me, and thanked her repeatedly.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, No. 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, and No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road

name: Prepare dinner and enjoy some family time.
description: Back home, I put on an apron and started cooking: steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and seaweed egg drop soup went onto the stove one after another, and the kitchen was steaming hot. Xuanxuan kept running over to report that she had built a castle with blocks, and the house was filled with laughter and joy. Amid the warm cooking atmosphere, I enjoyed the close interaction with my daughter.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Zhiqiang came home from work just as the dishes were served. We sat around the table together. I shared the great results of the spring clothing pre-sale, Zhiqiang talked about his plans for the year-end bonus that had arrived, and Xuanxuan proudly announced that her painting at kindergarten had been praised by the teacher. The dinner table was full of warmth and harmony, cozy and reassuring.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: The whole family took a walk at Yundang Lake.
description: After resting for half an hour after the meal, the three of us went out for a walk on the Yundang Lake trail. The deep winter night was peaceful, with streetlights reflecting on the water. Zhiqiang and I walked side by side, discussing buying a cashmere vest for his mother and a purple clay teapot for my father as New Year gifts. Xuanxuan walked ahead, singing the newly learned nursery rhyme 'Little Flower.' It was a warm scene.
location: Yundang Lake Trail, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Getting daughter washed up and putting her to sleep
description: After getting home, I gave Xuanxuan a warm bath first, then read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You. When she finished, she imitated the little rabbit in the book and said, “Mommy, I love you all the way to the moon.” I kissed her forehead, turned off the light, and gently closed the door.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal care and stretching, as well as brewing tea and chatting at home with the family.
description: After putting my daughter to sleep, I started my own time: carefully applying skincare products, using a hydrating mask, and doing a 10-minute stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom to relax my core muscles. Afterwards, I brewed some Longjing tea that Zhao Min had sent me, and curled up with Zhiqiang on the living room sofa. Amid the tea fragrance and moonlight, we talked about our little wishes for the new year and planned the details of the bank face-to-face interview on New Year's Day, enjoying the peace and tranquility of year-end.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After checking the items Xuanxuan needed to bring to kindergarten tomorrow and setting the alarm, I knelt by the bedside with my hands together and whispered a bedtime prayer, giving thanks for today's safety and gains and praying for the new year and my family. Then I turned off the light and, amid my husband's steady breathing, soon fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and hope.
location: At home, No. 82 Shanggu Street, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Morning wake-up, meal preparation, and family breakfast.
description: Woken by the alarm early in the morning, I opened the curtains to see a cloudy sky. After washing up, I went to the kitchen, sliced the turnip cake my mother had given me yesterday and pan-fried it slowly until golden, while heating milk and cutting oranges. I also brewed the Longjing tea sent by my mother's friend in advance and poured it into a travel mug. Then I woke my husband Zhiqiang and my daughter Xuanxuan, and the family of three sat around the table enjoying breakfast. During breakfast, I told my husband about the evening inventory arrangement at the shop and reminded him to pick up Xuanxuan and arrange his own dinner. I braided my daughter's hair, and the warm morning was full of the taste of home.
location: Home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Rode the electric scooter to take her daughter to school, then returned home to change clothes.
description: Helped Xuanxuan put on her jacket and helmet, then rode an e-bike to take her to Siming Experimental Kindergarten. The morning breeze was cool and refreshing, and on the way Xuanxuan happily recited a newly learned nursery rhyme. After arriving, she had a brief chat with Teacher Li on duty, then watched her daughter run happily into the classroom. After returning home, she quickly changed into a quick-drying sports bra and T-shirt, zipped up a track jacket, and packed her gym bag: water bottle, towel, training log, and brewed Longjing tea, getting ready for her workout.
location: Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China

name: Ride a shared bike to the gym and complete the final workout
description: Cycled on a shared bike from home to Gravity Women's Pilates Studio in Huli District, listening to a fashion podcast through earphones along the way. Arrived after about a 20-minute ride and began the last core training session of the year. Under the guidance of Coach Zhang, completed high-intensity moves such as crunches and planks, sweating profusely.
