After the session, the coach assessed that her core stability had improved significantly and suggested adding kettlebell swings and jogging in the next phase. In her training log, she drew a small trophy symbolizing completion, took a photo, and posted it on Moments to commemorate the last workout of 2025, looking forward to continuing in the new year.
location: Gravity Women's Pilates Fitness (Huiteng Branch), 321-107 Jiahe Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Called her mother while riding back to the store.
description: After working out, she rode a shared bike back to her shop in Siming District. On the way, she called her mother, Lin Xiuying, on WeChat voice and shared the joy of her year-end bonus being credited. She also planned to buy each parent a down vest and a massage device. Her mother urged her not to work too hard and to take care of her health, her words full of warm concern.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (final destination along the route)

name: Morning store daily affairs.
description: After arriving at the store, she first brewed herself a cup of Longjing tea. After checking the overall decor, she opened her laptop to process the spring wear pre-sale orders on the WeChat store, contacting customers one by one by phone or WeChat to confirm sizes and delivery times, avoiding disputes after the holiday. She then sorted out the basic T-shirts returned by customers in the past few days, checked them for defects, packed them separately, and got ready to contact the supplier to return them.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Had lunch with Xiaomei and discussed the inventory division of labor.
description: With few customers at noon, staff member Xiaomei brought back two portions of the signature satay noodles from the nearby time-honored Wutang Satay Noodle restaurant. As they ate, they went over the specific division of work for the afternoon inventory check: Song Yajing was responsible for printing the latest inventory list and circling slow-moving items, and Xiaomei was responsible for checking the scanner gun battery and preparing sale tags.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Tended the store in the afternoon and previewed the annual sales data.
description: In the afternoon, there were more tourists on the pedestrian street, and a few customers came into the store. Using the gaps, I logged into the WeChat Mall and the Kuaituantuan merchant backend on my phone, took screenshots and saved key data such as annual sales and return rate. This gave me a preliminary picture for the afternoon review and prepared me for deeper analysis at night.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Counting materials and organizing the store
description: Officially kicked off the inventory count material preparations with Xiaomei. Printed the latest stock list and circled in red pen the item numbers that had been slow-moving for more than six months and the areas with broken-size, orphaned items. Xiaomei checked the barcode scanner's battery and carried two large rolls of red sale tags out of the storeroom. The two also sorted and categorized the new spring clothing that hadn't yet been put on display, making thorough preparations for the full scanning that night.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Pick up my daughter from school, get the family settled in, and have dinner together
description: After handing over with Xiaomei, she rode her bike to the kindergarten to pick up Xuanxuan. On the way home, Xuanxuan happily shared that she had painted an underwater world in kindergarten. When they got home, her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already gotten off work. She handed him the ingredients from the fridge and asked him to make simple tomato and egg noodles. The family of three sat around the table eating noodles. Song Yajing told her husband and daughter again that she would be home late due to the evening inventory count, and reminded Xuanxuan to listen to her father and go to bed early. After dinner, she tidied up briefly and set off back to the store.
location: Home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Return to the store and conduct a full inventory scan and count.
description: Night fell, and they walked back to the brightly lit Zhongshan Road. When they arrived at the store, Xiaomei had already sorted the clothes into tops, bottoms, outerwear, and so on. They pulled down the rolling shutter door, hung up a "Stocktaking in Progress" sign, and began scanning and checking each item. They found several knit base tops with a system inventory of 5 but only 4 on hand, and immediately recorded them as "suspected fitting room loss"; all styles that had been slow-moving for over half a year and odd-size single pieces were moved to the sale area and marked with eye-catching red labels.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Exported the full-year data and identified key operational issues.
description: After the inventory check, I opened my laptop and exported the annual sales details from WeChat Mall and Kuaituantuan. Through the pivot chart, I could clearly see two major problems: plus-size women's clothing consultations and clicks accounted for over 15%, but purchases only accounted for 5%; the return rate for basic T-shirts was as high as 12%, with widespread complaints about fabric pilling. These findings immediately pointed out the direction for New Year adjustments.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Formulate a procurement adjustment plan for the new year and sync with suppliers
description: Based on the data conclusions, she dictated the adjustment plan on the spot, and Xiaomei recorded it in her phone memo: increase the procurement share of plus-size women's clothing to 20% for spring 2026, and strictly screen the fabric and fit of basic T-shirts, with the goal of reducing the return rate to below 5%. After taking a screenshot, she sent it to supplier Susan via WeChat, along with a voice message explaining the data logic and the tone for the new year's cooperation.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Organize and archive review documents and mark to-do items.
description: She integrated the inventory list, sales data screenshots, and procurement adjustment plan into a Word document, named it "2025 Year-End Inventory and Procurement Review," and saved it into the "2026 Restart Plan" folder. In the to-do section, she solemnly added "Contact three new fabric suppliers after the Spring Festival," patted Xiaomei on the shoulder, thanked her for the whole day's collaboration, and the two felt confident about improvements in the coming year.
location: Yajing Boutique Clothing Store, No. 36 Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Late-night walk home to unwind.
description: After saying goodbye to Xiaomei and locking the store door, I walked alone down Zhongshan Road in the dead of night. The streetlights were dim and yellow, and few passersby were around. I let out a long sigh. Though my body was exhausted, my mind was unusually clear. I felt unprecedented confidence about the direction for the coming year, and a deep sense of steadiness rose in my heart.
location: Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China (on the way home)

name: Washing up, skincare, and nighttime serenity
description: Back home, a small night light was left on in the living room. She tiptoed in to check on her sleeping daughter and tucked in the blanket, then took a comfortable hot bath, applied a hydrating mask, and did a simple facial care routine, washing away the day's fatigue.
location: Home, No. 82 Community, Shanggu Street, 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, China

name: Bedtime gratitude prayer and falling asleep peacefully.
description: Lying in the warm bed, I closed my eyes and reviewed the day with gratitude: the core training completed, the precise data analysis, and the clear new plan. Silently giving thanks to God for His guidance, I brought 2025 to a close with a sense of direction, and prayed that every plan for 2026 would go smoothly, finally falling into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian, China, No. 82 Shanggu Street Community (bedroom)

name: Getting up and personal preparation
description: The alarm rang on time at 7 a.m. She got up quietly so as not to wake her sleeping husband. After washing up quickly, she applied moisturizer in front of the mirror, changed into comfortable loungewear, gave herself a smile full of energy, and prepared to welcome the last day of 2025.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom in the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Wake up my daughter and spend the morning together
description: Gently woke up her daughter Chen Lexuan and encouraged her to take the stage today as a little dancer. She helped her put on the sparkly performance dress prepared in advance, tied two playful braids, and fastened them with pink bow hair ties. Her daughter happily looked at herself in the mirror from every angle, and her mother praised her as the brightest little star on the stage.
location: Daughter's room and living room at home in the residential community at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Simple breakfast and family updates.
description: Her husband Chen Zhiqiang had already warmed the milk, bread, and fried eggs, and the family sat around eating breakfast. While eating, she reminded her husband to bring the insurance signing document folder, and sent a voice message to her mother in Quanzhou with New Year wishes, telling her she would come home after the performance.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Setting off for the kindergarten performance
description: Chen Zhiqiang went downstairs first to get the car. Song Yajing helped her daughter put on her small water bottle and snack bag and took along their belongings. The family drove to Siming Experimental Kindergarten, about a 4–5 minute drive.
location: On the way from the residential complex at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to Siming Experimental Kindergarten (by car)

name: Watching my daughter's New Year's Day party performance
description: Arrived at the multi-function hall of Siming Experimental Kindergarten, found a seat and sat down. The daughter was taken backstage by her teacher to prepare. The performance officially started at 9 a.m. I recorded my daughter's dance "Little Star" on my phone throughout. Seeing her dance confidently as the lead, even when she was half a beat slow she immediately caught up, my heart was full of pride. The performance ended at 11 a.m. I applauded enthusiastically, rushed to the edge of the stage to hug my daughter, and praised her as the best little dancer in my heart.
location: Multifunction Hall, Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Return home from kindergarten and tidy up
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove the family home, and their daughter excitedly shared in the car how nervous she was before going on stage and the teacher's praise. After arriving home, Song Yajing carefully helped her daughter take off the performance costume and hung it in the wardrobe as a memento of her first time as lead dancer. Chen Zhiqiang went to park the car, while Song Yajing quickly tidied up the living room.
location: From Siming Experimental Kindergarten, 123 Gucheng West Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province, to home in the community at 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province (by car).

name: Family financial review and confirmation of insurance materials.
description: She took out the family ledger and electronic insurance policies and went over this year's family bills with her husband. They confirmed that 90,000 yuan had been saved as planned for the family protection fund, and that the education fund and travel fund were also largely in place, which increased their sense of security. Then she put all the materials back into the document folder and placed it on the entryway cabinet to make sure she wouldn't forget the in-person signing tomorrow morning.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Simple lunch and casual chat with family
description: Her husband heated up frozen dumplings and siu mai, Song Yajing quickly stir-fried some greens, and the family sat around having lunch. During the meal, she asked her daughter what she wanted to do in the afternoon. Her daughter wanted to draw a "New Year Tree" in the living room, and she smiled and agreed.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: After the meal, her husband accompanied their daughter to watch cartoons. Song Yajing returned to the bedroom, changed into a comfortable cotton nightgown, went to the balcony, sat on a small rattan chair, looked at the neighborhood scenery below, and let her mind drift for half an hour. Then she went back to the bedroom, set the alarm, lay down with her eyes closed, and rested for 20 minutes.
location: The master bedroom and balcony of the home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street residential complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian.

name: Annual key outcomes review for the store
description: Went into the study, opened the laptop, and looked at the annual sales data sheet Xiaomei had sent. Revenue rose 18% year-on-year, not quite reaching the 20% target, but net profit increased; co-branded items contributed 22% of sales; plus-size women's clothing had a significantly lower return rate than basic styles. In the diary, she wrote 2025.12.31, today is the first year of the store's partnership system, and noted the details of Xiaomei officially joining as a shareholder with a 12% stake, feeling free from being bound by numbers and deeply grounded.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Went out alone for a walk and did some shopping along the way.
description: She walked to Jiaxingyuan Park, took two brisk laps around the small lake, and admired the withered winter lotus, feeling calm. On the way back, she turned into the stationery store at Yubincheng Phase 2, No. 35 Gongyuan South Road, and bought a pack of animal crackers her daughter likes and a box of new colored pencils.
location: Jiaxing Garden Park, Bailu Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province; Stationery Store, Phase 2 of Yubincheng, No. 35 Park South Road, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Prepare New Year's Eve dinner
description: After returning home, her husband was already dealing with half a roast chicken in the kitchen. Song Yajing tied on an apron and prepared the broth base for Minnan braised noodles, slicing shiitake mushrooms, lean pork, and dried scallops. As they cooked, the couple chatted about their daughter's wonderful performance, and she mentioned wanting to take French dessert classes again next year, once a week as a hobby.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: A warm family New Year's Eve dinner.
description: Dinner was served: Minnan braised noodles, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and reheated roast chicken. She poured coconut juice for the whole family, and her daughter drank children's milk. During the meal, she asked her daughter what made her happiest during the performance, and she answered that it was seeing her mother watching in the audience. The couple looked at each other and smiled, feeling warm inside.
location: Home dining room at the No. 82 residential compound, Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Tidying up at home and spending time with family
description: After dinner, she quickly loaded the dishes into the dishwasher while her husband wiped the table. Then her husband accompanied their daughter in the living room to draw with the new colored pencils, while Song Yajing brewed a cup of homemade fruit tea and brought it to the study to prepare for her personal review.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home in the No. 82 Shanggu Street community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Personal physical and mental review and drawing the Tree of Life
description: At her desk, she opened her diary and recorded her personal data: weight 48.5 kg; the weight-gain plan was beginning to show results, with next year's target of 48–50 kg; breast re-examination results were stable, and she was grateful for the regular routine since the May checkup. With new colored pencils, she drew a sturdy tree of life. On its leaves and fruits she noted important matters: "first year of the partnership," "18% growth," "Xuanxuan leads the dance," "baking failure," and so on, and she added a "children's painting" fruit for her daughter's drawing competition on December 6. On the trunk she wrote the names of important family members and friends, and at the roots she wrote in bold: "Take root, grow downward, live."
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Write reflections on the church visit
description: She opened the memo app on her phone and wrote a reflection titled "Stop Asking for Love, Instead Learn to Give," recalling her experience visiting a patient on December 14. In a calm tone, she wrote about the wonderful experience that giving brought. After reviewing it, she scheduled it to be sent to the regular customer group at 8 a.m. the next morning, with the note "May we illuminate each other in imperfection in the new year," as the first gift to set the tone for the new year in the community.
location: Home study, No. 82 Shanggu Street Residential Complex, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: New Year's Eve pillow talk and balcony ritual with her husband
description: She closed the laptop. Her husband handed her a glass of warm water and asked about next year's travel plans. Song Yajing replied, 'Survive first, then live well.' The two walked to the balcony. There were already a few stray fireworks in the distance. Leaning on his shoulder, she felt the warmth in the night breeze, and with their fingers interlocked, they kept their calm amid the noise.
location: Home study and balcony, No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and prayer
description: First went to the bathroom to wash up and apply night cream, then tiptoed into her daughter's room, tucked in the quilt for her daughter who had fallen asleep hugging the new colored pens, and kissed her forehead. Returning to the master bedroom, she locked the diary in the drawer and felt an unprecedented sense of steadiness in her heart.
location: Bathroom, daughter's room, and bedroom at the home in No. 82 Shanggu Street residential community, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Lying in bed nestled beside her husband, she closed her eyes and recalled all the images of the day: her daughter's dancing, the aroma of braised noodles, the roots of the tree of life. She made the sign of the cross and prayed, thanking God for the year's protection, wishing her family a safe and smooth new year, and fell into a deep sleep in the power of gratitude and rootedness, heading toward 2026.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the home at No. 82 Shanggu Street, Siming District, Xiamen, Fujian Province
